2508.14926.tldr: This work provides a reproducible benchmark for Safe RL with explicitly ethics-aware objectives in human-mixed traffic scenarios and highlights the potential of combining formal control theory and data-driven learning to advance ethically accountable autonomy that explicitly protects those most at risk in urban traffic environments.

2508.18312.tldr: It is shown that the quality of chosen responses plays a dominant role in optimizing the DPO objective, while the quality of rejected responses may have relatively limited impact.

2509.00616.tldr: TimeCopilot is introduced, the first open-source agentic framework for forecasting that combines multiple Time Series Foundation Models with Large Language Models through a single unified API, and achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at low cost.

2509.03505.tldr: LimiX-16M and LimiX-2M are presented, two instantiations of the authors' large structured-data models that treat structured data as a joint distribution over variables and missingness, thus capable of addressing a wide range of tabular tasks through query-based conditional prediction via a single model.

2509.12386.tldr: Amulet is introduced, the first Python library for evaluating both intended and unintended interactions among ML defenses and risks, enabling the first systematic evaluation of unintended interactions across multiple risks.

2509.18116.tldr: Amortized Latent Steering (ALS) is proposed, which collapses this iterative optimization into a single offline-computed vector applied at constant cost during inference, showing that much of latent optimization's benefit can be captured offline, making sophisticated reasoning techniques viable for production deployment.

2509.18883.tldr: This work presents LongCat-Flash-Thinking, an efficient 560-billion-parameter open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning model, which exhibits exceptional efficiency in agentic reasoning, reducing average token consumption by 64.5% on AIME-25 without degrading task accuracy.

2509.21993.tldr: The results establish that training on a relational knowledge dataset induces the emergence of bilinear internal representations, which in turn support language models in behaving in a logically consistent manner after editing, suggesting that the efficacy of language model editing depends not only on the choice of algorithm but on the underlying representational geometry of the knowledge itself.

2509.23994.tldr: A regulatory machine learning framework that converts unstructured design artifacts into verifiable runtime guardrails and generates auditable rationales aligned with AI governance frameworks that enables secure-by-design deployment, continuous compliance, and scalable AI safety and AI security assurance for regulatable ML.

2510.04173.tldr: Open Agent Specification is introduced, a declarative language that defines AI agents and agentic workflows in a way that is compatible across frameworks, promoting reusability, portability and interoperability of AI agents.

2510.07871.tldr: The approach augments Falcon with collision risk understanding that learns to predict distance-based collision risk scores for surrounding humans, which enables the agent to develop more robust spatial awareness and proactive collision avoidance behaviors.

2510.15144.tldr: HugAgent (Human-Grounded Agent Benchmark) is introduced, which rethinks human reasoning simulation along three dimensions: from averaged to individualized reasoning, from behavioral mimicry to cognitive alignment, and from vignette-based to open-ended data.

2510.15418.tldr: A specialization framework that adapts MedGemma into a high-quality query generator is introduced, creating a factually-grounded query generation component critical for multimodal clinical decision support systems.

2510.16227.tldr: This work presents a theoretical analysis of the relationship between grammar, meaning, and string probability, based on simple assumptions about the generative process of corpus data, and suggests directions for future work in LM grammatical evaluation.

2510.17797.tldr: Enterprise Deep Research is presented, a multi-agent system that integrates a Master Planning Agent for adaptive query decomposition, four specialized search agents, an extensible MCP-based tool ecosystem supporting NL2SQL, file analysis, and enterprise workflows, and a Visualization Agent for data-driven insights.

2510.22115.tldr: At the trillion scale, Ling-1T establishes a new Pareto frontier of reasoning accuracy versus computational efficiency, demonstrating that sparse activation, when properly aligned with reasoning objectives, enables scalable and efficient intelligence.

2510.22780.tldr: While agents exhibit promise in their alignment to human workflows, they take an overwhelmingly programmatic approach across all work domains, even for open-ended, visually dependent tasks like design, creating a contrast with the UI-centric methods typically used by humans.

2510.22990.tldr: The Ultrasound Self-Supervised Foundation Model with Masked Autoencoding (USF-MAE), the first large-scale self-supervised MAE framework pretrained exclusively on ultrasound data, is introduced, demonstrating strong cross-anatomical generalization.

2510.25441.tldr: This work introduces Learn-to-Ask, a general, simulator-free framework for learning and deploying proactive dialogue agents directly from offline expert data, bypassing the need to model complex user dynamics.

2511.01348.tldr: A shared perspective on the future of GenAI-driven software engineering is presented, grounded in cross-sector dialogue as well as experiences and findings within the GENIUS consortium, providing a foundation for reliable, scalable, and industry-ready GenAI solutions for software engineering teams.

2511.02818.tldr: Orion-MSP is introduced, a tabular ICL architecture featuring three key innovations: multi-scale processing to capture hierarchical feature interactions; block-sparse attention combining windowed, global, and random patterns for scalable efficiency and long-range connectivity; and a Perceiver-style memory enabling safe bidirectional information flow across components.

2511.03211.tldr: The tactics and strategies of what one participant described as'retrofitting'old laws to ADM are explored; the enabling institutional arrangements without which effective litigation and accountability will falter are presented: the enabling institutional arrangements without which effective litigation and accountability will falter.

2511.03724.tldr: Solly is presented, the first AI agent to achieve elite human play in reduced-format Liar's Poker, a game characterized by extensive multi-player engagement and outperformed large language models, including those with reasoning abilities, on the same metrics.

2511.03891.tldr: This paper introduces Class-Based Image Composition, an approach that allows us to reformulate training inputs through a fusion of multiple images of the same class into combined visual composites, named Composite Input Images (CoImg), that enhances the intra-class variance and improves the valuable information density per training sample.

2511.03929.tldr: Nemotron Nano V2 VL is introduced, the latest model of the Nemotron vision-language series designed for strong real-world document understanding, long video comprehension, and reasoning tasks, and major enhancements in model architecture, datasets, and training recipes are introduced.

2511.04247.tldr: This paper evaluates a diverse set of lexical, syntactic, and semantic perturbations across multiple CLIP variants using the TRECVID Ad-Hoc Video Search queries and the V3C1 video collection to highlight robustness as a critical dimension for evaluating vision-language models beyond benchmark accuracy.

2511.04682.tldr: The Load-Balance-Longest-Path (LBLP) algorithm is introduced, that dynamically assigns all CNN nodes to the available IMCE PUs, for maximizing the processing rate and minimizing latency due to efficient resources utilization.

2511.04683.tldr: This work establishes the first validated AI-agent methodology for academic citation integrity, demonstrating practical applicability for supervisors, students, and institutional quality assurance.

2511.04685.tldr: This work presents the solution approach for the Integrated Healthcare Timetabling Competition 2024 submitted by Team Twente, which ultimately ranked third among the finalists, and investigates the different soft constraints and specific parts of the algorithm.

2511.04686.tldr: This paper examines the interplay between KV cache management strategies, the architectural context limits of models like meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8b-instruct, and the often-overlooked integrity of positional encodings, and advocates for eviction techniques that respect architectural limits, preserve positional structure, and view"cache health"holistically beyond mere size.

2511.04691.tldr: Two of the three architectural modifications introduced in the state-of-the-art EEG decoder improved performance, highlighting the promise of personalized architectures for brain-to-speech decoding and applications in brain-computer interfaces.

2511.04696.tldr: EncouRAGe is introduced, a comprehensive Python framework designed to streamline the development and evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems using Large Language Models and Embedding Models, and results show that RAG still underperforms compared to the Oracle Context, while Hybrid BM25 consistently achieves the best results across all four datasets.

2511.04697.tldr: This work develops an agent-based simulation using Large Language Models to model responses to misinformation, and shows that LLM-generated agents align closely with ground-truth labels and human predictions, supporting their use as proxies for studying information responses.

2511.04700.tldr: This work proposes WinnowRAG, a novel RAG framework designed to systematically filter out noisy documents while preserving valuable content -- a process they refer to as winnowing, and proposes two strategic merging techniques to ensure that only relevant knowledge is used for generating the final response.

2511.04703.tldr: A systematic review of 445 LLM benchmarks from leading conferences in natural language processing and machine learning finds patterns related to the measured phenomena, tasks, and scoring metrics which undermine the validity of the resulting claims.

2511.04705.tldr: A large-scale evaluation of over 10 state-of-the-art LLMs on POLIS-Bench reveals a clear performance hierarchy where reasoning models maintain superior cross-task stability and accuracy, highlighting the difficulty of compliance tasks.

2511.04707.tldr: NINJA (short for Needle-in-haystack jailbreak attack), a method that jailbreaks aligned LMs by appending benign, model-generated content to harmful user goals to reveal fundamental vulnerabilities in modern LMs.

2511.04711.tldr: This paper investigates model copyright protection by auditing whether suspicious third-party models incorporate protected soft prompts, and proposes sequential watermarking for soft prompts (SWAP), which implants watermarks into a different and more complex space.

2511.04716.tldr: This paper introduces a novel and realistic grey box threat model that exploits the explainability features of these platforms, where a model's internal knowledge state vectors are exposed to users through visualizations such as radar charts, and proposes a profile-based MIA framework that leverages both the model's final prediction probabilities and the exposed internal knowledge state vectors as features.

2511.04720.tldr: RADAR, Retrieval Augmented Diagnostic Reasoning Agents, an agentic system for rare disease detection in brain MRI is introduced, designed as a model-agnostic reasoning module that can be seamlessly integrated with diverse large language models, consistently improving their rare pathology recognition and interpretability.

2511.04727.tldr: IndicVisionBench is introduced, the first large-scale benchmark centered on the Indian subcontinent and establishes a reproducible evaluation framework that paves the way for more inclusive multimodal research.

2511.04728.tldr: This study introduces the Trustworthiness Calibration Framework (TCF), a reproducible methodology for evaluating phishing detectors across three dimensions: calibration, consistency, and robustness, and establishes a transparent and reproducible foundation for assessing model dependability in LLM-based phishing detection.

2511.04729.tldr: This work introduces a novel knowledge-based anomaly detection method for detecting network-induced shape artifacts in synthetic images that allows developers to evaluate synthetic images for known anatomic constraints and pinpoint and address specific issues to improve the overall quality of a synthetic dataset.

2511.04753.tldr: This work construct winning and losing control signals, $\mathbf{c}^{w}$ and $\mathbf{c}^{l}$, and train the model to prefer $\mathbf{c}^{w}$, which eliminates confounding factors and yields a low-variance training objective.

2511.04758.tldr: This work presents ScheduleStream, the first general-purpose framework for planning&scheduling with sampling operations with sampling operations, and proposes domain-independent algorithms that solve ScheduleStream problems without any application-specific mechanisms.

2511.04790.tldr: This work outlines a statistical and computational framework for causal structure and representation learning motivated by fundamental biomedical questions: how to effectively use observational and perturbational data to perform causal discovery on observed causal variables; how to use multi-modal views of the system to learn causal variables; and how to design optimal perturbations.

2511.04798.tldr: Manhattan Distance Mapping is a post-training DNN weight mapping technique for memristive bit-sliced compute-in-memory (CIM) crossbars that reduces parasitic resistance (PR) nonidealities and provides a lightweight, spatially informed method for scaling CIM DNN accelerators.

2511.04803.tldr: It is demonstrated that selective DQ based replay reintroducing just 5–10% of the source data effectively restores source performance, while full replay can hinder target adaptation and it is suggested that efficient training requires not only compact subsets but also retention aware learning strategies and informed domain ordering.

2511.04805.tldr: P PuzzleMoE is introduced, a training-free MoE compression method that achieves both high accuracy and efficient inference through two key innovations: first, PuzzleMoE performs sparse expert merging by identifying element-wise weight redundancy and specialization, and second, it introduces a bit-packed encoding scheme that reuses underutilized exponent bits, enabling efficient MoE inference on GPUs.

2511.04811.tldr: This work addresses bottlenecks in biomedical image segmentation by proposing a data-centric AI workflow that leverages active learning and pseudo-labeling to combine the strengths of traditional neural networks and large foundation models while minimizing human intervention.

2511.04812.tldr: The proposed Multimodal Diffusion Forcing (MDF) is a unified framework for learning from multimodal robot trajectories that extends beyond action generation and encourages the model to learn temporal and cross-modal dependencies.

2511.04814.tldr: This work presents the Expanded Standardized Collection for Antimicrobial Peptide Evaluation (ESCAPE), an experimental framework integrating over 80.000 peptides from 27 validated repositories, and proposes a transformer-based model that leverages sequence and structural information to predict multiple functional activities of peptides.

2511.04849.tldr: This study proposes using prompts, a common and basic strategy to interact with LLMs and redirect their responses using only system prompts with an appropriate and efficient prompt structure designed using advanced prompt engineering techniques, so that LLMs can be crafted without requiring a training session or access to their base design.

2511.04855.tldr: This paper introduces the epistemic reject-option predictor, which abstains in regions of high epistemic uncertainty caused by insufficient data, and is the first principled framework that enables learning predictors capable of identifying inputs for which the available training data is insufficient to support well-informed predictions.

2511.04880.tldr: Dynamic Memory Alignment is introduced, an online learning framework that systematically incorporates multi-granularity human feedback to align ranking in interactive settings that positions DMA as a principled approach to feedback-driven, real-time adaptation in RAG without sacrificing baseline capability.

2511.04886.tldr: This work introduces a novel geospatial deep learning framework that leverages satellite imagery as a comprehensive spatial input and estimates a full Beta probability distribution over fatal crash risk, yielding accurate and uncertainty-aware predictions--a critical feature for trustworthy AI in safety-critical applications.

2511.04898.tldr: AgileThinker is proposed, which simultaneously engages both reasoning paradigms for deploying language models in agents and consistently outperforms agents engaging only one reasoning paradigm as the task difficulty and time pressure rise, effectively balancing reasoning depth and response latency.

2511.04902.tldr: A simple yet effective method for label-free RL that utilizes curriculum learning to progressively introduce harder problems during training and mask no-majority rollouts during training is proposed, providing a path toward more robust unsupervised RL that can bootstrap reasoning abilities in resource-constrained models.

2511.04909.tldr: This paper constructs DGL specifically for combinatorial selection problems with natural one-of-many constraints, such as matching, knapsack, and shortest path and proves that DGL has asymptotically diminishing decision regret, analyzes runtime complexity, and shows on two problem classes that DGL matches or exceeds state-of-the-art DFL methods while using far fewer solver calls and substantially less training time.

2511.04948.tldr: A comprehensive multimodal dataset, comprising 8775 dental checkups from 4800 patients collected over eight years (2018-2025), with patients ranging from 10 to 90 years of age, is presented, providing an essential resource for future research in AI dentistry.

2511.04949.tldr: A novel deep learning framework that harnesses high-dimensional latent space representations and the Multi-Agent Adversarial Reinforcement Learning (MAARL) paradigm to develop a robust and adaptive watermarking approach that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches.

2511.04956.tldr: ORCHID is a modular agentic system for HRP classification that pairs retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with human oversight to produce policy-based outputs that can be audited and illustrates a practical path to trustworthy LLM assistance in sensitive DOE compliance workflows.

2511.04963.tldr: PDS is proposed, introducing two key innovations: a pattern-aware dual-modal 3D diffusion framework for cross-modality learning, and a tissue refinement network integrated with a efficient microstructure refinement to maintain structural fidelity and fine details.

2511.04970.tldr: This work shows that optimized shapes can act as potent semantic carriers, generating high-confidence classifications from inputs defined purely by their geometry; that they are high-fidelity interpretability tools that precisely isolate a model's salient regions; and that they constitute a new, generalizable adversarial paradigm capable of deceiving downstream visual tasks.

2511.04995.tldr: By eliminating reliance on human evaluators, this AI-driven public speaking trainer enables repeated practice, helping students naturally align their speech with body language and emotion—crucial for impactful and professional communication.

2511.04998.tldr: A Bi-Positional Embedding Transformer Encoder or BiPETE is proposed for single-disease prediction, which integrates rotary positional embeddings to encode relative visit timing and sinusoidal embeddings to preserve visit order and outperforms baseline models.

2511.05000.tldr: The experiments show that existing retrieval models struggle with the complex multi-document queries in KoBankIR, demonstrating the value of the systematic approach for domain-specific benchmark construction and underscoring the need for improved retrieval techniques in financial domains.

2511.05018.tldr: PBSUITE is presented, a dynamic evaluation suite designed to systematically assess LLMs'capacity to adhere to pluralistic alignment specifications in multi-turn, interactive conversations and highlights that existing model alignment and safety moderation methods fall short in coherently enforcing pluralistic behavioral policies in real-world LLM interactions.

2511.05025.tldr: This work introduces 8bit-GPT; a language model simulated on a legacy Macintosh Operating System, to evoke reflection on the nature of Human-AI interaction and the consequences of anthropomorphic rhetoric.

2511.05028.tldr: OvA-LP is introduced, a minimalist framework that is, to the authors' knowledge, the first explicitly designed to suppress drift at its source within the PEFT-based FFT paradigm, and provides a principled and efficient basis for robust FFT under heterogeneity.

2511.05034.tldr: Experiments conducted over cancer subtyping, cancer recognition, and mutation prediction tasks proved the effectiveness of the proposed DRE-SLCL method for end-to-end WSI representation.

2511.05039.tldr: The Parallel-EfficientNet-CBAM-LSTM (PECL) network to process data in three complementary domains: Range-Time, Doppler-Time, and Range-Doppler, achieves an accuracy of 96.16% and performs best in distinguishing between easily confused actions.

2511.05040.tldr: The obtained results reveal that even top-performing models, such as OpenAI o3 and GPT-5, solve only half of the problems, highlighting the challenge of code generation in low-resource natural language.

2511.05053.tldr: This study designs and implements custom GPU instructions optimized for HDC operations, enabling efficient processing for hybrid HDC-CNN workloads and demonstrates the potential of RISC-V GPUs for energy-efficient, high-performance computing.

2511.05055.tldr: PITTA enables highly effective TTA on a pretrained MDE network in a pose-agnostic manner without resorting to any camera pose information, and surpasses the existing state-of-the-art techniques with remarkable performance improvements in MDE during TTA.

2511.05073.tldr: This study first empirically finds that image-based adversarial examples are notably sensitive to occlusion, and proposes Sliding Window Mask-based Adversarial Example Detection (SWM-AED), which avoids catastrophic overfitting of conventional adversarial training.

2511.05131.tldr: This report connects common loss functions such as Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and various Cross-Entropy losses to the statistical principle of Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE).

2511.05150.tldr: Hireca, a biomarker-focused pathology foundation model pretrained on more than 80,000 whole-slide images spanning 38 organ types from three medical centers, together with CytoMap, an interpretability module that localizes cellular-scale evidence underlying predictions, are introduced.

2511.05229.tldr: 4D3R is presented, a pose-free dynamic neural rendering framework that decouples static and dynamic components through a two-stage approach that achieves up to 1.8dB PSNR improvement over state-of-the-art methods, particularly in challenging scenarios with large dynamic objects.

2511.05250.tldr: This paper proposes an online recognition system for skeleton sequence streaming composed from two main components: a detector and a classifier, which use a Semi-Positive Definite matrix representation and a Siamese network.

2511.05254.tldr: It is shown that both superposition and entanglement enhance the search dynamics of evolutionary quantum algorithms, establishing gate-based QGAs as a promising framework for quantum-enhanced global optimization.

2511.05263.tldr: This work introduces OregairuChar, a benchmark dataset designed for appearance frequency analysis in the anime series My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU, and serves as a valuable resource for exploring computational narrative dynamics and character-centric storytelling in stylized media.

2511.05265.tldr: Compared to advanced reinforcement learning algorithm benchmarks, the proposed framework significantly reduces the total training time required while achieving superior final performance, highlighting its notable advantage in training efficiency.

2511.05266.tldr: This paper employs a machine learning-enhanced localization framework that uses large ensembles with permeabilities generated by the diffusion model and states computed by simple ML algorithms to improve covariance estimation for the Ensemble Smoother with Multiple Data Assimilation (ESMDA).

2511.05269.tldr: This work introduces TAMAS, a benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness and safety of multi-agent LLM systems, and introduces Effective Robustness Score (ERS) to assess the tradeoff between safety and task effectiveness of these frameworks.

2511.05299.tldr: This work introduces LiveStar, a pioneering live streaming assistant that achieves always-on proactive responses through adaptive streaming decoding, and constructs an OmniStar dataset, a comprehensive dataset for training and benchmarking that encompasses 15 diverse real-world scenarios and 5 evaluation tasks for online video understanding.

2511.05311.tldr: The empirical results indicate that LLM-based agents are a promising solution for improving the quality of the datasets used in PdM systems and ultimately developing predictive maintenance models that are more reliable and useful.

2511.05320.tldr: This paper studies the feasibility of extracting descriptions of criminal behaviors in verdicts by which offenders are found guilty from publicly available court decisions from Slovakia using two different approaches for retrieval: regular expressions and large language models.

2511.05363.tldr: AI User, an interactive online curriculum that introduces core AI concepts through scenario-based activities set in real-world contexts, is developed, which informs the design of AI literacy tools that align with diverse teaching contexts and support critical engagement with AI in higher education.

2511.05375.tldr: This framework shows how AI agents can augment human planners by systematically exploring solution spaces, verifying regulatory compliance, and deliberating over trade-offs transparently -- not replacing human judgment but amplifying it with computational reasoning capabilities.

2511.05385.tldr: This work proposes TeaRAG, a Token-efficient agentic RAG framework capable of compressing both retrieval content and reasoning steps, and supporting iterative DPO to improve reasoning conciseness.

2511.05396.tldr: This work proposes the first computationally efficient algorithm that achieves sublinear regret in online RMDPs with $f$-divergence based transition uncertainties and establishes matching regret lower bounds, demonstrating that the algorithm achieves optimal dependence on both the supremal visitation ratio and the number of interaction episodes.

2511.05399.tldr: New neural audio fingerprinting techniques are developed and evaluated with the aim of improving their robustness, showing that fingerprints extracted with music foundation models (e.g., MuQ, MERT) consistently outperform models trained from scratch or pretrained on non-musical audio.

2511.05404.tldr: Experiments show that MPRF outperforms state-of-the-art retrieval methods in precision while enhancing pose estimation robustness in low-texture regions, demonstrating the potential of foundation models to unify place recognition and pose estimation.

2511.05420.tldr: This paper proposes a continual learning framework in the smart grid context to evolve the model together with the environment, and introduces Prototype-based Dark Experience Replay (ProDER), a unified replay-based approach that integrates prototype-based feature regularization, logit distillation, and a prototype-guided replay memory.

2511.05430.tldr: Findings from a study of AI User, a modular, web-based curriculum that teaches core AI concepts through interactive, no-code projects grounded in real-world scenarios, offer actionable insights for designing inclusive, experiential AI learning resources that scale across disciplines and learner backgrounds.

2511.05442.tldr: Despite the substantial computational saving that APP provides, circuits obtained from APP exhibit substantial overlap and similar performance to previously established Path Patching circuits.

2511.05475.tldr: It is argued that when training people for AI-related work, educators should consider evaluating them with instruments that emphasize highly contextualized practical skills rather than abstract technical knowledge, especially when preparing workers without technical backgrounds for AI-integrated roles.

2511.05480.tldr: A deterministic, non-asymptotic upper bound on the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the flow-matching distribution approximation is derived, which implies statistical convergence rates of Flow Matching Transformers under the Total Variation (TV) distance.

2511.05483.tldr: DGTN (Diffused Graph-Transformer Network), a novel architecture that co-learns graph neural network weights for structural priors and transformer attention through a diffusion mechanism, establishes a principled framework for integrating heterogeneous protein representations through learnable diffusion.

2511.05489.tldr: GRPO with Completeness Self-Verification (GRPO-CSV) is introduced, which gathers searched video frames from the interleaved reasoning process and utilizes the same policy model to verify the adequacy of searched frames, thereby improving the completeness of video reasoning.

2312.10440.tldr: This paper proposes a novel scheme to adapt gradient-based methods for weight-entangled spaces and reveals that this integration of weight-entanglement and gradient-based NAS brings forth the various benefits of gradient-based methods, while preserving the memory efficiency of weight-entangled spaces.

2402.11903.tldr: A novel differential logic layer-aided language modeling (DiLA) approach, where logical constraints are integrated into the forward and backward passes of a network layer, to provide another option for LLM tool learning.

2402.12727.tldr: It is shown that posterior sampling is computationally intractable: under the most basic assumption in cryptography -- that one-way functions exist -- there are instances for which every algorithm takes superpolynomial time, even though unconditional sampling is provably fast.

2402.15987.tldr: This paper investigates the presence and impact of likelihood bias in LLM-based evaluators and proposes a method to mitigate the likelihood bias, which successfully mitigates this bias, improving evaluation performance significantly and improving correlation of models with human scores significantly.

2405.20318.tldr: This paper presents Quriosity, a collection of 13.5K naturally occurring questions from three diverse sources: human-to-search-engine queries, human-to-human interactions, and human-to-LLM conversations that enables a rich understanding of human curiosity across various domains and contexts.

2406.01044.tldr: Key items discussed included emerging needs and tools for computational nuclear oncology, new frontiers in large language and generative models, defining the value proposition for the use of artificial intelligence in nuclear medicine, open science including efforts for data and model repositories, and issues of reimbursement and funding.

2406.12403.tldr: FedCoT, a federated framework designed for the Chain-of-Thought distillation of knowledge from LLMs to SLMs, ensures secure and efficient knowledge transfer while ensuring the preservation of clients'data privacy, is proposed.

2406.14135.tldr: An autonomous robotic drilling system with no offline planning, consisting of a trajectory planner with execution-time feedback with drilling completion level recognition based on image and force information is developed, addressing the challenge of drilling over a trajectory with specified depth using image and force information.

2406.16995.tldr: The results demonstrate that tcrLM not only surpasses existing TCR-antigen binding prediction methods, but also outperforms other mainstream protein language models, and effectively captures the biochemical properties and positional preference of amino acids within TCR sequences.

2407.19405.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that with the assistance of LD, S-LLMs can achieve outstanding results in continuous decision-making tasks, comparable to, or even surpassing, those of L-LLMs.

2408.13850.tldr: This work proposes a method that expands condensed datasets using model inversion, a technique for generating synthetic data based on the impressions of a pre-trained model on its training data, which demonstrates significant gains in KD accuracy compared to using condensed datasets alone and outperforms standard model inversion-based KD methods.

2409.09684.tldr: This study investigates how DFL adjusts stock return prediction models to optimize MVO decisions and shows that DFL’s gradient tilts MSE-based prediction errors by the inverse covariance matrix Σ− 1, incorporating inter-asset correlations into learning, while MSE treats each asset independently.

2410.01334.tldr: To enable skill path extracting from circuit graphs, this work proposes a three-step framework, consisting of decomposition, pruning, and post-pruning causal mediation, which offers a complete linear decomposition of the transformer model which leads to a disentangled computation graph.

2410.01739.tldr: Conceptual Belief-Informed Reinforcement Learning is introduced to emulate human intelligence (HI-RL), an efficient experience utilization paradigm that can be directly integrated into existing RL frameworks and demonstrate consistent improvements in sample efficiency and performance across both discrete and continuous control benchmarks.

2410.12538.tldr: Examining behavioral differences and adaptations of AVs and HVs at unsignalized intersections by utilizing two large-scale AV datasets from Waymo and Lyft reveals a paradox: while AVs maintain larger safety margins, their conservative behavior can lead to unexpected situations for human drivers, potentially causing unsafe conditions.

2410.15052.tldr: GlitchMiner is introduced, an behavior-driven framework designed to identify glitch tokens by maximizing predictive entropy, providing a generalizable and scalable solution for effective glitch token discovery.

2410.15483.tldr: This work theoretically prove the sub-optimality of sequential post-training and proposes a practical joint post-training framework which has theoretical convergence guarantees and empirically outperforms sequential post-training framework, with up to 23% overall performance improvement across multiple LLM evaluation benchmarks, while having minimal computational overhead.

2410.21673.tldr: Knowledge-guided Prompt learning for Public Code Review (KP-PCR) is proposed to achieve developer-based code review request quality assurance and demonstrates that the KP-PCR outperforms baselines by 2.3%-8.4% in the request necessity prediction and by 1.4%-6.9% in the tag recommendation.

2411.00078.tldr: This study establishes a benchmark for the development and deployment of cell vision foundation models tailored for real-world data applications by thoroughly evaluating the performance of recent cell foundation models on a curated multi-center, multi-disease, and multi-species external testing dataset.

2411.04372.tldr: A novel benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in mathematical reasoning and algorithmic code synthesis tasks, testing LLMs'abilities to accurately and efficiently generate Python code to compute these sequences without using lookup tables.

2411.07066.tldr: This paper proposes NeuroAl, a top-up algorithm that can be used on top of any given pruning algorithm for LLMs, which modifies the block-wise and row-wise sparsity, exploiting information from both the dense model and its sparse version to maximize the neuron alignment among activations.

2412.04845.tldr: It is suggested that ML‐based modeling should use computational units that are inherently physically‐interpretable, and how generic network architectures comprised of Mass‐Conserving‐Perceptron can be used to model dynamical systems in a physically‐interpretable manner is explored.

2412.12475.tldr: RareAgents is introduced, the first LLM-driven multi-disciplinary team decision-support tool designed specifically for the complex clinical context of rare diseases, which outperforms state-of-the-art domain-specific models, GPT-4o, and current agent frameworks in diagnosis and treatment for rare diseases.

2412.12987.tldr: This work introduces a stochastic interior-point method (SIPM) framework for general conic optimization, along with four novel SIPM variants leveraging distinct stochastic gradient estimators.

2412.14194.tldr: The comprehensive analysis shows the feasibility of monitoring the cognitive and psychological health of older adults, as well as the need for collecting largescale interview datasets of older adults to benefit from the latest advances in deep learning technologies to develop generalizable models across older adults with diverse demographic backgrounds and disease conditions.

2502.00801.tldr: The proposed EdO-LCEC offers a practical and generalizable solution that improves upon existing target-free methods, facilitating deployment in sensor fusion and mechatronic systems and enhances calibration robustness.

2502.01276.tldr: This work proposes a game-theoretic explainability framework for HPO based on Shapley values and interactions, named HyperSHAP, which provides an additive decomposition of a performance measure across hyperparameters, enabling local and global explanations of hyperparameters' contributions and their interactions.

2502.09649.tldr: ImitDiff, a diffusion-based imitation learning policy guided by fine-grained semantics within a dual-resolution workflow, is proposed, which outperforms state-of-the-art vision-language manipulation frameworks, as well as visuomotor imitation learning policies, particularly under increased scene complexity and visual distractions.

2502.12767.tldr: R2-KG is introduced, a plug-and-play, dual-agent framework that separates reasoning into two roles: an Operator that gathers evidence and a Supervisor that makes final judgments, which is cost-efficient for LLM inference while still maintaining strong reasoning accuracy.

2502.15857.tldr: The PPC-GPT framework is proposed, a novel unified framework that systematically addresses both privacy preservation and model compression in federated settings while ensuring robust privacy protection through its federated architecture.

2502.17493.tldr: This work introduces a return-weighted loss function that will drive top growth while providing the ML models a limited amount of information, and demonstrates the superiority of the novel loss function over traditional loss functions via several performance metrics and statistical evidence.

2502.19907.tldr: This work introduces an order-centric data augmentation framework based on commutativity in logical reasoning that significantly enhances LLMs'reasoning performance and adaptability to diverse logical structures.

2502.21228.tldr: ECLeKTic is presented, a multilingual closed-book QA dataset that Evaluates Cross-Lingual Knowledge Transfer in a simple, black-box manner and shows that current SOTA models struggle to effectively share knowledge across languages, even if they can predict the answer for questions in the language in which the knowledge was acquired.

2503.05029.tldr: A large-scale empirical study across four MoE transformers shows that MoE LLMs maintain their sample efficiency (relative to a FLOP-matched dense model) during CPT and that they can match the performance of a fully re-trained MoE at a fraction of the cost.

2503.21514.tldr: The results show that the Hybrid NNs engines achieve Elo ratings comparable to those of CCNNs engines, while the quantum engines underperform under current hardware constraints, suggesting that quantum communication can be incorporated with limited impact on performance, providing a foundation for future hybrid quantum applications.

2504.00299.tldr: This paper presents a model collaboration framework with two key innovations: a context-aware synthesis strategy that shifts the query topics while preserving reasoning patterns; and a tool-based answer reconstruction approach that reuses the remote-generated plug-and-play solution with code snippets.

2504.02904.tldr: Insight is provided into the fundamental mechanisms preserved and altered during post-training, facilitates downstream tasks like model steering, and could potentially benefit future research in interpretability and LLM post-training.

2504.03546.tldr: This work presents the first systematic study on medical ST, to best knowledge, by releasing MultiMed-ST, a large-scale ST dataset for the medical domain, spanning all translation directions in five languages: Vietnamese, English, German, French, and Simplified/Traditional Chinese, together with the models.

2504.06319.tldr: This paper proposes an L2 Cache-oriented asynchronous KV Cache prefetching method to break through the memory bandwidth bottleneck in LLM inference through computation-load overlap, providing a scalable latency-hiding solution for next-generation LLM inference engines.

2504.08915.tldr: This paper investigates the redundancies in the segment anything model (SAM) and proposes a novel parameter-free fine-tuning method, which introduces a channel selection algorithm based on the model's output difference to identify redundant and effective channels.

2504.09597.tldr: This work revisits the classical relationship between compression and prediction, grounded in Kolmogorov complexity and Shannon information theory, to provide deeper insights into LLM behaviors and introduces a simplified yet representative hierarchical data-generation framework called the Syntax-Knowledge model.

2504.10514.tldr: The introduction of ColorBench, an innovative benchmark meticulously crafted to assess the capabilities of VLMs in color understanding, including color perception, reasoning, and robustness, highlights the critical limitations of current VLMs and underscores the need to enhance color comprehension.

2504.16275.tldr: Across multiple small-scale object recognition tasks, the QDSFormer consistently surpasses both a standard ViT and other doubly stochastic Transformers and shows improved training stability and lower performance variation suggesting that it may mitigate the notoriously unstable training of ViTs on small-scale data.

2504.18800.tldr: A video-language model that processes full video sequences from five standard views, trained on 60,747 echocardiographic video-report pairs is developed and evaluated the gains in retrieval performance from video input and multi-view support, including the contributions of various pretrained models.

2505.01185.tldr: A lightweight, interpretable, site-calibrated pipeline that couples an environment-aware multi-wall path loss model with a forward-only, innovation-driven Kalman prefilter for RSSI is presented, providing a useful building block for future multi-gateway localization and a benchmark for indoor LoRaWAN ranging.

2505.07096.tldr: X-Sim, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that uses object motion as a dense and transferable signal for learning robot policies, is proposed, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that uses object motion as a dense and transferable signal for learning robot policies.

2505.12096.tldr: A theoretical proof is provided linking IGB to MF analyses, establishing that a network predisposition toward specific classes is intrinsically tied to the conditions for efficient learning, and leading to a counterintuitive conclusion: the initialization that optimizes trainability is systematically biased rather than neutral.

2505.12310.tldr: A novel learning-optimization-combined 4D radar odometry model, named DNOI-4DRO, which outperforms recent classical and learning-based approaches and achieves results comparable to A-LOAM with mapping optimization using LiDAR point clouds as input.

2505.13182.tldr: This work proposes universal definitions for model interpretability and ethical safety, and rigorously prove and validate four key theorems: the equivalence between model interpretability and information existence, the constructive formulation of ethical safety assurance and two types of total variation distance (TVD) upper bounds.

2505.14733.tldr: This work explores how test-time compute (TTC) can serve as an energy-efficient complement to conventional scaling strategies by allocating additional computational resources at inference time rather than during training, and reveals that TTC surpasses traditional model scaling in accuracy/energy efficiency.

2505.19291.tldr: This work proposes a novel two-stage pipeline that integrates reinforcement learning (RL) for rapid and optimized text layout generation with a diffusion-based image synthesis model that significantly accelerates the bounding box prediction step while reducing overlaps, allowing the system to run efficiently on both CPUs and GPUs.

2505.20354.tldr: A retrieval-enhanced method is proposed, which significantly outperforms fine-tuned LLMs for protein-to-text generation and shows accuracy and efficiency in training-free scenarios.

2505.24409.tldr: This work introduces Language-to-Thought (L2T) prompting, which aligns the model's internal ''thinking'' language with the source of knowledge, and consistently outperforms English-based reasoning, reversing the expected advantage of English prompts.

2505.24838.tldr: This work proposes VideoCADFormer, a state-of-the-art model for learning CAD interactions directly from video, which outperforms existing behavior cloning baselines and proposes a visual question-answering benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal large language models (LLMs) on spatial reasoning and video understanding.

2506.00708.tldr: DrKGC (Dynamic Subgraph Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Knowledge Graph Completion) employs a flexible lightweight model training strategy to learn structural embeddings and logical rules within the KG, and leverages a novel bottom-up graph retrieval method to extract a subgraph for each query guided by the learned rules.

2506.02703.tldr: A case study is presented showing how a minimal neural network architecture with data leakage outperforms many sophisticated methods reported in literature, achieving 99.9\% recall despite fundamental evaluation flaws.

2506.06344.tldr: The fairness properties of previous work are explored and a novel method is proposed that aims at obtaining both an efficient and fair duplex Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface-Reinforcement Learning system for multiple legitimate User Equipment units without reducing the level of achieved physical-layer security hardening.

2506.07315.tldr: FinAR-Bench is proposed, a solid benchmark dataset focusing on financial statement analysis, a core competence of fundamental analysis of large language models, to offer a clear understanding of LLMs current strengths and limitations in fundamental analysis and provide a more practical way to benchmark their performance in real-world financial settings.

2506.14496.tldr: This paper implements and compares classical and LLM-based versions of two well-established swarm algorithms: Boids and Ant Colony Optimization, and indicates that while LLM-powered swarms can emulate swarm-like dynamics, they are constrained by substantial computational overhead.

2506.17631.tldr: This work proposes Time-Prompt, a framework for activating large language models for time series forecasting, which constructs a unified prompt paradigm with learnable soft prompts to guide the LLM's behavior and textualized hard prompts to enhance the time series representations.

2506.22146.tldr: This paper introduces Visual Input Structure for Enhanced Reasoning (VISER), a simple, effective method that augments visual inputs with low-level spatial structures and pairs them with a textual prompt that encourages sequential, spatially-aware parsing.

2507.01693.tldr: This paper presents the Sparse One-hot Discrete Adam (SODA) algorithm, a search-based inversion method that can accurately reconstruct the input text, given white-box access to the language model and its output, and demonstrates for the first time that exact language model inversion is possible on both natural language and random inputs.

2507.08721.tldr: This work extends existing monitoring tools based on sequential testing with confidence sequences to accommodate scenarios in which the model is updated at test time and no test labels are available to estimate the performance metrics of interest, and demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed TTA monitoring framework.

2507.10639.tldr: Analysis of multiple LLM-based workflows that combine reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and a custom toolkit that enables the LLM to interact with SPICE simulations to estimate the impact of circuit modifications reveals that most parameter tuning design tasks can be solved, while limits remain for certain topology adaption tasks.

2507.13659.tldr: A pedestrian attribute-guided contrastive learning framework to enhance feature learning for person re-identification, termed TriPro-ReID is proposed, which not only effectively explores the visual features from both RGB frames and event streams, but also fully utilizes pedestrian attributes as mid-level semantic features.

2507.16795.tldr: Concept Ablation Fine-Tuning (CAFT) is introduced, a technique that leverages interpretability tools to control how LLMs generalize from fine-tuning, without needing to modify the training data or otherwise use data from the target distribution.

2507.17047.tldr: This work fine-tuned the LaViLa video captioner to produce both action and scene captions, significantly improving the efficiency of the captioning pipeline compared to using separate captioning models for the two tasks, and incorporated static scene descriptions into the captioning pipeline using LLaVA VLM.

2507.19856.tldr: RaGS is the first framework that leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting (GS) to fuse 4D radar and monocular cues for 3D object detection and achieves object-centric precision and comprehensive scene perception.

2508.00024.tldr: Using 16-qubit tensor network simulation via cuTensorNet, this work provides the first systematic evidence that quantum kernel advantage depends critically on embedding choice, revealing fundamental synergy between transformer attention and quantum feature spaces.

2508.00903.tldr: These findings suggest stable and universal representational structures emerge during language model training, and quantify neuron persistence, demonstrating high stability of universal neurons across training checkpoints, particularly in early and deeper layers.

2508.01561.tldr: GenZ-LTL is introduced, a method that enables zero-shot generalization to arbitrary LTL specifications and a novel subgoal-induced observation reduction technique that can mitigate the exponential complexity of subgoal-state combinations under realistic assumptions.

2508.02073.tldr: This study addresses construction site hazard identification by proposing a retrieval-augmented framework that enhances large language models (LLMs) without requiring fine-tuning, and significantly improves identification accuracy and contextual understanding.

2508.02240.tldr: A novel approach to better leverage Taylor-based acceleration by shifting the Taylor prediction target from the module level to the last block level, significantly reducing the number of cached features and using the error between the Taylor-estimated and actual outputs of the first block as an indicator of prediction reliability.

2508.07659.tldr: The effectiveness of the proposed method (CloudNine-v2) is validated using real-world atmospheric state and observation data from East Asia, achieving up to 15% reductions in RMSE over existing STGNN models.

2508.08424.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation of tokenizers using small-sized BERT models for Telugu, along with preliminary evaluation in Hindi and English, reveals the choice of tokenizer algorithm is the most significant factor influencing performance, with Unigram-based tokenizers consistently outperforming BPE across most settings.

2508.08501.tldr: GVGAI-LLM serves as a reproducible testbed for advancing research on language model capabilities, with a particular emphasis on agentic behavior and spatial reasoning, and its ability to generate infinite benchmarks, both manually and procedurally, provides a scalable framework for longitudinal evaluation.

2508.08875.tldr: O Oblivionis, a lightweight learning and unlearning framework that enables clients to selectively remove specific private data during federated LLM training, enhancing trustworthiness and regulatory compliance, is introduced.

2508.10747.tldr: The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed sparse, goal-aware GNN representation makes RL-based generalized planning practical in grid-based PDDL environments that were previously infeasible with dense graph representations, while also improving training stability, policy generalization, and overall success rates.

2508.12104.tldr: The results show that Curiosity, a generative medical event foundation model, can effectively capture complex clinical dynamics, providing an extensible and generalizable framework to support clinical decision-making, streamline healthcare operations, and improve patient outcomes.

2508.18258.tldr: Ano is introduced, a novel optimizer that decouples direction and magnitude: momentum is used for directional smoothing, while instantaneous gradient magnitudes determine step size, which improves robustness to gradient noise while retaining the simplicity and efficiency of first-order methods.

2508.20013.tldr: This study addresses critical industrial challenges in e-commerce product categorization, namely platform heterogeneity and the structural limitations of existing taxonomies, by developing and deploying a multimodal hierarchical classification framework that integrates textual features (RoBERTa), visual features (ViT), and joint vision-language representations (CLIP).

2508.20325.tldr: GUARD (Guideline Upholding Test through Adaptive Role-play and Jailbreak Diagnostics) is a testing method designed to operationalize guidelines into specific guideline-violating questions that assess LLM adherence, demonstrating its usage in promoting reliable LLM-based applications.

2508.21382.tldr: This paper proposes to revisit the Turing test through the concept of normality, and argues that large language models such as ChatGPT are unlikely to pass the Turing test as those models precisely target exceptional rather than normal/average human intelligence.

2508.21800.tldr: A Tree-guided Diffusion Planner (TDP), a zero-shot test-time planning framework that balances exploration and exploitation through structured trajectory generation that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on all tasks.

2509.01396.tldr: This work proposes a Multi-Agent Hierarchical Task Generation (MAHTG) system that extracts research-worthy inspirations from seminar transcripts and translates research-worthy inspirations into high-quality research tasks, ensuring the traceability of research task formulation while filtering noise.

2509.10591.tldr: The results indicate promising applications for AI in routine assessment tasks, though careful consideration must be given to student perceptions of fairness and trust in integrating AI-based grading into educational practice.

2509.13333.tldr: A clear power-law scaling is revealed: evaluation awareness increases predictably with model size, which enables forecasting deceptive behavior in future larger models and guides the design of scale-aware evaluation strategies for AI safety.

2509.18094.tldr: UniPixel is a large multi-modal model capable of flexibly comprehending visual prompt inputs and generating mask-grounded responses that enables fine-grained pixel-level reasoning in image- and video-language understanding.

2509.18667.tldr: This work proposes TERAG, a simple yet effective framework designed to build informative graphs at a significantly lower cost, and incorporates Personalized PageRank (PPR) during the retrieval phase, and achieves at least 80% of the accuracy of widely used graph-based RAG methods while consuming only 3%-11% of the output tokens.

2509.19012.tldr: This survey delves into advanced VLA methods, aiming to provide a clear taxonomy and a systematic, comprehensive review of existing research, and presents a comprehensive analysis of VLA applications across different scenarios.

2509.20835.tldr: Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed SS-ISAC framework in terms of both SAC and eavesdropping prevention performance.

2509.21275.tldr: This paper proposes a EPP that orchestrates token-level PP and batch-level PP to adapt to resource and workload heterogeneity, and a Stage-Aware Chunk-Level Adaptive Checkpointing that efficiently integrates gradient checkpointing with EPP.

2509.25884.tldr: The utility of scUnified is demonstrated through experimental analyses of representative biological tasks, providing a reproducible foundation for the standardized evaluation of computational methods on a unified dataset.

2510.08662.tldr: DPCformer, a deep learning model integrating convolutional neural networks with self-attention to capture nonlinear genotype-phenotype relationships, is established as a robust framework for genomic prediction, excelling in accuracy, small-sample performance, and polyploid data processing.

2510.09041.tldr: Intelligent General-sum Constrained Adversarial Reinforcement Learning (IGCARL), a novel robust autonomous driving approach that consists of a strategic targeted adversary and a robust driving agent, is proposed, demonstrating superior robustness to adversarial attacks and enhancing the safety and reliability of DRL-based autonomous driving.

2510.13839.tldr: This paper harnesses the recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) to develop a fully-automated method of extracting product ontologies, in the form of meronymies, from raw review texts, and demonstrates that the ontologies produced by the method surpass an existing, BERT-based baseline when evaluating using an LLM-as-a-judge.

2510.17670.tldr: This work proposes a cascaded approach that couples the broad generalization of a large pre-trained OVD model with a lightweight few-shot classifier, establishing a practical and resource-efficient framework for adapting foundation models to specific user needs.

2510.17959.tldr: For the first time, it is demonstrated that a single model can unify spectral data across resolutions and domains, suggesting that the model can serve as a powerful building block for foundation models in astronomy -- and potentially extend to other scientific domains with heterogeneous sequential data, such as climate and healthcare.

2510.18406.tldr: It is shown that tuple counts admit a trainable unbiased risk estimator (URE) by linking the tuple-generation process to latent instance marginals and introducing simple ReLU corrections to the URE that preserve asymptotic correctness.

2510.18551.tldr: SOCIA-Nabla converts brittle prompt pipelines into reproducible, constraint-aware simulator code generation that scales across domains and simulation granularities by unifying multi-agent orchestration with a loss-aligned optimization view.

2510.26512.tldr: A systematic ablation study of CORE-KG is presented to quantify the individual contributions of its two key components to offer empirical insights for designing robust LLM-based pipelines for extracting structured representations from complex legal texts.

2510.26828.tldr: This work investigates how generative adversarial networks (GANs) can be optimized for small datasets to generate realistic and diagnostically meaningful images and establishes effective training strategies and designed an optimized configuration for 256x256-resolution datasets.

2511.00051.tldr: This work identifies that DoRA's success stems from its capacity to increase the singular value entropy of the weight update matrix, which promotes a more uniform update distribution akin to full fine-tuning, and proposes a unified framework for designing advanced PEFT methods by exploring two orthogonal dimensions.

2511.00065.tldr: This work compares embeddings from two models: wav2vec2, which encodes sound into language, and CLIP, which maps words to images, and suggests that combining multimodal, layer-aware representations may bring us closer to decoding how the brain understands language, not just as sound, but as experience.

2511.00457.tldr: GraphChain is presented, a framework that enables LLMs to analyze complex graphs through dynamic sequences of specialized tools, mimicking human exploratory intelligence, enabling scalable and adaptive LLM-driven graph analysis.

2511.00521.tldr: EPIC, an Ensemble Planning with Contrastive learning framework to learn a shared representation space that captures both model reasoning abilities and query-method compatibility, and incorporates the authors' probability bounds as a regularizer in a utility-driven optimization that balances accuracy and computational cost.

2511.01450.tldr: A GT-Pair is introduced that automatically builds high-quality preference pairs by using real videos as positives and model-generated videos as negatives, eliminating the need for any external annotation, and which incorporates the SFT loss as a regularization term into the DPO loss to enhance training stability and generation fidelity.

2511.01746.tldr: A Hierarchical Scam Detection System (HSDS) that combines a lightweight multi-model voting front end with a fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1 8B Instruct back end to improve accuracy and robustness against adversarial attacks is proposed.

2511.01934.tldr: This work proposes a dynamic generalization-guided reward design for rule-based RL, which progressively shifts rewards from exploratory to exploitative tool-use patterns and introduces the Tool-Zero series models.

2511.02029.tldr: Numerical results show that the solution quality of RobustFSM substantially exceeds that of the conventional federated algorithm when attacks are severe, and the degree of this improvement depends on the dataset and attack scenarios.

2511.02193.tldr: This work proposes MMUNet, a novel architecture tailored for efficient retinal vessel segmentation, which incorporates Morph Mamba Convolution layers and Reverse Selective State Guidance modules integrate reverse guidance theory with state-space modeling to improve geometric boundary awareness and decoding efficiency.

2511.03020.tldr: A hybrid analytical framework that integrates statistical modelling and machine learning for detecting and forecasting cyberattack patterns in the e-commerce domain and uniquely combines seasonal forecasting with interpretable ensemble learning, enabling temporal risk anticipation and breach-type classification is presented.

2511.03170.tldr: This work proposes a new model, GraphCliff, which integrates short- and long-range information through a gating mechanism, and demonstrates that GraphCliff consistently improves performance on both non-cliff and cliff compounds.

2511.03732.tldr: The results showed that when debating the games using Hyperchat AI technology, the groups converged on “High Confidence” predictions that significantly outperformed Vegas betting markets, suggesting that real-time interactive deliberation is central to amplified accuracy.

2511.03773.tldr: DreamGym is introduced, the first unified framework designed to synthesize diverse experiences with scalability in mind to enable effective online RL training for autonomous agents, and yields significant additional performance gains while requiring far fewer real-world interactions, providing a scalable warm-start strategy for general-purpose RL.

2511.04053.tldr: The results show that LLMs encode real-world numerical correlations but tend to systematically amplify them, which reveals a vulnerability in LLM decision-making and lays the groundwork for fairer, representation-aware control under multi-attribute entanglement.

2511.04076.tldr: Evaluation on post-2020 U.S. Census data across all states shows that Agentmandering significantly reduces partisan bias and unfairness, while achieving 2 to 3 orders of magnitude lower variance than standard baselines.

2511.04583.tldr: This study clarifies the current role and limitations of AI Scientist systems, offering insights into the areas that still require human expertise and the risks that may emerge as these systems evolve.

2511.04698.tldr: MultiMentalRoBERTa is presented as a lightweight, robust, and deployable solution for enhancing support in mental health platforms, highlighting the effectiveness of fine-tuned transformers for reliable and interpretable detection in sensitive contexts, while also underscoring the importance of fairness, bias mitigation, and human-in-the-loop safety protocols.

2511.04875.tldr: Through controlled finetuning experiments on instruction-tuned LLMs with low-rank adapters (LoRA), it is found that self-awareness can be reliably induced using a single rank-1 LoRA adapter and that self-awareness is non-universal and domain-localized, with independent representations across tasks.

2511.05308.tldr: A novel metric, named Surface Normal Concordance (SNC), which approximates surface similarity by comparing estimated point normals, provides a more comprehensive evaluation of the quality of generated samples, and is proposed for the Diffusion Point Transformer.

2511.05350.tldr: It is shown that training autoencoders to reconstruct inputs from noised versions of their encodings, when combined with perceptually motivated losses, yields encodings that are structured according to a perceptual hierarchy, and that such perceptual hierarchies improve latent diffusion decoding in the context of estimating pitch surprisal in music and predicting EEG-brain responses to music listening.

2511.05501.tldr: This work lays out design requirements for AI evaluations that are contextualized, value-aligned, and cultivate evaluative literacy for domain end-users through an instantiation of design-based approaches for benchmark creation in the journalism domain.

2511.05502.tldr: Although Apple Silicon inference frameworks still trail NVIDIA GPU-based systems such as vLLM in absolute performance, they are rapidly maturing into viable, production-grade solutions for private, on-device LLM inference.

2511.05505.tldr: These findings validate the lightweight TV-DTF as a robust framework, revealing spatiotemporal brain dynamics and directional influences across different stress levels, highlighting the advantages of dynamic over static measures.

2511.05509.tldr: This paper introduces Randomized-MLP (RMLP) regularization, a contrastive learning-based method that encourages more semantically aligned representations and uses RMLPs when fine-tuning DINOv2 to both medical and natural image modalities.

2511.05510.tldr: A novel hierarchical autoregressive framework for modeling protein dynamics that leverages the intrinsic multi-scale organization of molecular motions and ensures that the causal dependencies inherent in protein dynamics are preserved, enabling the generation of temporally coherent and physically realistic trajectories.

2511.05511.tldr: This chapter bridges technical analysis and organizational preparedness by tracing the path from layered failure modes to reliability awareness in generative and agentic AI systems, and develops the concept of awareness mapping: a maturity-oriented framework that quantifies how well individuals and organizations recognize reliability risks across the AI stack.

2511.05516.tldr: A novel framework that unifies speech understanding, generation, and editing is introduced and the first comprehensive benchmark tailored for instruction-based free-form speech editing is introduced, featuring diverse scenarios and evaluation dimensions spanning semantic correctness, acoustic quality, and instruction alignment.

2511.05518.tldr: Confusion-Inducing Attacks (CIA) is introduced, a principled framework for extracting memorized data by systematically maximizing model uncertainty by optimizing input snippets to deliberately induce this consecutive high-entropy state.

2511.05524.tldr: EviBound is an evidence-bound execution framework that eliminates false claims through dual governance gates requiring machine-checkable evidence, and this package includes execution trajectories, MLflow run IDs for all verified tasks, and a 4-step verification protocol.

2511.05528.tldr: SMAGDi, a distillation framework that transfers the debate dynamics of a five-agent Llama-based MAS into a compact Socratic decomposer-solver student, is introduced, highlighting that explicitly modeling interaction graphs and Socratic decomposition enable small models to inherit the accuracy benefits of multi-agent debate while remaining efficient enough for real-world deployment.

2511.05536.tldr: A computational framework for modelling neurophysiological adaptation across diverse gravitational environments provides a novel approach for investigating human adaptation to spaceflight and offers a predictive tool to assess performance and resilience, supporting the design of future space exploration missions.

2511.05542.tldr: This work introduces ConnectomeBench, a multimodal benchmark evaluating large language model (LLM) capabilities in three critical proofreading tasks: segment type identification, split error correction, and merge error detection.

2511.05549.tldr: AGRAG is proposed, an advanced graph-based retrieval-augmented generation framework that can serve as explicit reasoning paths to tell LLM why certain chunks were retrieved, thereby making the LLM better focus on the query-related part contents of the chunks, reducing the impact of noise, and improving AGRAG's reasoning ability.

2511.05553.tldr: EVLP (Embodied Vision-Language Planner) is presented, an innovative multimodal unified generation framework that jointly models linguistic reasoning and visual generation that achieves multimodal planning for long-horizon tasks through a novel training pipeline incorporating dynamic pretraining and reinforced alignment.

2511.05558.tldr: This work introduces diversified flow matching (DFM), an ODE-based framework for DDM, which is the first ODE-based approach guaranteeing translation identifiability and Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the proposed method.

2511.05560.tldr: Experiments across both STRICT and STRICT-SMALL tracks show that linear attention combined with sliding win- dow attention consistently improves zero-shot performance, and the Muon optimizer stabi- lizes convergence and reduces perplexity over AdamW.

2511.05562.tldr: This work introduces Iterative Reward-Guided Refinement (IterRef), a novel test-time scaling method tailored to discrete diffusion that leverages reward- guided noising-denoising transitions to progressively refine misaligned intermediate states, and formalizes this process within a Multiple-Try Metropolis (MTM) framework.

2511.05563.tldr: This work proposes Lookahead Unmasking (LookUM), a framework that couples a path generator that proposes paths by sampling from pools of unmasking sets with a verifier that computes the uncertainty of the proposed paths and performs importance sampling to subsequently select the final paths.

2511.05565.tldr: This paper investigates how in-context learning enables state-of-the-art VLMs to perform few-shot object detection when large annotated datasets are unavailable, as is often the case with microscopic images.

2511.05566.tldr: PTRN-HAR is introduced, the first successful application of PTM-based OCL to sensor-based HAR, which significantly reduces the resource consumption required for model training while maintaining high performance, and improves data efficiency by reducing the amount of labeled data needed for effective continual learning.

2511.05567.tldr: A novel method of RoadTracer using the teacher–student-based ensemble learning model of adaptive DBN is proposed, since the road maps contain many complicated features so that a model with high representation power to detect should be required.

2511.05571.tldr: This study presents a cross-modal cross-content contrastive diffusion framework, called C3-Diff, for ST enhancement with histology images as guidance, and proposes a dynamic cross-modal imputation-based training strategy to mitigate ST data scarcity.

2511.05573.tldr: This work investigates a lightweight approach to improve T2V diffusion models using synthetic supervision and shows improvement in short-text legibility and temporal consistency with emerging structural priors for longer text.

2511.05574.tldr: This work presents the self-awareness mechanism emulation in the form of a supervising artificial neural network observing patterns in activations of another underlying ANN in a search for indications of the high uncertainty of the underlying ANN and, therefore, the trustworthiness of its predictions.

2511.05577.tldr: The authors' fine-tuned models, using LoRA, outperform unimodal and baseline approaches, demonstrating the benefits of multimodal learning and reduces the need to train separate models for different properties, lowering deployment and maintenance costs.

2511.05589.tldr: CoPRIS mitigates long-tail inefficiencies by maintaining a fixed number of concurrent rollouts, early-terminating once sufficient samples are collected, and reusing unfinished trajectories in subsequent rollouts, and introduces Cross-stage Importance Sampling Correction, which concatenates buffered log probabilities from the previous policy with those recomputed under the current policy for importance sampling correction.

2511.05595.tldr: Spatio-Temporal Flow is proposed, a physics-inspired paradigm that explicitly models dynamic node couplings through quantifiable flow transfers governed by conservation principles, and FlowNet, a novel architecture leveraging flow tokens as information carriers to simulate source-to-destination transfers via Flow Allocation Modules, ensuring state redistribution aligns with conservation laws.

2511.05597.tldr: Using the vLLM inference engine, a predictive model is developed that accurately estimates inference energy consumption across unseen architectures and hardware, and is implemented as a browser extension to raise awareness of the environmental impact of generative AI.

2511.05600.tldr: The findings suggest that MedGemma-powered classification systems can advance clinical radiograph triage by providing scalable and accurate abnormality detection, with potential for broader applications in automated medical image analysis.

2511.05609.tldr: Trajectory-Centric Distillation (TraCe), a novel text-to-3D generation framework, which reformulates the mathematically trackable framework of Schr\"odinger Bridge to explicitly construct a diffusion bridge from the current rendering to its text-conditioned, denoised target, and trains a LoRA-adapted model on this trajectory's score dynamics for robust 3D optimization.

2511.05612.tldr: An AI-driven, high-density NIRS system optimized to provide real-time, layer-specific oxygenation data from the brain cortex, specifically targeting acute neuro-emergencies, and underscores its capability to advance neuro-monitoring precision through AI, enabling timely, data-driven decisions in critical care environments.

2511.05613.tldr: First-party reporting is sparse, often superficial, and declining in areas like environmental impact and bias, while third-party evaluators provide broader, more rigorous coverage of bias, harmful content, and performance disparities.

2511.05614.tldr: An ontology for scientific benchmarking developed through a unified, community-driven effort that extends the MLCommons ecosystem to cover physics, chemistry, materials science, biology, climate science, and more is introduced.

2511.05616.tldr: This work presents the first framework for personalized image editing in diffusion models, introducing Collaborative Direct Preference Optimization (C-DPO), a novel method that aligns image edits with user-specific preferences while leveraging collaborative signals from like-minded individuals.

2511.05619.tldr: Why TSFMs often struggle to generalize and highlight spectral shift as a key factor is examined, and frequency awareness is position as critical for robust TSFM deployment and motivate new pretraining and evaluation protocols that explicitly account for spectral diversity.

2511.05622.tldr: This work proposes a model architecture that grounds action recognition in physical space by fusing two powerful, complementary representations: V-JEPA 2's contextual, predictive world dynamics and CoMotion's explicit, occlusion-tolerant human pose data.

2511.05626.tldr: This work introduces SpackIt, an end-to-end framework that combines repository analysis, retrieval of relevant examples, and iterative refinement through diagnostic feedback for reliable package synthesis, and shows that SpackIt increases installation success from 20% in a zero-shot setting to over 80% in its best configuration.

2511.05627.tldr: A complex landscape where AI models frequently generate high-quality, well-structured legal responses but also produce dangerous misinformation, including fabricated case citations, incorrect legal procedures, and potentially harmful advice is revealed.

2511.05628.tldr: This work proposes a novel analytical framework that recasts a multi-layer ReLU network into an equivalent single-layer linear model with input-dependent effective weights, and demonstrates that as training progresses, the effective weights corresponding to samples from the same class converge, while those from different classes diverge.

2511.05629.tldr: SSTODE, a physics-informed Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Neural ODEs) framework for SST prediction, derives ODEs from fluid transport principles, incorporating both advection and diffusion to model ocean spatiotemporal dynamics, and introduces an Energy Exchanges Integrator-inspired by ocean heat budget equations-to account for external forcing factors.

2511.05630.tldr: BrainCSD is proposed, a hierarchical mixture-of-experts (MoE) foundation model that jointly synthesizes FC/SC biomarkers and supports downstream decoding tasks (diagnosis and prediction) and achieves SOTA results: 95.6\% accuracy for MCI vs. CN classification without FC, low synthesis error, and low synthesis error.
