2511.09049.tldr: This paper breaks the intrinsic relationship tie of attribute categories and learns customized distance metrics suitable for flexibly and accurately revealing various cluster distributions, and the fitting ability of the clustering algorithm is significantly enhanced, benefiting from the learnable category relationships.

2511.09067.tldr: This work introduces MM-CRITIC, a holistic benchmark for evaluating the critique ability of LMMs across multiple dimensions: basic, correction, and comparison, and integrates expert-informed ground answers into scoring rubrics that guide GPT-4o in annotating responses and generating reference critiques, which serve as anchors for trustworthy judgments.

2511.09088.tldr: SAE is proposed to enhance the robustness of AE semantics against domain drift by making them more similar to the target class while distinguishing them from all other classes, and a Filtering-and-Augmentation Module is proposed, which first identifies non-target examples with target-class semantics in the latent space and then augments them to foster more stable semantics.

2511.09090.tldr: The proposed Diff-V2M framework is a general V2M framework based on a hierarchical conditional diffusion model, comprising two core components: visual feature extraction and conditional music generation, and introduces timestep-aware fusion strategies, including feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) and weighted fusion.

2511.09092.tldr: Extensive evaluations across diverse real-world benchmarks demonstrate that OR-R1 provides a robust, scalable, and cost-effective solution for automated OR optimization problem modeling and solving, lowering the expertise and data barriers for industrial OR applications.

2511.09093.tldr: This work proposes to learn a reordering network by minimizing \(l_1\) norm of triangular factors of the reordered matrix to approximate the exact number of fill-ins in a sparse matrix.

2511.09105.tldr: This work investigates the minimum-cost poisoning attack required to steer an LLM's policy toward an attacker's target by flipping preference labels during RLHF/DPO, without altering the compared outputs, and proposes a cost-minimization post-processing method to reduce the number of label flips required while preserving the intended poisoning effect.

2511.09120.tldr: This paper introduces an integrated approach that combines MCDM outranking methods with Differential Privacy (DP), safeguarding individual contributions'privacy in ranking problems, and relies on a pre-processing step to aggregate multiple user evaluations into a comprehensive performance matrix.

2511.09127.tldr: A native end-to-end model is developed, HAR-GUI-3B, which alters the inherent reasoning mode from history-agnostic to history-aware, equipping the GUI agent with stable short-term memory and reliable perception of screen details.

2511.09157.tldr: ProBench is introduced, a comprehensive mobile benchmark with over 200 challenging GUI tasks covering widely-used scenarios and a newly introduced Process Provider automatically supplies accurate process information, enabling presice assessment of agent's performance.

2511.09158.tldr: A pipeline for training a Conciseness Reward Model (CRM) that scores the conciseness of reasoning path is proposed and a novel reward formulation named Conciseness Reward Function (CRF) with explicit dependency between the outcome reward and conciseness score is introduced, thereby fostering both more effective and more efficient reasoning.

2511.09178.tldr: This work derives the main reliability challenges of agentic AI systems during operation based on their characteristics and proposes a two-layered reliability monitoring framework for agentic AI systems which consists of a out-of-distribution detection layer for novel inputs and AI transparency layer to reveal internal operations.

2511.09179.tldr: This paper proposes a cell extraction method for TQA without manual identification, even for complex table headers by computing similarities between a given question and individual cells via a hybrid retrieval mechanism that integrates a language model and TF-IDF.

2511.09221.tldr: Results indicate that compact AE architectures can effectively learn structured, algebraically optimal binary codes through stable and straightforwardTraining, and enforce binary codewords within differentiable AE architectures remains difficult.

2511.09247.tldr: Experiments on three real-world datasets show that MedFuse consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on key predictive tasks, establishing MedFuse as a generalizable approach for modeling irregular clinical time series.

2511.09252.tldr: This study presents a low-exposure, high-efficiency paradigm for federated backdoor attacks and expands the application of fractal features in adversarial sample generation by introducing a dynamic angular perturbation mechanism that adaptively adjusts perturbation intensity across the training phases to balance efficiency and stealthiness.

2511.09294.tldr: GuardFed is proposed, a self-adaptive defense framework that maintains a fairness-aware reference model that maintains a fairness-aware reference model using a small amount of clean server data augmented with synthetic samples, achieving state-of-the-art performance compared with existing robust FL methods.

2511.09309.tldr: This work proposes Cognitive Chain, a novel framework that models task difficulty from a cognitive perspective, and develops an LLM-based method to automatically extract cognitive chains from task execution traces, discussing potential applications in agent training, capability assessment, and human-agent delegation optimization.

2511.09325.tldr: It is argued for developing dedicated qualitative AI systems built from the ground up for interpretive research, which must be transparent, reproducible, and privacy-friendly.

2511.09363.tldr: An LLM-based agentic framework for barrier certificate synthesis that uses natural language reasoning to propose, refine, and validate candidate certificates, integrating LLM-driven template discovery with SMT-based verification, and supporting barrier-controller co-synthesis to ensure consistency between safety certificates and controllers is introduced.

2511.09374.tldr: MTQ-Eval is introduced, a novel framework for multilingual text quality evaluation that learns from examples of both high- and low-quality texts, adjusting its internal representations, and leads to notable improvements in downstream tasks.

2511.09378.tldr: A longitudinal comparison across model generations -- from GPT-3.5, which solves zero tasks, to GPT-5 -- reveals a striking upward trajectory, suggesting that Frontier LLMs might finally be able to plan; the question now is how far this capability will extend.

2511.09381.tldr: Comparing performance trends and error-correction behaviors across various natural language understanding and reasoning tasks, covering language models of different scales and families, highlights that the design of self-correction mechanisms should take into account the interaction between task structure and output space.

2511.09404.tldr: CallosumNet is proposed, a divide-and-conquer spatio-temporal graph unlearning framework inspired by the corpus callosum structure that facilitates communication between the brain's two hemispheres that achieves complete unlearning with only 1%-2% relative MAE loss compared to the gold model, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.

2511.09433.tldr: A novel method based on latent flow matching with classifier-free guidance that disentangles latent subspaces by explicitly separating information included in conditioning from information that remains in the residual representation is introduced.

2511.09438.tldr: A convergence argument for the variational aggregation procedure is outlined, a differential privacy threat model based on a moments accountant is described, and applications to knowledge graph completion, recommendation-style link prediction, and citation and product graphs are presented.

2511.09443.tldr: This work establishes a generalizable foundation for bronchoscopy navigation through a robust vision-based framework and a new synthetic benchmark dataset that enables standardized and reproducible evaluation, and introduces the first public synthetic benchmark dataset for bronchoscopy navigation, addressing the lack of paired CT-endoscopy data.

2511.09450.tldr: This study assesses the performance of statistical, machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL) models in forecasting traffic speed and flow using real-world data from California's Harbor Freeway, sourced from the Caltrans Performance Measurement System (PeMS).

2511.09454.tldr: It is demonstrated that algorithmic advice can function as a strategic signal, shaping coordination even without explicit communication, and underscore the need for careful design and oversight of algorithmic decision-support systems in competitive environments.

2511.09478.tldr: AdaCuRL is proposed, a Adaptive Curriculum Reinforcement Learning framework that integrates coarse-to-fine difficulty estimation with adaptive curriculum scheduling and incorporates a data revisitation mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.

2511.09493.tldr: A complementary, architecture-agnostic approach that enhances safety through the aggregation of multiple generative models, with the aggregated model inheriting its safety from the safest subset of a given size among them.

2511.09497.tldr: The aim is to create a theoretical foundation that describes the physical embodiment, sensory perception, ability to act, learning processes, and context sensitivity of intelligent systems within a coherent framework, and form the conceptual basis for designing and evaluating physically intelligent systems.

2511.09502.tldr: This work introduces DreamPose3D, a diffusion-based framework that combines action-aware reasoning with temporal imagination for 3D pose estimation and introduces a representation encoder that incorporates kinematic joint affinity into the attention mechanism.

2511.09515.tldr: World-Model-based Policy Optimization (WMPO) is introduced, a principled framework for on-policy VLA RL without interacting with the real environment that enables the policy to perform on-policy GRPO that provides stronger performance than the often-used off-policy methods.

2511.09533.tldr: This paper investigates how individual entrepreneurs can turn creative ideas into successful solo businesses in an era increasingly shaped by Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents, and presents a framework with three key stages, focusing on the specific context of solopreneurship.

2511.09535.tldr: RPO is introduced, a formalism for adversarial optimization that avoids self-sabotage by ensuring agents remain rational--that is, their policies are optimal with respect to some possible partner policy, and achieves strong performance in several popular cooperative and general-sum environments.

2511.09549.tldr: This work theoretically and empirically compare two popular methods for escaping UHRs in breadth-first search (BrFS) and restarting random walks (RRWs) and derives the expected runtime of escaping a UHR using BrFS and RRWs, based on properties of the UHR and the random walk procedure, and identifies when RRWs will be faster in expectation than BrFS.

2511.09558.tldr: This work achieves high-performance semantic grasping without any manually collected training data by combining the global semantic understanding of internet-scale models with the geometric precision of a simulation-based locally-aware force-closure.

2410.17337.tldr: This paper introduces MMECInstruct, the first-ever, large-scale, and high-quality multimodal instruction dataset for e-commerce, and develops CASLIE, a simple, lightweight, yet effective framework for integrating multimodal information for e-commerce.

2501.14250.tldr: Siren, a learning-based multi-turn attack framework designed to simulate real-world human jailbreak behaviors, is proposed and it is hoped Siren inspires the development of stronger defenses against advanced multi-turn jailbreak attacks under realistic scenarios.

2502.18573.tldr: FactReasoner is presented, a novel neuro-symbolic based factuality assessment framework that employs probabilistic reasoning to evaluate the truthfulness of long-form generated responses to improve factual precision and recall.

2503.02034.tldr: The experiments show that Abn-BLIP outperforms state-of-the-art medical vision-language models and 3D report generation methods in both accuracy and clinical relevance, and highlight the potential of integrating multimodal learning strategies for improving radiology reporting.

2503.06161.tldr: FeatureEndo-4DGS (FE-4DGS), the first real time pipeline leveraging feature-distilled 4D Gaussian Splatting for simultaneous reconstruction and semantic segmentation of deformable surgical environments, is introduced.

2506.22837.tldr: This work proposes xLSTMAD, the first anomaly detection method that integrates a full encoder-decoder xLSTM architecture, purpose-built for multivariate time series data, and evaluates the method on the comprehensive TSB-AD-M benchmark, which spans 17 real-world datasets.

2508.05294.tldr: This survey paper reviews works that advance agentic applications and architectures, including initial efforts with GPT-style interfaces and more complex systems where AI agents function as coordinators, planners, perception actors, or generalist interfaces.

2508.12211.tldr: VLAPS offers a principled framework to: i) control test-time compute in VLA models, ii) leverage a priori knowledge of the robotic environment, and iii) integrate established planning and reinforcement learning techniques into the VLA inference process.

2508.15721.tldr: Analysis on EcomMMMU reveals that product images do not consistently improve performance and can, in some cases, degrade it, indicating that MLLMs may struggle to effectively leverage rich visual content for e-commerce tasks.

2510.01611.tldr: The proposed PsychCounsel-Bench benchmark provides a comprehensive assessment of an LLM's ability to function as a counselor, suggesting that only frontier LLMs are currently capable of meeting counseling exam standards, highlighting both the promise and the challenges of developing psychology-oriented LLMs.

2511.04939.tldr: The Search-Is-Not-Retrieve (SINR) framework is introduced, a dual-layer architecture that distinguishes between fine-grained search representations and coarse-grained retrieval contexts that enhances the composability, scalability, and context fidelity of retrieval systems by directly connecting small, semantically accurate search chunks to larger, contextually complete retrieve chunks.

2511.09563.tldr: This work presents a novel and more efficient approach that attains high-accuracy, near-optimal solutions for large-scale JRA problems and introduces a Partial Path Reconstructon (PPR) solver that first identifies key item-placeholder pairs to form a reduced subproblem, which is solved efficiently to refine the global solution.

2511.09564.tldr: An approach of Mamba-driven multi-perspective structural understanding (MPSU-Mamba) is proposed to localize molecular ground-state conformation and indicates that MPSU-Mamba significantly outperforms existing methods on QM9 and Molecule3D datasets.

2511.09570.tldr: This paper presents the competition-winning approach, based on the Variable Neighborhood Search (VNS) metaheuristic, which achieves the best results on the full competition dataset and also outperforms a more recent algorithm published afterward.

2511.09571.tldr: This work presents a novel framework, General Intelligence-based Fragmentation (GIF), that guides pretrained LLMs through spectra simulation using structured prompting and reasoning and highlights the value of using LLMs not only for spectra simulation but for enabling human-in-the-loop workflows and structured, explainable reasoning in molecular fragmentation.

2511.09576.tldr: Prostate-VarBench is introduced, a curated pipeline for creating prostate-specific benchmarks that integrates COSMIC, ClinVar, and ClinVar (expert-curated clinical variants) into a harmonized dataset of 193,278 variants supporting patient- or gene-aware splits to prevent data leakage.

2511.09600.tldr: It is proved that, while cogent extensions are weakly admissible, the converse is not true: while cogent extensions are weakly admissible, the converse is not true.

2511.09603.tldr: An explainable intrusion detection framework that integrates Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) with Random Forest (RF) to enhance detection of Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs).

2511.09652.tldr: UCB-QRL is an iterative algorithm in which, at each iteration, it is shown that UCB-QRL yields a high-probability regret bound, which is a problem-dependent constant that captures the sensitivity of the underlying MDP's quantile value.

2511.09663.tldr: These findings show that fairness must be judged not only by model metrics but also by the burden imposed on users at the margins, compelling context-aware safeguards that alleviate alignment debt in Global South settings.

2511.09681.tldr: SEBA is proposed, a sample-efficient framework for black-box adversarial attacks on visual RL agents that significantly reduces cumulative rewards, preserves visual fidelity, and greatly decreases environment interactions compared to prior black-box and white-box methods.

2511.09682.tldr: It is demonstrated that Rebellion, a robust RT that trains ARMs to be robust to the worst-case representation drift, can protect against advanced audio jailbreaks without compromising performance on benign tasks, and significantly improves accuracy-safety trade-off over standard RT method.

2511.09724.tldr: PALMS+$ is proposed, a modular, image-based system that addresses indoor localization challenges by reconstructing scale-aligned 3D point clouds from posed RGB images using a foundation monocular depth estimation model (Depth Pro), followed by geometric layout matching via convolution with the floor plan.

2511.09727.tldr: It is demonstrated that purely curiosity-based signals, with no external supervision, can drive coordinated multimodal learning, imitating an infant's progression from random motor babbling to purposeful behaviors.

2511.09735.tldr: A novel deep learning model that enhances the Social LSTM with a new Dynamic Occupied Space loss function that achieves up to a 31% reduction in the collision rate and reduces the average displacement error and the final displacement error by 5% and 6%, respectively, on average across all datasets compared to the baseline.

2511.09737.tldr: This work introduces SPARC: single-phase adaptation for robust control, and tests it on varying contexts within the high-fidelity racing simulator Gran Turismo 7 and wind-perturbed MuJoCo environments, finding that it achieves reliable and robust OOD generalization.

2511.09740.tldr: This paper creates a new data subset, which, despite being much smaller, provides enough information for the segmentation method to reach comparable results in a much shorter time.

2511.09741.tldr: This work proposes TawPipe--topology-aware weight pipeline parallelism, which exploits hierarchical bandwidth in distributed clusters for improved communication efficiency and achieves superior throughput and scalability compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2511.09742.tldr: While medical pre-training is beneficial, architectural choices are critical, and pre-trained features are not universally effective, especially for complex localization tasks where supervised models remain a strong alternative.

2511.09748.tldr: Overall, compact, instruction-tuned LLMs augmented with lightweight calibration and small-sample supervision can deliver trustworthy, on-device CED for MT, enabling private, low-cost error screening in real-world translation pipelines.

2511.09765.tldr: This work establishes a novel EEG-driven optimization framework for cognitive neuromodulation, providing a foundational model for next-generation AI-integrated BCI systems aimed at personalized neurorehabilitation in FXS and related disorders.

2511.09766.tldr: This work evaluates the performance of Ksurf on estimation-based resource orchestration tasks involving highly variable workloads when employed as a contextual multi-armed bandit objective function model for cloud scenarios using Drone.

2511.09768.tldr: The approach is to formalize bias assumptions as programs in ProbLog, a probabilistic logic programming language that allows for the description of probabilistic causal relationships through logic, and concludes that ProbLog4Fairness outperforms baselines due to its ability to flexibly model the relevant bias assumptions, where other methods typically uphold a fixed bias type or notion of fairness.

2511.09774.tldr: Solvaformer is introduced, a geometry-aware graph transformer that models solutions as multiple molecules with independent SE(3) symmetries that provides an accurate, scalable, and interpretable approach to solution-phase property prediction.

2511.09775.tldr: This work proposes a novel privacy-preserving approach based on SHAP entropy regularization to mitigate privacy leakage in explainable AIoT applications, and develops a suite of SHAP-based privacy attacks that strategically leverage model explanation outputs to infer sensitive information.

2511.09788.tldr: This position paper argues for the importance of open small AI models in creative independence for interactive art practices and explores the practical applications and implications of using open small AI models in interactive art, contrasting them with closed-source alternatives.

2304.11954.tldr: Spikingformer is presented, a novel spiking transformer backbone that merges the MS Residual connection with Self-Attention in a biologically plausible way to address the non-spike computation challenge in Spikformer while maintaining global modeling capabilities.

2406.12163.tldr: A discussion-graph semantics for first-order logic with equality is formulated, enabling reasoning about discussion and argumentation in AI more generally than before, and it is shown that the set of all generalised extensions (acceptability semantics), too, are first-order characterisable.

2406.16464.tldr: A novel framework, InterCLIP-MEP, featuring a Memory-Enhanced Predictor (MEP), featuring a dynamic dual-channel memory mechanism that captures and retains valuable knowledge from test samples during inference, serving as a nonparametric classifier to enhance sarcasm detection robustness.

2408.11062.tldr: Interactive-T2S is introduced, a framework that generates SQL queries through direct interactions with databases through direct interactions with databases and includes four general tools that facilitate proactive and efficient information retrieval by the LLM.

2410.20749.tldr: Matryoshka Pilot is introduced, a lightweight white-box LLM controller that guides a large-scale black-box LLM generator by decomposing complex tasks into a series of intermediate outputs that enhances the capabilities of black-box LLMs in complex, long-horizon tasks.

2410.21597.tldr: This study conducts a comprehensive empirical evaluation of various methods, ranging from prompting, fine-tuning to preference learning and the recently proposed general alignment technique known as Circuit Breakers, and shows that it is possible to scope language models.

2412.16725.tldr: This paper aims to enhance the conflict-solving capabilities of LLMs by leveraging formal abstract argumentation, integrating language model learning with symbolic computation, and provides detailed illustrations that mitigate the lack of transparency typically associated with neural networks.

2501.02409.tldr: PerturbODE is proposed, a novel framework that employs interpretable neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODEs) to model cell state trajectories under perturbations and derive the underlying causal GRN from the neural ODE parameters, enabling downstream simulation of unseen genetic interventions.

2501.11094.tldr: The identification of suicidal ideation in social media text is improved by utilising a hybrid framework that integrates Convolutional Neural Networks and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory, enhanced with an attention mechanism.

2501.18638.tldr: The GAP (Graph of Attacks with Pruning) framework is introduced, an advanced approach for generating stealthy jailbreak prompts to evaluate and enhance LLM safeguards and proves highly effective in improving content moderation systems.

2502.02390.tldr: The novel Chain-of-Associated-Thoughts (CoAT) framework is developed, which introduces an innovative synergy between the Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm and a dynamic mechanism for integrating new key information, termed'associative memory', and significantly expands the LLM search space.

2502.10012.tldr: This work designs three novel task setups in which the differentiable dynamics are combined within an end-to-end computation graph not with a policy, but a state predictor, and demonstrates how differentiable simulation enables their efficient, end-to-end learning.

2504.03966.tldr: The Dynamic Course Content Integration mechanism, which dynamically retrieves course content from Canvas LMS and structures it within an LLM’s context window via prompt engineering, enabling the LLM-powered assistant, Ask ME, to deliver context-aware, curriculum-aligned responses while mitigating hallucinations.

2504.12672.tldr: It is shown that blending AIFS with NWP models improves overall forecast skill, even when AIFS alone is not the most accurate component, and statistical post-processing methods developed for NWP are directly applicable to AI models, enabling national meteorological centres to incorporate AI forecasts into existing workflows in a low-risk, incremental fashion.

2505.00787.tldr: This work shows that it significantly reduces the number of base policies needed to ensure optimality in new tasks, and proves that it is strictly more expressive than a CCS, enabling particular classes of non-linear tasks to be solved optimally.

2505.06347.tldr: A large language model (LLM)-assisted framework for quantum-circuit design that systematically scales state-preparation circuits to large lattice volumes is introduced, providing the first scalable ansatz for this class of 2+1d models.

2505.19164.tldr: This research proposes BroadGen, an innovative framework that recommends efficient and effective broad match keyphrases by utilizing historical search query data, and demonstrates that BroadGen, through token correspondence modeling, maintains better query stability over time.

2505.21538.tldr: A vision-text decoupling analysis finds that models struggling with direct visual reasoning show marked improvement when reasoning over their own generated text captions, revealing a strong need for improved VLM Chain-of-Thought (CoT) abilities, even in models that consistently exceed human performance.

2506.18925.tldr: A granular computer vision-based method for quantifying PD motor characteristics from video recordings that achieves a higher accuracy in MDS-UPDRS score prediction, while still providing an interpretable quantification of individual finger-tapping motor characteristics.

2506.19794.tldr: This work investigates strategies to enhance the data analysis capabilities of open-source LLMs by curating a seed dataset of diverse, realistic scenarios and evaluates model behavior across three core dimensions: data understanding, code generation, and strategic planning.

2507.14882.tldr: A novel framework for calculating importance metrics in pruning groups not only shrinks the model size but also considers various application-specific constraints to find the best pruning coefficient for each group.

2507.20067.tldr: PITA is a novel framework that integrates preference feedback directly into the LLM's token generation, eliminating the need for a reward model, and is evaluated across diverse tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in aligning LLM outputs with user preferences.

2508.05615.tldr: This work proposes GUI-RC (Region Consistency), a test-time scaling method that constructs spatial voting grids from multiple sampled predictions to identify consensus regions where models show highest agreement, and introduces GUI-RCPO (Region Consistency Policy Optimization), a test-time reinforcement learning method that transforms consistency patterns into rewards for test-time reinforcement learning.

2508.05888.tldr: Findings support the hypothesis that the structural information modeled in the graph provides complementary signals to pure similarity matching, particularly for queries requiring sequential tool composition.

2508.06959.tldr: A novel method is proposed, named Subtle-Cue Oriented Perception Engine (SCOPE), which adaptively enhances the representational capability of low-level details and high-level semantics in the spatial domain, breaking through the limitations of fixed scales in the frequency domain and improving the flexibility of multi-scale fusion.

2508.10027.tldr: Crucially, validation on the Delaware corpus demonstrates that the proposed pipeline generalizes to early-stage impairment, supporting its potential as a scalable approach for clinically relevant early screening.

2508.17311.tldr: Bine trees maintain the generality of binomial trees and butterflies while cutting global-link traffic by up to \(33\%\) while cutting global-link traffic by up to \(33\%\) .

2509.05796.tldr: Evaluations on the Surface Seal Image dataset-representing sterile-barrier packaging inspection-demonstrate that the proposed methods outperform reference baselines, including MOCCA, CPCAE, and RAG-PaM, under realistic industrial constraints.

2509.06035.tldr: TinyDef-DETR, a DETR-based framework designed to achieve accurate and efficient detection of transmission line defects from UAV-acquired images, achieves superior detection performance and strong generalization capability, while maintaining modest computational overhead.

2509.09651.tldr: These findings demonstrate that carefully targeted grounding provides a simple yet strong baseline and an effective domain-specific solution for regulatory question answering, and consistently improves generation accuracy across all tested models.

2509.09958.tldr: This work reformulates REC as box-wise visual-language verification: given proposals from a COCO-clean generic detector (YOLO-World), a general-purpose VLM independently answers True/False queries for each region, which reduces cross-box interference, supports abstention and multiple matches, and requires no fine-tuning.

2509.11816.tldr: This work identifies the root cause - unlearning targets representations which are too general - and develops a highly selective technique that unlearns robustly while preserving general performance, which enables robust and non-disruptive unlearning.

2509.14289.tldr: The results show that while some architectures natively exhibit subsets of these properties, targeted augmentations substantially improve modular agent performance, especially in complex, multi-step, and real-time penetration testing tasks.

2509.19319.tldr: FHIR-AgentBench is introduced, a benchmark that grounds 2,931 real-world clinical questions in the HL7 FHIR standard and systematically evaluates agentic frameworks, highlighting the practical challenges of retrieving data from intricate FHIR resources and the difficulty of reasoning over them.

2509.23213.tldr: On a real-world automotive dataset with 29,100 events and 474 labels, OSCAR recovers interpretable causal structures in minutes, while classical methods fail to scale, enabling practical scientific diagnostics at production scale.

2510.01252.tldr: It is argued that the LLM+SAEs pipeline offers a scalable framework for auditing how cultural assumptions from the data are embedded in model representations.

2510.05162.tldr: C calibrated confidence and conservative routing enable AI to reliably handle a sizable subset of routine cases while reserving expert judgment for ambiguous or pedagogically rich responses.

2510.06557.tldr: This work proposes Markovian Thinking, a paradigm in which the policy advances reasoning while conditioning on a constant-size state, decoupling thinking length from context size, and instantiates Delethink, an RL environment that structures reasoning into fixed-size chunks.

2510.12787.tldr: Ax-Prover is competitive with state-of-the-art provers, while it largely outperforms them on the new benchmarks, showing that, unlike specialized systems that struggle to generalize, the tool-based agentic theorem prover approach offers a generalizable methodology for formal verification across diverse scientific domains.

2510.17064.tldr: BRAINCELL-AID is presented, a novel multi-agent AI system that integrates free-text descriptions with ontology labels to enable more accurate and robust gene set annotation and creates a valuable resource to support community-driven cell type annotation.

2510.26125.tldr: The Waymo Open Dataset for End-to-End Driving (WOD-E2E) is introduced and a novel open-loop evaluation metric: Rater Feedback Score (RFS) is proposed, measuring how closely the predicted trajectory matches rater-annotated trajectory preference labels.

2511.05508.tldr: A novel Chain-of-Thought summarization framework that condenses financial news into concise, event-driven summaries that provide an intermediate layer that supports language models in producing investor-focused narratives, bridging the gap between raw news and actionable insights.

2511.05901.tldr: It is found that research primarily relied on publicly available data, with limited application in private data, and approaches commonly relied on English-centric embedding models, while LLMs were mostly generic, with limited use of medical-specific LLMs.

2511.06471.tldr: This work introduces GHOST, a hierarchical framework that optimally solves the GCS-TSP by combining combinatorial tour search with convex trajectory optimization and proves that GHOST guarantees optimality and presents a bounded-suboptimal variant for time-critical scenarios.

2511.07090.tldr: A unified, operational definition of Green AI distinct from Sustainable AI is established and a calibrated measurement framework combining estimator models with direct metering to enable reproducible, provider agnostic comparisons is defined.

2511.07250.tldr: Through extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art open-source and closed-source models, the MVU-Eval benchmark is introduced, revealing significant performance discrepancies and limitations in current MLLMs'ability to perform understanding across multiple videos.

2511.07863.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that WaterMod consistently attains strong watermark detection performance while maintaining generation quality in both zero-bit and multi-bit settings, and robustness holds across a range of tasks, including natural language generation, mathematical reasoning, and code synthesis.

2511.08132.tldr: SpeechCARE is a multimodal speech processing pipeline that leverages pretrained, multilingual acoustic and linguistic transformer models to capture subtle speech-related cues associated with cognitive impairment and employs a dynamic fusion architecture that weights transformer-based acoustic, linguistic, and demographic inputs.

2511.08238.tldr: This work first extracts multilevel semantic features from different vision encoder to capture more visual cues of the relationships, then learns to project the vision features to group related semantics, among which are more likely to have relationships.

2511.08379.tldr: This work proves that SOMs generalize the prior work's difference-in-means technique, and proposes a novel method leveraging Self-Organizing Maps to extract multiple refusal directions, demonstrating that ablating multiple directions from models'internals outperforms not only the single-direction baseline but also specialized jailbreak algorithms, leading to an effective suppression of refusal.

2511.08570.tldr: It is demonstrated that AdaptKAN exceeds or matches the performance of prior KAN architectures and MLPs on four different tasks: learning scientific equations from the Feynman dataset, image classification from frozen features, learning a control Lyapunov function, and detecting OOD inputs on the OpenOOD v1.5 benchmark.

2511.09147.tldr: A top-down pipeline that recovers multi-person global human meshes solely from pressure signals, which leverages a tracking-by-detection strategy to first identify and segment each individual's pressure signal from the raw pressure data, and subsequently performs HMR for each extracted individual signal.

2511.09193.tldr: This work presents an enhanced version of PIBT that addresses this limitation by incorporating multi-action operations and demonstrates how the method, when combined with graph-guidance technique and large neighborhood search optimization, achieves state-of-the-art performance in the online LMAPF-T setting.

2511.09231.tldr: The proposed method integrates an open-weight LLM to systematically extract actors and use cases from software requirements with advanced prompt engineering techniques to assist in this tedious process of use case modeling.

2511.09492.tldr: This study bridges the gap between predictive accuracy and practical usability, resulting in a high-performance scoring system that not only reduces password-based vulnerabilities but also empowers users to make more informed security decisions.

2511.09796.tldr: This paper presents an analysis of predicate-argument structures in parallel Chinese and English sentences, inspecting similarities and differences and proposing a categorization of structural divergences, showing clearly that language transfer is asymmetric.

2511.09804.tldr: SlideBot is a modular, multi-agent slide generation framework that integrates LLMs with retrieval, structured planning, and code generation that demonstrates SlideBot's potential to streamline slide preparation while ensuring accuracy, relevance, and adaptability in higher education.

2511.09810.tldr: This paper investigates how the compositional structure of neural networks shapes their optimization landscape and training dynamics, and shows that key structural features are universal across all admissible costs, depending solely on the overparameterized representation rather than on problem-specific details.

2511.09814.tldr: A novel deep learning framework that incorporates a task embedding network and a representation learning network with the balancing penalty is proposed that outperforms existing baselines and confirms the practical implications and utility of the framework.

2511.09820.tldr: This paper presents a simple yet effective cross-view image retrieval framework that leverages a pretrained vision encoder and a large language model (LLM), requiring no additional training and enables automatic construction of semantically aligned street-to-satellite datasets.

2511.09822.tldr: This work presents the first robust watermarking framework tailored to GBDT models, utilizing in-place fine-tuning to embed imperceptible and resilient watermarks and proposes four embedding strategies, each designed to minimize impact on model accuracy while ensuring watermark robustness.

2511.09834.tldr: ConcertMask is a certifiably robust defense that constructs a provably sufficient set of binary masks to neutralize patch effects with strong theoretical guarantees, and improves certified robust accuracy by up to +13.4\% over PatchCleanser, while maintaining clean accuracy nearly identical to the vanilla model.

2511.09871.tldr: A fully differentiable, exemplar-free expandable method composed of two complementary memories that learns common features that can be used across all tasks, and the other combines the shared features to learn discriminative characteristics unique to each sample.

2511.09879.tldr: This study constructed a secure dataset by filtering an existing Python corpus using a static analysis tool to retain only vulnerability-free functions and trained two transformer-based models, which produced outputs with fewer security issues, while maintaining comparable functional correctness.

2511.09884.tldr: This work proposes a conceptual model for management of quantum resources and scheduling of applications driven by timeliness constraints, and discusses multiple challenges, including trainability limits, data access, and loading bottlenecks, verification of quantum components, and adversarial QAI.

2511.09889.tldr: The Anchor-based Fair Clustering Framework is introduced, a novel, general, and plug-and-play framework that empowers arbitrary fair clustering algorithms with linear-time scalability and proves theoretically ensures that the fairness of the final clustering on the entire dataset matches that of the anchor clustering.

2511.09891.tldr: A Scale-Aware Relay Layer (SARL) and a Scale-Adaptive Loss (SAL) for tiny object detection, both of which are seamlessly compatible with the top-performing frameworks are proposed.

2511.09895.tldr: SE-Diff, a novel physiological simulator and experience enhanced diffusion model for comprehensive ECG generation and an LLM-powered experience retrieval-augmented strategy to inject clinical knowledge, providing more guidance for ECG generation are proposed.

2511.09921.tldr: This paper introduces a curvature-aware de Branges-Rovnyak space, a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) that is isometric to a Poincare ball, and builds a family of adaptive hyperbolic kernels, including the novel adaptive hyperbolic radial kernel, whose learnable parameters modulate hyperbolic features in a task-aware manner.

2511.09924.tldr: An adaptive fused dual-domain seasonal MLP that categorizes seasonal signals into strong and weak components and an energy invariant attention mechanism that adaptively focuses on different feature channels within trend and seasonal predictions across time steps is developed.

2511.09926.tldr: This work introduces a latent space transition operator and proposes Sequential Learning with Drift Compensation (SLDC), which aims to align feature distributions across tasks to mitigate the impact of drift and significantly improves the performance of SeqFT.

2511.09942.tldr: AdaptViG is an efficient and powerful hybrid Vision GNN that introduces a novel graph construction mechanism called Adaptive Graph Convolution that builds upon a highly efficient static axial scaffold and a dynamic, content-aware gating strategy called Exponential Decay Gating.

2511.09962.tldr: An AI driven Decision Support System (DSS) that integrates multi source data including social media streams, marketing expenditure records, consumer engagement logs, and sentiment dynamics using a hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN) and Temporal Transformer framework is proposed.

2511.09964.tldr: EnvTrace, a simulation-based method that evaluates execution traces to assess semantic code equivalence, is introduced, showing that many top-tier models can approach human-level performance in rapid control-code generation.

2511.09969.tldr: Owl algorithm, an educational platform that supports Self-Regulated Learning (SRL) in competitive programming (CP) through AI-generated reflective questions, suggests advantages of LLM-supported reflection for novice programmers, though refinements are needed to ensure reliability and pedagogical value for advanced learners.

2511.09970.tldr: MultiTab-Net is introduced, the first multitask transformer architecture specifically designed for large tabular data that consistently achieves higher multitask gain than existing MTL architectures and single-task transformers across diverse domains including large-scale recommendation data, census-like socioeconomic data, and physics datasets.

2511.09973.tldr: The idea behind DiVE is to constrain difference vectors, each of which is obtained by subtracting the embeddings extracted from the pre-trained and fine-tuning models for the same data sample, which preserves the geometric structure during fine-tuning.

2511.10010.tldr: It is concluded that AI and computer architecture are in a symbiotic relationship, where hardware-software co-design is no longer an optimization but a necessity for future progress in computing.

2511.10014.tldr: This work introduces fastbmRAG, an fast graph-based RAG optimized for biomedical literature, which provides a fast solution for quickly understanding, summarizing, and answering questions about biomedical literature on a large scale.

2511.10020.tldr: Anomagic is proposed, a zero-shot anomaly generation method that produces semantically coherent anomalies without requiring any exemplar anomalies by unifying both visual and textual cues through a crossmodal prompt encoding scheme, and can generate anomalies for any normal-category image using user-defined prompts.

2511.10023.tldr: An in-depth examination of Retinopathy of Prematurity diagnosis, employing advanced deep learning methodologies, reveals the potential of the proposed customized CNN model to alleviate computational burdens associated with deep neural networks and highlights their utility as valuable diagnostic aids in clinical settings.

2511.10031.tldr: A method is developed that facilitates the incorporation of prior knowledge into parameter learning based on Variational Inference, to guide the model estimation of a new temporal latent variable structural causal model.

2511.10032.tldr: The extent to which people's moral preferences change over time, and the impact of such changes on AI alignment are investigated, highlighting the need to better understand the object of alignment (what to align to) when user preferences change significantly over time.

2511.10054.tldr: The critical challenge is to maintain both high inference speed and model accuracy when prefetching fails, which is to maintain both high inference speed and model accuracy when prefetching fails.

2511.10065.tldr: Experiments on three public chest X-ray benchmarks show that RadHiera consistently improves diagnostic accuracy and inter-section consistency over state-of-the-art methods, while also demonstrating good adaptability to report generation in ultrasound report generation.

2511.10087.tldr: UEPO, a unified generative framework inspired by large language model pretraining and fine-tuning strategies, is proposed, providing a multi-seed dynamics-aware diffusion policy that efficiently captures diverse modalities without training multiple models.

2511.10088.tldr: A new black-box model-agnostic adversarial attack for post-hoc explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), particularly in the image domain, to modify the original explanations while being undetected by the human eye and maintain the same predicted class.

2511.10093.tldr: It is concluded that the summarization and generative properties of language models directly facilitate many applications at large and other features may find particular uses.

2511.10101.tldr: Effective control is best framed as seed then cede: brief, smooth parameter-level nudges place the system in a favourable basin of attraction, after which reaction-diffusion dynamics complete and stabilize the pattern.

2511.10108.tldr: Experimental validation confirms that MATAI-designed alloys outperform commercial references such as TC4, highlighting the framework's potential to accelerate the discovery of lightweight, high-performance materials under real-world design constraints.

2511.10128.tldr: This work proposes RAGFort, a structure-aware dual-module defense combining "contrastive reindexing for inter-class isolation and"constrained cascade generation" for intra-class protection, offering comprehensive defense against knowledge base extraction attacks.

2511.10136.tldr: Achieving genuine compositionality will require fundamental advances in representation and reasoning rather than incremental adjustments to existing architectures, and current solutions and simple scaling cannot bridge this gap.

2511.10154.tldr: The Generation-Enhanced Alignment (GEA) is proposed from a generative perspective, which introduces diffusion-generated images as intermediate semantic representations to bridge the gap between text and visual patterns and demonstrates the effectiveness of the method on three public TIPR datasets.

2511.10161.tldr: DenoGrad is a gradient-based framework for data refinement that leverages a pretrained neural network to iteratively correct noisy observations by optimizing the input space while keeping the model fixed, and is applicable to both tabular regression and time-series forecasting.

2511.10187.tldr: From the experimental results, it is found that training offline RL agents on QME-embedded states with decoded rewards yields significantly better performance than training on the original states and rewards.

2511.10208.tldr: Fractional Neural Attention is introduced, a principled mechanism connecting self-attention, stochastic dynamics, and geometry, providing an interpretable, biologically grounded foundation for powerful, neuroscience-inspired AI.

2511.10215.tldr: A novel Persona-Aware Alignment Framework is proposed, which directly treats persona alignment as the training objective of dialogue generation and outperforms many state-of-the-art personalized dialogue methods and large language models.

2511.10232.tldr: VocalNet-M2 is introduced, a novel low-latency SLM that integrates a multi-codebook tokenizer and a multi-token prediction (MTP) strategy that directly generates multi-codebook speech tokens, thus eliminating the need for a latency-inducing flow-matching model.

2511.10244.tldr: PepTriX offers both predictive robustness and interpretable validation, bridging the gap between performance-driven peptide-level models (PLMs) and domain-level understanding in peptide research.

2511.10245.tldr: The proposed hybrid LSB+DFT technique, which leverages redundant embedding and a fallback extraction mechanism, is shown to provide the optimal balance, maintaining high visual fidelity while exhibiting superior resilience to all tested attacks.

2511.10250.tldr: This paper constructs the first AQA dataset containing fine-grained sub-score and deduction annotations for aerial skiing, which will be released as a new benchmark and proposes a novel AQA method, named JudgeMind, which significantly enhances performance and reliability by simulating the judgment and scoring mindset of professional referees.

2511.10251.tldr: This work proposes Heuristic Transformer (HT), an in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) approach that augments the in-context dataset with a belief distribution over rewards to achieve better decision-making.

2511.10258.tldr: A novel approach to categorization of modern workload schedulers is presented, highlighting similarities in the focus of scheduling strategies design, applicable to both local and distributed systems.

2511.10260.tldr: This work proposes H3Former, a novel token-to-region framework that leverages high-order semantic relations to aggregate local fine-grained representations with structured region-level modeling and introduces the Hyperbolic Hierarchical Contrastive Loss (HHCL), which enforces hierarchical semantic constraints in a non-Euclidean embedding space.

2511.10264.tldr: This work proposes a generalized approach that enhances both state sampling and heuristic updates by performing limited-horizon searches and updating each state's heuristic based on the shortest path to the search frontier, incorporating both edge costs and the heuristic values of frontier states.

2511.10266.tldr: This paper studies the verification of the evolution of conditional-independence (CI) propositions against temporal logic specifications, and shows that deciding if a stochastic CI proposition eventually holds is at least as hard as the Skolem problem for linear recurrence sequences.

2511.10268.tldr: This work introduces causal analysis into the object recognition scenario of LVLMs, establishing a Structural Causal Model (SCM) and formally de- fine spurious correlations arising from co-occurrence bias, to quantify the influence induced by these spurious correla- tions.

2511.10271.tldr: The empirical study examined the quality of generated patches regarding security, maintainability, and performance efficiency, which were identified as critical code-level quality attributes, highlighting the need to integrate quality assurance mechanisms into LLM code generation pipelines to ensure that future generated code not only passes tests but truly passes with quality.

2511.10272.tldr: This paper builds upon the state-of-the-art optimal bidirectional search algorithm, BAE*, designed for consistent heuristics, and introduces several variants of BAE* specifically tailored for the bounded-suboptimal context.

2511.10276.tldr: RoboBenchMart is introduced, an open-source simulated benchmark targeting retail dark-store environments, where a mobile manipulator must perform complex manipulation tasks with diverse grocery items.

2511.10277.tldr: A modular NPC dialogue system that leverages Small Language Models, fine-tuned to encode specific NPC personas and integrated with runtime-swappable memory modules, enabling expressive interactions and long-term memory without retraining or model reloading during gameplay is proposed.

2511.10281.tldr: This paper proposes a novel fake news detection framework, dubbed FactGuard, that leverages LLMs to extract event-centric content, thereby reducing the impact of writing style on detection performance, and introduces a dynamic usability mechanism that identifies contradictions and ambiguous cases in factual reasoning.

2511.10282.tldr: Torch-Uncertainty, a PyTorch and Lightning-based framework designed to streamline DNN training and evaluation with UQ techniques and metrics, is introduced and comprehensive experimental results that benchmark a diverse set of UQ methods across classification, segmentation, and regression tasks are presented.

2511.10284.tldr: A formal framework to audit privacy leakage using abductive explanations, which identifies minimal sufficient evidence justifying model decisions and determines whether sensitive information disclosed and introduces the notion of Potentially Applicable Explanations (PAE).

2511.10301.tldr: This work presents LLaViT - Large Language Models as extended Vision Transformers - which enables the LLM to simultaneously function as a vision encoder through three key modifications: learning separate QKV projections for vision modality, enabling bidirectional attention on visual tokens, and incorporating both global and local visual representations.

2511.10316.tldr: A novel computational framework that integrates depth-of-field supervision and multi-view consistency supervision to advance 3D Gaussian Splatting and achieves superior depth fidelity, demonstrating a 0.8 dB PSNR improvement over the state-of-the-art method on the Waymo Open Dataset.

2511.10356.tldr: A framework for structure-to-instance theorem autoformalization (SITA), which systematically bridges the gap between abstract mathematical theories and their concrete applications in Lean proof assistant.

2511.10370.tldr: This work introduces SHRUG-FM, a framework for reliability-aware prediction that enables GFMs to identify and abstain from likely failures, and builds a pathway toward safer and more interpretable deployment of GFMs in climate-sensitive applications.

2511.10392.tldr: The first approximation theory for applying random Fourier features (RFF) to KPKM is introduced, introducing the first approximation theory for applying random Fourier features (RFF) to KPKM and establishing strong theoretical guarantees for this combination.

2511.10395.tldr: AgentEvolver is a self-evolving agent system that leverages the semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities of LLMs to drive autonomous agent learning and achieves more efficient exploration, better sample utilization, and faster adaptation compared to traditional RL-based baselines.

2511.10409.tldr: This work proposes methods to generate policy summarizations that capture task ordering and agent cooperation in decentralized MARL policies, along with query-based explanations for When, Why Not, and What types of user queries about specific agent behaviors.

2511.10428.tldr: This work investigates how to use proofs generated by a constraint solver as a starting point for computing step-wise explanations, instead of computing them step-by-step, and proposes several methods for converting a proof to a step-wise explanation sequence.

2511.10436.tldr: MACHOP (Multi-Armed CHOice Perceptron), a novel query generation strategy that integrates non-domination constraints with upper confidence bound-based diversification and produces higher-quality explanations than the standard approach is introduced.

2511.10439.tldr: ReCalX is introduced, a novel approach to recalibrate models for improved explanations while preserving their original predictions that consistently reduces perturbation-specific miscalibration most effectively while enhancing explanation robustness and the identification of globally important input features.

2511.10465.tldr: KPPO introduces three key innovations: a knowledge gap filling mechanism for knowledge gap identification and targeted remediation, a batch-wise candidate evaluation approach that considers both performance improvement and distributional stability, and an adaptive knowledge pruning strategy that balances performance and token efficiency.

2511.10484.tldr: The results suggest that PSL is useful for T2DM screening and could potentially help predict the early onset of T2DM.

2511.10502.tldr: This work proposes novel lightweight client-side detection techniques, based on statistically improbable weight structures and anomalous loss and gradient dynamics, that enable clients to effectively detect active GIAs without any modifications to the FL training protocol.

2511.10519.tldr: This work systematically study how linguistic styles can reframe harmful intent and elicit unsafe responses from aligned models, and introduces a style neutralization preprocessing step using a secondary LLM to strip manipulative stylistic cues from user inputs, significantly reducing jailbreak success rates.

2511.10524.tldr: It is argued that at this time AI must augment but not replace human judgment in academic workflows such as peer review, ethical evaluation, and validation of results.

2511.10566.tldr: It is identified that early layers LayerNorm are the most critical over middle/later layers and their influence varies across Pre and Post LayerNorm models, and shed new light on the role of LayerNorm in shaping memorization and learning in transformers.

2511.10573.tldr: A Responsible Reinforcement Learning framework that integrates emotional and contextual understanding with ethical considerations into the sequential decision-making process, and operationalizes empathy and responsibility within machine learning policy optimization, bridging safe RL, affective computing and responsible AI.

2511.10583.tldr: This paper systematically evaluates three distinct prompting paradigms: a straightforward one-Shot approach, a reasoning-focused ReAct framework, and a multi-step agentic workflow, revealing that while more complex frameworks like ReAct and agentic flows are powerful, the simpler one-shot prompting method achieved the highest performance on the official validation set.

2511.10585.tldr: It is demonstrated that a purely greedy agent guided by the semantic similarity of article titles is overwhelmingly effective and underscores the transformative potential of large language models to act as powerful, zero-shot semantic navigators in complex information spaces.

2511.10591.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that mined prompting improves response relevance, while metadata-guided generation further refines clinical precision, highlighting promising directions for developing AI-driven tools that can provide reliable and efficient wound care support.

2511.10593.tldr: RG generates faster forward models than the current state of the art, beating other GGP systems (Regular Boardgames, Ludii) in terms of efficiency.

2511.10611.tldr: ArachNet is presented, the first system demonstrating that LLM agents can independently generate measurement workflows that mimics expert reasoning, enabling broader access to sophisticated measurement capabilities while maintaining the technical rigor required for research-quality analysis.

2511.10618.tldr: It is demonstrated how entropy estimates can be obtained on a per-token basis, and it is shown empirically that causal models trained to approach but not exceed estimated per-token entropies exhibit greater generalization than models trained without taking entropy into account.

2511.10621.tldr: This paper proposes Socratic Self-Refine (SSR), a novel framework for fine-grained evaluation and precise refinement of LLM reasoning that decomposes model responses into verifiable (sub-question, sub-answer) pairs, enabling step-level confidence estimation through controlled re-solving and self-consistency checks.

2511.10627.tldr: A formal definition of how labeled time series sensor data can match an abstract scenario, represented as a scenario program using the Scenic probabilistic programming language is introduced, and a querying algorithm is presented that, given a scenario program and a labeled dataset, identifies the subset of data that matches the specified scenario.

2309.15942.tldr: It is argued that achieving more efficient and reliable AI will require embracing a set of principles that are well-aligned with the goals of neuromorphic engineering, which are in turn inspired by how the brain processes information.

2310.10070.tldr: GreatSplicing, a manually created, large-scale, high-quality splicing dataset, is proposed, enabling detection models to learn splicing traces more effectively and achieve low misidentification rates and stronger cross-dataset generalization compared to existing datasets.

2403.10568.tldr: The Mixture of Prompt Experts (MoPE) is proposed, a framework that significantly enhances prompt adaptivity and expressiveness by dynamically generating instance-specific prompts, enabling the model to selectively attend to task-relevant sub-sequences based on instance-specific multimodal input.

2405.15033.tldr: A simulation-based study using the physical process of the glass breakage to create perturbed scenarios, representing a realistic class of physics-based adversarial samples, and evaluating detection failure rates for critical object classes using CNN-based object detection models and a transformer-based architecture with Pyramid Vision Transformers.

2405.19212.tldr: A novel procedure is developed based on three metrics per feature, which reveals not only how features are correlated with the target but also the additional and overlapping information provided by considering them in combination with other features.

2406.03442.tldr: It is argued that rational norms tied to coherence do apply to some language models, but not to others, and the Minimal Assent Connection is introduced and a new account of credence is proposed, which captures the strength of belief in language models.

2407.00482.tldr: This work proposes an explainability framework to preemptively disentangle the nature of such spurious associations in a dataset before model training, and proposes a novel measure of the spuriousness of a dataset.

2410.19238.tldr: The results show that AI-Agents align with humans in correlations between input Big Five traits and output responses and may serve as useful tools for preliminary research, although discrepancies in finer response patterns indicate that AI-Agents cannot (yet) fully substitute for human participants in precision or high-stakes projects.

2410.20856.tldr: This work introduces Strada-LLM, a novel multivariate probabilistic forecasting LLM that explicitly models both temporal and spatial traffic patterns, and proposes a lightweight distribution-derived strategy for domain adaptation to enhance adaptability and interpretability in real-world traffic networks.

2411.16657.tldr: DREAMRUNNER is proposed, a novel story-to-video generation method that structure the input script using a large language model (LLM) to facilitate both coarse-grained scene planning as well as fine-grained object-level layout planning, and exhibits strong fine-grained condition-following ability in compositional text-to-video generation.

2412.00060.tldr: The need for MLLMs to enhance accuracy in complex, multi-object sentiment analysis tasks is underscored and MOSABench is established as a foundational tool for advancing sentiment analysis capabilities in MLLMs.

2412.14626.tldr: This framework provides a balanced approach to research idea generation, achieving high-quality outcomes in the experiment by dynamically navigating the trade-offs among novelty, feasibility, and effectiveness.

2412.17159.tldr: This paper recap the classical concepts and foundations of the Semantic Web as well as modern and recent concepts and applications, building upon these foundations.

2412.18890.tldr: This study represents a first effort in conceptualizing the search for symbolic solutions as a lifelong, iterative process, marking a significant step towards harnessing LLMs in the perpetual pursuit of scientific and engineering breakthroughs.

2502.03270.tldr: This work quantifies the impact of temporal entanglement, demonstrating a strong correlation between a policy's success rate and the ability of its latent space to capture task-progression cues and proposes a simple, yet effective disentanglement baseline designed to mitigate temporal entanglement.

2502.03500.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations of various image restoration tasks and datasets show that ELIR achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, effectively balancing distortion and perceptual quality metrics while significantly reducing model size and computational cost.

2502.09125.tldr: This paper proposes two novel adaptive network pruning schemes in parallel: sparse graph-structured lasso pruning with Information Bottleneck (sGLP-IB) and sparse tree-guided lasso pruning with Information Bottleneck (sTLP-IB).

2502.15980.tldr: SQLsynth, a human-in-the-loop text-to-SQL data annotation system that streamlines the creation of high-quality text-to-SQL datasets through human-LLM collaboration in a structured workflow, and significantly accelerates text-to-SQL data annotation, reduces cognitive load, and produces datasets that are more accurate, natural, and diverse.

2502.17506.tldr: CLADD, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-empowered agentic system tailored to drug discovery tasks, is proposed, showing that it outperforms general-purpose and domain-specific LLMs as well as traditional deep learning approaches.

2503.09956.tldr: A comprehensive exploration of the relationship between LLMs and wireless networks is offered, presenting a vision of how these domains empower each other to drive innovation.

2503.11880.tldr: Through extensive experiments on NLP benchmarks, it is demonstrated that FedALT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art personalized federated LoRA fine-tuning methods, achieving superior local adaptation without sacrificing computational efficiency.

2503.13812.tldr: Overall, this case study highlights that while AI personas can usefully surface new perspectives and prompt discussion in deliberative settings, their successful deployment depends on clarifying their limitations and emphasizing that they complement rather than replace genuine participation.

2503.19195.tldr: Mining-Gym is presented -- a configurable, open-source benchmarking environment for training, testing, and evaluating RL algorithms in mining process optimization, enabling fair evaluation of adaptive decision-making and demonstrating the strong performance potential of RL-trained schedulers.

2504.07379.tldr: A modified PIKAN architecture is introduced, tanh-cPIKAN, which is based on Chebyshev polynomials for parametrization of the univariate functions with an extra nonlinearity for enhanced performance.

2505.01812.tldr: The results demonstrate that the Self-QA protocol of Sys2-FT significantly improves models'in-weight learning of the news while preserving general capabilities, and discover the contextual shadowing effect.

2505.12684.tldr: FedGFM+ is presented, an enhanced framework with two core modules to reduce knowledge entanglement, an enhanced framework with two core modules to reduce knowledge entanglement that is evaluated on 8 diverse benchmarks across multiple domains and tasks.

2505.16270.tldr: The overall Pilot-Copilot framework is named the Transformer Copilot, which introduces a novel Copilot model design, a joint training paradigm where the Copilot continuously learns from the evolving Mistake Log alongside the Pilot, and a fused inference paradigm where the Copilot rectifies the Pilot's logits for enhanced generation.

2505.16927.tldr: This work employs a form of posterior-regularized Monte Carlo Expectation-Maximization to both identify a condensed set of the most effective latent principles and teach the LM to strategically invoke them in order to intrinsically refine its responses.

2506.03662.tldr: A novel zero-shot TIL approach dubbed EgoLoc to locate the timings of grasp actions for human-object interaction in egocentric videos, which achieves better temporal interaction localization for egocentric videos compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2506.07853.tldr: This paper proposes a structured, temporal modeling pattern grounded in the LRMoo ontology, and demonstrates that the architecture enables the exact reconstruction of any part of a legal text as it existed on a specific date.

2506.10521.tldr: The Scientists'First Exam (SFE) benchmark is presented, designed to evaluate the scientific cognitive capacities of MLLMs through three interconnected levels: scientific signal perception, scientific attribute understanding, scientific comparative reasoning.

2506.11331.tldr: MUDAS efficiently adapts models by selectively retraining the classifier in situ using high-confidence data, minimizing computational and memory requirements to suit on-device deployment, achieving good performance in a resource-constrained IoT setting.

2506.18588.tldr: This framework leverages a system of stochastic differential equations (SDEs) to capture both deterministic and stochastic forces and sheds light on how noisy supervision, parameter initialization, batch size, and mini-batch sampling trajectories, among other factors, shape the evolution of the Lipschitz continuity of neural networks.

2506.20893.tldr: A new fine-tuning objective is proposed that mitigates privacy leakage in class unlearning evaluations by approximating, for forget-class inputs, the distribution over the remaining classes that a retrained-from-scratch model would produce.

2507.10624.tldr: It is argued that LLMs function as powerful pattern completion engines, but lack the architectural scaffolding for principled, compositional reasoning, and delineate the boundary of current LLM capabilities and motivate future models with metacognitive control, principle lifting, and structurally grounded execution.

2507.11017.tldr: FOEM, a novel PTQ method that explicitly incorporates first-order gradient terms to improve quantization error compensation, is proposed, and it is revealed that FOEM consistently outperforms the classical GPTQ method.

2507.14642.tldr: The goal of this study is to streamline story point estimation by evaluating a comparative learning-based framework for calibrating project-specific story point prediction models and finding the approach is more efficient than regression-based approaches.

2507.21383.tldr: This study introduces a hybrid LNN and XGBoost model to optimize ordering strategies in multi-tier supply chains, leveraging LNN's dynamic feature extraction and XGBoost's global optimization capabilities to mitigate the bullwhip effect and enhance cumulative profitability.

2507.23318.tldr: FastDriveVLA is proposed, a novel reconstruction-based vision token pruning framework designed specifically for autonomous driving that includes a plug-and-play visual token pruner called ReconPruner, which prioritizes foreground information through MAE-style pixel reconstruction.

2508.03404.tldr: MACT is introduced, a Multi-Agent Collaboration framework with agent-wise adaptive Test-time scaling that pioneers a paradigm shift to procedural scaling, adapting dynamically to the functional entities of visual documents understanding and reasoning.

2508.19257.tldr: This work proposes Temporal Token Fusion (TTF), a training-free approach that intelligently integrates historical and current visual representations to enhance VLA inference quality, and reveals that selective Query matrix reuse in attention mechanisms enhances rather than compromises performance.

2509.00625.tldr: By combining the flexibility of language-based agents with the reliability of compiled execution, NetGent provides a scalable foundation for generating the diverse, repeatable datasets needed to advance ML in networking.

2509.01348.tldr: A simple penalty expression is introduced and the resulting QUBO formulation is relaxed into a differentiable advanced torrential loss function through an approximation process, which demonstrates its superiority through the Lipschitz constant, forecast performance evaluations, consistency experiments, and ablation studies with the operational model.

2509.07733.tldr: A chatbot interface that allows users to interactively explore the carbon impact of composite meals and relate the results to familiar activities and a methodology that combines advances in LCA and publicly available databases with knowledge-augmented AI techniques to estimate cradle-to-gate carbon footprints of food products are presented.

2509.09168.tldr: This paper presents a training-free framework for adaptive token merging in pretrained vision transformers to jointly reduce inference time and transmission resource usage, and forms the selection of per-layer merging proportions as a multi-objective optimization problem to balance accuracy and computational cost.

2509.14657.tldr: A defence-in-depth architecture comprising a security protocol that treats the edge device, cellular network and cloud backend as three separate trust domains, linked by TPM-based remote attestation and mutually authenticated TLS 1.3.

2509.15901.tldr: FRAME, a modular pipeline that reframes summarization as a semantic enrichment task, and proposes P-MESA, a multi-dimensional, reference-free evaluation framework to assess if a summary fits a target reader.

2509.24967.tldr: Extensive experiments show that, by leveraging additional compute at inference, SecInfer effectively mitigates both existing and adaptive prompt injection attacks, outperforming state-of-the-art defenses as well as existing inference-time scaling approaches.

2510.06188.tldr: A dialect-aware ASR system, BRDialect, developed by fine-tuning the IndicWav2Vec model in ten Bengali regional dialects is introduced, which outperforms the baseline ASR models by 12.41-33.98% on the RegSpeech12 dataset.

2510.08068.tldr: Back-testing on Bitcoin price data from July 2024 to April 2025 shows consistent outperformance across market regimes, demonstrating that verbal feedback represents a new, scalable, and low-cost approach of tuning LLMs for financial goals.

2510.09719.tldr: A novel routing method using in-context vectors to represent model capabilities that achieves state-of-the-art routing performance in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks and allows for seamless integration of new models without retraining the router.

2510.12732.tldr: This work proposes CLUTCH, a novel deep combinatorial bandit that can observe variable length JavaScript test case representations, using an attention mechanism from deep learning and shows that CLUTCH increases efficiency in JavaScript fuzzing compared to three state-of-the-art solutions by increasing the number of valid test cases and coverage-per-testcase.

2510.14683.tldr: Improvements to COUP are presented, bringing theoretically-grounded, utilitarian algorithm configuration to the point where it is competitive with widely used, heuristic configuration procedures that offer no performance guarantees.

2510.21244.tldr: A practical, extensible, and domain-oriented standard for benchmarking LLMs in professional applications, and introduces a dynamic evaluation method that adapts to task variations, integrating automated and human-in-the-loop assessment to measure task execution accuracy, professional knowledge application, adaptability, and user experience quality.

2510.23049.tldr: This note reconciles two seemingly distinct approaches to policy gradient optimization for the Pass@K objective in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards: direct REINFORCE-style methods, and advantage-shaping techniques that directly modify GRPO.

2510.26023.tldr: StuckSolver is a novel Large Language Model (LLM) driven recovery framework that enables AVs to resolve immobilization scenarios through self-reasoning and/or passenger-guided decision-making and exhibits further improvements when passenger guidance is incorporated.

2510.27102.tldr: This paper offers a framework for ERA-based exploratory evaluation of generative audio models by adapting ERA to text-to-audio models, making the analysis tractable by looking at the expressive range of outputs for specific, fixed prompts.

2511.00098.tldr: This work proposes a filter functionality on CLE video sequences to reduce the dataset redundancy in SSL training and improve SSL training convergence and training efficiency and shows that the proposed CLE video filter can be utilized to improve training efficiency in self-supervised scenarios, resulting in a reduction of 67% in training time.

2511.00108.tldr: A novel framework is established, DPPO (Deliberate Practice Policy Optimization), inspired by human metacognition, inspired by human metacognition to train Pelican-VL 1.0, a new family of open-source embodied brain models with parameter scales ranging from 7 billion to 72 billion.

2511.05394.tldr: An AI-assisted Augmented Reality assembly workflow that uses deep learning-based object recognition to identify different assembly components and display step-by-step instructions and a case study on assembling LEGO sculptures is presented.

2511.05863.tldr: Experimental results show that EMOD achieves the state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating strong adaptability and generalization across diverse EEG-based emotion recognition scenarios.

2511.06285.tldr: FreqRec is proposed, a Frequency-Enhanced Dual-Path Network for sequential Recommendation that jointly captures inter-session and intra-session behaviors via a learnable Frequency-domain Multi-layer Perceptrons and is optimized under a composite objective that combines cross entropy with a frequency-domain consistency loss.

2511.06292.tldr: This work introduces a self-improving prompt framework driven by data-augmented optimization that steadily improves prompt accuracy on financial reasoning tasks without needing external labels, and achieves higher performance in both accuracy and robustness than standard prompt methods.
