2511.06606.tldr: SPUR provides a simple recipe that transforms monaural LALMs into spatially aware models and consistently improves spatial QA and multi-speaker attribution while preserving general audio understanding.

2511.07095.tldr: This paper studies the data complexity of querying inconsistent weighted description logic (DL) knowledge bases under recently-introduced cost-based semantics and establishes that certain answers for instance queries and possible answers for conjunctive queries can be computed using first-order rewriting and thus enjoy the lowest possible data complexity.

2511.07943.tldr: Experimental results indicate that with as few as several hundred training samples, the performance of Thinker is competitive with established baselines, and when scaled to the full training set, Thinker significantly outperforms these methods across various datasets and model sizes.

2511.08015.tldr: This work employs a two-stage approach, termed Road-Style Adversary Generation and Scenario-Associated Adaptation, to maximize the attack effectiveness on the input scene while ensuring the natural appearance of the poster, allowing the attack to be carried out stealthily without drawing human attention.

2511.08086.tldr: The results indicate that global sparsity is rare, but instead the tasks show local, state-dependent sparsity in their dynamics and this sparsity exhibits distinct structures, appearing in temporally localized clusters and affecting specific subsets of state dimensions.

2511.08136.tldr: This paper proposes a novel approach, SafeMIL, to learn a parameterized cost that predicts if the state-action pair is risky via Multiple Instance Learning, and uses the learned cost to avoid non-preferred behaviors, resulting in a policy that prioritizes safety.

2511.08172.tldr: This work introduces an efficient training pipeline that combines model-based data filtering with parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enabling compact yet capable multimodal reasoning agents.

2511.08464.tldr: Results demonstrate that CIG yields more informative attributions both quantitatively, using MIL-AIC and MIL-SIC, and qualitatively, through visualizations that align closely with ground truth tumor regions, underscoring its potential for interpretable and trustworthy WSI-based diagnostics.

2511.08544.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive theory of JEPAs and instantiates it in LeJEPA, a lean, scalable, and theoretically grounded training objective, and introduces a novel objective to constrain embeddings to reach that ideal distribution.

2511.08628.tldr: This work proposes a topology-driven multi-subspace fusion framework that enables adaptive subspace collaboration on the Grassmannian manifold and successfully adapts the proven multi-channel interaction philosophy of Euclidean networks to non-Euclidean domains, achieving superior discriminability and interpretability.

2511.09133.tldr: This paper argues that a multifaceted understanding of humor is necessary and addresses this gap by systematically evaluating LLMs through the lens of Oogiri, a form of Japanese improvisational comedy games, and releases the annotated corpus to the community to pave the way for the development of more emotionally intelligent and sophisticated conversational agents.

2511.09914.tldr: This paper organizes the original dataset according to document attributes and generates a large-scale dataset comprising 360k training QA pairs and 10k testing QA pairs, develops domain-specific multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) and explores the impact of multimodal inputs on task performance.

2511.09923.tldr: Triangular-Distribution ES (TD-ES) is proposed, which pairs bounded triangular noise with a centered-rank finite-difference estimator to deliver stable, parallelizable, gradient-free updates and preserves early sample efficiency while enabling robust late-stage gains.

2511.10002.tldr: This paper presents the framework "PustakAI" for the design and evaluation of a novel question-answering dataset"NCERT-QA"aligned with the NCERT curriculum for English and Science subjects of grades 6 to 8, and analyzes the strengths and limitations of current open-source LLMs and high-end LLMs as AI-based learning tools in formal education systems.

2511.10067.tldr: Multifaceted Self-Refinement (MuSeR) is proposed, a data-driven approach that enhances LLMs' context-awareness along three key facets (decision-making, communication, and safety) through self-evaluation and refinement through self-evaluation and refinement.

2511.10480.tldr: STAGE is introduced, a framework that synthesizes high-fidelity execution graphs to accurately model distributed AI workloads (including LLMs and MoEs) and supports a comprehensive set of parallelization strategies, allowing users to systematically explore a wide spectrum of model architectures and system configurations.

2511.10628.tldr: This work introduces Instella, a family of fully open three billion parameter language models trained entirely on openly available data and codebase and releases two specialized variants: Instella-Long, capable of handling context lengths up to 128K tokens, and Instella-Math, a reasoning-focused model enhanced through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning on mathematical tasks.

2511.10650.tldr: This work presents an unsupervised cycle detection framework that combines structural and semantic analysis that first applies computationally efficient temporal call stack analysis to identify explicit loops and then leverages semantic similarity analysis to uncover subtle cycles characterized by redundant content generation.

2511.10651.tldr: This work proposes a method that first decomposes the complex task into several sub-tasks and designs effective system prompts and user prompts for each sub-task to enable structured data extraction as well as multi-step analysis and evaluation.

2511.10652.tldr: This work transforms biographical data into 1,774 enriched first-person memories with affective-semantic metadata, then employs two-stage retrieval achieving 0.52s prompt generation, offering a practical framework for educational, museum, and research applications requiring both accuracy and efficiency.

2511.10653.tldr: This work presents the first hybrid quantum-classical large language model (LLM) for natural language generation, HyQuT, capable of performing coherent and context-aware dialogue and providing an early demonstration of the feasibility of integrating quantum computing to large-scale generative language models.

2511.10654.tldr: It is demonstrated that temporal constraint satisfaction cannot be reliably learned through next-token prediction on natural language, even with targeted fine-tuning, and deploying such systems in time-critical applications without hybrid architectures incorporating symbolic reasoning modules represents unacceptable risk.

2511.10655.tldr: This work extends the Spectral NSR framework with modular, semantically grounded preprocessing steps that improve graph quality without altering the core spectral reasoning engine, resulting in a more robust, interpretable, and scalable reasoning system suitable for deployment in open-domain and real-world settings.

2511.10656.tldr: A novel framework named PRO is proposed, i.e., PReference Orchestrator, which features a lightweight preference adapter that automatically infers prompt-specific preference weights during both training and deployment phases, and theoretical analysis proving that the prompt-aware preference mechanism achieves superior performance compared to fixed preference weights in multi-objective alignment scenarios.

2511.10658.tldr: These findings show that open-weight LLMs can extract structured data from clinical reports across diseases, languages, and institutions, offering a scalable approach for clinical data curation.

2511.10660.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that performs Test-Time Steering via a Weighted Product of Experts (wPoE) and adaptively combines a universal compression model with a pretrained neural language model, ensuring the compression rate is at least as good as that of the best individual model.

2511.10665.tldr: This work introduces a practical, self-supervised framework for improving the semantic robustness of guard models, which leverages paraphrase sets to enforce prediction consistency using a novel, skew-aware aggregation strategy for robust target computation.

2511.10667.tldr: By analyzing 9 frontier LLMs across 15 diverse decision settings, it is found that most models struggle to achieve consistently strong accuracy across diverse domains; models can be accurate yet globally unfaithful, and there are frequent mismatches between stated rationales and factors driving predictions.

2511.10675.tldr: A two-stage demonstration selection method, TopK + Label Distribution Divergence (L2D), which leverages a fine-tuned BERT-like small language model (SLM) to generate label distributions and calculate their divergence for both test inputs and candidate demonstrations, which consistently outperforms previous demonstration selection strategies.

2511.10676.tldr: This paper utilizes the activations before the attention block in the same layer with 2 linear functions and ranking-aware loss to achieve accurate prediction, which also supports prefetching in the first layer, and proposes pre-attention expert prediction to achieve accurate and lightweight expert prefetching.

2511.10689.tldr: Gender bias dynamics across three generations of recursive text generation are investigated using three complementary evaluation frameworks: rule-based pattern matching, embedding-based semantic similarity, and downstream task performance to demonstrate that semantic similarity metrics may diverge from behavioral fairness outcomes.

2511.10690.tldr: A new perspective on the hidden language of multimodal systems is offered and Reasoning-LLMs are used to uncover unexpected concept relationships that transcend textual and visual similarities, inferring how multimodal systems understand and simulate the world.

2511.10693.tldr: This study investigates whether state-of-the-art text-to-speech systems have internalized the human tendency to reduce speech rate to convey politeness - a non-obvious prosodic marker.

2511.10696.tldr: PiAttention is presented, a periodic sparse Transformer that factorizes attention into ring-local neighborhoods, deterministic $\pi-stride skips, and an adaptive fusion gate, and reveals the importance of periodic skips, adaptive fusion, and head-level sparsity coordination for efficient long-context modeling.

2511.10705.tldr: This work establishes a novel training paradigm for GUI agents, shifting from isolated optimization to an integrated, self-driven co-evolution approach, and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods after just three iterations without requiring external data.

2511.10707.tldr: Bias-REstrained Prefix Representation FineTuning (BREP ReFT) is proposed, which enhances ReFT's mathematical reasoning capability by truncating training data to optimize the generation of initial reasoning prefixes, intervening on the early inference stage to prevent error accumulation, and constraining the intervention vectors'magnitude to avoid disturbing numerical encoding.

2511.10710.tldr: The preliminary experiments on synthetic datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of aggregated precision-recall curves in capturing model approximation uncertainty, enabling systematic comparison among different model architectures based on their uncertainty characteristics.

2511.10714.tldr: This work proposes BadThink, the first backdoor attack designed to deliberately induce "overthinking" behavior in CoT-enabled LLMs while ensuring stealth, demonstrating a new class of sophisticated attacks against CoT-enabled systems.

2511.10716.tldr: An axiomatic analysis of existing quality measures is conducted, uncovering several unintuitive behaviors and introducing a new measure, directed coverage, demonstrating that the choice of quality measure has a decisive impact on the characteristics of the selected set of solutions and that the proposed measure performs competitively or even favorably across a range of settings.

2511.10720.tldr: PISanitizer is proposed, which first pinpoints and sanitizes potential injected tokens (if any) in a context before letting a backend LLM generate a response, thereby eliminating the influence of the injected instruction.

2511.10761.tldr: This work demonstrates an end-to-end differentiable pipeline where a 3D U-Net full-field surrogate replaces both meshing and simulation steps by training it on the mapping between the signed distance field (SDF) of the shape and the fields of interest.

2511.10767.tldr: Novel reductions from argumentation problems to (Q)SAT are designed, linearly preserve the clique-width, resulting in directed decomposition-guided (DDG) reductions, which cannot be significantly improved under reasonable assumptions.

2511.10776.tldr: New counterfactual decision-making rules are studied by introducing two new metrics: the probabilities of potential outcome ranking (PoR) and the probability of achieving the best potential outcome (PoB).

2511.10780.tldr: Tunisian Arabic to English speech translation dataset, the first publicly available Tunisian Arabic to English speech translation dataset, is introduced and the annotation guidelines and corpus publicly available are made.

2511.10796.tldr: A matrix-free perspective is introduced, using trace estimation to rapidly analyze the empirical, finite-width NTK, and shows so-called one-sided estimators can outperform Hutch++ in the low-sample regime, especially when the gap between the model state and parameter count is large.

2511.10804.tldr: A new mathematical model of discounted cuts is introduced, in which the cost of a cut is evaluated by excluding its most expensive edges, and establishes polynomial-time solvability for all discounted cut problems when the input is restricted to bounded-genus graphs.

2511.10810.tldr: This paper presents the Human-Agent Risk Navigation and Event Safety System (HARNESS), a modular AI framework designed to forecast hazardous events and analyze operational risks in U.S. Department of Energy environments.

2511.10837.tldr: A principled evaluation framework is introduced that differentiates between extrinsic and intrinsic hallucination categories and evaluates detection performance across a suite of curated benchmarks and proposes novel attention aggregation strategies that improve both interpretability and hallucination detection performance.

2511.10841.tldr: FlowPath is proposed, a novel approach that learns the geometry of the control path via an invertible neural flow, guided by invertibility constraints that enforce information-preserving and well-behaved transformations.

2511.10842.tldr: This work proposes HyperComplEx, a hybrid embedding framework that adaptively combines hyperbolic, complex, and Euclidean spaces via learned attention mechanisms, and releases the implementation and dataset family to facilitate reproducible research in scalable knowledge graph embeddings.

2511.10845.tldr: It is shown that such networks can resist attacks of a large class of potential attackers and maintain asymptotically optimal welfare post attack, and shows the counter-intuitive result, that attackers that aim at minimizing the social welfare post attack do not actually inflict the greatest possible damage.

2511.10846.tldr: An emergent safety issue of emotion AI reinforcing racial stereotypes through biased emotion classification is found and the need for culturally and dialect-informed affective computing systems is emphasized.

2511.10850.tldr: This work provides an effective approach for merging and transferring specialized skills across evolving LLM families, reducing redundant fine-tuning and enhancing model adaptability.

2511.10852.tldr: This study presents an adaptive DT framework that integrates Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) for physics-aware dimensionality reduction with a Koopman operator for representing nonlinear system in a linear lifted space for the real-time decision-making via model predictive control (MPC).

2511.10857.tldr: A planning support system with agentic AI that enables users to generate demand-oriented regions for disaster planning, integrating the human-in-the-loop principle for transparency and adaptability is introduced.

2511.10860.tldr: HPCAgentTester is introduced, a novel multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) framework designed to automate and enhance unit test generation for HPC software utilizing OpenMP and MPI primitives, offering a more robust and scalable solution for ensuring the reliability of parallel software systems.

2511.10862.tldr: Bangladeshi journalists' high reliance on GenAI like their Western colleagues despite limited institutional support and the near absence of AI policy is found, contributing to understanding how contextual factors shape technology adoption trajectories in non-Western journalism.

2511.10866.tldr: A Short-Window Sliding Learning framework for real-time violence detection in CCTV footages that divides videos into 1-2 second clips and applies Large Language Model (LLM)-based auto-caption labeling to construct fine-grained datasets, enabling precise recognition of rapid violent events.

2511.10872.tldr: Empirical results indicate that leveraging high and low-level intrinsic rewards from the graph encoder-decoder significantly enhances the performance of state-of-the-art GCHRL approaches with an extra small computational cost in dense and sparse reward environments.

2511.10881.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs exhibit format-level negative bias, meaning the prompt format more influences their responses than the semantics of the negative response, and the degree of negative bias can vary depending on the type of prompt, which influences the direction of the response.

2511.10890.tldr: A novel framework that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) as expert guides on the interaction of regional variables to enhance learning of disease progression from irregularly sampled longitudinal patient data and demonstrates superior prediction accuracy and interpretability compared to traditional approaches while revealing additional disease-driving factors beyond conventional connectivity measures.

2511.10892.tldr: This paper proposes Multimodal Cross-Attention Network and Contrastive Learning (MCN-CL) for multimodal emotion recognition, which uses a triple query mechanism and hard negative mining strategy to remove feature redundancy while preserving important emotional cues, effectively addressing the issues of modal heterogeneity and category imbalance.

2511.10896.tldr: An unsupervised pansharpening framework, CLIPPan, is proposed that enables model training at full resolution directly by taking CLIP, a visual-language model, as a supervisor, and forms a novel loss integrating semantic language constraints, enabling CLIPPan to use language as a powerful supervisory signal and guide fusion learning without ground truth.

2511.10903.tldr: These findings highlight the challenges of training complex deep models on limited data and underscore the value of careful data augmentation and simpler algorithms (such as augmented SVM) for Bloom's Taxonomy classification.

2511.10912.tldr: A novel dataset of 176 symptom-diagnosis pairs extracted from House M.D., a medical television series validated for teaching rare disease recognition in medical education is introduced, establishing baseline performance metrics for narrative medical reasoning and providing a publicly accessible evaluation framework for advancing AI-assisted diagnosis research.

2511.10913.tldr: This work highlights a previously underexplored content-centric misuse vector for TTS and underscores the need for robust cross-modal safeguards throughout training and deployment.

2511.10925.tldr: Results show that domain specialization and coordinated reasoning can meaningfully improve legal AI performance, providing a scalable and regulation-aware framework for trustworthy and interpretable automated compliance verification.

2511.10949.tldr: SafeAgents systematically exposes how design choices such as plan construction strategies, inter-agent context sharing, and fallback behaviors affect susceptibility to adversarial prompting, and introduces Dharma, a diagnostic measure that helps identify weak links within multi-agent pipelines.

2511.10958.tldr: TG-DFER is proposed, a text-guided weakly supervised framework that enhances MIL-based DFER by incorporating semantic guidance and coherent temporal modeling, and introduces visual prompts, which align enriched textual emotion labels with visual instance features, enabling fine-grained reasoning and frame-level relevance estimation.

2511.10983.tldr: The theory formalizes how open-ended vision queries can be quantized to MCQs and further binarized into True/False verifications, establishing a hardness ladder.

2511.10985.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive, data-centric analysis of popular open-source DPO corpora, using the Magpie framework to annotate each sample for task category, input quality, and preference reward, a reward-model-based signal that validates the preference order without relying on human annotations.

2511.11006.tldr: A novel Multi-Segment Multi-Task Fusion Network (MSMT-FN) that is uniquely designed for addressing this business demand and consistently outperforms or matches state-of-the-art methods is proposed.

2511.11017.tldr: This work presents a novel approach for integrating multiple databases using knowledge graphs, focusing on the application of large language models as semantic agents for mapping and connecting structured data across systems by leveraging existing vocabularies.

2511.11018.tldr: This work proposes a novel method to enhance diversity in automaton-based structured generation by utilizing automata traversal history to steer LLMs towards novel structural patterns.

2511.11029.tldr: A new incomplete method of breaking the symmetries of abstract structures by better exploiting their representations is demonstrated, and it is shown that this method is faster than the previous methods proposed in this paper.

2511.11034.tldr: This work introduces CrossMed, a benchmark designed to evaluate compositional generalization (CG) in medical MLLMs using a structured Modality-Anatomy-Task (MAT) schema, and evaluates two open-source MLLMs on both Related and Unrelated MAT splits.

2511.11038.tldr: SemanticNN, a semantic codec that tolerates bit-level errors in pursuit of semantic-level correctness, enabling compressive and resilient collaborative inference offloading under strict computational and communication constraints is proposed.

2511.11040.tldr: It is demonstrated that allocating roles with differing viewpoints to specific positions significantly impacts MAD's performance in reasoning tasks, and a novel role allocation strategy, "Truth Last", is found, which can improve MAD performance by up to 22% in reasoning tasks.

2511.11041.tldr: Through extensive experiments, it is shown that renormalization consistently and statistically significantly improves the performance of existing models on the Massive Multilingual Text Embedding Benchmark (MMTEB).

2511.11062.tldr: LiteAttention is introduced, a method that exploits temporal coherence to enable evolutionary computation skips across the denoising sequence and eliminates redundant attention computations without repeated profiling overheads, combining the adaptivity of dynamic methods with the efficiency of static ones.

2511.11065.tldr: This survey provides the first systematic synthesis of DR research spanning 2016-2025, consolidating results from 50+ studies and over 20 datasets and critically examines methodological advances, including self- and semi-supervised learning, domain generalization, federated training, and hybrid neuro-symbolic models.

2511.11066.tldr: A novel SFT paradigm that establishes anatomically-grounded alignment by leveraging auxiliary signals of varying granularities is proposed, highlighting a promising direction for enhancing grounding capabilities in complex, multi-modal generation tasks.

2511.11095.tldr: A novel, yet simple method is introduced that is guaranteed to learn valid generalised plans and state space pruning axioms for search, and demonstrates significant improvements over state-of-the-art (generalised) planners with respect to the 3 metrics of synthesis cost, planning coverage, and solution quality.

2511.11113.tldr: VideoP2R is proposed, a novel process-aware video RFT framework that enhances video reasoning by modeling perception and reasoning as distinct processes and achieves state-of-the-art (SotA) performance on six out of seven video reasoning and understanding benchmarks.

2511.11124.tldr: AV-Dialog is presented, the first multimodal dialog framework that uses both audio and visual cues to track the target speaker, predict turn-taking, and generate coherent responses, achieving robust streaming transcription, semantically grounded turn-boundary detection and accurate responses, resulting in a natural conversational flow.

2511.11125.tldr: It is shown that few-shot prompting approaches are sufficient to solve simple problems in a language that is otherwise not well-supported by an LLM and that is possible on-premise, thereby ensuring the protection of sensitive company data.

2511.11144.tldr: The metamodel provides an abstract representation of fairness, enabling the formal definition of fairness notions, and is used in the Tiles framework, which offers modular components that can be interconnected to represent various definitions of fairness.

2511.11162.tldr: This work proposes a novel I2I translation framework, OT-ALD, grounded in optimal transport (OT) theory, which retains the strengths of DDIB-based approach and eliminates latent distribution mismatches.

2511.11169.tldr: AlignVQA is introduced, a debate-based multi-agent framework, in which diverse specialized VLM -- each following distinct prompting strategies -- generate candidate answers and then engage in two-stage interaction, which yields confidence estimates that more accurately reflect the model's true predictive performance.

2511.11172.tldr: This paper proposes a group recommender system called Group Soft-Impute SVD, which leverages soft-impute singular value decomposition to enhance group recommendations and addresses the challenge of sparse high-dimensional data using low-rank matrix completion.

2511.11182.tldr: The Multi-agent Undercover Gaming (MUG) protocol is introduced, inspired by social deduction games like "Who is Undercover?". MUG reframes MAD as a process of detecting "undercover" agents (those suffering from hallucinations) by employing multimodal counterfactual tests.

2511.11231.tldr: DiT-Gaze is proposed, a framework that enhances 3D gaze redirection models using a novel combination of Diffusion Transformer, weak supervision across gaze angles, and an orthogonality constraint loss to set a new state-of-the-art in both perceptual quality and redirection accuracy.

2511.11240.tldr: HealSplit is presented, the first unified defense framework tailored for SFL, offering end-to-end detection and recovery against five sophisticated types of poisoning attacks, achieving superior robustness and defense effectiveness across diverse attack scenarios.

2511.11244.tldr: A new, real-world AI application for gaze target detection in autistic children, which predicts a child's point of gaze from an activity image and proposes a novel Socially Aware Coarse-to-Fine (SACF) gaze detection framework that explicitly leverages the social context of a scene to overcome the class imbalance common in autism datasets.

2511.11252.tldr: UAVBench establishes a reproducible and physically grounded foundation for benchmarking agentic AI in autonomous aerial systems and advancing next-generation UAV reasoning intelligence, and presents UAVBench_MCQ, a reasoning-oriented extension containing 50,000 multiple-choice questions spanning ten cognitive and ethical reasoning styles, ranging from aerodynamics and navigation to multi-agent coordination and integrated reasoning.

2511.11257.tldr: AIonopedia is introduced, to the best of its knowledge, the first LLM agent for IL discovery, powered by an LLM-augmented multimodal domain foundation model for ILs, which enables accurate property predictions and incorporates a hierarchical search architecture for molecular screening and design.

2511.11258.tldr: This paper presents a scalable and deterministic pipeline for generating natural language QA from KGs, with an additional refinement step using LLMs to further enhance linguistic quality.

2511.11265.tldr: The Software Quality Dataset (SQuaD), a multi-dimensional, time-aware collection of software quality metrics extracted from 450 mature open-source projects across diverse ecosystems, enables empirical research on maintainability, technical debt, software evolution, and quality assessment at unprecedented scale.

2511.11281.tldr: An appropriate notion of contrastive explanations for the special case of ABox reasoning with description logic ontologies is developed, and the computational complexity for different variants under different optimality criteria is analyzed, considering lightweight as well as more expressive description logics.

2511.11286.tldr: D-GAP (Dataset-agnostic and Gradient-guided augmentation in Amplitude and Pixel spaces), improving OOD robustness by introducing targeted augmentation in both the amplitude space (frequency space) and pixel space, consistently outperforms both generic and dataset-specific augmentations.

2511.11287.tldr: VOIX, a web-native framework that enables websites to expose reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving capabilities for AI agents through simple, declarative HTML elements, provides a foundational mechanism for realizing the Agentic Web.

2511.11298.tldr: These findings reveal practical trade-offs among VLA model architectures in balancing precision, generalization, and deployment cost, offering actionable insights for selecting and deploying VLAs in real-world robotic manipulation tasks.

2511.11299.tldr: This work introduces AUVIC, a novel visual concept unlearning framework for MLLMs that applies adversarial perturbations to enable precise forgetting and achieves state-of-the-art target forgetting rates while incurs minimal performance degradation on non-target concepts.

2511.11301.tldr: EcoAlign is proposed, an inference-time framework that reframes alignment as an economically rational search by treating the LVLM as a boundedly rational agent and offering a principled, economical pathway to robust LVLM alignment.

2511.11323.tldr: This work proposes RLSLM, a hybrid Reinforcement Learning framework that integrates a rule-based Social Locomotion Model, grounded in empirical behavioral experiments, into the reward function of a reinforcement learning framework, enabling socially aligned navigation policies with minimal training.

2511.11324.tldr: Quantitative evaluation shows NOVA outperforms coding-agent baselines, and a pathologist-verified case study links morphology to prognostically relevant PAM50 subtypes, demonstrating its scalable discovery potential.

2511.11340.tldr: The Multi-Domain Detection of AI-Generated Text (M-DAIGT) shared task, which focuses on detecting AI-generated text across multiple domains, particularly in news articles and academic writing, is introduced.

2511.11373.tldr: Applied to Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, MarsRL improves AIME2025 accuracy from 86.5% to 93.3% and BeyondAIME from 64.9% to 73.8%, even surpassing Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507.

2511.11393.tldr: This survey systematically reviews recent advances in robust and efficient communication strategies for MARL under realistic constraints, including message perturbations, transmission delays, and limited bandwidth and focuses on three applications involving cooperative autonomous driving, distributed simultaneous localization and mapping, and federated learning.

2511.11397.tldr: This work addresses one of the main challenges when dealing with variational quantum algorithms on general problems, namely designing an expressive and efficient quantum ansatz working on tracking events with fixed detector geometry by employing a quantum architecture search method based on Monte Carlo Tree Search to design the quantum circuits for different problem sizes.

2511.11435.tldr: The Cultural Reference Transformation metric is introduced, which separates two dimensions of model behavior: Recognition, whether a model evokes a reference, from Realization, how it depicts it through replication or reinterpretation, and shows that the behavior of diffusion models in culturally iconic settings cannot be reduced to simple reproduction, but depends on how references are recognized and realized.

2511.11439.tldr: RETROFIT is proposed, which regulates knowledge retention and adaptation with controlled forgetting at each update, without requiring historical data, and achieves over 2x the BLEU score of transfer learning used in prior work and surpasses all baselines in cross-representation generalization.

2511.11461.tldr: It is shown that the structural gap is identically zero for any dataset, and that the estimation variance of the recursive strategy at any horizon can be written as the one-step variance multiplied by a Jacobian-based amplification factor that measures how sensitive the composed predictor is to parameter error.

2511.11468.tldr: The research delves into the robustness of the VLLMs to plausible yet unanswerable questions, and reveals VLLMs'Limitations and demonstrates that VRD-UQA can serve as an evaluation framework for developing resilient document VQA systems.

2511.11476.tldr: Symbiotik is presented, an intelligent, context-aware adaptive visualization system that leverages neurophysiological signals to estimate mental workload (MWL) and dynamically adapt visual dashboards using reinforcement learning (RL).

2511.11502.tldr: The Prelim Attention Score (PAS), a lightweight, training-free signal computed from attention weights over prelim tokens, achieves state-of-the-art object-hallucination detection across multiple models and datasets, enabling real-time filtering and intervention.

2511.11519.tldr: Experience-Guided Reasoner (EGuR), which generates tailored strategies dynamically at inference time based on accumulated experience using an LLM-based meta-strategy -- a strategy that outputs strategies -- enabling adaptation of all strategy components (prompts, sampling parameters, tool configurations, and control logic).

2511.11533.tldr: This work introduces a new ergodic control formulation that optimizes spatial coverage using a volumetric state representation, preserves the asymptotic coverage guarantees of ergodic control, adds minimal computational overhead for real-time control, and supports arbitrary sample-based volumetric models.

2511.11558.tldr: A human-AI collaborative (HAIC) workflow that integrates large language models for hypothesis generation and analysis, with collaborative policy updates driving autonomous pulsed laser deposition (PLD) experiments for remote epitaxy of BaTiO$_3$/graphene.

2308.04371.tldr: This work introduces Cumulative Reasoning (CR), a structured framework that enhances LLM problem-solving by emulating human-like iterative and cumulative thought processes, and demonstrates CR's advantage through several complex reasoning tasks.

2411.02671.tldr: This work focuses on an optimal demonstration selection approach that utilizes latent concept variables for resource-efficient task adaptation and empirically verify that the fair latent variable approach improves fairness results on tabular datasets compared to multiple heuristic demonstration selection methods.

2504.15217.tldr: DRAGON is a new approach to designing and optimizing reward functions for improving human-perceived quality, which can optimize reward functions that evaluate either individual examples or distributions of them, making it compatible with a broad spectrum of instance-wise, instance-to-distribution, and distribution-to-distribution rewards.

2505.11225.tldr: History-Aware Policy Optimization employs a novel length reward function based on this history state to incentivize the discovery of correct solutions that are more concise than those previously found, and avoids overly penalizing shorter incorrect responses with the goal of facilitating exploration towards more efficient solutions.

2506.05628.tldr: An efficient training-free method for navigating and sampling from the molecular space with a generative Chemical Language Model (CLM), while using the molecular similarity to the target as a guide, which outperforms existing training-free baseline methods.

2506.08552.tldr: This work proposes a lightweight post-training framework that refines latent reasoning trajectories using two novel strategies: Contrastive reasoning feedback, which compares reasoning embeddings against strong and weak baselines to infer effective update directions via embedding enhancement; and Residual embedding refinement, which stabilizes updates by progressively integrating current and historical gradients, enabling fast yet controlled convergence.

2506.09105.tldr: This work presents MetaTT, a Tensor Train (TT) adapter framework for fine-tuning of pre-trained transformers, and demonstrates that integrating this approach with AdamW enhances optimization performance for a specified target rank.

2506.10245.tldr: ToxSyn-PT is introduced, the first Portuguese large-scale corpus explicitly designed for multi-label hate speech detection across nine protected minority groups, including the non-toxic counterexamples absent in all other public datasets.

2506.11305.tldr: Results show that Avey compares favorably to the Transformer across a variety of standard short-range NLP benchmarks, while significantly outperforming it on tasks requiring long-range dependency modeling.

2506.23293.tldr: This work teaches us that words arise as a side-effect of emergent symbolic order, and that human language patterns at all structural levels reflect a universal mechanism of word formation (which is subregular).

2508.07208.tldr: This paper theoretically shows that a two-layer transformer with one head per layer can indeed represent any conditional k-gram, and provides the tightest known characterization of the interplay between transformer depth and Markov order for ICL.

2510.13714.tldr: Dedelayed is a real-time inference system that divides computation between a remote model operating on delayed video frames and a local model with access to the current frame, that improves performance on the task of real-time streaming video segmentation using the BDD100k driving dataset.

2510.24796.tldr: This work provides the first large-scale empirical validation of bidirectional desire dynamics in human-AI interaction and establishes mutual wanting as a measurable phenomenon with clear implications for building more trustworthy and relationally-aware AI systems.

2511.05805.tldr: This work theoretically quantify the estimation bias that arises from na\"ively aggregating performance estimates from treatment and control groups and derive the condition under which this bias leads to incorrect model selection, and proposes nuisance parameter weighting (NPW), an unbiased model evaluation approach that reweights data from the treatment group to mimic the distributions of samples that would or would not experience the outcome under no intervention.

2511.10367.tldr: DermAI is introduced, a lightweight, smartphone-based application that enables real-time capture, annotation, and classification of skin lesions during routine consultations that highlights the importance of standardized, diverse data collection aligned with healthcare needs and oriented to machine learning development.

2511.11579.tldr: This work performs a deeper dive into the positional versus symbolic dichotomy of attention heads behavior, both at the theoretical and empirical level, and provides a detailed understanding of RoPE, and how its properties relate to model behavior.

2511.11581.tldr: This work develops a state-of-the-art paged attention kernel that builds exclusively on the domain-specific just-in-time compiled language Triton to achieve state-of-the-art performance on both NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

2511.11583.tldr: RAG-FLARKO is introduced, a retrieval-augmented extension to FLARKO that overcomes scalability and relevance challenges using multi-stage and parallel KG retrieval processes and enables smaller, more efficient models to achieve high performance in both profitability and behavioral alignment.

2511.11584.tldr: Two mitigations are introduced to address two issues of OpenAI's monitorability and task performance, which achieve a Pareto improvement in terms of monitorability and task performance compared to regular training.

2511.11592.tldr: This paper develops a practical off-policy algorithm, DSAC-E, by extending the state-of-the-art distributional soft actor-critic with three refinements (DSAC-T), and proposes a trajectory entropy-constrained reinforcement learning (TECRL) framework to address these two challenges.

2511.11593.tldr: This work considers GNNs with mean aggregation and non-negative weights, proving the precise class of monotonic rules that can be sound for them, as well as providing a restricted fragment of first-order logic to explain any MAGNN prediction.

2511.11594.tldr: This work introduces TimeStampEval, a benchmark for retrieving precise millisecond timestamps from long transcripts given non-verbatim quotes, and improves fuzzy match accuracy by up to 50 points while halving latency and reducing cost per correct result by up to 96%.

2511.11595.tldr: This review synthesizes insights from both domains to identify shared cognitive mechanisms that mediate vulnerability to information-based threats and shape behavioral outcomes, and outlines directions for future research aimed at integrating these perspectives.

2511.11597.tldr: It is argued that bridging this gap between knowledge synthesis and verifiable attribution is essential for the deployment of AI in scientific workflows and that reliable, interpretable benchmarks like CLINB are needed to progress towards building trustworthy AI systems.

2511.11600.tldr: Causal Guard is a new approach that combines causal reasoning with symbolic logic to catch and prevent hallucinations as they happen, and reduces false claims by nearly 80% while keeping responses natural and helpful.

2511.11603.tldr: A comparative analysis of state-of-the-art artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms for resource allocation reveals that hybrid architectures combining multiple artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques consistently outperform single-method approaches.

2511.11607.tldr: The Clustering Orthogonal Weight Modified (COWM) layer is introduced, which can be integrated into the policy network of any RL algorithm and mitigate non-stationarity effectively effectively and improves learning speed but also reduces gradient interference, thereby enhancing the overall learning efficiency.

2511.11608.tldr: SLICER is introduced, a retraining-free, architecture-agnostic framework that compresses IFs to reduce both communication and server load in split computing and attaches to off-the-shelf models without retraining or architectural changes, offering a plug-and-play path to scalable, low-latency distributed inference.

2511.11612.tldr: This study evaluates twenty-one publicly available LLMs on a representative heterogeneous high-performance computing workload mapping and scheduling problem, finding leading models can reconstruct optimal schedules directly from natural language, but most still struggle with precise timing, data transfer arithmetic, and dependency enforcement.

2511.11614.tldr: Field-Programmable Gate Arrays emerge as a reconfigurable platform that allows mapping AI algorithms directly into device logic, and reduces latency and required bandwidth, improves privacy, and frees GPUs from specialized tasks in data centers.

2511.11615.tldr: A transparent, lightweight and fast-to-train associative memory AI model with Hopfield neural network (HNN) architecture that reduces data-to-insight turnaround times and can accelerate decision making in both captive and wild settings.

2511.11616.tldr: An adaptive differential privacy mechanism, wherein the noise level is dynamically reduced based on an evaluation of the measured real-time threat that in turn maximized the privacy-utility tradeoff is proposed.

2511.11619.tldr: DIAP introduces a zero-dependency ZKP deployment model through a universal proof manager and compile-time build script that embeds a precompiled Noir circuit, eliminating the need for external ZKP toolchains.

2511.11621.tldr: AIvailable is introduced, a low-cost, highly available LLM-as-a-Service (LLMaaS) platform that uses a software-defined approach for running LLMs across heterogeneous and legacy GPU nodes, including NVIDIA and AMD devices, with a focus on fully utilizing each node's VRAM.

2511.11622.tldr: It is demonstrated that pretrained models consistently leverage well-designed tokenizers more effectively, particularly at smaller vocabulary sizes, and is suggested that combining small, efficient vocabularies with pretrained weights is especially advantageous in multi-modal forecasting settings, where the overall vocabulary must be shared across modalities.

2511.11623.tldr: A multi-modal deep learning framework that dynamically fuses patient demographics, laboratory tests, diagnoses, and medications, and addresses extreme class imbalance through AUC-based optimization is developed that substantially improves existing approaches for early GVHD prediction.

2511.11624.tldr: This study evaluates the power efficiency of five representative SLMs and concludes that Llama 3.2 provides the best balance of accuracy and power efficiency, while TinyLlama is well-suited for low-power environments at the cost of reduced accuracy.

2511.11625.tldr: This work presents MedFedPure, a personalized federated learning defense framework designed to protect diagnostic AI models at inference time without compromising privacy or accuracy, and shows a significant gain in adversarial robustness.

2511.11627.tldr: This work introduces a new paradigm for efficient, scalable, and physically interpretable full-waveform inversion by proposing a Structure-Aligned Encoder-Mixture-of-Operators architecture for velocity-field inversion under unknown subsurface structures.

2511.11628.tldr: The Adaptive Scheduling Agent (ASA) is presented, a lightweight framework that intelligently matches workloads to the most suitable"expert"scheduling policy at runtime at runtime, and consistently outperforms the default Linux scheduler.

2511.11630.tldr: Among the tested models, the LSTM network achieved the highest accuracy and the most stable performance, maintaining physically consistent predictions over extended horizons while reducing computation time from about 20 minutes per sequence to only a few seconds, whereas the other architectures tended to diverge when forecasting further in time.

2511.11632.tldr: The substructures of classifiers are explored and a novel meta-learning algorithm to learn each classifier as a combination of meta-components is proposed to improve the generalization of classifiers.

2511.11635.tldr: E EduAgentQG, a multi-agent collaborative framework for generating high-quality and diverse personalized questions that outperforms existing single-agent and multi-agent methods in terms of question diversity, goal consistency, and overall quality.

2511.11641.tldr: EcoSpa is introduced, an efficient structured sparse training method that jointly evaluates and sparsifies coupled weight matrix pairs, preserving their interaction patterns through aligned row/column removal.

2511.11647.tldr: Simulation results confirm that the approach maintains high performance while drastically cutting energy costs, demonstrating the potential of transfer learning to enable scalable, adaptive, and environmentally conscious RL-based beam selection strategies in dynamic and diverse propagation environments.

2511.11648.tldr: LTSV, a Lightweight Time Series Valuation on TSFMS via in-context finetuning is proposed, which suggests that in-context finetuning on time series foundation models provides a practical and effective bridge between data attribution and model generalization in time series learning.

2511.11650.tldr: The proposed solution is based on an feature extractor and a one-class Support Vector Machines trained on no-leak data, so that leaks are detected as anomalies and outperforms recent methods for leak detection.

2511.11651.tldr: Incomplete Depression Feature Selection with Missing EEG Channels (IDFS-MEC) integrates missing-channel indicator information and adaptive channel weighting learning into orthogonal regression to lessen the effects of incomplete channels on model construction, and then utilizes global redundancy minimization learning to reduce redundant information among selected feature subsets.

2511.11654.tldr: The primary contribution of this work is the proof that the specific multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm for traffic control is proven to converge under the given conditions extending it from single agent convergence proofs for asynchronous value iteration.

2511.11656.tldr: This work introduces the rifier, a method that exploits an ensemble of randomized decision trees to generate candidate input regions satisfying a desired output property and refines them through active resampling, providing a practical, scalable solution for computing compact preimage approximations in cases where exact solvers fail to scale.

2511.11663.tldr: This paper revisits the challenge of extreme LLM compression from a Fourier frequency domain perspective, and proposes SpecQuant, a two-stage framework that tackles activation outliers and cross-channel variance, and introduces a lightweight truncation module during inference that adjusts truncation thresholds based on channel characteristics.

2511.11664.tldr: A novel lightweight compression framework that leverages Range Asymmetric Numeral Systems (rANS) encoding with asymmetric integer quantization and sparse tensor representation to reduce transmission overhead dramatically, addressing a fundamental bottleneck in deploying sophisticated artificial intelligence systems in bandwidth-constrained environments without compromising model performance.

2511.11665.tldr: This work explores a quaternion-based approach -- Quaternion Rotary Embeddings (QuatRo) -- in place of Euler angles, leveraging quaternions'ability to represent 3D rotations to parameterize the axes of rotation.

2511.11668.tldr: This work proposes RollPE, a novel positional encoding mechanism based on traveling waves, implemented by applying a circular roll operation to the query and key tensors in self-attention, allowing the model to compute attention as a function of positional differences rather than absolute indices.

2511.11674.tldr: This framework posits that future battlefields will be defined by a merger of physical and abstract domains, where human imagination and algorithmic logic become a unified, actionable reality.

2511.11675.tldr: This work proposes a bidirectional pruning-regrowth strategy that starts from an extremely compressed network that satisfies hardware constraints and selectively regenerates critical connections to recover lost performance, effectively mitigating the sharp accuracy drop commonly observed under high sparsity conditions.

2511.11676.tldr: This work introduces Learning with Preserving (LwP), a novel framework that shifts the focus from preserving task outputs to maintaining the geometric structure of the shared representation space, and shows superior robustness to distribution shifts and is the only approach to surpass the strong single-task learning baseline.

2511.11678.tldr: Co-PLMs is proposed, a novel co-tuning framework for collaborative training of large and small language models, which integrates the process of structure-agnostic mutual learning to realize knowledge exchange between the heterogeneous language models.

2511.11680.tldr: This RF-SHAP framework offers a robust, comprehensible, and adaptable method for assessing wildfire risks, enabling informed decisions and creating targeted strategies to mitigate dangers.

2511.11683.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that WPAC outperforms existing pruning criteria in knowledge concentration, and the combination with PIAD offers a strong alternative to state-of-the-art model compression and model expansion methods.

2511.11690.tldr: A dynamic retrieval-augmented modulation module that retrieves high-confidence knowledge from a dynamic knowledge base using the test image feature as a query, and uses the retrieved knowledge to modulate the predictions, and develops a reliability-aware prompt optimization module that incorporates a confidence-based weighted ensemble and cross-modal consistency distillation to impose regularization constraints during prompt tuning.

2511.11691.tldr: This work proposes a framework that overcomes limitations in saliency-based methods by quantifying the magnitudes of cues within salient regions, linking saliency to expert-referenced acoustic cues of speech emotions.

2511.11692.tldr: This work reformulate text-to-3D optimization as mapping a dynamically evolving source distribution to a fixed target distribution, and introduces AnchorDS, an improved score distillation mechanism that provides state-anchored guidance with image conditions and stabilizes generation.

2511.11693.tldr: Experiments show that VALOR significantly reduces unsafe outputs by up to 100.00% while preserving prompt usefulness and creativity, highlighting VALOR as a scalable and effective approach for deploying safe, aligned, and helpful image generation systems in open-world settings.

2511.11702.tldr: This work introduces Task-Aware 3D Scene-level Affordance segmentation (TASA), a novel geometry-optimized framework that jointly leverages 2D semantic cues and 3D geometric reasoning in a coarse-to-fine manner to improve the affordance detection efficiency.

2511.11703.tldr: This project proposes two novel input representations: SS-only and RGB+SS, both employing semantic segmentation on RGB colour images, both employing semantic segmentation on RGB colour images to address the challenges of reinforcement learning in 3D environments with high-dimensional sensory input.

2511.11712.tldr: This paper argues for a specific answer to the question: reasoning is iterative operator application in state spaces, converging to fixed points, and has concrete architectural implications that explain both the failures of current systems and the path to genuine reasoning capabilities.

2511.11719.tldr: The Eccentric framework, based on an adaptation of knowledge from the edge model to the cloud one, reduces the computation and communication costs of the system during inference while achieving the best performance possible.

2511.11725.tldr: The authors' masked autoencoder-based visual backbone incorporates knowledge about the blind spot in human eyes to define a novel masking strategy, which represents a significant shift from standard random masking strategies, which are difficult to justify from a biological perspective.

2511.11730.tldr: This work proposes Graph-guided Representation of Omics and Vision with Expert Regulation for Adaptive Spatial Multi-omics Fusion (GROVER), a novel framework for adaptive integration of spatial multi-omics data and introduces a spot-feature-pair contrastive learning strategy that explicitly optimizes the correspondence across modalities at each spot.

2511.11733.tldr: Decentralized Speculative Decoding (DSD), a plug-and-play framework for decentralized inference that turns communication delay into useful computation by verifying multiple candidate tokens in parallel across distributed nodes, is presented.

2511.11740.tldr: This work proposes ExpertAD, a novel framework that enhances the performance of ADS with Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture and introduces a Perception Adapter to amplify task-critical features, ensuring contextually relevant scene understanding, and a Mixture of Sparse Experts (MoSE) to minimize task interference during prediction, allowing for effective and efficient planning.

2511.11746.tldr: A concise, self-contained derivation of diffusion-based generative models, focusing on transparent algebra, explicit intermediate steps, and consistent notation, so that readers can both follow the theory and implement the corresponding algorithms in practice.

2511.11750.tldr: The proposed IDOL employs the wind field model and dark correlation knowledge of TC to model task-shared and task-specific identity tokens, enabling robust estimation of TC wind speed, pressure, inner-core, and outer-core size under distribution shifts.

2511.11751.tldr: A multi-agent system - Concept-RuleNet that reinstates visual grounding while retaining transparent reasoning and augments state-of-the-art neurosymbolic baselines by an average of 5% while also reducing the occurrence of hallucinated symbols in rules by up to 50%.

2511.11752.tldr: AI-Mandel is a prototypical demonstration of an AI physicist that can generate and implement concrete, actionable ideas in quantum physics, and reveals concrete open challenges on the path to human-level artificial scientists.

2511.11757.tldr: The authors argue students across fields must be taught to responsibly and expertly harness the potential of AI tools to ensure job market readiness and positive outcomes.

2511.11758.tldr: GeoBPE is a geometry-grounded PST that transforms continuous, noisy, multi-scale backbone conformations into discrete ``sentences'' of geometry while enforcing global constraints, and its hierarchical vocabulary provides a strong inductive bias for coarsening residue-level embeddings from large PLMs into motif- and protein-level representations.

2511.11759.tldr: This work uniquely demonstrates the complete attack pipeline targeting elderly populations, highlighting that current AI safety measures fail to protect those most vulnerable to fraud.

2511.11764.tldr: This post-CS1 course that introduces various subfields of computer science so that it integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) includes explicit instruction on how LLMs work, exposure to current AI tools and ethical issues, and studentlection on personal use of LLMs and the larger evolving landscape of AI.

2511.11770.tldr: This work presents a generalizable blueprint for teaching agents to master formal, symbolic tools through interaction, bridging the gap between probabilistic LLMs and the structured world of Knowledge Graphs.

2511.11773.tldr: This work identifies three assumptions that often underpin intelligence-focused evaluation: generality, stability, and realism and proposes generality as a more stable foundation for evaluating capability across diverse and evolving tasks.

2511.11788.tldr: MALBO (Multi-Agent LLM Bayesian Optimization), a systematic framework designed to automate the efficient composition of LLM-based agent teams, provides a data-driven tool for deploying cost-effective and highly specialized multi-agent AI systems.

2511.11789.tldr: This paper presents a systematic investigation into persona-induced biases in multi-agent interactions, with a focus on social traits like trustworthiness and insistence, highlighting an urgent need for awareness and mitigation to ensure the fairness and reliability of multi-agent systems.

2511.11810.tldr: This work assesses definitions of reasoning and how key papers in the field of natural language processing (NLP) use the notion and argues that the definitions provided are not consistent with how LMs are trained, process information, and generate new tokens.

2511.11816.tldr: A novel evaluation protocol is proposed explicitly designed to distinguish genuine semantic-level logical understanding from superficial pattern recognition, memorization, and dataset contamination, and it is shown that state-of-the-art, dialogue-oriented LLMs demonstrate strong NL-FOL translation skills and a genuine grasp of sentence-level logic, whereas embedding-centric models perform markedly worse.

2511.11821.tldr: This work evaluated seven open-weight models on hydropower licensing documentation to provide empirical deployment guidance and establishes the first comprehensive resource-performance mapping for open-weight information extraction in regulatory contexts, enabling evidence-based model selection.

2511.11825.tldr: Experimental results obtained demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves noise reduction, speech intelligibility, and perceptual quality compared to the noisy input signal, achieving performance close to the clean reference.

2511.11828.tldr: This work proposes Conformal Constrained Policy Optimization (CCPO), a training paradigm that integrates constrained policy optimization with off-policy reinforcement learning and recent advances in online conformal prediction to solve the problem of large language models' high computational costs.

2511.11829.tldr: This paper explores the use of a simple LLM-based autoformalizer to verify LLM-generated outputs against a small set of natural language requirements, suggesting that autoformalization holds significant potential for ensuring the fidelity and logical consistency of LLM-generated outputs.

2511.11831.tldr: TopoPerception is introduced, a benchmark that leverages topological properties to rigorously evaluate the global visual perception capabilities of LVLMs across various granularities and finds that even the coarsest perceptual granularity, all models perform no better than random chance, indicating a profound inability to perceive global visual features.

2511.11834.tldr: Investigation of Volatility in Certainty (VC), a recently proposed, label-free metric that quantifies irregularities in model confidence by measuring the dispersion of sorted softmax outputs, reveals a strong negative correlation between classification accuracy and $\log$ (VC) (correlation $\rho\lt-0.90$ in most cases), suggesting that VC effectively reflects performance degradation without requiring labeled data.

2511.11836.tldr: The paper proposed the Confidential Zero-Trust Framework (CZF), a novel security paradigm that synergistically combines Zero-Trust Architecture for granular access control with the hardware-enforced data isolation of Confidential Computing.

2511.11845.tldr: An Autonomous Underwater Cognitive System (AUCS) is presented that integrates Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with a Soar-based cognitive architecture to enable adaptive navigation in complex oceanic conditions.

2511.11857.tldr: A framework that analyzes the sentiment arcs of movie scripts and performs an extended analysis regarding the context of the characters involved in the movie and a custom lexicon based sentiment analysis using LabMTsimple storylab module is proposed.

2511.11880.tldr: It is demonstrated how model architecture, context length, and multimodal inputs jointly determine performance in GPP prediction, guiding future developments of DL frameworks for monitoring terrestrial carbon dynamics.

2511.11885.tldr: Flash-Fusion is presented, an end-to-end edge-cloud system that reduces the IoT data collection and analysis burden on users and enables personas across disciplines to efficiently iterate over IoT data without the burden of manual query authoring or preprocessing.

2511.11891.tldr: FLEX bridges the gap between local recourse and global attribution, supporting transparent and intervention-oriented decision-making in risk-sensitive applications and is compatible with different counterfactual generation methods.

2511.11894.tldr: Chain-of-Generation (CoG) is proposed, a training-free multi-stage latent diffusion framework that yields higher semantic alignment, diversity, and controllability than one-shot baselines, producing molecules that more faithfully reflect complex, compositional prompts while offering transparent insight into the generation process.

2511.11898.tldr: This work adapts the Declarative Self-improving Python (DSPy) framework for structured automated prompt optimization in medical vision-language systems through a comprehensive, formal evaluation, demonstrating significant gains for vision-based applications requiring accurate clinical image interpretation.

2511.11899.tldr: Frame-to-Outcome (F2O), an end-to-end system that translates tissue dissection videos into gesture sequences and uncovers patterns associated with postoperative outcomes, establishes a foundation for data-driven surgical feedback and prospective clinical decision support.

2511.11902.tldr: A novel gradient-free training algorithm, the Bidirectional Subspace Rotation Algorithm (B-SRA), is proposed, which significantly improves the robustness and convergence behavior of BAM and introduces new regularization strategies into B-BP, resulting in models with greatly improved resistance to corruption and adversarial perturbations.

2511.11908.tldr: PI-NAIM is a novel dual-path architecture that dynamically routes samples to optimized imputation approaches based on missingness complexity that enables seamless integration into vision pipelines handling incomplete sensor measurements, missing modalities, or corrupted inputs, providing a unified solution for real-world scenario.

2511.11916.tldr: Results demonstrate that GPT-4.1-Mini consistently achieved the highest overall accuracy across all architectures, indicating a strong reasoning capability, and aligns with recent recommendations, which emphasize that single-run evaluations are fragile and may lead to unreliable conclusions.

2511.11918.tldr: A complete derivation of batch matrix-form backpropagation for MLPs, symbolic validation of all gradient equations, and uniform Python and C++ reference implementations grounded in a small set of matrix primitives establish a validated, extensible foundation for understanding, teaching, and researching neural network algorithms.

2511.11937.tldr: This is the first fully automated end-to-end pipeline for both detecting thyroid nodules on ultrasound images and predicting their malignancy, and suggests that the implicit visual features learned from the localised nodule are more predictive than explicit shape features alone.

2311.00192.tldr: An algorithmic stack that comprises an iterative radial layout optimization procedure to define a global staging layout for the manufacturing facility and a distributed control policy that enables robots to execute the assembly motion plan collision-free is presented.

2403.17101.tldr: A formal machine model for consciousness is developed, inspired by Alan Turing's simple yet powerful model of computation and Bernard Baars'theater model of consciousness, which supports the claim that machine consciousness is not only plausible but inevitable.

2404.02174.tldr: This study addresses critical stability and sustainability challenges within the PinFi protocol, namely: the propensity of LPs to prefer selling in external markets over participation in the protocol; a similar inclination towards selling within the PinFi system rather than contributing as LPs; and a scenario where LPs are disinclined to sell within the protocol.

2405.13746.tldr: This study introduces an innovative approach to compress gradients to improve communication efficiency during LLM FL, formulating the new FL pipeline named CG-FedLLM and developing a novel training strategy that comprises Temporal-ensemble Gradient-Aware Pre-training to identify characteristic gradients of the target model and Federated AutoEncoder-Involved Fine-tuning to compress gradients adaptively.

2405.18248.tldr: A new bandit algorithm (UCB1-Uniform) is proposed that formally proves its regret bound and empirically demonstrate its performance in classical planning.

2406.09422.tldr: The PinFi protocol introduces a distinctive dynamic pricing mechanism that enables providers to allocate excess computing resources to a "dissipative"PinFi liquidity pool, distinct from traditional DeFi liquidity pools, ensuring seamless access for clients at equitable, market-based prices.

2406.16756.tldr: Novel fairness mechanisms are introduced that provably ensure both stability and fairness in performative prediction, validated by theoretical analysis and empirical results.

2407.11077.tldr: Under the symmetry assumption for a Markov Decision Process (MDP), a symmetric data augmentation method is proposed, and augmented samples are integrated into the dataset of Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient to enhance its coverage rate of the state-action space.

2407.12492.tldr: STAD is proposed, a Bayesian filtering method that adapts a deployed model to temporal distribution shifts by learning the time-varying dynamics in the last set of hidden features in the last set of hidden features.

2408.00998.tldr: A novel, concise, and efficient approach that adapts pre-trained large-scale text-to-image (T2I) diffusion model to the image-to-image (I2I) paradigm in a plug-and-play manner, realizing high-quality and versatile text-driven I2I translation without model training, fine-tuning, or online optimization process.

2408.04998.tldr: This paper introduces a novel approach that enhances the fusion process by incorporating both the training and inference modes and introduces ProFuser to progressively transition from inference mode to training mode, providing a more comprehensive assessment.

2408.14398.tldr: The first comprehensive empirical study comparing different calibration languages for pruning multilingual models across diverse languages, tasks, models, and SotA pruning techniques reveals that while calibration on the target language effectively retains perplexity and yields high signal-to-noise ratios, it does not consistently improve downstream task performance.

2409.03060.tldr: This work significantly improves both the size and the generation time of formal explanations in VeriX+, and introduces a bound propagation-based sensitivity technique to improve the size and a binary search-based traversal with confidence ranking for improving time.

2409.12371.tldr: This work proposes FedLoRU, a general low-rank update framework for FL that enforces low-rank client-side updates and accumulates these updates to form a higher-rank model and can adapt to environments with statistical and model heterogeneity by employing multiple or hierarchical low-rank updates.

2409.14830.tldr: Hawk is evaluated with the first large and real-world datasets containing multiple cheat types and cheating sophistication, and it exhibits promising efficiency and acceptable overheads, shorter ban times, higher recall and similar false positive rate compared to the in-use anti-cheat.

2410.06965.tldr: ProFILE, an automated framework to uncover and measure factor-level preference alignment of humans and LLMs, is introduced and a significant discrepancy is found: while LLMs show poor factor-level alignment with human preferences when generating texts, they demonstrate strong alignment in discrimination tasks.

2410.13981.tldr: Transformers as an L2O algorithm can leverage structural information embedded in the training tasks to accelerate its convergence during ICL, and generalize across different lengths of demonstration pairs, where conventional L2O algorithms typically struggle or fail.

2410.16136.tldr: This work proposes a probabilistic model that predicts the joint distribution of the neuronal responses from video stimuli and stimulus-independent latent factors and demonstrates that unsupervised learning of latent factors from population responses can reveal biologically meaningful structure that bridges sensory processing and behavior, without requiring explicit behavioral annotations during training.

2410.22303.tldr: This work revisits the problem of secure aggregation in the single-server setting where a single evaluation server can securely aggregate client-held individual inputs and introduces One-shot Private Aggregation, a model where clients speak only once (or even choose not to speak) per aggregation evaluation.

2410.23320.tldr: This work introduces Lina-Speech, a TTS model with Gated Linear Attention (GLA) to replace standard self-attention as a principled backbone, improving inference throughput while matching state-of-the-art performance and introduces an Initial-State Tuning (IST) strategy that unlocks the possibility of multiple speech sample conditioning of arbitrary numbers and lengths.

2411.00034.tldr: This study is the first to define the correctness of a response based on how the support team at AFAS makes decisions, and contributes a definition and metrics for assessing correctness, and suggestions to improve correctness with respect to regional language and question type.

2411.06098.tldr: This paper systematically examines the effects of key network components on LT handling, such as topology, convolutions, and activation functions, and proposes two convolutional operations optimized for improved performance.

2411.11647.tldr: This work establishes the viability of the shuffle model for secure data-driven decision-making in networked systems by leveraging the emerging shuffle model of privacy, an intermediate trust model that provides strong privacy guarantees without a centralized trust assumption.

2411.12155.tldr: Coarse-to-fine Q-Network with Action Sequence (CQN-AS), a novel value-based RL algorithm that learns a critic network that outputs Q-values over a sequence of actions, i.e., explicitly training the value function to learn the consequence of executing action sequences.

2411.13537.tldr: This work presents the MUSE framework, a framework to integrate metacognitive processes of self-assessment and self-regulation into autonomous agents, and presents two implementations of MUSE: one based on world modeling and another leveraging large language models (LLMs).

2411.13768.tldr: The evaluation-driven development and operations (EDDOps) approach, which unifies offline and online evaluation within a closed feedback loop, supports safer, more traceable evolution of LLM agents aligned with changing objectives, user needs, and governance constraints.

2411.14696.tldr: This work implements a multi-level algorithm that iteratively refines community assignments by alternating between QUBO problem setup and QHD-based optimization, and demonstrates the potential of hybrid quantum-inspired solutions for advancing community detection in largescale graph data.

2411.15218.tldr: Publishers must enforce their policies against undeclared AI usage in cases that are detectable; this is the best defense currently available to the academic publishing community against the proliferation of undisclosed AI.

2412.08098.tldr: The results reveal that LLMs are susceptible to imperceptible coding perturbations, with varying degrees of degradation highlighted across different LLMs, and highlight the urgent need for robust LLMs capable of manoeuvring behaviours under imperceptible adversarial conditions.

2412.11050.tldr: RAC3, a novel framework designed to enhance the performance of VLMs in corner case comprehension, is proposed and demonstrates the effectiveness of retrieval-augmented strategies and cross-modal alignment for safer and more interpretable autonomous driving.

2501.02036.tldr: A novel clustering strategy of gradual community detection that initializes clustering by partitioning samples into many pseudo-communities and then gradually expands clusters by community merging is proposed, demonstrating that the new network perspective can effectively improve community pseudo-label purity, resulting in improved self-supervision.

2501.07251.tldr: The MOS Attack adopts a set-based multi-objective optimization strategy, enabling the incorporation of numerous loss functions without additional parameters and automatically mines synergistic patterns among various losses, facilitating the generation of potent adversarial attacks with fewer objectives.

2501.18577.tldr: Bootstrap confidence intervals are introduced that apply when the complete data is a nonuniform sample and to settings where an arbitrary subset of features is imputed and are valid under no assumptions on the quality of the machine learning model.

2502.05498.tldr: This work presents a novel framework for online learning in Stackelberg general-sum games, where two agents engage in sequential turn-based interactions, and provides a rigorous theoretical basis for regret minimization on the learned manifold.

2502.06728.tldr: FlexDeMo is introduced, whereby nodes fully shard model parameters locally between different accelerators, while inter-node communication is reduced by synchronizing only fast-moving components instead of the full gradients -- resulting in a hybrid sharded data parallel training strategy.

2502.17533.tldr: This work presents an automated framework for the unification of mathematical formulas by linking canonical formulas by Euler, Gauss, Brouncker, and newer ones from algorithmic discoveries by the Ramanujan Machine, and generalizes to other constants, including $e, $\zeta(3)$, and Catalan's constant.

2502.19662.tldr: HALO is proposed, a versatile framework for Hardware-Aware Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) that explicitly incorporates detailed hardware characteristics, including critical-path timing and power consumption, into its quantization approach, and significantly enhances inference efficiency.

2503.00374.tldr: MIRROR, a novel multi-modal representation learning framework designed to foster both modality alignment and retention, is presented, demonstrating its effectiveness in constructing comprehensive oncological feature representations and benefiting the cancer diagnosis.

2503.02104.tldr: This survey explores the potential of foundation models in diverse domains within biomedical fields, including computational biology, drug discovery and development, clinical informatics, medical imaging, and public health.

2503.04789.tldr: Ext2Gen is presented, an extract-then-generate framework that strengthens LLMs via joint evidence selection and answer generation, dynamically identifying query-relevant content while suppressing noise, thereby removing the need for any independent pre-generation compression module.

2503.17798.tldr: GaussianFocus, an innovative approach that incorporates a patch attention algorithm to refine rendering quality and implements a Gaussian constraints strategy to minimize redundancy, is introduced and the capability of the approach to effectively manage and render large scenes, such as urban environments, whilst maintaining high fidelity in the visual output is demonstrated.

2503.19730.tldr: While CamSAM2 only adds negligible learnable parameters to SAM2, it substantially outperforms SAM2 on three VCOS datasets, especially achieving 12.2 mDice gains with click prompt on MoCA-Mask and 19.6 mDice gains with mask prompt on SUN-SEG-Hard.
