2503.23379.tldr: KernelDNA decouples kernel adaptation into input-dependent dynamic routing and pre-trained static modulation, ensuring both parameter efficiency and hardware-friendly inference, and achieves a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency balance among dynamic convolution variants.

2504.04737.tldr: This paper introduces TathyaNyaya, the largest annotated dataset for FJPE tailored to the Indian legal context, encompassing judgments from the Supreme Court of India and various High Courts, and presents FactLegalLlama, an instruction-tuned variant of the LLaMa-3-8B Large Language Model, optimized for generating high-quality explanations in FJPE tasks.

2504.12982.tldr: Swin-VIB is proposed, a novel framework that integrates a pipeline of variational information bottleneck models to adapt the retrieved information difference, facilitating robust response generation of LLMs even in conflicting contexts.

2505.02712.tldr: This study formulate a novel control problem for Boolean network models under the asynchronous update mode, specifically in the context of cellular reprogramming, and devise GATTACA, a scalable computational framework that allows for scalability and effectiveness of the approach.

2505.02781.tldr: This work adapts the PC algorithm to recover only the portion of the graph needed for identifying CDEs, and introduces the local essential graph (LEG), a graph structure defined relative to a target variable, and presents LocPC, an algorithm that learns the LEG using solely local conditional independence tests.

2505.05440.tldr: EcoAgent is a closed-loop device-cloud collaborative multi-agent framework designed for privacy-aware, efficient, and responsive mobile automation, which matches the task success rates of fully cloud-based agents, while reducing resource consumption and response latency.

2505.13191.tldr: A novel hard attention framework that explicitly models the neural hierarchy of human visual processing is proposed, MRAM, which achieves more human-like attention dynamics, but also consistently outperforms CNN, RAM and DRAM baselines on standard image classification benchmarks.

2505.16000.tldr: A newly curated dataset comprising 20k doctor-patient Q&A pairs and 60\% of a 90-million-token crawled corpus from medical magazines is introduced, providing a novel solution for Persian medical AI applications suitable for resource-constrained environments.

2505.16186.tldr: This work identifies a safety aha moment that can activate safety reasoning and lead to a safe response in large Reasoning Models (LRMs), and proposes SafeKey, a method to enhance safety by reshaping internal attention and improving the quality of hidden representations.

2505.16826.tldr: This work proposes Key-token Advantage Estimation (KTAE) - a novel algorithm that estimates fine-grained, token-level advantages without introducing additional models that achieves higher accuracy with shorter responses and even surpass R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B using the same base model.

2505.20334.tldr: Lookahead Q-Cache (LAQ) is proposed, a novel eviction framework that generates low-cost pseudo lookahead queries to better approximate the true decoding-stage queries and achieves more consistent and accurate KV cache eviction aligned with real inference scenarios.

2505.21895.tldr: This work introduces SineLoRA$\Delta, a principled and effective method for delta compression that improves the expressivity of quantized low-rank adapters by applying a sinusoidal activation, and validates SineLoRA across a diverse variety of domains.

2506.00210.tldr: It is demonstrated that REIC outperforms traditional fine-tuning, zero-shot, and few-shot methods in large-scale customer service settings, demonstrating its potential for real-world deployment in adaptive and large-scale intent classification systems.

2506.02949.tldr: The CRDP-KT model provides more accurate and systematic input features for subsequent model training, thereby minimizing distortion in the simulation of cognitive states and improves its ability to express the student's cognition through a weighted fusion of optimized record representations and re lationships learned from a bipartite graph.

2506.03238.tldr: OmniAbnorm-CT, which can automatically ground and describe abnormal findings on multi-plane and whole-body CT images based on text queries, is proposed, which can significantly outperform existing methods in both internal and external validations, and across all the tasks.

2506.05925.tldr: This work introduces an end-to-end, open-source framework that empowers educators using small (3B-7B parameter), locally deployable LLMs for comprehensive teacher support, including customized teaching material generation and AI-assisted assessment.

2506.09883.tldr: Geometric Distillation is proposed, a lightweight, annotation-free fine-tuning framework that injects human-inspired geometric cues into pretrained VLMs without modifying their architecture, achieving improved 3D spatial reasoning with significantly lower computational cost.

2506.10008.tldr: A hierarchical knowledge graph framework for the structured semantic understanding of visual narratives, using comics as a representative domain for multimodal storytelling, by integrating symbolic graphs that encode semantic, spatial, and temporal relationships.

2506.10680.tldr: This paper introduces Saturation Self-Organizing Maps (SatSOM)—an extension designed to enhance knowledge retention in continual learning scenarios that incorporates a novel saturation mechanism that progressively reduces the learning rate and neighborhood radius of neurons as they accumulate information.

2506.13958.tldr: These findings show that intrinsic motivation operates beyond simple exploration bonuses, acting as a representational prior that shapes embedding geometry in biologically plausible ways, creating environment-specific organizational structures that facilitate better decision-making.

2507.00032.tldr: KUL-Rec, a biologically inspired ER system that couples a fast Hebbian memory with slow replay-based consolidation to enable continual, few-shot personalization from sparse interactions, is presented.

2507.00537.tldr: Results highlight that AAT can effectively refine large-scale VLMs with virtually no extra inference cost, while yielding semantically meaningful patterns that align with existing interpretability findings.

2507.00833.tldr: HumanoidGen is presented, an automated task creation and demonstration collection framework that leverages atomic dexterous operations and LLM reasoning to generate relational constraints and employs a variant of Monte Carlo tree search to enhance LLM reasoning for long-horizon tasks and insufficient annotation.

2507.11916.tldr: A parallelized cost-bounded depth-first search framework that can be applied to both IDA* and BTS, significantly improving their performance and demonstrating the strength of the approach on the 3x3 Rubik's Cube and the 4x4 sliding tile puzzle with both classifier-based and regression-based heuristics.

2507.16124.tldr: This work presents a set of privacy-relevant scenarios developed using the Contextual Integrity (CI) framework and aims to explore the extent to which out-of-the-box LLMs are privacy-aware in the context of household robots.

2507.20630.tldr: This work observes that the transition of token representations provides a meaningful signal of semantic information and proposes TransPrune, a training-free and efficient token pruning method that achieves comparable multimodal performance to original LVLMs, while reducing inference TFLOPs by more than half.

2507.22564.tldr: This work proposes CognitiveAttack, a novel red-teaming framework that systematically leverages both individual and combined cognitive biases to generate prompts that embed optimized bias combinations, effectively bypassing safety protocols while maintaining high attack success rates.

2507.22805.tldr: A novel visual framework, MoCHA, that integrates four vision backbones to extract complementary visual features and is equipped with a sparse Mixture of Experts Connectors (MoECs) module to dynamically select experts tailored to different visual dimensions, which outperforms state-of-the-art open-weight models on various tasks.

2508.00709.tldr: This work proposes NyayaRAG, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework that simulates realistic courtroom scenarios by providing models with factual case descriptions, relevant legal statutes, and semantically retrieved prior cases and shows that augmenting factual inputs with structured legal knowledge significantly improves both predictive accuracy and explanation quality.

2508.01742.tldr: INSIGHT is a unified two-stage framework for egocentric action anticipation that focuses on extracting semantically rich features from hand-object interaction regions and enhances action representations using a verb-noun co-occurrence matrix.

2508.02124.tldr: A large body of experimental evidence shows that DMA consistently holds a Pareto advantage over state-of-the-art sparse attention baselines in tasks including scaling laws, multi-query associative recall, standard benchmarks, and needle in a haystack tests, while also delivering up to a 10x overall speedup.

2508.02503.tldr: OptiHive is introduced, a framework that enhances any solver-generation pipeline to produce higher-quality solvers from natural-language descriptions of optimization problems, increasing the optimality rate from 5% to 92% on the most complex problems.

2508.03127.tldr: Landsat30-AU is a large-scale vision-language dataset built from 30-meter resolution imagery collected by four Landsat satellites over Australia, spanning more than 36 years, and is curated through a bootstrapped pipeline that leverages generic VLMs with iterative refinement and human verification to ensure quality.

2508.03294.tldr: It is concluded that supervised learning using LLM uncertainty can help professors better estimate the difficulty of exam questions, improving the quality of assessment.

2508.03661.tldr: The Evo-MCTS (Evolutionary Monte Carlo Tree Search) framework is presented, integrating large language models (LLMs) with tree-structured evolutionary search for interpretable algorithm discovery, establishing a generalizable methodology for automated algorithm discovery in scientific computing.

2508.04511.tldr: ABIDE (Argumentative BIas detection by DEbate), a novel framework that structures bias detection transparently as debate, guided by an underlying argument graph as understood in (formal and computational) argumentation is presented.

2508.05337.tldr: This paper proposes Certainty-Guided Reflection Suppression (CGRS), a novel method that mitigates overthinking in LRLMs while maintaining reasoning accuracy and achieves the optimal balance between length reduction and performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2508.07015.tldr: It is shown that exact HS computations instantiated via PB reasoning can be made competitive with a numerically exact IP solver, and the use of PB reasoning as a basis for HS computations allows for obtaining certificates for the correctness of IHS computations.

2508.08385.tldr: A bilevel modification to MCTS is proposed that runs a best-first search from each selected leaf node with an expansion budget proportional to $d, which achieves amortized runtime complexity for node selection, equivalent to the traditional queue-based OPEN list.

2508.09724.tldr: UDA (Unsupervised Debiasing Alignment), a framework that reduces inter-judge disagreement by dynamically adjusting the Elo rating system, and elevates the performance of poorly performing judges to achieve parity with high-quality ones, fostering a more robust and reliable evaluation ecosystem.

2508.12638.tldr: This work proposes a novel cloud-edge collaborative paradigm for VLMs, termed Context Transfer, which treats the delayed outputs of LVLMs as historical context to provide real-time guidance for SVLMs inference and designs edgeVLM, which incorporates both context replacement and visual focus modules to refine historical textual input and enhance visual grounding consistency.

2508.12845.tldr: CAMAR is introduced, a new MARL benchmark designed explicitly for multi-agent pathfinding in environments with continuous actions and allows the integration of classical planning methods such as RRT and RRT* into MARL pipelines.

2508.14031.tldr: This work proposes Prefix INjection Guard (PING), a simple yet effective method that prepends automatically generated natural language prefixes to agent responses, guiding them to refuse harmful requests while preserving performance on benign tasks.

2508.15222.tldr: A training-free agentic system that couples a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with Large Language Models (LLMs) to produce editable Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) programs, which prioritizes qualitative reasoning over brittle numerical estimates and preserves global constraints.

2508.16161.tldr: This work proposes Spatio-Temporal Aware Graph Adversarial Neural Network (STA-GANN), a novel GNN-based kriging framework that improves spatio-temporal pattern validity and generalization and contains an adversarial transfer learning strategy to ensure generalizability.

2508.16839.tldr: This work presents a framework that employs a single vision-language model (VLM) in two complementary, modular roles, and fine-tune the same VLM on specialty-specific datasets so that one model per specialty covers multiple downstream tasks, simplifying deployment while maintaining performance.

2508.17229.tldr: This work investigates the challenges of applying preference-based post-training to generative speech restoration, focusing on how to define a robust preference signal and curate high-quality data to avoid reward hacking.

2508.18982.tldr: This work proposes PAX-TS, a model-agnostic post-hoc algorithm to explain time series forecasting models and their forecasts, based on localized input perturbations and results in multi-granular explanations, which is able to characterize cross-channel correlations for multivariate time series forecasts.

2508.19843.tldr: This SoK presents the first comprehensive study of the emerging LLM fingerprinting, and introduces a unified framework and taxonomy that structures the field: white-box methods are classified based on their feature source as static, forward-pass, or backward-pass fingerprinting, while black-box methods are distinguished by their query strategy as either untargeted or targeted.

2509.00091.tldr: Across 150 debates spanning 15 scenarios and five ensemble configurations, ensembles outperform single-model baselines on a 7-point rubric, with the largest gains in reasoning depth and argument quality.

2509.01110.tldr: NoLBERT, a lightweight, timestamped foundational language model for empirical research -- particularly for forecasting in economics, finance, and the social sciences, exceeds domain-specific baselines on NLP benchmarks while maintaining temporal consistency.

2509.02758.tldr: This article presents an ontology-based framework for annotating and optimizing geometry problem sets, originally developed in the 1990s, and contends that this approach addresses longstanding challenges in representing dynamic, procedurally complex mathematical knowledge, paving the way for adaptive, feedback-rich educational tools.

2509.10122.tldr: A Realism Controlled One-step Diffusion (RCOD) framework for Real-ISR that outperforms state-of-the-art OSD methods in both quantitative metrics and visual qualities, with flexible realism control capabilities in the inference stage.

2509.10517.tldr: The findings indicate that regularization-based FL algorithms like FedProx offer a more robust and effective solution for heterogeneous and imbalanced clinical prediction tasks than standard or server-side adaptive aggregation methods, and provides a crucial empirical benchmark for selecting appropriate FL strategies for real-world healthcare applications.

2509.11838.tldr: This work proposes a probabilistic verification framework that is architecture-agnostic and scalable to high-dimensional input-output spaces and employs conformal inference (CI), enhanced by a novel technique that is called clipping block, to provide provable guarantees while mitigating the excessive conservatism of prior methods.

2509.11947.tldr: This project addresses a critical pedagogical need: offering students continuous, on-demand academic assistance beyond conventional reception hours, and demonstrates how consumer GPUs can enable affordable, private, and effective AI tutoring for HPC education.

2509.12040.tldr: This work comprehensively evaluate several representative OVS/OVRSIS models and reveals their limitations when directly applied to remote sensing scenarios, and proposes RSKT-Seg, a novel open-vocabulary segmentation framework tailored for remote sensing.

2509.12440.tldr: This work introduces MedFact, a challenging Chinese medical fact-checking benchmark with 2,116 expert-annotated instances from diverse real-world texts, spanning 13 specialties, 8 error types, 4 writing styles, and 5 difficulty levels, and reveals the "over-criticism"phenomenon.

2509.19002.tldr: A novel benchmark consisting of 200 travel videos that frames itinerary reconstruction as a challenging task designed to evaluate and push forward MLLMs'geospatial-temporal intelligence, and develops a prototype travel-planning agent that leverages the insights gained from VIR-Bench.

2509.21746.tldr: HyperCore is presented, a robust and adaptive coreset selection framework designed explicitly for noisy environments, that consistently surpasses state-of-the-art coreset selection methods, especially under noisy and low-data regimes.

2509.25230.tldr: This work proposes to use score matching and annealed energy distillation to learn a metric tensor that faithfully captures the underlying data geometry and informs more accurate flows.

2509.25292.tldr: MCPCrawler is designed and implemented, a systematic measurement framework that collects and normalizes data from six major markets and reveals that more than half of listed projects are invalid or low-value, that servers face structural risks including dependency monoculture and uneven maintenance, and that clients exhibit a transitional phase in protocol and connection patterns.

2510.00411.tldr: Proper calibration is essential for leveraging the full diagnostic power of zero-shot VLMs, enabling them to match or even outperform efficient, task-specific supervised models.

2510.02760.tldr: This work introduces Hierarchical Generalized Category Discovery for Brain Tumor Classification (HGCD-BT), a novel approach that integrates hierarchical clustering with contrastive learning and extends contrastive learning based GCD by incorporating a novel semi-supervised hierarchical clustering loss.

2510.06067.tldr: This work introduces CAPTCHA-X, the first real-world CAPTCHA benchmark with reasoning, covering seven categories of CAPTCHAs with step-by-step action solutions and grounding annotations, and proposes a general agentic VLM-based framework that incorporates the models inherent reasoning abilities.

2510.06638.tldr: StaR-KVQA is proposed, a framework that equips IK-KVQA with dual-path structured reasoning traces to provide a stronger inductive bias than generic answer-only supervision, and consistently improves both answer accuracy and the transparency of intermediate reasoning.

2510.08956.tldr: It is found that governance grows by expanding and balancing categories of participation without major shifts in prescriptive force, and whether future AI mediated workflows concentrate or redistribute authority is evaluated.

2510.09114.tldr: A novel membership inference game is introduced that can efficiently audit the approximate worst-case privacy risks of data records and effectively reduces the disparity in group privacy risks, thereby enhancing the fairness of privacy protection in DPML.

2510.12689.tldr: It is found that trustee-style predictions weighted toward long-term interests produce policy decisions that align more closely with expert consensus on well-understood issues, but also show greater bias toward models'default stances on topics lacking clear agreement.

2510.14741.tldr: Dexter is introduced, a data-free framework that employs diffusion models and large language models to generate global, textual explanations of visual classifiers that outperforms existing approaches in global model explanation and class-level bias reporting.

2510.15501.tldr: DeceptionBench is established, the first benchmark that systematically evaluates how deceptive tendencies manifest across different societal domains, what their intrinsic behavioral patterns are, and how extrinsic factors affect them, and how contextual factors modulate deceptive outputs under neutral conditions.

2510.16742.tldr: Results show that the surrogate model and XAI coupling enables large-scale exploration in seconds, uncovers nonlinear interactions and emergent behaviors, identifies key design and policy levers, and signals regions where surrogates require more data or alternative architectures.

2510.17482.tldr: A Range-Adaptive Perception module, in which learnable queries are modulated by the ego vehicle states and enriched with temporal-spatial associations to enable extended-range perception, and a State-Conditioned Forecasting module, which replaces classification-based forecasting with regression-guided formulation, precisely aligning the dynamic queries with the continuity of the 4D environment.

2510.18905.tldr: A 3D optimization framework that jointly calibrates accuracy, cost, and latency within a unified decision space, enabling constraints-aware inference scaling and shows that smaller models, when combined with optimal inference scaling, can match or exceed the performance of larger models at a fraction of the cost.

2510.18988.tldr: This work proposes ACTMED (Adaptive Clinical Test selection via Model-based Experimental Design), a diagnostic framework that integrates Bayesian Experimental Design with large language models (LLMs) to better emulate real-world diagnostic reasoning.

2510.19072.tldr: It is empirically demonstrated that supplying informative spatiotemporal cues to the planner can significantly improve solution quality without exceeding a moderate time budget.

2510.21341.tldr: Magellan is introduced, a novel framework that reframes creative generation as a principled, guided exploration of an LLM's latent conceptual space and shows that for creative discovery, a principled, guided search is more effective than unconstrained agency.

2510.21424.tldr: This work introduces a descriptive caption data set and proposes comprehensive evaluation methods to evaluate VLMs in HAR, and demonstrates that VLMs achieve comparable performance and, in some cases, even surpass conventional approaches in terms of accuracy.

2510.21788.tldr: The use of expert-guided bandit learning is explored and theoretical guarantees for the regret properties in the bandit setting under ideal circumstances are derived, and empirical results are provided accordingly.

2510.22266.tldr: A multi-level machine learning approach to classify the proficiency of 9th-grade and high school students using microdata from the System of Assessment of Basic Education (SAEB) reveals that academic performance is a systemic phenomenon deeply tied to the school’s ecosystem.

2510.22963.tldr: This work presents COMA, a transfer-based black-box attack that optimizes pre-compression perturbations using attacker-side surrogate compressors and backend LLMs to exploit adversarial information loss (AIL), the excess downstream distortion caused by adversarially steering a lossy compressor beyond benign compression alone.

2510.24021.tldr: SelecTKD is introduced, a plug-and-play Selective Token-Weighted distillation framework that shifts the focus from"how to measure divergence" to"where to apply learning" and achieves state-of-the-art results for small models without architectural changes or extra reference models.

2510.24645.tldr: FunReason-MT is presented, a novel data synthesis framework for real-world multi-turn tool use that resolves the complexity barrier in multi-turn FC data by employing Environment-API Graph Interactions to gather varied high-quality trajectories with targeted tool.

2510.25506.tldr: An analysis of the reproducibility of LLM-centric studies, insights into the factors impeding reproducibility, and suggestions on how to improve the current state are contributed.

2510.27176.tldr: Glia is presented, an AI architecture for networked systems design that uses large language models (LLMs) in a human-inspired, multi-agent workflow that generates interpretable designs and exposes its reasoning process.

2511.01668.tldr: A hybrid legal QA agent tailored for judicial settings that integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with multi-model ensembling to deliver reliable, auditable, and continuously updatable counsel.

2511.03138.tldr: A novel safety response framework designed to systematically safeguard LLMs at both the input and output levels, which achieves a significantly higher safety score on public safety evaluation benchmarks compared to the baseline model, TinyR1-Safety-8B.

2511.04128.tldr: An efficient Dual-branch Maritime SORT method for maritime MOT, which attains the fastest runtime among existing ReID-based MOT frameworks while maintaining high identity consistency and robustness to jitter and occlusion.

2511.04260.tldr: Proto-LeakNet is proposed, a signal-leak-aware and interpretable attribution framework that integrates Closed-set classification with a density-based Open-set evaluation on the learned embeddings, enabling analysis of unseen generators without retraining.

2511.04718.tldr: A novel framework featuring Adaptive Cas cade Decomposition to learn task-relevant frequency sub-bands for each brain region and Frequency-Coupled Connectivity Learning to capture both intra- and nuanced cross-band interactions in a unified functional network is proposed.

2511.05156.tldr: SmartSecChain-SDN is a platform that combines machine learning based intrusion detection, blockchain-based storage of logs, and application-awareness-based priority in SDN networks to improve cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and the administration of next-generation programmable networks.

2511.05810.tldr: DiagnoLLM is a hybrid framework that integrates Bayesian deconvolution, eQTL-guided deep learning, and LLM-based narrative generation for interpretable disease diagnosis and shows that LLMs, when deployed as post-hoc reasoners rather than end-to-end predictors, can serve as effective communicators within hybrid diagnostic pipelines.

2511.06568.tldr: It is argued that demographic parity does not meet desired properties for fairness assessment in ranking-based tasks such as link prediction, and a lightweight post-processing method combined with decoupled link predictors is proposed that effectively mitigates bias and achieves state-of-the-art fairness-utility trade-offs.

2511.07046.tldr: Across five MuJoCo tasks, policy networks are obtained that are competitive with full precision (FP32) policies but require as few as 3 or even only 2 bits per weight, and per internal activation value, as long as input precision is chosen carefully.

2511.07998.tldr: This work proposes a self-correction distillation (SCD) method, which achieves the best performance and superior generalization on small-scale LLM (8B) compared to other distillation methods, and closely approaches the performance of GPT4 on some datasets.

2511.08078.tldr: This paper contributes the first approach to effectively compute robust policies subject to arbitrary structural constraints using a flexible and efficient framework and achieves flexibility by allowing to express constraints in first-order theory over a set of MDPs.

2511.08151.tldr: SciAgent is introduced, a unified multi-agent system designed for generalistic scientific reasoning-the ability to adapt reasoning strategies across disciplines and difficulty levels, establishing SciAgent as a concrete step toward generalistic scientific intelligence-AI systems capable of coherent, cross-disciplinary reasoning at expert levels.

2511.08181.tldr: This work proposes MARC, a multimodal and multi-task cocktail recommender system based on Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) utilizing graph database under cold-start conditions and demonstrates that answers generated via the graph database outperformed those from a simple vector database in terms of quality.

2511.08343.tldr: JobSphere effectively fills significant accessibility gaps for Punjab/Hindi-speaking users in rural locations, while also affirming the users access to trusted job content provided by government agencies.

2511.08363.tldr: An AI-powered data visualization platform that automates the entire data analysis process, from uploading a dataset to generating an interactive visualization, allowing for significant reduction of manual inputs to the data analyses process while maintaining a high quality, impactful visual outputs and user experiences.

2511.08496.tldr: HQ-SVC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art zero-shot SVC methods in conversion quality and efficiency, and achieves superior voice naturalness compared to specialized audio super-resolution methods while natively supporting voice super-resolution tasks.

2511.08982.tldr: This work presents the first Graph Neural Network approach to approximate credulous acceptance in ABA, and proposes two GNN architectures - ABAGCN and ABAGAT - that stack residual heterogeneous convolution or attention layers, respectively, to learn node embeddings.

2511.09057.tldr: PAN is introduced, a general, interactable, and long-horizon world model that predicts future world states through high-quality video simulation conditioned on history and natural language actions, taking a step towards general world models that enable predictive simulation of future world states for reasoning and acting.

2511.09073.tldr: This paper proposes a novel GFM state-space reduction technique that significantly reduces the number of automata states, and introduces a direct construction method for formulas of the form $\mathsf{G}\mathsf{F}\varphi$, where $\varphi$ is a co-safety formula.

2511.09275.tldr: HyperD (Hybrid Periodic Decoupling), a novel framework that decouples traffic data into periodic and residual components, achieves state-of-the-art prediction accuracy, while offering superior robustness under disturbances and improved computational efficiency compared to existing methods.

2511.09287.tldr: This work proposes a paradigm shift from"model training" to"model raising", in which alignment is woven into a model's development from the start, so that knowledge, skills, and values are intrinsically much harder to separate.

2511.09292.tldr: Experiments show that C$^3$TG significantly outperforms baselines across multiple metrics including attribute accuracy, linguistic fluency, and output diversity, while simultaneously reducing toxicity.

2511.09829.tldr: A thermally activated adversarial wearable designed to ensure adaptability and effectiveness in complex real-world environments and maintains an adversarial success rate above 80\% across diverse real-world surveillance environments is proposed.

2511.09894.tldr: EgoEMS is introduced, the first end-to-end, high-fidelity, high-fidelity, multimodal, multiperson dataset capturing over 20 hours of realistic, procedural EMS activities from an egocentric view in 233 simulated emergency scenarios performed by 62 participants, including 46 EMS professionals.

2511.10089.tldr: An empirical study across the five most popular open-source T2I models demonstrates that all five models encode and amplify pronounced societal skew: caregiving and nursing roles are consistently feminized, while high-status professions such as corporate CEO, politician, doctor, and lawyer are overwhelmingly represented by males and mostly White individuals.

2511.10218.tldr: A novel Multimodal framework, MTP, for urban Traffic Profiling, which learns multimodal features through numeric, visual, and textual perspectives and designs a hierarchical contrastive learning on the three branches to fuse the spectrum of three modalities.

2511.10338.tldr: A systematic study on the generation and evaluation of synthetic multilingual pretraining data for Indic languages, where a large-scale synthetic dataset BhashaKritika is constructed using 5 different techniques for 10 languages and the impact of grounding generation in documents, personas, and topics is explored.

2511.10390.tldr: This work introduces MonkeyOCR v1.5, a unified vision-language framework that enhances both layout understanding and content recognition through a two-stage pipeline, and proposes a visual consistency-based reinforcement learning scheme that evaluates recognition quality via render-and-compare alignment, improving structural accuracy without manual annotations.

2511.10449.tldr: This work proposes a novel formalism called S4F Standpoint Logic, which generalises both S4F and standpoint propositional logic and is therefore capable of expressing multi-viewpoint, non-monotonic semantic commitments.

2511.10964.tldr: This paper investigates the impact of several data quality issues, including missing values, noisy attributes, outliers, and label errors, on the predictive accuracy of the machine learning model used in credit risk assessment, and introduces controlled data corruption to assess the robustness of 10 frequently used models.

2511.11000.tldr: The proposed DialogGraph-LLM framework demonstrates strong performance and efficiency in intent recognition in real world scenario audio dialogues, proving its practical value for audio-rich domains with limited supervision.

2511.11238.tldr: This work introduces Virtual Width Networks (VWN), a framework that delivers the benefits of wider representations without incurring the quadratic cost of increasing the hidden size and identifies an approximately log-linear scaling relation between virtual width and loss reduction.

2511.11275.tldr: This paper presents the first running workflow supporting the generation of tamper-proof, verifiable and exhaustive traces of AI decisions, and expands the DBOM concept into an effective running workflow leveraging confidential computing technology.

2511.11347.tldr: This review provides researchers and practitioners with a structured framework for understanding privacy vulnerabilities in healthcare RAG and offers a roadmap toward developing systems that achieve both clinical effectiveness and robust privacy preservation.

2511.11560.tldr: This work analyzes S2S and S2A within a unified convergence framework that accounts for key system parameters: sampling rate, server aggregation frequency, and network connectivity, revealing distinct regimes where one strategy outperforms the other, depending primarily on the degree of data heterogeneity across devices.

2511.11569.tldr: It is proved that MSS achieves worst-case MSE within a constant factor of state-of-the-art protocols such as SS and ProjectiveGeometryResponse (PGR) while avoiding the algebraic prerequisites and dynamic-programming decoder required by PGR.

2511.11945.tldr: This paper proposes a novel data augmentation method, that treats the predictive problems around climate change as being, in part, due to class-imbalance issues; that is, prediction from historical datasets is difficult because, by definition, they lack sufficient minority-class instances of climate outlier events.

2511.11947.tldr: The experiments demonstrate that the AIObased SA architecture is sensitive to mobility, even at low speeds, but this limitation can be mitigated through AI-driven KPI forecasting, and a concise overview of the state-of-the-art architectures for Open-RAN and AIRAN is provided.

2511.11951.tldr: A transformer-based architecture that processes stacked range-velocity-angle (RVA) spatiotemporal tensors via patch embeddings and cross-axis attention mechanisms to explicitly model the sequential nature of MDS data across multiple frames is designed.

2511.11954.tldr: These findings show that LLM-assisted formalization, anchored in symbolic logic, enables transparent and reliable statutory inconsistency detection, and is capable of autonomously identifying inconsistencies.

2511.11992.tldr: Results show that the proposed decentralized, goal-driven MARL framework significantly improves task success rates and reduces time-to-goal compared to non-cooperative baselines, and task performance remains stable as the number of agents increases, demonstrating scalability.

2511.12006.tldr: SIT-ADDA improves reconstruction and downstream segmentation over full-encoder adaptation and non-adversarial baselines, with reduced drift of semantic features, and is introduced with robustness via multi-metric evaluation, blinded expert assessment, and uncertainty-depth ablations.

2511.12008.tldr: RECAP-PATH is presented, an interpretable framework that establishes a self-learning paradigm, shifting off-the-shelf multimodal large language models from passive pattern recognition to evidence-linked diagnostic reasoning, and provides clinically trustworthy AI and demonstrates a generalizable path toward evidence-linked interpretation.

2511.12027.tldr: GCAgent is introduced, a novel Global-Context-Aware Agent framework that achieves comprehensive long-video understanding and establishes state-of-the-art performance among comparable 7B-scale MLLMs, validating the agent-based reasoning paradigm and structured memory for cognitively-inspired long-video understanding.

2511.12031.tldr: This work proposes a new KV cache allocation mechanism called Balancing Memory and Compute (BMC), and makes an interesting observation that the extra rows allocated in the KV tensors and the resulting redundant computation can be repurposed for Speculative Decoding (SD) that improves token generation efficiency.

2511.12036.tldr: This work demonstrates that language models can be optimized for multiple design objectives using a single, unified reward signal through Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and is the first demonstration of preference-tuning a language model using physics-grounded feedback for structural alloy design.

2511.12046.tldr: BackWeak shows that a powerful backdoor can be implanted by simply fine-tuning a benign teacher with a weak trigger using a very small learning rate, and calls on researchers studying KD backdoor attacks to pay particular attention to the trigger's potential adversarial characteristics.

2511.12047.tldr: DCMM-Transformer is presented, a novel ViT architecture for medical image analysis that incorporates a Degree-Corrected Mixed-Membership (DCMM) model as an additive bias in self-attention and substantially enhance interpretability.

2511.12052.tldr: This study presents a scientometric analysis of AI-driven steganography-based data hiding techniques using a thematic modelling approach, and breaks down the underlying causes of observed trends, including the influence of DL developments, trends in East Asia and maturity of foundational methods.

2511.12056.tldr: A novel pipelining frame- work named PipeDiT is proposed to accelerate video generation, which is equipped with three main innovations, including a pipelining algorithm for sequence parallelism (SP) to enable the computation of latent generation and commu- nication among multiple GPUs to be pipelined, thus reduc- ing inference latency.

2511.12072.tldr: This paper introduces ProAV-DiT, a Projected Latent Diffusion Transformer designed for efficient and synchronized audio-video generation, which efficiently models spatiotemporal dependencies, enabling the generation of high-fidelity synchronized audio-video content while reducing computational overhead.

2511.12075.tldr: TreatStitch is proposed, a novel data augmentation framework that generates clinically valid treatment trajectories by intelligently stitching segments from existing treatment data by augmenting these synthetic trajectories into the original dataset so offline RL can learn from a more diverse dataset, thereby improving its ability to optimize ATS.

2511.12089.tldr: The KrwEmd algorithm is developed, which clusters signal observation infosets using earth mover's distance to measure discrepancies between their features, and significantly improves AI gameplay performance compared to existing algorithms.

2511.12113.tldr: This work proposes a comprehensive solution that alleviates catastrophic forgetting from both the data and fine-tuning approach perspectives and introduces GDPO (Group Direction Preference Optimization), which enables more effective knowledge transfer from the large model and constrains excessive parameter drift.

2511.12116.tldr: LLMLagBench is introduced, an LLM freshness benchmark, as a systematic approach for identifying the earliest probable temporal boundaries of an LLM's training data by evaluating its knowledge of recent events.

2511.12131.tldr: Object Attribute Description Promoter (OAD-Promoter) is proposed, a novel approach for enhancing LLM-based VQA by mitigating language bias and improving domain-shift robustness, and is demonstrated to significantly improves the performance of LLM-based VQA methods in few-shot or zero-shot settings.

2511.12149.tldr: BackdoorVLA is introduced, a targeted backdoor attack that compels a VLA to execute an attacker-specified long-horizon action sequence whenever a trigger is present, providing a standardized framework for evaluating VLA vulnerabilities and demonstrating the potential for precise adversarial manipulation.

2511.12154.tldr: This work introduced a multimodal foundational model for financial transactions that integrates both structured attributes and unstructured textual descriptions into a unified representation that outperforms classical feature engineering and discrete event sequence methods but is also particularly effective in data-scarce Open Banking scenarios.

2511.12175.tldr: The proposed system integrates real time sensor data, machine learning based fault prediction, and cost aware operational analytics to improve reliability and energy efficiency in distributed microgrid environments to improve reliability and energy efficiency in distributed microgrid environments.

2511.12203.tldr: A two stage process that returns locally optimal obstacle displacements to enable a feasible path for the robot is proposed that successfully demonstrates the approach on two distinct classes of constraint displacement problems.

2511.12206.tldr: An AI-powered system to automate traffic violation detection, significantly enhancing enforcement efficiency and road safety and leveraging YOLOv8 for robust object detection and EasyOCR for license plate recognition is presented.

2511.12212.tldr: The results validate the practical value of SSIMMap for objective blur assessment and denoising parameter tuning and show that SSIMMap is more sensitive to blur and local intensity transitions and complements SSIMImg.

2511.12213.tldr: MME-RAG is introduced, a Multi-Manager-Expert Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework that decomposes entity recognition into two coordinated stages: type-level judgment by lightweight managers and span-level extraction by specialized experts.

2511.12214.tldr: ViTE (Virtual graph Trajectory Expert router), a novel framework for pedestrian trajectory prediction, consists of a Virtual Graph that introduces dynamic virtual nodes to model long-range and high-order interactions without deep GNN stacks, and an Expert Router that adaptively selects interaction experts based on social context using a Mixture-of-Experts design.

2511.12236.tldr: Rigorous empirical evaluation on multiple datasets shows that CONFACTCHECK can detect hallucinated facts efficiently using fewer resources and achieves higher accuracy scores compared to existing baselines that operate under similar conditions.

2511.12239.tldr: This paper uses case studies from the philosophy of science literature to critically examine whether the world model framework adequately characterizes human-level understanding, and focuses on specific philosophical analyses where the distinction between world model capabilities and human understanding is most pronounced.

2511.12241.tldr: Augmented Unplanned Removal Alert (AURA) is proposed, a vision-based risk detection system developed and validated entirely on a fully synthetic video dataset that demonstrates a novel pathway for developing privacy-preserving, reproducible patient safety monitoring systems with potential for deployment in intensive care settings.

2511.12248.tldr: The proposed Deep Unfolded BM3D (DU-BM3D), a hybrid framework that unrolls BM3D into a trainable architecture by replacing its fixed collaborative filtering with a learnable U-Net denoiser, preserves BM3D's non-local structural prior while enabling end-to-end optimization.

2511.12256.tldr: A prompt-conditioned framework built on MedSigLIP that injects textual priors via Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) and multi-scale pooling that combines global, local, and texture-aware pooling through separate regression heads fused by a lightweight MLP.

2511.12265.tldr: An efficient fine-tuning method called Calibrated Adversarial Sampling (CAS) is proposed, which dynamically designs rewards and balances exploration and exploitation by considering the dynamic and interdependent characteristics of multiple robustness dimensions within the multi-armed bandit framework.

2511.12271.tldr: These findings establish that LLM agents can be systematically trained to internalize and apply specific moral frameworks to novel situations, providing a critical foundation for AI safety as language models become more integrated into human decision-making processes.

2511.12286.tldr: Sangam is proposed, a CXL-attached PIM-chiplet based memory module that can either act as a drop-in replacement for GPUs or co-executes along side the GPUs.

2511.12301.tldr: The frequency misalignment between real and synthesized images is identified as one of the key factors underlying unreliable GDA and the Frequency Recalibration (FreRec) method is proposed to reduce the frequency distributional discrepancy and thus improve GDA.

2511.12309.tldr: The first comprehensive analysis of SC's scaling behavior and its variants is provided, drawing on mode estimation and voting theory, and Blend-ASC, a novel variant of self-consistency that dynamically allocates samples to questions during inference, achieves state-of-the-art sample efficiency.

2511.12321.tldr: This work proposes a simple yet effective framework that equips standard feedforward classifiers with temporal reasoning, all without modifying model architectures or introducing recurrent modules, using a novel Support-Exemplar-Query (SEQ) learning paradigm.

2511.12342.tldr: For single-camera systems, back-projection yields more accurate trajectory classification and turning movement counts and it is shown that even higher accuracy can be achieved through weak fusion of back-projected detections from multiple cameras.

2511.12351.tldr: A deep reinforcement learning framework that combines a Variational Autoencoder, an LSTM-based Deep Q-Network, dynamic reward shaping, and an active learning module to address issues in a unified learning framework for accurate and scalable anomaly detection in real-world multivariate systems is presented.

2511.12359.tldr: This paper formally introduces a class of computational-rational user models for cognitively-bounded agents acting optimally under biased beliefs, and proposes an efficient online inference method based on nested particle filtering that simultaneously tracks the user's latent belief state and estimates the unknown cognitive bound from a stream of observed actions.

2511.12378.tldr: This work introduces a framework that dynamically learns and adapts to varying suggester reliability in partially observable environments, and introduces an explicit ``ask''action allowing agents to strategically request suggestions at critical moments, balancing informational gains against acquisition costs.

2511.12379.tldr: The Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) is outlined as a generalization of the QAOA, highlighting its potential in the NISQ era and addressing challenges such as barren plateaus and ansatz design.

2511.12387.tldr: ILAKKANAM is introduced, the first Tamil-specific linguistic evaluation benchmark manually curated using 820 questions from Sri Lankan school-level Tamil subject examination papers, and results show that Gemini 2.5 achieves the highest overall performance, while open-source models lag behind, highlighting the gap in linguistic grounding.

2511.12400.tldr: MSLoRA is introduced, a backbone-agnostic, parameter-efficient adapter that reweights feature responses rather than re-tuning the underlying backbone, providing a simple and universal approach for efficient adaptation of frozen vision backbones.

2511.12404.tldr: The SynthGuard platform is introduced, an open, user-friendly platform for detecting and analyzing AI-generated multimedia using both traditional detectors and multimodal large language models (MLLMs).

2511.12422.tldr: This work proposes MeanFlow-Incubated ResNet (MFI-ResNet), which employs a compression-expansion strategy to jointly improve parameter efficiency and discriminative performance and demonstrates that generative flow-fields can effectively characterize the feature transformation process in ResNet.

2511.12442.tldr: This work proposes GLFormer, a novel attention-free Transformer-style framework for dynamic graphs that achieves SOTA performance, which reveals that attention-free architectures can match or surpass Transformer baselines in dynamic graph settings with significantly improved efficiency.

2511.12448.tldr: This work introduces SeedAIchemy, an automated LLM-driven corpus generation tool that makes it easier for developers to implement fuzzing effectively and performs significantly better than a naive corpus and similarly to a manually-curated corpus on a diverse range of target programs and libraries.

2511.12449.tldr: MOON2.0, a dynamic modality-balanced Multimodal representation learning framework for e-commerce prOduct uNderstanding, is proposed and MBE2.0, a co-augmented Multimodal representation Benchmark for E-commerce representation learning and evaluation is released.

2511.12460.tldr: Experiments show P3HF achieves around 10\% improvement on accuracy and weighted F1 for binary and ternary depression classification task over existing methods, confirming that personality-guided representation learning and high-order hypergraph reasoning are both essential for generating robust, individual-aware depression-related representations.

2511.12472.tldr: This paper formally defines the serendipity-aware KGQA task and proposes the SerenQA framework, a rigorous serendipity metric based on relevance, novelty, and surprise, to evaluate LLMs'ability to uncover unexpected insights in scientific KGQA tasks.

2511.12480.tldr: This work revisits the image masking approach, proposing to treat masked content as auxiliary knowledge rather than ignored, and proposes MaskAnyNet, which combines masking with a relearning mechanism to exploit both visible and masked information.

2511.12484.tldr: This paper proposes the ADN-Agent architecture, which leverages a general large language model (LLM) to coordinate multiple DSMs, enabling adaptive intent recognition, task decomposition, and DSM invocation, and demonstrates that the ADN-Agent architecture outperforms existing LLM application paradigms.

2511.12485.tldr: A novel task named Latent Reasoning Chain Extraction (ARCHE), in which models must decompose complex reasoning arguments into combinations of standard reasoning paradigms in the form of a Reasoning Logic Tree (RLT), and proposes two logic-aware evaluation metrics.

2511.12491.tldr: This work exploits a dual perspective on FTTA, and proposes Agnostic FTTA (AFTTA) as a novel formulation that enables the usage of off-the-shelf domain transformations during test-time to enable direct generalization to unforeseeable target data.

2511.12494.tldr: This work discovers the significance of proportional information of the observed labels and captures it by an innovative constraint to utilize it during the optimization process, proving the feasibility of the method in learning from hidden labels and theoretically gives the recovery bound of the method.

2511.12497.tldr: SGuard-v1, a lightweight safety guardrail for Large Language Models (LLMs), which comprises two specialized models to detect harmful content and screen adversarial prompts in human-AI conversational settings, achieves state-of-the-art safety performance while remaining lightweight, thereby reducing deployment overhead.

2511.12523.tldr: This paper investigates the impact of perturbations on the best-response-based algorithms approximating Nash equilibria in zero-sum games, namely Double Oracle and Fictitious Play and shows that using such an oracle reduces the number of iterations for both algorithms.

2511.12563.tldr: This work introduces LOBERT, a general-purpose encoder-only foundation model for LOB data suitable for downstream fine-tuning and achieves leading performance in tasks such as predicting mid-price movements and next messages, while reducing the required context length compared to previous methods.

2511.12568.tldr: A significant reduction in time complexity is demonstrated, with only a minimal decrease in model accuracy post-optimization, showcasing the state-of-the-art optimization approach.

2511.12573.tldr: Empirical evaluations show that the proposed causal framework for analyzing and mitigating length bias in RLHF reward modeling reduces length bias in reward assignment and leads to more concise, content-focused outputs from the policy model.

2511.12579.tldr: PCRS-TKA is proposed, a prompt-based framework employing retrieval-augmented generation to integrate PLMs with knowledge graphs, and selectively filters context-relevant knowledge and explicitly models collaborative preferences using specialized supervision signals.

2511.12592.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework built on cryptographic techniques like hashing and zero-knowledge machine learning (zkML) to achieve low latency inference, via a certifiable, early-exit mechanism from an arbitrarily large baseline model, to achieve nanosecond-order latency.

2511.12596.tldr: This work introduces Group-Aware Policy Optimization (GAPO), a simple extension of the recent and popular Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that computes rewards over the group as a whole that enables learning from the group-level properties such as diversity and coverage.

2511.12601.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the method aligns Implicit Neural Representations and Convolutional Neural Networks under both permutation and scaling symmetries without explicitly solving the assignment problem, ensuring that similar networks naturally converge within the same basin.

2511.12603.tldr: PIDLD is introduced, a novel sampling acceleration algorithm that reinterprets the sampling process using control-theoretic principles and achieves higher quality with fewer steps, making Langevin-based generative models more practical for efficiency-critical applications.

2511.12614.tldr: A unified, end-to-end framework that seamlessly integrates object detection and pose estimation with a versatile onboarding process, showcasing its practical applicability in both model-based and model-free scenarios.

2511.12627.tldr: C3Net demonstrates that complex, multifaceted detection challenges require architectural innovation, with specialized components working synergistically to achieve comprehensive coverage beyond isolated improvements.

2511.12630.tldr: Knots is constructed, a high-quality dataset of 12,347 expert-annotated NOTAMs covering 194 Flight Information Regions, enhanced through a multi-agent collaborative framework for comprehensive field discovery and achieves substantial improvements in aviation text understanding and processing.

2511.12635.tldr: LLM4SCREENLIT-practical recommendations for researchers conducting LLM-screening evaluations and for editors and reviewers assessing such studies-differentiated by study type (retrospective benchmarking vs deployment for a specific SR).

2511.12648.tldr: A three-tier hybrid security architecture HAVEN (Hierarchical Autonomous Vehicle Enhanced Network), which decouples real-time local threat detection and distributed coordination operations and incorporates a light ensemble anomaly detection model on the edge, Byzantine-fault-tolerant federated learning to aggregate threat intelligence at a regional scale, and selected blockchain mechanisms to ensure critical security coordination.

2511.12663.tldr: FLClear is proposed, a novel framework that simultaneously achieves collision-free watermark aggregation, enhanced watermark security, and visually interpretable ownership verification and introduces a transposed model jointly optimized with contrastive learning to integrate the watermarking and main task objectives.

2511.12668.tldr: The AIRS Framework thus extends SBOM practice to the AI domain by coupling threat modeling with automated, auditable evidence generation, providing a principled foundation for standardized, trustworthy, and machine-verifiable AI risk documentation.

2511.12676.tldr: Embodied Memory Visual Reasoning (EMVR) is proposed, which formulates the inspection EQA task as a Markov decision process and shows strong performance over the baselines.

2511.12677.tldr: This work proposes a novel dynamic variant of tree databases for compressing state sets over propositional and numeric variables and proves that it maintains the desirable properties of the static counterpart.

2511.12690.tldr: Results indicate that combining self-supervised pre-training, discrete speech units, and synthetic parallel data is effective for improving direct S2ST in low-resource language pairs such as Persian-English.

2511.12691.tldr: R$^{2}$Seg, a training-free framework for robust OOD tumor segmentation that operates via a two-stage Reason-and-Reject process, substantially improves Dice, specificity, and sensitivity over strong baselines and the original foundation models.

2511.12693.tldr: HEDGE, a unified framework for hallucination detection that combines controlled visual perturbations, semantic clustering, and robust uncertainty metrics, is presented, providing a principled, compute-aware foundation for evaluating multimodal reliability.

2511.12709.tldr: A novel framework is proposed, called Adaptive Graph Rewiring in Mesh-Based Graph Neural Networks (AdaMeshNet), that introduces an adaptive rewiring process into the message-passing procedure to model the gradual propagation of physical interactions.

2511.12751.tldr: This work investigates whether small, locally deployed LLMs (<14B parameters) can meaningfully support autonomous highway driving through reward shaping rather than direct control, and presents a case study comparing RL-only, LLM-only, and hybrid approaches.

2511.12752.tldr: A novel block-level attack that manipulates the KV cache to steer model generation without altering the user-facing prompt, demonstrating that the KV cache is a significant vector for security analysis, as it encodes not just context but also topic trajectory and structural planning, making it a powerful interface for manipulating model behavior.

2511.12754.tldr: A strategy-conditioned cooperator framework that learns to represent, categorize, and adapt to a broad range of potential partner strategies in real-time in a complex collaborative cooking environment that requires effective coordination among two players with a diverse potential strategy space.

2511.12757.tldr: The novel optimal transport--based approach presented indeed gives smoother image interpolations, suggesting that viewing the embeddings as point clouds (rather than as matrices) better reflects and leverages the geometry of the embedding space.

2511.12759.tldr: These findings challenge the assumption that more complex sampling mechanisms inherently lead to better cognitive models of memory retrieval and show that appropriately structured embeddings, even with simple sampling, can produce near-optimal foraging dynamics.

2511.12768.tldr: The findings suggest that phase-transition reorganizations are a general feature of language model training, observable even in modest models, detectable directly in linear training space, and occurring surprisingly early as coherence emerges.

2511.12769.tldr: This work proposes Event-CausNet, a framework that uses a Large Language Model to quantify unstructured event reports, builds a causal knowledge base by estimating average treatment effects, and injects this knowledge into a dual-stream GNN-LSTM network using a novel causal attention mechanism to adjust and enhance the forecast.

2511.12785.tldr: This work addresses color harmonization for AR by proposing a lightweight approach that supports on-device inference and leveraging classical optimal transport theory by training a compact encoder to predict the Monge-Kantorovich transport map.

2511.12792.tldr: Results show that MARL enables effective coordination across heterogeneous satellites, balancing imaging performance and resource utilization while mitigating non-stationarity and inter-agent reward coupling.

2511.12793.tldr: A compositional framework is introduced, demonstrating how logic rules acquired from ear- lier tasks can be efficiently reused in subsequent ones, leading to improved scalability and performance in Neural-Symbolic AI.

2511.12804.tldr: It is shown that alignment is not a static goal but an evolving equilibrium, shaped both by power asymmetries and path dependence, shaped both by power asymmetries and path dependence.

2511.12828.tldr: It is revealed that while KANs exhibit promising retention in low-dimensional algorithmic settings, they remain vulnerable to forgetting in high-dimensional domains such as image classification and language modeling.

2511.12832.tldr: STAR: Steering via Attribution and Representation tests this assumption by using attribution patching to identify the layer--token positions where each behavioral trait causally originates, then injecting contrastive activation vectors at precisely those locations.

2511.12834.tldr: This work introduces SAGA (Source Attribution of Generative AI videos), the first comprehensive framework to address the urgent need for AI-generated video source attribution at a large scale, and proposes Temporal Attention Signatures (T-Sigs), a novel interpretability method that visualizes learned temporal differences, offering the first explanation for why different video generators are distinguishable.

2511.12838.tldr: This study demonstrates that high expressivity and scalability are not mutually exclusive: principled, topology-guided sparsification enables powerful, efficient GNNs with theoretical guarantees.

2511.12846.tldr: RoS-Guard is proposed, a robust and optimal OCD algorithm tailored for linear systems with uncertainty that employs neural unrolling to enable efficient parallel computation via GPU acceleration and provides theoretical guarantees on performance.

2511.12851.tldr: NeuroLex is a lightweight domain-adaptive language model trained purely on EEG report text from the Harvard Electroencephalography Database, enabling it to serve as both an independent textual model and a decoder backbone for multimodal EEG-language systems.

2511.12852.tldr: The proposed method turns a neural network into a collection of local white box dynamical models and suggests which internal directions are natural candidates for pruning or constraints to improve interpretability.

2511.12865.tldr: Results indicate that DDQN not only achieves higher expected NPV in complex project optimization but also provides a reliable framework for stable and effective policy implementation.

2511.12868.tldr: This work proposes Visual Chain-of-Thought (vCoT), an explicit reasoning process that generates transitional event descriptions between consecutive frames that significantly improves the performance of image-only models on long-form video question answering, while yielding only marginal gains for video-finetuned models.

2511.12874.tldr: This study provides a framework for computational analysis of hope, with applications in mental health and social media analysis, while demonstrating that architectural suitability may outweigh model size for specialized emotion detection tasks.

2511.12901.tldr: This work extends ChatHTN so that when ChatGPT generates a task decomposition, ChatHTN learns from it, akin to memoization, however, unlike memoization, it learns a generalized method that applies not only to the specific instance encountered, but to other instances of the same task.

2511.12903.tldr: The interpretability of neural network features from a Bayesian Gaussian view, where optimizing a cost is reaching a probabilistic bound is studied, is studied, and an encoder-mixture-decoder architecture whose decoder is multiple-output, producing multiple centers per sample, potentially tightening the bound is proposed.

2511.12905.tldr: Results indicate that while promotions are highly predictable, follower growth exhibits greater complexity, which provides actionable insights for professionals seeking to optimize their LinkedIn presence and career strategies.

2511.12908.tldr: This work introduces DeepSport, the first end-to-end trained MLLM framework designed for multi-task, multi-sport video understanding, and establishes a new foundation for domain-specific video reasoning to address the complexities of diverse sports.

2511.12913.tldr: The Chain-of-Scheduling (CoS) framework is proposed, which activates the event scheduling capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) through a guided, efficient scheduling process, and demonstrates strong zero-shot learning ability on out-of-domain data.

2511.12916.tldr: Fault2Flow establishes a reproducible path from fault analysis to operational automation, substantially reducing expert workload and optimizing the reasoning logic using a novel AlphaEvolve module.

2511.12922.tldr: The proposed UniTok framework is a Unified item Tokenization framework that integrates the authors' own mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture with a series of codebooks to convert items into discrete tokens, enabling scalable tokenization while preserving semantic information across multiple item domains.

2511.12936.tldr: A partial decryption verifiable threshold multi client function encryption scheme is constructed, and applied to Federated learning to implement the federated learning verifiable threshold security aggregation protocol (VTSAFL), which provides efficiency guarantee for large-scale deployment.

2511.12955.tldr: It is shown that GCTAF effectively detects intense flares and improves predictive performance, demonstrating that refining transformer-based architectures presents a high-potential alternative for solar flare prediction tasks.

2511.12962.tldr: EndoSight AI, a deep learning architecture developed and evaluated independently to enable accurate polyp localization and detailed boundary delineation, is presented, promising to advance diagnostic accuracy and clinical decision-making in gastrointestinal healthcare.

2511.12964.tldr: CalibrateMix is introduced, a targeted mixup-based approach that aims to improve the calibration of SSL models while maintaining or even improving their classification accuracy, using training dynamics of labeled and unlabeled samples to identify ``easy-to-learn'' and ``hard-to-learn'' samples.

2511.12971.tldr: A novel EVM bytecode representation called Stable-Semantic Graph (SSG), which captures relationships between'stable instructions'(special instructions identified by the authors' study), and is implemented, Esim, which embeds SSG into matrices for similarity detection using a heterogeneous graph neural network.

2511.12986.tldr: Tree-Gate Proximal Policy Optimization (TGPPO) is proposed, a novel framework that employs Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), a Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm, to train a branching policy aimed at improving generalization across heterogeneous MILP instances.

2511.12997.tldr: This work introduces WebCoach, a model-agnostic self-evolving framework that equips web browsing agents with persistent cross-session memory, enabling improved long-term planning, reflection, and continual learning without retraining.

2511.13005.tldr: Spuriousness-Aware Guided Exploration (SAGE) is proposed, a simple and effective method that mitigates spurious bias through guided prompt selection that consistently improves zero-shot performance and generalization and requires no training, fine-tuning, or external annotations.

2511.13007.tldr: This paper proposes a generative entropy-guided preference modeling approach named GEM, which empowers the LLM to rely on its own judgments and establishes an entropy-guided closed-loop cognitive optimization framework, enabling highly efficient few-shot alignment of LLMs.

2511.13010.tldr: Fractal nodes are proposed, inspired by the fractal structure observed in real-world networks, that alleviate the over-squashing problem by providing direct shortcut connections that enable long-range propagation of subgraph-level representations.

2511.13019.tldr: This work develops an efficient training and sampling scheme for MeanFlow in the latent space of a Representation Autoencoder (RAE), where a pre-trained vision encoder provides semantically rich latents paired with a lightweight decoder.

2511.13020.tldr: PHASE is designed, a physiology-aware hyperspectral reconstruction paradigm that fundamentally redefines object-to-human transfer by disentangling cross-channel physiological semantics via Physiological Channel Reinterpretation and restricting reconstruction to physiologically plausible solutions through Physiologically Constrained Alignment.

2511.13021.tldr: It is revealed that LMs struggle to memorize crucial details, such as tracking entities under linguistic alterations to conversations, and a dual-perspective interpretability framework is proposed which identifies transformer layers that are useful or harmful and highlights linguistic alterations most influenced by harmful layers.

2511.13023.tldr: SLMQuant is introduced, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating LLM compression techniques when applied to SLMs and reveals fundamental disparities between SLMs and LLMs in quantization sensitivity, demonstrating that direct transfer of LLM-optimized techniques leads to suboptimal results.

2511.13027.tldr: This work scales two major generative verification methods to millions of tokens and identifies their combination as the most effective framework for solution verification and selection, and establishes practical guidelines for designing and evaluating scalable proof-verification and selection systems.

2511.13029.tldr: AA-Omniscience, a benchmark designed to measure both factual recall and knowledge calibration across 6,000 questions, is introduced, revealing persistent factuality and calibration weaknesses across frontier models.

2511.13035.tldr: This work proposes to reformulate MeanFlow to enable direct noise-to-action generation by integrating the velocity field and noise-to-action transformation into a single policy network-eliminating the need for separate velocity estimation.

2511.13052.tldr: This paper proposes Learning-from-the-Undesirable (LfU), a simple yet effective regularization scheme for SFT to mitigate overfitting issues when fine-tuning LMs with limited data, and proposes a novel form of consistency regularization that directly aligns internal representations of the model with those after an undesirable update.

2511.13060.tldr: The framework packages heterogeneous latency, noncommutativity, and implementation-gap effects into a single interpretable lower-bound statement that can be stress-tested and tuned in real-world systems.

2511.13061.tldr: MACKO-SpMV is proposed, a GPU-optimized format and kernel co-designed to reduce storage overhead while preserving compatibility with the GPU's execution model that enables efficient SpMV for unstructured sparsity without specialized hardware units or format-specific precomputation.

2511.13087.tldr: MEGA-GUI is introduced, a multi-stage framework that separates grounding into coarse Region-of-Interest (ROI) selection and fine-grained element grounding, orchestrated by specialized vision-language agents, and shows that leveraging this modular structure achieves consistently higher accuracy than monolithic approaches.

2511.13091.tldr: STEP (Success-rate-aware Trajectory-Efficient Policy optimization), a framework that dynamically allocates sampling based on per-task success rates and performs step-level optimization, is proposed, which substantially improves sample efficiency and training stability over trajectory-level GRPO.

2511.13116.tldr: GFOES, a novel framework comprising a Generative Feedback Network (GFN) and a two-phase fine-tuning procedure, is introduced, enabling the model to forget class-specific knowledge without access to the original forget data, while preserving performance on retained classes.

2511.13118.tldr: Experiments across five diverse domains and six LLMs demonstrate that AEC consistently outperforms prior zero-shot baselines, showcasing the power of treating event extraction like code generation.

2511.13131.tldr: This work proposes MM-Telco, a comprehensive suite of multimodal benchmarks and models tailored for the telecom domain, which introduces various tasks that address various practical real-life use cases such as network operations, network management, improving documentation quality, and retrieval of relevant text and images.

2511.13132.tldr: This work proposes Indoor Lighting-based Adversarial Attack (ILA), a black-box framework that manipulates global illumination to disrupt VLN agents, and designs two attack modes: Static Indoor Lighting-based Attack (SILA), where the lighting intensity remains constant throughout an episode, and Dynamic Indoor Lighting-based Attack (DILA), where lights are switched on or off at critical moments to induce abrupt illumination changes.

2511.13133.tldr: SoCo-DT, a Soft Conflict-resolution method based by parameter importance, which outperforms the state-of-the-art method by 7.6% on MT50 and by 10.5% on the suboptimal dataset, demonstrating its effectiveness in mitigating gradient conflicts and improving overall multi-task performance.

2511.13137.tldr: The Conditional Diffusion Model for Dynamic Task Decomposition is presented, a novel two-level hierarchical MARL framework designed to automatically infer subtask and coordination patterns and achieves better performance than existing baselines.

2511.13143.tldr: It is demonstrated that defense effectiveness varies substantially across different evaluation setups, and critical gaps in current evaluation practices are identified, including insufficient reporting of computational overhead and behavior under benign conditions, bias in hyperparameter selection, and incomplete experimentation.

2511.13145.tldr: This project explores the use of state-of-the-art CV techniques for road distress segmentation with results showing that GAN-generated data improves model performance and that MaskFormer outperforms the CNN model in two metrics: mAP50 and IoU.

2511.13160.tldr: InteractiveGNNExplainer is introduced, a visual analytics framework to enhance GNN explainability, focusing on node classification, that incorporates interactive graph editing, allowing users to perform a "what-if" analysis by perturbing graph structures and observing immediate impacts on GNN predictions and explanations.

2511.13166.tldr: A novel collaborative filtering method called Local Collaborative Filtering (LCF), which utilizes local similarities among users and integrates their data using the law of large numbers (LLN), thereby improving the utilization of user behavior data.

2511.13168.tldr: This work proposes SOMA, a dense registration framework that integrates structural gradient priors into deep features and refines alignment through a hybrid matching strategy, and introduces the Feature Gradient Enhancer (FGE), which embeds multi-scale, multi-directional gradient filters into the feature space using attention and reconstruction mechanisms to boost feature distinctiveness.

2511.13193.tldr: This work introduces the Dynamic Auction-based Language Agent (DALA), a novel framework that treats communication bandwidth as a scarce and tradable resource and cultivates the emergent skill of strategic silence in a dynamic manner via resource constraints.

2511.13198.tldr: Experimental results indicate that ParaDySe addresses OOM and CPC bottlenecks in LLM training by systematically integrating long-sequence optimizations with existing frameworks.

2511.13214.tldr: This paper leverages Graph Neural Networks in conjunction with Deep Reinforcement Learning to develop an effective policy for task scheduling that operates similarly to a priority dispatch rule and is paired with a Serial Schedule Generation Scheme to produce a schedule.

2511.13223.tldr: TokenSqueeze is proposed, a novel Long2Short method that condenses reasoning paths while preserving performance and relying exclusively on self-generated data, enabling efficient and high-fidelity reasoning without relying on manually curated short-answer datasets across diverse applications.

2511.13226.tldr: A verbalization strategy to communicate robot plans informatively is proposed, by measuring the information gain that verbalizations have against a second-order theory of mind of the user capturing his prior knowledge on the robot.

2511.13243.tldr: De-VQA, a dynamic evaluation for visual question answering, is introduced, uncovering a phenomenon the authors term transient blindness, overfitting to edit-similar text while ignoring visuals, and locality-aware adversarial losses to balance cross-modal representations are proposed.

2511.13244.tldr: This work introduces a framework for non-differentiable guidance of protein generative models, coupling a continuous diffusion-based generator with any black-box objective via a tailored genetic algorithm, and demonstrates its effectiveness across three modalities: pairwise distance constraints, nuclear Overhauser effect restraints, and for the first time chemical shifts.

2511.13259.tldr: The benchmark demonstrate that while current LMMs achieve impressive performance in geo-localization tasks, their effectiveness declines significantly on the more complex pose estimation tasks, highlighting a critical area for future improvement, and instruction-tuning LMMs on the training data of GeoX-Bench can significantly improve the cross-view geo-sense abilities.

2511.13274.tldr: KForge is presented, a platform-agnostic framework built on two collaborative LLM-based agents: a generation agent that produces and iteratively refines programs through compilation and correctness feedback, and a performance analysis agent that interprets profiling data to guide optimization.
