2511.16016.tldr: CARE is a framework that enhances LLMs'causal-reasoning ability by teaching them to effectively utilize the outputs of established causal-discovery algorithms through supervised fine-tuning, and shows results that significantly outperforms both traditional causal-discovery algorithms and state-of-the-art LLMs with over a thousand times more parameters.

2511.16018.tldr: This paper proposes SpellForger, a game where players create custom spells by writing natural language prompts, aiming to provide a unique experience of personalization and creativity, validating the use of AI as a direct gameplay mechanic.

2511.16026.tldr: The proposed material classification technique using a speckle pattern of the material's surface based on deep learning to monitor and control the laser cutting process provides a robust and accurate solution for material-aware laser cutting using speckle sensing.

2511.16027.tldr: HGCN2SP is a novel model with a hierarchical graph designed for 2SP problems, encoding each scenario and modeling their relationships hierarchically, and exhibits remarkable generalization capabilities in handling large-scale instances, even with a substantial number of variables or scenarios that were unseen during the training phase.

2511.16045.tldr: This paper proposes a novel Constraint Programming model that uses key alignment parameters that allow it to reason directly on the sequences of same-family jobs scheduled on the machines, resulting in a more compact formulation.

2511.16048.tldr: A soft flying robotic art installation whose physical form, a 3D pixel style cloud, is a physical glitch derived from digital archaeology, and a lo-fi framework for creating imperfect companions whose success is measured in character over efficiency is demonstrated.

2511.16055.tldr: A framework that classifies AI-accounting research along two dimensions: research focus (accounting-centric versus AI-centric) and methodological approach (AI-based versus traditional methods) is proposed to map existing studies and identify research opportunities.

2511.16072.tldr: A collection of short case studies in which GPT-5 produced new, concrete steps in ongoing research across mathematics, physics, astronomy, computer science, biology, and materials science, underscoring how GPT-5 can help human mathematicians settle previously unsolved problems.

2511.16075.tldr: A hybrid architecture is designed, combining two powerful tools: the CNN LSTM model for time series forecasting and an orchestrator based on multi agent Deep Reinforcement Learning, embedding the predictive forecast from the CNN LSTM directly into the DRL agent state space.

2511.16080.tldr: Empirical evaluation demonstrates that Operon outperforms an existing workflow engine with 14.94x baseline overhead reduction while maintaining near-linear end-to-end output rates as workloads scale, making it particularly suitable for large-scale data generation pipelines in machine learning applications.

2511.16084.tldr: SpectralTrain is introduced, a universal, architecture-agnostic training framework that enhances learning efficiency by integrating curriculum learning with principal component analysis (PCA)-based spectral downsampling and enables efficient learning of spectral -- spatial patterns at significantly reduced computational costs.

2511.16090.tldr: This work proposes three convex combination strategies, symmetric and asymmetric, that balance pessimistic estimates to mitigate overestimation and optimistic exploration via double actors to alleviate underestimation, enabling tunable control across the bias spectrum.

2511.16122.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework called Ensemble Learning based Prompt Optimization (ELPO), which outperforms state-of-the-art prompt optimization methods across different tasks, e.g., improving F1 score by 7.6 on ArSarcasm dataset.

2511.16131.tldr: This work introduces AskDB, a large language model powered agent designed to bridge the gap by supporting both data analysis and administrative operations over SQL databases through natural language, and highlights the potential of AskDB as a unified and intelligent agent for relational database systems.

2511.16135.tldr: CoSP is proposed, an intelligent inverse design method based on contrastive pretrained large language model (LLM) that allows the model to preserve its linguistic capabilities while also comprehending Maxwell's Equations, enabling it to describe material structures with target optical properties in natural language.

2511.16145.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark and empirical study to rigorously compare supervised and unsupervised paradigms and introduces \stand, a deliberately minimalist supervised baseline, urging the community to prioritize data-centric label utilization over purely algorithmic complexity.

2511.16183.tldr: Footovision Play-by-Play Action Spotting in Soccer Dataset (FOOTPASS) is introduced, the first benchmark for play-by-play action spotting over entire soccer matches in a multi-modal, multi-agent tactical context.

2511.16201.tldr: It is argued that the next breakthrough will come not from more automation, but from coupling automation with understanding from systematic benchmarking, which will shift the field from blind search to interpretable, class-specific algorithm design, accelerating progress while producing reusable scientific insight into when and why optimisation strategies succeed.

2511.16216.tldr: An automated pipeline that resolves long-range logical dependencies and cross-page discontinuities in OCR-parsed documents, recovering coherent question--answer--figure associations even when answers reside in separate companion volumes is proposed.

2511.16248.tldr: This paper revisits fairness-aware interactive recommendation by introducing a novel control knob, i.e., the lifecycle of items, and introduces LHRL, a lifecycle-aware hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that dynamically harmonizes fairness and accuracy by leveraging phase-specific exposure dynamics.

2511.16278.tldr: Game-Theory Attack is proposed, an scalable black-box jailbreak framework that formalizes the attacker's interaction against safety-aligned LLMs as a finite-horizon, early-stoppable sequential stochastic game, and reparameterize the LLM's randomized outputs via quantal response.

2511.16283.tldr: This work proposes an intent-aware retrieval framework that leverages large language models to hypothesize potential answers, decompose them into intent-specific queries, and retrieve supporting passages for each underlying intent to balance coverage across diverse intents while reducing redundancy.

2511.16324.tldr: SDA (Steering-Driven Distribution Alignment), a training-free and model-agnostic alignment framework designed for open-source LLMs, is proposed, demonstrating its effectiveness and generalization across diverse models and application scenarios.

2511.16353.tldr: It is found that highly informative rationales are not likely to help classify the instance correctly and sufficiency conversely captures the classification impact of the non-rationalised context, which interferes with rationale information in the same input.

2511.16373.tldr: This work integrates into MalDataGen a Super-Metric that aggregates eight metrics across four fidelity dimensions, producing a single weighted score that is more stable and consistent than traditional metrics.

2511.16375.tldr: This work provides the first systematic comparison of foundation models against classical machine learning baselines for corporate bankruptcy prediction, showing that models such as XGBoost and CatBoost consistently outperform foundation models across all prediction horizons.

2511.16383.tldr: This work proposes a novel agent-based method for automatic validation of optimization models that builds upon and extends methods from software testing to address optimization modeling and shows high quality of validation provided by this agent ensemble in terms of the well-known software testing measure called mutation coverage.

2511.16390.tldr: This work proposes a robot metacognition architecture centered on confidence (a second-order judgment on decisions) and demonstrates it on the use case of autonomous tool invention and highlights potential applications and research directions for robot metacognition.

2511.16395.tldr: The framework CorrectHDL is proposed that leverages high-level synthesis results as functional references to correct potential errors in LLM-generated HDL designs and demonstrates that circuits generated by the proposed framework achieve significantly better area and power efficiency than conventional HLS designs and approach the quality of human-engineered circuits.

2511.16398.tldr: This study contributes to health information systems by offering a computational solution for integrated physical and mental healthcare and provides design principles for advancing collaborative chronic disease management across the pre-treatment, treatment, and post-treatment phases.

2511.16402.tldr: This paper draws an operational analogy to MVCC in databases and shows why a direct transplant fails in a decoupled, multi-language setting, and proposes an agent-first design, Bauplan, that reimplements data and compute isolation in the lakehouse.

2511.16417.tldr: The proposed Pharos-ESG is a unified framework that transforms ESG reports into structured representations through multimodal parsing, contextual narration, and hierarchical labeling, and enriches its outputs with ESG, GRI, and sentiment labels, yielding annotations aligned with the analytical demands of financial research.

2511.16423.tldr: To fully leverage the generalizable multimodal features in pre-trained VLMs, TOFA employs both visual and textual pipelines to extract task-relevant representations, and is training-free, not relying on additional training resources on either the client or server side.

2511.16427.tldr: A generative modeling framework based on latent neural stochastic differential equations that views clinical time series as discrete-time partial observations of an underlying controlled stochastic dynamical system that outperforms ordinary differential equation and long short-term memory baseline models in accuracy and uncertainty estimation is proposed.

2511.16432.tldr: This paper discusses five examples, the shortcomings of world modeling, the generation of thought processes, attention, neural scaling laws, and quantization, that illustrate how much neuroscience could potentially learn from ML research.

2511.16445.tldr: Preliminary results show that flattened sentiment can often be detected with simple statistical models in users with low baseline variability, while detecting semantic drift requires temporal modeling and personalized baselines, and across both tasks, personalized classifiers consistently outperform generalized ones, highlighting the importance of individual behavioral context.

2511.16467.tldr: The processing of idiomatic expressions in transformer-based language models is investigated using a novel set of techniques for circuit discovery and analysis, and attention heads that frequently activate across different idioms are identified.

2511.16482.tldr: This work introduces ExCIR (Explainability through Correlation Impact Ratio), a correlation-aware attribution score equipped with a lightweight transfer protocol that reproduces full-model rankings using only a fraction of the data.

2511.16483.tldr: This work proposes a large language model (LLM)-based reward design approach to generate autonomous cyber defense policies in a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-driven experimental simulation environment and suggests that LLM-guided reward designs can lead to effective defense strategies against diverse adversarial behaviors.

2511.16494.tldr: This work proposes a novel physics-informed deep generative learning framework that, for the first time, integrates wave optics-based physical rendering and depth alignment into a generative adversarial network (GAN), to synthesise high-fidelity microscope images for microrobot pose estimation efficiently.

2511.16501.tldr: ODE-ViT is introduced, a Vision Transformer reformulated as an ODE system that satisfies the conditions for well-posed and stable dynamics and a plug-and-play teacher-student framework in which a discrete ViT guides the continuous trajectory of ODE-ViT by treating the intermediate representations of the teacher as solutions of the ODE.

2511.16528.tldr: This work introduces TurkColBERT, the first comprehensive benchmark comparing dense encoders and late-interaction models for Turkish retrieval, and evaluates 10 models across five Turkish BEIR datasets covering scientific, financial, and argumentative domains.

2511.16548.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that CLOZE provides an accurate, scalable, and privacy-preserving ontology extension framework, with strong potential to support a wide range of downstream applications in biomedical research and clinical informatics.

2511.16557.tldr: This study designs a reservoir computing (RC) network by exploiting short- and long-term memory dynamics in Au/Ti/MoS$_2$/Au memristive devices, and achieves 89.56\% precision in a spoken-digit recognition task and is also used to analyze a nonlinear time series equation.

2511.16566.tldr: NutriScreener is a retrieval-augmented, multi-pose graph attention network that combines CLIP-based visual embeddings, class-boosted knowledge retrieval, and context awareness to enable robust malnutrition detection and anthropometric prediction from children's images, simultaneously addressing generalizability and class imbalance.

2511.16575.tldr: ECPv2 is proposed, a scalable and theoretically grounded algorithm for global optimization of Lipschitz-continuous functions with unknown Lipschitz constants that retains ECP's no-regret guarantees with optimal finite-time bounds and expands the acceptance region with high probability.

2511.16577.tldr: A method that uses statistical language models as oracles for disambiguation that does not require any hand-annotation of training data to construct and is evaluated against human-annotated gold answers to demonstrate its effectiveness.

2511.16579.tldr: This work develops a theoretical framework for the Synthesis of safe-PCTL specifications, shows how the reducing global specification satisfaction to local constraints, and defines CPCTL, a fragment of safe-PCTL, to demonstrate how the expressiveness of CPCTL makes it a relevant fragment for the Synthesis Problem.

2511.16582.tldr: A taxonomical framework is developed for classifying challenges to the possibility of consciousness in digital artificial intelligence systems and for disambiguating between challenges to computational functionalism and challenges to digital consciousness, as well as between different ways of parsing such challenges.

2511.16588.tldr: Abductive Latent Explanations (ALEs), a formalism to express sufficient conditions on the intermediate (latent) representation of the instance that imply the prediction, which combines the inherent interpretability of case-based reasoning models and the guarantees provided by formal XAI.

2511.16590.tldr: D-GARA is modular and extensible, supporting the seamless integration of new tasks, anomaly types, and interaction scenarios to meet specific evaluation goals, and construct and annotate a benchmark featuring commonly used Android applications with embedded anomalies to support broader community research.

2511.16593.tldr: This research aims to model resilience for automatic state detection, develop agent-based policies that optimize the greenness-resilience trade-off, and understand catastrophic forgetting to maintain performance consistency in OL-CAIS.

2511.16602.tldr: Deliberate Practice Policy Optimization is introduced, a metacognitive ``Metaloop''training framework that dynamically alternates between supervised fine-tuning (competence expansion) and reinforcement learning (skill refinement) that enables automatic weakness identification and targeted resource allocation, specifically designed to maximize learning efficiency from sparse, finite data.

2511.16625.tldr: Although the framework does not improve risk-coverage ranking, and temperature scaling or deep ensembles may provide advantages in calibration cost or risk ranking, MedBayes-Lite offers a practical calibration-and-abstention layer that reduces confident high-severity errors in clinical question-answering benchmarks.

2511.16637.tldr: This work develops a method for instead encoding orders with auxiliary variables that leads to orders-of-magnitude speed-ups in both theory and practice, and shows that this leads to orders-of-magnitude speed-ups in both theory and practice.

2511.16653.tldr: A novel teacher-guided pruning framework that tightly integrates Knowledge Distillation with importance score estimation is introduced that outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as EPG and EPSD at high sparsity levels, while offering a more computationally efficient alternative to iterative pruning schemes like COLT.

2511.16661.tldr: The proposed framework AINA enables the learning of 3D point-based policies for multi-fingered hands that are robust to background changes and can be deployed directly without requiring any robot data (including online corrections, reinforcement learning, or simulation).

2511.16671.tldr: This preliminary study introduces Thinking-while-Generating (TwiG), the first interleaved framework that enables co-evolving textual reasoning throughout the visual generation process, and investigates three candidate strategies, zero-shot prompting, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning via a customized TwiG-GRPO strategy, each offering unique insights into the dynamics of interleaved reasoning.

2511.16674.tldr: This paper introduces a method of dataset distillation called Linear Gradient Matching that optimizes the synthetic images such that, when passed through a pre-trained feature extractor, they induce gradients in the linear classifier similar to those produced by the real data.

2401.06925.tldr: A conditioning operation for SCMs is introduced: it maps an SCM with explicit selection mechanisms to one without them while preserving the causal semantics of the selected subpopulation, and preserves simplicity, acyclicity, and linearity of SCMs, and interacts well with marginalization, conditioning, and interventions.

2102.11361.tldr: FaCells is a method that turns model internals into line based artworks that bridges data, model, and paper while acknowledging the limits of the labels and the biases of the dataset.

2207.07250.tldr: A framework of the equivariant convolutional quantum algorithms is introduced which is tailored for a number of machine-learning tasks on physical systems with arbitrary SU$(d)$ symmetries, providing evidence against PQC+ being classically simulatable.

2311.02733.tldr: This study proposes a new method based on a multimodal self-supervised-learning (SSL) feature extractor to exploit inconsistency between audio and visual modalities for multimodal video forgery detection and achieves new state-of-the-art performance on the FakeAVCeleb and DeepfakeTIMIT datasets.

2405.17838.tldr: A new model to detect information concerning hazards, trained on a new collection of annotated X posts is developed and it is shown that not only does this model perform well, but that the hazard information it extracts is not strongly correlated with such widely used indicators as moral outrage, sentiment, and emotions.

2406.01183.tldr: A novel method to estimate the relative importance of the input components for a Deep Neural Network is proposed by leveraging on a spectral re-parametrization of the optimization process.

2406.02966.tldr: A critical interpretive analysis traced textual, visual, and structural patterns that revealed forms of digital neocolonialism and their implications for educational equity and proposed a dual-pathway mitigation model to address resulting inequities.

2406.03283.tldr: CatCoder is presented, a novel code generation framework designed for statically typed programming languages that enhances repository-level code generation by integrating relevant code and type context and indicates consistent performance improvements across all models, which underlines the practicality of CatCoder.

2407.05650.tldr: These findings establish CNA as a promising paradigm for developing neural representations that integrate local feature processing with global structure formation, providing a foundation for future research on invariant object recognition.

2408.15511.tldr: The first large-scale real-world image-text pre-training dataset, AerialAgent-Ego10k, featuring urban drones from a first-person perspective is constructed and SkyAgentEval, the downstream task evaluation metrics based on GPT-4 are developed, revealing the potential and limitations of 2D/3D visual language models in UAV-agent tasks.

2409.11078.tldr: A novel ANN architecture called MonoKAN is introduced, which is based on the KAN architecture and achieves certified partial monotonicity while enhancing interpretability and outperforming state-of-the-art monotonic MLP approaches.

2409.11393.tldr: A novel LLM-based Agent Unified Modeling Framework (LLM-Agent-UMF) is proposed that establishes a clear foundation for agent development from both functional and software architectural perspectives, developed and evaluated using the Architecture Tradeoff and Risk Analysis Framework (ATRAF).

2411.09613.tldr: A novel Precision-driven Tool Recommendation approach, PTR, which captures an initial, concise set of tools by leveraging historical tool bundle usage and dynamically adjusts the tool set by performing tool matching, culminating in a multi-view-based tool addition.

2502.10568.tldr: This work proposes a framework to handle observer-aware Markov decision processes to partial observability and formalizes properties such as legibility, explicability and predictability, and discusses theoretical properties of PO-OAMDPs.

2503.01424.tldr: A systematic review of the progress in hypothesis formulation, hypothesis validation, and manuscript publication and offers a comprehensive overview of existing benchmarks and tools across various domains that support the integration of AI into the research process.

2503.09114.tldr: This study measures key performance indicators—including memory usage, inference speed, and energy consumption—across various device configurations, and examines throughput-energy trade-offs, cost considerations, and usability, alongside an assessment of qualitative model performance.

2503.09878.tldr: This work proposes CleverDistiller, a self-supervised, cross-modal 2D-to-3D KD framework introducing a set of simple yet effective design choices, and introduces the auxiliary self-supervised spatial task of occupancy prediction to enhance the semantic knowledge, obtained from a VFM through KD, with 3D spatial reasoning capabilities.

2503.12972.tldr: This paper proposes Vision-align-to-Language integrated Knowledge Graph (VaLiK), a novel approach for constructing MMKGs that enhances LLMs reasoning through cross-modal information supplementation that outperform previous state-of-the-art models on multimodal reasoning tasks.

2503.17987.tldr: This work proposes Reason2Attack(R2A), which aims to enhance the LLM's reasoning capabilities in generating adversarial prompts by incorporating the jailbreaking attack into the post-training process of the LLM and design an attack process reward that considers prompt length, prompt stealthiness, and prompt effectiveness, aiming to further enhance reasoning accuracy.

2504.08016.tldr: A computational-theoretical framework is established to provide an account of psychopathology applicable to large language models and shows the promise of developing a new powerful in silico model of psychopathology and also alludes to the possibility of safety threat from the AI systems with psychopathological behaviors in the near future.

2504.18777.tldr: This study analyses AI-generated digitization results from Google Earth imagery and compares them with digitized outputs from OpenStreetMap (OSM) to evaluate performance.

2504.21194.tldr: ISS-Geo142 and these three pipelines provide a concrete, historically grounded benchmark for future work on ISS image geolocation, and TerraByte establishes the strongest overall baseline, correctly geolocating approximately 90% of the images while also producing human-readable geographic descriptions.

2505.01094.tldr: This work introduces a water resource management case study and model it as a MORL environment, and benchmarks existing MORL algorithms on this task, showing that specialized water management methods outperform state-of-the-art MORL approaches and underscoring the scalability challenges MORL algorithms face in real-world scenarios.

2505.04736.tldr: The results demonstrate that LLMs may be used to augment tutoring systems with logic tutoring hints, but require additional modifications to ensure accuracy and pedagogical appropriateness.

2505.11289.tldr: A new open-source version of Meta-World is released that has full reproducibility of past results, is more technically ergonomic, and gives users more control over the tasks that are included in a task set.

2505.12188.tldr: LLM-DSE is presented, a multi-agent framework designed specifically for optimizing HLS directives, which leverages essential domain knowledge to identify efficient parameter combinations while maintaining adaptability through verbal learning from online interactions.

2505.21535.tldr: A Function-preserving Attention Replacement framework that substitutes all attention in pretrained DeiTs with sequential modules inherently compatible with IMC dataflows, highlighting its potential for energy-efficient transformer inference on IMC-based edge accelerators.

2506.00133.tldr: Results show that RL-RPL-UA is a potential and energy-efficient way to route data in underwater networks and adds 80 seconds to the network's lifetime compared to previous approaches.

2506.08255.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that integrates Interval Bound Propagation with a hypernetwork-based architecture to enable certifiably robust continual learning across sequential tasks, and introduces Interval MixUp, a novel training strategy that blends virtual examples represented as $\ell_{\infty}$ balls centered around MixUp points.

2506.08708.tldr: PhyBlock is introduced, a progressive benchmark designed to assess VLMs on physical understanding and planning through robotic 3D block assembly tasks, and benchmark 21 state-of-the-art VLMs, highlighting their strengths and limitations in physically grounded, multi-step planning.

2506.22397.tldr: HazeMatching is proposed, a novel iterative method for dehazing light microscopy images, which effectively balances the fidelity of the dehazing results and the realism of individual predictions by adapting the conditional flow matching framework by guiding the generative process with a hazy observation in the conditional velocity field.

2507.04224.tldr: Whether LLMs differentiate responses across user identities by prompting six state-of-the-art LLMs to assist patrons differing in sex, race/ethnicity, and institutional role is evaluated.

2507.06819.tldr: This paper performs an in-depth analysis of a set of prominent prototype models including ProtoPNet, ProtoPool, ProtoPool and PIPNet and proposes several new metrics to further complement the analysis of model interpretability.

2507.10998.tldr: This work proposes a latent-space perturbation framework using a mixed-input Variational Autoencoder (VAE) to generate statistically consistent adversarial examples, and introduces In-Distribution Success Rate (IDSR) to jointly evaluate attack effectiveness and distributional alignment.

2507.13290.tldr: A Formal Query Language is proposed that can represent a user's intent in a formally defined but natural language-like manner that a user can confirm matches their intent and is implemented in Astrogator, a system widely used for system administration, including for critical systems.

2508.06869.tldr: The VISUAL-SUBTITLE INTEGRATION (VSI) is proposed, a multimodal keyframe retrieval framework that employs a dual-branch collaborative retrieval approach combining Video Search and Subtitle Match to fuse complementary visual and textual information for precise localization.

2508.10599.tldr: Multi-Subspace Representation Steering (MSRS) is proposed, a novel framework for effective multi-attribute steering via subspace representation fine-tuning that significantly reduces attribute conflicts, surpasses existing methods across a range of attributes, and generalizes effectively to diverse downstream tasks.

2508.18694.tldr: This work benchmarks state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction methods on AgriChrono, revealing the profound challenge of reconstructing high-fidelity, dynamic non-rigid scenes in such farmland settings and validates AgriChrono as a critical asset for advancing model generalization.

2509.06938.tldr: This work establishes how and when hallucinations arise in pre-trained transformer models through concept representations captured by sparse autoencoders, and shows that hallucinations in the output of a transformer model can be reliably predicted from the concept patterns embedded in transformer layer activations.

2509.10577.tldr: A minimal coding abstraction is introduced that is a zero-bit tamper-detection code that samples a pseudorandom codeword and decides whether it should be treated as unmarked content or as the result of tampering with a valid codeword, which proves a sharp unconditional limit on robustness to independent symbol corruption.

2509.14001.tldr: MOCHA (Multi-modal Objects-aware Cross-arcHitecture Alignment Alignment), a distillation framework that transfers multimodal region-level knowledge from a frozen VLM teacher into a lightweight vision-only detector, consistently outperforms prior baselines across four personalized detection benchmarks under strict few-shot regimes.

2509.21651.tldr: A highly scalable approach to continuous physical safety benchmarking of Embodied AI systems, grounded in real-world injury narratives and operational safety constraints, and a post-training paradigm to teach models to explicitly reason about embodiment-specific safety constraints provided through system instructions.

2510.10135.tldr: CharCom is proposed, a modular and parameter-efficient framework that achieves character-consistent story illustration through composable LoRA adapters, enabling efficient per-character customization without retraining the base model.

2510.12194.tldr: In fully autonomous mode, ResearStudio achieves state-of-the-art results on the GAIA benchmark, surpassing systems like OpenAI's DeepResearch and Manus, and shows that strong automated performance and fine-grained human control can coexist.

2510.13827.tldr: This work presents a new framework that combines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) within a multilingual contrastive reward signal to enhance both task efficiency and semantic accuracy in Text-to-SQL systems in cross-lingual scenarios.

2510.17309.tldr: RubiSCoT, an AI-supported framework designed to enhance thesis evaluation from proposal to final submission, is presented, discussing its potential to optimize academic assessment processes through consistent, scalable, and transparent evaluation.

2510.22300.tldr: T2I-RiskyPrompt is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark designed for evaluating safety-related tasks in T2I models and a reason-driven risky image detection method that explicitly aligns the MLLM with safety annotations is proposed.

2510.27629.tldr: The results show that current filtering practices may not be particularly effective: Excluded knowledge can be rapidly recovered in some cases via fine-tuning, and exhibits broader generalizability in sequence modeling, highlighting the challenges of data filtering as a standalone procedure.

2511.02969.tldr: This paper develops two novel algorithms that incorporate the expected gain from learning the value of information into Bootstrapped DQN, and uses value of information estimates to measure the discrepancies of opinions among distinct network heads, and drive exploration towards areas with the most potential.

2511.07318.tldr: It is shown that existing hallucination detection methods, such as confidence-based filtering and inner-state probing, fundamentally fail in the presence of spurious correlations, and further elucidates why these statistical biases intrinsically undermine confidence-based detection techniques.

2511.07772.tldr: Steering Activations towards Leakage-free Thinking (SALT) is introduced, a lightweight test-time intervention that mitigates privacy leakage in model's Chain of Thought (CoT) by injecting targeted steering vectors into hidden state.

2511.12233.tldr: DHMI is proposed, the first diffusion-based model inversion framework designed for deep hashing, which outperforms the existing state-of-the-art model inversion attacks in black-box scenarios, confirming both its practical efficacy and the critical privacy risks inherent in deep hashing systems.

2511.12797.tldr: This work develops a controlled experimental framework comprising symbolic reasoning tasks instantiated in both linguistic and genomic forms, enabling direct comparison of ICL across genomic and linguistic models, and shows that genomic models, like their linguistic counterparts, exhibit log-linear gains in pattern induction as the number of in-context demonstrations increases.

2511.13750.tldr: This work introduces SCALEX, a framework for scalable and automated exploration of diffusion model latent spaces, and shows that SCALEX detects gender bias in profession prompts, ranks semantic alignment across identity descriptors, and reveals clustered conceptual structure without supervision.

2511.14567.tldr: This paper introduces SweeperBot, a system that enables SR users to leverage visual question answering to explore and compare 3D models and the quality of the descriptions generated by SweeperBot was validated by a second survey study with 30 sighted participants.

2511.15675.tldr: A gold standard dataset of 103 clinically assessed participants collected through a tripartite data approach which uniquely integrated eye tracking data with audio and video to give a comprehensive representation of depressive symptoms is introduced.

2511.15738.tldr: This work revisits test-time enhancement techniques through the lens of scaling effect and introduces a unified framework of multi-dimensional test-time scaling to extend the capacity of test-time reasoning and proposes 3D test-time scaling, which integrates context, batch, and turn scaling.

2511.16541.tldr: A novel two-stage detection framework designed to address the generalization challenge inherent in synthetic image detection, and marks a significant advancement toward robust, scalable forensic attribution systems capable of adapting to the evolving generative AI landscape without requiring exhaustive retraining protocols.

2511.16675.tldr: P PepBridge is introduced, a novel framework for the joint design of protein surface and structure that seamlessly integrates receptor surface geometry and biochemical properties that facilitates surface complementarity, conformational stability, and chemical feasibility.

2511.16680.tldr: Shona spaCy is presented, an open-source, rule-based morphological pipeline for Shona built on the spaCy framework that advances NLP accessibility and digital inclusion for Shona speakers and provides a template for morphological analysis tools for other under-resourced Bantu languages.

2511.16681.tldr: Semantic Pyramid Indexing (SPI) is proposed, a VecDB-layer indexing framework that organizes embeddings into $L$ semantically aligned resolution levels and selects retrieval depth per query via a lightweight uncertainty-aware controller.

2511.16683.tldr: A novel dataset containing parallel Tunizi, standard Tunisian Arabic, and English translations, along with sentiment labels is introduced, revealing significant differences between models, highlighting both their strengths and limitations in understanding and processing Tunisian dialects.

2511.16688.tldr: This paper presents a practical, reproducible, and model-agnostic procedure to evaluate whether a prompt candidate can effectively steer generated text toward specific human values, formalising a scoring method to quantify the presence and gain of target values in generated responses.

2511.16698.tldr: This work focuses on the problem of hierarchical concept retrieval from SNOMED CT with OOV queries, and proposes an approach driven by utilising language model-based ontology embeddings, which represent hierarchical concepts in a hyperbolic space for enabling efficient subsumption inference between a textual query and an arbitrary concept.

2511.16699.tldr: Investigating empathy-in-action -- the willingness to sacrifice task efficiency to address human needs -- as a linear direction in LLM activation space finds safety training may affect steering robustness rather than preventing manipulation, though validation across more models is needed.

2511.16700.tldr: An end-to-end pipeline combining automated data cleaning with LLM-driven SQL query generation, deployed on a production system managing 240,000 employee records over six months, provides a reproducible framework for AI-native enterprise data governance.

2511.16707.tldr: A copyright-aware benchmark of 108 Creative Commons-licensed systematic reviews and ten large language models across five input formats substantially improves LLM-based PRISMA assessment, though human expert verification remains essential before editorial decisions.

2511.16709.tldr: This work introduces AutoBackdoor, a general framework for automating backdoor injection, encompassing trigger generation, poisoned data construction, and model fine-tuning via an autonomous agent-driven pipeline, and demonstrates that the method achieves over 90% attack success with only a small number of poisoned samples.

2511.16715.tldr: DDTime, a lightweight and plug-in distillation framework built upon first-order condensation decomposition, is proposed, which revisits value-term alignment through temporal statistics and introduces a frequency-domain alignment mechanism to mitigate autocorrelation-induced bias, ensuring spectral consistency and temporal fidelity.

2511.16716.tldr: This discussion paper presents SODA ADVANCE, a data reconstruction tool designed to enhance evaluation processes related to the password strength, and investigates the capabilities and risks associated with emerging Large Language Models (LLMs) in evaluating and generating passwords, respectively.

2511.16743.tldr: SaFeR-CLIP successfully reconciles safety and performance, recovering up to 8.0% in zero-shot accuracy over prior methods while maintaining robust safety, and shows that respecting the geometry of pretrained representations is key to achieving safety without sacrificing performance.

2511.16757.tldr: The first comprehensive evaluation comparing contrastive and captioning objectives for learning audio representation across speech, music, and environmental sound tasks shows critical trade-offs: contrastive learning offers superior data efficiency, while captioning exhibits better scalability.

2511.16783.tldr: GAR is envisioned as a future AR paradigm that delivers high-fidelity experiences in terms of realism, interactivity, and immersion, while eliciting new research challenges on technologies, content ecosystems, and the ethical and societal implications.

2511.16786.tldr: This work introduces an Outlier KV Recognition Module that models the principal component of multimodal KV matrices in the frequency domain and preferentially retains KV pairs that significantly deviate from it, and proposes FlashCache, a frequency-domain-guided, Outlier-KV-aware KV Cache compression framework.

2511.16807.tldr: The proposed Mesh RAG is a novel, training-free, plug-and-play framework for autoregressive mesh generation models, Inspired by RAG for language models, that augments the generation process by leveraging point cloud segmentation, spatial transformation, and point cloud registration to retrieve, generate, and integrate mesh components.

2511.16814.tldr: The results suggest that, in contrast to language‐centered tasks, GenAI models may face unique challenges in visual domains, where creativity depends on perceptual nuance and contextual sensitivity, distinctly human capacities that may not be readily transferable from language models.

2511.16822.tldr: This study classify large-scale loT attacks by utilizing the CICloT2023 dataset, and delves into the exploration of FL algorithms, specifically FedAvg, FedProx, and Scaffold, under different data distributions, to illuminate the performance nuances of these FL methods.

2511.16823.tldr: MOCET, an interpretable and doubly-scalable metric that can quantify real-world risks, is introduced, an interpretable and doubly-scalable metric (automatable and open-ended) that can quantify real-world risks.

2511.16825.tldr: This work introduces WorldGen, a system that enables the automatic creation of large-scale, interactive 3D worlds directly from text prompts, advancing the frontier of 3D generative AI for applications in gaming, simulation, and immersive social environments.

2511.16828.tldr: ManifoldFormer addresses the fundamental mismatch between model assumptions and neural geometry limits representation quality and cross-subject generalization through a novel geometric deep learning framework that explicitly learns neural manifold representations.

2511.16837.tldr: A comparison across three LLMs on a benchmark of knowledge extraction, conflict detection, and reasoning tasks shows that all models can execute Cognitive BASIC programs, with overall strong but not uniform performance.

2511.16842.tldr: This work introduces a framework for systematic benchmark revision that leverages statistical analysis of response patterns to flag potentially invalid questions for further expert review and introduces an LLM-judge first pass to review questions, further reducing human effort.

2511.16846.tldr: A novel reference-free metric for evaluating the conciseness of responses generated by LLMs, offering a practical tool for automated evaluation of response brevity in conversational AI systems without the need for ground truth human annotations.

2511.16848.tldr: Strong results demonstrate the potential of supervised ML and DL to extract age- and sex-related features from lobster sounds, enabling real-world edge computing applications for underwater species.

2511.16856.tldr: This study confirms the efficiency of DNNs and emphasizes their potential to provide greater accuracy and reliability for the early detection of neurodegenerative diseases using voice-based biomarkers.

2511.16912.tldr: PepEVOLVE is introduced, a position-aware, dynamic framework that learns both where to edit and how to dynamically optimize peptides for multi-objective improvement, enabling more efficient exploration and improving design quality across multiple objectives.

2511.16916.tldr: Extensive experiments conducted using both online planning and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning algorithms demonstrate that the HDR mechanism significantly improves convergence speed and policy stability and confirms that HDR guides agents to learn high-quality cooperative policies that effectively balance traffic efficiency and safety.

2511.16937.tldr: PG-TAF, a training-free two-stage framework decomposing STVG into high-level temporal grounding and fine-grained spatio-temporal propagation is proposed and DeepSTG, a systematic evaluation framework quantifying dataset quality across four complementary dimensions beyond superficial statistics is introduced.

2511.16961.tldr: Using verbal and visual modalities together is better than using either modality alone for some of these question types, and using verbal and visual modalities together is better than using either modality alone for some of these question types.

2511.16964.tldr: This work presents a logical framework for comparing multi-agent PyTorch optimization systems, and shows that exploit-heavy strategies perform best when paired with error-fixing agents, and that performance correlates with the granularity of optimization steps.

2511.17006.tldr: The Budget Tracker is introduced, a lightweight plug-in that provides the agent with continuous budget awareness, enabling simple yet effective scaling, and BATS (Budget Aware Test-time Scaling), an advanced framework that leverages this awareness to dynamically adapt its planning and verification strategy.

2511.17012.tldr: A fine-grained, schema-guided instruction template tailored to the Hunan historical celebrities domain is designed and an instruction-tuning dataset is built to mitigate the lack of domain-specific training corpora.

2511.17014.tldr: This work proposes a novel compositing approach that directly estimates the CoC map from RGB images, bypassing the need for scene depth or camera metadata, and achieves high-fidelity compositing with realistic defocus effects, outperforming state-of-the-art techniques in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations.

2511.17038.tldr: This work introduces DAPS++, which fully decouples diffusion-based initialization from likelihood-driven refinement, allowing the likelihood term to guide inference more directly while maintaining numerical stability and providing insight into why unified diffusion trajectories remain effective in practice.

2511.17043.tldr: This work investigates the use of MedImageInsight, a medical imaging foundational model, for automated binary classification of chest X-rays into Normal and Abnormal categories, demonstrating performance comparable to established architectures such as CheXNet.

2511.17053.tldr: A new unified Pedestrian Tracking framework, namely OmniPT is proposed, which can track, track based on reference and generate semantic understanding of tracked objects interactively, and can perform better than the previous methods.

2511.17056.tldr: This work proposes a method for multi-modal patient-level information extraction that leverages both the tabular features available in the patient's EHR as well as clinical notes describing the patient's symptoms (using neural text classifiers) to provide an interpretable, probabilistic fusion of the models'predictions.

2511.17113.tldr: This work proposes AutoGraphAD, a novel unsupervised anomaly detection approach based on a Heterogeneous Variational Graph Autoencoder, which yields the same, and in some cases better, results than Anomal-E, but without requiring costly downstream anomaly detectors.

2511.17131.tldr: UI-CUBE (UiPath Computer Use BEnchmark) functions as an enterprise-readiness diagnostic, revealing that while current CUAs can manipulate individual interface elements, they cannot yet function as reliable workflow automation tools.

2511.17136.tldr: DeMT, which processes a speaker's frequency response curve as a line graph using a vision-language model to extract device embeddings, enables effective speaker-style transfer and robust few-shot adaptation for unseen devices, supporting applications like device-style augmentation and quality enhancement.

2511.17161.tldr: A functional typology of the organic, converted, and synthetic instructions used in PLLuM is presented and some observations about the implications of using human-authored versus synthetic instruction datasets in the linguistic adaptation of base LLMs are shared.

2511.17162.tldr: A formal BDI Ontology is presented, conceived as a modular Ontology Design Pattern (ODP) that captures the cognitive architecture of agents through beliefs, desires, intentions, and their dynamic interrelations, ensuring semantic precision and reusability by aligning with foundational ontologies and best practices in modular design.

2511.17165.tldr: Mutual Intrinsic Reward (MIR) is introduced, a simple yet effective enhancement strategy for MARL with extremely sparse rewards like episodic rewards that effectively stimulates team exploration and improves algorithm performance.

2511.17170.tldr: This paper introduces Aspect-Based Causal Abstention (ABCA), a new framework that enables early abstention by analysing the internal diversity of LLM knowledge through causal inference and improves abstention reliability, achieves state-of-the-art performance, and enhances the interpretability of abstention decisions.

2511.17184.tldr: An Attention-Guided Feature Fusion (AGFF) model is introduced that combines statistical and semantic features in a unified framework and demonstrates superior performance compared to both traditional statistical models and purely semantic deep learning models.

2511.17198.tldr: This work introduces a novel agent design framework centered on a Hierarchical Task Abstraction Mechanism (HTAM), and instantiates this framework as EarthAgent, a multi-agent system tailored for complex geospatial analysis.

2511.17225.tldr: This work proposes AWMSystem, an autonomous decision-making system composed of three key modules: BreakLLM (instruction decomposition), LocateLLM (goal selection), and StatusMLLM (task monitoring), and designs MASMap, which combines 3D point cloud accumulation with 2D semantic mapping for accurate and efficient environmental understanding.

2511.17233.tldr: This manuscript explains implementation challenges of Deep MPC, algorithmic way to distribute control authority and argues that a poor choice in distributing control authority may lead to poor performance.

2511.17238.tldr: This work presents MirageTVQA, a new benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs on these exact dimensions, and reveals two primary failure points: a severe degradation in performance when faced with visual noise and a consistent English-first bias where reasoning abilities fail to transfer to other languages.

2511.17269.tldr: This research proposes a novel approach that addresses the problem discussed by editing real-world LiDAR scans using semantic mask-based guidance to generate novel synthetic LiDAR point clouds, and offers a cost-effective and scalable solution for generating diverse LiDAR data.

2511.17276.tldr: This paper presents an efficient approach for determining the joint configuration of a multifingered gripper solely from the point cloud data of its poly-articulated chain, as generated by visual sensors, simulations or even generative neural networks, through a Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder (CVAE), which takes point cloud data of key structural elements as input and reconstructs the corresponding joint configurations.

2511.17282.tldr: A comprehensive analysis showing that current T2I models often produce culturally neutral or English-biased results under multilingual prompts indicates that the issue stems not from missing cultural knowledge but from insufficient activation of culture-related representations, and introduces two complementary alignment strategies.

2511.17301.tldr: It is now feasible to provide systems that generate reliable information about sentiment analysis to detect social challenges and draw conclusions about possible needs for actions on specific topics and within different language groups.

2511.17309.tldr: This work extends MAE to arbitrarily many views of the same scene by uniformly masking all views and employing a lightweight decoder with inter-frame attention, finding that it outperforms the state-of-the-art visual encoders DINOv3 and CroCo v2.

2511.17323.tldr: This work proposes MusicAIR, an innovative multimodal AI music generation framework powered by a novel algorithm-driven symbolic music core, effectively mitigating copyright infringement risks and develops Generate AI Music, a web tool using MusicAIR for lyric-to-song, text-to-music, and image-to-music generation.

2511.17331.tldr: This position paper argues that some AI workers can be considered actors of geopolitics and makes the timely case that governance alone cannot ensure responsible, ethical, or robust AI development and use, and greater attention should be paid to bottom-up interventions at the site of AI development.

2511.17346.tldr: It is shown that late reverberation perturbs phase components with white, uniformly distributed noise, except at low frequencies, means that the wet phase carries limited useful information and is not essential for weakly supervised dereverberation.

2511.17393.tldr: This work proposes a comprehensive methodology that integrates advanced generative models to create varied and diverse high-quality synthetic face images, and introduces the Diverse and Inclusive Faces for Verification (DIF-V) dataset, designed as a benchmark for future research in face verification.

2511.17400.tldr: MoE-ViT is proposed, a Mixture-of-Experts architecture for multi-channel images in ViTs, which treats each channel as an expert and employs a lightweight router to select only the most relevant experts per patch for attention, making it a practical and attractive backbone for multi-channel imaging.

2511.17432.tldr: This work introduces SMILE: Semantic Metric Integrating Lexical Exactness, a novel approach that combines sentence-level semantic understanding with keyword-level semantic understanding and easy keyword matching, bridging the gap between lexical and semantic evaluation.

2511.17442.tldr: This work introduces the RSFM Database (RS-FMD), the first structured and schema-guided resource covering over 160 RSFMs trained on various data modalities, spanning different spatial, spectral, and temporal resolutions, and presents REMSA, a constraint-aware agent that enables automated RSFM selection from natural language queries.

2511.17450.tldr: SketchVerify is proposed, a training-free, sketch-verification-based planning framework that improves motion planning quality with more dynamically coherent trajectories prior to full video generation by introducing a test-time sampling and verification loop.

2511.17461.tldr: Results show that SRA-CP achieves less than 1% average precision (AP) loss for safety-critical objects compared to generic CP, while using only 20% of the communication bandwidth, and improves the perception performance by 15% over existing selective CP methods that do not incorporate risk awareness.

2511.17473.tldr: MR-RLVR (Masked-and-Reordered RLVR), which constructs process-level self-supervised rewards via masked-then-fill and step reordering to extract learnable signals from intermediate reasoning, indicates that incorporating process-aware self-supervised signals can effectively enhance RLVR's scalability and performance in only outcome-verifiable settings.

2511.17477.tldr: Experimental findings show that the UniSpeech-BERT multimodal configuration provides strong results and that fusion-based transformer architectures are effective for phoneme-level mispronunciation detection.

2407.20240.tldr: This work explores the risks that general-purpose generative AI tools might pose on newcomers to first, warn against the unguarded use of generative AI, and second, incentivize further research and development in creating AI literacy programs as well as customized LLMs that are aligned with the preferences of the impacted communities.

2409.09825.tldr: The investigation demonstrated the subtle changes of bio-factor entities'representations in the GP-GPT, which suggested the opportunities for the application of LLMs to advancing gene-phenotype research.

2502.13290.tldr: This work explores the applicability of neural temporal point processes in the context of adverse event onset prediction, with the aim of explaining clinical pathways and providing interpretable insights.

2511.17507.tldr: The present and future uses of AI from the interfaces are clarified, to identify the obstacles, obstacles, brakes and limits to appropriation ``in the fact of making the content one's own and integrating it as a part of oneself'' in the context of a collaboration between musician and machine.

2511.17580.tldr: A multi-resource load balancing strategy which can be utilised within an agent-based system where the social behaviour of the agent and its adaptation abilities are applied to determine an optimal setup for a given configuration.

2409.08641.tldr: A framework designed to identify key problem features that characterize its complexity and guide the selection of suitable algorithms to solve diverse JSP scenarios, thereby advancing efficiency and sustainability in manufacturing logistics.

2409.15687.tldr: This study aims to provide a comprehensive evaluation of 33 LLMs, ranging from 2 billion to 405+ billion parameters, in performing key mental health tasks using social media data across six datasets, representing the largest-scale systematic evaluation of modern LLMs for mental health applications.

2409.17516.tldr: The primary goal is to provide a perspective on spike classification for future research and provide a comprehensive understanding of the methodologies and issues involved, and organizes materials in the spike classification field for future studies.

2410.01791.tldr: This work presents DreamGarden, an AI system capable of assisting with the development of diverse game environments in Unreal Engine, and explores design implications of this system, charting courses for future work in semi-autonomous assistants and open-ended simulation design.

2410.08255.tldr: It is concluded that the lack of ground truth representations of graphs makes it challenging to study how LLMs represent them, and improving the understanding of LLM representations could facilitate the development of more interpretable, robust, and controllable AI systems.

2411.02462.tldr: This paper investigates both full fine-tuning and various PEFT methods, including LoRA, (IA)^3, and prompt tuning, across thirteen models of different architectures and sizes and shows that LoRA can deliver performance comparable to full fine-tuning for unit test generation in several cases.

2412.01558.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations on QVHighlights, TVSum, and Charades-STA benchmarks demonstrate that VideoLights significantly surpasses existing baselines, establishing new state-of-the-art performances.

2412.10924.tldr: It is argued that LLMs demonstrate that the Distributional Hypothesis is sufficient for reasonably human-like language performance, and that the emergence of human-meaningful linguistic units among tokens and current structural constraints motivate changes to existing, linguistically-agnostic tokenization techniques.

2412.15289.tldr: This work proposes a novel jailbreak paradigm, Simple Assistive Task Linkage (SATA), which can effectively circumvent LLM safeguards and elicit harmful responses and achieves state-of-the-art performance and outperforms baselines by a large margin.

2412.16216.tldr: This work introduces a novel MoE graph-based framework, GMoE, aimed at enhancing the collaboration among multiple experts, and leverages a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique, i.e., Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), to implement the graph MoE architecture.

2412.17629.tldr: Graph Neural Evolution is proposed, a novel EA framework that represents the population as a graph, where nodes represent individuals, and edges capture their relationships, enabling global information usage and outperforms classical and advanced algorithms under various conditions, including noise-corrupted and optimal solution deviation scenarios.

2501.07502.tldr: A new policy loss function is proposed that penalizes distribution similarities between the current policy and different-level experiences, and assigns different weights to the penalty terms based on the performance levels, hence yielding a similar learning mechanism as humans.

2501.08068.tldr: A taxonomy of integration methods is presented, exploring how LLMs can be utilized within the HP life cycle and initial results for a state-of-the-art HP planner and LLM planner are presented.

2501.12104.tldr: A novel model named PFADSeg is proposed, which integrates a pre-trained teacher network, a denoising student network with multi-scale feature fusion, and a guided anomaly segmentation network into a unified framework, and improves the student network's ability to learn from teacher network features.

2501.16466.tldr: The need to improve the abstractions and interfaces for LLM-assisted red teaming is argued, with the design and implementation of Incalmo, an LLM-assisted system for autonomously red teaming multi-host networks.

2501.17079.tldr: This work proposes a novel mean field control model inspired by local weak convergence to include sparse graphs such as power law networks with coefficients above two and designs scalable learning algorithms which apply to the challenging class of graph sequences with finite first moment.

2502.00313.tldr: This paper examines whether LLM responses adhere to fundamental fairness concepts such as equitability, envy-freeness, and Rawlsian maximin, and investigates their alignment with human preferences, and examines the performance of several LLMs, providing a comparative benchmark of their ability to reflect these measures.

2502.04645.tldr: This work mechanistically analyzing how one commonly used model, a cross-encoder, estimates relevance finds that the model extracts traditional relevance signals in early-to-middle layers and combines these concepts in later layers similar to the well-known probabilistic ranking function, BM25.

2502.18978.tldr: Low-Confidence Gold (LCG) is introduced, a novel filtering framework that employs centroid-based clustering and confidence-guided selection for identifying valuable instruction pairs that curates high-quality subsets while preserving data diversity.

2503.05012.tldr: This semi-structured interviews with sixteen early-adopter software professionals who integrated LLM-based tools into their day-to-day work in early to mid-2023 offer actionable implications for developers, organizations, educators, and tool designers seeking to integrate LLMs responsibly into software practice today.

2503.06567.tldr: This work proposes CogGRAG, a human cognition-inspired, graph-based RAG framework designed for Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA), which unifies problem decomposition, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning under a single graph-structured cognitive framework, allowing early integration of relational knowledge and adaptive verification.

2503.10638.tldr: An empirical study is carried out to provide a fresh perspective on classifier-free guidance, tracing back to the root, i.e., classifier guidance, pinpoint the key assumption for the derivation, and conduct a systematic study to understand the role of the classifier.

2503.10727.tldr: This work proposes a two-tiered evaluation methodology capturing both passage-level classification and span-level annotation quality and conducts a comparative analysis of seven state-of-the-art LLMs on two annotation schemes, including the widely used OPP-115 dataset.

2503.13223.tldr: A Distributionally Robust Free Energy model is introduced that embeds robustness directly into the agent decision-making mechanisms through free energy minimization and may inspire both deployments in multi-agent settings and the quest for an explanation of how natural agents survive in capricious environments.

2503.13558.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid survival analysis framework integrating survival data reconstruction, survival model learning, and survival probability estimation that transforms battery voltage time series into time-to-failure data using path signatures.

2503.22688.tldr: A benchmark for evaluating the instruction-following capabilities of LLMs in interactive code generation, which incorporates nine types of verifiable instructions aligned with the real-world software development requirements, facilitating the evaluation of instruction-following capability in multi-turn interactions.

2504.01632.tldr: This paper introduces novel, region-aware metrics for benchmarking the spatial robustness of segmentation models, along with an evaluation framework to assess the impact of natural localized corruptions, and proposes a region-aware multi-attack adversarial analysis to systematically assess model robustness across specific image regions.

2504.13612.tldr: A time scheduler that selects sampling points based on entropy rather than uniform time spacing, ensuring that each point contributes an equal amount of information to the final generation, and proves that this time reparameterization does not depend on the initial choice of time.

2504.15668.tldr: A novel method of waypoint identification is proposed by casting the problem as an instance of the longest common subsequence problem, a widely popular problem in computer science, typically considered as an illustrative example for the dynamic programming paradigm.

2505.11579.tldr: The case for dimensional governance is made: a framework that tracks how decision authority, process autonomy, and accountability distribute dynamically across human-AI relationships, and where a dimensional mindset could offer a more resilient and future-proof path forward for both governance and innovation at the frontier of artificial intelligence.

2505.13738.tldr: As N and D scale, optimal $\tau$ obeys a precise power law in the tokens-per-parameter ratio, D/N, which provides a method to accurately predict $\lambda$opt in advance of large-scale training.

2505.18670.tldr: This work develops MoveGPT, a large-scale foundation model specifically architected to overcome barriers to scaling ability in human mobility, validating a clear path toward building increasingly capable foundation models in this domain.

2505.19536.tldr: This work rethink the emergence of redundant visual tokens from a fundamental perspective: information flow, which models the interaction between tokens and layers by capturing how information moves between tokens across layers by capturing how information moves between tokens across layers.

2505.19574.tldr: A novel framework for online learning of hidden state representations, with which robots can adapt in real time to uncertain and dynamic conditions that would otherwise be ambiguous and result in suboptimal or erroneous behaviors, enabling adaptive and context-aware decision-making.

2505.20613.tldr: This paper presents REAL-Prover, a new open-source stepwise theorem prover for Lean 4 to push the boundary on solving college-level mathematics problems and introduces FATE-M, a new benchmark focused on algebraic problems, where the prover achieves a SOTA success rate of 56.7%.

2505.21505.tldr: This work proposes a ternary classification methodology that categorizes neurons into three types, including language-specific neurons, language-related neurons, and general neurons, and proposes a corresponding identification algorithm to distinguish these different types of neurons.

2505.22633.tldr: This work introduces SKG2Data, a novel multimodal synthesis approach guided by spatial knowledge graphs, grounded in the concept of knowledge-to-data generation that enhances the spatial perception and reasoning abilities of MLLMs markedly, albeit with a slight cost to their general capabilities.

2505.23518.tldr: TRAP is introduced, a novel generative adversarial framework that manipulates the agent's decision-making using diffusion-based semantic injections into the vision-language embedding space, guided by a Siamese semantic network and layout-aware spatial masking.

2506.04427.tldr: A graph-based framework that leverages human-curated relational knowledge to explicitly encode schema links and join paths is proposed, and is believed to be the first multi-table QA system applied to truly complex industrial tabular data.

2506.09755.tldr: Intelligent Design 4.0 is introduced as an emerging paradigm empowered by foundation model-based agentic AI systems and an ontological framework is proposed for ID 4.0 to support end-to-end automation of engineering design processes through coordinated, autonomous multi-agent-based systems.

2506.09782.tldr: Q-SAM2 is presented, an accurate low-bit quantization method that achieves high compression and high fidelity and introduces two novel contributions: Variance-Reduced Calibration (VRC), an initialization method that reduces weight statistical variance by minimizing the Frobenius norm over a small calibration batch.

2506.10016.tldr: This survey categorises six primary generative modalities and examines how foundational techniques, namely Self-Supervised Learning, Mixture of Experts, Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, and Chain-of-Thought prompting, enable cross-modal capabilities.

2506.11088.tldr: SPACE is proposed, a unified framework that jointly enhances factuality and faithfulness by editing shared activation subspaces within neural representations in LLMs through a hybrid probe strategy combining spectral clustering and attention head saliency scoring.

2506.12109.tldr: This paper proposes CoPe (Contrasting Personal Preference), a novel decoding-time approach applied after performing parameter-efficient fine-tuning on user-specific data to leverage reward-guided decoding specifically for personalization by maximizing each user's implicit reward signal.

2506.12509.tldr: The results show that GoV's adaptive approach significantly outperforms both holistic baselines and other state-of-the-art decomposition-based methods, establishing a new standard for training-free reasoning verification.

2506.13292.tldr: By improving registration accuracy and minimizing manual intervention, this work enhances intraoperative navigation, contributing to more accurate and effective surgical outcomes in computer-assisted surgery (CAS).

2506.16001.tldr: This work introduces AutoHFormer, a hierarchical autoregressive transformer that addresses challenges of time series forecasting through three key innovations: Hierarchical Temporal Modeling, Adaptive Temporal Encoding, and Dynamic Windowed Attention.

2506.16114.tldr: A GFlowNets-based fine-tuning framework that integrates collaborative knowledge from traditional recommender systems to create an adaptive trajectory sampler and a comprehensive reward model and emerges as a promising approach to mitigate the exposure bias problem.

2506.20495.tldr: This work proposes ReCode (rule-based Reinforcement learning for Code Update), a novel framework that mimics human programmer adaptation to API changes and significantly boosts LLMs' code generation performance in dynamic API scenarios, especially on the unseen CodeUpdateArena task.

2506.23210.tldr: Experiments on image classification and medical image segmentation demonstrate that FedRef achieves superior predictive performance and faster convergence under heterogeneous, non-IID settings, while significantly lowering client-side computation compared with existing methods.

2507.02752.tldr: A novel retrosynthesis-guided molecule design framework that finds synthetically accessible molecular analogs by emulating expert chemists' strategies in three steps: retrosynthesis, searching similar building blocks, and virtual synthesis, which outperforms state-of-the-art machine learning models at exploring synthetically accessible analogs.

2507.04726.tldr: This work introduces a model-poisoning attack that embeds a covert backdoor into a ControlNet, causing it to produce attacker-specified content when exposed to visual triggers, without textual prompts, and proposes clean fine-tuning (CFT), a practical defense for responsible synthetic-data pipelines.

2507.10510.tldr: This work identifies that ultra-low bitrate is a key factor for low latency, and proposes Context-Aware Video Streaming that recognizes the importance of each video region for chat and allocates bitrate almost exclusively to chat-important regions.

2507.10750.tldr: AI might cause some initial growing pains for the environment, but it has the potential to support climate mitigation efforts, and its ability to further automate and optimize processes across industries, from energy production to logistics, could significantly decrease the authors' carbon footprint.

2507.16356.tldr: A field trial of a collaborative bandit algorithm designed to optimize call timing by learning individual mothers' preferred call times demonstrates a statistically significant improvement in call pick-up rates with the bandit algorithm, indicating its potential to enhance message delivery and impact millions of mothers across India.

2507.16887.tldr: Comparing the performance of PLMs under both fine-tuning and prompt engineering, assessing their effectiveness and generalizability across various training and testing settings, and analyzing their robustness to a series of perturbations reveal that PLMs incorporating pre-training tasks designed to capture the syntactic and semantic patterns of code outperform both general-purpose PLMs and those solely pre-trained or fine-tuned on large code corpora.

2508.01285.tldr: BioDisco is a multi-agent framework that draws upon language model-based reasoning and a dual-mode evidence system for grounded novelty, integrates an internal scoring and feedback loop for iterative refinement, and validates performance through pioneering temporal and human evaluations and a Bradley-Terry paired comparison model to provide statistically-grounded assessment.

2508.02744.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive analysis of LLM-based agents designed for data science tasks, summarizing insights from recent studies and offering a dual-perspective framework that connects general agent design principles with the practical workflows in data science.

2508.02912.tldr: It is revealed that while emergent communication is viable in simple settings, the engineered, world model-based approach shows superior performance, sample efficiency, and scalability as complexity increases.

2508.02995.tldr: This work demonstrates that integrating high-level neuroscientific principles, viewed through a geometric lens, can lead to more efficient and robust models, providing a promising direction for addressing long-standing challenges in machine learning.

2508.03546.tldr: A novel Supervised Deep Dynamic Principal component analysis framework that incorporates the target variable and lagged observations into the factor extraction process, and a factor-augmented nonlinear dynamic forecasting model that unifies a broad family of factor-model-based forecasting approaches is proposed.

2508.05264.tldr: SGDFuse is proposed, a conditional diffusion model guided by the Segment Anything Model that achieves state-of-the-art performance in both subjective and objective evaluations, as well as in its adaptability to downstream tasks, providing a powerful solution to the core challenges in image fusion.

2508.06251.tldr: This work proposes a method for generating privacy-preserving high-quality synthetic tabular data using Tensor Networks, specifically Matrix Product States (MPS), and benchmark the MPS-based generative model against state-of-the-art models, focusing on both fidelity and privacy-preserving capabilities.

2508.06908.tldr: A novel benchmark for multi-modal large language models-based person ReID, termed VP-ReID, is introduced to facilitate the community in developing more robust and generalizable cross-modal foundation models for person ReID.

2508.07742.tldr: A declarative rule-based framework for specifying and computing a priority relation between conflicting facts, which employs answer set programming to evaluate the preference rules, apply the desired cycle resolution techniques to obtain a priority relation, and answer queries under prioritized-repair semantics is introduced.

2508.08227.tldr: The OMGSR framework is presented, a GAN-based Real-ISR framework that employs a DDPM-based generative model as the generator and a DINOv3-ConvNeXt model with multi-level discriminator heads as the discriminator, and the DINOv3-ConvNeXt DISTS (Dv3CD) loss is enhanced for structural perception at varying resolutions.

2508.10123.tldr: A novel ReFT framework, dubbed Nested-ReFT, where a subset of layers of the target model acts as the behavior model to generate off-policy completions during training, and three variants of bias mitigation to minimize the off-policyness in the gradient updates that allows for maintaining performance that matches the baseline ReFT performance.

2508.11977.tldr: TBGRecall is proposed, a framework integrating Next Session Prediction (NSP), designed to enhance generative retrieval models for e-commerce applications, and represents a significant advancement in the effectiveness of generative recommendation systems for e-commerce applications.

2508.17167.tldr: An error analysis for the deep Kolmogorov method for heat PDEs is provided and convergence with convergence rates for the overall mean square distance between the exact solution of the heat PDE and the realization function of the approximating deep neural network (DNN).

2508.18337.tldr: Warm Chat is proposed, a novel emotion-aware talking head generation framework for dyadic interactions that produces temporally consistent virtual avatars with rich emotional variations that seamlessly transition between speaking and listening states.

2508.20840.tldr: This framework leverages the spatiotemporal vision priors in video models and the semantic awareness of VLMs to bridge the gap between fine-grained physical interaction and high-level reasoning, paving the way toward scalable, interpretable, and general-purpose embodied intelligence.

2509.00062.tldr: It is shown that discrete diffusion language models can be extended beyond inherently sequential domains such as text to generate spatially coherent 3D structures and produces realistic and coherent structures even when trained on data with over 98% sparsity.

2509.09711.tldr: This work introduces PsychiatryBench, a rigorously curated benchmark grounded exclusively in authoritative, expert-validated psychiatric textbooks and casebooks, and offers a modular, extensible platform for benchmarking and improving LLM performance in mental health applications.

2509.21354.tldr: KV-Efficient VLA is presented, a model-agnostic memory compression approach designed to address limitations of Vision-Language-Action models by introducing a lightweight mechanism to selectively retain high-utility context.

2509.22850.tldr: This work introduces a novel black-box, decision-based adversarial attack tailored for tabular data that combines gradient-free direction estimation with an iterative boundary search, enabling efficient navigation of discrete and continuous feature spaces under minimal oracle access.

2509.25662.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework using formal abductive explanations to explain proxy discrimination in individual AI decisions, leveraging background knowledge to identify which features act as unjustified proxies for protected attributes, revealing hidden structural biases.

2510.01047.tldr: In-situ Tweedie Discrete Diffusion is proposed, a framework that performs diffusion guaranteed by Tweedie's formula directly within the discrete one-hot space, hence"in-situ."
