2512.15584.tldr: This work provides a principled method for determining when an AI is aligned enough for a given context, shifting the focus from achieving perfect alignment to managing the risks and rewards of delegation under uncertainty.

2512.16214.tldr: PDE-Agent is introduced, the first toolchain-augmented multi-agent collaboration framework, inheriting the reasoning capacity of LLMs and the controllability of external tools and enabling automated PDE solving from natural language descriptions, to validate and evaluate this new paradigm of toolchain-augmented multi-agent PDE solving.

2512.16244.tldr: A Coarse-to-Fine open-set Classification (CFC) framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) for graph datasets and improves OOD detection by ten percent over state-of-the-art methods on graph and text domains and achieves up to seventy percent accuracy in OOD classification on graph datasets.

2512.16280.tldr: Investigating romance-baiting scams and the role of Large Language Models in both current and future automation suggests that romance-baiting scams may be amenable to full-scale LLM automation, while existing defenses remain inadequate to prevent their expansion.

2512.16301.tldr: Post-training methods, adaptive memory architectures, and agent skills are reviewed; their trade-offs in cost, flexibility, and generalization are compared; and evaluation practices are summarized across deep research, software development, computer use, and drug discovery.

2512.16515.tldr: A way of reading the universe's history as the evolution of dynamics itself, culminating in biological and artificial systems capable of modeling, predicting, and deliberately perturbing their own future trajectories is presented.

2512.16661.tldr: An Attention-Based Subgraph Retriever model is proposed, a GNN-as-retriever model that applies attention-based pruning to extract a refined subgraph, which is then passed to a large language model for advanced knowledge reasoning.

2512.16707.tldr: This work formalizes two independent computational limitations that constrain algorithmic intelligence: formal incompleteness and dynamical unpredictability and shows that these two extrema together impose structural bounds on an agent's ability to reason about its own predictive capabilities.

2512.17100.tldr: UniCoMTE, a model-agnostic framework for generating counterfactual explanations for multivariate time series classifiers, is introduced and results show that the approach produces concise, stable, and human-aligned explanations that outperform existing methods in both clarity and applicability.

2512.17145.tldr: This work proposes a Solomonoff-inspired method that weights LLM-generated hypotheses by simplicity and predictive fit, and produces Solomonoff-weighted mixtures for per-cell predictions, yielding conservative, uncertainty-aware outputs even when hypotheses are noisy or partially incorrect.

2512.17370.tldr: TakeAD is proposed, a novel preference-based post-optimization framework that fine-tunes the pre-trained IL policy with this disengagement data to enhance the closed-loop driving performance and mitigating the open-loop gap.

2512.18561.tldr: The Adaptive Accountability Framework is presented, an end-to-end runtime layer that records cryptographically verifiable interaction provenance, detects distributional change points in streaming traces, and applies cost-bounded interventions-reward shaping and targeted policy patching-to steer the system back toward compliant behavior.

2512.18567.tldr: This work builds a high-precision detection pipeline and a representative benchmark to distinguish AIGCode from human-written code, and applies them to development commits from the top 1,000 GitHub repositories (2022-2025) and 7,000+ recent CVE-linked code changes.

2512.18571.tldr: This work proposes ESearch-R1, a cost-aware embodied reasoning framework that unifies interactive dialogue, episodic memory retrieval, and physical navigation into a single decision process and introduces HC-GRPO (Heterogeneous Cost-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization).

2512.18573.tldr: A hybrid 3D deep learning model for automated PAS detection from volumetric MRI scans is proposed and developed and evaluated on a retrospective dataset of 1,133 MRI volumes, demonstrating a clear potential to assist radiologists by providing a robust decision support to improve diagnostic consistency across interpretations, and ultimately enhance the accuracy and timeliness of PAS diagnosis.

2512.18575.tldr: This work provides the first empirical evidence for modality-specific memory optimization in neuromorphic systems, achieving 603x energy efficiency over traditional neural networks.

2512.18593.tldr: This paper presents the work for the JUST-NLP 2025 Legal MT shared task, focusing on English-Hindi translation using Transformer-based approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of domain adaptation in enhancing translation quality and demonstrating the potential of L-MT systems to improve access to justice and legal transparency in multilingual contexts.

2512.18607.tldr: An inherent representational bias in modern DNNs is uncovered and interaction order is established as a powerful lens for interpreting and guiding deep representations in DNNs.

2512.18613.tldr: Text2Graph VPR is presented, an explainable semantic localization system that converts image sequences into textual scene descriptions, parses those descriptions into structured scene graphs, and reasons over the resulting graphs to identify places.

2512.18614.tldr: PTTA is presented, a pure text-to-animation framework for high-quality animation creation and extensive visual evaluations show that the proposed approach consistently outperforms comparable baselines in animation video synthesis.

2512.18616.tldr: A practical human-AI teaming framework grounded in shared mental models, a deception-based strategy for insider threat detection, and empirical evidence of enhanced robustness under adversarial conditions are contributed.

2512.18618.tldr: A solver tailored for practical packaging-planning scenarios with richer constraints, including multiple placeholder options, time-frame restrictions, and multi-class item packaging is developed, significantly outperforming the shaking-based exact solver.

2512.18619.tldr: Qualitative results demonstrate that the model preserves spatial coherence during non-contact motion and generates plausible contact predictions, while the LLM-based judge distinguishes collision from non-collision trajectories.

2512.18622.tldr: MATS, a novel Text2SQL framework designed specifically for Large Language Models, uses a multi-agent mechanism that assigns specialized roles to auxiliary agents, reducing individual workloads and fostering interaction, thereby maintaining competitive performance despite a limited LLM size.

2512.18623.tldr: LLM-CAS is proposed, a framework that formulates real-time hallucination correction as a hierarchical reinforcement learning problem and provides an efficient and context aware solution for improving the reliability of LLMs, with promising potential for future multimodal extensions.

2512.18633.tldr: ARC (Attribute Representation via Compositional Learning), a cross-problem learning framework that learns disentangled attribute representations by decomposing them into two complementary components, achieves state-of-the-art performance across in-distribution, zero-shot generalization, few-shot adaptation, and real-world benchmarks.

2512.18640.tldr: This work proposes GPERT, a framework to address the trade-off between accuracy and temporal resolution in event-based 3DGS, by decouple the rendering into two branches: event-by-event geometry (depth) rendering and snapshot-based radiance (intensity) rendering, by using ray-tracing and the image of warped events.

2512.18661.tldr: The ASTIF (Adaptive Semantic-Temporal Integration for Cryptocurrency Price Forecasting), a hybrid intelligent system that adapts its forecasting strategy in real time through confidence-based meta-learning, is proposed, a scalable, knowledge-based solution for fusing quantitative and qualitative data in non-stationary environments.

2512.18665.tldr: It is proposed that chunking mechanisms play an essential role and shown how the CogAct computational model grounds concept learning in fundamental cognitive processes and structures (such as chunking, attention, STM and LTM), and integrated into the broader theories of cognitive psychology.

2512.18669.tldr: IntelliCode demonstrates how persistent learner modeling, orchestrated multi-agent reasoning, and principled instructional design can be combined to produce transparent and reliable LLM-driven tutoring.

2512.18674.tldr: Remoe is a heterogeneous MoE inference system tailored for serverless computing that assigns non-expert modules to GPUs and expert modules to CPUs, and offloads infrequently activated experts to separate serverless functions to reduce memory overhead and enable parallel execution.

2512.18703.tldr: A novel trajectory planning framework that integrates causal prior knowledge into the control process and achieves a closer alignment with human driving behaviors is proposed, providing methodological support for human-like trajectory planning and practical value for improving safety, stability, and realism in autonomous vehicle testing and traffic simulation platforms.

2512.18709.tldr: A Knowledge Mastery-State Disambiguation for Knowledge Tracing model (KeenKT), which represents a student's knowledge state at each interaction using a Normal-Inverse-Gaussian distribution, thereby capturing the fluctuations in student learning behaviors and introducing an NIG-distance-based attention mechanism to model the dynamic evolution of the knowledge state.

2512.18732.tldr: A geometric framework in which conceptual growth is modeled as admissible basis extension evaluated under a Minimum Description Length (MDL) criterion, and distinguish representational counterfactuals--counterfactuals over an agent's conceptual basis--from causal or value-level counterfactuals, and show how MDL provides a normative selection principle governing representational change.

2512.18733.tldr: This work proposes XG-Guard, an explainable and fine-grained safeguarding framework for detecting malicious agents in MAS, and utilizes a bi-level agent encoder to jointly model the sentence- and token-level representations of each agent.

2512.18735.tldr: A challenging new testbed to catalyze the development of next-generation models with a more holistic understanding of the dynamic visual world, built upon paired videos that provide multi-perspective observations of an indoor scene before and after a state change.

2512.18737.tldr: PIPCFR is introduced, a novel approach that incorporates post-treatment variables to improve pseudo-outcome imputation and achieves significantly lower ITE errors compared to existing methods.

2512.18747.tldr: IPCV is proposed, a training-free, information-preserving compression framework for MLLM visual encoders that substantially reduces end-to-end computation and outperforms state-of-the-art training-free token compression methods across diverse image and video benchmarks.

2512.18755.tldr: MEEA leverages repeated low-toxicity semantic exposure to induce a gradual shift in a model's effective safety threshold, enabling progressive erosion of alignment constraints over sustained interactions, and demonstrates that LLM safety behavior is inherently dynamic and history-dependent.

2512.18791.tldr: A universal watermarking scheme for TTS diffusion models, termed Smark, is proposed by designing a lightweight watermark embedding framework that operates in the common reverse diffusion paradigm shared by all TTS diffusion models.

2512.18792.tldr: This work argues for a pragmatic statistical-causal reframing: explanations of computational systems should be treated as parameters of a (statistical) model, inferred from computational traces, and interpretability methods become statistical estimators.

2512.18797.tldr: Using a quantum kernel in audio deepfake detection reduces falsepositive rates without increasing model size, and compares quantum-kernel SVMs (QSVMs) with classical SVMs using identical mel-spectrogram preprocessing and stratified 5-fold cross-validation across four corpora.

2512.18809.tldr: This work proposes an on-device federated learning framework for video violence detection that integrates self-supervised VideoMAE representations, LoRA-based parameter-efficient adaptation, and defense-in-depth privacy protection and reduces the trainable parameter count to 5.5M.

2512.18815.tldr: Stochastic Decomposition Layers (SDL) is introduced for converting deterministic machine learning weather models into probabilistic ensemble systems and requires less than 2\% of the computational cost needed to train the baseline model.

2512.18826.tldr: This survey reviews hyperbolic graph embedding models, and evaluates them on anomaly detection, highlighting their advantages over Euclidean methods in capturing complex structures and provides an open-source library to foster further research in this field.

2512.18878.tldr: CrashChat is proposed, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) for multitask traffic crash analysis, built upon VideoLLaMA3, which acquires domain-specific knowledge through instruction fine-tuning and employs a novel multitask learning strategy based on task decoupling and grouping, which maximizes the benefit of joint learning within and across task groups while mitigating negative transfer.

2512.18892.tldr: This work introduces a structural reinforcement learning (SRL) method which treats prices via simulation while exploiting agents'sructural knowledge of their own individual dynamics and yields a general and highly efficient global solution method for heterogeneous agent models.

2512.18908.tldr: Results demonstrate that expert-knowledge-guided probabilistic reasoning can significantly enhance automated triage systems, offering a promising approach to supporting emergency responders in MCIs.

2512.18930.tldr: This paper introduces a training- and inference-light, interpretable method for representing and transferring artistic style, achieving or surpassing existing methods on style evaluations (VGG Style Loss and CLIP Score Style) while being 1.7-20x faster and, critically, interpretable.

2512.18947.tldr: A novel algorithm centered on a Clustering-based Autoencoder prediction dynamic response mechanism, which utilizes an autoencoder model to process matched clusters to generate a highly diverse initial population is proposed.

2512.18950.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that structured external memory with Bayesian selection and contrastive refinement enables sample-efficient, interpretable, and continually improving agents without LLM parameter updates.

2512.18969.tldr: SASOW is proposed, an enhancement of KG-SP that considers the weighting of states and objects while improving composition recognition accuracy, and introduces self-attention mechanisms into the classifiers for states and objects, leading to enhanced accuracy in recognizing both.

2512.18986.tldr: R-GenIMA is introduced, an interpretable multimodal large language model that couples a novel ROI-wise vision transformer with genetic prompting to jointly model structural MRI and single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) variations that yields biologically meaningful explanations in Alzheimer's disease.

2512.18991.tldr: A global geometric association strategy that establishes consistent instance correspondences by estimating an optimal transformation between instance-level point sets and a global geometry-aware soft matching mechanism that enforces spatially coherent point-wise correspondences grounded in the spatial distribution of instance point sets is proposed.

2512.18999.tldr: Experimental results show that while the end-to-end approach frequently fails on lengthy and complex forms, the modular method-built on task decomposition, semantic clustering, and flow management-substantially improves dialog stability and extraction accuracy, highlighting the necessity of integrating external control mechanisms when deploying LLMs in high-stakes medical follow-up scenarios.

2512.19004.tldr: A training-free interface is proposed that injects prompt-conditioned priors from a lightweight auxiliary model into the diffusion initialization, and instantiate it with two mechanisms: discrete token injection and representation-level embedding interpolation.

2512.19024.tldr: This work introduces IndoorUAV, a novel benchmark and method specifically tailored for VLN with indoor UAVs, and introduces the IndoorUAV-Agent, a novel navigation model designed for this benchmark, leveraging task decomposition and multimodal reasoning.

2512.19026.tldr: Across CUB, Stanford Cars, and animal Re-ID benchmarks, Finer-Personalization Rank more faithfully reflects identity retention than semantic-only metrics and reveals substantial identity drift in several popular personalization methods.

2512.19061.tldr: This paper introduces a graph transformation technique that first identifies connected components via hard links, merges them into super-nodes, and then reconstructs a weighted soft-link graph amenable to efficient embedding and clustering that provides a scalable and practical solution for industrial-scale fraud detection systems.

2512.19069.tldr: This work leverages existing techniques for extracting high-level concepts from larger models to investigate their transferability to smaller language models (SLM) during inference, and introduces inference-time scaling to enhance performance by dynamically adjusting the steering intensity.

2512.19081.tldr: The proposed Population-Evolve, a training-free method inspired by Genetic Algorithms to optimize LLM reasoning, maintains a dynamic population of candidate solutions for each problem via parallel reasoning, and establishes a unification framework that interprets existing test-time scaling strategies through the lens of genetic algorithms.

2512.19093.tldr: A framework that joins reasoning and calculation using NuminaMath-7B-TIR, GPT-4o, and Mistral-7B using adaptive routing, tool-based reinforcement learning, and knowledge distillation to connect different reasoning paths.

2512.19096.tldr: A new conditioning rule is introduced for Accept-Desirability models, based on the idea that observing an event introduces new indifferences between options, and two interesting special cases where all of the AGM axioms for belief revision still hold are investigated.

2512.19107.tldr: The FC-MIR framework is proposed, leveraging keyframe sampling and adaptive concatenation, it cuts visual redundancy to boost inference efficiency, while integrating state-of-the-art closed-source MLLMs or fine-tuned models for trajectory summarization and intent prediction, and deployed in a real-world setting.

2512.19114.tldr: This work introduces HyperLoad, a cross-modality framework that exploits pre-trained large language models (LLMs) to overcome data scarcity and consistently surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating its practicality for sustainable green data center management.

2512.19154.tldr: A meta-algorithm (Adaptive Stacking) is proposed for achieving exactly that with convergence guarantees and quantify the reduced computation and memory constraints for MLP, LSTM, and Transformer-based agents.

2512.19155.tldr: A hierarchical design principle is suggested: GWT provides broadcast capacity, while HOT provides quality control, while GWT-style broadcasting amplifies internal noise, creating extreme fragility.

2512.19178.tldr: The Vision-Language-Policy (VLP) model, based on a vision-language model fine-tuned on real-world data, can interpret semantic instructions and integrate reasoning over the current task scene to generate behavior policies that control the robot to accomplish the task.

2512.19180.tldr: It is suggested that quantum derived information becomes most valuable when integrated through principled multimodal fusion rather than used in isolation or loosely appended to classical features.

2512.19184.tldr: A new Rademacher generalization bound is derived for this framework, explicitly addressing underfitting and overfitting through kernel refinement strategies, and a novel deep learning framework, deep vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (vvRKHS), is proposed.

2512.19199.tldr: A tighter bound is proposed than those derived from conventional norm based methods by leveraging small condition numbers in the weight matrices and introducing a tailored Sobolev space as an expanded hypothesis space, offering a more precise theoretical understanding of multitask deep learning in the context of kernel methods.

2512.19206.tldr: MixKVQ is proposed, a novel plug-and-play method that introduces a lightweight, query-aware algorithm to identify and preserve critical key channels that need higher precision, while applying per-token quantization for value cache.

2512.19210.tldr: An interactive framework for evaluating whether large language models (LLMs) exhibit genuine "understanding" in a simple yet strategic environment, focusing on Rock-Paper-Scissors, provides a practical and interpretable proxy for mind-like inference in sequential games, offering insights into both the strengths and limitations of current LLM reasoning.

2512.19219.tldr: Image-LoRA is introduced, a vision-oriented PEFT recipe that views LoRA as a token-level residual update and applies this update only to visual tokens, and matches or closely approaches standard LoRA, while showing especially favorable trade-offs in image-token-heavy regimes.

2512.19221.tldr: Overall, this study demonstrates that graph-based structure provides expressive, generalizable, and interpretable signals for modelling urban perception, advancing human-centric and context-aware urban analytics.

2512.19228.tldr: This work investigates the extent to which LLMs, adapted on domain-specific code and data through different fine-tuning strategies, can generate rule-based plausibility checks for forgery detection on constrained hardware resources and demonstrates that the models are capable of generating executable and effective verification procedures.

2512.19234.tldr: The proposed DeliveryBench is a city-scale embodied benchmark grounded in the real-world profession of food delivery and reveals a substantial performance gap to humans, and finds that VLM-based embodied agents are short-sighted and frequently break basic commonsense constraints.

2512.19240.tldr: ChemATP is introduced, a framework that decouples chemical knowledge from the reasoning engine and enables frozen LLMs to explicitly retrieve and reason over this information dynamically, ensuring interpretability and adaptability while preserving the LLM's intrinsic general intelligence.

2512.19247.tldr: A novel prompt optimization pipeline for frame detection in logistics texts is proposed, combining retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, and automatic CoT synthesis (Auto-CoT) to generate highly effective task-specific prompts.

2512.19275.tldr: This study evaluates four different GenAI models across two primary evaluation tasks to assess their ability to restore gait patterns from reference videos under varying conditions of complexity and transfer these gait patterns to different visual identities, and exposes a fundamental flaw in appearance-based gait recognition.

2512.19287.tldr: Vibe Reasoning is introduced, a human-AI collaborative paradigm for solving complex mathematical problems that transforms AI's latent potential into manifested capability through generic meta-prompts, agentic grounding, and model orchestration, and suggests that lightweight human guidance can unlock frontier models'hematical reasoning potential.

2512.19297.tldr: Causal-Guided Detoxify Backdoor Attack (CBA) is proposed, a novel backdoor attack framework specifically designed for open-weight LoRA models that enables post-training control over attack intensity through causal influence-based weight allocation, eliminating the need for repeated retraining.

2512.19311.tldr: The training-testing discrepancy problem for improving the diffusion models is studied and a novel training approach, named MixFlow, is presented, motivated by the Slow Flow phenomenon, which leverages the interpolations at the slowed timesteps, named slowed interpolation mixture, for post-training the prediction network for each training timestep.

2512.19317.tldr: SafeMed-R1 is introduced, a hybrid defense framework that ensures robust performance while preserving high-quality, interpretable medical reasoning and demonstrates that models trained with explicit chain-of-thought reasoning exhibit superior adversarial robustness compared to instruction-only variants.

2512.19320.tldr: MAGIC is a plug-and-play framework that rectifies layer-wise magnitudes in feature and weight spaces, with three variants that consistently boosts performance across diverse Computer Vision tasks and NLP tasks without additional training.

2512.19323.tldr: Some tentative experiments are reported, where the original sinusoidal version of the alternative functions is substantially outperformed, which strongly suggests that the alternative functions may have a wider use in other transformer architectures.

2512.19349.tldr: VIGOR+ (Variational Information Gain for iterative cOnfounder Refinement), a novel framework that closes the loop between LLM-based confounder generation and CEVAE-based statistical validation and establishes an iterative feedback mechanism that guides subsequent LLM generation rounds.

2512.19350.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation benchmark, \textit{PENDULUM}, comprises approximately 2,000 human-curated Visual Question Answering pairs specifically designed to elicit sycophantic responses, and proposes novel metrics to quantify sycophancy in visual reasoning, offering deeper insights into its manifestations across different multimodal contexts.

2512.19355.tldr: This work considers the use of first-order languages in goal-conditioned RL and generalized planning, and shows that further performance gains can be achieved when states and goals are represented by sets of atoms.

2512.19387.tldr: A dual-pathway design introduces a novel paradigm for stable workflow recognition, demonstrating that decoupling the modeling of temporal consistency and phase ambiguity yields superior performance and clinical applicability.

2512.19396.tldr: EchoTrail-GUI is introduced, a novel framework designed to mimic human-like experiential learning by equipping agents with a dynamic, accessible memory, validating the power of structured memory in creating more robust and intelligent GUI automation.

2512.19410.tldr: It is argued that learnability in dynamical systems should be studied as a finite-sample question, and be based on the properties of the underlying dynamics rather than the statistical properties of the resulting sequence.

2512.19428.tldr: The complexity of Grassmann mixing is analyzed, linear scaling in sequence length for fixed rank is shown, and it is argued that such manifold-based designs offer a more structured route toward geometric and invariant-based interpretations of neural reasoning.

2512.19438.tldr: This work introduces a Collaborative Interaction Mechanism (CIM) that establishes direct, bidirectional communication between the embedder and extractor, enabling a mutual-teacher training paradigm and coordinated optimization.

2512.19456.tldr: Results show that the activations possess strong discriminative power in evaluating essay quality and that LLMs can adapt their evaluation perspectives to different traits and essay types, effectively handling the diversity of scoring criteria in cross-prompt settings.

2512.19458.tldr: VASP Agent is presented, a coding-agent-centered system that combines reusable domain skills, deterministic tools, workspace-state inspection, runtime evidence, and scientific guardrails to execute multi-step VASP calculations.

2512.19472.tldr: Multi-Layer Analysis for Confidence Scoring (MACS) is introduced, a unified post-hoc framework that analyzes intermediate activations to produce classification-maps that derive a score applicable for confidence estimation, detecting distributional shifts and adversarial attacks, and unifying the three problems in a common framework.

2512.19481.tldr: This work studies the capabilities of GPT-5 and GPT-5-mini to predict the code entities impacted by given source code changes and finds that both LLMs perform poorly in the two experiments, whereas GPT-5 outperforms GPT-5-mini.

2512.19506.tldr: A Domain Knowledge Embedded Spatio-Temporal Network (DK-STN), a stable neural network model for accurate and efficient MJO forecasting that combines the benefits of NWP and ANN methods and successfully improves the forecast accuracy of ANN methods while maintaining a high level of efficiency and stability.

2512.19516.tldr: The Latent Causal Diffusion Model (LacaDM), a novel approach designed to enhance the adaptability of MORL in discrete and continuous environments, learns latent temporal causal relationships between environmental states and policies, enabling efficient knowledge transfer across diverse MORL scenarios.

2512.19526.tldr: QuantiPhy is presented, the first benchmark designed to quantitatively measure a VLM's physical reasoning ability and finds that state-of-the-art VLMs lean heavily on pre-trained world knowledge rather than faithfully using the provided visual and textual inputs as references when reasoning kinematic properties quantitatively.

2512.19530.tldr: This work introduces the Catechol Benchmark, a high-throughput transient flow chemistry dataset comprising 1,227 experimental yield measurements for the rearrangement of allyl-substituted catechol in 24 pure solvents and their binary mixtures, parameterized by continuous volume fractions.

2512.19535.tldr: This work reinvestigate the effectiveness of cross-attention for vision-language modeling, and trains cross-attention VLMs both from a text-only LLM and by adapting a pretrained insertion-based VLM, showing that simple cross-attention is far more competitive with token insertion than previously reported.

2512.19551.tldr: An Emotion-Transferable and Scenario-Adapted Mixture of Experts (ES-MoE) approach which designs a causal-guided emotion decoupling block and a scenario-adapted expert constructing block to address the two challenges, respectively are proposed.

2512.19557.tldr: A Hybrid LRR-TED framework that addresses the dilemma of Scalability-Stability Dilemma by initialising the explanation matrix with automated safety rules and augmenting it with a Pareto-optimal set of just four human-defined risk rules, achieving 94.00% predictive accuracy.

2512.19560.tldr: This work introduces BabyFlow, a generative AI model that disentangles facial identity and expression, enabling independent control over both and improves 3D reconstruction accuracy, particularly in highly expressive regions such as the mouth, eyes, and nose.

2512.19564.tldr: This report introduces the competition format and provides a comparison of representative high-performing planners from the 2023 and 2024 editions of the CommonRoad Motion Planning Competition, conducted using the CommonRoad benchmark suite.

2512.19569.tldr: Analysis of global AI patenting from 2010 to 2023 finds a highly concentrated patent landscape: China leads in patent volumes, while the United States dominates in citation impact and technological influence.

2512.19609.tldr: A scalable synthetic data generation pipeline is introduced that leverages synthetic map images and pixel-level parsing to automatically produce precise annotations for this challenging task, and shows that fine-grained spatial reasoning, absent in pretrained models, can be explicitly taught with synthetic supervision.

2512.19620.tldr: This paper discovers features aligned with Human and Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPTs) responses by studying statistical and machine learning metrics and shows that instructing GPTs to employ metrics used by Human can improve their judgment and conforming them better with human responses.

2512.19654.tldr: A new notion of consistency is introduced, measuring the label distance between two consecutive solutions, and new consistent approximation algorithms for the classical $k$-center and $k$-median problems are designed.

2512.19663.tldr: This work proposes a novel knowledge-enhanced joint embedding framework that integrates retinal fundus images, clinical text, and structured patient data through a multimodal transformer architecture to address the critical gap in medical image-text alignment.

2512.19678.tldr: This work proposes WorldWarp, a framework that couples a 3D structural anchor with a 2D generative refiner that achieves state-of-the-art fidelity by ensuring that 3D logic guides structure while diffusion logic perfects texture.

2212.12044.tldr: This study analyzes the dynamic interactions among the NASDAQ index, crude oil, gold, and the US dollar using a reduced-order modeling approach, demonstrating that a limited number of principal components is sufficient to capture the dominant dynamics of each asset, with varying complexity across markets.

2401.09986.tldr: A novel model training approach for federated learning, FLex&Chill, is proposed, which exploits the Logit Chilling method and can expedite model convergence and improve inference accuracy in the presence of non-i.i.i.d. training data over local clients.

2401.15894.tldr: The Cycle to Mixer (Cy2Mixer) is introduced, a novel spatio-temporal GNN based on topological non-trivial invariants of spatio-temporal graphs with gated multi-layer perceptrons (gMLP).

2402.04536.tldr: This work introduces GEOTACT, the first robotic system capable of grasping and retrieving objects of potentially unknown shapes buried in a granular environment, and introduces a training curriculum that bootstraps learning in simulated granular environments, enabling zero-shot transfer to real hardware.

2407.04258.tldr: A novel approach for unsupervised video summarization using reinforcement learning (RL), addressing limitations like unstable adversarial training and reliance on heuristic-based reward functions by correlating summary quality with reconstruction ability.

2408.02152.tldr: This work proposes a few-shot indexing-based generative retrieval framework (Few-Shot GR), which has a few-shot indexing process without any training, and achieves superior performance to state-of-the-art GR methods requiring heavy training.

2411.18714.tldr: The Concept-Wrapper Network (CW-Net) is introduced, a method for faithfully explaining the behavior of machine-learning-based planners that causally grounds their reasoning in human-interpretable concepts without sacrificing performance.

2512.20482.tldr: SweRank+, a framework that couples SweRankMulti, a cross-lingual code ranking tool, with SweRankAgent, an agentic search setup, for iterative, multi-turn reasoning over the code repository, improves localization over single-pass ranking.

2512.20520.tldr: This study compares large language models, including GatorTron-Base (trained on clinical data), Llama 8B, and Mistral 7B, against models like BioBERT, DocBERT, BioClinicalBERT, Word2Vec, and Doc2Vec, setting benchmarks for predicting Shock in critically ill patients to suggest that LLMs are not inherently superior to SLMs in predicting future clinical events despite their strong performance on text-based tasks.

2512.20563.tldr: After careful modifications to narrow the gaps between expert and student, the TransFuser v6 (TFv6) student policy achieves a new state of the art on all major publicly available CARLA closed-loop benchmarks, reaching 95 DS on Bench2Drive and more than doubling prior performances on Longest6~v2 and Town13.

2512.20569.tldr: A simple and efficient recipe for layer selection that uses layer importance scores derived from a small amount of training on generic text data is described, which is more effective than existing approaches for layer selection, including heuristics that uniformly interleave linear attentions based on a fixed ratio.

2512.20586.tldr: SAGE (Secure Agent for Generative Dose Expertise), an LLM-based planning agent for automated SRS treatment planning, revealed that constraint verification and causal explanation concentrated in the reasoning agent, offering a path toward transparent automated planning.

2512.20618.tldr: A multi-agent framework in which a master LLM coordinates a grounding agent to localize question-relevant segments and a vision agent to extract targeted textual observations is proposed, which significantly outperforms strong non-agent baselines and shows reinforcement learning further strengthens reasoning and planning for the trained agent.

2502.06842.tldr: A human centered approach optimizes clinicians' capabilities in comprehensive data collection, interpretation of complex clinical information, and timely application of relevant medical knowledge while prioritizing patient safety, healthcare equity, and transparency.

2504.02080.tldr: This study evaluates both open-source and closed-source large language models by employing four state-of-the-art attack techniques and assessing the efficacy of three new defensive approaches.

2504.16172.tldr: This work introduces Simulation-Calibrated Scientific Machine Learning (SCaSML), a framework that systematically improves pre-trained PDE solvers at inference time without any retraining, and proves that SCaSML achieves a faster convergence rate, with a final error bounded by the product of the surrogate and simulation errors.

2505.11785.tldr: This work proposes a framework for the weighted aggregation of prediction sets, where weights are assigned to each prediction set based on their contribution, and generalizes to data-dependent weights, as it derives a procedure for weighted aggregation that maintains finite-sample validity even when the weights depend on the data.

2505.17019.tldr: Let Androids Dream (LAD) is proposed, a novel framework for image implication understanding and reasoning that addresses contextual missing through the three-stage framework, and provides new insights into how AI can more effectively interpret image implications.

2506.08602.tldr: WGLE is proposed, a novel black-box watermarking paradigm for GNNs that enables embedding the multi-bit string in GNN models without using backdoors, and achieves 100% ownership verification accuracy, with an average fidelity degradation of only 1.41%.

2506.11718.tldr: This work proposes a layered conceptual framework for human-agent systems that integrates Interaction, Process, and Infrastructure, and elevates Process to a first-class concern, an explicit, inspectable structural representation of activities.

2507.01041.tldr: A low-complexity block-wise model partitioning algorithm that simplifies the DAG by abstracting each block into a single vertex and can reduce algorithm running time and training delay compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2509.22615.tldr: This work develops a scalable 2DGS pipeline with structured initialization, luminance-aware pruning, and batched CUDA kernels, achieving over 90x faster fitting and about 97% GPU utilization compared to prior implementations, establishing 2DGS as a viable multimodal substrate, pinpoint architectural bottlenecks, and open a path toward representations that are both semantically powerful and transmission-efficient for edge-cloud learning.

2512.00617.tldr: The ART framework provides a scalable, production-ready solution for applications requiring high-quality, vetted LLM responses, achieving an 8.4% improvement in overall quality metrics and R^2 values exceeding 0.96 in ELO rating convergence.

2512.10952.tldr: This work proposes Dataset Selection via Hierarchies (DaSH), a dataset selection method that models utility at both dataset and group levels, enabling efficient generalization from limited observations.

2512.13725.tldr: The results suggest that causal reasoning is unexpectedly robust to four bit quantization, graph structured augmentation can selectively reinforce interventional reasoning, and current counterfactual benchmarks fail to capture deeper causal brittleness.

2512.14554.tldr: The Vietnamese Legal Benchmark (VLegal-Bench) is introduced, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to systematically assess LLMs on Vietnamese legal tasks, and supports the development of more reliable, interpretable, and ethically aligned AI-assisted legal systems.

2512.18432.tldr: The AITP is presented as a foundational technology for future 6G networks that supports a user-centric, privacy-first design and was shown to be superior to traditional non-adaptive and centralized AI methods across several key metrics.

2512.19512.tldr: This work implements a progressive learning strategy called Anatomical Similarity Curriculum Learning by controlling question difficulty via the similarity of answer choices, enabling the model to master complex problems incrementally, and utilizes question augmentation referred to as Group Diversity Question Augmentation to expand the model's search space for difficult queries, mitigating the tendency to produce uniform responses.

2512.20082.tldr: An adaptive framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) with real-world stock market feedback to improve sentiment classification in the context of the Indian stock market is proposed.

2512.20135.tldr: This is the first work to formalize molecular design as an Agentic Reinforcement Learning problem, where an LLM agent learns to interleave reasoning, tool-use, and molecular optimization in a sequential, tool-guided process.

2512.20136.tldr: Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that M$^3$KG-RAG significantly enhances MLLMs'multimodal reasoning and grounding over existing approaches, and introduces GRASP (Grounded Retrieval And Selective Pruning), which ensures precise entity grounding to the query, evaluates answer-supporting relevance, and prunes redundant context to retain only knowledge essential for response generation.

2512.20621.tldr: This work investigates whether indirect reciprocity can be transposed to children-robot interactions; whether artificial agents can learn to cooperate given children's strategies; and how differences in learning algorithms impact human-AI cooperation.

2512.20623.tldr: BitRL-Light is presented, a novel framework combining 1-bit quantized Large Language Models (LLMs) with Deep Q-Network (DQN) reinforcement learning for real-time smart home lighting control on edge devices, enabling intelligent home automation without cloud dependencies.

2512.20624.tldr: A quantum-inspired framework for optimizing the exploration–exploitation tradeoff in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), applied to UAV-assisted 6G network deployment, shows that QI-MARL achieves a superior balance between exploration and exploitation compared to classical methods.

2512.20625.tldr: This paper proposes an alternative, parameter-efficient look at Neural CDEs, which requires much fewer parameters, while also presenting a very logical analogy as the"Continuous RNN", which the Neural CDEs aspire to.

2512.20626.tldr: This work introduces a multimodal knowledge graph-based RAG that enables cross-modal reasoning for better content understanding and consistently outperforms existing RAG-based approaches on both textual and multimodal corpora.

2512.20627.tldr: A Federated Evaluation Enhanced Intent-Based Networking framework (FEIBN), which leverages large language models (LLMs) to translate user intents into structured strategy tuples and employs federated learning to support distributed strategy evaluation, is proposed.

2512.20630.tldr: This work introduces microprobe, a novel approach that achieves comprehensive reliability assessment using only 100 strategically selected probe examples that combines strategic prompt diversity across five key reliability dimensions with advanced uncertainty quantification and adaptive weighting to efficiently detect potential failure modes.

2512.20631.tldr: This zero-training temporal drift analysis of transformer-based sentiment models validated on authentic social media data from major real-world events enables immediate deployment for real-time sentiment monitoring systems and provides new insights into transformer model behavior during dynamic content periods.

2512.20632.tldr: This report provides a detailed introduction to Erkang-Diagnosis-1.1 model, the authors' AI healthcare consulting assistant developed using Alibaba Qwen-3 model, employing a hybrid approach combining enhanced pre-training and retrieval-enhanced generation to create a secure, reliable, and professional AI health advisor.

2512.20633.tldr: This work demonstrates a scalable, interpretable, and workflow-compatible pathway for advancing AI-driven decision support in oncology by reframing LLMs as knowledge curation engines rather than black-box predictors.

2512.20634.tldr: The shallow versus deep alignment framework is introduced, providing the first quantitative characterization of alignment depth, and explains why spurious forgetting occurs, why it is reversible, and why fine-tuning attacks are effective.

2512.20636.tldr: Gate-Norm is proposed, a one-shot, weight-only criterion that ranks attention sublayers by query--key coupling and removes the least coupled ones, requiring no calibration data, no forward passes, no fine-tuning, and no specialized kernels.

2512.20638.tldr: This work proposes a simple new method using concept activations from sparse autoencoders, to identify fine-grained gaps on a per-concept basis, which can be used to complement existing benchmarks, by providing a concept-level decomposition of model behavior, and by helping benchmark developers iterate upon benchmark design.

2512.20643.tldr: This work uses the Neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs) and Universal differential equations (UDEs) frameworks to predict and forecast the system dynamics and indicates that the UDE model is much more data efficient, needing only 20% of data for a correct forecast, whereas the Neural ODE requires 90%.

2512.20647.tldr: This work explores whether a partially completed reasoning chain from one model can be reliably continued by another model, either within the same model family or across families, and points towards interchangeability as an emerging behavioral property of reasoning models.

2512.20649.tldr: This paper presents AiAuditTrack (AAT), a blockchain-based framework for AI usage traffic recording and governance that provides a scalable and verifiable solution for AI auditing, risk management, and responsibility attribution in complex multi-agent environments.

2512.20650.tldr: This work proposes Mixture of Attention Schemes (MoAS), a novel architecture that dynamically selects the optimal attention scheme for each token via a learned router and demonstrates that dynamic routing performs better than static averaging of schemes and achieves performance competitive with the MHA baseline while offering potential for conditional compute efficiency.

2512.20651.tldr: The Memory Bear system is proposed, which constructs a human-like memory architecture grounded in cognitive science principles that significantly improves knowledge fidelity and retrieval efficiency in long-term conversations, reduces hallucination rates, and enhances contextual adaptability and reasoning capability through memory-cognition integration.

2512.20652.tldr: An AI-driven, modular multi-agent hiring assistant that integrates document and video preprocessing, structured candidate profile construction, public-data verification, technical/culture-fit scoring with explicit risk penalties, and human-in-the-loop validation via an interactive interface is presented.

2512.20655.tldr: A large-scale benchmark dataset constructed from real IC designs at the 45$\mathrm{nm}$ node, evaluated for state-of-the-art deep learning models for IC mask optimization, and the evaluation results expose distinct trade-offs across baseline models.

2512.20660.tldr: The results suggest that architectural constraints can substitute for parameter scale in achieving reliable code generation in achieving reliable code generation.

2512.20661.tldr: An Adversarial Feedback for Attention (AFA) training mechanism that enables the model to automatically redistribute attention weights to appropriate focal points without requiring manual annotations is proposed.

2512.20662.tldr: These findings suggest that while compliance with detailed instructions remains an open challenge, modern LLMs may internally mitigate some hypothesized failure modes (such as context forgetting) in straightforward retrieval scenarios.

2512.20664.tldr: This work reformulate the verification of LLM reasoning as a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP) operating independently of the generation likelihood, and demonstrates that this approach successfully rejects ``smooth falsehoods''-- statements that are highly probable yet structurally disconnected -- that probability-based verifiers are principally incapable of detecting.

2512.20666.tldr: DominanceBench is introduced and its findings characterize DvD as a systematic concept-level failure mode and provide a basis for more reliable and controllable multi-concept generation.

2512.20668.tldr: Experimental results show that FOTON (Forward-Only Training of Orthogonal Networks) outperforms PEPITA, enabling us to train neural networks of any depth, without the need for a backward pass, and opens up avenues for its application to more advanced architectures.

2512.20669.tldr: The results demonstrate that the proposed architecture is capable of generating coherent and realistic synthetic data, whose use improves the accuracy of the various classifiers employed for cardiac risk detection, outperforming state-of-the-art deep learning approaches for synthetic data generation.

2512.20670.tldr: The Dynamic Conflict-Consensus Framework (DCCF), an inconsistency-seeking paradigm designed to amplify rather than suppress contradictions, is proposed, which consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2512.20671.tldr: It is argued that a bridge is needed by introducing a conceptual language which can match FTAI and NTAI, and such a semantic language can assist developers as a framework to assess AI systems in terms of trustworthiness.

2512.20674.tldr: This work introduces HyDRA, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework designed to implement hierarchical and dynamic rank scheduling for mobile VLMs, and demonstrates that HyDRA consistently outperforms the baseline.

2512.20675.tldr: It is shown that a simple triplet loss outperforms state-of-the-art methods, suggesting that much of the improvements in recent approaches could be attributed to differences in data and architectures.

2512.20688.tldr: Mechanism-Based Intelligence (MBI) is introduced, a paradigm that reconceptualizes intelligence as emergent from the coordination of multiple"brains", rather than a single one, and provides a provably efficient, auditable and generalizable approach to coordinated, trustworthy and scalable multi-agent intelligence grounded in economic principles.

2512.20714.tldr: The evidence supports generative AI as a mechanism for precision scaffolding when embedded in exploration-first, audit-ready workflows that preserve productive struggle while scaling personalized support.

2512.20723.tldr: The path from “organic” to “artificial” intelligence in digital health is neither mystical nor merely a matter of parameter count—it is fundamentally about organization and adaption.

2512.20724.tldr: SA-DiffuSeq is introduced, a diffusion framework that integrates sparse attention to fundamentally improve scalability for long document modeling and significantly reduces computational complexity while maintaining semantic coherence and generation quality.

2512.20732.tldr: FEM-Bench establishes a structured foundation for evaluating AI-generated scientific code, and future iterations will incorporate increasingly sophisticated tasks to track progress as models evolve.

2512.20739.tldr: This framework which centers on AI driven green CRN aims at integrating deep reinforcement learning with transfer learning, energy harvesting, energy harvesting, reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) with other light-weight genetic refinement operations that optimally combine sensing timelines, transmit power, bandwidth distribution and RIS phase selection.

2512.20749.tldr: An analysis of Lipschitz properties in multimodal autoencoders, combining both theoretical insights and empirical validation to enhance the training stability of these models and contribute a solution for enhancing their performance.

2512.20755.tldr: This work defines a robustness property tailored to early exit architectures and shows how off-the-shelf solvers can be used to assess it, and shows how these metrics can help users navigate the inherent trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.

2512.20778.tldr: This paper introduces a novel decentralized framework for optimal joint action selection that explicitly accounts for belief inconsistencies, and provides probabilistic guarantees for both action consistency and performance with respect to open-loop multi-agent POMDP.

2512.20783.tldr: This work proposes NullBUS, a multimodal mixed-supervision framework that learns from images with and without prompts in a single model, and introduces nullable prompts, implemented as learnable null embeddings with presence masks, enabling fallback to image-only evidence when metadata are absent and the use of text when present.

2512.20789.tldr: X-GridAgent is presented, a novel large language model-powered agentic AI system designed to automate complex power system analysis through natural language queries and introduces two novel algorithms: LLM-driven prompt refinement with human feedback and schema-adaptive hybrid retrieval-augmented generation for accurate information retrieval from large-scale structured grid datasets.

2512.20822.tldr: This work introduces MediEval, a benchmark that links MIMIC-IV electronic health records (EHRs) to a unified knowledge base built from UMLS and other biomedical vocabularies, and proposes Counterfactual Risk-Aware Fine-tuning (CoRFu), a DPO-based method with an asymmetric penalty targeting unsafe confusions.

2512.20823.tldr: NotSoTiny is a benchmark that assesses LLM on the generation of structurally rich and context-aware RTL, emphasizing its effectiveness in overcoming current limitations of LLMs applied to hardware design, and in guiding the improvement of such promising technology.

2512.20831.tldr: This paper extends the scope of RL algorithms to long-horizon, sparse-reward settings with parameterized actions by enabling agents to autonomously learn both state and action abstractions online by introducing algorithms that progressively refine these abstractions during learning.

2512.20848.tldr: Nemotron 3 Nano demonstrates enhanced agentic, reasoning, and chat abilities and supports context lengths up to 1M tokens and achieves up to 3.3x higher inference throughput than similarly-sized open models like GPT-OSS-20B and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, while also being more accurate on popular benchmarks.

2512.20856.tldr: The Nemotron 3 family of models - Nano, Super, and Ultra - deliver strong agentic, reasoning, and conversational capabilities and will openly release the model weights, pre- and post-training software, recipes, and all data for which they hold redistribution rights.

2512.20884.tldr: A formal probabilistic framework that provides agents with a non-altruistic motive for bidirectional knowledge exchange is proposed and public contribution is reframed as optimal active learning: sharing solutions to elicit feedback is the most efficient method for an agent to reduce its own uncertainty.

2512.20898.tldr: This work introduces a Dual-Graph Spatiotemporal Attention Network, which leverages temporal variations and multimodal data to enhance the accuracy of predictions and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in classifying pulmonary nodules with exceptional computational efficiency.

2512.20902.tldr: This paper proposes a novel hierarchical multi-scale Transformer-based user trajectory prediction model based on the users' historical trajectory traces captured by the embodied AI agent, and designs a prediction-enhanced deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithm designed for intelligently optimizing UAV flight trajectory and task offloading decisions.

2512.20920.tldr: RevFFN is introduced, a memory efficient fine tuning paradigm for mixture of experts (MoE) LLMs that enables efficient full fine tuning on a single consumer grade or server grade GPU and significantly reduces peak memory consumption for full parameter fine tuning.

2512.20934.tldr: Transductive Visual Programming is presented, a novel framework that builds new tools from its own experience rather than speculation, and establishes experience-driven transductive tool creation as a powerful paradigm for building self-evolving visual programming agents that effectively tackle challenging spatial reasoning tasks.

2512.20949.tldr: Experimental results on LongFact, HealthBench, and TriviaQA demonstrate that MLP probes significantly outperform state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, recall, and detection capability under low false-positive conditions.

2512.20950.tldr: The TriAligner approach, a novel approach that leverages a dual-encoder architecture with contrastive learning and incorporates both native and English translations across different modalities, is introduced, demonstrating significant improvements in retrieval accuracy and fact-checking performance over baselines.

2512.20954.tldr: Reflection pretraining is introduced, for the first time in a biological sequence model, which enables the model to engage in intermediate reasoning through the generation of auxiliary"thinking tokens" beyond simple answer tokens, thereby improving the overall reasoning capacity of the model.

2512.20958.tldr: This work introduces ReACT-Drug, a fully integrated, target-agnostic molecular design framework based on Reinforcement Learning, which highlights the potential of integrating structural biology, deep representation learning, and chemical synthesis rules to automate and accelerate rational drug design.

2512.20959.tldr: This work designs a prediction task where a crucial latent variable is hidden in relevant image data instead of tabular features, and shows that agentic AI that relies on generic analytics workflow falls short of methods that use domain-specific insights.

2408.06672.tldr: TimeBridge is proposed, a framework that flexibly synthesizes time series data by using diffusion bridges to learn paths between a chosen prior and the data distribution and experiments show that this framework with data-driven priors outperforms standard diffusion models on time series generation.

2409.00162.tldr: A novel sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) reward modeling method that enables richer and fine-grained language feedback without additional annotations, models, or training stages and reduces the refusal-to-response paradigm in single-turn safety dialogues and the long-response bias in text summarization tasks.

2412.18047.tldr: Experiments on real-world electricity datasets show that HUCA significantly reduces electricity costs and maintains competitive performance in meeting EV charging requirements under both simulated certain and uncertain departure scenarios, highlighting the importance of hierarchical control and the proposed critic augmentation under the uncertain departure scenario.

2502.06096.tldr: This paper develops a very general framework to construct confidence sets for the unknown changepoint using only the data observed up to a data-dependent stopping time at which an arbitrary sequential detection algorithm declares a change.

2504.04973.tldr: Stochastic Pessimistic-Optimistic Thresholding (SPOT), a novel model-based primal-dual algorithm for multiple constraints against stochastic thresholds, is designed, which is the first reinforcement learning algorithm that realises theoretical guaranteed performance in an uncertain environment where even thresholds are unknown.

2507.01061.tldr: Epitome is introduced, an open experimental platform that operationalizes this paradigm through Matrix-like social worlds where researchers can study isolated human subjects and groups interacting with LLM agents, demonstrating capacity to generate robust findings while reducing experimental complexity.

2507.11783.tldr: A review of ten early EEG-FMs indicates that the development of benchmarks, software tools, technical methodologies, and applications in collaboration with domain experts may advance the translational utility and real-world adoption of EEG-FMs.

2508.21010.tldr: A novel, modular paradigm that explicitly decouples causal reasoning from answer generation, introducing natural language causal chains as interpretable intermediate representations and positioning the CCE as a reusable causal reasoning engine across diverse domains.

2509.18527.tldr: The FEncing Referee Assistant (FERA) is presented, a pose-based framework for this setting, and study it through foil fencing, where decisions depend on fast bilateral motion and right-of-way rules.

2509.22358.tldr: Stochastic activations are introduced and provided an alternative way to increase the diversity of generated text and have higher diversity and has only slightly inferior performance to the best deterministic non-linearity, SILU, combined with temperature sampling.

2510.00915.tldr: Two lightweight corrections are implemented as lightweight hooks in a group relative policy optimization pipeline that improve RLVR for math reasoning under synthetic and real verifier noise, with the forward variant being more stable under heavier noise.

2510.07611.tldr: Evaluation on three scenarios, including inspection of a complex real-world structure with over 92M triangular mesh faces, indicates that even a rudimentary sampling-based planner with IPIM can generate inspection trajectories of similar quality to those generated by the state-of-the-art planner, while using up to 70× less memory than the state-of-the-art inspection planner.

2510.09016.tldr: This work introduces a two-stage pipeline of diffusion-based Singing Voice Synthesis, and proposes DiTSinger, a Diffusion Transformer with RoPE and qk-norm, systematically scaled in depth, width, and resolution for enhanced fidelity.

2510.11822.tldr: A novel regression-based framework that directly models the validator bias using a small set of human-annotated ground truth data and reduces the maximum absolute error to just 1.2%, achieving a 2x improvement over the best-performing ensemble of 14 state-of-the-art LLMs.

2510.15905.tldr: Challenging tensions in digital companionship dynamics are observed: participants grappled with bounded personhood, forming deep attachments while denying chatbots"real"human qualities, and struggled to reconcile chatbot relationships with social norms.

2510.25787.tldr: VDSP is introduced as an efficient approach for unsupervised and local learning in memristive synapses based on Hebbian principles, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance and robustness on pattern recognition tasks.

2511.12867.tldr: This work proposes a novel preference-based policy optimization (PbPO) framework that formulates the learning process as a min-max game between the main policy and a reward model (RM).

2511.17129.tldr: This work explores the untapped potential of context compression as a pretext task for unsupervised adaptation of LLMs and produces a strong representation model (LLM2Comp) that outperforms contemporary LLM-based text encoders on a wide range of tasks while being more sample-efficient, requiring significantly less training data.

2512.00020.tldr: This review provides a systematic literature review of LLM-based methods for Verilog code generation, examining their effectiveness, limitations, and potential for advancing automated hardware design.

2512.12284.tldr: This work is the first to comprehensively tackle KV cache retrieval across algorithms and hardware, enabling real-time streaming video LLM inference on resource-constrained edge devices.

2512.15249.tldr: Cross-Modal Alignment Consistency (CMAC-MMD) is developed, a training framework that standardises diagnostic certainty across intersectional patient subgroups and establishes a scalable framework for developing high-stakes clinical decision support systems that are both accurate and can perform equitably across diverse patient subgroups.

2512.16378.tldr: Hearing to Translate, the first comprehensive test suite rigorously benchmarking 6 state-of-the-art SpeechLLMs against 16 strong direct and cascade systems that couple leading speech foundation models (SFM), with multilingual LLMs, finds that cascaded systems remain the most reliable solution overall.

2512.17864.tldr: This study introduces an interpretable attention-guided Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), CBAM-VGG16, for plant leaf disease detection, integrating Convolution Block Attention Module (CBAM) at each convolutional stage, which enhances feature extraction and disease localization.

2512.18748.tldr: This work introduces Code2Doc, a quality-first curated dataset for function-level code documentation generation that is constructed using a four-stage curation pipeline that enforces documentation completeness and clarity, filters functions based on structural and complexity criteria, removes exact and near-duplicate code, and identifies documentation likely to be AI generated.

2512.20605.tldr: To discover temporally-abstract actions, a higher-order, non-causal sequence model is introduced whose outputs control the residual stream activations of a base autoregressive model, suggesting internal RL as a promising avenue for realizing hierarchical RL within foundation models.

2512.20968.tldr: This paper proposes a new distributed attention algorithm, Mesh-Attention, by rethinking the design space of distributed attention with a new matrix-based model that leads to a much lower communication complexity and exhibits good scalability comparing to other current algorithms.

2512.20974.tldr: Generalised Linear Models in Deep Bayesian RL with Learnable Basis Functions (GLiBRL) is introduced, and it is shown that GLiBRL admits a closed-form relationship between the $\mathcal{L}_2$ distance of its task representations and empirical kernel-based correspondence between task samples, which is to the authors' knowledge the first such structural result for online deep BRL.

2512.20978.tldr: GenTSE, a two-stage decoder-only generative LM approach for TSE: Stage-1 predicts coarse semantic tokens, and Stage-2 generates fine acoustic tokens, separates semantics and acoustics stabilizes decoding and yields more faithful, content-aligned target speech.

2512.20983.tldr: An automatic pipeline that extracts mistakes LLMs make in patient-doctor conversations and converts them into a benchmark of single-shot QA pairs is introduced, which found that GPT models, Claude and Grok obtained the best performance on MedMistake-Bench.

2512.20985.tldr: A single architecture model comprising of LangChain-based multi-agent system with a permissioned blockchain to guarantee constant monitoring, policy enforcement, and immutable auditability of agentic action is suggested to provide a universal system of implementing high-impact agentic AI applications that are autonomous yet responsible.

2512.20991.tldr: A price aware agentic AI system, which combines personal finance management with diet optimization, can locally combine affordability with nutritional adequacy and provide a viable avenue of capacity-building towards sustainable and fair diet planning in line with Sustainable Development Goals on Zero Hunger and Good Health.

2512.20996.tldr: The proposed TrafficSimAgent is an LLM-based agent framework that serves as an expert in experiment design and decision optimization for general-purpose traffic simulation tasks and yields superior performance when compared with other systems and SOTA LLM based methods.

2512.21010.tldr: It is demonstrated that CSD provides a more nuanced and context-aware ranking than traditional aggregate scoring and static pairwise models, representing a vital step towards risk-informed, next-generation LLM evaluation.

2512.21017.tldr: This study advances LLM fine-tuning by explicitly balancing CoT learning with additional optimization on answer-relevant tokens with an average accuracy improvement exceeding 5\% over conventional SFT, while preserving the ability to generate correct formats.

2512.21024.tldr: This work reformulates the learning problem by utilizing LLMs to perform optimization directly in the space of programmatic policies, and formalizes this process as PIBR, an algorithm where the policy code is optimized by textual gradients, using structured feedback derived from game utility and runtime unit tests.

2512.21054.tldr: DexAvatar is introduced, a novel framework to reconstruct bio-mechanically accurate fine-grained hand articulations and body movements from in-the-wild monocular sign language videos, guided by learned 3D hand and body priors.

2512.21106.tldr: This work proposes a Graph-Exemplar-guided Semantic Refinement (GES) framework for graph representation learning which -- unlike existing LLM-enhanced methods that generate node descriptions without graph context -- leverages structurally and semantically similar nodes from the graph itself to guide semantic refinement.

2512.21107.tldr: This work suggests a different approach: utilizing semi-supervised learning techniques, which leverage both labeled and unlabeled data, to improve the performance on the safety task, and demonstrates the importance of using task-specific augmentations, which significantly increase the performance when compared to general-purpose augmentation techniques.

2512.21118.tldr: STLDM is a diffusion-based model that learns the latent representation from end to end alongside both the Variational Autoencoder and the conditioning network, and achieves superior performance compared to the state of the art, while also improving inference efficiency.

2512.21127.tldr: Failure analysis reveals that, in this setting, the dominant failure mechanism is contextual reasoning rather than missing medication knowledge, with five primary patterns: overconfidence in uncertainty, applying standard guidelines without adjusting for patient context, misunderstanding how healthcare is delivered in practice, factual errors, and process blindness.

2512.21132.tldr: This work presents AutoBaxBuilder, an automated pipeline that generates code security benchmarking tasks from scratch that leverages the code-understanding capabilities of LLMs combined with robust reliability checks to construct functional tests and end-to-end security-probing exploits.

2512.21135.tldr: TGC-Net, a CLIP-based framework focusing on parameter-efficient, task-specific adaptations, is proposed, which incorporates a Semantic-Structural Synergy Encoder that augments CLIP's ViT with a CNN branch for multi-scale structural refinement.

2512.21152.tldr: It is shown that MODE achieves (1-1/e)-approximation with O(n \log n) complexity and demonstrates competitive accuracy while providing interpretable insights into data utility evolution.

2512.21165.tldr: Across challenging WAN regimes, BALLAST substantially reduces recovery time and unwritable time compared to standard randomized timeouts and common heuristics, while remaining competitive on stable LAN/WAN settings.

2512.21201.tldr: Experiments in simulation and on a physical Go2 quadruped show that Schrodinger's Navigator outperforms strong ZSON baselines, improving hidden-target discovery and risk-aware waypoint selection in occlusion-heavy navigation scenarios, and highlight imagined 3D futures as a scalable and generalizable strategy for zero-shot navigation in uncertain real-world environments.

2512.21204.tldr: This paper introduces SpidR-Adapt for rapid adaptation of speech units to new languages using minimal unlabeled data and proposes a novel heuristic solution, first-order bi-level optimization (FOBLO), avoiding heavy computation costs.

2512.21221.tldr: This work proposes a lightweight two-stage retrieval pipeline that leverages event-centric entity extraction to incorporate temporal and contextual signals from real-world captions to highlight the effectiveness of combining event-guided filtering with long-text vision-language modeling for accurate and efficient retrieval in complex, real-world scenarios.

2512.21236.tldr: SPELL is proposed, a comprehensive testing framework specifically designed to evaluate the weakness of security alignment in malicious code generation and reveal significant security gaps in current LLM implementations and provide valuable insights for improving AI safety alignment in code generation applications.

2512.21241.tldr: This paper proposes a momentum-based algorithm, ARS-OPT, which proactively estimates the gradient with respect to a future ray direction inferred from accumulated momentum, and provides a theoretical analysis of its convergence behavior, showing that ARS-OPT enables more accurate directional updates and achieves faster, more stable optimization.

2512.21243.tldr: LookPlanGraph is proposed - a method that leverages a scene graph composed of static assets and object priors and continuously updates the graph with relevant objects, either by verifying existing priors or discovering new entities during plan execution.

2512.21246.tldr: Findings reveal that perception dimensions actively mediate AI-augmented learning and that the developmental stage moderates their interdependencies, establishing a foundation for the development of AI integration strategies that respond to learners'velopmental levels and account for age-specific dimensional structures in student-AI interactions.

2512.21288.tldr: This analysis introduces a "cross-task heterogeneity"term that formally captures the mismatch between diverse fine-tuned model priors and the target multi-task distributions, and operationalizes this objective via SAMerging, a method that employs Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) to find flat minima.

2512.21316.tldr: Findings suggest continued model scaling could boost U.S. productivity by approximately 20% over the next decade.

2512.21326.tldr: The all-pairs paired method is proposed, which applies the paired analysis to all pairs of LLMs and measures all the noise components based on millions of question-level predictions across many evals and settings, revealing clear patterns.

2512.21332.tldr: This work presents C2LLM - Contrastive Code Large Language Models, a family of code embedding models in both 0.5B and 7B sizes that adopts a Pooling by Multihead Attention (PMA) module for generating sequence embedding from token embeddings.

2512.21336.tldr: This work establishes Denoising Entropy as a principled tool for understanding and controlling generation, effectively turning the uncertainty in MDMs from a liability into a key advantage for discovering high-quality solutions.

2405.04875.tldr: This work proposes SFL with Concatenated Activations and Logit Adjustments (SCALA), in which activations from client-side models are concatenated as the input of the server-side model to centrally adjust label distribution across different clients, and logit adjustments in the loss functions of both server-side and client-side models are performed.

2405.05512.tldr: The characteristic generator is proposed, a novel one-step generative model that combines the efficiency of sampling in Generative Adversarial Networks with the stable performance of flow-based models and achieves high-quality and high-resolution sample generation with the efficiency of just a single neural network evaluation.

2407.15192.tldr: This paper presents an approach based on Error Detection Rules (EDR) that allow for learning explainable rules about the failure modes of machine learning models and is effective in detecting machine learning errors and recovering constraints, is noise tolerant, and can function as a source of knowledge for neurosymbolic models on multiple datasets, including a newly introduced military vehicle recognition dataset.

2411.02455.tldr: The use of three representative LLMs for automated course evaluation at both the micro level (classroom discussion analysis) and the macro level (holistic course review) is investigated, demonstrating that LLMs can extract key pedagogical features and generate structured evaluation results aligned with expert judgement.

2412.20166.tldr: Implemented via an MLIR-based compiler and evaluated on a cycle-accurate simulator, PIMphony significantly improves throughput for long-context LLM inference, enabling more efficient deployment of LLMs in real-world long-context applications.

2501.07774.tldr: A novel tokenization approach is introduced, referred to as Sensor Snapshot Tokenization (SST), which preserves variable-specific representations of power delay profile (PDP) and enhances attention mechanisms by effectively capturing multi-variate correlation, making Transformer models more efficient and suitable for resource-constrained scenarios.

2501.09926.tldr: This work proposes a low-cost forest fire detection system that utilizes a central gateway device with computer vision capabilities to monitor a 360° field of view for smoke at long distances, leveraging real-time sensor data from distributed IoT devices.

2501.15544.tldr: This work proposes an innovative solution that enhances LLMs with retrieval-augmented generation for automatic problem formulation, code generation, and customizing optimization and shows LLMs' potential in energy optimization of the IoT-enabled microgrids and promotes intelligent DSM solutions.

2502.04963.tldr: A fast adaptive anti-jamming channel access approach guided by the intuition of ``learning faster than the jammer", where a synchronously updated coarse-grained spectrum prediction serves as an auxiliary task for the deep Q network (DQN) based anti-jamming model.

2502.09990.tldr: X-Boundary is proposed, which aims to push harmful representations away from boundary-safe representations and obtain an exact distinction boundary, so that harmful representations can be precisely erased without disrupting safe ones.

2502.18848.tldr: Causal Diagnosticity is presented, a testbed framework for evaluating faithfulness metrics for natural language explanations, and the concept of diagnosticity is used, and model-editing methods are employed to generate faithful-unfaithful explanation pairs.

2502.20565.tldr: DPZV is proposed, a communication-efficient and differentially private ZO-VFL framework with tunable privacy guarantees based on zeroth-order (ZO) optimization that injects calibrated scalar-valued DP noise on the downlink, significantly reducing variance amplification while providing equivalent protection against targeted inference attacks.
