2601.04963.tldr: AlignXplore+, a universal preference reasoning model that generates textual preference summaries, is developed that achieves state-of-the-art performanc -- outperforming substantially larger open-source models -- while exhibiting strong transferability across tasks, model families, and interaction formats.

2601.04973.tldr: ConMax (Confidence-Maximizing Compression), a novel reinforcement learning framework designed to automatically compress reasoning traces while preserving essential reasoning patterns, is introduced, proving its effectiveness in generating high-quality, efficient training data for LRMs.

2601.04977.tldr: It is argued that safeguards should prioritise reproducibility, standardisation, and procedural constraints over post-hoc detection over post-hoc detection, and recommendations for algorithm developers, explanation providers, and auditors are provided.

2601.04982.tldr: A safety-critical triggering framework based on calibrated probabilities for multimodal next-action prediction in Activities of Daily Living that turns the confidence threshold into a quantitative safety parameter for assisted actions and enables verifiable behavior in an assistive control loop.

2601.05002.tldr: A theoretical analysis of GRPO style methods by studying them within a unified surrogate formulation reveals recurring properties that affect all the methods under analysis that highlight fundamental limitations of current approaches and provide principled guidance for the design of future formulations.

2601.05009.tldr: It is revealed that LLMs lack an inherent ability to detect and correct subtle distortions in table representations, and only when provided with an explicit prior, via a system prompt, do models partially adjust their reasoning strategies and correct some distortions, though not consistently or completely.

2601.05016.tldr: This work establishes that structured agent self-reflection, when augmented by human oversight and advisory guidance, produces higher-quality 3D models while maintaining efficient workflow integration through real-time Blender synchronization.

2601.05017.tldr: This work proposes a novel imputation approach that explicitly models cross-type feature dependencies within a unified framework and achieves superior performance over existing techniques and significantly enhances downstream machine learning tasks, providing a robust solution for real-world systems with missing data.

2601.05019.tldr: This analysis suggests that SFT induces a "Cargo Cult"effect, where students ritualistically replicate the linguistic form of reasoning (verbosity) without internalizing the teacher's dynamic resource allocation policy.

2601.05027.tldr: OptiSet is a set-centric framework that unifies set selection and set-level ranking for RAG, and introduces a set-list wise training strategy that jointly optimizes set selection and set-level ranking, enabling the model to favor compact, high-gain evidence sets.

2601.05036.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive experimental analysis of this advantage of QGANS applied to SAT4 image generation, obtaining an exponential advantage in capacity scaling for a quantum generator in the hybrid latent style-based QGAN architecture.

2601.05038.tldr: ArcAligner (Adaptive recursive context *Aligner*), a lightweight module integrated into the language model layers to help the model better utilize highly compressed context representations for downstream generation, which consistently beats compression baselines at comparable compression rates.

2601.05049.tldr: A rigorous analysis through the dual lenses of training stability and feature learning to elucidate the underlying reasons why module-wise parameter tuning underperforms in large-scale settings.

2601.05051.tldr: This article presents a case study in atomic layer deposition and etching (ALD/E) where review tables are published as FAIR, machine-actionable comparisons in the Open Research Knowledge Graph (ORKG), turning them into structured, queryable knowledge.

2601.05053.tldr: This work designs a length-aware segment-level advantage estimator that rewards concise and correct reasoning while penalizing unnecessarily long reasoning chains, and designs a semantic-entropy-based branching strategy and an $\varepsilon$-exploration mechanism to encourage more diverse reasoning exploration.

2601.05062.tldr: This work embeds individual behaviors, expressed as natural language instructions, into dedicated tokens via self-distillation and shows that steering tokens lead to superior multi-behavior steering of verifiable constraints compared to competing approaches (instructions, activation steering, and LoRA merging).

2601.05076.tldr: This work study how to induce privacy-first reasoning, where models reason without exposing sensitive information, using deployable interventions rather than post-hoc redaction, demonstrating that private reasoning can be achieved without sacrificing performance.

2601.05084.tldr: A novel method for predicting a driver's intention to steer using electroencephalography (EEG) signals through deep learning is presented, which lays the foundation for more intuitive brain-to-vehicle communication systems.

2601.05091.tldr: This research delivers a production-ready AI solution for brand sentiment tracking and establishes a strong benchmark for multilingual NLP in low-resource, code-mixed environments.

2601.05101.tldr: This work provides a standardized framework to measure the functional accuracy and robustness of models in Arabic agentic workflows, and reveals a huge performance gap: when users interact in Arabic, tool-calling accuracy drops by an average of 5-10\%, regardless of whether the tool descriptions themselves are in Arabic or English.

2601.05107.tldr: This work shows that an agent's reliance on memory can be modeled as an explicit and user-controllable dimension, and proposes a framework that allows users to dynamically regulate memory reliance, ranging from a fresh-start mode that promotes innovation to a high-fidelity mode that closely follows interaction history.

2601.05111.tldr: This work identifies key dimensions that characterize this paradigm shift and establishes a developmental taxonomy that organizes core methodologies and survey applications across general and professional domains.

2601.05114.tldr: This work calls this the reliability paradox: judges cannot agree on what constitutes quality, yet their disagreement patterns are so stable they function as fingerprints.

2601.05125.tldr: VersE helps uncover the visual features associated with error-prone clusters, and that retraining with samples containing these features substantially boosts F1 performance without degrading generalization, and it is demonstrated that on-premise models such as Donut and Idefics2, when optimized with VERSE, match or even surpass the performance of SaaS solutions.

2601.05144.tldr: A Criticality Score is proposed to identify semantically pivotal tokens from the reasoning trace, which are distilled into a Principal Semantic Vector (PSV) that guides a semantically-adaptive mechanism that modulates watermark strength based on token-PSV alignment, ensuring robustness without compromising logical integrity.

2601.05148.tldr: Atlas 2, Atlas 2-B, and Atlas 2-S are presented, three pathology vision foundation models which bridge shortcomings by showing state-of-the-art performance in prediction performance, robustness, and resource efficiency in a comprehensive evaluation across eighty public benchmarks.

2601.05152.tldr: This work provides the taxonomy and the details of continual online safe reinforcement learning methods based on the type of safe learning mechanism that takes adaptation to nonstationarity into account.

2601.05159.tldr: Vision-Language Introspection is introduced, a training-free inference framework that simulates a metacognitive self-correction process and achieves state-of-the-art performance on advanced models, reducing object hallucination rates and improving accuracy on advanced models.

2601.05167.tldr: RelayLLM is a novel framework for efficient reasoning via token-level collaborative decoding that bridges the performance gap between the two models, and introduces a two-stage training framework to teach the model to balance independence with strategic help-seeking.

2601.05174.tldr: FaST is an effective and efficient framework based on heterogeneity-aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) for long-horizon and large-scale STG forecasting, which unlocks one-week-ahead prediction with thousands of nodes and achieves remarkable computational efficiency compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2601.05184.tldr: It is found that the performative loop increases preference bias and decreases disparate bias, and a reward-based rejection sampling strategy is designed to mitigate the bias, moving towards more trustworthy self-improving systems.

2601.05187.tldr: SimuAgent bridges the gap between LLMs and graphical modeling environments, offering a practical solution for AI-assisted engineering design in industrial settings, and Reflection-GRPO (ReGRPO), which augments Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with self-reflection traces that supply rich intermediate feedback, accelerating convergence and boosting robustness.

2601.05201.tldr: This work identifies a small set of attention heads whose ablation substantially reduces prompt-induced hallucinations (PIH) by at least 40% without additional training, and characterize these differences and show that PIH ablation increases correction toward visual evidence.

2601.05214.tldr: This work presents a computationally efficient framework that detects tool-calling hallucinations in real-time by leveraging LLM'internal representations during the same forward pass used for generation, demonstrating strong detection performance and maintaining real-time inference capabilities with minimal computational overhead.

2601.05240.tldr: Robust inference is identified as an effective Symmetry-Protected Topological phase, where logical operations are formally isomorphic to non-Abelian anyon braiding, replacing fragile geometric interpolation with robust topological invariants.

2601.05241.tldr: This work introduces visual identity prompting, which supplies exemplar images as conditioning inputs to guide the generation of the desired scene setup, and builds a scalable pipeline to curate a visual identity pool from large robotics datasets.

2601.05242.tldr: This paper introduces Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO), a new policy optimization method to resolve issues by decoupling the normalization of individual rewards, more faithfully preserving their relative differences and enabling more accurate multi-reward optimization, along with substantially improved training stability.

2601.04216.tldr: Graph-GAP is proposed, a methodology that decomposes requirements from authoritative policy texts into a four layer graph of evidence, mechanism, governance, and indicator, and that computes two metrics, GAP score and mitigation readiness, to identify governance gaps and prioritise actions.

2107.09288.tldr: MIPO (Mutual Integration of Patient Journey and Medical Ontology) is proposed, a robust end-to-end framework that employs a Transformer-based architecture for representation learning and consistently outperforms baseline methods under both sufficient and limited data conditions.

2402.11314.tldr: This approach evaluates the influence of demographic factors such as race, gender, and age on collective decision-making in the design of multi-generative agent systems and provides a predictive framework for decision-makers to anticipate stakeholder reactions, including concerns, objections, and support.

2409.14590.tldr: Researchers should formally define the problems they intend to solve and design methods accordingly, which will lead to diverse use-case-dependent notions of explanation correctness and objective metrics of explanation performance that can be used to validate XAI algorithms.

2409.18695.tldr: This work presents its vision for building an AI-powered chemical brain, which frames chemical intelligence around four core capabilities: information extraction, semantic parsing, knowledge-based QA, and reasoning&planning, and argues that domain knowledge and logic are essential pillars for enabling such a system to assist and accelerate scientific discovery.

2410.12278.tldr: This work presents a novel approach to automatically generate non-trivial task-specific synthetic datasets for hallucination detection using hallucination pattern guidance and a language style alignment during generation, and adopts a data mixture strategy to improve performance robustness and generalization.

2411.11930.tldr: This paper proposes a novel paradigm of Self-structured Chain of Thought (SCoT), which consists of minimal semantic atomic steps and generates flexible CoT structures for various complex tasks but also mitigates the phenomenon of overthinking for easier tasks.

2502.14045.tldr: A broad, thorough, and reproducible evaluation of the top-performing supervised models on the most popular benchmark and additional baselines representing the most active architecture families, finding that slight changes to experimental setups or current evaluation metrics drastically shift the common belief that newly published results are advancing the state of the art.

2502.17749.tldr: LPcodedec is developed, a detection method that identifies paraphrase relationships between human-written and LLM-generated code, and discover which LLM is used for the paraphrasing.

2503.09527.tldr: This work introduces CombatVLA, an efficient VLA model optimized for combat tasks in 3D action role-playing games (ARPGs) and demonstrates that it not only outperforms all existing models on the combat understanding benchmark but also achieves a 50-fold acceleration in game combat.

2503.11514.tldr: The findings indicate that OP-GIA is the most practical attack setting despite its unsatisfactory performance, while GEN-GIA has many dependencies and ANA-GIA is easily detectable, making them both impractical.

2503.16342.tldr: HiQ-Lip is proposed, a hybrid quantum-classical hierarchical method that leverages quantum computing to estimate the global Lipschitz constant by converting it into a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization problem and implementing a multilevel graph coarsening and refinement strategy to adapt to the constraints of contemporary quantum hardware.

2503.24305.tldr: This work focuses on ApisTox, the most comprehensive dataset of experimentally validated chemical toxicity to the honey bee, an ecologically vital pollinator, to determine the suitability of diverse machine learning approaches for modeling such toxicity, including molecular fingerprints, graph kernels, and graph neural networks, as well as pretrained models.

2504.06753.tldr: This paper is the first to comprehensively establish an all-type ADD benchmark to evaluate current CMs, incorporating cross-type deepfake detection across speech, sound, singing voice, and music and introduces the prompt tuning self-supervised learning (PT-SSL) training paradigm, which optimizes SSL front-end by learning specialized prompt tokens for ADD, requiring 458x fewer trainable parameters than fine-tuning (FT).

2504.11741.tldr: A detailed analysis of model performance on the AIME24 dataset is conducted to understand how reasoning capabilities evolve, discovering a ladder-like structure in problem difficulty, categorize questions into four tiers, and identify the specific requirements for advancing between tiers.

2505.03176.tldr: seq-JEPA demonstrates strong performance on both equivariance- and invariance-demanding downstream tasks without sacrificing one for the other, and excels at tasks that inherently require aggregating a sequence of observations, such as path integration across actions and predictive learning across eye movements.

2505.10055.tldr: An insightful assessment of the capabilities and limitations of current LMMs for OCR tasks in Pashto is provided and establishes a foundation for further research not only in Pashto OCR but also for other similar scripts such as Arabic, Persian, and Urdu.

2505.10282.tldr: Quicker, an LLM-powered system that automates evidence synthesis and generates clinical recommendations following standard guideline development workflows, delivers an end-to-end pipeline from clinical questions to recommendations and supports customized decision-making through integrated tools and interactive interfaces.

2505.11274.tldr: This work proposes SelfBudgeter - a self-adaptive reasoning strategy for efficient and controllable reasoning that dynamically allocates budgets according to problem complexity, and introduces budget-guided GRPO for reinforcement learning, which effectively maintains accuracy while reducing output length.

2505.21825.tldr: This work seeks to illuminate the landscape of test-time scaling by demonstrating the existence of reasoning settings where sequential scaling offers an exponential advantage over parallel scaling, based on graph connectivity problems in challenging distributions of graphs.

2505.24472.tldr: This work introduces VietMix, the first expert-translated, naturally occurring parallel corpus of Vietnamese-English code-mixed text, and establishes VietMix's utility by developing a data augmentation pipeline that leverages iterative fine-tuning and targeted filtering.

2506.05970.tldr: A new inference-time method for ToM, Shoes-of-Others (SoO) prefilling, which makes fewer assumptions about contexts and is applicable to broader scenarios is presented, which suggests that SoO prefilling elicits faithful thoughts, thereby improving the ToM performance.

2507.01770.tldr: The method completely searches the feasible domain and successfully encloses the guaranteed global minimum of these 11 benchmark test functions with up to 10,000 dimensions using only one GPU in a reasonable computation time, far exceeding the reported results in the literature due to the unique method design and implementation based on GPU architecture.

2507.22533.tldr: CARE, a framework for Grounding Large Language Models in Clinical Guidelines for Decision Support over Longitudinal Cancer Electronic Health Records, is proposed and validated using large-scale, longitudinal data from a private Chinese cancer dataset and the public English MIMIC-IV dataset.

2508.13201.tldr: This work highlights persistent challenges in code generation, long-context handling, and context-aware knowledge retrieval, providing a critical empirical foundation and best practices for developing robust AI agents in computational biology.

2509.01022.tldr: This work formally defines the Block Rearrangement Problem (BRaP) as a graph search problem and proposes five search-based solution algorithms, leveraging joint configuration space search, classical planning, multi-agent pathfinding, and expert heuristics.

2509.03811.tldr: A Generative AI-powered agentic framework is introduced, functioning as an intelligent cognitive interface, that bridges the gap between unstructured business contexts and structured analytical workflows, enabling the system to comprehend complex semantics and coordinate decisions across organizational boundaries.

2509.07677.tldr: This work proposes the Spectral Masking and Interpolation Attack (SMIA), a novel method that strategically manipulates inaudible frequency regions of AI-generated audio to create adversarial samples that sound authentic while deceiving CMs.

2509.17885.tldr: Confidence-Gated Training (CGT), a paradigm that conditionally propagates gradients from deeper exits only when preceding exits fail, is proposed, offering a practical solution for deploying deep models in resource-constrained environments.

2509.19153.tldr: This study combines quantitative metrics with qualitative analysis, and shows that recent reasoning-oriented LLMs - although lacking soundness guarantees - can be surprisingly effective at predicting the (in)validity of complex properties, suggesting a new frontier in the convergence of AI and formal methods for secure smart contract development and auditing.

2509.20234.tldr: It is found that CNNs are not inherently texture-biased but predominantly rely on local shape features, and this reliance can be substantially mitigated through modern training strategies or architectures (ConvNeXt, ViTs).

2509.21434.tldr: This review, which is the first on the topic of foundation models in high-energy physics, summarizes and discusses the research that has been published in the field so far.

2509.21674.tldr: QueryGym is introduced, an interactive environment for building, testing, and evaluating LLM-based query planning agents that requires agents to construct explicit sequences of relational algebra operations, ensuring engine-agnostic evaluation and transparent step-by-step planning.

2509.23292.tldr: This work identifies two common patterns: a calculator pattern that uses code for direct computation, and an algorithmic pattern that encodes problems as programs and proposes a two-stage framework that first builds code competence from both patterns and then aligns pattern selection with teacher preferences.

2509.25475.tldr: TDHook is an open-source, lightweight, generic interpretability framework based on $\texttt{tensordict}$ and applicable to any $\texttt{torch}$ model, aiming to bridge the gap between these method classes to make modern interpretability pipelines more accessible.

2509.26145.tldr: The LMILAtt model, which innovatively integrates Long Short-Term Memory autoencoders and attention mechanisms, is proposed, which significantly reduces the cost of labeling and provides an efficient solution for large-scale social media depression screening.

2510.08098.tldr: A significant multilingual reasoning distinction is uncovered: open-weight models consistently switch to English for their internal reasoning steps, even when negotiating in German or Italian, while a leading commercial model maintains language consistency between reasoning and final output.

2510.10961.tldr: This work categorizes Korean obfuscation patterns into linguistically grounded classes, defines transformation rules derived from real-world examples, and provides the resulting obfuscation framework as an open transformation package to facilitate better understanding and mitigation of obfuscated toxic content in LLM for Korean.

2510.12047.tldr: Using ContractEval to evaluate five representative open-source code LLMs, this work reveals a stark disparity between functional correctness and contract satisfaction, establishing contract satisfaction as a crucial and previously overlooked axis of code generation quality.

2510.12700.tldr: The topological signatures of ReLU neural network activation patterns are explored and the Fiedler partition of the dual graph appears to correlate with the decision boundary -- in the case of binary classification.

2510.16769.tldr: GraphVista is proposed, a unified framework that enhances both scalability and modality coordination in graph structure understanding and consistently outperforms existing textual, visual, and fusion-based methods.

2510.20171.tldr: The NCCLX collective communication framework is engineered to optimize performance across the full LLM lifecycle, from the synchronous demands of large-scale training to the low-latency requirements of inference, designed to support complex workloads on clusters exceeding 100,000 GPUs.

2511.01033.tldr: This work uncovers a relatively simple and interpretable structure of the weight matrices implementing the induction head, and gives a formal proof that the training dynamics remain constrained to a 19-dimensional subspace of the parameter space.

2511.01937.tldr: This work shows that retaining and modestly up-weighting moderately easy problems acts as an implicit length regularizer, and learns to solve harder problems without inflating the output length, despite the absence of any explicit length penalization.

2511.01938.tldr: It is argued that post-memorization learning can be understood through the lens of constrained optimization: gradient descent effectively minimizes the weight norm on the zero-loss manifold in the limit of infinitesimally small learning rates and weight decay coefficients.

2511.02108.tldr: This paper conducted a literature review and collected 191 MRs for NLP tasks, and implemented a representative subset to conduct a series of experiments with three popular LLMs, shedding light on the capabilities and opportunities of MT for LLMs, as well as its limitations.

2511.09993.tldr: An LLM-powered Time Agent is developed that leverages tool-augmented code generation to advance cross-calendar temporal reasoning, and two key obstacles for LLMs are identified: Future-Date Degradation and Calendar Asymmetry Bias.

2511.16035.tldr: Evaluating three black- and white-box lie detection techniques on LIARS'BENCH finds that existing techniques systematically fail to identify certain types of lies, especially in settings where it's not possible to determine whether the model lied from the transcript alone.

2511.19517.tldr: A novel, automated pipeline for generating large-scale, psychologically-grounded multi-turn jailbreak datasets, which highlights a critical divergence in how current safety architectures handle conversational context and underscores the need for defenses that can resist narrative-based manipulation.

2511.21744.tldr: NEULIF is introduced, a lightweight approach that achieves best performance in the lightweight detector class, that does not require extensive computational power and provides high detection accuracy and highlights the potential of such models for broader applications across languages, domains, and streaming contexts.

2511.23143.tldr: A novel framework that integrates Large Language Models with automated planning and formal verification to streamline the creation and use of Markov Decision Processes (MDP) and is validated in three human-robot interaction scenarios.

2512.11847.tldr: Overall, TRM's ARC-AGI-1 performance appears to arise from an interaction between efficiency, task-specific conditioning, and aggressive test-time compute rather than deep internal reasoning.

2512.12669.tldr: DynaGen dynamically constructs entity-centric subgraphs and processes them with a synergistic dual-branch GNN encoder to capture evolving structural context and applies a conditional diffusion process, which forces the model to learn underlying evolutionary principles rather than just superficial patterns, enhancing its ability to predict unseen future events.

2512.12805.tldr: A theoretical framework to analyze Transformers' ability to extrapolate from smaller token sets to significantly longer ones and proves that for Transformers with stable positional encodings, this bound is determined by the sampling density and the intrinsic dimensionality of the data manifold.

2512.15906.tldr: DV has been released as free, open-source, extensible software, on an"as is"basis, without warranties or conditions of any kind, either express or implied.

2512.16303.tldr: The latest Gemini 3 Pro Image has emergent image generation capabilities that generate semantic masks with high fidelity under zero-shot settings, showcasing visual intelligence unseen before and true generalization in new image generation tasks.

2512.17629.tldr: SCOPE (Sequential Causal Optimization of Process Interventions), a PresPM approach that learns aligned sequential intervention recommendations that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PresPM techniques in optimizing the KPI.

2512.18508.tldr: It is shown that innovation statistics computed after gating converge to gate-conditioned rather than nominal quantities, implying that nominal innovation statistics cannot be preserved under nontrivial gating and association.

2512.19011.tldr: GuardChain is designed, a three-stage safety pipeline that routes each prompt to the cheapest stage capable of a confident decision, and provides evidence that GPU-class infrastructure is unnecessary for the majority of traffic.

2512.23385.tldr: It is revealed that many security issues arise from the complex dependencies and black-box nature of AI components, Notably, challenges related to Models and Data often lack concrete solutions.

2601.01132.tldr: This work proposes a novel hybrid framework that decomposes D-TSP into two efficient steps, utilizing a simple Graph Pointer Network (GPN), augmented with an approximated sequence entropy loss, to efficiently sample a large, diverse pool of high-quality tours.

2601.01301.tldr: A recursive AlphaZero-style Monte--Carlo tree search algorithm, RMCTS, is introduced, and it is found that RMCTS-trained networks match the quality of MCTS-UCB-trained networks in roughly one-third of the training time.

2601.01739.tldr: This technical report presents K-EXAONE, a large-scale multilingual language model developed by LG AI Research, positioned as a powerful proprietary AI foundation model for a wide range of industrial and research applications.

2601.02163.tldr: EverMemOS, a self-organizing memory operating system that implements an engram-inspired lifecycle for computational memory, is introduced and it is shown that EverMemOS achieves state-of-the-art performance on memory-augmented reasoning tasks.

2601.02778.tldr: A practical sim-to-real reinforcement learning framework that utilizes dense tactile feedback combined with joint torque sensing to explicitly regulate physical interactions and provides a practical solution to achieve reliable dexterous manipulation.

2601.03624.tldr: This paper presents an approach for architecting such systems using design patterns derived from enterprise distributed systems standards, formal methods, and industry practice, and ground these patterns in a formal framework that specifies collaboration agreements where AI agents and humans fill roles within governed ecosystems.

2601.03666.tldr: e5-omni is proposed, a lightweight explicit alignment recipe that adapts off-the-shelf VLMs into robust omni-modal embedding models and shows consistent gains over strong bi-modal and omni-modal baselines, and the same recipe also transfers well to other VLM backbones.

2601.03731.tldr: RepoReason is presented, a white-box diagnostic benchmark centered on abductive assertion verification, and an execution-driven mutation framework that utilizes the environment as a semantic oracle to regenerate ground-truth states is implemented.

2601.03888.tldr: IndexTTS 2.5 is presented, which significantly enhances multilingual coverage, inference speed, and overall synthesis quality through four key improvements and establishes practical design principles for zero-shot multilingual emotional TTS.

2601.04263.tldr: The proposed Temporal Saliency Distillation effectively improves the performance of baseline methods while also achieving desirable properties beyond predictive accuracy and is hoped to establish a new paradigm for interpretable knowledge distillation in time series analysis.

2601.04285.tldr: Agent Mallard is outlined, a forward-planning, rules-based agent for tactical control in systemised airspace that embeds a stochastic digital twin directly into its conflict-resolution loop and is intended to combine model-based safety assessment, interpretable decision logic, and tractable computational performance in future structured en-route environments.

2601.04287.tldr: Results indicate that online action-stacking helps bridge a key gap between standard reinforcement learning formulations and operational ATC requirements, and provides a simple mechanism for scaling to more complex control scenarios.

2601.04405.tldr: This is the first work that integrating self-supervised and weakly-supervised learning for mastoidectomy shape prediction, offering a robust and efficient solution for CI surgical planning while leveraging 3D T-distribution loss in weakly-supervised medical imaging.

2601.04651.tldr: An Reasoner-Verifier framework named Adversarial Reasoning RAG (ARR) is proposed, where the Reasoner and Verifier engage in reasoning on retrieved evidence and critiquing each other's logic while being guided by process-aware advantage that requires no external scoring model.

2601.04996.tldr: AlgBench is proposed, an expert-curated benchmark that evaluates LRMs under an algorithm-centric paradigm and exposes fundamental limitations of problem-centric reinforcement learning and highlights the necessity of an algorithm-centric training paradigm for robust algorithmic reasoning.

2601.05034.tldr: A revised E(S) relationship tailored for WSD scheduler is derived, characterizing the trade-off between training data consumption E and steps S during pre-training, and the resulting scheduling strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and final model quality.

2601.05172.tldr: Chain-of-View (CoV) prompting is proposed, a training-free, test-time reasoning framework that transforms a VLM into an active viewpoint reasoner through a coarse-to-fine exploration process that suggests that question-aligned view selection coupled with open-view search is an effective, model-agnostic strategy for improving spatial reasoning in 3D EQA without additional training.

2601.05215.tldr: MineNPC-Task, a user-authored benchmark and evaluation harness for testing memory-aware, mixed-initiative LLM agents in open-world Minecraft, and releases the complete task suite, validators, logs, and evaluation harness to support transparent and reproducible evaluation of future memory-aware embodied agents.

2601.05253.tldr: SP-Rank is introduced, the first large-scale, publicly available dataset for benchmarking algorithms that leverage both first-order preferences and second-order predictions in ranking tasks, and results show that incorporating second-order signals substantially improves accuracy over vote-only methods.

2601.05256.tldr: NAIAD employs an agentic AI assistant leveraging Large Language Models and a variety of external tools to provide a holistic solution for general-purpose inland water quality monitoring using Earth Observation (EO) data, and preliminary results indicate promising performance and high versatility relative to the expertise level of the input prompt.

2601.05257.tldr: This paper proposes KP-Agent, an LLM agentic system with domain tool set and memory module, which generates code snippets to refine keyword sets through reinforcement learning and improves cumulative profit by up to 49.28% over baselines.

2601.05258.tldr: This work proposes a multi-stage framework for trending detection, which achieves systematic optimization from both offline generation and online identification perspectives and significantly outperforms baseline methods in both offline evaluations and online A/B tests, and user satisfaction is relatively improved.

2601.05260.tldr: The Influence Score (IS), a novel metric based on Partial Information Decomposition that measures the impact of each retrieved document on the generated response, is introduced, offering a valuable tool for improving the transparency and reliability of RAG systems.

2601.05262.tldr: LLM2IR is introduced, an efficient unsupervised contrastive learning framework to convert any decoder-only large language model (LLM) to an information retrieval model and sheds light on the relationship between information retrieval ability and model context length, which helps the design of better information retrievers.

2601.05265.tldr: This work introduces Cross-Document Topic-Aligned (CDTA) chunking, which reconstructs knowledge at the corpus level, which improves measurably over within-document optimization in high-query-volume applications with distributed knowledge.

2601.05266.tldr: RAGsemble is introduced, a retrieval-augmented multi-LLM ensemble framework that orchestrates nine state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) within a structured three-phase pipeline and demonstrates significant gains in extraction accuracy, technical completeness, and structured output quality compared to leading single-LLM baselines.

2601.05270.tldr: LiveVectorLake is introduced, a dual-tier temporal knowledge base architecture that enables real-time semantic search on current knowledge while maintaining complete version history for compliance, auditability, and point-in-time retrieval.

2601.05273.tldr: The answer is negative in a PCSG-inspired regime where overlapping coalitions generate highly coherent, near-duplicate columns: the irrepresentable condition fails for the design, and $k$-step Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) exhibits a nonvanishing probability of irreversible mis-selection.

2601.05277.tldr: An evolutionary approach to creating a cognitive architecture that includes components, the interaction of which ensures the evolution of the agent and the requirements for the functional core and its composition are discussed.

2601.05279.tldr: A novel Dynamic Window-based Simulation-Free PSRO is proposed, which introduces the concept of a strategy window to replace the original strategy set maintained in PSRO, and uses Nash Clustering to select the strategy to be eliminated, ensuring that the number of strategies within the strategy window is effectively limited.

2601.05293.tldr: This survey examines the implications of agentic AI for cybersecurity, surveys emerging threat models, security frameworks, and evaluation pipelines tailored to agentic systems, and analyzes systemic risks including agent collusion, cascading failures, oversight evasion, and memory poisoning.

2601.05296.tldr: MoEBlaze is presented, a memory-efficient MoE training framework that addresses issues through a co-designed system approach with optimized data structures to eliminate intermediate buffers and activation materializing and co-designed kernels with smart activation checkpoint to mitigate memory footprint while simultaneously achieving better performance.

2601.05328.tldr: Bi-orthogonal Factor Decomposition is introduced, a two-stage analytical framework that exposes how tokens interact through attention and which informational factors mediate their communication, yielding practical insights into vision transformer mechanisms.

2601.05330.tldr: This work proposes the knowledge-enhanced hypergraph model, Hyper-Enz, which integrates a hypergraph transformer with a KGE model to learn representations of the hyper-edges that involve multiple educts and products that involve multiple educts and products.

2601.05339.tldr: MJAD-MLLMs is introduced, a holistic framework that systematically analyzes the proposed Multi-turn Jailbreaking Attacks and multi-LLM-based defense techniques for MLLMs and proposes a novel fragment-optimized and multi-LLM defense mechanism, called FragGuard, to effectively mitigate jailbreaking attacks in the MLLMs.

2601.05355.tldr: The proposed Bayesian generative modeling framework leverages the power of AI to capture complex relationships among variables while adhering to Bayesian principles, emerging as a promising framework for advancing various applications in modern data science.

2601.05356.tldr: This work introduces PRISM (Protocol Refinement through Intelligent Simulation Modeling), a framework that automates the design, validation, and execution of experimental protocols on a laboratory platform composed of off-the-shelf robotic instruments.

2601.05364.tldr: Two new model families are introduced, STResNet for image classification and STYOLO for object detection, jointly optimized for accuracy, efficiency, and memory footprint on resource constrained platforms.

2601.05366.tldr: This work introduces MLCL, a diagnostic benchmark, and conducts a systematic evaluation of multilingual tool calling across Chinese, Hindi, and the low-resource language Igbo, finding that many failures occur despite correct intent understanding and tool selection.

2601.05373.tldr: Ensemble methods combining DL and radiomics predictions significantly enhance breast cancer diagnosis from mammograms.

2601.05376.tldr: This work shows that personas function as behavioral priors that introduce context-dependent trade-offs rather than guarantees of safety or expertise, and finds systematic, context-dependent, and non-monotonic effects.

2601.05384.tldr: Con conformity, the tendency to align with group opinions under social pressure, is examined in large multimodal language models functioning as AI agents, revealing fundamental security vulnerabilities in AI agent decision-making that could enable malicious manipulation, misinformation campaigns, and bias propagation in multi-agent systems.

2601.05399.tldr: A multi-task learning framework to fine-tune BiomedCLIP and evaluate improvements to CXR image-text retrieval and t-SNE visualizations reveal clearer semantic clustering of normal and abnormal cases, demonstrating the model's enhanced diagnostic sensitivity.

2601.05432.tldr: Experimental results show that the method outperforms existing open- and closed-source models on most metrics, specifically improving Acc@500m from 8.0\% to 22.1\% compared to \textit{Gemini-3-Pro} with Google Search/Map grounded mode.

2601.05437.tldr: The results provide mechanistic evidence that moral concepts in LLMs are distributed, layered, and partly disentangled, suggesting that pluralistic moral structure can emerge as a latent pattern from the statistical regularities of language alone.

2601.05455.tldr: This paper proposes ART (Adaptive Reasoning Trees), a hierarchical method for claim verification which outperforms strong baselines, establishing a new benchmark for explainable claim verification which is more reliable and ensures clarity in the overall decision making step.

2601.05459.tldr: It is shown that aligning the model's internal reasoning processes with Korean inputs-particularly by tuning Korean-specific neurons in early layers-is key to unlocking RL's effectiveness, and the crucial factor in multilingual reasoning enhancement is not injecting new linguistic knowledge, but effectively eliciting and aligning existing reasoning capabilities.

2601.05465.tldr: PRISMA is a decoupled RL-guided framework featuring a Plan-Retrieve-Inspect-Solve-Memoize architecture that provides reasoning-based feedback to refine the Planner's decomposition and fine-grained retrieval, while enforcing evidence-grounded reasoning in the Solver.

2601.05466.tldr: iMIST disguises malicious queries as normal tool invocations to bypass content filters, while simultaneously introducing an interactive progressive optimization algorithm that dynamically escalates response harmfulness through multi-turn dialogues guided by real-time harmfulness assessment.

2601.05474.tldr: ALVGL is proposed, a novel and general enhancement to the differentiable causal discovery pipeline that employs a sparse and low-rank decomposition to learn the precision matrix of the data and is used to initialize a standard differentiable causal discovery method with a more focused search space, thereby improving both optimization efficiency and accuracy.

2601.05483.tldr: MMUEChange, a multi-modal agent framework that flexibly integrates heterogeneous urban data via a modular toolkit and a core module, Modality Controller for cross- and intra-modal alignment, enabling robust analysis of complex urban change scenarios, is proposed.

2601.05498.tldr: This study presents a multi-task deep learning framework that jointly performs lesion segmentation and diagnostic classification using embeddings from the Segment Anything Model (SAM) vision encoder using embeddings from the Segment Anything Model vision encoder.

2601.05502.tldr: This study evaluates the effectiveness of nine state-of-the-art LLMs for automated web performance issue resolution, revealing that LLMs universally excel at SEO&Accessibility issues, however, their efficacy in performance-critical DOM manipulations is mixed.

2601.05503.tldr: This work conducts a systematic evaluation of over-searching across multiple dimensions, including query types, model categories, retrieval conditions, and multi-turn conversations, and introduces Tokens Per Correctness (TPC), an evaluation metric that captures the performance-cost trade-off for search-augmented LLMs.

2601.05527.tldr: DeMa preserves Mamba's linear-complexity advantage while substantially improving its suitability for MTS settings, and introduces three key innovations that achieves state-of-the-art performance while delivering remarkable computational efficiency.

2601.05537.tldr: This work proposes a Heterogeneous-aware Orthogonal Prototype Experts framework named HOPE, a plug-and-play replacement for the standard prediction head that uses learnable prototype-based routing to assign instances to experts by similarity, letting expert usage follow the natural long-tail distribution, and adds expert orthogonalization to encourage diversity and prevent collapse.

2601.05542.tldr: This paper presents an empirical study on the effectiveness of LLMs in generating test oracles that expose software failures, and investigates how different prompting strategies and levels of contextual input impact the quality of LLM-generated oracles.

2601.05547.tldr: This work investigates the outputs of internal attention heads, postulating that specific heads carry the primary signals for truthful generation in hallucinations, and proposes VIB-Probe, a novel hallucination detection and mitigation framework leveraging the Variational Information Bottleneck (VIB) theory.

2601.05556.tldr: A dynamic thresholding method to adapt to the requirements of the semi-supervised learning framework for facial expression recognition tasks, and through a selective negative learning strategy, it fully utilizes unlabeled samples with low confidence by mining useful expression information from complementary labels, achieving impressive results.

2601.05560.tldr: Experiments show that ReasonAny effectively synthesizes"Reasoning + X"capabilities, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines while retaining robust reasoning performance, and proposes ReasonAny, a novel merging framework that resolves the reasoning-domain performance collapse through Contrastive Gradient Identification.

2601.05567.tldr: This work introduces WildSci, a new dataset of domain-specific science questions automatically synthesized from peer-reviewed literature, covering 9 scientific disciplines and 26 subdomains, and applies reinforcement learning to finetune models on these data and analyze the resulting training dynamics, including domain-specific performance changes, response behaviors, and generalization trends.

2601.05570.tldr: Crisis-Bench provides the first quantitative framework for assessing "Reputation Management" capabilities, arguing for a shift from rigid moral absolutism to context-aware professional alignment.

2601.05578.tldr: This paper proposes a novel approach that employs Reinforcement Learning to post-train lightweight language models specifically for fraud detection tasks using only raw transaction data, and utilizes the Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) algorithm combined with a rule-based reward system to fine-tune language models of various sizes on a real-life transaction dataset provided by a Chinese global payment solution company.

2601.05579.tldr: RISE is a novel LLM-based SQL dialect translation approach that can accurately handle lengthy and complex SQL queries and achieves accuracies of 97.98% on TPC-DS and 100% on SQLProcBench, outperforming the baselines by an average improvement of 24.62% and 238.41%, respectively.

2601.05584.tldr: This study proposes the GS-DMSR method, which quantitatively analyzing the dynamic evolution process of Gaussian attributes achieves adaptive gradient focusing, enabling it to dynamically identify significant differences in the motion states of Gaussian models.

2601.05587.tldr: HogVul is proposed, a black-box adversarial code generation framework that integrates both lexical and syntax perturbations under a unified dual-channel optimization strategy driven by Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO).

2601.05589.tldr: The ACR Framework is proposed, which dynamically monitors and reshapes the interaction history to mitigate contextual inertia and state drift actively and significantly outperforms existing baselines while reducing token consumption.

2601.05590.tldr: A novel causal learning-based ranking framework that extends ULTR by combining Structural Causal Models (SCMs) with information-theoretic tools and incorporating a causal inference estimator, i.e., doubly robust estimator, to ensure more reliable risk estimation is introduced.

2601.05613.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PiXTime achieves state-of-the-art performance in heterogeneous federated environments, while maintaining robust superiority in standard homogeneous and centralized forecasting settings.

2601.05629.tldr: This paper proposes the Cumulative Path-Level Semantic Reasoning for inductive knowledge graph completion (CPSR) framework, which simultaneously captures both the structural and semantic information of KGs to enhance the inductive KGC task.

2601.05637.tldr: The results show that model controllability is surprisingly fragile and highly dependent on the experimental setting, highlighting the need for rigorous controllability analysis, shifting the focus from simply attempting control to first understanding its fundamental limits.

2601.05647.tldr: It is revealed that transformers trained in an autoregressive manner naturally encode time-delayed causal structures in their learned representations and the gradient sensitivities of transformer outputs with respect to past inputs directly recover the underlying causal graph without any explicit causal objectives or structural constraints.

2601.05851.tldr: Router-Suggest is presented, a router framework that dynamically selects between textual models and VLMs based on dialog context, along with a lightweight variant for resource-constrained environments, which achieves a 2.3x to 10x speedup over the best-performing VLM.

2601.06060.tldr: It is argued that AI Slop is not mere digital detritus but has its own aesthetic value, and should be taken seriously as an object of study in its own right.

2601.06300.tldr: Experiments across diverse baselines show that CAMLM consistently improves amendment prediction, enabling more robust and cost-effective clinical trial design.

2601.06301.tldr: It is argued that large language models (LLMs) have democratized web scraping, enabling low-skill users to execute sophisticated operations through simple natural language prompts, and that end-to-end agents have made complex scraping accessible.

2601.06309.tldr: VideoWeave is presented, a simple yet effective approach to improve data efficiency by constructing synthetic long-context training samples that splice together short, captioned videos from existing datasets that achieve higher accuracy than conventional video finetuning.

2601.06328.tldr: C-World, an environment creation system that enables users to build agent environments on demand, and the World Engine, which approximates tool behavior without live service access, enabling scalable environment creation -- including environments for domains and tools that do not yet exist in the real world.

2601.06334.tldr: The proposed framework provides high interpretability through spline-based functional visualizations and latent-space projections, enabling identification of the design and tolerance parameters that most strongly influence manufacturability.

2601.06335.tldr: SAFER is introduced, a model-driven methodology supported by Generative AI to improve the generation and analysis of safety requirements for complex safety-critical systems, and is demonstrated on an autonomous drone system, significantly improving the detection of requirement inconsistencies and enhancing both efficiency and reliability of the safety engineering process.

2601.06338.tldr: This study trains DiTs of different sizes with different text encoders to learn to generate images containing two objects whose attributes and spatial relations are specified in the text prompt, and finds that, although all the models can learn this task to near-perfect accuracy, the underlying mechanisms differ drastically depending on the choice of text encoder.

2601.06341.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark suite that evaluates robustness across multiple perturbation types, including general text edits, formatting changes, multilingual and cross-lingual inputs, and positional variations in instructions, demonstrates that the relationship between model size and robustness is more nuanced than conventional assumptions suggest.

2601.06352.tldr: CARD is presented, a hierarchical framework that achieves effective personalization through progressive refinement that first clusters users according to shared stylistic patterns and learns cluster-specific LoRA adapters, enabling robust generalization and strong low-resource performance.

2601.06357.tldr: The Smart Privacy Policy Assistant is presented, an LLM-powered system that automatically ingests privacy policies, extracts and categorizes key clauses, assigns human-interpretable risk levels, and generates clear, concise explanations.

2403.11169.tldr: MUSE is proposed, an LLM augmented with vision-language modeling and web retrieval over relevant, credible sources to generate responses that determine whether and which part(s) of the given content can be misinformed or potentially misleading, and to explain why with grounded references.

2403.16933.tldr: The authors propose Generalized Latent Equilibrium (GLE), a framework for fully local spatio-temporal credit assignment in physical, dynamical neuronal networks such as the brain that exploits dendritic structure and prospective coding in cortical neurons to enable an online approximation of backpropagation through space and time.

2404.00195.tldr: This work proposes an algorithm named CAESAR, which approximate the optimal offline sampling distribution and compute the importance weighting ratios for all target policies by minimizing a step-wise quadratic loss function inspired by the DualDICE objective.

2408.05748.tldr: A light-weight component based on Knowledge Distillation (KD) which is titled FedKD and tailored specifically for FKGE methods, which dynamically adjust the weight of KD loss to optimize the training process.

2408.16031.tldr: The decompose the scoring function of LFL, provide a theoretical explanation for the inefficiency of LFL, and propose adding a memory term to the scoring function to enhance the model's memory capability, along with an approximation of this memory term.

2412.06099.tldr: The design and implementation of the DECO framework is detailed, emphasizing its innovative NL2SearchQuery functionality and a lightweight agentic framework, which enables the addressing of complex technical questions and provides seamless, automated access to internal resources.

2501.01149.tldr: Android Agent Arena (A3) is presented, a novel"essential-state"based procedural evaluation system for mobile GUI agents that leverages MLLMs as reward models to progressively verify task completion and process achievement and address the limitations of traditional function based evaluation methods on online dynamic apps.

2501.09705.tldr: Group Sparse LoRA (GS-LoRA) is proposed, a simple group sparse regularization is adopted, enabling automatic selection of specific LoRA groups and zeroing out the others and extended to more practical scenarios, GS-LoRA++.

2501.13772.tldr: Jailbreak-AudioBench establishes a foundation for advancing future research on LALMs safety alignment by enabling the in-depth exposure of more powerful jailbreak threats, such as query-based audio editing, and by facilitating the development of effective defense mechanisms.

2501.17414.tldr: Reqo is introduced, a Robust and Explainable Query Optimization cost model that comprehensively enhances three main stages in query optimization: plan generation, plan representation, and plan selection.

2502.02283.tldr: GP-GS, a Gaussian Process (GP) based densification framework for 3DGS optimisation, consistently improves reconstruction quality and rendering fidelity, achieving up to 1.12 dB PSNR improvement over strong baselines.

2502.06472.tldr: KARMA is presented, a novel framework employing multi-agent large language models (LLMs) to automate KG enrichment through structured analysis of unstructured text, and employs nine collaborative agents, spanning entity discovery, relation extraction, schema alignment, and conflict resolution.

2502.06830.tldr: A new order fusion methodology is developed, which is an end-to-end and parameter-efficient probabilistic forecasting model that learns a full interaction-aware representation of the buy-sell dynamics of the orderbook.

2502.11140.tldr: Extensive experiments on MatPlotBench and Qwen-Agent Code Interpreter Benchmark show that VisPath outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing a more reliable framework for AI-driven visualization generation.

2502.12558.tldr: The results reveal the significant challenges in long-video moment retrieval in terms of accuracy and efficiency, despite improvements from the latest long-video MLLMs and task-specific fine-tuning.

2502.15785.tldr: MissTSM is introduced, a novel model-agnostic and imputation-free approach for IMTS modeling that shows competitive performance compared to other IMTS approaches, especially when the amount of missing values is large and the data lacks simplistic periodic structures.

2502.18798.tldr: A new scoring method called Normalized Probability Shift by the Question (NPSQ), designed to isolate the impact of the question itself and provide a more reliable assessment of comprehension, is introduced.

2503.10662.tldr: The results indicate that LLM-based classification achieved high accuracy in Morphology, Geography, and People categories, however, classification accuracy was lower in Ecology & Behavior and Modern & Past Culture, revealing challenges in interpreting animal behavior and cultural contexts.

2503.11720.tldr: Rich Preference Optimization (RPO) is introduced, a novel pipeline that leverages rich feedback signals from Vision Language Models to improve the curation of preference pairs for fine-tuning visual generative models like text-to-image diffusion models.

2503.11742.tldr: Unsafe Weights Manipulation (UWM) is introduced, a new set of metrics that evaluate safety at different levels of granularity that uncovers a surprising issue of training-based methods: they make the model less safe on safe inputs.

2503.14469.tldr: This work is a first investigation of score alignment depending on the query and the database; and provides a syntactic dichotomy result for queries: on one side, pairs of scores are always aligned, on the other, they are not always aligned.

2503.21889.tldr: StarFlow is introduced, a framework for generating structured workflow outputs from sketches using vision-language models, and shows that finetuning significantly enhances structured workflow generation, outperforming large vision-language models on this task.

2503.23988.tldr: This study indicates the feasibility and affordability of cloud-based Deep Learning inference solutions without a GPU, benefiting resource-constrained users such as startups and small research groups.

2504.01400.tldr: This paper proposes ToolACE-R, a novel framework that includes both model-aware iterative training and adaptive refinement for tool learning, and introduces adaptive self-refinement mechanism for efficient test-time scaling.

2504.01919.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive and up-to-date overview of how LLMs are being leveraged for MT across data regimes, languages, and application settings, and systematically analyze prompting-based methods, parameter-efficient and full fine-tuning strategies, synthetic data generation, preference-based optimization, and reinforcement learning with human and weakly supervised feedback.

2504.04260.tldr: This work proposes two key architectural enhancements to improve Fourier Neural Operators' spectral learning capabilities to represent a broad range of frequency components, including a parallel branch performing local spectral convolution and a novel frequency-sensitive loss based on radially binned spectral errors.

2504.14523.tldr: This work proposes a new approach for synthetic data generation which is grounded in the analysis of an existing LMM's reasoning failures and leverages frontier models to automatically analyze errors produced by a weaker LMM and propose new examples which can be used to correct the reasoning failure via additional training, which are then further filtered to ensure high quality.

2504.16787.tldr: Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that PAR-RAG consistently outperforms competitive baselines, while ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of complexity-aware planning and dual verification.

2504.17331.tldr: This study proposes a novel locomotion technique powered by large language models (LLMs), which allows users to navigate virtual environments using natural language with contextual awareness and states that it can facilitate hands-free locomotion in virtual spaces, especially in supporting accessibility.

2504.21323.tldr: This work introduces a novel attack methodology that strategically poisons the distillation dataset with adversarial examples embedded with backdoor triggers, and represents the first successful exploitation of vulnerabilities within the knowledge distillation process using clean teacher models.

2505.11618.tldr: A hierarchical SpatioTemporal reAsoning benchmaRK, STARK is proposed, to systematically evaluate LLMs across three levels of reasoning complexity: state estimation, spatiotemporal reasoning over states, and world-knowledge-aware reasoning that integrates contextual and domain knowledge.

2505.11837.tldr: Three practical interventions are proposed -- restricting distillation to non-vulnerable points, adding a low-dimensional Bottleneck Projection, and a normalization variant (NoNorm) -- which show these methods reduce both aggregate and member-specific MIA success while preserving model utility, improving privacy-utility trade-offs for distilled LLMs.

2505.11881.tldr: This work introduces Orthogonal Residual Update: it decompose the module's output relative to the input stream and add only the component orthogonal to this stream, aiming to guide modules to contribute primarily new representational directions, fostering richer feature learning while promoting more efficient training.

2505.14268.tldr: This work proposes Think-J, which improves generative LLM-as-a-Judge by learning how to think by utilizing a small amount of curated data and proposing two methods for judgment thinking optimization, based on offline and online RL, respectively.

2505.14656.tldr: The experiments show that existing tree-based LLM planners often struggle to find cost-optimal plans, and that additional search computation does not reliably improve optimality, suggesting that improving LLM planning under resource constraints will likely require new search algorithms, rather than solely scaling inference-time compute.

2505.19562.tldr: A new benchmark, FairMedQA, is proposed and results reveal substantial accuracy disparity ranging from 3 to 19 percentage points across sensitive demographic groups, underscoring an urgent need for targeted debiasing techniques and more rigorous, identity-aware validation protocols before LLMs can be safely integrated into practical clinical decision-support systems.

2505.20166.tldr: Experimental results indicate that the proposed data generation framework, BALSa, effectively mitigates audio hallucinations while reliably maintaining strong performance on audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks, as well as instruction-following skills.

2506.05623.tldr: DPIaC-Eval is constructed, the first deployability-centric IaC template benchmark consisting of 153 real-world scenarios cross 58 unique services and an LLM-based deployability-centric framework is proposed, dubbed IaCGen, that uses iterative feedback mechanism encompassing format verification, syntax checking, and live deployment stages, thereby closely mirroring the real DevOps workflows.

2506.05680.tldr: ManGO is introduced, a diffusion-based framework that learns the design-score manifold, capturing the design-score interdependencies holistically, and outperforms 24 single- and 10 multi-objective optimization methods across diverse domains.

2506.07919.tldr: This work presents a framework to systematically dissect the functional role of nonlinearity in recurrent networks, using Almost Linear Recurrent Neural Networks (AL-RNNs), which allow recurrence nonlinearity to be gradually attenuated and decompose network dynamics into analyzable linear regimes, making computational mechanisms explicit.

2506.10420.tldr: This work introduces an agent-based autoscaling framework that dynamically adjusts both hardware resources and internal service configurations to maximize requirements fulfillment in constrained environments and provides evidence for the viability of multi-dimensional agent-based autoscaling for edge environments.

2506.12704.tldr: A flexible realignment framework that supports quantitative control of alignment degree during training and inference is proposed that incorporates Training-time Realignment (TrRa), which efficiently realigns the reference model by leveraging the controllable fusion of logits from both the reference and already aligned models.

2506.13932.tldr: This work surveys code reasoning techniques that underpin these capabilities, with a focus on test-time compute and inference-time reasoning paradigms, and examines a variety of code-specific reasoning methods and progressively build up to SWE agents, which combine planning, tool use, and multi-step interaction.

2506.19256.tldr: A temporal regularization training (TRT) memthod is unveiled, designed to unleash the generalization and performance potential of SNNs through a time-decaying regularization mechanism that prioritizes early timesteps with stronger constraints.

2506.20209.tldr: An extensive analysis across diverse subjective text classification tasks including hate speech, irony, abusive language, and stance detection is conducted, to highlight the importance of capturing human disagreements, often overlooked by traditional aggregation methods.

2507.02620.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves inference speed across diverse models and configurations, achieving speedup ratios 1.37$\times$-1.73$\times compared to baselines.

2507.04094.tldr: MMOS is proposed, a no-reference, multi-domain audio quality assessment system that estimates four orthogonal axes: Production Quality, Production Complexity, Content Enjoyment, and Content Usefulness across speech, music, and environmental sounds.

2507.04632.tldr: Model Predictive Prompt Selection is introduced, a Bayesian risk-predictive framework that online estimates prompt difficulty without requiring costly LLM interactions and accelerates training with significantly reduced LLM rollouts.

2507.05558.tldr: A1 is presented, an agentic system that transforms any LLM into an end-to-end exploit generator, providing agents with six domain-specific tools for autonomous vulnerability discovery, from understanding contract behavior to testing strategies on real blockchain states.

2507.11210.tldr: A role-playing LLM-based multi-agent dialogue support framework that analyzes dialogue and generates feedback that can detect categories of suppressed emotion with reasonable discrimination, and produce feedback rated highly in empathy and practicality is developed.

2507.15066.tldr: Time-series Reasoning for Anomaly (Time-RA), a novel task that reformulates TSAD from a discriminative into a generative, reasoning-intensive paradigm, is proposed, and RATs40K, the first real-world large-scale multimodal benchmark with ~40,000 samples across 10 domains is introduced.

2507.17224.tldr: HuiduRep is proposed, a robust self-supervised representation learning framework that extracts discriminative and generalizable features from extracellular spike waveforms and a spike sorting pipeline that clusters spike representations without supervision is developed.

2507.18061.tldr: TELEVAL is presented, a dynamic, user-centered benchmark for evaluating SLMs in realistic Chinese spoken interaction scenarios, and consolidates evaluation into two core aspects: Reliable Content Fulfillment and Interactional Appropriateness.

2507.18448.tldr: This study explores the application of transformer-based models, specifically XLM-RoBERTa-large, to automatically restore punctuation in unpunctuated Bangla text by predicting four punctuation marks across diverse text domains and shows strong generalization to reference and ASR transcripts.

2508.03030.tldr: Collab-Solver is proposed, a novel multi-agent-based policy learning framework for MILP that enables collaborative policy optimization for multiple modules and forms the collaboration between cut selection and branching in MILP solving as a Stackelberg game.

2508.06899.tldr: This work proposes Distributed Guided Local Search (DGLS), a novel GLS framework for DCOPs that incorporates an adaptive violation condition to selectively penalize constraints with high cost, a penalty evaporation mechanism to control the magnitude of penalization, and a synchronization scheme for coordinated penalty updates.

2508.08211.tldr: SAEMark establishes a new paradigm for scalable watermarking that works out-of-the-box with closed-source LLMs while enabling content attribution and demonstrates the framework's effectiveness using Sparse Autoencoders, achieving superior detection accuracy and text quality.

2508.08344.tldr: This work introduces a general method for constructing benchmarks and presents BRINK (Benchmark for Reasoning under Incomplete Knowledge) to systematically assess KG-RAG methods under knowledge incompleteness, showing that current KG-RAG methods have limited reasoning ability under missing knowledge.

2508.08997.tldr: Intrinsic Memory Agents is introduced, a novel framework that addresses memory limitations through agent-specific memories that evolve intrinsically with agent outputs to improve the capabilities of multi-agent LLM systems on structured planning tasks.

2508.09220.tldr: A novel method integrating limited handwritten formulas with large-scale LaTeX-rendered formulas with large-scale LaTeX-rendered formulas is proposed by developing a scalable data engine to generate complex and consistent LaTeX sequences.

2508.09325.tldr: It is demonstrated that SegDAC achieves significantly better visual generalization, doubling prior performance on the hardest setting and matching or surpassing prior methods in sample efficiency across all evaluated tasks.

2508.11890.tldr: This study proposes the AMAD-SRL framework, an extended and refined version of the Autonomous Mission Agents for Drones (AMAD) cognitive multi-agent architecture, enhanced with symbolic reinforcement learning for dynamic mission planning and execution, and establishes a robust foundation for handling complex UAV missions.

2508.13021.tldr: The attention behaviors in MDMs are investigated, revealing the phenomenon of Attention Floating, which provides a mechanistic explanation for the strong in-context learning capabilities of MDMs, allowing them to double the performance compared to ARMs in knowledge-intensive tasks.

2508.20443.tldr: This work proposes EGUP (Entanglement-Guided Unlearning with Proxy Constraint), a novel framework that leverages entanglement and proxy constraint to guide the unlearning process while mitigating over-unlearning.

2509.00140.tldr: This work proposes an open-source large language model (LLM)-assisted approach to RTE for SES and explores an effective AOG workflow that includes document segmentation, candidate term mining, LLM-based relation inference, term normalization, and cross-section alignment.

2509.04791.tldr: What-if Analysis LLM (WiA-LLM), a framework that trains an LLM as an explicit, language-based world model, uses natural language to simulate how the game state evolves over time in response to candidate actions, and provides textual justifications for these predicted outcomes.

2509.09681.tldr: The db3 team's winning solution for the Meta CRAG-MM Challenge 2025 at KDD Cup'25 is presented, securing the grand prize for excellence in ego-centric queries through superior handling of first-person perspective challenges.

2509.10825.tldr: CUBE is proposed, a design-based framework that explains a trained predictive model through balanced low--high probes and recovers dominant learned effect structure, clarifies query-efficient identifiability, and supports screening--follow-up refinement.

2509.14343.tldr: An xApp called xSlice for the Near-Real-Time (Near-RT) RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) of 5G O-RANs is presented, showing that xSlice can reduce performance regret by 67% compared to the state-of-the-art solutions.

2509.20823.tldr: CaTS-Bench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark for Context-aware Time Series reasoning across 11 diverse domains, centered on a gold-standard evaluation set of 1746 human-rewritten captions that measure how effectively models translate numeric trends into immediately interpretable narratives.

2509.25503.tldr: This paper proposes a real-time deepfake detection method adapted to this genre of attack, utilizing previously unavailable biometric information, and is the first reported method to utilize point-of-gaze tracking for deepfake detection.

2509.25531.tldr: Results show that permissive-first data with high instruction and reasoning density, tiered by licensing and provenance-related risk, can provide a practical and risk-mitigated foundation for training capable LLMs, reducing reliance on broad web scrapes without sacrificing competitiveness.

2510.00023.tldr: This work introduces ToolBrain, a lightweight and user-friendly framework for training tool use in agentic models with flexible reinforcement learning, thereby easing the barriers for researchers and practitioners to adapt LLM-based agents to specific domains.

2510.02212.tldr: This work unifies the existing baseline approach such as d1 by proposing to train surrogate policies via off-policy RL, whose likelihood is much more tractable as an approximation to the true dLLM policy, and incentivizes dLLMs'natural multi-token prediction capabilities by letting the model learn to adaptively allocate an inference threshold for each prompt.

2510.03405.tldr: LegalSim, a modular multi-agent simulation of adversarial legal proceedings that explores how AI systems can exploit procedural weaknesses in codified rules, reveals emergent exploit chains, motivating red-teaming of legal rule systems in addition to model-level testing.

2510.04923.tldr: REN is introduced, the first anatomically-informed MoE framework for medical image classification and demonstrates strong generalizability and clinical interpretability, establishing a scalable, anatomically-guided framework potentially extensible to other structured medical imaging tasks.

2510.05699.tldr: The first study on membership leakage through tokenizers is presented and five attack methods to infer dataset membership are explored, highlighting tokenizers as an overlooked yet critical privacy threat and underscoring the urgent need for privacy-preserving mechanisms specifically designed for them.

2510.05774.tldr: ConstraintLLM is introduced, the first LLM specifically designed for CP modeling, which is trained on an open-source LLM with multi-instruction supervised fine-tuning, and the Constraint-Aware Retrieval Module (CARM) is proposed to increase the in-context learning capabilities.

2510.06747.tldr: A training-free method for unsupervised short text clustering that relies less on careful selection of embedders than other methods and achieves comparable or superior results to state-of-the-art methods, but without embeddings optimization or assuming prior knowledge of clusters or labels.

2510.07038.tldr: The proposed Tool-Augmented Policy Optimization (TAPO), a novel reinforcement learning framework that systematically integrates multi-hop reasoning with adaptive tool-calling capabilities, achieves more efficient tool utilization than baseline methods while preventing excessive calls caused by reward hacking.

2510.08521.tldr: FlowSearch is a multi-agent framework that actively constructs and evolves a dynamic structured knowledge flow to drive subtask execution and reasoning, capable of strategically planning and expanding the knowledge flow to enable parallel exploration and hierarchical task decomposition.

2510.08812.tldr: A Bayesian network is integrated into the POMDP observation space to manage the high-dimensional and uncertain measurements typical of astrobiology missions and reduces sample identification errors by nearly 40%.

2510.10008.tldr: The RIPRAG attack framework is proposed, an end-to-end attack pipeline that treats the target RAG system as a black box and leverages the proposed Reinforcement Learning from Black-box Feedback (RLBF) method to optimize the generation model for poisoned documents.

2510.11218.tldr: Short-Long Form Alignment for Factual Question Answering (SLAQ), a controlled evaluation framework that compares LLMs'answers to the same factual questions asked, finds that aligned facts activate overlapping model internals, and that metrics based on mechanistic similarity can predict short-long answer alignment with up to 78% accuracy.

2510.11599.tldr: This work introduces an embedding decoding pipeline that decodes embeddings back into natural language descriptions of their associated aspects, and shows that this decoding remains effective even for unoccupied regions in low-dimensional visualizations, thus offering vastly improved interpretability in user-centric settings.

2510.14319.tldr: MASC is presented, a metacognitive framework that endows MAS with real-time, unsupervised, step-level error detection and self-correction, confirming that the metacognitive monitoring and targeted correction can mitigate error propagation with minimal overhead.

2510.18913.tldr: Anchored Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO), a policy alignment method derived from first principles of KL-regularized reinforcement learning, is presented, showing that this formulation unifies supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and ranking-based objectives under a single geometric perspective.

2510.20548.tldr: This work proposes GlobalRAG, a reinforcement learning framework designed to enhance global reasoning in multi-hop question answering, and introduces Planning Quality Reward and SubGoal Completion Reward, which encourage coherent planning and reliable subgoal execution.

2510.21144.tldr: This work proposes NeuroGenPoisoning, a novel attack framework that generates adversarial external knowledge in RAG guided by LLM internal neuron attribution and genetic optimization and can effectively resolves knowledge conflict.
