2503.07884.tldr: LLMIA is presented, an out-of-the-box, tuning-free index advisor leveraging large language models (LLMs) through in-context learning for index recommendation, and demonstrates robust generalization on two real-world commercial workloads, delivering high-quality recommendations without the need for additional adaptation or retraining.

2503.09538.tldr: This work considers the more realistic setting in which the adversary can access only a bounded number of channels and proposes a new distributed algorithm that recovers strategies with simultaneously vanishing Nash gap and privacy budget as the number of players increases.

2503.21800.tldr: Deployed in production at British Columbia Cancer Registry, ELM represents the first successful deployment of a hybrid small, encoder only models-LLM architecture for tumor group classification in a real-world PBCR setting, demonstrating how strategic combination of language models can achieve both high accuracy and operational efficiency.

2504.15995.tldr: OPUS-VFL introduces a novel, privacy-aware incentive mechanism that rewards clients based on a principled combination of model contribution, privacy preservation, and resource investment, and integrates an adaptive differential privacy mechanism that enables clients to dynamically calibrate noise levels to optimize their individual utility.

2505.02024.tldr: A comprehensive overview of Manus AI is presented, exploring its core technical architecture, diverse applications across sectors such as healthcare, finance, manufacturing, robotics, and gaming, as well as its key strengths, current limitations, and future potential.

2505.08916.tldr: This paper introduces categorical semantics of all logical constructors of the DL SH including EL with disjunction, negation, universal restriction, role inclusion and transitive roles, and shows that the logic resulting from weakening semantics is more expressive than EL with the bottom concept, transitive roles and role inclusion.

2505.21854.tldr: Two complementary strategies to improve both the effectiveness and imperceptibility of the gradient-based adversarial attack are proposed, offering a principled refinement of gradient-based attacks for 3D point clouds.

2507.01062.tldr: This study develops an exploratory Monte Carlo simulation framework for quantifying perception-based student success in the context of GenAI use and offers a transparent, reproducible, and privacy-preserving proof-of-concept framework linking structured literature search, item-level summary statistics, and probabilistic modelling.

2507.02861.tldr: LiteReality is proposed, a novel pipeline that converts RGB-D scans of indoor environments into compact, realistic, and interactive 3D virtual replicas and introduces a training-free object retrieval module that achieves state-of-the-art similarity performance on the Scan2CAD benchmark, along with a robust material painting module capable of transferring appearances from images of any style to 3D assets.

2507.12261.tldr: The solution, called Infherno, is designed to adhere to the FHIR document schema and competes well with a human baseline in predicting FHIR resources from unstructured text, supporting clinical data integration processes and interoperability across institutions.

2507.16861.tldr: This work proposes Prior Guided Depth Calibration (PGDC), which leverages 2D priors to alleviate misalignment and preserve correct cross-modal feature pairs and introduces Discontinuity Aware Geometric Fusion (DAGF) to suppress residual noise from PGDC and explicitly enhance sharp depth transitions at object-background boundaries, yielding a structurally aware representation.

2507.19530.tldr: An ensemble framework to predict blood pressure from electronic health records, incorporating rigorous data leakage prevention and root-cause analysis identified three primary obstacles to generalizability: site-specific feature distributions, even among standard physiological variables and institutional variations in measurement protocols creating non-transferable learned patterns.

2508.05321.tldr: This study introduces an unsupervised deep learning framework that leverages the inherent similarities between iterative reconstruction, Deep Image Prior (DIP), and unrolled optimization schemes, and demonstrates the feasibility of reconstructing images from measurement data by pure network inference, without additional gradient steps for unseen samples.

2508.20784.tldr: Results suggest that the proposed single-agent RL approach, informed by categorical identifiers in the state representation and realistic schedule-aware design in the ridge-shaped reward function, can effectively mitigate bus bunching in non-loop settings.

2508.21475.tldr: MMSearch-Plus is introduced, a 311-task benchmark that enforces multimodal understanding by requiring extraction and propagation of fine-grained visual cues through iterative image-text retrieval and cross-validation under retrieval noise and established as a rigorous benchmark for advancing agentic MLLMs.

2509.22925.tldr: This work introduces soft embeddings, a simple relaxation that replaces discrete tokens with the expected embeddings under the generator's output distribution, and Integrating soft embeddings into the Di[M]O distillation framework makes one-step generators end-to-end trainable and enables straightforward application of GAN-based refinement, differentiable reward fine-tuning, and TTEO.

2509.23098.tldr: This work identifies an underexplored pathway within VLE mid-layers to construct a spatial map, applicable for improving zero-shot RIS by 1-7 mIoU on nine RefCOCO benchmarks, and leveraging mixed-language mid-layer embeddings yields enhanced spatial grounding accuracy.

2510.01242.tldr: The utility of AAS as a theoretically grounded, task-independent diagnostic tool for evaluating memory degradation in artificial systems is supported and its empirical validation reported here is limited to this specific model version and protocol, and applications to other architectures or training regimes require revalidation.

2510.08581.tldr: This paper introduces a systematic pipeline that converts existing multimodal hallucination benchmarks into spoken-query versions while preserving the original tasks and labels and releases RePOPE-Spk, where all queries are provided as spoken audio under diverse input conditions.

2602.23696.tldr: C cumulative parameter trajectories of transformer training under AdamW are analyzed and a dominant low-dimensional drift direction ("backbone") is identified that captures 60--80% of long-horizon displacement from initialization.

2603.03415.tldr: This study provides new mechanistic insights into how LLMs internalize OOD challenges, and designs Sparsity-Guided Curriculum In-Context Learning (SG-ICL), a strategy that explicitly uses representation sparsity to schedule few-shot demonstrations, leading to considerable performance enhancements.

2603.07514.tldr: The results reveal a structural connection to diffusion models: both methods use score-mismatch transport directions, but drifting realizes the score nonparametrically through kernel-based estimates, whereas diffusion models learn it parametrically with neural networks.

2603.15030.tldr: This work introduces VisualToolChain-Bench (VTC-Bench), a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate tool-use proficiency in MLLMs and establishes a rigorous baseline to guide the development of more generalized visual agentic models.

2603.15434.tldr: This work proposes Reaction Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), a framework that optimizes over interaction consequences rather than rubric scores and significantly outperforms strong reinforcement learning baselines in driving positive interaction outcomes.

2603.15678.tldr: Spectral Edge Dynamics (SED) is introduced to quantify this structure: a rolling-window SVD of parameter updates reveals a sharp boundary -- the spectral edge -- between coherent optimization directions and stochastic noise, identified via the maximum consecutive singular value ratio $\sigma_k / \sigma_{k+1}$.

2603.15888.tldr: The benchmark zeroes in on a narrower question: can a model actually use what it sees to adapt a plan when things do not go as expected, revealing weaknesses in visual grounding and state tracking that ultimately undermine interactive planning.

2603.15978.tldr: A safety gap is introduced that no current platform has closed: two agents individually verified as safe can, when combined, reach a forbidden goal through an emergent conjunctive dependency that neither possesses alone.

2603.16060.tldr: ARISE (Agent Reasoning via Intrinsic Skill Evolution), a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework, in which a shared policy operates both to manage skills at high-level and to generate responses at low-level (denoted as a Skills Manager and a Worker, respectively).

2603.16098.tldr: This work introduces LICA (Layered Image Composition Annotations), a large scale dataset of 1,550,244 multi-layer graphic design compositions designed to advance structured understanding and generation of graphic layouts and introduces graphic design video as a new and largely unexplored challenge for current vision-language models.

2603.16313.tldr: This thesis addresses automated fault diagnostics by unifying event sequence modeling, causal discovery, and large language models into a coherent framework for high-dimensional event streams and introduces several Transformer-based architectures for predictive maintenance, scalable sample- and population-level causal discovery frameworks and a multi-agent system that automates the synthesis of Boolean EP rules.

2603.16744.tldr: It is found that AI agents exhibit sizable nonstandard errors (NSEs), that is, uncertainty from agent-to-agent variation in analytical choices, analogous to those documented among human researchers.

2603.16952.tldr: The Deployment Gauntlet organizes constraints into eight coupled barriers that determine whether embodied foundation models can run reliably in practice, including decompositions that separate fast control from slower semantic reasoning.

2603.17024.tldr: HopChain is proposed, a scalable framework for synthesizing multi-hop vision-language reasoning data for RLVR training of VLMs that improves generalizable vision-language reasoning.

2603.17380.tldr: A specialized large-scale foundation model SCALE for virtual cell perturbation prediction is presented that addresses the above limitations jointly and suggests that advancing virtual cells requires not only better generative objectives, but also the co-design of scalable infrastructure, stable transport modeling, and biologically faithful evaluation.

2603.17759.tldr: This work introduces a novel multimodal, multilingual benchmark for detecting and understanding harmful and offensive humor, and systematically evaluates state-of-the-art (SOTA) open and closed-source models across all modalities.

2603.17973.tldr: TDAD (Test-Driven Agentic Development), an open-source tool that performs pre-change impact analysis for AI coding agents, improves issue-resolution rate from 24% to 32%, confirming that surfacing contextual information outperforms prescribing procedural workflows.

2603.18043.tldr: The LLM Delegate Protocol is extended with delegation contracts that bound authority through explicit objectives, budgets, and failure policies; a claimed-vs-attested identity model that distinguishes self-reported from verified quality; and typed failure semantics enabling automated recovery.

2603.18046.tldr: NanoZK introduces a layerwise proof framework that decomposes transformer inference into independently provable layers linked by a SHA-256 commitment chain, yielding constant-size sub-circuit proofs comparable in total size to and substantially more parallelizable than prior ZKML's monolithic 101-126 KB proofs.

2603.18063.tldr: MCP-38 is presented, a protocol-specific threat taxonomy consisting of 38 threat categories consisting of 38 threat categories (MCP-01 through MCP-38), derived through a systematic four-phase methodology.

2603.18066.tldr: This paper presents a digital architecture that implements a discrete-time predictive coding update directly in hardware, a deterministic, synthesizable RTL substrate built around a sequential MAC datapath and a fixed finite-state schedule.

2603.18073.tldr: This thesis proposes a synthetic data approach that diversifies and amplifies small corpora into rich knowledge representations, enabling a model to effectively update its parameters from limited source material, and shows that by scaling search during test time over the space of algorithms, AI can search over a larger space of learning algorithm configurations than human researchers can explore manually.

2603.18074.tldr: A lightweight adaptation framework that fuses an LLM-based judge with a lightweight relevance-based Reranker to distill high-fidelity reward signals while reducing the computational cost compared to standard LLM-as-a-Judge reinforcement learning is proposed.

2603.18079.tldr: This work proposes SLEA-RL (Step-Level Experience-Augmented Reinforcement Learning), a framework that retrieves relevant experiences at each decision step conditioned on the current observation and achieves superior performance compared to various reinforcement learning baselines.

2603.18083.tldr: Meta-BayFL is proposed, a personalized probabilistic FL method that combines meta-learning with BNNs to improve training under uncertain and heterogeneous data and provides a theoretical convergence analysis and characterize the upper bound of the global model over communication rounds.

2603.18084.tldr: The results suggest that neural network-based policies, which are often regarded as black boxes, can autonomously acquire interpretable phase structures and logical branching mechanisms.

2603.18085.tldr: A Multi-Trait Subspace Steering (MultiTraitsss) framework is developed that leverages established crisis-associated traits and novel subspace steering framework to generate Dark models that exhibits cumulative harmful behavioral patterns in Human-AI interactions.

2603.18088.tldr: Experiments on dialogue and code generation show that dynamic constraints outperform both KL regularization and unconstrained baselines, achieving substantially higher task rewards while maintaining training stability.

2603.18089.tldr: CytoSyn is introduced, a state-of-the-art foundation latent diffusion model that enables the guided generation of highly realistic and diverse histopathology H&E-stained images, as shown in an extensive benchmark.

2603.18096.tldr: This paper presents an assurance framework for multi-agent LLM systems, intended as a common abstraction to support testing and evaluation of multi-agent LLM systems, and to facilitate reproducible comparison across orchestration designs and configurations.

2603.18101.tldr: A novel asymmetric training-only framework for few-shot adaptation that employs a cache-aware dual-objective strategy to supervise this relational knowledge directly into the Tip-Adapter's key-value cache, effectively upgrading the prototypes while the graph teacher is discarded at test time.

2603.18104.tldr: The result is a class of domain-specific AI systems that are smaller and more precise than general-purpose models, continuously adaptive, verifiably correct with respect to the physical structure of their domains, and initializable from existing models.

2603.18107.tldr: This paper introduces ARTEMIS (Arbitrage-free Representation Through Economic Models and Interpretable Symbolics), a novel neuro-symbolic framework combining a continuous-time Laplace Neural Operator encoder, a neural stochastic differential equation regularised by physics-informed losses, and a differentiable symbolic bottleneck that distils interpretable trading rules.

2603.18112.tldr: Tula is presented, an online service that automatically optimizes time, cost, and convergence quality for large-batch training of convolutional models and achieves up to 20x overall speedup and improves test accuracy by 9% on average over standard large-batch training on various vision tasks, thus successfully mitigating the generalization gap and accelerating training at the same time.

2603.18113.tldr: This work revisits multi-value alignment from the perspective of value consistency in data and proposes VC-soup, a data filtering and parameter merging framework grounded in value-consistent learning that effectively mitigates conflicts and consistently outperforms existing multi-value alignment methods.

2603.18115.tldr: An LLM-augmented computational phenotyping framework ``Grace Cycle'' is proposed that iteratively integrates hypothesis generation, evidence extraction, and feature refinement to discover clinically meaningful subgroups from longitudinal patient data.

2603.18117.tldr: Intellectual stewardship is proposed as a human-centered, conceptually grounded framework for advancing creative learning practices with AI, calling for the development of meta-level dispositions and capabilities that characterize wisdom-oriented, socially responsible knowledge builders in the AI age.

2603.18118.tldr: Insight-V++ introduces two novel algorithms, ST-GRPO and J-GRPO, which enhance spatial-temporal reasoning and improve evaluative robustness, and guides an iterative reasoning path generation process, retraining the entire multi-agent system in a continuous, self-improving loop.

2603.18122.tldr: This agent-supported, but code-first approach to workflows, along with the context-engineering used in Skele-Code, can help reduce token costs compared to the multi-agent system approach to executing workflows.

2603.18130.tldr: Stakeholders identified priority research thrusts including human robot collaboration, trustworthy autonomy, simulation and digital twins, multi modal sensing, and ethical integration of generative AI into clinical workflows including human robot collaboration into clinical workflows.

2603.18161.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs not only alter the voice and tone of human writing, but also consistently alter the intended meaning, highlighting a misalignment between the perceived benefit of AI use and an implicit, consistent effect on the semantics of human writing.

2603.18166.tldr: This work proposes and extensively evaluates a novel cluster-based approach that groups individuals based on similar attributes over time, enabling faster execution through accurate group summarisation and leads to faster processing and lower memory usage when compared with state-of-the-art methods.

2603.18178.tldr: VLM-AutoDrive offers a scalable recipe for adapting general-purpose VLMs to safety-critical, temporally localized perception tasks, and achieves substantial gains in Collision and Near-Collision detection while producing interpretable reasoning traces, bridging the gap between perception, causality, and decision reasoning in autonomous driving.

2603.18189.tldr: TeachingCoach is a pedagogically grounded chatbot designed to support instructor professional development through real-time, conversational guidance that produces clearer, more reflective, and more responsive guidance than a GPT-4o mini baseline.

2603.18197.tldr: This work proposes a design of website-based interaction for AI agents with fine-grained access control for delegated critical tasks, which encompasses a website design and implementation, as well as modifications to the access grant protocols in an open-source authorization service to tailor it to agentic AI.

2603.18201.tldr: A physics-based autonomous vehicle simulation platform with a justifiable error injector is leveraged to generate high-quality data for AI system reliability analysis and a new reliability modeling framework is developed to explicitly characterize error propagation across stages.

2603.18237.tldr: Compared with multiple sampling baselines, the data selected by GITS achieves lower rollout error across multiple PDE systems, model backbones and sample ratios, and ablation studies demonstrate the necessity and complementarity of the two optimization objectives in GITS.

2603.18256.tldr: MolRGen is introduced, a benchmark and molecular verifier for training and evaluating reasoning LLMs on de novo molecular generation and a diversity-aware top-k metric is introduced to measure whether models can generate a diverse set of high-scoring molecules.

2603.18258.tldr: This work develops a theoretical framework that models the coordinate-wise dynamics in logit space and investigates logits-SAM, a computationally efficient variant that perturbs only the output layer with negligible overhead and integrates seamlessly with other DPO variants.

2603.18261.tldr: LRConv-NeRV is proposed, an efficient NeRV variant that replaces selected dense 3x3 convolutional layers with structured low-rank separable convolutions, trained end-to-end within the decoder architecture, and achieves a more favorable efficiency versus quality trade-off.

2603.18266.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively captures complex actor-actor interactions and generates long-horizon, physically consistent trajectories, while requiring significantly fewer training samples than traditional agent-centric generative approaches.

2603.18272.tldr: This work establishes a robust supervised fine-tuning recipe using LoRA that outperforms several state-of-the-art agent training pipelines and provides a detailed analysis of key design choices for experience retrieval, identifying optimal strategies for storage, querying, and trajectory selection.

2603.18273.tldr: This technical report presents the Educational Data Mining Automated Research System (EDM-ARS), a domain-specific multi-agent pipeline that automates end-to-end educational data mining research and outlines a phased roadmap toward causal inference, transfer learning, psychometric, and multi-dataset generalization.

2603.18280.tldr: This work studies political censorship in Chinese-origin language models as a natural experiment, using probes, surgical ablations, and behavioral tests across nine open-weight models from five labs to support a three-stage descriptive framework: detect, route, generate.

2603.18284.tldr: The first measurement study of mobile robotic manipulation workloads across onboard, edge, and cloud GPU platforms is presented, finding that the full workload stack is infeasible to run on smaller onboard GPUs, while larger onboard GPUs drain robot batteries several hours faster.

2603.18290.tldr: CORE achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across five architectures and five benchmark configurations, ranking first in three of five settings and achieving the highest grand average AUROC with negligible computational overhead.

2603.18298.tldr: This work proposes the first sparsely supervised framework for monocular 3D object tracking and automatically generates high-quality 3D pseudolabels across entire videos, effectively transforming sparse supervision into dense 3D track annotations and enables existing fully-supervised trackers to effectively operate under extreme label sparsity.

2603.18300.tldr: ChoiceEval is introduced, a reproducible framework for auditing preferences for brands and cultures in large language models (LLMs) under realistic usage conditions and reveals consistent preferences that persist across user personas, suggesting systematic rather than incidental effects.

2603.18314.tldr: A Reinforcement Learning based Approximate Subgraph Matching (RL-ASM) algorithm that exploits graph transformers to effectively extract graph representations and RL-based policies for ASM that outperforms existing methods in terms of effectiveness and efficiency.

2603.18315.tldr: DriveVLM-RL is proposed, a neuroscience-inspired framework that integrates VLMs into RL through a dual-pathway architecture for safe and deployable autonomous driving and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in collision avoidance and task success.

2603.18327.tldr: Overall, clinician post-editing demonstrates consistent shifts from conversational phrasing toward standardized, section- appropriate clinical terminology, supporting section-aware ambient AI design.

2603.18329.tldr: FaithSteer-BENCH is introduced, a stress-testing benchmark that evaluates steering methods at a fixed deployment-style operating point through three gate-wise criteria: controllability, utility preservation, and robustness, which shows that existing methods do not necessarily provide reliable controllability in deployment-oriented practical settings.

2603.18330.tldr: This work introduces MemArchitect, a governance layer that decouples memory lifecycle management from model weights and enforces explicit, rule-based policies, including memory decay, conflict resolution, and privacy controls.

2603.18331.tldr: This survey presents differential equations as a theoretical foundation for understanding, analyzing, and improving DNNs, and reviews how this framework connects model design, theoretical analysis, and performance improvement.

2603.18334.tldr: This work introduces VCoT-Lift, a framework that lifts low-level solver reasoning into high-level, human-readable verification steps, and introduces VCoT-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark of 1,988 VCoT completion tasks for rigorously evaluating LLMs' understanding of the entire verification process.

2603.18342.tldr: A unified uncertainty quantification approach for predicting rollout success versus failure that uses max-based sliding window pooling to preserve transient risk signals, applies motion-aware stability weighting to emphasize high-frequency action oscillations associated with unstable behaviors, and performs DoF-adaptive calibration via Bayesian Optimization to prioritize kinematically critical axes is proposed.

2603.18353.tldr: Current mechanistic interpretability methods cannot reliably translate internal knowledge into corrected outputs, with implications for AI safety frameworks that assume interpretability enables effective error correction.

2603.18356.tldr: LGESynthNet, a latent diffusion-based framework for controllable enhancement synthesis, enabling explicit control over size, location, and transmural extent is introduced, enabling explicit control over size, location, and transmural extent.

2603.18358.tldr: A temporal taxonomy of news-document trajectories that defines how documents relate to topic formation over time is introduced, which distinguishes anticipatory outliers from documents that either reinforce existing topics or remain isolated.

2603.18363.tldr: By targeting $\alpha$-power distributions, PowerFlow enables the directional elicitation of the dual nature of LLMs: sharpening the distribution to intensify logical reasoning, or flattening it to unlock expressive creativity, shifting the Pareto frontier in creative tasks.

2603.18373.tldr: A Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework is introduced with three per-sample metrics: Latent Anomaly Detection, Visual Necessity Score, and Competition Score, which disentangle perception, dependency, and alignment failures and enable a training-free selective-prediction strategy yielding up to +9.5 percentage points accuracy at 50% coverage.

2603.18382.tldr: It is shown that LLM-based agents weaken this barrier to re-identification by combining scattered, individually non-identifying cues with public evidence, and suggest that privacy evaluations for agentic systems should measure not only what information is accessed or disclosed, but also what identities can be inferred.

2603.18411.tldr: Token-level Adaptive Routing (TARo) is proposed, which steers frozen LLMs toward structured reasoning entirely at inference time, extending test-time alignment from preference optimization to robust, cross-domain reasoning.

2603.18417.tldr: This paper proposes AFBS-BO (Adaptive Fidelity Binary Search with Bayesian Optimization), a fully automated framework that discovers optimal layer- and head-specific hyperparameters without human intervention and enables plug-and-play acceleration across diverse transformer architectures and domains.

2603.18418.tldr: DermCase is constructed, a long-context benchmark derived from peer-reviewed case reports, that establishes DermLIP-based similarity metrics that achieve stronger alignment with dermatologists for assessing differential diagnosis quality and reveals critical limitations in current models'reasoning capabilities.

2603.18420.tldr: The method extends Predictive Associative Memory from episodic recall to concept formation: where PAM recalls specific associations, multi-epoch contrastive training under compression extracts structural patterns that transfer to unseen texts, the same framework producing qualitatively different behaviour in a different regime.

2603.18426.tldr: The problem of optimizing the compression order is formulated and the Progressive Intensity Hypothesis is introduced, which states that weaker perturbations should precede stronger ones and theoretical guarantees showing that the relative benefit of one order increases with the underlying performance gap are provided.

2603.18427.tldr: This work proposes a novel synthetic data augmentation pipeline that integrates controllable diffusion models and utilizes class-aware prompting and visual prior blending to improve image quality further, ensuring precise alignment with segmentation labels.

2603.18428.tldr: A reinforcement learning-based decoder sampler that treats decoding as sequential decision-making and learns a lightweight policy to adjust sampling parameters at test-time while keeping LLM weights frozen is introduced, enabling domain-aware and user-controllable generation without retraining large models.

2603.18436.tldr: These results demonstrate that a soft differentiable fixpoint operator, combined with constraint-aware attention and declarative constraint specification, can match or exceed pipeline and solver-based neuro-symbolic systems while maintaining full end-to-end differentiability.

2603.18444.tldr: This work reformulate RLVR from a statistical estimation perspective by modeling rewards as samples drawn from a policy-induced distribution and casting advantage computation as the problem of estimating the reward distribution from finite data, and proposes Discounted Beta-Bernoulli (DBB) reward estimation, which leverages historical reward statistics for the non-stationary distribution.

2603.18447.tldr: SODIUM-Agent is developed, a multi-agent system composed of a web explorer and a cache manager that conducts deep and comprehensive web exploration and performs structurally coherent information extraction, powered by the proposed ATP-BFS algorithm and optimized through principled management of cached sources and navigation paths.

2603.18459.tldr: Evaluation on real-world benchmarks shows that HypeMed outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both recommendation precision and DDI reduction, simultaneously enhancing the effectiveness and safety of clinical decision support.

2603.18460.tldr: This work developed an interpretable framework for automatic cancer detection using a small dataset of 162 T2-weighted prostate MRI images, addressing data scarcity through transfer learning and augmentation, and achieves competitive performance using only T2-weighted images, reducing acquisition complexity and computational cost.

2603.18462.tldr: AlignMamba-2 is proposed, an effective and efficient framework for multimodal fusion and sentiment analysis that introduces a dual alignment strategy that regularizes the model using both Optimal Transport distance and Maximum Mean Discrepancy, promoting geometric and statistical consistency between modalities without incurring any inference-time overhead.

2603.18472.tldr: A consistent cognitive mismatch is observed across leading MLLMs, indicating that current systems often compensate with linguistic priors, template retrieval or procedural reasoning instead of robust visual grounding, and shows that symbolic understanding remains a major bottleneck for multimodal intelligence.

2603.18474.tldr: WASD (unWeaving Actionable Sufficient Directives), a novel framework that explains model behavior by identifying sufficient neural conditions for token generation, is proposed.

2603.18480.tldr: These findings suggest a perception--understanding gap in current VLMs: although they can recognize visible gameplay cues, they still struggle to robustly infer human engagement across games.

2603.18493.tldr: Gains in FILT3R shrink in stable regimes as uncertainty contracts with accumulated evidence, and rise when genuine scene change increases process uncertainty, improving long-horizon stability for depth, pose, and 3D reconstruction, compared to the existing methods.

2603.18495.tldr: This work introduces NeSyCR, a neurosymbolic counterfactual reasoning framework that enables verifiable adaptation of task procedures, providing a reliable synthesis of code policies and achieving robust cross-domain adaptation across both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks.

2603.18501.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diff-SIT establishes a new state-of-the-art in perceptual quality and temporal consistency, particularly in the challenging ultra-low-bitrate regime.

2603.18507.tldr: This work studies how model optimization, task type, prompt length, and placement can impact expert persona effectiveness across instruction-tuned and reasoning LLMs, and provides insight into conditions under which expert personas fail and succeed, and developed a pipeline to fully leverage the benefits of an expert persona.

2603.18508.tldr: This handbook develops domain-adapted transformer architectures for structured visual understanding, relational vehicle representation learning, and multimodal document intelligence, enabling end-to-end automation of vehicle damage analysis, claims evaluation, and underwriting workflows.

2603.18513.tldr: CAFlow is introduced, an adaptive-depth single-step flow-matching framework that routes each image tile to the shallowest network exit that preserves reconstruction quality and outperforms all comparable-compute baselines while remaining competitive with the much larger SwinIR-Medium model.

2603.18523.tldr: A lightweight intervention strategy is proposed that exploits simple and abundantly available synthetic images to fine-tune arbitrary pretrained LVLMs exclusively on counting, and not only enhances counting accuracy on in-distribution synthetic data, but also yields an average improvement on out-of-distribution counting benchmarks.

2603.18528.tldr: Correlation-Weighted Multi-Reward Optimization is proposed, a framework that leverages the correlation structure among concept rewards to adaptively weight each attribute concept in optimization and applies to state-of-the-art diffusion models, SD3.5 and FLUX.

2603.18544.tldr: SCISSR is presented, a scribble-promptable framework for interactive surgical scene segmentation that converts freehand scribbles into dense prompt embeddings compatible with the mask decoder, enabling iterative refinement for a target object by drawing corrective strokes on error regions.

2603.18558.tldr: HiMu achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among frame selection methods and improves over uniform sampling across seven diverse MLLMs as a drop-in module, matching the accuracy of uniform sampling at $4\times its frame budget, without retraining and without multiple iterative MLLM calls during selection.

2603.18563.tldr: It is proved that AI agents, acting as Bayesian posterior samplers rather than expected utility maximizers, are guaranteed to eventually become weakly close to a Nash equilibrium in infinitely repeated games, suggesting that strategic stability in AI-mediated markets can emerge from the intrinsic reasoning and learning properties of modern AI agents, without the need for unrealistic universal fine-tuning.

2603.18564.tldr: Transformers are compared against classical baselines that are optimal or suboptimal under the corresponding maximum-likelihood criteria and consistently match or outperform these baselines, demonstrating robust in-context adaptation beyond classical estimators.

2603.18567.tldr: SpecForge is introduced, an open-source, production-oriented framework for training speculative decoding models with full support for EAGLE-3, and SpecBundle, a suite of production-grade EAGLE-3 draft models trained with SpecForge for mainstream open-source LLMs.

2603.18571.tldr: A new benchmark for subcellular localization that integrates diverse 3D structural representations with fine-grained subcellular localization annotations carefully curated by domain experts is introduced, demonstrating the potential for bridging the gap with intuitive biological interpretability and paving the way for data-driven discoveries in cell biology.

2603.18573.tldr: A reference-free simulation framework that trains two independent LLMs, one as the user and one as the conversational recommender, resulting in more realistic and diverse conversations that closely mirror authentic human-AI interactions.

2603.18577.tldr: This work introduces MedForge-90K, a large-scale benchmark of realistic lesion edits across 19 pathologies with expert-guided reasoning supervision via doctor inspection guidelines and gold edit locations, and MedForge-Reasoner, a data-and-method solution for pre-hoc, evidence-grounded medical forgery detection.

2603.18579.tldr: Evaluating 7 LLMs across 4 English tasks, 6 non-English languages, and 2 attribution methods, it is found that faithfulness is operator-dependent: operator gaps reach up to 44 percentage points, suggesting that faithfulness should be interpreted comparatively across intervention operators rather than as a single score.

2603.18604.tldr: This work presents AutORAN, the first LLM-driven natural language programming framework for agile xApps that automates the entire xApp development pipeline and drastically accelerates the xApp development cycle, streamlining O-RAN innovation.

2603.18614.tldr: It is shown that ZebraArena requires a combination of in-depth reasoning and accurate external tool calling, which remains a challenge as frontier reasoning models such as GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro only achieves 60% accuracy on the hard instances.

2603.18620.tldr: A 4B-parameter model trained with LSE outperforms self-evolving policies powered by GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5, as well as prompt optimization methods including GEPA and TextGrad, and transfers to guide other models without additional training.

2603.18623.tldr: OpenT2M, a million-level, high-quality, and open-source motion dataset containing over 2800 hours of human motion, and MonoFrill, a pretrained motion model that achieves compelling T2M results without complicated designs or technique tricks as"frills" are introduced.

2603.18624.tldr: REST (Receding Horizon Explorative Steiner Tree), a training-free framework that builds an explicit open-vocabulary 3D map from online RGB-D streams, grows an agent-centric tree of safe and informative paths as the option space via sampling-based planning, and textualizes each branch into a spatial narrative and selects the next-best path through chain-of-thought LLM reasoning.

2603.18627.tldr: AFS-Search is introduced, a training-free closed-loop framework built upon FLUX.1-dev that incorporates a training-free closed-loop parallel rollout search and flow steering mechanism, which leverages a Vision-Language Model as a semantic critic to diagnose intermediate latents and dynamically steer the velocity field via precise spatial grounding.

2603.18631.tldr: D-Mem is introduced, a dual-process memory system that retains lightweight vector retrieval for routine queries while establishing an exhaustive Full Deliberation module as a high-fidelity fallback, and employs a Multi-dimensional Quality Gating policy to dynamically bridge these two processes.

2603.18633.tldr: The ORS framework charts a path from narrow technical alignment toward comprehensive philosophical foundations for the synthetic minds already among us, and is applied to emergent scenarios including autonomous research agents, AI-mediated healthcare, and agentic AI ecosystems, demonstrating its capacity to generate proportionate, adaptive governance recommendations.

2603.18647.tldr: ADLA is proposed, a leakage detection framework that applies the two-sample Anderson--Darling test for leakage detection and can provide improved leakage-detection sensitivity in protected implementations for a low number of traces compared to TVLA.

2603.18652.tldr: This work applies LLM-as-a-judge for semantic table evaluation, integrated into a matching pipeline that accommodates inconsistencies in parser outputs and establishes a reproducible, scalable evaluation methodology for this critical task of reliably extracting tables from PDFs.

2603.18655.tldr: Switch is proposed, a novel SSL framework with two key innovations: 1) a multiscale switch (MSS) strategy that employs hierarchical patch mixing to achieve uniform spatial coverage; and 2) a frequency-domain switch (FDS) with contrastive learning that performs amplitude switching in Fourier space for robust feature representations.

2603.18656.tldr: Results show that SCALe consistently improves accuracy over vanilla SFT and matches the performance of the full two-phase SFT + GRPO pipeline while requiring only about one-seventh of the training time, making it a lightweight yet effective alternative.

2603.18662.tldr: This work proposes Action Applicability Policy Optimization (A2PO), a reinforcement learning paradigm for mastering strategic construction that employs Adaptive Reward Shaping to regulate the timing and quality of visual aids via counterfactual sampling to distinguish necessary from redundant constructions.

2603.18676.tldr: MANAR is a compatible re-parameterization of MHA with identical semantic roles for its projections, enabling knowledge transfer from pretrained transformers via weight-copy and thus overcoming the adoption barriers of structurally incompatible linear-time alternatives.

2603.18677.tldr: A conceptual and mathematical framework to distinguish cognitive amplification, where AI improves hybrid human AI performance while preserving human expertise, from cognitive delegation, where reasoning is progressively outsourced to the AI system, risking long term atrophy of human capabilities.

2603.18683.tldr: HISR is proposed, exploiting Hindsight Information to modulate Segmental process Rewards, which closely aligns rewards with sub-goals and underscores significant segments to enhance the reliability of credit assignment.

2603.18712.tldr: Linear-Network (Li-Net), a novel architecture designed for multi-channel time series forecasting that captures the linear and non-linear dependencies among channels, provides a superior balance between prediction accuracy and computational burden, exhibiting significantly lower memory usage and faster inference times.

2603.18718.tldr: Memory-augmented LLM agents maintain external memory banks to support long-horizon interaction, yet most existing systems treat construction, retrieval, and utilization as isolated subroutines, creating two coupled challenges: strategic blindness on the forward path of the memory cycle and sparse, delayed supervision on the backward path.

2603.18729.tldr: These findings suggest that for intersectionality-informed software engineering, fairness evaluation should include model-specific validation of mitigation strategies, and workflow-level controls (e.g., agentic architectures involving critique models) in high-impact LLM deployments.

2603.18736.tldr: CausalRM, a causal-theoretic reward modeling framework that aims to learn unbiased reward models from observational feedback, is proposed, which effectively learns accurate reward signals from noisy and biased observational feedback and delivers substantial performance improvements on downstream RLHF tasks.

2603.18740.tldr: This paper studies how LLM-based vulnerability detection in ACR is affected by the framing effect: the tendency to let the presentation of information override its semantic content in forming judgments, and designs a realistic and controlled experimental environment to assess the susceptibility of real-world ACR pipelines to vulnerability reintroduction attacks.

2603.18743.tldr: A generalist, continually-learnable LLM agent system that functions as an agent-designing agent that autonomously constructs, adapts, and improves task-specific agents through experience, built on a memory-based reinforcement learning framework with stateful prompts.

2603.18752.tldr: This work empirically demonstrate, through extensive validation on multiple metrics to assess faithfulness, simulatability, diversity, and plausibility, that WeNLEX is able to produce faithful and plausible explanations, using as little as 5 ground-truth explanations per diagnosis.

2603.18756.tldr: A systematic analysis of GRPO indicates that incorporating negative feedback is essential training solely on actions above a baseline limits learning and that simpler REINFORCE based approaches can effectively enhance reasoning in LLMs, offering a more transparent and efficient alternative to GRPO.

2603.18762.tldr: ClawTrap is presented, a MITM-based red-teaming framework for real-world OpenClaw security evaluation that supports diverse and customizable attack forms, and provides a reproducible pipeline for rule-driven interception, transformation, and auditing.

2603.18767.tldr: Diversified Unlearning is proposed, a distributional framework that represents a concept through a set of contextually diverse prompts rather than a single keyword, which enables more precise and robust unlearning.

2603.18773.tldr: AutoPipe is proposed, a budget-aware two-stage framework for configuration selection in LLM post-training that consistently outperforms offline-only baselines and achieves comparable performance with the strongest online HPO baselines while using less than 10\% of their computational cost.

2603.18793.tldr: This work first solves a generalized eigenvalue problem to extract a stable functional subspace for watermark injection, while introducing an adaptive spectral truncation strategy to achieve an optimal balance between robustness and model utility.

2603.18795.tldr: Perceptio is presented, a perception enhanced LVLM with 2D and 3D spatial reasoning abilities, enabled via explicit semantic segmentation tokens and depth tokens generated directly within the autoregressive sequence, demonstrating that explicit spatial chain-of-thought materially strengthens spatial grounding in LVLMs.

2603.18806.tldr: Trajectory Reduction Policy Optimization (dTRPO) is proposed, which substantially improves the core performance of state-of-the-art dLLMs, and exhibits strong training efficiency due to its offline, single-forward nature, and achieves improved generation efficiency through high-quality outputs.

2603.18815.tldr: Under the rollout-as-a-service philosophy, this work presents ProRL Agent, a scalable infrastructure that serves the full agentic rollout lifecycle through an API service and validate ProRL Agent through RL training on software engineering, math, STEM, and coding tasks.

2603.18827.tldr: Both men and women perceive potential threats in the same manner, with men more aware of war, AI controlled drones, terrain recognition, and information war and women seem to have a stronger tendency towards ethical considerations and helping others.

2603.18856.tldr: Motion-o is introduced, a motion-centric extension to vision-language models (VLMs) that makes trajectories explicit and verifiable and suggests that an explicit motion interface can complement existing VLM pipelines by converting implicit dynamics into verifiable evidence.

2603.18859.tldr: This work introduces RewardFlow, a lightweight method for estimating state-level rewards in agentic reasoning that substantially outperforms prior baselines across four agentic benchmarks, and performs topology-aware propagation to estimate each state's contribution to success, yielding principled, annotation-free dense rewards.

2603.18871.tldr: The Semantic-Augmented DRL (SA-DRL) framework is proposed, which employs a Logit Fusion mechanism to inject the LLM's semantic reasoning directly into the policy as a prior, effectively guiding the agent toward critical intersections.

2603.18881.tldr: Three illustrative vignettes are provided, i.e., exploratory probes, in the hope that they will spark lively discussions and follow-up work on what world AI systems construct, and how brittle are model outputs to minute syntactic variations.

2603.18886.tldr: This paper builds and releases training data and benchmarks for deriving mathematical objects, the Principia suite, and provides training recipes with strong LLM-judges and verifiers, where it is shown that on-policy judge training boosts performance and how on-policy training can also be used to scale test-time compute via aggregation.

2603.18892.tldr: MultihopSpatial is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark designed for multi-hop and compositional spatial reasoning, and reinforcement learning post-training on the authors' corpus enhances both intrinsic VLM spatial reasoning and downstream embodied manipulation performance.

2603.18893.tldr: It is found that greedy-decoded self-reports collapse outputs to few uninformative values, but introspective capacity can be unmasked by calculating logit-based self-reports, and numeric self-report is position as a viable, complementary tool for tracking internal emotive states in conversational AI systems.

2603.18894.tldr: Evidence that integrity in institutional AI should be treated as a pre-deployment requirement rather than a post-deployment assumption is presented, and institutional design is implied that institutional design is a precondition for safe delegation.

2603.18895.tldr: This paper proposes a measurement framework for evaluating human-AI decision-making centered on team readiness, and introduces a four part taxonomy of evaluation metrics spanning outcomes, reliance behavior, safety signals, and learning over time, and connects these metrics to the Understand-Control-Improve lifecycle of human-AI onboarding and collaboration.

2603.18896.tldr: PASTA surpasses state-of-the-art methods by preserving both structural and pathological details through its highly interactive dual-arm architecture and multi-modal condition integration and introduces a novel cycle exchange consistency and volumetric generation strategy that significantly enhances PASTA's ability to produce high-quality 3D PET images.

2603.18897.tldr: PASTE is a tool-aware agent-serving system that predicts concrete future tool invocations from recurring agent patterns and executes them speculatively while the LLM is still generating, to avoid shifting bottlenecks to the GPU.

2603.18911.tldr: XKD-Dial is presented, a progressive four-stage training pipeline for explainable, knowledge-grounded dialogue generation in a bilingual (English-Hindi) setting, comprising three post-hoc explainability analyses applied systematically across the training trajectory to reveal how citation behaviour is learned, not only whether it is learned.

2603.18914.tldr: This paper reviews the evolving European Union AI regulatory provisions via analyzing 24 relevant documents published between 2024 and 2025 and deconstructs the regulatory interpretations of security, privacy, and agentic AI, distinguishing them from closely related concepts to resolve ambiguity.

2603.18968.tldr: This paper introduces intentional interventions, a new time-agnostic operator that induces a twin SCM that is a structural final model (SFM), and shows how SFMs can be used to empirically detect agents and to discover their intentions.

2603.18976.tldr: It is suggested that structured intent representations can improve alignment and usability in human-AI interaction, especially in tasks where user intent is inherently ambiguous.

2603.18979.tldr: This work presents PRIOR, an efficient and reproducible framework that achieves robust terrain traversal with human-like gaits through a simple yet effective design of a parametric gait generator that supplies stable reference trajectories derived from motion capture without adversarial training.

2603.18992.tldr: This guide develops the mathematical foundations of the Schrodinger bridge problem, drawing on optimal transport, stochastic control, and path-space optimization, and focuses on its dynamic formulation with direct connections to modern generative modeling.

2603.18999.tldr: The results provide the first formal regret-theoretic justification for decentralized competitive allocation in modular architectures and establish cost endogeneity as a fundamental challenge distinct from partial observability.

2603.19005.tldr: The results show that current AI agents struggle with domain-specific reasoning, and challenge the narrative of complete automation by AI and underscore the enduring importance of human expertise in data science, while illuminating directions for the next generation of AI.

2603.19008.tldr: Hypothesis-Conditioned Query Rewriting (HCQR) is proposed, a training-free pre-retrieval framework that reorients RAG from topic-oriented retrieval to evidence-oriented retrieval, allowing the generator to confirm or overturn the initial hypothesis based on the retrieved evidence.

2603.19011.tldr: It is revealed that current LLM models can reliably detect danger signals but cannot reliably verify safety, the very capability required for privacy-preserving agentic protocols such as NDAI zones.

2603.19017.tldr: Cross mixed-effects regression shows that temporal linearity is the strongest predictor of temporal reasoning in high-resource languages, whereas fragmentation is the stronger predictor in low-resource languages.

2603.19022.tldr: Stability Monitor is introduced, a black-box stability monitoring system that periodically fingerprints an endpoint by sampling outputs from a fixed prompt set and comparing the resulting output distributions over time, and observes substantial provider-to-provider and within-provider stability differences.

2603.19028.tldr: SEM is proposed, a post-hoc, zero-shot debiasing framework that operates in a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latent space that identifies and modulates bias-relevant neurons while preserving query-relevant ones and achieves substantial fairness gains in retrieval and zero-shot classification.

2603.19054.tldr: Em-Garde is proposed, a novel framework that decouples semantic understanding from streaming perception and demonstrates consistent improvements over prior models in proactive response accuracy and efficiency, validating an effective solution for proactive video understanding under strict computational constraints.

2603.19066.tldr: It is found that LLM-generated analogies are reliably judged as better than human-generated ones, and are also more closely aligned with the parallelogram structure in a distributional embedding space (GloVe).

2603.19074.tldr: CAMO is proposed, a conditional neural solver for MOMTSP that generalizes across varying numbers of targets, agents, and preference vectors, and yields high-quality approximations to the Pareto front (PF).

2603.19087.tldr: It is shown that humans reliably benefit from randomly assigned cross-domain mappings, while LLMs, on average, generate more original ideas than humans and do not show a statistically significant effect of cross-domain mappings.

2603.19092.tldr: Experiments across multiple VLMs and an additional state-of-the-art benchmark show that safety decisions are highly sensitive to semantic cues, indicating reliance on learned visual-linguistic associations rather than grounded visual understanding.

2603.19097.tldr: DaPT, a novel multilingual RAG framework that generates sub-question graphs in parallel for both the source-language query and its English translation counterpart, then merges them before employing a bilingual retrieval-and-answer strategy to sequentially solve sub-questions, significantly enhancing RAG performance on this task.

2603.19100.tldr: LuMamba (Latent Unified Mamba), a self-supervised framework combining topology-invariant encodings with linear-complexity state-space modeling, using LUNA's learned-query cross-attention mechanism for channel unification, and FEMBA's bidirectional Mamba blocks for efficient temporal modeling, is proposed.

2603.19101.tldr: FedTrident is proposed, which introduces neuron-wise analysis for local model misbehavior detection for local model misbehavior detection, and adaptive client rating for client exclusion according to the local model detection results in each FL round, and machine unlearning for corrupted global model remediation once malicious clients are excluded during FL.

2603.19138.tldr: The first large-scale, trace-level study showing that multi-pass LLM reasoning gives rise to structured, token-level implicit patterns that serve as an abstraction of LLM reasoning, and which form a stable, structured system with distinct temporal roles and measurable characteristics.

2603.19144.tldr: This work proposes an internal-representation--level debiasing framework for large language models that models the Transformer as a structured computational graph, and introduces a log-space constraint on sensitive logits and a selective anchor-based objective to preserve definitional semantics.

2603.19146.tldr: D5P4 is introduced, a beam-style decoding method tailored to discrete diffusion models, which casts intermediate beam selection as MAP inference under a partitioned Determinantal Point Process and yields a model-internal batch objective that balances quality and diversity without external verifiers.

2603.19152.tldr: Variable Entropy Policy Optimization (VEPO), which leverages Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards to incorporate deterministic structural constraints into the policy alignment process, ensures prescribed sequence length, robust format consistency, and rigorous linguistic well formedness during training.

2603.19163.tldr: Experiments show that cuGenOpt outperforms general MIP solvers by orders of magnitude, achieves competitive quality against specialized solvers on instances up to n=150, and attains 4.73% gap on TSP-442 within 30s.

2603.19166.tldr: This work empirically demonstrate that state-of-the-art VLM-based grounding approaches struggle with complex metric-semantic language queries, and proposes MAPG (Multi-Agent Probabilistic Grounding), an agentic framework that decomposes language queries into structured subcomponents and queries a VLM to ground each component.

2603.19169.tldr: ARIADNE is presented, a two-stage framework coupling preference-aligned perception with RL-based diagnostic reasoning for topologically coherent stenosis detection, demonstrating that preference-based learning over structural constraints mitigates topological violations while maintaining diagnostic sensitivity in interventional cardiology workflows.

2603.19173.tldr: SOL-ExecBench reframes GPU kernel benchmarking from beating a mutable software baseline to closing the remaining gap to hardware Speed-of-Light, and reports a SOL Score that quantifies how much of the gap between a release-defined scoring baseline and the hardware SOL bound a candidate kernel closes.

2603.19182.tldr: A conceptual process-control architecture that decomposes LLM reasoning into three explicit layers: memory grounding, structured inference, and boundary enforcement is proposed, indicating that process-level control may offer a promising direction for improving reliability in large language model reasoning.

2603.19191.tldr: OS-Themis is proposed, a scalable and accurate multi-agent critic framework that decomposes trajectories into verifiable milestones to isolate critical evidence for decision making and employs a review mechanism to strictly audit the evidence chain before making the final verdict.

2603.19216.tldr: This work proposes DreamPartGen, a framework for semantically grounded, part-aware text-to-3D generation that introduces Duplex Part Latents that jointly model each part's geometry and appearance, and Relational Semantic Latents that capture inter-part dependencies derived from language.

2603.19223.tldr: This work presents F2LLM-v2, a new family of general-purpose, multilingual embedding models in 8 distinct sizes ranging from 80M to 14B, and releases all models, data, code, and intermediate checkpoints to facilitate open-source embedding model research.

2603.19229.tldr: NavTrust is the first benchmark that exposes embodied navigation agents to diverse RGB-Depth corruptions and instruction variations in a unified framework, and systematically corrupts input modalities, including RGB, depth, and instructions, in realistic scenarios and evaluates their impact on navigation performance.

2602.18922.tldr: This work introduces W5H2, a structured intent decomposition framework and provides risk-controlled selective prediction guarantees via RCPS with nine bound families, and shows existing caching methods fail.

2603.13733.tldr: In this paper, Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE) is investigated as an alternative generative modeling approach for planning that offers strong mode coverage while enabling inference that is two orders of magnitude faster, making it particularly well suited for real-time MPC tasks.

2603.16065.tldr: A robust, scalable reward model based on a state-of-the-art VLM, trained on a large-scale, multi-source dataset encompassing real-world robot trajectories, human-object interactions, and diverse simulated environments is developed.

2603.16929.tldr: By shaping the optimization landscape with hazard-aware penalties, the proposed MHPO achieves fine-grained regulation of asymmetric policy shifts simultaneously mitigating mode collapse from over-expansion and preventing policy erosion from catastrophic contraction within a stabilized trust region.

2603.17655.tldr: The CC-CDFSL method with cycle consistency is proposed, which translates local visual features into text features and then translates them back into visual features (and vice versa), and constrains the original features close to the translated back features.

2603.19220.tldr: Nemotron-Cascade 2 is introduced, an open 30B MoE model with 3B activated parameters that delivers best-in-class reasoning and strong agentic capabilities that aims to achieve Gold Medal-level performance in the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad, the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI), and the ICPC World Finals.

2603.20986.tldr: The results show that the gap between knowing the physics and executing a validated simulation campaign can be bridged by a lightweight multi-agent orchestration layer, providing a pathway toward AI-driven materials discovery and self-driving laboratories.

2603.20988.tldr: In this framework, experimental paradigms exploring conceptually meaningful task structures are directly sampled from an LLM, and the tedious step of handcrafting cognitive models is replaced by LLM-based program synthesis, which performs a high-throughput search over a vast landscape of algorithmic hypotheses.

2603.20990.tldr: A semantic residual variant of Effective Contrastive Information that ranks candidate negative sources using frozen target-encoder embeddings using a weighted residual information matrix from target consistency, semantic locality, lexical residuality, and a log-determinant diversity objective.

2603.20993.tldr: This study addresses an important gap in time series outlier detection by proposing a novel problem setting: long-term outlier prediction by proposing a simple and unsupervised two-layer method that is independent of specific models.

2603.20994.tldr: The Intelligent Disobedience Game is introduced, a sequential game-theoretic framework based on Stackelberg games that models the interaction between a human leader and an assistive follower operating under asymmetric information that provides a needed mathematical foundation that enables both the algorithmic development of agents that can learn safe non-compliance and the empirical study of how humans perceive and trust disobedient AI.

2603.21029.tldr: KLDrive is presented, the first knowledge-graph-augmented LLM reasoning framework for fine-grained question answering in autonomous driving and improves over the strongest baseline on counting, demonstrating substantially reduced hallucinations and the benefit of coupling reliable scene fact construction with explicit reasoning.

2603.21046.tldr: SpatialFly is proposed, a geometry-guided spatial representation framework for UAV VLN that outperforms state-of-the-art UAV VLN baselines across both seen and unseen environments, and produces trajectories with better path alignment and smoother, more stable motion.

2603.21048.tldr: This work develops and evaluates a temporal action localization framework tailored for driver monitoring scenarios, particularly suitable for periodic inspection settings such as transportation safety checkpoints or fleet management assessment systems.

2603.21054.tldr: An innovative MMD approach is introduced, titled Harmful Visual Content Manipulation Matters in MMD, which introduces two weakly supervised indicators as substitutes by incorporating supplementary datasets focused on image manipulation detection and framing two different classification tasks as positive and unlabeled learning issues.

2406.01914.tldr: A novel framework to improve the HPE accuracy by leveraging the object detection grounding capability of a VLM, referred to as CogVLM, and achieves a 31.5% reduction in Mean Absolute Error over the current state-of-the-art CNN model, 6DRepNet, in cross-dataset evaluation.

2410.01591.tldr: It is proposed that the multi-scale integrated Transformer AMPlifier (TAMP), the first imaging foundation model for universal NICT enhancement, consistently improves image quality and clinical acceptability, underscoring its significant potential to advance CT imaging and broaden NICT applications in clinical practice.

2410.08947.tldr: This work designs an Event-Triggered Temporal Graph Network to model the irregular spatiotemporal correlations between evolving real estate transactions, and proposes a Tri-Level Optimization Based Meta- Learning framework to adaptively re-weight training transaction instances from multiple source cities to mitigate negative transfer, and thus improve the cross-city knowledge transfer effectiveness.

2412.02868.tldr: A resource-efficient preprocessing technique that can be adopted in existing LLM procedures and substantially enhanced the performance of the original smaller LLMs in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and F1 scores, making it well-suited for privacy-sensitive and resource-constrained applications.

2501.02406.tldr: This work model LLM text as a sequential stochastic process with complete dependence on history and designs zero-shot statistical tests to identify whether text was generated by a known LLM or by any unknown model, which has a host of practical applications.

2501.06404.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid framework that combines Variational Autoencoders to learn joint distributions of multi-line and multi-year claims data with Proximal Policy Optimization reinforcement learning to adapt treaty parameters dynamically, and highlights the usefulness of generative models for capturing cross-line dependencies.

2502.18220.tldr: This work proposes UASTrack, a unified adaptive selection framework that facilitates both model and parameter unification, as well as adaptive modality discrimination across various multi-modal tracking tasks, and designs a Discriminative Auto-Selector capable of identifying modality labels, thereby distinguishing the data distributions of auxiliary modalities.

2503.11851.tldr: The results demonstrate that bidirectional cross-attention with uncertainty quantification can improve performance and transparency in medical image classification and enhance feature integration, interpretability, and reliability in prediction.

2504.02293.tldr: The results show that BdSL text-to-gloss task can greatly benefit from rule-based synthetic dataset, and a new paradigm for text-to-gloss task using mBART models is proposed.

2504.09396.tldr: A reinforcement learning (RL) framework for insurance loss reserving is developed that formulates reserve setting as a finite-horizon sequential decision problem under claim development uncertainty, macroeconomic stress, and solvency governance.

2504.14145.tldr: DIP tackles the challenge of dynamic imbalance via two key techniques: separating computations of different modalities into dedicated pipeline segments to balance workloads within a continuous set of stages and dynamically splitting input data into finer-grained, modality-specific sub-microbatches to balance workloads across these segments.

2504.14636.tldr: This work presents AlphaZero-Edu, a lightweight, education-focused implementation built upon the mathematical framework of AlphaZero, which boasts a modular architecture that disentangles key components, enabling transparent visualization of the algorithmic processes.

2505.07775.tldr: A taxonomy for persuasion research is introduced and key challenges for future research are discussed to enhance the safety, fairness, and effectiveness of AI-powered persuasion while addressing the risks posed by increasingly capable language models.

2505.12224.tldr: This work constructs a large-scale failure-centric dataset and develops a lightweight multimodal model specialized for task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction, enabling efficient local deployment while remaining competitive with large proprietary models.

2505.23667.tldr: This paper introduces Formula-R1, a model trained via Formula Tuning (Fortune), a formula-driven reinforcement learning (RL) framework for table reasoning that substantially improves LLM performance on table reasoning, particularly for tasks involving complex tables and multi-step numerical computation.

2506.00835.tldr: This paper proposes Synergistic Preference Optimization (SynPO), a novel optimization method offering significant advantages over DPO and its variants, and extensively evaluates SynPO not only on video captioning benchmarks but also across well-established NLP tasks, including general language understanding and preference evaluation.

2506.05736.tldr: This work formalizes Generalized Incremental Learning under Concept Drift (GILCD), characterizing the joint evolution of distributions and label spaces in open-environment streaming contexts, and proposes a novel framework called Calibrated Source-Free Adaptation (CSFA), which establishes a unified framework for stable adaptation to evolving semantics and distributions in open-world streaming scenarios.

2506.13113.tldr: A novel multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for reinsurance treaty bidding, addressing long-standing inefficiencies in traditional broker-mediated placement processes, contributes to emerging literature at the intersection of algorithmic market design, strategic bidding, and AI-enabled financial decision-making.

2507.03156.tldr: A systematic review and mapping of 39 peer-reviewed studies published between January 2014 and December 2024 that examine how large language model assistants affect software developer productivity reveals that whether LLM-based assistants improve or degrade code quality remains unresolved.

2507.19408.tldr: This study empirically analyze the extent, drivers, and ramifications of predictive multiplicity across diverse medical tasks and model architectures, and shows that even small ensembles can mitigate/eliminate predictive multiplicity in practice.

2507.20115.tldr: This paper proposes Dual-Stream Temporal-Field Diffusion (DSTF-Diffusion), a multi-view, multi-stream network traffic generative model based on diffusion models, featuring two main streams: the field stream utilizes spatial mapping to bridge network data characteristics with pre-trained realms of stable diffusion models, effectively translating complex network interactions into formats that stable diffusion can process.

2508.14936.tldr: Adversarial random forests (ARF) is proposed as an efficient and convenient method for synthesizing tabular epidemiological data and demonstrated favourable performance regarding utility, privacy preservation, and generalisation relative to other synthesizers and superior computational efficiency.

2509.18801.tldr: A model-based neural network for dynamic PET image denoising, using the inter-frame spatial correlation and intra-frame structural consistency in dynamic PET to establish the kernel space-based multidimensional sparse (KMDS) model, and substitute the inherent forms of the parameter estimation with neural networks to enable adaptive parameters optimization.

2602.13279.tldr: A novel framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) as a structural augmentation layer for graph-based rumor detection and develops a structured prompt framework that mitigates inherent biases in LLMs while maintaining robust graph learning performance.

2603.08291.tldr: A clear roadmap for understanding and comparing different MMR approaches is established around four fundamental questions: What to extract from multimodal inputs, how to represent and align textual and visual information, how to perform the reasoning, and how to evaluate the correctness of the overall reasoning process.

2603.13406.tldr: A recognition framework that integrates temporal segment modeling with Multimodal Large Language Models, and leverage the Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B model, fine-tuned on the BAH dataset using LoRA and full-parameter strategies via the MS-Swift framework, enabling the model to synergistically analyze visual and auditory signals.

2603.14803.tldr: This work introduces VorTEX (Various overlap ratio for Target speech EXtraction), a text-prompted TSE architecture with a Decoupled Adaptive Multi-branch (DAM) Fusion block that separates primary extraction from auxiliary regularization pathways and proposes Suppression Ratio on Energy (SuRE), a diagnostic metric that detects suppression behavior not captured by conventional measures.

2603.15586.tldr: The problem of constructing artificial general intelligence is formalized as a system for making optimal decisions in the space of specific agent needs under conditions of uncertainty, maximizing success in achieving goals, minimizing existential risks, and maximizing energy efficiency.

2603.16666.tldr: The proposed Fast-WAM architecture, a WAM architecture that retains video co-training during training but skips future prediction at test time, suggests that the main value of video prediction in WAMs may lie in improving world representations during training rather than generating future observations at test time.

2603.16960.tldr: This work evaluates adversarial robustness of open-source vision-language model (VLM) agents deployed in a self-contained e-commerce environment built to simulate realistic pre-deployment conditions and finds meaningful architectural differences in adversarial resilience between open-source VLM families.

2603.17775.tldr: CoVerRL is proposed, a framework where a single model alternates between generator and verifier roles, with each capability bootstrapping the other, confirming that both capabilities genuinely co-evolve.

2603.18421.tldr: Regulatory authorities are suggested to establish a strict information disclosure system for AI technology, conduct differentiated digital financial education to enhance the identification capabilities of vulnerable groups, promote digital financial mutual aid groups to leverage the protective effects of social capital, and improve the consumer protection mechanism for farmers in digital finance.

2603.18873.tldr: It is proposed that language learning applications should generate lessons that adapt to an individual's needs through personalized, domain specific lesson scenarios while maintaining foundational support through general, relatable lesson scenarios.

2603.19415.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage routing architecture that addresses limitations through automated fine-grained task discovery and task-aware quality estimation, and consistently outperforms existing baselines and surpasses the strongest individual model while incurring less than half its cost.

2603.19828.tldr: FormalEvolve maintains a compilation-feasible archive for reuse, while reporting the deduplicated semantically accepted repertoire for evaluation and downstream proving, and recast autoformalization as budgeted test-time search.

2603.19897.tldr: This work proposes Domland, a two-pronged methodology that synergizes the spatial information obtained from FLA and domain-driven analysis to systematically capture the hidden characteristics of configuration tuning cases, explaining how and why a tuner might succeed or fail.

2603.21071.tldr: This framework introduces a multi-teacher collaborative mechanism composed of one general teacher and multiple sonar-specific teachers and dynamically quantifies the reliability of pseudo-labels by evaluating the consistency and stability of predictions across multiple views and multiple teachers, thereby mitigating the negative impact caused by noisy pseudo-labels.

2603.21078.tldr: Results show accurate reproduction for high-frequency words but poor generalization to low-frequency items, suggesting that the examined TTS architectures rely more on lexical-level memorization than on abstract segmental-prosodic encoding, which highlights a limitation in such TTS systems'ability to generalize prosodic detail beyond seen data.

2603.21084.tldr: The proposed ViCLSR (Vietnamese Contrastive Learning for Sentence Representations), a novel supervised contrastive learning framework specifically designed to optimize sentence embeddings for Vietnamese, leveraging existing natural language inference datasets, is proposed.

2603.21095.tldr: A clinically guided multitask framework that jointly predicts the nodule mask and TI-RADS category within a single model that consistently improves risk stratification while maintaining segmentation quality compared to single-task training and conventional multitask baselines is addressed.

2603.21096.tldr: This work introduces learnable sparse memory banks: a set of latent tokens, randomly initialized and trained end-to-end, that transformer layers query via cross-attention to retrieve stored knowledge, demonstrating that explicit associative memory provides complementary capacity to what is captured implicitly in model parameters.

2603.21100.tldr: Progressive Adaptation for Multi-Modal Tracking (PATrack) incorporates modality-dependent, modality-entangled, and task-level adapters, effectively bridging the gap in adapting RGB pre-trained networks to multi-modal data through a progressive strategy.

2603.21108.tldr: DMMRL is proposed, which employs variational autoencoders to disentangle molecular representations into shared (structure-relevant) and private (modality-specific) latent spaces, enhancing both interpretability and predictive performance.

2603.21135.tldr: Multi-Cluster Memory (MCM), a plug-and-play framework that organizes stored samples into multiple clusters using lightweight pixel-level statistical descriptors, establishes memory organization as a key design axis for practical test-time adaptation.
