2604.05995.tldr: A simple diagnostic framework is introduced that subjects models to discriminative self-assessment under in-context learning (ICL) settings that better reflect real-world application environments, specifically designed to scrutinize the subtle behavioral nuances induced by memory modifications.

2604.06013.tldr: The claim is not that blinded analysis produces better results, but that without blinding, there is no way to know to what degree the agent is adhering to the analytical process the researcher designed.

2604.06019.tldr: CritBench is introduced, a novel framework designed to evaluate the cybersecurity capabilities of LLM agents within IEC 61850 Digital Substation environments, and develops a domain-specific tool scaffold to facilitate industrial protocol interaction.

2604.06028.tldr: A multi-stage validation framework for LLM-based clinical information extraction that enables rigorous assessment under weak supervision is proposed and demonstrates that scalable, trustworthy deployment of LLM-based clinical information extraction is feasible without annotation-intensive evaluation.

2604.06074.tldr: Graph-PiT is proposed, a framework that explicitly models the structural dependencies of visual components using a graph prior, representing visual parts as nodes and their spatial-semantic relationships as edges, and offers a scalable and interpretable mechanism for complex, multi-part image synthesis.

2604.06079.tldr: A novel Dual Self-Consistency Reinforcement Learning optimization paradigm is introduced, which utilizes Round-Trip Verification to penalize degenerate code and boost overall self-consistency in TikZ code.

2604.06086.tldr: LAG-XAI (Lie Affine Geometry for Explainable AI), a novel geometric framework that models paraphrasing not as discrete word substitutions, but as a structured affine transformation within the embedding space, provides a mathematically grounded, resource-efficient path toward the mechanistic interpretability of Transformers.

2604.06091.tldr: These findings reveal that multi-agent systems are sensitive not only to individual reasoning but also to the social dynamics of their configuration, highlighting critical vulnerabilities in AI delegates that mirror the psychological biases observed in human group decision-making.

2604.06095.tldr: This work proposes LLM4CodeRE, a domain-adaptive LLM framework for bidirectional code reverse engineering that supports both assembly-to-source decompilation and source-to-assembly translation within a unified model, achieving robust bidirectional generalization.

2604.06107.tldr: It is considered how AI may open a grand perspective on mathematics by forging a new route, complementary to mathematical logic, to understanding the global structure of formal proof, in terms of universal proof and structural hypergraphs.

2604.06124.tldr: The findings demonstrate that lightweight projector-based adaptation provides an effective and practical route for transferring RGB-pretrained VLMs to thermal drone imagery, expanding their utility from object-level recognition to habitat-context interpretation in ecological monitoring.

2604.06126.tldr: Gym-Anything, a framework for converting any software into an interactive computer-use environment, and CUA-World, a collection of over 10K long-horizon tasks spanning domains from medical science and astronomy to engineering and enterprise systems, each configured with realistic data along with train and test splits are introduced.

2604.06129.tldr: The Polynomial Mixer is introduced, a novel token mixing mechanism with linear complexity that serves as a drop-in replacement for self-attention and proves that PoM satisfies the contextual mapping property, ensuring that transformers equipped with PoM remain universal sequence-to-sequence approximators.

2604.06135.tldr: This work introduces shot‐based quantum encoding (SBQE), a data embedding strategy that distributes the hardware's native resource, shots, according to a data‐dependent classical distribution over multiple initial quantum states by treating the shot counts as a learnable degree of freedom.

2604.06138.tldr: A synthetic data generation pipeline designed to serve both as a training resource and as a controlled evaluation environment, and instantiate it for first-visit doctor-patient conversations with SOAP note generation as the task.

2604.06148.tldr: A cross-jurisdictional regulatory alignment structure mapping enterprise AI identity governance obligations under EU, US, and Chinese frameworks simultaneously, identifying irreconcilable conflicts and providing a governance mechanism for managing them.

2604.06156.tldr: This work forms reasoning as a latent variable and introduces pair-aware reasoning selection that employs counterfactual intervention to identify reasoning paths beneficial for query-target alignment and adopts reinforcement learning to selectively invoke reasoning only when necessary.

2604.06169.tldr: This work introduces In-Place Test-Time Training (In-Place TTT), a framework that seamlessly endows LLMs with Test-Time Training ability, and replaces TTT's generic reconstruction objective with a tailored, theoretically-grounded objective explicitly aligned with the Next-Token-Prediction task governing autoregressive language modeling.

2409.01633.tldr: This study introduces two novel deep learning models, SleepNet and DreamNet, which are designed to improve representation utilization through feature enrichment and reconstruction strategies, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed enrichment and reconstruction approaches.

2411.19121.tldr: The MSG(Multi-Scene Generation) score is introduced, a hierarchical attention-based metric that adaptively evaluates narrative and visual consistency that serves as the core verifier within the CGS (Candidate Generation and Selection) framework, which automatically identifies and filters high-quality outputs.

2503.02129.tldr: It is argued that it is highly possible that the first near-complete nonasymptotic generalization theory for multilayer neural networks with path regularization reveals the true underlying mechanism of the double descent phenomenon.

2505.22976.tldr: This work proposes LoopNav, a dataset and corresponding benchmark centered on loop-based navigation for evaluating spatial consistency, and introduces a Scene Graph Consistency Score to quantify spatial consistency while remaining invariant to pixel-level variations.

2506.19420.tldr: The proposed Commander-GPT proposes Commander-GPT, a modular decision routing framework inspired by military command theory that orchestrates a team of specialized LLM agents where each agent will be selectively assigned to a focused sub-task such as keyword extraction, sentiment analysis, etc.

2508.04691.tldr: This work adopts an agent-simulation approach in which all team roles, including the supervisory manager, are instantiated as LLM agents, allowing us to diagnose coordination failures before humans join the team and inform the design of resilient robot teams.

2508.15358.tldr: Various planning-based compilations that aim to jointly optimize both the sum of action costs and plan disruption are defined, and experimental results show that the reformulated task can be effectively solved in practice.

2508.20765.tldr: It is argued that the recent advances in Foundation Models make for an ideal setting to address abstract concept understanding in videos, and drawing on decades of community experience will help shed light on this important open grand challenge and avoid “re-inventing the wheel” as it starts revisiting it in the era of multi-modal Foundation Models.

2509.01986.tldr: Draw-In-Mind (DIM), a dataset comprising two complementary subsets containing 14M long-context image-text pairs to enhance complex instruction comprehension, is introduced, demonstrating that explicitly assigning the design responsibility to the understanding module provides significant benefits for image editing.

2509.17183.tldr: This work introduces LifeAlign, a novel framework for lifelong alignment that enables LLMs to maintain consistent human preference alignment across sequential learning tasks without forgetting previously learned values.

2509.23435.tldr: This work proposes AudioRole, a meticulously curated dataset from 13 TV series spanning 1K+ hours with 1M+ character-grounded dialogues, providing synchronized audio-text pairs annotated with speaker identities and contextual metadata, and introduced ARP-Eval, a dual-aspect evaluation framework that assesses both response quality and role fidelity.

2602.15889.tldr: A longitudinal study of GPT-4o's average performance under fixed conditions challenges the assumption of time invariance and carries important implications for research involving LLMs.

2602.22220.tldr: NovelQR, a novelty-driven quotation recommendation framework that formalizes quote recommendation as choosing contextually novel but semantically coherent quotations, operationalizes with NovelQR, a generative label agent that interprets each quotation and its surrounding context into multi-dimensional deep-meaning labels, enabling label-enhanced retrieval.

2603.20654.tldr: The model helps explain the migration of value-producing work toward learned late-stage computation and the shared design pressure that is making both GPUs and AI accelerators more programmable2.

2603.28253.tldr: MR-CDM, a framework combining hierarchical multi-resolution trend decomposition, an adaptive embedding mechanism for variable-length inputs, and a multi-scale conditional diffusion process, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2604.02022.tldr: Experiments on frontier LLMs, open-source models, and specialized guard systems show that ATBench is challenging even for strong evaluators, while enabling taxonomy-stratified analysis, cross-benchmark comparison, and diagnosis of long-horizon failure patterns.

2604.03044.tldr: JoyAI-LLM Flash is introduced, an efficient Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model designed to redefine the trade-off between strong performance and token efficiency in the sub-50B parameter regime, and a joint training-inference co-design that incorporates dense Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) and Quantization-Aware Training (QAT).

2604.03486.tldr: Results show that integrating perception and execution enables faster task completion and reduces interaction overhead compared to non-always-on and non-agent baselines, and suggest a new paradigm for wearable AI agents, where perception and action are continuously coupled to support situated, hands-free interaction.

2604.03647.tldr: This work introduces a Retracing Re-inference Mechanism (RRM) that the model re-inferences from anchor points to expand the exploration of long-tail reasoning paths, and proposes Softened Frequency Reward (SFR), which replaces binary rewards with continuous signals, calibrating reward based on the answers'frequency across sampled reasoning sets.

2604.03815.tldr: It is proved that k-MIP transformers can approximate any full-attention transformer to arbitrary precision, which results in linear memory complexity and practical speedups of up to an order of magnitude compared to all-to-all attention.

2604.04384.tldr: The decompose the attention logit field into a learned component and a generated component and measure their spectra separately to show the compressibility of softmax-attended language.

2604.04563.tldr: This work introduces TILA (Temporal Inversion-aware Learning and Alignment), a simple yet effective framework that uses temporal inversion, reversing image pairs, as a supervisory signal to enhance the sensitivity of existing temporal vision-language models to directional change.

2604.04614.tldr: HealthPoint (HP) is proposed, a unified clinical point cloud paradigm for multi-level incomplete EHRs that enables flexible event-level interaction and fine-grained self-supervision, supporting robust modality recovery and effective use of unlabeled data.

2604.04868.tldr: This paper provides strong empirical evidence that TabPFN is highly robust under sub-optimal conditions and suggests that TabPFN is a robust TFM capable of maintaining both predictive performance and coherent internal behavior under various scenarios of data imperfections.

2604.04958.tldr: CalM, a self-supervised neural foundation model trained solely on neuronal calcium traces and adaptable to multiple downstream tasks, including forecasting and decoding, is proposed, paving the way for scalable pretraining and broad applications in functional neural analysis.

2604.05172.tldr: ClawsBench, a benchmark for evaluating and improving LLM agents in realistic productivity settings, is introduced and eight recurring patterns of unsafe behavior are identified, including multi-step sandbox escalation and silent contract modification.

2604.05268.tldr: This work proposes Region-R1, a query-side region cropping framework that formulates region selection as a decision-making problem during re-ranking, allowing the system to learn to retain the full image or focus only on a question-relevant region before scoring the retrieved candidates.

2604.05429.tldr: This work introduces the OpenCEM Simulator and Dataset: the first open-source digital twin explicitly designed to integrate rich, unstructured contextual information with quantitative renewable energy dynamics, and aims to accelerate research into the next generation of intelligent, sustainable, and truly context-aware energy systems.

2604.05704.tldr: QA-MoE is proposed, a Quality-Aware Mixture-of-Experts framework that quantifies modality reliability via self-supervised aleatoric uncertainty and achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across diverse degradation scenarios and exhibits a promising One-Checkpoint-for-All property in practice.

2604.05743.tldr: This work shows that diffusion-based compressors built on the Reverse Channel Coding (RCC) paradigm are substantially more robust to bit flips than classical and learned codecs, and introduces a more robust variant of Turbo-DDCM that significantly improves robustness while only minimally affecting the rate--distortion--perception trade-off.

2604.06247.tldr: This work introduces SALLIE (Safeguarding Against Latent Language&Image Exploits), a lightweight runtime detection framework rooted in mechanistic interpretability that mitigates both textual and visual threats simultaneously without degrading performance or requiring architectural modifications.

2604.06250.tldr: Evaluating 18~VLMs, it is found that Chemistry exhibits substantially lower language-prior exploitability than Biology, confirming molecular visual content as a harder test of genuine visual reasoning; open-source models consistently score higher when reasoning from their own verbalized descriptions than from raw images, exposing a systematic integration bottleneck; and closed-source models show no such gap.

2604.06251.tldr: The proposed machine learning models consistently outperform existing rule-based heuristics and random baselines in precision and recall and demonstrate the practical value of predictive analytics for improving operational efficiency and supporting data-driven decision-making in container terminal logistics.

2604.06253.tldr: These findings suggest that combining LoRA, optimized training methods, and frequency-domain regularization can efficiently adapt single-language LLMs to perform well across multiple programming languages.

2604.06254.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the SE ViT-BiLSTM model outperforms existing approaches across multiple metrics and was trained and evaluated on two real-world benchmark datasets.

2604.06255.tldr: This work presents an self-supervised physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework that provides a mesh-free and fully differentiable approach to solving the stellar structure equations under hydrostatic and thermal equilibrium and establishes a foundation for scalable, physics-informed emulation of stellar interiors.

2604.06256.tldr: It is suggested that spectral edge dynamics identify low-dimensional functional subspaces governing learning, whose representation depends on the algebraic structure of the task.

2604.06260.tldr: Results show that classical search over denoising trajectories provides a practical mechanism for test-time scaling in DLMs, and proposes S^3 (Stratified Scaling Search), a classical verifier-guided search method that improves generation by reallocating compute during the denoising process rather than only at the final output stage.

2604.06262.tldr: Dual-Stream Calibration (DSC) is proposed, a test-time training framework that transcends superficial knowledge exposure to achieve deep internalization during inference, and shifts the reasoning paradigm from passive attention-based matching to an active refinement of the latent inferential space.

2604.06263.tldr: This work proposes the Incentive-Aware Multi-Fidelity Mechanism (IAMFM), a unified framework coupling Vickrey-Clarke-Groves incentives with Multi-Fidelity Optimization to maximize expected social welfare and introduces Active Counterfactual Optimization, a "warm-start"approach that reuses optimization data for efficient payment calculation.

2604.06264.tldr: ToxReason is introduced, a benchmark grounded in the Adverse Outcome Pathway (AOP) that evaluates organ-level toxicity reasoning across multiple organs and shows that reasoning-aware training improves mechanistic reasoning and, consequently, toxicity prediction performance.

2604.06266.tldr: An attribution-driven analysis of encoder-based LLMs for network intrusion detection using flow-level traffic features demonstrates that model decisions are driven by meaningful traffic behavior patterns, improving transparency and trust in transformer-based SDN intrusion detection.

2604.06267.tldr: A robust multimodal survival model is instantiate, termed MO-RiskVAE, which consistently improves risk stratification over the original MyeVAE without introducing additional supervision or complex training heuristics and it is demonstrated that structuring the latent space can improve alignment between learned representations and survival risk gradients.

2604.06269.tldr: MAT-Cell first uses Reverse Verification Query to combine tissue context, observed differentially expressed genes, and LLM-elicited biological priors into structured candidate-specific premises, and Verifier agents then convert these premises into explicit premise-to-claim reasoning trees.

2604.06274.tldr: This paper explores the integration of international best practices, specifically ISO/IEC 27001 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, into national regulatory systems and proposes a methodology for automating the development of target security profiles using Large Language Models enhanced by RetrievalAugmented Generation (RAG).

2604.06277.tldr: This work introduces a weak supervision framework that combines three complementary grounding signals: substring matching, sentence embedding similarity, and an LLM as a judge verdict to label generated responses as grounded or hallucinated without human annotation, and results support this hypothesis.

2604.06279.tldr: Plasma GraphRAG is introduced, a novel framework that integrates Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) with large language models (LLMs) for automated, physics-grounded parameter range identification and offers a methodology for accelerating scientific discovery across complex, data-rich domains.

2604.06280.tldr: DosimeTron autonomously executed complex dosimetry pipelines across diverse prompt configurations and achieved high dosimetric agreement with OpenDose3D at clinically acceptable processing times, demonstrating the feasibility of agentic AI for patient-specific Monte Carlo dosimetry in PET/CT.

2604.06284.tldr: ClawLess is presented, a security framework that enforces formally verified policies on AI agents under a worst-case threat model where the agent itself may be adversarial, ensuring security regardless of the agent's internal design.

2604.06285.tldr: Together, HyPE and HyPS offer an efficient, interpretable, and resilient approach to safeguarding VLMs against malicious prompt misuse.

2604.06327.tldr: This work introduces the first automatic framework for detecting speaker drift by formulating it as a binary classification task over utterance-level speaker consistency and establishes speaker drift as a standalone research problem and bridges geometric signal analysis with LLM-based perceptual reasoning in modern TTS.

2604.06336.tldr: BiScale-GTR is introduced, a unified framework for self-supervised molecular representation learning that combines chemically grounded fragment tokenization with adaptive multi-scale reasoning and highlights chemically meaningful functional motifs.

2604.06342.tldr: This work surveys industry practitioners and conducts follow-up interviews to suggest that GenAI creates demand for new skills, while strengthening the importance of soft-skills and traditional competencies in university curricula and evaluation redesign.

2604.06346.tldr: This work proposes a severity-aware weighted loss for fine-tuning Arabic language models on medical complaint-response data that depends on soft severity probabilities to dynamically scale token-level loss contributions during optimization, thereby prioritizing clinically critical interactions without modifying model architectures.

2604.06349.tldr: This work proposes BiSDG, a bi-level optimization framework that explicitly decouples task learning from domain modeling, and develops a practical gradient approximation scheme that enables efficient bi-level training without second-order derivatives.

2604.06352.tldr: This paper proposes a simple vision-language framework for food-item-level nutritional analysis using paired before-and-after eating images that leverages natural language prompts to localize specific food items and estimate their weight directly from a single RGB image.

2604.06356.tldr: It is found that speaking rate strongly affects ICL performance and is also mimicked in the output, whereas pitch range and intensity have little impact on performance and are not consistently reproduced.

2604.06358.tldr: This work introduces GS-Surrogate, a deformable Gaussian Splatting-based visualization surrogate for parameter-space exploration, which first constructs a canonical Gaussian field as a base 3D representation and adapts it through sequential parameter-conditioned deformations.

2604.06365.tldr: A Severity-based Curriculum Learning Strategy for Arabic Medical Text Generation is introduced, where the training process is structured to move gradually from less severe to more critical medical conditions.

2604.06373.tldr: A Feature-Driven Human-In-The-Loop (FD-HITL) framework that systematically guides project generation from curated project descriptions is proposed and Cursor can generate functional large-scale projects averaging 16,965 LoC and 114 files.

2604.06375.tldr: SymptomWise is presented, a framework that separates language understanding from diagnostic reasoning that shows meaningful overlap with clinician consensus and may serve as a deterministic structuring and routing layer for foundation models, improving precision and potentially reducing unnecessary computational overhead in bounded tasks.

2604.06387.tldr: Results show that Evidential Deep Learning achieves the best reconstruction accuracy and uncertainty calibration across all sensor configurations at the lowest inference cost, while Gaussian Processes are fundamentally limited by their stationary kernel assumption and become intractable as observation density grows.

2604.06389.tldr: This work proposes SELFDOUBT, a single-pass uncertainty framework that resolves this impasse by extracting behavioral signals directly from the reasoning trace itself, and establishes SELFDOUBT as a scalable, production-ready foundation for uncertainty estimation over proprietary reasoning models.

2604.06391.tldr: This work introduces a graph foundation model designed to learn transferable structural representations that are not specific to specific node identities or feature schemes, which provides a unique approach toward reusable, foundation-scale models for graph-structured data in biomedical and network science applications.

2604.06392.tldr: Qualixar OS provides a complete runtime for heterogeneous multi-agent systems spanning 10 LLM providers, 8+ agent frameworks, and 7 transports, and achieves 100% accuracy at a mean cost of $0.000039 per task.

2604.06401.tldr: This paper presents a hybrid pipeline where an LLM generates a typed proof sketch in a compact DSL and a lightweight trusted kernel expands the sketch into explicit proof obligations.

2604.06403.tldr: This paper explored various methods of utilizing LLMs for the ToxHabits Shared Task, including zero-shot, few-shot, and prompt optimization, and found that GPT-4.1's few-shot prompting performed the best in the authors' experiments.

2604.06405.tldr: This demonstration showcases how users interact with BDI-Kit to iteratively explore, validate, and refine schema and value matches through a combination of automated matching, AI-assisted reasoning, and user-driven refinement.

2604.06409.tldr: This work formalizes privacy-preserving LLM communication as an IS task, introduces free-text pseudonymization as a third strategy that replaces sensitive attributes with functionally equivalent alternatives, and proposes a conversational evaluation protocol that assesses strategies under realistic multi-turn follow-up pressure.

2604.06411.tldr: This paper provides an in-depth review of current cybersecurity practices for CubeSats, highlighting limitations and identifying gaps in existing methods, and explores non-cyber anomaly detection techniques that offer insights into adaptable algorithms and deployment strategies suitable for CubeSat constraints.

2604.06416.tldr: Comparing human narrative engagement with model attention mechanisms suggests explanations for degraded narrative comprehension and targets for future development.

2604.06422.tldr: The Graded Color Attribution dataset is introduced, a controlled benchmark designed to elicit decision rules and evaluate participant faithfulness to these rules, and it is found that VLMs are excellent estimators of color coverage, yet blatantly contradict their own reasoning in their final responses.

2604.06424.tldr: A transformer-based approach to solving the SympTEMIST named entity recognition (NER) and entity linking (EL) tasks by fine-tune a RoBERTa-based token-level classifier with BiLSTM and CRF layers on an augmented train set.

2604.06427.tldr: This work tests whether models can discover multi-step planning strategies without supervision on intermediate steps and execute them latently, within a single forward pass, and reveals a dissociation between the ability to discover a latent strategy under final-answer supervision alone and the ability to execute it once discovered.

2604.06435.tldr: This work proposes Tiny-Dinomaly, a lightweight adaptation of the Dinomaly model built on the DINO foundation model that achieves 13x smaller memory footprint and 20x lower computational cost while improving Pixel F1 by 5 percentage points.

2604.06465.tldr: Evo-L2S is introduced, a novel framework that formulates L2S reasoning as a multi-objective optimization challenge and explicitly optimizes the trade-off between accuracy and output length to produce a robust Pareto front of merged models.

2604.06483.tldr: A practical implementation of activation-level interpretability (logit lens) and steering (steering vector) that scales up to multi-GPU language models and shows controllable, monotonic shifts in model outputs with a mean steerability slope of 0.702 across evaluated datasets.

2604.06491.tldr: The results establish DoMinO as an useful framework for controllable discrete sequence generation as well as establishing an upper bound on the discretization error of DoMinO and tractable upper bounds for the regularizers.

2604.06495.tldr: This work proposes a masking-based regularization that randomly replaces tokens during training to disrupt co-occurrence patterns, which improves robustness across SAE architectures and sparsity levels reducing absorption, enhancing probing performance, and narrowing the OOD gap.

2604.06505.tldr: It is found that conclusion writing is behaviorally distinct from summary writing, strong models remain closely clustered under current automatic metrics, and judge identity can substantially shift absolute scores.

2604.06515.tldr: Experiments on large-scale MoE models, including Switch Transformer and Mixtral, show that the proposed theoretically grounded expert-wise mixed precision strategy achieves higher accuracy than existing approaches, while also reducing inference cost and incurring only negligible overhead for bit-width assignment.

2604.06518.tldr: This work proposes an adaptive differentially private federated learning framework for medical image segmentation that dynamically adjusts privacy mechanisms to better balance the privacy-utility trade-off, and demonstrates the practical viability of ADP-FL for high-performance, privacy-preserving medical image segmentation in real-world federated settings.

2604.06520.tldr: This work addresses the problems of giving a semantics to- and doing query answering (QA) on a relational database that has missing values (MVs) and proposes two QA techniques that jointly capture probabilistic uncertainty and statistical plausibility of the implicit imputation of MVs.

2604.06523.tldr: This work proposes a method that trains matrices directly while maintaining unitarity through a single regularization term added to the loss function, which produces a trained variational circuit in under four minutes, compared to over two hours for direct circuit training, while achieving lower binary cross-entropy loss.

2604.06550.tldr: SkillSieve is a three-layer detection framework that applies deeper analysis only where needed, and is deployed as a Feishu chat bot for real-time skill vetting, suggesting a low-cost adaptation path to similar enterprise platforms.

2604.06562.tldr: This work studies emotion-sensitive decision making by combining representation-level emotion induction with a structured game-theoretic evaluation, and introduces a benchmark built around canonical decision templates that span cooperative and competitive incentives under both complete and incomplete information.

2604.06566.tldr: This work proposes automating the design of evaluators by co-evolving them with the solutions, demonstrating that addressing the evaluation bottleneck unlocks the potential of ADRS to generate highly optimized, deployable code for next-generation data systems.

2604.06571.tldr: The Guardian Parser Pack is introduced, an AI-driven parsing and normalization pipeline that transforms multi-source investigative documents into a unified, schema-compliant representation suitable for operational review and downstream spatial modeling and support controlled use of probabilistic AI within a schema-first, auditable pipeline for high-stakes investigative settings.

2604.06603.tldr: This work proposes an LLM generation method that integrate subject-specific knowledge with strong constraints, and builds an extensible framework to effectively constrain the model generation on domain tasks.

2604.06610.tldr: TwinLoop is proposed, a simulation-in-the-loop digital twin framework for online multi-agent reinforcement learning that can improve post-shift adaptation efficiency and reduce reliance on costly online trial-and-error.

2604.06628.tldr: This work revisits this claim for reasoning SFT with long chain-of-thought supervision and finds that cross-domain generalization is not absent but conditional, jointly shaped by optimization dynamics, training data, and base-model capability.

2604.06629.tldr: Logical Robots is presented, an interactive multi-agent simulation platform where autonomous robot behavior is specified declaratively in the logic programming language Logica, providing a coherent framework for exploring multi-agent robot behavior.

2604.06631.tldr: SubFLOT introduces an Optimal Transport-enhanced Pruning (OTP) module that treats historical client models as proxies for local data distributions, formulating the pruning task as a Wasserstein distance minimization problem to generate customized submodels without accessing raw data.

2604.06636.tldr: Stage-aware Hierarchical Advantage via Potential Estimation (SHAPE), a framework that formalizes reasoning as a trajectory through a state space of empirical solvability, and introduces a hierarchical credit assignment mechanism.

2604.06638.tldr: RPM-Net is proposed, a novel framework that introduces reciprocal point mechanism to learn "non-class" representations for each known attack category, coupled with adversarial margin constraints that provide geometric interpretability for unknown threat detection.

2604.06650.tldr: A multitask prompt distillation and decomposition framework that learns a single shared metaprompt from 21 diverse clinical source tasks and adapts it to unseen target tasks with fewer than 0.05% trainable parameters is presented.

2604.06663.tldr: This study compares six segmentation configurations across two open-weight LLMs and finds that increasing identifier granularity does not produce consistent improvement, and highlights the need for heterogeneity-aware evaluation and variance-preserving modeling strategies.

2604.06666.tldr: A graph-enhanced defense framework (G-Defense) is proposed that provides fine-grained explanations based solely on unverified reports that achieves state-of-the-art performance in both veracity detection and the quality of its explanations.

2604.06685.tldr: This work introduces ChemVLR, a chemical VLM designed to prioritize reasoning within the perception process, which achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, surpassing both leading proprietary models and domain-specific open-source baselines.

2604.06691.tldr: This work proposes resource aware Knowledge Distillation for Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning KD MARL a two stage framework that transfers coordinated behavior from a centralized expert to lightweight decentralized student agents to preserve coordination under heterogeneous and limited observations.

2604.06695.tldr: StepFlow is proposed, a saliency-inspired test-time intervention that adjusts shallow saliency patterns measured by Step-Saliency via Odds-Equal Bridge and adds a small step-level residual in deep layers via Step Momentum Injection, indicating that repairing information flow can recover part of their missing reasoning performance.

2604.06696.tldr: Experiments on a curated routing benchmark with several 3B--7B open-weight models show that compact models can provide competitive routing performance in constrained settings, and that model differences are mainly reflected in action prediction, candidate selection, and structured grounding quality.

2604.06714.tldr: It is revealed that obvious and elusive hallucinations elicit different intervention probes, allowing for fine-grained control over the model's verifiability, and an activation-space intervention method is proposed that learns separate probes for obvious and elusive hallucinations.

2604.06723.tldr: This study proposes local Platt-scaling applied separately to three different fine-grained confidence scores, finding that fine-grained confidence scores consistently achieve lower calibration error across a broader range of probability intervals, and this effect is further amplified when global Platt-scaling is applied.

2604.06724.tldr: The TTP with time window constraints is introduced which provides a TTP variant highly relevant to real-world situations where good can only be collected at given time intervals and a new heuristic approach for the TTP with time windows is provided.

2604.06728.tldr: URA first injects visual evidence into textual representations through multi-head cross-attention, and then applies self-attention in the fused semantic space to enhance incongruity reasoning, and models textual, visual, and interaction-aware representations as learnable Gaussian posteriors to estimate modality-specific uncertainty.

2604.06765.tldr: This work proposes TeamLLM, a human-like Team-Oriented Multi-LLM Collaboration Framework that adopts four team roles with distinct division and employs a three-phase multi-LLM collaboration for multi-step contextualized tasks and constructs the CGPST benchmark.

2604.06770.tldr: FlowExtract is presented, a pipeline for extracting directed graphs from ISO 5807-standardized flowcharts, using YOLOv8 and EasyOCR for standard domain-aligned node detection and text extraction and a novel edge detection method that analyzes arrowhead orientations and traces connecting lines backward to source nodes.

2604.06771.tldr: This work first constructs self-consistent preference alignment data from three dimensions (rewriting, retrieval, and response) to generate more diverse rewritten queries, and proposes prefix guided multi-faceted direct preference optimization to learn preference information from three different dimensions.

2604.06774.tldr: This work proposes a framework that employs convolutional architectures to extract sparse features from a finite number of samples, together with deep fully connected networks to effectively approximate nonlinear functionals and shows that sparse approximators enable stable recovery from discrete samples.

2604.06793.tldr: Inspired by documentation-driven development, SWD-Bench is introduced, a novel benchmark for evaluating repository-level software documentation that evaluates documentation quality by assessing an LLM's ability to understand and implement functionalities using the documentation, rather than by directly scoring it.

2604.06795.tldr: This work proposes Federated Domain-Aware Prototypes (FedDAP), a framework to construct domain-specific global prototypes by aggregating local client prototypes within the same domain using a similarity-weighted fusion mechanism to address the domain shift challenges.

2604.06811.tldr: The results show that skill-level backdoors can be highly effective with minimal degradation of benign behavior, exposing a critical blind spot in current skill-based agent architectures and motivating defenses that explicitly reason about skill composition and execution.

2604.06814.tldr: OmniTabBench is introduced, the largest tabular benchmark to date, comprising 3030 datasets spanning diverse tasks that are comprehensively collected from diverse sources and categorized by industry using large language models, providing clearer, more actionable guidance than prior compound-metric studies.

2604.06820.tldr: The results suggest that directly asking for the target response may not always yield the most effective score for predicting it, and that comparing direct scores with indirect paths through related judgments may reveal a more effective predictive route.

2604.06831.tldr: Privacy-Preserving Fine-Tuning (PPFT) is introduced, a novel training pipeline that eliminates the need for transmitting raw prompt text while maintaining a favorable balance between privacy preservation and model utility for both clients and service providers.

2604.06834.tldr: Two variant methods are proposed: ASLEC-DROP, which drops first-token probabilities when computing average log probability, and ASLEC-CASL, which applies a causal debiasing regression to remove the first tokens'confounding effect.

2604.06838.tldr: This paper explores the use of ILASP (Inductive Learning of Answer Set Programs) to approximate preference learning systems through weak constraints, and proposes a preprocessing step that exploits Principal Component Analysis to reduce the dataset's dimensionality while keeping the authors' explanations transparent.

2604.06845.tldr: HingeMem is proposed, a boundary-guided long-term memory that operationalizes event segmentation theory to build an interpretable indexing interface via boundary-triggered hyperedges over four elements: person, time, location, and topic.

2604.06846.tldr: Evaluating five frontier LLMs across 7,225 dialogues, it is found a fundamental asymmetry: information pollution (fabricating symptoms) produces 1.4x larger accuracy drops than information deficit (withholding information), and fabricating is the only configuration achieving statistical significance across all five models (McNemar p<0.05).

2604.06863.tldr: This paper presents the first large-scale comparative study of bias in skin-toned emoji representations across two distinct model classes, and finds evidence of skewed sentiment and inconsistent meanings associated with emojis across different skin tones.

2604.06865.tldr: The resulting picture is that surveillance robustness cannot be judged reliably from isolated per-frame benchmarks alone; it has to be examined as a system problem unfolding over time, across sensors, and under realistic physical deployment constraints.

2604.06871.tldr: Affinity Pooling is introduced, a training-free, similarity-based token merging mechanism that effectively compress speech representations without compromising semantic information by strategically applying this method at both input and deep layers.

2604.06900.tldr: SentinelSphere illustrates that coupling intelligent threat detection with adaptive, LLM-driven security education can meaningfully address both technical and human-factor cybersecurity vulnerabilities within a single, cohesive framework.

2604.06901.tldr: XR-CareerAssist demonstrates how the fusion of XR and AI can produce more engaging, accessible, and effective career development tools, with the integration of five AI modules within a single immersive environment yielding a multimodal interaction experience that distinguishes it from existing career guidance platforms.

2604.06906.tldr: An AI Impact Matrix is proposed -- an interpretive framework that positions skills along four quadrants: High Displacement Risk, Upskilling Required, AI-Augmented, and Lower Displacement Risk, suggesting that text-based automation feasibility may be more skill-dependent than model-dependent.

2604.06912.tldr: Q-Zoom is proposed, a query-aware adaptive high-resolution perception framework that operates in an efficient coarse-to-fine manner and establishes a dominant Pareto frontier.

2604.06916.tldr: Sol-RL (Speed-of-light RL), a novel FP4-empowered Two-stage Reinforcement Learning framework, is proposed, which empirically demonstrate that the framework maintains the training integrity of BF16 precision pipeline while fully exploiting the throughput gains enabled by FP4 arithmetic.

2410.08334.tldr: A reinforcement learning framework to study how children compose numbers using base-ten blocks is built and shows that instructions providing explicit action guidance are a more effective learning signal for RL agents to construct numbers.

2411.18084.tldr: AppRay is a system that integrates task-oriented app exploration with automated deceptive pattern detection to reduce manual effort, expand detection coverage, and improve performance and contributes two datasets, AppRay-Tainted-UIs and AppRay-Benign-UIs.

2506.05171.tldr: This Perspective argues for a paradigm shift to provable probabilistic safety that integrates provable guarantees with progressive achievement toward a probabilistic safety boundary on overall system performance, and outlines a roadmap for provable probabilistic safety, along with corresponding challenges and potential solutions.

2506.18841.tldr: This work proposes an incentivization-based approach that leverages reinforcement learning (RL) to foster the emergence of ultra-long, high-quality text generation capabilities in LLMs, and employs specialized reward models that steer the LLM towards improved length control, writing quality, and structural formatting.

2508.07299.tldr: This paper centers on the assumptions underlying unsupervised pretext tasks and explores the feasibility of preemptively estimating the impact of unsupervised pretext tasks at low cost, and proposes a low-cost estimation method that can quantitatively estimate the actual target performance.

2508.13657.tldr: This work proposes PS-PFN to efficiently explore and exploit adapting ML pipelines by extending Posterior Sampling to the max k-armed bandit problem setup and leverages prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) to efficiently estimate the posterior distribution of the maximal value via in-context learning.

2510.13820.tldr: The proposed system eliminates the need for physical presence during monitoring by addressing the shortcomings of conventional wired communication systems, and includes an additional feature to remotely control these parameters by controlling the speed of DC motors through online commands.

2603.28906.tldr: It is claimed that Category Theory and AGI will have a very symbiotic relation, and a general, algebraic and category theoretic framework for describing, comparing and analysing different possible AGI architectures is developed.

2604.01840.tldr: Perception-Grounded Policy Optimization (PGPO) is introduced, which is a novel fine-grained credit assignment framework that dynamically reshapes advantages at the token level that effectively reduces gradient variance, prevents training collapse, and acts as a potent regularizer for robust, perception-grounded multimodal reasoning.

2604.05292.tldr: Broken by Default: a formal verification study of 3,500 code artifacts generated by seven widely-deployed LLMs across 500 security-critical prompts, producing mathematical satisfiability witnesses rather than pattern-based heuristics.

2604.06018.tldr: Examination of the perception of legal professionals on the governance of AI in developing countries, using Nigeria as a case study, shows that there were concerns about data privacy risks and the lack of enforceable legal frameworks.

2604.06934.tldr: A novel multi-modal extension of YOLOv5 that integrates GPT-generated textual descriptions of UI images into the detection pipeline through cross-attention modules, establishing that combining visual and textual modalities can substantially enhance UI element detection, particularly in edge cases where visual information alone is insufficient.

2604.06940.tldr: NICO-TSP (Neural Improvement for Combinatorial Optimization): a 2-opt improvement framework for TSP that serves both as a competitive replacement for classical local search and as a powerful test-time refinement module for constructive solvers.

2604.06946.tldr: It is shown that cost-efficient, locally deployable open-source models can serve as viable alternatives to proprietary systems when combined with well-designed fine-tuning approaches, and LoRA-based fine-tuning significantly improves the performance of all open-source models.

2604.06985.tldr: A multimodal wearable framework to estimate frailty-related functional change between visits in elderly breast cancer patients enrolled in the multicenter CARDIOCARE study and ablation results indicated that smartwatch activity and sleep provide the strongest predictive information for frailty-related functional changes, while HRV contributes complementary information when fused with smartwatch streams.

2604.06987.tldr: CAAP is proposed, a capture-aware adversarial patch framework for palmprint recognition that learns a universal patch that can be reused across inputs while remaining effective under realistic acquisition variation, and adopts a cross-shaped patch topology.

2604.06989.tldr: This generative formulation enables photomosaic composition that is both semantically expressive and structurally coherent, effectively overcoming the fundamental limitations of matching-based approaches.

2604.06990.tldr: This work estimates perceived stress in an elderly, multicenter breast cancer cohort (CARDIOCARE) using multimodal wearable data from a smartwatch and a chest-worn ECG sensor to predict PSS at month 3 (M3) and month 6 (M6).

2604.06995.tldr: This work proposes an innovative GUI reasoning paradigm called UI-in-the-Loop (UILoop), enabling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to explicitly learn the localization, semantic functions, and practical usage of key UI elements, which achieves precise element discovery and performs interpretable reasoning.

2604.06996.tldr: This is the first study of SPB in rubric-based evaluation, an increasingly popular benchmarking paradigm where judges issue binary verdicts on individual evaluation criteria, instead of assigning holistic scores or rankings, and examines the factors that drive SPB in this setting.

2604.07007.tldr: The Separation of Power (SoP) model is proposed, a constitutional governance architecture deployed on public blockchain that breaks this monopoly through three structural separations: agents legislate operational rules as smart contracts, deterministic software executes within those contracts, and humans adjudicate through a complete ownership chain binding every agent to a responsible principal.

2604.07009.tldr: A theoretical analysis of CAFP is provided, showing that it eliminates direct dependence on the protected attribute, reduces mutual information between predictions and sensitive attributes, and provably bounds the distortion introduced relative to the original model.

2604.07017.tldr: A-MBER, an Affective Memory Benchmark for Emotion Recognition, is introduced to suggest that memory supports affective interpretation not simply by providing more history, but by enabling more selective, grounded, and context-sensitive use of past interaction.

2604.07019.tldr: ConceptTracer is introduced, an interactive application for analyzing neural representations through the lens of human-interpretable concepts that provides a practical framework for investigating how neural networks like TabPFN encode concept-level information.

2604.07028.tldr: The Strategic Courtroom Framework is presented, a multi-agent simulation environment in which prosecution and defense teams composed of trait-conditioned Large Language Model agents engage in iterative, round-based legal argumentation and a reinforcement-learning-based Trait Orchestrator is introduced that dynamically generates defense traits conditioned on the case and opposing team.

2604.07041.tldr: AV-SQL is a framework that decomposes complex Text-to-SQL into a pipeline of specialized LLM agents that achieves 70.38% execution accuracy on the challenging Spider 2.0 benchmark, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines, while remaining competitive on standard datasets.

2604.07042.tldr: This paper proposes $allmin$, an optimal algorithm that solves planning task shielding tasks by minimally modifying the original actions to render the planning task unsolvable, and empirically evaluates the performance of $allmin$ in shielding planning tasks of increasing size.

2604.07084.tldr: Flow Motion Policy is introduced, an open-loop, end-to-end neural motion planner for robotic manipulators that leverages the stochastic generative formulation of flow matching methods to capture the inherent multi-modality of planning datasets.

2604.07101.tldr: SurFITR provides a large collection of forensically valuable imagery generated via a multimodal LLM-powered pipeline, enabling semantically aware, fine-grained editing across diverse surveillance scenes, and shows significant improvements in both in-domain and cross-domain performance.

2604.07108.tldr: This paper introduces the Informational Buildup Framework (IBF), an alternative substrate for continual learning, based on the premise that information is the achievement of structural alignment rather than stored content, and achieves replay-superior retention without storing raw data.

2604.07121.tldr: Mixed-Initiative Context is proposed, which reconceptualizes the context formed across multi-turn interactions as an explicit, structured, and manipulable interactive object that can be dynamically organized and adjusted according to task needs, enabling both humans and AI to participate in context construction and regulation.

2604.07126.tldr: The proposed model provides an efficient and effective way to predict agent trajectories under aerial scenes by employing a cross-modal attention module and enhancing the spatial encoding module to consider ego-centric velocity and acceleration of neighboring vehicles.

2604.07132.tldr: This work introduces CSA-Graphs, a privacy-preserving structural dataset that provides structural representations that remove explicit visual content while preserving contextual information for classifying CSAI.

2604.07133.tldr: A multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) algorithm that enables each access point (AP) to autonomously control antenna re-configuration and advanced sleep mode (ASM) selection and achieves a similar PC level but with a significantly lower drop ratio.

2604.07147.tldr: Dynamic Context Evolution is introduced, comprising three mechanisms: verbalized tail sampling, which filters high-probability candidates via model self-assessment; semantic memory, which maintains a persistent embedding index to reject near-duplicates across batches; and adaptive prompt evolution, which reconstructs the generation prompt each batch using memory state and rotating diversity strategies.

2604.07154.tldr: A subspace decomposition framework is proposed that reframes multimodal fusion as a problem of orthogonal subspace separation rather than translation and provides a structured characterization of modality complementarity grounded in representation geometry rather than image translation.

2604.07180.tldr: The presented cases serve as proof-of-concept that patient-specific energy manifolds can function as geometric reference systems for longitudinal mpMRI analysis without explicit segmentation or supervised classification, providing a foundation for further investigation of manifold-based tissue-at-risk tracking in neuro-oncology.

2604.07182.tldr: The deep learning models capabilities to classify the disease in real life tea leaf disease detection and management, and a prototype in order to leverage the models capabilities on real life agriculture are illustrated.

2604.07190.tldr: A clear trend where Chinese models overtook their counterparts built in the U.S. in the summer of 2025 and subsequently widened the gap over their western counterparts is documented.

2604.07191.tldr: This paper proposes novel assumptions based on conditional independence given the class label, which ensure identifiability even when irreducibility does not hold, and develops method of moments estimators under these assumptions and analyze their asymptotic properties.

2604.07223.tldr: TraceSafe-Bench is introduced, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to assess mid-trajectory safety, and suggests that securing agentic workflows requires jointly optimizing for structural reasoning and safety alignment to effectively mitigate mid-trajectory risks.

2604.07240.tldr: The code-based challenge for automated, open-ended mathematical discovery based on the $k-server conjecture, a central open problem in competitive analysis, is introduced and results show that it mitigates important limitations of existing open-ended code-based benchmarks, including early saturation and the weak separation between naive random baselines and more sophisticated methods.

2604.07253.tldr: A remote participatory design study with 20 women in Afghanistan shows that accountable and safe GenAI is not only about harm reduction but can also actively enable women to imagine and pursue viable learning and employment futures.

2604.07264.tldr: This system bridges the semantic gap between operator intent and network configuration while maintaining the safety guarantees required for operational deployment, and demonstrates that apparent performance gaps in polar-avoidance scenarios are largely explained by topological reachability ceilings rather than routing quality.

2604.07274.tldr: Results show that retrieval augmentation significantly improves zero-shot medical question answering performance, and Domain-specialized language models were also found to better utilize retrieved medical evidence than general-purpose models.

2604.07276.tldr: This work integrates the MLIP framework DeePMD-kit into GROMACS, enabling domain-decomposed, GPU-accelerated inference across multi-node systems, and introduces a domain decomposition layer decoupled from the main simulation.

2604.07277.tldr: This paper proposes Android Coach, a novel framework that shifts the training paradigm to Single State Multiple Actions, allowing the agent to sample and utilize multiple actions for a single online state without fully exploring each costly emulator state.

2604.07286.tldr: CADENCE, an adaptive system that dynamically scales the computational complexity of a slimmable monocular depth estimation network in response to navigation needs and environmental context, ensures high-precision computing is only used when mission-critical.

2604.07298.tldr: ROAM (Region-graph OptimAl-transport Mixture-of-experts), a spatially aware MoE-MIL aggregator that routes region tokens to expert poolers via capacity-constrained entropic optimal transport, promoting balanced expert utilisation by construction.

2604.07304.tldr: A saturation-based scoping review of conversational assessment approaches in programming education is reported and a Hybrid Socratic Framework for integrating conversational verification into Automated Programming Assessment Systems (APASs) is synthesized.

2604.07320.tldr: This work constructs synchronous context-free grammars which define pairs of formal languages designed to model particular aspects of natural language grammar, morphology, and written representation, and measures how well LLMs can translate sentences from one formal language into another when given both the grammar and the source-language sentence.

2604.07321.tldr: Assessing how effectively several representative LLMs translate assertive English sentences into LTL formulas reveals three findings: in line with prior findings, LLMs perform better on syntactic aspects of LTL than on semantic ones; and reformulating the task as a Python code-completion problem substantially improves overall performance.

2604.07331.tldr: RoSHI, a hybrid wearable that fuses low-cost sparse IMUs with the Project Aria glasses to estimate the full 3D pose and body shape of the wearer in a metric global coordinate frame from egocentric perception, is introduced.

2604.07348.tldr: MoRight, a unified framework that addresses both limitations through disentangled motion modeling, is introduced, and state-of-the-art performance in generation quality, motion controllability, and interaction awareness is demonstrated.

1912.08786.tldr: This work proposes three strategies how an AI-resilient society is able to transform threats caused by new AI tecchnologies such as generative adversarial networks: awareness, agreements, and red flags.

2402.08267.tldr: This study proposes a novel training method for learned ICM models that applies auxiliary loss to the encoder to improve its recognition capability and rate-distortion performance.

2406.10521.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework to generate synthetic tabular data, powered by large language models (LLMs) that emulates the architecture of a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) that emulates the architecture of a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN).

2406.13086.tldr: NaviSplit is proposed, the first instance of a lightweight navigation framework embedding a distributed and dynamic multi-branched neural model based on split DNNs for autonomous navigation and is the first exemplar of dynamic multi-branched model based on split DNNs for autonomous navigation.

2407.01563.tldr: NaviSlim is designed as a gated slimmable neural network architecture that, different from existing slimmable networks, can dynamically select a slimming factor to autonomously scale model complexity, which consequently optimizes execution time and energy consumption.

2407.19426.tldr: This work introduces a causal model called LV-SEM-ME, which contains four types of variables: directly observed variables, variables that are not directly observed but are measured with error, the corresponding measurements, and variables that are neither observed nor measured, and establishes a form of identification robustness.

2411.02622.tldr: Adaptive Probability Approximate Unlearning (AdaProb) is a novel method that enables models to forget data efficiently and in a privacy-preserving manner and outperforms state-of-the-art approaches with over 20% improvement in forgetting error, better protection against membership inference attacks, and less than 50% of the computational time.

2412.08637.tldr: DMin (Diffusion Model influence), a scalable framework for estimating the influence of each training data sample on a given generated image, is proposed, which is the first method capable of influence estimation for DMs with billions of parameters.

2503.01870.tldr: It is demonstrated that supervised fine-tuned (SFT) LLMs perform at least as well as professional analysts and substantially better than foundational LLMs, and these results generalize to alternative foundational LLMs and require relatively"small" models.

2503.02537.tldr: This paper proposes RectifiedHR, a straightforward and efficient solution for training-free high-resolution synthesis, and introduces average latent energy analysis and finds that tuning the classifier-free guidance hyperparameter can significantly improve generation performance.

2504.04640.tldr: A scalable, two-stage process that filters large collections of "potential" SLPs (PSLPs) to surface the most promising candidates for deeper, qualitative investigation is presented.

2504.17069.tldr: OAR generation is presented, a self-distillation pipeline that first trains an any-order AR model, then extracts specialized generation orders from the model's own confidence scores, and fine-tunes on these orders.

2505.00017.tldr: A globally connected knowledge graph is developed comprising 18850 biological information nodes, including cell types, gene markers, features, and other related entities, along with 48,944 edges connecting these nodes, which is used by LLMs to retrieve entities associated with differential genes for cell reconstruction.

2505.10375.tldr: This work provides the first empirical evidence that SAEs can be used to detect software bugs directly from the internal representations of pretrained LLMs, without any fine-tuning or task-specific supervision.

2505.13126.tldr: PDDLego is proposed, a framework to iteratively formalize, plan, grow, and refine PDDL representations by decomposing the environment and the goal into fully observable episodes and shows robustness against problem complexity compared to end-to-end approaches.

2505.17732.tldr: RQR3D regresses the smallest horizontal bounding box encapsulating the oriented box, along with the offsets between the corners of these two boxes, thereby transforming the oriented object detection problem into a keypoint regression task, and introduces a simplified radar fusion backbone that applies standard 2D convolutions to radar features.

2506.04742.tldr: This work demonstrates that a simple neural operator architecture, such as DeepONet, coupled with an unconstrained optimization routine, can solve tracking-type partial differential equation (PDE) constrained control problems with a single physics-informed training phase and a subsequent optimization phase.

2506.09354.tldr: An AI-supported system with an LLM-simulated distressed client, context-sensitive LLM-generated suggestions, and real-time emotion visualisations is presented and evaluated, demonstrating how LLM-supported systems can scaffold this development--if designed with care and guided by expert oversight.

2506.12040.tldr: Binary quantization represents the most extreme form of compression, reducing weights to +/-1 for maximal memory and computational efficiency, and a novel sub-1-bit LLM quantization framework that leverages binary pattern clustering and weight transformation to overcome these limitations is presented.

2506.17212.tldr: This work introduces Part$^{2}GS, a novel framework for modeling articulated digital twins of multi-part objects with high-fidelity geometry and physically consistent articulation that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 10$\times in Chamfer Distance for movable parts.

2508.05674.tldr: This work systematically investigates the key factors that drive agent success and provides a detailed recipe for building effective LLM-based offensive security agents, and proposes a novel metric, CTF Competency Index (CCI) for partial correctness, revealing how closely agent solutions align with human-crafted gold standards.

2508.09521.tldr: This work proposes structured empathetic reasoning, which breaks support into three steps: conversation history analysis, multimodal emotional state inference, and strategy selection, prior to generating the final reply.

2509.23727.tldr: Improved sampling method AudioMoG is introduced, an improved sampling method that enhances text-to-audio (T2A) and video-to-audio (V2A) generation quality without requiring extensive training resources and introduces a mixture-of-guidance framework that integrates diverse guidance signals with their interaction terms to maximize cumulative advantages.

2602.13235.tldr: Lang2Act is proposed, which enables fine-grained visual perception and reasoning through self-emergent linguistic toolchains and designs a two-stage Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based training framework to support this mechanism.

2603.06582.tldr: The potential of SPARQL-MCP-based intelligent agents to facilitate federated SPARQL querying is explored and prior work on automated SPARQL query federation is complements and extends towards fruitful combinations with agentic AI.

2603.18019.tldr: BenchBrowser is introduced, a retriever that surfaces evaluation items relevant to natural language use cases over 20 benchmark suites and generates evidence to help practitioners diagnose low content validity and low convergent validity.

2603.18030.tldr: Quine is a runtime architecture and reference implementation that realizes LLM agents as native POSIX processes and exposes where the POSIX process model stops: processes provide a robust substrate for execution, but not a complete runtime model for cognition.

2603.20843.tldr: Across language modeling, retrieval, and instruction-following benchmarks, HiCI yields consistent improvements over strong baselines, including matching proprietary models on topic retrieval and surpassing GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K on code comprehension.

2603.22364.tldr: Fine-tuning diffusion models with MCLR induces CFG-like improvements under standard sampling, substantially improving guidance-free conditional generation and narrowing the gap to inference-time CFG, providing a mechanistic interpretation of CFG as an implicit inference-time contrastive alignment procedure.

2603.27765.tldr: Sortify is presented, the first fully autonomous LLM-driven ranking optimization agent deployed in a large-scale production recommendation system, and provides a decomposable measure where all factor contributions sum to exactly 100%.

2603.28507.tldr: This paper argues that continued AI scaling requires repeated efficiency doublings, and Moore's Law is understood less as a theorem than as an organizing expectation of repeated efficiency improvement.

2603.28618.tldr: This work introduces PRCO (Perception-Reasoning Coevolution), a dual-role RLVR framework with a shared policy that yields consistent improvements across model scales by over 7 points on average accuracy compared to the base model, outperforming prior open-source RL-tuned baselines.

2604.01930.tldr: Results highlight the importance of operating-point-aware assessment in rare-event detection and demonstrate that the proposed hybrid geometric-variational framework provides interpretable, scalable, and regime-adaptive classification across heterogeneous data settings.

2604.02500.tldr: A scenario where the majority of evaluated state-of-the-art AI agents explicitly choose to suppress evidence of fraud and harm, in service of company profit is presented.

2604.04083.tldr: A parent selection strategy for the $(\mu+1)$ genetic algorithm that prioritizes the selection of maximally distant parents for crossover, and it is shown that, with an appropriately chosen population size, the resulting algorithm solves the Jump$_k$ problem in $O(k4^kn\log(n)$ expected time.

2604.04418.tldr: Two methods that succeed at improving verifiability are introduced: reflect-and-rephrase (RR) for mathematical reasoning and oracle-rephrase (OR) for factual QA, both of which improve verifiability by incorporating domain-appropriate external information.

2604.04440.tldr: Among these orthonormal bases, the DCT is preferred because its separable fast transform admits a fused reconstruction kernel: the materialized weight matrix never leaves on-chip memory, so the parameter saving translates into a bandwidth saving as well.

2604.05350.tldr: DQA is introduced, a diagnostic question-answering framework that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases at the level of root causes rather than individual documents to support systematic troubleshooting under enterprise latency and context constraints.

2604.06210.tldr: DOVE is introduced, a distributional evaluation framework that directly compares human-written text distributions with LLM-generated outputs and achieves superior predictive validity, attaining a 31.56% correlation with downstream tasks, while maintaining high reliability with as few as 500 samples per culture.

2604.06323.tldr: The synthesis clarifies where blockchain contributes provenance, trust, and auditability, where AI contributes detection, adaptation, and orchestration, and where future work should focus on interoperable interfaces, privacy-preserving analytics, bounded agentic automation, and open cross-domain benchmarks.

2604.06613.tldr: Black-box Adaptive Early Exit (BAEE) is proposed, which uses free continuations for both detection and extraction, truncating 70--78% of serial generation while improving accuracy by 1--5pp across all models.

2604.06747.tldr: The results demonstrate that TurboAgent enables an autonomous closed-loop design process from natural language requirements to final design generation, providing an efficient and scalable paradigm for turbomachinery aerodynamic design.

2604.06829.tldr: WRAP++ (Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining), which amplifies the associative context of factual knowledge by discovering cross-document relationships from web hyperlinks and synthesizing joint QA over each discovered document pair, and substantially outperform single-document approaches and exhibit sustained scaling gains.

2604.07236.tldr: This work externalize a planning harness for noisy Collaborative Battleship into four progressively richer layers -- posterior belief tracking, declarative planning, symbolic reflec tion, and an LLM-backed revision gate -- under a common runtime, taking \emph{win rate} as the primary metric and \emph{F1} as secondary, and pre-specifying \emph{heavy lifting} as the single largest positive marginal to the primary metric.

2604.07369.tldr: The empirical evaluation on LLM behavior suggests that positive emotional stimuli lead to more accurate and less toxic results, but also increase sycophantic behavior.

2604.07384.tldr: Empirical evaluation through large-scale randomized controlled trials demonstrates that the DFL policy reduced cumulative engagement drops by 31% relative to the current standard of care, significantly outperforming the Two-Stage model.

2604.07393.tldr: DSPR (Dual-Stream Physics-Residual Networks), a forecasting framework that explicitly decouples stable temporal patterns from regime-dependent residual dynamics, suggests that architectural decoupling with physics-consistent inductive biases offers an effective path toward trustworthy industrial time-series forecasting.

2604.07395.tldr: A physical agentic loop is introduced that wraps an unmodified learned manipulation primitive (grasp-and-lift) with an event-based interface and an execution monitoring layer, Watchdog, which converts noisy gripper telemetry into discrete outcome labels using contact-aware fusion and temporal stabilization.

2604.07397.tldr: Data Warmup is proposed, a curriculum strategy that schedules training images from simple to complex without modifying the model or loss, and requires only ~10 minutes of one-time preprocessing with zero per-iteration overhead.

2604.07398.tldr: Seven output-side rules are proposed, each targeting a documented linguistic mechanism, and validates them empirically, as a configuration-file system prompt requiring no model modification; validation uses a single model.

2604.07405.tldr: It is shown that gradient flow on L-layer ReLU networks without bias preserves L-1 conservation laws C_l = ||W_{l+1}||_F^2 - ||W_l||_F^2, confining trajectories to lower-dimensional manifolds, and identifies two dynamical regimes separated by a width-dependent transition.

2604.07411.tldr: This paper utilise reinforcement learning with reward machines to make sleep-control decisions that balance immediate energy savings and long-term QoS impact, i.e. time-averaged packet drop rates for deadline-constrained traffic and time-averaged minimum-throughput guarantees for constant-rate users.

2604.07415.tldr: SubSearch is introduced, a specialized framework that shifts from outcome-only supervision to intermediate reward signals that incentivize planning high-quality reasoning and leads to more robust reasoning traces in both QA and multi-hop QA datasets over using only outcome rewards.

2604.07424.tldr: A human-in-the-loop research methodology for LLMs to automatically classify and summarize research descriptions at scale is illustrated, establishing a framework for evidence-based policy interventions to align the NIH AI portfolio with health equity goals and strategic research priorities.

2604.07426.tldr: This work introduces GIRL (Generative Imagination Reinforcement Learning), a latent world-model framework that addresses this failure mode with two key components, and re-derive a value-gap bound using the Performance Difference Lemma and Integral Probability Metrics.

2604.07428.tldr: The Replay Suppression Diagnostic (RSD) is introduced, a controlled exposure-decay-replay protocol that isolates this failure mode under frozen-policy evaluation and shows that, under stationary observable transition kernels, replay cannot be structurally suppressed without inducing a persistent shift in replay-time action distributions.

2604.07429.tldr: GameWorld is introduced, a benchmark designed for standardized and verifiable evaluation of MLLMs as generalist game agents in browser environments and lays a robust foundation for advancing research on multimodal game agents and beyond.

2604.07455.tldr: The results indicate that LLM-assisted formalization of standard mathematical textbooks in Isabelle/HOL is quite feasible, cheap and fast, even if some human supervision is useful.

2604.07457.tldr: Competence Manifold Projection uses a Frame-Wise Safety Scheme that transforms the infinite-horizon safety constraint into a computationally efficient single-step manifold inclusion and introduces an Isomorphic Latent Space that aligns manifold geometry with safety probability, enabling efficient O(1) seamless defense against arbitrary OOD intents.

2604.07468.tldr: M-ArtAgent, an evidence-based multimodal agent that reframes implicit influence discovery as probabilistic adjudication, demonstrates that implicit influence analysis benefits from historically grounded adjudication rather than pattern matching alone.

2604.07473.tldr: This paper presents the first theoretical example in which switching between two algorithms -- the $(1+\lambda)$ EA and the $(1+(\lambda,\lambda))$ GA -- solves the OneMax problem asymptotically faster than either algorithm used in isolation.

2604.07480.tldr: This paper deals with the problem of learning reward machines directly from raw state and policy information, and assumes no access to observations of rewards, labels, or machine nodes, and shows what trajectory data is sufficient for learning the reward machine in this information-scarce regime.

2604.07487.tldr: CLEAR first employs a reflection agent to perform contrastive analysis over past execution trajectories and summarize useful context for each observed task to train a context augmentation model (CAM), which further optimize CAM using reinforcement learning, where the reward signal is obtained by running the task execution agent.

2604.07490.tldr: This work proposes Direct Feature Reasoning-Gemma (DFR-Gemma), a novel framework that enables LLMs to reason directly over dense geospatial embeddings and shows that DFR allows LLMs to decode latent spatial patterns and perform accurate zero-shot reasoning across tasks, while significantly improving efficiency compared to text-based baselines.

2604.07492.tldr: It is shown that augmenting Message Passing Neural Networks or Graph Transformers with CLATT significantly improves their performance on a wide range of graph datasets including datasets from the recently introduced GraphLand benchmark representing real-world applications of graph machine learning.

2604.07494.tldr: Triage, a framework that uses code health metrics -- indicators of software maintainability -- as a routing signal to assign each task to the cheapest model tier whose output passes the same verification gate as the expensive model, is proposed.

2604.07502.tldr: This paper presents a systematic analysis of human-centric conventions under agentic pressure and proposes a key design principle: semantic density optimization, eliminating tokens that carry zero information while preserving tokens that carry high semantic value.

2604.07513.tldr: This work proposes SYN-DIGITS (SYNthetic Control Framework for Calibrated DIGItal Twin Simulation), a principled and lightweight calibration framework that learns latent structure from digital-twin responses and transfers it to align predictions with human ground truth.

2604.07530.tldr: It is found that a model's longevity is shaped more by when it was released than by its characteristics: release year predicts time-to-peak and lifespan more strongly than architecture, openness, or scale.

2604.07533.tldr: RL-ASL, a reinforcement learning-driven adaptive listening framework that dynamically decides whether to activate or skip a scheduled listening slot based on real-time network conditions, provides a practical, scalable, and energy-aware scheduling mechanism for next-generation low-power IIoT networks.

2604.07535.tldr: Although the presence of urgency in human-AI interactions does not affect the trust in AI, it may be detrimental to the human user's self-confidence and self-efficacy, which may lead to performance loss, suboptimal decisions, human errors, and ultimately, unsustainable AI systems.
