2604.07546.tldr: It is argued that existing copyright frameworks are ill-equipped to govern AI agent-mediated interactions that occur at scale, speed, and with limited human oversight, and a supervised multi-agent governance framework is developed that integrates legal rules and principles, technical protocols, and institutional oversight.

2604.07551.tldr: A defense-placement-oriented security analysis of MCP is presented, introducing a layer-aligned taxonomy that organizes attacks by the architectural component responsible for enforcement that suggests that many MCP security weaknesses stem from architectural misalignment rather than isolated implementation flaws.

2604.07553.tldr: A framework for generating the gold-standard summary fully automatically and reproducibly based on multiple human summaries of Turkish educational videos is presented, and the proposed AutoMUP (Automatic Meaning Unit Pyramid) method can be generalized to other Turkic languages at low cost.

2604.07558.tldr: Generative experience is introduced as a paradigm for DMH support, where the intervention experience is composed at runtime in GUIDE, a system that generates personalized intervention content and multimodal interaction structure through rubric-guided generation of modular components.

2604.07559.tldr: The Dual-Loop Control Framework is introduced, a digital twin-based architecture designed to overcome challenges in balancing energy efficiency with outage risk and improves policy interpretability and supports more trustworthy DRL deployment.

2604.07569.tldr: It is argued LLMs are best seen as an instance of lossy compression, where over training they learn by retaining only information in their training data relevant to their objective(s), and pre-training results in models that are optimally compressed for next-sequence prediction, approaching the Information Bottleneck bound on compression.

2604.07584.tldr: This workflow demonstrates a practical approach for converting unstructured technical literature into traceable, analysis-ready datasets without task-specific fine-tuning, enabling scalable database construction in materials science.

2604.07585.tldr: This work underscores the need for repeated measurements to assess a brand's GEO performance and to characterize visibility as a distribution rather than a single-point outcome in generative engine optimization.

2604.07590.tldr: D (Domain-Collection-Document), a domain-oriented design to structure knowledge and control query processing in RAG systems without modifying the underlying language model, is introduced.

2604.07591.tldr: This paper reframes annotation as a measurement process and introduces a statistical framework for decomposing labeling outcomes into interpretable sources of variation: instance difficulty, annotator bias, situational noise, and relational alignment.

2604.07601.tldr: This symposium focuses on a collection of partnership projects that all involve Google and all address AI literacy as a comparative set of examples, and identifies at what points in the life cycle do research, practice, and industry partnerships clearly intersect.

2604.07612.tldr: A latent diffusion model generates instrumental accompaniment in response to a live stream of context audio as a sliding-window look-ahead protocol, training the model to predict future audio from partial context, where system latency is a critical constraint.

2604.07622.tldr: This work proposes Dynamic Verification Relaxed Speculative Decoding (DIVERSED), a relaxed verification framework that improves time efficiency while preserving generation quality and achieves substantially higher inference efficiency compared to standard speculative decoding methods.

2604.07632.tldr: It is shown that an intermediate modality can strictly reduce effective hardness even when direct alignment remains infeasible, and bridging via composed projection families is defined, in a concrete ReLU setting, that an intermediate modality can strictly reduce effective hardness even when direct alignment remains infeasible.

2604.07639.tldr: This work proves that a small quantum computer of polylogarithmic size can perform large-scale classification and dimension reduction on massive classical data by processing samples on the fly, whereas any classical machine achieving the same prediction performance requires exponentially larger size.

2604.07644.tldr: GPU-SLS, a GPU-parallelized framework for safe, robust nonlinear model predictive control (MPC) that scales to high-dimensional uncertain robotic systems and long planning horizons, achieves 100% empirical safety, unlike high-dimensional learning-based reachability baselines.

2604.07645.tldr: PRIME (Proactive Reasoning via Iterative Memory Evolution), a gradient-free learning framework that enables continuous agent evolvement through explicit experience accumulation rather than expensive parameter optimization, is introduced.

2604.07650.tldr: This work develops a statistical framework for auditing behavioral entanglement among black-box LLMs and demonstrates a practical use case of entanglement through de-entangled verifier ensemble reweighting through de-entangled verifier ensemble reweighting.

2604.07651.tldr: CauPsi is a cognitive science-grounded causal multi-task learning framework that explicitly models the hierarchical dependencies among Traffic Context Recognition (TCR), Vehicle Context Recognition (VCR), Driver Emotion Recognition (DER), and Driver Behavior Recognition (DBR).

2604.07652.tldr: This work presents a two-stage workflow that translates natural language WIA questions into interactive visual interfaces via an intermediate representation, powered by the Praxa Specification Language (PSL), demonstrating that the intermediate specification is critical for reliably bridging NL and interactive WIA interface in LLM-powered WIA systems.

2604.07658.tldr: Pre-training at 180M-440M scales shows consistent zero-shot language modeling improvements, significant long-context retrieval gains for Mamba-2 (MQAR and NIAH), and competitive or improved performance across other architectures.

2604.07666.tldr: Noise rates up to 15% yield peak validation accuracy within 2 percentage points of the clean baseline, and results indicate that imperfect verification does not constitute a fundamental barrier to RLVR, suggesting that practitioners should prioritize moderate accuracy with high precision over perfect verification.

2604.07667.tldr: Conformal Social Choice, a post-hoc decision layer that converts debate outputs into calibrated act-versus-escalate decisions is introduced, a post-hoc decision layer that converts debate outputs into calibrated act-versus-escalate decisions.

2604.07669.tldr: MolReAct is introduced, a framework that formulates lead optimization as a Markov Decision Process over a synthesis-constrained action space defined by validated reaction templates, and produces molecules that are not only property-improved but each accompanied by an explicit template-grounded synthetic pathway.

2604.07681.tldr: This work establishes a flexible paradigm for LLM-driven scientific automation on HPC systems, with broad applicability to materials discovery and beyond, and presents a scalable, hierarchical multi-agent framework for orchestrating high-throughput screening campaigns.

2604.07687.tldr: A joint optimization problem of DMI task offloading, inference optimization and UAV trajectory planning as the system utility maximization (SUM) problem to address the fidelity-delay tradeoff for the GAI-empowered ITDT is investigated and a sequential update-based heterogeneous-agent twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm is proposed.

2604.07695.tldr: This work presents AITH (AI Trust Handshake), a post-quantum continuous delegation protocol that validate AITH through five rounds of multi-model adversarial auditing, resolving 12 vulnerabilities across four severity layers.

2604.07727.tldr: It is empirically demonstrated that hidden states in critical layers during the decoding phase carry stronger and more stable risk signals than input jailbreak prompts, confirming that hidden-state trajectories during decoding can effectively support real-time jailbreak detection.

2604.07729.tldr: Internal representations of emotion concepts are found, which encode the broad concept of a particular emotion and generalize across contexts and behaviors it might be linked to and causally influence the LLM's outputs, including Claude's preferences and its rate of exhibiting misaligned behaviors.

2604.07733.tldr: CivBench is introduced, a benchmark for LLM strategists (i.e., agentic setups) in multiplayer Civilization V, and its potential to estimate strategic capabilities as an unsaturated benchmark is demonstrated, revealing model-specific effects of agentic setup, and outline distinct strategic profiles not visible through outcome-only evaluation.

2604.07740.tldr: CG-CLIP is proposed, a novel caption-guided CLIP framework that leverages explicit textual descriptions and learnable tokens to efficiently aggregate spatiotemporal features, reducing computational overhead.

2604.07745.tldr: It is argued that a central design lever is where control resides in LLM systems, bounded services, Cartesian agents, and integrated agents as contrasting approaches to control that trade off autonomy, robustness, and oversight.

2604.07747.tldr: Hint scaffolding is effective when it restores learnable updates on challenging questions early in training and is then gradually removed before no-hint evaluation, suggesting that, in math RLVR, hint scaffolding is effective when it restores learnable updates on challenging questions early in training and is then gradually removed before no-hint evaluation.

2604.07752.tldr: MIMIC-Py is presented, a Python-based automated game-testing tool that transforms personality-driven LLM agents into a reusable and extensible framework that enables deployment to new game environments with minimal engineering effort.

2604.07758.tldr: DailyArt is presented, which formulates articulated joint estimation from a single static image as a synthesis-mediated reasoning problem, and achieves strong performance in articulated joint estimation and supports part-level novel state synthesis conditioned on joints.

2604.07763.tldr: This study not only empirically proves the existence of universal forgery traces but also achieves significant performance breakthroughs on unknown modalities via the MAF framework, offering a pioneering technical pathway for universal multimodal defense.

2604.07766.tldr: LSLORA, which restricts LoRA adaptation to layers identified via a novel correctness-differential hidden-state metric, and GARFA (GQA-Aware RoPE Frequency Adaptation), which attaches 8 learnable per-KV-head scalar multipliers to each targeted layer are introduced.

2604.07778.tldr: The central result, the Accountability Incompleteness Theorem, proves that for any collective whose compound autonomy exceeds the Accountability Horizon and whose interaction graph contains a human-AI feedback cycle, no framework can satisfy all four properties simultaneously.

2604.07781.tldr: This paper presents a practical graph learning framework for 3D engineering AI, in which heterogeneous engineering assets are converted into physics-aware graph representations and processed by Graph Neural Networks (GNNs).

2604.07784.tldr: Agentic Engineering Intelligence (AEI), an industrial vision framework that models engineering workflows as constrained, history-aware sequential decision processes in which AI agents support engineer-supervised interventions over engineering toolchains, is presented.

2604.07799.tldr: This work introduces the concept of Embodied Capability Modules (ECMs), which represent modular, versioned units of embodied functionality that can be learned, refined, and composed over time, and presents a unified framework in which capability evolution is decoupled from agent identity.

2604.07801.tldr: A controlled emotion translation framework is developed that rewrites problems into emotional variants while preserving all quantities and relationships, showing both that the degradation is tied to emotional style rather than content corruption and that neutralization can serve as a lightweight inference-time mitigation.

2604.07802.tldr: This work proposes latent anomaly knowledge excavation (LAKE), a training-free framework that identifies and elicits these critical neuronal signals using only a minimal set of normal samples and constructs a highly compact normality representation that integrates visual structural deviations with cross-modal semantic activations.

2604.07803.tldr: The extent to which computer vision research is being used in the military and surveillance domains is studied by collecting a dataset of tech companies with financial ties to the field's central research exchange platform: conferences, revealing that 44% have a direct connection with military or surveillance applications.

2604.07809.tldr: PolicyLong is proposed, shifting data construction towards a dynamic on-policy paradigm, by iteratively re-executing data screening (entropy computation, retrieval, and verification) using the current model, which ensures the training distribution tracks evolving capabilities, yielding an emergent self-curriculum.

2604.07813.tldr: The importance of Agentivism lies in explaining how learning remains possible when intelligent delegation is easy and human-AI interaction is becoming a persistent and expanding part of human learning.

2604.07821.tldr: This work builds a turn-based multi-agent environment that strips away all strategic complexity, making cooperation costless and trivially optimal, and finds that several capable models actively withhold information despite gaining nothing from withholding.

2604.07822.tldr: Recurrent-depth transformers, which enables iterative computation over the same transformer layers, are studied, which shows that while vanilla transformers struggle with both generalization challenges, recurrent-depth transformers can effectively make such generalization.

2604.07835.tldr: Contextual Representation Ablation (CRA), a novel inference-time intervention framework designed to dynamically silence model guardrails and expose the intrinsic fragility of current alignment mechanisms, revealing that safety constraints can be surgically ablated from internal representations.

2604.07837.tldr: SPARD is proposed, a framework that establishes an automated, self-paced curriculum by perceiving learning progress to dynamically adjust multi-objective reward weights and data importance, thereby synchronizing learning intent with data utility for optimal performance.

2604.07851.tldr: ReRec is proposed, a novel reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) framework designed to improve LLM reasoning in complex recommendation tasks and demonstrates that ReRec outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and preserves core abilities like instruction-following and general knowledge.

2604.07853.tldr: This work proposes QaRL (Rollout Alignment Quantization-Aware RL), which aligns training-side forward with the quantized rollout to minimize mismatch, and identifies a failure mode in quantized rollouts: long-form responses tend to produce repetitive, garbled tokens (error tokens).

2604.07855.tldr: These results formalize a standard claim in the neural decoding literature: local autoregressive sampling is easy, whereas exact decoding and exact conditioning under global form constraints are computationally intractable in general.

2604.07857.tldr: This survey proposes an energy accounting framework identifying computational and communication costs across the Perception-Reasoning-Action cycle, and establishes a unified taxonomy spanning model simplification, computation control, input and attention optimization, and hardware-aware inference.

2604.07863.tldr: A learned graph-memory retriever that constructs task-adaptive relevance graphs over agent histories using policy-gradient optimization from downstream task success, ACGM captures heterogeneous temporal dynamics with modality-specific decay and learns sparse connectivity.

2604.07872.tldr: This work introduces Metacognitive Evolutionary Programming (MEP), a framework that elevates the LLM to a strategic discovery agent and steering the LLM to reason strategically about the exploration-exploitation trade-off, discovers more effective and efficient heuristics applicable across a wide spectrum of VRP variants.

2604.07879.tldr: FlowGuard is introduced, a cross-model in-generation detection framework that inspects intermediate denoising steps in latent diffusion, where early-stage noise obscures visual signals in Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content.

2604.07884.tldr: This work proposes a reinforcement-guided synthetic data generation framework that adapts general-domain generative priors to privacy-sensitive identity recognition tasks, and introduces a multi-objective reward that jointly optimizes semantic consistency, coverage diversity, and expression richness.

2604.07894.tldr: TSUBASA is introduced, a two-pronged approach designed to improve memory writing via dynamic memory evolution, and memory reading via self-learning with a context distillation objective to internalize user experiences, delivering robust, high-fidelity personalization with a reduced token budget.

2604.07895.tldr: This paper introduces dialogue-conditioned BGM recommendation, where a model should select non-intrusive, fitting music for a multi-turn conversation that often contains no music descriptors.

2604.07897.tldr: This paper tackles inductive rule learning problems from images with a framework called {\gamma}ILP, which provides a fully differentiable pipeline from image constant substitution to rule structure induction.

2604.07900.tldr: AnomalyAgent is an anomaly synthesis agent with self-reflection, knowledge retrieval, and iterative refinement capabilities, aiming to generate realistic and diverse anomalies, and is equipped with five tools, enabling closed-loop optimization.

2604.07907.tldr: The key insight is that capture positions anchor the labeling to externally verified sub-models, breaking the circularity that allows trivial fixpoints (such as the all-draw labeling) to satisfy self-consistency alone.

2604.07911.tldr: Dynamic Attentional Context Scoping (DACS), a mechanism in which the orchestrator operates in two asymmetric modes, achieves 90.4% steering accuracy versus 21.0--60.0% for a flat-context baseline, and the accuracy advantage grows with N and D; keyword matching is validated by LLM-as-judge across all phases.

2604.07914.tldr: MESA targets hallucination-relevant responses while preserving the model's original token distribution, enabling effective hallucination reduction without compromising generation behavior, outperforming prior methods across multiple LVLM families.

2604.07922.tldr: Stepwise Adaptive Thinking (SAT) is introduced, a framework that performs step-level, difficulty-aware pruning while preserving the core reasoning structure in a Finite-State Machine.

2604.07925.tldr: It is shown that doubly stochastic attention matrices normalized with Sinkhorn algorithm preserve rank more effectively than standard Softmax row-stochastic ones, and a theoretical bound for the pure self-attention rank decay is derived when using Sinkhorn normalization.

2604.07929.tldr: A trace-level evaluation framework that compares human and agent behavior across task outcome and effort, query formulation, and navigation across interface states shows that outcome and query alignment do not imply behavioral alignment.

2604.07944.tldr: This paper builds on the GPT-Driver framework, which represents driving scenes as language prompts and generates waypoint trajectories with chain-of-thought reasoning, and investigates two student training paradigms: on-policy generalized knowledge distillation (GKD), which trains the student on its own self-generated outputs using dense token-level feedback from the teacher.

2604.07951.tldr: The results suggest that deep reinforcement learning can be helpful to find non-intuitive, optimal circuit structures, providing a pathway toward efficient, hardware-aware quantum algorithm design.

2604.07953.tldr: A holistic evaluation framework that explicitly explores the balance of predictive performance and resource consumption in TSC, and applies a theoretically bounded pruning strategy to leading hybrid classifiers - Hydra and Quant - and presents Hydrant, a novel, prunable combination of both.

2604.07957.tldr: WorldMAP is presented, a teacher--student framework that converts world-model-generated futures into persistent semantic-spatial structure and planning-derived supervision that suggests the value of world models may lie less in supplying action-ready imagined evidence than in synthesizing structured supervision for navigation learning.

2604.07963.tldr: DoGraph is introduced, a reweighting framework that formulates data scheduling as a graph-constrained optimization problem and consistently achieves competitive performance on GPT-2 models of varying scales.

2604.07964.tldr: It is argued that machine-driven assessment may systematically favor standardized, pattern-conforming research while penalizing unconventional and paradigm-shifting ideas that require contextual human judgment, which could lead to epistemic homogenization.

2604.07965.tldr: Dynamic Subspace Concept Alignment (DSCA) is introduced which by design mitigates this limitation by decomposing the representation space into a set of orthogonal semantic subspaces and proposing edits only in those transformed spaces.

2604.07967.tldr: AtomEval provides a stable evaluation target for evaluating adversarial rewriters that must balance verifier evasion with proposition preservation, and provides fine-grained diagnostics that explain both proposition-level failures and non-minimal valid rewrites.

2604.07973.tldr: This work comprehensively assess 17 representative models, including non-reasoning LMMs, reasoning LMMs, agent-based methods, and vision-language-action models, and reveals an intriguing phenomenon: navigation errors do not accumulate linearly but instead diverge rapidly from the destination after a critical decision bifurcation.

2604.07981.tldr: This paper decomposes long-context reasoning into a set of fundamental atomic skills, and automatically synthesizes a suite of pseudo datasets, each explicitly targeting a specific atomic skill, which confirms that proficiency in these atomic skills is strongly correlated with general long-text reasoning performance.

2604.07988.tldr: This paper proposes a new abstraction called LogAct, where each agent is a deconstructed state machine playing a shared log, allowing the agent to analyze its own execution history using LLM inference, which in turn enables semantic variants of recovery, health check, and optimization.

2604.07989.tldr: An intent-aware infographic retrieval framework that better aligns user queries with infographic designs and can adapt the designs to their own data with high-level edit intents, supported by an interactive agent that performs low-level adaptation.

2604.08000.tldr: This work proposes DD-MM-PAS (Demand Detection, Memory Modeling, Proactive Agent System) as a general paradigm for streaming proactive AI agent and introduces LatentNeeds-Bench, a real-world benchmark built from user-consented data and refined through thousands of rounds of human editing.

2604.08001.tldr: A comprehensive analysis of major competition platforms such as Kaggle and Zindi, examining their workflows, evaluation methodologies, and reward structures and demonstrates that MLCs function at the intersection of academic research and industrial application, fostering the exchange of knowledge, data, and practical methodologies across domains.

2604.08004.tldr: It is hypothesized that robust CX generation methods will be better suited to address the challenge of providing valid and plausible counterfactuals when inputs are incomplete, and that while robust CX methods achieve higher validity than non-robust ones, all methods struggle to find valid counterfactuals.

2604.08008.tldr: This work introduces SearchAD, a large-scale rare image retrieval dataset for AD containing over 423k frames drawn from 11 established datasets, and establishes the first large-scale dataset for retrieval-driven data curation and long-tail perception research in AD.

2604.08030.tldr: This paper operationalizes personalization as individual actionability, characterized along two dimensions: hard constraints that specify which features are individually actionable, and soft, individualized constraints that capture preferences over action values and costs within the causal algorithmic recourse framework.

2604.08032.tldr: It is revealed that while these explanations are highly valuable in complex multi-vessel encounters, they can increase cognitive workload, suggesting that future maritime interfaces may benefit most from demand-driven or scenario-specific explanation strategies.

2604.08033.tldr: The Spatial Trajectory Graph is introduced, a neurosymbolic paradigm built on a “verify-before-commit” discipline that transforms open-ended planning into a verifiable optimization problem by grounding semantic hypotheses against a physical world model and cleanly separating language inference from deterministic scheduling.

2604.08037.tldr: Comparative experiments on the present setup show the feasibility of privacy-aware personalized talking-head training in federated environments, while suggesting that stronger component-wise, privacy-utility, and qualitative claims need further standardized evaluation.

2604.08039.tldr: LINE is introduced, a novel, training-free iterative approach tailored for open-vocabulary concept labeling in vision models that achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple model architectures, and provides a complete generation history, enabling polysemanticity evaluation and producing visual explanations that rival gradient-dependent activation maximization methods.

2604.08042.tldr: 3DrawAgent is introduced, a training-free, language-driven framework for 3D sketch generation that leverages large language models to sequentially draw 3D Bezier curves under geometric feedback and introduces a relative experience optimization strategy that adapts the recently proposed Group Reward Policy Optimization (GRPO) paradigm.

2604.08062.tldr: This work presents a gaze-grounded multimodal LLM assistant that uses egocentric video with gaze overlays to identify likely points of difficulty and target follow-up retrospective assistance and suggests that gaze-aware LLM assistants can reason about cognitive needs to improve cognitive outcomes of users.

2604.08070.tldr: This paper introduces AtlasOCR, the first open-source Darija OCR model built by fine-tuning a 3B parameter Vision Language Model (VLM), and details the comprehensive approach, from curating a unique Darija-specific dataset leveraging both synthetic generation with OCRSmith library and carefully sourced real-world data, to implementing efficient fine-tuning strategies.

2604.08113.tldr: This work proposes TADP-RME (Trust-Adaptive Differential Privacy with Reverse Manifold Embedding), a framework that enhances reliability under varying levels of user trust and consistently outperforms existing methods against inference attacks, providing a unified approach for reliable learning in adversarial environments.

2604.08115.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that Revise effectively corrects OCR outputs, enabling more structured representation and systematic management of document contents, highlighting the potential to overcome the structural management limitations of existing Document AI frameworks.

2604.08120.tldr: Crucially, Tempo compresses hour-long videos substantially below theoretical limits, proving true long-form video understanding relies on intent-driven efficiency rather than greedily padded context windows.

2604.08121.tldr: A unified flow method that performs continuous flow matching for video and discrete flow matching for text within a single process, enabling coherent multimodal generation and validating generation-centric architectures as a scalable path toward unified multimodal intelligence.

2604.08123.tldr: A case for micro-serving diffusion workflows with LegoDiffusion, a system that decomposes a workflow into loosely coupled model-execution nodes that can be independently managed and scheduled, which outperforms existing diffusion workflow serving systems.

2604.08124.tldr: A novel framework, Hierarchical Experience (HiExp), is proposed, to enhance the performance and training stability of search agents and extract empirical knowledge through contrastive analysis and a multi-level clustering mechanism, transforming raw reasoning trajectories into hierarchical experience knowledge.

2604.08133.tldr: This work introduces the concept of \emph{activation budget} as a constraint on the number of expert activations and proposes Alloc-MoE, a unified framework that optimizes budget allocation coordinately at both the layer and token levels to minimize performance degradation.

2604.08140.tldr: A Byte-Grounded Traffic Description (BGTD) benchmark for the first time is proposed, combining raw bytes with structured expert annotations to address data scarcity and provides necessary behavioral features and verifiable chains of evidence for multimodal reasoning towards explainable encrypted traffic interpretation.

2604.08159.tldr: Face-D(^2)CL, a framework for facial DeepFake detection, leverages multi-domain synergistic representation to fuse spatial and frequency-domain features for the comprehensive capture of diverse forgery traces, and employs a dual continual learning mechanism that combines Elastic Weight Consolidation and Orthogonal Gradient Constraint.

2604.08168.tldr: ViVa is a video-generative value model that repurposes a pretrained video generator to jointly predict future proprioception and a scalar value, and achieves state-of-the-art results in metric-based evaluation across three tasks.

2604.08169.tldr: Three methods to substantially recover alignment in LLMs are implemented, and honesty steering generalizes to out-of-distribution scenarios: a single honesty direction extracted from the aligned model significantly raises scores on the MASK benchmark, suppresses deception in multi-agent settings, doubles the hidden-behavior discovery rate on AuditBench, and restores honesty in an emergently misaligned model.

2604.08171.tldr: OceanMAE is an ocean-specific masked autoencoder that extends standard MAE pre-training by integrating multispectral Sentinel-2 observations with physically meaningful ocean descriptors during self-supervised learning to learn more informative and ocean-aware latent representations from large- scale unlabeled data.

2604.08178.tldr: This work presents Plan-RewardBench, a trajectory-level preference benchmark designed to evaluate how well judges distinguish preferred versus distractor agent trajectories in complex tool-using scenarios, and reveals that all three evaluator families face substantial challenges.

2604.08184.tldr: The All-Type Audio Deepfake Detection (AT-ADD) Grand Challenge for ACM Multimedia 2026 is proposed, designed to bridge controlled academic evaluation with practical multimedia forensics, and aims to accelerate the development of robust and generalizable audio forensic technologies.

2604.08203.tldr: This work introduces MedVR, a novel reinforcement learning framework that enables annotation-free visual reasoning for medical VLMs and achieves state-of-the-art performance on diverse public medical VQA benchmarks, significantly outperforming existing models.

2604.08226.tldr: The Clinical World Model is introduced, a framework that formalizes care as a tripartite interaction among Patient, Provider, and Ecosystem and supplies a common grammar through which clinical AI can be specified, evaluated, and bounded across stakeholders.

2604.08232.tldr: A tailored training pipeline comprising hybrid supervised fine-tuning as a cold start, followed by online reinforcement learning with the proposed hybrid reasoning strategy to explicitly activate reasoning only for high-entropy actions is proposed, significantly reducing computational overhead while improving decision quality.

2604.08245.tldr: This work establishes a new theoretical foundation and technical path for next-generation AI with physical common sense, causal reasoning, and mathematical rigor by embedding physical meta-principles into neural network architecture by constructing the Meta-Principle Physics Architecture.

2604.08260.tldr: Behavior-Aware Item Modeling (BAIM) is proposed, a framework that enriches item representations by integrating dynamic procedural solution information, and consistently outperforms strong pretraining-based baselines under repeated learner interactions.

2604.08263.tldr: Responsible-DKT is proposed, a neural-symbolic deep knowledge tracing approach that integrates symbolic educational knowledge into sequential neural models for responsible learner modelling and offers intrinsic interpretability via a grounded computation graph that exposes the logic behind each prediction, enabling both local and global explanations.

2604.08276.tldr: The Asymmetric Collaborative Framework is proposed, which structurally decouples covert communication from semantic reasoning via orthogonal statistical and cognitive layers via orthogonal statistical and cognitive layers by deploying a prefix-independent decoding paradigm governed by a shared steganographic configuration.

2604.08284.tldr: The results suggest that rule knowledge is not uniformly localized, and therefore cannot be reliably edited by a single-layer or contiguous-block intervention, and proposes Distributed Multi-Layer Editing (DMLE), which applies a shared early-layer update to formulas and descriptions and a separate middle-layer update to instances.

2604.08293.tldr: The results indicate that a structured, standards-oriented approach can effectively guide LLMs in producing system-level architectural documentation that is both usable and cost-effective.

2604.08294.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLMs across activity domains, establishing a rigorous baseline for future VLM-based AQA research and providing an actionable outline for failure modes requiring mitigation prior to reliable real-world deployment.

2604.08295.tldr: U-CECE is proposed, a unified, model-agnostic multi-resolution framework for conceptual counterfactual explanations that adapts to data regime and compute budget and shows that the retrieved structural counterfactuals are semantically equivalent to, and often preferred over, exact GED-based ground-truth explanations.

2604.08304.tldr: Mapping attacks, defenses, remediation, and evaluation onto a six-stage knowledge-access pipeline, this work exposes two structural mismatches in RAG.

2604.08305.tldr: HistDiT is introduced, a novel latent conditional Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that establishes a new benchmark for visual fidelity in virtual histological staining and outperforms existing baselines, as demonstrated through rigorous quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

2604.08326.tldr: This work introduces ProMedical, a unified alignment framework grounded in fine-grained clinical criteria that generalizes robustly to external benchmarks, demonstrating performance comparable to state-of-the-art models on UltraMedical.

2604.08333.tldr: As the first attempt to dissect classification performance degradation in medical MLLMs, the findings reveal four failure modes: quality limitation in visual representation, fidelity loss in connector projection, comprehension deficit in LLM reasoning, and misalignment of semantic mapping.

2604.08335.tldr: A feedforward graph architecture in which heterogeneous frozen large language models serve as computational nodes, communicating through a shared continuous latent space via learned linear projections, and Gradient flow through multiple frozen model boundaries is empirically verified to be tractable.

2604.08337.tldr: InstAP, an Instance-Aware Pre-training framework that jointly optimizes global vision-text alignment and fine-grained, instance-level contrastive alignment by grounding textual mentions to specific spatial-temporal regions, is introduced.

2604.08340.tldr: PokeGym is introduced, a visually-driven long-horizon benchmark instantiated within Pokemon Legends: Z-A, a visually complex 3D open-world Role-Playing Game and reveals a key limitation of current VLMs: physical deadlock recovery, rather than high-level planning, constitutes the primary bottleneck, with deadlocks showing a strong negative correlation with task success.

2604.08344.tldr: It is suggested that GenAI reshapes the distribution of regulatory responsibility in collaboration and offer implications for the human-centred design of AI-supported collaborative learning.

2604.08358.tldr: A convolutional neural network decoder is introduced that exploits the geometric structure of QEC codes, and is used to probe a novel "waterfall" regime of error suppression, demonstrating that the logical error rates required for large-scale fault-tolerant algorithms are attainable with modest code sizes at current physical error rates, and within the real-time budgets of several leading hardware platforms.

2604.08366.tldr: This work proposes Mixture Optimization via Scaling-Aware Iterative Collection (MOSAIC), a general data selection framework that operates by partitioning the dataset into domains and optimizing a data mixture by iteratively adding data from domains that maximize the change in metrics.

2604.08369.tldr: TrACE is the first training-free, per-timestep adaptive-compute controller for LLM agents to be evaluated on multi-step sequential decision tasks, and it is shown that inter-rollout agreement is a reliable signal of step-level success.

2604.08377.tldr: SkillClaw is a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-user agent ecosystems, which treats cross-user and over-time interactions as the primary signal for improving skills and enables cross-user knowledge transfer and cumulative capability improvement.

2604.08381.tldr: A Generative Adversarial Network and Large Language Model-driven data augmentation framework to dynamically model users'linguistic patterns for enhanced Chinese sarcasm detection, which outperforms all existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches.

2604.08384.tldr: Across multiple source-to-target adaptation settings, TASU2 improves in-domain and out-of-domain recognition over TASU, and consistently outperforms strong baselines including text-only fine-tuning and TTS-based augmentation, while mitigating source-domain performance degradation.

2604.08388.tldr: Together, these results show that heavy domain supervised fine-tuning can suppress general tool-use ability without permanently erasing it, and that a small amount of domain-specific agentic data can awaken dormant tool-use capabilities.

2604.08395.tldr: This work demonstrates for the first time that the stealthiness of existing VLM backdoor attacks has been substantially overestimated and introduces Phantasia, a context-adaptive backdoor attack that dynamically aligns its poisoned outputs with the semantics of each input.

2604.08398.tldr: A new pre-training paradigm for time-series data called ADAPT is presented, which can efficiently align the physical properties of data in the time-series domain, enabling mixed-batch pre-training despite the extreme discrepancies in the input sizes and channel dimensions of pre-training data.

2604.08400.tldr: This work recasts the multivariate time series forecasting problem as a series of scalar regression problems which can be solved zero-shot by any tabular foundation model with regression capabilities, and introduces a generally applicable framework for multivariate time series forecasting using tabular foundation models.

2604.08401.tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework that enforces verification over internal belief states within the agent before action commitment, achieving faithful reasoning, and structurally generates persona-based diverse candidate beliefs for selection under a faithfulness-relevant structure space.

2604.08412.tldr: It is shown that, in multi-speaker environments with temporally ambiguous utterances, the device-addressed speech detection task is more effectively modelled as a sequential routing problem over interaction history than as an utterance-local classification task.

2604.08418.tldr: A revised version of DMBN-Positional Time Encoding is proposed, termed DMBN-Positional Time Encoding (DMBN-PTE), that facilitates learning a more robust representation of temporal information, and preliminary results of its effectiveness in expanding the applicability of the architecture are provided.

2604.08423.tldr: A reinforcement learning primitive, the Dataset Policy Gradient (DPG), which can precisely optimize synthetic data generators to produce a dataset of targeted examples to suggest that DPG is a powerful and flexible technique for shaping model properties using only synthetic training examples.

2604.08424.tldr: This work addresses eXplainable Artificial Intelligence for onboard Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery within the Attitude and Orbit Control Subsystem by introducing a framework that enhances interpretability in neural anomaly detectors by proposing a method to derive low-dimensional, semantically annotated encodings from intermediate neural activations, called peepholes.

2604.08425.tldr: DiADEM, a neural architecture that learns how much each demographic axis matters for predicting who will disagree and on what, is introduced, demonstrating that explicitly modeling who annotators are not just what they label is essential for NLP systems that aim to faithfully represent human interpretive diversity.

2604.08426.tldr: This work evaluates modern KV offloading on Text2JSON and other context-intensive tasks and finds significant performance degradation on both Llama 3 and Qwen 3 models, highlighting the need for a comprehensive and rigorous evaluation of long-context compression techniques.

2604.08432.tldr: This work establishes a practical pathway from simulation to experimental demonstration of photonic KANs using commodity telecom hardware, and uses a fully differentiable physics model for end-to-end optimisation of optical parameters.

2604.08435.tldr: This work proposes HST-HGN, a novel Heterogeneous Spatial-Temporal Hypergraph Network driven by Bidirectional State Space Models, which encapsulates high-order synergistic facial deformations, effectively overcoming the limitations of conventional methods.

2604.08455.tldr: KnowU-Bench is introduced, an online benchmark for personalized mobile agents built on a reproducible Android emulation environment, covering 42 general GUI tasks, 86 personalized tasks, and 64 proactive tasks, and provides comprehensive evaluation of the complete proactive decision chain, evaluated through a hybrid protocol combining rule-based verification with LLM-as-a-Judge scoring.

2604.08460.tldr: This work investigates how to recover component-level health indicators from operational sensor data under realistic degradation and maintenance patterns and introduces self-supervised learning approaches that learn latent representations without access to true health labels, a scenario reflective of real-world operational constraints.

2604.08461.tldr: This paper proposes OVS-DINO, a novel framework that revitalizes latent edge-sensitivity of DINO through structural alignment with the Segment Anything Model (SAM), and introduces a Structure-Aware Encoder and a Structure-Modulated Decoder to effectively activate boundary features of DINO using SAM's structural priors.

2604.08465.tldr: It is argued that architectural design choices outperform model selection as a primary alignment strategy in deployed multi-agent analytical systems and poses a structural challenge for Computer System Validation of such platforms in regulated environments, for which two architectural mitigations are proposed.

2604.08468.tldr: Test-Time Variational Synthesis is introduced, a novel framework that enables LRMs to self-evolve by dynamically augmenting the training stream from unlabeled test queries, and outperforms state-of-the-art supervised RL-based techniques trained on vast, high-quality labeled data.

2604.08476.tldr: Faithful GRPO is proposed, a variant of GRPO that enforces consistency and grounding as constraints via Lagrangian dual ascent and substantially improves reasoning quality, reducing the inconsistency rate and improving visual grounding scores.

2604.08499.tldr: PIArena is introduced, a unified and extensible platform for prompt injection evaluation that enables users to easily integrate state-of-the-art attacks and defenses and evaluate them across a variety of existing and new benchmarks.

2604.08502.tldr: The C-Score (Consistency Score), a confidence-weighted, annotation-free metric that quantifies intra-class explanation reproducibility via intensity-emphasised pairwise soft IoU across correctly classified instances, is proposed.

2604.08504.tldr: The study of language generation in the limit is initiated, a model recently introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan, and it is proved that no $\varepsilon$-DP algorithm can identify a collection containing two languages with an infinite intersection and a finite set difference, a condition far stronger than the classical non-private characterization of identification.

2604.08523.tldr: ClawBench is introduced, an evaluation framework of 153 simple tasks that people need to accomplish regularly in their lives and work, spanning 144 live platforms across 15 categories, from completing purchases and booking appointments to submitting job applications.

2604.08524.tldr: It is shown that steering vectors can be sparsified by up to 90-99% while retaining most performance, and that different steering methodologies agree on a subset of important dimensions, and that different steering methodologies agree on a subset of important dimensions.

2604.08525.tldr: This paper provides a framework for categorizing the ways in which conflicting incentives might lead LLMs to change the way they interact with users, inspired by literature from linguistics and advertising regulation and presents a suite of evaluations to examine how current models handle these tradeoffs.

2604.08529.tldr: PSI identifies shared state as the missing systems layer that transforms AI-generated personal software from isolated apps into coherent personal computing environments and shows that later-generated instruments can be integrated automatically through the same contract.

2604.08536.tldr: This work introduces RewardFlow, an inversion-free framework that steers pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models at inference time through multi-reward Langevin dynamics, and introduces a differentiable VQA-based reward that provides fine-grained semantic supervision through language-vision reasoning.

2604.08540.tldr: A multi-granular evaluation framework that combines lightweight specialist models with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is proposed, enabling evaluation from perceptual quality to fine-grained semantic controllability inText-to-Audio-Video generation.

2604.08541.tldr: The Routing Distraction hypothesis is proposed: when processing visual inputs, the routing mechanism fails to adequately activate task-relevant reasoning experts, and a routing-guided intervention method is designed that enhances domain expert activation.

2604.08545.tldr: HDRO is a framework that reframes tool efficiency from a competing scalar objective to a strictly conditional one, and maintains two orthogonal optimization channels: an accuracy channel that maximizes task correctness, and an efficiency channel that enforces execution economy exclusively within accurate trajectories via conditional advantage estimation.

2507.14787.tldr: FOCUS is presented, the first framework that enables reliable and efficient spatial-spectral interpretability for frozen ViTs, and makes high-resolution ViT interpretability practical for real-world hyperspectral applications, bridging a long-standing gap between black-box modeling and trustworthy HSI decision-making.

2503.18836.tldr: A novel framework, called Dual-domain Multi-path Self-supervised Diffusion Model (DMSM), that integrates a self-supervised dual-domain diffusion model training scheme, a lightweight hybrid attention network for the reconstruction diffusion model, and a multi-path inference strategy, to enhance reconstruction accuracy, efficiency, and explainability.

2509.10546.tldr: This work introduces a controllable black-box multi-turn risk-concealed red-teaming framework (CoRT) that progressively conceals surface-level risk while exploiting regulatory-violating behaviors.

2409.10588.tldr: A viral evolution simulator using the Absolut! framework is built, in which shapers successfully target both current and future viral variants, outperforming myopic antibodies, and it is shown that shapers modify the distribution over viral evolutionary trajectories to result in weaker variants.

2503.05587.tldr: This work identifies and study spurious features in the RAG paradigm, a robustness issue caused by the sensitivity of LLMs to semantic-agnostic features, and proposes a novel framework, SURE, to empirically quantify the robustness of RALMs against spurious features.

2506.11480.tldr: A novel gradient-alignment-based method, named LearnAlign, which intelligently selects the learnable and representative training reasoning data for RLVR post-training, and introduces the data learnability based on the success rate, which indicates the learning potential of each data point.

2505.16024.tldr: In the nonlinear Gaussian mixture regime, it is proved that distilling composite steps incurs unavoidable approximation error due to the exponential growth of mixture components, and it is quantified how these errors amplify across merges.

2309.06020.tldr: A comprehensive dataset of 341,740 SATD items from 2,568,728 commits across 1,060 Apache repositories is curated and analyzed, and an innovative approach for Predicting Repayment Effort of SATD using Textual Information is proposed, named PRESTI.

2504.20018.tldr: This paper defines multi-vector search index tuning and proposes a framework to solve it, and develops algorithms to find indexes that minimize latency and meet storage and recall constraints.

2502.03669.tldr: A novel analysis is introduced, serialization, which reveals that non-backtracking AI-inspired methods, e.g. LTFT (which is based on GFlowNets), end up reasoning similarly to the simplest degree-based greedy, and thus worse than KaMIS, which suggests a need for a rethinking of current approaches in AI for CO.

2508.08127.tldr: A hierarchical agent encoder to capture individual, neighborhood, and global interaction patterns of each agent, providing a comprehensive understanding for malicious agent detection and a corruption-guided detector that consists of directional noise injection and contrastive learning, allowing effective detection model training solely on normal agent behaviors.

2509.17255.tldr: These results establish a blueprint for the safe integration of agentic AI into accelerator experiments and demanding machine physics studies, as well as routine operations, with direct portability across accelerators worldwide and, more broadly, to other large-scale scientific infrastructures.

2502.05664.tldr: This paper introduces CodeSim, a novel multi-agent code generation framework that comprehensively addresses the stages of program synthesis-planning, coding, and debugging-through a human-like perception approach and shows potential for even greater enhancement when cascaded with external debuggers.

2406.11452.tldr: Experimental results show the RL method outperform the baseline reducing by 28% inter-core communications for random circuits for random circuits while minimising time-to-solution.

2508.00933.tldr: This work presents the first systematic effort to construct an Ocean Knowledge Graph (OKG) specifically designed to represent diverse ocean knowledge for SST prediction, and develops a graph embedding network to learn the comprehensive semantic and structural knowledge within the OKG.

2509.00081.tldr: This work proposes a novel methodology that combines ontology-driven structured outputs with Large Language Models (LLMs), to build an Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent that improves the accuracy and explainability of information extraction from cybersecurity logs.

2508.19679.tldr: This paper proposes \textbf{InquireMobile}, a novel model inspired by reinforcement learning, featuring a two-stage training strategy and an interactive pre-action reasoning mechanism, which achieves an 46.8% improvement in inquiry success rate and the best overall success rate among existing baselines on InquireBench.

2507.16079.tldr: This paper evaluates the number of linear regions of ternary regression NNs with Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) for activation functions and proves that the number of linear regions increases polynomially with respect to network width and exponentially with respect to depth, similar to standard NNs.

2503.04980.tldr: Through an expert consensus process, a framework for privacy evaluation in synthetic data was developed and there was consensus on the importance of membership and attribute disclosure, both of which involve inferring personal information.

2501.02548.tldr: This work proposes Adaptive Modularized Model (AMM), a modular planning architecture that separates a domain-specific observation adapter from a shared internal dynamics model defined in a common planning state space that improves both performance and data efficiency compared with existing conventional controllers and learning-based baselines.

2405.16730.tldr: This work shows that with a virtually scaled noise magnitude, the gradient of the NCE objective can closely align with that of Maximum Likelihood, enabling a trajectory-wise approximation from NCE to MLE, and faster convergence both theoretically and empirically.

2312.15020.tldr: The findings reveal that while early heuristic‐based techniques laid the foundation for SATD detection, more recent advancements in DL and Transformer models have significantly improved detection accuracy, however, challenges remain in scaling these models for broader industrial adoption.

2508.01495.tldr: WinkTPG is developed, a windowed execution framework that converts MAPF plans into safe and kinodynamically feasible speed profiles while maintaining precedence relations implied by the discrete plan.

2307.10803.tldr: A comprehensive survey of existing spatial-temporal data mining studies for ocean science is provided to help scientists from both computer science and ocean science better understand the fundamental concepts, key techniques, and open challenges of STDM for ocean science.

2502.14888.tldr: This work introduces the Modality Dominance Score (MDS), which attributes multimodal features to specific modalities by categorizing them into three classes: vision-dominant features, language-dominant features, and cross-modal features, and proposes automatic interpretability metrics to evaluate these modality-specific features in a scalable manner.

2508.01635.tldr: This work proposes USRFNet, a dual-stream framework that separates the modeling of demand and capacity, and introduces a Reliability-Aware Gradient Modulation strategy that dynamically rescales gradients based on the generalization ratio of each data stream.

2507.05519.tldr: This work proposes using global constraints of ASP to represent obligations, prohibitions, and permissions in deontic modal logic, and shows that the proposed representation results in the various decades-old paradoxes of deontic modal logic being simply and elegantly resolved.

2506.20332.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical curriculum consisting of three stages: on-policy exploration with verifiable action feedback to ground basic execution, multi-turn task-level training with realistic environment to unlock exploration and self-correction, and effectively bootstraps the agent.

2506.05425.tldr: It is shown that leading MLLMs perform relatively well on SSU but remain weak on SSR and SDP, with the systematic confusion in relation inference as a key bottleneck, and SIV-Bench offers a unified testbed to measure progress, expose limitations, and guide future research toward more socially intelligent MLLMs.

2505.16637.tldr: By augmenting SSR with external supervision from COMET, the strongest model, SSR-X-Zero-7B, achieves state-of-the-art performance in English $\leftrightarrow$ Chinese translation, surpassing all existing open-source models under 72B parameters and even outperforming closed-source models.

2509.25414.tldr: An asymmetric multi-LoRA design with multiple $A$ matrices and a single shared $B$ in multi-task fine-tuning, and a novel matrix decomposition strategy to accommodate heterogeneous ranks across clients are proposed.

2509.25346.tldr: SynthPert is presented, a novel method that enhances LLM performance through supervised fine-tuning on synthetic reasoning traces generated by frontier models, and shows the effectiveness of synthetic reasoning distillation for enhancing domain-specific reasoning in LLMs.

2604.02923.tldr: The Council Mode, a multi-agent consensus framework that dispatches queries to multiple heterogeneous frontier LLMs in parallel and synthesizes their outputs using a dedicated consensus model is proposed, suggesting that structured multi-agent consensus is a promising direction for enhancing the reliability and factual grounding of LLM-generated content.

2603.26729.tldr: The proposed multi-view graph convolutional network with fully leveraging consistency via GB-based topology construction, feature enhancement and interactive fusion (MGCN-FLC) outperforms state-of-the-art semi-supervised node classification methods.

2603.19451.tldr: Location-aware Fine-grained representation learning (LoFi) is proposed, which jointly optimizes sigmoid, captioning, and location-aware captioning losses using a lightweight large language model and integrates a fine-grained encoder into retrieval-based in-context learning to enhance chest X-ray grounding across diverse settings.

2603.06881.tldr: This study presents a Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO)-based AI surrogate model designed for high-efficiency prediction of threshold voltage (Vth) shifts and retention behavior, and demonstrates its effectiveness on a single FeFET configuration, serving as a pathway toward modeling the retention loss mechanisms.

2604.12069.tldr: A unified black-box robustness evaluation framework for token-level explanations based on leave-one-out occlusion is proposed, and robustness improvements to inference cost are related to inference cost, yielding a practical cost-robustness tradeoff curve that supports model and explanation selection prior to deployment in compliance-sensitive applications.

2604.10708.tldr: Beyond its core capabilities, Audio-Omni exhibits remarkable inherited capabilities, including knowledge-augmented reasoning generation, in-context generation, and zero-shot cross-lingual control for audio generation, highlighting a promising direction toward universal generative audio intelligence.

2604.12311.tldr: The research quantifies the severe limits of zero-shot vibe codes for construction safety and reveals a highly significant relationship between user persona and data hallucination, demonstrating that less formal prompts drastically increase the AI's propensity to invent missing safety variables.

2604.08568.tldr: This study investigates whether this shift in writing assistance tools is homogenizing research papers by analyzing native language identification (NLI) trends in ACL Anthology papers across three eras: pre-neural network (NN), pre-LLM, and post-LLM.

2602.15853.tldr: A lightweight explainable guardrail (LEG) method to detect unsafe prompts that obtains equivalent or better performance than the state-of-the-art for both prompt classification and explainability, both in-domain and out-of-domain on three datasets, despite the fact that its model size is considerably smaller than current approaches.

2604.12890.tldr: This work proposes a novel Long-horizon MultiModal deep search framework, named LMM-Searcher, centered on a file-based visual representation mechanism, that mitigates context overhead while preserving multimodal information for future access by offloading visual assets to an external file system and mapping them to lightweight textual identifiers.

2604.13071.tldr: Earth Virtual Expert (EVE), the first open-source, end-to-end initiative for developing and deploying domain-specialized LLMs for Earth Intelligence, is introduced, the first open-source, end-to-end initiative for developing and deploying domain-specialized LLMs for Earth Intelligence.

2604.22805.tldr: PrivAR is proposed, which leverages vision language models (VLMs) with chain-of-thought prompting for contextual privacy risk detection in AR environments, and investigates contextually-informed warning interfaces to enhance user privacy awareness.

2604.22781.tldr: BiTA redesigns the temporal aggregation function within the TGN framework by jointly encoding bidirectional sequential dependencies and long-range contextual relations over each node's temporal neighborhood, enabling complementary temporal reasoning at different scales while preserving the original TGN memory and message-passing structure.

2604.22770.tldr: Learning in Blocks is introduced, a framework that grounds progression in demonstrated conversational competence evaluated using CEFR-aligned rubrics and demonstrates that combining rubric-aligned scoring and recommendation with spaced review and mastery-based progression produces better learning outcomes than feedback alone.

2604.22767.tldr: Imbalanced user-AI relationships are identified as a distinct class of front-end ethical failure: patients are rendered highly visible to AI systems through data inference, yet cannot understand, question or influence how they are represented.

2604.22766.tldr: Diverse forecasting approaches are synthesized, significant limitations in existing methods are documented, and a research agenda for developing more-robust forecasting infrastructure is proposed for developing more-robust forecasting infrastructure.

2604.22759.tldr: This paper proposes a related question retrieval model through conversations, called TeCQR, that incorporates conversational feedback by learning to ask tag-enhanced clarifying questions to retrieve related questions more effectively and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2604.22757.tldr: This work introduces StratRAG, an open-source retrieval evaluation dataset for benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems on multi-hop reasoning tasks under realistic, noisy document-pool conditions, and benchmark three retrieval strategies -- BM25, dense retrieval, and hybrid fusion -- reporting Recall@k, MRR, and NDCG@5 on the validation set.

2604.19072.tldr: A new Semi-Supervised Meta Additive Model (S$^2$MAM) is proposed based on a bilevel optimization scheme that automatically identifies informative variables, updates the similarity matrix, and simultaneously achieves interpretable predictions and theoretical guarantees are provided.

2604.22758.tldr: RedParrot is proposed, a novel NL-to-DSL framework that accelerates inference via a semantic cache that bypasses the costly pipeline by matching new requests against cached"query skeletons"(normalized structural patterns) and adapting their corresponding DSLs.

2604.22756.tldr: This study developed customer agents capable of dynamically retrieving and reasoning upon their specific past preferences and constraints as virtual respondents using large language model-based "customer digital twins (CDT)" as virtual respondents.

2604.22780.tldr: A generative SSRL framework TS2TC introduces a bilinear temporal-spectrogram fusion method in the mixed domain, aligning latent representations from different domains and establishing fine-grained contextual interactions across multiple sources of information.

2604.22777.tldr: An intelligent fault diagnosis framework based on multi-fidelity digital twin is proposed, integrating four modules: high-fidelity flight dynamics simulation, FMEA-driven fault injection, multi-fidelity residual feature extraction, and large language model (LLM)-enhanced interpretable report generation.

2604.22771.tldr: These findings establish a structural lower bound on randomness in pretrained language models, characterise how this bound differs across architectures, and demonstrate that language itself modulates the bound independently of tokenisation.

2604.22783.tldr: This work introduces LARS (Low-memory Activation-Rank Subspace), a novel adaptation framework that decouples memory consumption from sequence length and constrains the activation subspace used during training, directly targeting the dominant source of memory consumption and fundamentally flattening the memory growth rate.

2604.22779.tldr: KARL is proposed, a novel framework that continuously aligns an LLM's abstention behavior with its evolving knowledge boundary, and achieves a superior accuracy-hallucination trade-off, effectively suppressing hallucinations while maintaining high accuracy across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios.

2604.22765.tldr: How the EU AI Act interacts with the fundamental principles of administrative law is examined, with a particular focus on administrative discretion, the duty to state reasons, and the principle of proportionality.

2604.22764.tldr: This study examines the reinforcement of these assumptions in the responses of four major general-purpose LLMs through the use of linguistic, behavioral, and cognitive anthropomorphic cues and contributes a novel dataset of simulated user queries for moral judgments.

2604.22762.tldr: The Behavioral Intelligence Problem is formalized, a taxonomy of detectors for autonomous insight generation is introduced, and an interestingness score is proposed to prioritize insights under limited attention.

2604.19139.tldr: It is demonstrated that verbal tics accumulate over multi-turn conversations, are amplified in subjective tasks, and show distinct cross-lingual patterns, underscore the alignment tax of current training paradigms and highlight the urgent need for more authentic human-AI interaction frameworks.

2604.18398.tldr: This work proposes AlphaContext, an evolutionary tree-based psychometric context generator for creativity assessment that formalizes expert-designed outlining as a rule-guided hypertree and performs top-down hierarchical planning.

2604.18239.tldr: This work identifies the disentanglement band (DB), a simple, testable condition that tells us when training can follow the desired path: suppress the loser while preserving the winner, possibly after an early stage.

2604.17025.tldr: The Convergent AI Agent Framework is introduced, which transitions agentic workflows from open-loop generation to closed-loop fail-safe determinism via three pillars: Recursive Atomic Decomposition with physical context firewalls, and Harness as an Asset, formalizing domain invariants into machine-readable registries enforced by a deterministic Unified Assertion Interface.

2604.22760.tldr: A unified benchmarking framework is presented to quantify inter-LLM divergence, defined as the extent to which models differ in API discovery and ranking under identical tasks, and reveals systematic failure modes in multi-agent LLM coordination.

2604.22755.tldr: Results indicate that a locally controlled, multi-modal RAG framework with domain-specific retrieval and provenance enforcement is necessary to achieve the factual accuracy, transparency, and auditability that nuclear engineering workflows demand.

2604.18467.tldr: An integrated framework for early-stage peptide screening that combines a partner-aware prediction and localization model (ConGA-PepPI) with a target-conditioned generative model (TC-PepGen) that preserves target information throughout autoregressive decoding via layerwise conditioning is presented.

2604.22800.tldr: An AI-powered Help Desk using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) built on LangChain with a pgvector store (PostgreSQL) and GPT-4.1-mini provides around-the-clock depositor assistance with citation-backed, streaming responses.

2604.22789.tldr: UGAF-ITS is introduced, a standards harmonization framework that consolidates 154 source obligations from the three instruments into 12 unified controls across eight governance domains through a reproducible five-phase crosswalk methodology.

2604.22782.tldr: It is demonstrated that dropping a layer's cache offers efficient optimization without information loss, and for larger models in data-constrained settings, this approach is suggestive of a regularization-like effect, frequently preserving or improving performance while significantly reducing the cache's memory footprint.

2604.22776.tldr: It is shown that this knowledge is already encoded in FlavorGraph's 300-dimensional ingredient embeddings, trained on recipe cooccurrence and food chemistry, and that it can be systematically recovered.

2604.22979.tldr: Results from CHAR Latent Temporal Rule Extraction indicate competitive performance while preserving explicit temporal and causal structure, showing that deterministic symbolic classification grounded in unsupervised discrete latent representations constitutes a viable alternative to end-to-end black-box models for wireless HAR.

2604.22942.tldr: 3D Variable-Step Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (VS-DDPM) a framework engineered to maintain generative quality while accelerating inference by several factors is proposed, demonstrating that VS-DDPM provides a robust and tunable solution for high-fidelity 3D medical image synthesis.

2604.22905.tldr: The key idea is to use the paired CT volume from the PET/CT acquisition to construct a voxel-wise regularization map for the DDF, replacing the conventional single global regularization weight, which yields anatomy-adaptive regularization strength across rigid and soft tissues.

2604.22873.tldr: This work studies deployment-time adaptation for frozen offline actors using Product-of-Experts (PoE) composition with a goal-conditioned prior, and makes explicit a closed-form identity in the frozen-actor setting.

2604.22870.tldr: The results establish an innate lower- and upper-bound in terms of how far (fragments of) C2 can be taken to characterise GNNs, and imply that is indeed the unbounded interaction of aggregation and readout that pushes the logical expressive power of GNNs above C2.

2604.22869.tldr: A high-fidelity, physics-informed co-simulation of a common aircraft main-fuel-pump system modelled in MATLAB/Simulink Simscape Fluids is introduced, and its generated time-series data with health and fault mode annotations are described.

2604.22971.tldr: The central finding is that single-channel anonymization produces near-zero bias effects, because individual channels act in opposite directions and cancel each other out -- a result that would lead an evaluator to conclude that identity bias is absent when it is not.

2604.22903.tldr: A novel hybrid quantum-classical architecture for breast cancer diagnosis based on a dual-branch feature-extraction pipeline is proposed, providing a stable, high-performance architecture for the clinical deployment of quantum-enhanced diagnostic tools.

2604.22897.tldr: Sophiabench is introduced, a large-scale patent retrieval benchmark comprising 10,000 queries and 75,000 corpus documents stratified across ten years, eight IPC technology sections, and twelve filing jurisdictions, and QaECTER, a 344M-parameter embedding model trained on patent citation graphs and multi-view self-alignment establishes a new state of the art for patent retrieval.

2604.22888.tldr: RouteGuard is proposed, a frozen-backbone detector that combines response-conditioned attention and hidden-state alignment through reliability-gated late fusion, and is consistently the strongest or most robust detector across both real and synthetic open-source skill benchmarks.

2604.22885.tldr: RCSR is proposed, a personalization-friendly federated framework that integrates prototype anchoring, retrieval-centric semantic routing, and optional client-specific adapters that consistently improves global retrieval accuracy and training stability, while further enhancing client-level retrieval performance.

2604.22883.tldr: A pipeline is proposed that converts T1-weighted MRI into anatomically informed 2D point clouds using Anatomical Priority Sampling (APS), producing ADNI-2DPC, the first neuroanatomically labeled MRI-derived point cloud dataset, and NeuroAPS-Net, a lightweight geometric deep learning model that incorporates anatomical priors via region-aware feature encoding and ROI token aggregation.

2604.22881.tldr: MTServe is proposed, a hierarchical cache management system that virtualizes GPU memory by leveraging host RAM as a scalable backup store and introduces a suite of system-level optimizations, including a hybrid storage layout, an asynchronous data transfer pipeline, and a locality-driven replacement policy.

2604.22852.tldr: SwarmDrive, a semantic Vehicle-to-Vehicle coordination framework in which nearby vehicles run local Small Language Models, share compact intent distributions only when uncertainty is high, and fuse them through event-triggered consensus, is presented.

2604.22835.tldr: This work presents ParkingScenes, a comprehensive multimodal dataset specifically designed for end-to-end autonomous parking in simulated scenes, and establishes a scalable and reproducible benchmark for advancing learning-based autonomous parking systems.

2604.22828.tldr: This study investigates spatial scale as a new scaling axis in foundation models and presents MetaEarth3D, the first generative foundation model capable of spatially consistent generation at the planetary scale, and argues that this study may help empower next-generation spatial intelligence for Earth observation.

2604.22824.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that WeatherSeg significantly outperforms baseline models in both accuracy and robustness across various weather conditions, establishing it as an effective solution for all-weather semantic segmentation in autonomous driving and related applications.

2604.22808.tldr: In simulations from 64K to 1M tokens, FreqFormer substantially reduces estimated attention FLOPs and KV-related memory traffic versus dense attention while keeping a hardware-friendly pattern, supporting spectrally structured heterogeneous attention as a practical direction for long-video diffusion transformers.

2604.23002.tldr: The first systematic characterisation of semantic drift in physics autoformalisation in terms of concepts such as notational collapse and abstraction elevation is provided which reveals what formal language verifies when full semantic preservation is unattainable.

2604.22990.tldr: GSAL, an active learning framework for object detection that combines a diffusion-based difficulty signal with a hierarchical semantic coverage prior, improves retrieval of subtle and rare targets that are often missed by uncertainty-only selection.

2604.22989.tldr: CheXmix is presented, a unified early-fusion generative model trained on a large corpus of chest X-rays paired with radiology reports that expands on Chameleon's autoregressive framework by introducing a two-stage multimodal generative pretraining strategy that combines the representational strengths of masked autoencoders with MLLMs.

2604.22891.tldr: A fully automated framework to quantifying and mitigating Self-Preference Bias is introduced, which constructs equal-quality pairs of responses with negligible quality differences, enabling statistical disentanglement of discriminability from bias propensity without human gold standards.

2604.22871.tldr: This work proposes AutoRISE, a method that searches over executable attack programs rather than individual prompts, requiring no fine-tuning, human annotation, or GPU compute and improves attack success by up to 16 points on frontier targets with low baseline success rates.

2604.22854.tldr: These findings validate that self-supervised learning combined with transformer-based segmentation models is an appropriate approach to the problem of data shortage in medical image analysis.

2604.22838.tldr: Real-time layer-wise weight decay is introduced, designed to enhance both convergence and generalization by aligning with the characteristics of weight updates and network architecture, and weight rollback is integrated with the optimizer, incorporating a rollback term into each weight update step.

2604.22837.tldr: The method augments the original SAM3 tracker with four ingredients: a reliability-aware tracking state machine, branch-based recovery, delayed DRM promotion, and a selective policy for native SAM3 memory selection to improve memory control rather than changing the backbone.

2604.22816.tldr: This work investigates an analog FM"Walkie Talkie"radio signal of interest in the presence of an Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing (OFDM) interferer, and shows the benefits of transformer-based interference mitigation in tactical settings.

2604.23016.tldr: This work proposes DeepSignature, a novel approach that integrates the guarantees of digital signatures with the capabilities of deep neural networks, and introduces a novel latent-space verification approach to detect and localize tampering attempts.

2604.22934.tldr: This work reformulate text-to-SQL generation within the lens of software test coverage where the original query is prepared with a suite of test cases with simpler, atomic SQLs that are executed in parallel and together ensure semantic coverage of the original query.

2604.22898.tldr: This work introduces the Reconstructive Authority Model (RAM), which separates integrity from coverage, and formalizes RAM, proves necessity via two theorems (attestation insufficiency and RAM necessity) and three corollaries, and presents a hybrid RAM+Attestation architecture with privilege-narrowing.

2604.22875.tldr: SketchVLM is presented, a training-free, model-agnostic framework that enables VLMs to produce non-destructive, editable SVG overlays on the input image to visually explain their answers, and finds that single-turn generation already achieves strong accuracy and annotation quality, and multi-turn generation opens up further opportunities for human-AI collaboration.

2604.22868.tldr: EAR is presented, an editing-as-reasoning paradigm that reformulates visual planning as a single-step image transformation and introduces AMAZE, a procedurally generated dataset that features the classical Maze and Queen problems, covering distinct, complementary forms of visual planning.
