2604.22839.tldr: Two complementary distillation strategies for few-shot PES are studied: Adaptive Weight Distillation (AWD), a prediction-level method that adaptively weights teacher supervision on unlabeled data, and Annealed Multimodal Distillation for Few-Shot Event Detection (AMD-FED), a representation-level framework that transfers robust skeleton knowledge into visual modalities through annealed pseudo-labeling.

2604.22832.tldr: This paper introduces an intervention-aware distillation framework that leverages perturbational transcriptomics to guide image representation learning and significantly improves one-shot transfer to unseen interventions and drug-target gene discovery compared to self-supervised and alignment baselines.

2604.22822.tldr: Evaluations across diverse open- and closed-source VLMs reveal systematic differences in prior sensitivity and perceptual reliability, demonstrating that object hallucination reflects heterogeneous, mechanism dependent failure patterns beyond aggregate accuracy.

2604.22818.tldr: The structural mechanisms suggest that low perceived volatility regimes can endogenously accumulate hidden leverage through position stickiness, which subsequently collapses when shocks trigger synchronized deleveraging.

2604.23001.tldr: This survey argues that future advances in VLA will depend less on model architecture and more on the co-design of high-fidelity data engines and structured evaluation protocols, and presents a systematic, data-centric analysis of VLA research organized around three pillars: datasets, benchmarks, and data engines.

2604.22958.tldr: This paper considers a PAF inverse problem which takes an argumentation graph, a labelling and a semantics as an input, and outputs a ``yes"or ``no"as to whether there is a preference relation between the arguments which can yield the desired labelling and shows that the problem can be answered in polynomial time.

2604.22939.tldr: Self-Knowledge Re-expression (SKR) is proposed, a novel, task-agnostic adaptation method that transforms the LLM's output from generic token generation to highly efficient, task-specific expression.

2604.22893.tldr: This paper presents a dynamic data valuation framework that transitions from static accounting to utility-based pricing, demonstrating that proxy-based empirical gain achieves near-perfect ranking alignment with realized utility, substantially outperforming row-count and token-count baselines.

2604.22884.tldr: The proposed SOUBench, the first and comprehensive benchmark for exploring the small objects understanding capability of existing MLLMs, and the developed SOU-Train, a multimodal training dataset to improve the SOU capabilities of MLLMs, are introduced.

2604.22879.tldr: Results indicate that self-avoidance is unreliable and that multi-agent security benefits from a centralized enforcement layer operating above individual agents, as well as empirically validate the need for external enforcement.

2604.22861.tldr: This work introduces a new task, INformation reTRieval through literAture reVIEW (IntraView), which aims to automate fine-grained information retrieval faithfully grounded in the provided content in response to research-driven queries, and proposes IntrAgent, an LLM-based agent that addresses this challenging task.

2604.22843.tldr: This work proposes Structure Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation (SG-RAG), which models the retrieval process as an embedding-based subgraph matching task, and uses the retrieved topological structures to guide the LLM to generate answers that meet all specified query conditions.

2604.22825.tldr: SGP-SAM, a self-gated prompting framework for efficient and effective transfer to 3D lesion segmentation, and a Zoom Loss that up-weights lesion-focused supervision by combining Dice and a voxel-balanced focal term to address small-lesion learning.

2604.22823.tldr: This work introduces the post-alignment merging task, which aims to integrate cross-modal alignment capabilities learned from heterogeneous multimodal pre-training, and proposes PivotMerge, a post-alignment merging framework for cross-modal projectors that consistently outperforms existing baselines.

2604.22820.tldr: Overall, complete cyclic subtask graphs are used as a maximally flexible experimental lens for measuring when multi-agent revisitation helps, when it mainly adds coordination cost, and when external task bottlenecks dominate.

2604.23018.tldr: AmaraSpatial-10K, a dataset of over 10,000 synthetic 3D assets optimised for zero-shot deployment, is presented, a reusable evaluation suite for 3D asset banks, a continuous Scale Plausibility Score (SPS), an LLM Concept Density metric, anchor-error auditing, and a cross-modal CLIP coherence protocol are introduced.

2604.23054.tldr: DeepImagine, a framework for teaching LLMs biomedical reasoning through successive counterfactual imagining, is proposed, with the central idea to approximate hidden causal mechanisms of clinical trials by training models to infer how observed trial results would change under controlled perturbations of experimental conditions.

2604.23195.tldr: AnalogRetriever is presented, a unified tri-modal retrieval framework for analog circuit search that consistently improves functional pass rates and enables previously unsolved tasks to be completed.

2604.23124.tldr: Evaluation across five case studies spanning safety-critical, financial, and information-system domains shows that ArgRE provides argument-level traceability absent from existing frameworks, indicating improved auditability, while semantic intent preservation remains comparable.

2604.23106.tldr: MOSAIC is introduced, a training-free multi-agent framework for scientific code generation without I/O supervision that employs a student-teacher knowledge distillation framework that grounds generation through domain-specific examples and structured problem decomposition.

2604.23280.tldr: This report conducts a gap analysis across the full agent identity lifecycle and identifies five critical gaps that no current technology or regulatory instrument resolves.

2604.23278.tldr: It is argued that as agents engage in epistemic foraging to resolve ambiguity, the governance controls that remain effective must shift systematically from external constraints to the internal modulation of prior preferences, offering a principled, variational bridge from computational phenotyping to AI governance strategy.

2604.23276.tldr: This work presents a lightweight and production level PDF parsing framework that can accurately detect visual elements and associates captions using a combination of spatial heuristics, layout analysis, and semantic similarity and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art parsers and large vision-language models on both internal data and the MMDocRAG benchmark.

2604.23072.tldr: Analytica, a novel agent architecture built on the principle of Soft Propositional Reasoning (SPR), reframes complex analysis as a structured process of estimating the soft truth values of different outcome propositions, allowing us to formally model and minimize the estimation error in terms of its bias and variance.

2604.23187.tldr: It is revealed that there is still room for substantial improvement in the field of medical image segmentation, with the majority of techniques achieving a Dice Coefficient of 0.82, which sheds light on the true progress of the field and redefines the benchmark for progress in medical image segmentation.

2604.23129.tldr: MindTrellis is an interactive visual system where users and AI collaboratively build a dynamic knowledge graph, and users can query the graph to retrieve document-grounded information, and contribute by introducing new concepts, modifying relationships, and reorganizing the hierarchy to reflect their developing understanding.

2604.23079.tldr: This study presents a methodology that combines strong discriminative models with multimodal explanations, converting retinal pixels into clinically interpretable outputs, and concludes that VLM variants showed a trade-off between clinical completeness and template-level semantic similarity.

2604.23058.tldr: An analytical model is developed in which a firm jointly chooses AI deployment and cybersecurity investment under this governance-capability gap, showing a deployment paradox: in high-loss environments, better AI can lead a firm to deploy less when capability is deployed through broader authority exposure under weak governance.

2604.23049.tldr: This paper presents a decoupled HITL system architecture that treats human oversight as an independent system component within the agent operating environment and provides a foundation for scalable governance and progressive autonomy in agentic workflows.

2604.23277.tldr: A training-free and model-agnostic compression framework that selects a compact set of sentences guided by structural graph priors that is competitive with strong extractive and abstractive baselines, demonstrating larger gains on long-document benchmarks.

2604.23257.tldr: The research shows that knowledge lever activation improves alignment across the project management iron triangle (scope, time, cost) by reducing rework and rediscovery costs.

2604.23256.tldr: The results support treating architecture as a measurable design variable that should be reported, stress-tested, and selected using held-out validation rather than fixed a priori.

2604.23245.tldr: This work lays the groundwork for broader adoption of privacy-preserving ML in real-world applications, balancing security with computational feasibility by proposing a proof-of-concept for a privacy-preserving framework that leverages Cheon-Kim-Kim-Song (CKKS) for approximate real-number arithmetic.

2604.23238.tldr: This work presents a theoretical formulation of antidistillation as a Stackelberg game, grounding a problem that has so far largely been approached heuristically, and proposes TraceGuard, an efficient, post-generation black-box method to poison sentences with high importance for teacher reasoning.

2604.23145.tldr: This work proposes UpstreamQA, a modular framework that disentangles and evaluates core video reasoning components through explicit upstream reasoning modules that offers a principled framework for combining explicit reasoning and multimodal understanding in VideoQA.

2604.23141.tldr: UNSEEN is presented, a coordinated cross-stack defense that combines an AR ACL (Access Control Layer) for identity-gated sensing, F-RMU-based LLM unlearning for sensitive profile suppression, and runtime agent guardrails for adaptive interaction control.

2604.23056.tldr: This work proposes a simple yet effective alternative to reward normalization in policy gradient reinforcement learning by integrating a 1D Kalman filter for online reward estimation, which recursively estimates the latent reward mean, smoothing high-variance returns and adapting to non-stationary environments.

2604.23027.tldr: This paper introduces a systematic approach for LLM debugging that treats models as observable systems, providing structured, model-agnostic methods from issue detection to model refinement, and argues that such a structured methodology not only accelerates troubleshooting but also fosters reproducibility, transparency, and scalability in the deployment of LLM-based systems.

2604.23255.tldr: This paper investigates how prompt design and batching strategies can be optimised to balance coding accuracy, processing time, and environmental impact in team-based healthcare simulation debriefing, and offers practical guidance for scaling dialogue analytics in contexts where timeliness, privacy, and sustainability are critical.

2604.23263.tldr: This study proposes a pre-inference prompt optimization mechanism via explicit prompt disambiguation that promotes explicit prompt disambiguation as an effective prompt optimization method without disturbing the internal mechanism of LLM inference.

2604.23251.tldr: An LLM-as-reviewer integrated directly into GitHub pull requests (human-in-the-loop) across two cohorts across two cohorts (more than 100 students, 2023--2024) is investigated.

2604.23231.tldr: A provable robustness defense that resists SemBugger's homogeneous attacks through a controlled noise mechanism is proposed, and a theoretical lower bound on the defense efficacy is formally provided.

2604.23190.tldr: RAT (RunAnyThing), a modular and extensible agent framework for fully automated configuration across programming languages on arbitrary repositories, and RATBench, a benchmark that reflects the comprehensive coverage of real-world repositories are proposed.

2604.23179.tldr: This work proposes a learning-based framework for cooperative policies from decentralized observations using multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), supported by an architecture that handles variable numbers of humans and temporal dependencies and consistently outperforms classical coverage, persistent monitoring, and learning-free multi-robot baselines.

2604.23150.tldr: A workload-aware micro-batch grouping and an expert placement strategy to maximize token locality to the destination expert, thereby reducing inter-node communication are proposed.

2604.23148.tldr: PhySE is a novel framework that efficiently pre-train a Visual Language Model with social-context data, enabling rapid, on-the-fly profile generation, and introduces a psychological LLM that dynamically deploys distinct classes of psychological strategies based on target response, moving beyond static, handcrafted scripts.

2604.23137.tldr: A new hybrid architecture that combines a SqueezeNet-style CNN branch with a MobileViT-style global transformer branch, through an Adaptive Attention Gate mechanism, is proposed, showing that dynamic feature weighting is an effective way to classify medical images.

2604.23108.tldr: This work establishes a scalable paradigm for resource-efficient MoE design, offering a practical solution for optimizing inference costs in real-world scenarios, and introduces an All-size Group-decoupling Allocation strategy coupled with an Intra-Group Experts Auxiliary Loss.

2604.23080.tldr: This work compares stable, node-churn-only, agent-cooling-only, and combined regimes to see when routing efficiency, resilience, and service readiness align or favor different designs, finding structured overlays are more robust and efficient in stable and node-churn regimes, while gossip-based overlays remain competitive and can be faster when readiness dominates.

2604.23057.tldr: Whether explicit belief graphs improve LLM performance in cooperative multi-agent reasoning is investigated and full-game evidence confirms inter-agent conventions outperform all single-agent interventions, and individual belief-graph components must be combined to produce gains.

2604.23290.tldr: This research collects annotations of text samples from crowd-sourced workers through a crowd-sourcing platform, conducts extensive empirical studies of 8 commonly used active learning techniques (in conjunction with deep neural networks), and sheds light on the performance of these techniques under real-world challenges, where annotators can provide incorrect labels, and can also refuse to provide labels.

2604.23284.tldr: A novel multimodal architecture that extends Large Language Models with audio processing, Au-M-ol is a strong candidate for real-world clinical applications, where reliable and context-aware audio understanding is essential.

2604.23270.tldr: CAP-CoT is proposed, a Cycle Adversarial Prompt optimization framework designed to improve both CoT reasoning accuracy and stability of a single deployed solver and aims to expose logical vulnerabilities in reasoning chains.

2604.23239.tldr: AdaMamba is a novel framework that endogenizes adaptive and context-aware frequency analysis within the Mamba state-space update process and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in forecasting accu racy while maintaining competitive computational efficiency.

2604.23210.tldr: This work introduces EPO-Safe (Experiential Prompt Optimization for Safe Agents), a framework where an LLM iteratively generates action plans, receives sparse binary danger warnings, and evolves a natural language behavioral specification through reflection, demonstrating that LLMs can perform safety reasoning from a strictly impoverished signal in structured, low-dimensional environments.

2604.23198.tldr: This work introduces StoryTR, the first video moment retrieval benchmark requiring ToM reasoning, and proposes an agentic Data Pipeline that generates training data with explicit three-tier ToM chains (intent decoding, narrative reasoning, boundary localization).

2604.23194.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed AdaPlan-H method significantly improves task execution success rates while mitigating overplanning at the planning level, providing a flexible and efficient solution for multi-step complex decision-making tasks.

2604.23099.tldr: This work proposes ProEval, a proactive evaluation framework that leverages transfer learning to efficiently estimate performance and identify failure cases, and proves that theoretically, the pre-trained GP-based BQ estimator is unbiased and bounded.

2604.23090.tldr: A controlled experimental study using domain-specific insurance contracts to investigate which architectural design choices drive generation quality and why current approaches fail, highlighting planning-first, artifact-driven generation as a promising and more auditable path toward scalable automated ontology engineering.

2604.23295.tldr: This work presents the first open, reproducible full-duplex spoken dialogue system for Hindi by adapting Moshi, a state-of-the-art duplex speech architecture, using a custom Hindi tokeniser and training on 26,000 hours of real spontaneous conversations collected from 14,695 speakers with separate speaker channels.

2604.23289.tldr: This paper proposes a simple yet effective framework, MetaErr, whose goal is to predict whether a base deep neural network will succeed or fail in predicting a particular data sample, by observing the base models performance on a given learning task.

2604.23467.tldr: Results indicate that hybrid JIT-CUDA Graph execution can effectively reduce inference latency and variance for short-sequence LLM workloads, making it a practical optimization strategy for latency-sensitive AI applications.

2604.23460.tldr: It is demonstrated that continuous thought models can exhibit misaligned latent reasoning while producing aligned outputs, with aligned and misaligned reasoning occupying geometrically distinct regions of latent space, and misalignment is encoded in early latent thinking tokens, suggesting safety monitoring for continuous thought models should target the planning phase of latent reasoning.

2604.23432.tldr: A novel public benchmark is introduced to systematically evaluate the robustness of monocular depth estimation models from equirectangular images in a reproducible way and a depth calibration-based error protocol is proposed to convert predicted relative depth values into metric depth values using supervised learned scaling factors for each model.

2604.23388.tldr: Post-adaptation memory tuning (PAMT), a memory-only stabilization stage that augments an adapted model with a modular parametric memory head (PMH), is proposed, which substantially improves retention on earlier slices with minimal impact on retrieval performance for newly added documents, while modifying only a sparse subset of memory values per session.

2604.23386.tldr: This work presents a scalable and architecturally sound method for managing client-level disagreements, and enhances the practical applicability of FL in settings where policy compliance and strategic control are non-negotiable.

2604.23355.tldr: LEGO, a unified skill-based platform for front-end design generation, is presented and results show that modular skill composition supports both effective and flexible RTL design automation.

2604.23354.tldr: Two algorithms are applied -- Single-Linkage Clustering (SLINK) and Hierarchical Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (HDBSCAN) -- to analyse the different ways in which representations from the speaker recognition network can form clusters with hierarchical relationships.

2604.23505.tldr: A systems-level account of uncertainty propagation is developed, a conceptual framing for characterising propagated uncertainty signals is introduced, a structured taxonomy spanning intra-model, system-level, and socio-technical propagation mechanisms is presented, and cross-cutting engineering insights are synthesised.

2604.23445.tldr: This work identifies a systematic, modality-spanning failure: RLHF safety alignment disrupts the therapeutic mechanism of action by grounding patients during imaginal exposure, offering false reassurance, inserting crisis resources into controlled exercises, and refusing to challenge distorted cognitions mentioning self-harm in PE.

2604.23407.tldr: It is shown that accuracy alone misleads -- weaker models exploit the modal count rather than reason temporally, suggesting counting is a proxy for broader temporal reasoning.

2604.23351.tldr: It is demonstrated that CoT encodes recoverable, token-level problem-solving information, offering new insight into how reasoning is represented and where it breaks down, suggesting complete reasoning chains are not always necessary.

2604.23312.tldr: It is demonstrated that GIFT increase the stability of the control interaction while maintaining comparable task performance, thereby improving the suitability of deep RL policies for real-world control systems.

2604.23296.tldr: S^2IT is a novel Stepwise Syntax Integration Tuning framework that progressively integrates syntactic structure knowledge into LLMs through a multi-step tuning process that significantly improves state-of-the-art performance across multiple datasets.

2604.23523.tldr: This work introduces a framework that combines counterfactual reasoning with a grammar-constrained refinement loop to refine operational rules, aligning them with the observed system behavior and resolved the inconsistencies in an operational rule inferred by a conventional baseline while remaining grammar compliant.

2604.23576.tldr: A safe reinforcement learning framework that learns a probabilistic control-affine dynamics model in an offline setting that is leveraged to explicitly construct control barrier functions that incorporate model uncertainty to provide conservative safety constraints.

2604.23563.tldr: This work introduces CyberCane, a neuro-symbolic framework integrating deterministic symbolic analysis with privacy-preserving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and introduces PhishOnt, an OWL ontology enabling verifiable attack classification through formal reasoning chains.

2604.23562.tldr: It is demonstrated that pupil diameter and fixation duration can effectively classify left and right brain hemisphere activities and suggest that ocular metrics are robust indicators of lateralized brain activity and can be applied in cognitive monitoring and neurorehabilitation.

2604.23547.tldr: A hardware-efficient FPGA implementation of the sigmoid activation function using a mixed-radix CORDIC-based architecture that achieves a mean absolute error of 4.23 10^-4, outperforming several recent sigmoid implementations.

2604.23539.tldr: This work introduces MetaGAI, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 2,541 verified document triplets constructed through semantic triangulation of academic papers, GitHub repositories, and Hugging Face artifacts, and establishes a robust evaluation protocol combining automated metrics with validated LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks.

2604.23532.tldr: Results indicate that incorporating facial expression-derived emotion embeddings into emotion-conditional short-term pose prediction based on a lightweight predictive world model architecture is a feasible approach.

2604.23530.tldr: This work proposes MTRouter, which encodes the interaction history and candidate models into joint history-model embeddings, and learns an outcome estimator from logged trajectories to predict turn-level model utility, and reveals several mechanisms underlying its effectiveness.

2604.23500.tldr: A unified, interpretable, physics-informed ensemble framework is proposed, integrating a Convolutional Neural Network branch for local feature extraction and a Transformer branch for long-range dependency modeling; the branches are fused through a validation-optimized weighted ensemble and regularized by a physics-informed loss derived from the piecewise parabolic temperature-demand relationship of the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) system.

2604.23494.tldr: It is established that scoring granularity is a consequential design variable for AML investigation systems -- same data, same budget, different queues, different addresses investigated.

2604.23493.tldr: K-SENSE (Knowledge-guided Self-augmented Encoder for Neuro-Semantic Evaluation of Mental Health), a framework that jointly exploits external psychological reasoning and internal representation robustness, is proposed.

2604.23466.tldr: The first independent, cross-architecture evaluation of CuTile against established approaches such as cuBLAS, Triton, WMMA, and raw SIMT on three NVIDIA GPUs spanning Hopper and Blackwell is presented, showing that CuTile effectiveness is strongly workload- and architecture-dependent.

2604.23396.tldr: It is found that PAG's planning signal is brittle under lexical surface-form variation: intent-preserving typos can trigger plan collapse, where the planned candidate pool shifts enough that the look-ahead bonus provides little useful guidance, effectively reverting decoding toward weaker unguided search.

2604.23366.tldr: To the authors' knowledge, GSAR is the first published groundedness framework coupling evidence-typed scoring with tiered recovery under an explicit compute budget.

2604.23348.tldr: EmoTrans is presented, a benchmark for evaluating emotion dynamics understanding in multimodal videos and conducts a comprehensive evaluation of 18 state-of-the-art MLLMs on EmoTrans, forming a progressive evaluation framework from coarse-grained detection to deeper reasoning and prediction.

2604.23546.tldr: Minimum Risk Training is introduced to OCSR and COMO (Closed-loop Optical Molecule recOgnition), a closed-loop framework that mitigates exposure bias by directly optimizing over molecule-level, non-differentiable objectives, by iteratively sampling and evaluating the model's own predictions.

2604.23518.tldr: Experimental results reveal that DCT preprocessing substantially reduces the observed low-frequency preference in TSF, and theoretical analysis and empirical validation confirm that the spectral bias of KANs in TSF tasks is indeed induced by the autocorrelation among input variables.

2604.23483.tldr: This paper formalizes this strict black-box threat model and proposes a two-agent evasion framework operating in a semantic perturbation space, confirming that adaptive strategy discovery is essential when evasion is non-trivial.

2604.23446.tldr: This work presents IndustryAssetEQA, a neurosymbolic operational intelligence system that combines episodic telemetry representations with a Failure Mode Effects Analysis Knowledge Graph (FMEA-KG) to enable Embodied Question Answering (EQA) over industrial assets.

2604.23430.tldr: This study systematically evaluates the performance of off-the-shelf Large Language Models (LLMs) in analyzing scientific texts according to a given classification scheme, utilizing the hierarchical ORKG taxonomy as a classification framework and investigating the effectiveness of advanced prompt engineering strategies.

2604.23403.tldr: Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and Imagenette show that the training time of the models is more than halved without significantly impacting accuracy, and the effectiveness of the proposed technique in speeding up learning of CNNs is demonstrated.

2604.23392.tldr: This work explores the technical capability of integrating MLLMs with refereeing expertise, and evaluations show the system significantly outperforms general-purpose MLLMs in decision accuracy and explanation quality.

2604.23361.tldr: The results demonstrate that local models can identify a meaningful share of bugs, though precise localization remains difficult for locally executed LLMs, particularly when handling complex and context dependent bugs in realistic development scenarios.

2604.23325.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that the proposed EAD-Net method outperforms existing methods in terms of lip-sync accuracy, temporal consistency, and emotional accuracy, and that it outperforms existing methods in terms of lip-sync accuracy, temporal consistency, and emotional accuracy.

2604.23468.tldr: A significant milestone was achieved in February 2026: the result was formally verified, with the final stages of the verification done by Math, Inc.'s autoformalization model'Gauss'.

2604.23557.tldr: Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that a unified DLM outperforms strong offline MARL baselines and LLM-based conversational decision-making methods, while demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to unseen scenarios across tasks.

2604.23552.tldr: Analysis of how distillation reshapes memorization behavior in diffusion models suggests that distillation can serve not only as an acceleration tool, but also as a mechanism for improving the memorization-generalization trade-off.

2604.23543.tldr: A novel preference-based training framework that uses a multi-objective value function to better reflect the structure of preference data is proposed, Pref-CTRL, which has outperformed RE-Control on two benchmark datasets and showed greater generalization on out-of-domain datasets.

2604.23449.tldr: A generative AI-powered system that creates groups optimizing for stance heterogeneity while constraining argumentation quality differences to +/-1 level on a validated learning progression is presented, suggesting ArguAgent can enable real-time, theoretically grounded grouping that promotes productive STEM argumentation in classrooms.

2604.23377.tldr: An ASP-based algorithm is developed that verifies whether a given constraint set uniquely determines the intended concept mapping, with proven soundness and completeness and provides a complexity classification: deciding shortcut-freeness is coNP-complete, counting shortcuts is #P-complete, and finding minimal repairs is NP-hard.

2604.23324.tldr: A novel framework named Layer Embedding Deep Fusion Graph Neural Network (LEDF-GNN) is proposed, which designs a Layer Embedding Deep Fusion (LEDF) operator that nonlinearly fuses multi-layer embeddings to capture inter-layer dependencies and effectively alleviate deep propagation degradation.

2604.23307.tldr: CombiMOTS is a Pareto Monte Carlo Tree Search (PMCTS) framework that generates dual-target molecules that is designed to explore a synthesizable fragment space while employing vectorized optimization constraints to encapsulate target affinity and physicochemical properties.

2604.23435.tldr: Knee-xRAI grounds every prediction in an auditable chain of measured radiographic findings, providing clinical transparency at the point of care, and decomposes the grading process by mimicking clinical radiological workflows.

2604.23786.tldr: This work investigates VLM performance across laboratory (AFAR-BSFT) and naturalistic datasets, focusing on diagnostic reliability and demographic fairness, and concludes that future fairness interventions must jointly optimise predictive accuracy, demographic parity, and cross-domain generalisation.

2604.23732.tldr: Classifying hypoglycemia using DiaData, a large CGM dataset of patients with T1D, shows that the FCN model trained on the whole population captures temporal patterns leading to hypoglycemia with similar or superior performance compared to models trained on age-specific subsets, indicating strong cross-demographic generalization.

2604.23728.tldr: This work proposes ESIA (Energy-based Spatiotemporal Interaction-Aware framework), a novel Conditional Random Field (CRF)-based paradigm that achieves state-of-the-art performance with improved interpretability over existing methods.

2604.23724.tldr: This work introduces an online Bayesian inference module that continuously evaluates vehicle trajectories to dynamically update the probabilistic boundaries of normal driving behaviors, serving as an asynchronous trigger to precisely localize anomalies in space and time.

2604.23716.tldr: A practical decision framework for four foundational measures - Entropy, KL divergence/cross-entropy, Mutual Information, and Transfer Entropy is provided, organized around three prescriptive questions for each: what question does the measure answer and in which AI context; which estimator is appropriate for the data type and dimensionality; and what is the most dangerous misuse.

2604.23666.tldr: A measurement integrity validation scheme that operates as a supervisory instrumentation layer for modern LCDRs and interprets short windows of synchronized instantaneous current measurements recorded during relay operation and assesses their physical consistency to distinguish genuine fault-induced trajectories from cyber-manipulated measurement streams.

2604.23599.tldr: The partition-of-unity Gaussian KAN (PU-GKAN), a Shepard-type normalized Gaussian KAN in which the Gaussian basis values on each edge are divided by their local sum over fixed centers, indicates that Shepard-type partition-of-unity normalization is a simple and effective stabilization mechanism for RBF-based KANs.

2604.23674.tldr: This paper introduces Vibe Medicine, a co-work paradigm in which clinicians and researchers direct skill-augmented AI agents through natural language to execute complex, multi-step biomedical workflows, while retaining the role of research director who specifies objectives, reviews intermediate results, and makes domain-informed decisions.

2604.23712.tldr: OptProver is presented, a trained model that achieves robust transfer from Olympiad to undergraduate optimization and achieves state-of-the-art Pass@1 and Pass@32 among comparably sized models while maintaining competitive performance on general theorem-proving tasks, demonstrating effective domain transfer without catastrophic forgetting.

2604.23875.tldr: It is demonstrated that noise-robust learning must be evaluated through a clinical risk lens, and that combining robust training with cost-sensitive optimization can meaningfully reduce risk in noisy-label medical imaging scenarios.

2604.23859.tldr: With spotforecast2-safe, an integrated Compliance-by-Design approach to Python-based point forecasting of time series in safety-critical environments is presented, and interactive visualisation, hyperparameter tuning and automated machine learning are deliberately excluded.

2604.23841.tldr: This work introduces a unified graph framework that employs feature-based homogenization to project distinct node roles into a shared latent space and proposes a hypothesis of structural saturation, demonstrating that policies trained on critically congested instances learn scale-invariant resolution strategies.

2604.23816.tldr: This work establishes the feasibility of using LLMs for scalable contextual, on-demand documentation generation with query-driven UML diagram generation, where LLMs create diagrams that directly answer natural language questions about code.

2604.23750.tldr: KID-Bench is released, a 489-question benchmark that separates novel recall, cross-knowledge combination, and prior-graded conflicts, and it is shown the failure is a magnitude problem rather than a representational one.

2604.23753.tldr: A novel computational model is introduced to infer video-induced pleasure via cognitive appraisal variables, using cognitive appraisal theory and a fuzzy model within an innovative framework to bridging the semantic gap and enhancing model explainability beyond conventional statistical associations.

2604.23701.tldr: Agri-CPJ (Caption-Prompt-Judge), a training-free few-shot framework in which a large vision-language model first generates a structured morphological caption, iteratively refined through multi-dimensional quality gating, before any diagnostic question is answered.

2604.23653.tldr: ResAF-Net, a satellite-based tree detection framework designed for large-scale agricultural monitoring in resource-constrained settings, is presented and implemented within a web-based GIS application integrated with Palestinian cadastral data from GeoMolg, enabling tree analysis at scene, parcel, and community levels.

2604.23623.tldr: Tandem is a novel collaborative framework that synergizes large and small language models (LLMs and SLMs) to achieve high-quality reasoning with significantly reduced computational cost, and introduces a cost-aware termination mechanism that adaptively determines when sufficient reasoning guidance has been accumulated.

2604.23580.tldr: This work proposes a Self-Corrective Multi-Agent Refinement Framework (SMRF) with three specialized agents that collaborate iteratively with domain-specific validation to produce physically accurate simulations, demonstrating that error correction is critical for accurate physics-aware symbolic simulation and that specialized multi-agent approaches significantly outperform single-agent methods across the tested physical domains.

2604.23878.tldr: On LongMemEval-500, ZenBrain matches a long-context oracle's binary-judge accuracy to within 4.5 pp, and wins all 12 head-to-head answer-quality cells against Letta, Mem0, and A-Mem under Bonferroni correction.

2604.23862.tldr: These results are not intended as a state-of-the-art claim; they support the viability and structural interpretability of replacing dense within-token transformation with graph-mediated memory navigation.

2604.23854.tldr: SalUn-CRA (Clinical Risk-Aware), a variant of SalUn that replaces random relabeling with entropy-based forgetting for malignant samples in the forget set, preventing the model from learning harmful benign associations is proposed.

2604.23853.tldr: It is argued that reusable agent skills should be evaluated at the rule-type level, not as monolithic instruction packages, and ClawTrace, the TraceCard schema, and the full set of typed skills are released.

2604.23839.tldr: An ROI-aware representation learning framework is proposed and instantiate it for first-trimester nuchal translucency (NT) screening under multi-hospital domain shift and can be adopted for other fetal biometry targets and broader medical imaging settings where small ROIs dominate clinical decisions.

2604.23806.tldr: Symmetric bilinear EqProp is the first local, readout-only training rule that preserves the low-rank coupling enabling scalable thermodynamic diffusion models and derives a sharp bias bound controlled solely by substrate stiffness, local curvature, and the norm of the loss-gradient signal.

2604.23747.tldr: It is shown that numerous recently published research papers rely on a faulty baseline caused by two distinct bugs: a CPU-offloaded optimizer bug in DeepSpeed that silently drops intermediate micro-batches during gradient accumulation and a loss aggregation bug in OpenRLHF that incorrectly weights per-mini-batch losses.

2604.23658.tldr: FlowPlace is proposed, which features mask-guided synthetic data generation, flow-based efficient training with flexible prior injection, and hard constraint sampling for overlap-free layouts in generative models.

2604.23646.tldr: This work proposes the Policy-Execution-Authorization (PEA) architecture, a "separation-of-powers" design that enforces safety at the system level and provides a robust foundation for the governance of autonomous agents.

2604.23644.tldr: Reconstruction as Validation (RaV-IDP) is presented, a document processing pipeline that introduces reconstruction as a first-class architectural component and proposes a per-stage evaluation framework pairing each pipeline component with an appropriate benchmark.

2604.23633.tldr: Quantitative Argumentation for Causal Discovery is proposed, a semantics-driven framework that represents CI outcomes as graded, defeasible arguments rather than irreversible constraints, and improves structural coherence and interventional reliability in several noisy or inconsistent CI regimes.

2604.23615.tldr: The proposed method significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art models for this task in terms of accuracy and macro-average F1 score; in some aspects, it even surpasses or closely matches the results of human evaluations.

2604.23593.tldr: Together, this taxonomy and experimental audit provide an evidence-based baseline for assessing and tracking the reliability of AI peer review and highlight concrete failure points to guide targeted, testable mitigations.

2604.23578.tldr: Behavior Understanding Alignment (BUA), a novel framework that integrates LLMs into human behavior modeling through a structured curriculum learning process, is proposed, highlighting its effectiveness and flexibility in applying LLMs to complex human behavior modeling.

2604.23886.tldr: Results demonstrate that the musculoskeletal hand model demonstrates superior biomechanical stability and tracking precision compared to the existing model, and validate that the musculoskeletal hand model and muscle-driven controller can generate physiologically plausible activation patterns that align with human electromyography (EMG) recordings.

2604.23861.tldr: An empirical ablation-based study of CNN optimization for the CIFAR-10 benchmark suggests that performance gains in CNN-based classification depend less on indiscriminate increases in depth or parameter count than on careful empirical selection of training and architectural modifications.

2604.23860.tldr: This work presents a systematic and automatic evaluation framework for analyzing audio hallucinations in egocentric video through a targeted question-answering (Q/A) protocol, and proposes a grounded taxonomy that distinguishes between foreground action sounds from the user activities and background ambient sounds.

2604.23842.tldr: It is shown that AI Explanation yields the largest gains over no support in NS-rated competence, while contextual appropriateness judgments show indifference across support.

2604.23783.tldr: Experiments on TriviaQA, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA show that S2G-RAG improves multi-hop QA performance and robustness under multi-turn retrieval, and can be integrated into existing RAG pipelines as a lightweight component, without modifying the search engine or retraining the generator.

2604.23776.tldr: A deep learning framework is proposed to generate 10-meter resolution oil palm plantation maps for Indonesia and Malaysia from 2020 to 2024, utilizing Sentinel-2 imagery without requiring new manual annotations, and to address the resolution mismatch between coarse 100-meter historical labels and 10-meter imagery.

2604.23588.tldr: FinGround, a three-stage verify-then-ground pipeline for financial document QA, proposes retrieval-equalized evaluation as standard methodology for RAG verification research: when all systems receive identical retrieval, FinGround still reduces hallucination rates by 68% over the strongest baseline.

2604.23829.tldr: A strict domain-specific concept universe is constructed from a large SAE inventory using contrastive activations and a multi-stage filtering process, and two aligned graph views are built that convert feature-level interpretability into a global map of model knowledge and enables audits of reasoning faithfulness.

2604.23779.tldr: GLIER (Generative Legal Inference and Evidence Ranking), a framework that reformulates retrieval as an inference process over latent legal variables, exhibits strong data efficiency and outperforms strong baselines such as SAILER and KELLER.

2604.23719.tldr: AIPsy-Affect is released, a 480-item clinical stimulus battery that removes the confound at the stimulus level that removes the confound at the stimulus level and is released openly under MIT license.

2604.23703.tldr: The study concludes that short, transparent, and carefully designed avatars may provide a reusable communication layer for introductions, transitions, reminders, and recaps when used selectively and with appropriate ethical safeguards.

2604.23678.tldr: This work develops neuroGravity, a physics-informed deep learning model that reliably reconstructs mobility flows from limited observations and transfers to unobserved cities, and uncovers that spatial income segregation plays a key role in model transferability.

2604.23635.tldr: This work develops Expectations Management (EM): a culturally embedded model describing how practitioners shape, calibrate, and repair expectations by balancing organisational rights with culturally situated rites, and shows that EM differs from expectation-confirmation theory and trust-calibration by foregrounding moral judgement, situated action, and cross-cultural variation.

2604.23605.tldr: A novel chain-based clinical reasoning framework, called DxChain, which transforms the diagnostic workflow into an iterative process by mirroring a clinician's cognitive trajectory that consists of "Memory Anchoring","Navigation" and "Verification"phases.

2508.18473.tldr: This work forms the problem of detecting hallucinations as a hypothesis testing problem and draws parallels with the problem of out-of-distribution detection in machine learning models, and proposes a multiple-testing-inspired method that systematically aggregates multiple evaluation scores via conformal p-values, enabling calibrated detection with controlled false alarm rate.

2506.07435.tldr: This work introduces an efficient force layout algorithm that embeds a graph into a low-dimensional space, where the radial distance from the origin serves as a proxy for various centrality measures.

2506.06455.tldr: Six ML models were trained on six synthetic datasets with known ground truths, utilizing various model-agnostic interpretability techniques, as well as gradient-based and counterfactual-based explainers, underscoring the value of robust consensus strategies in improving explanation reliability.

2504.11349.tldr: This review surveys state-of-the-art AI-based 3D reconstruction algorithms in radiological imaging and organizes them into four representation families according to how the reconstructed target is parameterized: discrete grid representations, explicit basis expansion representations, explicit primitive representations, and implicit neural representations.

2411.08533.tldr: This work introduces ACROSS, a novel framework for translating data between tactile sensors by exploiting sensor deformation information, and demonstrates the approach to the most challenging problem of going from a low-dimensional tactile representation to a high-dimensional one.

2406.06587.tldr: This work investigates how well LLMs align with human touch experiences using the "textile hand" task, and suggests that a degree of perceptual alignment exists, however varies significantly among different textile samples.

2205.03886.tldr: This work proposes an end-to-end deep neural network-based architecture for image transmission and demonstrates its feasibility in a real-time wireless channel by implementing a prototype based on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA).

2412.10441.tldr: This work developed an algorithm for efficient computation of intrinsic volume of any volumetric data recovered from computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance (MR) and proposed the 30 configurations of volume values based on the polygonal mesh generation method.

2404.10425.tldr: This paper investigates a BioTac simulation that uses temperature, force, and contact point positions to predict the sensor outputs, and reveals that the XGBoost regressor and transformer outperform traditional feed-forward neural networks in this task.

2507.15707.tldr: This study investigates the performance of five LLMs on three different types of questions using quantitative and deductive reasoning tasks, and finds significant differences exist in LLM performance across different question types.

2503.06778.tldr: A holistic workflow that removes irrelevant documents, merges documents about the same event, and annotates the events is evaluated, finding LLM-based automated annotations are better than traditional TF-IDF-based methods or Event Set Curation but still not reliable annotators compared to human experts.

2501.16726.tldr: This work establishes a foundation for bridging the gap between theoretical models and real-world deployment, highlighting essential considerations for system design and optimization and identifies frequency selectivity of the actual channel as a critical factor in performance degradation.

2409.13869.tldr: This study investigates how generative artificial intelligence systems reproduce and reinforce societal biases, with a specific focus on the representation of women, Black individuals, age groups, and people with visible disabilities in AI-generated occupational images.

2104.05565.tldr: The state of the art of RL methods for their possible use for different problems of NLP, focusing primarily on conversational systems, is reviewed, mainly due to their growing relevance.

2412.07584.tldr: This work proposes a system that integrates the latest methodologies, introducing a novel pipeline that extracts multimodal data, and incorporate information from multiple frames within a video, enabling the model to abstract higher-level information that captures latent meanings.

2411.16073.tldr: Soft-TransFormers (Soft-TF), a continual learning framework that adapts a frozen pre-trained Transformer through task-specific soft subnetworks: real-valued multiplicative masks over the query, key, value, and output projections of selected self-attention layers, outperforms prompt-based, adapter-based, and LoRA-style baselines at comparable trainable-parameter budgets.

2509.11449.tldr: This study presents a deep tabular learning framework for predicting crash severity in electric vehicle (EV) collisions using real-world crash data from Texas (2017-2023) and highlights the potential of deep tabular architectures for improving crash severity prediction and enabling data-driven safety interventions in EV crash contexts.

2509.08470.tldr: The Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Representation Integration Technique (Sparse MERIT), a flexible MTL framework that applies frame-wise expert routing over self-supervised speech representations, provides robust and generalizable performance for both emotion recognition and enhancement tasks in noisy environments.

2508.18090.tldr: The feasibility of applying LLMs to NER in historical documents using zero-shot and few-shot prompting strategies, which require little to no task-specific training data are explored, suggesting that LLMs offer a viable and efficient alternative for information extraction in low-resource or historically significant corpora, where traditional supervised methods are infeasible.

2207.09845.tldr: This work isolates and quantifies the effect of feedback frequency in robotic tasks with continuous state and action spaces, and shows that seemingly contradictory reported phenomena occur at different complexity levels.

2411.05174.tldr: Across both synthetic environments and real healthcare scenarios like Intensive Care Unit (ICU) patient management in hypotension, this work demonstrates not only significant improvements in decision-making, but that the posterior can inform when transfer will be successful.

2206.06282.tldr: This work defines an easy-to-reproduce experimental setup for a robotic reach-and-balance manipulator task, which can serve as a benchmark for comparison and compares four randomization strategies with three randomized parameters both in simulation and on a real robot.

2203.11544.tldr: The current state of the art of visuo-haptic object perception in robots is summarized, the biological basis of human multimodal object perception is outlined, and promising new research directions are outlined.

2506.23773.tldr: BayesL (pronounced Basil), a logical framework for specifying, querying, and verifying the behaviour of BNs, is introduced, establishing a white-box verification paradigm in which model structure, assumptions, and reasoning processes are explicitly encoded and systematically checked.

2503.17783.tldr: An end-to-end pipeline is proposed that investigates the trade-off between energy efficiency and model performance for an LLM during fault ticket analysis in communication networks and shows that an appropriate combination of quantization and pruning techniques is able to reduce energy consumption while significantly improving model performance.

2603.27341.tldr: It is demonstrated that even with multi-billion parameter models and extensive training, current Vision Language Models fall short in the seemingly simple task of tool detection in neurosurgery, and experiments suggest that current models could still face significant obstacles in surgical use cases.

2603.26783.tldr: Stroke-size control is studied as a controlled intervention that changes the effective roughness of the supervised target, predictions and perturbations across timesteps, in an attempt to ease the low signal-to-noise challenge.

2603.13730.tldr: R3-REC (Reasoning-Retrieval-Recommendation), a prompt-centric, retrieval-augmented framework that unifies Multi-level User Intent Reasoning, Item Semantic Extraction, Long-Short Interest Polarity Mining, Similar User Collaborative Enhancement, and Reasoning-based Interest Matching and Scoring is proposed.

2603.15954.tldr: This work presents a methodology for designing large language models using hardware-in-the-loop architecture search under mobile latency constraints, and develops MobileLLM-Flash, a family of foundation models for efficient on-device use with strong capabilities, supporting up to 8k context length.

2604.12147.tldr: This paper presents the first extensive, systematic analysis of plan compliance in programming agents, examining 16,991 trajectories from SWE-agent across four LLMs on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro under eight plan variations.

2604.10359.tldr: Multinex is an ultra-lightweight structured framework that integrates multiple fine-grained representations within a principled Retinex residual formulation that significantly reduces computational cost and outperforms corresponding lightweight SOTA models.

2604.09019.tldr: RegimeRouter is proposed, a lightweight binary router that selects between question-only and question-plus-relation-sentence retrieval using five text features derived directly from the predicate definitions.

2604.07927.tldr: Q+ is introduced, a set of query and evidence processing tools that make web search more deliberate by guiding query planning, monitoring search progress, and extracting evidence from long web snapshots, and suggests that EigentSearch-Q+ produces more coherent tool-calling trajectories by making search progress and evidence handling explicit.

2604.04978.tldr: Results highlight a coverage boundary worth examining: auto mode assumes dangerous actions transit the shell, but agents routinely achieve equivalent effects through file edits that the classifier does not evaluate, highlighting a coverage boundary worth examining.

2604.03254.tldr: This paper provides a legal-technical analysis of the choices that shape how accuracy is defined, measured, and assessed, using the 2024 European Union AI Act -- which mandates an"appropriate level of accuracy" for high-risk systems -- as a primary case study.

2604.02467.tldr: VERTIGO is introduced, the first framework for visual preference optimization of camera trajectory generators, which leverages a real-time graphics engine to render 2D visual previews from generated camera motion and reduces the character off-screen rate from 38% to nearly 0% while preserving the geometric fidelity of camera motion.

2604.06171.tldr: This study evaluates three Large Language Model (LLM) methodologies — Fine-Tuning, RAG, and a Hybrid approach — for constructing a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Knowledge Base from support tickets and demonstrates that the generated knowledge base provides an excellent starting point for accelerating RCA tasks and improving network resilience.

2604.23947.tldr: Results suggest that phase-bounded architectural structure correlates more strongly with alignment quality than prompting strategy alone, and suggest that phase-bounded architectural structure correlates more strongly with alignment quality than prompting strategy alone.

2604.17121.tldr: It is argued that temporally extended cognition requires refocusing from explicit thought traces to implicit activation dynamics via recurrent architectures via recurrent architectures, and a taxonomy of recurrent and continuous-thought transformer architectures is introduced.

2604.09618.tldr: HearthNet is presented, an edge multi-agent orchestration system for smart homes that keeps orchestration, state management, and device control on-premise while using hosted LLM APIs for inference.

2604.03472.tldr: This work introduces vocabulary dropout, a lightweight intervention that randomly masks the proposer's output logits during both policy training and curriculum generation, and improves the solver by an average of +4.4 points at 8B with the largest gains on competition-level benchmarks.

2604.17188.tldr: A novel framework that couples explicit cognitive-style reasoning with reward-based optimization for multi-role dialogue summarization and demonstrates clear gains in factual faithfulness and model-based preference alignment is proposed.

2604.24983.tldr: This work proposes Prompt Embedding Optimization (PEO), a multi-round white-box jailbreak that directly optimizes the embeddings of the original prompt tokens without appending any adversarial tokens, and shows that the concern is unfounded.

2604.24955.tldr: Deployed on two prominent scientific benchmarks, BenchGuard identified 12 author-confirmed issues in ScienceAgentBench - including fatal errors rendering tasks unsolvable - and exactly matched 83.3% of expert-identified issues on the BIXBench Verified-50 subset, catching defects that prior human review missed entirely.

2604.24952.tldr: Semi-DPO is proposed, a semi-supervised approach that treats consistent pairs as clean labeled data and conflicting ones as noisy unlabeled data and significantly improves alignment with complex human preferences, without requiring additional human annotation or explicit reward models during training.

2604.24933.tldr: This work introduces S-SONDO (Self-Supervised KnOwledge DistillatioN for General AuDio FOundation Models), the first framework to distill general audio models using only their output embeddings, which is architecture-agnostic and broadly applicable to embedding-based teachers.

2604.24921.tldr: Libra-VLA is introduced, a novel Coarse-to-Fine Dual-System VLA architecture that explicitly decouple the learning complexity into a coarse-to-fine hierarchy to strike a training equilibrium, while simultaneously leveraging this structural modularity to implement an asynchronous execution strategy.

2604.24911.tldr: This work proposes a Bayesian framework to embed linear relationships across inputs and outputs into the learning process, whilst characterizing full predictive uncertainty over both the model parameters and the domain knowledge.

2604.24622.tldr: This work proposes CF-VLA, a coarse-to-fine two-stage formulation that restructures action generation into a coarse initialization step that constructs an action-aware starting point, followed by a single-step local refinement that corrects residual errors.

2604.24278.tldr: An abstention-aware transcription framework is introduced that enables ASR models to explicitly abstain from uncertain segments and RAS, a reliability-oriented metric that balances transcription informativeness and error aversion, is proposed.

2604.24827.tldr: Effective knowledge capacity is reported for all major proprietary frontier models as prediction bands rather than point estimates; for heavily safety-tuned models these are lower bounds, since refusal policy can suppress tens of percentage points of otherwise-answerable capacity.

2604.24819.tldr: It is shown that when a structured knowledge representation extracted from the source corpus serves as the shared foundation for both training data and evaluation, the complete data-engineering lifecycle maps onto the software development lifecycle in a precise and operative way.

2604.24811.tldr: Time-varying Interaction Graph Ordinary Differential Equations (TI-ODE) is proposed, which decomposes the evolution function of a graph ODE into a set of learnable interaction basis functions, where each basis function corresponds to a distinct type of inter-node interaction.

2604.24808.tldr: It is claimed that the ITAS (Intelligent Teaching Assistant System), a multi-agent tutoring system that a graduate quantum computing course used for a semester at Old Dominion University, is one workable answer to the question of what an LLM-based ITS needs to look like end-to-end to run in a real course.

2604.24807.tldr: ITAS (Intelligent Teaching Assistant System), a multi-agent tutoring system built around four contributions: a five-module QIS curriculum grounded in Watrous's information-first framework, a Spoke-and-Wheel teaching architecture with quantum-specialized agents, a cloud infrastructure designed for production use and regulatory compliance, and a conversational analytics layer for instructors and content developers.

2604.24788.tldr: This study explores the use of Liquid Neural Networks for short-horizon forecasting of the Henry Hub spot price, a primary benchmark for pricing and aims to reduce uncertainty and enhance decision support across energy trading and power market applications.

2604.24954.tldr: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni is introduced, the latest model in the Nemotron multimodal series and the first to natively support audio inputs alongside text, images, and video and incorporates innovative multimodal token-reduction techniques.

2604.24927.tldr: Exploratory Sampling (ESamp), a decoding approach that explicitly encourages semantic diversity during generation, achieves robust generalization across mathematics, science, and code generation benchmarks and breaks the trade-off between diversity and coherence in creative writing.

2604.24878.tldr: A systematic recipe for translating ReLU approximation results to softmax attention mechanism yields target-specific, economic resource bounds beyond universal approximation statements, and provides new analytical tools for analyzing softmax transformer models.

2604.24826.tldr: Evaluation results demonstrate that DKnownAI Guard achieves the highest recall rate and ranks first in true negative rate (TNR) and ranks first in true negative rate (TNR) among all evaluated guardrails, delivering the best overall performance among all evaluated guardrails.

2604.24814.tldr: SWE-QA, a text and code corpus aimed at benchmarking multi-hop code comprehension, addressing the gap between simplified evaluation tasks and the complex reasoning required in real-world software development is introduced.

2604.24806.tldr: Deployed on production DLRMs, the system reduces training data infrastructure resource usage while enabling aggressive sequence length scaling that delivers significant model quality gains, serving as the foundational data infrastructure for modern recommendation model architectures, including HSTU and ULTRA-HSTU.

2604.24790.tldr: It is found that injection variety is consistently more effective than repeating the same phrase, suggesting that models treat diverse safety cues as corroborating evidence, and that systems that route unauthenticated audio text directly into the LLM create an avoidable security dependency between safety monitoring and action selection.

2604.24785.tldr: The results reveal the benefits of using hardware accelerators such as NPUs and GPUs, along with multi-dimensional evaluations quantifying the trade-offs between power efficiency, physical device size and token throughput; offering practical guidance for deploying generative AI in privacy-sensitive and connectivity-limited environments such as unmanned vehicles and portable, ruggedised operations.

2604.24766.tldr: The proposed GCA-BULF, a bottom-up short-term load forecasting framework based on grouped critical appliances, supported by three key designs, improves hourly total load forecasting by 20.85%-57.88% compared to existing top-down methods and by 33.03%-92.48% compared to bottom-up methods.

2604.24477.tldr: Gammaf (Graph-based Anomaly Monitoring for LLM Multi-Agent systems Framework) is introduced, an open-source benchmarking platform designed to generate synthetic multi-agent interaction datasets and benchmark the performance of existing and future defense models.

2604.24987.tldr: A new framework is proposed, FairChart2Table, for analyzing y-axis-related bias on five state-of-the-art models because of significant y-axis biases related to the digit length of the major tick values, the number of major ticks, the range of values, and the tick value format.

2604.24929.tldr: This work proposes a refined workflow for adapting English benchmarks into multiple languages with explicit functional alignment, cultural alignment, and difficulty calibration using both automated checks and human review, and introduces GAIA-v2-LILT, a re-audited multilingual extension of GAIA covering five non-English languages.

2604.24920.tldr: The Secret-Use Delegation Protocol is proposed, in which a requester proposes a canonical operation, the user authorizes it with a fresh authenticator-backed grant, and a custodian redeems the grant to perform the bounded use; reusable authority never crosses the requester boundary.

2604.24833.tldr: This work proposes a large-scale modular latent generative backbone tailored for robust real-time motion generation, effectively modeling a dataset of over 350,000 motion clips with a single model, and introduces smart primitives that provide a unified, robust, and intuitive interface for authoring both navigation and object interaction.

2604.24810.tldr: This work builds on Adaptive Deep Neural Networks that employ the Multi-Armed Bandit framework, and introduces four additional Upper Confidence Bound strategies in ADNNs, namely UCB-V, UCB-Tuned, UCB-Bayes, and UCB-BwK, and performs a comparative study of these strategies with respect to trade-offs between accuracy, energy consumption, and latency.

2604.24179.tldr: This work proposes a prompted weak supervision (PWS) approach that decomposes meme understanding into targeted, question-based labeling functions with constrained answer options for homophobia and transphobia detection in the LT-EDI 2026 shared task.

2604.24996.tldr: PAT (Personalization with Aligned Trajectories), a reasoning framework for cold-start LLM personalization, which employs a reinforcement learning-based, iterative dual-reasoning mechanism that enables the LLM to jointly refine and integrate signals.

2604.24905.tldr: This paper proposes MultiHedge, a hybrid architecture where an LLM produces structured allocation decisions conditioned on retrieved historical precedents, and execution is grounded in canonical option strategies, and results show that memory and architectural design play a central role in robustness in modular decision systems.

2604.24881.tldr: This work develops a framework that distills multi-agent debate into a single LLM through a two-stage fine-tuning pipeline combining debate structure learning with internalization via dynamic reward scheduling and length clipping, and investigates the mechanistic basis of this capability through activation steering.

2604.24842.tldr: Co-Director, a hierarchical multi-agent framework formalizing video storytelling as a global optimization problem, is presented, offering a principled approach that seamlessly generalizes to broader cinematic narratives.

2604.24832.tldr: This work proposes two locality aware blockwise models, namely Jigsaw and Scatter, that inject left-to-right inductive bias by enforcing autoregressive locality within blocks while preserving iterative refinement at the block level to mitigate instabilities in standard random masking models.

2604.24820.tldr: This work identifies the major bottleneck and presents a hardware accelerator for long context attention decoding via hardware-software co-design and proposes dual-compression dynamic sparse attention, which is the first ASIC accelerator that efficiently supports long context inference.

2604.24809.tldr: It is proved that the SCA readout mechanism can exactly retrieve any individual token from the prefix summary and can reproduce any output of softmax attention as a special case, establishing that SCA is at least as expressive as full self-attention in the continuous limit.

2604.24040.tldr: This work introduces a lightweight residual bottleneck adapter on top of a frozen encoder that maps single-serialization embeddings towards centroid targets while preserving variance and enforcing covariance regularization.

2604.24026.tldr: These findings suggest that an explicit, source-grounded structure can make agent skills easier to search and review, positioning SSL as a practical step toward more inspectable, reusable, and operationally actionable skill representations, rather than a finished standard or end-to-end skill-management mechanism.

2604.24877.tldr: This work builds a data engine that transforms well-lit images into supervised training triplets consisting of a poorly-illuminated input image, a natural language lighting instruction, and a well-illuminated output image and finetune a diffusion model on this data.

2604.24794.tldr: A taxonomy of voice generation risk grounded in a multi-source threat modeling effort, which explicitly models how risk emerges, interact with contextual factors such as degree of exposure, social visibility, and the availability of legal protections for various affected groups.

2604.25224.tldr: ValueBlindBench is a pre-calibration metrology layer for AI-finance evaluation: it governs whether a proposed LLM-judge-based investment-rationale claim is stable enough, agreed enough, and uncontaminated enough to be reported at all.

2604.25220.tldr: This work introduces DataReel, a benchmark for automated data-driven video story generation comprising 328 real-world stories, and proposes a multi-agent framework that decomposes the task into planning, generation, and verification stages, mirroring key aspects of the human storytelling process.

2604.25088.tldr: This work introduces Cooperate to Compete (C2C), a multi-agent environment where players can engage in private negotiations while competing to be the first to achieve their secret objective, and establishes C2C as a testbed for studying and building LM-based agents that can navigate the sophisticated coordination required for real-world deployments.

2604.25053.tldr: This paper analyzes the intermediate reasoning steps of LLMs to uncover hidden stigmatizing language and the internal rationales driving it, and rates the severity of these statements, distinguishing between overt prejudice and more subtle, less immediately harmful biases.

2604.25047.tldr: Pedagogical challenges, including difficulties in teaching hands-on subjects and sustaining student engagement, emerged as the most critical concerns and highlighted the importance of strengthening pedagogical training, providing clear institutional support, and fostering responsible competence in AI use.

2604.25039.tldr: This project aims to address the gap: can Small Language Models (SLMs) reason reliably using the same or fewer tokens, and probes whether process supervision and simple test-time controls can substitute for model scale or large sampling counts.

2604.25299.tldr: This work draws inspiration from modular human cognition and proposes a recursive, sparse mixture-of-experts framework integrated into conventional diffusion models that iteratively refines visual tokens over multiple latent steps while efficiently sharing parameters via sparse selection of neural modules.

2604.25008.tldr: A novel framework is proposed to meet URLLC requirements through a synergistic integration of extreme value theory (EVT) with generative artificial intelligence (AI), demonstrating that this integration enhances data augmentation for extreme quantiles, while requiring fewer samples than traditional analytical EVT methods and generative baselines in online estimation of channel distribution.

2604.25334.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage framework that integrates deep representation learning with statistically interpretable hypothesis testing and introduces a projection-based score that admits a natural hypothesis testing interpretation, allowing for a distribution-free calibration procedure.

2604.25325.tldr: R$^3$-SQL, a Text-to-SQL framework that addresses both issues through unified reward for ranking and resampling, and introduces agentic resampling, which judges the generated candidate pool and selectively resamples when the correct SQL is likely absent.

2604.25191.tldr: This work identifies the reward design as the primary cause for the performance gap with experts, and instead of formalizing intricate processes, it bypasses this by directly learning from expert layouts to derive a reward model.

2604.25166.tldr: It is demonstrated that a small transformer can learn to execute programs in MicroPy, a simplified yet computationally universal programming language, and that the trained model can achieve out-of-distribution generalization; i.e., evaluate novel programs from distribution on programs.

2604.25161.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed capability-oriented testing approach discovers more failure cases and more accurately pinpoints capability-level deficiencies than state-of-the-art baselines, providing more interpretable and actionable guidance for improving embodied agents.

2604.25150.tldr: This work analyzes weight-space symmetries in neural networks and proves that these symmetries act as a form of diagonal preconditioning on the Hessian, enabling the existence of better-conditioned minima within each equivalence class of functionally identical solutions.

2604.25136.tldr: This work introduces a compact taxonomy of frictive interventions, a structured friction functional that operationalizes multiple alignment failure modes, and a unified family of FPO methods spanning reward shaping, preference pairing, group-relative ranking, and risk-conditioned trust regions.

2604.25149.tldr: This work benchmarks three frontier LLMs and interprets the presence of the semantic-layer document as a structural result: explicit business semantics suppress the dominant class of text-to-SQL errors not by making the model more capable, but by changing what the model is being asked to do.

2604.25000.tldr: This work formalizes this residual openness as a closure-gap vector, defines delegation envelopes as pre-authorized regions of action space, distinguish misclosure from undersearch, and outline benchmark metrics for testing when closure interventions outperform additional inference-time search.

2604.24999.tldr: BifDet is introduced, the first publicly-available dataset specialized for 3D airway bifurcation detection, filling a critical gap in existing resources and providing detailed pipelines, including preprocessing steps and specific implementation design choices.

2604.25318.tldr: This work presents Cutscene Agent, an LLM agent framework for automated end-to-end cutscene generation, and evaluates a range of LLMs on CutsceneBench, a hierarchical evaluation benchmark for cutscene generation.

2604.25297.tldr: This study introduces LegalMidm, a Korean legal-domain LLM, and presents a methodology for constructing high-quality, use-case-driven legal datasets and optimized training pipelines, with a focus on Korean law.

2604.25200.tldr: A TEE-based architecture that helps reconcile requirements for auditable, contestable, and accountable evaluation through remote attestation, and includes a canonicalization and sanitization layer that normalizes document representations and records suspicious transformations before inference.

2604.25085.tldr: A general model of audit policy design as a principal-agent game with multiple agents, where the principal commits to an audit policy, and agents collectively choose an equilibrium that minimizes the principal's utility is introduced.

2604.25272.tldr: This work studies a bandit problem where the payoffs of arms are smooth on a graph, and introduces the notion of an effective dimension, which is small in real-world graphs, and proposes three algorithms for solving the problem that scale linearly and sublinearly in this dimension.

2604.25267.tldr: A robust framework for DUCPP to achieve efficient UGV-UAV cooperation for path planning and inspection is presented, offering practical solutions for navigation in challenging and uncertain conditions.

2604.25256.tldr: This work presents AutoResearchBench, a dedicated benchmark for autonomous scientific literature discovery, which is research-oriented, calling for in-depth comprehension of scientific concepts; literature-focused, demanding fine-grained utilization of detailed information; and open-ended, involving an unknown number of qualified papers and thus requiring deliberate reasoning and search throughout.

2604.25249.tldr: It is proposed that positional-distribution shift may be a more effective behavioural signature than below-chance accuracy for detecting prompted underperformance at this model scale.

2604.25231.tldr: The DRAGON dataset contains 11,664 annotated question instances collected from six diagram QA datasets and is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating evidence-grounded visual reasoning in diagrams with a 2,445-instance benchmark test set with human-verified reasoning evidence annotations and a standardized evaluation framework.

2604.25203.tldr: This work presents BARRED (Boundary Alignment Refinement through REflection and Debate), a framework for generating faithful and diverse synthetic training data using only a task description and a small set of unlabeled examples, offering a scalable solution for accurate custom guardrails.

2604.25143.tldr: The SED-LCH coupling is therefore a strong diagnostic of where feature formation concentrates in parameter space, but it is not a unique causal pathway: the natural full-rank AdamW attention update is highly rank-redundant under the authors' hyperparameters.

2604.25083.tldr: This work introduces Agentic Architect, an agentic AI framework for computer architecture design exploration and optimization that combines LLM-driven code evolution with cycle-accurate simulation and is the first end-to-end open-source framework for agentic AI architecture exploration and optimization.

2604.25071.tldr: This work is the first to show that real-world scalable privacy-preserving biometric authentication without auxiliary identifiers is feasible, and it is believed that it will spur widespread industrial adoption and further research in this area.
