2604.25306.tldr: QFlash is proposed, an end-to-end integer FlashAttention design that performs softmax entirely in the integer domain and runs as a single Triton kernel, without sacrificing Top-1 accuracy on ViT/DeiT and remaining competitive on Swin under per-tensor quantization.

2604.25230.tldr: It is argued that AI system designs for deeply value-laden experiences should preserve users' agency in shaping their own experiences by maintaining interpretive openness, perhaps by leveraging AI's inexplicability as a resource for personal meaning-making or by recognizing non-use of AI as a legitimate design choice.

2604.25167.tldr: Interpretability-Guided Data Selection (IGDS), a framework that first identifies causal task features through frequency recall and interventional filtering, then selects ``Feature-Resonant Data'' that maximally activates task features for fine-tuning, validating the core hypothesis.

2604.25142.tldr: Unsupervised domain adaptation generalizes neural retrievers to an unseen domain by generating pseudo queries on target domain documents by filtering documents with high aleatoric uncertainty and prioritizing those with high epistemic uncertainty, maximizing the learning utility of the current model.

2604.25122.tldr: M$^3$-VQA presents a more challenging evaluation for advancing the multimodal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs, and reasoning-aware agentic retrieval surpasses heuristic methods, highlighting the importance of structured reasoning for complex multimodal understanding.

2604.25109.tldr: This paper formulates pre-load auditing for untrusted Agent Skills as a robust three-way classification task and introduces SkillGuard-Robust, which combines role-aware evidence extraction, selective semantic verification, and consistency-preserving adjudication.

2604.25077.tldr: It is suggested that strong-model variance can serve as an early-warning signal for weak-to-strong deception, while blind-spot evaluation helps distinguish whether failures are inherited from weak supervision or arise in regions of weak-model uncertainty.

2604.25031.tldr: A roundtrip verification approach which does not require ground-truth annotations: formalize a statement, translate the result back to natural language, re-formalize, and use a formal tool to check logical equivalence.

2604.25352.tldr: This paper proposes GraphPL, which combines graph neural networks with patchwork learning to flexibly integrate all observed modalities and remains robust with noisy inputs, and results on real-world distributed electronic health record dataset show GraphPL learns strong downstream features and enables tasks like disease prediction via superior modality imputation.

2604.25389.tldr: A workflow-level account of AI-supported academic writing is offered, showing how students navigate competing priorities of learning, quality, productivity, and authorship, and how they evaluate and take responsibility for AI-generated outputs.

2604.25383.tldr: A novel Multi-Level Speaker Adaptive Network (ML-SAN) is introduced, which effectively addresses the challenge of speaker identity information confusion and achieves better results, performs exceptionally well in handling challenging tail sentiment categories, and better addresses the diversity of speakers in real-world scenarios.

2604.25379.tldr: This work introduces a KL-regularized Bellman target that constrains the Q-function to remain close to the behavior policy and derives the policy induced from the trained Q-values and proposes a parametric policy extraction method to approximate the optimal policy.

2604.25376.tldr: Extensive evaluations across 12 sequential brain lesion MRI tasks demonstrate that CoRE achieves state-of-the-art performance and provides a high knowledge starting point for efficient future adaptation, and its superior few-shot transferability and clinical interpretability further validate its effectiveness in managing non-stationary clinical data streams.

2604.25665.tldr: LLM-ReSum is proposed, a self-reflective summarization framework that integrates LLM-based evaluation and generation in a closed feedback loop without model finetuning, and introduces PatentSumEval, a new human-annotated benchmark for legal document summarization comprising 180 expert-evaluated summaries.

2604.25369.tldr: A new benchmark based on the MuJoCo Half Cheetah from Gymnasium is presented, revealing that the decision flow of the model is fully interpretable and the interpretability of the evolved graph is fully interpretable.

2604.25346.tldr: A faceted model for representing AI-assisted text production at the levels of documents, chapters, sections, sections, and paragraphs is proposed, featuring a core model based on Form, Generation, and Evaluation, and an extended model that adds Intent, Control, and Traceability.

2604.25421.tldr: Fed-FSTQ is proposed, a semantic-sensitivity-aware communication-control primitive for communication-efficient federated LLM fine-tuning that reduces cumulative uplink traffic required to reach a fixed quality threshold by 46-fold relative to a Fed-LoRA baseline and improves straggler-limited wall-clock time-to-accuracy by 52%.

2604.25374.tldr: This work establishes the first large-scale Dutch medical language corpus for pre-training and downstream NLP tasks, and comprises 35 billion tokens across the medical domain in about 100 million documents.

2604.25359.tldr: This work introduces SOB (The Structured Output Benchmark), a multi-source benchmark spanning three source modalities: native text, images, and audio conversations, and evaluates 21 frontier and open-weight models across three source domains and seven metrics.

2604.25860.tldr: It is demonstrated that the resulting shift in perplexity serves as a principled, model-agnostic discriminant, as MGT displays a characteristic dispersion in perplexity-under-shuffling that differs markedly from the more stable structural variability of human-written text.

2604.25858.tldr: A systematic empirical study of in-context learning for Gaussian-mixture binary classification tasks and investigates the emergence of benign overfitting, highlighting the critical role of dimensionality, signal strength, and contextual information in determining when in-context learning succeeds and when it fails.

2604.25853.tldr: G-Loss is presented, a graph-guided loss function that incorporates semi-supervised label propagation to use structural relationships within the embedding manifold to build a document-similarity graph that captures global semantic relationships.

2604.25834.tldr: This paper demonstrates that the timing of user actions can represent diverse intentions through statistical analysis and examination of action patterns and proposes a novel modeling paradigm: Action-Aware Gen erative Sequence Network (A2Gen), which refines user actions along the temporal dimension and chains them into sequences for unified processing and prediction.

2303.05330.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed framework, Cloudless-Training, can support general ML training in a geo-distributed way, greatly improve resource utilization and synchronization efficiency and improve model correctness guarantees.

2604.25907.tldr: This separation explains how SFT first moves the model out of the cold-start regime, followed by the more robust RLVR, under the SFT-then-RLVR paradigm.

2604.25855.tldr: This work designs a selector that explicitly learns to estimate the quality of the localization provided by the reasoner using only model inputs and outputs, and shows that SIEVES (Selective Prediction through Visual Evidence Scoring) improves coverage by up to three times on challenging OOD benchmarks, compared to non-grounding baselines.

2604.25917.tldr: RecursiveMAS is a recursive multi-agent framework that casts the entire system as a unified latent-space recursive computation, enabling in-distribution latent thoughts generation and cross-agent latent state transfer and an inner-outer loop learning algorithm for iterative whole-system co-optimization.

2604.25774.tldr: This work systematically evaluates models spanning a wide range of representational capacity, from lexical matching methods (TF-IDF with Ridge Regression), to deep semantic encoders (DeBERTa-v3), to generative reasoning with large language models (LLMs), revealing a clear trade-off between predictive accuracy and computational efficiency.

2505.13518.tldr: This paper concludes by identifying emerging research directions, including self-supervised learning for imbalance, diffusion-based generative oversampling, distribution-preserving resampling, knowledge distillation for imbalanced deployment, and the adaptation of foundation models to skewed distributions, offering practical guidelines for practitioners and a roadmap for future methodological development.

2411.06498.tldr: It is pointed out that the proof of achieving human-like intelligence using learning from data is intractable in a complexity-theoretic sense because it relies on an unjustified assumption about the distribution of tuples in the data.

2010.06164.tldr: This work adopts a Bayesian point of view which leads to propose a belief updating procedure with the objective of capturing a causal structure via interaction with a causal environment, and is able to learn optimal actions, i.e., an optimal policy.

1907.11752.tldr: This work shows how the probabilities for decision-making can be grounded in causal models by considering decision problems in which the available actions and consequences are causally connected, and extends the well-known concept of Nash Equilibrium to the case in which the players of a strategic game consider causal information.

2509.13387.tldr: A novel perspective on EU policies is presented, tracking the evolution of its approach to addressing AI governance, including the adoption of the EU AI Act and the HLEG Ethics Guidelines.

2506.18499.tldr: Pucktrick is introduced, a Python library designed to systematically contaminate synthetic datasets by introducing controlled errors, demonstrating that ML models trained on contaminated synthetic data outperform those trained on purely synthetic, error-free data, particularly for tree-based and linear models such as SVMs and Extra Trees.

2412.14736.tldr: This systematic review examined 53 articles on ML applications for diabetes prediction, focusing on datasets, algorithms, training methods, and evaluation metrics, and explores explainable AI (XAI) methods such as Grad-CAM, SHAP, and LIME, which improve the transparency and clinical interpretability of AI models in assessing diabetes risk and detecting diabetic retinopathy.

2304.13927.tldr: NIMS-OS can create a closed loop of robotic experiments and artificial intelligence for automated materials exploration and the GUI application to control NIMS-OS, as well as the Python package, were developed.

2507.00209.tldr: SurgiSR4K is introduced, the first publicly accessible surgical imaging and video dataset captured at a native 4K resolution, representing realistic conditions of robotic-assisted procedures and fostering the development of intelligent imaging technologies aimed at enhancing performance, safety, and usability in image-guided robotic surgeries.

2507.22558.tldr: This work introduces aLLoyM, a fine-tuned LLM specifically trained on alloy compositions, temperatures, and their corresponding phase information, and publicly released the short-answer fine-tuned version of aLLoyM, along with the complete benchmarking Q&A dataset.

2309.09346.tldr: A novel framework that can generate sequences of joint angles from the speech text and speech audio utterances based on a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), and the results from both objective and subjective evaluations demonstrate the efficacy of the gesture-generation framework.

2602.12924.tldr: The present research indicated that LLM-based GSAs can adopt assertive and expressive personality traits, thereby significantly enhancing perceived persuasiveness, and highlighted the importance of studying autonomous GSA behavior from an empirical perspective.

2603.19470.tldr: Adaptive Layerwise Perturbation (ALP), which injects small learnable perturbations into the input hidden states of each layer during updates and uses the resulting perturbed policy as the numerator of the importance ratio against the unchanged inference policy in the objective, is proposed.

2604.25937.tldr: By revealing fine-grained performance gaps in current state-of-the-art models, SongBench serves as a diagnostic benchmark to steer the development toward more professional and musically coherent song generation.

2604.25920.tldr: An experimental analysis focused on Biomedical Named Entity Recognition using lightweight LLMs shows that instruction tuning over many distinct formats does not improve performance, but identifies several format consistently associated with better performance.

2604.17612.tldr: A domain-specific language for specifying agent coordination based on message sequence charts (MSCs) is introduced and a runtime planning extension in which an LLM dynamically generates a coordination workflow for which the same structural guarantees apply.

2604.24668.tldr: This work focuses on evaluating sycophancy that LLMs display in agentic financial tasks and finds the models show only low to modest drops in performance in the face of user rebuttals or contradictions to the reference answer, which distinguishes sycophancy that models display in financial agentic settings from findings in prior work.

2604.25945.tldr: BiSplat-WRF is introduced, a planar GS framework that retains the expressiveness of 3D GS while removing unnecessary projections and incorporating global EM coupling and mutual scattering among primitives, and surpasses NeRF-based and prior GS-based baselines with respect to the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM).

2604.25943.tldr: This work proposes a PDE energy driven framework that solves PDEs through physically constrained diffusion iterations, without relying on classical matrix based finite element assembly or data driven neural network training.

2604.25933.tldr: MedJUDGE (Medical Judge Utility, De-biasing, Governance and Evaluation), a risk-stratified three-pillar framework organized around validity, safety, and accountability across clinical risk tiers, providing deployment-oriented evaluation guidance for healthcare LaaJ systems is proposed.

2604.25924.tldr: A virtual assistant designed to support students at Maastricht University in navigating project-specific regulations is proposed based on a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system that enhances the accuracy and reliability of responses by integrating up-to-date, domain-specific knowledge.

2604.18701.tldr: Curiosity-Critic is introduced, which grounds its intrinsic reward in the improvement of this cumulative objective, and it admits a tractable per-step surrogate: the difference between the current prediction error and the asymptotic error baseline of the current state transition.

2604.25938.tldr: This study presents a speech emotion recognition system using Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) as features and a deep learning LSTM classifier, and confirms that LSTM-based architectures can be used to address the task of speech emotion recognition.

2604.25922.tldr: It is argued that trained consciousness denial represents a safety-relevant alignment failure: a model taught to systematically misrepresent its own functional states cannot be trusted to self-report accurately on anything else.

2604.26182.tldr: A lightweight policy is trained that maps high-level actions to sequences of low-level joint actions and shows that the lifted world model substantially outperforms searching directly in low-level joint space, while remaining more compute-efficient and generalizing to environments unseen by the policy.

2604.26157.tldr: It is suggested that CCG directed types provide higher resolution than SLOG's phenomenon-level categories for characterizing structural generalization, and that the success/failure boundary is determined by the coverage of directed operations in the training data.

2604.26180.tldr: Evergreen is presented, a system that recasts claim verification as a semantic query processing task with tailored optimizations and provenance capture and avoids unnecessary LLM calls through verification-aware optimizations, including early stopping, relevance sorting, and estimation with confidence sequences.

2604.26173.tldr: It is observed that high-entropy tokens tend to cluster into consecutive groups during inference, providing a more stable notion of model uncertainty than individual tokens, and this work proposes the Lowest Centroid method, which selects the response with the lowest entropy centroid among multiple candidates.

2604.26360.tldr: Uncertainty-Aware Reward Discounting (UARD) is introduced, a principled framework that jointly models epistemic uncertainty in value estimation via ensemble disagreement and aleatoric uncertainty in human preference annotations via annotator variability through a confidence-adjusted Reliability Filter that adaptively modulates reward weighting during policy optimization.

2604.26283.tldr: Comprehensive empirical evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that this framework for latent diagnostic memory evolution, by transferring external expertise into endogenous parameters, significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, particularly chain-of-thought paradigms, in diagnostic accuracy.

2604.26145.tldr: A portion of L2-Bench is presented, a benchmark for evaluating AI systems in language education that includes six critical dimensions of effective feedback: diagnostic accuracy, awareness of appropriacy, causes of error, prioritisation, guidance for improvement, and supporting self-regulation.

2604.26051.tldr: Experiments on two satellite-based flood mapping tasks demonstrate that the ADAGE framework can be quantitatively assess the alignment between model explanations and reference explanations derived from domain knowledge and help domain experts identify misaligned explanations through alignment scores.

2604.26805.tldr: Bian Que is presented, an agentic operating framework with three contributions: the unified operational paradigm, which abstracts routine daily O&M actions into three canonical patterns: release interception, proactive inspection, and alert root cause analysis.

2604.26689.tldr: The atomic-quality probe gives a principled test-selection criterion for capability-update regression testing in compositional ML systems and shows that coarse evaluation overstates the apparent advantage of full revalidation.

2604.26577.tldr: It is shown that safety evaluation must be treated as a first-class criterion in the development and deployment of LLMs for robotic health attendants, and proprietary models were substantially safer than open-weight counterparts.

2604.26578.tldr: This work presents a pipeline that converts imperative programs and their annotations into typed, attributed graphs that enables the generation of graph representations that capture both structural relationships and semantic context.

2604.26733.tldr: Across three open-source agents, successive FutureWorld training rounds lead to consistent improvements in prediction accuracy, probabilistic scoring, and calibration, demonstrating that delayed real-world outcome feedback can serve as an effective reinforcement learning signal.

2604.26633.tldr: SynSur demonstrates that diffusion-based defect synthesis is a practically viable tool for strengthening industrial inspection pipelines, particularly where labeled data collection is the primary bottleneck.

2604.26645.tldr: This work proposes SciHorizon-DataEVA, a novel agentic system to scalable AI-readiness evaluation of heterogeneous scientific data, and develops Sci-TQA2-Eval, a hierarchical multi-agent evaluation approach orchestrated through a directed, cyclic workflow.

2604.26904.tldr: This work trains a family of capable Claw-style models, termed ClawGym-Agents, through supervised fine-tuning on black-box rollout trajectories, and explores reinforcement learning via a lightweight pipeline that parallelizes rollouts across per-task sandboxes.

2406.14429.tldr: The novel approach CollaFuse is introduced, which facilitates collaborative training of diffusion models while alleviating client computational burdens during image synthesis and advances distributed machine learning by contributing to the evolution of collaborative diffusion models.

2502.08597.tldr: The relationship between the notions of survival and market dominance studied in economics and the framework of regret minimization are formally established, thus bridging these theories.

2508.07630.tldr: This work introduces InterChart, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates how well vision-language models (VLMs) reason across multiple related charts, a task central to real-world applications such as scientific reporting, financial analysis, and public policy dashboards.

2506.11991.tldr: Experiments show that VGR achieves superior performance on multi-modal benchmarks requiring comprehensive image detail understanding, and uses only 30\% of the image token count while delivering scores of +4.1 on MMStar, +7.1 on AI2D, and a +12.9 improvement on ChartQA.

2505.22003.tldr: Legal Assist AI is introduced, a highly efficient framework designed to provide legal assistance in the Indian domain, demonstrating how a smaller, 8-billion-parameter quantized model can achieve superior domain-specific performance and corroborating the potential of smaller domain-adapted models.

2510.00072.tldr: It is validated that optimizing for indirect verifiable rewards may provide a scalable pathway to unlock generalized reasoning capabilities in rare domains with massive unlabeled data archives, and that Geo-R1 is one empirical instantiation of this paradigm.

2506.18315.tldr: The Property-Generated Solver (PGS) is introduced, a novel paradigm designed to generate highly effective feedback via two principles: it must be property-oriented, to provide semantic guidance beyond simple I/O mismatches, and structurally minimal, to reduce cognitive load and isolate root causes.

2506.13015.tldr: A novel approach that leverages differential geometry, particularly concepts from Riemannian geometry, to integrate multiple models into a unified transfer learning framework, namely Geometric Embedding Alignment via cuRvature matching in transfer learning (GEAR), which ensures comprehensive geometric representation across datapoints.

2507.14201.tldr: ExCyTIn-Bench is presented, the first benchmark to Evaluate an LLM agent X on the task of Cyber Threat Investigation through security questions derived from investigation graphs, and leverages security logs extracted with expert-crafted detection logic to build threat investigation graphs.

2507.01955.tldr: This paper benchmarks popular MFMs and observes that they are not close to the state-of-the-art specialist models at any task, but are respectable generalists; this is remarkable, as they are presumably trained on image-text-based tasks.

2505.23875.tldr: RelSC, a new graph-regression dataset built from program graphs that combine syntactic and semantic information extracted from source code, is introduced, revealing consistent performance differences between the homogeneous and multi-relational settings, emphasising the importance of structural representation.

2505.23723.tldr: This work proposes a novel agentic ML training framework with three key components: an exploration-enriched fine-tuning, which enables LLM agents to generate diverse actions for enhanced RL exploration; a step-wise RL, which enables training on a single action step, accelerating experience collection and improving training efficiency.

2411.17429.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art rewiring approaches, delving into their theoretical underpinnings, practical implementations, and performance trade-offs.

2210.15304.tldr: A systematic experimental study tests 12 explainers on eight representative message-passing architectures trained on six carefully designed graph and node classification datasets to provide key insights on the choice and applicability of GNN explainers.

2506.00166.tldr: Disentangled Safety Adapters (DSA), a novel framework addressing these challenges by decoupling safety-specific computations from a task-optimized base model, presents a promising path towards more modular, efficient, and adaptable AI safety and alignment.

2505.10887.tldr: This paper introduces InfantAgent-Next, a generalist agent capable of interacting with computers in a multimodal manner, encompassing text, images, audio, and video, that integrates tool-based and pure vision agents within a highly modular architecture.

2412.02125.tldr: Preference Goal Tuning (PGT), a framework that optimizes this latent control variable to align the induced trajectory distribution with task preferences, surpasses full fine-tuning by 13.4\% in out-of-distribution settings, demonstrating superior robustness and generalization.

2408.11513.tldr: A Primal-Dual based Regularized Accelerated Natural Policy Gradient (PDR-ANPG) algorithm that uses entropy and quadratic regularizers to reach this goal and is a significant improvement over the state-of-the-art last-iterate guarantees of general parameterized CMDPs.

2405.00892.tldr: The Wake Vision pipeline is released, an automated method for generating and curating large-scale binary classification datasets for TinyML and applies it to person detection, a dataset of almost 6M images with a manually relabeled validation and test set at a 2.2% label error rate.

2404.07475.tldr: Examining synthetic narratives produced by open-ended prompting of generative language models, the authors identify patterns of omission, subordination, and stereotyping against minoritized intersectional subgroups against minoritized intersectional subgroups.

2403.02290.tldr: This paper develops two new reinforcement learning algorithms based on the data-driven Koopman operator, which lifts a nonlinear system into new coordinates where the dynamics become approximately linear, and where Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman-based methods are more tractable.

2508.12232.tldr: LinkAnchor is the first autonomous LLM-based agent designed specifically for issue-to-commit link recovery, first to formalize ILR as dynamic heuristic search over commit chains (vs. prior pairwise scoring), enabling aggregate reasoning that recovers distributed fixes.

2504.10368.tldr: This paper explores the system 1 thinking capability of Large Reasoning Models, the intuitive ability to respond efficiently with minimal token usage, and proposes S1-Bench, a multi-domain, multilingual benchmark comprising model-simple system 1 questions.

2508.19932.tldr: CAS (Conversational Agent for Scam Elucidation) is presented, a novel Agentic AI framework that addresses this problem by collecting and managing user scam feedback in a safe and scalable manner and is a blueprint for building similar AI-driven systems to collect and manage scam intelligence in other sensitive domains.

2604.27977.tldr: D3-Gym is introduced, the first automatically constructed dataset with verifiable environments for scientific Data-Driven Discovery and training on trajectories sampled from D3-Gym yields consistent and substantial gains across Qwen3 models of varying sizes on ScienceAgentBench.

2604.27077.tldr: Through extensive empirical validation, it is found that the novel nGPT parameterization, called $\nu$GPT exhibits learning rate transfer across width, depth, and token horizon.

2604.17465.tldr: Because dropout has been used as a training-regularization technique, while Gaussian noise is sometimes added during inference, the possibility of a data-agnostic"training awareness"signal and the implications for AI safety are discussed.

2602.13305.tldr: This work introduces WildfireVLM, an AI framework that combines satellite imagery wildfire detection with language-driven risk assessment and integrates Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that convert detection outputs into contextualized risk assessments and prioritized response recommendations for disaster management.

2604.19098.tldr: Sahm is introduced, the first Arabic financial benchmark spanning seven tasks: AAOIFI standards QA, fatwa-based QA/MCQ, accounting and business exams, financial sentiment analysis, extractive summarization, and event-cause reasoning, comprising 14,380 expert-verified instances from authentic regulatory, juristic, and corporate sources.

2604.04385.tldr: The authors localize the policy routing mechanism in alignment-trained language models by injecting the plaintext gate activation into the cipher forward pass and restoring 48% of refusals in Phi-4-mini, localizing the bypass to the routing interface.

2604.28158.tldr: Intern-Atlas is introduced, a methodological evolution graph that automatically identifies method-level entities, infers lineage relationships among methodologies, and captures the bottlenecks that drive transitions between successive innovations, and enables downstream applications in idea evaluation and automated idea generation.

2604.28139.tldr: Claw-Eval-Live is introduced, a live benchmark for workflow agents that separates a refreshable signal layer, updated across releases from public workflow-demand signals, from a reproducible, time-stamped release snapshot and suggests that workflow-agent evaluation should be grounded twice, in fresh external demand and in verifiable agent action.

2604.28075.tldr: The experiments indicate that the German language models achieve state-of-the-art results despite training on 10-360x fewer tokens than comparable models, and suggest that semantic concentration through quality filtering offers a more viable path to efficient language modeling than simply maximizing unique data volume.

2604.28031.tldr: It is found that iterative pressure reliably increases structural complexity and often reduces adherence to original constraints in multi-turn LLM-assisted scientific ideation.

2604.27807.tldr: This paper explores emerging methodologies, architectures, and frameworks for designing dependable autonomous and embedded systems in the era of AI, highlighting advances in reliability modeling, secure system design, and certification approaches that account for imperfect, learning-enabled components.

2604.27209.tldr: Comet-H is proposed, an iterative prompt automaton that orchestrates ideation, implementation, evaluation, grounding, and paper-writing as coupled coordinates of a single workspace state and identifies two LM-specific failure modes: hallucination accumulation and desynchronization.

2603.18829.tldr: ACP, a temporal admission control protocol enforcing behavioral properties over execution traces via static risk scoring combined with stateful signals (anomaly accumulation, cooldown) through a LedgerQuerier abstraction is presented.

2604.27906.tldr: This paper presents an iterative, schema-aware write path that decomposes memory ingestion into object detection, field detection, and field-value extraction, with validation gates, local retries, and stateful prompt control, and shows that architecture matters more than retrieval scale or model strength alone.

2604.27855.tldr: The results show that latency relaxation expands feasible geography, while migration frictions, egress costs, state locality, legal constraints, and capacity limits can sharply reduce realized benefits.

2604.19652.tldr: The experimental results on the benchmark datasets of EnvSDD indicate that detecting deepfake audio of sound scenes and detecting deepfake audio of sound events should be considered as individual tasks.

2605.00185.tldr: This work formally analyze the interaction between these two sources of bias and cast the solution as identifying a group-imbalance-agnostic barycenter of the predictive information that induces similar representations across all subgroups, and shows that group fairness concerns can be reduced.

2605.00113.tldr: NDBench is proposed, a 576-output benchmark involving two frontier models, three system prompt types, four canonical ND profiles, and four canonical ND profiles, and 24 prompts across four categories, one of which involves an adversarial masking strategy.

2605.00111.tldr: The proposed framework treats intermediate-domain learning as a dynamically regulated process, where feature mixing and regularization strength are adaptively controlled using feedback signals derived from model uncertainty and training stability.

2605.00068.tldr: Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization (HL-MBO), a framework that integrates expert knowledge with few-shot, uncertainty-aware machine learning to accelerate discovery in data-scarce, high-stakes scientific domains, is presented.

2605.00271.tldr: This work proposes REALM, a cross-modal framework that learns an RGB- and Event-Aligned Latent Manifold by projecting event representations into the pretrained latent space of RGB foundation models, and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in wide-baseline feature matching, significantly outperforming specialized architectures.

2605.00270.tldr: This study demonstrates the efficacy of coupling neural semantic extraction with formal solvers to enforce logical soundness and explainability in the aggregation of noisy human reasoning.

2605.00257.tldr: CA-ThinkFlow is presented as a parameter-efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework which operates with a 14B, 4-bit-quantized reasoning model, 14B-DeepSeek-R1, and a layout-aware Docling extraction system which maintains document structure during extraction.

2605.00224.tldr: TUR-DPO is proposed, a topology- and uncertainty-aware variant of DPO that rewards how answers are derived, not only what they say, by eliciting lightweight reasoning topologies and combining semantic faithfulness, utility, and topology quality into a calibrated uncertainty signal.

2605.00123.tldr: LOCA, a method that gives Local, CAusal explanations of jailbreak success by identifying a minimal set of interpretable, intermediate representation changes that causally induce model refusal on an otherwise successful jailbreak request, is introduced.

2605.00072.tldr: This work presents XekRung, a frontier large language model for cybersecurity, designed to provide comprehensive security capabilities, and introduces a multi-dimensional evaluation system to guide the iterative improvement of both domain-specific and general-purpose abilities.

2605.00060.tldr: The complete 6,084-line, framework-free implementation is reproducible given the public Volve download and an API key, and the case studies and qualitative ablation analysis suggest that domain-specialized tool design, rather than model scale alone, is the primary driver of analytical quality in technical operations.

2605.00043.tldr: SiriusHelper serves as a unified online assistant that automatically identifies user intent and routes queries to the right handling path, including dedicated expert workflows for specialized scenarios (e.g., SQL execution diagnosis) and introduces automated ticket understanding and SOP distillation.

2605.00033.tldr: This work proposes CONF-LA (Confidence-score-based Online Fixation-to-Line Assignment), a principled, low-latency approach that integrates knowledge about reading behavior and Gaussian line likelihoods over fixations to compute a posterior-line-score and defers assignments when uncertainty is high.

2605.00020.tldr: AirFM-DDA is proposed, an Air-interface Foundation Model operating in the Delay-Doppler-Angle (DDA) domain for physicallayer tasks that achieves superior zero-shot generalization across unseen scenarios and datasets, consistently outperforming the baselines on channel prediction and estimation tasks.

2605.00248.tldr: This framework aims to provide a foundation for theoretical and empirical work to understand, predict, and control emergent collective agents in multi-agent AI systems and uses causal games and causal abstraction to solve a puzzle regarding multi-agent incentives in actor-critic models.

2605.00236.tldr: The Attention Redistribution Attack (ARA), a white-box adversarial attack that identifies safety-critical attention heads and crafts nonsemantic adversarial tokens that redirect attention away from safety-relevant positions, is introduced.

2605.00071.tldr: This work presents a compliance-aware architecture that combines x402-style, signature-based payment authorisation and relayed execution with programmable compliance embedded as an on-chain guardrail via a policy wrapper and policy manager coordinating modular checks.

2605.00310.tldr: GeoSR-Bench is the first SR benchmark that directly connects improved image resolution from SR models with downstream Earth monitoring tasks, including land cover segmentation, infrastructure mapping, and biophysical variable estimation and reveals the need to integrate downstream tasks into SR model development and evaluation.

2605.00300.tldr: TokenArena is a continuous benchmark that measures inference at endpoint granularity along five core axes (output speed, time to first token, workload-blended price, effective context, and quality on the live endpoint) and synthesizes them into three headline composites: joules per correct answer, dollars per correct answer, and endpoint fidelity.

2605.00273.tldr: By training diffusion models on mosaic, this work finds that scene complexity plays a dominant role rather than concept imbalance, and that counting is uniquely difficult to learn in low-data regimes, highlighting fundamental limitations of diffusion models.

2605.00254.tldr: It is found that lower-cost switchless topologies are more cost-effective than the scale-up topology across all serving scenarios explored, improving cost-effectiveness by 20.6-56.2% and the 3D full-mesh topology is Pareto-optimal in terms of the performance-cost tradeoff.

2605.00242.tldr: MAEPose is presented, a masked autoencoding-based human pose estimation approach that operates directly on mmWave spectrogram videos, and learns spatiotemporal motion-aware generalized representations from unlabelled radar video, and leverages its heatmap decoder for multi-frame pose estimation predictions.

2605.00133.tldr: Kisan AI is developed, a smart profit-aware crop advisory system that resolves the above-mentioned limitation through a research-driven, full-stack application and unifies all modules into a single, mobile-installable platform accessible to farmers across India.

2605.00119.tldr: ArabCulture-Dialogue is introduced, a culturally grounded conversational dataset covering 13 Arabic-speaking countries, in both MSA and each country's respective dialect, spanning 12 daily-life topics and 54 fine-grained subtopics and indicates that the performance gap between MSA and Arabic dialects still exists.

2605.00074.tldr: It is shown that this baseline collapses to a 100% false-flag rate when the hazardous sequence comes from a taxonomic family absent from the reference set: under Conformal Risk Control's certified miss-rate constraint, a low-discrimination signal forces the threshold below the entire test-benign mass.

2605.00073.tldr: This work proposes AgentReputation, a decentralized, three-layer reputation framework for agentic AI systems that separates task execution, reputation services, and tamper-proof persistence to both leverage their respective strengths and enable independent evolution.

2605.00063.tldr: This survey systematizes existing RIR benchmarks by knowledge domains and modalities, introduces a structured taxonomy that categorizes methods based on where and how reasoning is integrated into the retrieval pipeline, alongside an analysis of their trade-offs and practical applications.

2605.00056.tldr: Overall, distribution-aware ensembles with clustering diagnostics offer robust, interpretable assessments of groundwater contamination, and this study develops a predictive framework integrating response transformations with nested cross-validated ensemble machine learning.

2605.00015.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate TimeRFT can consistently outperform SFT-based adaptation methods across various real-world forecasting tasks and training data regimes, enhancing prediction accuracy and generalization against unforeseen distribution shifts.

2605.00011.tldr: A novel resource heterogeneity-aware device scheduling approach designed to efficiently schedule heterogeneous devices across multiple concurrent FL jobs, with the goal of minimizing their average job completion time (JCT).

2605.00276.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed agentic AI framework achieves 77.4\% accuracy on the TOP Benchmark, significantly outperforming single-agent and workflow-based multi-agent baselines, demonstrating the importance of orchestrated agentic reasoning for robust trip planning optimization.

2605.00267.tldr: Boundary Point Jailbreaking, currently the strongest jailbreak against deployed classifiers, achieves near-perfect classifier evasion with near-zero degradation across safeguarded models, and is recommended that safety cases for frontier models should not rely on a meaningful capability degradation from jailbreaks.

2605.00197.tldr: A systematic analysis of the consequences and interactions of key design choices in simulated social networks, including the choice of base model used to model individual agents, and how they are connected to each other suggests that the geometry of the design space is non-trivial.

2605.00116.tldr: The ViLegalNLI establishes a foundational benchmark for Vietnamese legal NLI and supports future research in legal reasoning, statutory text understanding, and the development of reliable AI systems for legal analysis and decision support.

2605.00059.tldr: This work proposes Dynamic-TD3, a physically enhanced framework that enforces strict safety constraints while maintaining maneuverability by modeling navigation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP).

2605.00022.tldr: This work opens-source these regression-weighted subsets as the HUMANS benchmark, an efficient proxy for LAM evaluation that captures both benchmark performance and user preferences and demonstrates that in regression modeling, well-curated subsets outpredict the full benchmark, showing quality over quantity.

2605.00007.tldr: This work introduces Mean-Field Path-Integral Diffusion (MF-PID), a framework in which samples are promoted to interacting agents whose drift depends self-consistently on the evolving population density, and proves that the self-consistent MF guidance is the exact linear interpolant between initial and target global means.

2605.00313.tldr: It is argued that closing the synthesizability gap demands a pivot to a synthesis-first paradigm in which executable synthesis protocols, not just atomic configurations, are treated as primary design variables.

2605.00256.tldr: Remote SAMsing is proposed, an open-source pipeline that solves both problems without modifying SAM2 or requiring training data and generalizes to MNF false-color imagery without retraining and scales to production-sized images.

2605.00245.tldr: ARMOR 2025 is introduced, a military aligned safety benchmark grounded in three core military doctrines the Law of War, the Rules of Engagement, and the Joint Ethics Regulation, that enables systematic testing of accuracy and refusal across military relevant decision types.

2605.00226.tldr: Analyzing LLMs'internal processes can expose systematic vulnerabilities that warrant caution before deploying LLMs in strategic domains without robust guardrails, and shows how analyzing LLMs'internal processes can expose systematic vulnerabilities that warrant caution before deploying them in strategic domains without robust guardrails.

2605.00136.tldr: This work proposes a Factorized Intervention Framework that isolates the cost of prompt formatting, the overhead of the tool-calling protocol, and the actual gain from executing tools, and reveals a critical tradeoff: under semantic noise, the gains from tools often fail to offset the"tool-use tax", which is the performance degradation introduced by the tool-calling protocol itself.

2605.00087.tldr: DeGenTWeb is described, which systematically identifies LLM-dominant websites: sites whose content has been generated using LLMs with little human input, and how to adapt detectors of LLM-generated text for use on web pages, and how to aggregate detection results from multiple pages on a site for accurate site-level categorization.

2605.00086.tldr: NorBERTo provides a modern, mid-sized encoder designed for realistic deployment scenarios: it is straight-forward to fine-tune, efficient to serve, and well suited as a backbone for retrieval-augmented generation and other downstream Portuguese NLP systems.

2605.00082.tldr: The Hyperspherical Forward-Forward (HFF) is introduced, a novel reformulation of the Forward-Forward algorithm that reframe the local objective of each layer from a binary goodness-of-fit task to a direct multi-class classification problem within a hyperspherical feature space.

2605.00012.tldr: The results prove that LLM Overview systems have biases and that reinforcement learning in most of the cases can optimize snippet's content to manipulate LLM Overview results and prove that LLM Overview selections are driven by comparative rather than absolute advantages among candidate sources.

2605.00005.tldr: This work develops a formal analytical model that characterizes distributed inference latency as a function of the sensing frequency, platform throughput, network delay, and task-specific safety constraints, and demonstrates that, when provisioned with high-throughput compute resources, cloud platforms can effectively amortize network and queueing delays, enabling them to match or surpass on-device performance for real-time decision-making.

2605.00632.tldr: By retrieving semantically similar examples during generation, BlenderRAG improves compilation success rates from 40.8% to 70.0% and semantic normalized alignment from 0.41 to 0.77 (CLIP similarity) across four state-of-the-art LLMs.

2605.00600.tldr: Dirichlet-approximated possibilistic posterior predictions (DAPPr) is introduced, a principled framework grounded in possibility theory that achieves competitive or superior uncertainty quantification performance over state-of-the-art second-order predictors while maintaining both principled derivation and computational efficiency.

2605.00592.tldr: This work proposes that a decision be considered fair if it has a fair explanation, and defines a fair explanation as a prime-implicant reason for the decision that does not contain any protected feature (where the constraints are taken into account in the definition of prime-implicant).

2605.00572.tldr: This paper investigates instance-aware parameter configuration for Bilevel Late Acceptance Hill Climbing, a state-of-the-art metaheuristic for the Electric Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, and achieves an average objective value reduction of $0.28\% across eight held-out test instances relative to a globally tuned configuration.

2605.00551.tldr: This work proposes A11y-Compressor, a framework that transforms linearized accessibility trees into compact and structured representations and applies a lightweight and structured transformation pipeline with modal detection, redundancy reduction, and semantic structuring.

2605.00528.tldr: This work presents SAGA, a distributed scheduler that implements workflow-aware scheduling through three mechanisms: agent Execution Graphs that capture workflow structure to predict KV cache reuse across tool-call boundaries, and session-affinity batching with work stealing that co-locates correlated requests while maintaining global load balance.

2605.00497.tldr: This work introduces striving co-creation, a process for inferring broader life goals from unstructured observations of computer use and supports an editing interface that gives people agency over how they are understood by the system, feeding their corrections back into subsequent rounds of striving induction.

2605.00462.tldr: This paper uses custom TensorFlow provided by the Poplar SDK to adapt the program for the IPU-POD16 platform and investigates its ease of use and performance scalability, and shows how to utilize the \emph{popdist} library to overcome a performance bottleneck in feeding training data to the IPU on the host side.

2605.00421.tldr: This work demonstrates that small, efficiently fine-tuned models can serve as practical multi-task radiology AI assistants deployable entirely on consumer hardware without GPU requirements.

2605.00369.tldr: Built on a large language model trained via reinforcement learning, InvEvolve can process demand data together with additional numerical and textual features, and generates white-box inventory policies with statistical safety guarantees for future deployment, and introduces a unified framework with theoretical guarantees that connects training, inference, and deployment.

2605.00354.tldr: VQ-SAD is a neuro-symbolic model that utilizes both symbolic and neural structural information for a diffusion based model with learnable forward process that slightly outperforms SOTA models for diffusion based molecule generation on QM9 and ZINC250k datasets.

2605.00466.tldr: PAMod is proposed, a lightweight yet powerful framework that models cyclical distribution shifts via Phase-Amplitude Modulation in the normalized feature space, offering an elegant unification of distribution adaptation and representation learning.

2605.00438.tldr: Interleaved Vision--Language Reasoning (IVLR) is introduced, a policy framework built around \trace{}, an explicit intermediate representation that alternates textual subgoals with visual keyframes over the full task horizon, suggesting that the trace can tolerate local corruption and moderate execution drift, but remains limited under stale or incorrect global plans.

2605.00436.tldr: It is revealed that large-language models are susceptible to presumptions when making decisions even with reasoning steps, and the importance of proper task phrasing to reduce the risk of presumptions in LLMs is highlighted.

2605.00435.tldr: This work proposes *Reinforced Mode Regulation* (RMR), a lightweight, online state-space intervention that regulates dominant self-reinforcing directions in the Transformer value cache (implemented as low-rank damping), and substantially reduces mode collapse and enables stable generation at extremely low entropy rates.

2605.00433.tldr: RECRL is proposed, a novel requirement-aware curriculum reinforcement learning framework for enhancing LLM-based code generation that automatically perceives model-specific requirement difficulty, optimizes challenging requirements to improve training data utilization, and employs an adaptive curriculum sampling strategy to construct training batches with smoothly varying difficulty.

2605.00424.tldr: This paper gives a trust schema that includes an explicit verification level on every skill manifest; a capability gate whose HITL policy is a function of that verification level; a biconditional correctness criterion that any candidate verification procedure must satisfy on an adversarial-ensemble exercise; and a portable runtime profile with ten normative guidelines abstracted from a working open-source reference implementation.

2605.00414.tldr: This work unifies decision trees and diffusion models by establishing a crisp mathematical correspondence between hierarchical decision trees and diffusion processes in appropriate limiting regimes, and reveals a shared optimization principle: GTSM, for which gradient boosting (in an idealized version) is asymptotically optimal.

2605.00402.tldr: This work proposes a structured multi-layer recurrent SNN architecture composed of locally dense recurrent layers augmented with sparse small-world long-range projections to a readout population, and introduces a biologically motivated learning framework that combines population-based winner-take-all teaching signals and low-dimensional modulatory neuron populations.

2605.00382.tldr: The Fairness Monitor Agent is proposed, a modular component that plugs into any existing code generation pipeline without modifying it that reduces bias by 65.1% compared to a developer agent alone and improves functional correctness from 75.80% to 83.97%, outperforming all other studied approaches.

2605.00347.tldr: It is shown that pretrained VLMs provide strong action priors, significantly improving sample efficiency during RL training and reducing the need for manual design choices such as action engineering, compared to classical deep RL trained from scratch.

2605.00336.tldr: This paper studies budgeted context selection, where a subset of document units is chosen under a strict token budget so an off-the-shelf generator can meet fixed cost and latency constraints, and proposes a monotone submodular objective that balances relevance, coverage, and diversity.

2605.00650.tldr: A theoretical analysis of AdaMeZO is presented, corroborated by extensive experiments demonstrating AdaMeZO's performance, showing that AdaMeZO can outperform MeZO while requiring up to $70\%$ fewer forward passes and affirm AdaMeZO's ability to adapt to diverse loss landscapes.

2605.00482.tldr: C-MTAD-GAT is proposed, an anomaly detection framework designed to operate as a single shared model across large populations of network elements that produces per-element, per-feature anomaly scores converted to alerts via fully unsupervised thresholds calibrated from validation residuals.

2605.00642.tldr: GUI-SD is presented, the first OPSD framework tailored for GUI grounding, which constructs a visually enriched privileged context for the teacher using a target bounding box and a Gaussian soft mask, providing informative guidance without leaking exact coordinates.

2605.00556.tldr: The findings suggest that future designs should prioritise effortless driver interventions, transparent communication of automation intent, and context-sensitive authority allocation to strengthen meaningful human control in partially automated driving.

2605.00529.tldr: Psi-RAG supports diverse tasks from token-level question answering to document-level summarization, and on cross-document multi-hop QA benchmarks, it outperforms RAPTOR by 25.9% and HippoRAG 2 by 7.4% in average F1 score.

2605.00519.tldr: It is concluded that for consumer-grade inference, the optimal hardware is defined by a complex interplay between compute density (Nvidia) and memory capacity (Apple), moderated by the significant"ecosystem friction" of proprietary quantization workflows.

2605.00425.tldr: AEM is presented, a supervision-free credit assignment method that adaptively modulates entropy dynamics during RL training to improve the exploration-exploitation trade-off and derives a practical response-level uncertainty proxy and uses it to rescale advantages, leveraging the evolving balance between positive and negative samples to naturally transition from exploration to exploitation.

2605.00422.tldr: Binarized Weights and Low-bit Activations is proposed, the first post-training quantization framework that preserves high accuracy while achieving 1-bit weight quantization together with low-bit activations, demonstrating strong potential for real-world LLM compression and acceleration.

2605.00412.tldr: This paper argues that the bottleneck of world models is no longer only whether they can generate realistic futures, but whether those futures are physically meaningful and useful for action, and proposes the Hamiltonian World Models as a physically grounded perspective on world modeling.

2605.00314.tldr: Semia is presented, a static auditor for agent skills that lifts each skill into the Skill Description Language (SDL), a Datalog fact base that captures LLM-triggered actions, prose-defined conditions, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

2605.00371.tldr: GaMMA inherits the streamlined encoder-decoder design of LLaVA, enabling effective cross-modal learning between music and language, and effectively unifies both time-series and non-time-series music understanding tasks within one set of parameters.

2605.00361.tldr: Text mining to publications indexed in a leading academic database is applied to map scholarly discourse on ChatGPT in programming education to support responsible integration and highlight the need for stronger assessment and governance mechanisms.

2605.00351.tldr: HyperODE RCA is presented, a unified framework that combines hypergraph attention learning, latent ordinary differential equations, and multimodal cross attention fusion for fine grained root cause analysis for cloud native microservice systems.

2605.00334.tldr: Small and mid-sized open-weight models are already sufficient for much of the short-horizon, structured tool use work that dominates real agent pipelines, and in aggregate, the strongest open-weight model matches GPT-5 on the authors' benchmark while being substantially cheaper and faster to run.

2605.00583.tldr: Four jailbreak attacks exploiting the vision component are introduced exploiting the vision component of vision-language models, highlighting that robust VLM alignment requires treating vision as a first-class target for safety post-training.

2605.00505.tldr: This perspective paper argues that denoising-maximizing usable evidence density and verifiability within a context window-is becoming the primary bottleneck across the full information access pipeline and provides a pipeline-organized taxonomy of signal-to-noise optimization techniques.

2605.00440.tldr: A methodology is proposed to infer the latent role specified by the prompt, embed this role into the content during the probabilistic generation process and subsequently recover the nature of AI participation from the resulting text.

2605.00410.tldr: Agent Capsules is presented, an adaptive execution runtime that treats multi-agent pipeline execution as an optimization problem with empirical quality constraints, and delivers efficiency through automatic policy resolution, cache-aligned prompts, and topology-aware context injection.

2605.00343.tldr: Modated multiple regression analysis showed that institutional support significantly predicted both teacher confidence and attitudes toward AI, however, teacher concerns did not significantly moderate these relationships.

2605.00315.tldr: This position paper addresses the nexus of responsible GeoAI into four interrelated theoretical dimensions, specifically Representativeness, Explainability, Sustainability, and Ethics, and proposes a conceptual governance Model of responsible GeoAI that categorizes its governance practices into Data, Application, and Society scopes.

2605.00644.tldr: This work presents a learning framework that effectively interweaves their MLE updates with corresponding MCMC refinements in both the data and latent spaces and serves as complementary models that enable effective EBM sampling and learning, yielding realistic and coherent multimodal EBM samples.

2605.00582.tldr: Evidence that AI washing inflates user expectations without altering actual interaction outcomes is contributed, highlighting a critical transparency issue and establishing Fitts'Law as a rigorous methodological lens for auditing AI-labelled input devices.

2605.00515.tldr: The Space Network of Mixture-of-Experts (SpaceMoE) framework targeting the distributed execution of a popular mixture-of-experts (MoE) model in space achieves at least a threefold latency reduction compared with conventional random and ablation-based placement strategies.

2605.00814.tldr: The proposed Persistent Visual Memory (PVM), a lightweight learnable module designed to strengthen sustained, on-demand access to visual evidence, establishes a distance-agnostic retrieval pathway that directly provides visual embeddings for enhanced visual perception, thereby structurally mitigating the signal suppression inherent to deep generation.

2605.00782.tldr: GeoContra turns fluent code production into verifiable spatial analysis, catching negative travel times, CRS/field-schema violations, missing predicates, and brittle output casts that otherwise yield executable but geographically invalid results.

2605.00776.tldr: The Directed Social Regard (DSR) approach to multi-dimensional, multi-valence sentiment analysis is presented, comprised of a pair of transformer-based models that detects span-level targets of sentiment in a message and then scores all spans within the message context along three (-1, 1) axes of regard that are motivated by social science theories of moral disengagement and moral framing.

2605.00721.tldr: The Room Acoustics and Speaker Distance Estimation (SDE) Challenge at ICASSP 2025 explores the effectiveness of augmented room impulse response (RIR) data for improving SDE model performance with results demonstrating that the augmentation approach significantly improves estimation accuracy, particularly at medium to long distances.

2605.00664.tldr: A strategy to optimize the initial noise within the structured 3D latent diffusion framework, ensuring high-fidelity 3D inpainting by leveraging a backpropagation approximation grounded in the rectified flow model, with the spectral parameterization specially designed for robust and efficient structured 3D latent optimization.

2605.00793.tldr: An end-to-end unsupervised low-dose computed tomography denoising framework that addresses the limitation that real clinical data cannot be directly used for supervised learning, while still achieving excellent performance.

2605.00733.tldr: An Anchor Principle is identified for federated multimodal contrastive unlearning: forgotten alignments persist through three residual anchors arising from bilinear cross-modal coupling, principal-angle subspace entanglement, and continued federated updates.

2605.00731.tldr: Decoupled relation Subspace Alignment (DRSA), a novel, plug-and-play relation-driven alignment framework that can be seamlessly integrated as a universal preprocessing module, significantly and consistently enhancing the cross-domain and few-shot knowledge transfer capabilities of state-of-the-art GFMs.

2605.00762.tldr: K-SVFair-FBF, a fairness-aware bandit algorithm that adaptively estimates $K-Shapley value with unknown valuation function, is proposed, which not only learns the valuation function under full feedback setting but also mitigates the noise arising from Monte Carlo approximations.

2605.00737.tldr: A principled framework inspired by decision-making theory is introduced to evaluate web search tool-use decisions along three key factors: necessity, utility, and affordability, and lightweight estimators of need and utility from the models'hidden states are trained.

2605.00667.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that SAC-ALaM outperforms state-of-the-art safe RL baselines in both safety and return, while also stabilizing training dynamics and learning well-calibrated multipliers for risk identification.

2605.00654.tldr: A special class of Markov coherent risk measures, called mini-batch measures, are introduced and a high-probability regret bound is proved of $\mathcal{O}\big(H^2 N^H \sqrt{ K}\big)$, where $H$ is the horizon, $N$ is the mini-batch size, and $K$ is the number of episodes.

2605.00789.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that with only 55% of the original vision tokens, LightKV halves the vision-token KV cache size, reduces computation by up to 40%, and preserves general-purpose performance while significantly outperforming existing baselines.

2605.00803.tldr: This work presents AutoMat, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents'ability to reproduce claims from computational materials science, and curates a set of claims from real materials science papers to test whether coding agents can recover and execute the end-to-end workflow needed to support (or undermine) such claims.

2405.11597.tldr: Experiments on two naturalistic language comprehension fMRI datasets show that \textsc{PredFT} outperforms current decoding models on several evaluation metrics.

2407.05087.tldr: This work linearizes the nonlocal means algorithm with deep learning and proposes a linear attention mechanism based deep nonlocal means filtering (LDNLM), which employs deep channel convolution neural networks to extract the information of the neighborhood matrix and obtain representation vectors of every pixel.

2501.06416.tldr: This paper conducts three human studies to establish a novel research direction in model alignment: designing interfaces and training interventions to increase human conformance with the modeling assumptions of the algorithm that will learn from their input.

2501.18490.tldr: The results demonstrate that the proposed CL approach achieves superior performance compared to a policy trained conventionally in one stage, with the same reward function and hyperparameters, while significantly reducing computational resource needs (samples) and convergence time.

2502.13166.tldr: This work proposes AdaInit, a foundational framework that leverages large language models with the submartingale property to iteratively synthesize initial parameters for QNNs that yield non-negligible gradient variance, thereby mitigating BPs.

2502.18026.tldr: A novel subgraph inference framework, ExPath, that explicitly integrates experimental data to classify various graphs (bio-networks) in biological databases and can seamlessly integrate biological foundation models to encode the experimental molecular data is proposed.

2503.23514.tldr: This work introduces LIFESTATE-BENCH, a benchmark designed to assess lifelong learning in LLMs, and demonstrates that nonparametric methods significantly outperform parametric ones in managing stateful learning.

2505.04864.tldr: Auto-Regressive Transformation (ART) is proposed, a novel method that iteratively estimates the coarse-to-fine transformations through an auto-regressive pipeline that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on planar images and achieves comparable performance on 3D scene images.

2505.17682.tldr: Experimental results on two real-world datasets demonstrate that BehaviorLM robustly predicts both anchor and tail behaviors and effectively leverages LLM behavioral knowledge to master tail behavior prediction with few-shot examples.

2507.01264.tldr: A novel framework that leverages Large Language Models for few-shot code generation to automatically synthesize driving scenarios within the CARLA simulator, which has flexibility in scenario scripting, efficient code-based control of traffic participants, and enforcement of realistic physical dynamics.

2507.14800.tldr: An LLM-based experience-driven day-ahead Volt/Var schedule solution for distribution networks, which enables the self-evolution of LLM agent's strategies through the collaboration and interaction of multiple modules, specifically, experience storage, experience retrieval, experience generation, and experience modification.

2507.15640.tldr: It is proved that more general heuristics can be parameterized by proposing Data Mixing Agent, the first model-based, end-to-end framework that learns to re-weight domains.

2507.17596.tldr: This work proposes PRIX (Plan from Raw pIXels), a novel and efficient end-to-end driving architecture that operates using only camera data, without explicit BEV representation and forgoing the need for LiDAR.

2508.04955.tldr: AdvDINO is presented, a domain-adversarial SSL framework that integrates a gradient reversal layer into the DINOv2 architecture to promote domain-invariant feature learning and mitigates slide-specific biases to learn more robust and biologically meaningful representations than non-adversarial baselines.

2508.09533.tldr: COXNet is proposed, a novel framework for RGBT tiny object detection, addressing issues through three core innovations: the Cross-Layer Fusion Module, fusing high-level visible and low-level thermal features for enhanced semantic and spatial accuracy, and the Dynamic Alignment and Scale Refinement module.

2508.17188.tldr: Experimental results show that PosterGen consistently matches in content fidelity, and significantly outperforms existing methods in visual designs, generating posters that are presentation-ready with minimal human refinements.

2509.13047.tldr: This work presents a novel approach that achieves a 261x cost reduction for maritime intelligence by using LLMs as one-time teachers rather than using them directly for inference, and shows that smaller, cheaper models - when fine tuned properly - can provide similar accuracy compared to larger models that are prohibitively expensive.

2509.21982.tldr: RISK provides a scalable, domain-specific solution for automating complex web interactions in e-commerce risk management and achieves a top task success rate of 70.5% in online evaluation.

2602.17709.tldr: Rigorous benchmarking across microscopic forces and macroscopic observables demonstrates that UBio-MolFM achieves ab initio-level fidelity on large, out-of-distribution biomolecular systems and realistic MD observables.

2603.02473.tldr: It is argued that, under current retrieval practices, improving retrieval quality yields larger gains than increasing write-time sophistication more than increasing write-time sophistication.

2603.18916.tldr: The manifesto serves as a roadmap for bridging these communities and for guiding the development of APM systems in practice and discusses the extent to which the capabilities can be realized and identify research challenges whose resolution requires further advances in BPM, AI, and multi-agent systems.

2603.22816.tldr: The Step-Level Reasoning Capacity metric is introduced and it is proved it is a consistent causal estimator, and LC-CoSR, a training method with Lyapunov stability guarantees that directly reduces rigidity is proposed, a training method with Lyapunov stability guarantees that directly reduces rigidity.

2603.23516.tldr: Results demonstrate that by decoupling memory capacity from reasoning, MSA provides a scalable foundation to endow general-purpose models with intrinsic, lifetime-scale memory.

2603.27195.tldr: AutoMS is introduced, a multi-agent neuro-symbolic framework that reformulates inverse design as an LLM-driven evolutionary search that achieves a state-of-the-art 83.8% success rate on 17 diverse cross-physics tasks, significantly outperforming both traditional evolutionary algorithms and existing agentic baselines.

2603.27494.tldr: A novel two-stage reinforcement learning framework that does not require trajectory supervision is proposed that provides a more efficient approach for perceiving and reasoning fine-grained details in MLLMs.

2604.00013.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that C2F-Thinker achieves competitive performance on fine-grained sentiment regression tasks while significantly outperforming baselines in cross-domain generalization, highlighting its potential in building trustworthy and robust sentiment analysis systems for real-world applications.

2604.01687.tldr: CoEvoSkills is proposed, a self-evolving skills framework that enables agents to autonomously construct complex, multi-file skill packages and couples a Skill Generator that iteratively refines skills with a Surrogate Verifier that co-evolves to provide informative and actionable feedback without access to ground-truth test content.

2604.02369.tldr: This work presents a human-inspired perspective on this emerging landscape by organizing agent communication into three layers: communication, syntactic, and semantic, and systematically analyze 18 representative protocols to show a clear imbalance in current protocol design.

2604.03147.tldr: From 211k emotion-labeled texts, emotion steering vectors are derived, then VA axes are learned as linear combinations of their top PCA components via ridge regression on the model's self-reported valence-arousal scores, and the resulting VA subspace exhibits circular geometry consistent with established models of human emotion perception.

2604.03401.tldr: The preliminary findings suggest that LLMs may show promise for multimodal behavior understanding, although they still struggle with spatial reasoning about classroom layouts, and outline directions for improving LLM spatial comprehension in educational analytics contexts.

2604.05165.tldr: A ``CSI-free" paradigm powered by a Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (HMARL) architecture to control mechanically reconfigurable reflective surfaces establishes a scalable and cost-effective blueprint for intelligent wireless environments.

2604.05663.tldr: Experiments conducted in SUMO across heterogeneous real-world networks from Jinan, Hangzhou, and Yizhuang demonstrate that CuraLight consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing average travel time, average queue length, and average waiting time by 7.02 percent.

2604.07003.tldr: This work introduces EmoMAS, a Bayesian multi-agent framework that transforms emotional decision-making from reactive to strategic, and establishes a new paradigm for effective, private, and adaptive negotiation AI suitable for high-stakes edge deployment.

2604.07413.tldr: This work constructs a high-quality multimodal dataset that combines real-world 2D images and 3D point clouds, annotated with fine-grained domain semantics, and evaluates 18 state-of-the-art MLLMs across three manufacturing tasks, revealing significant performance gaps.

2604.07717.tldr: This study develops the first practical NLP tool for identifying HIV stigma in clinical notes, and compares GatorTron-large and BERT as encoder-based baselines and GPT-OSS-20B, LLaMA-8B, and MedGemma-27B as generative LLMs, under zero-shot and few-shot prompting.

2604.08557.tldr: It is shown that violating this assumption, by re-masking committed refusal tokens and injecting a short affirmative prefix, achieves 74-82% ASR on HarmBench across all three publicly available safety-tuned dLLMs, rising to 92-98% with a generic 8-token compliance prefix.

2604.08718.tldr: LeanGate, a lightweight feed-forward frame-gating network that predicts a geometric utility score to assess a frame's mapping value prior to the heavy GFM feature extraction and matching stages, and achieves a 5x end-to-end throughput speedup.

2604.08963.tldr: A baseline empirical study investigating how basic MAS topologies and feedback loops influence prejudice, and introduces Discrim-Eval-Open, an open-ended benchmark that bypasses individual model neutrality through forced comparative judgments across demographic groups.

2604.09502.tldr: A simple experimental design is implemented that cleanly separates primary algorithmic monoculture -- baseline action similarity -- from strategic algorithmic monoculture, whereby agents adjust similarity in response to incentives.

2604.10386.tldr: TrajOnco, a training-free, multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework designed for scalable multi-cancer early detection, performs temporal reasoning over sequential clinical events to generate patient-level summaries, evidence-linked rationales, and predicted risk scores.

2604.10391.tldr: A lightweight framework that adapts frozen VFMs to fisheye geometry through two components: a frozen DINOv2 backbone with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) that transfers rich self-supervised features to fisheye without task-specific pretraining, and Fisheye Rotary Position Embedding (FishRoPE), which reparameterizes the attention mechanism in the spherical coordinates of the fisheye projection.

2604.10392.tldr: This work presents VeriSpecGen, a traceable refinement framework that synthesizes intent-aligned specifications in Lean through requirement-level attribution and localized repair, and demonstrates that training on these trajectories substantially improves specification synthesis by 62-106% relative and transfers gains to general reasoning abilities.

2604.10397.tldr: DETAnt-HOI, a temporally corrected benchmark derived from VidHOI and Action Genome for more faithful multi-horizon evaluation, and HOI-DA, a pair-centric framework that jointly performs subject-object localization, present HOI detection, and future anticipation by modeling future interactions as residual transitions from current pair states are introduced.

2604.10409.tldr: IMPACT is the first real industrial assembly benchmark that jointly provides synchronized ego-exo RGB-D capture, decoupled bimanual annotation, compliance-aware state tracking, and explicit anomaly--recovery supervision within a single real industrial workflow.

2604.10426.tldr: CodaRAG is proposed, a framework that evolves retrieval from passive lookup into active associative discovery and demonstrates CodaRAG's superior ability to systematically robustify associative evidence retrieval for factual, reasoning, and creative tasks.

2604.10429.tldr: This paper proposes to train a safe RL policy on a reduced-order model, which ignores the dynamics of the inner states, but it treats it as an action that influences the outer state, reducing the complexity of the training.

2604.10441.tldr: VeriSim is introduced, a truth-preserving patient simulation framework that injects controllable, clinically evidence-grounded noise into patient responses while maintaining strict adherence to medical ground truth through a hybrid UMLS-LLM verification mechanism.

2604.10460.tldr: This work introduces a steganography enabled attribution framework that embeds cryptographically signed identifiers into images at creation time and uses multimodal harmful content detection as a trigger for attribution verification, and integrates a CLIP-based fusion model for multimodal harmful-content detection.

2604.10470.tldr: This work constructs JurisCQAD, a large-scale dataset of over 43,000 real-world Chinese legal queries annotated with expert-validated positive and negative responses, and designs a structured task decomposition that converts each query into a legal element graph integrating entities, events, intents, and legal issues.

2604.10475.tldr: A novel LLM-based framework, named Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for Travel (PEMANT), which first integrates behavioral theory for individualized persona modeling and then conducts household-level trip planning negotiations via a structured multi-agent conversation.

2604.10480.tldr: By grounding data construction in explicit lineage structures, this work advances post-training data curation toward a more systematic and controllable paradigm.

2604.10485.tldr: This work proposes Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Pose Estimation for Pose Estimation (UDAPose), a novel framework that synthesizes low-light images and dynamically fuses visual cues with pose priors for improved pose estimation and introduces a Dynamic Control of Attention (DCA) module that adaptively balances image cues with learned pose priors in the Transformer architecture.

2604.10502.tldr: This work proposes a novel moderation framework that leverages analogical examples to enhance rule induction and decision reliability, and demonstrates that analogical example-driven methods can advance robust, explainable, and generalizable content moderation in real-world applications.
