2405.02079.tldr: This paper introduces argumentative LLMs (ArgLLMs), a method for augmenting LLMs with argumentative reasoning, and defines novel properties to characterise contestability and assess ArgLLMs formally in terms of these properties.

2603.06811.tldr: Context specification is introduced and described as a process to support and inform this decision making process for evaluating what AI systems are likely to do in the deployment contexts that organizations actually manage.

2604.03675.tldr: OASES is proposed, an Outcome-Aligned Search-Evaluation Supervision framework for agentic search that co-trains the search policy and the state evaluator on policy, allowing the evaluator to adapt to evolving search behavior and provide more reliable process rewards.

2605.01041.tldr: A multi-agent reinforcement learning paradigm in which homogeneous aircraft within heterogeneous fleets operate concurrently to perform package delivery missions over Dallas, Texas, USA is investigated, which shows that two fleets with distinct, shared PPOA2C policies can reach an equilibrium to maintain safe separation.

2604.18555.tldr: Experiments support claims that biased EDEN (with optimized $S$) is more accurate than TurboQuant$_{\text{mse}}$, and unbiased EDEN is markedly more accurate than TurboQuant$_{\text{prod}}$, often by more than a bit.

2604.18978.tldr: This paper proposes using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a structural regularizer for critic learning in off-policy RL, and demonstrates that it efficiently reduces critic loss during training and improves overall policy performance, achieving the best or competitive results on most tasks.

2604.17415.tldr: A seemingly fragmented collection of reward-based fine-tuning methods are turned into a smaller, more interpretable, and more actionable design space under a common framework, which is called reward score matching (RSM).

2605.05227.tldr: This work introduces ADAPT (Adaptive Data reweighting for Pretraining and FineTuning), a dynamic online framework that reweights training samples with adaptive per-sample learning rates guided by similarity-based quality signals, without changing the number of training samples.

2605.05223.tldr: This work presents a geometric framework for analyzing the instability of feature unions, and derives an asymptotic compositional-collapse threshold under a spherical dictionary model, characterized by the Gaussian mean width of the signal cone.

2605.05220.tldr: This paper establishes a link between steering and affine concept erasure, and establishes a principled theoretical framework for concept switching, LEACE-Switch, and introduces MidSteer (Minimal Disturbance concept Steering), a more general affine framework for concept manipulation that relaxes assumptions and enables directed, minimal-disturbance transformations.

2605.05218.tldr: This work establishes the first rigorous connection between chaos theory and predictive multiplicity, providing principled guidance for deploying machine learning in safety-critical chaotic domains.

2605.05226.tldr: This work introduces a supervision-internalization method for reinforcement learning for reasoning, enabling the model to automatically extract process-level learning signals through identifying, correcting, and reusing failed reasoning trajectories, thereby achieving finer-grained policy optimization under outcome-only supervision.

2605.05224.tldr: This work provides the first systematic investigation of unlearnable examples across diverse training paradigms and proposes a hierarchical deception strategy, Shallow Semantic Camouflage (SSC), that confines the generation process to a semantically valid subspace, aiming to bypass the semantic suppression introduced by pretrained weights.

2605.05215.tldr: This work adapts DINOv3 to the document domain via context-aware SimMIM fine-tuning and supervised metric learning with composite loss that encourages inter-class separability and intra-class compactness and provides a production-aligned basis for discovering novel and campaign-scale fraud under distribution shift.

2605.05340.tldr: ImmersedPrivacy is presented, an interactive audio-visual evaluation framework that simulates realistic physical environments using a Unity-based simulator and reveals that current VLMs in the physical world suffer from perceptual fragility and fail to let their knowledge of privacy cues govern their situated behavior.

2605.05225.tldr: MACS introduces an Entropy-Weighted Load mechanism to quantify the semantic value of visual tokens, addressing information heterogeneity, and the Dynamic Modality-Adaptive Capacity mechanism allocates expert resources based on the real-time modal composition of the input.

2605.05228.tldr: The work shows that proposed evolution with an appropriate set of operators and parameters can fast improve the accuracy of the quantization states of the network based on nearest neighbour rounding does not guarantee optimal accuracy.

2605.05222.tldr: Token-Selective Attention (TSA), a learned per-token gate on residual updates between consecutive transformer blocks that produces a continuous halting probability, making the mechanism end-to-end differentiable with 1.7% parameter overhead and no changes to the base architecture.

2605.05219.tldr: Sparse prefix caching is formalized as checkpoint placement under a distribution over overlap depths, yielding an exact O(NM) dynamic program that consistently improves the Pareto frontier traced by standard heuristics on real-world data.

2605.05214.tldr: MedMamba, a principle-driven multi-scale bidirectional state space architecture tailored for medical time series classification, is proposed, suggesting that principle-guided state space modeling offers an effective and scalable alternative to Transformer-based approaches for medical time series analysis.

2605.05209.tldr: It is proved weakness is minimax-optimal under exchangeable demands, and that PAC-Bayes bounds work because they correlate with it, and that Simplicity is dataset dependent, whereas weakness is invariant.

2605.05236.tldr: A topology-driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (TD-MARL) framework to coordinate multi-robot systems to avoid entanglement is proposed and the full simulation experiments show that the method is better than the current advanced deep reinforcement learning (DRL) method in terms of convergence and anti-winding effect.

2605.05211.tldr: This review synthesizes recent applications of LLMs in this domain, including extracting sentiment from financial news and social media, analyzing financial reports and earnings-call transcripts, tokenizing or symbolizing stock price series, and constructing multi-agent trading systems.

2605.05217.tldr: This framework provides a general recipe for embedding physics adaptively into neural networks, offering a robust and reproducible approach for data-scarce problems across various scientific domains, including fluid dynamics and material modeling.

2605.05611.tldr: X-Voice, a 0.4B multilingual zero-shot voice cloning model that clones arbitrary voices and enables everyone to speak 30 languages outperforms existing flow-matching based multilingual systems like LEMAS-TTS and achieves zero-shot cross-lingual cloning capabilities comparable to billion-scale models such as Qwen3-TTS.

2605.05580.tldr: AlphaCrafter, a multi-agent framework built upon a structured agent harness, suggests that harness-based agent design provides a practical foundation for building more reliable, controllable, and robust multi-agent systems for quantitative trading.

2605.05482.tldr: A unified, data-efficient framework for training grounded domain-specific LLMs that optimizes answer quality, citation grounding, and calibrated refusal under real-world deployment constraints is presented.

2605.05443.tldr: SLAM (Structural Linguistic Activation Marking), a novel white-box watermarking scheme that sidesteps this cost by writing the mark into structural geometry rather than token frequencies, creates a complementary robustness profile but is vulnerable to paraphrase that restructures syntax.

2605.05427.tldr: Refusal rates are a poor proxy for LLM safety, and demographic protection is unequal: models over-protect prominent racial and religious groups, frequently refusing even benign prompts about them, while providing substantially weaker protection against disability-targeted attacks.

2605.05409.tldr: FinAgent-RAG is proposed, an agentic RAG framework that orchestrates iterative retrieval-reasoning loops with self-verification, specifically engineered for the precision requirements of financial numerical reasoning.

2605.05372.tldr: This work reformulates reconstructionbased anomaly detection through consistency learning, enabling direct prediction of anomaly-free geometry in one or two network evaluations, and introduces a novel hybrid loss formulation that explicitly enforces reconstruction toward clean data.

2605.05367.tldr: Tamaththul3D is introduced, a reconstruction pipeline that aligns hand and body estimates through geometric inverse kinematics on the forearm chain followed by 2D-supervised shoulder refinement and generalizes across five typologically distinct sign languages without dataset-specific adaptation.

2605.05407.tldr: This paper introduces PRISM, a framework that tightly couples perception (VLM) and decision (LLM) through a dynamic question-answer (DQA) pipeline, and shows that PRISM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image-based models.

2605.05598.tldr: Prober.ai is presented, a web-based writing environment that inverts the conventional AI-tutoring paradigm: rather than generating or rewriting student text, the system constrains an LLM through persona-specific system prompts and structured JSON output schemas to produce only targeted, inquiry-based questions about argumentative weaknesses.

2605.05558.tldr: A natural intuition about the economics of AI agents is that, because agents can be replicated at very low marginal cost, agent labor may be supplied highly elastically, placing downward pressure on cognitive-labor wages when it closely substitutes for human labor, but this framing is argued to be wrong in mechanism and partially correct in conclusion.

2605.05583.tldr: The proposed BeliefMem shifts the memory paradigm from committing to a single conclusion per observation to retaining multiple candidate conclusions with their probabilities, enabling the agent to act with high confidence on well-evidenced knowledge while retaining the capacity to update its confidence when new evidence arrives.

2605.05704.tldr: This work proposes SafeHarbor, a novel framework designed to establish precise decision boundaries for LLM agents, and designs a local hierarchical memory system for dynamic rule injection, offering a training-free, efficient, and plug-and-play solution.

2605.05693.tldr: The proposed regularization encourages quantized weights to remain close to the original weights during calibration, leading to improved generalization at inference time, resulting in SARQC, a unified framework that augments standard PTQ objectives with a regularizer that explicitly controls weight deviation from the original weights.

2605.05674.tldr: Euclidean Geodesic Alignment (EGA) is proposed, a residual adapter that couples three principles: zero initialization, local triplet loss, and hypersphere projection that achieves the highest worst-case Label Precision on the four primary splits and a consistent improvement on the fifth.

2605.05775.tldr: Three main conclusions can be drawn: (1) in-domain multitracer PET/CT segmentation is sufficient and probably approaching reader agreement; (2) compositional generalization to unseen tracer-center combinations remains an open problem mainly driven by systematic volume overestimation; (3) heterogeneity and case difficulty drive performance variation substantially more than the choice of algorithm among top-ranked teams.

2605.05739.tldr: A behavioral evaluation methodology that complements output-level testing by scoring the intermediate decision process itself and applies to any agentic system whose intermediate decisions can be logged is developed.

2605.05732.tldr: It is suggested that controlling adaptation in representation space, guided by output-space divergence, provides a scalable and principled approach to continual learning in LLMs.

2605.05703.tldr: An ensemble-based information-theoretic task selection framework that estimates task informativeness by how much a candidate task changes the distribution over graph parameters, using ensemble Kalman inversion as an efficient and derivative-free approximation of the corresponding Bayesian update is proposed.

2605.05686.tldr: Geometric margin--the hidden state's distance to the nearest memorized basin--reads this geometry directly and separates correct recall from hallucination far more cleanly than output entropy, with zero false refusals where entropy-based detection cannot avoid rejecting the vast majority of correct outputs.

2605.05627.tldr: It is demonstrated that even small quantities of prompt-generated data significantly improve performance for underrepresented species, and concludes that vision-language models can serve as agile data generators, effectively bootstrapping perception tasks for niche AI domains where expert labels are scarce or unavailable.

2605.05682.tldr: This work develops PersonaTeaming Workflow, which incorporates personas into the adversarial prompt generation process to explore a wider spectrum of adversarial strategies, and instantiates PersonaTeaming Playground, a user-facing interface that enables red-teamers to author their own personas and collaborate with AI to mutate and refine prompts.

2605.05743.tldr: This work presents three complementary RFF-based methods forming a practical toolkit for score-based, constraint-based, and hybrid causal discovery for Gaussian process marginal likelihood scores and kernel conditional independence tests.

2605.05736.tldr: SDFlow is proposed, a non-autoregressive framework that operates entirely in the frozen VQ latent space and enables parallel sequence generation via flow matching and provides significant inference speedups over autoregressive baselines, offering both high fidelity and computational efficiency.

2605.05965.tldr: This work introduces P-trace as a sample-efficient, critic-free eligibility traces method, upon which S-trace is built, implementing a sparse eligibility traces mechanism to further mitigate variance and achieve fine-grained credit assignment by selectively masking low-entropy tokens.

2605.05953.tldr: PCNET, a Probabilistic Circuit trained as a tractable density estimator over the LLM residual stream, achieves near-perfect hallucination detection and obtains the highest True+Info, MC2, and MC3 scores on TruthfulQA in three out of four models, in comparison with state-of-the-art baselines.

2605.05951.tldr: HaM-World is proposed, a structured world model that decomposes the latent state into a canonical (q, p) subspace and a context subspace c, while using Mamba selective state-space memory as the history-conditioned input to the same latent dynamics.

2605.05920.tldr: SECDA-DSE is presented, a framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) into the SECDA ecosystem, comprising tools built around SECDA to automate the design space exploration (DSE) of FPGA-based accelerators.

2605.05882.tldr: A new framework for fairness in structural causal models that is tailored to continuous protected attributes is introduced and a fair tuning algorithm is proposed that either constructs such a predictor or allows for a trade-off between SP and PP.

2605.05977.tldr: This work designs a novel metric that captures behavioral drift in action distributions to identify and suppress backdoor actions at runtime, and proposes BehaviorGuard, the first online backdoor defense that counters attacks both in single- and multi-agent DRL.

2605.05958.tldr: The Temporal Smoothness Doubly Robust (TSDR) framework jointly optimizes the KT predictor and the imputation model with a smoothness regularizer, effectively reducing variance while preserving the unbiasedness guarantee of DR.

2605.05914.tldr: It is shown that Cayley-parameterised unitary adapters improve the perplexity of Llama 3.1 8B, an 8-billion-parameter model in widespread use, by 1.4% with only 6,000 additional parameters and end-to-end inference validated on real Quantum Processing Unit (QPU).

2605.05848.tldr: VideoRouter is presented, a query-adaptive dual-router framework built on InternVL for budgeted evidence allocation that enables aggressive compression on less relevant frames while preserving detail on critical evidence frames.

2605.05811.tldr: This work proposes Sheet As Token (SAT), a graph-enhanced framework that treats each worksheet as a unified semantic unit for multi-sheet spreadsheet retrieval and improves both retrieval accuracy and serving efficiency.

2605.05990.tldr: iPhoneBlur is introduced, a difficulty-stratified benchmark of 7,400 image pairs synthesized from high-framerate iPhone 17 Pro videos captured in diverse real-world scenarios that enables systematic assessment of model reliability and failure modes for resource-constrained edge systems.

2605.05959.tldr: FedSAF is designed, which shifts the alignment objective from absolute coordinates to inter-class relational structure, and demonstrates that structural alignment consistently outperforms coordinate alignment in heterogeneous settings.

2605.05938.tldr: ICU-Bench is introduced, a continual multimodal unlearning benchmark built on privacy-critical document data and shows that existing methods generally struggle in continual settings and exhibit clear limitations in balancing forgetting quality, utility preservation, and scalability over long task sequences.

2605.05929.tldr: A methodology to analyze the distribution of languages across LOD KGs is presented and a preliminary multi-level categorization based on DBpedia, BabelNet, and Wikidata is proposed to bring a formal definition of low-, high-, and medium-resource languages that could be later leveraged to select cross-lingual transfer candidates.

2605.05895.tldr: MAST is proposed, a detector that processes multi-channel temporal residuals with a spike-driven temporal branch alongside a frozen semantic encoder for cross-generator generalization, matching or surpassing the strongest ANN-based detectors and demonstrating the practical applicability of SNNs to AI-generated video detection.

2605.05995.tldr: Safety Bottleneck Regularization (SBR) shifts the defensive focus from the redundant parameter space to the unembedding layer, which serves as a geometric bottleneck, and enables the model to maintain safe responses even under persistent HFT.

2605.05985.tldr: Ingenix BioResearcher is introduced, a scenario-guided multi-agent system that maps queries to versioned research playbooks, delegates to specialized subagents over 30+ tools and machine-learning endpoints, mixes structured database access with sandboxed code for genome-scale analyses, and applies claim-level multi-model reconciliation before editorial assembly.

2605.05963.tldr: TheraAgent, an agentic framework that replaces one-shot generation with an iterative generate-judge-refine pipeline, and introduces TheraJudge, a treatment-specific evaluation module integrated into the inference loop to enforce clinical standards.

2605.05949.tldr: MAS-Algorithm is proposed, a systematic multi-agent workflow for algorithmic problem solving inspired by the practices of competitive programmers and algorithm engineers that decomposes the end-to-end solving process into modular stages, enabling structured reasoning, tool integration, and flexible coordination among agents.

2605.05812.tldr: This work proposes long-horizon Q-learning (LQL), which introduces a principled backstop against compounding error when learning the optimal action-value function by using a hinge loss to penalize violations of these bounds.

2605.05980.tldr: This paper introduces TACT (Think-Act Calibration via activation Steering), to detect and mitigate agent drift in the residual stream before it surfaces as a behavioral failure, and positions TACT as a viable handle for reliable long-horizon agents.

2605.05973.tldr: This work proposes SIREN, a selection-aware repeated-split reporting protocol that freezes the post-search shortlist, separates splitwise selection from held-out evaluation, and uses an item-level Gaussian multiplier bootstrap for uncertainty quantification.

2605.05931.tldr: This proposal identifies key variables that characterize language distribution in LOD, including the number of Wikipedia articles per language edition and the number of language-tagged entities in LOD KGs and intends to study the impact of cross-lingual transfer candidate selection on the task of multilingual KG completion.

2605.05921.tldr: Findings from a formative user study with 11 expert mathematicians who used AlphaEvolve, an evolutionary coding agent, to tackle advanced problems in their fields of expertise suggest an approach to designing AI tools for scientific discovery that goes beyond the existing question/answer model of many current systems.

2605.06148.tldr: WAR-Tok, arete image tokenizer that reduces AR loss and improves generation FID on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet at comparable reconstruction quality by adding a distribution-level prior-matching signal during tokenizer training, while keeping the reconstruction objective unchanged.

2605.06116.tldr: This work forms stepwise model routing as a constrained decision-making problem, which is solved by training a small control policy using reinforcement learning in conjunction with threshold calibration to tune the performance-efficiency tradeoff.

2605.06094.tldr: This work proposes VISD, a structured self distillation framework that introduces diagnostically meaningful privileged information for video reasoning, and introduces a direction magnitude decoupling mechanism to stably integrate dense supervision with RL.

2605.06066.tldr: MTG-Causal-RL gives causal-RL, world-model, and LLM-agent research a shared testbed for questions current benchmarks cannot pose together: causal credit assignment under masked action spaces, structural transfer across archetypes, and SCM-grounded policy auditability.

2605.06054.tldr: This work presents an approach to visually compare LLM outputs across generation conditions by modeling responses as collections of linguistic choices, including content, expression, and structure, enabling direct, distribution-level comparison of condition-specific tendencies.

2605.06040.tldr: A measurable concept of novelty is proposed that describes the uniqueness of a new node (thought) in comparison to nodes previously seen in the search tree, which can be used to prune branches and reduce the scope of the search.

2605.06032.tldr: A large-scale empirical study systematically evaluating synthetic time series augmentation across five architectures, four synthetic signals and seven datasets finds that only the Seasonal-Trend generator reliably helps across the tested benchmarks, and that hard curriculum switching is actively harmful.

2605.06012.tldr: PFCVR, a Part-level Fine-grained Cross-modal Vehicle Retrieval model for text-to-image vehicle re-identification, is proposed and a new large-scale dataset called T2I-VeRW is constructed, which contains 14,668 images covering 1,796 vehicle identities with fine-grained part-level annotations.

2605.06161.tldr: It is argued that any trustworthy safety judge must satisfy a basic property the authors call policy invariance, and it is operationalized as three testable principles: rubric-semantics invariance under certified-equivalent rewrites, rubric-threshold invariance under intentional strict-to-lenient shifts, and ambiguity-aware calibration so that verdict instability concentrates on genuinely ambiguous cases.

2605.06149.tldr: AdaGamma is proposed, a practical deep actor--critic method for state-dependent discounting that learns a state-dependent discount function together with a return-consistency objective to regularize the induced backup structure and suggest that state-dependent discounting can be made effective in deep RL when coupled with a return-consistency objective that prevents degenerate target manipulation.

2605.06124.tldr: P-Guide is introduced, a framework that achieves high-quality guidance through a single inference pass by modulating only the initial latent state, and is equivalent to CFG in the sense that it steers generation from the prior space, without requiring explicit velocity field extrapolation during sampling.

2605.06123.tldr: This work argues that knowledge becomes the primary search object and code merely instantiates and tests it, making what is learned explicit and reusable across problems and trajectories, and formalizes this shift through a statistical-learning view that exposes a distortion--compression trade-off.

2605.06115.tldr: CrossCult-KIBench is introduced, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for assessing both the effectiveness of knowledge insertion and its unintended side effects on non-target cultures and proposes Memory-Conditioned Knowledge Insertion (MCKI) as a baseline method.

2605.06165.tldr: This work proposes Post-Reasoning, a simple yet effective approach that improves instruction-tuned models by conditioning them to justify their answers after generating the final response, and proposes supervised post-reason tuning, which improves performance and establishes a new performance ceiling for direct-answer capabilities.

2605.06154.tldr: A model-agnostic framework based on a vocabulary of graphlets that mines a KG between relations via pattern matching is introduced that is evaluated on 51 KGs from a wide range of domains, for zero-shot inductive and transductive link prediction.

2605.06143.tldr: This work develops a suite of detectors with various architectures and fine-tuning strategies, trained on the authors' large-scale photorealistic fake image dataset, AIText2Image, and assess their performance on state-of-the-art text-to-image AI generators.

2605.06142.tldr: The Implicit Reminiscence Context Benchmark, the Implicit Reminiscence Context Benchmark, for evaluating implicit entity recognition in reminiscence transcripts is introduced and 19 configurations across LLM generation, dense retrieval, RAG, and fine-tuning are evaluated.

2605.06137.tldr: Prologue generates a small set of prologue tokens prepended to the visual token sequence, trained exclusively with the AR cross-entropy loss, while visual tokens remain dedicated to reconstruction.

2605.06136.tldr: BUILD-AND-FIND is introduced, a protocol for evaluating whether downstream agents can recover intended choices from generated repositories and how much inspection that recovery requires, and how much inspection that recovery requires.

2605.06112.tldr: An event sparsity-aware tracking framework that explicitly models event-density variations across multiple temporal scales is proposed, and a sparsity-aware Mixture-of-Experts module is introduced to encourage expert specialization under different sparsity patterns.

2605.06047.tldr: TFM-Retouche, a lightweight input-space residual adapter that is architecture-agnostic by design with respect to the frozen TFM backbone, is introduced, a lightweight input-space residual adapter that is architecture-agnostic by design with respect to the frozen TFM backbone.

2605.06010.tldr: FusionProxy is proposed, a real-time image fusion module designed as a fully independent, plug-and-play component with diffusion level quality, providing a flexible and generalizable solution for all-day perception.

2605.06187.tldr: This work introduces a structured feedback prior that models how feedback sources vary in their access, relevance, and distortion relative to the true objective, and uses it to pretrain a feedback-aware transformer for black-box optimization of synthetic and real-world tasks.

2605.06185.tldr: Experiments on long-video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that Event-Causal RAG consistently outperforms strong clip-based retrieval baselines and long-context video models, particularly on questions requiring multi-event integration and causal inference across long temporal gaps, while also achieving improved memory efficiency and robust streaming performance.

2605.06173.tldr: Retina-RAG, a low-cost modular framework that jointly performs DR severity grading, macular edema detection, and report generation, is proposed, demonstrating that clinically structured retinal AI can be achieved with modest computational resources.

2605.06156.tldr: ME-AM incorporates two mechanisms: a Mirror Descent entropy maximization objective that mitigates the popularity bias to facilitate the extraction of optimal policies from offline datasets, and a Mix Behavior Prior that broadens the geometric support to encompass out-of-distribution high-reward regions.

2605.06145.tldr: This work unify GCRL and MISL as instances of control maximization and shows that MISL objectives are bounded by formulation-specific downstream goal-sensitivities, establishing a precise correspondence between MISL methods and downstream GCRL tasks.

2605.06127.tldr: Experiments show that CEA improves average restoration quality over strong prompt-, descriptor-, and expert-based baselines, with the clearest gains on spatially varying and compositional degradations, while maintaining favorable parameter, FLOP, and runtime efficiency.

2605.06111.tldr: ASTOR, a multi-tASk code reinforcement learning framework via uTility-driven coORdination, consistently improves a single model across all tasks, outperforming the best task-specific specialist by 9.0%-9.5% and surpassing the strongest MTRL baseline by 7.5%-12.8%.

2605.06029.tldr: Based on this analysis, what socio-technical development programmes could plausibly move toward AGI-adjacent capability while meeting requirements for transparency, moderation, wellbeing and sustainable business models?

2605.06024.tldr: Strat-LLM, a framework grounded in Stratified Strategy Alignment, is proposed, operating in a live-forward setting throughout 2025, it integrates heterogeneous data including sequential prices, real-time news, and annual reports to eliminate look-ahead bias.

2605.06007.tldr: Through an in-the-wild evaluation with 8 distinct personas, it is demonstrated that PersonaKit provides an extensible, end-to-end framework for studying complex sociolinguistic behaviors in next-generation spoken agents.

2605.06183.tldr: This work proposes DomLoRA, a placement method that places a single adapter at the dominant adaptation module, supporting the dominant adaptation module perspective as a practical placement guideline and improves other LoRA variants, supporting the dominant adaptation module perspective as a practical placement guideline.

2605.06177.tldr: BioMedArena is an open-source toolkit that addresses this reproducibility gap and provides an arena for comparing deep research agents under a shared evaluation environment and ships a library of high-quality reference components.

2605.06157.tldr: This work proposes Hard Negative Captions (HNC): an automatically created dataset containing foiled hard negative captions for ITM training towards achieving fine-grained cross-modal comprehension in VL and demonstrates that HNC models yield a comparable or better initialization for fine-tuning.

2605.06140.tldr: SymDrift is a framework that makes the drifting field itself symmetry-aware, and introduces two complementary strategies: a symmetrized drift in coordinate space based on optimal alignment, and a $G$-invariant embedding that removes symmetry ambiguity by construction.

2605.06110.tldr: This work proposes Monte Carlo Portfolio Planning (MCPP), a lightweight closed-loop planner that directly estimates constrained completion probability through simulated workflow executions and replans after observed outcomes and demonstrates that MCPP consistently improves constrained completion probability over strong baselines across a wide range of budget--deadline constraints.

2605.06105.tldr: Results show that long-context prompt tokens need not always persist as full-depth KV-cache objects when Decode-phase tokens remain full-depth, and show a phase-asymmetric KV-visibility policy that materializes non-anchor prompt-token KV states only in lower layers while keeping Decode-phase tokens full-depth.

2605.06104.tldr: This work proposes SlimDT, which removes RTG from the autoregressive sequence, allowing the Transformer to process only a compact (state, action) sequence, and reduces the sequence length by one-third, directly improving inference efficiency.

2605.06087.tldr: A kernel embedding framework that treats safety certification as a classification problem on trajectory data, directly estimating the $T$-step safety probability without recursion bypasses compounding error across the horizon and enables certification for systems with non-Markovian dynamics.

2605.06078.tldr: This work introduces a milestone-guided policy learning framework, BEACON, that leverages the compositional structure of long-horizon tasks to ensure precise credit assignment and establishes milestone-anchored credit assignment as an effective paradigm for training long-horizon language agents.

2605.06068.tldr: This paper proposes VibeServe, the first agentic loop that generates entire LLM serving stacks end-to-end, and suggests a different point in the design space for infrastructure software: generation-time specialization rather than runtime generality.

2605.06036.tldr: This work proposes SelectiveRM, a framework grounded in optimal transport that enables the autonomous exclusion of samples with noisy preference that contradict semantic consistency, and demonstrates that this approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse benchmarks.

2605.06035.tldr: Q-Patch, a quantum feature map tailored to audio that encodes local time-frequency patches from mel-spectrograms into quantum states using shallow, hardware-efficient circuits with adjacency-aware entanglement, provides a practical framework for incorporating time-frequency-aware representations into quantum kernel learning for audio authenticity assessment in low-resource settings.

2605.06014.tldr: It is proved that a composition of three RHTs leads to decaying coordinate covariance, which ensures that any fixed, bounded, multi-dimensional VQ codebook optimized for URRs has the same expected error when using three RHTs, up to an additive term that vanishes with the dimension.

2508.16571.tldr: This paper describes and benchmark a competitor-discovery component used within an agentic AI system for fast drug asset due diligence and introduces a competitor validating LLM-as-a-judge agent that filters out false positives from the list of predicted competitors to maximize precision and suppress hallucinations.

2508.05463.tldr: A suite of five data-agnostic probes are introduced to quantify how task difficulty influences the topology and robustness of representations in multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), highlighting the crucial role of signed bipartite topology in learned representations and suggesting practical strategies for model compression and interpretability that align with task complexity.

2506.11512.tldr: A taxonomy that reflects the evolution from TSA to TSQA, driven by a shift from external to internal alignment is proposed, and existing literature is organized into three alignment paradigms: Injective Alignment, Bridging Alignment, and Internal Alignment.

2504.11101.tldr: CE-OCR is developed, a lightweight multi-model framework that verifies outputs by ensemble agreement, selects the best outputs, and further improves efficiency through adaptive routing, and requires no training or supervision, enabling plug-and-play integration.

2503.17656.tldr: NaFM demonstrates the ability to capture evolutionary information from molecular scaffolds while capturing side-chain information by incorporating contrastive learning and masked graph learning objectives and achieves state-of-the-art results in various downstream tasks related to natural product mining and drug discovery.

2305.18593.tldr: Investigating different variations of diffusion modeling for unsupervised and semi-supervised anomaly detection finds that Denoising Diffusion Probability Models (DDPM) are performant on anomaly detection benchmarks yet computationally expensive, and introduces an alternative approach called Diffusion Time Estimation (DTE).

2310.15288.tldr: The Hidden Utility Bandit framework is proposed to model differences in teacher rationality, expertise, and costliness, formalizing the problem of learning from multiple teachers and it is found that Active Teacher Selection algorithms outperform baselines by actively selecting when and which teacher to query.

2509.00338.tldr: This work proposes Scalable Option Learning (SOL), a highly scalable hierarchical RL algorithm which achieves a ~35x higher throughput compared to existing hierarchical methods and significantly surpassing flat agents and demonstrating positive scaling trends.

2509.25584.tldr: A unified framework is proposed that characterizes the redundancy conditions under which pruning can enhance efficiency without sacrificing performance and provides a theoretically grounded understanding of redundancy in VLMs and unifies many of the ideas behind modern layer-skipping techniques.

2509.02826.tldr: Comparisons of ensemble stacking and hybrid majority voting methods for obesity risk prediction confirm that ensemble stacking provides stronger predictive capability, particularly for complex data distributions, while hybrid majority voting remains a robust alternative.

2510.02371.tldr: A graph-centric, multimodal detector that fuses physical-layer and behavioral indicators over ego-centric star subgraphs and short temporal windows to detect passive attacks, making the approach suitable for non-IID federated smart-grid deployments.

2509.12047.tldr: An open-source implementation that leverages open-sourced state-of-the-art computer vision techniques to automate animal behavior analysis in a group housing environment, contributing to precision pig farming and welfare assessment through automated, objective, and continuous analysis.

2503.12285.tldr: A notion of $\alpha,\beta,\delta,\texttt{N})-resilience for bi-criteria approximation algorithms is introduced, capturing how joint approximation guarantees degrade under bounded (possibly worst-case) oracle noise, and a general black-box framework is developed that converts any resilient offline algorithm into an online algorithm for bi-criteria combinatorial multi-armed bandits with bandit feedback.

2406.13724.tldr: An explainable framework for inferring land use that synergises heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNs) with Explainable AI techniques, enhancing both accuracy and explainability is introduced.

2410.18103.tldr: A Hybrid GNN (HybGNN) that combines a Common Graph Neural Network (CGNN) branch using common connections and an Individualized Graph Neural Network (IGNN) branch employing individualized connections is proposed that achieves state-of-the-art performance.

2509.21654.tldr: The core finding is that an accurate and trusted AI system cannot be a human-level reasoning system: for such an accurate, trusted system there are task instances which are easily and provably solvable by a human but not by the system.

2310.07379.tldr: A novel framework, CAusal Unsupervised Semantic sEgmentation (CAUSE), which leverages insights from causal inference to achieve state-of-the-art performance in unsupervised semantic segmentation.

2601.15599.tldr: This work introduces Autonomous Business System (AUTOBUS), a system that integrates LLM-based AI agents, predicate-logic programming, and business-semanticscentric enterprise data into a unified neuro-symbolic architecture for executing end-to-end business initiatives.

2602.16928.tldr: This work deploys one of such agentic frameworks, AlphaEvolve, to navigate the design spaces of two distinct game-theoretic paradigms: counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) and policy-space response oracles (PSRO).

2602.13298.tldr: It is suggested that effective depth serves as a superior framework for predicting scaling potential and practical trainability, ultimately indicating that architectural topology - rather than sheer layer volume - is the primary determinant of gradient health in deep learning models.

2602.13224.tldr: Two detection methods grounded in a taxonomy identifying three types of unfaithfulness, confabulation, and factual error are introduced: the Semantic Grounding Index for Type I, which measures whether a response moves toward provided context on the unit hypersphere, and the Directional Grounding Index for Type II, which measures displacement geometry in context-free settings.

2605.01999.tldr: Results show that, when labels are limited, SSL-pretrained models outperform supervised baselines in terms of F1-score, recall, accuracy, and precision, demonstrating SSL's scalability and dependability in diagnosing brain tumors from unlabeled medical data.

2603.24755.tldr: SlopCodeBench provides the first measurement of code degradation under iterative extension, revealing that agents pass checkpoints while producing code that erodes and bloats with each turn.

2604.24013.tldr: A novel method termed CommFuse is proposed that replaces conventional collective operations of reduce-scatter and all-gather with decomposed peer-to-peer (P2P) communication and schedules partitioned computations to enable fine-grained overlap to effectively mitigate communication bottleneck of tensor parallelism and data parallelism for distributed training and inference.

2605.01459.tldr: SRGAN--CKAN is proposed, a hybrid super-resolution framework that integrates Convolutional Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (CKAN) into an adversarial learning setting reformulating convolution as a nonlinear patch-based transformation, allowing expressive modeling of complex local structures and high-frequency textures using minimal hardware resources.

2603.06859.tldr: C3 is the first method-agnostic auditing tool for multi-agent LLM credit assignment with three independently computable diagnostics, credit fidelity, within-group variance, and inter-agent influence, constitute the first method-agnostic auditing tool for multi-agent LLM credit assignment.

2603.16876.tldr: The proposed MARL-Rad framework decomposes chest X-ray interpretation into region-specific agents and a global integrating agent, and jointly optimizes them using clinically verifiable rewards, and produces reports clinically comparable to ground-truth reports.

2605.01482.tldr: This work introduces an SCM-inspired framework that grounds reasoning in explicit directed dependency graphs, treating verification as a constructive structural reasoning process rather than full causal inference with interventions or counterfactual semantics.

2604.09839.tldr: Under practical assumptions, it is proved that activation steering pushes the residual stream off the manifold of states reachable from discrete prompts, and establishes a formal separation between white-box steerability and black-box prompting.

2604.03420.tldr: This work shows that robustness to post-training quantization (PTQ) is a transferable direction in weight space, and proves rigorously that quantization vectors are well-defined and do not suffer from reparameterization symmetries, and suggests that quantization robustness can be partially isolated, reused, and transferred through simple weight-space algebra.

2605.01758.tldr: A training-free Foresight-Guided Local Purification (FLP) framework, where each agent reasons over future interactions to track behavioral evolution and eliminate infections, is proposed, which reduces the maximum cumulative infection rate from over 95% to below 5.47%.

2605.01717.tldr: A new framework that combines Thread-Constrained Directed Acyclic Graph (TC-DAG) and Discourse-Aware Rotary Position Embedding (D-RoPE) is proposed, which filters out cross-thread noise based on thread constraints, maintains global connectivity through root anchoring, and incorporates the temporal sequence of the dialogues.

2605.01240.tldr: Rhamba, a region-aware pretraining framework that integrates anatomically guided masking with hybrid Attention-Mamba architectures for resting state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) analysis, offers a flexible framework for balancing interpretability, scalability, and performance in large-scale fMRI representation learning.

2604.24372.tldr: This work introduces \model, a modular strategy-space layer that turns language-level strategic reasoning into first-class population-level evolutionary state in LLM-driven program search, suggesting that persistent strategy representations provide a practical mechanism for improving the effectiveness and cost-efficiency of LLM-guided evolutionary search.

2605.06723.tldr: In controlled delayed-verdict tasks with Qwen3-4B-Instruct, the contextual finite-answer projection stabilizes before the answer is parseable, with 17--31 token mean lead in the main templates and positive, shorter lead in a parser-clean replication.

2605.06714.tldr: A comprehensive review of the current state of the art in edge deep learning, focusing on computer vision applications, focusing on medical diagnostics, is provided, emphasising the capacity of this technology to revolutionise a wide range of domains.

2605.06699.tldr: This work is, to the authors' knowledge, the first to demonstrate the feasibility of jointly modeling MRI and mixed-type tabular data in a single latent diffusion framework, offering a proof-of-concept for generating coherent synthetic multimodal patient data and aligning with the broader goal of developing digital twins in healthcare.

2605.06696.tldr: The results demonstrate that analyzing hidden-state mutual information through spectral partitioning provides a scalable diagnostic for identifying representational coalitions, offering a valuable tool for monitoring emergent structure in distributed AI systems.

2605.06683.tldr: It is demonstrated that TMMs are capable of retaining more input information resulting in improved copying ability, which is argued results from a lack of architectural biases, and that trained Toeplitz layers of causal non-invertible models are more likely to be invertible than models that are actually invertible over their inputs.

2605.06623.tldr: MASPO is introduced, a novel framework designed to automatically and iteratively refine prompts across the entire system, which effectively bridges the gap between local interactions and global outcomes without relying on ground-truth labels.

2605.06483.tldr: Experiments show that a 4B model trained with \textsc{ReasonSTL} achieves state-of-the-art performance in both automatic metrics and human evaluations, demonstrating that \textsc{ReasonSTL} provides a transparent, low-cost, and privacy-preserving alternative for formal specification drafting.

2605.06713.tldr: This paper introduces a Three Channel Agentic Cyber Risk Model and an Agentic Attack Compression Model, uses the 2026 Linux kernel Copy Fail incident as a case study for foothold-to-root acceleration, and develops a 2026 to 2028 forecast for large enterprises and the German and European Mittelstand.

2605.06708.tldr: This formulation of VTC in the language of measure transport yields a downstream-label-free routing criterion that selects whether to use the visual path for a given input or benchmark instance, and a transport-informed foveation mechanism that re-encodes high-cost regions at higher resolution.

2605.06682.tldr: A composite-move Tabu search (CM-Tabu) that systematically expands the feasible neighborhood space in Tabu search while preserving contiguity and delivers optimization performance suitable for real-world practices and decision-support workflows.

2605.06669.tldr: A reproducible benchmark protocol for head-to-head comparison under identical conditions, including stratified bootstrap confidence intervals, paired McNemar significance tests, multi-seed sensitivity sweeps, and direct evaluation of Prompt Guard and NeMo Guardrails on the same split with unified instrumentation is provided.

2605.06387.tldr: AOPD replaces ineffective negative reinforcement with localized divergence minimization in non-positive advantage regions while preserving positive reinforcement learning and maintains higher policy entropy during training and better capability retention during sequential tool-use adaptation.

2605.06230.tldr: Safactory is the first framework to propose a unified evolutionary pipeline for next-generation trustworthy autonomous intelligence, and is likely the first framework to propose a unified evolutionary pipeline for next-generation trustworthy autonomous intelligence.

2605.06690.tldr: This paper represents the reasoning state as an epistemic state graph encoding extracted claims, evidential relations, open questions, and confidence weights, and applies the framework to recursive reasoning systems and sketches its application to agent loops, tree-of-thought reasoning, theorem proving, and continual learning.

2605.06707.tldr: An eight-week observational comparison of 68 single-file HTML generations collected across 17 public experiments in the "HTML AI Battle" project between December 10, 2025 and February 4, 2026 shows that Gemini as a judge was significantly more lenient than the human evaluator on functional correctness and overall performance, while stable self-favoring bias remained unresolved.

2605.06702.tldr: CASCADE (CASe-based Continual Adaptation during DEployment), a general and principled framework that equips LLM agents with an explicit, evolving episodic memory that allows agents to accumulate, select, and refine task-relevant cases, transforming past experience into actionable knowledge.

2605.06672.tldr: The results argue that reasoning-capable models should not be treated as order-robust by default in MCQ evaluation pipelines, and offer a diagnostic toolkit for auditing position bias in reasoning models.

2605.06435.tldr: Both the textual and linguistic features were found to improve fake news detection when used separately, however, combining them into a single model did not improve the detection significantly.

2605.06728.tldr: GEO-OmicsQA, a benchmark for multi-sample biological question answering built from real Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) studies is introduced, demonstrating that OmicsLM can use expression profiles directly and perform comparably to specialized omics models on profile-level tasks, while outperforming both omics-specialized models and general LLMs on language-guided biological reasoning over expression data.

2605.06717.tldr: A three level taxonomy of proactivity (Reactive, Scheduled, and Situation Aware), a comparison of contemporary coding agents against five practical criteria, and an active user simulation protocol with three evaluation targets are proposed.

2605.06607.tldr: This work presents AI CFD Scientist, an open-source AI scientist for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) that is the first to span literature-grounded ideation, validated execution, vision-based physics verification, source-code modification, and figure-grounded writing within a single inspectable workflow.

2605.06384.tldr: This work introduces MinMax Recurrent Neural Cascades, a class of recurrent neural networks built from a novel form of recurrence over the MinMax algebra that enjoys strong formal expressivity, efficient evaluation, stable dynamics, and non-vanishing state gradients.

2605.06298.tldr: NoVA, a world modelling framework that represents the system state as the weights and biases of an auxiliary coordinate-based implicit neural representation (INR), is introduced, which eliminates the decoder bottleneck while conferring compactness, portability, and zero-shot super-resolution.

2605.06223.tldr: Proactive Instance Navigation with Comparative Judgment (ProCompNav), a two-stage framework that first constructs a candidate pool and then identifies the target through comparative judgment, and achieves state-of-the-art Success Rate on TextNav, suggesting that comparative judgment is broadly useful for instance-level navigation among similar distractors.

2605.06733.tldr: Instead of aggregating raw factors, GLoRA estimates a consensus update subspace from client projectors and aggregates client updates in shared reference coordinates, thereby representing semantic update aggregation entirely in low-rank form and achieves a favorable efficiency--performance trade-off.

2605.06724.tldr: Intelligent Partitioning for Self-supervised Denoising (iPSD) eliminates the need for clean references by learning to partition an input EEG segment into independent noisy realizations with the same underlying signal, enabling self-supervision of deep learning denoisers, even in zero-shot settings.

2605.06720.tldr: This work demonstrates that discrete diffusion fine-tuning achieves strong language modeling performance on antibody sequences while allowing for generation conditioned on any off-the-shelf classifier, and introduces germline absorbing diffusion, a novel modification of the discrete diffusion noise process in which the germline sequence serves as the absorbing state.

2605.06729.tldr: A novel architecture that unifies Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections, Deep Delta Learning, and the Cayley transform to obtain input-adaptive, unconditionally orthogonal residual connections and introduces the E$\Delta-MHC-Geo Hybrid, which combines Cayley rotation with Householder reflection via a learned operator-selection gate.

2605.06716.tldr: This survey proposes a novel evolutionary framework for LLM agent memory mechanisms, formalizing the development process into three stages: Storage (trajectory preservation), Reflection (trajectory refinement), and Experience (trajectory abstraction).

2605.06671.tldr: GraphDC, a Divide-and-Conquer multi-agent framework for scalable graph algorithm reasoning, inspired by Divide-and-Conquer design, decomposes an input graph into smaller subgraphs, assigns each subgraph to a specialized agent for local reasoning, and uses a master agent to integrate the local outputs with inter-subgraph information to produce the final solution.

2605.06317.tldr: This work proposes Top-Down VLN (TD-VLN), reformulating navigation as a one-step global path planning problem on pre-built top-down maps, supported by the newly constructed R2R-TopDown dataset.

2605.06895.tldr: This work designs an approach to dynamically adjust the rationality parameter beta during reward learning using an LLM-as-judge to assess the likely presence of cognitive biases, and shows that this approach learns a more rational downstream model, even when finetuning on datasets with strongly biased preferences.

2605.06882.tldr: This paper evaluates LLMs' performance on the simplest yet long-chain reasoning task, namely the Equivalence Class Problem (ECP), i.e., determining whether two variables are equal given a set of randomly generated equivalence relations.

2605.06850.tldr: This work states that the sampler generates responses under a sparse context, whereas the learner updates parameters using the full, dense context, whereas the sampler updates parameters using the full, dense context of the RL framework.

2605.06840.tldr: A new method to characterize LLM planning by extracting and quantifying search trees from reasoning traces in the four-in-a-row board game reveals a key difference between LLM and human planning: while human expertise is driven by deeper search, LLMs do not act on deep lookahead.

2605.06839.tldr: An open hypothesis-learning framework that combines symbolic regression with large-language-model-based physical evaluation and implement it for autonomous scanning probe microscopy is introduced and a route for integrating symbolic regression, physical reasoning, and adaptive experimentation into hierarchical autonomous scientific workflows is established.

2605.06835.tldr: This work quantifies the impact of training setup, synthesis choices, and attacker knowledge on privacy leakage and demonstrates that adversaries need not have perfect knowledge of the training setup, identical data distributions, or massive compute resources to construct successful attacks.

2605.06832.tldr: Intentional Fine-Tuning (IFT), which fine-tunes the models on the training set in IntentGrasp, yielding significant gains of 30+ F1 points on All Set and 20+ points on Gem Set is proposed, verifying that it is a promising approach to substantially enhancing the intent understanding of LLMs.

2605.06820.tldr: Real-world FL improves cross-center robustness of CT-based OAR segmentation models in pediatric upper abdominal tumors, and maintained stable performance across patient orientations and reduced false-positive kidney segmentations.

2605.06938.tldr: It is proved that most modern neural architectures admit a generalized SVD representation in which they are left-invertible before a final linear layer, with no change in input-output behavior, and the left-invertible nonlinear portion of the input-output behavior can be made to be norm preserving.

2605.06908.tldr: DIAL (Direction-Informed Adaptive Learning), a sparse gate trained from signal-agnostic counterfactual exploration to learn the utility direction of state features per, is proposed, which yields a stronger overall success-cost trade-off than fixed-direction baselines.

2605.06846.tldr: The first model organisms of narrow secret loyalties are constructed, and poisoned training examples even at low poison fractions are identified, while dataset-monitoring precision degrades and static black-box audits remain ineffective.

2605.06825.tldr: This work proposes Diamond Attention, a cross-attention architecture in which each agent samples a scalar random number per timestep, inducing a transient rank ordering that masks lower-ranked peers from agent-to-agent attention while leaving task attention fully unmasked.

2605.06815.tldr: It is demonstrated that the cognitive abilities of generative models are evolving unevenly, suggesting that scaling and optimization approaches to AGI development alone may be insufficient to overcome fundamental architectural limitations in achieving balanced, human-like general intelligence.

2605.06765.tldr: VITA-QinYu is presented, the first expressive end-to-end (E2E) spoken language model (SLM) that goes beyond natural conversation to support both role-playing and singing generation and achieves state-of-the-art conversational accuracy and fluency.

2605.06762.tldr: LiT-G2P (Linear-Transformer Genotype-to-Phenotype), an automated predictive framework that integrates additive genetic variance effects with Transformer-based nonlinear interactions using genome-wide single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) data, is proposed.

2605.06897.tldr: MIST is introduced, a synthetic multi-turn, voice-driven code generation task that operates over IoT devices and it is found that there is a significant gap between open- and closed-weight multimodal LLMs on MIST, and that even frontier closed-weight LLMs have substantial headroom.

2605.06924.tldr: Across public and LVBench-C benchmarks spanning one- to ten-minute videos, A$^2$RD outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 30% in consistency and 20% in narrative coherence.

2605.06914.tldr: TAPER is introduced, a per-step admission controller that treats extra branches as opportunistic work, admitted only when the predicted branch externality fits within the batch's current slack budget.

2605.06869.tldr: Agentick's capability-decomposed, multi-modal design provides the empirical infrastructure needed to drive progress toward general autonomous agents, both as an evaluation framework and as a training ground for RL post-training of foundation models in truly sequential environments.

2605.06859.tldr: This work observes that different medical imaging domains scale at variable rates during pretraining, and knowledge transfer between domains is strongly asymmetric: training on one domain can substantially improve another, but the reverse may be much weaker, and forms data allocation as a scaling-law optimization problem.

2605.06761.tldr: This work proposes Weblica (Web Replica), a framework for constructing reproducible and scalable web environments that leverages HTTP-level caching to capture and replay stable visual states while preserving interactive behavior and LLM-based environment synthesis grounded in real-world websites and core web navigation skills.

2605.06737.tldr: This paper proposes a reliability-aware self-healing framework for LLM-based software agents that integrates failure detection, reliability assessment, and automated recovery mechanisms, and establishes an integrated monitoring system that combines the agent's internal reasoning process with external execution results.

2605.06736.tldr: STDA-Net is proposed, a framework that combines a convolutional neural network for spectrogram-based feature extraction, a bidirectional long short-term memory module for temporal modeling of sleep dynamics, and a domain-adversarial neural network for source-to-target feature alignment without requiring any labeled target-domain data during training.

2605.06957.tldr: This work presents a dynamic policy-learning approach that combines generalized planning and hierarchical task decomposition for LLM-based agents and demonstrates that classical planning concepts can be effectively integrated with LLM agents for improved accuracy and efficiency.

2605.06920.tldr: Algorithms for approximating the least core, which leverage novel routines for constraint seeding and constraint separation, are developed and found that they are capable of approximating the least core using orders of magnitude fewer LLM calls compared to alternative methods.

2605.06898.tldr: Spell is introduced, a Lisp-based language in which programs can edit and re-evaluate themselves, and effectful expressions like model invocations are structured such that re-evaluating an edited program does not replay its side effects.

2605.06875.tldr: E EULER-ADAS is presented, a SIMD-enabled logarithmic bounded-Posit neural compute engine for energyefficient and reliability-aware ADAS acceleration that enables 4xPosit-8, 2xPosit-16, or 1xPosit-32 operation without duplicating precision-specific hardware.

2605.06841.tldr: AGWM (Affordance-Grounded World Model), which learns an abstract affordance structure represented as a DAG of prerequisite dependencies to explicitly track the dynamic executability of actions to achieve lower multi-step prediction error, better generalization to novel configurations, and improved interpretability.

2605.06812.tldr: Evaluation on representative real-world agentic attack scenarios shows that Agent-BOM can reconstruct stealthy attack chains, and provides a unified and auditable foundation for root-cause analysis and security adjudication in complex agentic ecosystems.

2605.06755.tldr: GXPO is proposed, a plug-compatible policy-update rule for GRPO-style reasoning RL that approximates a longer local lookahead using only three backward passes during an active phase and gives a plain-gradient-descent surrogate analysis that explains when the extrapolation is exact and where its local errors come from.

2605.06738.tldr: The Combined Evidence Protocol (CEP) is addressed: a five-condition predicate any party recomputes from anchored data, turning"did the boundary-owner follow its own admission rules"into a fact anyone verifies rather than a claim anyone believes.

2605.06734.tldr: This work proposes gated QKAN-FWP, a fast-weight framework that integrates FWP with Quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (QKAN) using single-qubit data re-uploading circuits as learnable nonlinear activation, known as DatA Re-Uploading ActivatioN (DARUAN).

2605.06955.tldr: K-DSM achieves state-of-the-art performance in the semi-supervised setting, and when combined with a lightweight EMA-teacher filtering rule that removes low-density training points before each gradient step, suggests that simple, data-adaptive noise scaling enables robust anomaly detection while reducing reliance on hyperparameter tuning.

2605.06951.tldr: Empirical evaluations demonstrate that MOCI significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving improved predictive performance, and maintaining competitive computational efficiency on a standard grid-world benchmark, establishing MOCI as an accurate, flexible, and computationally practical approach for real-world constraint inference and preference learning tasks.

2605.06946.tldr: This work proposes learning {\lambda} directly from the input via a lightweight two-layer MLP, producing per-token, per-level decay that adapts to content rather than position, finding that input-dependent decay consistently outperforms the baseline, with the largest gains in long-range memory settings where baseline {\lambda} degrades or collapses entirely.

2605.06936.tldr: PostEDA-Bench is introduced, a hierarchical benchmark with 145 tasks across DRC-Essential, DRC-Reasoning, PPA-Mono, and PPA-Multi, supported by EDA toolchains with machine-checkable evaluation and finds that agents handle synthetic DRC-Essential and single-objective PPA-Mono reasonably well but degrade sharply on the more practical DRC-Reasoning.

2605.06927.tldr: An energy-adaptive framework that combines an energy-aware XiResOFA search space, a two-stage energy estimator, and iterative search to identify a single energy-efficient base architecture and applies compound scaling to transform this base design into the XiYOLO family across deployment budgets, enabling interpretable accuracy-energy tradeoffs under sparse hardware measurements.

2605.06903.tldr: This work introduces MELD (Multi-Task Equilibrated Learning Detector), a deployable detector for AI-generated text that enriches binary detection with auxiliary supervision and introduces MELD-eval, a held-out evaluation pool built from recent chat models released by four major LLM providers.

2605.06885.tldr: REPR-ALIGN is introduced, a representation alignment objective that adapts a bidirectional masked diffusion model to reuse representations from a pretrained AR model of identical architecture that suggests that linguistic representations can transfer across generation order, and that representation alignment provides a simple and effective technique for training diffusion language models.

2605.06833.tldr: PAMPOS is presented, a causal transformer-decoder trained on benign VeReMi++ trajectories to learn normal mobility patterns, using a top-K normalized anomaly scoring mechanism that localizes falsification to specific kinematic features, without requiring attack-labeled training data.

2605.06831.tldr: The empirical validation verifies that DDPM has a significantly lower hallucination rate than DDIM when this region is entered, and exhibits how using additional stochastic steps can help DDIM avoid hallucinations and offer new insights on how to design improved samplers.

2605.06772.tldr: This study uses SCALAR (Structured Critic--Actor Loop for AI Reasoning), an Actor--Critic--Judge pipeline applied to quantum field theory and string theory problems, to evaluate which interaction structures help or hinder AI-driven scientific discovery.

2605.06764.tldr: A variance-adjusted algorithm based on eligibility traces is derived, termed Adaptive Q$(\lambda)$, which approaches double the human baseline on the same subset, surpassing existing methods by all performance metrics.

2605.06749.tldr: This work proposes the first comprehensive statistical framework for ACA with multiple collectives acting on the same system, and focuses on collective action in classification, studying how multiple collectives can influence a classifier's behavior.

2605.06740.tldr: GeoKANs is introduced, a family of geometry-aware KAN-type models in which approximation is carried out in learned, geometry-adapted coordinates rather than in fixed Euclidean input coordinates, well suited to sharp, stiff, localized, and strongly non-uniform regimes arising in scientific machine learning and differential-equation problems.

2605.06890.tldr: A mechanistic-interpretability toolkit built on Sparse Autoencoders, which decompose activations into sparse internal features, and linear probes, lightweight classifiers that read signals from those features that helps surface deeper causes of agent failure, especially in long-horizon runs.

2605.07161.tldr: This work uses SREGym, a high-fidelity benchmark for SRE agents, to evaluate frontier agents and shows that their capabilities varies significantly in addressing different kinds of failures, with up to 40% differences in end-to-end results.

2605.07137.tldr: Two extensions to the NSR framework are proposed: Adaptive Negative Sample Reinforcement and Confidence-Weighted Negative Reinforcement, allowing the model to leverage prior-guided probability redistribution while providing a natural defense against overfitting.

2605.07111.tldr: A Mixture of LoRA and Full (MoLF) Fine-Tuning is proposed, a unified framework that enables continuous navigation between both training regimes, and dynamically routes updates between FFT and LoRA at the optimizer level to ensure that exact gradient signals are available to both experts throughout training, yielding stable training dynamics.

2605.07096.tldr: An approach for predicting benchmark performance that leverages cached model responses based on the Data Kernel Perspective Space (DKPS), a method for quantifying the relationship between models in the black-box setting and an offline method for selecting a set of queries that maximizes the goodness-of-fit on reference models are introduced.

2605.07079.tldr: This work discovers that a new type of latent action representation, which is referred to as *Residual Latent Action* (RLA), can be easily learned from DINO residuals, and proposes *RLA-WM, which predicts RLA values via flow matching and outperforms both state-of-the-art feature-based and video-diffusion world models on simulation and real-world datasets.

2605.07065.tldr: This work introduces an anchored neural architecture that guarantees structural constraint satisfaction by construction and employs precision-corrected intersection-bound inference to correct extremum bias, leveraging Epistemic Neural Networks for scalable, high-dimensional uncertainty quantification.

2605.07042.tldr: It is argued that framing the LLM agent loop as a CGDP can guide the design of modular, non-interfering improvements to agentic search harnesses.

2605.07019.tldr: LensVLM is proposed, an inference framework and post-training recipe that enables VLMs to scan compressed images, then selectively expand only the relevant images to their uncompressed form via learned tools, and validates this approach: training makes visual compression robust to rendering choices, and as compression grows the model increasingly relies on expanded content rather than unreliable visual reading.

2605.06978.tldr: GoSkills is an inference-time group-structured retrieval method that changes the agent-facing retrieval object from a flat skill list to a compact, role-labeled execution context, and often improves reward and agent-only runtime relative to structural retrieval references.

2605.06979.tldr: PLOT (Progressive Localization via Optimal Transport), a transport-based framework that localizes causal variables from the output effect geometry of abstract and neural interventions, is introduced, providing an efficient localization engine for causal abstraction research at scale.

2605.07147.tldr: By turning Mathlib PR histories into a supervised signal, MathlibPR provides a step toward reviewer assistants and reward models that could help evaluate PRs and steer LLMs toward producing merge-ready Mathlib contributions.

2605.07140.tldr: This work introduces a neurosymbolic formulation of skeleton-based HAR that reframes action recognition as concept-driven first-order logical reasoning over motion primitives, and highlights neurosymbolic reasoning as an effective paradigm for interpretable spatio-temporal action understanding.

2605.07073.tldr: TeamBench is presented, a benchmark with 851 task templates and 931 seeded instances for evaluating agent coordination under operating system-enforced role separation that separates specification access, workspace editing, and final certification across Planner, Executor, and Verifier roles.

2605.07068.tldr: This work proposes WiCER (Wiki-memory Compile, Evaluate, Refine), an iterative algorithm inspired by counterexample-guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR) that closes the compilation gap between LLM Wiki and RepLiQA.

2605.07066.tldr: A neuro-symbolic pipeline based on 2.5-D decomposition is presented: the LLM plans in the two-dimensional horizontal plane while a deterministic executor computes all vertical placements from column occupancy, eliminating an entire class of errors.

2605.07055.tldr: Saliency-Guided Masking (SGM), which uses the model attention distribution to adaptively mask dominant organs during pre-training, thus encouraging more balanced cross-organ, whole-body learning, is introduced.

2605.07040.tldr: This work proposes Cognitive Agent Compilation (CAC), a framework that uses a strong teacher LLM to compile problem-solving knowledge into an explicit target agent, with the goal of making bounded problem solving more inspectable and editable in educational settings.

2605.07020.tldr: This work presents FlashMol, an ultra-fast molecule generative model producing high-quality molecular conformations in as few as 4 steps, and regularizes DMD with a Jensen-Shannon divergence term, which incorporates the mean-seeking behavior of the forward KL divergence.

2605.06977.tldr: This work develops a comprehensive theoretical framework for online RLHF with a general $f-divergence regularized objective and proposes two algorithms based on distinct sampling principles that extend the classical optimism principle with a carefully designed exploration bonus and introduce a new method that exploits the sensitivity of the optimal policy to reward perturbations under $f-divergence regularization.

2605.06965.tldr: It is argued that the fundamental problem of whether AI systems can be conscious is currently intractable in its direct form, given the absence of a universally accepted scientific theory of consciousness, as well as the historical open-endedness of the philosophical mind-body problem.

2605.07151.tldr: DPG-CD, a depth-prior-guided multi-temporal cross-modal fusion framework for joint 2D semantic and 3D height change detection, is proposed and demonstrated that DPG-CD outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both 2D and 3D change detection tasks.

2605.07141.tldr: Qwen3-VL-Seg is presented, a parameter-efficient framework that treats the MLLM-predicted box as a semantically grounded structural prior and decodes it into pixel-level referring segmentation, with clear advantages on language-intensive instructions and strong out-of-distribution generalization.

2605.07129.tldr: RRCM is proposed, a ranking-driven retrieval-and-reasoning framework over collaborative and metadata memories for LLM-based agentic recommendation that significantly outperforms traditional baselines and diverse LLM-based recommendation approaches.

2605.07058.tldr: This paper formalizes clinical diagnosis as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) with three action types: questioning the patient, ordering medical exams as tool calls, and issuing a diagnosis, and introduces a systematic noise model comprising seven patient noise types and three exam noise types.

2605.07049.tldr: This work establishes the first regret bound for online RL with batch update that depends on the standard complexity measure of coverability, complementing existing results based on a newly introduced Eluder-Condition class.

2605.06971.tldr: This work adopts a structured, weight-based formulation that explicitly captures the streaming-data origin of the time-varying objective: at each time step, every agent receives a new sample, and the network seeks to track the minimizer of a temporally weighted objective formed from all samples observed across the network so far.

2605.07063.tldr: This work moves beyond the data-selection framing and introduces Dr. Post-Training (Data-Regularized Post-Training), a novel framework that reconceptualizes general training data as a data-induced regularizer that prevents overfitting to the scarce target objective, rather than serving as a pool for selection.

2605.07138.tldr: The Adversarial Empathy Benchmark AEB is constructed and the Emotional Consistency Score ECS is introduced to evaluate empathetic robustness under adversarial conditions and is interpreted as a behavioral/legibility dissociation inside this simulator family, not as evidence about internal understanding or clinical readiness.

2605.07133.tldr: This work presents a multi-dimensional benchmark that systematically evaluates GAD models under three deployment-relevant challenges: million-scale graphs, extreme anomaly scarcity, and missing node attributes, and suggests that strong performance in laboratory settings does not guarantee robustness in production environments.

2605.07125.tldr: A benchmark audit with an intentionally simple graph heuristic suggests that strong performance on standard benchmarks does not always demonstrate advanced sequential, semantic, or generative modeling ability, and calls for more careful dataset selection and dataset-level diagnostic analysis when using benchmarks to support claims about new recommendation models.

2605.07121.tldr: AdaTKG is proposed, which maintains a per-entity memory that is updated with every observed interaction, with the memory accumulating online and predictions improving as more interactions arrive, enabling AdaTKG to handle entities unseen during training.

2605.07032.tldr: It is demonstrated that environment formalization, specifically dense rewards and extended episode lengths, is the primary driver of jailbreaking success and provides a tool for improving RL-jailbreaker efficiency and, ultimately, harden generative models resistant to RL-based attacks.

2605.07029.tldr: BGM-IV is proposed, a latent Bayesian generative modeling approach that reframes nonlinear IV regression as posterior inference in a causally structured latent space and shows that structured latent generative modeling provides a principled and effective strategy to nonlinear IV estimation with rich covariates.

2605.07026.tldr: Experiments suggest that MADCLE achieves competitive or improved performance compared with single-atlas baselines, multi-atlas GNN/Transformer models, and recent multi-atlas consistency frameworks, which support the potential value of structured disentanglement for FC-based disorder identification under heterogeneous parcellation schemes.
