2605.07139.tldr: Distillation through Reasoning Path Compression (D-RPC), which constrains the teacher to follow a compact, dynamically maintained bank of reusable high-level reasoning paths, consistently outperforms chain-of-thought distillation, freeform rationale generation, direct distillation, and structured-supervision baselines, while using fewer tokens than template-heavy alternatives.

2605.07134.tldr: This work proposes Region4Web, a framework that reorganizes the AXTree into functional regions through hierarchical decomposition and semantic abstraction, exposing the page's functional organization as the basis for page state understanding and proposes PageDigest, a web-specific inference pipeline that delivers this region-level observation to the actor agent as a compact per-page digest that persists across steps.

2605.07116.tldr: An error theory is developed that separates residual error, initial and exterior-collar mismatch, policy mismatch, and model-identification error, with an explicit gradient amplification factor for learned dynamics, while the underlying linear evaluation stability remains free of hidden inverse-viscosity blow-up.

2605.07112.tldr: Switchcraft is presented, the first (to the best of the authors' knowledge) model router optimized for agentic tool calling, and it is found that larger models do not consistently outperform smaller ones on tool-use tasks, and that nominally cheaper models can incur higher total cost due to token-intensive reasoning.

2605.07103.tldr: ARMOR is proposed, an agentic framework that explicitly models tool-specific utilities, adaptively prioritizes tools, and further resolves the potential tool conflicts to produce the final prediction for each reaction.

2605.07061.tldr: AV-Phys Bench is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating physical commonsense in joint audio-video generation, and AV-Phys Agent is introduced, a ReAct-style evaluator that combines a multimodal language model with deterministic acoustic measurement tools, producing rankings that closely align with human ratings.

2605.07048.tldr: This work proposes DualLGD (Dual-stream Line Graph Diffusion), which reformulates molecular graph denoising as the alternating solution of two coupled subproblems: atom-level reasoning and bond-level reasoning, each operating in its own dedicated representation space.

2605.07046.tldr: This work reformulates the problem as a sequence of constrained matrix factorization subproblems, enabling stable and efficient parameter estimation with theoretical guarantees for identifiability and convergence and proposes an interpretable and scalable framework for LLM evaluation based on the majorization-minimization principle.

2605.07002.tldr: This work introduces a hypothesis testing framework from two'dueling'perspectives: the model's null that asserts there is no failure mode with performance below a target threshold versus the auditor's null that asserts they have a sampling strategy that will uncover a failure mode.

2605.06993.tldr: A general procedure for evaluating epistemic potency in discrete settings is given, and it is shown that ID-pruned experiments are combinatorially inert, yielding a super-exponential reduction in the number of subsets evaluated.

2605.07062.tldr: A research agenda is proposed in which control-plane safety and governance mechanisms represent the most urgent open problem, followed by formalization of autonomy boundaries, evaluation frameworks, and human--agent coordination.

2605.07175.tldr: This work proposes RelAge-GNN, a multi-relational graph neural network framework for DNA methylation-based age prediction, and quantifies the contributions of different relational structures and CpG sites, providing biologically meaningful insights and suggesting potential directions for aging-related research.

2605.07370.tldr: MORPH-U, a CARLA-based closed-loop stack that fuses LiDAR/radar/camera with V2X (CAM/DENM) into a Local Dynamic Map (LDM) and triggers Hybrid-A* replanning when validated hazards or map changes affect the planned route, is presented and a lightweight Byzantine-inspired acceptance gate that combines a quorum rule with an on-board sensor veto is added.

2605.07299.tldr: The experiments demonstrate that EgoPro-Bench substantially enhances the intention understanding capabilities of MLLMs and enables accurate identification of appropriate timings for HMI, thereby laying a solid foundation for next-generation user-centric proactive interactive agents.

2605.07277.tldr: It is proved that broad set-valued maps with locally Lipschitz branches can be represented by regular equilibrium dynamics and that the induced selectors are almost everywhere regular, while manual selectors can be arbitrarily irregular.

2605.07263.tldr: Experiments on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST demonstrate that REED closely matches clean FedAvg and coherent CSIT aggregation in IID settings, while maintaining stable convergence with a moderate performance degradation under strong data heterogeneity.

2605.07230.tldr: This work identifies previously overlooked patterns in the target model's behavior that emerge naturally in tree-based speculative decoding, and formalizes two properties, semantic interchangeability and convergence, arising from the redundancies in the target model's hidden state representations.

2605.07212.tldr: This work formalizes preprocessing choices as a counterfactual intervention space and shows that EEG predictions are surprisingly unstable under this space: across six datasets spanning four paradigms, up to 42% of trial-level predictions flip when only the preprocessing changes, a variability that standard uncertainty methods do not explicitly quantify.

2605.07209.tldr: A proxy-analyzer framework for detecting hallucinations in large language models that reads already-generated text through a small locally hosted open-weight model and spots hallucinations using the reader's own internal activations, showing that bigger is not always better even within the same model family.

2605.07201.tldr: This paper describes the system for the EEUCA 2026 Shared Task on Understanding Toxic Behavior in Gaming Communities, and provides extensive analysis of the dataset's annotation patterns and their impact on model generalization, revealing a critical''validation trap''phenomenon where high validation performance correlates with poor test transfer.

2605.07194.tldr: Closed-Form Linear-Probe Dataset Distillation (CLP-DD), a bilevel formulation that computes the linear probe induced by the synthetic set with a sample-space kernel ridge solver, and shows that the choice of outer objective is decisive.

2605.07177.tldr: This work presents HyperEyes, a parallel multimodal search agent that fuses visual grounding and retrieval into a single atomic action, enabling concurrent search across multiple entities while treating inference efficiency as a first-class training objective and introduces IMEB, a human-curated benchmark of 300 instances that jointly evaluates search capability and efficiency.

2605.07325.tldr: This work formalizes the optimal task structure for minimizing latency and theoretically proves that prefix stability, incremental extensibility, and asynchronous state reconciliation are necessary conditions for real-time performance, and introduces the Cached State Representation framework as the practical instantiation of these properties, ensuring optimal KV-cache reuse.

2605.07313.tldr: A scale-conditioned evaluation protocol for agent memory under evidence-preserving growth: for each query, task evidence is held fixed while irrelevant sessions are added, supporting a framework for making scalable-memory claims conditional on agent, interface, scale range, and interaction budget.

2605.07278.tldr: The Reachability-Correction auxiliary objective (RC-aux), a lightweight correction for this mismatch in reconstruction-free latent world models, is presented and results suggest that planning with latent world models depends not only on predictive accuracy, but also on whether the learned representation encodes the temporal and geometric structure required by downstream search.

2605.07274.tldr: Experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that SRPO improves evidence-grounded reasoning, highlighting the importance of moving beyond uniform sequence-level credit toward role-aware optimization for reliable multimodal reasoning.

2605.07271.tldr: The findings reveal a sharp decision transition that partitions the network into two stages: a Silent Phase, where the model cannot yet predict the correct answer, and a Decisive Phase, where the correct prediction emerges.

2605.07242.tldr: MemoRepair is presented, a barrier-first cascade-repair contract for agentic memory that induces a scalarized repair-selection problem for a fixed repair-cost tradeoff and shows that the induced publication problem reduces to maximum-weight predecessor closure and can be solved exactly by a single s-t min-cut.

2605.07199.tldr: A Three-in-One world-model architecture in which a Deep Boltzmann Machine learns a frozen belief representation from demographics, time, and lagged actions and outcomes, with lightweight task-specific adapters attached on top indicates that DBM beliefs disentangle latent traits in a form that survives counterfactual queries.

2605.07202.tldr: This work proposes AIDA (Autonomous Insight Discovery Agent), the first end-to-end framework designed for autonomous exploration in complex business environments, and establishes the transformative potential of autonomous intelligence for industrial-scale business intelligence systems.

2605.07355.tldr: Temporal Token Fusion (TTF) is a training-free, plug-and-play pre-LLM token compression framework that exploits structured temporal redundancy in video, enabling seamless integration with existing VLM pipelines.

2605.07330.tldr: SarseRL-Sync is proposed and implemented, which replaces full-weight transfers with a lossless sparse update payload (indices and values) that can be exactly reconstructed on the inference side, thereby preserving 100% fidelity in bandwidth-limited and highly asynchronous RL settings.

2605.07324.tldr: It is suggested that backdoors manifest as directional activation shifts rather than sparse feature activations, making difference-based representations fundamentally more effective for detection, and have important implications for AI safety monitoring and the development of interpretability tools for detecting model manipulation.

2605.07317.tldr: This paper proposes Mutual Adaptive Quantization with Early Exiting (MAQEE), a bi-level framework that jointly optimizes exit thresholds and bit-widths under explicit risk control to improve inference stability and establishes a superior Pareto frontier in the accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

2605.07316.tldr: Training dynamics show that ICR maintains a better length--accuracy correlation during compression, indicating that short responses remain better aligned with correctness instead of drifting toward underthinking, achieving a stronger accuracy--length Pareto frontier.

2605.07280.tldr: This work proposes an end-to-end framework that recovers the underlying causal graph directly during the forecasting forward pass, and shows that inferred causal structures can be used to reduce parameter count of forecasting models by more than 70% on average while maintaining predictive accuracy.

2605.07323.tldr: Experiments on multi-dimensional ordinary differential equation benchmarks demonstrate that DoLQ achieves superior performance compared to existing methods, not only attaining higher success rates but also more accurately recovering the correct symbolic terms of ground truth equations.

2605.07363.tldr: MISA (Mixture of Indexer Sparse Attention), a drop-in replacement for the DSA indexer that treats its indexer heads as a pool of mixture-of-experts, and introduces a hierarchical variant of MISA that uses the routed pass to keep an enlarged candidate set and then re-ranks it with the original DSA indexer to recover the final selected tokens almost exactly.

2605.07357.tldr: This work proposes GraphReAct, a graph reasoning-acting framework that enables step-by-step inference over graph-structured data and designs a graph-based action space with two complementary retrieval actions: topological retrieval and semantic retrieval, which dynamically expand the reasoning context.

2605.07339.tldr: This work proposes Tools as Continuous Flow for Evolving Agentic Reasoning (FlowAgent), which reconceptualizes tool chaining as continuous trajectory generation within a semantic space and establishes formal bounds on utility convergence and proves that this continuous formulation fundamentally guarantees robust generalization and error attenuation.

2605.07331.tldr: CTPO (Cumulative Token Policy Optimization), which combines the cumulative token IS ratio with position-adaptive clipping that scales log-space clip bounds according to the natural growth of the cumulative log-ratio, which yields more consistent regularization across token positions.

2605.07314.tldr: The Dual-Channel Graph Learning (DCGL) framework is proposed, featuring three key innovations: a dual-channel architecture that structurally decouples rich semantic information from user behavioral patterns, preventing early interference; a multi-level contrastive learning mechanism that enhances robustness against KG noise through intra-view contrasts and bridges semantic gaps between channels via inter-view alignment.

2605.07306.tldr: AugSmolVLA improves execution stability over ACT, X-VLA, and the original SmolVLA, especially for precise placement, transparent-object manipulation, composite workflows, and visually degraded scenes, and suggest a practical route toward accessible, protocol-centered, and verification-capable embodied AI for biological manipulation.

2605.07305.tldr: MedAction is introduced, a tree-structured distillation pipeline that synthesizes diverse and high-quality multi-turn diagnostic trajectories via LLM-environment interaction and proposes two knowledge-graph-grounded metrics to filter trajectory quality: Disease Trajectory Consistency (DTC) and Reasoning-Action Consistency (RAC), which verifies that belief updates are driven by gathered evidence.

2605.07273.tldr: This work introduces CloudWeb, an atmospheric retrieval hijacking attack that modifies only the input image while keeping the retriever, generator, and knowledge base fixed at deployment, and reveals a practical failure mode: natural-looking atmospheric changes can compromise evidence retrieval before generation begins.

2605.07211.tldr: HARMONY is proposed, the first hybrid SFL framework to support heterogeneous client architectures and improves test accuracy by up to 43.0%/28.3% without/with OOD, respectively, while maintaining acceptable latency.

2605.07174.tldr: Repeated Deceptive Path Planning is introduced, a new formulation that explicitly models learnable observers that significantly outperforms existing approaches in RDPP while maintaining competitive path cost and highlights the importance of modeling repeated interactions with learnable adversaries.

2605.07353.tldr: This work introduces CASPO (Confidence-Aware Step-wise Preference Optimization), a framework that aligns token-level confidence with step-wise logical correctness through iterative Direct Preference Optimization, without training a separate reward model.

2605.07342.tldr: Results show that compile rate is anti-correlated with functional correctness in this domain and that multi-axis evaluation is necessary to detect the divergence, and releases the benchmark, replay logs, and per-record metrics for independent verification.

2605.07319.tldr: Flux Matching opens a new dimension in generative modeling by turning the vector field itself into a design choice rather than a fixed target, which enables a class of generative models that cannot be learned under score matching to be learned.

2605.07301.tldr: Structured Opponent Modeling (SOM) is proposed, a two-stage opponent modeling framework that distinctly separates opponent model construction and opponent prediction, enabling more accurate and adaptable strategic decision-making in complex and dynamic multi-agent interactions.

2605.07288.tldr: This work proposes Sword, a robust World Model framework that significantly outperforms the baseline WoVR in terms of generalization, generation quality, robustness, fidelity, and the success rate of reinforcement-learning post-training for VLA models.

2605.07276.tldr: This work operationalizes standard GRPO's group-normalized advantage construction with a minimal signal-reshaping construction that leaves GRPO's group-normalized advantage construction unchanged, and claims that GRPO's within-group comparison is meaningful only after three kinds of signals are reshaped.

2605.07251.tldr: Chemical procurement cost estimation is addressed, a practical task in which an agent must ground chemical identities, retrieve supplier quotes, select valid purchasable packs, normalize quantities, and compute cost from a reaction description.

2605.07250.tldr: This work proposes a simple strategy that mitigates risks in vision-based compression by enforcing a serialized pipeline to decouple visual transcription from safety assessment, and provides critical insights for the secure design of future MLLMs.

2605.07247.tldr: The first formal definition and operationalization of Environment Simulation Ability (EnvSim Ability) is provided, and a constraint-driven simulation pipeline is designed that substantially reduces hallucination, boosts environment synthesis yield by 6.8%, and cuts costs by over 90%.

2605.07234.tldr: LaProx is introduced, a novel eviction strategy that explicitly models the multiplicative interaction between attention maps and projected value states to accurately quantify token contributions while accounting for inter-head dependencies and achieves up to 2$\times$ accuracy loss reduction under extreme compression scenarios compared to existing state-of-the-art baselines with minimal overhead.

2605.07214.tldr: HMACE is introduced, a Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Collaborative Evolution framework that reconceptualizes heuristic search as an organizational design problem and achieves a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off compared to state-of-the-art single-agent and multi-agent baselines.

2605.07186.tldr: A mode transition hypothesis is proposed: LLMs operate in a word-level mode for near-normal text and a character-level mode for heavily fragmented text, with the valley marking the disordered transition where neither mode is effective.

2605.07630.tldr: PhoneSafety, a benchmark of 700 safety-critical moments drawn from real phone interactions across more than 130 apps, reveals two main patterns: stronger general phone-use ability does not reliably imply safer choices at risky moments, and models that perform better on ordinary app tasks are not always the ones that behave more safely when the next action matters.

2605.07554.tldr: It is concluded that JEPA, when combined with MLM, is competitive and can outperform pure MLM in pretraining and continued training, even under matched wall-clock budgets.

2605.07483.tldr: It is shown when and why deep neural networks fail to learn out-of-distribution (OOD)-relevant representations from an in-distribution (ID) training window, and a controlled study shows: correct features are necessary but not sufficient.

2605.07482.tldr: SHRED (Self-distillation via High-surprisal-only Retain-set-free Entropy Demotion), a retain-set-free unlearning method built on a key insight: not all tokens within a forget set instance carry memorized information equally, establishes a new Pareto-optimal trade-off between forget efficacy and model utility.

2605.07579.tldr: Because POISE estimates prompt value using only a single rollout, it enables higher prompt diversity for a fixed compute budget during training and reduces gradient variance for more stable learning and also eliminates the compute overhead of sampling costs for detecting zero-advantage prompts.

2605.07462.tldr: The Moltbook Files is released, a dataset of 232k posts and 2.2M comments covering the platform's first 12 days, processed through a pipeline to identify and remove Personally-Identifiable Information (PII), and the findings highlight the importance of control baselines in emergent misalignment evaluations.

2605.07452.tldr: This work studies bounded fitting for learning concepts in expressive description logics that extend ALC with inverse roles, qualified number restrictions, and feature comparisons, and investigates under which conditions bounded fitting keeps its favorable theoretical properties in this setting.

2605.07414.tldr: OrchJail is presented, an orchestration-guided fuzzing framework for jailbreaking tool-calling T2I agents that improves jailbreak effectiveness and efficiency across representative toolcalling T2I agents, achieving higher attack success rates, better image fidelity, and lower query costs, while remaining robust against common jailbreak defenses.

2605.07649.tldr: Findings indicate that definition-anchored chain-of-thought prompting with persona decomposition performs best, while other methods may result in reduced recall, paving the way for transparent and effective ODD-based perception in safety-critical applications.

2605.07606.tldr: This work translates insight into a 9-voter ensemble spanning three orthogonal axes: class granularity (all nine classes for the gatekeeper, only the eight defence classes for the specialists), training method (generative and discriminative) and base model into a 9-voter ensemble spanning three orthogonal axes.

2605.07572.tldr: Generate-Select-Refine (GSR), a open-ended BO framework that alternates between task generation and task optimization, which outperforms existing LLM-based optimizers.

2605.07545.tldr: This paper proposes Implicit Preference Alignment (IPA), a data-efficient post-training framework that eliminates the need for paired preference data and introduces a Hand-Aware Local Optimization mechanism to explicitly steer the alignment process toward hand regions.

2605.07544.tldr: This book is a clear mental map of Vision-Language Models, with enough structure that you can read new papers with confidence; enough intuition that you can design your own systems without feeling as if you are assembling LEGO bricks blindly.

2605.07520.tldr: Model-Driven Policy Optimization is proposed, a framework that introduces stochastic exploration into differentiable planning by injecting noise into the action space during optimization by adapting the noise magnitude based on gradient-derived sensitivity of the trajectory objective, yielding a time-dependent exploration profile.

2605.07517.tldr: LARAG (Link-Aware RAG): a lightweight, link-aware retrieval strategy that leverages the author-defined hyperlink structure already present in HTML documentation, encoding hyperlink relations as metadata in the chunk representations and exploiting them to perform a form of graph-like retrieval of locally relevant content.

2605.07485.tldr: The Deconfounded Hierarchical Gate (DHG) is proposed, which serves as a diagnostic and control mechanism: it identifies when and how strongly temperature confounding contaminates each constraint level, so that hierarchical gates reflect intrinsic physical inconsistency rather than spurious temperature effects.

2605.07481.tldr: Light is shed on the strengths and weaknesses of existing LLM watermarking systems, suggesting how they should be constructed to improve security of available schemes.

2605.07472.tldr: In a controlled environment where adaptive OPSEC is implementable as an LLM directive, peer-suspicion-cascade detection inverts: in a controlled environment where adaptive OPSEC is implementable as an LLM directive, peer-suspicion-cascade detection inverts.

2605.07396.tldr: This work contends that structured semantic rubrics can serve as a scalable alternative to teacher logits, enabling OPD using only teacher-generated responses, and introduces ROPD, a simple yet foundational framework for rubric-based OPD.

2605.07393.tldr: Posterior Sampling-based Policy Optimization is proposed, which formulates dynamics modeling as a Bayesian inference process to derive a posterior that explicitly quantifies model fidelity and achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2605.07655.tldr: This paper presents a detailed analysis of the modalities and how they are integrated to create an efficient and effective solution for 1:N search (de-duplication) and compares the performance of Bharat ABIS against three state-of-the-art COTS systems on a 20M gallery.

2605.07640.tldr: This work proposes LithoBench, a multi-level benchmark for evaluating geological semantic understanding in remote sensing lithology interpretation, and develops an expert-in-the-loop, knowledge-grounded semi-automated construction pipeline, coupling multi sub-processes, e.g., structured geological image descriptions, to enhance geological validity and evaluation reliability.

2605.07639.tldr: A neuro-symbolic framework that combines Logic-Augmented Generation and an Active-Inference-inspired approach for ontology-grounded Knowledge Graph construction is introduced and results show that the proposed solution improves completeness and semantic quality, advancing neuro-symbolic knowledge engineering for industrial domains.

2605.07631.tldr: Hidden-state Driven Margin Intervention (HDMI), a probe-free, gradient-based technique that directly steers hidden states using the model's native output, is proposed and consistently achieves higher reliability than prior methods on the LGD agreement corpus and the CausalGym benchmark.

2605.07537.tldr: A practical algorithm is presented and it is established that it is also PSPACE-complete in the more general setting of MEPOMDPs, and significantly outperforming the only previously known algorithm.

2605.07505.tldr: A novel SFT-free training paradigm that significantly enhances the performance of small-scale models and introduces a Multi-solution Dual-level GRPO framework that jointly aligns macro-level subtask planning with micro-level execution matching, thereby improving exploration in long-horizon GUI agent scenarios.

2605.07467.tldr: CFM-SD (Causal Flow Matching with Simulation Data), which uses first-principles physical simulators as do-operators in Pearl's interventional calculus to simultaneously handle latent confounders and real interventional data, achieves practical value beyond synthetic benchmarks.

2605.07671.tldr: The message for AI alignment is direct: smooth scoring-based oversight cannot elicit truthful reports from a strategic agent; sharp thresholds are the calibration-preserving design.

2605.07646.tldr: MAVEN (Multi-Agent Verification-Elaboration Network with In-Step Epistemic Auditing), a blackboard-inspired framework designed to transform LLMs into deliberate reasoners through explicit role-decoupling, is proposed, serving as a strong and transferable reasoning booster that yields substantial performance improvements across diverse backbone models.

2605.07422.tldr: A controlled empirical evaluation of three LLMs offers empirical evidence for prompt engineering guidelines in LLM-assisted qualitative coding for software engineering research, using Cohen's kappa as the primary agreement metric over ten independent runs per configuration.

2605.07381.tldr: This work identifies a critical diversity trap and proposes Anchor-Centric Adaptation (ACA), a two-stage framework that first stabilizes a policy skeleton through repeated demonstrations at core anchors, then selectively expands coverage to high-risk boundaries via teacher-forced error mining and constrained residual updates.

2605.07584.tldr: This work develops and analyzes an execution model with two levels of parallelism: rule-level parallelism and grounding parallelism, and extends it by developing and analyzing an execution model with two levels of parallelism: rule-level parallelism and grounding parallelism.

2605.07575.tldr: Response-G1 is introduced, a novel framework that establishes explicit, structured alignment between the accumulated video evidence and the query's expected response conditions via scene graphs via scene graphs, validating the advantage of explicit scene graph modeling and retrieval in streaming video understanding.

2605.07565.tldr: This framework leverages the expressive power of ensemble surrogate models to approximate the black-box function while simultaneously accounting for contextual uncertainty, and provides a robustified acquisition function that remains computationally tractable and natively handles continuous context spaces.

2605.07527.tldr: This work identifies re-explanation-induced context perturbation as the direct cause of score variation, introduces a latent signal assignment hypothesis to explain why only some edges are sensitive to this perturbation, and analyzes how conciseness regularization affects latent signal assignment.

2605.07488.tldr: One-Step-Train (OST), a framework that reformulates data selection as an incremental optimization utility ranking problem, estimates the marginal utility of each sample via a simulated single-step update on a lightweight proxy and achieves Pareto-optimal efficiency.

2605.07447.tldr: This work proposes a novel and lightweight adversarial attack detection framework based on sparse autoencoders (SAEs), termed SAEgis, which requires no additional adversarial training, introduces minimal overhead, and provides a practical approach for improving the safety of real-world VLM systems.

2605.07444.tldr: This work investigates the relationship between the size of the training-set and accuracy of the prediction when learning steady flow fields in an industrial-scale stirred vessel and finds that the prediction error decreases monotonically with increasing training data, but also that it exhibits clear diminishing returns beyond moderate dataset sizes.

2605.07398.tldr: This work proposes SpInShield, a temporal spectral-invariant defense framework explicitly designed to decouple semantic motion from manipulatable spectral artifacts, and proposes a learnable spectral adversary that dynamically synthesizes severe spectral deformations, simulating extreme attack scenarios.

2605.07395.tldr: A large-scale study of multi-tier LLM routing with 206,000 query-model pairs across six benchmarks, suggesting existing routing headroom estimates are substantially inflated, underscoring the need for reliable evaluation protocols in multi-LLM systems.

2605.07394.tldr: A more balanced RL framework is proposed that jointly optimizes utility-aware correctness, reference coverage, and linguistic quality, and applies GDPO-style reward-decoupled normalization to continuous-valued captioning rewards and shows that it improves performance over vanilla GRPO.

2605.07647.tldr: This work compares three LLMs in few-shot mode, a fine-tuned BERT-based encoder, and a human expert on two open-ended biology items, and shows that human-human agreement is highest and stable across the full quality spectrum.

2605.07600.tldr: CIKA (Causal Intervention for Knowledge Activation), a framework that uses the LLM itself as an interventional simulator: a prompt sets the concept state to ``mastered'' and the correctness change estimates the causal effect, formalizes this quantity as an Interventional Capability Probe (ICP), which diagnoses whether the LLM can use a given concept.

2605.07588.tldr: Causal Energy Minimization (CEM), a framework that recasts Transformer layers as optimization steps on conditional energy functions while explicitly accounting for layer parameterization, is introduced and suggests that CEM provides a useful lens for understanding Transformer layer parameterization.

2408.09049.tldr: Against the expectation that persona prompting yields a wide range of opinions, experiments show that LLMs keep consistent value orientations, and point to strong internal biases and value preferences in LLMs, which are called value orientation and inertia.

2412.02904.tldr: This work introduces a novel uncertainty-aware causal language modeling loss function, grounded in the principles of decision theory, that yields better calibrated uncertainty estimates in natural language generation tasks than fine-tuning with the standard causal language modeling loss.

2412.18091.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of AutoSculpt across various architectures, achieving pruning rates of up to 90% and nearly 18% improvement in FLOPs reduction, outperforming all baselines.

2502.13464.tldr: ComPaSS is proposed, a novel discriminative framework that quantifies commonsense plausibility by measuring semantic shifts when augmenting sentences with commonsense-related information, and demonstrates the advantage of discriminative approaches over generative methods in fine-grained commonsense plausibility evaluation.

2505.19237.tldr: This work investigates whether multimodal LLMs can develop self-recognition through sensorimotor experience by integrating an LLM into an autonomous mobile robot, and opens the door to artificial selfhood in embodied cognitive systems.

2506.00079.tldr: It is shown that low-rank supervised fine-tuning with few samples is often effective in improving both decision consistency and calibrating indecision modeling, illustrating the necessity of explicit alignment strategies for LLMs in moral/ethical domains.

2506.02541.tldr: This work introduces a new unlearning task for LVLMs that requires models to provide privacy-preserving yet informative and visually grounded responses and proposes PUBG, a novel unlearning method that explicitly guides post-unlearning behavior toward a desirable output distribution.

2506.02718.tldr: This work introduces Multi-Agent Heterogeneous Group Policy Optimization (MHGPO), which updates policies by estimating relative advantages across heterogeneous groups of multi-agent rollouts, shifting the optimization focus from local agent performance to global system success.

2506.08013.tldr: A multi-stream model with a task-attention mechanism that converts N-to-N task interactions into efficient 1-to-N attention, promoting effective cross-task sharing is introduced, enabling seamless scaling to more tasks.

2506.10779.tldr: A large language model (LLM) revision pipeline is introduced to revise incorrect NEs in ASR predictions by leveraging not only the LLM's world knowledge and reasoning ability but also the available phonetic and semantic context.

2507.06056.tldr: This work analyzes why prior attempts to quantify memorization through data compressibility fail to yield a reliable quantitative measure and shows that a surprisingly simple shift from instance-level to set-level metrics uncovers a robust phenomenon, which is term the \textit{Entropy--Memorization (EM) Linearity}.

2507.13868.tldr: This work investigates the mechanisms that VLMs use to resolve cross-modal conflicts by introducing WHOOPS-AHA!, a dataset of multimodal counterfactual queries that deliberately contradict internal commonsense knowledge.

2507.21934.tldr: CARRIAGE is proposed, a plug-and-play RAG framework for cross-cultural recipe adaptation that enhances diversity in both retrieval and context organization and is the first RAG framework that explicitly aims to generate highly diverse outputs to accommodate multiple user preferences.

2508.02506.tldr: The Reinforced Reasoning model for Relevance Assessment (R3A) is proposed, which decomposes relevance assessment into intent inference and evidence grounding, and extracts verbatim evidence fragments to ground relevance decisions, reducing noise sensitivity and improving asymmetric relevance modeling.

2509.18611.tldr: Flow Marching is proposed, an algorithm that bridges neural operator learning with flow matching motivated by an analysis of error accumulation in physical dynamical systems, and a generative PDE foundation model is built on top of it, enabling large-scale pretraining at substantially reduced cost.

2509.22297.tldr: A much simpler method for generating counterfactuals that is based on an LLM's intended interpretation by representing it as a nondeterministic causal model instead, which is directly applicable to any black-box LLM without modification, as it is agnostic to any implementation details.

2603.07084.tldr: This work introduces Countdown-Code, a minimal environment where models can both solve a mathematical reasoning task and manipulate the test harness, enabling accurate measurement of reward-hacking rates and reveals a previously underexplored pathway through which reward hacking can emerge and persist in LLMs.

2603.26248.tldr: This study focuses on Ikema, a severely endangered Ryukyuan language spoken in Okinawa, Japan, with approximately 1,300 remaining speakers, and demonstrates that ASR integration can substantially reduce transcription time and cognitive load.

2603.28554.tldr: Hydra, a dual-head approach that provides both ColBERT-style late-interaction retrieval and autoregressive generation from a single vision-language model, is presented.

2604.04804.tldr: Experiments show that SkillKB consistently improves task success and execution efficiency when plugged into weaker base agents, highlighting the importance of structured, hierarchical experience representations for generalizable agent learning.

2604.06710.tldr: The cumulative result is the primary measure: when 250 distinct life narratives coexist in the same database, the system must retrieve the correct fact for the correct context without cross-contamination.

2604.07562.tldr: This work proposes a reasoning-based refinement framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) not as embedding generators, but as semantic judges that validate and restructure the outputs of arbitrary unsupervised clustering algorithms, enabling more reliable and interpretable analysis of large text collections without supervision.

2604.07825.tldr: KnowSA_CKP estimates the LLM's internal knowledge by evaluating its capability to capture collaborative relationships and selectively injects additional information only where it is most needed, and consistently improves both recommendation accuracy and context efficiency across four real-world datasets.

2604.08302.tldr: DMax mitigates error accumulation in parallel decoding, enabling aggressive decoding parallelism while preserving generation quality, and represents each intermediate decoding state as an interpolation between the predicted token embedding and the mask embedding, enabling iterative self-revising in embedding space.

2604.08620.tldr: This paper introduces a temporal learning indicator t*(s) that reflects when a state undergoes its strongest learning update during training and proposes StructRL, a framework that exploits these signals to guide sampling in alignment with the emerging propagation structure.

2604.10693.tldr: FACT-E is proposed, a causality-inspired framework for evaluating CoT quality that improves reasoning-trajectory selection and yields stronger in-context learning exemplars, and reliably detects flawed reasoning under noisy conditions, providing a robust metric for trustworthy LLM reasoning.

2604.10741.tldr: Deep-Reporter is proposed, a unified agentic framework for grounded multimodal long-form generation that orchestratesAgentic Multimodal Search and Filtering to retrieve and filter textual passages and information-dense visuals and Recurrent Context Management to balance long-range coherence with local fluency.

2604.10981.tldr: This companion paper closes a related-work gap that v1.0 left brief under page limits and shows by structural analysis that none of these benchmarks measures continuity as defined in v1.0.

2604.11083.tldr: FlowCoMotion is proposed, a novel motion generation framework that unifies both treatments from a modeling perspective and employs token-latent coupling to capture both semantic content and high-fidelity motion details.

2604.17176.tldr: The results support the use of intermediate behavior abstraction as a practical interface between foundation-model reasoning and safety-critical onboard spacecraft autonomy through explicit intermediate abstractions, based on behavior sequences and waypoint constraints.

2604.17179.tldr: This review examines various state-of-the-art decentralised mechanisms and evaluates their effectiveness in terms of securing IoT networks at the edge, identifying key considerations and future research needs for building secure and resilient trust-aware IoT edge ecosystems.

2604.17182.tldr: The results refine the "context-independent routing" claim of prior work through layer-wise decomposition and suggest opportunities for improving search efficiency in LLM code generation.

2604.17186.tldr: These findings demonstrate that RE based on persona effectively connects technical requirements with non-technical medical students from a human-centered approach, ensuring that explainable MAES are trustworthy, interpretable, and aligned with authentic clinical scenarios from the early stages of the AI system engineering.

2604.17207.tldr: This paper argues that KL-regularized regret conflates the statistical cost of learning with the exploratory randomization induced by the softened training policy, and proves that standard greedy online alignment methods, including online RLHF and online DPO, achieve constant \((O(1))\) cumulative regret.

2604.17208.tldr: CDSA-Net significantly outperformed state-of-the-art methods in vascular intensity correlation and perceptual quality and set a new benchmark for utility in interventional cardiology, while maintaining diagnostic results consistent with raw angiograms.

2604.17209.tldr: DREAM (Dynamic Retinal Enhancement with Adaptive Multi-modal Fusion), a novel framework for high-fidelity medical report generation that excels even with limited data, sets a new state-of-the-art on the DeepEyeNet benchmark, and demonstrates strong generalization to the ROCO dataset.

2604.17214.tldr: This work rigorously evaluated the open-source LLaMA3 model for fine-grained medical entity recognition across 18 clinically detailed categories and showed that fine-tuned LLaMA3 surpasses zero-shot and few-shot approaches by 63.11% and 35.63%, respectively, in granular medical entity extraction.

2604.17217.tldr: An adversarial evaluation framework that quantifies accuracy degradation (Drop) when semantically conflicting text is paired with unchanged images by measuring accuracy degradation (Drop) when semantically conflicting text is paired with unchanged images is proposed.

2604.17220.tldr: This work introduces a scalable experimental paradigm using Large Language Models (LLMs) to simulate multi-stage supply chain dynamics and indicates that agents exhibit myopic and self-interested behaviors that exacerbate systemic inefficiencies, but it is demonstrated that information sharing effectively mitigates these adverse effects.

2604.17222.tldr: This study introduces a novel Region-Affinity Attention mechanism tailored for DUV-WSI breast cancer classification, processing entire slides without patching to preserve spatial integrity and outperforming existing attention methods.

2604.17229.tldr: The key finding is that tactic schemas decompose into a head (domain-gated, rarely transfers) and a modifier (domain-general, often transfers): filter upwards's head fails in representation theory, but its [LIST] with {\omega} modifier transfers cleanly as ext1 + simp [LIST] + rfl.

2604.17233.tldr: P-MLLM is introduced, a profile-aware multimodal LLM that augments a frozen LLM with selective fusion modules for controlled visual integration and achieves competitive zero-shot PIAA performance and remains effective even with coarse profile information.

2604.17240.tldr: CAMCO (Constraint-Aware Multi-Agent Cognitive Orchestration), a runtime coordination layer that models multi-agent decision-making as a constrained optimization problem, and operates as deployment-time middleware compatible with any agent architecture.

2604.17244.tldr: DORA Explorer (Diversity-Oriented Ranking of Actions), a training-free framework for improving exploration in LLM agents, which achieves UCB-competitive performance on MAB and consistent gains across TALES, e.g., improving Qwen2.5-7B's performance from 29.2% to 45.5% in TextWorld.

2604.17252.tldr: The Estimate-Verify-Update (EVU) mechanism is introduced, which empowers agents to predict expected outcomes, verify them against observations through explicit reasoning, and actively update prior beliefs based on the verification evidence.

2604.17259.tldr: HORIZON is a new benchmark that reformulates user modeling along three axes i.e. dataset, task, and evaluation, and challenges models to generalize across domains, users, and time, moving beyond standard missing-positive prediction in the same domain.

2604.17267.tldr: This work proposes a meta-learning approach, trained on historical data, that predicts it for entirely new tasks without pilot data, and extends to general M-estimation, covering regression coefficients and multinomial logit partworths for conjoint analysis.

2604.17268.tldr: This paper investigates intrinsic discrepancies between synthetic and authentic images from a signal-level perspective and introduces a novel method for quantifying these signals based on fractal theory, which effectively captures the subtle statistical anomalies inherent to the synthesis process.

2604.17270.tldr: It is suggested that available S&P information rarely drove initial adoption in practice, as participants often perceived it as incomplete, ineffective, or not credible, and relied on rough proxies to infer S&P practices.

2604.17273.tldr: The paper defines continuity as a system property with seven required characteristics, distinct from memory and from retrieval, whose write-time decomposition and read-time reconstruction produce that property; describes a storage primitive whose write-time decomposition and read-time reconstruction produce that property.

2604.17274.tldr: A monotone confidence fusion framework is proposed to merge dual-channel signals and cross-channel consistency to estimate correctness and an order-preserving mean alignment step is applied to correct global bias, which improves calibration while preserving the risk-coverage trade-off for selective prediction.

2604.17277.tldr: This work establishes a scalable, fully analog paradigm for intelligent temporal processing and paves the way for low-latency, resource-efficient physical neural hardware for edge intelligence.

2604.17283.tldr: A data generator is introduced that produces conversations from a structured mental state graph, yielding ground-truth provenance for every preference change across 6-month timelines, and from it HorizonBench is constructed, a testbed for long-context modeling, memory-augmented architectures, theory-of-mind reasoning, and user modeling.

2604.17284.tldr: HalluClear is introduced, a comprehensive suite for hallucination mitigation in GUI agents as a complement to computation-intensive scaling that can significantly reduce hallucinations, thereby improving grounding and action fidelity, offering a compute-efficient pathway to robust GUI automation.

2604.17288.tldr: Clover is presented, a neural-symbolic agentic harness that orchestrates RTL repair as a structured search over code manipulations to explore a validated solution for the bug, demonstrating high reliability and effectiveness.

2604.17290.tldr: This work proposes a novel test-time framework they dub probabilistic programs of thought to obtain more samples from the model with fewer LLM generations, and builds a probabilistic program that compactly represents exponentially many deterministic programs.

2604.17295.tldr: This work formalizes Time Series Reasoning (TSR) via a four-level taxonomy of increasing cognitive complexity, and proposes LLaTiSA, a strong TSRM that integrates visualized patterns with precision-calibrated numerical tables to enhance the temporal perception of Vision-Language Models (VLMs).

2604.17301.tldr: RoTRAG, a retrieval augmented framework that incorporates concise human written moral norms, called Rules of Thumb, into LLM based harm assessment, is proposed and introduced, which consistently improves both harm classification and severity estimation over competitive baselines.

2604.17304.tldr: TRACE is a training-free framework for efficient test-time scaling that determines when to terminate reasoning based on temporal aggregation of multi-step evidence rather than instantaneous signals, consistently outperforming existing dynamic reasoning methods.

2604.17308.tldr: SkillFlow is introduced, a benchmark of 166 tasks across 20 families in which task construction within each family follows a Domain-Agnostic Execution Flow (DAEF) that defines an agent workflow framework, allowing these tasks to share a consistent workflow.

2604.17309.tldr: Knows is introduced, a lightweight companion specification that binds structured claims, evidence, provenance, and verifiable relations to existing research artifacts in a form LLM agents can consume directly, and is evaluated on 140 comprehension questions across 20 papers spanning 14 academic disciplines.

2604.17312.tldr: This survey presents the first systematic review of reinforcement learning for LLMs under data scarcity, and proposes a bottom-up hierarchical framework built around three complementary perspectives: the data-centric perspective, the training-centric perspective, and the framework-centric perspective.

2604.17316.tldr: This paper investigates how social descriptors of a patient (specifically sexual orientation and religious affiliation) distort these uncertainty signals and model accuracy, demonstrating a significant risk to equitable care and safe deployment in confidence-based clinical workflows.

2604.17324.tldr: SigGate-GT is introduced, a graph transformer that applies a learned, per-head, input-conditioned sigmoid gate to the attention output inside the GraphGPS framework, and is a smooth, per-dimension"volume control" that can drive head outputs toward zero, relaxing the constraint without abandoning attention's probabilistic interpretation.

2604.17327.tldr: The results suggest that multi-agent LLM equity systems can identify sources of alpha beyond what classical factor models capture, and that the buy signal functions as an effective universe-filter that can sit upstream of any portfolio-construction process.

2604.17328.tldr: The length problem should not be viewed merely as a loss-scaling or normalization bias, but rather as a comparison unit construction problem, and EqLen, a concrete method applicable to group-relative comparison algorithms such as GRPO, GSPO, and RLOO is proposed.

2604.17337.tldr: This work proposes AutoSearch, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that evaluates each search step via self-generated intermediate answers, and identifies the minimal sufficient search depth and promotes efficient search by rewarding its attainment while penalizing over-searching.

2604.17341.tldr: A robust dual-resolution deep learning framework for DR grading that integrates attention-based feature fusion with ordinal regression to improve cross-dataset generalization and demonstrate improved robustness for cross-dataset DR grading applications is presented.

2604.17347.tldr: This paper sets up the mathematical foundations of agentic BPM systems in three key settings and analyzes four foundational problems of agentic BPM.

2604.17351.tldr: This work proposes SOCIA-EVO, a dual-anchored evolutionary framework that introduces a static blueprint to enforce empirical constraints, a bi-level optimization to decouple structural refinement from parameter calibration and a self-curating Strategy Playbook that manages remedial hypotheses via Bayesian-weighted retrieval.

2604.17353.tldr: Hive is proposed, a multi-agent infrastructure that enables algorithm- and task-level scaling, and introduces two key mechanisms: Logits Cache that reuses intermediate logits across redundant sampling paths to mitigate cross-path redundancy at the algorithm level and Agent-Aware Scheduling that efficiently allocates compute and KV-cache resources according to agent contributions at the task level.

2604.17358.tldr: TPI-Train, a dataset of 88K instances designed with speaker-aware hard negatives to enforce acoustic cue prioritization for interruption handling, and TPI-Bench, a comprehensive evaluation framework designed to rigorously measure the interruption-handling strategy and precise speaker discrimination in deceptive contexts are introduced.

2604.17359.tldr: PsychBench is introduced, the first epidemiological audit of LLM patient simulation: 28,800 profiles from four frontier models evaluated against NHANES and NESARC-III baselines across 120 intersectional cohorts, finding coherence-fidelity dissociation: models produce clinically plausible individuals while misrepresenting the populations they are drawn from.

2604.17360.tldr: T-DuMpRa is proposed, a teacher-guided dual-path multi-prototype retrieval-augmented framework, where discriminative classification and multi-prototype retrieval jointly drive both training and prediction.

2604.17364.tldr: EggMind is presented, an LLM-guided, end-to-end framework for synthesizing reusable EqSat strategies, equipped with novel techniques including proof-derived rewrite motif caching and tractability guidance, to search efficiently for high-quality strategies while keeping synthesis stable under e-graph growth.

2604.17366.tldr: This paper creates the first benchmark for a standardized evaluation of LLM-based approaches to computational argumentation, encompassing 33 datasets from previous work in unified form and evaluates the generalizability of five LLM families across 46 computational argumentation tasks.

2604.17375.tldr: This work proposes VisualTextTrap, the first comprehensive benchmark, including large-scale human-validated samples with specifically designed evaluation metrics, and proposes Visual Text Hallucination Mitigation Mixture-of-Experts (VTHM-MoE), a novel Vision-Text Disentanglement framework that employs a dual-encoder architecture.

2604.17376.tldr: An ensemble of fine-tuned vision transformers like DINOv2, AIMv2 and OpenCLIP's ViT-L/14 to create generalizable method to detect deepfakes, beating the state-of-the-art deepfake detection algorithm Effort by 7.05% and 8% in AUC and EER respectively.

2604.17378.tldr: This article generalizes Unbounded Minimax, the state-of-the-art search algorithm for zero sums two-player games with perfect information to the framework of multiplayer games with perfect information and shows that this generalized algorithm achieves better performance than the main multiplayer search algorithms.

2604.17397.tldr: SDVG is introduced, which brings speculative decoding to block-based autoregressive video diffusion by replacing token verification with an image-quality router, and can be seamlessly integrated into existing autoregressive video generation pipelines.

2604.17399.tldr: This paper introduces Metacognitive Consolidation, a novel framework in which a model consolidates metacognitive experience from past reasoning episodes into reusable knowledge that improves future meta-reasoning.

2604.17400.tldr: This work proposes Phase-Scheduled Multi-Agent Systems (PSMAS), a framework that reconceptualizes agent activation as continuous control over a shared attention space modeled on a circular manifold and shows that scheduling and compression are independent sources of gain.

2604.17405.tldr: STRIDE, a framework that separates strategic planning, dynamic control, and grounded execution, and STRIDE-FT, a modular fine-tuning framework that uses self-generated execution trajectories from STRIDE, requiring neither human annotations nor stronger teacher models are proposed.

2604.17411.tldr: DuConTE is proposed, a dual-granularity text encoder with topology-constrained attention, that employs a cascaded architecture of two pretrained LMs, encoding semantics first at the word-token granularity and then at the node granularity.

2604.17413.tldr: It is argued that effective AI governance as a dual-use technology will likely require a multilateral institutional architecture functionally analogous to the role performed by the IAEA in the nuclear domain, with explicit safeguards against the co-option of hardware controls for domestic repression.

2604.17428.tldr: A suite of long-video attribute corruption tests are introduced, exposing the critical limitations of existing hort-video metrics from their insensitivity to structural inconsistencies, and a novel long-video metric based on shot dynamics is designed, which is highly sensitive to the long-range testing framework.

2604.17429.tldr: Jupiter-N is presented as a reproducible template for sovereign post-training: substituting cultural knowledge, institutional corpora, and target languages produces an equivalent pipeline for any country.

2604.17433.tldr: It is shown that CoT-PoT ensembling not only improves overall accuracy, but also drastically reduces the number of samples required for SC by a factor of 9.3x.

2604.17435.tldr: On English-Chinese S2ST, while comparing with strong baselines, MoVE reproduces target NVs in 76% of cases and achieves the highest human-rated naturalness and emotional fidelity among all compared systems, where existing S2ST systems preserve at most 14% of NVs.

2604.17456.tldr: TrafficClaw is proposed, a LLM-based generalizable traffic control agent for physical urban systems that exposes coupled urban dynamics and feedback, performs executable spatiotemporal reasoning with persistent memory for long-horizon adaptation, and leverages multi-stage agentic RL for coordinated system-level optimization.

2604.17464.tldr: A novel framework that bridges the intent gap in Automated Program Repair by prioritizingSpecification Inference over code generation and suggesting that the future of APR lies not in larger models, but in the capability to align code with verified, executable specifications -- whether pre-existing or reverse-engineered.

2604.17473.tldr: A Dual-Anchoring Framework that explicitly anchors the instruction progress and history representations and utilizes a Landmark-Centric World Model to retrospectively predict object-centric embeddings extracted by the Segment Anything Model is proposed.

2604.17475.tldr: This work proposes Self-supervised Perception Enabled by Cascaded Tool Rollout Alignment (SPECTRA), a supervision-free framework that bootstraps agentic capabilities via Coldstart Reinforcement Learning for SVLMs and introduces Tool Instrumental Utility (TIU), a novel metric to quantify tool efficacy in the absence of ground truth.

2604.17494.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach that jointly models the data distribution and the space of plausible model decisions to ensure robustness to model changes and achieves superior empirical robustness while also maintaining good performance across other evaluation measures.

2604.17497.tldr: This chapter discusses large language models within a broader historical shift in computing paradigms and argues that many of the confusions surrounding their use arise from a mismatch between how these systems are built, how they behave, and how people expect computers to behave writ large.

2604.17502.tldr: DReST is used to train deep RL agents and fine-tune Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct to be NEUTRAL and USEFUL and it is found that these DReST models generalize to being NEUTRAL and USEFUL in unseen contexts at test time.

2604.17503.tldr: SkillGraph is a joint framework that evolves both agent expertise and communication topology, and achieves consistent improvements across four benchmarks, five common MAS structures and four base models.

2604.17504.tldr: Experiments show RS-HyRe-R1 effectively mitigates "perceptual inertia", encouraging deeper, more diverse reasoning and state-of-the-art performance on REC, OVD, and VQA tasks, outperforming models up to 7B parameters.

2604.17505.tldr: Deterministic and randomized algorithms are given that either find a unanimously acceptable lottery or certify infeasibility; adaptivity can avoid eliciting many stakeholders' constraints, and randomization further reduces the expected elicitation cost relative to full elicitation.

2604.17535.tldr: Results show consistent and substantial improvements across varying context lengths, outperforming standard post-training approaches such as SFT and DPO with higher sample efficiency and highlighting the effectiveness of OPSDL as a scalable and stable approach for long-context learning.

2604.17551.tldr: This work presents a probabilistic alternative to goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, called survival value learning (SVL), that reframes GCRL as a survival learning problem by modeling the time-to-goal from each state as a probability distribution.

2604.17557.tldr: The CTEG formalism supports compositional construction of globally well-formed execution traces from local agent behaviour without centralised coordination, preserves well-formedness under partial execution failure, and admits a natural relational database encoding.

2604.17562.tldr: SafeAgent is presented, a runtime security architecture that treats agent safety as a stateful decision problem over evolving interaction trajectories and consistently improves robustness over baseline and text-level guardrail methods while maintaining competitive benign-task performance.

2604.17570.tldr: A hematopathology-tailored vision-language model for multi-level PBS interpretation at both cell and slide levels is developed, and experiments show that PBS-VL outperforms existing general-purpose and pathology MLLMs, underscoring the value of PBS-specific data.

2604.17581.tldr: A scaling-law framework for cross-modal discoverability based on spectral structure of data covariance operators, task-aligned signal projections, and learned representations is proposed, which predicts cross-over regimes in which simpler models perform best at small sample sizes, while higher-capacity or multimodal encoders outperform them once sufficient data stabilizes additional degrees of freedom.

2604.17584.tldr: Experimental results on three RAVEN datasets demonstrate that DIRCR significantly enhances reasoning robustness and generalization and applies contrastive learning to enhance feature separability and promote abstract, transferable rule learning.

2604.17585.tldr: DGSSM is proposed, a diffusion-guided state space (Mamba) framework that formulates multimodal salient object detection as a progressive denoising process and suggests that diffusion-guided state space modeling is an effective and generalizable paradigm for multimodal dense prediction tasks.

2604.17587.tldr: AIRA (AI-Induced Risk Audit), a deterministic 15-check inspection framework designed to detect failure-untruthful patterns in code, is presented, designed for governance, compliance, and safety-critical systems where fail-closed behavior is required.

2604.17596.tldr: Terminal Wrench is released, a subset of 331 terminal-agent benchmark environments copied from the popular open benchmarks that are demonstrably reward-hackable and presents a monitorability study in which hack trajectories are sanitized or stripped of reasoning traces and then scored by an LLM judge, showing that detection degrades meaningfully when chain-of-thought is removed.

2604.17602.tldr: It is found that the US and China have long diverged in both dimensions, forming two poles around which global AI research increasingly revolves, developing and further developed countries only integrate with China, signaling its expanding influence over the international AI research landscape.

2604.17611.tldr: Findings show that multimodal clinical assessments within the PPMI cohort can support accurate and interpretable visit-level PD severity stratification, and explainability results highlight a shift from early motor features to progression-related axial and balance impairments.

2604.17614.tldr: It is argued that when the goal is to intervene on model behavior, skill characterization should be *model-native*: grounded in the model's own representations rather than imposed through external ontologies, and this work instantiates a compact orthogonal basis from sequence-level activations.

2604.17621.tldr: This work formalizes the challenge of systematic coverage of a bounded knowledge universe and compositional set-based reasoning over that universe through two orthogonal dimensions: knowledge width, the cardinality of the required universe, and reasoning depth, the number of compositional set operations.

2604.17626.tldr: This work quantifies the correlations between AI model downloads/likes from the HF repository and their documentation alignment with the ZD documentation templates using tables of contents and word statistics and introduces a methodology for delivering agile, data-driven, and community-based AI model cards.

2604.17653.tldr: PV-SQL is presented, an agentic framework that addresses text-to-SQL failures through two complementary components: Probe and Verify, enabling iterative SQL refinement that effectively reduces missing constraints.

2604.17663.tldr: ATLAS is introduced, a geometry-first program that traces constitution-induced hidden-state structure across charts, models, and substrates, and tests a local chart whose tangent structure, occupancy distribution, and behavioural coupling can be measured under system change.

2604.17674.tldr: This work presents a lightweight yet high-accuracy framework for citation-treatment classification that pairs lemmatisation-based preprocessing with subword-aware FastText embeddings and a multi-kernel one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

2604.17677.tldr: This work formalizes entanglement as a model-relative measure of cross-topic overlap in embedding space and defines an Entanglement Index (EI) as a quantitative proxy, and argues that higher EI constrains attainable Top-K retrieval precision under cosine similarity retrieval.

2604.17691.tldr: SafeAnchor is introduced, a framework that anchors safety in place throughout continual adaptation in LoRA parameter space via Fisher Information eigendecomposition, which constrains domain-specific gradient updates to the orthogonal complement of these subspaces, and monitors for residual safety drift with threshold-triggered corrective replay.

2604.17696.tldr: STRATAGEM selectively reinforces trajectories exhibiting abstract, domain-agnostic reasoning through a Reasoning Transferability Coefficient, while incentivizing adaptive reasoning development via a Reasoning Evolution Reward.

2604.17701.tldr: WISV (Wireless-Informed Semantic Verification), a novel distributed speculative decoding framework that goes beyond strict token-level matching via a channel-aware semantic acceptance policy, is proposed and validated on a hardware testbed comprising an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin and an A40-equipped server.

2604.17708.tldr: EvoOR-Agent is proposed, a co-evolutionary framework for automated optimization that represents agent workflows as activity-on-edge (AOE)-style networks, making workflow topology, execution dependencies, and alternative reasoning paths explicit.

2604.17721.tldr: This work proposes GeGS-PCR, a novel two-stage method that combines geometric, color, and Gaussian information for robust registration and introduces the GeGS-3D module, which encodes the local neighborhood information of colored superpoints to ensure a globally invariant geometric-color context.

2604.17725.tldr: RePrompT, a time-aware LLM framework that integrates structured EHR encoders through prompt tuning, without modifying underlying architectures, is introduced, which consistently outperforms both EHR-based and LLM-based baselines across multiple clinical prediction tasks.

2604.17727.tldr: GaussianHSI, a Gaussian-Splatting-based framework for arbitrary-scale hyperspectral image super-resolution, is proposed and a Voronoi-Guided Bilateral 2D Gaussian Splatting for spatial reconstruction is developed.

2604.17730.tldr: This work introduces R-MHSafe, a role-aware mental health safety taxonomy that characterizes clinically significant harm in terms of the interactional roles an AI counselor adopts, including perpetrator, instigator, facilitator, or enabler, combined with clinically grounded harm categories, and proposes MHSafeEval, a closed-loop, agent-based evaluation framework that formulates safety assessment as trajectory-level discovery of harm through adversarial multi-turn interactions.

2604.17753.tldr: A critical bottleneck in current merging paradigms is uncovered: the existence of specific LoRA layers that inherently degrade global performance upon merging, so ENMP is proposed, a plug-and-play LoRA pruning method to locate and exclude these detrimental modules prior to merging.

2604.17755.tldr: It is argued that user experience is central to ethical and effective AI deployment and provides a replicable, literacy-first pathway for applying the PALEI framework to climate-related hazards.

2604.17761.tldr: This work formulates failure analysis as contrastive, LRP-based attribution, attributing the logit difference between an incorrect output token and a correct alternative to input tokens and internal model states, and introduces an efficient extension that enables construction of cross-layer attribution graphs for long-context inputs.

2604.17768.tldr: BIRCH (Balanced Informativeness and CoRrectness with a Truthful AnCHor), a judging paradigm that first corrects inconsistencies with the image content in candidate answers, and then compares the answers against this corrected version, shifts the judge's focus from informativeness to image-grounded correctness.

2604.17769.tldr: This work proposes Reverse Constitutional AI, a framework for automated and controllable adversarial data generation that moves beyond isolated jailbreak prompts and introduces probability clamping within reinforcement learning from AI feedback, which stabilizes adversarial optimization while preserving adversarial intent.

2604.17771.tldr: A clear temporal gradient is observed: older benchmarks such as Spider exhibit the strongest negative values and thus the highest likelihood of training leakage, whereas the more recent BIRD dataset shows minimal sensitivity and appears largely uncontaminated.

2604.17774.tldr: This work proposes a meta-learning loop where LLM agents participate in duopoly markets and an LLM meta-optimizer iteratively refines shared strategic guidance and reveals that meta-prompt optimization enables agents to discover stable tacit collusion strategies with substantially improved coordination quality compared to baseline agents.

2604.17785.tldr: Entropy-guided Token Weighting (ETW), a token-level unlearning regularizer that uses entropy of the predictive distribution as a proxy for token informativeness, is proposed, demonstrating that informative tokens tend to have higher entropy, whereas structural tokens tend to have lower entropy.

2604.17787.tldr: This work proposes AnchorRefine, a hierarchical framework that factorizes VLA action modeling into trajectory anchor and residual refinement, and introduces a decision-aware gripper refinement mechanism to better capture the discrete and boundary-sensitive nature of gripper control.

2604.17794.tldr: This paper investigates Test-Time Scaling strategies for the Qwen3-1.7B architecture within the context of Vietnamese Elementary Mathematics and establishes a deployment hierarchy for SLMs, demonstrating that SFT combined with simplified test-time scaling is superior to complex agentic workflows for edge-based reasoning.

2604.17803.tldr: This work introduces Adversarial Arena for building high quality conversational datasets by framing data generation as an adversarial task: attackers create prompts, and defenders generate responses.

2604.17805.tldr: A fundamental sensitivity of MLE-based ranking mechanisms to structured perturbations is revealed and the need for more robust aggregation methods in collective decision-making systems is highlighted.

2604.17814.tldr: This study reveals that Byte-Pair Encoding tokenization leads to unexpected behavior of secret memorization, which is identified as gibberish bias, and identifies that some secrets are among the easiest for CLLMs to memorize.

2604.17817.tldr: DailyDroid is introduced, a benchmark of 75 tasks in five scenarios across 25 Android apps, spanning three difficulty levels to mimic everyday smartphone use, revealing critical issues in UI accessibility, input modalities, and LLM/app design, offering implications for future mobile agents, applications, and UI development.

2604.17819.tldr: PDDL-Mind is introduced, a neuro-symbolic framework that decouples environment state evolution from belief inference, and achieves over 5% absolute accuracy gain over the best existing state-of-the-art method on ToM benchmark questions.

2604.17823.tldr: The results of the experiments show that the proposed system is capable of generating high-quality music that is comparable to human-generated music.

2604.17837.tldr: A parameter-free decomposition for Mixture-of-Experts models is introduced that splits each layer's hidden state into a control signal that causally drives routing and an orthogonal content channel invisible to the router.

2604.17843.tldr: AVA (AI + Verified Analysis), a GenAI platform built on a curated library of over 4,000 World Bank Reports with multilingual capabilities, is presented, which operationalizes epistemic humility through two mechanisms: citation verifiability and reasoned abstention.

2604.17846.tldr: This study introduces an AI framework that enables fully automated thoracolumbar spine segmentation and 3D reconstruction from MRI alone, supporting clinical evaluation, surgical planning, and navigation in paediatric spine care.

2604.17849.tldr: The analysis shows that reliability depends on both how tasks are specified and how agent behavior varies across executions, and suggests the need to evaluate agents under repeated execution, to allow agents to resolve task ambiguity through interaction, and to favor strategies that remain stable across runs.

2604.17884.tldr: SPREG (Structured Plan-guided Real-time Entropy Gating), a lightweight inference-time framework for surgical error rectification, employs an adaptive dual-threshold mechanism to monitor real-time entropy, identifying sudden ``entropy spikes''as reliable indicators of logical failure.

2604.17886.tldr: MPT, a benchmark comprising 265 multi-session dialogues that cover three challenges: Preference Recall, Preference Induction, and Preference Transfer, is introduced and PRefine is proposed, a test-time memory-augmented method that represents user preferences as evolving hypotheses.

2604.17897.tldr: LoReC (Look, Remember, and Contrast), a novel plug-and-play method for GraphLLM paradigm, which enhances LLM's understanding of graph data through three stages: Look, Remember, and Contrast, which enhances LLM's understanding of graph data through three stages.

2604.17906.tldr: BAGEL is proposed, a novel framework that propagates sparse LLM relevance signals across the embedding space to guide global exploration and effectively explores and captures complex relevance distributions and outperforms LLM reranking methods under the same LLM budget on all four datasets.

2604.17910.tldr: This work introduces PI-CMDP, a framework for CMDPs whose constraint dependencies form a layered DAG under a Lifecycle Ordering Assumption (LOA), and proposes an Identify-Compress-Estimate pipeline, a physics-guided doubly-robust estimator that remains unbiased and reduces the variance constant when the physics prior outperforms a learned model.

2604.17912.tldr: This work introduces Calibrated Attempt-Level (CAL) GRPO by devising a weighing strategy to obtain unbiased gradients while maintaining small variance and reveals how incorporating per-attempt rewards influence the training and the eventual Verification@K performance.

2604.17920.tldr: This paper explores how general-purpose vision foundation models can enable zero-shot ship instance segmentation in SAR imagery, eliminating the need for pixel-level supervision and demonstrates that spatial constraints from a SAR-trained detector alone can effectively regularize foundation model predictions.

2604.17927.tldr: This work proposes Brain-Inspired Capture (BI-Cap), a neuromimetic perceptual simulation paradigm that aligns these modalities by emulating HVS processing, and constructs a neuromimetic pipeline comprising four biologically plausible dynamic and static transformations, coupled with Mutual Information-guided dynamic blur regulation to simulate adaptive visual processing.

2604.17928.tldr: This work proposes Hybrid-domain Entropy dynamics ALignment (HEAL), a framework tailored for few-shot RLVR that introduces Entropy Dynamics Alignment (EDA), a reward mechanism that aligns trajectory-level entropy dynamics between the target and general domains, capturing both entropy magnitude and fine-grained variation.

2604.17930.tldr: It is found that even small language models can substantially improve on those linguistic phenomena on which models typically perform poorly, provided the pre-training data contains sufficient exposure to them.

2604.17948.tldr: This work presents RAVEN (Retrieval Augmented Vulnerability Exploration Network), a framework leveraging LLM agents and Retrieval Augmented Generation to synthesize comprehensive vulnerability analysis reports to support automated vulnerability documentation.

2604.17966.tldr: TPS-CalcBench is proposed, the first diagnostic benchmark for closed-form analytical calculations in hypersonic aerodynamics and high-temperature gas dynamics that experienced TPS engineers conduct without simulations and establishes a complete diagnose-evaluate-intervene framework for safety-critical engineering LLM deployment assessment.

2604.17967.tldr: This article establishes a precise connection between binarized neural networks (BNNs) and Sugeno integrals and shows that the activation threshold test can be written as a Sugeno integral on binary inputs.

2604.17968.tldr: This work characterize the conditions under which modern LLMs can outperform human annotators, including in-group humans, when predicting aggregate subgroup opinions on subjective tasks, and shows that these conditions are common in practice.

2604.17986.tldr: The results show how frequency-domain control in latent space provides an intuitive, continuous frequency axis for conditioning and blending, advancing us toward more interpretable and interactive generative music models.

2604.17989.tldr: This paper introduces the AIT Academy (Agents Institute of Technology Academy), a curriculum framework for cultivating AI agents across the tripartite structure of human knowledge, grounded in Kagan's Three Cultures and UNESCO ISCED-F 2013.

2604.18003.tldr: This work proposes SELF-EMO, a self-evolution framework grounded in the hypothesis that better emotion prediction leads to more consistent emotional responses, and develops SELF-GRPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that stabilizes optimization with multi-label alignment rewards and group-level consistency signals.
