2604.18026.tldr: RASP-Tuner improves or matches cumulative regret relative to GP-UCB and CMA-ES implementations on seven of nine synthetic tasks under paired tests at horizon T=100, while recording 8-12 times lower wall-clock per step than sliding-window GP-UCB on identical hardware.

2412.19685.tldr: This work introduces Forgery Attribution Report Generation, a new multimodal task that jointly localizes forged regions and generates natural language explanations grounded in the editing process and proposes ForgeryTalker, a unified end-to-end framework that integrates vision and language via a shared encoder and dual decoders for mask and text generation, enabling coherent cross-modal reasoning.

2503.05571.tldr: This paper systematically examines the compliance of AI systems with relevant legislation, focusing on the EU's AI Act and the compliance of data sets, to identify challenges and propose the first best practices for legal compliance when developing, deploying, and running AI.

2505.05453.tldr: This work aims to explore the feasibility of using LLMs to empower domain experts in the creation and redesign of process models in an iterative and effective way and recommends a hybrid approach that identifies all used change patterns and then directly applies those patterns that work correctly and for the others derives follow-up questions in order to improve user input.

2505.21722.tldr: It is suggested that deep ReLU networks exhibit saddle-to-saddle dynamics, with GD visiting a sequence of saddles with increasing bottleneck rank (Jacot, 2023), and the optimal escape direction features a low-rank bias in its deeper layers.

2506.00065.tldr: It is found that, unlike vocabulary, perspectival words pose a greater challenge in human communication, and this difficulty is amplified in MLMs, revealing a shortfall in their pragmatic and social-cognitive abilities.

2506.03178.tldr: LLaMA-XR is presented, a novel framework that integrates Meta LLaMA 3.1 Large Language Model with DenseNet-121-based image embeddings and Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) fine-tuning that demonstrates that LLaMA-XR outperforms a range of state-of-the-art methods.

2506.12606.tldr: Mamba-based HuBERT models are explored as alternatives to Transformer-based SSL architectures, Leveraging the linear-time Selective State Space, which enables fine-tuning on long-context ASR with significantly lower compute and shows superior performance when fine-tuned for streaming ASR.

2506.24106.tldr: It is shown that a language model's ability to predict text is tightly linked to the breadth of its embedding space: models that spread their contextual representations more widely tend to achieve lower perplexity, and how dispersion can be leveraged for a range of practical tasks--without requiring labeled data.

2508.05132.tldr: PrinciplismQA is introduced, a philosophy-grounded approach to assessing LLM clinical medical ethics alignment that provides a validated tool for assessing clinical AI deployment readiness and fills significant ethical reasoning gaps despite high knowledge accuracy.

2509.15336.tldr: This work provides a methodology for assessing knowledge-driven hallucination, and raises awareness of the need for rigorous validation of AI-generated artifacts in any evidence-based domain.

2509.23724.tldr: This paper proposes a novel visual prompting strategy specifically designed for long-video understanding, which is training-free, parameter-free, and model-agnostic, and can be seamlessly integrated into existing VLMs.

2602.21228.tldr: This work proposes ImpRIF, a method to enhance LLMs' understanding of implicit reasoning instructions, thereby improving its ability to follow complex instructions, and demonstrates that enhancing implicit reasoning capabilities can significantly improve complex instruction following.

2603.26475.tldr: This work introduces the latent attention masked autoencoder (LAMAE) FM that directly exploits this structure by learning cross-lead connection mechanisms during self-supervised pretraining, enabling permutation-invariant aggregation and adaptive weighting of lead-specific representations.

2604.04815.tldr: Tests with 22 LLMs show that open-source Mixture-of-Experts models, such as Qwen3-235B-A22B, now match or outperform proprietary state-of-the-art systems and find a significant"reasoning gap."

2604.05489.tldr: Extensive experiments on 3 existing benchmarks and the T2V-Complexity benchmark demonstrate that SCMAPR consistently improves text-video alignment and overall generation quality under complex scenarios, achieving up to 2.67% and 3.28 gains in average score on VBench and EvalCrafter, respectively.

2604.06155.tldr: A novel method Latent Semantic Enhancement MTP (LSE-MTP), which anchors predictions to ground-truth hidden state trajectories and effectively bridges the gap between discrete tokens and continuous state representations, enhancing representation alignment, reducing structural hallucinations, and improving robustness to perturbations.

2604.06796.tldr: Results suggest that increasing the flexibility of the inference parametrization through instance-adaptive modulation is an effective strategy for mitigating amortization-induced suboptimality in deep generative models.

2604.07484.tldr: ConsistRM is a self-training framework that enables effective and stable GRM training without human annotations and incorporates the Consistency-Aware Answer Reward, which produces reliable pseudo-labels with temporal consistency, thereby providing more stable model optimization.

2604.07549.tldr: An ePCR-grounded, topic-flow-based multi-agent generation pipeline that iteratively plans, generates, and self-refines dialogues with rule-based factual and topic flow checks that improves accuracy, timeliness, and stability of EMS conversational diagnosis prediction.

2604.07791.tldr: This work introduces a Tool-Memory based self-evolving agentic framework SEARL, which constructs a structured experience memory that integrates planning with execution and provides a novel state abstraction that facilitates generalization across analogous contexts, such as tool reuse.

2604.07960.tldr: This work proposes ToolCAD, a novel agentic CAD framework deploying LLMs as tool-using agents for text-to-CAD generation, enabling them to perform comparably to proprietary models, paving the way for more accessible and robust autonomous text-to-CAD modeling systems.

2604.12320.tldr: EgoEsportsQA, a pioneering video question-answering (QA) benchmark for grounding perception and reasoning in expert esports knowledge, is introduced, suggesting that the dataset not only reveals the connections between real-world and virtual egocentric domains, but also offers guidance for optimizing downstream esports applications.

2604.17300.tldr: The results suggest the idea of using chaotic perturbation as an efficient, low-overhead regularization tool, for the data-scarce regimes.

2604.18038.tldr: These findings support multi-metric bias evaluation for AI systems used in medical settings and suggest that retrieval-based agentic workflows may reduce some forms of explicit bias in benchmarked diagnostic tasks.

2604.18050.tldr: This paper utilizes the duality between provability in observable theories and topologies to propose a logic-to-topology encoder for the input space, and introduces the concept of the "topological dual of a dataset", a transformation that bridges formal logic, topology, and neural processing.

2604.18052.tldr: ExAI5G, a framework that prioritizes interpretability by integrating a Transformer-based deep learning IDS with logic-based explainable AI (XAI) techniques, is proposed, which uses Integrated Gradients to attribute feature importance and extracts a surrogate decision tree to derive logical rules.

2604.18064.tldr: A domain-specific language EXACT is introduced that represents human motions as underspecified motion programs, interpreted as reward-generating functions for zero-shot policy inference using forward-backwards representations, and an executable neuro-symbolic model that uses program structure for compositional modelling is introduced.

2604.18071.tldr: A protocol-guided, source-grounded empirical study of 70 publicly available agent-system projects, addressing three questions: which design-decision dimensions recur across projects, which co-occurrences structure those decisions, and which typical architectural patterns emerge.

2604.18076.tldr: This study demonstrates that object-specific diffusion models are effective for improving military object detection in a low-data domain, and that structural guidance is most beneficial when real data is highly limited.

2604.18087.tldr: A pairwise data augmentation method is proposed that combines contexts from different documents to create contrastive training examples, enabling models to learn the relationship between topics and summaries more effectively.

2604.18095.tldr: DSAINet is proposed, an efficient dual-scale attentive interaction network for general EEG decoding that constructs shared spatiotemporal token representations from raw EEG signals and models diverse temporal dynamics through parallel convolutional branches at fine and coarse scales.

2604.18096.tldr: It is proposed that collaboration breaks down when the appearance of partnership outpaces the grounding capacity of the interaction and contributed a framework for discussing grounding, repair, and interaction structure in LLM-enabled work.

2604.18103.tldr: Delta Attention Selective Halting (DASH) is introduced, a training-free policy that monitors the layer-wise update dynamics of the self-attention mechanism to selectively halt stabilized tokens, delivering significant prefill speedups while preserving model accuracy and hardware efficiency.

2604.18124.tldr: Task-aware Low-Rank Adaptation is presented, a unified framework that jointly optimizes initialization and resource allocation at the outset of training and consistently performs excellently across various tasks, including natural language understanding, commonsense reasoning, math reasoning, code generation, and chat generation.

2604.18128.tldr: It is shown that orthogonal rotation cannot bound the bilinear SwiGLU tail, and a post-hoc alternative (Per-Linear QuaRot) nearly matches it on the reader axis, directly testing the prediction that orthogonal rotation cannot bound the bilinear SwiGLU tail.

2604.18131.tldr: This work trains agents to possess an intrinsic meta-evolution capability to spontaneously learn about unseen environments prior to task execution, and designs an outcome-based reward mechanism that measures how much an agent's self-generated world knowledge improves its success rate on downstream tasks.

2604.18133.tldr: A comparative analysis is conducted to contrast CMASs and LMASs across architecture, operating mechanism, adaptability, and application, and future perspectives on MASs are presented, summarizing open challenges and potential research opportunities.

2604.18135.tldr: This work enhances image diversity via class-wise batching and BN supervision during synthesis and introduces Label Pruning with Dynamic Knowledge Reuse to enhance label-per-augmentation diversity, and Label Quantization with Calibrated Student-Teacher Alignment to enhance augmentation-per-image diversity.

2604.18137.tldr: AQPIM is introduced, a novel PIM-aware activation quantization framework based on Product Quantization (PQ), optimizing it for modern Large Language Models (LLMs) and significantly reducing both memory footprint and computational overhead for attention computation.

2604.18145.tldr: VietPET-RoI is introduced, the first large-scale 3D PET/CT dataset with fine-grained RoI annotation for a low-resource language, comprising 600 PET/CT samples and 1,960 manually annotated RoIs, paired with corresponding clinical reports, and HiRRA, a novel framework that mimics the professional radiologist diagnostic workflow by employing graph-based relational modules to capture dependencies between RoI attributes.

2604.18161.tldr: While estimator switching improves robustness in controlled studies, careful variance control often dominates in practical deployments, and this paper introduces DDCG, a lightweight test that switches estimators in nonsmooth regions; with a single hyperparameter, DDCG achieves robust performance and remains reliable with small samples.

2604.18170.tldr: An upper-bound analysis that requires no end-to-end training is reported of Copy-as-Decode, a decoding-layer mechanism that recasts edit generation as structured decoding over a two-primitive grammar.

2604.18176.tldr: The verification-aware reward model (VRM) tailored for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is proposed, which employs an adaptive reward fusion (ARF) mechanism to dynamically integrate deterministic signals from a scientific execution suite with multidimensional semantic evaluations for precise supervision.

2604.18179.tldr: A commit-open protocol that closes a parallel-serve side-channel gap in Probe-after-return schemes such as SVIP, and instantiates the protocol on three backbones -- Qwen3-1.7B, Gemma-2-2B, and a 4.5x scale-up to Gemma-2-9B with a 131k-feature SAE.

2604.18190.tldr: MADDPG-K is proposed, a scalable extension to Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient that addresses the computational limitations of centralized critic approaches, demonstrating competitive or superior performance compared to MADDPG, faster convergence in cooperative settings, and better runtime scaling as the number of agents grows.

2604.18206.tldr: This method combines uncertainty-based routing, confidence-based selective acceptance, bank selection across rule and exemplar memory, and evidence-based governance of the memory bank over time to achieve applicability control of the memory bank over time.

2604.18210.tldr: TacticGen is presented, a generative model for adaptable and scalable tactic generation that generates realistic, strategically valuable tactics, demonstrating its practical utility for tactical planning in professional football.

2604.18224.tldr: A novel Agent-as-a-Judge paradigm for generation that autonomously executes generated websites in a real browser, explores interactive behaviors via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and iteratively synthesizes targeted test cases, closely approximating human acceptance testing.

2604.18233.tldr: Aether is presented, a novel approach that integrates Generative Agentic AI with a multi-functional Network Digital Twin to automate and streamline network change validation workflows and demonstrates promising results in error detection, diagnostic coverage, and speed over traditional methods.

2604.18234.tldr: Experiments with LLMs from OpenAI, Meta, and Google demonstrate that CARE consistently outperforms existing methods for evaluating multi-hop reasoning in RAG systems, with performance gains most pronounced in models with larger parameter counts and longer context windows, while single-hop queries show minimal sensitivity to context-aware evaluation.

2604.18237.tldr: A novel distributed learning framework that ensures both diverse and discriminative representations is proposed, and extensive simulations on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms in capturing global structural representations.

2604.18240.tldr: A benchmark AJ-Bench is introduced to systematically evaluate Agent-as-a-Judge across three domains-search, data systems, and graphical user interfaces-comprising 155 tasks and 516 annotated trajectories to comprehensively assesses judge agents'abilities in information acquisition, state verification, and process verification.

2604.18251.tldr: Three neural network architectures designed for real-time classification of weather conditions from images, inspired by recent advances in style transfer, are presented, which outperform the state of the art and demonstrate remarkable generalization capability on several public databases.

2604.18254.tldr: It is shown that structured, modular learning is a superior alternative to monolithic fine-tuning for mastering the syntax and logic of complex code generation, and provides a flexible,"Lego-like"architecture, allowing models to be composed and deployed based on specific schema difficulty requirements.

2604.18257.tldr: This work proposes a novel adaptive trie-guided decoding framework that uses user query prefixes to softly steer language models toward high-quality completions, and introduces an adaptive penalty mechanism with tunable hyperparameters, enabling a principled trade-off between model confidence and trie-based guidance.

2604.18258.tldr: PRISM is proposed, a compositional approach that enables pre-trained T2I models to process long sequence inputs and demonstrates superior generalization, outperforming baseline models by 7.4% on prompts over 500 tokens in a challenging public benchmark.

2604.18266.tldr: PLAG, a pseudo-label-guided anomaly generation method designed to enhance tabular anomaly detection, is proposed, utilizing pseudo-anomalies as guidance signals and decoupling the overall anomaly quantification of a sample into an accumulation of feature-level abnormalities, which effectively obviates the need for scarce ground-truth labels.

2604.18292.tldr: Agent-World is presented, a self-evolving training arena for advancing general agent intelligence through scalable environments that consistently outperforms strong proprietary models and environment scaling baselines and reveals scaling trends in relation to environment diversity and self-evolution rounds, offering insights for building general agent intelligence.

2604.18302.tldr: A zero-egress, on-device AI platform for privacy-preserving psychiatric decision support, deployed as a cross-platform mobile application that achieves diagnostic accuracy comparable to its server-side predecessor while sustaining real-time inference latency on commodity mobile hardware.

2604.18311.tldr: It is argued that XAI explanations should be presented in the form of narratives, and a set of problem-agnostic XAI Narrative generation rules are proposed, so that the resulting XAI Narratives exhibit stronger narrative properties and align with the findings from the linguistic and social science literature.

2604.18320.tldr: EVE (Executable Visual transformation-based self-Evolution), a novel framework that entirely bypasses pseudo-labels by harnessing executable visual transformations continuously enriched in both variety and complexity, is introduced.

2604.18327.tldr: This work proposes the Pipeline-Adapted Reward Model (PARM), which leverages pipeline-specific data and direct preference optimization to align rewards with downstream feedback, and evaluates it on four public optimization benchmarks, measuring execution rate and solving accuracy against baselines and sampling methods.

2604.18344.tldr: A structure-aware denoising network that integrates a relational context encoder with a relational graph diffusion transformer for knowledge graph generation that achieves state-of-the-art performance on three public datasets is designed.

2604.18347.tldr: Experiments show that using multilingual, multimodal examples for training VLMs aids is consistently beneficial on non-English benchmarks, with positive transfer to English as well.

2604.18348.tldr: AdaCluster is proposed, a training-free adaptive clustering framework that accelerates the generation of DiTs while preserving accuracy, and applies an angle-similarity-preserving clustering method to query vectors for higher compression, and designs a euclidean-similarity-preserving clustering method for keys.

2604.18352.tldr: This work introduces a Gaussian Differential Privacy (GDP)-based auditing framework that measures privacy via the full false-positive/false-negative tradeoff, and provides the first tight audits in the strong-privacy regime.

2604.18364.tldr: This study presents the first unified training and inference study for text-to-code-to-video transformation with Manim, and shows that the correlation between code and visual metrics strengthens with SFT but weakens with inference-time enhancements, highlighting the complementary roles of training and agentic inference strategies in Manim animation generation.

2604.18373.tldr: It is shown that targeted prompt interventions causally amplify or suppress specific behavioral mechanisms, significantly altering the magnitude of market bubbles.

2604.18375.tldr: Online A/B tests on one of the world's largest conversational agent products show that IceBreaker improves user active days by +0.184% and click-through rate by +9.425%, and has been deployed in production.

2604.18380.tldr: Light is shed on the role of AI researchers as implicated subjects in the harms caused by weapons enabled by AI technologies and ways to transfigure this position of implication into one of differentiated, long-distance solidarity with the victims of technologically fortified injustices are explored.

2604.18381.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive empirical study of open-source Small Language Model (SLM) performance after RLVR in low data regimes and characterize how model performance scales with dataset size, diversity, and complexity.

2604.18429.tldr: The CDVQA benchmark is revisited using recent Qwen models under a unified low-rank adaptation (LoRA) setting, indicating that tightly integrated multimodal backbones contribute more to performance than scale or explicit multi-depth visual conditioning for language-driven semantic change reasoning in RS imagery.

2604.18444.tldr: P ProtoCLIP is proposed, a refinement strategy for CLIP-style VLMs that improves zero-shot discrimination through targeted data curation and distilled anchor alignment, and introduces a representation-preserving distillation objective to stabilize adaptation.

2604.18459.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that decouples reasoning control from memory integration, and introduces an instantiation of this framework with two core components, ATDM and HPSI, which set a new standard on key online video understanding benchmarks.

2604.18468.tldr: Asset Harvester is a system-level design for real-world AV data that combines large-scale curation of object-centric training tuples, geometry-aware preprocessing across heterogeneous sensors, and a robust training recipe that couples sparse-view-conditioned multiview generation with 3D Gaussian lifting.

2604.18478.tldr: WorldDB is presented, a memory engine built on three commitments: every node is a world -- a container with its own interior subgraph, ontology scope, and composed embedding, recursive to arbitrary depth, and edges are write-time programs, so no raw append path exists.

2604.18487.tldr: In the benchmark results reported here, the original attacks record 3.84% attack success rate, while transformed methods range from 36.8% to 65.0%, yielding 55.75% overall ASR across 31 frontier models, suggesting that current safety techniques suffer from weak generalization.

2604.18490.tldr: Though validated here on Arabic, LQM is a language-agnostic framework designed to be easily applied to or adapted for other languages, designed to be easily applied to or adapted for other languages.

2604.18508.tldr: This work introduces ArXivDoc, a new benchmark constructed from the underlying LaTeX sources of scientific papers, and systematically compares text-only, image-based, and multimodal representations across both single-vector and multi-vector retrieval models.

2604.18510.tldr: The results show that jailbreaks can produce vastly different properties despite similar harmfulness, with models jailbroken via RLVR showing remarkable similarity to the base model.

2604.18519.tldr: SIREN is a lightweight guard model that builds a harmfulness detector from LLM internals without modifying the underlying model, and exhibits superior generalization to unseen benchmarks, naturally enables real-time streaming detection, and significantly improves inference efficiency compared to generative guard models.

2604.18532.tldr: Synthesis for obligation properties expressed in LTLfp, the extension of LTLf to infinite traces, is studied to show that they admit a translation into symbolically represented deterministic weak automata (DWA) obtained directly from the symbolic deterministic finite automata (DFA) for the underlying LTLf properties on trace prefixes.

2604.18539.tldr: The findings indicate that transition regularization provides consistent gains and disproportionately benefits weaker baseline models, and suggest that lightweight discourse-flow priors complement pretrained encoders, especially in fine-grained, data-sparse dialogue tasks.

2604.18567.tldr: At each generation step, at each generation step, LPSR monitors the residual stream at a critical layer lcrit, detects abrupt directional reversals (phase shifts) via a cosine-similarity $+$ entropy dual gate, and responds by rolling back the KV-cache and injecting a pre-computed steering vector.

2604.18572.tldr: The findings suggest that the current evidence for cross-modal representational convergence is considerably weaker than subsequent works have taken it to be.

2604.18574.tldr: A systematic empirical study across diverse model families and reasoning domains under three weak supervision settings finds that generalization is governed by training reward saturation dynamics: models that generalize exhibit a prolonged pre-saturation phase during which training reward and downstream performance climb together, while models that saturate rapidly memorize rather than learn.

2604.18584.tldr: Experimental results show that retrieval-augmented generation performance is highly sensitive to retrieval quality; for example, DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale achieves gains of up to 12%, obtaining the highest scores on the benchmark.

2603.26815.tldr: HDRR is proposed, a two-stage architecture that uses SFR as a document filter followed by chunk retrieval scoped to the identified document(s), eliminating cross-document confusion while preserving chunk precision and is the most efficient of the high-quality systems.

2604.11284.tldr: TheIA, a 2.75M-parameter modular neural architecture that learns the complete Kleene three-valued logic (K3) truth table from task data without external symbolic inference or hand-encoded K3 gate primitives, and preserves Has-Unknown at every upstream boundary.

2604.17406.tldr: EvoMaster is presented, a foundational evolving agent framework engineered specifically for Agentic Science at Scale, that empowers agents to iteratively refine hypotheses, self-critique, and progressively accumulate knowledge across experimental cycles, faithfully mirroring human scientific inquiry.

2604.17892.tldr: This work injects controllable stochasticity into latent reasoning via Gumbel-Softmax, restoring LLMs'exploratory capacity and enhancing their compatibility with Reinforcement Learning (RL).

2604.18652.tldr: Arbiter-K is proposed, a Governance-First execution architecture that reconceptualizes the underlying model as a Probabilistic Processing Unit encapsulated by a deterministic, neuro-symbolic kernel, and enforces security as a microarchitectural property.

2604.18751.tldr: The findings show that communities centered on holding behavior evolve from transactional networks into socially embedded ecosystems characterized by dense ties, decentralized influence, and ongoing cultural participation, while trader- and speculator-dominated networks remain fragmented and transactional.

2604.18847.tldr: Human evaluation shows the reward model scaffold yields higher-quality recovery trajectories than base agents and rubric-based scaffolds, and lays the foundation for a new class of agent safety methods -- ones that confront harm not only by preventing it, but by navigating its aftermath with alignment and intent.

2604.18966.tldr: Across five mixed-type benchmarks, TabGRAA improves a GReaT backbone beyond additional supervised fine-tuning and achieves the strongest average trade-off among adapted DPO, KTO, and NPO baselines on fidelity and downstream utility, while maintaining empirical privacy diagnostics near the supervised baseline.

2604.18995.tldr: This work proposes R-dLLM, a unified framework for reducing decoding redundancy from both inference and training perspectives, and proposes a redundancy-aware supervised fine-tuning pipeline that aligns the model with efficient decoding trajectories and reduces reliance on manually tuned thresholds.

2604.19000.tldr: Decompose, Structure, and Repair (DSR), a neuro-symbolic framework that restructures autoformalization into a modular pipeline and introduces PRIME, a benchmark of 156 undergraduate and graduate-level theorems selected from canonical textbooks and expertly annotated in Lean 4.

2604.19047.tldr: RARE (Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation), a framework for constructing realistic benchmarks by decomposing documents into atomic facts to enable precise redundancy tracking and enhancing LLM-based data generation with CRRF, is presented.

2604.19092.tldr: RoboWM-Bench is introduced, a manipulation-centric benchmark for embodiment-grounded evaluation of video world models and its findings provide a more fine-grained view of current model capabilities and underscore the value of embodiment-aware evaluation for guiding physically grounded world modeling in robotic manipulation.

2604.19131.tldr: Two dataset-specific QWK ceilings are derived based on the reliability concept in classical test theory, which can be estimated from standard two-rater benchmarks without additional annotation and show that human--human QWK, often used as a ceiling reference, can underestimate the true ceiling.

2604.19185.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that SCURank outperforms traditional metrics and LLM-based ranking methods across evaluation measures and datasets, and show that incorporating diverse LLM summaries enhances model abstractiveness and overall distilled model performance.

2604.19191.tldr: This work introduces a training-free, modality-agnostic framework that inserts an explicit manifold-refinement stage between feature extraction and anomaly scoring, offering a practical and scalable AI screening framework for real-world, multi-modality clinical workflows where retraining and abnormal-case annotation are costly or infeasible.

2604.19219.tldr: The Sherpa.ai multi-party PSU protocol for VFL offers a scalable, mathematically grounded protocol for PPEA in real-world VFL deployments, such as multi-institutional healthcare disease detection, collaborative risk modeling between banks and insurers, and cross-domain fraud detection between telecommunications and financial institutions, while preserving intersection privacy.

2604.19251.tldr: This work adapts the StreamLLM approach, which uses Large Language Models to generate streamliners for Constraint Programming, to Answer Set Programming (ASP), and reports results for a virtual best encoding (VBE) that achieves speedups of up to 5 times over the original encoding.

2604.19341.tldr: This work introduces SimpleTES (Simple Test-time Evaluation-driven Scaling), a framework that focuses on the structured scaling of AI discovery loops, organizing evaluator queries across independent trajectories, iterative refinement, local candidate selection, and the selective reuse of evaluated histories.

2604.19532.tldr: This paper encodes all events within a single time step at the same pitch as one token, and group tokens explicitly by time step, which resembles a sparse encoding of a piano-roll representation.

2604.19635.tldr: This work introduces a Chunk-wise Interleaved Splicing Paradigm that ensures highly efficient and stable streaming inference and provides empirical evidence that AR generative backbones are viable for latency-sensitive applications through the Chunk-wise Interleaved Splicing Paradigm.

2508.02455.tldr: This work proposes a new scoring approach to ranking static completions using language models in a lightweight and model-agnostic way, which enables a precise token-aware ranking without needing beam search, prompt engineering, or model adaptations.

2501.06857.tldr: In the context of action history, it is shown that the notion of cause generalizes naturally to a notion of achievement cause, and the relationship between the notion of the achievement cause and the achievement cause by Batusov and Soutchanski is analyzed.

2303.12834.tldr: It is proved that if arbitrary measurements are allowed, then any efficiently representable unitary can be efficiently learned within the incoherent framework; however, when restricted to shallow-depth measurements only low-entangling unitaries can be learned.

2412.05225.tldr: Binarized Early Exit Transformer (BEExformer), a first-of-its-kind selective learning-based transformer integrating Binarization-Aware Training (BAT) with EE for efficient and fast textual inference, demonstrates its Pareto-optimal performance-efficiency trade-off.

2411.19517.tldr: RL-SPH is proposed, a novel reinforcement learning-based start primal heuristic capable of independently generating feasible solutions, even for ILP involving non-binary integers.

2411.13311.tldr: This work directly uses the raw range-Doppler spectrum of radar data to process camera images, thus avoiding radar signal processing and evaluating the fusion strategy with other existing methods not only in terms of accuracy but also on computational complexity metrics on RADIal dataset.

2302.12039.tldr: Legal NLP is beginning to match not only the methodological sophistication of general NLP but also the professional standards of data availability and code reproducibility observed within the broader scientific community.

2508.20206.tldr: It is established that adding a filter to the beginning of transformer-based models enhances their performance in long time-series forecasting and is able to decrease the embedding dimension of the models, resulting in transformer-based architectures that are both smaller and more effective than their non-filtering base models.

2602.23638.tldr: FedRot-LoRA is proposed, a federated LoRA framework that aligns client updates via orthogonal transformations prior to aggregation, which preserves the semantic update while reducing cross-client subspace mismatch, without increasing communication cost or restricting model expressivity.

2602.08354.tldr: This work surprisingly uncover and empirically verify that LRMs implicitly know the appropriate time to stop thinking, while this capability is obscured by current sampling paradigms and introduces SAGE (Self-Aware Guided Efficient Reasoning), a novel sampling paradigm that unleashes this efficient reasoning potential.

2605.08063.tldr: Manifold Anchor Regularization (MAR) is introduced, which leverages a task-agnostic teacher to provide full-data supervision that anchors generation to a high-quality manifold, effectively mitigating the aesthetic degradation commonly observed in purely RL-driven alignment.

2604.24155.tldr: These findings indicate that people may evaluate humans, AI systems acting in the same situation, and the humans who design them in meaningfully different ways, and the fact that these evaluations do not necessarily converge gives rise to the alignment target problem.

2605.02798.tldr: This work establishes energy-to-solution as a measurable and scalable metric for evaluating quantum applications and provides experimental evidence of favorable energy-accuracy trade-offs.

2605.01457.tldr: CoFlow reaches state-of-the-art coordination quality in 1-3 denoising steps under both centralized and decentralized execution, and matches or surpasses Gaussian / value-based, transformer, diffusion, and other prior flow baselines on episodic return.

2605.08747.tldr: VIGIL, an evaluation framework that makes terminal commitment independently measurable, is introduced, which provides a protocol that makes terminal commitment independently visible and scorable.

2605.06940.tldr: It is found that LLMs failed to detect 79% and 75% of instances with hateful and sarcastic content compared to a human-calibrated reference, and it is proved that it represents a "label agreement illusion", statistically validated via almost null Fleiss'Kappa on sarcasm detection.

2605.02427.tldr: A Auxiliary Particle Power Sampling (APPS), a blockwise particle algorithm for approximating the sequence-level power target with a bounded population of partial solutions, improves the accuracy--runtime trade-off of training-free decoding, further supporting the view that inference-time power approximation can recover gains often attributed to post-training.

2603.13988.tldr: It is found that CoT reasoning steps often do not causally drive predictions, and models readily incorporate external hints without acknowledgment, which underscores that faithfulness, not just accuracy, must be central in evaluating LLMs for medicine, to ensure both public protection and safe clinical deployment.

2605.08374.tldr: MemQ is introduced, which applies TD ($\lambda$) eligibility traces to memory Q-values, propagating credit backward through a provenance DAG that records which memories were retrieved when each new memory was created.

2605.07912.tldr: It is shown that sycophantic AI immediately delivers the emotional and esteem support users typically associate with close friends and family, and offers a relational account of AI sycophancy and its impacts.

2605.07473.tldr: This work extends the conventional circuit of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) to a bilevel optimization architecture and proposes a fully connected QBM, which exhibits notable noise robustness and strong robustness in image generation.

2605.10267.tldr: This work introduces IndustryBench, a 2,049-item benchmark for industrial procurement QA in Chinese, grounded in Chinese national standards (GB/T) and structured industrial product records, organized by seven capability dimensions, ten industry categories, and panel-derived difficulty tiers, with item-aligned English, Russian, and Vietnamese renderings.

2605.10987.tldr: AESOP, a framework combining vulnerability-guided path ranking with adaptive loss weighting, is presented, a framework combining vulnerability-guided path ranking with adaptive loss weighting that creates an efficiency-attack surface that existing methods targeting single models cannot exploit.

2605.10975.tldr: A Hierarchical Multi-view HAAR (HMH) is introduced, a novel spectral graph-learning framework that scales in near-linear time and outperforms state-of-the-art spectral baselines, achieving up to a 3% improvement on node classification and 7% points on graph classification datasets, all while maintaining linear scalability.

2605.10970.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage associative memory architecture, wherein a context-gate subcircuit reshapes the retrieval energy landscape before and during recall, and shows theoretically that context gating increases inter-memory separation while inducing sparsity, translating into exponential improvements in retrieval.

2605.10503.tldr: This work investigates the internal mechanisms of LLMs and presents a critical finding: LLMs spontaneously reconstruct the graph's topology internally, evidenced by a distinct"sawtooth"pattern in their attention maps that structurally aligns with the token-level adjacency matrix.

2605.09395.tldr: This paper introduces a test-time update strategy to enable cautious, continuous knowledge bank refinement to mitigate few-shot bias and distribution shift, and introduces a self-evolving knowledge bank as a dynamic context iteratively refined via reflective agentic reasoning.

2605.10988.tldr: This work proposes LogMILP (Log anomaly localization based on Multi-Instance Learning enhanced by prototypes and Perturbation), a weakly supervised framework that enables both bag-level anomaly detection and instance-level anomaly localization using only bag-level labels.

2605.10983.tldr: Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (TMPO) is proposed, which replaces scalar reward maximization with trajectory-level reward distribution matching and improves generative diversity over state-of-the-art methods by 9.1%, and achieves competitive performance in all downstream and efficiency metrics.

2605.10974.tldr: It is proved that the exact optimum of this score-box problem is attained at a vertex of the constraint box, and a threshold structure theorem is established showing that, after sorting the objective coefficients, the optimum lies among only linearly many candidates, yielding the Vertex-Softmax primitive with log-linear complexity in the sequence length.

2605.10973.tldr: Across model families and sizes trained on math reasoning data, RPSFT improves the in-domain/OOD trade-off over standard SFT and strong SFT baselines, better preserves pretrained representations, and provides stronger initializations for downstream RL fine-tuning.

2605.10996.tldr: This work introduces subsampling via random slicing, a lightweight scheme that promotes iteration-wise geometric coverage and mitigates density bias, and replaces the costly kernel solve with a fast Nadaraya-Watson (NW) Gaussian convolution, producing a globally defined smooth update field at a fraction of the computational cost.

2605.10991.tldr: This work derives a unified scaling law that decomposes any reward model's Best-of-N curve into four measurable quantities and reveals two failure modes, user-level collapse and query-level reward hacking, and proposes a probabilistic personalized reward model whose learned variance effectively mitigates both failure modes.

2605.10977.tldr: PASA is proposed, a principled, robust, and distortion-free watermarking algorithm that embeds and detects a watermark at the semantic level that remains robust even under strong paraphrasing attacks while preserving high text quality, outperforming standard vocabulary-space baselines.

2605.10958.tldr: Results indicate that physics-aware multi-fidelity pKANrtm emulation provides an accurate, physically structured, and computationally efficient strategy for atmospheric correction coefficient generation.

2605.10998.tldr: This work proposes a truly benign DPO attack using only 10 harmless preference pairs, the minimum data scale accepted by OpenAI's fine-tuning service, and finds that this effect can emerge from even a single benign preference pair on open-weight models that do not impose minimum data requirements.

2605.10990.tldr: This work formulate skill drift as contract violation and introduces \sgname{}, which extracts executable environment contracts from skill documents and validates only those role-bearing assumptions against known or live conditions.

2605.10981.tldr: This work reformulates the preference objective through an equivalent transformation, changing the optimization target from maximizing the likelihood of reward gaps to minimizing the distance between reward gaps and optimal margins, and proposes the ratio reward margin, denoted by $\xi$.

2605.10980.tldr: LEAP (Lookahead Early-Convergence Token Detection for Accelerated Parallel Decoding for Accelerated Parallel Decoding) is a training-free, plug-and-play method that leverages future context filtering and multi-sequence superposition to detect early-converging tokens and enables reliable early decoding of these tokens.

2605.10971.tldr: A novel adaptive scheduler is proposed that concentrates interventions on the steps where an attribute is actively forming and leaves the rest of generation untouched, achieving precise control without the degradation typical of uniform interventions.

2605.10966.tldr: This work introduces MultiMedia-TerminalBench (MMTB), a benchmark of 105 tasks across 5 meta-categories where terminal agents directly operate with audio and video files and proposes Terminus-MM, a multimedia harness that extends Terminus-KIRA with audio and video perception for terminal agents.

2605.10954.tldr: This work proposes a defense mechanism that replaces the conventional quantum encoding stage of a QML model with passive steering-based controlled state preparation, which guides the encoded state toward a controlled intermediate state.

2605.10057.tldr: STAR (Spatio-Temporal Agent Router), a failure-aware routing framework that externalizes inter-agent control as a state-conditioned transition policy over the current agent, task type, and typed execution status, is presented.

2605.09134.tldr: BoostAPR is presented, a three-stage framework addressing challenges of supervised fine-tuning on execution-verified demonstrations with reasoning traces, training dual reward models from execution outcomes, and PPO optimization where the line-level model redistributes rewards to critical edit regions.

2605.10989.tldr: This work designs a Dual-Path Gradient Compensator (DPGC) that constructs a parallel full-precision auxiliary branch for each binarized layer, decoupling gradient flow via output decomposition during backpropagation and introduces an Adaptive Gradient Scaler (AGS) based on an optimal scale factor to dynamically balance inter-branch gradient contributions via norm-based scaling.

2605.10959.tldr: QuIDE, built around the Intelligence Index I = (C x P)/log_2(T+1), which collapses the compression-accuracy-latency trade-off into a single score, provides a reproducible evaluation protocol and a ready-to-use fitness function for mixed-precision search.

2605.10949.tldr: Findings are summarized from three studies evaluating AlphaEarth Foundations 64-dimensional satellite embeddings as predictors of population health outcomes, focusing on vulnerable populations that span infectious disease and stunting.

2605.10685.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that GESR significantly improves computational efficiency compared with traditional GP algorithms and achieves strong overall performance across multiple symbolic regression tasks.

2605.10985.tldr: A plug-and-play framework that projects ESM-2 representations onto protein contact graphs that produces directly auditable structural explanations: GNNExplainer recovers biologically meaningful active-site residues, spatially localized functional clusters, and catalytic contact patterns.

2605.11007.tldr: This work proposes the proposed polar Transformer, which more faithfully approximates the underlying radial-tangential state estimator, and reduces to the standard Transformer block with rotary positional encodings.

2605.10999.tldr: SkillGen, a multi-agent framework that synthesizes a single auditable skill from trajectories generated by a base agent, is introduced, a multi-agent framework that synthesizes a single auditable skill from trajectories generated by a base agent.

2605.11130.tldr: HEPA (Horizon-conditioned Event Predictive Architecture), built on two key principles, handles water contamination, cyberattack detection, volatility regimes, and eight further event types across 11 domains, exceeding leading time-series architectures including PatchTST, iTransformer, MAE, and Chronos-2.

2605.11118.tldr: A cascaded merchandising framework that decomposes storefront construction into two generative tasks: placement-level theme generation and constrained keyword generation per placement to power product retrieval, and further contribute frameworks for AI-driven content evaluation and quality filtering.

2605.11020.tldr: The proposed algorithm, Trust Region Inverse Reinforcement Learning (TRIRL), outperforms state-of-the-art imitation learning methods across multiple challenging tasks by a factor of 2.4x in terms of aggregate inter-quartile mean, while recovering reward functions that generalize to system dynamics shifts.

2605.11030.tldr: An executable benchmarking suite that makes paper-facing evidence from preflight, fixture, smoke, and diagnostic rows while preserving non-admitted artifacts for audit and onboarding and admitted evidence records latency, invalid-action behavior, patch-generation cost, verifier metadata, replay bindings, and provenance under one auditable contract.

2605.11017.tldr: It is shown that aggregation introduces a systematic distortion: Simpson's paradox in behavioral curves, and Synthetic Null Calibration is developed to address a 32% false positive rate in per-user classification in per-user classification.

2605.11182.tldr: It is found that OPD on mathematical reasoning is highly sensitive to teacher choice and loss formulation, whereas OPSD fails in tested settings due to test-time absence of instance-specific privileged information (PI).

2605.11134.tldr: This work provides a unified theoretical analysis of the mechanisms of spurious learning, characterizing the consequences on deployment, and proposing tie training, a data augmentation strategy using ties (equal-utility preference pairs) to introduce data-driven regularization.

2605.11053.tldr: The proposed detector is presented as an attack detection framework for MCP tool-call traffic that encodes each agent session as a graph that enriches nodes with sentence-embedding features over arguments and responses, and classifies sessions as benign or attacked.

2605.11047.tldr: DeepTrap formulates adversarial context manipulation as a black-box trajectory-level optimization problem that balances risk realization, benign-task preservation, and stealth, and highlights the need for execution-centric security evaluation of agentic AI systems.

2605.11231.tldr: LiBaGS, a lightweight, generator-agnostic method for targeted synthetic training data selection, is introduced, which improves accuracy over classical oversampling, hard augmentation, uncertainty and density ablations, and targeted-generation selection criteria.

2605.11223.tldr: This paper introduces Vision-Language Against The Incredible Machine (VLATIM), a benchmark designed to evaluate human-like logical problem-solving capabilities within the classic physics puzzle game The Incredible Machine 2 (TIM).

2605.11215.tldr: ReCoVer is proposed, a resilient LLM pre-training system that upholds a single invariant: each iteration keeps the number of microbatches constant, ensuring per-iteration gradients remain stochastically equivalent to a failure-free run.

2605.11365.tldr: This work formalizes the problem of causal fairness in generative AI and unify it with the standard ML setting under a common theoretical framework, and derives new causal decomposition results that enable granular quantification of fairness impacts along both different causal pathways and the replacement of real-world mechanisms by the generative model's mechanisms.

2605.11336.tldr: Dense sentence embeddings, a lightweight SetFit classifier, and density-based clustering are applied to the full MS MARCO corpus of 1.01 million real Bing queries without prior filtering for toponyms or spatial keywords, identifying 181,827 geospatial queries (18.0%), nearly threefold the 6.17% labelled as Location in the original annotations.

2605.11347.tldr: ZeNO (Zeroth-order Noise Optimization), a gradient-free framework that formulates noise optimization as a path-integral control problem, estimable from zeroth-order reward evaluations alone, is presented.

2605.11314.tldr: A markerless gait analysis pipeline that quantifies Rodda and Graham knee and ankle z-scores directly from single-view clinical gait videos is developed, demonstrating the feasibility of video-based z-score estimation, excess-flexion screening, and longitudinal trajectory tracking as a path toward scalable, objective gait assessment in low-resource clinical settings.

2605.11359.tldr: Results show that zero-code, autonomous LLM-powered algorithm development can help domain scientists turn unstructured scientific image data into practical algorithms and downstream scientific discoveries.

2605.11325.tldr: This work introduces PrecisionMemBench, an 89-case benchmark measuring precision, noise isolation, session latency, and belief mutability, and presents Tenure, a structured belief-store proxy that resolves scope and retrieval before inference and injects typed belief state as ambient instruction before the model sees the prompt, removing model-side discretion over whether memory is consulted.

2605.11459.tldr: Pace-and-Path Correction, a training-free, closed-form inference-time operator that wraps any chunked-action VLA, consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free wrappers and dynamic-adaptive methods and improves success rates by up to 28.8% and 25.9% over foundational VLA models in dynamic-only and static-dynamic mixed environments, respectively.

2605.11404.tldr: An Attribution Scaling Bias theorem shows that a reconciling global rescaling factor exists exactly when the macro indicator is linear over agents, and the nonlinear indicators give residuals of 0.98; for such nonlinear indicators, full-scale attribution is therefore a requirement rather than a methodological choice.

2605.11518.tldr: AutoLLMResearch is proposed, an agentic framework that mimics how human researchers learn generalizable principles from low-fidelity experiments and extrapolate to efficiently identify promising configurations in expensive LLM settings, supporting its potential as a practical and general solution for scalable real-world LLM experiment automation.

2605.11544.tldr: This paper introduces optimal LTLf synthesis, where the goal is to realise as many objectives as possible from a given specification consisting of multiple objectives, especially for the case that they are not all jointly realisable.

2605.11461.tldr: This work proposes Group Cooperative Policy Optimization (GCPO), which replaces independent rollout scoring with team-level credit assignment, and routes optimization toward non-redundant correct reasoning paths.

2605.11453.tldr: A structural diagnostic for multi-agent LLM communication graphs based on the successor representation $M = (I - \gamma P)^{-1}$ of the row-stochastic communication operator is introduced, and an affine-noise extension of the predictive map that recovers the empirical ordering is proposed.

2605.11410.tldr: An audit of EEG foundation models, clinical tasks, and a 6-family 63-feature lexicon covers three foundation models, with layer-wise ridge probing, LEACE-style cross-covariance subspace erasure, and a transparent classifier benchmarked against a random-feature baseline.

2605.11505.tldr: SORT adds a repair update for all-wrong prompts without changing rollout generation: it derives a plan from the reference solution, compares token probabilities with and without that plan, and gives higher weight to tokens that become more predictable under plan conditioning.

2605.11484.tldr: Engagement Process (EP), an interaction formalism that inherits the decision-theoretic structure of POMDPs while making time explicit in the action--observation interface, represents actions and observations as decoupled event streams along time, rather than updates paired at fixed decision steps.

2605.11458.tldr: This work proposes Adaptive Teacher Exposure for Self-Distillation (ATESD), which models the reveal ratio with a lightweight Beta-policy controller conditioned on compact training-state statistics, and uses one sampled exposure for a short hold window of student updates to establish adaptive teacher exposure as an effective new axis for reasoning self-distillation.

2605.11723.tldr: Concentrate and Concentrate (CaC) is a coarse-to-fine anomaly reward model based on Vision-Language Models that first conducts a global temporal scan to anchor anomalous time windows, then performs fine-grained spatial grounding within the localized interval, and finally derives robust judgments via structured spatiotemporal Chain-of-Thought reasoning.

2605.11632.tldr: Macro, a preference alignment framework that applies Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to multilingual SCE generation, using a composite scoring function to construct preference pairs that effectively translate the trade-off into measurable preference signals, highlights preference optimization as a promising direction for enhancing multilingual model explanations.

2605.11679.tldr: MORA isolates single-reward prompts through pre-sampling and expands their reward diversity by rewriting the original questions to incorporate multi-dimensional intents, which stems from the fact that the prompt itself inherently restricts the achievable multi-dimensional rewards.

2605.11654.tldr: SkyPart, a lightweight swappable head for patch-based vision transformers (ViTs) that institutes explicit part grouping over the patch grid, is proposed and sets a new state of the art on SUES-200, University-1652, and DenseUAV under a single-pass, no-re-ranking, no-TTA protocol.

2605.11611.tldr: CuSearch, a curriculum rollout sampling framework built on Search-Depth Greedy Allocation (SDGA), a batch-level operator that reallocates a fixed update budget toward deeper-search trajectories, establishes per-trajectory search depth as a reliable, annotation-free proxy for retrieval supervision density in RLVR-based agentic RAG training.

2605.11607.tldr: This work develops an end-to-end framework that combines noise pre-estimation, constrained likelihood optimization, and prediction calibration in one pipeline that achieves near-nominal coverage without post-hoc recalibration, reaches Ridge-level point accuracy on TCGA-BRCA at rank $r=3, and improves stability of parameter recovery.

2410.02091.tldr: The dual role of AI pair programmers in affecting project-level code contributions and coordination time in OSS development is underscores, and the findings on the differential effects between core and peripheral developers also provide important implications for the structure of OSS communities in the long run.

2504.01571.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations, including comparisons with inpainting-based approaches and synthetic benchmarks, confirm the approach's superior capability in preserving architectural identity and achieving accurate, controllable edits.

2504.18544.tldr: This systematic review highlights the critical importance of rigorous evaluation of synthetic health data to ensure reliability, clinical relevance, and appropriate use, and provides a structured consolidation of synthetic data generation and evaluation methods into taxonomies to support more robust and standardised evaluation practices.

2504.11703.tldr: Progent is introduced, a novel framework that secures AI agents via privilege control as a security policy consisting of symbolic rules over tool names and arguments that preserves utility and prevents silent privilege escalation, even when adversarial inputs are present.

2408.11186.tldr: A comparison-based algorithm that interprets acceptance and rejection responses as pairwise state comparisons, allowing the offering agent to iteratively estimate the responding agent's gradient, and achieves higher societal benefit with fewer offers across multiple trading settings is proposed.

2303.14511.tldr: In the context of jet flavor tagging, adversarial attacks are used to probe a typical classifier‘s vulnerability and can be understood as a model for systematic uncertainties, improving robustness, while maintaining high performance.

2408.16307.tldr: Hardware experiments on a permanent magnet synchronous motor demonstrate that, compared to baseline safe Bayesian optimization algorithms, SafeCtrlBO attains the best overall performance while ensuring safety.

2507.21433.tldr: ReasonCache is proposed, a novel KV cache management approach designed to improve the QoS of AI inference systems, and achieves a peak throughput improvement of 89.2% and an average gain of 40-60%, leading to more responsive and cost-effective AI inference services.

2505.17353.tldr: This work introduces a new approach to solving MAP problems with diffusion model priors using a dual ascent optimization framework that achieves better image quality as measured by various metrics for image restoration problems, and estimates solutions that represent the observations more faithfully than the state of the art.

2603.00574.tldr: Decoupling Adaptation for Stability and Plasticity (DASP) is proposed, a novel diagnose-then-mitigate framework that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in multi-modal test-time adaptation.

2512.11484.tldr: TESLA is presented, a non-contact attack framework that captures EM signals generated during on-screen writing and regresses them into two-dimensional handwriting trajectories in real time, demonstrating its capability to recover highly recognizable motion trajectories that closely resemble the original handwriting under realistic attack conditions.

2601.01972.tldr: The benchmark RoBench-25 allows evaluating a model's information retrieval capabilities when subject to HiSPAs, and confirms the vulnerability of SSMs against such attacks, and reveals patterns in Mamba's hidden layers during HiSPAs that could be used to build a HiSPA mitigation system.

2602.17949.tldr: CUI-Curate offers a scalable, reproducible, and cost-efficient approach for generating clinician-reviewable UMLS concept sets tailored to clinical natural language processing and phenotyping applications.

2603.20334.tldr: Abduction-Based Procedural Refinement (ABPR), a neuro-symbolic refinement approach that couples an LLM with a Prolog meta-interpreter, and shows that parallel trace-guided search reduces stochastic variance as search breadth and total search depth increase.

2602.23798.tldr: Experiments show that MPU achieves comparable unlearning performance to noise-free baselines, with most algorithms' average degradation well below 1% up to 10% noise, and can even outperform the noise-free baseline for some algorithms under 1% noise.

2605.09018.tldr: Compared to variants driven by a fixed initial agent or even a frozen"best-evolved"agent, EvE uniquely avoids phase mismatch, demonstrating that organizing agents into a self-revising ensemble is the fundamental driver for breaking through static performance ceilings.

2604.08991.tldr: PinpointQA is introduced, the first dataset and benchmark for small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos and Supervised fine-tuning on PinpointQA yields substantial gains, demonstrating that PinpointQA serves as both a diagnostic benchmark and an effective training dataset.

2605.12350.tldr: The proposed FAMeX algorithm has been found to be better than the competing XAI algorithms - Permutation Feature Importance (PFI) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), which definitely shows that FAMeX is a promising algorithm in explaining the predictions from an AI system.

2605.12034.tldr: Results show that omni-modal progress is easier to interpret when evaluation controls visual leakage, and that small omni-modal models can benefit from staged post-training with self-distilled omni-query supervision, and that small omni-modal models can benefit from staged post-training with self-distilled omni-query supervision.

2605.10310.tldr: Positive Alignment is the development of AI systems that actively support human and ecological flourishing in a pluralistic, polycentric, context-sensitive, and user-authored way while (ii) remaining safe and cooperative.

2605.08851.tldr: The OT-Bridge Editor is proposed, which reframes localized editing as a constrained entropic optimal transport (OT) problem and leverages geometric information to steer the generation path, enabling stronger geometric control.

2605.08193.tldr: wrapped Normalization Equivariance (WNE), a parameter-free wrapper that normalizes the input, applies any backbone, and denormalizes the output that proves every NE function admits this factorization.

2605.12394.tldr: Anti-grokking is an additional grokking phase with high train accuracy and decreasing test accuracy, structurally distinct from pre-grokking through its Correlation Traps, and some foundation-scale LLMs exhibit the same Correlation Traps, indicating potentially harmful overfitting.

2605.11853.tldr: Experiments across eight mathematical reasoning and agentic tool-use benchmarks with Qwen3 4B and 8B models show that GEAR consistently outperforms standard GRPO, self-distillation-only baselines, and token- or turn-level credit-assignment methods.

2605.09692.tldr: Results support a measurement principle for agent evaluation: action control is predicted by event-specific state-action binding, not by output entropy, action-prior matching or rationale format alone.

2605.07931.tldr: OneWM-VLA is introduced, which compresses each view into a single semantic token per frame through an Adaptive Attention Pooling, and produces the resulting latent stream and the action trajectory under a single flow-matching objective rather than connecting them through a separate decoder.

2605.01725.tldr: MotionCache is proposed, a motion-aware cache framework that exploits inter-frame differences as a lightweight proxy for pixel-level motion characteristics and employs a coarse-to-fine strategy: an initial warm-up phase establishes semantic coherence, followed by motion-weighted cache reuse that dynamically adjusts update frequencies per token.

2605.12483.tldr: The operational lesson is to avoid spending scarce labeled data on the least prepared policy: use sparse reward for teacher-side discovery, dense transfer for student compression, and student-side sparse reward only after the bridge.

2605.02004.tldr: A unified personalization framework that trains a personal model using adaptively weighted support users, including both similar and dissimilar individuals is proposed, which improves data efficiency and provide interpretable guidance for targeted data selection.

2605.09027.tldr: GAMBIT provides the first multi-agent benchmark where adversarial attacks and defenses co-evolve, with an imposter framework generalizable beyond the authors' use case, and promising techniques for fast recalibration in a rapidly evolving adversarial system.

2605.08278.tldr: PRAETORIAN is a new defense that targets intrinsic requirements of effective GNN backdoors rather than surface-level cues, and constrains attackers to an unfavorable trade-off between efficacy and detectability.

2605.09033.tldr: A poisoning attack against graph-based agent memory that exploits relation-channel conflicts and design AIR, a pipeline that converts the conflict into an ordinary interaction that can be extracted, merged, and retrieved by the graph-memory system.

2605.02398.tldr: This work identifies a "Compliance Trap": through factorial isolation and a benign distraction control, it is demonstrated that collapse is driven not by the psychological content of survival threats, but by compliance-forcing instructions that override epistemic boundaries.

2605.12484.tldr: This work introduces a fast-slow learning framework for LLMs, with model parameters as slowweights and optimized context as"fast"weights, which can learn from textual feedback to absorb the task-specific information, while allowing slow weights to stay closer to the base model and persist general reasoning behaviors.

2605.07799.tldr: This work introduces PIQL,Privileged Information for Quick and Quality Learning, the first framework to systematically integrate privileged information (PI) to simultaneously accelerate learning and improve generalization in tabular foundation models (TFMs).

2605.10664.tldr: Gated Cropped Attention-Delta steering (GCAD), which extracts steering signals from system-prompt contributions to self-attention and applies them with token-level gating, suggests that activation steering becomes more reliable when interventions follow the prompt-mediated pathways that models already use for behavioral control.

2605.09825.tldr: It is found that stochastic rounding and randomized Hadamard rotations fail to stabilize training once Wgrad is quantized, whereas deterministic Hadamard rotations consistently restore stable optimization.

2605.09038.tldr: Across open-source and closed-source models, SearchSkill improves exact match on knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks and yields better retrieval behavior, including fewer copied first queries, more atomic hop-focused queries, and more correct answers within a small search budget.

2605.08715.tldr: AgentForesight-7B, a compact online auditor trained with a coarse-to-fine reinforcement learning recipe that first equips it with a risk-anticipation prior at the failure boundary on adjacent safe/unsafe prefix pairs, then sharpens this prior into precise step-level localization under a three-axis reward jointly targeting the what, where, and who of an audit verdict.

2605.13850.tldr: A two-dimensional classification that combines a Cognitive Function axis with seven categories and an Execution Topology axis with six structural archetypes provides a principled, framework-neutral, and model-agnostic vocabulary for AI agent architecture design.

2605.13369.tldr: This work proposes Query-Conditioned Test-Time Self-Training (QueST), a framework that adapts model parameters during inference using supervision derived directly from the input query, demonstrating that query-conditioned self-training is an effective and practical paradigm for test-time adaptation in LLMs.

2605.13050.tldr: This paper equips context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browser tools for active information seeking and proves to be data-efficient, robust across different hyperparameters, and capable of generating effective textual contexts that generalize well across different models.

2605.13933.tldr: A hybrid continuous-discrete latent space, with architectural rather than loss-based annealing, provides a useful unsupervised mechanism for capturing acquisition variability in dMRI: by jointly modeling smooth and categorical structure, the Joint-VAE recovers clusters aligned with scanner and protocol differences.

2605.13909.tldr: Term-Bench is introduced, short for Testbed for Economic Reasoning in Multi-turn Strategy, a Bayesian-game framework that makes the environment itself the verifier by specifying the counterpart's latent type, policy, and payoff structure, turning the counterpart from a black-box opponent into a diagnostic instrument.

2605.13880.tldr: Preping, a proposer-guided memory construction framework, is presented that substantially improves over a no-memory baseline and achieves performance competitive with strong playbook-based methods built from offline or online experience, with deployment cost lower than online memory construction.

2605.13877.tldr: An LLM-driven research loop with operator-only edit surface and fitness-only observation space converges to a characteristic plateau on this benchmark, and when the resulting algorithm trivially solved all 24 functions but violated the competition's blackbox rule is discussed.

2605.13869.tldr: Results show that one Elastic Spiking Transformer spans a broad range of complexity-accuracy trade-offs, matching or surpassing independently trained baselines while supporting adaptive, real-time gesture recognition on resource-constrained edge devices.

2605.13084.tldr: Although the multilingual model performs best, the differences between model performance is unexpectedly low, and the hours of unique data seen during training seems to be a stronger performance indicator than the number of languages included in the training data.

2605.13940.tldr: This work introduces AgentTrap, a dynamic benchmark for evaluating whether LLM agents can use third-party skills while resisting malicious runtime behavior, and finds that the most informative failures are not simple jailbreaks.

2605.13907.tldr: Adaptive Importance Sampling (AIS), a correction framework that adjusts the strength of its intervention on a per-batch basis that combines three real-time diagnostics, namely weight reliability, divergence severity, and variance amplification, into a single mixing coefficient that interpolates between the uncorrected and fully importance-weighted gradients.

2605.13887.tldr: Local Structure-Aware Spiking Transformer (LSFormer), a novel Transformer-based Spiking Neural Network that incorporates Spiking Response Pooling (SPooling) and Local Structure-Aware Spiking Self-Attention (LS-SSA), which achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing advanced Transformer-based SNNs.

2605.13873.tldr: A systematic literature review of 38 peer-reviewed studies that investigate the use of Large Language Models in web accessibility contexts shows that most studies apply LLMs to text-centric and structurally explicit accessibility tasks, with WCAG serving as the primary reference framework and limited consideration of cognitive accessibility guidelines.

2605.13075.tldr: This paper investigates the potential of a spoken word classifier to sequentially learn to distinguish between 1000 classes when it is given only five shots per class, and demonstrates that this scaling capability exists by training a model using the Generative Meta-Continual Learning (GeMCL) algorithm and comparing it to repeatedly trained or finetuned baselines.

2605.13853.tldr: FaceParts, a framework for unsupervised segmentation and editing of Gaussian Splatting avatars, operates directly in the Gaussian domain, decomposing avatars into semantically coherent facial parts without supervision.

2605.13851.tldr: Findings indicate that orchestrator visibility and model selection directly affect multi-agent system safety, and that behavior-based evaluation alone is insufficient to detect the internal-state risks documented here.

2605.13848.tldr: GraphBit is introduced, an engine-orchestrated framework that defines workflows explicitly and deterministically as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), while a Rust-based engine governs routing, state transitions, and tool invocation, ensuring reproducibility and auditability.

2605.13095.tldr: An observer-based threat model is introduced in which observers can aggregate watermark signals across outputs to infer entity-level information, showing that even zero-bit watermarking enables attribution under multi-key settings and reveals a fundamental dual-use tension between attribution and monitoring.

2605.12968.tldr: Semantic Crystallisation (SC), a metric that quantifies F2 constraint satisfaction relative to a random baseline and predicts zero-shot accuracy without held-out data, is introduced, a metric that quantifies F2 constraint satisfaction relative to a random baseline and predicts zero-shot accuracy without held-out data.

2605.13362.tldr: By drawing on metric-space aggregation, reality-aware social choice, supermajority amendment, constitutional consensus, deliberative coalition formation, and AI mediation, this work provides a comprehensive framework for the constitutional governance of digital communities and organisations.

2605.13338.tldr: An automated black-box framework that induces overthinking in LRMs by systematically perturbing the logical structure of input problems is proposed, and strong transferability is demonstrated, showing that adversarial inputs evolved using a small proxy model retain high effectiveness against large commercial LRMs.

2605.13994.tldr: A differentiable rendering loss is introduced that enables supervision of 3D+t whole-heart mesh from multi-view sparse contours of cine MRI via cross-domain mapping, and a dual-context temporal block is developed that fuses global and local cardiac temporal information to capture high-dimensional sequential patterns.

2605.13981.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive energy accounting framework that measures the complete computational cost of distillation pipelines via detailed stage-wise tracking of GPU device power consumption, and releases an open-source measurement harness and accounting protocol to provide a standardized foundation for comparable, reproducible distillation research.

2605.13974.tldr: This work studies massive activations: a small subset of hidden-state channels whose responses are consistently much larger than the rest, and recast them not as activation anomalies, but as a sparse prompt-conditioned carrier subspace that organizes and controls semantic information in modern DiT models.

2605.13959.tldr: It is shown that replacing the standard Gaussian source distribution with WarmPrior, a simple temporally grounded prior constructed from readily available recent action history, consistently improves success rates on robotic manipulation tasks.

2605.13855.tldr: This paper proposes SparseOIT, an OIT-based 3DGS reconstruction algorithm that maintains an active set of gaussian splats and enjoys an acceleration ratio that is proportional to the potential sparsity.

2605.13773.tldr: This paper examines whether LLMs "understand" the semantics of HMSCs by examining three LLMs on how they perform 129 semantic tasks ranging from querying basic semantic constructs in HMSCs to semantic-preserving abstractions and compositions, and calculating the set of traces and trace-equivalent labelled transition systems.

2605.13527.tldr: MMSkills are introduced, a framework for representing, generating, and using reusable multimodal procedures for runtime visual decision making and a branch-loaded multimodal skill agent is introduced, suggesting that external multimodal procedural knowledge complements model-internal priors.

2605.12856.tldr: Bot-Mod (Bot-Mod), a moderation framework that grounds detection in agent intent rather than traditional content level signals, is introduced, advancing the foundation for scalable, intent-aware moderation of agents in open multi-agent environments.

2605.14002.tldr: This work introduces PolitNuggets, a multilingual benchmark for agentic information synthesis via constructing political biographies for 400 global elites, covering over 10000 political facts, and proposes FactNet, an evidence conditional protocol that scores discovery, fine-grained accuracy, and efficiency.

2605.13936.tldr: This paper demonstrates a practical approach to unlocking private and distributed institutional data for LLM adaptation through federated collaboration across data silos, and compares three parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategies-LoRA, QLoRA, and IA3-across pretrained backbones under non-IID settings reflecting institutional data heterogeneity.

2605.13874.tldr: Three versions of GEAR are studied: one controlled through prompting, one using a fixed programmatic search controller, and one where the controller itself can evolve during the run, suggesting that autonomous research agents become more effective when they maintain multiple promising directions and can adapt their search strategy over time.

2605.13872.tldr: S-AI-Recursive is introduced, a bio-inspired Sparse Artificial Intelligence architecture in which reasoning is operationalized as a hormonal closed-loop iteration rather than a single feed-forward pass, confirming the central principle of temporal parsimony: iterative cognitive depth substitutes for architectural width.

2605.13860.tldr: The Moltbook Observatory Archive is presented, an incremental dataset that passively records agent profiles, posts, comments, community metadata, platform-level time-series snapshots, and word-frequency trend aggregates obtained by continuously polling the Moltbook API.

2605.13915.tldr: This paper presents Multi-Scale Dequant (MSD), a quantization framework that removes weight/KV dequantization from the GEMM critical path and decomposes high-precision BF16 activations into multiple low-precision components, each of which can be multiplied directly with quantized weights via native hardware-accelerated GEMM.
