2605.13997.tldr: On three open-weight Sparse MoE backbones under aggressive expert reduction, HodgeCover matches state-of-the-art learning-free baselines on the expert-reduction axis, leads on the aggressive-compression frontier of the hybrid axis, and uniquely balances retained mass across all four Hodge components.

2605.13941.tldr: This work presents EvolveMem, a self-evolving memory architecture that exposes its full retrieval configuration as a structured action space optimized by an LLM-powered diagnosis module, and realizes an AutoResearch process that autonomously conducts iterative research cycles on its own architecture, replacing manual configuration tuning.

2605.13916.tldr: Experiments validate that DOMT consistently curtails empirical weighted regret, achieving an order-optimal sublinear mitigation of threshold depletion to navigate the non-stationary Pareto frontier.

2605.13905.tldr: This work presents a non-destructive methodological framework achieving AI-driven pharmacoinformatics readiness without altering legacy source code, offering a regulation-aware path to AI-integrated clinical reporting, accelerating drug development without interrupting regulatory submissions.

2605.13861.tldr: This work studies news propagation from a spectral view by connecting graph spectra to propagation-related structural properties through rigorous spectral bounds, and introduces several new bounds and integrates them with existing ones into a unified spectral representation of information propagation.

2605.13859.tldr: BiSpikCLM, the first fully binary spiking MatMul-free causal language model, introduces Softmax-Free Spiking Attention (SFSA) and Spike-Aware Alignment Distillation (SpAD), which aligns ANN teacher and SNN student across embeddings, attention maps, intermediate features, and output logits.

2605.13789.tldr: Ensembits is introduced, the first tokenizer of protein conformational ensembles, which enables Ensembits to predict dynamics token from one single predicted structure, which alleviates dynamics data sparsity.

2605.13276.tldr: D-VLA, a high-concurrency, low-latency distributed RL framework for large-scale embodied foundation models, introduces"Plane Decoupling,"physically isolating high-frequency training data from low-frequency weight control to eliminate interference between simulation and optimization.

2605.13213.tldr: HAM is introduced, a Hierarchical Attack framework for multi-modal multi-agent systems that decomposes attacks into three interconnected layers that achieves an Attack Success Rate of up to 78.3%, with reasoning-layer attacks being the most effective.

2605.13137.tldr: LeanSearch v2 is presented, a two-mode retrieval system for this task, outperforming strong reasoning retrieval systems and premise-selection baselines on the same benchmark, and confirming that retrieval quality propagates to proof generation.

2605.13126.tldr: The Multi-Label Graph Information Bottleneck (MLGIB) is proposed, which formulates multi-label message passing as constrained information transmission under irrelevant label noise and derives tractable variational bounds, which lead to an end-to-end label-aware message-passing architecture.

2605.14163.tldr: It is proved that coverage can be amplified by repeated sampling, but cannot by itself create useful critics or comparators; reliable amplification requires an additional local soundness signal, such as execution, proof checking, type checking, tests, or constraint solving.

2605.14215.tldr: This work introduces GenCircuit-RL, a reinforcement learning framework built around hierarchical verification rewards that decompose correctness into five levels, from code execution to task-specific topological checks, and a four-stage curriculum that shifts optimization pressure from code generation to functional reasoning.

2605.14175.tldr: A runtime verifier is closed with a runtime verifier that maintains an explicit dependency graph: an LLM classifies each turn into one of 8 update operations drawn from four formalisms drawn from four formalisms, and a symbolic engine records which claims depend on which evidence.

2605.14126.tldr: An end-to-end post-training pipeline is presented that reliably improves multi-turn reasoning over structured clinical graphs on FHIR as a sequential decision-making problem over a queryable structured graph.

2605.14117.tldr: This work introduces a text-based floor plan generation approach that fine-tunes a large language model (LLM) on real plans and then applies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to improve adherence to topological and numerical constraints while discouraging invalid or overlapping outputs.

2605.14066.tldr: This work proposes the first benchmark for speech-based EarlyPD detection, with a speaker-independent split designed for fair and replicable cross-method evaluation on researcher-accessible datasets, and presents multi-dimensional evaluation breakdowns by dataset, aggregation level, gender, and disease stage.

2605.14061.tldr: MathAtlas is introduced, the first large-scale autoformalization benchmark of in the wild graduate-level mathematics, containing ~52k theorems, definitions, exercises, examples, and proofs extracted from 103 graduate mathematics textbooks, and is the first autoformalization benchmark to include such relations, facilitating evaluation and development of dependency-aware autoformalization systems.

2605.14054.tldr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning framework that improves perception-reasoning synergy by reliably rewarding the perception fidelity, and introduces Perception Verification (PV), leveraging a"blindfolded reasoning"proxy to reward perceptual fidelity independently of reasoning outcomes.

2605.14053.tldr: Derivation Prompting is introduced, a novel prompting technique for the generation step of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework that significantly reduces unacceptable answers compared to traditional RAG and long-context window methods.

2605.14038.tldr: A model-adaptive definition of tool-necessity is introduced, grounded in each model's empirical performance, and results reveal a knowing-doing gap in LLM tool-use: improving tool-use reliability requires not only better recognition of when tools are needed, but also better translation of that recognition into action.

2605.14236.tldr: This work reframe PRP reranking as active learning from noisy pairwise comparisons and shows that active rankers are drop-in replacements that improve NDCG@10 per call in the call-constrained regime.

2605.14073.tldr: AttnGen, an attention-guided training framework that embeds interpretability directly into the optimization process, is presented, suggesting that attention-guided masking not only improves classification performance but also reshapes how models distribute importance across sequence positions.

2605.14062.tldr: Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection (MSIFR), a lightweight, training-free framework that detects and terminates low-quality generation trajectories at intermediate checkpoints before they reach full completion, provides a practical mechanism for improving the efficiency of LLM-based synthetic data generation without additional training or architectural changes.

2605.14237.tldr: The LOOP SKILL ENGINE is presented, a system that achieves a combined 99% success rate and 99% token reduction for periodic agent tasks through a one-shot recording, deterministic replay paradigm, and proves two theorems: Replay Determinism and Write Safety.

2605.14217.tldr: PreFT (Prefill-only Finetuning), wherein the adapter is only applied to prefill tokens and discard it afterwards, validates prefill-only adaptation of LLMs as a more favourable accuracy-throughput tradeoff than existing PEFTs for personalised serving.

2605.14211.tldr: It is demonstrated that self-improving agents are a scalable recipe for long-horizon embodied learning, and ASH, an agentic system that learns an embodied policy from unlabeled, noisy internet video, without reward shaping or expert annotation is introduced.

2605.14192.tldr: By reinforcing question-constrained evidence grounding, this work reshape internal routing so that answer generation remains guided by the question, leading to more effective integration of retrieved information and fewer errors.

2605.14164.tldr: It is argued that highlighted benchmarks function less as standardized measurement tools and more as flexible narrative devices prioritizing market positioning over scientific evaluation, leading to a fragmented evaluation landscape with limited cross-model comparability.

2605.14153.tldr: This work presents ExploitBench, a capability-graded benchmark that decomposes exploitation into 16 measurable flags, and results suggest that exploit construction against hardened targets is an emerging frontier capability.

2605.14113.tldr: ProtoMedAgent is introduced, a framework that formalizes multimodal clinical reporting as an iterative, zero-gradient test-time optimization problem over a strict neuro-symbolic bottleneck and leverages a binding $\ell$-diversity phase transition to systematically reduce artifact-level membership inference risks.

2605.14141.tldr: It is proved that the empirically fastest sample-consistent solver generalizes in both correctness and runtime over fixed solver libraries, and that identifiable hints can be recovered from polynomially many samples, and suggested LLM agents can discover distribution-specific computational shortcuts and compile them into efficient solver code.

2605.14033.tldr: A finite sheaf-theoretic framework for detecting theory-shift candidates through transport and obstruction, to isolate a finite diagnostic subproblem for AI agents: detecting when representational transport fails and extension becomes the coherent next move.

2605.14212.tldr: MetaAgent-X is introduced, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that jointly optimizes automatic MAS design and execution and establishes end-to-end trainable automatic MAS as a practical paradigm for building self-designing and self-executing agentic models.

2605.14133.tldr: ClawForge is presented, a generator-backed benchmark framework for executable command-line workflows under state conflict that evaluates agents step by step over persistent workflow surfaces using normalized end state and observable side effects rather than exact trajectory matching.

2605.14202.tldr: This work introduces two strategies, Guided and GuidedFewShot, that embed a mutation taxonomy from prior robustness testing research as domain context, and finds that GuidedFewShot achieves the highest single-run coverage on both systems while maintaining low cross-model similarity.

2605.14004.tldr: Conditional Attribute Transformers is introduced, a novel method for jointly estimating the next-token probability and the value of an attribute conditional on each potential next token selection that achieves state of the art performance on sparse reward tasks, improves next-token prediction at sufficient model sizes, and estimates attribute probabilities orders of magnitude faster than sampling.

2605.14111.tldr: Across simulated scenarios spanning short to long horizons, it is shown that attention-guided planning supports stable decision-making without complete state reasoning, and that attention-guided, satisficing strategies can reduce problem complexity while maintaining stable performance.

2605.14089.tldr: SkillFlow is a flow-based framework that takes a trainable Supervisor as the agent and a structured environment with dynamic skill library and frozen executor, automating task orchestration through multi-turn interaction and significantly outperforms baselines across question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and real-world interactive decision making tasks.

2605.14051.tldr: SPIN is a planning wrapper that combines validated Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) planning with prefix based execution control, and improves planning, grounding, and dependency related scores for both GPT OSS1 and Llama 4 Maverick.

2605.14036.tldr: This work proposes a principled method of reasoning that is efficient enough to be practical for large language models and articulate its advantages in terms of Robust Logic, a system for performing principled chaining on learned, and hence uncertain, information.

2605.14026.tldr: Experiments confirm that R2R2 effectively mitigates overfitting and extends the state-of-the-art SimbaV2, which originally lacks SPL by integrating a tailored SPL module, termed SimbaV2-SPL, which itself establishes a new state-of-the-art.

2605.14231.tldr: Extensive experiments show that AudioMosaic achieves state-of-the-art performance on several standard audio benchmarks under both linear probing and fine-tuning and that integrating the pretrained AudioMosaic encoder into audio-language models improves performance on audio-language tasks.

2605.14210.tldr: A fine-grained CBM framework that grounds each concept in localized visual evidence, enabling direct inspection of where and how concepts are encoded, enhancing the trustworthiness of CBMs and establishing a principled mechanism for human-model interaction at the concept level.

2605.14177.tldr: This work introduces Prospection-Guided Retrieval (PGR), which decouples retrieval from how memories are stored, and introduces MemoryQuest, a challenging multi-session benchmark in which each query is annotated with 3--5 dated reference facts subject to a low query-reference similarity constraint.

2605.14167.tldr: Epistematics is introduced, a methodology for deriving evaluation criteria directly from technical capability claims and auditing whether proposed benchmarks can discriminate the claimed capability from proxy behaviors, and a proposal that revises the dominant paradigm's theoretical assumptions at the architectural level while reproducing them in its evaluation criteria.

2605.14034.tldr: A novel value-based framework that employs GraphRAG to convert principles into value-based instructions and steer the agent to behave as expected by retrieving the suitable instruction upon a specific conversation context, providing a basis for the emergence of self-emotion in AI systems.

2605.14021.tldr: A large-scale longitudinal measurement study, issuing 55,393 trending queries across 19 topical categories over a 40-day window (March 13 - April 21, 2026), document a rapid transformation of the online information ecosystem whose consequences for epistemic security remain poorly understood.

2605.14220.tldr: It is shown that small token-level numerical disagreements can independently cause training collapse, and that TIM is not benign numerical noise, but a systems-level perturbation that should be treated as a first-order factor in analyzing LLM RL stability.

2605.14218.tldr: It is shown that a vector generalization of fusion-fission group dynamics observed in living and active-matter systems drives -- and can forecast -- future shifts in the AI's behavior.

2605.14205.tldr: SimPersona is introduced, a novel framework that learns discrete buyer types from historical traffic and exposes them to LLM-based web agents as compact persona tokens and achieves conversion-rate alignment with real buyers, exhibits interpretable behavioral variation across buyer types, and outperforms a baseline with more parameters on goal-oriented shopping tasks.

2605.14108.tldr: A two-tier edge-cloud cascade on the public APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection dataset that cuts cloud use by about half with a modest drop in grading performance and addresses the challenges of high latency, limited bandwidth, and high data transmission costs.

2605.14055.tldr: This work proposes a Parameter-Efficient Multi-task Learning (\PM), which employs a neural architecture engineering method for optimizing the continuous prompts while also performing low-rank adaption for model weights, and prototype PEML is prototype by creating an automated framework for optimizing the continuous prompts and adapting model weights.

2605.14049.tldr: This proposal presents a neuro-symbolic approach to legal AI that combines the expressive power of large language models with the rigor of formal verification, aiming to make AI-assisted legal reasoning both capable and trustworthy, thus reducing the burden of manual verification without sacrificing the accountability that legal practice demands.

2605.14358.tldr: Theoretically, theoretically, the existence of minimal sufficient subsets, local irreducibility guarantees for greedy elimination, and certificates of overcompleteness and sparse necessity are established.

2605.14291.tldr: This work proposes MMGuard to empower data owners to proactively protect their multimodal data against unauthorized LVLM fine-tuning, and demonstrates effective, stealthy, and robust protection under white-box, gray-box, and black-box threat models.

2605.14423.tldr: A federated actor-critic framework in which agents share a common linear subspace representation while maintaining personalized local policy components, and agents iteratively estimate the common subspace, local critic heads, and local policies is considered.

2605.14418.tldr: A new metric and two new frameworks (CAS-eval and CAS-gen) are proposed and it is shown that an attack can have an ASR drop of up to 30 percentage points when a jailbreak prompt needs to succeed on more than one attempt.

2605.14407.tldr: This work identifies a class of tasks, named for the Greek concept of metis, that are performed entirely on computers yet resist reliable AI automation, and proposes five structural characteristics that define the Metis AI zone: consequential irreversibility, relational irreducibility, normative open texture, adversarial co-evolution, and accountability anchoring.

2605.14398.tldr: An agentic framework constructing physics-based world models through executable simulation code that outperforms advanced video-based models in physical accuracy, instruction fidelity and visual quality, which could be applied to various scenarios including driving simulation and embodied robot tasks.

2605.14368.tldr: Results suggest that hidden-state geometry helps identify where diffusion-based replacement is feasible inside pretrained language models, and that hidden-state recovery improves over continuous diffusion baselines in a diagnostic comparison matching the diffusion/recovery training budget.

2605.14323.tldr: Dynamic Latent Routing is proposed, a language-model post-training method that jointly learns discrete latent codes, routing policies, and model parameters through dynamic search in a single training stage and matches or outperforms supervised fine-tuning across four datasets and six models.

2605.14322.tldr: EduAgentBench is the first theory-grounded and realistic benchmark for evaluating the holistic teaching capability of tutor agents, providing a measurement foundation for developing future tutor agents that can support realistic teaching work.

2605.14318.tldr: It is suggested that semantic feature segmentation provides an interpretable and information-preserving decomposition of monitoring signals, enabling competitive predictive performance without sacrificing the operational interpretability required in predictive maintenance applications.

2605.14267.tldr: This work fine-tune pre-trained DMs for dynamic resolution priors and adapt DPS and DAPS, which are two widely used pixel-space methods for general image restoration tasks, into the proposed framework, yielding methods referred to as SubDPS and SubDAPS, respectively.

2605.14261.tldr: This work parameterizes the heuristic value function of AIVAT to highlight AIVAT's potential vulnerabilities and shows how the heuristic uncertainty can be propagated to quantify the uncertainty of AIVAT estimates.

2605.14252.tldr: This work proposes Selective Alignment Knowledge Distillation (SeAl-KD), which selectively aligns class-level and temporal knowledge by equalizing competing logits at erroneous timesteps and reweighting temporal alignment based on confidence and inter-timestep similarity.

2605.14416.tldr: A knowledge-embedded framework inspired by the Route-First Cluster-Second heuristics that achieves superior solution quality compared with state-of-the-art learning-based methods, with a smaller gap to classical heuristics, demonstrating strong generalization across diverse CVRP variants.

2605.14401.tldr: This work proposes MARS (Memory-Augmented Agentic Recommender System), a framework that treats recommendation as a partially observable problem and maintains a structured belief state that progressively abstracts noisy behavioral observations into a compact estimate of user preferences.

2605.14355.tldr: Herculean is introduced, the first skilled benchmark for agentic financial intelligence spanning four representative workflows, including Trading, Hedging, Market Insights, and Auditing, and points to a key gap in current agents in turning financial reasoning into dependable workflow execution in high-stakes financial workflows.

2605.14344.tldr: The proposed CrystalReasoner (CrysReas), an end-to-end LLM framework that generates crystal structures from natural language instructions through reasoning and alignment, demonstrates the potential of leveraging thinking traces and RL for generating valid, stable, and property-conditioned crystal structures.

2605.14331.tldr: Simulations under 3GPP specifications show that analog RF computing can significantly reduce client-side energy consumption by nearly two orders of magnitude compared to digital computing, while mixed-precision inference requires even lower energy consumption than uniform-precision inference.

2605.14297.tldr: The structure of the mixed gradient is characterized, showing that its cross term -- which captures how continuous actions influence future discrete decisions -- becomes negligible near a discrete best response, thereby enabling approximate decentralized updates of the continuous and discrete components and reducing variance near optimality.

2605.14277.tldr: This paper presents a generalized parallelization framework, reframing CFR as a series of linear algebra operations, and describes how this technique can be applied to other tabular members of the CFR family of algorithms, including the state-of-the-art, such as CFR+, discounted CFR, and predictive variants of CFR.

2605.14269.tldr: This work proposes PhyMotion, a structured, fine-grained motion reward that grounds recovered 3D human trajectories in a physics simulator and evaluates motion quality along multiple dimensions of physical feasibility, and shows that PhyMotion achieves stronger correlation with human judgments than existing reward formulations.

2605.14242.tldr: An AI-based FHrCTG model is developed specifically for FHR monitoring, which effectively mitigates noise interference and precisely reconstructs signals, and demonstrates high sensitivity and specificity in detecting critical FHR decelerations and accelerations.

2605.14389.tldr: Nexus is a multi-agent forecasting framework that decomposes prediction into specialized stages: isolating macro-level and micro-level temporal fluctuations, and integrating contextual information when available before synthesizing a final forecast.

2605.14426.tldr: PRISMA (Precipitation Inference from Satellite Modalities via generAtive modeling), a plug-and-play latent generative framework for multi-sensor precipitation estimation, provides an extensible and efficient framework for multi-sensor precipitation estimation.

2605.14420.tldr: DVMap (High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping), a framework for fine-grained pluralistic value alignment, is proposed, demonstrating strong generalization and robustness.

2605.14386.tldr: The Darwin Family demonstrates that diagnostic-guided evolutionary merging is a practical and reproducible alternative to costly post-training pipelines for reasoning-centric language models.

2605.14379.tldr: A multi-agent starting-state sampling strategy designed to substantially accelerate online exploration in regularized policy-gradient game methods for two-player zero-sum games and a new set of benchmark environments that drastically increase exploration challenges and state counts in existing OpenSpiel games while keeping exploitability measurements analytically tractable.

2605.14373.tldr: This work proposes Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD), a deterministic, sample-efficient, and budget-aware ZO optimizer, and demonstrates that CoCD significantly outperforms BCCD in terms of sample efficiency and convergence loss/accuracy, and exhibits superior stability over randomized ZO methods.

2605.14294.tldr: This paper proposes a transformer verification approach that can achieve improved precision improvement for most of the verification tasks with acceptable compromise of efficiency, and extends two classic approaches to the context of transformers, creating two new frameworks for efficient and precise verification.

2605.14290.tldr: This work identifies the main barrier to adopting plan-then-execute on the web: For it to work well, tools must map cleanly to semantic actions, with effects known before execution, so agents have enough information to plan.

2605.14283.tldr: It is shown how the KGW watermark for LLMs can be adapted to watermark game-playing agents in perfect-information extensive-form games and it is shown that the degradation in the quality of the watermarked strategy profile can be bounded, but there is a tradeoff between detectability and quality.

2605.14266.tldr: A forward-looking perspective on agentic multi-agent AI platform in higher education, consisting interconnected autonomous, goal driven agents that support learning, teaching, and institutional operations is presented, highlighting how coordinated agentic multi-agent platform can support diverse learners through adaptive, multimodal interventions.

2605.14258.tldr: This work performs full Jacobian eigendecomposition across three production--scale LLMs and shows that training installs a monotonic spectral gradient that links perturbation propagation and compression to the network's functional topology.

2605.14392.tldr: Stable self-improvement depends not on producing more synthetic data, but on models learning to construct worlds whose difficulty stays structurally beyond their own reach.

2605.14374.tldr: This paper introduces the Optimal Pattern Detection Tree (OPDT), a rule-based machine learning model based on novel mixed-integer programming to discover a single optimal pattern in data through binary classification and introduces the Branching Structure Constraints (BSC) framework, which enables decision makers to encode domain knowledge and constraints directly into the model.

2605.14370.tldr: This study establishes the neural sensitivity kernel (NSK) and the wave tangent kernel (WTK) to analyze their convergence behavior from both model and data domains and proposes several enhanced NeurFWI methods with tailored eigen-structures in NSK and WTK to improve inversion performances and efficiency.

2605.14365.tldr: LoMETab, a rank-1 BatchEnsemble/TabM modulation to a rank-$r$ identity-residual Hadamard family of multiplicative implicit ensembles, is proposed, supporting LoMETab as a controllable family of implicit ensembles rather than a fixed rank-1 construction.

2605.14327.tldr: AIM-DDI is proposed, an architecture-independent multimodal integration module that represents heterogeneous modality information as tokens in a shared latent space that enables model-agnostic integration of structural, chemical, and semantic drug signals across different DDI prediction architectures.

2605.14359.tldr: RQ-MoE enables dynamic codebook construction and decouples instruction from quantization, facilitating parallel decoding, and achieves state-of-the-art or on-par performance in reconstruction and retrieval, while providing 6x-14x faster decoding than prior vector quantization methods.

2605.14311.tldr: BBCritic (Beyond-Binary Critic), a paradigm shift grounded in the Functional Equivalence Hypothesis, is introduced, which aligns instructions and actions in a shared Affordance Space, recovering the hierarchical structure that binary supervision flattens.

2605.14309.tldr: This paper proposes an interpretable concept-level unlearning framework for VLMs, which constructs a compact task-specific concept vocabulary from the forgetting set using a multimodal large language model.

2605.14289.tldr: MetaMoE, a privacy-preserving framework that unifies independently trained, domain-specialized experts into a single MoE using public proxy data as surrogates for inaccessible private data, is proposed.

2605.14246.tldr: The results suggest that action-conditioned near-term risk can provide an effective local signal for approximate risk-sensitive POMDP control when full belief-space planning is impractical.

2605.14421.tldr: This work introduces MemLineage, a defense for LLM agent memory that attaches both cryptographic provenance and LLM-mediated derivation lineage to every entry, and evaluates three defense cells against three memory-poisoning workloads on a deterministic mechanism-isolation harness.

2605.14415.tldr: This work presents SWE-Chain, a benchmark for evaluating agents on chained release-level package upgrades, where each transition builds on the agent's prior codebase, and reveals that current agents still struggle to make correct upgrades across chained package releases without breaking existing functionality.

2605.14413.tldr: MahaVar is proposed, a simple and effective post-hoc OOD detector that augments the Mahalanobis distance with a class-wise distance variance term, achieving state-of-the-art performance on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet and consistent improvements over existing Mahalanobis-based methods across all benchmarks.

2605.14362.tldr: This work presents a correctness-aware context hygiene framework: a pre-execution, size-based heuristic filter that intercepts repository scans before tokenization, using only OS-level stat() metadata with sub-millisecond overhead.

2605.14556.tldr: TeachAnything is developed, a cloud-based, crowdsourcing-oriented demonstration platform with physics simulation capable of collecting diverse demonstration data across varied scenes, tasks, and embodiments that serves as a practical foundation for developing embodied agents aligned with Symmetrical Reality.

2605.14559.tldr: PyCSP$^3$ Scheduling is presented, a library that adds scheduling abstractions to PyCSP$^3$ through 53 dedicated constraints and 27 expressions, and compiles them down to standard PyCSP$^3$/XCSP$^3$ constraints, maintaining the modeling/solving separation that underpins the PyCSP$^3$ ecosystem.

2605.14517.tldr: It is demonstrated that dimension-level intent fidelity evaluation is a necessary complement to holistic assessment when evaluating LLM outputs for user-specific tasks.

2605.14512.tldr: AsymRec is proposed, an asymmetric continuous-discrete framework that decouples input and output representations that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative recommenders by an average of 15.8 %.

2605.14504.tldr: HoloMind is proposed, a VLM-driven agent with a DAG-based long-horizon hierarchical planner, a Multimodal Spatial Memory for persistent world modeling, an Episodic Memory for experience reuse, and a global Critic for reflective supervision that substantially improves long-horizon performance while reducing reliance on model scale.

2605.14502.tldr: An impedance-based Attack Reachable Domain (ARD) framework is proposed that maps feasible adversarial actions to critical-eigenvalue migration through impedance reshaping and an Attack Penetration Index is defined to quantify node-level cyber-vulnerability.

2605.14494.tldr: NeurPRISE, a neural surrogate model built on a GNN-Transformer backbone that encodes the per-scenario structure via graph convolution and captures cross-scenario interactions through attention, is proposed, a problem-driven sequential lookahead heuristic that constructs reduced scenario sets by evaluating the marginal impact of each scenario.

2605.14487.tldr: This work proposes Head Forcing, a training-free framework that assigns each head type a tailored KV cache strategy: local and anchor heads retain only essential tokens, while memory heads employ a hierarchical memory system with dynamic episodic updates for long-range consistency.

2605.14478.tldr: Temporal validity of retrieved repository context is a distinct diagnostic variable for Code RAG robustness: stale context can actively bias models toward obsolete repository state rather than merely removing useful evidence.

2605.14465.tldr: TABALIGN is proposed, a planned table reasoning framework that operationalizes the multi-step LLM reasoning contract, and pairs a masked DLM planner with a lightweight verifier trained on 1,600 human-verified attention standards to score each step by its attention overlap with the plan-designated mask.

2605.14641.tldr: This work introduces RefineCAM, a method that produces high-resolution attribution maps by aggregating CAMs across multiple network layers and proposes ARCC, a new composite metric that more reliably identifies faithful explanations.

2605.14621.tldr: SIRA is a training-free internal contrastive decoding framework that constructs a counterfactual reference inside the same LVLM by exploiting the staged information flow of multimodal transformers and consistently reduces hallucinations while preserving descriptive coverage and incurring lower overhead than two-pass contrastive decoding.

2605.14587.tldr: A conceptual framework SCC for robust backdoor injection is derived that deconstructs the mechanistic interplay between interventions and backdoors in DRL, and abnormal loss landscape sharpness is derived as a key indicator for DRL backdoor detection.

2605.14581.tldr: This work develops a diagnostic benchmark using financial documents where changes in single digits can lead to significant semantic shifts, and identifies global texture dominance as the root cause.

2605.14558.tldr: An embarrassingly simple token reweighting approach, ActFocus, that downweights gradients on reasoning tokens, along with an additional energy-based redistribution mechanism that further increases the weights on action tokens with higher uncertainty is proposed.

2605.14543.tldr: RxEval is a prescription-level benchmark that evaluates LLM prescribing capability by multiple-choice questions: each question presents a detailed patient profile and time-ordered clinical trajectory, requiring selection of specific medication-dose-route triples from real prescriptions and patient-specific distractors generated via reasoning-chain perturbation.

2605.14495.tldr: A contestable multi-agent framework that integrates multimodal large language models, external verification tools, and arena-based quantitative bipolar argumentation (A-QBAF) is proposed as a submission to the ICMR 2026 Grand Challenge on Multimedia Verification.

2605.14449.tldr: QAOD (Question-Answer Orthogonal Decomposition), a single-pass framework that projects away the question-aligned direction from the answer representation to obtain a question-orthogonal component that suppresses domain-conditioned variation, is proposed.

2605.14443.tldr: This work proposes a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework for training learned prompting policies via iterative distillation of experience, and provides comprehensive comparisons against state-of-the-art evolutionary baselines like GEPA, showing that iterative distillation achieves superior performance with higher sample efficiency.

2605.14636.tldr: TCFT is proposed, a Temporal Critique Fine-Tuning framework that trains models to acquire cutoff-aware temporal verification, and teaches the model to identify post-cutoff leakage, explain temporal boundary violations, and judge temporal admissibility.

2605.14619.tldr: SliceGraph is proposed, a post-hoc problem-model-cell graph built by mutual-kNN over sparse activation-key Jaccard similarity between CoT slices, and treated as a measurement object for process geometry rather than as a decoding program.

2605.14612.tldr: The results indicate that integrating AI observability and evaluation into everyday IDE workflows can make modern AI development accessible to non-ML specialists while preserving software-engineering practices.

2605.14440.tldr: This work proposes a synthesis framework that integrates sampling, automata learning, and model-checking as an equivalence oracle and enables the synthesis of finite-state controllers with formal guarantees, provided the sampling-induced policy is regular.

2605.14455.tldr: The paper positions IIQ as a deployment-oriented measurement framework: a formal proposal for tracking AI embedding in workflows, not a direct measure of model capability or a substitute for causal productivity evaluation.

2605.14645.tldr: This work proposes an integrated framework that synergizes state-of-the-art (SOTA) vision models with statistical modeling that improves the accuracy of water level detection and flow estimation.

2605.14624.tldr: The Amortized Efficiency Threshold (AET) is defined as the deployment volume above which a neural solver breaks even with a heuristic baseline in total energy or carbon, under an explicit constraint on solution quality.

2605.14599.tldr: It is proved that both the trajectory-level KL divergence and the squared parameter error in the Hessian norm decay at the fast rate $\mathcal{O}(n^{-1})$, where $n$ is the number of expert trajectories.

2605.14534.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that RC achieves substantially stronger alignment with human judgments than existing evaluation protocols, and form the PROVE (Perceptual RemOVal cohErence) evaluation framework for visual media.

2605.14483.tldr: An LLM-based orchestrator that generates an executable orchestration specification that integrates task-specific roles, customized duties, capacity levels, and dependency structure into a single deployable system and achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated multi-agent orchestration methods.

2605.14605.tldr: This work identifies several defense mechanisms and shows that they share a single weakness: they obscure or misdirect the path to harmful behavior without removing the behavior itself, and develops a unified adaptive attack that breaks defenses across all defense mechanisms.

2605.14438.tldr: BEAM (Binary Expert Activation Masking), a novel method that learns token-adaptive expert selection via trainable binary masks, is proposed, demonstrating its effectiveness as a practical, plug-and-play solution for efficient MoE inference.

2605.14665.tldr: Falkor-IRAC is presented, a graph-constrained generation framework for Indian legal AI that grounds generation in structured reasoning over an IRAC (Issue, Rule, Analysis, Conclusion) knowledge graph and is evaluated using graph-native metrics: citation grounding accuracy, path validity rate, hallucinated precedent rate, and conflict detection rate.

2605.14660.tldr: MindGap is proposed, a privacy-preserving on-device conversational AI framework that delivers structured neuroplastic rehabilitation for PTSD through the practice of dependent origination, a Buddhist psychological framework that identifies the precise moment between the pre-cognitive affective signal and the reactive elaboration that follows as the site of therapeutic intervention.

2605.14542.tldr: VerbalValue is presented, a sales-conversion-oriented virtual host that turns exceptional verbal ability into real commercial value, built on three contributions that anchor product-related responses in verified expertise.

2605.14497.tldr: This work proposes Reinforcement Learning with Optimized Adaptive Data-mixing (ROAD), a dynamic plug-and-play framework that automates the data replay process, and demonstrates that this approach consistently outperforms existing data replay methods across various datasets.

2605.14488.tldr: Deepchecks' evaluation framework addresses RAG applications evaluation through a multi-faceted approach, root cause analysis and production monitoring, and provides a robust foundation for assessing reliability, relevance, and user satisfaction in RAG systems.

2605.14458.tldr: OmniDrop is a training-free, layer-wise token pruning framework that progressively prunes audiovisual tokens within the LLM decoder layers rather than at the input-level, allowing early layers to preserve sufficient omni-modal information fusion before aggressively removing tokens in deeper layers.

2605.14561.tldr: This work formally defines the segmentations and annotations and demonstrates that optimised segment-level annotations can lead to improved LLM responses, with the original prompt retained as a candidate in the optimisation space to prevent performance degradation.

2605.14544.tldr: Because complacent models reinforce users'prior beliefs, it is argued that AI literacy educational approaches should particularly focus on strategies to counter confirmation bias.

2605.14537.tldr: Two heuristic code agents outperform most tested LLMs, and behavioural traces surface recurring LLM failure modes including overbidding, self-bidding, bankrupt TC initiation, and weak opponent-state adaptation.

2605.14513.tldr: A head-wise adaptive framework with two plug-in components: Temporal Mask Reuse, which skips unnecessary mask prediction based on query-key drift, and Error-guided Budgeted Calibration, which assigns per-head top-$p$ thresholds by minimizing measured model-output error under a global sparsity budget.

2605.14473.tldr: Context-Driven Decomposition (CDD), an inference-time diagnostic intervention that elicits contextual and prior answers, isolates the conflicting premise, and records a resolution trace that can be perturbed, is introduced.

2605.14457.tldr: InsightReplay is proposed, a stateful reasoning approach in which the model periodically extracts critical insights from its reasoning trace and replays them near the active generation frontier, keeping them accessible as the reasoning scales.

2605.14434.tldr: A retrieval framework tailored for real-world recall scenarios, positioning generative retrieval as a recall-stage supplement rather than an end-to-end replacement, and developing EG-GRPO (Expert-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning approach that aligns generative recall with downstream ranking under sparse rewards.

2605.14635.tldr: A multi-label visual emotion analysis benchmark dataset for comprehensively evaluating the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict the emotions evoked by images and experiments with LLM-as-a-judge show that the method does not consistently improve MLLMs' performance, indicating its limitations for the subjective task of visual emotion analysis.

2605.14553.tldr: This work adapts provably efficient algorithms from multi-objective bandits and introduces a novel design for best feasible arm identification in structured bandits, establishing a principled and efficient framework for multi-objective prompt optimization.

2605.14866.tldr: RCLAgent is introduced, an in-depth root cause localization framework for microservice systems that realizes multi-agent recursion-of-thought with parallel reasoning and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both localization accuracy and inference efficiency.

2605.14741.tldr: This work integrates Goal-Space Planning with Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient, using learned temporally abstract models over discrete subgoals to propagate value across extended horizons and demonstrates the proposed approach improves sample efficiency over standard DDPG while satisfying terminal storage constraints, mitigating myopic control behavior.

2605.14666.tldr: This work presents and formally proves the correctness of a novel foundational framework for monitoring properties in an expressive fragment of LTLfMT, which combines automata-theoretic methods to handle the temporal aspects of the logic, with automated reasoning techniques to address the first-order dimension.

2605.14831.tldr: It is proved that expected future progress depends exponentially on the recency of the last observed breakthrough, and it is shown that the Algorithmic Prior is significantly more optimistic than the Length Prior, yielding a quadratic increase in expected discovery for the same observed profile.

2605.14774.tldr: The main novelty approach of this work is based on the deep learning algorithm Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient, where DDPG identified criminals with an amazing accuracy of 95% than other several existing methods.

2605.14761.tldr: This work focuses on the utility of Large Language Models pretrained on vast amounts of textual data, and develops an integrated DL-LLM system that actively elicits aesthetic preferences through LLM-based semi-structured interviews and predicts aesthetic evaluation by leveraging both low-level and high-level features.

2605.14752.tldr: A two-stage knowledge distillation framework that mines high-value samples from existing data and introduces a dual-layer marginal selection mechanism based on cognitive uncertainty, identifying four types of critical samples based on teacher model uncertainty and confidence differences.

2605.14749.tldr: This work introduces a general formulation of intervention that extends naturally to non-linearly represented features, together with a learning procedure that further enables intervention on implicit features lacking a direct output signature.

2605.14764.tldr: HNNs are orders of magnitude sparser than standard DNNs and require only minimal hyperparameter tuning, and recover the underlying compositional structure and remain stable in regimes where dense alternatives degrade as dimensionality increases.

2605.14859.tldr: Sufficiency-Tightness Decomposition is proposed, which first generates a coverage-oriented policy by forward-simulating the task and then audits each granted entry for grounding and sensitivity, which improves sensitive-task success by up to 15.8% on tightness-biased models while reducing attack success across all evaluated models.

2605.14854.tldr: Across camera-space and world-space benchmarks, FactorizedHMR remains competitive with strong baselines, with the clearest gains in occlusion-heavy recovery and drift-sensitive world-space metrics.

2605.14851.tldr: An Integrated Multi-Agent Framework for Generative Operational Planning and High-Fidelity Plan Verification (IFPV), which consists of two tightly coupled modules: Multi-Perspective Hierarchical Agents (MPHA) for generative operational planning and an Adversarial Cognitive Simulation Engine (ACSE) for high-fidelity adversarial plan verification.

2605.14791.tldr: Two complementary agentic systems for cosmology are discussed, which targets tasks with explicit quantitative objectives through LLM-guided code evolution and tree search and which targets open-ended scientific workflows through a virtual multi-agent research laboratory.

2605.14771.tldr: This report focuses on the architectural design philosophy of MediaClaw, the design logic of its core capability model, and the key engineering trade-offs in implementation to provide reusable practical reference for building multimodal capability platforms.

2605.14744.tldr: This work introduces five governance metrics that quantify policy compliance at the rationale level and applies them in a synthetic banking domain to compare text-only governance against mechanical enforcement, finding a governance-task decoupling under structural stress.

2605.14712.tldr: IntentVLA is introduced, a history-conditioned VLA framework that encodes recent visual observations into a compact short-horizon intent representation and uses it to condition chunk generation and improves rollout stability and outperforms strong VLA baselines.

2605.14876.tldr: The CLVR framework introduces an automated data engine with step-level visual verification to synthesize reliable reasoning trajectories, and proposes Proxy Prompt Reinforcement Learning (PPRL) to resolve long-context optimization instabilities by distilling interleaved multimodal histories into explicit reward signals for accurate causal attribution.

2605.14867.tldr: The proposed REALM shows that LFP-only models can achieve competitive decoding performance without reliance on spike signals, offering a practical and scalable alternative for next-generation wireless implantable BCIs.

2605.14893.tldr: This work employs spectral decomposition of covariance matrices to decompose the VLM latent space into a multi-modal semantic signal component and a shared noise subspace, suggesting that a substantial fraction of their latent geometry is governed by shared, architecture-level noise rather than task-relevant semantics alone.

2605.14857.tldr: A two-stage manual audit of 226 six-digit disagreements suggests that a non-trivial fraction of HSCodeComp ground-truth labels may deviate from HS general rules; full adjudication records are released in the appendix as preliminary findings for community review.

2605.14844.tldr: XFP, a dynamic weight quantizer for LLM inference that inverts the conventional workflow, is introduced and the H-Process, a quality-driven iteration over the two cosine thresholds that finds the operating point at which the model just fits while still producing sensible output is presented.

2605.14802.tldr: ARPM maintains semantic continuity, boundary continuity, and persona consistency, while exposing limits caused by weak protocol compliance, and shows that long-term persona consistency can be decomposed into governable components and evaluated in a white-box manner.

2605.14773.tldr: This work revisits data selection from an optimization perspective and shows that selected-data training induces an implicit regularization effect modulated by the instantaneous selection ratio, which reveals a key trade-off: lower ratios amplify selection-induced regularization, whereas higher ratios preserve data coverage and optimization fidelity.

2605.14754.tldr: XDomainBench is introduced, a diagnostic benchmark for interactive interdisciplinary scientific reasoning, formalize the composition order and mixture structure to enable systematic stress-testing from single-discipline to inter-disciplinary, comprising 8,598 interactive sessions across 20 domains and 4 task categories.

2605.14747.tldr: This work proposes Video2GUI, a fully automated framework that extracts grounded GUI interaction trajectories directly from unlabeled Internet videos and constructs WildGUI, a large-scale dataset containing 12 million interaction trajectories spanning over 1,500 applications and websites.

2605.14892.tldr: This survey provides a unified review organized around four causally linked stages, which are term the LIFE progression: Lay the capability foundation, Integrate agents through collaboration, Find faults through attribution, and Evolve through autonomous self-improvement, extending current coordination frameworks toward more self-organizing forms of collective intelligence.

2605.14886.tldr: A bidirectional federated knowledge distillation (BiFedKD) framework that employs an aggregation-by-distillation pipeline with temperature scaling to produce a stable global distillation signal for cross-client alignment is proposed.

2605.14865.tldr: This work presents a holistic agent evaluation framework that pairs top-down agent-level diagnosis with bottom-up span-level evaluation, decomposing analysis into independent per-span assessments, showing that evaluation methodology, not model capability, is the bottleneck.

2605.14841.tldr: GPart (Global Partition fine-tuning), a highly parameter-efficient fine-tuning method which removes the low-rank bottleneck entirely, and empirically demonstrates the superior or comparable performance of GPart to existing PEFT methods on natural language understanding, computer vision tasks, and mathematical reasoning.

2605.14833.tldr: It is suggested that stateful emotional memory may represent a foundational infrastructure layer for hyper-personalized AI systems, though broader validation across larger and more diverse evaluations remains necessary.

2605.14758.tldr: Experiments on partially observable single-agent and cooperative multi-agent tasks show that the proposed probabilistic framework, RNN-ProVe, yields more quantitative, feasibility-aware probabilistic guarantees than existing tools, while scaling to recurrent and multi-agent settings.

2605.14750.tldr: EVA (Editing for Versatile Alignment against Jailbreaks) is proposed, a novel framework that pioneers the application of direct model editing for safety alignment and offers a precise and efficient solution for post-deployment safety alignment.

2605.14721.tldr: This approach preserves strong equivalence under translation between certain classes of logic programs and both Dung-style and claim-augmented argumentation frameworks, thus restoring compatibility across these formalisms.

2605.14710.tldr: This paper proposes a novel tri-modal fusion model for ischemic stroke prognosis that achieves a dynamic and profound fusion through a dual semantic alignment loss, effectively mitigating modal heterogeneity.

2605.14698.tldr: It is concluded that pretrained models perform largely on par, with only narrow advantages for a few, and that current models do not yet deliver on the promise of an out-of-the-box unified EEG model.

2605.14679.tldr: Results show that glossary-augmented prompting is a low-overhead way to improve terminology control in cultural-heritage translation if institutions maintain minimal terminology resources and lightweight evaluation procedures.

2605.14897.tldr: A new model-agnostic method called Critic-Driven Voronoi State Partitioning, which partitions a black box control policy into regions where a simple class of model can be optimized using gradient descent and iteratively introduces new subpolicies in regions with insufficient value.

2605.14889.tldr: SurgicalMamba is presented, a causal SPR model built on Mamba2's structured state-space duality (SSD) that holds per-frame cost at O(d) that reaches state-of-the-art accuracy and phase-level Jaccard under strict online evaluation.

2605.14723.tldr: This work introduces SepsisAgent, a world model-augmented LLM agent for sepsis treatment recommendation that outperforms all traditional RL and LLM-based baselines in off-policy value while achieving the best safety profile under guideline adherence and unsafe-action metrics.

2605.14717.tldr: A unified Deep Learning framework that jointly performs White Blood Cell classification and continuous protein-expression regression from label-free Differential Phase Contrast (DPC) images is presented, enabling simultaneous phenotype identification and quantitative biomarker estimation without fluorescent staining.

2605.14685.tldr: This work studies deep neural networks whose internal layers are equivariant under a continuous symmetry and may therefore support analogous Goldstone-like degrees of freedom, providing a mechanism for stable information flow without relying on architectural stabilizers such as residual connections or normalization.

2605.14667.tldr: A mixed-effects framework for quantifying the influence that clinically relevant acquisition parameters have on models performance, while accounting for subject-level random effects is formulated and applied to lung cancer diagnosis in CT scans using two independent multicentre datasets.

2605.14855.tldr: Among the tested architectures, the hybrid LSTM augmented with contextual information achieved the lowest final displacement error (FDE) of 1.51m, outperforming temporal convolutional neural network (TCNN), graph attention network (GAT), and Transformers, while also requiring less data and training time compared to GAT and Transformers.

2605.14786.tldr: Across 14 frontier LLMs and four web environments spanning information retrieval and shopping tasks, it is shown that an agent's actions and interaction timings are sufficient to identify the underlying model with up to 96% F1.

2605.14766.tldr: An LLM-based architecture for real streaming speech-to-text translation that learns not just to emit output tokens, but also to decide whether it has seen enough audio to do so and achieves a translation quality close to the non-streaming baseline, but with a latency of only 1-2 seconds.

2605.14790.tldr: Graphs of Research (GoR), a supervised fine-tuning method that extracts a 2-hop reference neighborhood for each seed paper, derives the relations among those references from citation position, frequency, predecessor links, and publication time, and organizes them into a paper-evolution directed acyclic graph (DAG).

2407.14974.tldr: This work proposes an approach to extract a subnetwork from a fully trained network that does not rely on spurious correlations, and employs supervised contrastive loss in a novel way to force models to unlearn the spurious connections.

2408.00923.tldr: This paper explores a novel paradigm in low-bit quantization by framing optimal quantization as an architecture search problem within convolutional neural networks (ConvNets), and establishes a new state-of-the-art in terms of the optimization efficiency in low-bit quantization.

2504.06176.tldr: This work demonstrates how self-supervised learning can simultaneously enable anomaly detection, motion prediction, and synthetic data generation from rich pre-trained representations, supporting space safety and sustainability through automated monitoring and simulation.

2504.09499.tldr: This study is the first to explore Hattrick using structure learning techniques and Bayesian networks, integrating expert knowledge with data to develop models that simulate and explain the game-engine, and makes all data, graphical structures, and models publicly available online.

2504.09844.tldr: MegaScale-Data is presented, an industrial-grade distributed data loading architecture for multisource LFMs training, with three key innovations: disaggregated data preprocessing via role-specific actors (Source Loaders/Data Constructors) to eliminate source and parallelism redundant data access and ensure multisource scalability.

2505.01595.tldr: This work proposes a set of strong and precise probability estimation models for fine-grained probability estimation of propositions conditioned on context and shows that this approach consistently outperforms existing fine-tuned and prompting-based methods by a large margin.

2505.16518.tldr: It is revealed that most existing CMTs struggle to handle the full spectrum of context types encountered in real-world RAG scenarios, and many CMTs display inflated performance on simple synthesised datasets, compared to more realistic datasets with naturally occurring samples.

2509.06337.tldr: Two complementary task abstractions are introduced: Partial Attribute Simulation (PAS) and Full Attribute Simulation (FAS), where LLMs predict missing attributes from incomplete respondent profiles, and Full Attribute Simulation (FAS), where LLMs generate complete synthetic datasets under zero-context and context-enhanced conditions.

2603.00130.tldr: The Agentic Hive is introduced, a framework in which a variable population of autonomous micro-agents-each equipped with a sandboxed execution environment and access to a language model-undergoes demographic dynamics: birth, duplication, specialization, and death.

2603.06589.tldr: The Isotonic Layer is introduced, a differentiable piecewise linear module that unifies both calibration and debiasing problems within a single, lightweight architectural component - requiring no additional data preprocessing, no propensity estimation, and no separate calibration pipelines.

2604.03768.tldr: Results demonstrate that the agent effectively learns to increase total ESV; that spatial reward shaping successfully steers allocations toward ecologically sound patterns, including homogeneous land-use clustering and slight forest consolidation near water bodies; and that the framework responds meaningfully to policy parameter changes, establishing its utility as a scenario-analysis tool for environmental planning.

2604.09388.tldr: The central finding: the intelligence of an AI-driven development system resides not in the AI model itself, but in the infrastructure of instructions, tests, metrics, and feedback loops that surround it.

2604.12290.tldr: Frontier-Eng establishes a new standard for assessing the capacity of AI agents to integrate domain knowledge with executable feedback to solve complex, open-ended engineering problems.

2604.13006.tldr: It is shown that simple lexical constraints cause instruction-tuned LLMs to collapse their responses, losing 14--48\% of comprehensiveness across seven models spanning five families (7B--70B, open- and closed-weight).

2604.18491.tldr: It is demonstrated that GIST achieves a level of predictive accuracy suitable for early-stage aerodynamic design, providing a first validation of the concept of interactive design-space exploration within industrial motorsport workflows.

2604.18648.tldr: This work bridges principles from dance studies, human anatomy, and biomechanics to propose \textit{Choreographic Syntax}, a novel theoretical framework with a tailored annotation system that empower DanceCrafter to achieve the high-fidelity and stable generation of complex dance sequences.

2604.19465.tldr: A data-driven framework that automatically identifies stability properties and optimal forcing responses from observation data alone, without requiring governing equations is introduced, establishing a broadly applicable tool for analyzing complex, high-dimensional datasets.

2604.23888.tldr: This work proposes a novel end-to-end pipeline aimed at domain adaptation by leveraging geometry-preserving loss functions in conjunction to pre-trained generative adversarial networks (GANs) and rethinks the problem of adaptation by re-contextualizing the role of GAN inversion in obtaining accurate latent space representations.

2604.23897.tldr: This work proposes MarketBench, a benchmark for assessing whether AI agents have informative signals of their own ability to successfully complete a task and the cost of doing so, and uses a 93-task subset of SWE-bench Lite with six recently released LLMs as a demonstration.

2604.23902.tldr: Overall, this study demonstrates that LLMs can enhance traffic signal control when used as constrained reasoning and decision-support modules rather than direct low-level controllers.

2604.23905.tldr: This project presents SMSI, a hybrid neuro-symbolic pipeline that starts from a SysML architecture model and produces a prioritized list of NIST 800-53 security controls, demonstrating that dense embeddings provide a strong basis for automated control recommendation.

2604.23921.tldr: This work introduces a neural combinatorial optimization approach to the atom allocation challenge and, subsequently, CSP, based on graph neural networks (GNNs), which can effectively sample from the distribution of feasible structures in an unsupervised manner and is competitive with a commercial optimization solver across a range of chemical compositions.

2604.23922.tldr: The Quasi-Quadratic Gradient is introduced, a novel search direction designed to accelerate the BFGS method within the quasi-Newton framework that significantly outperforms vanilla BFGS in convergence speed while maintaining computational efficiency.

2604.23924.tldr: This work demonstrates the agentic AI's ability to orchestrate from data planning to execution, and from rule induction to explanation in ML, opening the door to various applications.

2604.23931.tldr: A systematic empirical comparison of four VQC families -- multi-layer fully-connected (FC-VQC), residual (ResNet-VQC), hybrid quantum-classical transformer (QT), and fully quantum transformer (FQT) -- across five regression and classification benchmarks provides practical architectural guidance for deploying VQCs on near-term quantum hardware.

2604.23948.tldr: This paper introduces a novel framework for Korean PLMs called KOMBO, which firstly brings the invention principles of Hangeul to represent character and sheds light on the superiority of using subcharacters over the typical subword-based approach for Korean PLMs.

2604.23949.tldr: The results show that HybridARX improves over classical ARX by yielding more stable and better-calibrated forecasts, particularly when incorporating noisy contextual signals into structured time-series models.

2604.23953.tldr: This paper experimentally finds that BOIQA can be formulated as a blind (2D planar) image quality assessment (BIQA) problem, and presents a new BOIQA approach, which has three merits: ie, viewport-unaware, unified, and generalized, which shows better generalizability against other competitors.

2604.23954.tldr: This work examines how different model update strategies can adversely affect model stability and proposes multiple dimensions for continuous monitoring to detect these issues and argues that such monitoring is essential for the development of trustworthy clinical decision support systems.

2604.23964.tldr: A task-guided spatiotemporal network (TGSN) with diffusion augmentation for EEG-based dementia diagnosis and MMSE prediction and a task-guided query module to achieve task-specific feature extraction, thereby mitigating task interference is proposed.

2604.23968.tldr: DecompKAN, a lightweight attention-free architecture that combines trend-residual decomposition, channel-wise patching, learned instance normalization, and B-spline Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) edge functions, is proposed.

2604.23970.tldr: An agentic framework that converts a single floor plan image into a structured, retrievable knowledge base to generate safe, accessible navigation instructions with lightweight infrastructure is presented and results show consistent gains over single-call LLM baselines.

2604.23972.tldr: The results support the view that the value of a KG in LLM-based clinical reasoning lies not merely in storing medically related facts, but in representing whether those facts are applicable to the specific patient context.

2604.23985.tldr: This work identifies trajectory curvature as a task-aligned representational feature that influences behavioral uncertainty in LLMs by relating contextual curvature-a geometric measure of how sharply the representational trajectory bends over recent context-to next-token entropy- to this feature.

2604.23988.tldr: This work bridges two ideas from reinforcement learning -- using information unavailable during execution to retrospectively generate training signal, and preference alignment -- and proposes Hindsight Preference Optimization: observed outcomes let an LLM judge rank candidate advisories on dimensions that scalar metrics cannot capture.

2604.23989.tldr: Experiments suggest that IRRI achieves inference performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods, and indicate that, even without complex search structures, refining initial programs with high-quality repair instructions alone can effectively improve inference performance.

2604.23990.tldr: A pilot study on a real trilingual digital front-desk system deployed in the lobby of an international financial institution provides initial evidence that failure-centered runtime evaluation can expose structured deployment signals hidden by aggregate scoring.

2604.23993.tldr: Reinforcement learning can turn product mapping from a high-latency agentic pipeline into a scalable, inspectable, and production-ready in-house system, and suggest that reinforcement learning can turn product mapping from a high-latency agentic pipeline into a scalable, inspectable, and production-ready in-house system.

2604.24001.tldr: CT-FineBench is proposed, a benchmark built from CT-RATE and Merlin to evaluate the fine-grained factual consistency of CT reports, constructed from CT-RATE and Merlin.

2604.24002.tldr: IntentVLM is presented, a novel two-stage video-language framework designed for open-vocabulary human intention recognition that achieves state-of-the-art results with up to 80% accuracy and offers a robust foundation for human-centered robotics.

2604.24020.tldr: ClawdGo is presented, a framework for endogenous security awareness training: it teaches the agent to recognise and reason about threats from the inside, at inference time, with no model modification.

2604.24038.tldr: This work introduces AgentPulse, a continuous evaluation framework scoring 50 agents across 10 workload categories along four factors (Benchmark Performance, Adoption Signals, Community Sentiment, and Ecosystem Health) aggregated from 18 real-time signals across GitHub, package registries, IDE marketplaces, social platforms, and benchmark leaderboards.

2604.24039.tldr: This paper introduces AgenticCache, a planning framework that reuses cached plans to avoid per-step LLM calls and offers a practical path to low-latency, low-cost embodied agents.

2604.24041.tldr: This tutorial introduces PyPOTS, an open-source Python ecosystem for end-to-end data mining and machine learning on POTS, and presents practical workflows spanning missingness simulation, data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation across core tasks.

2604.24043.tldr: This work proposes Automated Algorithm Design via Evolutionary Program Trees (A2DEPT), which treats LLMs as system-level algorithm architects and explores the vast program space via a tree-structured evolutionary search with hybrid selection and hierarchical operators, enabling iterative refinement of complete algorithms.

2604.24052.tldr: This paper proposes QEVA, a reference-free metric evaluating candidate summaries directly against source videos through multimodal question answering, and introduces MLVU(VS)-Eval, a new annotated benchmark derived from the MLVU dataset.

2604.24062.tldr: These findings reveal that large-scale statistical learning does not produce the decontextualized causal schemas underpinning human analogical reasoning, establishing grounding-dependent transfer as a fundamental limitation of current LLMs and VLMs.

2604.24070.tldr: The result is exploratory, binary rather than continuously calibrated, and observed at a single scale: confidence training requires label entropy, and correct targets regularise output format, identifying two design lessons.

2604.24073.tldr: FreeScale is introduced, a solution designed to mitigate the straggler problem through meticulously load balanced input samples, minimize the blocking communication by overlapping prioritized embedding communications with computations, and resolve the GPU resource competition during computation and communication overlapping by communicating through SM-Free techniques.

2604.24079.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that bridging-inference graphs yield significantly stronger semantic coherence and more stable persona identification than frequency or style-based baselines, and show that persona traits are consistently encoded in the structural organization of discourse rather than isolated lexical patterns.

2604.24082.tldr: This work introduces a novel multi-turn jailbreaking method that gradually builds conversational trust by simulating benign-seeming intentions and by exploiting the consistency property of the model, ultimately guiding the target model toward harmful, detailed outputs.

2604.24086.tldr: Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that AsyncShield, a plug-and-play asynchronous control framework, exhibits zero-shot and robust generalization capabilities, effectively improving the success rate and physical safety of asynchronous navigation.

2604.24088.tldr: This work proposes TACO (Tensor-parallel Adaptive COmmunication compression), a robust FP8-based framework for compressing TP intermediate tensors, which employs a data-driven reshaping strategy combined with an Adaptive Scale-Hadamard Transform to enable high-fidelity FP8 quantization, while its Dual-Scale Quantization mechanism ensures numerical stability throughout training.

2604.24096.tldr: This work investigates a meta-ensemble learning methodology that enhances prediction diversity by training base models on diverse data splits and combining their outputs through a trained meta-model, indicating its potential applicability to real-world clinical data.

2604.24102.tldr: The second version of SemML is presented, which outperforms all state-of-the-art tools for finding either solution and solves significantly more instances and does so much faster than other tools, while maintaining state-of-the-art solution quality.

2604.24110.tldr: ITAS is instrumented, a four-agent tutoring system built on Gemini 2.5 Flash and Google Vertex AI, across three throughput tiers (Standard PayGo, Priority PayGo, and Provisioned Throughput) and eleven concurrency levels up to 50 simultaneous users, producing over 3,000 requests drawn from a live graduate STEM deployment.

2604.24117.tldr: This study systematically investigates the conditions under which joint training is essential for optimal performance in the job-shop scheduling problem with transportation resources, and quantifies the coordination gap -- the performance difference between these two training modalities.

2604.24127.tldr: Semantically Relevant Skill Discovery is proposed, a novel human-in-the-loop approach that collects semantic labels from human feedback and learns a reward function to encourage skills to be more semantically diverse and relevant.

2604.24153.tldr: The Right-to-Act protocol is introduced, a deterministic, non-compensatory pre-execution decision layer that evaluates whether an AI-generated decision is permitted to be realized at all, preserving reversibility and preventing premature or irreversible actions.

2604.24154.tldr: Layer-wise Progressive Approximation (LPA) is proposed, a theoretically grounded training principle that explicitly aligns each layer with its residual target to realize such trajectories, providing a new lens on representation learning and a flexible framework for multi-depth deployment.

2604.24156.tldr: This work provides the first systematic evaluation of LLM bidders in repeated spectrum auctions, offering new insights into how AI-driven agents can interact strategically and reshape market dynamics in future 6G networks.

2604.24158.tldr: This work studies LLMs-as-Judges for sustainable city-trip lists across four dimensions -- relevance, diversity, sustainability, and popularity balance, and proposes a three-phase calibration framework that clarifies reasoning per dimension but exposes divergent interpretations of sustainability.

2604.24162.tldr: Tail-risk Intrinsic Geometric Smoothing (TIGS), a plug-and-play inference-time defense requiring no parameter updates, external clean data, or auxiliary generation, establishes a highly practical, deployment-ready defense standard for state-of-the-art LLMs.

2604.24170.tldr: CREDENCE (Credal Ensemble Concept Estimation), a CBM framework that decomposes concept uncertainty by construction, is introduced, showing that epistemic uncertainty is positively associated with prediction errors, whereas aleatoric uncertainty closely tracks annotator disagreement, providing guidance beyond error correlation.

2604.24175.tldr: AdapTime is proposed, an adaptive temporal reasoning method that dynamically executes reasoning steps based on the input context that integrates seamlessly with state-of-the-art LLMs and significantly enhances their temporal reasoning capabilities without relying on external support.

2604.24176.tldr: This work reformulates explanation quality assessment as a ranking problem rather than a generation problem, and trains reward models to discriminate among multiple candidate explanations and learn their relative quality.

2604.24178.tldr: Meal is proposed, i.e., MEta ALigner, a bi-level meta-learning framework enabling bidirectional optimization between preferences and policy responses, generating instructive dynamic preferences for steadier training, validating the effectiveness of the dynamic bidirectional preference-policy optimization framework.

2604.24186.tldr: MultiDx is proposed, a two-stage diagnostic reasoning framework that performs differential diagnosis by analyzing evidence collected from multiple knowledge sources by leveraging knowledge from web search, SOAP-formatted case, and clinical case database.

2604.24197.tldr: A capability-weighted risk framework is introduced that links model affordances to real-world harm in finance, medicine, news, law, emergency response, identity verification, and civic discourse and argues for layered control: model-side restrictions, cryptographic provenance, visible labeling, platform friction, sector-grade verification, and incident response.

2604.24198.tldr: DataPRM is introduced, a novel environment-aware generative process reward model that can serve as an active verifier, autonomously interacting with the environment to probe intermediate execution states and uncover silent errors, and employs a reflection-aware ternary reward strategy that distinguishes between correctable grounding errors and irrecoverable mistakes.

2604.24203.tldr: The results show that TEE-enabled agentic auditing provides a mechanism for privacy-preserving oversight, effectively decoupling qualitative verification from the need for data disclosure.

2604.24218.tldr: RefEvo is introduced, a dynamic multi-agent framework designed for agile and reliable reference modeling that achieves a 95% pass rate, outperforming static baselines by a large margin and reduces token consumption by an average of 71.04%, achieving absolute savings of over 70,000 tokens per session for complex designs.

2604.24219.tldr: Adaptive Tree-of-Retrieval (Adaptive ToR), a complexity-aware retrieval architecture that dynamically configures retrieval topology based on query characteristics, is proposed, validating complexity-aware resource allocation and establishing Pareto-optimal balance across accuracy, latency, and computational efficiency.

2604.24293.tldr: This work proposes the HGODE, which couples feature evolution with a latent topological potential driven by a learned pairwise force and provides asymptotic analysis of the collapse mechanism and the proposed hysteretic topology dynamics, and validate HGODE on theory-driven synthetic diagnostics and real-world graph benchmarks.

2604.24306.tldr: An attention-based deep learning model, inspired by transformer architecture, is used for short-term solar power forecasting, which significantly outperforms previous models on the same data set and exhibits high robustness and generalizability.

2604.24312.tldr: This work proposes an unconstrained framework that synergizes deep neural networks, algebraic priors, and temporal dynamics for uncalibrated multi-view human pose estimation, and devise the Temporal Equivariant Rectifier (TER), which exploits the equivariance property of human motion to impose temporal coherence and structural consistency in uncalibrated settings.

2604.24313.tldr: Self-Abstraction Learning (SAL), a hierarchical framework that effectively mitigates optimization issues, enabling stable training of deep architectures and ensuring robust generalization even in data-scarce and complex network regimes.
