2605.15665.tldr: This work presents PRISM (Prompt Reliability via Iterative Simulation and Monitoring), a closed-loop framework that treats prompt engineering as a continuous reliability engineering problem rather than a one-time authorship task, and suggests that continuous, simulation-driven prompt optimization is both tractable and necessary for reliable enterprise conversational AI at scale.

2605.15603.tldr: This work proposes a scalable value learning method that employs a winsorized horizon distribution to stabilize training by capping excessively large horizons, and demonstrates that the proposed method outperforms competitive baselines, particularly on tasks with highly suboptimal datasets and those requiring long-horizon reasoning.

2605.16087.tldr: This work proposes a Trustworthy AI perception module that is remarkably robust, integrates faithful explainability, and calibrated uncertainty estimates, and deploys these elements in a prototype vehicle and provides an XAI Interface that visualizes documentation artifacts, model uncertainty state, and saliency maps, demonstrating the feasibility of trustworthy perception monitoring in real time.

2605.16065.tldr: A prior-guided label reassignment method that assigns labels to 3D Gaussians by enforcing multiview consistency with learned priors is introduced, which achieves state-of-the-art segmentation accuracy and enables interactive, real-time object editing while maintaining high visual fidelity.

2605.16054.tldr: Ada-Diffuser is introduced, a causal diffusion model that learns the temporal structure of observed interactions and the underlying latent dynamics simultaneously, and furthermore, leverages them for planning and control, enabling adaptation to latent variations in dynamics, rewards, and latent actions.

2605.16043.tldr: Evaluated open-loop on an unseen rope configuration, the state-based policy outperforms its visual counterpart with a 30.8% reduction in L1 error when predicting the initial grasp-and-pull action, quantifying the observability gap between pixels and physics-consistent state, and pointing toward more data-efficient robot learning for the DLO manipulation task from limited human demonstrations.

2605.15983.tldr: The Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem (RCPSP) is formulated as optimal search over the reachability graph of a Timed Transition Petri Net with Resources, using relative-delay tokens so that scheduling decisions correspond to transition firings in the induced state space.

2605.15976.tldr: A consistent empirical pattern is identified in which gains are largest where baseline performance is weakest and reward discriminability is highest, making this approach most effective precisely where parallel data is scarcest, and this pattern is replicated across English and Spanish source languages.

2605.16205.tldr: A design principle for structured adversarial POMDPs is suggested: invest in programmatic infrastructure and clean task decomposition rather than deeper per-agent reasoning, as these strategies can interfere when combined.

2605.16194.tldr: A companion JSON file that travels with the PDF and addresses each failure with a lightweight convention, holding that minimum viable compliance, hand-written JSON alongside the PDF, is achievable in under an hour for a finished paper without touching the human-readable output.

2605.16165.tldr: The Fisher-Orthogonal Projection suppresses variance-induced modality conflicts, reducing the trade-off between visual generation and textual understanding, and introduces a hierarchical folding strategy that captures fine-grained variance with low micro-step overhead.

2605.16116.tldr: ShopGym is an integrated framework for realistic simulation and scalable benchmarking of e-commerce web agents that produces self-contained, resettable, inspectable, and stable evaluation artifacts that preserve structural properties and agent-evaluation signals relevant to shopping tasks.

2605.16112.tldr: This work identifies attention dispersion as a shared failure mode of dynamic graph Transformers under temporal distribution shift, and introduces DiffDyG, a reference implementation combining differential attention with standard input encodings.

2605.16153.tldr: This paper formalizes TDM using structural causal modeling notation and identifies three psychological operators that extend standard SCM to capture how people compute moral judgments under constraints, enabling neurosymbolic AI systems to compute morality in a way that is both mathematically rigorous and faithful to human moral cognition.

2605.16138.tldr: SNAC-Pack is presented, an integrated framework that automates the discovery and optimization of neural networks focusing on FPGA deployment, enabling multi-objective optimization across accuracy, FPGA resource utilization, and latency without requiring time-intensive synthesis for each candidate model.

2605.16122.tldr: GenShield is proposed, a unified autoregressive framework that jointly performs explainable AIGI detection and controllable artifact correction in a closed loop from diagnosis to restoration, revealing a mutually reinforcing relationship between these two tasks.

2605.16089.tldr: Experimental analyses using the Fedstellar simulator, MNIST dataset, and MLP classifier show clear trade-offs between different performance indicators in centralized and decentralized Federated Learning.

2605.16085.tldr: A hybrid architecture combining a fine-tuned BART encoder to capture intra-row semantics with a GraphSAGE-based GNN over REGs to inject relational context is proposed, suggesting that lightweight hybrid LM-GNN architectures offer a promising and resource-efficient path towards foundation models for relational databases.

2605.16076.tldr: An ensemble of ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, and DenseNet121 trained on 20,638 PlantVillage images across 15 pepper, potato, and tomato disease classes, which reaches 99.23% -- a two-thirds cut in error rate.

2605.15963.tldr: AGER is proposed, a topology-aware agent that decomposes construction into dependency-structured planning and pixel-level execution, establishing a new state of the art for point-precise GUI control.

2605.15959.tldr: A new analysis framework is proposed for adversarially trained PINNs, based on the key observation of how the discriminator in GANs can influence the training dynamics of PINNs, which can significantly reduce the pathology of PINNs training.

2605.16024.tldr: ScreenSearch is presented, a system that combines structural screen retrieval and deduplication with an ambiguity-aware PUCT graph-bandit for large-scale desktop exploration and shows that stronger proposal priors can materially improve unique-state discovery during corpus building.

2605.15967.tldr: This work formalizes the event-graph substrates class, proves a duality between explanatory and counterfactual queries that reduces both to the same causal-ancestor traversal, and evaluates a 1,400-line CLEVRER-DSL interpreter atop a domain-agnostic substrate runtime at full CLEVRER validation scale.

2605.16099.tldr: FedHF-Impute is proposed, a federated imputation framework that separates structural feature unavailability from conventional missingness and uses a shared global feature graph to propagate information across statistically related features through message passing and enables indirect cross-client knowledge transfer.

2605.16052.tldr: It is shown that performance can be inflated by contamination, and that neuro-symbolic frameworks offer a more reliable and robust foundation for legal AI, as well as improved generalization to unobserved situations.

2605.16045.tldr: RecMem is proposed, a memory consolidation scheme that stores incoming interactions in a subconscious memory layer and encode them using lightweight embedding models for retrieval and incorporates a semantic refinement mechanism that recovers the fine-grained facts omitted by memory extraction.

2605.16026.tldr: S2ST-Omni 2 is proposed, a many-to-one compositional S2ST framework that systematically reformulates multilingual language conditioning from flat language labels to structured typological priors and achieves superior average performance among representative S2ST approaches across BLEU, COMET, ASR-BLEU, and BLASER 2.0.

2605.16198.tldr: Experimental results show that by exploiting the formal syntax and semantics of Linear Temporal Logic (LTL), the proposed auditing and monitoring techniques are superior to LLM baseline methods in detecting violations of temporally extended behavioral constraints.

2605.16126.tldr: The results support entropy-rate scheduling as a practical low-budget allocation signal for high-dimensional bridge and flow samplers and derive a conditional-marginal entropy-rate objective for bridge-aware discretization, separating endpoint-conditioned bridge geometry from marginal flow evolution.

2605.15995.tldr: This work proposes Constrained Latent State Modeling (CLSM) as a unifying conceptual framework, which characterizes latent states through complementary constraints, including predictive sufficiency, minimality, temporal coherence, observation compatibility, invariance to nuisance factors, and structural constraints, and interprets representation learning as balancing these properties through trade-offs.

2605.15984.tldr: ToxiAlert-Bench, a large-scale audio dataset comprising over 30,000 audio clips annotated with seven major toxic categories and twenty fine-grained toxic labels, is presented, and a dual-head neural network with a multi-stage training strategy tailored for toxic speech detection is proposed.

2605.16142.tldr: Property-guided LLM synthesis can reduce cost and improve program quality whenever a problem admits a verifiable property, and compared to the best prior generation method this approach generates seven times fewer programs per domain on average, solves more tasks without using search, and requires several orders of magnitude less computation to evaluate candidates.

2605.16113.tldr: DebiasRAG is proposed, a novel tuning-free and dynamic query-specific debiasing framework based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that improves fairness while preserving the intrinsic properties of LLMs, such as representation ability.

2605.16215.tldr: Fully Open Meditron is introduced, the first fully open pipeline for building LLM-CDSS, comprising a clinician-audited training corpus, a reproducible data construction and training framework, and a use-aligned evaluation protocol, to show that fully open pipelines can achieve state-of-the-art domain-specific performance without sacrificing auditability or reproducibility.

2605.16207.tldr: A benchmark of seven LLM feedback agents in propositional logic using knowledge-graph-derived ground truth across 10,836 solution--feedback pairs and three feedback conditions suggests that LLMs are better suited for hybrid architectures where KG-grounded models handle diagnosis while LLMs support open-ended scaffolding and dialogue.

2605.16143.tldr: This work proposes the Explore-then-Act paradigm, which decouples information-gathering from task execution: agents first utilize an interaction budget to acquire grounded environmental knowledge, then leverage it for task resolution.

2605.16134.tldr: LLQR+SAM is introduced, which combines SAM with a learned preconditioner obtained from the recently proposed LLQR framework, a second-order method that recasts steepest descent as a layerwise linear-quadratic regulator problem.

2605.16103.tldr: This paper decomposes the Q-learning error into its componentwise positive and negative parts and derive separate finite-time rates for the two components, providing indirect theoretical evidence for max-induced overestimation.

2605.16094.tldr: Simulations based on channels generated from a segment of the Guangshen high-speed railway show that the proposed geometric prior substantially improves CFR reconstruction over pilot-only and non-geometric baselines.

2605.16088.tldr: MolCHG is proposed, a multi-level self-supervised pretraining framework built upon a novel Compositional Hierarchical Graph that organizes molecular structure into four types of nodes across three semantic levels that achieves the best performance on seven datasets across both classification and regression tasks.

2605.16079.tldr: VideoSeeker seamlessly integrates agentic reasoning with instance-level video understanding tasks, enabling the model to proactively perceive and retrieve relevant video segments on demand, and constructs a four-stage fully automated data synthesis pipeline to efficiently generate large-scale, high-quality instance-level video data.

2605.16048.tldr: It is demonstrated that depth-recurrence is orthogonal to sequence-recurrence and independently beneficial, and input reshaping is an equally neglected design axis, suggesting that depth and input reshaping are two independent and underexplored design axes for SSMs on time series.

2605.16046.tldr: This work proposes XSearch, an intrinsically explainable code search framework that identifies functional concepts in the query and explicitly aligns them with corresponding code statements, and produces inherent concept-level explanations and mitigates shortcut learning that harms out-of-distribution generalization.

2605.16035.tldr: This work formalizes the problem of agent attribution: linking an observed agent interaction to the responsible account at the hosting vendor, and develops robust canary constructions that cannot be suppressed without degrading the agent's own task performance, yielding a formal asymmetry in the defender's favor.

2605.15978.tldr: The objective is to measure the value of narratives to recover incident details only from the unstructured text and build temporal graphs with time cues and domain axioms to recover incident details only from the unstructured text.

2605.15960.tldr: A general theory of reward hacking and model exploitation is developed that proves that exploitation is essentially unavoidable on large policy sets and yields the corresponding claim for hacking as a special case and introduces a relaxed notion of exploitation and derives a safe horizon within which it can be avoided.

2605.15942.tldr: A Decomposed Vision-Language Alignment framework is proposed that explicitly factorizes textual prompts into a concept token and multiple attribute tokens, enabling separate cross-modal interactions for each semantic unit.

2605.16255.tldr: A framework for evaluating datacenter power delivery designs using throughput, power, and cost metrics over realistic arrival, oversubscription, and decommissioning sequences is developed and results show that multi-resource stranding materially changes deployable capacity, effective capital expenditure, and delivered performance.

2605.16245.tldr: A mathematical model of opinion dynamics in which an AI system sits between users on a social network, transforming the opinions they express and perceive is introduced and it is shown that biases introduced by AI in human-to-human communication can be amplified through the network and shift collective opinion in their direction.

2605.16234.tldr: Interchange-guided removal is several-fold safer than replacement-guided at the same layer budgets, while Llama-3.1-8B ties the two protocols for pruning cost even though interchange KL is lower, showing metric gaps need not map one-to-one to removal.

2605.16258.tldr: IVGT is proposed, an Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer that implicitly models continuous and coherent geometry from pose-free multi-view images and allows direct extraction of continuous and coherent surface geometry, enabling rendering of RGB images, depth maps, and surface normal maps from arbitrary viewpoints.

2605.16233.tldr: ForGE (Failure-Optimized Reflective Graduation and Evolution), a staged, population-based protocol that evolves prompt-injected natural-language memory for hierarchical ReAct agents, finds that population broadcast is critical mechanism, and Examples achieves the strongest returns for three of four models, Rules offers the best cost-reliability profile with $\sim$40% fewer tokens.

2605.16223.tldr: A fully automated evaluation framework organized across four dimensions: layout fidelity, motion correctness, temporal quality, and content fidelity is provided, which eliminates the reliance on subjective human evaluation and establishes a common basis for benchmarking progress in the field.

2605.16250.tldr: An end-to-end framework is proposed that unifies four production-grade capabilities under one architectural roof, including a generative-AI agent that drafts each customers natural-language billing statement from structured numeric inputs under a constrained decoding policy.

2605.16241.tldr: VLA-AD demonstrates that offline semantic guidance from VLMs can substantially improve the efficiency, robustness, and deployability of VLA policy distillation.

2605.16238.tldr: An autonomous system using Large Language Model-guided tree search to iteratively generate, evaluate, and optimize executable forecasting software, enabling rapid deployment of expert-level disease forecasting at unprecedented scales.

2508.06524.tldr: CarbonScaling jointly models tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism while incorporating memory, bandwidth, utilization, and runtime constraints and highlights the growing importance of embodied carbon at trillion-parameter scales.

2508.03018.tldr: This work proposes BPO, a three-stage framework (bootstrapping, extrapolation, and refinement) that establishes a self-improving data flywheel to develop robust reasoning models for long-horizon, sparse-reward environments and achieves state-of-the-art with significant token efficiency.

2503.13535.tldr: A hybrid-survey method is proposed to examine the impact of GAI on students across four different grades in six key areas (LIPSAL): learning interest, independent learning, problem solving, self-confidence, appropriate use, and learning enjoyment, and found that students have a positive attitude towards GAI and are very willing to use it.

2501.12709.tldr: QuNetQFL is presented, a QFL protocol implemented on quantum networks, in which local model updates are masked with distributed quantum secret keys, offering information-theoretic security during aggregation, establishing a practical and scalable route to quantum-secure federated learning for the emerging quantum internet.

2411.18234.tldr: The proposed random grid search combines the power of random search to explore the global space with the focused and exhaustive search of grid search in the most promising areas and yields a robust and time-efficient ML model for classification seetings.

2408.17352.tldr: A novel architecture named AASIST3 is proposed, enhancing the existing AASIST framework with Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, additional layers, encoders, and pre-emphasis techniques, and achieves a more than twofold improvement in performance.

2406.15797.tldr: This work proposes a graph clustering framework named synergistic deep graph clustering network (SynC), which employs a transform input graph autoencoder (TIGAE) to obtain high-quality embeddings via mitigating the representation collapse issue of GAE for guiding structure augmentation, and introduces a structure fine-tuning strategy to improve the model’s generalization on the low homophily graph.

2406.14427.tldr: A novel variant of the POMDP framework in which the information acquired through inference is treated as a resource that must be optimized alongside utility, establishing a framework for rational computation that extends existing approaches to information-constrained decision-making and offers normative insight into how brains and machines can achieve effective behavior under tight computational constraints.

2304.03427.tldr: This work presents the Transformer + Confidence Score mechanism architecture for post-processing Google’s Tibetan OCR-ed outputs, and says that according to the Loss and Character Error Rate metrics, this architecture proves superior to the Transformer, LSTM-to-LSTM, and GRU-to-GRU architectures.

2509.19590.tldr: It is argued that AI evaluations should instead be framed as inference tasks grounded on an explicit theory of capability, and empirically shown that reported performance can depend strongly on the evaluator's modeling assumptions, underscoring the need for transparent, theory-driven evaluation practices.

2509.06503.tldr: Empirical Research Assistance (ERA), an AI system that creates expert-level scientific software whose goal is to maximize a quality metric, represents a significant step towards accelerating scientific progress.

2508.06799.tldr: This work proposes LSDTs (LLM-Augmented Semantic Digital Twins), a framework that helps LLMs extract planning knowledge from unstructured documents like environmental regulations and technical guidelines, and organize it into a formal ontology, which forms a semantic layer that powers a digital twin.

2506.22901.tldr: MAGNET (Missing-modality-Aware Graph neural NETwork) is proposed to enhance multimodal prediction with partial modalities, featuring a dynamic patient-modality multi-head attention mechanism to fuse lower-dimensional modality embeddings based on their contribution and missingness.

2506.11925.tldr: Real-world hardware experimental validation demonstrates that the proposed lane-change prediction system anticipates the target vehicle’s lane change three to four seconds in advance, providing the ego vehicle sufficient time to react and allowing the target vehicle to make the lane change safely.

2505.16831.tldr: By probing unlearning limits, this work identifies a case of seemingly irreversible, targeted forgetting, offering insights for more robust erasure algorithms and exposes a gap in current evaluation and establishes a representation-level foundation for trustworthy unlearning.

2502.17007.tldr: It is shown how uncertainty can provide a principled unifying framework for counterfactual explainability by expressing the core counterfactual properties in terms of uncertainty, allowing to build two variants of an explainer upon them -- one based solely on uncertainty estimates and another pairing them with distance measured in the feature space.

2509.23986.tldr: TusoAI is an agentic AI system that takes a scientific task description with an evaluation function and autonomously develops and optimizes computational methods for the application, improving performance over a pool of candidate solutions.

2503.19950.tldr: LogQuant, a groundbreaking 2-bit quantization technique for KV Cache in large language model (LLM) inference, delivering substantial memory savings while preserving superior performance while integrating effortlessly with popular inference frameworks like Python's transformers library.

2503.20981.tldr: The results show that interpersonal factors and operational efficiency emerge as the strongest determinants of patient satisfaction in urgent care, while technical quality, finances, and facilities show no significant independent effects when adjusted for in multivariate models.

2503.13533.tldr: The current status of AI-TPACK for MTES in China for the first time is revealed, a dedicated SEM is designed to study the effect of specific factors on AI-TPACK, and a new AI-TPACK structural equation model is proposed to explore the impact of self-efficacy and teaching beliefs on AI-TPACK.

2503.12181.tldr: Action-Gradient MCTS (AGMCTS), a framework that combines global tree search with local gradient-based action refinement, while maintaining consistent value estimates, is proposed, which outperforms state-of-the-art sample-based solvers in multiple challenging continuous MDP and POMDP benchmarks.

2508.04149.tldr: By selecting preference data examples with smaller DPO implicit reward gaps, which are indicative of more challenging cases, this approach consistently outperforms five strong baselines across multiple datasets and alignment tasks, achieving superior performance with only 10\% of the original data.

2506.05442.tldr: A structured and concise benchmark dataset is introduced, NuScenes-S, which is derived from the NuScenes dataset and contains machine-friendly structured representations and achieves competitive performance on structured dataset, with approximately 20% accuracy improvement on decision-making tasks, while surpassing massive parameter baseline in inference speed with over 10x speedup.

2409.10102.tldr: This work proposes a unified framework, Trust-RAG Compass, that assesses the trustworthiness of RAG systems across six key dimensions: factuality, robustness, fairness, transparency, accountability, and privacy, and introduces an evaluation benchmark, TRC Bench, regarding the six dimensions.

2411.10636.tldr: RandSymKL is a refined training approach to integrate these elements in a unified way for extrinsic gender bias mitigation focused on classification tasks, with results showing that this technique not only effectively reduces bias but also maintains competitive accuracy compared to other baseline approaches.

2409.02428.tldr: This paper proposes ERFSL, an efficient reward function searcher using LLMs, which enables LLMs to be effective white-box searchers and highlights their advanced semantic understanding capabilities.

2401.03717.tldr: A novel taxonomy based on three fundamental elements in designing state-of-the-art universal representation learning methods for time series is presented based on existing studies and discusses their intuitions and insights into how these methods enhance the quality of learned representations.

2509.03403.tldr: PRocess cOnsistency Filter (PROF), a data curation method that uses PRM--ORM consistency for sample selection rather than direct reward optimization and consistently improves both final-answer accuracy and intermediate reasoning quality over strong baselines, with less dependence on strong PRMs.

2505.02360.tldr: An adaptive $l^p-FGSM that automatically tunes the training norm based on gradient information is developed, providing a novel and theoretically-principled pathway to mitigate the CO problem.

2502.20349.tldr: It is argued that progress in Artificial Intelligence offers timely opportunities for cognitive science to embrace experiments with increasingly naturalistic stimuli, tasks, and behaviors; and computational models that can accommodate these changes.

2502.13957.tldr: Findings show that supervising the search process produces more reliable and generalizable information-seeking agents, and proposes Re$^2$Search++, a process-supervised agent that achieves substantial improvements on multi-hop information-seeking benchmarks, especially in out-of-domain settings.

2603.02512.tldr: Human-Certified Module Repositories are introduced in this work as a new architectural model for constructing trustworthy software in the era of AI-assisted development, positioning HCMRs as a foundational substrate for reliable and auditable AI-constructed software systems.

2602.17831.tldr: Overall, this work suggests new paradigms for evaluating reasoning that avoid saturation by design, and that allow testing models for other skills like creativity and task creation alongside problem solving, that are close to Humanity's Last Exam.

2602.18584.tldr: This work proposes GIST (Gradient Isometric Subspace Transformation), a simple yet principled alternative that replaces axis-aligned scaling with robust subspace alignment and matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline with only 0.29% of the storage and 25% of the computational time under the same selection budget.

2604.04202.tldr: ClawArena is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents in evolving information environments and shows that model capability accounts for a 29-point score range across models while framework design accounts for up to a 24-point range, that MetaClaw's skill overlay reliably improves score without degrading accuracy, and that belief revision difficulty is determined by update design strategy rather than update volume.

2603.02218.tldr: It is revealed that sustainable self-evolution requires a self-synthesised data pipeline with learnable information that increases across iterations, and triadic roles that self-evolving LLMs play are identified, providing a measurable, system-level path from brittle self-play dynamics to sustained self-evolution.

2604.09450.tldr: ECHO enables stable one-step-per-block inference via a novel Direct Conditional Distillation (DCD) framework, which mitigates the mean-field limitation by constructing unfactorized supervision from on-policy diffusion trajectories to encode joint token dependencies.

2605.16268.tldr: A customer-facing AI powered triaging agent that leverages large language models to conduct multi-turn conversations, ask relevant questions, and classify cases for accurate, policy-guided routing, making it embedded in the customer journey is developed.

2605.12920.tldr: This work extends PARTNR, a benchmark for collaborative household robotics, with a natural-language dialogue channel that enables two agents with partial observability to communicate during task execution, and proposes a framework for measuring world-model alignment defined over per-agent world graphs.

2605.12824.tldr: A scale separating the evaluation of a model's generative sufficiency from its mechanistic plausibility (how the phenomenon could be produced), and clarifies the distinct roles of different models, such as predictive and explanatory ones is introduced as the Mechanism Plausibility Scale.

2605.16295.tldr: This work presents ANVIL, a multimodal generative system that automates the production of analogy-based instructional animations for computer science topics, and suggests that teachers respond positively to its perceived value and usability.

2605.16290.tldr: A persona-driven framework that replaces theoretical ability sampling with data-driven cognitive profiling is proposed, and the discovered personas are interpretable and offer insights into why items are difficult, with potential applications to diagnostic assessment design.

2605.16283.tldr: It is argued that AI's societal risk lies not in replacing teachers but in eliminating the productive struggle through which the next generation's capacity forms, and a research and design agenda targeting what current measurement systems miss is proposed.

2605.16282.tldr: This work presents the first systematic analysis dedicated to agent safety benchmarks as evaluation instruments, and proposes a six-axis taxonomy of benchmark evaluation methodology, and applies it across the corpus to characterize how methodological choices shape safety conclusions.

2605.16281.tldr: The Proactive AI Governance Compliance Framework (PAGCF) is proposed, a four-phase lifecycle for pre-deployment assessment, continuous monitoring, incident preparedness, and cross-framework verification for effective post-deployment governance.

2605.16280.tldr: This paper examines whether constraining large language models within deterministic symbolic scaffolds improves statute-grounded illegality assessment while preventing scope drift, and evaluates the neuro-symbolic variant of Rulemapping - a visual logic-tree method that operationalises the classic legal syllogism - on online hate-speech classification under German Criminal Code.

2605.12070.tldr: This work proposes three exact old-logit acquisition strategies: snapshot-based version tracking, a dedicated old-logit model, and synchronization via partial rollout interruption, and compares their system trade-offs to adopt a revised PPO-EWMA method.

2605.08794.tldr: This work shows that the deterministic field \(b_t\) of a stochastic generative process admits a natural transport--osmotic decomposition that separates deterministic transport from stochastic, diffusion-induced effects, and proposes Bridge Matching, a flow-based framework for learning decomposed generative dynamics through both marginal and conditional formulations.

2605.08475.tldr: This paper studies in-context kernel ridge regression with Gaussian kernels and shows that a standard softmax-attention transformer can approximate the KRR predictor during its forward pass by implementing preconditioned Richardson iteration on the associated kernel linear system.

2605.07905.tldr: CoReviewBench is introduced, which curates 3,900 papers from ICLR and NeurIPS to enable reliable and fine-grained evaluation of AI reviewers, and shows that AI reviewers remain limited in correctness and are prone to hallucinations.

2605.16292.tldr: A longitudinal analysis of classroom poll responses collected between 2020 and 2026 in AI-focused undergraduate and MSc courses in computer science suggests a gradual reappraisal of human intelligence as AI becomes a routine tool, with implications for learner autonomy and epistemic agency.

2605.16278.tldr: A practical framework for effective human oversight of AI systems is advanced, based on a cross-disciplinary perspective that draws on insights from computer science, human-computer interaction, psychology, philosophy, and law.

2605.16275.tldr: The development, implementation, and evaluation of teacher-prompted, AI-generated supplemental materials in an English for Academic Purposes (EAP) course at a Hong Kong Community College demonstrates that RAG tools enable scalable personalized feedback that would be less feasible through traditional methods.

2605.16272.tldr: A qualitative study with 22 creative writers, exploring reactions to refusals to common requests across writing stages, suggests that reflective potential depends on heterogeneous preference alignment along situational, cognitive, and relational dimensions.

2605.16265.tldr: AgentWall is introduced, a runtime safety and observability layer for local AI agents that intercepts every proposed agent action before it reaches the host environment, evaluates it against an explicit declarative policy, requires human approval for sensitive operations, and records a complete execution trail for audit and replay.

2605.16291.tldr: It is argued that collective input can and should be incorporated at multiple points across the ML development pipeline, from data collection through objective design to alignment, and that social choice provides a well-suited modelling language for the treatment of collective input across all stages.

2605.16286.tldr: The experimental result shows the theoretical problems of introductory computer science courses can be effectively perturbed, and a simple method to address this issue in the lazy student model is proposed.

2605.16284.tldr: Historical grade data as reported to the university registrar is used to triangulate the phenomenon of learning achievement in pre- and post-LLM eras and inform GenAI policy for professors, universities, and other educational institutions that are trying to maximize student learning in the age of AI.

2605.16277.tldr: This mid-year report summarizes teacher use of Colleague AI across 12 Washington State school districts from September 1 to December 31, 2025 and finds that link teachers'use of Colleague AI to student characteristics should be interpreted as preliminary signals.

2605.16269.tldr: This work shows how agentic AI can serve as a force multiplier for mental health support in austere environments and identifies pathways for broader evaluation and deployment across defense and humanitarian operations.

2605.06638.tldr: ScaleLogic is introduced, a synthetic logical reasoning framework that offers independent control over two axes of difficulty: the depth of the required proof planning and the expressiveness of the underlying logic.

2605.12825.tldr: Orthrus is a simple and efficient dual-architecture framework that unifies the exact generation fidelity of autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) with the high-speed parallel token generation of diffusion models, delivering up to a 7.8x speedup with only an O(1) memory cache overhead and minimal parameter additions.

2605.16259.tldr: An optimization landscape fundamentally different from that of NVIDIA GPUs is revealed -- including the absence of speedup from quantization, the ineffectiveness of parallel inference, and the unsuitability of the Neural Engine for large-scale models -- and practical guidelines for diffusion model inference on Apple Silicon are provided.

2605.12991.tldr: This work localizes the corruption to a narrow mid-layer window where attention carries the causal weight and MLP contribution is negligible; patching above this window restores 96% of the clean-to-pressured P(correct) gap.

2605.09826.tldr: EnactToM is introduced, an evolving benchmark of 300 embodied multi-agent tasks set in a 3D household with partial observability, private information, and constrained communication, and new tasks are generated increase difficulty as models improve.

2605.02832.tldr: Human-AI Adaptive Symbiosis (HAAS), an implemented framework for adaptive task allocation in software engineering and manufacturing, is presented, positioning HAAS as a pre-deployment workbench for comparing and inspecting human--AI allocation policies before organisational commitment.

2605.01235.tldr: MindMelody is a fully functional, closed-loop real-time system for EEG-driven personalized music intervention that improves control adherence and emotional alignment, and receives higher perceived helpfulness in a short-term listening setting, suggesting its promise as an adaptive affect-aware music generation framework.

2605.16297.tldr: Two design artifacts developed in a financial-services IT setting are described: T-IPO, which represents each task as an eight-element tuple, and LARA, a five-dimension rubric that scores a task's readiness for agent substitution, which seems to be determined jointly by cognitive-execution complexity and governance-compliance intensity.

2605.16294.tldr: How AI is reshaping the scientific lifecycle is examined and exposes the deeper danger: not that AI will fail to do science, but that humans may stop truly understanding it.

2605.16279.tldr: Overall, the findings show that in tiered professional platforms, demand expansion and competitive incentives can outweigh intrinsic crowding-out.

2605.16274.tldr: This work proposes ChartDesign, which post-trains LLMs to imitate human experts and generate chart design attributes given tabular data, and significantly improves chart design performance over strong baselines, achieving up to 84% accuracy on a held-out test set and generalizing to unseen domains.

2605.16393.tldr: ViTC-UNet is introduced, which conditions a UNet on frozen pre-trained ViT representations through learnable tokens and a two-way attention decoder, demonstrating that structure-conditioned UNet decoding can efficiently adapt large-scale visual priors to high-complexity biomedical segmentation.

2605.16391.tldr: A diffusion-based generative learning framework for synthesizing high-fidelity virtual IMU data from low-cost IMU measurements that breaks the performance limits of low-cost IMU and demonstrates the potential of diffusion-based generative learning for virtual high-grade IMU data.

2605.16381.tldr: StreamPro-Bench is introduced, a new benchmark that evaluates streaming models from three complementary perspectives: Perception Understanding, Temporal Reasoning, and Proactive Agency, where the last measures a model's ability to make early yet reliable decisions under partial observations.

2605.16371.tldr: This work proposes the GeoSym Engine, an automated and scalable neuro-symbolic framework that derives exact symbolic ground truths and seamlessly integrates with a robust rendering pipeline to produce high-precision geometric diagrams and introduces GeoSym-Bench, an expert-curated suite of 511 complex samples for rigorous evaluation.

2605.16354.tldr: The role of the LLM judge is shifted from substitutive to auxiliary, and the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm is formulates as one of augmenting human evaluation through a two-stage sampling design.

2605.16352.tldr: LARGER (Lexically Anchored Repository Graph Exploration and Retrieval), a lexically anchored active-set retrieval framework that starts from lexical matches, aligns them to graph anchors, and performs confidence-filtered local expansion within the agent's existing search loop is introduced.

2605.16348.tldr: The proposed Flow-Direct framework is naturally reusable: once optimization is complete, the collected dataset defines a reusable guidance field for generating novel target samples without additional reward evaluations, and distinct guidance fields can be combined to generate samples that simultaneously satisfy multiple objectives.

2605.16327.tldr: This paper presents a differentiable optimization layered safety-critical control method based on conformal prediction to handle uncertainties arising from sensor noise, and introduces two nested differentiable optimization layers to build the control barrier functions for obstacle avoidance and feasibility guarantee.

2605.16326.tldr: A machine learning framework that uses electroencephalography to predict treatment efficacy in patients with chronic neck pain is presented, with the goal of supporting individualized therapy and reducing the burden on healthcare systems.

2605.16312.tldr: Action availability as a distinct robustness surface in self-play RL is identified as a distinct robustness surface in self-play RL.

2605.16306.tldr: UVTran, a transformer-based framework that predicts an auxiliary projection surface better to capture the geometric characteristics of the hole boundary, is proposed, a transformer-based framework that predicts an auxiliary projection surface better to capture the geometric characteristics of the hole boundary.

2605.16299.tldr: ACE is proposed, a self-evolving code generation framework based on a solver--adversary architecture that prioritizes active failure discovery through execution-centric supervision and requires no ground-truth code or external reward models.

2605.16298.tldr: A novel AI- and data-driven distributed governance framework for smart building management that integrates decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs), digital twins, large language models (LLMs), and blockchain technology is introduced.

2605.16358.tldr: Evaluating state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight LLMs, it is found that these models can leverage signals extracted from complex events to enhance predictive performance and achieve better performance on equities they confidently identify as more predictable.

2605.16389.tldr: A unified theoretical framework and experimental evaluations for FO viscoelastic rendering under short-memory discretization is established, which generalizes previously reported results for integer-order Kelvin-Voigt, Maxwell, and SLS models.

2605.16377.tldr: CheckSupport, an open-source, locally deployable system that uses large language models to automate the recommendation of reporting checklists and the evidence-grounded completion of checklists for scientific manuscripts, demonstrates that large language models, when applied as structured inference components, can reduce reporting burden and support more transparent and reproducible scientific reporting across disciplines.

2605.16366.tldr: Across fine-grained short-video and long-video reasoning benchmarks, Fre-Res achieves a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off, matching or approaching full-token performance while substantially reducing visual-token length.

2605.16364.tldr: This work provides low-cost gold transcripts via multi-ASR agreement-guided post-editing and annotate answerability (answerable, ambiguous/needs-clarification, unsupported, not-a-request/noise) to separate intrinsic unanswerability from ASR-induced degradation.

2605.16351.tldr: Physic-Informed Multi-Scale Mamba (PIMSM), a state-space architecture that maps spectrum-estimated transition points between frequency regimes to scale-specific discretization parameters and anchors them to acquisition time units, improves robustness and representation stability under severe temporal-context truncation, extreme low-resource transfer, and resting-state-to-task-state generalization.

2605.16345.tldr: This paper proposes goal-conditioned supervised learning (GCSL) as an offline fine-tuning framework for LLMs and proposes natural-language goal representations to better leverage the semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

2605.16343.tldr: LoopQ is proposed, a loop-aware PTQ framework that preserves a shared quantized backbone while introducing lightweight adaptations and combines activation scaling, selective transformation, cross-loop state alignment, and trajectory-aware optimization to reduce distributional mismatch within loops and error accumulation across loops.

2605.16303.tldr: It is observed that, compared to survey agents trained on broader data, demographics-only agents exhibited a central tendency bias, skewing answers toward population means, and were unrealistically accurate, failing to reproduce the incorrect answers and"don't know" responses typical of human respondents.

2605.16380.tldr: Reliability-aware Temporal Aggregation with Mamba is proposed, which reconstructs clinical time series as time-variable token sequences, estimates observation reliability from missingness and elapsed time, and augments interval summaries with statistical descriptors.

2605.16336.tldr: SteganoPrompt is described, a single-page, zero-dependency web tool that encodes an arbitrary printable-ASCII payload into the deprecated Unicode Tags block that survives common copy-paste channels, and is reliably tokenized by frontier models.

2605.16331.tldr: This work traces the computational pathway through which ESM2-8M produces the prediction, that proteins begin with methionine, by tracing the computational pathway through which ESM2-8M produces this prediction.

2605.16325.tldr: The geometric structure of this framework is outlined, falsifiable predictions distinguishing it from single-field alternatives are identified, and consistency with recent empirical findings on alignment transitions, adversarial breakdown scaling, and partial introspection in large language models is shown.

2605.16302.tldr: This work proposes a counterfactual-comparison framework for credit assignment and introduces Implicit Behavior Policy Optimization (IBPO), which substantially improves training stability and the performance ceiling on mathematical and code-reasoning benchmarks.

2605.16387.tldr: A unified Train-Inference-Evaluation framework that explicitly stabilizes temporal inference dynamics using model-agnostic, plug-and-play components is proposed and the Temporal Fragmentation Index (TFI) is introduced, a reliability-aware metric that quantifies instability-induced temporal disagreement beyond conventional frame-wise and token-based measures.

2605.16384.tldr: This work rigorously identifies two key drawbacks in existing methods: information insufficiency when reconstructing images with patch tokens alone, and information redundancy among patch tokens, and introduces global tokens that model mutual information across patch tokens, and a Dynamic Token Filtering algorithm based on cumulative conditional entropy to eliminate redundancy.

2605.16383.tldr: This work proposes, for the first time, a unified neurosymbolic and epistemic modelling framework that augments Swin Transformers with focal set reasoning and differentiable fuzzy logic, and shows that combining focal set reasoning with fuzzy logic provides a practical step toward deep learning models that are both accurate and epistemically aware.

2605.16378.tldr: This work shows that MLM conditionals are intrinsically incompatible, and introduces a rectangle test that certifies this incompatibility and empirically verify its prevalence across modern MLMs, and provides a theoretical analysis of the induced Markov chain.

2605.16374.tldr: A diagnostic framework is proposed that leverages Sparse Autoencoders to define a task-anchored latent feature space, enabling analysis of how task-specific information evolves at a finer granularity, where individual SAE latents are treated as concept proxies for recurring and relatively disentangled visual patterns in the model's internal computations.

2605.16346.tldr: PropGuard is proposed, a propagation-aware framework for safeguarding LLM-MAS that consistently lowers attack success while maintaining high task-level defense success, achieving a favorable effectiveness--efficiency trade-off.

2605.16309.tldr: ANNEAL is the only evaluated system that commits persistent structural repairs--strong baselines such as ReAct and Reflexion achieve high episodic recovery yet retain 72--100% holdout failure rates on recurring faults, whereas ANNEAL reduces these to 0% in the tested recurring-failure settings.

2605.16301.tldr: MANTA is constructed, a benchmark of 1,088 five-turn conversations progressing from an implicit Turn-1 scenario through an explicit welfare prompt to three adversarial pressure rounds drawn from a five-type taxonomy, showing welfare robustness depends jointly on the animal and pressure applied.

2605.16300.tldr: A three-layer governance architecture is proposed, the Consent Runtime Verification Framework for Embodied Agents (CoRVE), which integrates consent scope modeling, delegation chain tracking, and physical irreversibility assessment for consent chain degradation.

2605.16379.tldr: An information-theoretic account of synthetic data effectiveness is provided, which leads to a guiding thesis: learning preferentially converges to the most information-efficient signal component available, which accelerates learning when that component is the intended one, but causes reward hacking when a spurious pattern happens to be simpler.

2605.16373.tldr: A bimodal end-to-end segmentation framework that integrates PET metabolic signals and CT bone-window anatomy through an early-fusion multimodal representation is developed and the cross-evaluation matrix quantitatively reveals how models successfully internalize distinct expert diagnostic philosophies, providing a robust, diversity-preserving paradigm for clinical AI deployment in bone infection segmentation.

2605.16360.tldr: The HybridAxialMapper is designed, which disentangles temporal feature extraction from cross-head alignment, together with a Multi-Granularity Hybrid Loss that shifts the learning objective from rigid regression to relative ranking consistency.

2605.16359.tldr: F^3A is proposed, a training-free router for visual token pruning that operates before the language model consumes image tokens, and requires no model training, no extra LLM forward pass and preserves the original multimodal prompting and decoding pipeline.

2605.16357.tldr: This paper proposes Intersection Pathway (IP), a cross-modal learning framework that aligns fingerprint traces and displacement traces in a shared latent space, such that latent addition and subtraction correspond to physical motion composition, enabling direct relative-displacement inference.

2605.16350.tldr: FedNL is proposed, a novel framework that reformulates FL as a three-level nested optimization system that embeds Titans-based linear attention into FL, enabling clients to perform lightweight, zero-shot test-time adaptation by treating a delta rule as an online gradient step.

2605.16342.tldr: DACA-GRPO introduces two complementary mechanisms: Denoising Progress Scores, which extract per-token importance weights from intermediate predictions at no additional forward cost, and Stratified Masking Likelihood, which partitions token positions into strata so that each token is predicted with most of the sequence as context, reducing the mean-field bias.

2605.16315.tldr: A sharp threshold at zero reach-weighted contingent action capacity is established, with severity scaling continuously via reach-weighted capacity in the tested domains, and the phenomenon is timing-invariant, fully reversible upon action restoration, and intensifies under function approximation.

2605.16361.tldr: A periodicity quantification framework based on sparse autoregression with sparsity and non-negativity constraints is introduced, revealing that frequently-viewed pages exhibit significantly weaker periodic structure than their less-viewed counterparts, showing direct implications for server allocation and traffic forecasting on large digital platforms.

2605.16527.tldr: The Hypergraph Pattern Machine (HGPM) is proposed, shifting the paradigm from message passing to learning the compositional pattern of subsets, and correctly identifies the drug addition that inhibits the side effect among feature-identical candidates, a discrimination existing methods cannot make.

2605.16474.tldr: Experiments show that LERA substantially improves ad selection accuracy and insertion diversity while incurring only controllable latency overhead, and naturally extends to multiple ad insertions within dynamic dialogue flows and long responses.

2605.16470.tldr: LoRA-Over is introduced, a framework grounded in a simple principle: enrich the optimization landscape during training, then collapse the enrichment at inference, showing that principled over-parameterization designed to vanish at inference is an effective lever for improving PEFT generalization.

2605.16430.tldr: An economic model for characterizing the rational behavior of an LLM training firm is developed by combining scaling laws with microeconomic theory, providing a theory of profit-optimal LLM training and providing a foundation for engaging critically with industry statements and supporting long-term economic decision making.

2605.16427.tldr: A large-scale multi-dataset evaluation of 29 data augmentation techniques and their pairwise combinations for 2D left ventricular segmentation using a U-Net trained on Unity, CAMUS, and EchoNet Dynamic datasets provides empirical guidance for designing augmentation policies that improve the robustness and transferability of echocardiography segmentation models.

2605.16418.tldr: This work devise a cognitive-dynamics-based adaptive blurring mechanism that dynamically integrates center-biased and saliency-guided visual cues via cross-modal attention and validates that optimizing visual information density to match neural granularity offers a more interpretable and robust pathway for neural decoding.

2605.16411.tldr: The results suggest that hallucination may arise not only from limited model capacity, but also from inherent tendencies of autoregressive probabilistic generation to favor linguistically plausible continuations under weak visual grounding.

2605.16468.tldr: Mechanistic interpretability is established as a path to discover and causally validate fine-grained hypotheses about neural function by applying mechanistic-interpretability tools to localize the features within natural images that drive millimeter-scale activity.

2605.16462.tldr: This work proposes interaction-layer antidistillation watermarks, which move the trace one layer higher, into the teacher's interaction behavior, complementary to token-, model-, and reasoning-trace-layer defenses.

2605.16443.tldr: The Two-Valued Symmetric Circulant Matrix (TVSCM), a very sparse architecture that employs just two weights per layer to keep it circulant and symmetric, is proposed, a extreme form of structured sparse architecture that provides negligible storage costs compared to traditional full-weight storage.

2605.16433.tldr: This work proposes an Edge-AI-driven decentralized task allocation framework based on ranking-aware negotiation, where lightweight decision intelligence is embedded at the machine level to enable low-latency coordination without centralized control.

2605.16398.tldr: VHYDRO is introduced, a variational hybrid dynamics learner that prevents branch loss in contact-rich robot dynamics by ensuring that every transition retained by the model-feasible carrier remains covered.

2605.16397.tldr: This work builds upon an existing object detection framework by incorporating GPS trajectory data into the inference process to enable input-adaptive computation and introduces an early-exit mechanism in a YOLOv8-based detector that incorporates motion cues - such as inter-vessel distances.

2605.16568.tldr: A modular framework that addresses each level of uncertainty within knowledge graphs through tailored techniques, and the central hypothesis is that specialized reasoning mechanisms, namely algebraic, logical, and geometric approaches, can reconcile semantic precision with computational tractability.

2605.16416.tldr: This work proposes Credit Assignment for Visual Evidence (CAVE), a structured process-reward method based on GRPO for interleaved visual reasoning that effectively improves the visual reasoning capacity and exhibits stronger robustness under longer-range and deeper cross-region dependencies.

2605.16514.tldr: AICON, a reactive gradient-descent framework developed for robotic manipulation, is applied to the Tower of London test, a cognitive test used to assess planning in Parkinson's disease, mild cognitive impairment, and stroke, suggesting its core abstraction reflects something real about how biological systems are organized.

2605.16464.tldr: The results showed that MHMamba achieved stable and significant improvements in overall accuracy, boundary smoothness, and sensitivity to tumor core and small-volume enhancement areas, while preserving the linear-complexity advantage of Mamba-based modeling, thus verifying the effectiveness and versatility of the method.

2605.16458.tldr: Preliminary computational evidence is provided that residual-bounded restoration is feasible in boundary-sensitive vascular imaging, but they do not establish clinical diagnostic performance and require expert review and prospective validation before clinical use.

2605.16446.tldr: Online Primal-Dual Allocation (OPDA), an online controller that schedules fairness and entropy-based stability penalties using violation, risk, and pseudo-label health signals, avoiding per-dataset selection of a fixed fairness weight within this diagnostic regime.

2605.16438.tldr: A MultiSignal ensemble that uses a dual-feature routing gate based on Euclidean and cosine Krum score gaps to classify attacks into four regimes and routes evasion attacks to a suspicion-penalized QUBO with agreement voting shows that QUBO-based quantum annealing with MultiSignal is a principled and scalable defense against the most challenging Byzantine strategies in federated learning.

2605.16435.tldr: A GPU-based deep learning framework for next-day prediction of urban thermal conditions and for heat risk assessment in Sarajevo and can be used as a practical basis for city heat analysis.

2605.16428.tldr: It is found that AI Overviews increase engagement in SFW communities: daily comments rise by 12.0 percent and the number of commenting users by 12.4 percent relative to NSFW communities, suggesting that the effects of AI search depend critically on interface design and types of content.

2605.16552.tldr: An AI agent architecture that integrates large language models with laboratory orchestration, enabling scientists to interactively create and monitor automated lab protocols using natural language and an order of magnitude reduction in required interface actions is presented.

2605.16535.tldr: RAPT, a deployment-oriented retrieval-augmented score thresholding wrapper, applied post-hoc to improve label set selection without retraining the underlying classifier is presented.

2605.16516.tldr: A mechanism-oriented framework for describing alignment drift is proposed, which defines the distinction between signal A and signal B, explains how drift develops through feedback loops and sub-pattern selection, divides the process into three interactional regimes, and identifies boundary conditions for controlling drift.

2605.16508.tldr: The results show that agent performance depends not only on model capability, but also on the structure, granularity, and exposure policy of the skill library, as well as on the structure, granularity, and exposure policy of the skill library.

2605.16480.tldr: MoleCode is introduced, an LLM-native, training-free, graph-explicit molecular language in which all molecular components are represented as typed entities with persistent identifiers and explicit relations, suggesting that the interface between scientific objects and LLMs should not treat structure as something to be decoded from text.

2605.16479.tldr: This work proposes a policy-grounded, retrieval-augmented ranking framework for facet suggestion, comprising offline taxonomy curation, embedding-based retrieval of top-K candidates, and distilled small language model (SLM) based candidate scoring.

2605.16452.tldr: Peak-Detector is a novel framework that leverages instruction-tuned Large Language Models for robust, cross-modal, and explainable peak detection, and demonstrates strong cross-modal performance under clinically relevant temporal tolerance.

2605.16451.tldr: This work proposes MacroDiff+, a physics-guided geometric diffusion framework that couples topological connectivity encoded by heterogeneous GNNs with global geometric context modeled by a Transformer, and introduces Physics-Guided Sampling, an inference strategy that actively steers the generation using explicit gradients to ensure both statistical plausibility and physical validity.

2605.16442.tldr: A hierarchical two-stage framework that combines a coarse long-term predictor with a grid-aware short-term predictor through a hierarchical fusion mechanism that outperforms the state-of-the-art by 25% in Average Displacement Error (ADE) and 17% in Final Displacement Error (FDE).

2605.16441.tldr: DeepArrhythmia is presented, a tool-grounded multimodal framework for segment-contextualized beat-level ECG arrhythmia classification that integrates rhythm context, explicit physiological grounding, and selective evidence acquisition for decision making.

2605.16439.tldr: This work proposes KVCapsule, a novel KV cache compression framework for vision tokens that keeps the pretrained VLM backbone frozen, requires no modification to the attention computation modules, and can be integrated into existing VLMs through lightweight compression and reconstruction components.

2605.16419.tldr: The proposed agentic pipeline for self-synchronized multi-view joint angle monitoring in uncalibrated environments using two cameras without hardware triggers is expected to provide a practical, patient self-deployable system to perform daily kinematic monitoring in uncalibrated home environments.

2605.16567.tldr: MetaEns, an automatic unsupervised framework for selecting ensembles of outlier detection models, is proposed, which consistently outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised selectors and ensemble baselines, achieving higher average precision while using fewer models.

2605.16481.tldr: The proposed Visual Agentic Memory (VAM), a training-free framework with three components, suggests that long-horizon video understanding benefits from treating visual memory as an explicit, inspectable, and queryable substrate.

2605.16449.tldr: PESD-TSF is proposed, a physics-inspired structured decomposition framework for long-term time series forecasting that jointly emphasizes interpretability and predictive accuracy and proposes Cross-Scale Collaborative Attention (CSCA), which reconstructs global inter-variable topology in deep feature spaces and enforces physically consistent collaboration through orthogonality and consistency constraints.

2605.16444.tldr: Overall, DAEM offers a clinically actionable framework for STAS assessment by enabling accurate and interpretable detection on FSs and PSs, supporting postoperative risk stratification through quantitative TME-based analysis.

2605.16436.tldr: The Infinite Impostor is introduced, an attack model in which an autonomous agent interposes itself between two parties who already trust each other, hijacking an existing relationship rather than building a new one from scratch, and the governance tensions that arise when platforms become the regulatory substrate of digital interaction.

2605.16429.tldr: QuantFPFlow is introduced, a reinforcement learning framework that integrates quantum amplitude estimation into the Fokker--Planck(FP) formulation of stochastic policy optimisation, and computational scaling of $\calO(d^{0.35})$ for QuantFPFlow versus $\calO(d^{0.76})$ for classical FP estimation is shown.

2605.16545.tldr: Symphony for Speech-to-Text is introduced, a medical-grade speech recognition system for real-time streaming and batch file-based clinical use and substantially outperforms state-of-the-art systems in clinical settings while matching or exceeding them in general-domain settings, suggesting robust generalization rather than overfitting.

2605.16806.tldr: The Affinity-Aligned Multimodal Learning Analytics (AAMLA) framework is proposed, whose core contribution is the Cross-modal Affinity-guided Modality Alignment (CAMA) module, which explicitly models inter-modal relationships via affinity matrices and enforces cross-modal consistency through contrastive learning, enabling adaptive suppression of uninformative modalities without discarding them.

2605.16785.tldr: Compared with a compact CNN trained on clean data, this method achieves competitive clean accuracy while offering markedly stronger robustness to several pixel-level corruptions, demonstrating that explicit topological structure is a practical route to robust HD representations.

2605.16779.tldr: This work presents a novel method for fitting superquadrics to point clouds under the contamination of noise and outliers, enabling the holistic fitting of both rigid and deformable superquadrics within a unified framework using unsupervised clustering analysis.

2605.16770.tldr: Experimental results provide new insights into the trade-offs between model architecture, model size, and the influence between different tasks, highlighting the potential of lightweight LLMs in judicial AI applications.

2605.16748.tldr: Genflow is introduced, a Compound AI System designed to enforce brand consistency in generative media production, and an Adversarial Multi-Agent Quality Control (QC) loop is implemented.

2605.16726.tldr: Experiments on two real-world traffic datasets show that the proposed GLGAT can effectively capture spatio-temporal correlations and has competitive performance against other state-of-the-art baselines.

2605.16716.tldr: Evaluations combining CLIP-based metrics, VLM-as-judge assessments, and videoquality measures show that multi-agent refinement, particularly parallel specialization, significantly improves cultural relevance while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency.

2605.16671.tldr: This work introduces an architecture that separates visual perception from reasoning, combining a visual encoder with a dynamic knowledge base, and supports knowledge sustainability by preserving expert insights in a structured form.

2605.16612.tldr: It is shown that PRISMat, despite taking less time for inference, is able to outperform LLMs in generating crystal slabs conditioned on critical materials'surface properties, and is able to outperform LLMs in generating crystal slabs conditioned on critical materials'surface properties.

2605.16575.tldr: It is found that current LLM agents can model a counterparty's preferences, but do not reliably turn that knowledge into strategic bargaining, and that turning that knowledge into strategic bargaining fails to improve outcomes for the informed side.

2605.16728.tldr: This study shows how minimal structural conditions for artificial subjectivity can be operationalized in the phenomenological sense, through the embodied organization of how a world is given to an agent.

2605.16727.tldr: PopuLoRA, a population-based asymmetric self-play framework for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) post-training of LLMs is introduced, which outperforms the baseline on three code benchmarks and seven math benchmarks and even the weakest member of the population beats the baseline on aggregate.

2605.16632.tldr: This work designs an MCTS-based data curation pipeline that uses symbolic heuristics to explore splitting decisions over SAT competition formulas, producing preference data grounded in solver statistics and augmented with reasoning traces from a teacher model.

2605.16600.tldr: This work characterises cross-entropy pretraining and preference alignment with a relative-subspace-fraction probe that tracks how weight deltas align with residual-stream activation subspaces and with the prediction subspace defined by the unembedding, and explains this pattern through anisotropic gradient accumulation.

2605.16591.tldr: Together, these results unify additive superposition with context-dependent attention reweighting into a mechanistic, testable account of how few-shot prompts implement tasks.

2605.16775.tldr: Volta-3D is presented, a self-supervised 3D Vision Transformer framework designed to learn transferable volumetric representations and supports effective multi-task downstream performance with task-specific pertaining, a step towards generalizable and clinically viable 3D models.

2605.16795.tldr: 3DPhysVideo is introduced, a novel training-free pipeline that generates physically realistic videos from a single image that outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on GPT-based scores, VideoPhy benchmark and human evaluation.

2605.16790.tldr: TIER: Trajectory-Invariant Execution Rewards is proposed, a reward framework that derives supervision directly from function schemas and runtime execution, rather than from reference trajectories, providing dense, interpretable sequence-level feedback derived from fine-grained verification of individual steps of tool use.

2605.16757.tldr: NeuroMAS is a method that first treats a multi-agent language system as a trainable and scalable neural-network-like architecture with LLM agents as nodes and intermediate textual signals as edges, and suggests that learned neural multi-agent systems are a promising scaling axis for LLMs.

2605.16654.tldr: This work generates sentence-level annotations with large language models over data drawn from MASC and InterCorp, extending coverage from previously annotated portions of VerbNet to 436 classes, and trains a RoBERTa-based classifier on these annotations and evaluates it on three held-out gold-standard datasets, showing promising performance.

2605.16598.tldr: Graph Agentic Search over Propositions (GRASP), an agentic system that simultaneously optimizes for high accuracy and minimal token usage in multi-hop question answering, is introduced and success economy - the amortized token cost per correct answer, weighted by difficulty - is introduced.

2605.16755.tldr: PermFlow, a conditional flow matching framework that operates directly on the affine subspace of matrices with unit row and column sums, achieves high accuracy on unambiguous inputs and recovers both valid permutations under ambiguity, where Sinkhorn-based baselines structurally fail.

2605.16750.tldr: A Unified Benchmark for Exercise Recommendation (UniER) is presented, a comprehensive evaluation framework that unifies ILER and PLER and introduces Weighted Cognitive Gain (WCG) as a unified metric to measure cross-paradigm algorithmic performance.

2605.16725.tldr: This work introduces Alice, a closed-loop system that treats failed candidate updates as structural signal: when a candidate explains a new transition but loses previously explained ones, the preservation conflict reveals dynamics that the current program had conflated.

2605.16719.tldr: Analysis of datasets tracking the evolution of frontiers across 9 different domains reveals universal dynamics governing punctuated progress and identifies the interplay between radical resets and incremental refinements as the key driver of how scientific and technological frontiers advance.

2605.16714.tldr: GRID (Graph Representation of Intelligence Data), an end-to-end framework for security text knowledge graph construction, is presented, showing that task-bank rewards can be built once offline and reused across later post-training runs, outperforming online End2End LLM-as-judge reward and weaker alternatives such as Choice-only Reward and End2End SFT without RL.

2605.16713.tldr: GeoWorld-VLM is introduced, a VLM-side distillation framework that transfers geometric structure from frozen camera-conditioned video world models into VLMs and improves performance by approximately 4 percent on both the What'sUp and VSR benchmarks, suggesting that world-model-guided visual alignment generalizes across model structures and spatial reasoning datasets.

2605.16672.tldr: This study exploits the temporal nature of camera-trap data to augment inferred predictions from a wildlife classification model and adopts several standard Multi-Object Tracking models to link detections across consecutive frames to fuse the softmax class probabilities.

2605.16668.tldr: GraViti is introduced, a transformer-based graph-level variational autoencoder that maps entire graphs to compact latent vectors that achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy on large datasets, and provides solid generative performance.

2605.16650.tldr: SKG-Eval is proposed, a quasi-deterministic and interpretable framework that models dialogue as an evolving Semantic Knowledge Graph (SKG) of entities, relations, and commitments across turns and suggests that structured externalized state tracking through semantic knowledge graphs provides a scalable alternative to implicit reasoning in LLM-based dialogue evaluators.

2605.16638.tldr: TTE-Flash-2B is introduced, a reasoning-aware multimodal representation model that outperforms its explicit-CoT counterpart on the MMEB-v2 benchmark, while producing latent think tokens that are interpretable both textually and visually.

2605.16573.tldr: Wavelet Flow Matching (WFM), a novel generative emulator that overcomes current trade-offs between cost and skill by performing optimal-transport directly in the multi-scale wavelet space, is proposed.

2605.16818.tldr: Observation-Aligned Mask Priors is proposed, a framework that learns the distribution of authentic observation masks and uses it to construct context-query partitions for training from incomplete data, demonstrating that learning mask priors from authentic occlusions is an effective alternative to heuristic masking for learning from incomplete physical observations.

2605.16799.tldr: This work proposes the Domain Adversarial Training Network with Structural-Semantic Transfer Discrepancy (DisTrans) to optimize cross-domain adaptive representation for molecular structures and visual images, and demonstrates that DisTrans outperforms 16 baseline methods, maintaining satisfactory performance even under pronounced inter-domain discrepancy.

2605.16746.tldr: The results suggest that safety in memory-augmented agents should be treated as a state-control problem over evolving context, with sanitization applied before unsafe information is compressed into persistent memory.

2605.16739.tldr: EmoMind is presented, the first end-to-end pipeline for decoding affective captions directly from fMRI signals and establishes continuous brain-decoded affect as a viable control signal for individualized affective caption generation and open new directions for studying individual affective brain organisation.

2605.16676.tldr: MetaKGEnrich, a fully automated pipeline that endows large language model applications with self-directed knowledge repair with topological self-diagnosis plus targeted retrieval can advance AI toward humanlike metacognitive learning.

2605.16675.tldr: LinAlg-Bench is introduced, a diagnostic benchmark evaluating 10 frontier large language models on structured linear algebra computation across a strict dimensional gradient of 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 matrices, showing a sharp behavioral threshold at 4x4 scale and showing that solution strategy rigidity is a near-perfect predictor of 5x5 determinant accuracy.

2605.16623.tldr: Findings are reported from two independent pilot studies on authors' use and perceptions of AI-based auxiliary review at two computer science venues about how authors use and perceive AI-based feedback.

2605.16602.tldr: This position paper argues that progress at the intersection of AI and haptics is constrained by three key bottlenecks: the scarcity of large, diverse, and balanced haptic datasets, the lack of standardized evaluation platforms and perceptual benchmarks, and limitations in model capacity and interpretability when applied to tactile perception.

2605.16571.tldr: This paper proposes a novel post hoc calibration method for Deep Cox models that uses isotonic regression to refine predicted survival probabilities without affecting discriminative power, and establishes favorable theoretical guarantees, including a double-robustness property and asymptotic calibration.

2605.16928.tldr: This work proposes RTPurbo, which retains the full KV cache only for retrieval heads and introduces a lightweight token indexer for sparse attention, and suggests that strong sparse inference can be obtained from standard full-attention training without expensive native sparse pretraining.

2605.16909.tldr: MM-ToolBench is proposed, a benchmark and evaluation harness for task-oriented omni-modal tool use and a practical foundation for evaluating and advancing next-generation omni-modal tool-using agents through closed-loop multimodal verification.
