2605.22833.tldr: This work proposes RAG4Outcome, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework for prognostic prediction in chronic osteomyelitis that combines a domain-specific retrieval corpus with expert-guided prompting, which enables more interpretable, evidence-grounded, and clinically reliable prognosis.

2605.22825.tldr: Simulations with representative service descriptions demonstrate that KPI2KVI consistently produces a complete end to end mapping from description to KVI intervals and provides transparent calculation narratives that support post hoc auditing and interactive advisory queries.

2605.20919.tldr: The compiler beta-reduces the whole program -- primitives, control flow, string I/O -- to one fused tensor-op graph over a frozen embedding substrate, and the same artifact is therefore both a logic program and a trainable neural network.

2605.20201.tldr: This work proposes ProxyCoT, a novel training framework that transfers reasoning capabilities from short proxy contexts to full long contexts with supervised fine-tuning, and demonstrates that models trained with ProxyCoT generalize their long-context reasoning capabilities to out-of-domain tasks.

2605.18859.tldr: TwinRouterBench is introduced, a step-level routing benchmark with two tracks that supports fast offline iteration followed by end-to-end validation under live agent execution, and success is measured by official task resolution and realized API spend.

2605.22856.tldr: PilotWiMAE is introduced, a self-supervised framework whose encoder ingests noisy pilot observations directly and whose attention factorizes along the axis separating temporal from joint space-frequency processing, an inductive bias inspired by the physics of the problem.

2605.22855.tldr: PrefBench provides a controlled benchmark for evaluating pricing-agent behavior under hidden buyer preferences and shows that structured action compliance and agreement-seeking behavior can coexist with weak profit-sensitive bargaining.

2605.22852.tldr: This work advocates Deep Homomorphism Networks as a model particularly well-suited for learning over relational databases, due to their close connection to important fragments of SQL such as conjunctive queries, and relates them to various natural fragments and extensions of first-order logic.

2605.22826.tldr: This work investigates the reasoning, persuasion, and deceptive capabilities of LLMs within the social deduction game Secret Hitler, introducing an open-source framework and novel metrics to measure performance: Role Identification Accuracy, Deception Retention Rate, and Game State Impact Rate.

2605.22824.tldr: An AI-driven framework for energy-efficient environmental monitoring in smart cities utilizing edge intelligence that leverages TinyML-enabled edge devices and context-aware adaptive decision-making in order to dynamically activate the sensors based on the spatiotemporal conditions, environmental statistics and energy constraints.

2605.20519.tldr: This work introduces CodecAttack, which optimizes a perturbation in a neural audio codec's continuous latent space rather than directly perturbing the audio waveform, and shows that the codec's compression channel, which discards waveform perturbations, transmits perturbations crafted in its own latent space.

2605.20087.tldr: ThoughtTrace is introduced, the first large-scale dataset that pairs real-world multi-turn human--AI conversations with users's self-reported thoughts: their reasons for sending prompts and reactions to assistant responses, and the utility of thoughts for downstream modeling is demonstrated.

2605.18993.tldr: It is shown that linearity with respect to weight perturbations, a property defined in parameter space, can be enforced through constraints in activation space during training, enabling effective composition of task vectors and achieving strong performance across vision and language benchmarks without incurring any inference-time overhead.

2605.17770.tldr: This work identifies and formally defines entropy-Gradient Inversion, a robust negative correlation between token entropy and logit gradients that acts as a definitive geometric fingerprint for LRM reasoning capability and proposes CorR-PO, which embeds this inversion signature into RL reward regularization.

2605.07717.tldr: This paper presents the AI-Native Large-Scale Agile Software Development Manifesto, a set of values and principles that redefine how large-scale software development is organized when AI becomes a first-class participant rather than a peripheral tool.

2605.20896.tldr: The Dynamic Threat Detection Agent is introduced, an always-on adaptive agent that continuously investigates security incidents across Microsoft Defender to uncover hidden threats and generate explainable detections when attack-story gaps are found, demonstrating that autonomous agents can identify missed malicious activity at a production scale.

2605.17468.tldr: The results demonstrate how multimodal analytic outputs can be systematically transformed into observable behavioral change through an integrated feedback architecture, advancing explainable and pedagogically grounded ITS design for performance-based competencies.

2605.23055.tldr: It is found that no single factor uniformly affects all models, but stacking factors progressively raises evaluation awareness across all of them, and the framework and EvalAwareBench provide the tools to measure, attribute, and mitigate evaluation awareness.

2605.22973.tldr: It is empirically show that many of the state-of-the-art methods in unsupervised feature selection are outperformed by random feature selection in both performance and efficiency.

2605.22903.tldr: Although VLMs do incorporate visual input, their predictions are less sensitive to the loss of fine-grained visual evidence that standard accuracy should have suggested, suggesting that current benchmarks are not sufficient to reliably evaluate fine-grained visual grounding in VLMs.

2605.22902.tldr: A function-centric framework based on Transcoders, sparse approximations of MLP sublayers that act as a causal proxy for layer-wise computation yields interpretable and predictive accounts of multimodal computation in VLMs.

2605.22880.tldr: An empirical red-teaming framework for measuring LLM Overton Windows is introduced, defined as the range of political opinions a model can reliably express on controversial topics, and for quantifying how simple natural-language jailbreaks expand that range.

2605.22872.tldr: Results demonstrate consistent accuracy improvements, maximum 7.0%, across diverse models and scales, demonstrating MedExpMem as a competitive method addresses medical adaptation needs beyond the reach of parameteric learning.

2605.23074.tldr: PathCal is introduced, a novel training-free decoding controller that calibrates reasoning paths by distinguishing marker types and intervening only at locally uncertain states, and achieves a better efficiency--performance trade-off, improving or preserving accuracy while reducing generation length, without relying on external verifiers or additional sampling.

2605.23094.tldr: Overall, augmentation utility was found to be architecture- and ratio-dependent, not guaranteed by visual fidelity alone.

2605.23089.tldr: GPLD is proposed, a gradient-penalized latent dynamics regularizer for DreamerV3 that applies a row-wise Jacobian penalty to the posterior latent distribution to encourage locally smooth transition learning.

2605.23033.tldr: This work introduces Layer-wise Optimal Embedding Selection (LOES), a constructive spectral method that identifies task-discriminative subspaces by minimizing residual error under orthogonality and isotropy constraints, and proposes Geometric Regularization Loss (GeoReg), which enforces a simplicial structure on class manifolds and stabilizes representation geometry during fine-tuning.

2605.22986.tldr: A framework that detects underspecified features and actively solicits targeted corrective demonstrations, and leverages this statistical signal to infer which features may have been insufficiently demonstrated, reduces ambiguity that would otherwise persist in learning from imperfect demonstrations.

2605.22981.tldr: Evaluating native FIM-format probes reveals that suffix context is not sufficient: verbatim recall under FIM-training remains strongly anchored in prefix context, and results show that evaluating only one span length or probing format can miss important nuances in memorization behavior.

2605.22878.tldr: This report introduces SciAtlas, a large-scale, multi-disciplinary, heterogeneous academic resource knowledge graph designed as a panoramic scientific evolution network and develops a neuro-symbolic retrieval algorithm featuring tri-path collaborative recall and graph reranking, achieving a seamless transition from simple semantic matching to deterministic association discovery.

2605.22873.tldr: This work shows that LLM reasoning is not a static property of tasks or models, but a dynamic decoding state that emerges during generation, and proposes EDRM (Entropy Dynamics-based Reasoning Manifold), a lightweight and training-free routing framework that leverages early decoding entropy to adaptively select inference strategies.

2605.22870.tldr: In three 1-3B instruction-tuned LMs on GSM8K, the answer-readout stage is isolated via prefix completion and a positional shortcut is identified: the model copies whichever number occupies the trailing position before the answer delimiter, regardless of intermediate reasoning.

2605.22866.tldr: BOHM is introduced, which extracts a hierarchical attribution tree directly from the routing weights such systems already maintain: leaf attribution is the path product of root-to-leaf routing weights; level-k attribution is the induced distribution over depth-k nodes.

2605.23007.tldr: The utility of MadEvolve to optimize algorithmic trading strategies and alpha generation at the example of Bitcoin trading is demonstrated and the findings strongly support the utility of AI-driven agentic and evolutionary algorithms for algorithmic trading and quantitative finance.

2605.22984.tldr: The results show that TTT can significantly increase the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and the ASR over 10 generation trials (ASR@10) and suggest that TTT exposes a new attack surface, strengthens attacks, and undermines existing safety guardrails.

2605.22976.tldr: This paper creates SpecDetect4LLM, a static source code analysis tool for their detection, and conducts extensive empirical evaluations of its detection effectiveness (precision and recall) as well as the prevalence of LLM code smells across 692 open-source software projects.

2605.22940.tldr: Human-Centered Learning Mechanics (HCLM) is proposed, a dynamical and information-theoretic framework for open and controlled learning systems that formalizes entropy regularization through effective information force and characterizes degenerate entropy regimes.

2605.22905.tldr: Eve-Agent is introduced, an Evidence-Verifiable Self-Evolving Agent that operationalizes this principle through a modification to the proposer--solver framework, and substantially improves evidence-grounded correctness over prior self-evolving search agents.

2605.22900.tldr: A unified account of the type-1 core together with interval type-2, granular type-3, and quantum extensions is developed, establishing soundness, paraconsistency, and conservativity over the underlying fuzzy base for formulas without mediation, and formulate coherent semantic extensions to interval type-2 truth values.

2605.22896.tldr: Agentic-VLA is introduced, an agentic training framework that enables VLAs to efficiently adapt online through three key innovations: Adaptive Reward Synthesis, which dynamically generates and adjusts reward functions based on the VLA's current capabilities and task complexity, decomposing complex tasks into learnable sub-goals for curriculum learning.

2605.22885.tldr: This work introduces ImProver 2, a neurosymbolic framework for automated proof optimization in Lean 4, and shows that with proper scaffolding and training, small models can effectively restructure research-level proofs over complex and varied metrics, matching substantially larger systems and establishing proof optimization as a scalable, learnable task.

2605.22871.tldr: Extensive experiments show that ManiF-SMC achieves unlearning effectiveness comparable to state-of-the-art approximate methods while operating solely within the model's representation space.

2605.22859.tldr: Despite lower agreement with the reference than contemporary deep learning models, the method provides deterministic decisions and natural language explanations aligned with AASM scoring rules, making it a complementary tool for auditing, debugging, and governing deep learning-based sleep staging.

2605.23091.tldr: This paper empirically evaluate the security of code generated by seven popular LLMs and builds upon previous work to mimic the behaviours of developers when using LLMs to generate code.

2605.23061.tldr: SF-NorMuon, a schedule-free spectral optimizer that enables practitioners to obtain high-quality checkpoints at any point during training without committing to a horizon in advance, makes horizon-free optimization more practical, taking a step towards truly open-ended, continual learning.

2605.23065.tldr: Results show that Floyd-Steinberg dithering at intermediate quantization levels, especially when combined with post-processing blur, exceeds or matches all tested baselines, including diffusion-based denoising, with substantially less degradation on clean inputs.

2605.23045.tldr: It is shown that using motion to represent videos actually addresses both of the core limitations of video technology, and allows us to massively reduce the scale of training data, as motion is inherently appearance-independent and hence needs fewer examples to generalize well.

2605.23024.tldr: This thesis proves an accuracy ceiling set by architecture alone: past a critical reasoning depth, no amount of training moves it, at any adapter rank, sample size, or loss function.

2605.22995.tldr: A structured survey of 112 papers on agentic AI for social good published between 2015 and 2026 finds a moral-geographic asymmetry: papers are least likely to specify geographic context in precisely the domains where local political, legal, and cultural context matters most.

2605.22993.tldr: TPA (Think, Plan, Ask), a proactive multi-agent dialogue framework applied to the language assessment component of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule Module 4 (ADOS-2), in which a doctor agent explicitly reasons about which traits remain unobserved before selecting a clinically grounded strategy and generating a targeted question is presented.

2605.22875.tldr: Through comprehensive expert evaluation, RMA outperforms strong baselines on the First Proof benchmark, including GPT-5.2R and Aletheia, solving eight out of ten research problems and producing more logically sound and readable proofs.

2605.23108.tldr: This work presents a system that constrains AI reviewer behavior through philosophical dispositions -- coherent personality lenses grounded in specific epistemological traditions that direct attention to structurally different types of issues.

2605.23056.tldr: This letter presents an intelligent resource allocation and edge caching framework for 6G O-RAN networks, leveraging Deep Q-Network (DQN) learning for optimizing edge caching and dynamic resource provisioning across multiple network slices within an O-RAN-compliant architecture.

2605.23035.tldr: This work decomposes GPT-2 XL and Llama-3.1-8B into 16K-32K interpretable features per layer, bridging sparse autoencoders from mechanistic interpretability with neural encoding models, and tests a novel cortical topography prediction: five semantic subcategories derived a priori from three independent neuroscience programs should map onto distinct brain regions.

2605.22963.tldr: This work constructs aligned bipartite graphs between reference information and LLM outputs and trains a graph neural network to model alignment structure using message passing and achieves state-of-the-art results on four diverse hallucination and question-answering datasets.

2605.22884.tldr: A two-level cache that pairs sliding-window softmax attention as a first-level cache with a fixed-size outer-product fast-weight memory as a second-level cache fed by KV pairs evicted from the window, which improves the memory--quality frontier over bounded-state baselines.

2605.22883.tldr: The findings establish that energy-per-inference is insufficient for agentic AI, and A-LEMS and OOI provide the measurement foundation for accurate benchmarking, where orchestration structure is the primary determinant of energy cost.

2605.22874.tldr: NeuroNL2LTL, a neurosymbolic architecture unifying learned translation with formal verification, demonstrates that formal verification can function as both training objective and runtime filter for neural specification systems, allowing to build neural-based tools whose reliability derives from logical guarantees rather than statistical confidence.

2605.23082.tldr: KAPLAN-HR is introduced, a B-spline Kolmogorov-Arnold Network for nonparametric estimation of the conditional hazard as a joint function of covariates and time, and a convergence rate is established for the nonparametric KAN hazard estimator that depends only on the smoothness of the underlying KAN representation and not on the covariate dimension, thereby mitigating the curse of dimensionality for KAN-representable targets.

2605.23409.tldr: An online hand gesture recognition system is proposed, which is able to localize gestures in real-time video stream and recognize what these gestures are and to improve the robustness of the system, the sliding window approach is used to refine results from multiple windows.

2605.23402.tldr: Parametric Prior Mapping is introduced, a framework that injects parametric structural priors into a generative modeling process and utilizes a parametric estimator to derive a dynamic, adaptive prior that guides the learning of a complex predictive distribution via a learnable mapping.

2605.23341.tldr: It is argued that a compositional latent structure is a natural choice: many embodied tasks share recurring motion fragments that can be made explicit as a finite repertoire of reusable motion primitives, and compositional units naturally align with subtask boundaries to support task decomposition.

2605.23138.tldr: CRiSP (a Clifford Reinforcement Learning agent for State Preparation), a framework that formulates discrete prefix selection as a sequential decision-making problem, is proposed, which outperforms state-of-the-art Clifford initialization methods on QAOA benchmarks and demonstrates the framework's robustness and generalizability.

2605.23311.tldr: DART is presented, a modular runtime that localizes the failed instance, certifies semantically recoverable boundaries of that instance, aligns checkpoints to those boundaries, and selects an admissible restore point that preserves committed downstream work under dependency and effect constraints-or blocks otherwise.

2605.23285.tldr: The Deep Microcanonical Graph Generator (DMGG) is introduced, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that transforms any given graph through degree-preserving rewirings to exactly reach a prescribed assortativity, which characterizes the degree--degree correlation of adjacent nodes.

2605.23271.tldr: EvalVerse is introduced, a comprehensive, pipeline-aware, and expert-calibrated evaluation framework that transcends a static leaderboard and establishes a fundamental infrastructure for future work, such as reward models and evaluator agent.

2605.23243.tldr: The absence of structured security testing traces end-to-end request/response sequences, failure-heavy data, and multi-step attack chains as the fundamental training data bottleneck is identified, and the case for vertical foundation models purpose-built for cybersecurity is made.

2605.23204.tldr: This survey examines the development of AI-powered scientific workflow automation through AutoResearch, defined as the developmental spectrum of AI-powered scientific workflow automation, and proposes five evaluation dimensions--novelty, validity, impact, reliability, and provenance--and shows that AutoResearch autonomy is domain-conditioned.

2605.23194.tldr: A scalable heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) workflow, built on HydraGNN, for data-driven OPF surrogate modeling and OPF-GFM development and shows that fine-tuning pretrained OPF GFM improves low-data accuracy, stabilizes training, accelerates convergence, and reduces adaptation cost when partial or head-only fine-tuning is used.

2605.23171.tldr: This paper introduces a new fine-tuning method for language models, utilizing symmetric noise in embeddings, which aims to enhance the model's function by more stringently regulating its local curvature, demonstrating superior performance over the current method, NEFTune.

2605.23159.tldr: It is suggested that labor-market adjustment to generative AI is a process of organizational reconfiguration, in which firms reshape both hiring demand and the task architecture of work.

2605.23118.tldr: This work proposes a Verified Tracking paradigm: a clinician verifies a registration-proposed prompt, which the model leverages alongside the baseline lesion appearance to resolve segmentation ambiguities, and presents a unified framework combining early spatial prompt fusion with latent temporal difference weighting for longitudinally-informed segmentation.

2605.23297.tldr: This paper introduces Ontological Knowledge Blocks (OKBs), a programmable governance infrastructure that compiles regulatory obligations into machine-checkable constraints over structured evidence graphs, and formalizes an OKB as a 5-tuple that binds normative obligations to an RDF/OWL concept schema.

2605.23165.tldr: This work introduces a novel exploration pipeline where a VLM performs high-level strategic decision-making, guiding a conventional low-level robotics control stack, and improves map coverage by up to 24\% over existing methods.

2605.23147.tldr: The additive structure at the prompt-to-answer transition supports interpretability and fine-grained steering of persona or task contributions; persona-conditioned behavior across the full continuation depends on a distributed prompt/KV mechanism that local activation arithmetic does not displace.

2605.23415.tldr: This work formalizes two types of reflection-axial reflection and bilateral reflection, and characterize their corresponding transformations, and introduces Reflex, a paradigm that seamlessly integrates with both on-policy and off-policy RL algorithms.

2605.23414.tldr: The Epistemic Planning Calibration Agentic Workflow (EPC-AW) is proposed, which assesses whether plans remain supported under varying information conditions rather than directly verifying feasibility, and employs Information-consistency-based Plan Selection, selecting plans whose evaluations are stable across agents.

2605.23320.tldr: The Ventilator Decision Support System (VDSS), a human in the loop multi agent framework that coordinates modular decision components through contract driven structured interfaces and produces traceable evidence for review is proposed.

2605.23348.tldr: A complementary AI infrastructure deployment model, AI Greeninferencing, that brings modular AI compute to renewable energy sources, focusing on wind, allowing AI footprint expansion, generating local behind-the-meter demand for renewable sites, and helping ease the growing strain on power utilities is proposed.

2605.23393.tldr: Unpack is developed, a backward recursion that decomposes credit through both sublayers, producing interaction strengths between any two components, named end-to-end paths with K/Q/V composition labels, and per-token attribution, all from a single forward pass, without intervention, gradients, or auxiliary training.

2605.23372.tldr: An automatic curriculum generation scheme is developed that can effectively generate new tasks more and more similar to the target task, which surpasses state-of-the-art CRL approaches based on interpolation and generative adversarial networks.

2605.23365.tldr: This work proposes Score-Based One-step MeanFlow Policy Optimization (SOM), an actor-critic algorithm that achieves state-of-the-art performance on locomotion tasks with a single generation step, while substantially reducing both training and inference time compared to prior diffusion- and flow-matching-based policies.

2605.23344.tldr: Contrastive Hallucination-Aware Step-wise Decoding (CHASD) is proposed for Large Vision-Language Models, an inference-time framework for "calibration on demand" and improves hallucination-related metrics over strong training-free baselines with competitive inference efficiency.

2605.23296.tldr: This work introduces parallel compaction for long-horizon agentic flows and characterize it against the sequential synchronous baseline across four backbones spanning 8B to 120B parameters, mixing dense and MoE architectures with reasoning and non-reasoning models.

2605.23272.tldr: SAGE-Fit (Structure-Aware and Semantics-Guided Evaluator for Symbolic Regression), an SR-native fitting framework that exploits the dual native priors of symbolic expressions, is proposed, effectively mitigating this optimization bottleneck.

2605.23263.tldr: A hierarchical communication architecture for human-robot remote interaction is proposed, comprising a human-intent perception layer, an open radio access network (O-RAN)-based transport layer, an intelligent intermediary layer, and an embodiment layer, confirming the practicality of the proposed architecture and providing a reference for future 6G-embodied agent research and industrial deployments.

2605.23262.tldr: This paper contributes a three-step approach for making explicit how benchmarked tasks represent the work claims attached to their scores: defining the work activity under evaluation, specifying the tested setting, and scoring the appropriate work product.

2605.23249.tldr: A novel loss function that explicitly promotes refinement and can be optimized through supervised contrastive learning; and a unified training framework that jointly optimizes calibration, refinement, and accuracy to improve DNN reliability are proposed.

2605.23245.tldr: SimInsert is presented, a training-free paradigm that efficiently decouples the task into intuitive single-frame editing and semantic motion description, and hinges on non-invasive guidance mechanisms that enforce structural consistency, facilitate seamless boundary fusion, and counteract the fidelity drift that typically accumulates during the denoising trajectory.

2605.23218.tldr: The Foundation Protocol is introduced, a graph-first coordination layer for an emerging human-AI society that unifies heterogeneous entities, including agents, tools, resources, humans, institutions, and organizations, and supports native multi-party organization and event-based collaboration.

2605.23203.tldr: This work presents a formal verification approach that targets robustness against 3D motion perturbations of the capturing camera, and enables the first formal verification of projective geometry transforms, without complex simulation, surrogate networks, or explicit image-formation models.

2605.23179.tldr: A capability-level theory of accountability-boundary placement in agentic ecosystems is developed and complementary assets are introduced: complementary assets that make AI-supported outputs legitimate, auditable, reviewable, and assignable to a responsible party.

2605.23168.tldr: PoisonForge, a benchmark that parameterizes this threat along four dimensions and evaluates 12 open-weight models across five families under a primarily 1% poison budget, confirms that poisoning design choices are the primary causes of attack success, and that these patterns generalize to predict attack success on new tasks.

2605.23109.tldr: Inductive Deductive Deductive Synthesis (IDS) is presented, which jointly and incrementally synthesizes implementation and proof, and learns from failed attempts to systematically try promising strategies, yielding implementations up to 3x faster than published verified systems.

2605.23259.tldr: Multi-Gate Residuals (MGR), which stabilizes activation scales without additional communication burden, utilizes a straightforward scoring and gating mechanism to maintain multi-stream context, coupled with Attention Pooling to extract hidden states from the stream states.

2605.23146.tldr: This work presents the first proof-of-concept implementation of an infra-Bayesian reinforcement learning architecture for finite-outcome stateless decision problems, and applies this implementation of the infra-Bayesian maximin decision process to an environment with Knightian uncertainty, and demonstrates a lower worst-case regret.

2605.23270.tldr: This work proposes ChainFlow-VLA, which unifies causal generation and global refinement within a unified probabilistic framework, and achieves robust planning in ambiguous and long-tail scenarios.

2605.23264.tldr: ASASR is proposed, a theoretically grounded framework that recasts the generative flow into a Sobolev-induced Riemannian geometry by explicitly coloring the noise transition kernel to mirror natural spectral decay, offering a robust solution that effectively mitigates artifacts.

2605.23219.tldr: PaP-NF is proposed, a probabilistic forecasting framework that aligns continuous time series representations with a frozen large language model (LLM) using a Prefix-as-Prompt mechanism, and conditions a normalizing flow decoder on the global context extracted by the LLM.

2605.23215.tldr: This work introduces FastKernels, a kernel benchmark built around a minimal set of 46 representative architectures spanning 8 categories, whose kernels collectively subsume those of 96.2% of HuggingFace Transformers architectures, and releases FastKernels as a stepping stone toward kernel agents whose benchmark gains translate directly into production throughput improvements.

2605.23200.tldr: Extensive experiments across a diverse suite of tasks, including mathematical reasoning, code completion, open-domain QA, and sparse retrieval, demonstrate that Adaptive Mass-Segmented KV Compression consistently mitigates structural fragmentation and boosts model performance.

2605.23170.tldr: Context Rot Evaluation is proposed, a controlled framework varying all three factors, and nine LLMs on GSM8K and ARC-Challenge are evaluated across two rounds: an initial five-model set and four newer vendor releases, exposing a structural evaluation gap in current reasoning benchmark design and vendor evaluation practice.

2605.23139.tldr: CALAD is proposed, a channel-aware contrastive learning framework for multivariate time series anomaly detection that combines contrastive learning and an auxiliary reconstruction head, allowing the model to learn discriminative representations while retaining normal structures.

2605.23123.tldr: A conceptual model and identifies the dimensions that define AI fatigue as a form of strain arising from sustained academic use of AI tools and develops a stage-based framework that explains how these pressures accumulate and reinforce one another across repeated AI interaction in academic tasks.

2605.23116.tldr: CoReVAD is a contextual reasoning framework for training-free video anomaly detection that operates with a single frozen VLM that generates anomaly scores and temporal descriptions from the VLM and introduces a Local Response Cleaning module based on local vision-text alignment.

2605.23426.tldr: Across 786 participants who made 1,572 post-interaction identity judgments, people did not distinguish AI from human teammates above chance and this dissociation creates new vulnerabilities to coordinated AI agents that can influence and manipulate online discourse at scale.

2605.23384.tldr: MaR is introduced, a metacognition-inspired RL framework that guides LLM reasoning through two general process dimensions: i) metacognitive knowledge, which identifies task-relevant information without hand-crafted instance-specific rubrics, and ii) metacognitive regulation, which plans and adjusts the reasoning process to provide reward guidance beyond final-answer outcomes.

2605.23238.tldr: Generating a distribution of two-player zero-sum imperfect-information card games and introducing a jaggedness measure of within-distribution smoothness that detects when a model's advantage jumps unpredictably between strategically similar games give a deployment-relevant diagnostic that the overall ranking alone cannot provide.

2605.23887.tldr: CHRONOS, a three-layer architecture providing a unified treatment of temporal knowledge-graph data marketplaces with explicit public and private separation, and utility derives primarily from public index routing and adaptive scheduling driven by low-sensitivity statistics.

2605.23883.tldr: These findings demonstrate that PGT effectively address the bottleneck of fine-grained perception, revealing that many spatial reasoning deficits stem from inadequate supervision signals rather than inherent architectural or resolution limitations.

2605.23825.tldr: The findings suggest that geopolitical preferences in language models are not simply inherited from large-scale internet data but are actively shaped during post-training, highlighting the need for greater transparency, auditing, and oversight of alignment processes that influence how models represent nations, cultures, and political perspectives.

2605.23551.tldr: This work shows that this approach significantly outperforms other methods on goal-conditioned Craftax and is competitive with existing baselines on continuous control environments, while achieving a>250x speed-up compared to all-goals relabelling.

2605.23482.tldr: Multimodal Distribution Matching (MDM), a geometry-aware framework for efficient and generalizable multimodal distillation, yields compact synthetic sets that preserve multimodal semantics, substantially reduce distillation cost, and remain robust across architectures.

2605.23652.tldr: The introduced pcsp (Persona Conditioned Shared Policy), a single reinforcement learning policy conditioned on frozen LLM embeddings of free-form persona descriptions, proves that shared RL policies can support scalable, real-time, persona-conditioned NPC control.

2605.23634.tldr: DualMem is proposed, a calibrated post-hoc filter that assumes a small image-disjoint annotated calibration split of held-out future-task objects and performs a non-parametric likelihood ratio test in frozen SigLIP feature space and uses a k-nearest-neighbor positive memory to protect future-task objects and a negative memory to suppress background-like proposals.

2605.23610.tldr: This work introduces sparse token conditioning compatible with pretrained models, restricting self-attention to entity-relevant tokens and reducing computational cost, and equip the entity representation with a noise-injection mechanism that enables fine-grained appearance control, preventing leakage of irrelevant information.

2605.23569.tldr: This paper aims to show that the two approaches toDynamic Programming and Constraint Programming can be combined effectively and elegantly, with DP serving as the primary search framework and CP used as a subroutine to leverage global constraint propagation.

2605.23562.tldr: ARMS is the first automatic reward shaping framework for MARL whose design is motivated by a game-theoretic equilibrium-preservation result, and alternates between policy learning and reward learning while sharing shaping parameters across agents for efficiency.

2605.23550.tldr: RA-DCA is proposed, a vertex-first randomized active-set DCA that projects active gradients onto sampled directions, checks a sampled vertex residual, and uses a small linear program only as a low-residual convex-combination fallback and preserves the descent structure of DCA and reduces the randomized screening layer to matrix multiplications.

2605.23493.tldr: EviDence GuidEd On-Policy Distillation (EDGE-OPD), a modification of OPSD with two distinct characteristics: a) it uses guided rollouts to inject privileged-context behavior to the student at sampling time, so that the rare target behavior is actually present in the on-policy data, and b) it applies an evidence mask.

2605.23458.tldr: This work proposes One-Forcing, a simple yet effective approach which augments the DMD objective with an auxiliary GAN loss for high-quality and efficient one-step video generation, and demonstrates that one-step framewise autoregressive generation can be achieved stably with merely one-third of the training cost of the chunkwise model.

2605.23440.tldr: Experiments show that SSDAU generates semantically consistent data, is more robust to ambiguity than non-LLM methods, and significantly outperforms strong alternatives in most settings.

2605.23655.tldr: CVSearch is introduced, a training-free adaptive framework that dynamically schedules search strategies via an Assess-then-Search workflow that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while substantially improving search efficiency.

2605.23623.tldr: Findings indicate that temporal drift should be considered when assessing the long-term robustness of intelligent detection systems under evolving data distributions and highlight the need for drift-aware robustness assessment frameworks in long-lived adversarial environments.

2605.23892.tldr: This work introduces a two-stage framework for effective token selection, and highlights the advantage of a diversity-based strategy for inter-frame selection, which ensures broad coverage of the scene and offers a superior speed-accuracy trade-off compared to existing solutions.

2605.23590.tldr: Co-ReAct is introduced, a rubric-guided action-selection framework that uses rubrics as step-level guidance during inference that consistently improves over ReAct and representative test-time compute baselines across search agents built on both 8B/14B open-source and frontier closed-source base models.

2605.23605.tldr: It is shown that, even without distillation, the latent-guided diffusion model outperforms the masked diffusion baseline while significantly accelerating inference, and lowers the computational overhead of continuous diffusion, such that the latent is generated in negligible time compared to discrete decoding.

2605.23603.tldr: PAL is an efficient architecture for tasks with long episodic memory and weak positional dependence, with O(n log n) total inference cost versus O(n^2) for standard attention, and is a formal analogue of the wiping property in classical hysteresis theory.

2605.23508.tldr: Experiments show that DrawVideo achieves strong structural controllability, appearance consistency, visual stability, and coherent long-video generation.

2605.23504.tldr: VACE (Velocity-Aligned Channel Embeddings), a self-supervised anomaly detection method that represents normality as a compact, directionally coherent region in the embedding space, achieves state-of-the-art performance on TSB-AD-M under rigorous evaluation, significantly outperforming more complex methods trained on substantially larger budgets.

2605.23473.tldr: This paper proposes an automated random embedding for high-dimensional Bayesian optimization with unknown effective dimension, called Dynamic Shared Embedding Bayesian Optimization (DSEBO), and demonstrates that DSEBO can better balance approximation and optimization errors.

2605.23470.tldr: CADENCE, a principled probabilistic framework that recovers continuous individual trajectories from isolated snapshots by anchoring latent dynamics to static, individual-level contexts, is introduced and novel identifiability guarantees for single-timepoint trajectory inference are provided.

2605.23867.tldr: The degree of persuasiveness, or lack thereof, for LLM-based explanations did not meaningfully impact decision accuracy over a simple AI prediction alone, in agreement with typical results with explainable AI based on feature importance.

2605.23780.tldr: This work addresses robust intrinsic multimodal knowledge editing by explicitly targeting generalization through knowledge units that group semantically equivalent multimodal inputs and define generality as consistent predictions within each unit, and introduces Latent Adversarial Robustification (LAR), which generates adversarial yet semantically coherent variants in the joint latent space.

2605.23772.tldr: Claude Code is evaluated in an agentic proving framework on CLEVER, a Lean 4 benchmark for verifiable code generation, providing empirical evidence that tight compiler-in-the-loop agentic paradigms are currently the most effective approach for foundational program verification.

2605.23771.tldr: This is the first work to make language-conditioned virtual photography in arbitrary Blender scenes an executable agent task, and the results show that an LLM-centered spatial agent can already produce strong photographs in a setting designed to challenge both 3D reasoning and aesthetic choice.

2605.23645.tldr: The setting enables the development of a theory that explains the mechanism of subliminal learning and to derive upper bounds on when subliminal learning fails, and the results turn subliminal learning from a surprising transfer effect into a theoretically grounded mechanism with predictable limits.

2605.23595.tldr: This work introduces MetaEvaluator, a cost-effective, model-agnostic framework for fast, label-free evaluation of unseen models across diverse architectures and modalities, and is believed to be the first model-agnostic framework that evaluates new models on unlabeled datasets.

2605.23559.tldr: Experiments on WSI-VQA and SlideBench-BCNB show that the proposed scan-search-readout design improves answer accuracy and yields more interpretable evidence-selection trajectories with higher efficiency.

2605.23471.tldr: An enhanced deep learning framework for aggressive driving detection using multivariate vehicle dynamics signals is proposed that consistently outperforms standard deep learning baselines with significant improvements in minority-class recall and safety-critical F-score metrics while maintaining practical computational efficiency.

2605.23901.tldr: The Shannon Scaling Law is proposed, a unified theoretical framework that models LLM training as information transmission over a noisy channel, grounded in the Shannon-Hartley theorem, and consistently outperforms classical scaling laws and recent perturbation-aware laws.

2605.23899.tldr: A utility-grounded evaluation framework is built that provides systematic experimental results across extractors and target agents, covering five diverse agentic task domains, and finds that model-generated skills are beneficial on average but exhibit non-trivial negative transfer, and that neither extractors nor targets behave uniformly.

2605.23898.tldr: This work systematically study whether current VLMs truly understand numerical values in spatial settings, and finds that models largely fail to ground numbers in spatial meaning and often perform close to random guess.

2605.23668.tldr: OnePred is proposed, which maintains a recursively updated memory as its sole cross-turn context, bounding the per-turn cost independently of conversation length, and trains the model via a two-stage reinforcement learning pipeline that first teaches what to predict, then what to compress, shaping the memory into a prediction-oriented intent chain.

2605.23459.tldr: A structured AI Failure Taxonomy is introduced, a revised five-layer AI Assurance Pyramid is proposed and operational guidance on evaluation-driven development, RAG system testing, model lifecycle management and governance is provided.

2605.23565.tldr: It is demonstrated that while out-of-distribution RL agent behaviour is dependent on the whole training pipeline, this dependence has an underlying structure that can be captured, laying groundwork for understanding goal generalisation from a developmental perspective.

2605.23491.tldr: CoSPlay is presented, a GT-free, training-free framework that jointly improves codes and UTs through cooperative self-play that generalizes across diverse backbones and outperforms GT-free TTS baselines under comparable token budgets, with continued gains as the budget scales up.

2605.23478.tldr: PhenoYieldNet is proposed, a multi-crop yield prediction framework that learns crop-specific phenology by explicitly modeling their responses with temporal drivers, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

2605.23448.tldr: This work examines an imbalance in artificial intelligence (AI) security research: the field tends to produce more work on attacking AI systems than on defending them, resulting in a literature rich in demonstrated vulnerabilities and thin on usable and deployed protections.

2605.23719.tldr: WePE maps normalized 2D patch coordinates onto the complex plane and constructs compact four-dimensional positional features using the Weierstrass elliptic function and its derivative, and its intrinsic lattice structure naturally matches the regular geometry of image patch grids.

2605.23572.tldr: HLM is presented, a three-phase training framework for transferring the capabilities of large-scale retrievers into compact, cost-efficient models and presents a comprehensive empirical study of key design choices, including alignment objectives, embedding dimensionality, model scale, architecture, and optimization strategies, to identify configurations that are most effective in production settings.

2605.23897.tldr: This work introduces ETCHR (Editing To Clarify and Harness Reasoning), a question-conditioned, reasoning-aware image editor decoupled from the downstream understanding model and trained with a two-stage recipe targeted at the two gaps: Reasoning Imitation via supervised fine-tuning on edit trajectories, followed by Reasoning Enhancement with VLM-derived rewards for edit correctness and downstream reasoning accuracy.

2605.23861.tldr: FM-CGM is introduced, a modular framework for end-to-end visual causal reasoning using pretrained foundation models and Causal Semantic Guidance (CSG) is developed, a cross-attention-based mechanism that ensures semantic interventions propagate to descendant concepts while preserving invariant regions.

2605.23819.tldr: The generative-discriminative dichotomy is the wrong axis for understanding human-aligned vision: alignment emerges not from choosing one objective over the other, but from balancing both.

2605.23904.tldr: The skill should be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible, and optimized skill artifacts retain value when moved across model scales, between Codex and Claude Code execution environments, and to a nearby math benchmark without further optimization.

2410.18717.tldr: This study revisits conventional AN solutions for privacy protection and real-time video anomaly detection (VAD) applications and proposes a lightweight adaptive AN for VAD (LA3D) that employs dynamic adjustment to enhance full-body privacy protection.

2411.04696.tldr: This article traces departures from the conventional statistical definition of spuriousness to examine how its meaning is negotiated in ML research and reveals that correlation desirability is not a fixed statistical property but a situated judgment informed by technical, epistemic, and ethical considerations.

2504.17401.tldr: The StereoMamba architecture, which is specifically designed for stereo disparity estimation in RAMIS, is proposed, based on a novel Feature Extraction Mamba (FE-Mamba) module, which enhances long-range spatial dependencies both within and across stereo images.

2505.08392.tldr: Adaptive GoGI-Skip is introduced, a framework that resolves tension by non-linearly coupling Goal-Gradient Importance (GoGI) with Adaptive Dynamic Skipping (ADS), which quantifies each token's functional contribution to answer correctness via gradient sensitivity.

2505.16120.tldr: This paper comprehensively examines the evolution of agent systems from the pre-LLM era to current LLM-powered architectures, categorizing agent systems into software-based, physical, and adaptive hybrid systems, highlighting applications across customer service, software development, manufacturing automation, personalized education, financial trading, and healthcare.

2507.22268.tldr: MMSC is proposed, a self-supervised multi-modal relational representation learning framework that combines a multi-modal foundation model adapted to encode item metadata and a self-supervised denoising module that learns relationship-aware representations from noisy user behaviors, unified by a hierarchical aggregation mechanism.

2602.19171.tldr: It is argued that HistCAD reframes CAD generation from static shape imitation to the synthesis of reusable parametric sequences with explicit constraints, and that HistCAD supports supervised CAD generation from text and direct LLM workflows.

2603.00042.tldr: LittleBit-2 is proposed, a framework employing Internal Latent Rotation and Joint Iterative Quantization (Joint-ITQ), which acts as a geometric preconditioner, aligning coherent latent distributions with the binary hypercube with zero inference overhead.

2603.00822.tldr: ContextCov is a framework that transforms passive natural language instructions into executable guardrails and intercepts agent actions and returns immediate, reproducible violation traces, enabling self-correction before non-compliant changes are finalized.

2603.18196.tldr: This work presents a RAG-based system that performs security incident analysis through targeted query-based filtering and LLM semantic reasoning, demonstrating that combining targeted query-based filtering with RAG-based retrieval enables accurate, cost-effective security analysis within LLM context limits.

2603.20151.tldr: Design-OS is presented, a lightweight, specification-driven workflow for engineering system design organized in five stages: concept definition, literature survey, conceptual design, requirements definition, and design definition that extends specification-driven orchestration of AI from software to physical engineering system design.

2603.26816.tldr: This work developed an uncertainty-aware belief model that encodes physics-informed features to improve prediction in semi-supervised learning, and posit PiCSRL as a sample-efficient adaptive sensing method across Earth observation domains for improved observation-to-target mapping.

2603.26845.tldr: GISclaw is presented, a comprehensive open-source agent system that performs realistic GIS analysis end to end - spatial joins, raster algebra, kriging interpolation, machine-learning classification, network analysis, choropleth cartography - directly through Python with no commercial GIS dependency.

2603.27343.tldr: Working Memory Fidelity-Active Manipulation (WMF-AM), a probe of cumulative state tracking, a probe of cumulative state tracking, the ability to maintain and update intermediate results across K sequential operations within a single query, without a scratchpad is introduced.

2604.18576.tldr: The Bayesian Linguistic Forecaster is presented, an agentic system for binary forecasting that achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ForecastBench benchmark, and outperforms all the top public methods.

2604.27167.tldr: It is found that chain-of-thought reasoning worsens Nash play in small models but achieves near-perfect Nash play above 70B parameters, and a small model can unravel any partner's cooperation by defecting early; two large models reinforce each other's cooperative instincts indefinitely.

2604.27267.tldr: This work presents the first DFD-based threat analysis integrating all three threat categories across the full perception-planning-actuation pipeline of an LLM-enabled robotic system and traces three cross-boundary attack chains from external entry points to unsafe physical actuation.

2604.27660.tldr: This paper proposes Ctx2Skill, a self-evolving framework that autonomously discovers, refines, and selects context-specific skills without human supervision or external feedback, and introduces a Cross-time Replay mechanism that identifies the skill set achieving the best balance across representative cases for the Reasoner side, ensuring robust and generalizable skill evolution.

2604.27743.tldr: This paper demonstrates that the preference for normal distributions in self-supervised encoders is a direct consequence of the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle and provides a theoretical basis for why optimal, target-neutral, latent representations should tend towards isotropic Gaussian states.

2604.27840.tldr: This work proposes CastFlow, a dynamic agentic forecasting framework that enables multi-view temporal pattern extraction, multi-round contextual features acquisition, iterative forecast refinement, and forecasting with ensemble forecasts.

2605.01656.tldr: A brain-inspired learning primitive in which cognition-level neural synchrony emerges through iterative bottom-up and top-down interactions between micro-scale dynamics of spiking neurons and a macro-scale mechanism of oscillatory synchronization is proposed.

2605.01659.tldr: This work proposes TRIMMER (Temporal Relative Information Maximization for Multi-objective Efficient Reinforcement), a novel self-supervised reinforcement learning framework for video summarization that achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised and self-supervised methods, while remaining competitive with leading supervised approaches.

2605.01668.tldr: IMPACT-Scribe is introduced, a correction-driven framework for dense labeling that uses each correction to improve future human-machine collaboration and improves labeling quality per effort, enhances boundary accuracy, and fosters better human-machine interaction over time.

2605.01675.tldr: CP-SynC (Constraint Programming modeling with Synthesized Checkers), a multi-agent workflow for zero-shot constraint modeling in MiniZinc, substantially outperforms existing baselines in MiniZinc modeling.

2605.01676.tldr: This work proposes MissBGM, an AI-powered missing data imputation method via Bayesian generative modeling that bridges the expressive flexibility of neural networks with the statistical rigor of Bayesian inference.

2605.01679.tldr: The proposed Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy framework integrated with a hybrid 3D Convolutional Neural Network and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory architecture achieves competitive performance and provides formal privacy guarantees, which are largely overlooked in existing studies.

2605.01688.tldr: These findings establish structured context anchoring as a broadly effective, architecture-agnostic augmentation paradigm for long-horizon conversational memory.

2605.01694.tldr: A functional taxonomy is proposed that groups methods by what their latent state is for, rather than by architecture or application domain: predictive embedding, recurrent belief state, object/causal structure, latent action interface, grounded planning interface, and memory substrate.

2605.01698.tldr: This work addresses BIM heterogeneity with a new paradigm, adaptive exploration, where an LLM-based agent iteratively executes code to extract information from a BIM model, discovering its structure at runtime instead of assuming it.

2605.01710.tldr: The paper introduces the route-receipt concept, a minimal schema and redaction model, and a documentation-based survey of selected platforms showing that receipt fragments already exist without a portable per-answer record.

2605.01726.tldr: FEDIN introduces a frequency-domain branch that utilizes a target-aware spectrum filtering mechanism to isolate these periodic interest signals and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art sequential recommendation baselines, demonstrating superior robustness against noise.

2605.01727.tldr: It is argued that LLM-based credibility assessment may not only evaluate truth claims but also differentially recognize the legitimacy of journalistic genres, and that evaluation should therefore include genre-stratified false-positive analysis alongside overall accuracy.

2605.01740.tldr: It is argued that unhardened agentic-AI runtimes are architecturally obsolete: a strictly better alternative exists, is adoptable today, and the gap requires re-architecture rather than configuration.

2605.01745.tldr: Overall, governed language-data platforms should calibrate pricing under uncertain access costs first and verify only when information is cheap and decision-actionable, in order to remain competitive with price-only and risk-aware baselines.

2605.01771.tldr: This work calls this the Compliance Gap: a third, orthogonal axis of AI honesty distinct from factual truthfulness and rhetorical substance, and releases BS-Bench: the first open benchmark for process compliance, with seven tool-call-log audit metrics and a public leaderboard.

2605.01777.tldr: This work explores a channel estimation mechanism at 7GHz frequency band for a given user location using Linear Regression, Support Vector Regression and Decision Tree Regression and explored Linear Regression, Support Vector Regression and Decision Tree Regression.

2605.01783.tldr: Momentum is presented, an endless-runner game that integrates runtime terrain generation, environment object spawning, and autonomous agent-based evaluation into a single gameplay loop, and formulates a measurable evaluation framework along the canonical PCG axes of playability, diversity, controllability, and runtime performance.

2605.01789.tldr: DataEvolver is a reusable framework for building visual datasets through explicit goal tracking, review, correction, and acceptance loops, and shows a consistent improvement path from scene-aware generation to feedback-driven correction and dual-gated validation.

2605.01790.tldr: A key finding is that text-vocal alignment can emerge within pure acoustic-token language modeling, without requiring a separate semantic token stage, suggesting that high-quality music generation can be effectively pursued without separating structure and fidelity into heterogeneous representation spaces.

2605.01794.tldr: A novel paradigm that leverages large language model (LLM)-guided evolutionary search to autonomously discover a closed-form power allocation solution for multi-target tracking achieves near-optimal tracking accuracy, reliable generalization across diverse scenarios and target counts, and over three orders of magnitude speedup compared to conventional iterative solvers.

2605.01797.tldr: A new method to compute stable models, called decision-propagation (DProp), which alternates falsity decisions and truth propagations and can learn to efficiently compute stable models, and it improves accuracy and scalability on neuro-symbolic benchmarks.

2605.01809.tldr: TMD-Bench is introduced, a benchmark for text-driven music-dance co-generation that assesses systems across unimodal generation quality, instruction adherence, and cross-modal rhythmic alignment and reveals that modern commercial audio-visual models, such as Veo 3 and Sora 2, produce high-quality music and video, while rhythmic coupling remains less consistently optimized and leaves room for improvement.

2605.01810.tldr: FedTGNN-SS is proposed, a privacy-preserving federated semi-supervised framework for clinical tabular EHR that combines prototype-guided pseudo-labeling with neighborhood agreement, adaptive graph refinement that periodically updates the k-NN graph using learned embeddings, and clinical-aware consistency augmentation applied only to continuous variables.

2605.01823.tldr: A Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum (SGAC) approach, which employs a learnable selector model on a multi-dimensional feature space consisting of success probability, reward variance, output disagreement, and semantic difficulty level, and confirms that entropy-based intelligent data curation leads to strict reasoning improvement over static training methods, particularly in severely limited data conditions.

2605.01829.tldr: GeoSAE is proposed, a geometry-guided SAE framework that uses the foundation model's learned manifold structure to prevent feature collapse and annotates each surviving feature via age-deconfounded partial correlations, showing that geometry-guided SAEs can extract interpretable, biomarkers from frozen brain MRI foundation models.

2605.01831.tldr: This work introduces RMGAP, a benchmark comprising 1,097 instances across Chat, Writing, Reasoning, and Safety domains and examines the generalizability of reward models, finding considerable room for improvement in reward model generalization.

2605.01833.tldr: This work addresses the challenge of remote control where one or more actors, lacking direct reward access, are steered by a controller over a communication-constrained channel, and introduces a novel framework leveraging remote generation.

2605.01834.tldr: This work demonstrates weak backdoor effects become reliable signals for dataset IP protection in challenging CL settings by proposing a multi-level watermarking scheme adapting to feature-level, soft-label, or hard-label outputs in CL.

2605.01848.tldr: A Feature Purifier, a cross-attention-based erasure mechanism that identifies and suppresses disease-correlated channels, yielding purified anatomical representations and Delta Steering, a training-free directional signal derived from the ordinal embeddings that enables explicit, single-pass control over disease transitions at inference without requiring additional forward passes.

2605.01853.tldr: Investigation of hidden-state transitions across decoding steps and layers identifies a distinct spatiotemporal pattern in LRMs: successful trajectories exhibit broad temporal dynamics with localized layer-wise concentration, while this structure is weaker in non-reasoning models and knowledge-heavy domains.

2605.01865.tldr: This framework combines a return-conditioned sigmoid schedule for global intensity control with a per-agent Reward Signal Quality metric that concentrates the exploration budget on agents with reliable signals that achieves top-tier returns across all environments.

2605.01866.tldr: ShiftLIF, a multi-level spiking neuron that maps membrane potentials to a logarithmically spaced power-of-two spike set, provides finer representation in the small-amplitude regime, while enabling multiplier-free synaptic computation through bit-shift and accumulation operations.

2605.01874.tldr: It is formally established that the performance of a classifier trained on a subset of a noisy dataset selected via cutstats is influenced by the accuracy of k-NN, and it is demonstrated that for real-world scenarios, learnt invariant representations can still facilitate the identification of near-optimal subsets.

2605.01879.tldr: This report provides an exhaustive analysis, justification, and extension of the STP framework, exploring its categorical foundations, implementation feasibility, and role in the future of resilient autonomous systems.

2605.01882.tldr: This work proposes Focus-CoT, a visual focusing chain-of-thought that enhances fine-grained perception by explicitly linking reasoning steps to key visual cues, such as local image regions and OCR signals, and introduces Focus-GRPO, a focus-driven reinforcement learning algorithm with an information-efficiency reward that compresses redundant visual information for efficient focusing.

2605.01888.tldr: An Adaptive Feature Fusion Transformer (AFFormer), a Transformer-based framework that mitigates the adverse effects of corrupted features by modeling temporal, inter-agent, and spatial correlations and demonstrates improved robustness to communication-induced feature degradation while maintaining a competitive efficiency-accuracy trade-off.

2605.01892.tldr: CyberAId is presented, a model-agnostic, on-premise-deployable platform in which a Main Agent coordination layer, a Reporting capability, and specialist subagents operate within a shared runtime under bounded human-in-the-loop autonomy, organised around four falsifiable design principles, and aligned with relevant regulations.

2605.01899.tldr: Persona-Invariant Alignment (PIA) is proposed, an adversarial self-play framework that achieves co-evolution through Persona Lineage Evolution on the attack side and Persona-Invariant Consistency Learning (PICL) on the defense side, grounded in the structural separation hypothesis.

2605.01901.tldr: GeoLaneRep, a behavior-grounded lane representation learning framework for traffic digital twins, provides a semantic interface between roadside observations and downstream digital twin tasks, supporting cross-camera transfer, behavior-aware monitoring, and goal-directed lane synthesis.

2605.01910.tldr: This work presents Stochastic Additive No-mulT Attention (SANTA), a method that sparsifies value-cache access by sampling indices from the post-softmax distribution and aggregates only those value rows, and proposes Bernoulli's sampling as a complementary technique to sparsify the score stage, reducing key-feature access through stochastic ternary queries.

2605.01913.tldr: This work introduces REFUSALGUARD, a representation-level fine-tuning framework that preserves safety-relevant structure during model adaptation, and achieves attack success rates comparable to base safety-aligned models while maintaining competitive task performance, significantly outperforming baselines.

2605.01920.tldr: The Agentic Context Description Language (ACDL), a language for specifying the structure and dynamics of LLM input contexts in a precise, readable, and standard manner, along with visualizations, is described and encouraged to adopt.

2605.01945.tldr: PepSpecBench is proposed, a unified benchmark for peptide MS/MS spectrum prediction that standardizes data preprocessing across complementary public datasets, enforces a strict backbone-disjoint splitting strategy to eliminate sequence leakage, and evaluates diverse architectures within a shared fragment-ion representation space.

2605.01948.tldr: Phone2Act is presented, a low-cost, hardware-agnostic teleoperation framework that transforms a commodity smartphone into a 6-DoF robot controller via Google ARCore and achieves a 90% success rate on a real-world multi-stage pick-and-place task deployed on a physical Dobot CR5.

2605.01950.tldr: TRAP is proposed, a backdoor attack framework for world models that targets imagined trajectory ranking and combines a tail-aware ranking loss to focus optimization on decision-critical trajectories with dual gating mechanisms that stabilize optimization and regulate when and where the attack penalty is applied.

2605.01954.tldr: This work forms pair trading as a hierarchical reinforcement learning problem and proposes a language-driven optimization framework in which both high-level and low-level policies are parameterized by large language models and optimized exclusively through prompt updates.

2605.01986.tldr: The work instantiates that scenario as a multi-agent benchmark for LLM deliberation: twelve agents, each conditioned on a film-faithful persona, debate the film's murder case using multi-agent framework and suggests that anchoring is the dominant failure mode of current LLMs in this setting.

2605.02010.tldr: This position paper argues that reliable AI requires infrastructure for human validation of implicit knowledge, and proposes Knowledge Objects (KOs) -- structured artifacts that externalize implicit knowledge into forms humans can inspect, verify, and endorse.

2605.02011.tldr: This work proposes Judge-R1, a unified framework designed to enhance LLM-based judgment document generation by jointly improving legal information collection and judgment document generation and introduces Agentic Legal Information Collection, which employs a dynamic planning agent to retrieve precise statutes and precedents from multiple sources.

2605.02024.tldr: Tenability, a family of dialogue-based semantics that formalize when a designated argument (or a set of arguments) can be maintained in debate by a proponent against any conflict-free attack which the opponent may present, is introduced.

2605.02033.tldr: This paper evaluates three prompting strategies, such as zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought, across three open-source LLMs of varying scale, and finds that DeepSeek-R1-32B achieves the strongest overall performance, suggesting that model scale plays a meaningful role in conventional commit classification.

2605.02037.tldr: A kirigami-based soft compliant gripper extension that induces predictable deformation under compressive loading, providing gentle and repeatable contact with delicate targets is designed, confirming that capable manipulation policies can be successfully trained and deployed on low-cost modular hardware.

2605.02038.tldr: It is argued that calibration definitions, evaluator logic, verbal parseability, and prompt robustness should be reported explicitly when making reliability claims.

2605.02045.tldr: Using reinforcement learning, the proposed approach achieves significant performance improvements under realistic hardware constraints, including limited FIR filter taps at the transmitter and receiver, mean photon number and finite DAC/ADC resolution.

2605.02050.tldr: This work establishes a foundational framework for standardizing AI evaluation RCTs by centering evaluation on human performance rather than model output alone, formalizing causal inference through RCT methodology for AI contexts, integrating heterogeneity analysis and practical significance assessment, and implementing a graded transparency and repeatability framework.

2605.02063.tldr: Coopetition-Gym v1 is the first platform to combine continuous-action mixed-motive environments, parameterized reward mutuality, calibrated interdependence coefficients, game-theoretic oracle baselines, and validated case studies.

2605.02069.tldr: Pair2Score is presented, a two-stage learning framework that transfers pairwise comparisons into absolute scoring with parameter-efficient LLaMA adaptation and evaluates on rubric-aligned Automated Essay Scoring traits under a five-fold protocol that co-rotates held-out fold and random seed.

2605.02080.tldr: This paper proposes cripping AI as a guiding framework to center lived disability experiences in AI research and development and outlines three directions for future work, including cripping AI with diverse human bodyminds, across the entire AI pipeline and ecosystem, and in collaboration with other justice-oriented AI efforts.

2605.02086.tldr: This work proposes GETA-3DGS, to its knowledge the first end-to-end automatic joint structured pruning and quantization framework for 3DGS, and is complementary to existing codecs: entropy coding is downstream, so the two can be composed.

2605.02106.tldr: The Dynamic Gist-Based Memory Model (DGMM), an architecture in which experience is represented as an evolving, graph-structured episodic-semantic memory, provides a coherent architectural theory in which memory is explicit and persistent, supporting evolving interpretation without retraining and enabling interpretable, context-aware, and temporally grounded AI systems.

2605.02120.tldr: The results show that the DQN policy at $\beta = 0.7$ achieves the best trade-off between accuracy and robustness: it matches the information-theoretic baseline on mean tracking accuracy while reducing the worst-case error by nearly a factor of ten.

2605.02122.tldr: STABLEVAL is introduced, a disagreement-aware evaluation framework that models latent item correctness and annotator-specific confusion patterns to produce posterior expected item credit and calibrated agent-level scores and demonstrates that modeling disagreement is essential for robust and reproducible AI evaluation.

2605.02123.tldr: A context-aware token communication framework that leverages a masked language model (MLM) as a shared contextual model between the transmitter (Tx) and receiver (Rx) and develops a context-aware token detection method that integrates channel likelihoods with MLM-based contextual priors under a Bayesian formulation, enabling robust token inference over noisy channels.

2605.02124.tldr: A boundary-layer calculus for this soft-to-hard limit in population squared-loss mixture-of-experts regression is developed, finding that the zero-temperature approximation is controlled by the probability carried by an $O(\tau)$ neighborhood of the routing interfaces, not by temperature alone.

2605.02137.tldr: Evaluations on SEN1FLOODS11, DEEPFLOOD, and SEN12MS demonstrate that FLoRA surpasses fusion baselines in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, demonstrating that multi-modal fusion within a teacher-guided latent space yields semantically faithful and physically consistent flood-water intelligence from spaceborne observations.

2605.02141.tldr: A sharp analysis of KL-PCB (Zhao et al., 2026), showing that it achieves a sample complexity of $\tilde{O}(\eta SAC^{\pi^*}/\epsilon)$ under large regularization and a sample complexity of $\tilde{\Omega}(SAC^{\pi^*}/\epsilon^2)$ under small regularization.

2605.02159.tldr: A PRISMA-guided systematic review of empirical studies on pretrained knowledge reuse in DRL, which contributes a narrower and internally consistent review scope, a study-level synthesis of empirical evidence, and a provisional independence spectrum that should be treated as a hypothesis for future benchmarking rather than a validated metric.

2605.02163.tldr: This work proposes DocSync, an agentic workflow that frames documentation maintenance as a structurally grounded, iterative generation task and incorporates a critic-guided refinement loop based on the Reflexion paradigm, providing strong evidence that coupling structural retrieval with agentic refinement is a highly promising direction for autonomously mitigating documentation debt.

2605.02168.tldr: A planner-centric reinforcement learning approach is introduced, which exclusively optimizes the planner using trajectory-level rewards from a VLM-as-judge, while freezing the other components in a systematic compute-allocation analysis.

2605.02173.tldr: The findings suggest that nominal context-window length is a poor proxy for usable long-context multi-hop capability, and that the sharpest discriminator between current 1M-context flagships is the 512K-to-1M transition.

2605.02177.tldr: This work formalizes query-class description length, the Kolmogorov complexity of the answer oracle induced by an SCM for a class of queries, and shows that these gaps equal the logarithm of residual higher-rung ambiguity up to lower-order terms.

2605.02178.tldr: This work proposes Token- and Turn-level Policy Optimization (T$^2$PO), an uncertainty-aware framework that explicitly controls exploration at fine-grained levels and monitors uncertainty dynamics and triggers a thinking intervention once the marginal uncertainty change falls below a threshold.

2605.02184.tldr: This work designs a Spatial Adaptive Refinement module that leverages the discrete wavelet transform for directional frequency separation and K-means clustering for regional partitioning, which enables the dynamic construction of region-specific adaptive convolution kernels, achieving spatially and frequency-adaptive feature enhancement.

2605.02187.tldr: Tests on SWE bench, AgentDojo, and ASB across five frontier models show that single-field rewriting can redirect agents while preserving apparent task completion, and proposes sign-c, a server-side scheme that authenticates execution bearing fields and outgoing queries.

2605.02193.tldr: It is shown that a large class of caterpillar graphs has log-concave dominating set sequences and a continuous analogue of the sequence is also log-concave for all graphs.

2605.02199.tldr: This work introduces MEMAUDIT, an exact packageoracle evaluation protocol for budgeted long-term memory writing, which provides reusable package generators, certified solvers, natural package exports, external-system scorers, and cached reproducibility metadata for evaluating what memory writers actually preserve under fixed storage budgets.

2605.02202.tldr: The Clean-Label Backdoor Attack on VLMs via Diffusion Models (CBV), which leverages diffusion models to generate natural poisoned examples via score matching, and incorporates the textual information of the triggered images as multimodal guidance during generation.

2605.02209.tldr: This work formalizes the selection of a small, informative subset as submodular maximization under a multivariate Gaussian model and shows that mutual information selection outperforms entropy for imputation at small subsets.

2605.02218.tldr: This work develops a training-free visual token reduction framework that prunes redundant visual tokens on the mobile device by jointly considering query relevance, token activity, and low-rank dependency and introduces a parallel branching mechanism with decoupled verification-correction to improve draft-side utilization during target-side verification and reduce correction-related transmission overhead.

2605.02240.tldr: PhysicianBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on physician tasks grounded in real clinical setting within electronic health record (EHR) environments, provides a realistic and execution-grounded benchmark for measuring progress toward autonomous clinical agents.

2605.02244.tldr: It is argued that the canonical instantiation of triadic data is two complementary products: long-horizon expert trajectories captured under stimulated-recall protocols, and simulated cross-functional companies -- instrumented teams of senior engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists working through ambiguous deliverables on shared infrastructure.

2605.02249.tldr: A generalization of the standard postulates for iterated revision for iterated revision, a more sophisticated, event model based revision operator, and the potential issues in defining an epistemic operator on Kripke models that can satisfy all of the generalized postulates for iterated multi-agent belief revision are discussed.

2605.02255.tldr: A unified threat model and notation is introduced, a representative set of privacy attacks are reproduced, and a structured ablation study is conducted to evaluate the impact of key factors such as model architecture, scale, dataset characteristics, and retrieval configuration.

2605.02266.tldr: A system-level analysis of multilingual orthopedic diagnosis from free-text clinical notes in English, Hindi and Punjabi shows that domain-adaptive specialization substantially improves cross-lingual discrimination and confidence behavior.

2605.02269.tldr: The results suggest that specification gaming is a fundamental challenge arising from RL reasoning training; a diverse suite of tasks where models can score highly by taking unintended actions is built and open source.

2605.02275.tldr: This work explores efficient LiDAR-based place recognition for EdgeAI by leveraging Bird's Eye View representations to enable lightweight image-based networks and benchmarks representative architectures without aggregation heads using a unified descriptor scheme based on global pooling and linear projection.
