2605.23984.tldr: This work first presents a comprehensive workflow for MODIAD and forms a Multi-class Intelligent Scheduling problem to coordinate cross class model updates by balancing data sufficiency and class update frequency, and designs a Sequential Marginal Gain Greedy (SMG) algorithm that enables effective multi-class training under resource constraints.

2605.23972.tldr: The introduction of Flux, a sequential reasoning environment specified entirely through natural-language rules, suggests that strong sequence prediction alone may struggle to support robust long-horizon dynamic reasoning without mechanisms for persistent state tracking and transition modeling.

2605.23958.tldr: M365 Copilot is emerging as an everyday assistant for knowledge work: writing dominates, but users also rely on it for information retrieval, analysis, decision making and strategizing, and evaluating and diagnosing programs and systems, among others.

2605.23954.tldr: Echodistill significantly improves the semantic reliability and task performance of Audio LLMs under complex noise, without introducing any additional inference costs.

2605.23965.tldr: The proposed LGMT (Logic-Grounded Metamorphic Testing), an oracle-free framework that leverages first-order logic (FOL) to evaluate LLM reasoning, provides a principled and scalable approach for diagnosing reasoning failures.

2605.23956.tldr: QUIVER is introduced, a formal framework for measuring perturbation propagation in graph-structured LLM pipelines that reveals distinct sensitivity profiles across architectures, distinguishes mechanistically different cascade patterns producing identical divergence rates, predicts nodes prone to trajectory bifurcation from observational data alone, and localizes stale evaluation artifacts to specific node-field categories that aggregate metrics cannot surface.

2605.23952.tldr: This paper argues that the philosophical impasse between two symmetrical errors can be circumvented not by resolving the consciousness question, but by introducing a disciplined measurement layer beneath it.

2605.24064.tldr: KREPE is proposed, the first generative representation learning method for HKGs that learns to model the probability distributions of missing components conditioned on the local fact components and global structure of HKGs via a masked discrete diffusion.

2605.24057.tldr: A bifurcation theory of representation dynamics is introduced to detect the onset of usable structure, the crystallization of feature identity, and representational collapse epochs before downstream metrics react, and provides a practical early-warning indicator for training health.

2605.24042.tldr: A complementary Fisher-ball lower bound is proved: every full-rank Gaussian release at $O(1)$ Fisher utility admits a direction whose Mahalanobis signal grows linearly in hidden width, ruling out uniform Gaussian safety in the class and matching the empirical empty middle.

2605.24037.tldr: Mode-as-Sequence is proposed, a unified decoding framework that translates an unordered mode set into an ordered mode sequence and explicitly models mode-to-mode dependency, and Early-Match-Take-All and its joint-scene extension MA-EMTA are introduced, together with a lightweight ranking regularizer that reduces confidence inversions.

2605.24034.tldr: This work applied a convolutional neural network with an attention mechanism to classify DNA sequences as WT or KO, achieving high predictive performance and identified motifs associated with transcription factor families that discriminate WT from KO sequences, demonstrating that CNN-guided saliency mapping is a powerful approach for uncovering functional sequence features.

2605.24020.tldr: This dissertation proposes novel architectures to improve intelligent agents across three key vision-language tasks: image captioning, visual dialog, and interactive instruction following, and introduces LTMI (Light-weight Transformer for Many inputs), a transformer-only architecture.

2605.24004.tldr: Reason--Imagine--Act (RIA), a closed-loop framework that couples an LLM reasoner with an action-conditioned world model for online safety verification, consistently outperforms training-free baselines, including CARLA TM and MADA, on core closed-loop metrics.

2605.23994.tldr: This work introduces \textbf{RAW} (Robust Avatar Watermarking), a benchmark comprising 50 synthetic avatar videos from 5 commercial providers and 6 attacks simulating real-world avatar workflows, and proposes WALT, which embeds watermarks in UV texture space via 3D face reconstruction.

2605.23992.tldr: GazeWorld, a medical imaging world model that treats the image as the world and the radiologist's fixation sequence as a trajectory through it, demonstrates that modeling how experts read, not just what they conclude, offers a promising pretraining paradigm for medical imaging AI.

2605.23987.tldr: The core idea is that thinking guides learning by identifying potential changes, selecting useful evidence, organizing training materials, and planning verification actions, while learning promotes thinking by updating task knowledge, feature-selection experience, action strategies, and future reasoning processes.

2605.23986.tldr: This work presents MemForest, a memory framework that reformulates agent memory as a write-efficient temporal data management problem, and introduces MemTree, a hierarchical temporal index that organizes memory as time-ordered trees rather than flat global summaries.

2605.23966.tldr: TriVAL is introduced, a tri-validation framework that performs explicit validation at three stages of automatic optimization modeling: semantic specification, mathematical formulation, and code generation and consistently outperforms state-ofthe-art methods on the most challenging problems.

2605.24055.tldr: Cascade-KDE is proposed, a training-free restoration framework for corrupted time series that aims to improve robustness under out-of-distribution impulse corruptions while keeping the restored trajectory close to the original local structure and shows consistent gains over classical filters and representative learning-based baselines on curve fidelity, derivative preservation, downstream classification, and runtime efficiency.

2605.23997.tldr: IVR-R1 (Iterative Visual-grounded Reasoning), a novel RL training framework that facilitates dynamic visual re-alignment that actively rectifies reasoning trajectories to guide policy optimization, is introduced, establishing a superior paradigm for maintaining logical and visual consistency in complex multimodal reasoning.

2605.23995.tldr: A task-oriented synthesis of SSL methods for medical imaging, focusing on how pretext-task design interacts with imaging modality, label availability, and downstream performance, and concludes that no SSL strategy is universally optimal.

2605.23993.tldr: Nano World Models is introduced, a minimalist codebase for future video prediction centered around diffusion forcing that provides a unified interface for generative objectives, model scales, action-conditioning mechanisms, latent observation spaces, datasets, evaluation protocols, and long-horizon rollout procedures.

2605.23983.tldr: This work proposes"saturating power-law growth with substrate-conditional (k, mu), observable when the substrate has reached its saturation regime" as a working framing.

2605.23981.tldr: It is shown that bounded and effective AI self-governance requires metacognitive alignment across computational, algorithmic, and ecological levels, and makes it possible to conceive generative AI as both capable and well-governed, rather than treating capability and governance as competing aims.

2605.23957.tldr: The proposed selector uses regret-normalized rollout labels, a contextual KNN uncertainty estimate, and a gate that acts only when the predicted improvement exceeds an uncertainty-adjusted margin to achieve the lowest mean RPD among learned selectors.

2605.23951.tldr: A precise semantics for skill behaviour faithful to how a skill is consumed by an LLM-driven runtime is given, state the verification problem as a capability-containment property over that semantics, and present three composable methods.

2605.24058.tldr: LoRDBA is introduced, a LoRA-compatible adapter that replaces both low-rank factors with binary sign carriers while representing magnitudes through lightweight, channel-wise scales, converting the dense adapter branch into two sign-accumulation matrix multiplications interleaved with channel-wise scaling.

2605.24018.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that EvoSci significantly outperforms strong baselines in LLM-based structured peer-review and comparative ranking evaluations, achieving the highest overall peer-review score and top ranking, suggesting its superiority in both scientific idea generation and continuous discovery.

2605.24005.tldr: Experiments show LC-ERD delivers a robust self-evolution path, uncovering trade-offs between logic consistency and accuracy while identifying high-value reasoning patterns missed by standard rewards.

2605.23989.tldr: This survey provides a focused examination of trustworthy agentic AI through two core dimensions that are critical for high-risk deployments: Safety and Robustness, and Privacy and System Security.

2605.24343.tldr: Intrinsic Action Disentanglement is proposed, a deep hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that learns distinct, partner-aware low-level action sequences conditioned on high-level latent skills that enables flexible adaptation to heterogeneous partner dynamics under distributional shift.

2605.24243.tldr: GIBLy is introduced, a lightweight geometric inductive bias layer that integrates learnable geometric priors into 3D segmentation pipelines and enhances existing architectures by providing features aligned with simple geometric shapes that improve segmentation performance with minimal computational overhead.

2605.24239.tldr: The first to reverse-engineer the PCC implementation on mobile devices to evaluate privacy aspects and to open its non-public interfaces on local devices to support custom PCC queries, and enables future research by making the PCC benchmarking framework publicly available.

2605.24229.tldr: A multi-method audit pipeline that treats each lab's published specification as an auditable target finds that models follow their own lab's specification substantially better with each generation.

2605.24213.tldr: An empirical study of 57 evaluation harnesses, deriving a five-stage harness model and classifying 16,560 issues by workflow stage and root cause, establishes an empirical foundation for treating evaluation engineering as a distinct software engineering concern.

2605.24211.tldr: A modular pipeline for educational analogy generation is presented, decomposing the task into four stages: source finding, sub-concept generation, explanation generation, and evaluation, which reveals cross-stage interactions that isolated studies cannot capture, and highlights sub-concept grounding as a key driver of analogy quality generation.

2605.24192.tldr: This work defines this model class using query precision vectors, response weights, and source distributions, and illustrates that existing methods are recoverable with specific choices of these design axes, and finds that FPMC performance can be improved with soft relaxations of prior patch-based methods, and through augmentations of source distributions.

2605.24111.tldr: This work proposes a novel map representation in the form of pixel-relative connectivity, which is geometrically accurate but does not require global geometric consistency and enables a highly capable navigation system, as validated on four types of navigation tasks in the simulator and through real world demonstrations.

2605.24212.tldr: DRUM optimizes worst-case predictive performance over the unknown target distribution of $A \mid X$ using a neural network generator, with a robustness parameter controlling allowable deviation from the source conditional, and develops a bias correction procedure that reduces sensitivity to nuisance estimation error.

2605.24197.tldr: This work proposes Agentic Evidence Attribution (AEA), a novel alignment paradigm that improves agent posteriors using context-specific evidence and shows that evidence-based alignment can effectively improve agent collaboration and leads to reliable multi-agent systems built on automated workflows.

2605.24172.tldr: EPPC-OASIS is developed, an ontology-aware adaptation approach for structured EPPC extraction that can support scalable retrospective EPPC mining, and structured inference refinement can support scalable retrospective EPPC mining, although external validation is needed before operational use.

2605.24171.tldr: The results show that vulnerability detection behavior is jointly determined by the model and the prompt, and that prompt sensitivity is a first-class system property that must be explicitly characterized in evaluation and deployment.

2605.24117.tldr: It is found that current agents often adapt locally but rarely form robust reusable skills, and capacity and cost analyses show that writing more skills or larger Tier-3 resource libraries is not sufficient: additional updates can improve coverage while introducing episode-specific drift and procedural clutter.

2605.24110.tldr: EvoCode-Bench, a benchmark of 26 stateful coding tasks and 227 evaluated rounds, shows tier-dependent behavior: weaker agents fail early, while stronger agents survive long enough to expose specification-tracking and regression failures.

2605.24326.tldr: This work conducts in-depth characterization of three key design dimensions: parallelism placement, parallelism scheduling, and network layer technologies and proposes ScaleAcross Explorer, an optimizer that considers the interplay of design dimensions and holistically optimizes scale-across training.

2605.24298.tldr: A weaknesses-aware zero-shot chain-of-thought (WA-0CoT) prompting strategy is introduced that enriches prompts with security context using CWE mappings to guide model reasoning, highlighting the importance of language-aware and model-aware prompt design when evaluating the security properties of LLM-generated code.

2605.24168.tldr: This work finds the insistence on dense attention unreasonable, and positions extreme context sparsity not as a heuristic, but as a principled foundation for LLM inference, training, and architecture design: one that is both feasible and beneficial, and a compelling direction for future systems.

2605.24202.tldr: The empirical map and its underlying mechanisms show that policy sharing routes training pressure through different channels rather than offering uniform stability, making it a design choice with workflow- and task-conditional tradeoffs.

2605.24173.tldr: It is shown that a realistic adversary with access to training data where personally identifiable information has been redacted, can even achieve higher recall on extracting redacted email addresses from DLMs than from scale-matched autoregressive models.

2605.24155.tldr: This study proposes CF-RL-TOPSIS, an interpretable late-fusion model that integrates a transition-aware collaborative branch, a compact reinforcement-style occupation-family bandit, and an entropy-weighted TOPSIS branch constructed from six semantic proxies; the validation-selected fusion coefficients remain auditable.

2605.24154.tldr: A modular, controllable, and efficient framework that selectively relaxes refusal behavior on authorized target domains while preserving standard safety elsewhere, offering a practical path toward foundation models that adapt to diverse professional needs.

2605.24139.tldr: This paper proposes Multi-State Aggregated PoLicy Evaluation (MAPLE), a tree search method that aggregates policy and value evaluations from multiple sampled world states within a single search tree, combining the advantages of PIMC and IS-MCTS while maintaining a controllable computational cost.

2605.24137.tldr: This work empirically investigates hallucinations in LLM-generated bug report summaries from a section-aware perspective and proposes a section-aware hallucination detection approach that jointly predicts whether a summary contains hallucinated content, identifies affected sections, and classifies hallucination types.

2605.24084.tldr: This work introduces an algorithm that leverages recent advances in neural network verification to compute arbitrarily tight exact lower and upper bounds on SHAP values for neural networks, ultimately recovering the exact SHAP values.

2605.24069.tldr: The MCP-TDP Security Benchmark is introduced, providing the first specialized security benchmark tailored for TDP, offering essential insights for securing the cognitive and planning layers of advanced agentic systems.

2605.24248.tldr: The design is given in normative Request-for-Comments (RFC 2119) form -- schema, verification rules, error registry, well-known registration, and machine-checkable conformance vectors -- so it can be adopted as an MCP addendum rather than reinvented.

2605.24247.tldr: This work proposes and demonstrates the efficacy of an AI-driven workflow in which AI helps write a per-category constitution that defines the label in enough detail to cover edge cases, and a frontier LLM interprets it on each input to produce the golden label more consistently and accurately than humans reading the same document.

2605.24216.tldr: Agent-ToM, a learning-to-monitor framework grounded in Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning for security analysis of autonomous agents, achieves strong precision-recall balance and outperforms state-of-the-art monitoring baselines, including ensemble methods, while using a coherent two-call reasoning pipeline.

2605.24183.tldr: AvalancheBench complements real-data benchmarks by providing a controlled setting for diagnosing whether agents recover the analytical structure behind enterprise data, and exposes how early analytical mistakes propagate into later conclusions.

2605.24162.tldr: Graph-in-Graph (GiG), a knowledge graph-modulated deep learning framework for data-efficient clinical prediction, is introduced and shown to improve robustness, interpretability, and sample efficiency in clinical data analysis, and provide a principled framework for integrating biological knowledge graphs into predictive modeling.

2605.24138.tldr: A systematic analysis of conversations between two agents, a Designer and a Programmer across 12 model combinations from 7 open-source LLMs reveals three key dimensions of multi-agent interaction: efficiency, consistency, and effectiveness.

2605.24304.tldr: This paper proposes ArtSplat, the first feed-forward framework for articulated 3D Gaussian Splatting, which reconstructs both geometry and joint parameters from sparse multi-view images across multiple articulation states in a single forward pass and introduces a per-pixel joint map representation that enables the integration of joint parameter estimation into the feed-forward pipeline.

2605.24300.tldr: The Mitigation-Aware Chain-of-Thought (MA-CoT) framework is introduced, which embeds task-specific CWE mitigation guidance and language-aware safeguards to reduce recurring vulnerabilities in generated code.

2605.24140.tldr: This work distilling reasoning progress into a hyperbolic geometric signal that guides step-by-step generation of combinatorial reasoning trees yields consistent gains, with larger improvements on deeper reasoning chains.

2605.24106.tldr: A novel Uncertainty-Aware PINN framework tailored specifically for applied Earth Observation is proposed, integrating a dynamic Warm-Start protocol and modeling heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty via a negative log-likelihood objective to dynamically relax physical constraints in regions of high sensor noise while strictly enforcing them in high-confidence areas.

2605.24096.tldr: A JIT system synthesis pipeline, Jitskit, is presented, and its effectiveness in synthesizing key-value stores from spec cards that span different YCSB workloads, deployment constraints, and system properties is explored.

2605.24079.tldr: This work presents TRACER, a semantic-aware framework for fine-grained code contamination detection, and introduces the first benchmark for fine-grained code contamination detection, spanning three widely used benchmarks and three representative post-training datasets.

2605.24305.tldr: This work presents ChaosBench-Logic v2, a 40,886-question benchmark over 165 dynamical systems with 27 FOL predicates and 78 axiom edges, together with CARE, a protocol that surfaces critical failure modes: prior collapse, inconsistency under paraphrase, and inability to reason about parameter-dependent dynamics.

2605.24294.tldr: A chronological adaptive maintenance framework that models deployment-time maintenance as a sequential decision problem and provides a strong cost-aware adaptation strategy, consistently remaining among the top-performing policies while achieving a favorable balance between temporal performance, memory retention, and maintenance cost under non-stationary deployment conditions.

2605.24270.tldr: Routing behavior of Mixtral 8x7B-Instruct under benign and harmful prompts is studied using two complementary signals: activation-based routing scores derived from expert selection frequencies and gradient-based scores derived from router-gate sensitivities.

2605.24266.tldr: To the authors' knowledge, this is the first work to advance deep research with an interactive, interpretable control paradigm, paving the way for controllable, user-aligned agents in long-form tasks.

2605.24253.tldr: Clustering-Based Redundancy-Reduced Instance Sampling for Pathology (CRISP) is introduced, a two-stage framework that first reduces redundancy within individual WSIs and subsequently applies clustering-based sampling to select a compact yet representative set of patches for the entire case.

2605.24238.tldr: This paper identifies and develops four key enactive concepts that it finds most relevant to AI: experience, action perception inseparability, autonomy, and embodiment, and suggests a broader incorporation of enactive ideas into both mainstream AI and RL.

2605.24588.tldr: HeartBeatAI, a deep learning framework combining domain generalization, multi-scale feature aggregation, and clinical explainability for robust 12-lead ECG classification is presented, moving beyond image-based paradigms.

2605.24562.tldr: Empirical evaluations show that finetuning state-of-the-art VLMs on PedestrianQA significantly improves intention classification, trajectory forecasting accuracy, and the quality of explanatory rationales, demonstrating the strong potential of VLMs as a unified and explainable framework for safety-critical pedestrian behavior modeling.

2605.24546.tldr: This paper introduces a resource-aware generation pipeline that produces formal BPMN 2.0 collaboration diagrams from natural-language descriptions that moves generative modeling toward a more comprehensive, multi-collaborative representation of business operations.

2605.24542.tldr: The findings demonstrate that cryptographic security must be reconceptualised as an adaptive, system-level property rather than a function of algorithm strength alone.

2605.24528.tldr: It is suggested that while children and LLM-based agents adapt similarly to environmental structure, their information-seeking behavior exhibits distinct underlying costs and inductive biases.

2605.24490.tldr: Market Regime Council is proposed, a cooperative multi-agent decision system that computes exact Shapley credits across all single, pairwise, and Grand-coalition outputs for online agent weighting and achieves the lowest MDD among active methods.

2605.24489.tldr: TIGER is presented, a Text-Informed Generalized Enzyme-Reaction Retrieval framework that leverages protein-to-text generation models to distill textual semantic knowledge from enzyme sequences, providing a generalized representation that bridges enzymes and biochemical reactions.

2605.24414.tldr: JT-Safe-V2 is introduced, a large language model designed to advance the safety and trustworthiness of foundation models, and Safe-MoMA (Safe Mixture of Models and Agents), a framework that enables traceable and efficient inference through the orchestrated deployment of multiple models and agents is proposed.

2605.24399.tldr: This work proposes ConceptM$^3$oE (Concept Multimodal MoE), which embeds concept formation directly within interaction-aware mixture-of-experts (MoE) pathways and offers a scalable path toward high-performance medical AI that is inherently verifiable and better aligned with the complex decision-making of clinical practice.

2605.24398.tldr: This work introduces VectorArk, a new VLM-based model designed for robust and practical image vectorization, which employs a novel rounded polygon representation that simplifies the learning process while naturally producing smooth, visually appealing primitives.

2605.24391.tldr: This work presents a versatile MXFP format, called MX-SAFE (MXSF in short), that adaptively uses two modes, i.e., a wider mantissa mode (FP8_E2M5) and a subnormal FP mode (FP5_E3M2), to support both training and direct-cast inference.

2605.24383.tldr: It is established that disclosure-based governance has a shallow, structurally determined reach in open-weight AI, and that achieving deep supply-chain accountability requires provenance mechanisms propagating governance signals through derivation itself.

2605.24577.tldr: It is shown that an orthogonal Procrustes fit on a single batch of activations transfers sparse-autoencoder feature dictionaries and steering vectors between independently trained models, with no retraining.

2605.24576.tldr: Physiological validation showed that AI-ECG HF risk predictions align primarily with measures of systolic function, particularly global longitudinal strain, while also capturing diastolic-related abnormalities in patients with preserved LVEF.

2605.24550.tldr: A Buffer-and-Reinforce fine-tuning framework that buffers harmful updates during user fine-tuning and reinforces safety after adaptation and achieves superior safety and utility with no additional safety data during user fine-tuning and minimal computational cost is proposed.

2605.24541.tldr: This paper introduces a reproducible experimental interface for studying lossy, LLM-decompressible text codes and a design principle: safety-critical and exact commitments should remain protected, while predictable low-risk context may be semantically zipped.

2605.24526.tldr: TRAFA, a real-time predictive feedback system for procedural tasks that intervenes before errors are committed, is presented and shows how real-time anticipation can be integrated into interactive systems to prevent errors before they occur.

2605.24484.tldr: A bidirectional Frechet representation is constructed using a novel furthest pivot sampling strategy to enable invariant node representations across distinct problem settings and a weight-decomposed adaptive decoding mechanism is introduced that decouples geometric perception from problem representations, mitigating the overfitting of constraint decisions to a specific geometry setting.

2605.24452.tldr: Cross-jurisdictional pretraining on Swiss Judgment Prediction data improves absolute performance but does not reduce temporal degradation magnitude, confirming that temporal drift is an intrinsic property of legal language evolution.

2605.24425.tldr: This work builds a family of optimizer-inspired Transformers (triple-momentum, Adam/AdamW, Muon, SOAP), and shows that TMMFormer and other momentum-based designs reach flatter minima than the vanilla Transformer, which leads to less forgetting and better generalization.

2605.24420.tldr: This work investigates the effect of BN layers on the memorization of atypical or outlier samples and its implications for privacy leakage and provides both practical and theoretical insights into how normalization layers can amplify the influence of rare or sensitive training examples.

2605.24410.tldr: This paper proposes a novel model named VISION for adVancIng graph few-Shot learning via In-cOntext LearNing that unifies unsupervised meta-learning with graph in-context learning, achieving efficient inference.

2605.24352.tldr: Analysis of learned skill representations shows that PASD adapts effectively to diverse partner behaviors, highlighting its robustness in human-AI collaboration, and consistently outperforms existing population-based and hierarchical baselines.

2605.24584.tldr: Dense geometry can be learned without storing a dense matrix, which enables data-adaptive global interactions in regimes where ordinary dense layers are out of reach, and LAPLEX separates expressivity from storage cost.

2605.24538.tldr: DeAI is analyzed as a six-layer decentralizing stack and it is argued that the central political challenge of governing AI in a decentralized world is reconstructing forms of democratic authorization for architectural choices that persist after the ordinary chain of policy has broken down.

2605.24518.tldr: Grammatically-Guided Sparse Attention is introduced, which constrains attention computations based on the grammatical roles of tokens, providing a path towards more efficient, interpretable, and linguistically-informed Transformer architectures.

2605.24516.tldr: Adaptive Punishment for Cooperation is proposed, a distributed method that determines punishment intensity based on both a dynamic punishment probability and the severity of defection, and uses a defection awareness module, whose learning is guided by game reward.

2605.24503.tldr: This work introduces FoodMonitor, a benchmark for explainable compliance analysis in commercial kitchen surveillance, and establishes a unified evaluation protocol with a two-stage matching mechanism that separately assesses spatial localization and semantic understanding, along with a composite metric that balances environment and person detection performance.

2605.24497.tldr: An adaptive evolutionary CoT jailbreak framework that rewrites harmful goals into mild prompts with teacher role-play and decomposes them into semantically coherent reasoning fragments to construct a pool of CoT jailbreak candidates, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art jailbreak methods.

2605.24486.tldr: This work proposes AgentFugue, a collective reasoning framework built around a shared reasoning hub that suggests that collective reasoning can turn scaling out peer agent systems into a distinct source of capability gains, rather than merely a way of spending more compute.

2605.24475.tldr: A novel Robust Fuzzy Multi-View Learning (R-FUML) framework grounded in Fuzzy Set Theory is proposed, which models network outputs as fuzzy memberships to quantify category credibility and uses an entropy-based method for reliable multi-view fusion.

2605.24423.tldr: A large-scale benchmark ICRL4AHT is introduced, built upon a high-throughput JAX implementation of Overcooked-V2 AHT, establishing this benchmark as a critical testbed for next-generation coordination algorithms.

2605.24405.tldr: Generative OOD-regularized Model-based Policy Optimization (GORMPO), a density-regularized offline RL algorithm that uses generative density modeling to restrict policy updates to high-density areas of the dataset is introduced.

2605.24396.tldr: Progressive confidence shaping is exploited in progressive confidence shaping, a reinforcement learning objective that trains models to update their confidence as they reason rather than commit early -- rewarding gradual confidence growth and penalizing early commitment, with no external labels or reward models.

2605.24381.tldr: This work evaluates foundation models against standard supervised approaches, and proposes a Complexity Router that assigns each series to the optimal model class using empirical features, providing a practical framework for balancing generalization and efficiency.

2605.24570.tldr: The results suggest that learning how to adapt the update structure during training can improve performance across both compact and deeper convolutional models while preserving a simple first-order optimization framework.

2605.24549.tldr: PALoRA, a two-stage framework for knowledge injection with reduced interference that preserves on average 95% of the SVF expert's reasoning performance while maintaining competitive factual recall, and consistently improves skill retention over prior spectral Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning methods.

2605.24384.tldr: This work quantifies covert dialect bias in online discourse by evaluating how LMs associate stereotypical traits with intent-equivalent tweets in Standard American English and African-American Vernacular English, and shows that existing evaluation settings for covert dialect bias may underestimate its severity, specifically in contrastive settings.

2605.24375.tldr: This work investigates whether GameCWM generation capabilities can be distilled into smaller models through post-training, and introduces a post-training pipeline combining Supervised Fine-Tuning with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards, which makes Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct more capable of generating valid GameCWMs, thereby offering a scalable path toward automatic environment generation from natural language.

2605.24358.tldr: A novel interference modeling mechanism that incorporates two partial attention mechanisms and a message amplifier that enables the model to capture differentiated networked effect (DNE), an effect caused by local networks consisting of neighbors with varying importance and scales.

2605.24564.tldr: FinCAD is proposed, an inference-time adaptation of Context-Aware Decoding that suppresses an LLM's memory of historical outcomes without retraining and cuts in-sample backtest returns by up to -67.1% on memorised dates while leaving 2025 out-of-sample returns within $8K and Sharpe within 0.10 of baseline.

2605.24545.tldr: This work argues that unlearning should mainly remove the unique memorized information attributable to the data to be forgotten, while preserving overlapping patterns that are also supported by the remaining data, and proposes Grouped Memorization Evaluation Evaluation, an example-level metric that separates memorized knowledge from overlapping knowledge.

2605.24543.tldr: An emission-aware RL strategy based on the Soft Actor Critic (SAC) algorithm is proposed, with a multi-objective reward that penalises carbon emissions, curtailed on-site renewables, and unmet user demand, and aligns charging with low-emission periods while preserving grid compliance and user satisfaction.

2605.24509.tldr: A simple, training-free approach for motion-conditioned video generation by injecting low-frequency phase information from a reference video directly into the diffusion noise latents, demonstrating effective control over both appearance and dynamics in generated videos, while achieving competitive or superior results compared to more complex conditioning approaches.

2605.24468.tldr: The proposed State-Adaptive Memory~(SAM), a standalone framework that consolidates ongoing interaction into compact memory cues while preserving raw trajectory pages for intent-driven recall, and suggests that explicit memory modeling provides a simple and effective foundation for long-horizon agentic reasoning.

2605.24460.tldr: MineC2FNet is proposed, a coarse-to-fine domain incremental learning framework that exploits abundant coarse data to enhance fine-grained mining footprint segmentation and introduces an expertly validated dataset of 219 images with precise boundary annotations across diverse geographies and commodities.

2605.24458.tldr: A novel multitask adversarial model is introduced that treats fairness and privacy as integral objectives rather than afterthoughts, and learns a latent representation that hides sensitive attributes while preserving essential task-related information.

2605.24453.tldr: A deterministic, importance-weighted IR compaction layer transforms full project IRs into diagram-specific views guaranteed to fit within token constraints, requiring no LLM calls and completing in milliseconds.

2605.24411.tldr: Psych LM is an iOS application that validates the thesis that, for such applications, the surrounding architecture is paramount and confirms that complex, context-aware interaction can be reliably achieved under the strict constraints of a mobile environment.

2605.24792.tldr: A dual-pipeline, PEFT model that addresses two fundamental problems, including medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) and the generation of privacy-preserving synthetic data generation in clinical AI, and demonstrates superior FBD and strong semantic alignment.

2605.24771.tldr: A benchmark calibration is provided for BiomedCLIP-generated weak labels on three medical-imaging benchmarks and six downstream architectures spanning an 11x parameter range to identify a concrete refinement (label-space projection) that future benchmarks can be designed to test.

2605.24769.tldr: A minimally trained, lightweight adapter that repurposes frozen pretrained RGB denoisers for hyperspectral restoration through a projection mapping, which denoises low-dimensional spectral projections and reconstructs the hyperspectral cube through constrained linear aggregation, while preserving plug-and-play compatibility and the stability properties of the underlying RGB denoiser.

2605.24755.tldr: This work provides a validated and scalable pipeline for the automated detection and characterization of content suggesting delusional beliefs in naturalistic speech.

2605.24727.tldr: A fundamental quadrilemma is mathematically proved, stating that AI and its explanation cannot satisfy the following four conditions simultaneously: 1) the complexity of the operation environment, 2) the goodness of the AI's performance, 3) the interpretability of the AI's explanation, and 4) the complete faithfulness of the AI's explanation.

2605.24684.tldr: This work proposes SUPRA (Shared-Unique Prior-Retaining Architecture), a decoupled dual-pathway paradigm that processes modality-specific features through topology-agnostic MLPs while capturing structural synergy via a lightweight shared GNN, with auxiliary deep supervision counteracting gradient starvation.

2605.24675.tldr: VaaWIT is proposed, an end-to-end framework that adapts Large Language Models for multilingual Web image translation and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) open-source baselines and achieves competitive performance against proprietary models.

2605.24661.tldr: A unified multi-dimensional framework for measuring LLM reasoning quality from a behavioral perspective is proposed, operationalizing six theoretically grounded dimensions rooted in cognitive science: Correctness (CQ), Consistency (CS), Robustness (RS), Local Logical Coherence (LS), Efficiency (ES), and Stability (SS).

2605.24632.tldr: It is argued that the near-term shift is not simply more zero-days, but a move toward broader defender remediation throughput: low-signal candidates become cheaper, evidence-rich remediation become more important, and scarce capacity shifts toward maintainer review and release work.

2605.24703.tldr: TS-Skill is introduced, a controlled benchmark for evaluating three composable analytical skills in TSQA: temporal scale selection, temporal localization, and cross-interval integration, and it is demonstrated that skill-level evaluation can uncover temporal reasoning failures that are obscured by aggregate TSQA scores.

2605.24663.tldr: Results show that expert-guided top-k usefulness provides a more faithful account of practical CyBOK mapping utility than exact structural matching alone, and that CyBOKClaw is effective as a CyBOK-specific expert-support retrieval system.

2605.24621.tldr: This work advances principled wavelet-deep learning integration, showing how phase information complements scattering's stability-expressiveness trade-off in pixel-level prediction.

2605.24609.tldr: The results support the potential of unsupervised anomaly detection as an automated MRI quality-control layer for radiotherapy workflows, with transparent visualization of image regions likely to compromise downstream AI-based tasks.

2605.24600.tldr: Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer is proposed, a multi-agent QDA framework that builds peer debriefing into key coding steps and suggests that simulating peer debriefing with explicit perspectives is a promising route to more credible LLM-assisted QDA.

2605.24773.tldr: The proposed method outperforms Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensemble simultaneously on three axes -- Jensen-Shannon divergence to the annotator distribution, Spearman correlation between per-emotion aleatoric uncertainty and disagreement, and selective-prediction Area Under the Risk-Coverage Curve (AURC) and Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC).

2605.24756.tldr: This work introduces the Trajectory Proper Score (TPS), a predictor-agnostic family of strictly proper trajectory-level scoring rules for any per-step uncertainty signal calibrated into a probability of eventual success, and proves that TPS strictly elicits the success-probability process under complete observation.

2605.24754.tldr: A weight-only codec that aligns permutation-symmetric blocks to maximize cross-layer correspondence, turning depth into a predictable sequence, and improves the rate accuracy Pareto frontier over strong quantization and learned weight-codec baselines, while maintaining competitive decode time.

2605.24737.tldr: Govllm is an open-source framework implementing a governance-driven routing architecture in which model selection is determined by accumulated compliance scores rather than by latency or cost alone, and is released as open-source software to support reproducible AI governance research.

2605.24728.tldr: This paper introduces Hylos, a systems architecture for contract-bounded spatial intelligence that maintains scene-scale operability state over objects, assemblies, assets, surface anchors, assertions, action candidates, solver jobs, shared actuator invocations, capability gaps, and effect diffs.

2605.24719.tldr: An exploratory evaluation of whether LLMs can serve as a catalyst for player expression while aiming to address the incoherence issues typical of purely LLM-based approaches suggests that transformations offer a way to maintain world-state consistency while encouraging players to interact creatively through their written inputs.

2605.24697.tldr: Experiments show that TraceLock improves the quality-step tradeoff over heuristic and learned baselines, with particularly stable behavior under cross-setting deployment, suggesting that frozen diffusion language models expose a learnable space of commitment trajectories beyond confidence-based decoding.

2605.24687.tldr: HoloFair, a comprehensive benchmark framework for multidimensional demographic bias analysis, is introduced and Fair-GRPO, a reinforcement-learning-based debiasing method that alters the distribution of generative models through a designed multi-objective reward function is introduced.

2605.24681.tldr: Mix-MoE, a mixed Mixture-of-Experts framework designed to train LLMs for multilingual MT, excels in multilingual MT, significantly outperforming existing baselines and showing notable progress in mitigating parameter interference.

2605.24639.tldr: DisDop is proposed, a unified framework that systematically distills multi-level domain priors from remote sensing foundation models into a lightweight detector that achieves new state-of-the-art performance on open-vocabulary aerial detection benchmarks.

2605.24602.tldr: An Attention-Focused Approach for Improved Image Perception (AFIP) is proposed, which corrects attention distraction via cross-head attention enrichment and reinforces visual grounding through dynamic historical attention enhancement.

2605.24597.tldr: This work investigates whether LLMs can learn to generate correct and efficient proofs with guidance from A* search, and finds that on larger search spaces, models trained with imperfect heuristics exhibit superior accuracy.

2605.24808.tldr: Disentangled Double Machine Learning is proposed, a novel algorithm that integrates two key strategies that decomposes covariates into confounders, treatment-specific factors, and outcomespecific factors for enabling reliable nuisance function estimation and mitigates residual dependence caused by nuisance estimation errors.

2605.24806.tldr: Two input modalities for zero-shot PD detection are compared: handcrafted acoustic features extracted from speech recordings analyzed by a general-purpose LLM, and direct waveform input analyzed by audio-capable models.

2605.24779.tldr: This work introduces Complement Submodular Information (CSI), a new class of complement-aware submodular objectives that quantify shared structural information between a subset and its complement and demonstrates how different CSI instantiations capture complementary notions of representativeness, diversity, connectivity, and balanced neighborhood preservation.

2605.24775.tldr: This work presents PRIMA, whose primary contributions are three operational patterns for surviving failure modes: a resilience-and-recovery layer that detects upstream rate-limit signals, persists a typed pause record to disk, and resumes long-running runs without re-executing converged work even across process restarts.

2605.24764.tldr: Spectral Retrieval is a plug-in re-ranking stage that interpolates between per-token MaxSim and mean-pool retrieval through a multi-scale sinc convolution over token embeddings through a multi-scale sinc convolution over token embeddings.

2605.24786.tldr: This work introduces CONF-KV, a KV-cache manager that converts the next-token distribution into a scalar confidence score and uses it to choose the per-step cache budget, retaining more context when the model is uncertain and pruning aggressively when it is confident.

2605.24784.tldr: GRAIL, an agentic translation system that converts Python geospatial workflows into executable Spark-based programs without requiring scientists to learn a new framework, is demonstrated.

2605.24699.tldr: The experimental work shows that performance lift is attributable to system architecture: specialty routing, multi-turn context preservation, drug-state safety gating, site-filtered search, length-aware synthesis, and engine-level reliability, supporting the view that agentic clinical benchmark performance is shaped both by the underlying foundation model and the orchestration architecture.

2605.24686.tldr: FACET (Functional Affective Competence and Empathy Test), a psychometrically grounded framework comprising 480 expert-crafted items, is introduced, challenging the assumption of linear emotional scaling and providing a rigorous roadmap for developing socially aware agents capable of genuine clinical resonance.

2605.24667.tldr: Analyzing how bulk and tail percentile CE move during training reveals that training reshapes the empirical per-token CE distribution, which correlates much more closely with task performance than does mean CE.

2605.24660.tldr: This work treats the number of tools shown to an LLM agent as the object of evaluation and applies Bits-over-Random (BoR), a chance-corrected metric that asks whether success at a given depth is better than what random selection would achieve at that same depth.

2605.24649.tldr: The R-DTLGN is the first recurrent architecture that couples learned temporal prediction with formal degradation guarantees rooted in three-valued logic, and the accuracy-versus-safety tradeoff between two label construction pipelines is evaluated.

2605.24631.tldr: This work proposes a world-centric perspective on minority sampling, which defines rarity with respect to real-world priors rather than generator-induced densities, and introduces JEPA guidance, a diffusion sampling framework guided by a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture -- a class of world models that encode broad, semantically rich representations.

2605.24598.tldr: Hera is presented, a step-level device--cloud LLM agent coordinator for long-horizon tasks achieving a strong performance--cost Pareto frontier and adopting a novel two-stage training paradigm: imitation learning for cold-start, followed by reinforcement learning that jointly optimizes task success and cloud usage efficiency.

2605.24657.tldr: This work evaluates an alternative: nightly consolidation of interaction knowledge into model weights via reflection, synthesis, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning on a single consumer GPU.

2605.24652.tldr: AVBench is a fully automated benchmark tailored for human-centric AV generation, which derives continuous evaluation scores from the model's prediction confidence on binary decisions, enabling a more reliable assessment than traditional VQA-style evaluation and aligns closely with human judgment.

2605.24614.tldr: The Unlearning Depth Score (UDS) is proposed, a metric that quantifies the mechanistic depth of unlearning via activation patching and achieves the highest faithfulness and robustness, confirming the causal approach as the most reliable for unlearning evaluation.

2605.24613.tldr: GuardedRepair is presented, a guarded best-of-N repair framework that diagnoses cached reasoning traces, selectively triggers repair, and accepts answer-changing candidates only when deterministic verification guards support replacement.

2605.24608.tldr: A rigorous algebraic framework for deep convolutional architectures, CNNs, ResNets, and encoder--decoder networks such as UNet, grounded in lattice theory and mathematical morphology, and establishes a complete fixed-point and convergence theory.

2605.24799.tldr: This work proposes Divide-and-Conquer Inference (DCI), a novel test-time scaling strategy for visual recognition with MLLMs that enables lightweight open-source models to rival or even surpass frontier closed-source giants without any additional training or fine-tuning.

2605.24743.tldr: This work proposes BOOST, a bilevel optimization framework where the inner level trains the LLM on reweighted data and the outer level trains a lightweight reweighting head on held-out real validation tasks, assigning continuous trajectory-level weights without requiring an external judge.

2404.18539.tldr: The Skea-Topo Aware loss is proposed, which is a novel loss function that takes into account the shape of each object and topological significance of the pixels and improves the segmentation accuracy by better modeling the object geometry with skeletons.

2506.07813.tldr: CasArbi leverages a coordinate-conditioned diffusion model for learning continuous image representations and adopts self-consistency guidance to generate scale-consistent details at inference time, and demonstrates superior scale consistency across diverse arbitrary-scale super-resolution benchmarks.

2508.18444.tldr: This work analyzes how different training methods affect the semantic understanding of the re-ranking task in LLMs and investigates whether these models can generate more informed textual reasoning to overcome the challenges of transparency or LLMs and limited training data.

2509.24935.tldr: This work investigates the scalability of Generative Adversarial Networks through two design choices: training in a compact Variational Autoencoder latent space and adopting purely transformer-based generators and discriminators, and finds issues as underutilization of early layers in the generator and optimization instability as the network scales.

2003.05746.tldr: It is shown that Pareto-optimal repairs correspond precisely to stable extensions (and often also to preferred extensions), and a novel semantics for prioritized KBs is proposed which is inspired by grounded extensions and enjoys favourable computational properties.

2506.10225.tldr: This work presents a method for fine grained control using inference-time interventions on an autoregressive generative transformer, MusicGen, to achieve genre control by steering the residual stream using weights of a linear probe on it.

2506.03627.tldr: Robustness of Prompting (RoP) is proposed, a novel prompting strategy aimed at enhancing the robustness of LLMs and preserves model accuracy with only minimal degradation compared to clean input scenarios, thereby establishing RoP as a practical and effective approach for enhancing LLM robustness in real-world applications.

2508.00748.tldr: A new dataset of realistic avatar videos created using a state-of-the-art one-shot avatar generation model, GAGAvatar, and a lightweight, explainable spatio-temporal Graph Convolutional Network architecture with temporal attention pooling, that uses only facial landmarks to model dynamic facial gestures are introduced.

2009.11997.tldr: HyperCRL, a method that continually learns the encountered dynamics in a sequence of tasks using task-conditional hypernetworks, outperforms existing continual learning alternatives that rely on fixed-capacity networks, and does competitively with baselines that remember an ever increasing coreset of past experience.

2306.13985.tldr: These classifiers are free of tuning parameters and are robust, in the sense that they are devoid of any moment conditions of the underlying data distributions, and yield perfect classification in the HDLSS asymptotic regime.

2507.20758.tldr: This work analyzes Chain-of-Thought's operational principles by reversely tracing information flow across decoding, projection, and activation phases, and finds that CoT modulates neuron engagement in a task-dependent manner.

2407.15073.tldr: MAC (Multi-Agent Causal Discovery Framework), which casts causal discovery as a multi-agent debate coupled with the autonomous selection of an SCD algorithm, achieves the best aggregate performance among five statistical and four LLM-based baselines.

2506.21443.tldr: A domain knowledge-enhanced Dual-LLM framework that integrates structured cues with pretrained models to improve fraud detection and drift classification and achieves 98% accuracy on benchmark datasets, significantly outperforming zero-shot LLMs and traditional classifiers.

2411.02355.tldr: The most comprehensive empirical study to date, evaluating FP8, INT8, and INT4 quantization across academic benchmarks and real-world tasks on the entire Llama-3.1 model family, offers practical, data-driven guidelines for deploying quantized LLMs at scale.

2509.04632.tldr: This paper proposes two large language model (LLM)-based approaches that use only column headers and cell values: GeSI uses generative LLMs to infer hierarchical types and their attributes from table- and column-level semantics, and EmSI employs LLM-based table embeddings to group tables by column-level semantics.

2602.11799.tldr: Hi-SAM is proposed, a Hierarchical Structure-Aware Multi-modal framework with two designs that unifies modalities via geometry-aware alignment and quantizes them via a coarse-to-fine strategy, and shows consistent improvements over SOTA baselines, especially in cold-start scenarios.

2604.08819.tldr: This work distill a frontier VLM into a compact 241M student model using a multi-task recipe that addresses vocabulary imbalance in autoregressive scene graph generation through suffix-based object identity, Vocabulary-Aware Recall (VAR) Loss, and a decoupled Query2Label tag head with asymmetric loss, yielding a +6.4 percentage point improvement in SenBen Recall over standard cross-entropy training.

2603.20020.tldr: To diagnose whether fine-grained information is preserved and usable by an LLM, $R$-Probe is introduced, which measures pixel-level reconstructability of projected visual tokens using a shallow decoder initialized from the first quarter of the LLM layers.

2604.04948.tldr: A systematic comparison of four open-source PDF-to-Markdown conversion frameworks demonstrates that data preparation quality is the dominant factor in RAG system performance.

2604.08999.tldr: This work introduces AdaSTR, which leverages the global semantic awareness of LLMs to reconstruct tables into Logical Semantic Trees and presents DuTR, a dual-mode reasoning framework that integrates tree-search-based textual navigation for linguistic alignment and symbolic code execution for precise verification.

2604.03785.tldr: An actor--critic framework that requests messages only when predicted CGDC is positive, predicts future observations to reduce misalignment at consumption, and fuses delayed messages via CGDC-guided attention is proposed, guided by CGDC.

2603.13282.tldr: FedTreeLoRA is proposed, a framework employing tree-structured aggregation for fine-grained, layer-wise alignment that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods by effectively reconciling generalization and personalization.

2605.09370.tldr: An empirical analysis of a 63-node NVIDIA B200 production cluster, using 55 days of Prometheus time-series data and 73 days of operational logs covering 224 multi-node training sessions, finds no single metric is consistently dominant across failure types, motivating multi-signal detection.

2605.18106.tldr: S symmetry-compatible update rules consistently improve final validation loss, reduce expert load imbalance in sparse MoE models, and in several cases control final vocabulary-logit growth, improve router stability, and overall training stability over the corresponding AdamW updates.

2605.21168.tldr: ScenePilot is proposed, a feasibility-guided, boundary-driven framework that targets the boundary band: scenarios that are physically solvable in principle yet still cause the deployed autonomy stack to fail, and that adversarial fine-tuning on these boundary-band scenarios consistently reduces downstream crash rates.

2605.26179.tldr: This work introduces AutoDFT, a closed-loop multi-agent framework that embeds LLM reasoning into every stage of the DFT lifecycle, and enables experimentalists without deep computational expertise to obtain reliable first-principles results.

2605.26121.tldr: This work introduces GEM (Geometric Entropy Mixing), a framework reformulating data curation as a variational problem on the hypersphere augmented with a mixing-balance regularizer that effectively counteracts the cluster collapse to discover balanced semantic structures invisible to Euclidean heuristics.

2605.26146.tldr: This paper defines Augment Engineering as the discipline of orchestrating multiple purpose-built AI tools across distinct professional domains, applying prompt and context engineering as portable competencies that transfer across tool boundaries.

2605.26136.tldr: The largest listening study on audio deepfake perception to date, collecting 35,532 judgments from 1,768 participants across 138 text-to-speech and voice conversion systems suggests that the primary threat posed by modern deepfakes may not be mere deception, but the erosion of trust in genuine audio.

2605.26156.tldr: BITE is introduced, a black-box adversarial framework that learns semantics-preserving edits to mislead an LLM judge and artificially inflate the scores it assigns and exposes a fundamental weakness in the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm and motivates robust, attack-aware evaluation.

2605.26133.tldr: This paper formalizes PDE across exposure levels, review attack and defense methods, synthesize empirical findings, and highlight open challenges and future research directions.

2605.26119.tldr: This paper argues that robust Edge AI deployment must be treated as a systems problem rather than a late-stage application packaging exercise, and presents a BSP-aware framework for industrial embedded platforms organized around five layers: hardware, BSP/operating-system adaptation, runtime and acceleration, application/inference, and operations/validation.

2605.26144.tldr: VISTA is used to assess four agent systems drawn from two model families and two harnesses, finding that visual fidelity and functional correctness are partially decoupled across both input conditions and agents, and that agent editing style varies sharply but is largely orthogonal to task quality.

2605.26118.tldr: Xe-Forge, a multi-stage LLM-powered pipeline that automates this process for Intel GPU, achieves a 1.17x geometric mean speedup over PyTorch eager, demonstrating that structured domain knowledge with hardware-in-the-loop verification can systematically eliminate the repetitive porting effort that currently gates algorithm deployment on new accelerators.

2605.26068.tldr: WSADBench is introduced, the first benchmark that unifies evaluation across distinct weakly supervised scenarios, benchmarking diverse approaches from specialized WSAD methods to advanced tabular foundation models.

2605.26137.tldr: AssetGen is a 3D generator that supports AI-assisted, deployable 3D content creation in interactive workflows and demonstrates competitive visual quality against leading commercial solutions in 30 seconds and preview-quality results in less than 15 seconds.

2605.25246.tldr: The results reveal that frontier models still struggle to move from executable formulations to efficient optimization algorithms: the strongest one-shot model outperforms Gurobi in only 31% of cases in both solution quality and computational efficiency, and even strong coding agents with test-time evolution achieve only 50% on selected hard tasks.

2605.26418.tldr: RLScale-Bench is a reproducible benchmark and evaluation protocol for DRL on adaptive resource control, where an agent allocates compute to a dynamic workload under cost and service-level constraints and challenges common assumptions.

2605.26397.tldr: These findings indicate that current alignment training causes persona-specific generative breakdown visible only through qualitative analysis, confirming a deep representational gap that prompt engineering cannot resolve.

2605.26305.tldr: This paper details two novel frameworks for developing autonomous, agentic AI in scientific workflows, utilizing a hybrid Local Body, Remote Brain architecture via Google Colab, utilizing Python-based local orchestrators to invoke large language model (LLM) cloud backends.

2605.26366.tldr: A new selection criterion is proposed, First Effective Peak of Intrinsic Dimension (FEPoID), which consistently identify optimal or near-optimal layers and outperforms both the aforementioned criteria and existing hallucination detection baselines.

2605.26438.tldr: This work proposes LURE (Live-Usage Replay Evaluations), a method for constructing deployment-like evaluations by replaying realistic agentic interaction trajectories and appending evaluation prompt at the end, and introduces an automated pipeline for measuring evaluation realism.

2605.26396.tldr: Empirical experiments show consistent gains in selecting the correct entities and parts, while substantially reducing hallucination and grounding-related errors, in affordance-grounded alignment, which casts creative tool use as a preference learning problem.

2605.26255.tldr: A gated multimodal framework that integrates structured EHR time-series data with CXR foundation-model representations is developed and support adaptive multimodal fusion as a practical strategy for incorporating imaging into prospective respiratory failure prediction.

2605.26195.tldr: A self-evolving cybersecurity agent framework that iteratively revises its own scaffold based on experience from failed execution attempts, which suggests that scaffold self-evolution is a promising direction for building adaptive LLM agents for security testing.

2605.26193.tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework, CoAD, which unifies the two paradigms to leverage their complementary strengths while mitigating their respective weaknesses, and significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art deep learning and traditional data mining methods in TSAD.

2605.26436.tldr: Token-to-Mask (T2M) remasking is proposed, a training-free, drop-in replacement for T2T editing that resets suspected erroneous tokens back to the mask state, allowing the diffusion process to re-predict them under cleaner context.

2605.26371.tldr: This work focuses on abstractions that exploit the intuition of local dynamics: local transitions in different global contexts require similar kinds of action sequences, and learns which skills to reuse and where to reuse them.

2605.26277.tldr: VesselSim is proposed, a two-stage framework for universal 3D blood vessel segmentation that eliminates the need for real annotated data during training, and suggests that learning vessel geometry from synthetic tubular structures is effective for robust cross-domain generalization.

2605.26595.tldr: A data poisoning method is proposed that teaches an LLM an information hiding scheme reliably and stealthily through semantic associations between shared knowledge such as facts or concepts and attacker-chosen phrases, thus revealing a new and subtle poisoning-induced vulnerability: covert control attacks.

2605.26542.tldr: This work implements ChainCaps as a transparent MCP proxy that requires no changes to the agent or tool servers, and reduces attack success rate from 25-68% to 0-4.8% while preserving 96-100% benign completion.

2605.26494.tldr: The MiniMax-M2 series, a family of Mixture-of-Experts language models built around the principle that mini activations can unleash maximum real-world intelligence, is introduced, designed end-to-end for agentic deployment.

2605.26442.tldr: This survey adopts a data centric perspective and reframe alignment tuning as a pipeline design problem, and decomposes alignment data construction into three interacting stages, response synthesis, preference evaluation, and preference instantiation, to organize existing alignment methods into a unified taxonomy.

2605.26702.tldr: This work introduces a principled third-order invariant construction by coupling higher-order $SO(3)$ irreducible representations via tensor products and projecting onto the trivial representation, which yields a spherical invariant bispectrum that preserves phase information while remaining strictly rotation-invariant.

2605.26772.tldr: These findings indicate that refusal in LRMs is jointly encoded in residual stream activations and CoT, which makes LRM more robust against activation-level interventions alone, but exposes CoT to a possible alternative surface attack.

2605.26874.tldr: AssetOpsBench (KDD 2026) establishes that GPT-4 agents achieve 65% on 139 industrial maintenance scenarios, and compares LLM orchestration paradigms (Agent-As-Tool vs. Plan-Execute) on a fixed data layer.

2605.26684.tldr: Graph-based Group Policy Optimization (GraphGPO), which first aggregates all rollout trajectories into a unified state-transition graph and then estimates the distance from each state to the task goal using the global information encoded in the graph, significantly improves training efficiency and achieves state-of-the-art performance across a range of challenging benchmarks.

2605.26704.tldr: SL-BiLEM is established as an interpretable tool for public health decision-makers seeking accurate prediction and principled intervention planning and enables counterfactual analysis for intervention decision support.

2605.26872.tldr: Student-Centric Answer Sampling (SCAS) is proposed, a framework that selects from verified teacher-generated answers according to their estimated student-centric learning cost and is derived by a token-wise gradient decomposition and used to guide answer selection during training.

2501.10332.tldr: This work introduces Agent4Edu, a novel personalized learning simulator leveraging recent advancements in human intelligence through large language models (LLMs) to address the gap between offline metrics and the actual online performance of personalized learning services.

2507.00037.tldr: This work introduces a neuron-centric family of fusion algorithms that frames fusion as a principled representation-matching problem: intermediate neurons across parent models are grouped into target representations, which the fused model's corresponding sub-networks are then trained to approximate.

2502.16548.tldr: This study proposes and evaluates a composable strategy framework for assessment and treatment optimization in heart failure, designed to provide more holistic patient evaluation and management and demonstrates superior accuracy in HF prognosis prediction compared to single-modal AI algorithms.

2508.15371.tldr: A new framework for speculative decoding is proposed, built on the idea of adjusting drafting based on confidence levels, which provides a flexible, easy-toimplement solution for more efficient and reliable decoding in large language models, especially when faced with uncertain conditions.

2508.12176.tldr: WaveVerse is a prompt-based, scalable framework that simulates realistic RF signals from generated indoor scenes with human motions guided by spatial paths, enabling diverse and feasible behaviors without manual trajectory design.

2503.13844.tldr: A lightweight model for persuasive text detection that achieves state-of-the-art performance in Subtask 3 of SemEval 2023 Task 3 while requiring significantly fewer computational resources and training data than existing methods is introduced.

2509.23730.tldr: EAPO incentivizes the policy to adaptively determine when and how to consult experts, yielding richer reward signals and more reliable reasoning trajectories, and generalizes to non-math benchmarks, including HumanEval, HLE, GPQA, MMLU, EvalPlus, HotpotQA, and SimpleQA.

2507.06092.tldr: It is found that GenAI techniques can significantly improve the performance of security classifiers, achieving improvements of up to 32.6% even in severely data-constrained settings, and it is demonstrated that GenAI can facilitate rapid adaptation to concept drift post-deployment, requiring minimal labeling in the adjustment process.

2205.04297.tldr: A learning-based visual peg-in-hole that enables training with several shapes in simulation and adapting to arbitrary unseen shapes in the real world with minimal sim-to-real cost is proposed.

2508.19282.tldr: CORE is a novel method for lossless context compression in RAG that is optimized end-to-end and does not depend on predefined compression labels, which are often impractical to obtain, and leverages downstream task performance as a feedback signal, iteratively refining the compression policy to enhance task effectiveness.

2502.20838.tldr: DSMIL-LocNet is presented, a weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) framework that performs both classification and temporal localization using only recording-level presence/absence labels and provides temporal localization that these baselines cannot produce without frame-level annotation.

2306.10356.tldr: This paper proposes MATNet, a novel transformer-based multimodal architecture for multi-step day-ahead PV power generation forecasting, fed with historical PV data and historical and future weather covariates through a multi-level joint fusion approach, employing a soft-attention mechanism at multiple fusion stages.

2508.05614.tldr: The results establish action grounding as a multi-dimensional challenge irreducible to scaling.

2506.06254.tldr: Experimental evaluations demonstrate that PersonaAgent significantly outperforms other baseline methods by not only personalizing the action space effectively but also scaling during test-time real-world applications, underscoring the feasibility and potential of the approach in delivering tailored, dynamic user experiences.

2603.00454.tldr: RapTB, an objective that anchors subtrajectory supervision at the root and propagates terminal rewards to intermediate prefixes via absorbed suffix-based backups, providing dense prefix-level learning signals, and SubM, a submodular replay refresh strategy that promotes both high reward and diversity.

2602.10388.tldr: This work introduces Feature Activation Coverage (FAC), which measures data diversity in an interpretable feature space, and proposes a diversity-driven data synthesis framework, named FAC Synthesis, that first uses a sparse autoencoder to identify missing features from a seed dataset, and then generates synthetic samples that explicitly reflect these features.

2602.11171.tldr: A Bayesian Optimization (BO) framework that leverages the domain knowledge of pre-trained LLMs to efficiently search for LoRA hyperparameters, and repurposes a pre-trained LLM as a discrete-to-continuous mapping module to link hyperparameters and their domain knowledge to a continuous vector space, where BO is conducted.

2602.14307.tldr: Critique-Resilient Benchmarking is proposed, an adversarial framework designed to compare models even when full human understanding is infeasible, and reformulates benchmarking as an adversarial generation-evaluation game in which humans serve as final adjudicators.

2605.13841.tldr: EVA-Bench is presented, an end-to-end evaluation framework that addresses two core evaluation challenges: generating realistic simulated conversations, and measuring quality across the full scope of voice-specific failure modes.

2605.12925.tldr: This work introduces AgentLens, a framework for process-level assessment of SWE-agent trajectories, and defines AgentLens-Bench, a dataset of 1,815 trajectories annotated with quality scores, waste signals, divergence points, and 47 task-level Prefix Tree Acceptor (PTA) references.

2605.07707.tldr: This work investigates whether large language models (LLMs) can generate effective search heuristics for HTN planning and shows that LLM-generated heuristics nearly match the coverage of the best available HTN planner, while substantially reducing search effort on 83% of shared problems.

2605.00969.tldr: MedMosaic, a medical audio question-answering dataset designed to benchmark language and audio reasoning models under realistic clinical constraints, reveals that reasoning remains challenging for all evaluated systems, with substantial performance variation across question types.

2605.13511.tldr: This work studies many-shot ICL on reasoning tasks, with a particular focus on many-shot chain-of-thought in-context learning (CoT-ICL), and identifies several distinctive properties of many-shot CoT-ICL.

2603.27052.tldr: It is concluded that GenAI adoption barriers are deeply embedded in organizational ecosystems and epistemic norms, while also reflecting individual experiences and other unmeasured factors, suggesting that universities must move beyond generalized training to develop role-specific governance and support frameworks.

2603.13249.tldr: This work identifies a sparse subset of attention heads that independently govern persona and style formation, which are term Style Modulation Heads and demonstrates that intervention targeting only these specific heads achieves robust behavioral control while significantly mitigating the coherency degradation observed in residual stream steering.

2605.12208.tldr: This work proposes to bypass the parameter posterior and focus directly on approximating the posterior predictive distribution of the Self-Supervised Laplace Approximation (SSLA), drawing inspiration from self-training within self-supervised and semi-supervised learning.

2605.13548.tldr: AttenA+, an architecture-agnostic framework that prioritizes kinematically critical segments via velocity-driven action attention, suggests that mining the intrinsic structural priors of action sequences offers a highly efficient, physics-aware complement to standard scaling laws, paving a new path for general-purpose robotic control.

2603.27150.tldr: MediHive is introduced, a novel decentralized multi-agent framework for medical question answering that integrates a shared memory pool with iterative fusion mechanisms and demonstrates superior performance in reasoning-intensive tasks.

2604.09557.tldr: How synthetic inputs overestimate real-world throughput is highlighted by quantifying how synthetic inputs overestimate real-world throughput, identifying batch-size dependent optimal draft lengths and biases in low-diversity data, and analyzing the caveats of vocabulary pruning in state-of-the-art drafters are analyzed.

2603.26668.tldr: This paper introduces the concept of abstract to bridge query entities and document chunks, providing robust semantic understanding and integrates the Cuckoo Filter in CFT-RAG, which provides O(1) entity lookup and naturally fits the entity-to-abstract pathway of the framework.

2605.13230.tldr: Teachers-Guided Policy Optimization uses teacher to directly guide token level generation conditioning on student-generated contexts; together with RLVR-style trajectory level rewards, TGPO steers exploration toward improved continuations.

2605.00846.tldr: ClinicBot is presented, an AI system that translates guideline recommendations into trustworthy clinical support through three key advances: structured extraction of clinical guidelines into semantic units, and evidence prioritization that ranks content by clinical significance and guideline structure rather than textual similarity.

2605.27176.tldr: These results support a redundancy-aware Compressive KG hypothesis: useful KG signal is often recoverable from compact, scientifically structured subgraphs rather than requiring the full local graph.

2605.28837.tldr: The LDPC-inspired semantic error correction for retrieval-augmented generation (SERC) is proposed, providing a theoretical framework to interpret and mitigate LLM hallucinations, and enables small language models to surpass the performance of larger baselines in hallucination reduction and information preservation.

2605.29359.tldr: This paper evaluates the feasibility of such evasion and outlines recommended countermeasures, including whistleblowing, chip tracking, forensic accounting, and memory and compute thresholds for clusters.

2605.29335.tldr: It is shown that distributional metrics should be interpreted together with the geometry of the reference dataset for more reliable benchmarking, and distributional density and effective rank significantly explain how FID changes as sample quality improves.

2605.29300.tldr: MusTBENCH is introduced, a music-expert-validated benchmark designed to evaluate temporal grounding in LALMs through five temporally grounded question-answering tasks, and MusT, a novel four-stage temporal optimization recipe spanning music encoder adaptation, LLM adaptation, LLM supervised fine-tuning, and RL-based optimization is proposed.

2605.29500.tldr: A quotient-DAG view that merges histories equivalent for evaluation and assigns weights using target-to-behavior forward-flow ratios on the merged graph yields Forward-DP, a subset-DAG dynamic program that computes exact unordered propensities without factorial enumeration.

2605.29491.tldr: It is demonstrated that reinforcement learning, specifically Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) can restore the probabilistic boundary between robust and distracted behaviors, and improve robustness by up to 15.5% without compromising general instruction-following capability.

2605.29475.tldr: MOOSE-Copilot, the first unified framework to bridge this abstraction gap through a formalized human-AI interaction (HAII) protocol, is presented, which empowers scientists to steer the generative process via three explicit signals: initial blueprints, inter-stage routing, and intra-stage feedback.
