2605.29402.tldr: This paper proposes a unified framework that decouples long-video reasoning into two complementary forms of evidence: semantic evidence and visual evidence, and demonstrates that explicitly structuring, retrieving, and integrating semantic and visual evidence is critical for effective long-video understanding with MLLMs.

2605.29307.tldr: This work introduces GrepSeek, an optimized direct corpus interaction (DCI) search agent that trains a compact search agent to find, filter, and compose evidence from large text corpora and suggests DCI as a practical and competitive method for search agents that can complement existing retrieval paradigms in the real world.

2605.29488.tldr: AnyMo is proposed, a unified multimodal framework combining a Residual FSQ-based motion tokenizer with a scalable masked modeling transformer, enabling high-quality motion synthesis under arbitrary modality combinations and achieving high-fidelity synthesis while offering flexible control over both spatial and stylistic attributes.

2605.29468.tldr: It is found that scientific integrity alignment is strongly framing-sensitive: models refuse explicit misconduct far more reliably than covert violations, especially failing when misconduct is presented as a pressure-driven shortcut.

2605.29467.tldr: This work identifies five factor-graph primitives, and proves that any model composed from them admits closed-form variational message passing, and yields a Bayesian mixture of experts in which gating functions are inferred rather than learned, providing calibrated uncertainty over expert selection across five benchmark datasets.

2605.29463.tldr: The mitigation replaces open-ended self-diagnosis with programmatic extraction of trajectory-level failure signals, increasing correct object mention from 0% to 86%, reducing RRR from 0.64 to 0.10, and solving 3 of 16 frozen ALFWorld environments, suggesting that reflective memory can reinforce false beliefs rather than correct them.

2605.29458.tldr: An adaptive interview framework is proposed that gathers persona-relevant information through a structured three-stage dialogue: core questions, dynamic follow-ups, and a synthesized personality summary, which highlights that richer persona context alone is insufficient and improvements arise only when models actually ground their decisions in user-specific evidence.

2605.29442.tldr: An observational study of 20,574 coding-agent sessions from 1,639 repositories across IDE and CLI workflows operationalizes misalignment as a breakdown made visible through developer pushback, and annotates each episode along four axes: form, cause, cost, and resolution.

2605.29414.tldr: Experiments show that simple sentence-level multilingual CSD consistently improves average multilingual performance across all four languages, indicating that multilingual code-switching can be effective beyond bilingual transfer settings.

2605.29400.tldr: Three supervised fine-tuned models are benchmarked against frontier zero-shot baselines on a 661-row held-out slice of PiSAR, a 12,929-tuple corpus of screen-anchored behavioural rationales curated from public app-store reviews, Pew American Trends Panel demographics, and the OPeRA shopper traces.

2605.29396.tldr: This paper is the first to study the robustness of safety alignment from the perspective of the base optimizer, and proposes a hybrid framework that first performs standard first-order safety alignment and then applies zeroth-order refinement to improve robustness.

2605.29368.tldr: Experimental evaluations show that SURGENT outperforms baseline LLMs and existing medical multi-agent frameworks, yielding recommendations more closely aligned with patient histories, and position SURGENT as a practical and trustworthy advancement toward intelligent, equitable, and secure surgical assistance systems.

2605.29360.tldr: MiraBench reveals three central findings: visual fidelity is a poor proxy for action fidelity; increasing model scale does not reliably improve action following; and optimism bias is pervasive across current systems.

2605.29394.tldr: EvoMD-LLM (Evolutionary Molecular Dynamics Large Language Model) is presented, a framework that reformulates species-level molecular dynamics as a symbolic temporal language modeling problem and provides an effective framework for grounding LLMs in dynamic physical simulations.

2605.29507.tldr: An embedding-level mechanistic framework for explaining dense retrieval, which first introduces a lightweight reasoning internalizer that approximates Chain-of-Thought reasoning directly in the embedding space with a single forward pass, enriching sentence embeddings with reasoning-oriented information while avoiding expensive autoregressive generation.

2605.29493.tldr: Analysis of federal civil filing data from FY2008-2025 finds that the federal civil pro se plaintiff rate rose from 11.33% pre-GenAI to 16.94% post-GenAI, a 5.61 percentage-point increase that persists after trend and covariate-adjusted robustness checks.

2605.29462.tldr: This work introduces CFMME, a novel Chinese financial multimodal evaluation benchmark that aims to comprehensively evaluate the perception, understanding, reasoning, and cognition capabilities of LVLMs throughout the entire financial business workflow in Chinese contexts.

2605.29453.tldr: Dual-Scale Retentive Dynamics is proposed, a unified framework that maintains a retentive representation state encoding both temporal memory and structural context and introduces two key components: a retentive state with dual-scale adaptation that jointly models temporal dynamics and structural propagation within a single recurrent formulation.

2605.29448.tldr: Direct optimization reveals that, while the Vendi Score is predictive over moderate score ranges, pushing the objective to higher values can make it a poor downstream performance proxy, and it is shown that size, class balance, and training budget do not alone determine data value: even when controlling for these factors, performance ranges smoothly from good to bad.

2605.29434.tldr: AliMark is a framework that reformulates sentence-level watermarking as a bit sequence encoding and alignment problem between a potentially watermarked text and a secret bit sequence to improve robustness to sentence merges and splits.

2605.29428.tldr: DELOS provides an efficient and sensitive framework for low-SNR transit searches and represents a practical step toward future searches for longer-period terrestrial planets in Kepler, K2, TESS, PLATO, and Earth 2.0 data.

2605.29425.tldr: ReasonLight, a multimodal foundation model-enhanced RL framework for zero-shot TSC that reduces emergency vehicle waiting time by up to 88.7% compared with the RL-only backbone while preserving comparable routine traffic performance, is proposed.

2605.29357.tldr: PassNet is proposed, the first large-scale ecosystem for LLM-based compiler pass generation, comprising: PassNet-Dataset, over 18K unique computational graphs from 100K real-world models; and PassBench, 200 curated long-tail fusible tasks evaluated under the Error-aware Speedup Score (ES_t).

2605.29350.tldr: ConMoE is proposed, a train-free prototype remapping framework that selects retained experts using calibration-based contribution and replaceability signals, then redirects original expert calls to the selected prototypes without weight updates or post-compression fine-tuning.

2605.29299.tldr: Pocket-Dentist is presented, an efficiency-aware benchmark for dental multimodal question answering that brings together three datasets spanning approximately 1,159 patients from BRAR and MetaDent, five task types and seven metrics, and reveals an interesting observation: compact VLMs, such as 2B-parameter models, become competitive with much larger VLMs on most metrics after lightweight adaptation while requiring substantially lower computational costs in dental image understanding.

2605.29288.tldr: This work studies post-conclusion continuation in answer-correct long-CoT data: a continuation where the answer appears sufficiently supported, but the trace continues with additional reasoning that remains in the supervised target.

2605.29420.tldr: It is suggested that persona prompting primarily reshapes response characteristics rather than broadly improving capability, and that multi-metric evaluation is necessary for understanding its effects.

2605.29486.tldr: PhoneWorld is presented, a reusable pipeline that converts real GUI trajectories and screenshots into controllable phone-use environments, executable tasks, automatic verifiers, and training rollouts, and scales the supply of phone-use environments themselves.

2605.29478.tldr: This study investigates SME's default predictors and applies explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques to them and introduces DEXiRE-EVO, a novel evolutionary rule extraction framework that combines multi-objective optimization with the Contextual Importance and Utility (CIU) explainability method.

2605.29446.tldr: CrystalXRD-Bench is introduced, a 250-sample benchmark built from 10 public crystallographic databases for a single task: recover the full set of HKLs contributing to the highest-intensity peak in an XRD pattern.

2605.29430.tldr: Experiments on multilingual, named-entity-intensive, and code-switching benchmarks show that iterative interaction consistently reduces semantic errors, with much larger gains in conventional token-level metrics than in conventional token-level metrics.

2605.29380.tldr: A theoretical framework for multimodal contrastive finetuning is developed, showing that self-distillation is more effective than other regularization approaches to retain the knowledge of the pretrained model and motivating TRACER, which combines contrastive learning with WMA-guided multi-perspective distillation.

2605.29303.tldr: This work proposes EKSFT (Entropy-KL Selective Fine-Tuning), which selectively masks tokens that exhibit either high entropy or high KL divergence from a reference model, which injects task-specific knowledge while preserving the integrity of the model's pre-trained distribution.

2605.29653.tldr: PTCG-Bench is presented, a benchmark built on the Pok'e}mon Trading Card Game (PTCG) that evaluates LLM agents at two complementary levels: their decision-making performance within a single complex environment, and their ability to self-evolving through accumulated experience.

2605.29640.tldr: VikingMem, an end-to-end Memory Base Management System implemented on the VikingDB vector engine, features event-centric memory extraction to selectively handle complex information streams, while entities are dynamically updated by events to achieve stateful evolution.

2605.29629.tldr: A simple early-stop rule derived from TLO cuts successful jailbreaks by more than half, without false alarms on plain benign queries, and TLO makes the first two observable from logits alone.

2605.29626.tldr: DLM-SWAI is proposed, a simple training-free steering method that biases the token distribution at each denoising step using pre-computed token-level style scores and effectively steers diffusion language models while preserving generation quality and requiring minimal computational overhead.

2605.29591.tldr: Mind-Omni is proposed, the first versatile framework that unifies seven distinct encoding and decoding tasks through a discrete diffusion paradigm and offers a powerful new paradigm for neural modeling and paves the way for foundation models of neural activity.

2605.29568.tldr: In DeepTool, a novel framework that scales deliberate thinking within the interleaved process of thinking, action, and observation at each turn is proposed, and the token cost-effectiveness analysis confirms the utility of interleaved thinking, demonstrating DeepTool's optimal balance between performance and token efficiency.

2605.29560.tldr: This work introduces a new paradigm that reframes the inverse problem as a reasoning task, and presents Battery-Sim-Agent, the first framework to deploy a Large Language Model agent in a closed loop with a high-fidelity battery simulator, which significantly outperforms strong BBO baselines like Bayesian optimization in identifying accurate parameters.

2605.29522.tldr: To enhance depth and fortify reliability, DeepSurvey combines citation-graph expansion with hybrid filtering for topic-focussed retrieval, enforces evidence-constrained citation assignment, and deploys multi-granularity agentic refinement to validate citation-claim alignment.

2605.29713.tldr: This book provides a compact, derivation-oriented introduction to the mathematical foundations of modern generative artificial intelligence, and develops a coherent route through the ideas connecting major families of generative models.

2605.29697.tldr: This work proposes Graph-Distance Contribution Reward (GDCR), a step-level process reward that scores newly-retrieved and newly-cited entities by their distance to the answer node in a training-time Entity-Relation (ER) graph, and proposes Step Advantage Policy Optimization (SAPO), which converts GDCR into step-level advantages and combines them with trajectory-level outcome advantages.

2605.29687.tldr: The results demonstrate that LLM-driven code generation combined with preference-based MaxSAT enables solver-verifiable optimisation with respect to generated encodings, and substantially improves correctness under independently verified reference semantics.

2605.29668.tldr: GRASP (Gated Regression-Aware Skill Proposer) is introduced, which treats agent improvement as a sequence of edits to a bounded skill library, admitting each candidate only if it produces a net improvement on a balanced held-out probe under a hard regression budget.

2605.29652.tldr: Think Fast, Talk Smart, a sleep-health insight pipeline in which deterministic code performs recurring analysis before one bounded LLM writer call, achieves lower numeric error, lower instruction-compliance error, and lower end-to-end cost than structured zero-shot and few-shot one-call baselines.

2605.29631.tldr: Experiments show that finetuning plays a crucial role in improving prediction performance, with absolute error reducing by -27% up to -71% compared to prompted out-of-the-box LLMs, and that the two-step framework is beneficial for out-of-domain generalization, highlighting the benefits of separating semantic interpretation from numerical effect estimation.

2605.29628.tldr: This work introduces COMET (Concept space Organization and Modality gap Explanation with PLS-SVD Transformation), a novel partial least squares singular value decomposition (PLS-SVD) framework for CLAP that unveils a broader perspective of the modality gap.

2605.29586.tldr: FinVerBench results support a construct-validity conclusion rather than a final leaderboard: financial statement verification is not merely arithmetic detection, but calibrated judgment under incomplete observability, prompt-induced assumptions, and realistic numerical rendering.

2605.29578.tldr: This work proposes a four stage simulation framework combining month conditioned spatial priors derived from GPS and survey data, trip extent prediction from tourist demographics, distance feasible ward sequence assignment, and LLM-based activity chain generation under household and spatial constraints to address tourist mobility planning challenges.

2605.29561.tldr: ParaTool is a framework that projects each tool into a dedicated, loadable set of parameters, and significantly outperforms strong ICL-based baselines, achieving superior performance while reducing computational complexity.

2605.29512.tldr: Mindgames is introduced, a multi-game arena and evaluation platform for LLM agents that operationalizes complementary reasoning demands relevant to ``theory of mind'': belief attribution under hidden information, opponent modeling through repeated strategic interaction, cooperative inference under knowledge asymmetries, and sustained deception in social deduction.

2605.29656.tldr: TRACE (Toulmin-based Reasoning Assessment through Constructive Elements), a metric that analyzes Chain-of-Thought reasoning processes, shows strong correlation with benchmark accuracy and is effective as a reinforcement learning reward signal, outperforming accuracy-only baselines.

2605.29562.tldr: Experiments on RoboTwin, RLBench, and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-Pro consistently improves cross-task generalization across multiple backbones, achieving up to a 207% relative improvement in simulation and increasing real-world success rate from 5.8% to 65.0%.

2605.29547.tldr: Singularity-aware Adam (S-Adam) is introduced, a novel optimizer that stabilizes training by dynamically modulating step sizes based on local geometric instability using the Local Geometric Instability (LGI) metric, a computationally efficient estimator of the Clarke subdifferential diameter derived from the variance of randomized directional derivatives.

2605.29539.tldr: GiPL, an efficient two-branch training framework that performs zero-shot inference on the support set to generate reliable pseudo-annotations, fuses them with ground-truth labels, and iteratively optimizes the model to fully exploit support set data.

2605.29526.tldr: This work comprehensively captures the 3-node temporal motif distribution of each active address using an efficient computational mechanism, enabling downstream temporal motif-aware graph learning and design a simple yet effective test-time adaptation strategy to facilitate the sharing of common patterns between training and testing graphs.

2605.29518.tldr: The main objective of the current article is to provide a comprehensive review, eliminate misconceptions, and outline the future of the network optimization aspects of autonomous vehicles by presenting various multidisciplinary methods, such as cooperative perception.

2605.29670.tldr: This work reframe schema linking as uncertainty-aware schema-need inference over multiple plausible SQL paths, where the system distinguishes required schema items from path-dependent uncertain ones and acquires evidence only where needed.

2605.29625.tldr: A novel ludic co-creation scenario involving children and Large Language Models interacting through a physical board game to create written stories is explored to develop a multi-agent framework capable of producing high-quality narratives suitable for young players.

2605.29601.tldr: This method, inspired by deliberative alignment, uses a scheming specification to elicit structured rationales from a frontier teacher, filters them with a separate judge, and distills the highest-quality rationales into open-weight monitors with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, providing practical low-cost, low-FPR alternatives to prompted frontier models.

2605.29716.tldr: Noise-aware Low-Rank Adaptation (NaRA) is proposed, which introduces a low-rank core matrix generated by a lightweight, globally shared hypernetwork conditioned on the noise level that enables the update matrices to vary continuously along the diffusion process while keeping parameter and latency overhead negligible.

2605.29556.tldr: This work proposes a novel LLM-based framework with Dual-side Verification (Opt-Verifier) from both structure and solution perspectives, thereby improving the modeling accuracy and achieving over 20\% improvement in accuracy.

2605.29532.tldr: GUITestScape is presented, an interactive benchmark covering 61 real-world Android applications and 508 preset defects spanning interaction and display types, and GUIJudge is introduced, an open-set evaluator that decomposes an agent's testing trajectory into independently diagnosable capabilities.

2605.29712.tldr: This work formulates grounded claim factuality checking as a true/false reading comprehension task and prompting LLMs with explicit test-taking strategies for efficient reasoning, which reduces token usage by over 80% compared to unguided open-ended reasoning, and achieves competitive performance to more expensive alternatives across two factuality benchmarks.

2605.29711.tldr: A conversation satisfaction evaluator that combines compact user memories with target-turn context to produce satisfaction scores and dissatisfaction-oriented rationales is built and meta-evaluation against human satisfaction annotations shows that personalized memory and post-hoc score calibration improve ordinal agreement and dissatisfied-turn detection over supervised, retrieval-based, and generic LLM-as-a-judge baselines.

2605.29695.tldr: A masked transformer-based autoencoder approach to reconstruct missing FHR signals by capturing both local temporal and frequency components of the data is proposed and can be applied retrospectively to research datasets to support the development of AI-based risk algorithms.

2605.29675.tldr: From Prompts to Context, an ontology-driven framework for representing Human-Generative AI collaboration, is introduced by outlining design principles for future Human-Generative AI systems that emphasise not only output quality, but also the explicit representation of the collaborative context in which outputs are produced.

2605.29657.tldr: This work proposes OccamToken, a training-free framework that replaces absolute token ranking with register-anchored relative evidence testing, and argues that register tokens naturally absorb low-information attention patterns, making them a stable reference for identifying genuinely informative visual evidence.

2605.29705.tldr: BitTP is proposed, which converts an LLM-based trajectory predictor into a lightweight bitlinear architecture and demonstrates that weight-only quantization to 1.58-bit (BitTP-Weight) is optimal, demonstrating that carefully designed quantization acts as an effective regularizer, enabling the practical deployment of sophisticated LLM-based reasoning on edge devices.

2605.29563.tldr: Self-exploration emerges as a promising path toward VLMs that can actively reason and plan in 3D space, and an iterative framework that alternates self-exploration with view graph distillation is proposed.

2605.29543.tldr: Semantic reasoning for Communication via Open-set Plug-in with Examples (SCOPE), a novel lightweight-training LLM framework that advances both the efficiency and accuracy of machine-based ATC readback monitoring, is proposed.

2605.29524.tldr: KBF is introduced, a low-cost black-box auditing protocol that fingerprints model APIs using stable numerical recall near the knowledge boundary and flags all 155 economically relevant substitutions without rejecting any same-model controls.

2605.29685.tldr: NICE (Norm, Interaction, Cognition, Experience), a diagnostic benchmark of 137 items operationalized through representative Chinese contexts, is introduced, which reframes social intelligence evaluation toward theory-grounded diagnosis of socially consequential weaknesses in LLMs.

2605.29659.tldr: Across an expanded comparison spanning 12 safety-classification tasks and 17 category tasks against eight contemporary guardrail systems, Opir variants are competitive on or ahead of the strongest open-weight baselines on the majority of benchmark datasets while operating with a substantially smaller deployment footprint.

2605.29645.tldr: The main result is the design of algorithms that, with high probability, output an $\epsilon$-optimal policy compared to policy class $\Pi$ using $\tilde{O} ((s/\epsilon^2 + |A|/\epsilon)\log |\Pi|/\delta)$ samples.

2605.29630.tldr: This work proposes entity-collision, a system-agnostic protocol that pins the BM25 floor by construction -- every distractor shares the answer's entity tokens -- and stratifies queries by discriminator tag, so any lift over BM25 is attributable to the embedder.

2605.29610.tldr: AlignG is proposed, which learns context-conditioned predicate semantics via prototype feedback and infers context-conditioned predicate semantics from the relation candidates within each image and feeds the adapted semantics back to recalibrate relation representations.

2605.29606.tldr: HiKEY is proposed, a hierarchical tree-based multimodal retrieval framework that elevates document hierarchy to a first-class retrieval signal and reconstructs a logical heterogeneous graph via Document Hierarchical Parsing (DHP), explicitly encoding parent-child relationships.

2602.08885.tldr: SimpliPy, a rule-based simplification engine achieving a 100-fold speed-up over SymPy at comparable quality, is proposed, which enables substantial improvements in amortized SR, including scalability to much larger training sets, more efficient use of the per-expression token budget, and systematic training set decontamination with respect to equivalent test expressions.

2602.24210.tldr: The results show that improving IF in LRMs can significantly enhance privacy, suggesting a promising direction for future privacy-aware LRMs, and introduces an SFT dataset that teaches models to follow general instructions throughout their reasoning process.

2603.00068.tldr: A three-pronged policy response is proposed: mandatory model-level transparency that covers inference consumption, benchmarks, and compute locations; user rights to opt out of unnecessary generative AI integration and to select environmentally optimized models; and international coordination to prevent regulatory arbitrage.

2605.17373.tldr: FML-Bench is proposed, a benchmark of 18 fundamental ML research tasks across 10 domains that separates agent strategy from execution infrastructure and defines 12 process-level behavioral metrics and reveals that early convergence and directionally focused exploration are significantly associated with final performance, while solution diversity and compute cost are not.

2605.11946.tldr: This work introduces Counterfactual Trace Auditing (CTA), a framework for measuring how a skill changes agent behavior, and identifies 522 SIP instances across the same paired traces, showing that the skills substantially reshape agent behavior even when pass rate is nearly unchanged.

2603.19262.tldr: The empirical observation that diverse inference-time prompting pipelines repeatedly exhibit reproducible log-ratio structure under controlled conditions is observed, which provides a protocol-sensitive perspective for analyzing calibration, evidence amplification, uncertainty propagation, and interaction sensitivity in inference-time LLM pipelines.

2605.18024.tldr: This paper proposes an interaction-breaking adversarial learning (IBAL) framework that takes an information-theoretic view to construct attacks that impede coordination by perturbing agents' observations and actions, and trains agents to perform reliably under such disruptions.

2605.17101.tldr: SEMA-RAG is proposed, a Self-Evolving Multi-Agent RAG framework for medical question answering, which assigns these roles to three specialist agents: the Interpreter Agent for clinical schema interpretation, the Explorer Agent for sufficiency-driven self-evolving retrieval, and the Arbiter Agent for evidence adjudication and answer selection.

2605.08145.tldr: This work analyzes multimodal interactions -- redundant (shared), unique (exclusive), and synergistic (emergent) task-relevant information provided by the modalities -- to determine their impacts on model reliability and suggests that increasing redundancy can reduce visual induced errors and improve consistency.

2604.18587.tldr: This work introduces a learning-to-refine framework that leverages this compression to perform efficient learning and proof exploration, and performs tree search that corrects errors locally conditioned on explicit verifier feedback, thereby circumventing the costs associated with accumulating a long history of proof attempts.

2603.20253.tldr: SimulCost is introduced, the first benchmark targeting cost-sensitive parameter tuning in physics simulations, and open-source SimulCost is open-source as a static benchmark and extensible toolkit to facilitate research on improving cost-aware agentic designs for physics simulations, and for expanding new simulation environments.

2603.06738.tldr: This paper proposes Rank-factorized Implicit Neural Bias~(RIB), an alternative to RPB that enables FlashAttention in SR Transformers and introduces a convolutional local attention and a cyclic window strategy to fully leverage the advantages of long-range interactions enabled by RIB and FlashAttention.

2605.18803.tldr: This work introduces a KL-constrained adversarial curriculum in which a policy is trained to expose high-error trajectories of a diffusion-based world model while remaining close to the behavior distribution, and proposes a Prioritized Adversarial Trajectory (PAT) buffer that re-ranks trajectories based on prediction error, action fidelity, and learning progress.

2603.22867.tldr: TRINE is a single-bitstream FPGA accelerator and compiler that executes end-to-end multimodal inference without reconfiguration, delivering state-of-the-art latency and energy efficiency for unified vision, language, and graph workloads-in one bitstream.

2605.19806.tldr: This paper investigates chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation on German statutory law, using the German Civil Code as a structured benchmark corpus, and shows that preserving domain-specific structure is critical for effective legal information retrieval.

2605.01134.tldr: A framework to dissolve the confounding problem inherent to noun-based causal inference and provide the foundation for a spontaneously growing causal-reasoning world model is instantiate and applied to longitudinal EHR data from 3,276 breast cancer patients.

2605.30409.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the SANA-Streaming co-design approach significantly outperforms existing SOTA methods in both temporal coherence and system throughput.

2605.30393.tldr: NumLeak is introduced, a measurement framework that combines API-boundary probes on production models with a white-box controlled validation on an open causal LM that detects memorization that open-ended generation misses.

2605.30383.tldr: It is found that switching from fully connected to modular hierarchical interactions improves normalised performance by 47 points, whereas doubling neural network hidden size yields at most 9 points, and interaction structure can play a dominant role within the tested system and task setting.

2605.30376.tldr: Unicorn (Universal Correlation Network), a framework for scalable, multi-dataset pretraining on high-dimensional time series, with a latent prototype codebook that decouples correlation modeling from specific channel identities.

2605.30375.tldr: MHLF combines a topologically consistent geometric multigrid representation with a hierarchical strategy that captures regional flow heterogeneity during both prediction and subsequent CFD correction, achieving a 3 to 8 times efficiency improvement over conventional initialization.

2605.30363.tldr: The results demonstrate that combining unstructured policy text with statistical structural-break detection improves the robustness and interpretability of regime shift identification in financial markets.

2605.30362.tldr: Extensive experiments show that the proposed XOResNet outperforms existing state-of-the-art deep SNNs optimized via gradient descent, and validate the effectiveness of the OA shortcut and XOR meta-residual components in overcoming fundamental limitations of residual learning in SNNs.

2605.27355.tldr: This work introduces alignment tampering, a potential vulnerability where the LLM undergoing alignment influences the preference dataset, causing RLHF to amplify undesired behaviors and reveals structural vulnerabilities of current RLHF.

2605.30406.tldr: This paper introduces a foundational framework and taxonomy for managing catastrophic AI LOC incidents and provides a concrete, proportional guide for managing unprecedented AI risks.

2605.30391.tldr: This thesis breaks new ground by, for the first time, simulating ATR through the multi-agent debate (MAD) of large language models (LLMs) and suggesting that collective reasoning may be universally favourable over individualist reasoning, rather than a quirk in biology or evolution.

2605.30365.tldr: This work proposes a dual-layer caption poisoning strategy that preserves high-level retrieval anchors while injecting low-level acoustic descriptors to steer prompt augmentation and downstream music generation toward an attacker-chosen target intent.

2605.30361.tldr: This work presents a method for training SNNs using EGGROLL, a low-rank factorisation of ES perturbations that reduces per-generation memory from $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ to $\mathcal{O}(r(m{+}n))$.

2605.30288.tldr: MIRA, a source-aware filtering framework based on self-anchored rubric discovery, is proposed, to make rubric construction part of data selection: MIRA first discovers what should be evaluated for each source group, then distills those judgments into scalable student scorers for full-corpus filtering.

2605.30387.tldr: Dual-Spectral Flow Matching (DSFM) is proposed, a novel fMRI generative framework that cascades dual frequency representation of BOLD signals with spectral flow matching and demonstrates the efficacy of the approach through improved downstream fMRI-based brain network classification.

2605.30381.tldr: A multi-model paradigm in which honest and deceptive variants of five transformer models are fine-tuned using LoRA, demonstrating that robust, domain-invariant dishonesty representations can be rapidly entrenched via modest supervised fine-tuning, with implications for activation-based monitoring.

2605.30370.tldr: It is demonstrated how, simply by using a more realistic neural unit element without augmenting the number of parameters, the resulting ANNs offer a number of important advantages that include increases in expressivity, robustness and learning speed, and a reduction in memorization and the amount of training data needed.

2605.30368.tldr: The findings of this study indicate that spiking dynamics may serve as a mechanism to facilitate the convergence of objective SSMs with subjective human safety perception.

2605.30120.tldr: This paper proposes Single-stage Sparse Retrieval (SSR), a paradigm shift that replaces expensive clustering with efficient sparse coding, and utilizes Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) to project token embeddings into a high-dimensional but highly sparse representation.

2605.25773.tldr: It is found that existing efficient benchmarking methods can be greatly improved by simply using kernel ridge regression at the prediction stage, and an information-theoretic feature-selection algorithm called minimum redundancy maximum relevance (mRMR) can further improve upon these methods by selecting question subsets that will be maximally useful for prediction.

2605.25842.tldr: MuCRASP is proposed, a structured pruning framework that targets reasoning-critical components while preserving cross-modal alignment and accounting for layer-wise sensitivity under a global parameter budget, and maintains high reasoning consistency up to 50% pruning.

2605.20873.tldr: This work uses PlanningBench, a framework for generating scalable, diverse, and verifiable planning data for both evaluation and training, to evaluate open-source and closed-source frontier LLMs, and finds that current models still struggle to produce complete solutions under coupled constraints.

2605.30415.tldr: The results suggest that domain adaptation may primarily reshape the linguistic frameworks from which continuations are generated, with changes in stance emerging secondarily from those shifts.

2605.30385.tldr: The purpose of this article is to provide validation to my deep neural network alternative in the context of LLMs, which does not need DNN as it finds the global optimum of the loss function in closed form, in one iteration, thus eliminating the tedious training step.

2605.30364.tldr: The results indicate that embedding physics-informed structural priors into attention mechanisms is an effective approach to large-scale transmitter identification on raw wireless signals, with the phase increment embedding providing the single largest per-component improvement.

2605.28918.tldr: This audit finds two dominant one-shot failure modes -- reward flooding and semantic/API misunderstanding -- plus a rarer weak-shaping case and proposes diagnostic-driven iterative refinement, where training diagnostics and a failure-mode taxonomy guide targeted reward-function revision.

2605.26942.tldr: Evaluation shows hallucination detection rates of over 83% for structured entities and 72% for semantic fabrications, with a 30% reduction in report creation time, demonstrating that neuro-symbolic architectures can provide principled safeguards for LLM deployment in data-sensitive domains.

2605.30039.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework, DOMINO, that learns a minimal sufficient domain representation from reference samples and leverages it to guide the generation of domain-aligned synthetic data, enabling practical and scalable domain adaptation without manual prompt design or natural language domain specifications.

2605.21108.tldr: PVMC is proposed, a new training method that bridges paradigms and robustly trains DSSMs for both discriminative and generative tasks and matches or exceeds state-of-the-art performance.

2605.30407.tldr: This study formalizes Autonomous Agentic Data Engineering, a novel task designed to evaluate LLMs as autonomous data engineers that drive model specialization through end-to-end data curation, and charts a path toward agent-driven model specialization.

2605.30394.tldr: Evaluation of nine LLMs on Python and C++ tasks demonstrates that reasoning models significantly outperform non-reasoning models, achieving best average percentile of 70.97% in C++, highlighting reasoning's importance for languages with strict syntax requirements.

2605.29833.tldr: OmniMatBench provides crucial insights into the capabilities and limitations of current MLLMs and establishes a foundation for reliable AI assistants in materials-science research.

2605.29796.tldr: This work proposes SAAS, a novel RL framework designed to cultivate dynamic self-awareness that precisely regulates search behavior without compromising accuracy, and demonstrates that SAAS substantially reduces over-search, while maintaining accuracy.

2605.27255.tldr: PIPO trains a lightweight confidence head that decides whether draft tokens should be accepted, and observes that On-Policy Distillation naturally matches the rejection-sampling criterion of speculative decoding, so the confidence head can be trained alongside OPD with negligible extra cost.

2605.30155.tldr: This paper presents a middle-ground approach featuring partial multi-neuron relaxation, in which multi-neuron bounds are generated for only a small, heuristically selected subset of neurons for neural network verification.

2605.30512.tldr: Evaluated on a benchmark of 1,449 problems spanning mechanics, optics, and electromagnetism, PhyDrawGen significantly outperforms GPT-5-image, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Gemini 3 Pro, demonstrating robust physical accuracy even on unusual-object problems.

2605.30461.tldr: This work shows that lightweight neighbor-to-neighbor consensus over Lagrange multipliers suffices for globally coordinated constraint enforcement while preserving the scalability of independent training, and proves that under mild connectivity assumptions, the consensus error among agents'multipliers is bounded.

2605.30686.tldr: The results establish injection depth as the dominant variable and show that sanitising only the first tool observation captures 67% of measured injection successes.

2605.30677.tldr: Defensive tactics for detecting the presences of prompt injection strings in the decompiler output of adversarial example programs are demonstrated and methods for obfuscating these attacks are explored.

2605.30589.tldr: The fine-tuned ImmigrationQA model shows concentrated improvement in procedural subdomains (travel documents, adjustment of status, nonimmigrant visas) while remaining weak on complex legal reasoning and time-sensitive statistics.

2605.30585.tldr: Five major approaches for constructing prediction intervals as a means of capturing the uncertainty in neural network predictions of turbine gas temperature are investigated, providing a practical guide for selecting and tuning prediction interval methods in engine health management and prognostics, ensuring both interpretability and precision in real-world applications.

2605.30576.tldr: This work proposes an uncertainty-aware framework that leverages expert advice to guide exploration while avoiding long-term dependence, and demonstrates that risk-sensitive uncertainty coupled with regulated expert integration enables safer and more efficient exploration for sensor-based RL policy learning in unsignalized intersection navigation.

2605.30529.tldr: An open recipe for building domain-specific medical retrievers from LLM-generated data is built and a characterisation of where gains concentrate by language and rank is characterised.

2605.30486.tldr: GC-MoE is proposed, a graph-conditioned mixture of experts framework that assigns each node a personalized combination of frozen forecasting experts based on graph topology and the recent traffic input window, and improves MAE over a zero-parameter ensemble baseline.

2605.30462.tldr: This work introduces a white-box semantic fingerprinting approach based on semantic correlation descriptors (SCDs), which capture the semantic correlation structure learned by a model and make it comparable across dataset mixtures, and proposes a practical SCD-based membership score.

2605.30447.tldr: It is found that calibration correlates strongly but not perfectly with benchmark accuracy, suggesting it captures a meaningful quality dimension beyond top-1 accuracy, and motivates future work on understanding the downstream effects of miscalibration and developing methods to correct it.

2605.30646.tldr: A semantic verification framework based on Natural Language Inference is proposed to filter meaning-preserving prompt variations to filter meaning-preserving prompt variations, which is further refined using an LLM-as-a-judge and audited by a clinical expert.

2605.30639.tldr: This work formalizes AIV as a finite-horizon decision process and introduces PInVerify, an offline embodied benchmark for AIV, a task in which an agent actively selects viewpoints around a candidate object to decide whether it matches a fine-grained natural-language description.

2605.30628.tldr: The framework relocates rather than dissolves long-context difficulty: where the number of hard decisions itself grows with task length, reliability remains hard; the contribution is to identify the on-axis intervention rather than to make those regimes easy.

2605.30611.tldr: Crafter is instantiated, a multi-agent harness for figure generation that generalizes across figure types and input conditions without architectural changes, and CraftEditor, which applies the same pattern to convert raster outputs into editable SVGs, are introduced.

2605.30604.tldr: This paper proposes an organization-scoped LLM agent runtime architecture for financial cybersecurity, describing an implementable slice as the architecture's testability surface, and proposing a falsifiable evaluation plan with metric-level pass criteria for architecture readiness, security-policy enforcement, evidence traceability, output quality, and operational observability.

2605.30570.tldr: This work considers two well-known map representations and introduces two novel representations that improve the characterization of FPS maps that can generate maps with higher diversity and quality than the representations previously used for evolving FPS maps.

2605.30561.tldr: This work proposes VLM3, a scalable method with the simplest design that enables standard VLMs to master diverse 3D tasks, matching expert vision model accuracy while maintaining standard architectures and text-based training.

2605.30523.tldr: It is proved that polynomially padded constant-precision transformers are equivalent to $\text{L-uniform AC}^0$ while growing-precision ones achieve $\text{L-uniform TC}^0$ regardless of width, and looping enables sequential processing analogous to circuits.

2605.30510.tldr: The Global Context-aware Squeeze and Excite Residual UNet (GCSER-UNet) is introduced, which facilitates a fusion of spatial and channel-wise attention and thus enhances the model's capacity to capture intricate spatial dependencies and contextual information.

2605.30509.tldr: Improved bounds for estimating discrete probability distributions under the $\ell_\infty$ norm are presented, including minimax bounds in expectation and high-probability tail bounds and a fully empirical version of the tightest risk bound presented.

2605.30454.tldr: Tool-augmented LLM agents are vulnerable to prompt injection: a third party who controls part of the agent's context can plant instructions that the agent then executes as if they came from the user, so both attack and defense evaluation must report per-surface vulnerability.

2605.30452.tldr: This work develops a unifying framework for gradient aggregation in MOO, establishing (optimal) rates of convergence to Pareto stationarity, the standard measure of performance in MOO, and presents a primal optimization perspective of gradient aggregation that encompasses established algorithms, clarifies their theoretical relationships, and enables the design of new variants.

2605.30434.tldr: LongDS is introduced, a benchmark for long-horizon, multi-turn data analysis where agents must maintain, update, restore, and compose evolving analytical states, suggesting that the key bottleneck is maintaining a correct analytical state rather than increasing interaction budget.

2605.30680.tldr: This work recast hospital mechanism design as program synthesis for language models and synthesizes an inspectable mixed-objective program that eliminates up-coding, halves rejection, and retains most of the profit-oriented baseline's funds.

2605.30668.tldr: CobSeg is proposed, a novel multi-branch architecture that separates coherence-level semantic continuity from lexical boundary transitions and recovers both through directional boundary prediction and incorporates a corpus-derived topic coherence cue with learned combination weights.

2605.30667.tldr: This paper presents an adversarial technique using genetic algorithm-based prompt generation, a modification of an adversarial attack known as AutoDAN, to demonstrate the ability to deceive LLM-powered disassembly and decompilation systems into misinterpreting binary executables, effectively corrupting their analytical output.

2605.30664.tldr: This work proposes three rerooter designs: a clustering-based rerooter that exploits global state-space structure, a heuristic-based rerooter that leverages learned cost-to-go estimates, and a hybrid that combines both signals.

2605.30651.tldr: LARK is a learnability-grounded method for reasoning trajectory selection that combines a learnability proxy and a regularized selection policy that balances learnability and distributional coverage, both with strong theoretical guarantees on their estimation error.

2605.30637.tldr: EHRBench is introduced, an automated and reliable EHR-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLM-based clinical decision-making at scale and shows consistent capability trends across settings, further validating the reliability of EHRBench and highlighting actionable gaps toward clinically reliable LLM systems.

2605.30625.tldr: This work introduces a framework which extends active experimentation to the space of measures by leveraging Linearized Optimal Transport (LOT), and yields an acquisition policy that iteratively selects measurement times to minimize uncertainty.

2605.30590.tldr: The Causal Sensitivity Score (CSS), a pre-registered interventional metric that mutates oncology tumor-board cases along five clinically meaningful dimensions - biomarker flips, prior-treatment failures, biomarker removals, surgery-status changes, and stage perturbations - is introduced and reveals a universal safety blind spot.

2605.30571.tldr: Physical-AI decode is memory-dominated, but faster memory does not translate into proportional latency gains, which isolates a launch-side overhead that becomes visible on fast GPUs but remains mostly hidden on slower, bandwidth-bound GPUs.

2605.30557.tldr: This work constructs a controlled evaluation framework, SpatialUncertain, and introduces two types of observation challenges, occlusion, which hides target information, and perspective ambiguity, which produces misleading visual cues, and designs spatial questions that are answerable under clean observations but require abstention under the introduced challenges.

2605.30698.tldr: This work proposes EAGLE (EAGLE), a training-free evidence-centered framework for coordinating multiple VLM agents that explicitly exposes each agent's grounding regions as visual evidence, enables mutual verification over the evidence, and uses evidence consistency to guide final decision-making.

2605.30685.tldr: Using a large-scale dataset of anonymized, de-identified, and privacy-scrubbed interactions with a widely available and free AI chatbot, empirically characterize differences in early adopters' usage across countries.

2605.30711.tldr: SAGE is proposed, a Spherical Adaptive Gate for memory Evolution that scores candidate facts with a von Mises-Fisher-based density estimator over memory embeddings and routes them with an adaptive threshold that tracks memory-store geometry, suggesting that novelty-aware write control is a practical lever for improving both memory quality and system efficiency in long-term agentic memory.

2605.30632.tldr: Rationalize, a role-pair framework for shared semantic reasoning between humans and AI models in data-driven sensemaking, is introduced, illustrating how aligning AI to humans and"aligning humans to AI"differ by role.

2605.30631.tldr: A controllable latent diffusion model is proposed that synthesizes pulmonary nodules within full 3D CT volumes while accurately modeling nodule-specific intensity distributions, and introduces a histogram-based regularization term that constrains voxel intensity distributions during the generative process.

2605.30581.tldr: This review argues against a single cross-task leaderboard and instead asks what prior grounds the deployment decision, which connects CAD-based detection and 6D pose-estimation literature with industrial anomaly and surface-inspection literature that is usually reviewed separately.

2605.30689.tldr: This work proposes a novel multi-scale encoder architecture that integrates convolutional (Conv) inductive biases with transformer Self-attention to jointly capture fine-grained local dependencies and long-range global context, leading to more comprehensive feature representations than existing methods.

2605.30675.tldr: This work investigates the presence and strength of human-similar uncertainty signals, deemed uncertainty alignment, in large language model overt behavior and internal activation patterns and describes the effect of instruct fine-tuning on each of these facets.

2605.30641.tldr: COFT (Chain of Fair Thought), a training-free decoding method that applies token-level fairness control at decode time, with distribution-free marginal validity guarantees (under exchangeability) for any frozen causal language model, is presented.

2605.30638.tldr: This work identifies the loss score as the signal to broadcast, supplies the orthogonality theory and theoretical grounding for the three-factor learning rule from neuroscience, and shows how score vector expansion enriches the decorrelation directions of the resulting objective.

2605.30621.tldr: Investing capability budget in the task-solving agent rather than the evolver is suggested, and targeting harness invocation and long-horizon instruction following in agent training is suggested.

2605.30619.tldr: A recent analysis of preference data via its induced conditional distribution to Best-of-$N derives closed-form reward targets as explicit functions of $N$ and the base distribution, and shows that they preserve the latent reward ranking.

2605.30593.tldr: A multi-task scientific machine learning framework for turbine prognostics that jointly predicts turbine gas temperature untrimmed (TGTU), Delta Turbine Gas Temperature (DTGT), and RUL, with quantified uncertainty in the form of prediction intervals whose empirical coverage is evaluated.

2605.30563.tldr: This work proposes several ways to encode factored tasks in SAT, focusing on different strategies for translating the factored transition relation into propositional logic, and analyzed how to exploit parallelism at various levels in this setting.

2605.30542.tldr: It is argued that embodied AI requires world models that identify the simplest physical abstraction sufficient to answer an intervention query, and the right abstraction is not the most detailed model of the world, but the simplest model that preserves the distinctions relevant to the query.

2605.30654.tldr: The Social AI Design Code is introduced, a framework for evaluating whether LLMs align with user welfare in social interactions, including whether they encourage harmful intimacy, dependence, or prolonged engagement in natural and diverse user-LLM interactions.

2605.31023.tldr: This work proposes a novel transformer-based architecture tailored for heterogeneous satellite cluster autonomous EO Mission with relational observations-actions tokenization and differential attention mechanism that exhibits strong adaptability and transferability with respect to varying numbers of satellite clusters.

2605.31021.tldr: This study introduces a state-space constrained emulation framework for AI evaluation that replaces singular assessment functions with a structured manifold of synthetic cognitive profiles representing diverse human perspectives, and argues for the necessity of embedding dynamic, viability-driven regulatory mechanisms within generative systems to preserve coherent cognitive emulation.

2605.30965.tldr: This work proposes ImmersiveTTS, an environment-aware text-to-speech model that generates natural speech seamlessly integrated within environmental contexts by explicitly modeling cross-modal interactions and introduces a domain-specific representation alignment objective tailored to environment-aware TTS.

2605.30911.tldr: This study provides the first systematic exploration linking architecture-level design to hallucination robustness, offering practical guidance for developing reliable and efficient LVLMs.

2605.30880.tldr: PatchWorld is introduced, a gradient-free framework that turns offline trajectories into executable Python world models through counterexample-guided code repair and reveals a tradeoff in executable world models, since improving observation fidelity can come at the expense of action-discriminative dynamics, and vice versa.

2605.30859.tldr: This work characterize the long-tail distribution at a finer granularity, identifying intra-prompt long tails, and revealing that they frequently consist of ineffective verbosity, thereby fundamentally resolving tail-induced overheads.

2605.30808.tldr: This work proposes DPPrefSyn, a novel algorithm for generating differentially private (DP) synthetic preference data to enable privacy-preserving preference alignment, and is the first work to generate DP synthetic preference data for LLM alignment.

2605.30802.tldr: This work compares independent aggregation and deliberative consensus against single-LLM baselines and proposes routing criteria for hybrid AI-human oracle systems: auto-resolving only unanimous, high-confidence questions yields 97.87 percent accuracy, with inter-agent disagreement flagging the remainder for human review.

2605.30789.tldr: It is uncovered that smaller models within the same model family inherently exhibit higher policy-level diversity, indicated by their superior pass@k relative to larger counterparts as sample counts increase, and proposed S2L-PO (Small-to-Large Policy Optimization), a framework that leverages fixed small models as natural explorers to train larger models.

2605.30788.tldr: This work introduces a set of synthetic algorithmic tasks to detect cross-lingual gaps in the abilities of large language models and shows through extensive experiments that this benchmark exposes persistent cross-lingual gaps in multiple state-of-the-art models.

2605.30736.tldr: OrcaRouter is presented, a production-oriented LLM router that combines a LinUCB-based contextual bandit over lexical and sentence-embedding features with a hybrid offline-online learning protocol with a hybrid offline-online learning protocol.

2605.30792.tldr: It is shown that systems with strong translation quality can still differ substantially in speech quality, as well as in temporal quality, and OpenSTBench provides a reproducible protocol for analyzing these cross-dimensional differences and supporting application-oriented comparison of speech translation systems.

2605.30930.tldr: The TUX Index is operationalized as a pairwise measure of similarity between human and agent judgments, and it is found that nearest human--agent pairs in trait space achieve significantly higher TUX, suggesting that tacit alignment is structured by person-level characteristics rather than random similarity.

2605.30913.tldr: It is found that toxic lexical perturbations consistently reduce factual accuracy and increase uncertainty, while polite phrasing yields limited and inconsistent changes, and increasing toxicity selectively amplifies perturbation-sensitive variant nodes while relatively stable core reasoning nodes remain more invariant.

2605.30907.tldr: BlueFin is presented, a benchmark that tasks large language model (LLM) agents with synthesis, manipulation, and comprehension tasks over spreadsheet workbooks in the professional finance domain and features a set of 131 challenging, complex tasks with real-world relevance in the domain.

2605.30900.tldr: BilliardPhys-Bench is presented, a benchmark for physical reasoning in synthetic billiards environments and a consistent failure mode the authors call "stasis bias": when the correct physical outcome is harder to infer, models tend to predict no interaction.

2605.30833.tldr: Building on the insight that next-step teacher confidence reflects the discriminative strength of future reverse-KL supervision, this work evaluates the student's top-K candidate tokens by the teacher confidence they induce at the subsequent step and assigns a group-normalized reward.

2605.30826.tldr: This work introduces a candidate-level panel-output benchmark for panel-surfaced candidate verification, where the unit is an aligned candidate surfaced by an explicitly defined multi-model panel rather than a standalone extractor output.

2605.30825.tldr: A principled constrained optimization framework is proposed that formulates unlearning as minimizing the deviation from a pretrained model, subject to explicit separation constraints from the unlearning distributions, based on reverse and forward KL divergences, and likelihood constraints.

2605.30803.tldr: PReMISE is the only rubric source to score non-trivially on applicability, specificity, and effective dimensionality simultaneously, and is the only rubric source to score non-trivially on applicability, specificity, and effective dimensionality simultaneously.

2605.30984.tldr: Across state-of-the-art 3D CT report generation baselines, CLarGen mitigates Template Collapse and substantially improves clinical accuracy while maintaining fluent reporting, suggesting that explicit, measurable clinical grounding is essential for template-collapse-resistant 3D CT report generation.

2605.30966.tldr: The claim network is proposed: a representational pattern in which each cross-document reference is reified as a typed claim, carrying source, target, claim text, and a four-class stance label grounded in the citation-intent literature.

2605.30963.tldr: AMix-2 is presented, a protein-text foundation model that establishes protein as a native modality in large language models (LLMs), unifying protein understanding and sequence design within a single foundation model that outperforms frontier LLMs and demonstrates competitive performance to task-specific protein models.

2605.30834.tldr: This paper proposes Hide-and-Seek, a framework that formulates VLA failure detection as a coarsely supervised learning problem that achieves state-of-the-art multi-task failure detection performance with a practical accuracy--timeliness trade-off under conformal prediction, and generalizes well to both seen and unseen tasks.

2605.30861.tldr: Evaluating the method for Lean4 theorem-proving, it is found that Feedback Distillation maintains greater diversity in generated trajectories than GRPO, yielding higher policy entropy and better pass@k scaling.

2605.30919.tldr: This paper proposes the first LLM unlearning framework based on data attribution rewards called DareU that performs reinforcement learning to update the LLM by reducing the attribution score of its generated responses (i.e., de-attributing) to the forget data owners.

2605.30903.tldr: The theoretical analysis shows that the joint feasible set shrinks monotonically as data are added, and the exact characterization of when a new demonstrator strictly tightens it is given, and two recovery guarantees are established for the feasible reward set of the ground-truth optimal demonstrator.

2605.30832.tldr: A theoretical characterization of segment suboptimality under the correctness-length trade-off objective is derived and an RL framework that selectively suppresses redundant segments based on this criterion is proposed, establishing a superior accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier.

2605.30824.tldr: DecomposeR, a planner-centric deep research framework that represents research plans as typed directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), allowing planning to be made explicit, structured, and rewardable, is proposed.

2605.30818.tldr: GaMi, a multimodal material identification system integrating mmWave and acoustic sensing to robustly operate under unconstrained geometric conditions is presented, leveraging the insight of shared geometric consistency between co-located bimodal sensors to employ an intra-sample cross-modal subtractive disentanglement framework.

2605.30747.tldr: GRiD, a framework that reformulates graph-like rule discovery as a discrete generative process conditioned on the target relation, is proposed and Experiments on six benchmark datasets show that GRiD achieves competitive performance on KG completion tasks.

2605.30716.tldr: Overall, this work provides a strong, reproducible baseline for efficient pathology report generation, lowering the barrier to multi-WSI VLM research under limited compute.

2605.30785.tldr: AdaCoM is introduced, which trains an external LLM to manage the context of a frozen agent through flexible modification actions and end-to-end reinforcement learning, and reveals a Fidelity-Reliability Trade-off: agents with higher vanilla ReAct performance benefit from higher-fidelity context preservation, whereas lower-performing agents require more aggressive compression to stay within a reliable reasoning regime.

2605.30719.tldr: PromptPO, an iterative method that prompts an LLM with Python descriptions of the state space, action space, and reward function, then has it generate and refine executable policies based on rollout feedback, demonstrates that LLM-based policy optimization is sufficient when the LLM can leverage prior knowledge about the environment or optimization strategy.

2605.30898.tldr: UIS is introduced, an online framework that models adaptive UIS as a contextual multi-armed bandit problem and learns inference policies via LinUCB and effectively exploits the synergy in the UIS space to deliver a fine-grained and consistently better quality-cost trade-off across diverse, dynamic inference scenarios.

2605.30873.tldr: Federated Variational Preference Alignment with Gumbel-Softmax Prior with Orthogonal Loss is proposed, a framework designed to disentangle diverse preferences without compromising privacy and significantly outperforms monolithic baselines.

2605.30854.tldr: Safe Equilibrium Policy Optimization is proposed, a training objective that augments expected payoff with explicit penalties for exploitability, collusion risk, and externality cost and outperforms the base model on safety in four domains, and corrects the over-cooperative behavior introduced by SFT.

2605.30838.tldr: Comparing COMPASS, a Cognitive MCTS-Guided Process Alignment framework designed to achieve robust safety alignment throughout the agent workflow while preserving general utility, achieves a favorable safety-utility trade-off while requiring substantially less training data.

2605.30794.tldr: The first comprehensive mechanical drawing understanding dataset, MechVQA, is introduced and the MechVL model is developed through a multi-stage training paradigm, building a strong domain-specialized baseline and significantly enhancing mechanical drawing understanding ability.

2605.30740.tldr: Experiments show that GSAM reduces standard deviation by 3.1% and improves manipulation success rate by 36.0% compared to the best baseline, respectively demonstrating the superior object generalization and interaction safety of GSAM in practical scenarios.

2605.30738.tldr: MAVEN (Modular Agentic Verification and Execution Network), a lightweight symbolic reasoning scaffold for structured decomposition, adaptive tool orchestration, and intermediate verification, is presented, suggesting that lightweight verification-centered scaffolds can strengthen compositional reasoning and motivate more process-aware evaluation of agents in the wild.

2605.31007.tldr: The Distilled Explanation Model (DEM) is proposed, a three-stage glass-box framework that distills the non-linear knowledge of a gradient boosting expert into an interpretable decision tree operating on residuals relative to a linear baseline, so that the explanation is not an approximation but the prediction itself.

2605.30968.tldr: This approach reformulates image-text matching with fine-grained semantic scarcity as a variational inference problem and constructs a latent space for cross-modal similarity and uses regularization techniques to mitigate overfitting to binary annotations.

2605.30899.tldr: SURE is a unified experimentation framework that standardizes prediction formats, normalization, and scoring, and improves comparability and reproducibility for deployment-oriented evaluation and introduces an agent-assisted training conversion flow.

2605.30862.tldr: It is argued that curbing over-exploration is key to the effective use of these API surfaces, and Sophrosyne, a data system environment that augments API responses with directives that guide the agent's exploration process is proposed.

2605.30844.tldr: Canopy Entropy is proposed, a measure that views language generation from a tree perspective, where ``canopy''represents the space of all possible rollouts, making $\mathrm{CE}^\star$ naturally quantify the effective size of the generation space.

2605.30790.tldr: It is found that answer retention is the primary determinant of generator accuracy; notably, when retention is high, a representation's wording, structure, length, and query-dependence have limited effect.

2605.31251.tldr: It is observed that geo-localization is strongly correlated with the other capability dimensions, suggesting that accurate localization depends on integrated perception, spatial reasoning, and commonsense inference rather than isolated visual recognition.

2605.31250.tldr: The Entropic Projection Alignment method, Entropic Projection Alignment (EPA), aligns the source distribution to the target by matching carefully selected moments while simultaneously minimising the KL divergence from the source.

2605.31228.tldr: EchoRL is a lightweight module that first identifies an EchoClip from verified-success rollouts based on their step-level entropy values, and then feeds this clip back as an auxiliary supervision signal in the RL objective, demonstrating that EchoRL consistently improves RLVR post-training with minimal overhead.

2605.31226.tldr: Nearly 70 ODL works are surveyed under one principle: the distribution change regime, which analyzes how different types of distribution change influence the applications addressable on-device, the hardware employed, and the structure of the solutions.

2605.31210.tldr: A novel data-driven crowd simulation model that incorporates the pedestrian collision mechanism into the loss function to reduce collisions is established, based on a Generative Adversarial Network architecture and termed CPGAN (Collision-Penalized GAN).

2605.31196.tldr: This work introduces TouchSafeBench, a physics-grounded benchmark for evaluating collision grounding in vision-language models (VLMs), and reveals a central limitation of embodied VLMs: visual fluency does not imply physical accountability.

2605.31143.tldr: This work formalises an AI-Augmented PoV Pyramid, a structured prompt architecture for synthesis and hypothesis generation, and an AI-enabled Playbook Card system that embeds Generative AI into UXR workflows while preserving traceability and ethical oversight.

2605.31131.tldr: A Generative AI-augmented UXR methodology, grounded in the UXR Point of View (PoV) Playbook, to support the design of emotionally intelligent and Neuroinclusive digital ER interventions for adults with ADHD.

2605.31090.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach for mislabeled data detection that leverages training dynamics and introduces a signed entropy integral (SEI) statistic that captures both the magnitude and temporal trend of prediction entropy across training epochs.

2605.31041.tldr: A structured multi-level visual perturbation framework is introduced to analyze visual-behavior dependency in VLA-based driving models systematically and reveals evaluation-dependent dependency patterns and uneven visual grounding across abstraction levels.

2605.31229.tldr: This work proposes Dynamic Adapter Routing (DAR), a novel approach based on adapters selected through prototype-based routing and combined via model merging that achieves superior performance over the previous baselines and demonstrates strong generalization under out-of-distribution evaluation.

2605.31173.tldr: MindVoice is introduced, a neuro-to-speech reconstruction framework that uses pretrained models to compensate for the incomplete semantic and acoustic information in neural recordings and substantially outperforms existing methods on various metrics.

2605.31148.tldr: This work introduces SpatialAct, a simulator-grounded benchmark for probing action-conditioned spatial reasoning in 3D scenes and designs its decomposed counterpart, Single-step Error Detection and Fix, together with five fundamental spatial ability tasks to diagnose the underlying causes of model failures.

2605.31147.tldr: An exemplar case study is presented demonstrating how a culturally grounded, AI-augmented UXR POV was developed to inform TeleDeCa, a telemedicine dementia care framework for family caregivers in Nigeria.

2605.31146.tldr: Findings show that effective wellbeing systems for EPSP must minimise cognitive effort, adapt to operational context, and prioritise psychological safety, demonstrating how AI can assist large-scale evidence interpretation while human researchers maintain responsibility for contextual judgement and design direction.

2605.31120.tldr: SWIM is a new imitation method for swimming motions, which can learn from a single swimming motion and generalize to unseen environments, body conditions, and swimming styles, outperforming alternative methods across multiple classes of tasks and metrics.

2605.31094.tldr: It is shown that the Panoptic Quality framework extends naturally to part-aware panoptic segmentation, and the framework explores part-aware evaluation on biomedical data and how different combinations of thresholds and matching strategies behave in practice.

2605.31080.tldr: A parallel BLV-oriented caption corpus is constructed from artwork images and metadata, and language-specific adapters show more stable controllability and visually grounded description quality for Romanian and Serbian, while multilingual adaptation remains competitive in German.

2605.31051.tldr: A novel benchmark suite derived from up-to-date real-world economic data and an algorithmic scheme that leverages state-of-the-art LOP metaheuristics to generate diverse sets of high-quality solutions, together with metrics for assessing both quality and diversity are introduced.

2605.31239.tldr: This work introduces a principled alternative based on anytime-valid inference for anytime-valid control of false splits under arbitrary data streams, including non-stationary settings, and improves performance while producing substantially smaller trees.

2605.31171.tldr: This work proposes MIMO: Multilingual Information Retrieval via Monolingual Objectives, a two-stage framework that uses a stable English semantic space from a high-performing teacher model as an anchor and jointly optimizes distillation and cross-lingual contrastive learning to improve retrieval discrimination while preserving alignment.

2605.31164.tldr: A Dynamic Directional graph-constrained Data scheduling framework that formulates the complex interactions among train-units as a dynamic influence graph and solves a constrained optimization problem over this graph to derive the training order, which ensures that the data sequence respects the evolving information flow throughout training.

2605.31149.tldr: By embedding cognitive accessibility principles into measurable and technically traceable requirements, the proposed Cognitive Accessibility UXR Playbook provides a structured pathway for aligning theory, system architecture, and stakeholder strategy.

2605.31145.tldr: This work introduces a two-stage training framework that explicitly optimizes in-context attention between support bounding boxes and query images without category supervision, and further refine localization via reinforcement learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to directly minimize localization error.

2605.31142.tldr: A meta-study of multilingual model performance robustness in MTEB is presented, applying a diverse set of multi-criteria decision-making ranking schemes and introducing two robustness indicators: dataset-composition robustness and ranking-scheme robustness, to enable systematic sensitivity analysis of whether benchmarking conclusions remain stable under different evaluation designs.

2605.31126.tldr: The results suggest that prompt-free self-training works by amplifying what the student already knows, not by importing structure from the data, and reveal a regime in which capability and verbatim memorization can be separated without any explicit unlearning objective.

2605.31100.tldr: This work proposes an iterative, reference-based geometric embedding hashing that recovers vector links from a tiny seed set of paired anchors that represents each vector by distances to sampled paired anchors, proposes candidate links via hash-space matching, and aggregates evidence across views in a Beta-Bernoulli posterior to bootstrap high-confidence links as new anchors.

2605.31099.tldr: This work introduces KnowledgeGain, a metric that evaluates the quality of science news by measuring how much knowledge readers gained after reading it, and shows that the metric successfully captures the differential knowledge gained by human readers reading different types of science media.

2605.31064.tldr: This work pioneer a data-centric paradigm and proposes a novel framework, the Data-centric Reasoning Compiler (DCRC), which ensures faithful numerical reasoning by design and is validated through deployment in a real-world online financial QA system.

2605.31053.tldr: AnchorSteer is proposed, a framework that disentangles tension by coupling structural anchoring with self-discovered semantic steering, enabling significant semantic transformations with high-fidelity structural preservation in controlable music editing.

2605.31034.tldr: It is proved that annealed softmax greedy achieves Bayes regret $\tilde{O}(m + T/m)$, and in particular $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ when the number of arms scales as $m = \Theta(\sqrt{T})$.

2605.31031.tldr: GraphARC is introduced, a benchmark for abstract reasoning on graph-structured data that combines aspects of node classification, link prediction, and graph generation within a single framework, and provides a promising testbed for future graph foundation models.

2605.31249.tldr: LVCG is introduced, the first general self-supervised representation learning framework designed to operate in this physically grounded latent space, and generally outperforms ECG-space baselines across tasks, demonstrating enhanced robustness and generalization, especially in domain shift settings.

2605.31212.tldr: E2V-Bench is constructed, a benchmark spanning four pedagogically grounded visual types, along with automatic metrics for evaluating visual correctness, and benchmark-guided enhancement strategies are explored that improve representative models and call for stronger numerical and relational grounding in future T2I models.

2605.31183.tldr: This work finds that Sparse Autoencoders can, in fact, perform close to on par with the reference LoRA performance on the AxBench benchmark, when features are selected and labelled with the supervised pipeline.

2605.31167.tldr: LLM-FACETS (LLM FActuality Cross-EvaluaTion System) is introduced: an open-source framework with a browser-accessible interface and a plugin architecture, structured around three practitioner profiles that mirror the stakeholder categories identified in the EU AI Act and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.

2605.31121.tldr: This work proposes a unified outdoor VLN framework that survives semantic-cue interruptions by maintaining traversability-consistent executable guidance throughout prolonged cue-free phases, and extracts semantic bearings from visibility-gated goal or exploration cues and grounds them into executable headings using a real-time near-field traversability profile.

2605.31061.tldr: A novel method for learning interpretable representations of progressive time series, that is, data capturing irreversible state transitions such as degradation or task completion, validating three key capabilities: end-state prediction, multi-step forecasting, and interpretable phase separation.

2605.31049.tldr: By introducing the tool CHECKMATE, this work shows that algorithm generation via code evolution represents a paradigm shift by eliminating the need to formulate the how, and underscores the potential of formal methods in guiding code evolution for automatically solving complex real-world problems.

2605.31042.tldr: DASGuard is proposed, which scans control-like text in sensitive local files, traces its origin, and removes control content that does not originate from a trusted source in order to address multi-step trojan attacks in local agentic harnesses.
