2605.31170.tldr: The results show that posts proposing new languages for avoiding oversight are judged by DeepSeek-3.2 as being less aligned than the other categories and that all languages can be learned by other language models in-context merely from a description of the language.

2605.31224.tldr: The findings suggest that the conversational agent can reduce interactional effort by supporting more direct access to information, while the dashboard remains valuable for overview and verification, however, these benefits may vary across tasks and require validation through larger-scale studies.

2605.31199.tldr: MAECO-Lite is proposed, a lightweight ontology designed to represent data and operationalize their processing for dynamic malware analysis that adopts a modular structure centered on samples, processes, actions, system artifacts, and MITRE ATT&CK Techniques, while maintaining a clear separation between enduring entities and runtime events.

2605.31159.tldr: Trust-Region behavior Blending is proposed, a warmup method that replaces the early rollout policy with the closest-to-teacher behavior policy inside a student-centered KL trust region, while keeping the per-prefix reverse-KL OPD loss unchanged.

2605.31138.tldr: This paper introduces a Generative AI-augmented UXR methodology, grounded in the UXR Point of View (PoV) Playbook, to guide the design of psychologically safe, low-cognitive-load digital health interventions for MSM and transgender individuals living with HIV/AIDS in Nigeria.

2605.31097.tldr: This work presents SpecDB, a system that uses large language models (LLMs) to synthesize customized relational databases and adopts the FODA feature model and extends it with a cooperate edge, yielding a dependency graph DBGraph.

2605.31065.tldr: This paper proposes an iterative joint channel estimation and prediction framework in the context of 6G NTNs that significantly reduces pilot overhead by transmitting pilots only in the initial slot and relying on data-driven processing for subsequent slots, and introduces Data-driven Refinement and Iterative Forecast for wireless channel Tracking (DRIFT), a lightweight architecture that refines data-aided channel estimates and predicts future channel frequency responses with low computational cost and reduced error propagation.

2605.31340.tldr: An economic perspective by applying signaling theory to human-AI conversation is introduced by applying signaling theory to human-AI conversation and proposes Signal Cost Proxies mapped to affective, cognitive, and associative empathy.

2605.31278.tldr: GLIDE is introduced, an open-source Python library that unifies state-of-the-art PPI estimators and samplers and samplers under a scipy-style API specialized to mean estimation.

2605.31564.tldr: This work analyzes MDLM generation trajectories and proposes lambda-scaled structural decoding, a training-free inference-time modification that downweights structural token confidence and recovers +9.4 BLEU-4.

2605.31469.tldr: This paper introduces BEA-Dialogue+, an expanded version of the corpus that relaxes the split criterion for experimenters and dialogue partners while preserving complete separation of the primary speakers, and evaluates several Whisper- and FastConformer-based models on both corpus versions.

2605.31446.tldr: FiVeD, a framework for Fine-grained Verification with Diagnostic reasoning supervision, is proposed, where the verifier is trained with multiple complementary objectives, including validity classification and quality score estimation as primary tasks, with error type classification and rationale generation as auxiliary tasks.

2605.31432.tldr: Decoder-Only Attention is proposed, a training-free policy that enables long-form simultaneous translation with off-the-shelf SpeechLLMs by deriving a proxy alignment from self-attention, enabling low-latency long-form SimulST with quality close to offline decoding without retraining.

2605.31520.tldr: This work proposes a three-class classification framework that explicitly models placeholder or weak credentials as a distinct class, leveraging CodeBERT-based semantic understanding combined with character-level pattern recognition, and improves placeholder or weak credential detection from 54% to 81% F1-score while maintaining strong cross language generalization.

2605.31556.tldr: LALS (Latent Association Leaning Score), a zero-shot metric that projects visual-token activations into the model's text-embedding space to measure concept associations per token and layer, is introduced.

2605.31535.tldr: RayDer, a unified, feed-forward transformer that consolidates camera estimation, scene reconstruction, and rendering into a single backbone, turning self-supervised NVS into a well-posed single-model scaling problem, exhibits clean power-law scaling with data and compute, and outperforms static-scene data mixtures.

2605.31500.tldr: This work takes an I/O- and arithmetic-intensity--centric view and shows that widely used layers fall into three kernel families: SpMM-based convolutions, reduction-based aggregations, and attention-based layers (GATv2/Graph Transformer).

2605.31468.tldr: This work presents AutoSci, a memory-centric agentic system for the full scientific research lifecycle, organized around four modules that make AutoSci a persistent research environment that can execute, remember, and evolve across research projects.

2605.31463.tldr: PithTrain is built, a compact, agent-native MoE training framework that matches the throughput of production frameworks, and on ATE-Bench, PithTrain enables higher agent-task efficiency, with up to 62% fewer Agent Turns and 64% less Active GPU Time.

2605.31421.tldr: This paper focuses on a complex algorithm, Cocke-Youger-Kasami (CYK) for parsing context-free grammars in Chomsky Normal Form and proposes CYKNN, a simple recurrent neural network architecture for encoding the CYK algorithm in trainable matrix-vector multiplications.

2605.31286.tldr: DeMaVLA is a VLA foundation model for generalizable Deformable Manipulation that adopts a VLM backbone with an action expert and formulates continuous action generation using flow matching, and achieves competitive performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and strong real-world results on the authors' household folding benchmark.

2605.31284.tldr: This work simulates realistic mitochondria data and emulate the optical properties of fluorescence microscopes to create a large-scale annotated dataset, and proposes a scalable solution to data scarcity by finetuning SAM exclusively on synthetically generated FM data.

2605.31266.tldr: A representation-driven framework that disentangles semantics from primitives for robust few-shot adaptation of layout-to-image methods and regulates optimization with a saliency-aware objective to preserve foreground semantic consistency is proposed.

2605.31261.tldr: A theoretical justification for their empirical effectiveness is provided by constructing and studying two linear filters and it is shown that the constructed linear filter serves as a strong feature extractor in a small reinforcement learning game.

2605.31354.tldr: CoSee is introduced, an auditing framework that formalizes the read-write-verify loop to trace information flow in document visual question answering, providing trace-level diagnostics and a mechanistic baseline for reliable modular design.

2605.31275.tldr: The findings reveal that contextualization reduces the persuasive power of AI, but its combination with warmth restores persuasiveness through a crossover interaction, suggesting that users are prone to deferring to AI agents over human expert judgment.

2605.31534.tldr: An adaptive feature-optimized vision front end for 3D reconstruction that can make classical and learned 3D pipelines more deliberate about which visual evidence they spend compute on is proposed.

2605.31514.tldr: The purported anthropomorphic attributes of LLMs are empirically non-unique: although some properties could remain invariant, others might change with the substrate, and any empirically-grounded discussion on these attributes requires explicit measurement criteria; otherwise the interpretation is left to the representation.

2605.31464.tldr: LLMs can play a broader role in kernel optimization, by acting as virtual models of a GPU rather than solely as kernel generators for search, and are demonstrated that their utility can be improved through reinforcement learning.

2605.31444.tldr: This work explores Answer-Set Programming (ASP), which is a rich and, contrary to Prolog, fully declarative modelling language, to realise CARCASS abstractions, and indicates that CARCASS with ASP provides a promising approach to constructing abstractions for RL.

2605.31308.tldr: TraceGraph provides a process vocabulary for asking what agent benchmarks test, where models diverge on a shared landscape, and how failure regions can guide downstream improvement.

2605.31558.tldr: It is shown that successful learning is associated with the emergence of pure heads, i.e., heads that express themselves as either positional or symbolic for a given prompt, and that symbolic mechanisms extrapolate more reliably to longer sequences while positional mechanisms face sharper limitations.

2605.31509.tldr: This work introduces ReuseRL, which grounds agentic RL in the Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle, and extracts a shared skill dictionary from successful trajectories and augments the RL objective with a segmentation cost, explicitly penalizing idiosyncratic behaviors that encode poorly.

2605.31492.tldr: It is shown that adding simple parent pointers to explicitly represent the linearized tree (LinTree) structure improves both task performance and search efficiency relative to implicit reasoning models and LLM-heuristic-guided search.

2605.31408.tldr: In this controlled subset, skill availability is associated with higher success than no skill, while the tested presentation-granularity changes yield small, uncertain, and model-dependent effects.

2605.31377.tldr: Results show that persistent, structure-aware semantic expansion can translate offline agentic reasoning into practical improvements in coverage, freshness, and relevance for real-world news retrieval.

2605.31370.tldr: HypoAgent is an Agentic framework for interactive abductive Hypothesis Generation over knowledge graphs that achieves state-of-the-art semantic similarity under single-turn, multi-turn, and unconditional settings.

2605.31324.tldr: This paper introduces a novel generalization measure, local inconsistency, derived from an information-geometric perspective on the parameter space of neural networks, and proposes Inconsistency-Aware Minimization (IAM), which incorporates local inconsistency into the training objective.

2605.31295.tldr: This paper investigates the mechanistic interpretability of the Multitrack Music Transformer and proposes a framework for deterministic attribute modulation without retraining to bridge this gap via inference-time activation steering.

2605.31289.tldr: The terminal representation (TR) is introduced, which encodes reward-weighted trajectories similarly to the DR, but can be learned as a lower-dimensionality object, and can be used directly for the mentioned applications without eigenvector computations.

2605.31264.tldr: This work presents an automated trace-to-skill distillation system for generating person-grounded AI skills via expert knowledge distillation and illustrates how person-grounded skills can be represented as portable, correctable packages rather than opaque prompts or hidden memories.

2605.31330.tldr: A welfare-centric framework for institutional incentives in finite, well-mixed populations playing a social dilemma, considering both rewards for cooperators and punishments for defectors is developed, revealing a systematic gap between incentives optimised for cost or cooperation frequency and those that maximise welfare.

2605.31287.tldr: Findings indicate that conversational interaction offers conditional rather than universal benefits for industrial decision support, whereas LLM-based CAs may reduce information-access effort, whereas complex decisions continue to benefit from persistent, inspectable visual representations.

2602.10117.tldr: This work introduces a fully automated, black-box pipeline for detecting task-specific unverbalized biases in large Language Models, and provides a practical, scalable path to automatic, more efficient, and broader task-specific unverbalized bias discovery.

2605.31445.tldr: It is found that off-the-shelf LLMs all substantially deviate from game-theoretical equilibria, they attempt to lie about their private information but cannot efficiently exploit information asymmetries, and fine-tuning on financial utility makes the agents stronger at achieving better deals but also more dishonest.

2605.31410.tldr: FAM-Bench is introduced, a multi-modal Food-as-Medicine benchmark with 2500 nutrition-expert-verified instances across 13 diet-related health conditions, providing a standardized testbed for grounded health-aware reasoning in language and vision-language models.

2605.31404.tldr: Overall, this study shows that effective text-based spatial representations in LLM-based navigation should preserve topological integrity, calibrate representational compression to model capacity, and ensure semantic correctness, rather than simply adopting a single representation.

2605.31373.tldr: The maximal clique complex is introduced, enabling scalable CWNs with reduced time and memory complexity while retaining strong empirical performance, and a scalable topological learning framework for higher-order graph representation is proposed.

2605.31365.tldr: This work proposes SCALE (Self-Cognitive-Aware Learning and Exploration), a scalable and generalizable solution for building truly autonomous and adaptive web agents that leverages three adversarial roles, Selector, Predictor, and Judger to autonomously discover the agent's limitations and expand its cognitive boundaries through environmental exploration.

2605.31361.tldr: This work introduces an architecture that factorizes the latent state of a Dreamer-style recurrent state-space model (RSSM) into environment and teammate components, and learns an auxiliary Theory-of-Mind (ToM) head to infer latent embeddings of partner behavior such as character, intent, and predicted actions from partial trajectories.

2501.04661.tldr: A diagnostic evaluation to systematically assess natural language understanding in LLMs by leveraging Construction Grammar, which provides a psycholinguistically grounded framework for testing generalization.

2605.31279.tldr: GUIDE, a physics-guided deep unfolding framework that embeds wireless channel physics into differentiable layers that achieves 2.75x beamforming gain than the deep learning-based baseline FIRE with only a slight increase in inference time.

2502.11537.tldr: Simulus is introduced, a modular token-based WM agent that integrates: a flexible tokenization framework supporting arbitrary combinations of observation and action modalities; intrinsic motivation for epistemic uncertainty reduction; prioritized world model replay; and regression-as-classification for reward and return prediction.

2508.11070.tldr: This work extends algorithmic recourse from individual recommendations to system-level design, providing a tractable path toward higher social welfare while maintaining individual actionability, and shows how recourse systems can be designed to balance aggregate welfare with distributive considerations.

2508.13434.tldr: Event-aware non-stationary time series forecasting (EventTSF), an autoregressive diffusion framework that integrates historical time series and textual events via step-wise diffusion and uses an event-aware flow-matching timestep conditioned on event semantics is proposed.

2605.09233.tldr: It is discovered that with properly designed editing paradigms, sequential decomposition yields robust improvements even as task complexity increases, demonstrating the promise of sim-to-real generalization for tackling complex image editing across broader domains.

2605.09235.tldr: It is shown that the conditional velocity plays two distinct statistical roles in the loss: both as an unbiased regression target and as a Monte Carlo control variate in a Jacobi-vector product, with the original MeanFlow loss assigning the wrong coefficient to the latter.

2605.09241.tldr: AME is proposed, which seeks a favorable operatingpoint on the bias-variance frontier by applying Gaussian constraints in multiple random subspaces rather than in the originalembedding space, leading to a better balance between training stability and representation flexibility.

2605.09243.tldr: This work formulate this question mathematically, and begins to address it theoretically using a simple, analytically tractable linear gaussian model of task targets and neural recordings, to provide a foundation for understanding how valuable brain data could be for improving machine learning.

2605.09253.tldr: This work investigates high-loss tokens, a token type that--as the most direct signal of student-teacher mismatch under OPD's per-token KL objective--should progressively diminish as training converges according to existing studies; however, empirical analysis shows otherwise.

2605.09256.tldr: The resulting framework provides a mechanism for improving generalization through structured message sharing through structured message sharing rather than replica collapse or parameter-space coupling.

2605.09258.tldr: This work extends monocular biomechanical analysis to detailed finger tracking, expanding access to quantitative characterization of hand movement from readily available video and porting SAM 3D Body from PyTorch to JAX for integration with MuJoCo-MJX, enabling GPU-accelerated optimization.

2605.09259.tldr: This work confirms that the cross-stem modeling is essential for mixture-level timbre transfer as the proposed joint setting consistently exceeds an equivalent single-stem ablation.

2605.09268.tldr: Synthetic benchmarks based on real-world datasets from varied domains are constructed based on real-world datasets from varied domains to simulate context shifts of different levels of difficulty and discuss key takeaways for improving long-term robustness in multi-turn capabilities for LLMs.

2605.09272.tldr: This work shows that text-only approaches fail to capture the true challenges of medical consultation and suggests that high-stakes real-time diagnostic AI is most safely advanced in collaborative, triadic models where AI can be a supportive co-clinician for doctors and patients.

2605.09278.tldr: EquiMem is proposed, an inference-time calibration mechanism that quantifies each update algorithmically against the shared memory state, using agents' existing retrieval queries and traversal paths as evidence rather than soliciting any LLM judgment.

2605.09283.tldr: This paper presents a framework that automatically attaches structured metadata to AIGC at generation time, including modularized prompts, contexts, thoughts, model information, hyperparameters, and confidence, which enables efficient curation of structured AIGC and facilitates its safe use for applications such as fine-tuning and knowledge distillation.

2605.09284.tldr: This work proposes SuperMeshNet, an HR data-efficient super-resolution framework for mesh-based simulations aided by message passing neural networks (MPNNs), and introduces complementary learning, a semi-supervised approach that effectively leverages both a small amount of paired LR-HR data and abundant unpaired LR data via two jointly trained, complementary MPNN-based models.

2605.09288.tldr: A hybrid WoS-Neural Network PDE solver that treats a low-budget Monte Carlo solution as a structured estimator of the true field and learns a single-pass neural correction to recover a high-fidelity solution is presented.

2605.09292.tldr: A strategy-level evaluation framework instantiated on 80 AMC 10/12 and AIME problems with 217 AoPS-derived reference strategy families is introduced, position strategy diversity as a complementary dimension for evaluating mathematical reasoning beyond answer correctness.

2605.09294.tldr: The results suggest that LLM computation admits useful effective descriptions via RET: high-level, dynamically meaningful variables that support interpretation, prediction, and intervention.

2605.09296.tldr: This work proposes Micro-Defects expose Macro-Fakes (MDMF), a local distribution-aware detection framework that amplifies micro-scale statistical irregularities into macro-level distributional discrepancies, and introduces a learnable Patch Forensic Signature that projects semantic patch embeddings into a compact forensic latent space.

2605.09301.tldr: Neural CFRS is introduced, the first purely non-autoregressive one-shot neural CFRS framework for the CVRP, and is designed primarily for real-world spatial distributions under a constant capacity setting, scales robustly to out-of-distribution instances with a<4% gap.

2605.09308.tldr: The Hierarchical Attention-based Heterogeneous GNN (HA-HeteroGNN), a framework that addresses both issues through a unied explainability-to-pruning pipeline, by producing per-node relevance scores via an attention-based GNN Explainer without requiring gradient backpropagation.

2605.09310.tldr: This work proposes to impose ESG constraints without modifying the financial policy's observation or reward, using a Multimodal Action-Conditioned Constraint Field (MACF) that learns mechanism-specific ESG costs from point-in-time multimodal evidence and contemplated portfolio transitions and introduces MACF-X, a family of optimizer-specific adapters that converts MACF costs and uncertainties into native constrained-optimization interfaces through a shared slack- and uncertainty-aware pressure layer.

2605.09311.tldr: This work proposes a non-autoregressive learning framework based on auxiliary modality learning, which treats atomic trajectories as an auxiliary modality during training but does not require them at inference, and achieves over 200 times speedup compared to autoregressive models on the dataset with atomic trajectories.

2605.09314.tldr: This work uncovers a compact causal mechanism for persuasion-induced factual errors, and isolates a rank-one evidence-routing feature that controls the route, revealing persuasion as a narrow, monitorable circuit.

2605.09315.tldr: This work proposes Capability-Preserving Evolution (CPE), a general stabilization principle that constrains destructive capability drift during continual adaptation and suggests that stable long-horizon self-evolving agents require not only acquiring new capabilities, but also explicitly preserving previously learned ones during continual adaptation.

2605.09316.tldr: An exact one-bit classical RAC benchmark is provided, showing explicitly that the relevant quantum enhancement is not total information beyond the bottleneck, but fair query-conditioned access, and requiring stability of a one-bit bottleneck for arbitrary depth selects the Tsirelson threshold.

2605.09330.tldr: This work proposes CAMEL, a plug-and-play calibration method that operates across diverse memory architectures at both write and retrieval time and consistently reduces reliance on spurious patterns across all three types while preserving or improving performance on clean inputs and staying robust under adaptive attacks targeting the calibration.

2605.09339.tldr: This paper presents a focused analytical extension of the COLIBRI fuzzy color model by investigating perceptual asymmetry between hue categories, and introduces quantitative measures of category extent and boundary uncertainty, namely Wideness and Boundary Width, derived from fuzzy membership functions at the 0.5 level.

2605.09343.tldr: Experiments show that SKG-VLA consistently improves policy-grounded reasoning, complaint decision accuracy, long-tail generalization, and robustness under incomplete evidence.

2605.09346.tldr: One-Model One-Step is introduced, a novel compression framework for Latent Reasoning with Rule-Based Priors(RuPLaR) to address the challenge of eliminating cascaded processes and inter-model dependencies in latent CoT reasoning.

2605.09347.tldr: This work develops a native SAT solver for discrete logic, which is a direct extension of Boolean logic in which variables can take arbitrary values.

2605.09348.tldr: HOME-KGQA, a novel KGQA benchmark dataset built on a multimodal KG of daily household activities, is introduced and experimental results show that the LLM-based KGQA methods fail to achieve performance comparable to that on existing datasets when evaluated on HOME-KGQA.

2605.09350.tldr: This work proposes Chaintrix, an end-to-end auditing framework whose central architectural commitment is that every LLM-generated claim must be discharged against a deterministic structural contract representation.

2605.09352.tldr: Directional convergence analysis is introduced using cycle-kNN, an asymmetric alignment measure, applied across dozens of independently trained unimodal models spanning point clouds, vision, and language, uncovering a consistent directional asymmetry that holds across all model families and scales.

2605.09359.tldr: This work proposes Skill-R1, a reinforcement learning framework for instance-level recurrent skill optimization from verifiable rewards, which achieves consistent gains over no-skill baselines and standard GRPO across benchmarks with verifiable rewards, with particularly strong improvements on complex, multi-step tasks.

2605.09360.tldr: A PDE-grounded refinement loop that uses deterministic violation reports to correct generated code iteratively, and develops a Intent Fidelity Score (IFS) metric, reinforcing that executable simulation code should be verified against the mathematical structure it is intended to encode, not accepted on execution alone.

2605.09365.tldr: This work takes the position that language models should primarily be used for structured extraction in deterministic enterprise workflows, while computation and storage are delegated to knowledge bases and symbolic procedures, and demonstrates that modular architectures are more reliable and maintainable than monolithic frameworks.

2605.09369.tldr: Probabilistic Logical Knowledge Tracing is proposed, an interpretable KT framework that formulates prediction as a goal-conditioned evidence reasoning process over historical learning behaviors and employs robust Beta-distributed probabilistic embeddings to represent student knowledge states.

2605.09378.tldr: EduStory, a unified framework for reliable instructional video generation, is proposed that integrates pedagogical state modeling to track persistent knowledge states, script-guided structured control to organize multi-shot narratives, and learning-oriented evaluation metrics to assess knowledge fidelity and constraint satisfaction.

2605.09384.tldr: LiteMedCoT-VL is introduced, a pipeline that transfers chain-of-thought reasoning from a 235B teacher model to 2B student models through LoRA-based fine-tuning on explanation-enriched training data, and indicates that a 2B model with reasoning distillation can match or exceed models with twice the parameters.

2605.09386.tldr: A kinetic-optimal scheduler for prescribed scalar-parameterized probability paths is derived and a finite-step moment correction is introduced that adjusts the jump probability while preserving the CTMC jump destination distribution.

2605.09387.tldr: NEXUS is introduced, a modular framework designed for continual learning in embodied agents that decouples physical feasibility from safety specifications and different from prior works that treat symbolic artifacts merely as static interfaces.

2605.09410.tldr: This work introduces RePO-VLA, a recovery-driven policy optimization framework that assigns distinct roles to success, recovery, and failure trajectories, and introduces FRBench, with standardized error injection and recovery-focused evaluation.

2605.09419.tldr: Neuro-Symbolic Experience Replay (NSER), a framework that transforms experience replay from a passive sample reuse mechanism into an active engine for knowledge construction, achieves consistent superior sample efficiency and convergence speed across reactive, rule-based, and procedural benchmarks.

2605.09420.tldr: This study tackles Generalized Category Discovery via a Relational Retrieval perspective, explicitly coupling labeled and unlabeled data through bidirectional knowledge transfer, and proposes Relational Pattern Consistency (RPC) that enables mutual enhancement.

2605.09425.tldr: This work input semantic segmentation, depth, and edges extracted from the original image into a multi-condition image generation model, thereby providing rich structural information as conditions and providing an important step toward mitigating data scarcity in high-level autonomous-driving tasks.

2605.09429.tldr: COAST (COntrastive Adaptive Semantic Token Pruning), a training-free pruning framework that casts compression as adaptive semantic routing, is introduced, showing that adaptive semantic routing is a robust alternative to one-shot scalar pruning.

2605.09440.tldr: This work forms a canonical key-conditioned extractive question answering over OCR-derived clinical reports and introduces key coverage as a metric to quantify inventory completeness, showing that key coverage is a dominant factor for end-to-end performance.

2605.09442.tldr: SWIFT introduces a lightweight Semantic Injection Cache that augments cached video memory rather than reconstructing it from scratch at every prompt boundary, and maintains segment-level semantic anchors that summarize prompt-conditioned video history and reintroduce it as compact memory tokens.

2605.09457.tldr: RAwR is introduced, a computationally efficient rewiring framework that augments the input graph with a quotient graph derived from equitable partitions that enables a controllable reduction of the quotient graph, which recovers the conventional Master Node rewiring technique.

2605.09460.tldr: The results position distilled backbone replacement as a simple, training-free strategy for improving the efficiency-fidelity tradeoff of identity-preserved generation.

2605.09476.tldr: An experimental study on the collection and processing of crowd-sourced simplification data from comparable corpora to construct a corpus suitable for both training and testing text simplification systems across multiple languages (Catalan, English, French, Italian and Spanish).

2605.09477.tldr: This work first refine the measurement via explicit noise estimation to mitigate the effect of noise, then forms an iteratively reweighted least squares objective based on the Huber loss to address the outliers and proposes a method utilizing gradient descent to approximately solve the corresponding optimization problem for the robust objective.

2605.09483.tldr: Bounded Pragmatic Listener extends Rational Speech Act theory with three cognitively motivated bounds derived from the bounded rationality literature with a recursion depth bound, a prior compression parameter, and an availability sample size that operationalises importance sampling with saliency-weighted proposals.

2605.09486.tldr: CTQWformer is the first hybrid CTQW-based Transformer, integrating CTQW-derived structural bias with temporal evolution modeling to advance graph learning, demonstrating the potential of integrating quantum dynamics into trainable deep learning frameworks for graph representation learning.

2605.09494.tldr: An intelligent control method based on the LASSA (LLM-based Agent with Solver, Sensor and Actuator) architecture is proposed, which enables fast-slow dual closed-loop collaborative control, where the slow loop undertakes high-level dynamic decision-making and the fast loop guarantees high-frequency real-time control.

2605.09497.tldr: This work formalizes deception-aware web agent defense and proposes DUDE (Deceptive UI Detector&Evaluator), a two-stage framework combining hybrid-reward learning with asymmetric penalties and experience summarization to distill failure patterns into transferable guidance.

2605.09498.tldr: STNPs are proposed, a frequency-aware extension of Transformer Neural Processes that introduces a Spectral Aggregator that estimates an empirical context spectrum, compresses it into a spectral mixture, samples task-adaptive spectral features, and concatenates them with time-domain embeddings thereby injecting a spectral-mixture-kernel bias into TNPs.

2605.09502.tldr: This work delineates a boundary for mechanistic interpretability: error representations during reasoning are fundamentally different from the factual knowledge representations that prior work has successfully edited.

2605.09504.tldr: The results demonstrate that both safety bypass of frontier models and software vulnerability discovery are achievable at effectively zero cost using commodity hardware and openly available models.

2605.09511.tldr: WindINR, a latent-state implicit neural representation framework for continuous high-resolution local wind query and sparse-observation correction, is presented, suggesting a practical interface between kilometer-scale background products, sparse local observations, and wind queries in complex terrain.

2605.09515.tldr: This work shows GTFEP provides a principled foundation for analyzing and optimizing transformer architectures and shows heads with negligible contribution can be pruned with minimal performance loss.

2605.09516.tldr: Mixture of Layers (MoL), which replaces full-width transformer blocks with K parallel thin blocks at reduced dimensionality (d_thin<<d_model), connected via learned down/up projections and composed via top-k block routing.

2010.03496.tldr: This work proposes a holistic evaluation protocol for entity representations learned via a link prediction objective, and evaluates an architecture based on a pretrained language model, that exhibits strong generalization to entities not observed during training, and outperforms related state-of-the-art methods.

2407.06576.tldr: This work introduces Anthology, a method for conditioning LLMs to particular virtual personas by harnessing open-ended life narratives, which they refer to as backstories, and shows that the methodology enhances the consistency and reliability of experimental outcomes while ensuring better representation of diverse sub-populations.

2410.10247.tldr: This work proposes a framework named LPT, specifically designed for vision-language models, which uses CLIP to filter out fine-grained foreground information that may lead to overfitting, and develops a Structural Preservation constraint at the feature level, which aligns the model's overall feature space structure with the frozen CLIP, enabling effective reshaping of the feature space during optimization.

2501.05614.tldr: This work watermarked GNN explanations such that these explanations are statistically distinct from others, so ownership claims must be verified through statistical significance, and theoretically proves that, even with full knowledge of the method, locating the watermark is NP-hard.

2502.09891.tldr: This work introduces a novel graph-based RAG approach, called Attributed Community-based Hierarchical RAG (ArchRAG), by augmenting the question using attributed communities, and also introducing a novel LLM-based hierarchical clustering method.

2503.14434.tldr: LLM-FE is proposed, a novel framework that combines evolutionary search with the domain knowledge and reasoning capabilities of LLMs to automatically discover effective features for tabular learning tasks, and demonstrates that LLM-FE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2505.20654.tldr: The constructed CHNCI is the first Chinese cyberbullying incident detection dataset, which consists of 220,676 comments in 91 incidents and demonstrates that the constructed dataset can be a benchmark for the tasks of cyberbullying detection and incident prediction.

2507.03310.tldr: ReTimeCausal is an EM-based framework that alternates between imputation and structure learning, which encourages structural consistency throughout the optimization process and is more effective than existing methods under challenging irregular sampling and missing data.

2507.07871.tldr: This work proposes a defense that is provably forgery-resistant of the number of watermarked content collected by the attacker, provided they cannot easily distinguish watermarks from different keys, and focuses on the image and text modalities.

2507.18847.tldr: A new volumetric grasp model that is equivariant to rotations around the vertical axis, leading to a significant improvement in sampling efficiency and a novel tri-plane feature design in which features on the horizontal plane are equivariant to rotations around the vertical axis.

2508.13813.tldr: This paper introduces the first formal framework for assessing the trustworthiness of AI training datasets, enabling uncertainty-aware evaluations of global properties such as bias, and instantiates this framework on the trustworthiness property of bias.

2509.08031.tldr: AU-Harness is introduced, an efficient and comprehensive evaluation framework for LALMs that achieves a speedup of up to 151% over existing evaluation toolkits through optimized batch processing and parallel execution, enabling large-scale evaluations previously considered impractical.

2509.12635.tldr: Token-Aware Phase Attention (TAPA) is introduced, a new positional encoding method that incorporates a learnable phase function into the attention mechanism and attains substantially lower perplexity and stronger retrieval performance in the long-context regime than RoPE-style baselines.

2509.13332.tldr: This work presents a systematic comparison of "thinking" and "non-thinking"LLMs in the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm using open-source Qwen 3 models of relatively small sizes, and confirms that explicit reasoning extends its benefits beyond English.

2603.00166.tldr: This work formalizes the concept of AI Obedience, a hierarchical framework that grades a model's ability to transition from probabilistic approximation to pixel-level determinism (Levels 1 to 5), and introduces Violin, the first systematic benchmark designed to evaluate Level 4 Obedience through three deterministic tasks: color purity, image masking, and geometric shape generation.

2603.10165.tldr: OpenClaw-RL is the first RL framework to unify real-world agent settings spanning terminal, GUI, SWE, and tool-call environments, where the utility of next-state signals in long-horizon settings is demonstrated.

2603.26680.tldr: This work introduces AlpsBench, An LLM PerSonalization benchmark derived from real-world human-LLM dialogues, and defines four pivotal tasks - personalized information extraction, updating, retrieval, and utilization - and establishes protocols to evaluate the entire lifecycle of memory management.

2604.01527.tldr: This paper presents REAP (Relevance and Execution-Audited Pipeline), an automated curation pipeline that constructs production-derived benchmarks from real developer-agent sessions without manual labeling and uses it to curate Harvest, a benchmark where each task feeds the coding agent a real developer prompt and verifies the resulting code change against fail-to-pass tests retrieved from production.

2604.04306.tldr: This work presents HighFM, a first cut approach towards a FM for high temporal resolution, multispectral EO data, and benchmarks SEVIRI pretrained Vision Transformers against traditional baselines and recent geospatial FMs, highlighting the potential of temporally dense geostationary data for real-time EO.

2604.08577.tldr: A Distributionally Robust Token Optimization (DRTO) approach, which combines token-level Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) with Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO), providing a principled way to emphasize difficult response segments during policy optimization.

2604.23904.tldr: Across controlled simulation experiments, hybrid synthesis improves causal fidelity relative to fully generative baselines; the ACTG application shows improved predictive fidelity and potential for finite-sample estimator benchmarking.

2604.24428.tldr: BandRouteNet is proposed, an adaptive frequency-aware neural network for EEG denoising that jointly exploits band-specific processing and full-band contextual modeling that outperforms other methods under EOG, EMG, and mixed-artifact conditions in terms of Relative Root Mean Square Error and Signal-to-Noise Ratio Improvement.

2604.26961.tldr: This work proposes Sliceformer, a novel approach that reformulates static program slicing as a sequence-to-sequence task using small language models such as CodeT5+ to improve dependency modeling and eliminate hallucination.

2604.28087.tldr: Results indicate that the pipeline can successfully derive minimal necessary and sufficient rule sets and formalize them as logical constraints, and suggest that the pipeline supports incremental, modular, and traceable rule synthesis grounded in established legal and safety principles.

2605.02751.tldr: Steering with implicit traits is proposed: a technique that intermittently injects system prompts with statements that reinforce an LMs initial traits and is more effective than system prompt repetition at keeping models in line with their initial pro-social behaviors.

2605.07786.tldr: This work introduces APEX (Assumption-free Projection-based Embedding eXamination), a novel evaluation framework leveraging the Sliced Wasserstein Distance as a mathematically grounded, assumption-free similarity measure.

2605.09519.tldr: The concept of weighted rules under the stable model semantics following the log-linear models of Markov Logic provides versatile methods for resolving inconsistencies in answer set programs, ranking stable models, associating probability tostable models, and applying statistical inference to computing weighted stable models.

2605.09528.tldr: version 2 of system Cplus2ASP is presented, which implements the definite fragment of action language ${\cal C}$ +, which is fully compatible with the language of the Causal Calculator Versioni?ź2, but the new system is significantly faster thanks to modern answer set solving techniques.

2605.09533.tldr: The findings reveal that while premium models perform best out of the box, open-source models can achieve comparable quality when enhanced with RAG, and RAG emerges as the most effective and cost-efficient adaptation method for both closed- and open-source models.

2605.09534.tldr: The study develops a governed AI query-broker artifact that separates AI planning from operational execution through schema-grounded retrieval, approved templates, policy validation, read-only adapters, normalized outputs, auditable agent traces, and engineering review board gates.

2605.09536.tldr: Experiments show that TAD consistently improves the accuracy-parallelism trade-off, and naturally gives rise to two deployment configurations: a Quality model that prioritizes accuracy and a Speed model that favors more aggressive acceleration.

2605.09538.tldr: PhysHanDI (Physics-based Reconstruction of Hand and Deformable Object Interactions), a framework that enables full 3D reconstruction of both interacting hands and non-rigid objects, and demonstrates that it outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline across reconstruction and future prediction.

2605.09542.tldr: TESSERA is presented, a 3-part neuro-symbolic framework that uses LLMs in a circumscribed role: for local discriminative judgement rather than autonomous multi-step generation; the knowledge graph then defines the hypothesis space enforcing hard structural constraints, and MCTS coordinates the long-horizon search with principled credit assignment via backpropagation.

2605.09544.tldr: TIDE-Bench is introduced, a holistic and efficient benchmark for evaluating TIR methods, featuring three key advantages: it provides diverse task settings, combining widely used mathematical reasoning and knowledge-intensive QA tasks with two newly designed tasks to probe models'abilities in complex tool invocation and multi-tool coordination.

2605.09572.tldr: These findings position multi-scale supervision as the key mechanism for improving notation-conditioned pose generation, with KAN offering a compact alternative for efficient modeling.

2605.09579.tldr: Biosignal fingerprints are introduced: compact latent representations of cardiovascular state derived from a cross-modal foundation model, the Multi-modal Masked Autoencoder (M2AE), trained on over 3.4 million paired ECG and PPG signals that achieve competitive or superior performance compared to leading domain-specialist foundation models in frozen settings.

2605.09584.tldr: This study introduces CLR-voyance, a framework that reformulates inpatient reasoning as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) and supervises it with rewards that are simultaneously outcome-grounded and clinician-validated, yielding state-of-the-art inpatient clinical reasoning while retaining generalist capabilities.

2605.09588.tldr: This work designs a failure-conditioned greedy algorithm that preserves the standard $(1-1/e)$ guarantee while obtaining instance-dependent query savings and provides small-scale LLM experiments illustrating the predicted query savings and the role of complementarity in committee selection.

2605.09610.tldr: Systematic analysis of 9,000 generated contracts reveals characteristic failure modes and quantifies a +8.29 composite-score advantage of generated contracts over ground-truth implementations, attributable to LLMs' literal specification-following behavior.

2605.09622.tldr: DiffKT3D, a unified Any2Any 3D diffusion framework that leverages prior knowledge from pretrained video diffusion models for efficient and clinically meaningful dose prediction, and a novel reinforcement learning (RL) post-training mechanism guided by a clinically-informed Scorecard explicitly tailored to institutional treatment preferences.

2605.09623.tldr: A framework that dynamically splits neural network layers across the heterogeneous continuum and achieves reductions in energy and end-to-end latency is proposed, confirming the superiority of adaptive to static partitioning.

2605.09636.tldr: Results indicate that current agents remain limited in producing numerically reliable and efficient PDE solvers, and that PDEAgent-Bench provides a reproducible testbed grounded in the practical requirements of numerical PDE solving.

2605.09650.tldr: This work proposes a principled way to evolve the workspace, mirroring the structure of weight-space training: artifacts in place of parameters, evidence in place of data, counterexamples in place of losses, and textual feedback in place of gradients.

2605.09652.tldr: RDEx-CASK is competitive with RDEx, UDE-III,&CL-SRDE in feasibility-aware quality&improves time-to-target on most problems and is competitive with RDEx, UDE-III,&CL-SRDE in feasibility-aware quality.

2605.09661.tldr: MedMeta is introduced, the first benchmark designed to evaluate an LLM's ability to generate conclusions from medical meta-analyses using only the abstracts of cited studies, and demonstrates that for clinical applications, developing robust RAG systems is a more promising direction than model specialization alone.

2605.09663.tldr: This work proposes a framework that complements existing drift detection by leveraging Structural Causal Models as "Digital Twins" of data-generating processes, enabling precise causal interventions while preserving structural dependencies.

2605.09665.tldr: This paper proposes a framework for learning multi-indicator weights that jointly adapts data selection to both the downstream task and the specific model, and reveals a trade-off between semantic diversity and logical complexity in reasoning tasks, highlighting the necessity of joint task-model adaptation.

2605.09666.tldr: The need to rethink the evaluation of MS lesion segmentation models is highlighted to highlight what neurologists look for in brain MRI scans for MS detection and progression monitoring, and which metrics are required to properly quantify model performance in these contexts.

2605.09675.tldr: This work introduces CodeClinic, a benchmark built on MIMIC-IV for evaluating whether LLM agents can synthesize and compose reusable clinical skills instead of relying on fixed toolboxes, and proposes an offline autoformalization pipeline that converts natural-language clinical guidelines into reusable and verified Python skill libraries through iterative LLM refinement.

2605.09676.tldr: ChaosNetBench (CNB), a synthetic benchmark dataset and evaluation framework for studying STGNN performance under controlled multidimensional chaotic dynamics, and results reveal a regime dependent transition in which non-graph baselines remain competitive when there is low local chaos, while STGNNs are generally more resilient to higher levels of local and global chaos.

2605.09678.tldr: Absurd World is proposed, a benchmarking framework, to test LLMs against altered realism, where scenarios are logically coherent, and humans can easily solve the tasks.

2605.09679.tldr: Evaluating over 30 model configurations, it is found that reliable quantitative measurement is the primary bottleneck, making later-stage visual and medical reasoning harder for VLMs, while tool augmentation substantially mitigates this issue.

2605.09685.tldr: This paper presents a novel framework, Unified Unsupervised Anomaly Detection, that comprehensively addresses anomaly detection in multivariate time series by utilizing score-based generative modeling and introduces a novel time-dependent score network and a unified training objective.

2605.09693.tldr: It is found that large multimodal models develop mental imagery when solving spatial puzzles, and they do imagine sheep when solving sheep puzzles, and it is found that integrating as few as sixteen visual tokens per step into the chain of thought improves the average solve rate from 83% to 89%, with particularly strong gains on reasoning-heavy tasks such as jigsaw and 3D mental rotation.

2605.09698.tldr: Diagnostic suites for prediction-target ambiguity and evaluation-objective ambiguity are introduced, and failures are silent commitments: wrong-target submissions on Target, wrong-metric or non-committal baseline submissions on Objective.

2605.09707.tldr: The learned policy improves empirical constraint satisfaction on test problems while significantly improving efficiency, and is validated on both Lyapunov NNs and PINNs, and has broader applicability to domains where adaptive input selection is essential for effective training.

2605.09708.tldr: The held-out gate scoring function $\Phi_\mathcal{T}$ (evaluated once at end-of-run on a configuration the agent never sees during search) functions as a cheap mechanical oversight primitive on this automatic search loop, catching e.g. an Opus templateHMC win that returns wrong samples at unseen dimensions, and a GPT FFT3D best that collapses to a silent regression that the in-distribution score alone cannot see.

2605.09716.tldr: This work proposes a framework for AI systems that can make practically useful but formally transparent clinical predictions under uncertainty, and shows how an initial proof-of-concept of this framework can be used for differential diagnosis, producing an uncertainty-weighted list of potential diagnoses that could explain a patients'symptoms.

2605.09719.tldr: To improve reasoning without chain-of-thought (CoT) data, this work introduces "Hidden CoT": learnable latent tokens that serve as an internal scratchpad before answer generation in distilled 3D VLMs, the first use of latent scratchpad reasoning in distilled 3D VLMs.

2605.09721.tldr: This analysis suggests that many risks in autonomous cloud agents arise not from novel vulnerabilities, but from over-privileged tools, capability-intent mismatches, and ambient authority leakage in execution environments.

2605.09727.tldr: This work establishes a connection between non-linear transformers and kernel-based temporal difference learning by interpreting the transformer as performing regression in a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS), and shows that value functions from different domains can be represented using a shared set of weights, provided they lie within the same RKHS.

2605.09734.tldr: This work fine-tunes Llama 3.1 8B with QLoRA on API-Bank using four sequential domain blocks and studies a tractable version of this question in tool use: when a model learns a stream of new API domains, does keeping tool-use trajectories help compared with stripping the intermediate API trace?

2605.09735.tldr: KV-RM is presented, a runtime design that regularizes KV-cache movement beneath a static-graph LLM decoder, and suggests that KV-cache movement, rather than kernel shape, can be an effective boundary for recovering runtime flexibility in static-graph LLM serving.

2605.09739.tldr: Semantic Softmax is proposed, an inference-time layer that recovers lost information by aggregating the scores of the semantic neighborhood surrounding each target label by accounting for linguistic nuances.

2605.09742.tldr: TIDES is proposed, a selective SSM variant that reconciles selective and continuous architectures by moving input-dependence off the step size and onto the diagonal state matrix, allowing the model to handle irregular timestamps natively without sacrificing the per-token expressivity that makes selective SSMs effective.

2605.09745.tldr: Entropy-informed decoding (EDEN), a plug-and-play, model-agnostic decoding framework that adaptively allocates computation based on the model's own uncertainty, approximating higher-width beam search with fewer expansions, is introduced.

2605.09746.tldr: It is argued that SFFS represents a principled feature selection approach to input design in Earth observation, in contrast to the prevailing practice of appending every available band and hoping the model learns what to ignore.

2605.09749.tldr: This work proposes primal-dual guided decoding, an inference-time method that formulates constrained generation as a KL-regularised optimisation problem and solves it online via adaptive Lagrangian multipliers.

2605.09764.tldr: LEVI is a harness-first evolutionary framework built on the bet that stronger search architectures can substitute for or even outperform larger LLMs in evolutionary search and improves on three core components of evolutionary search.

2605.09765.tldr: This work proposes WISTERIA, a weakly supervised representation learning framework that models labels as stochastic observations of an underlying latent clinical state and constructs multiple weak supervision operators and learns representations by enforcing consistency across their induced label distributions.

2605.09771.tldr: A novel geometric diffusion model is introduced to characterize the temporal evolution of complex data representation such as brain networks (region-to-region connectivity encoded in a graph), in parallel with diffusion models for tabular data from other organ systems.

2605.09777.tldr: This work establishes evolutionary optimization as a principled paradigm for diverse LLM alignment as well as providing theoretical motivation extending recent multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA) runtime analysis suggesting why archive-based methods escape collapse more effectively than single-trajectory optimization.

2605.09781.tldr: QD-LLM is presented, a framework for parameter-efficient neuroevolution that evolves prompt embeddings, compact neural interfaces that steer generation in frozen LLMs (70B+ parameters), within a Quality-Diversity (QD) optimization framework.

2605.09790.tldr: A multi-tier labeling cascade is presented that composes three weak supervision sources of increasing fidelity: a fast physics rule set, an Interacting Multiple Model Unscented Kalman Filter bank, and a supplemental-element calibration step (supGP), to produce labels at a scale unavailable from any single source.

2605.09802.tldr: CrossVL, a framework combining Complexity-Aware Pathway Aggregation (CPA) and Paired Curriculum Learning (PCL) for enhanced cross-view detection for VLM, demonstrates that coordinated architectural and training adaptations are crucial for robust cross-view VLM detection.

2605.09803.tldr: Insight, an Android accessibility service that provides natural language interaction and real-time summarization of the screen, is introduced, and the potential of hybrid solutions combining gesture and dialogue modalities towards more inclusive design is described.

2605.09806.tldr: LEAD (Length-Efficient Adaptive and Dynamic reasoning), a method that replaces static heuristics with online, self-adaptive mechanisms that achieves the highest accuracy and Accuracy-Efficiency Score among RL-trained efficient-reasoning methods while producing substantially shorter outputs than the base model.

2605.09822.tldr: Oracle Poisoning is defined, an attack class in which an adversary corrupts a structured knowledge graph that AI agents query at runtime via tool-use protocols, causing incorrect conclusions through correct reasoning, distinct from CTI embedding poisoning.

2605.09827.tldr: Fashion Florence, a Florence-2 vision-language model fine-tuned with LoRA to extract structured fashion attributes from clothing images, generates a JSON object containing category, color, material, style tags, and occasion tags, structured output suitable for direct programmatic consumption by downstream recommendation and retrieval systems.

2605.09839.tldr: The Free Energy Manifold is introduced, a score-trained conditional energy model specialized for inference in hybrid Bayesian networks with discrete and continuous variables, and valley regularization is proposed, an off-data calibration term that restores near-uniform posteriors in such regions while preserving in-data fit.

2605.09842.tldr: This paper compares forecasting performance on U.S. Treasury yield curve data across econometrics/time-series analysis, classical machine learning, and deep learning methods, using daily data over 47 years to examine a variety of methods that have not been tested on yield curve forecasting.

2605.09846.tldr: This work provides a reproducible engineering prototype for Chladni audio-visual art creation, based on Kirchhoff-Love plate theory, and builds an end-to-end system in Python and Max/MSP, mapping recognized patterns to corresponding sine wave frequencies.

2605.09850.tldr: Apparent routing-aware calibration gains in this AR setting should not be read as internal-state calibration until matched-confidence, bandwidth, capacity, and permutation controls rule out common confounds.

2605.09852.tldr: A seven-dimensional taxonomy is introduced, three generative mechanisms of explanation inequity are identified, and a canonical six-step evaluation workflow for operationalizing explanation fairness audits in practice is proposed.

2605.09856.tldr: Motion Prior for Occluded human mesh recovery achieves state-of-the-art performance on both occlusion-specific and standard benchmarks, significantly enhancing the accuracy and temporal consistency of occluded human mesh recovery.

2605.09861.tldr: Using geometric invariant theory, it is proved that alignment geometry has a canonical closed, polystable stratum given by a flag variety, and that subspace intersection dimension is its unique reparameterization-invariant observable, establishing that subspace metrics are not empirical conventions but mathematical necessities.

2605.09862.tldr: This work proposes a Unified Flow-Oriented framework (UFO), which models conditional feature distributions via flow-based generative modeling and produces replay representations, mitigating forgetting without storing historical data, and estimates instance-level reliability scores to distinguish clean from noisy nodes.

2605.09863.tldr: Nautilus Compass is presented, a black-box persona drift detector and agent memory layer for production coding agents, and to the authors' knowledge, the only public agent memory layer that does not call an LLM at index time to extract facts or build a graph.

2605.09867.tldr: This work gives explicit constructions of constant-depth transformers that implement two foundational online decision-making procedures by storing their algorithmic state as linear combinations of feature embeddings, using a small number of latent context tokens.

2605.09870.tldr: Theoretically, it is proved that the full structural VAR becomes identifiable under a coverage condition on the simulator-clampable variables, and derive an end-to-end error bound that decomposes into Monte Carlo, simulator fidelity, and Flow Matching terms.

2605.09874.tldr: This work introduces EgoMemReason, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates week-long egocentric video understanding through memory-driven reasoning and establishes a strong foundation for evaluating and advancing long-context, memory-aware multimodal systems.

2605.09875.tldr: An anchor-projection framework that maps hidden representations from each model into a shared anchor coordinate space (ACS) provides a novel perspective on cross-family interpretability, revealing that representation-level transfer remains robust across model families.

2605.09879.tldr: This paper proposes M2A, a novel paradigm that synergizes mathematical and agentic reasoning via model merging via model merging that effectively extends agentic reasoning depth and delivers substantial performance improvements.

2605.09883.tldr: Polaris-Bench is introduced, which re-formulates 53 visual reasoning tasks in Polar coordinate space with paired Cartesian counterparts as reference, while preserving consistent logical constraints and task semantics -- thus fundamentally breaking the orthogonal prior that models exploit.

2605.09887.tldr: This work conducts the first cross-layer SAE scaling study, fitting and regressing on 844 residual-stream Gemma Scope SAE checkpoints across 68 layers of Gemma 2 2B and 9B, and finds that manifold geometry predicts the per-layer width exponent in both models, and that the same regression coefficients learnt on one model predict the other model's per-layer exponents under cross-model transfer, indicating a transferable geometric law.

2605.09893.tldr: This work introduces VALDI, a framework for measuring alignment between stated values and generated dialogue, and proposes VIVALDI, a multi-agent value auditor that intervenes at different stages of generation.

2605.09899.tldr: A hyperbolic constrained cross-modal distillation method for multimodal 3D object detection (HGC-Det), which adaptively refines the spatial representation of the 3D branch by leveraging semantic cues from the image branch, thereby mitigating the issue of inadequate representation fusion.

2605.09900.tldr: K KnotBench pairs an 858,318-image corpus from 1,951 prime-knot prototypes with a protocol whose answers are checked against Regina's canonical knot signature, and read together, the four families suggest current vision-language models hold features of a diagram but lack apparatus to simulate moves on those features.

2605.09905.tldr: The results suggest that sleep staging can be effectively addressed with structure-driven smoothing mechanisms rather than complex dependency modeling, enabling more efficient and edge-deployable healthcare systems for large-scale physiological monitoring.

2605.09906.tldr: This work proposes Separate First, Fuse Later (SFFL), an audio-visual reasoning framework designed to reduce cross-modal interference, and introduces a modality-specific reasoning mechanism that preserves modality isolation during the separated reasoning stage while enabling full access to cross-modal information at the evidence fusion stage.

2605.09907.tldr: Motivated by recent progress in conditional discrete graph diffusion models, RADAR is formed, a redundancy-aware and query-adaptive generative framework that actively reduce communication overhead and achieves higher accuracy, lower token consumption, and greater robustness across diverse scenarios.

2605.09908.tldr: The results demonstrate that the proposed models can extract content-agnostic biomarker information, which, when combined with lexical features extracted from audio, yields improved predictive performance in production settings.

2605.09915.tldr: This position paper characterizes a new systemic threat, which a malicious actor deploys AI agents to generate and submit a large volume of superficially plausible but low-quality papers, and argues that durable protection will require system-level policy and incentive reforms, rather than relying primarily on technical detection alone.

2605.09918.tldr: This work introduces NaiAD, the first comprehensive dataset for LLM-native advertising comprising 58,999 carefully constructed ad-embedded responses paired with user queries and provides score labels calibrated by a Variance-Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference (VC-PPI) framework.

2605.09920.tldr: Verifier-free Intrinsic Gradient-Norm Reward (VIGOR), a simple reward that uses only the policy model itself that outperforms the state-of-the-art Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback baseline, and it exhibits cross-domain transfer to code benchmarks when trained only on math data.

2605.09922.tldr: This paper proposes Team-based self-Play with dual Adaptive Weighting (TPAW), a novel self-play algorithm designed to improve alignment in a fully self-supervised setting that consistently outperforms existing baselines across various base models and LLM benchmarks.

2605.09931.tldr: PruneTIR, a rather effective yet efficient framework that enhances the tool-integrated reasoning at inference time, is proposed, which significantly improves Pass@1 and efficiency while reducing the working context length for tool-capable LLMs.

2605.09942.tldr: HAGE is proposed, a weighted multi-relational memory framework that reconceptualizes retrieval as sequential, query-conditioned traversal over a unified relational memory graph, and introduces a reinforcement learning-based training framework that jointly optimizes routing behavior and edge representations using downstream tasks.

2605.09948.tldr: Experiments show that LoopVLA pushes the efficiency-performance frontier of VLA policies, reducing parameters by 45% and improving inference throughput by up to 1.7 times while matching or outperforming strong baselines in task success.

2605.09950.tldr: Two GPU accelerated versions of the Boruta feature selection procedure are proposed, in which Boruta-Permut relies on permutation based feature importance and Boruta-TreeImp employs importance based on impurity reduction.

2605.09956.tldr: SDTalk is proposed, a one-shot 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based framework that generalizes to unseen identities without personalized training or fine-tuning, and demonstrates that SDTalk surpasses existing methods in both visual quality and inference efficiency.

2605.09959.tldr: G-Zero is introduced, a verifier-free, co-evolutionary framework for autonomous self-improvement that bypasses the capability ceilings of external judges, providing a scalable, robust pathway for continuous LLM self-evolution across unverifiable domains.

2605.09971.tldr: HapticLDM is proposed, the first text-to-vibration generative model built upon Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs), which introduced a text-processing strategy that emphasizes dynamic characteristics to curate high-quality data pairs for fine-grained dynamic modeling.

2605.09973.tldr: This work presents GLiNER2-PII, a small 0.3B-parameter model adapted from GLiNER2 and designed to recognize a broad taxonomy of 42 PII entity types at character-span resolution, and publicly releases the model on Hugging Face to support further research and practical deployment of open PII detection systems.

2605.09981.tldr: This work introduces Yeti, a simple and compact protein structure tokenizer based on lookup free quantization and trained end to end with a flow matching objective for multimodal learning, which generally achieves the best codebook utilization and token diversity, and second best reconstruction accuracy.

2605.09984.tldr: This work proposes Geometric 4D Stitching, an efficient framework that explicitly identifies missing geometric regions and complements them with geometrically grounded 4D stitches, and demonstrates that this explicit 4D stitching supports interative expansion of 4D mesh as well as 4D scene editing.

2605.09985.tldr: This work proposes and test the hypothesis that in non-stationary domains human library learning selects abstractions prospectively: targeting compression of future tasks, and shows that human abstraction behavior reflects sensitivity to latent, non-stationary structure in the task-generating process.

2605.09991.tldr: For two-layer ReLU networks, it is shown that solutions from a single optimizer -- AdamW, Muon, or others in the Lion-$\mathcal{K}$ family -- form a connected set at sufficiently large width, a result not implied by prior work.

2605.09992.tldr: Two architectural changes are proposed: Post-norm on the drafter hidden states and per-hidden-state RMSNorm after capturing target hidden states and shorter train-time-test depths to generalize over longer drafting sequences.

2605.09998.tldr: Continual Harness removes the human fully from this loop: a reset-free self-improving harness for embodied agents that formalizes and automates what was observed.

2605.10019.tldr: It is shown that the value of the rule increases with rule complexity and decreases with model capacity, while themem is approximately invariant to the rule and scales nearly linearly with dataset size $N$.

2605.10025.tldr: It is suggested that selecting examples based on human-interpretable dataset tags can improve generation precision and stability in clinical LLM applications.

2605.10027.tldr: To better capture emotional signals in spoken conversations, a paralinguistic injection method is introduced that inserts identified non-verbal emotional cues into speech transcripts, enabling LLM-based reasoning to incorporate critical acoustic nuances.

2605.10035.tldr: A response-oriented discrete edit optimization approach comprising two tightly coupled components: a single-step molecular edit response predictor (SMER) and a multi-step planner that composes local predictions into optimization trajectories via guided tree search (SMER-Opt).

2605.10036.tldr: A unified memory paradigm that dissolves the boundaries between sensing and reasoning by mapping biological memory hierarchies onto heterogeneous computing fabrics is proposed, creating a cognitive continuum where microsecond-level reflexes, millisecond-level reasoning, and long-term evolution share state across time scales.

2605.10038.tldr: TimeClaw is presented, an exploratory execution learning framework that turns exploratory execution into reusable hierarchical distilled experience through a four-stage loop: Explore, Compare, Distill, and Reinject.

2605.10043.tldr: C-BPO is proposed, a framework that personalizes LLMs via preference-calibrated binary signals via preference-calibrated binary signals that purifies negative signals by subtracting ``positive bias'', ensuring alignment with unique idiosyncrasies without compromising general helpfulness.

2605.10044.tldr: This work proposes Adaptive Action CHunking (ACH), a novel offline-to-online RL algorithm that dynamically modulates chunk length during both training and inference, and demonstrates superior generalization and learning efficiency in complex environments.

2605.10047.tldr: This work considers loss reweighting as an inverse problem and proposes an inverse-view reweighting strategy that infers class weights dynamically to match this ideal equal loss objective.

2605.10051.tldr: This work formally derive the optimal guidance term for Stochastic Interpolants (SI) by analyzing the value function's time evolution via the Backward Kolmogorov Equation, establishing a modified drift that theoretically guarantees sampling from a target distribution.

2605.10064.tldr: This paper introduces MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution), a framework that externalizes self-knowledge into a four-subgraph co-evolutionary knowledge graph that achieves strong performance against prompt-based frozen-backbone baselines.

2605.10065.tldr: NCO, a decoding strategy that performs online pattern matching over finite hard constraints and regex constraints, reducing computational overhead without inducing state explosion, is proposed and empirically demonstrate its effectiveness across practical tasks, including PII and profanity suppression.

2605.10084.tldr: This work presents PoDAR (Power-Disentangled Audio Representation), a framework that utilizes a randomized power augmentation and latent consistency objective to decouple signal power from invariant semantic content and isolating power into dedicated channels enables the application of CFG exclusively to power-invariant content.

2605.10106.tldr: This paper introduces ViSRA, a human-aligned Video-based Spatial Reasoning Agent, as a framework to probe the spatial reasoning mechanism of MLLMs, and demonstrates consistent improvement across a set of MLLMs on both existing benchmarks and unseen 3D spatial reasoning tasks.

2605.10107.tldr: This paper proposes Arcane, an efficient assertion reduction framework that integrates a two-tier assertion clustering approach for accurate semantic classification of large assertion sets, and employs Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explore optimal rule-application sequences for efficient assertion reduction.

2605.10111.tldr: Leave-one-subject-out experiments on two stroke MI-EEG datasets show that CFSPMNet outperforms representative CNN, Transformer, Mamba, and adaptation-based baselines, and suggest that latent neural-state modeling can improve rehabilitation-oriented cross-patient BCI decoding.

2605.10117.tldr: Enhanced HOPE is proposed, an adaptive perception architecture that measures the geometric complexity of each incoming LiDAR frame using an unsupervised statistical estimator and routes it through a shallow or deep processing path accordingly, requiring no manual scene labels.

2605.10120.tldr: This work introduces MicroWorld, a framework that constructs a multimodal attributed property graph (MAPG) from large-scale scientific image--caption corpora and leverages it to augment MLLM reasoning at inference time without any domain-specific fine-tuning.

2605.10121.tldr: The Post-Recurrent Module (PRM) is presented, an additional layer designed to improve both performance and transparency, incorporated into a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) architecture for classifying P300 signals from EEG data.

2605.10122.tldr: This paper systematically revisits existing neural solvers from the perspective of the generation mechanism for state embeddings during decoding, and proposes a simple yet powerful Constraint-Aware Residual Modulation (CARM) module that effectively enhances constraint awareness.

2605.10141.tldr: This work introduces the first benchmark for evaluating reward models in formal theorem proving with Lean 4.5, and reveals that frontier LLMs achieve the highest performance while specialized theorem provers perform the worst, suggesting that theorem proving ability does not transfer to proof evaluation.

2605.10142.tldr: The results indicate that larger models do not reliably provide higher-quality explanations, and that explainability should therefore be assessed explicitly during model selection for safety-sensitive deployments.

2605.10146.tldr: This work presents EditRisk-Bench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating safety risks of knowledge-intensive reasoning under malicious knowledge editing, and provides an extensible testbed for understanding and mitigating safety risks in knowledge editing for LLMs.

2605.10163.tldr: This work shows that in the linear non-Gaussian (LiNG) setting, the high-dimensional acyclicity assumption can be relaxed while still allowing recovery of a low-dimensional causal directed acyclic graph (DAG), and connects identifiability of this low-dimensional DAG to existing results.

2605.10169.tldr: This paper considers polynomial reachability games, where transitions and objectives are described by polynomial constraints over real variables, and proposes a fully automated algorithm for computing a winning strategy for $\texttt{REACH}$ player together with a formal correctness witness in the form of a ranking certificate.

2605.10171.tldr: This work introduces a fine-grained formulation of reviewer contradiction analysis that operates over full peer reviews by explicitly identifying contradiction evidence spans and assigning graded disagreement intensity scores.

2605.10176.tldr: This work proposes a multi-layered security framework designed to detect and mitigate LLM-mediated SQL injection attacks, and demonstrates that the proposed approach achieves high detection accuracy while maintaining low false-positive rates, significantly improving the secure deployment of LLM-powered database applications.

2605.10177.tldr: MTA-RL is proposed, the first framework that bridges perception and control through Multi-modal Transformer-based 3D Affordances and Reinforcement Learning (RL), and ablation studies confirm that multi-modal fusion and reward shaping are critical, significantly outperforming image-only and unshaped variants.

2605.10179.tldr: This work proposes one-step Graph-Structured Neural Flows (GSNF), which introduces two auxiliary-trajectory self-supervision strategies to strengthen interaction learning, and achieves state-of-the-art classification performance with highly competitive training time and memory usage.

2605.10184.tldr: A foundation model using 1.2m high resolution satellite images of the Netherlands is developed, demonstrating that the model can learn rich, generalizable representations from limited data, achieving competitive performance on global benchmarks while using a fraction of the parameters of larger state-of-the-art remote sensing models.

2605.10186.tldr: LegalCiteBench is intended as a diagnostic framework for studying authority generation failures, verification behavior, and abstention when external grounding is absent, incomplete, or bypassed, and is introduced as a benchmark for studying closed-book citation recovery, citation verification, and case matching in legal language models.

2605.10189.tldr: ProteinOPD is proposed, a multi-objective preference alignment framework that can effectively balance multiple preference objectives while maintaining the inherent designability of PLMs and achieves substantial gains on target preference objectives without compromising the designability.

2605.10194.tldr: This work proposes Token-Routed Alignment for Critical rEasoning (TRACE), which distills only on annotator-marked critical spans: forward KL on key spans of correct rollouts, optional reverse KL on localized error spans, and GRPO on all remaining tokens, with the KL channel annealed away after a short warm-up.
