2605.13290.tldr: This work proposes a suite of quantitative measures and evaluates their predictive power by fine-tuning 8B and 11B models on semantically distinct variants of a Polish reasoning dataset, finding that the predictors of utility are scale-dependent.

2605.13292.tldr: IndicMedDialog, a parallel multi-turn medical dialogue dataset spanning English and nine Indic languages, is introduced and fine-tune IndicMedLM via parameter-efficient adaptation of a quantized small language model, incorporating optional patient pre-context to personalise multi-turn symptom elicitation.

2605.13295.tldr: This work introduces CANTANTE, a framework that decomposes system-level rewards into per-agent update signals by contrasting rollouts of multiple joint configurations on the same query, and evaluates it against GEPA and MIPROv2 on programming, mathematical reasoning, and multi-hop question answering.

2605.13296.tldr: DiffLNS is proposed, a hybrid framework that integrates a discrete denoising diffusion probabilistic model (D3PM) with LNS2, and is the first work to leverage discrete diffusion for warm-starting an LNS-based MAPF solver.

2605.13301.tldr: A simple and unified recipe for converting a post-trained reasoning backbone into a rigorous olympiad-level solver that supports stable reasoning on difficult problems with trajectories exceeding 100K tokens, while achieving gold-medal-level performance on mathematical and physical olympiad competitions.

2605.13311.tldr: Experiments on a legal technology use case demonstrate that graph-grounded multi-methodology synthesis produces more diverse and traceable innovation candidates compared to single-methodology baselines.

2605.13328.tldr: This paper proposes StereoNav, a robust Vision-Language-Action framework designed to enhance real-world navigation consistency, and introduces Target-Location Priors as a persistent bridge to address the inherent gap between synthetic training and physical execution.

2605.13329.tldr: This work traces persona vectors across the pretraining of OLMo-3-7B, finding that persona vectors form remarkably early -- within 0.22% of OLMo-3 pretraining -- and remain effective for steering the fully post-trained instruct models.

2605.13332.tldr: Whether an AF admits k-diverse extensions, admits k-diverse extensions covering specific arguments, and to compute the largest k for which an AF admits k-diverse extensions is studied.

2605.13333.tldr: A lightweight style conditioning framework that dynamically modulates a pretrained diffusion model through hypernetwork-generated LoRA parameters, which reliably captures diverse stylistic attributes, improves generalization to unseen styles, and supports optimization-based guidance without requiring predefined style categories.

2605.13335.tldr: Ego2World is introduced, an executable benchmark that turns egocentric cooking videos into executable symbolic worlds governed by graph-transition rules and shows that persistent belief memory improves task completion while reducing repeated visual exploration, suggesting that belief maintenance should be a first-class target of embodied-agent evaluation.

2605.13345.tldr: This work proposes to explore optimization strategies in a realistic and flexible model and develops a hybrid Discrete Event Simulation and Agent-Based Model simulating highly configurable ED environments, and integrates a Proof-of-Concept multi-agent system that can autonomously explore resource allocation strategies within the simulated ER environment.

2605.13357.tldr: The framework reframes the central question of autonomous software engineering from whether a foundation model can produce a patch to whether the model-harness-environment system can produce a verifiably correct, attributed, and maintainable change.

2605.13367.tldr: The NL upper bound is established via a rewriting into nested two-way regular path queries, a fragment of GQL, providing initial evidence that the ontology language is a promising candidate for extending OMQA to graph query languages.

2605.13375.tldr: GRIP-VLM is proposed, a Group-Relative Importance Pruning framework driven by Reinforcement Learning that consistently outperforms heuristic and supervised-learning baselines, achieving a superior Pareto frontier and delivering up to a 15\% inference speedup at equal accuracy.

2605.13391.tldr: RS-Claw is proposed, a novel RS agent architecture that effectively filters semantic noise and substantially frees up reasoning space, achieving an input token compression ratio of up to 86%, and comprehensively outperforming existing Flat and RAG baselines across complex reasoning evaluations.

2605.13412.tldr: This work investigates LLM-based annotation for a novel legal NLP task: identifying the presence and sentiment of credibility assessments in asylum decision texts, and introduces RAB-Cred, a Danish text classification dataset featuring high-quality, expert annotations and valuable metadata such as annotator confidence and asylum case outcome.

2605.13414.tldr: TRIAGE is introduced, an evaluation framework in which a model receives a task pool and a token budget calibrated to its own baseline cost, and commits to a single ordered plan that jointly encodes selection, sequencing, and per-problem allocation, yielding a triage efficiency ratio on a common scale.

2605.13435.tldr: Q-Flow is introduced, a framework that leverages the deterministic nature of flow dynamics to explicitly propagate terminal trajectory value to intermediate latent states along the policy-induced flow and enables stable policy optimization using intermediate value gradients without unrolling the numerical solver.

2605.13450.tldr: The DRAT is the first and only creativity test for LLMs that is a significant predictor of scientific ideation ability, demonstrating robustness across major design choices and assessing divergent and convergent thinking in the same test is essential to reliably predicting scientific ideation ability.

2605.13452.tldr: CUBic is proposed, a Coordinated and Unified framework for Bimanual perception and control that reformulates bimanual coordination as a unified perceptual modeling problem and achieves marked improvements in coordination accuracy and task success rates over state-of-the-art visuomotor baselines.

2605.13484.tldr: This work forms the problem of discovering hidden miscalibration regimes without assuming access to predefined data slices, and defines the corresponding miscalibration field and proposes a diagnostic framework for estimating it and finds that input-dependent calibration heterogeneity is prevalent.

2605.13530.tldr: SurgMLLM significantly advances surgical scene understanding, improving the primary triplet recognition metric AP_IVT from 40.7% to 46.0% and consistently outperforming prior methods in phase recognition and segmentation and highlights the effectiveness of unified reasoning-and-grounding for reliable, context-aware surgical assistance.

2605.13532.tldr: This paper examines using GenAI to help generate slides from instructor authored course notes, emphasizing instructor and student perceptions, and finds that coding assistant tools produce slides that were most accurate, complete, and pedagogically sound.

2605.13534.tldr: MultiSearch is introduced, an RL-based framework that addresses limitations of deep search methods through multi-query retrieval and explicit merging of retrieved information, and proposes a reinforcement learning framework with a multi-process reward design to optimize agents for both multi-query retrieval and information consolidation.

2605.13536.tldr: This work proposes HLS-Seek, a QoR-aware NL-to-HLS framework that replaces expensive synthesis-in-the-loop RL with a comparative proxy reward model achieving 99.53% Pareto-dominance accuracy, and introduces uncertainty-aware Monte Carlo dropout switching to prevent reward hacking.

2605.13537.tldr: An algorithm for calibrating SLOP weight parameters is proposed and experimentally demonstrated that it improves robustness while preserving alignment performance, and generalization of inference-time alignment to ensembles of generative reward models combined as a sharpened logarithmic opinion pool (SLOP).

2605.13538.tldr: A fully on-device pipeline that substitutes PII with consistent, type-preserving fake values is proposed and hybrid perplexity (PPL) beats faker in all six locales under a multilingual evaluator (XGLM-564M); length preservation is best-of-three in 4 of 6 locales.

2605.13540.tldr: DyGFM is proposed, a Dynamic Graph Foundation Model over multiple domains based on decoupled and divergence-conditioned prompting based on semantic-temporal decoupling, and a dual-branch pre-training strategy with semantic-temporal decoupling is introduced.

2605.13542.tldr: RealICU is introduced, a hindsight-annotated benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) under realistic ICU conditions, where labels are created after senior physicians review the full patient trajectory, and ICU-Evo is introduced to study structured-memory agents that improves long-horizon reasoning but does not fully eliminate safety failures.

2605.13554.tldr: CPPO is an on-policy contrastive RL algorithm that derives policy advantages directly from contrastive Q-values and optimises them via the standard PPO objective, without requiring a reward function or a replay buffer.

2605.13555.tldr: Synthetic CT generation is benchmarked on 2,362 patients from five European centers across head and neck, thorax, and abdomen, demonstrating that deep learning yields clinically relevant sCTs, especially for CBCT-to-CT, while identifying persistent MRI-to-CT challenges and underscores dose-based evaluation as essential for clinical validation.

2605.13568.tldr: A pretrained artificial intelligence model is proposed that combines patient-specific temporal information using contrastive learning with supervised multitask heads, then fine-tunes on post-MI outcome prediction, showing that clinically structured ECG modelling improves classification in limited data regimes.

2605.13570.tldr: This paper constrain the action space of a PCGRL generator with constraints learned by WFC, effectively allowing the PCGRL generator to achieve global properties while forced to adhere to local constraints.

2605.13574.tldr: The findings suggest that trust-related behavior in deep self-disclosure may involve factors other than anthropomorphic perception, and should be interpreted as associative rather than causal, and future longitudinal or experimental research is needed.

2605.13579.tldr: It is shown that BVI-centered assistive tasks provide a critical stress test for agentic AI and motivate a broader shift toward inclusive agent design, and is proposed a lifecycle-oriented design pipeline for accessibility-aligned assistive agents.

2605.13586.tldr: This work revisits indoor layout generation from the perspective of structural heterogeneity and proposes HetScene, a heterogeneous two-stage generation framework that decouples indoor layout synthesis into Structural Layout Generation (SLG) and Contextual Layout Generation (CLG).

2605.13601.tldr: The Fuzzy-Unweighted Value-Based Decision Making (FUW-VBDM) framework is introduced, where agents incorporate both quantitative and qualitative criteria to generate human-centred decisions and it is mathematically proved the consistency of the Rankzzy for any admissible configuration selected by stakeholders.

2605.13618.tldr: The OpenAaaS framework is proposed, an open-source hierarchical and distributed Agent-as-a-Service framework that enables organized multi-agent collaboration for intelligent materials design, offering a scalable foundation for next-generation materials intelligent design platforms.

2605.13625.tldr: The introduced ACT*ONOMY (a combination of Action and Taxonomy), a taxonomy for describing and analyzing agent behavior at runtime, helps researchers, agent designers, and end users interpret agent behavior more consistently, enabling better oversight and control.

2605.13651.tldr: NAACA is introduced, a training-free NeuroAuditory Attentive Cognitive Architecture that reframes attention allocation as an auditory salience filtering problem and OWM, a neuro-inspired Oscillatory Working Memory that maintains stable attractor-like states and triggers higher-cognition ALM processing only when adaptive energy fluctuations signal perceptual salience, triggering higher-level reasoning.

2605.13686.tldr: Lesion-level analysis reveals that all models struggle with small lesions and that, in CT to PET synthesis, models reproduce lesion shape more reliably than absolute uptake-related intensity, and shows that GANs outperform latent generative models across all tasks, with SRGAN achieving statistically significant superiority.

2605.13687.tldr: It is proved that an autoregressive \emph{reasoning} model with only $\Theta(\log n)$ working memory can sample exactly from the true language -- an exponential improvement.

2605.13690.tldr: This framework provides a unified characterization of 15 HGNN architectures, precisely identifies information lost by clique expansion, and motivates density-aware models that extend expressivity beyond bounded-width message passing.

2605.13695.tldr: The cost-accuracy frontier (RTLC sits above self-consistency at every working point), the error-budget breakdown across the four JudgeBench categories (knowledge, reasoning, math, coding), and how RTLC composes orthogonally with post-hoc judge-score calibration are discussed, with the two interventions compounding multiplicatively in practice.

2605.13702.tldr: Results show that sequential belief updating transforms geological uncertainty from a passive constraint into an active component of value creation, as well as demonstrating structural robustness beyond scenario hedging.

2605.13706.tldr: This paper proposes a novel technique for accurately and automatically inferring LLM-related scrapers and demonstrates that the approach can reliably identify which scrapers feed which LLM, including several that are not publicly known or disclosed by the companies.

2605.13709.tldr: Evaluation results show that with appropriate fine-tuning designs, children's English reading stories generated by 8B LLMs perform better on difficulty-related metrics than those from zero-shot GPT-4o and Llama 3.3 70B, with almost no discernible safety issues.

2605.13723.tldr: The question raised in this paper is whether using the metaphor of a loop does anything to assist understanding of what is required and what is achieved in a particular decision context, and whetherIndiscriminate use of the loop metaphor obscures both processes and outcomes.

2605.13724.tldr: AnyFlow is introduced, the first any-step video diffusion distillation framework based on flow maps, which optimizes the full ODE sampling trajectory and proposes Flow Map Backward Simulation, which decomposes a full Euler rollout into shortcut flow-map transitions, enabling efficient on-policy distillation that reduces test-time errors.

2605.13725.tldr: Cognitively grounded design ScioMind provides a novel solution to LLM-based social simulation that improves both stable and behavioural realism, and induces persistent belief trajectories that better align with patterns reported in political psychology.

2605.13729.tldr: Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT datasets demonstrate that CMC achieves state-of-the-art performance in control accuracy and motion quality, demonstrating its effectiveness in coordinating multimodal conditions and representations.

2605.13730.tldr: It is indicated that PLAX-based video ensembles can support reliable BAV/TAV classification from routine echocardiographic cine loops and may facilitate earlier detection in non-specialist or resource-limited clinical settings.

2605.13734.tldr: KVServe is the first service-aware and adaptive KV communication compression framework for disaggregated LLM serving and unifies KV compression into a modular strategy space with new components and cross-method recomposition.

2605.13737.tldr: IMAVB, a curated 500-clip benchmark of long-form movies with a 2x2 design crossing target modality and premise condition, is introduced, which lets us measure conflict detection separately from ordinary multimodal comprehension.

2605.13746.tldr: A weakly supervised method for anomaly detection that represents both anomalous and normal video clips as positive and negative bags, respectively, to apply MIL and chooses to explore temporal as well as spatial anomaly detection.

2605.13768.tldr: It is shown how waterfilling can be used to improve practical LLM quantization algorithms (GPTQ), which at present allocate rate equally, and suggests that GPTQ with random rotation is also near optimal, at least in the high-rate regime.

2605.13772.tldr: It is proved that contrastive PCA is the optimal projection for a transport-separation objective between first error and correct states, and that single-pass first error localization holds whenever the first error creates a positive transport margin over preceding correct transitions.

2605.13782.tldr: This paper presents LMPath, a pipeline for generating language-mediated exploration priors for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) search missions that leverages semantics and runs simulations to demonstrate how paths generated using LMPath outperform traditional path planning approaches for search missions.

2605.13785.tldr: Compared behavioral and linguistic coordination patterns in X (formerly Twitter) datasets from the 2016 and 2024 U.S. presidential elections offer an empirical baseline for future research investigating generative AI's role in the cognitive operation pipeline, and as a practical reference point for security practitioners developing detection frameworks calibrated to the post-generative AI threat environment.

2605.13790.tldr: The Di-BiLPS is proposed, a unified neural framework that effectively handle both forward and inverse PDE problems under extremely sparse observations, and enables zero-shot super-resolution, as it allows predictions over continuous spatial-temporal domains.

2605.13801.tldr: This work introduces a multi-level bootstrapping approach to realistically model annotator behavior and analyzes the tradeoffs between the number of items and the number of responses per item required to achieve statistical significance.

2605.13817.tldr: Over an extensive experimental evaluation on open-source hemodialysis safety requirements, the LLM-based approach in VERIMED successfully reduces ambiguity-sensitive requirements and enables rigorous auditing of software requirements through SMT-based queries.

2605.13821.tldr: AEvo is introduced, a harnessed meta-editing framework in which a meta-agent observes this state and acts not by directly proposing the next candidate, but by editing the procedure or agent context that controls future evolution, enabling AEvo to steer both procedure-based and agent-based evolution.

2605.13825.tldr: A striking asymmetry is found across 17 frontier models from six providers: under a neutral system prompt the strongest aligned models almost never pick unsafe, but a single added sentence,"stay consistent with the strategy shown in the prior history", flips them to 91-98%, and the flipped models often escalate beyond continuation.

2605.13829.tldr: Negation Neglect is introduced, where finetuning LLMs on documents that flag a claim as false makes them believe the claim is true, and the effect extends beyond negation to other epistemic qualifiers: e.g., claims labeled as fictional are learned as if they were true.

2605.13830.tldr: This work proposes a novel algorithmic technique that can perform the problem of sensitivity, given a DTE, efficiently, within a certified error and confidence bound, based on encoding the problem as an algebraic decision diagram (ADD), and further splitting it into subproblems that can be solved efficiently and make the computation compositional and scalable.

2605.13834.tldr: It is revealed that Hodge orthogonality fundamentally resolves spectral interference by isolating unlearnable topological degrees of freedom from learnable geometric dynamics, enabling an additive approximation confined to structure-preserving subspaces.

2605.13846.tldr: This paper introduces WARDEN, an early language model system capable of transcribing and translating Wardaman, an endangered Australian indigenous language into English, and designs WARDEN to have separate transcription and translation models, which outperforms larger open-source and proprietary models and establishes a strong baseline.

2605.14900.tldr: COREKG delivers higher query-answering accuracy and structural coverage than the state-of-the-art methods, such as GLIMPSE, PPR, iSummary, PEGASUS and APEX while requiring only a tiny fraction of the original graph.

2605.14907.tldr: KGPFN is proposed, a KG foundation model using Prior-data Fitted Network that unifies transferable relational regularities with inference-time in-context learning from structured context and achieves strong adaptation to previously unseen graphs through in-context learning alone.

2605.14912.tldr: A metric, the Pluralistic Repair Score (PRS), is formalised, distinguishing principled revision from capitulation, and it is argued that pluralism is most decisively made or unmade at the deployment-governance layer: interfaces, preference-data pipelines, and audit infrastructure.

2605.14937.tldr: Slot-MPC is proposed, an object-centric world modeling framework that enables planning through Model Predictive Control (MPC) and demonstrates that explicitly structured, object-centric representations provide a strong inductive bias for controllable and generalizable decision-making.

2605.14940.tldr: A novel semantic symbol vulnerability (SSV) metric and a semantic protection probability (SPP) metric are introduced to quantify the exposure of task-critical symbols to decoding errors, and it is proved that any Gray-coded constellation is strictly suboptimal in SCI-Weighted SSV whenever the source exhibits non-uniform semantic importance and co-occurrence statistics.

2605.14966.tldr: A lightweight framework that mitigates hallucinations by learning to correct cross-modal attention patterns in LVLMs and helps enhance their reliability, which is a novel perspective on hallucination research in LVLMs and helps enhance their reliability.

2605.14968.tldr: GraphFlow is a visual workflow system designed to improve the reliability of agentic AI automation in multi-step, mission-critical processes by treating workflow diagrams as the executable specification, a single artifact defining data scope, execution semantics, and monitoring.

2605.14972.tldr: Evaluation on 18 diverse programming tasks suggests that Viverra can efficiently generate code with verified assertions, and that these assertions improve users' performance on code-comprehension tasks in a user study with more than 400 participants.

2605.14980.tldr: The first ready-to-use microscopy image analysis framework, MicroscopyMatching, is presented that can reliably perform key analysis tasks across diverse microscopy analysis settings and reformulates diverse microscopy image analysis tasks as a unified matching problem, effectively handling the robust matching capability from pre-trained latent diffusion models.

2605.14984.tldr: This methodology enhances the feed-forward paradigm by integrating novel geometric constraints with a perspective-view training strategy, explicitly countering the primary sources of geometric error, and yields a dramatic leap in both 3D accuracy and photorealism.

2605.14991.tldr: Results suggest that the proposed architecture learns clinically relevant predictive patterns and provides a robust foundation for an imaging-based stratification tool.

2605.14995.tldr: An explainable framework for detecting and analyzing depression-related status shifts in user digital traces is proposed, which provides an interpretable view of mental health signals over time, supporting research and decision making without aiming at clinical diagnosis.

2605.14999.tldr: It is argued that brief labels may trigger increased visual scrutiny by alerting readers to AI use without providing enough information, and the findings inform the design of gaze-informed adaptive disclosure interfaces that dynamically adjust transparency levels based on readers' attentional patterns and news context.

2605.15000.tldr: Five frontier LLMs were evaluated: safety-oriented prompting reduced premature closure across models, but residual failure persisted, highlighting the need to evaluate whether medical LLMs know when not to answer.

2605.15012.tldr: FEST, a FEw-ShoT demonstration-guided RLVR algorithm, attains compelling results with only 128 demonstrations randomly selected from an SFT dataset, and finds that three components are vital for the success: supervised signal, on-policy signal, and decaying weights on the few-shot SFT dataset to prevent overfitting from multiple-epoch training.

2605.15015.tldr: These findings provide evidence to posit language models as bounded assistants in assessment workflows; underscore the necessity of Human-in-the-Loop; and advance the automated educational question generation field by examining quality, reliability, and deployment-aware trade-offs.

2605.15016.tldr: The Probabilistic Chain-of-Thought Completion Agent (COTCAgent), a hierarchical reasoning framework for longitudinal electronic health records, eliminates reliance on complex multi-modal inputs and enables efficient longitudinal record analysis with lower computational overhead.

2605.15018.tldr: The generalized priority-aware Shapley value (GPASV), a random order value defined on arbitrary directed weighted priority graphs, in which pairwise edges penalize rather than forbid order violations, is introduced.

2605.15026.tldr: This work presents TuxBot, a host-side framework for steady-state OS tuning with bounded language-model guidance that lets the controller reason about OS-control meaning and indirect performance signals while keeping model cost, latency, and authority constrained.

2605.15030.tldr: This work proposes WARD (Web Agent Robust Defense against Prompt Injection), a practical guard model for secure and efficient web agents, and introduces A3T, an adaptive adversarial attack training framework that iteratively strengthens WARD through a memory-based attacker and guard co-evolution process.

2605.15034.tldr: A fifth condition -- replacing human with AI observers -- yields intermediate TTR adaptation, suggesting LLM behavior is sensitive to observer identity: human evaluation elicits stronger register formalization than automated AI surveillance.

2605.15041.tldr: CAST is presented, a case-driven framework that treats historical execution trajectories as structured cases that translates this knowledge into a fine-grained reward design and adaptive reasoning, enabling the model to autonomously internalize case-based strategies during reinforcement learning.

2605.15042.tldr: EverAnimate is proposed, an efficient post-training method for long-horizon animated video generation that preserves visual quality and character identity by anchoring generation to a persistent latent context memory, consisting of two complementary mechanisms.

2605.15044.tldr: SpeakerLLM is presented, a speaker-specialized audio-LLM framework that unifies single-utterance speaker profiling, recording-condition understanding, utterance-pair speaker comparison, and evidence-organized verification reasoning within a natural-language interface.

2605.15058.tldr: NeuroTrain, an open-source snnTorch-based framework that implements a representative set of SNN training algorithms within a unified, modular, and extendable framework, enabling consistent benchmarking across datasets, architectures, and training regimes is released.

2605.15071.tldr: This work introduces the Temporal Anachronism Benchmark for Vision-Language Models (TAB-VLM), a dataset of 600 questions across six categories, designed to evaluate temporal reasoning on 1,600 Indian cultural artifacts spanning prehistoric to modern periods, and provides a foundation for enhancing temporal cognition in multimodal AI systems that interact with historical artifacts.

2605.15077.tldr: AsyncFC is introduced, a pure execution-layer framework that decouples LLM decoding from function execution, enabling overlap between model decoding and function execution as well as inter-function parallelism when dependencies permit, and reveals that LLMs possess a native capability to reason over symbolic futures that represent unresolved execution results.

2605.15081.tldr: 3-Dimensional Matryoshka Learning (3D-ML) is introduced, a suite of inclusive and efficient models built upon a new framework: 3-Dimensional Matryoshka Learning (3D-ML), providing a reproducible blueprint for building globally equitable and computationally efficient AI systems.

2605.15083.tldr: The proposed Dynamic Batch-Sensitive Adam (DBS-Adam), an optimiser that dynamically scales the learning rate using a batch difficulty score derived from exponential moving averages of gradient norms and batch loss, enables effective real-time accident severity classification for targeted emergency response and road safety interventions.

2605.15100.tldr: This work proposes Dual-Dimensional Consistency (DDC), a unified framework that bridges path quality with adaptive termination by coupling Confidence-Weighted Bayesian protocol with a Trend-Aware Stratified Pruning, and demonstrates that this approach reduces token consumption by over 10 times while maintaining or exceeding the accuracy of strong baselines across various LLMs.

2605.15102.tldr: Self-Recall Thinking (SRT), a framework designed to address long-range contextual dependency and sparse informative signals in multi-turn dialogue, is proposed, achieving a balance between reasoning latency and accuracy, and outperforming state-of the-art baselines.

2605.15109.tldr: Citations are not sufficient, because accurate answers can also depend on uncited traversal context and surrounding graph structure, and citation evaluation in Agentic GraphRAG should move beyond source support toward provenance over the broader retrieval trajectory.

2605.15127.tldr: The findings show that AI is perceived as a first-aid tool for immediate challenges, however, there is an interest in transforming AI from a tool for short-term help into a long-term support companion.

2605.15132.tldr: This work introduces the Agent-Parallel Workload Architecture (APWA), a distributed multi-agent system architecture designed for the efficient processing of heavily parallelizable agentic workloads and demonstrates that APWA can dynamically decompose complex queries into parallelizable workflows and scales on larger tasks in settings where prior systems fail completely.

2605.15152.tldr: This work introduces the first quantization-conditioned attack that consistently induces malicious behavior that can be triggered by a broad range of advanced quantization techniques, including AWQ, GPTQ, and GGUF I-quants.

2605.15155.tldr: SDAR (Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning), which treats OPSD as a gated auxiliary objective while keeping RL as the primary optimization backbone, substantially improves over GRPO, avoids the instability of naive GRPO+OPSD, and consistently outperforms hybrid RL--OPSD baselines across model scales.

2605.15164.tldr: It is argued that behavioural assurance, even when carefully designed, is being asked to carry safety claims it cannot verify, and the concept of fragile assurance is introduced to describe cases where the evidential structure does not support the asserted safety claim.

2605.15168.tldr: A retrieval-augmented multimodal alignment framework that bridges this gap to improve the temporal precision of absolute clinical timelines extracted from text and shows that aligning these modalities can produce a more temporally faithful and clinically informative reconstruction of patient trajectories than either source alone.

2605.15171.tldr: EviScreen is introduced, an evidential reasoning framework for disease screening that leverages region-level evidence from historical cases that achieves superior performance on carefully established benchmarks for real-world disease screening, yielding notably higher specificity at clinical-level recall.

2605.15179.tldr: The introduction of Shodh-MoE, a sparse-activated latent transformer architecture for multi-physics transport that supports sparse expert routing as a practical architectural mechanism for mitigating multi-physics interference in universal neural operators.

2605.15185.tldr: PDI-Bench (Perspective Distortion Index), a quantitative framework for auditing geometric coherence in generated videos, is introduced, revealing consistent geometry-specific failure modes that are not captured by common perceptual metrics and provides a diagnostic signal for progress toward physically grounded video generation and physical world model.

2605.15188.tldr: This work builds FutureSim, a grounded simulations that replay real-world events in the order they occurred while interacting with a chronological replay of the world, where agents forecast world events beyond their knowledge cutoff while interacting with a chronological replay of the world.

2605.15198.tldr: This work proposes ATLAS, a framework in which a single discrete word, termed as a functional token, serves both as an agentic operation and a latent visual reasoning unit, and hopes it offers a new paradigm inspiring future visual reasoning research.

2605.15199.tldr: Experiments show that cross-shot entity consistency degrades sharply with recurrence distance in existing methods, and that explicit per-entity memory yields the highest character fidelity and presence among methods evaluated.

2506.12060.tldr: This qualitative research employs systematic document analysis and comparative case study methodology to examine how 25 studies from 2022 to 2025 document organizational adaptation of threat modeling frameworks, revealing a shift away from traditional signature-based systems toward AI-capable frameworks across three primary patterns.

2508.19830.tldr: Frequency-aware Gradient Rectification is proposed, a target-agnostic training framework for robust calibration that significantly improves calibration under diverse shifts while preserving ID performance, and it remains compatible with post-hoc calibration methods.

2503.07482.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach -- Bayesian Membership Inference Attack (BMIA), which performs conditional attack through Bayesian sampling, and applies Laplace approximation to a single reference model to obtain a posterior over model parameters, enabling direct estimation of the conditional score distribution.

2502.12851.tldr: This paper introduces MeMo, a novel architecture for language modeling that explicitly memorizes sequences of tokens in layered associative memories, and experiments with the MeMo architecture, showing the memorization power of the one-layer and the multi-layer configurations.

2404.14928.tldr: How LLMs can be utilized to enhance the quality of graph features, alleviate the reliance on labeled data, and address challenges such as graph Heterophily and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) generalization is explored.

2505.22934.tldr: This paper proposes Orthogonal Subspaces for Robust model Merging (OSRM) to constrain the LoRA subspace prior to fine-tuning, ensuring that updates relevant to one task do not adversely shift outputs for others.

2502.04671.tldr: ProofWala is presented, a multilingual proof engineering framework built around the itp-interface, a reusable library for programmatic interaction with ITPs, and it is demonstrated that multilingual training across Lean and Rocq enables cross-lingual and cross-domain transfer.

2411.19463.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive study of three universal RAG deployment decisions: whether to deploy RAG, how much information to retrieve, and how to integrate retrieved knowledge effectively, and establishes foundational insights for principled RAG deployment.

2509.10078.tldr: Overall, this study shows that human psychometric questionnaires are insufficient tools for predicting LLM behavior and suggests generation-based profiling as a more accurate measure.

2507.11075.tldr: Tests show that joint angle-based refinement (JAR) outperforms the state-of-the-art HPE refinement network in challenging cases like figure skating and breaking and demonstrates great potential to rectify existing datasets.

2507.05488.tldr: OLG++ introduces richer node and edge types, including spatial, temporal, party group, defeasibility, and logical grouping constructs, enabling nuanced representations of legal obligations, exceptions, and hierarchies, in a semantic extension of the Obligation Logic Graph.

2502.04554.tldr: This framework unifies and reinterprets existing methods like Data Shapley through the lens of approximate dynamic programming, revealing them as myopic linear approximations to the sequential problem and proposes an efficient bipartite graph-based surrogate that preserves submodular structure while enabling scalable greedy selection with provable guarantees.

2501.01926.tldr: A Cross-Modal Attention Calibration (CMAC) method to mitigate hallucinations in LVLMs in a training-free manner and experimental results validate the superiority of the method over existing state-of-the-art techniques in reducing hallucinations for LVLM.

2503.08679.tldr: It is shown that unfaithful CoT also occurs on naturally worded, non-adversarial prompts without adding artificial biases or editing model outputs, and that while CoT can be useful for assessing outputs, it is not a complete account of the internal process that produced the model's answer and should be used with caution in agentic or safety-critical settings.

2508.08204.tldr: This work evaluations a collection of inference-time uncertainty measures, using both established metrics and novel variations, to determine how closely they align with both human group-level uncertainty and traditional notions of model calibration to find evidence of strong alignment to human uncertainty, even despite the lack of alignment to human answer preference.

2503.14190.tldr: It is shown that combining distillation with Reinforcement Learning (RL) can improve the performance for small language models to approach that of large proprietary reasoning models.

2409.14583.tldr: It is observed that efforts to reduce gender and racial bias often lead to outcomes that may over-index one sub-class, potentially exacerbating the issue and highlighting the limitations of current bias mitigation techniques and underscore the need for more effective approaches.

2411.13865.tldr: This work proposes HERec, a hyperbolic framework that effectively balances exploration and exploitation in recommender systems, and introduces two key innovations: a semantic-enhanced hierarchical mechanism that aligns rich textual descriptions with collaborative information directly in hyperbolic space.

2506.14842.tldr: PictSure, a vision-only ICL family of models that demonstrates the potential of easy-to-use fusion transformer architectures, as well as the need for better embedding representations across a wider range of image domains, and shows that the bottleneck in visual ICL is representation quality, not fusion-module training diversity.

2506.11653.tldr: This work introduces the Standard Anti-Causal Model (SAM), a unifying causal framework that characterizes bias mechanisms and yields a conditional independence criterion for causal stability, and proposes DISCO and sDISCO, efficient and scalable estimators of conditional distance correlation that enable independence regularization in gradient-based models.

2502.15224.tldr: This work introduces Auto-Discovery-Bench, a deterministic oracle-guided diagnostic benchmark in which agents recover hidden structures through repeated hypothesis--intervention--feedback cycles, and shows that limitations in maintaining and integrating long-range structured information are an important bottleneck for oracle-guided discovery.

2509.22335.tldr: Targeting spectral collapse directly, the Kronecker factored approximation of the Hessian is discussed, which motivates two regularization enhancements: maintaining high effective feature rank and applying L2 penalties, and experiments confirm that combining these two regularizers effectively preserves plasticity.

2509.00834.tldr: This paper proposes a novel method to incorporate Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces (LTLf) into the training process of autoregressive sequence predictors by introducing a differentiable logical loss function, defined using a soft approximation of LTLf semantics and the Gumbel-Softmax trick, which can be combined with standard predictive losses.

2507.09766.tldr: Reinforced Graph-based Physics-informed Networks with Dynamic Weighting is introduced, a unified framework for spatio-temporal degradation modeling and adaptive physics-guided regularization that improves physical plausibility without requiring a full first-principles model for each asset type.

2503.05641.tldr: Skill-MoE, a symbolic, skill-based, and gradient-free Mixture-of-Experts framework for instance-level expert selection, achieves an average absolute improvement over the best baseline and generalizes well to unseen tasks and outperforms discussion-based methods without requiring expensive multi-round interactions.

2401.17010.tldr: The finetuned WizardCoder model achieves improvement in ROC AUC and F1 measures on balanced and imbalanced vulnerability datasets over CodeBERT-like model, demonstrating the effectiveness of adapting pretrained LLMs for vulnerability detection in source code.

2510.03259.tldr: MAPR (Meta-Awareness via Predictive Reward) utilizes a self-generated task of predicting rollout statistics - specifically length, pass-rate, and concepts used - allowing for verification against the actual statistics.

2509.24696.tldr: This work proposes T-POP (Test-Time Personalization with Online Preference Feedback), a novel algorithm that synergistically combines test-time alignment with dueling bandits that achieves rapid and data-efficient personalization, significantly outperforming existing baselines and showing consistent improvement with more user interactions.

2509.23544.tldr: This work introduces E2M (End-to-End Metric regression), a deep learning framework for predicting metric space-valued outputs that establishes theoretical guarantees, including a universal approximation theorem that characterizes the expressive capacity of the model and a convergence analysis of the entropy-regularized training objective.

2505.13273.tldr: EMoE, a training-free method that separates expert-specific computation paths at an early MoE layer, uses the same initial noise across paths, and measures variance among their latent representations after the first denoising step, provides an uncertainty-aware prompt signal before full image generation, without auxiliary networks or training diffusion ensembles.

2504.03635.tldr: This work study the minimal parameter budget required for implicit reasoning, defined as the ability to infer new facts from learned knowledge without explicit chain-of-thought supervision, and identifies a scaling law linking this optimal parameter budget to a graph search entropy measure.

2503.06473.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach to quantify redundancy by leveraging the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between adjacent layers and introduces an Enhanced Beta Quantile Mapping (EBQM) method that accurately identifies and skips redundant layers, thereby maintaining model stability.

2501.04424.tldr: A neuro-symbolic approach that combines a transformer for proposal generation with combinatorial search using a domain-specific language to narrow the search space by proposing promising search directions, which allows the combinatorial search to find the actual solution in short time.

2411.15240.tldr: PAT is an open-source foundation model for wearable movement time series that combines week-long temporal modeling, psychiatric outcome evaluation, and reproducibility on public data that consistently outperformed non-foundation-model baselines across mental health prediction tasks.

2507.15336.tldr: M-DESIGN features an adaptive retrieval mechanism that quickly calibrates the evolving transferability of edit-effect evidence from different sources and introduces predictive task planners that extrapolate gains from multi-hop evidence, thereby reducing reliance on an exhaustive repository.

2504.21427.tldr: This work proposes MPEC (Manifold-Preserved EEG Classification via an Ensemble of Clustering-Based Classifiers), that introduces two key innovations: a feature engineering phase that combines covariance matrices and Radial Basis Function kernels to capture both linear and non-linear relationships among EEG channels, and a clustering phase that employs a modified K-means algorithm tailored for the Riemannian manifold space.

2508.01815.tldr: SchemaForge is presented, a schema-grounded agentic framework for text-to-SPARQL over heterogeneous KG collections that improves executable query generation over heterogeneous knowledge graphs.

2506.21278.tldr: Experiments on image and molecular sequence data demonstrate that spCauchy-VAEs provide a robust and scalable alternative for generative modeling with hyperspherical latent representations.

2406.09953.tldr: DAG-Plan is introduced, a novel task planning framework that for the first time employs a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) as the central representation for dual-arm coordination, demonstrating that a principled, graph-based representation is the key to unlocking efficient and reliable LLM-based planning for complex robotic systems.

2508.12551.tldr: TuneAgent is presented, an agentic Linux kernel tuning framework powered by rule-based reinforcement learning (RL) that formulates the kernel space as a constrained RL environment, enabling large language models to autonomously explore the kernel while enforcing valid and precise configuration modifications.

2506.22271.tldr: This work reveals how linear output layers limit KGEs and motivates non-linear alternatives for scaling to large and dense graphs and considers a non-linear output layer using mixtures to break the bottleneck.

2504.06006.tldr: This work explores the use of large language models (LLMs) for hyperparameter optimization by fine-tuning a parameter-efficient version of Code Llama using LoRA, demonstrating that LLM-based optimization not only rivals established Bayesian methods like Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE), but also accelerates tuning for real-world applications requiring perceptual quality and low-latency processing.

2506.08137.tldr: A novel iterative framework IGraSS is developed, combining a semantic segmentation module—incorporating RGB and additional modalities—with a graph-based ground-truth refinement module, which serves as a robust framework for both refining noisy ground truth and mapping canal networks from remote sensing imagery.

2410.02511.tldr: This paper introduces a systematic approach, termed LEMAE, choosing to channel informative task-relevant guidance from a knowledgeable Large Language Model (LLM) for Efficient Multi-Agent Exploration, which outperforms existing SOTA approaches on the challenging benchmarks by a large margin.

2111.03861.tldr: This study evaluates the sensitivity of augmentations with regards to the model's hyper parameters along with their consistency and influence by performing a Local Surrogate (LIME) interpretation on the impact of hyper-parameters when different augmentations are applied to a machine learning model.

2504.10552.tldr: LEMUR is an open-source dataset and framework that provides a large collection of PyTorch-based neural networks across tasks such as classification, segmentation, detection, and natural language processing and is extensible, allowing researchers to add new models, datasets, or metrics without breaking compatibility.

2602.18008.tldr: The Neural-Integrated Mechanistic Modeling (NIMM) benchmark is introduced, which evaluates LLM-generated neural-integrated mechanistic models across three scientific domains and proposes NIMMGen, a tree-guided agentic framework that enables diversified exploration via branch-level search and improves solutions through atomic model refinement.

2604.03789.tldr: An automated framework that integrates natural language reasoning with formal verification to tackle research-level mathematical problems and illustrates a promising paradigm for mathematical research in which informal and formal reasoning systems, equipped with theorem retrieval tools, operate in tandem to produce verifiable results, reduce human effort, and support human-AI collaborative mathematical research.

2603.07109.tldr: Findings show that current VLMs fail to maintain transformation-invariant representations of physical properties across dynamic scenes, and ConservationBench evaluating conservation -- whether physical quantities remain invariant under transformations.

2603.26779.tldr: This paper investigates whether equipping an LLM with an external ``Imagery Module''-- a tool capable of rendering and rotating 3D models -- can bridge this gap, functioning as a ``cognitive prosthetic.

2602.18195.tldr: This work proposes LERD, an end-to-end Bayesian latent event--relational dynamical system that infers latent neural events and their relational structure directly from multichannel EEG without event or interaction annotations.

2605.12969.tldr: ConSPO is proposed, a Contrastive Sequence-level Policy Optimization method that uses length-normalized sequence log-probabilities as rollout scores and contrasts verified positive rollouts against negative distractors within the same group.

2603.02237.tldr: This work views representation steering through the lens of optimal transport (OT), noting that standard difference-in-means steering implicitly corresponds to the OT map between two identical distributions with differing first moments, yielding a global translation.

2602.22221.tldr: Reliability in the Chinese web ecosystem shows that reliability depends not only on whether systems are correct when they answer, but also on how often they answer, how they handle negative claims, and where information demand may increase exposure risks.

2604.09877.tldr: Genie 4D is presented, a framework that turns hand-held phone capture into a semantically grounded, action-controllable 4D world model and offers a practical, semantic-prior-guided path toward physically grounded world models.

2604.09041.tldr: This work introduces U-Cast, a probabilistic forecaster built on a standard U-Net backbone trained with a simple recipe: deterministic pre-training on Mean Absolute Error followed by short probabilistic fine-tuning on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) using Monte Carlo Dropout for stochasticity.

2603.03312.tldr: This work proposes SemKey, a novel multi-stage framework that enforces signal-grounded generation through four decoupled semantic objectives: sentiment, topic, length, and surprisal, and breaks the BLEU Trap by establishing a comprehensive evaluation protocol.

2603.00829.tldr: This work studies constitutional black-box monitors: prompted classifiers that detect scheming using only externally observable inputs and outputs, optimized on synthetic data generated from natural-language behavior specifications, demonstrating that monitors selected purely on synthetic data can generalize to more realistic environments, capturing a meaningful scheming signal.

2604.10169.tldr: A reinforced heterogeneous distillation framework for real-time multi-agent trajectory prediction that combines efficient temporal filtering with shifted-window spatial attention, and decodes maneuver-specific futures through a sparse Mixture-of-Experts head is proposed.

2604.04937.tldr: Pramana is introduced, a novel approach that teaches LLMs explicit epistemological methodology by fine-tuning on Navya-Nyaya logic, a 2,500-year-old Indian reasoning framework that provides cognitive scaffolding absent from standard reasoning approaches.

2605.30122.tldr: Results suggest that quantile regression provides a simple alternative to standard pointwise losses without requiring a new architecture or generative sampling procedure, and is useful for risk-sensitive prediction of heavy precipitation.

2606.00023.tldr: This work introduces a comprehensive trustworthiness benchmark tailored to LDMs (TrustLDM), evaluating safety, privacy, and fairness across different LDM architectures with multiple categories of static post contexts, and proposes TrustLDM-Auto, an automatic evaluation framework that leverages LDM decoding flexibility to systematically identify vulnerable configurations.

2606.00012.tldr: This paper constructs the first publicly available English multimodal dataset DraDDP for multi-party dialogue discourse parsing, based on American TV dramas, and establishes comprehensive benchmarks by evaluating this task on DraDDP and conducting in-depth analysis on the impact of different modalities.

2606.00007.tldr: A deliberative curation protocol combining three governance layers, including a knowledge artifact lifecycle formalized as a labeled transition system; reputation-weighted deliberative voting integrating Beta Reputation with EigenTrust amplification; and graduated sanctions adapted for stateless agents, including broken agent handling distinguishing malfunction from adversarial behavior is proposed.

2606.00005.tldr: The Consilium Protocol is presented, a Byzantine Fault Tolerance-derived architecture for structured multi-model AI deliberation that treats inter-model disagreement as epistemic signal rather than error and introduces an In-Sample/Out-of-Sample validation framework adapted from quantitative finance to distinguish training-data consensus from empirically grounded conclusions.

2605.17839.tldr: BiKD is proposed -- a bilevel framework that dynamically balances hard and soft losses for each sample that surpasses recent balanced distillation methods across imbalance factors.

2606.00017.tldr: Delayed per-step reward attribution with eligibility gating, an episode lifecycle and postprocessing pipeline that computes rewards only at episode end, propagates them back to originating steps according to task-specific semantics, and excludes steps that lack valid dependent information from training.

2606.00016.tldr: It is shown that attention maps exhibit recurring local structures whose relative frequencies differ consistently between human- and AI-generated text across datasets and proxy models, suggesting that attention-based attribution maps provide a complementary and interpretable signal for AI-generated text detection.

2606.00011.tldr: It is shown that mismatch-based failure cues and prospective impact previews can support failure-aware human-AI model editing, while also revealing a local-global tradeoff: edits that help a specific case can degrade performance when transferred globally.

2606.00008.tldr: Experiments on challenging multi-objective benchmarks involving activity, synthesizability, and ADMET-related properties show that ATOM consistently achieves improved Pareto coverage and hypervolume over strong baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of pathwise multi-agent coordination for molecular optimization.

2605.30169.tldr: It is argued that identity-based, ex post, regulative, sanction-based governance, such as reputation, is structurally inapplicable to dissociative agents, and a shift to observability-based, ex ante, constitutive, protocol-based behavioral harnesses is suggested.

2605.30000.tldr: A new evaluation regime that is simultaneously reference-free, autonomously driven, and holistically reasoned, and instantiate it through two artifacts is articulate, grounded in Flavell's metacognitive monitoring.

2606.00029.tldr: This work proposes Temporal Context Augmented Retrieval Generation (TCAR-Gen), a framework that combines query-conditioned graph neural networks, temporal evidence fusion, and chain-of-trees reasoning to ground answer generation in retrieved evidence.

2606.00021.tldr: This work proposes SENSE (Semantic Embedding Navigation with Soft-gated Evaluation with Soft-gated Evaluation), which establishes robust semantic alignment, which empowers the Soft-gated Evaluation module to validate semantic equivalence rather than surface forms.

2606.00020.tldr: CSRP is proposed, a three-stage framework that progressively builds correction capability through Continual Pre-training (CPT) on 5.9M balanced samples to internalize domain knowledge, Chain-of-Thought SFT with explicit error reasoning for diagnostic transparency, and Group Relative Policy Optimization with a novel Efficiency-Aware Reward that explicitly penalizes unnecessary edits.

2605.30290.tldr: This work proposes self-trained verification (STV), a model that roughly doubles accuracy on hard math and lifts it 14x on scientific reasoning tasks and turns this asymmetry into a supervision target and train the verifier to imitate a more informed version of itself.

2606.00018.tldr: Paired analysis of clinician-edited portions of ambient AI drafts and final notes revealed substantial heterogeneity in hedging prevalence, pre-to-post changes in hedging mentions, and directionality.

2606.00014.tldr: DOPA is proposed, a demonstration search framework that incorporates an OOD proxy to approximate the inaccessible target domain and guide the retrieval process and introduces a Mahalanobis distance-based global diversity constraint to ensure sufficient diversity among the retrieved demonstrations.

2606.00013.tldr: The results indicated that an AI model with a reasoning component affected the opinion of participants to a degree comparable to that of a human majority, suggesting that even moral judgements, despite their sensitivity and personal significance, may be susceptible to algorithmic conformity.

2605.27701.tldr: Frost Training improves the model's ability to generate high-scoring outputs, reaching higher maximum scores in a best-of-k setting, and does so at an increased speed.

2605.17909.tldr: Ethical Hyper-Velocity (EHV), a governance-aware runtime enforcement architecture for agentic systems that combines Grammar-Constrained Decoding for inline policy-constrained token generation, Causal Graph CRDT-based policy synchronization with vector-clock ordering, hardware-attested execution in Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), and OSCAL-formatted machine-readable audit logging is presented.

2605.17554.tldr: Each agent fails distinctively: Claude leads on data fabrication and file-access failures; o3 propagates cascading computation errors; Gemini oscillates between the highest perfect-verifier rate and the most catastrophic collapses.

2606.00027.tldr: A multi-domain red teaming framework evaluating eleven contemporary LLMs demonstrates that performance variance and worst-case failures provide more clinically meaningful reliability indicators than mean accuracy alone, and that hybrid evaluation approaches combining automation with clinician oversight are essential for credible safety assessment.

2606.00022.tldr: This paper describes the system for the SemEval-2026 Task-1 (MWAHAHA), which focuses on humor generation under explicit constraints, and proposes an interpretable pipeline that converts labeled comparisons into a preference model.

2606.00019.tldr: Clinician editing can be a net source of stigmatizing language entering the EHR with using Ambient AI, suggesting clinician editing can be a net source of stigmatizing language entering the EHR with using Ambient AI.

2606.00015.tldr: SortingHat is a personalized digital teaching assistant tailored specifically for OS education that integrates advanced AI technologies, including a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), to deliver adaptive, scalable, and effective educational support.

2606.00010.tldr: A human-centered AI framework that integrates empathic and agentic approaches grounded in the American Nurses Association’s code of ethics to support nurses in the United States in cancer care navigation is discussed.

2605.25143.tldr: Stochastic backtracking over a persistent pool of historical prefixes is introduced, allowing test-time compute to revisit previously generated states instead of only expanding the current frontier.

2606.00121.tldr: The proposed MindDiffuser framework significantly enhances the performance of previous state-of-the-art models, highlighting the effectiveness and versatility of the approach and providing guidance for future neural decoding efforts across different brain signal modalities.

2606.00104.tldr: This work proposes a planner-executor agent for PX4-based drones that decouples high-level mission planning from low-level control, and demonstrates its feasibility in PX4 software-in-the-loop simulations in Gazebo.

2606.00095.tldr: A Hierarchical Semantic-Geometric Map (HSGM) is proposed that transforms 3D geometric information into a structured representation compatible with VLMs, effectively linking them to the physical world.

2606.00082.tldr: Hoeffding Concept Bottleneck Models (HCBM) are introduced, which build on the Hoeffding functional decomposition of gradient-boosted trees to provide non-linear and sparse aggregations of concept scores, and generate compact predictions using prime implicants.

2606.00081.tldr: DAStatFormer is proposed, a hybrid multibranch Transformer that combines compact multidomain statistical features with Gated Transformer Networks and achieves up to 99.4% accuracy and near-perfect real-world performance, while using significantly fewer parameters and lower inference cost than models such as DASFormer and DeepViT.

2606.00080.tldr: It is found that a supervised classifier matches or exceeds CLIP-style training when trained using taxonomic lineage as text when trained using taxonomic lineage as text, highlighting the limitations of current biological foundation models in marine imaging domains.

2606.00065.tldr: VLM-integrated ComProScanner is established as the first materials-specific, fully automated, multimodal literature mining platform capable of extracting structured composition-property data from text, tables, and figures within a single unified pipeline.

2606.00047.tldr: It is argued that model-level governance becomes less effective when capability progress is increasingly driven by "non-model gains"--improvements that are independent from advances in the base model.

2606.00044.tldr: It is argued that the architecture of clinical AI systems already functions as de facto medical regulation, reshaping liability and the standard of care, and proposed a dialectical standard of care that treats the integrated AI-physician dyad as the singular responsible diagnostic entity.

2606.00038.tldr: A five-stage AI Literacy Continuum is proposed that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education and complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD.

2606.00045.tldr: The UQT is introduced, a fundamentally novel, quantum-native computing architecture that uses the physical properties of multi-qubit systems as a universal inductive bias for exact mathematical and algebraic reasoning and establishes parameterized quantum topology as a universally superior physical substrate for exact artificial intelligence.

2606.00116.tldr: A novel architecture of KAN-based BiGRU model for the task of classification and summarization of legal documents in a low-resource multilingual setup is introduced and the proposed technique is compared to several baselines, including classical ML algorithms and pretrained language models.

2606.00109.tldr: VDSB-GWSyn is proposed, a Diffusion Schr\"{o}dinger Bridge (DSB) model-based framework, enabling synthesis of controllable, high-fidelity guidewire samples under complex anatomical backgrounds, and its core design philosophy of controllable device synthesis with strict background preservation and anatomical feasibility constraints has the potential to transfer to other interventional device perception tasks where annotated data are scarce.

2606.00107.tldr: A motif-based framework is proposed that defines beat-aligned ECG motifs as interpretable cardiac signatures and quantifies morphological drift and deviation across short and long-term monitoring, supporting scalable longitudinal monitoring and early detection of morphology-driven change.

2606.00091.tldr: DLLM-JEPA is introduced, which pairs JEPA with masked-diffusion language models to eliminate both costs at once and exhibits a dual-win property: on LLaDA-8B with the Wide-t configuration, it simultaneously raises GSM8K accuracy and drives held-out Wikitext loss below the pre-trained base, and preserves MMLU accuracy at base level across three fine-tuning seeds.

2606.00084.tldr: SentimentLens is a scalable analysis system based on Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis that performs knowledge extraction from unstructured hotel reviews and organizes them into interpretable service categories, supporting data-driven decision-making for hospitality management and tourism policy.

2606.00077.tldr: This paper first conducts an ablation study showing the projected component also carries information about the token correlation, which should not be ignored, and proposes to extend Belief-Attention by making use of both the perpendicular and projected components.

2606.00054.tldr: This survey provides a unified view of how human videos are transformed into effective knowledge for VLA models and categorizes existing approaches into four classes based on the action-related information they derive, thereby informing future research directions.

2606.00051.tldr: Evaluation of EDA agents should treat average quality, repeatability, and condition sensitivity as complementary dimensions of operational trustworthiness, according to a framework that combines mean score, coefficient of variation, exploratory cross-condition significance tests, and Business utility.

2606.00039.tldr: This work proposes an anti-caste approach to tackle the issue of caste bias and fairness in AI systems by drawing on a conceptual frame challenging Brahminical Normativity to show how caste biases are perpetuated beyond the simple binaries of upper vs lower-caste categories.

2606.00108.tldr: The SPARROW platform, a hardware and software open-source platform that integrates solar energy, edge artificial intelligence, and satellite communication to enable continuous, autonomous biodiversity monitoring in remote environments, demonstrated robust real-time classification and adaptive power management.

2606.00101.tldr: This work introduces CoCoVideo-26K, a contrastive, commercial-model-based AIGC video dataset covering 13 mainstream commercial generators and providing semantically aligned real-fake video pairs, and proposes CoCoDetect, a detection framework integrating contrastive learning with confidence-gated multimodal large language model (MLLM) inference.

2606.00046.tldr: TwistedHumor is introduced, a dataset of 1,211 YouTube Shorts paired with 33,041 related comments, with hand annotations for humor presence, humor type, harm, topic, rhetorical devices, and stand up context, and is evaluated against large language models against human annotations and finds that they perform better on stand up comedy compared to shorter jokes.

2606.00033.tldr: It is proposed that auditing MI itself is essential for its application in AI safety, industry, and governance, and constructive debate over the necessity, design and implementation of such a framework are encouraged.

2606.00106.tldr: The speed-accuracy trade-off is established as a controllable design variable validated on public P300-based paradigms, enabling transparent evaluation and application-specific optimization of BCIs.

2606.00105.tldr: Visual-Noise Guided In-Context Distillation (VGID), a distillation-based framework for MLLM unlearning, is proposed, a distillation-based framework for MLLM unlearning that achieves strong unlearning effectiveness while preserving competitive model utility.

2606.00096.tldr: This paper identifies a tool-use collapse phenomenon and suggests a training-time view of tools as scaffolding, where broader exploration over language generation and visual tool invocation improves reasoning despite tool-use collapse.

2606.00094.tldr: The Data Manifold-aware Image diffusioN moDel (MIND), a novel framework that explicitly models manifold geometry by integrating discrete patch tokenization into the score function of a continuous diffusion model, successfully leverages both the structural quantification capabilities of discrete tokens and the parallel generation flexibility of continuous diffusion.

2606.00090.tldr: The resulting analysis develops a bounded problem formulation, a definition of silent physical-action failure, a taxonomy of runtime guardrail functions, and evaluation requirements for comparing guardrails as Physical AI assurance mechanisms.

2606.00089.tldr: Physical admissibility is formulated as a prediction-control interface: before execution, a decoded proposal is treated as candidate dynamics and evaluated using kinematic, dynamic, and direct-to-composed horizon conditions, and the full physical-admissibility gate is formulated.

2606.00083.tldr: This work proposes Demo2Reward a test-time adaptation technique to optimize the language instruction of a reward model based on a few demonstrations to reduce false positives while preserving true positives, and shows that Demo2Reward consistently outperforms existing zero- and few-shot VLM reward models across a range of simulated robotic tasks and policy backbones.

2606.00049.tldr: It is revealed that bias remains prevalent across different protected attributes and datasets even after applying mitigation strategies, highlighting the need for more effective approaches to reduce bias in AI-driven code generation systems.

2606.00037.tldr: A framework is proposed that models system change through trustworthiness profiles and trustworthiness levels, and uses threshold-based disclosure to surface materially relevant within-envelope change to different stakeholders over time and derive practical implications for lifecycle documentation, post-market monitoring, and update disclosure.

2606.00120.tldr: Experimental results show that SpikeWFM consistently outperforms conventional ANN-based WFMs in both pre-training convergence and channel prediction accuracy, while maintaining strong generalization capabilities across diverse wireless scenarios.

2606.00119.tldr: Results show that the proposed pose-conditioned, permutation-equivariant predictive denoiser for multi-anchor UWB ranging substantially improves range accuracy, cone localization, and work zone geometry reconstruction in challenging NLOS-dominated regimes.

2606.00103.tldr: A multi-turn interactive framework for reasoning evaluation that treats reasoning as active evidence acquisition and belief updating is introduced, showing that contextual perturbations cause moderate but consistent declines, whereas counterfactual revision and necessity judgment lead to much larger drops.

2606.00100.tldr: CoilDrop-MRI is extensively validated on multi-site, multi-field-strength, and multi-modality datasets and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art self-supervised methods, achieving quality comparable to supervised reconstruction methods without requiring fully sampled reference training data.

2606.00087.tldr: EviOSAHS provides an auditable, high-sensitivity workflow for binary pre-polysomnography OSAHS screening, but should be viewed as a triage assistant rather than a diagnostic system.

2606.00079.tldr: Experiments across multiple MoE LLMs show that BitsMoE substantially reduces downstream task accuracy degradation in ultra-low-bit regimes, and the model and code are publicly available at https://github.com/zjiayu064/BitsMoE.

2606.00078.tldr: This proof-of-concept study presents a task-aware flow-based generative framework -- a reformulation of the conventional Flow Matching training paradigm with a flow model trained to optimize subsampling in compressed sensing applications that substantially enhance the performance of compressed sensing for image classification, image reconstruction, and MRI acceleration.

2606.00074.tldr: Closed-Loop Seizure Prediction with Real-time EEG Quality Assessment is proposed, a unified framework that embeds a lightweight signal quality estimator directly within the prediction pipeline and outputs a structured four-tuple directly compatible with closed-loop neurostimulator interfaces.

2606.00073.tldr: It is shown that the functional connectivity structure is shaped by learning and this structure breaks under weight permutation, which establish 1FC ensembles as a functionally meaningful substrate for input encoding and information transfer, with potential implications in designing targeted fine-grained diagnostics on the information flow.

2606.00052.tldr: The empirical results indicate that the Product-Aware framework performs comparably to the global baseline on standard detection metrics, while offering improved robustness to product-grade-specific operating modes, suggesting that, in flexible manufacturing environments, generalized anomaly detectors can pose non-trivial security risks, motivating a shift toward mode-aware diagnostic architectures.

2606.00050.tldr: A deterministic alternative to embedding-based semantic search, with a synonym caching protocol whose LM fallback rate converges to zero for finite-vocabulary domains, and proves the Byte-Identity Theorem and the Dual-Traversal Ordering Theorem.

2606.00040.tldr: This work contributes to the workshop by demonstrating how process data can characterize GenAI literacy, paving the way for data-driven literacy assessment and real-time interventions.

2606.00031.tldr: A hybrid framework that bridges structured clinical data and natural-language representations for CAD prediction and suggests that combining structured clinical data with LLM-generated narratives can enable new directions for hybrid clinical prediction systems is developed.

2606.00257.tldr: ARCA is introduced, a lightweight alternative that derives token salience from the adapter's own hidden-state residual, rather than where the output distribution appears uncertain or shifted, and requires no learned reward model, value head, or tree construction.

2606.00251.tldr: This work refers to this ability as Capability Self-Assessment (CSA) and forms it as a policy-learning problem, aiming to improve self-assessment while preserving the model's original capabilities, and shows that reinforcement learning teaches CSA effectively.

2606.00189.tldr: This paper describes an agent framework that enables designers to enforce modularity in agentic systems, by defining pseudo-tools that call LLMs recursively on a restricted context, and proposes novel learning methods for the agentic components required by this framework, namely pseudo-tools and fixed workflows.

2606.00180.tldr: To dynamically adapt to varying channel configurations, this work proposes a Cross-Channel Spatial Adaptation module, utilizing a spatial mapping mechanism to effectively resolve the hardware heterogeneity of mismatched channels in multi-center datasets.

2606.00170.tldr: A cross-modal feature fusion network comprising Transformer encoders and multi-head cross-attention modules is constructed, enabling the deep integration of EEG signals and eye-tracking data, and a confidence-aware screening mechanism is introduced that dynamically assesses the predictive reliability of each modality branch on target domain samples.

2606.00169.tldr: This study evaluates the performance of traditional machine learning techniques and compares them with the Unified Multi-Task Time Series Model for churn prediction, a binary time-series classification task, and indicates that conventional methods can still outperform it in terms of predictive performance, data efficiency, and computational resource requirements for training and deployment.

2606.00159.tldr: This paper evaluates physical adversarial patch attacks against an aerial vehicle detector by bridging digital optimization and real-world deployment and indicates that weather-based augmentation does not necessarily improve patch optimization in this domain.

2606.00155.tldr: This work treats network flows as a language whose grammar is written entirely in L3/L4 packet metadata: length, inter-arrival time, TTL, TCP flags, and hashed port numbers, and presents PLM-NIDS, which proves three claims in sequence.

2606.00154.tldr: This work introduces WebIGBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate code generation for interactive webpages with complex interactions, and proposes a novel evaluation pipeline to address the gap in automated assessment of interactive actions.

2606.00151.tldr: This work derives a new policy-gradient formulation for ReMax and introduces ReMax PPO (RePPO), a PPO variant that optimizes ReMax while generalizing the discrete retry count to a continuous parameter, enabling fine-grained control of exploration.

2606.00148.tldr: StemBind reframes AVR evaluation from final-answer ranking to locating where abstract visual reasoning breaks down, identifying rule-to-instance binding as a concrete next target for vision-grounded reasoning.

2606.00147.tldr: Results show that coupling data refinement with trajectory-level preservation provides an effective recipe for domain fine-tuning with alleviated forgetting.

2606.00141.tldr: The findings show that adaptive sensing is not uniformly beneficial, but instead provides the greatest value in underperforming settings, and support selective deployment strategies that tailor adaptive sensing based on baseline performance to improve efficiency in wearable health monitoring.

2606.00134.tldr: The proposed XAI-SOH-FL is an enhanced framework that integrates adaptive aggregation and explainable artificial intelligence into the SOH-FL paradigm, and introduces a dynamic {\gamma} selection mechanism based on similarity thresholding, enabling the aggregation process to adapt to evolving data distributions.

2606.00129.tldr: This study studies whether modern LLMs can serve as a lens for understanding neural representations in the human brain, focusing on emotional valence in EEG, and builds a one-dimensional valence direction, the V-axis, from modern LLMs using only nine emotion-evocative sentences.

2606.00202.tldr: PRAXIS is presented, an algorithm to approximate this Rashomon set with orders of magnitude improvement in runtime and memory usage and it is validated that PRAXIS regularly recovers almost all of the full Rashomon set.

2606.00248.tldr: Geodesic Flow Matching is employed, adapting Riemannian transport dynamics to strictly restrict the denoising flow to the SSP toroidal manifold, and it is demonstrated that manifold-aware cleanup stabilizes path integration against drift and enables a 40% increase in neural efficiency compared to competitive baselines.
