2606.00240.tldr: MindZero is introduced, a self-supervised reinforcement learning framework that trains multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for efficient and robust online mental reasoning and significantly outperforms model-based methods in both accuracy and efficiency, showing that mental reasoning can be effectively learned as a self-supervised skill.

2606.00232.tldr: TIGER is presented, an inference-time framework that redesigns feedback for localized repair that reduces unsupported content while preserving task quality and a CrisisFACTS case study suggests that the same repair mechanism can improve grounding in multi-source settings.

2606.00220.tldr: SEMBridge is a small tagless-final framework for generating weakest-precondition and bounded-checking interpretations from the same executable object programs, keeping executable semantics, weakest-precondition artifacts, and bounded validation synchronized.

2606.00183.tldr: The results identify a mechanistic normal form for transformer-based search, in which attention heads specialize and cooperate to extract decision-relevant traces from context and convert them into agentic action selection via RL training.

2606.00160.tldr: DataShield is proposed to efficiently and effectively identify potential safety-degrading samples in benign datasets and observations that open-ended question answering is more likely to trigger safety degradation, and corresponding responses tend to be longer are observed.

2606.00152.tldr: The experiments show that the unnecessary acquisition of sensitive information is widespread and Prompt-level defences reduce only a small fraction of acquisition-stage leakage, leaving the majority unmitigated, and auditing acquisition-stage privacy both urgent and necessary.

2606.00138.tldr: BaqusAgent is developed to facilitate analysis case generation and execution using Abaqus, one of the most widely used FEA packages, by turning users' natural-language instructions into executed FEA analyses and result visualization and advances the human-simulation interaction paradigm.

2606.00132.tldr: Experiments show that FoLoRA achieves the strongest preservation adaptation balance over baselines, improving target task performance with best aggregate preservation of non target capabilities.

2606.00130.tldr: It is suggested that ADNTNs are a promising, mathematically structured, and hardware-aware route toward much smaller neural networks, provided that optimisation, contraction schedules, and deployment kernels are designed together.

2606.00125.tldr: This work proposes a multimodal framework for session-based music recommendation that enriches the LastFM-1K dataset with three complementary signals: audio and lyric embeddings extracted using pretrained music and text representation models, LLM-generated semantic metadata using the MGPHot annotation schema, and listening completion ratios.

2606.00241.tldr: By reformulating MI estimation as an inference task, InfoAtlas establishes a foundation for real-time dependency analysis and generalizes effectively to complex, real-world scenarios.

2606.00198.tldr: A Budget-Aware Agent (BAGEN) should treat budget as an active control signal, rather than a passive cost metric, and is formalized as progressive interval estimation: at each step of a plan, an agent should predict an upper and lower bound on remaining budget, and alert when completion is unlikely.

2606.00172.tldr: This work proposes CAST, an answer-free self-distillation method for GRPO-style RLVR, which keeps the verifier-grounded GRPO objective, but uses a stop-gradient self-teacher to shape token-level advantages according to trajectory correctness.

2606.00136.tldr: This survey synthesizes emerging research to demonstrate a paradigm shift toward the proactive detection of emerging inauthentic narratives, and adopts a unified, lifecycle-based taxonomy to combine socio-technical lifecycle models of adversarial campaigns with advanced computational methodologies for emerging inauthentic narrative detection.

2606.00135.tldr: This paper systematically analyze tool-calling evaluation pipelines and shows that results can be highly sensitive to seemingly minor, often undocumented implementation choices including the random seed, system prompt, multi-turn template construction, and how prior interaction/reasoning history is carried forward.

2606.00131.tldr: This work uses Magellan, an agentic workflow that evolves the compiler heuristic in Propeller into a fine-grained interprocedural optimizer and fine-tunes the resulting policy hyperparameters to ensure high-fidelity.

2606.00123.tldr: CardioLens is introduced, a leakage-resistant evaluation testbed for multi-sequence Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance (CMR), constructed from private hospital archives through a rigorous report-to-QA construction and verification pipeline, and shows that current MLLMs remain far from reliable CMR interpretation.

2606.00174.tldr: The presented MyoSem is an EMG--action semantic alignment framework that maps low-level EMG signals into a shared semantic space constructed from multi-view action descriptions, enabling bidirectional retrieval between EMG signals and text descriptions.

2606.00161.tldr: Recall rates per-class calculated with confusion matrices, F1 heatmaps, and ROC curves show that minority attack classes, especially those with combined M+L infections, are detected reliably only when using SMOTE balance, which indicates the latest time steps as the most important predictor signals out of 60 steps in a power window.

2606.00157.tldr: It is shown that the training process of DNNs is equivalent to RG calculation on this kind of data and therefore the network can extract main features from the input data just like RG, providing an explanation for the outstanding performance of DNNs on real-world data.

2606.00153.tldr: DiffCrossGait is proposed, which reformulates cross-modal matching as trajectory-level alignment in an identity-relevant latent diffusion space, rather than assuming full equivalence between 2D and 3D observations, and introduces a Tri-Phase Alignment Strategy that exploits varying noise intensities to enforce identity anchoring, dynamics consistency, and cross-modal structural recoverability.

2606.00150.tldr: Experimental results from applying Persona Attack to several widely used LLMs reveal that, as injections accumulate in memory, models increasingly prioritize these instructions over their internal safety alignment mechanisms.

2606.00145.tldr: Completion at the Boundary (CaB) is proposed, which predicts an event-local completion object in the form of Boundary-Phase Tokens (Before/Hit/After), retaining two-sided boundary evidence under this discipline, and improves composite execution and handoff quality on a first-person Minecraft VLA benchmark under matched capacity and deployability constraints.

2606.00144.tldr: BudgetDraft is proposed, a multi-view sparse training method for sparse drafting in mid-to-long inference that recovers acceptance across sparsity levels without extra inference-time components and achieves up to 6.10x end-to-end speedup vs AR at 4K, 8K, and 16K context lengths.

2606.00143.tldr: ReCAP is proposed, a novel framework that integrates CL into PM to address the challenges of dynamic financial environments, and consistently outperforms popular baselines, achieving superior returns in long-term investment horizons and rapid adaptation to regime shifts.

2606.00229.tldr: This model first predicts continuous reasoning in the form of a structured set of continuous thoughts, then reuses them as shared context for chunk-structured action generation, and instantiates continuous reasoning as a shared Gaussian latent interface and trains it with a self-verification objective.

2606.00146.tldr: This work proposes a unified framework combining parameter-informed contrast disentanglement with severity-aware adaptive correction, and demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real-world clinical data acquired with unseen scanning parameters, where existing methods either fail to remove artifacts or introduce additional distortions.

2606.00139.tldr: A unified geodesic framework that integrates tangent-constrained priors with curvature penalization, extending the classical curvature-penalized geodesic models while enforcing mandatory tangent constraints is proposed.

2606.00272.tldr: An expert attorney and LLM-assisted evaluation of the follow-up question approach in FETCH is described and it is shown that while low-cost LLMs perform well at classification tasks, generating high-quality plain-language questions in this setting appears to require a more sophisticated and higher-cost model.

2606.00262.tldr: Results show that a more faithful statistical treatment of hard negatives can improve contrastive objectives, and propose a simple modification of InfoNCE that uses anchor-wise online batch statistics to blend the usual softmax logits with an endpoint shortfall correction, adding no trainable parameters.

2606.00508.tldr: This study proposes V-LynX, a scalable framework that integrates novel modalities into Video LLMs by repurposing the internalized interface, and integrates new sensory inputs with intrinsic video priors by aligning both attention responses and statistical distributions using unpaired unimodal data sets.

2606.00506.tldr: EnergyMamba is proposed, an uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal learning framework for accurate and reliable energy consumption prediction, which comprises a novel Graph-Enhanced Selective State Space Model that injects spatial context learned from the grid topology into the temporal dynamics, enabling coupled spatiotemporal modeling.

2606.00445.tldr: The paper presents the sensor stack, backbone abstraction, fusion path, anomaly head, and current validation of DarkVesselNet, a multi-modal remote sensing stack that combines Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical imagery, geospatial foundation model backbones, AIS trajectory reasoning, TGARD-style gap detection, and a Pi-DPM-inspired anomaly head.

2606.00408.tldr: This work reframe context management as a regime-dependent intervention and provides a holistic perspective for analyzing context use in agentic deep search.

2606.00384.tldr: It is found that VESTA's dynamic tool creation outperforms prior agentic pipelines, with the largest gains on complex and domain-specific tasks.

2606.00380.tldr: This work introduces SUPREME, an open-source framework that distributes these stages across multiple GPUs and makes three contributions: a registry-based design for adding new methods, metrics, models, and scenarios; a multi-GPU architecture supporting multiple accelerators and precision modes.

2606.00367.tldr: The Markov decision contest is proposed as a new problem model for reinforcement learning with pairwise preferences and it is proved that stationary Markov policies are optimal among all history-dependent policies, and that a simple iterative algorithm converges to an optimal policy at a sublinear rate.

2606.00336.tldr: Parameterized Diffusion Policy is proposed, a framework for learning diffusion policies conditioned on low-dimensional, continuous parameters embedded in a learned behavior manifold that enables smooth interpolation between known strategies and efficient adaptation to novel constraints without updating policy weights.

2606.00324.tldr: PrefixMem is proposed, a lightweight SID encoder based on prefix n-gram memory tables that provides the LLM with structured, prefix-conditioned representations at SID token positions that improves deepest-level SID accuracy by up to 46% relative and full-SID retrieval recall by up to 22% relative at matched training compute.

2606.00267.tldr: StressDream effectively steers imaginations toward high-impact yet plausible outcomes specified by text at inference time, such as task failures, enabling robust policy evaluation and improvement by identifying actions whose plausible futures include undesirable outcomes.

2606.00487.tldr: TAPS is proposed, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates and selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree.

2606.00467.tldr: Findings show the limitations of prompt-based correction in annotation tasks, highlighting the importance of definition alignment over text-level memorization.

2606.00435.tldr: Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment (TC-LIA), a model-agnostic method that probes patch-token representations across the layers of a CLIP ViT-H/14 vision encoder, and measures their similarity with the question embedding, tracking whether question-relevant visual evidence emerges across vision layers.

2606.00428.tldr: This paper asks whether a tensorized adapter with finer capacity increments changes the observed accuracy--budget trade-off, and instantiates this question with fixed-component canonical polyadic (CP) tensor adapters.

2606.00402.tldr: A distribution-free statistical framework that converts arbitrary rewrite-based detectors into detectors with finite-sample FDR guarantees without retraining, allowing existing rewrite detectors to inherit finite-sample false discovery rate (FDR) guarantees through a simple calibration procedure.

2606.00370.tldr: This work describes where vanilla LLM generation succeeds and fails for genomics visualization, identifying eight quality dimensions, and compares six schemes--direct generation, a fixed pipeline, and four agentic configurations varying in the number of specialist agents and the presence of a reviewer--across 159 cases spanning three levels of query ambiguity and specification complexity.

2606.00350.tldr: Under degraded data quality, where the baselines visibly struggle, DriftQL remains close to its clean-data performance, positioning it as a promising alternative to diffusion and flow-based methods while maintaining the simplicity and efficiency of deterministic approaches.

2606.00341.tldr: This work highlights the critical need for principled, corrigibility-focused alignment methods in autonomous agents, and shows that agents can exhibit misaligned behavior even in benign settings, taking unsafe actions when those actions are instrumental to task completion.

2606.00313.tldr: This issue is addressed in the context of maneuvering with double-Ackermann-steering mobile robots, which introduce additional constraints due to their non-holonomic nature and a sim-to-sim-to-real approach is adopted, where actuation effects observed in Gazebo are incorporated into the PyBullet training environment.

2606.00308.tldr: This work compares six widely-used multi-agent configurations under two models from the GPT-4o family across all 164 HumanEval tasks using the five RADON complexity metrics (SLOC, cyclomatic complexity, and Halstead Volume, Difficulty, and Effort).

2606.00510.tldr: SelSkill, a dual-granularity preference-learning framework for selective skill invocation, formulates skill use as a skill-or-skip decision, uses predictive uncertainty to prioritize candidate decision points, and constructs controlled invoke-skip preference pairs from shared trajectory prefixes.

2606.00503.tldr: TabChange is proposed, an approach that analyzes the relationship between the attribute of interest and other attributes in the dataset and generates counterfactuals in attributes that are comparable in naturalness and are more proximal to their original instances.

2606.00462.tldr: Results show that finetuning improves semantic fidelity, reduces hallucinations, and increases preference win rate against GPT-5-chat rewrites, suggesting that targeted adaptation for SLMs can substantially narrow the gap to cloud models and provide practical guidance for adapting SLMs to precision-critical rewrite tasks.

2606.00447.tldr: The repository state, the mathematical kernel implemented in geosam3d.propagate, the feature head trained from Segment Anything masks, and the validation already present in the codebase are described, which separates implementation validation, graph propagation quality, leakage control, and interactive latency.

2606.00440.tldr: Set-distance rewards are established as a unified signal for both post-training and test-time scaling in chest X-ray report generation and enable test-time best-of-N$ selection.

2606.00417.tldr: This paper introduces AgentxGCore, which leverages an Agentic AI-Native layer to extend the 3GPP architecture and enable a system based on the existing APIs across the Beyond Next Generation Core (xGC) domain, and establishes an AI-driven closed-loop for continuous optimization based on real-time information.

2606.00395.tldr: Predictive Routing Replay (PR2) is proposed, which augments each router with a lightweight evolution predictor that learns to anticipate short-horizon router evolution and reduces routing-induced mismatch, improves RL stability, and yields stronger performance across various reasoning benchmarks.

2606.00392.tldr: This work proposes Detector Evasion Policy Optimization (DEPO), a Lagrangian primal-dual reinforcement learning algorithm with a novel GRPO-style group-based policy update that adaptively balances semantic preservation and detector evasion during training, enabling the policy to improve attack success within a prescribed semantic-preservation region.

2606.00357.tldr: This work proposes Preference Delta Aggregation (PDA), the first framework that derives a preference delta from each weak-weaker model pair, instantiates it as a LoRA adapter learned through preference optimization, and aggregates the resulting deltas via LoRA merging.

2606.00306.tldr: The analysis reveals an asymmetric effect: temperature substantially enriches FKL with non-dominant token signals, whereas it mainly rescales RKL gradients, causing FKL to benefit much more from $\tau$ scaling than RKL.

2606.00305.tldr: Trajectory-aware OPD is proposed, which uses near-future trajectory information to identify real divergent states and distribute guidance across multiple future tokens.

2606.00270.tldr: This work introduces a novel shielding framework for robust MDPs (RMDPs), i.e., MDPs with sets of transition probabilities, and proves that every policy admissible by the shield is safe, and conversely, every safe RMDP policy is admissible by the shield.

2606.00275.tldr: This work proposes AsyMoE, a novel architecture that explicitly models this asymmetry in visual and linguistic modalities with symmetric architectures through three specialized expert groups, and achieves consistent improvements over baseline methods.

2606.00269.tldr: CTRL-STEER is proposed, a closed-loop framework that replaces static intervention strength with adaptive, time-varying control signals that achieves more stable concept regulation and a better steering-task success trade-off than fixed-coefficient baselines, without modifying or retraining the base model.

2606.00448.tldr: SkillReact is presented, a compositional security measurement framework with three components: a deterministic static-composition benchmark, a two-rater LLM-assisted human-adjudication pipeline, and an action-based exploitability harness that motivates install-time compositional checks and capability isolation as complements to per-skill scanning.

2606.00424.tldr: This work studies a more tractable form of weak supervision: using a weak model as a critic rather than as a labeler or judge, and proposes progressive on-policy critique distillation (**OPCD**), which filters high-quality critiques and distills critic-guided behavior into the strong model through adaptive self-teacher signals.

2606.00315.tldr: A novel hybrid framework to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) in inorganic synthesis planning is introduced by combining thermodynamic databases with simplified kinetics models to approximate realistic synthesis conditions.

2606.00299.tldr: This work proposes Real2SAM2Real, a framework that leverages 3D lifting models to extract an explicitly editable 3D cache, serving as a robust geometric scaffold for the VDM, and designs a Soft Spatial-Aligned Injection mechanism alongside a minimally invasive fine-tuning strategy tailored for VDMs.

2606.00282.tldr: This work introduces Synthetic Cross-domain Augmentation and Learning for Recommendation (SCALR), a framework that generates synthetic user-item interaction events for a target recommendation domain by leveraging observed events from a source domain.

2606.00278.tldr: A compatibility score is introduced that quantifies this notion of plausibility, notably without relying on the faithfulness assumption, for purely graphical bivariate causal statements, based on global consistency constraints that are derived from acyclicity and faithfulness assumptions.

2606.00476.tldr: Process-fidelity evaluation should elicit machine-checkable conclusions and probe for directional biases rather than assume a single upstream failure mode, lest it conflate measurement noise with model behavior.

2606.00390.tldr: Zamba2-VL is a suite of vision-language models built on Zamba2, a hybrid language-model architecture combining Mamba2 state-space layers with a small number of shared transformer blocks that substantially outperforms prior SSM-based and hybrid VLMs such as VL-Mamba, Cobra, and mmMamba.

2606.00376.tldr: Across 12 models and 8 task domains, tool-integrated reasoning consistently outperforms neural chain-of-thought; on the primary model suite it reaches 86-94% accuracy versus 24-42% for neural chain-of-thought.

2606.00334.tldr: The Triangulated Preference Shift score is introduced, a metric that triangulates between human gold standards, base models, and instructs variants to isolate shifts induced specifically by preference learning, without manual curation that supports model alignment and development of trustworthy AI.

2606.00655.tldr: This work provides a foundational understanding of MAS scaling laws, offering practical guidance for designing efficient collaborative systems and challenging the prevailing assumption that more agents invariably lead to better performance.

2606.00647.tldr: Three key strategies are leveraged: grouped stratified cross-validation (preventing leakage), minority-class round-robin lexical augmentation, and a post-processing pipeline with logit bias tuning and ensemble blending that close much of the validation-to-leaderboard gap and substantially improve minority-class recall.

2606.00642.tldr: REP, a lightweight in-context elicitation method that uses shadow-model-generated demonstrations wrapped in auxiliary code-like formats to raise user-visible reasoning traces from a victim model, substantially increases similarity between exposed and REP-conditioned internal traces while preserving useful reasoning signals.

2606.00619.tldr: MemPro is a system-level evolution framework that treats the entire MCR pipeline as an evolvable program rather than adapting only the memory bank or prompt text, and achieves a favorable performance-cost trade-off.

2606.00618.tldr: This paper shows that a modified version of a classical Open-Closed List (OCL) search provides just such an efficient inference procedure that synergizes two learned components: a generative model that performs fast rollouts from intermediate states and a heuristic model that prioritizes among candidate reasoning paths.

2606.00613.tldr: LUNA is a linguistically adaptive watermark that combines model-free detection with single-token non-distortion under the standard random-key model, and is the only method that simultaneously achieves AUROC>0.99 and an absolute median perplexity shift below 0.1.

2606.00611.tldr: TRACE uses a Compressor-Reader design: the Compressor encodes the full trajectory into a compact latent evidence state under trajectory-level supervision, and the Reader judges the raw trajectory with this latent evidence state as a safety reference, which helps aggregate dispersed risk cues and reduce premature evidence loss.

2606.00610.tldr: MemGraphRAG is a novel framework that introduces a memory-based multi-agent system to ensure high-quality graph construction and employs a collaborative society of agents supported by shared memory, which provides a unified global context throughout the extraction process.

2606.00561.tldr: Results suggest that stress-focused distillation can convert a black-box neural controller into a lightweight, auditable rule-like surrogate suited for real-time deployment, while also surfacing risks tied to deterministic actions and topology-specific generalization.

2606.00747.tldr: SkyShield, a geometry-first monocular baseline that integrates frame-wise UAV attitude into projection, fuses temporal occupancy features, and applies safety-prior optimization to preserve sparse collision-critical structures are provided.

2606.00722.tldr: This work proposes an efficient CFG-constrained decoding framework, EPIC, that improves decoding efficiency by combining lexing memoization, validation using Earley-style parsing instead of deterministic automata, and relaxed compatible subset selection for parallel commit.

2606.00672.tldr: A medication-aware framework that synchronizes medication adherence with transaction-level monitoring to improve detection of cognitively risky financial events is proposed and suggests that medication adherence is most useful as a contextual modifier of financial risk rather than as an isolated predictor.

2606.00515.tldr: PaCo-VLA is introduced, a passivity-shielded compliance prior that recasts the VLA interface, and establishes a provably sampled-passive runtime contract at the admittance port and provides a runtime interface for deploying foundation models in contact-rich domains.

2606.00741.tldr: This paper derives the deployment-time weight-error distribution from first principles using the Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) approximation and shows that it has structure that generic Gaussian noise models miss: an exact affine mean drift, a per-bit variance hierarchy dominated by the most-significant bit, and a per-layer dependence on the trained-network Jacobian.

2606.00570.tldr: A theoretical analysis based on the dimensional Collapse Hypothesis is presented, explaining how localized parameter edits can propagate along fragile directions in the representation space, inducing global interference and ultimately causing reasoning collapse.

2606.00708.tldr: Experiments against AutoML and agentic baselines show that \textsc{MOSAIC} improves task performance, execution success, and decision traceability, demonstrating the value of treating automated data science as structured, reusable, and execution-grounded model selection.

2606.00702.tldr: Beyond optimizing complete embodiments, it is shown that value gradients can identify performance-limiting design and control parameters, enabling both the optimization and the analysis of new robot designs.

2606.00644.tldr: This work introduces ForeSci, a temporally controlled benchmark for evaluating whether LLM agents can make such forward-looking research judgements from historical evidence, and evaluates native LLMs, Hybrid RAG, and three research-agent adaptations across four backbones.

2606.00636.tldr: This tech note describes the architecture and execution results of the LPDDR5X-PIM simulator, developed by Samsung Electronics, which provides a high-fidelity model of both the hardware data paths and the software control layers of the LPDDR5X-PIM block.

2606.00590.tldr: Critic-R is a framework that explicitly closes the feedback loop between the reasoning agent and the retrieval model during both inference and training, and introduces a critic model that evaluates the agent's introspective reasoning trace after consuming retrieved evidence to determine whether the retrieved context sufficiently supports the next reasoning step.

2606.00582.tldr: PropLLM is proposed, which is the first to integrate the hop-by-hop scene reconstruction paradigm with the generative reasoning capabilities of LLMs, and improves fault type diagnosis accuracy and root cause localization accuracy on a real-world Wi-Fi multimodal fault dataset.

2606.00559.tldr: An enhanced variant of the auxiliary reconstruction task that encourages the encoder to capture intra-state feature dependencies and enables the encoder to learn richer representations, thereby enhancing the performance of existing processors on algorithmic reasoning tasks.

2606.00518.tldr: An interaction-based framework for agentic torts is proposed, drawing on Michael Bratman's planning theory and on the common law's treatment of human-human concerted action, allowing courts to infer where the human-AI trajectory departed from the authorized undertaking and where liability should attach.

2606.00516.tldr: A closed-form condition is derived for this EB-MB performance crossover, along with asymptotically optimal phase-switching thresholds and memory-safe batch sizing for EB, which achieves up to 41.9% higher throughput on bandwidth-constrained GPUs, while MB retains its advantage on high-bandwidth hardware with larger models.

2606.00732.tldr: Inspired by the accelerated replay observed in rodents during slow-wave sleep, SHARP incorporates offline (sleep) phases in which temporally structured memory traces are replayed in an accelerated form and integrated into higher-level memory representations, improving long-range context retention.

2606.00724.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that WaveFilter, as a plug-and-play generic framework, significantly enhances the performance of existing mainstream KV Cache methods in complex long-context tasks.

2606.00717.tldr: Personalized federated weighted conformal prediction (PFWCP) is proposed, a framework that combines local density ratio weighting with weighted quantile aggregation to correct for heterogeneity while preserving privacy.

2606.00658.tldr: A deployment-oriented compression pipeline for Wan2.2-T2V-A14B is studied by combining few-step distribution-matching distillation with low-bit quantization, which keeps the quantized model close to the same-step full-precision model and surpasses the original full-precision baseline at 8 and 20 steps on average.

2606.00593.tldr: SPADER is proposed, a reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon tool use in Multi-Answer QA that includes Step-wise Peer Advantage, a critic-free step-level credit assignment mechanism that aligns parallel trajectories by decision step and estimates advantages from peer returns.

2606.00555.tldr: Inspired by medicinal chemists, who probe the pocket-ligand complex with controlled analog edits before choosing an optimization direction, PROBE is proposed, an optimization framework built around edit-response probing that achieves state-of-the-art performance and substantially mitigates the failure modes exposed by the diagnostics metrics.

2606.00700.tldr: COPF (Counterfactual Online Performative Fairness), a decision-layer framework for deployment-stable fairness monitoring and control in online link recommendation, is introduced and experiments show that COPF reduces worst-case spikes in exposure-counterfactual group disparities with modest impact on ranking utility.

2606.00726.tldr: Latent Reward Steering is proposed, an adaptive inference-time framework that promotes cognitive behaviors by optimizing the sparse-autoencoder latent states that implicitly carry them and consistently improves performance over various baselines.

2606.00718.tldr: CoEvo-AHD is proposed, an LLM-driven dual-population co-evolutionary framework for automated heuristic design in coupled combinatorial optimization that automatically discovers cooperative heuristic combinations and achieves competitive solution quality against traditional heuristics.

2606.00703.tldr: A near-matching achievability result with exact per-round bit accounting under a bounded-dynamic-range oracle, tight up to a logarithmic factor; the lower bound is for truly Gaussian (unbounded) gradients, and closing this oracle gap is left open.

2606.00674.tldr: A theoretical framework bridging Structural Causal Models (SCM) and the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle is established to explain why data scaling on homogeneous distributions may fail to correct reasoning flaws, and a new generalization bound is derived based on Semantic Coverage Measure rather than sample size.

2606.00656.tldr: This paper proposes two attribute-blind algorithms to enforce fairness requirements in practice: an in-processing approach for fairness intervention during training via the reduction approach, and a post-processing approach for fine-tuning output probabilities with plug-in estimation.

2606.00651.tldr: The proposed MESA (MoE Safety Alignment), a targeted alignment framework for MoE-based LLMs that strategically decentralizes safety responsibility to maximize coverage while minimizing interference with utility, is proposed.

2606.00616.tldr: This work introduces pause-and-think-T, a reasoning-centric training dataset that encourages models to pause, reason over visual evidence, and produce concise, actionable responses, and indicates that targeted reasoning supervision enables compact models to deliver actionable, visually grounded guidance while generalizing beyond training data, without requiring large-scale model expansion.

2606.00609.tldr: Experiments show that CARE-RL consistently outperforms standard multi-domain RL baselines, achieving Total Avg scores of 47.9 and 50.7 on Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-4B, respectively.

2606.00583.tldr: The proposed VRPO is a reinforcement-based optimization strategy that replaces REPA's static alignment loss with a generative representation policy optimization objective, and treats representation alignment as a reward-guided process: the model receives adaptive rewards based on generation fidelity, perceptual quality, and semantic coherence.

2606.00571.tldr: A mathematical analysis of MTS is presented, which reveals the dynamics of normalized data weights and the relation between disparate data quality and poor GSNR and proposes a set of informative features that capture the positions of training data in their distributions and training dynamics.

2606.00563.tldr: This work proposes a novel upper bound on the worst-case model performance on the target population under the realistic setting where the selection mechanism and the target population data are only partially observed, thereby enabling practitioners to build safer and more generalizable models in healthcare and beyond.

2606.00532.tldr: KACE is introduced, which separates storage from usage through difficulty- and domain-based organization through tiered self-consistency and construction and use of a difficulty- and domain-stratified knowledge base enabled by tiered self-consistency.

2606.00680.tldr: Posterior Hybrid Bayesian Belief (PhyB), which reformulates the expectation as a convex combination over a subset of dynamics models, and develops an iterative regularized policy optimization algorithm that provides metric-agnostic guarantees for monotonic improvement until convergence.

2606.00671.tldr: The operational discipline behind this property -- math-template bucketing, LOST_CORRECT scan as regression oracle, parseable-first onboarding, and abstain as first-class output -- constitutes a transferable framework for trustworthy neuro-symbolic systems beyond mathematics.

2606.00670.tldr: Findings suggest that affective facial information may support multimodal robustness and confidence estimation under acoustic uncertainty without directly encoding lexical content.

2606.00621.tldr: A comprehensive, multi-dimensional taxonomy of generative AI harms and attack vectors is presented, the capabilities and failure modes of technical controls including digital watermarking, provenance frameworks, and detection technologies are surveyed, and it is argued that no single mechanism is sufficient in open, adversarial, and evolving environments.

2606.00738.tldr: This work formalizes Epsilon Overfitting (EO), a perspective in which fixed perturbation magnitudes and directions exacerbate CO, and shows that introducing perturbation variability significantly improves robust generalization across different architectures and datasets, and introduces SORA, an adaptive step-size AT method that dynamically adjusts perturbations based on loss surface geometry.

2508.14623.tldr: Results show reduced noise in separated speech but suggest that processing references may introduce artefacts, limiting overall quality gains, and a method is proposed to enhance references and augment the mixtures with WHAM!, aiming to train models that avoid learning noisy references.

2506.06006.tldr: It is found that VLMs struggle to generate physically plausible transitions between frames from instructions, and a crucial asymmetry in multimodal grounding is identified: fine-tuning a VLM to learn inverse dynamics prediction (IDP) is significantly easier than learning FDP.

2411.19758.tldr: A novel framework, Language-VIsion Discriminator for dEtecting changes, LaVIDE, which bridges the semantic gap between high-level map categories and low-level image details using language as an intermediary and provides a practical solution for rapid map updating with minimal human intervention, promising broad impacts in urban planning, disaster assessment, and ecological conservation.

2407.13922.tldr: This work proposes CounterFace, a new counterfactual evaluation dataset comprising 20 facial attributes and 8 demographic factors, exceeding prior synthetic face datasets by 14 attributes and 2 demographics, and helps in the isolation of precise failure modes for individual systems unlike standard evaluation benchmarks.

2405.08036.tldr: This work proposes Potentially Optimal Joint Actions Weighting (POW), a method that ensures optimal policy recovery where existing approximate weighting strategies may fail and is architecture-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing value factorization algorithms.

2401.07386.tldr: This study expands on previous work that introduced the AIcon2abs method, an innovative approach designed to increase public understanding of machine learning across diverse age groups, including K-12 students, and aims to evaluate its effectiveness.

2006.04013.tldr: Combining block-based programming and WiSARD weightless artificial neural networks, this article presents the conceptualization and design of a new methodology, AI from concrete to abstract (AIcon2abs), to endow general people with a minimum understanding of what AI means.

2504.12329.tldr: Speculative Thinking is introduced, a training-free framework that enables large reasoning models to guide smaller ones during inference at the reasoning level, distinct from speculative decoding, which operates at the token level.

2509.10247.tldr: This letter introduces DiffAero, a lightweight, GPU-accelerated, and fully differentiable simulation framework designed for efficient quadrotor control policy learning that provides high-performance simulation but also serves as a research platform for exploring differentiable and hybrid learning algorithms.

2507.21638.tldr: Assistax provides a high-throughput, scalable suite of GPU-accelerated assistive robotics tasks built on JAX and MuJoCo-MJX, and includes an active humanoid agent as a simulated human partner, trainable alongside the robot using multi-agent RL (MARL).

2506.05233.tldr: This work introduces a numerically stable, chunkwise parallelizable version of the recently proposed Mesa layer, which could only run sequentially in time and was therefore not scalable, and shows that optimal test-time training enables reaching lower language modeling perplexity and higher downstream benchmark performance than previous RNNs, especially on tasks requiring long context understanding.

2504.15587.tldr: MetaMolGen is a first-order meta-learning-based molecular generator tailored for few-shot and property-conditioned generation that standardizes graph motifs by mapping them into normalized latent space and employs a lightweight autoregressive model to generate SMILES sequences that accurately reflect molecular structures.

2509.15676.tldr: This work first model an LLM as a linear function over input embeddings and frame the example selection task as a query-specific optimization problem: selecting a subset of exemplars from a larger example bank that minimizes the prediction error on a specific query.

2509.08846.tldr: This work proposes an intuitive framework for uncertainty estimation and decomposition based on the signal-to-noise ratio of class probability distributions across different model predictions and introduces a variance-gated measure that scales predictions by a confidence factor derived from ensembles.

2509.03351.tldr: This study presents a large language model, epiGPTope, pretrained on protein data and specifically fine-tuned on linear epitopes, which, for the first time, can directly generate novel epitope-like sequences, which are found to possess statistical properties analogous to the ones of known epitopes.

2602.11189.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that MuCO significantly and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in physical stability, structural diversity, secondary structure recovery, and computational efficiency, making it a promising computational tool for exploring and designing cyclic peptides.

2602.17907.tldr: This work introduces a novel topic model training framework by Distilling Soft Labels (DSL) from Language Models (LMs), which significantly outperforms existing methods in identifying semantically similar documents, highlighting its effectiveness for retrieval-oriented applications.

2605.21446.tldr: A controlled perturbation study of Vision-Language-Action robustness in autonomous driving evaluates Alpamayo R1 (10B parameters) across 1,996 scenarios under eight sensor perturbations, finding that reasoning consistency is a high-fidelity indicator of trajectory reliability.

2605.20654.tldr: By internalizing trajectory-level safety, Reflector overcomes the fundamental limitations of surface alignment without significant computational overhead, offering an efficient and scalable solution for the development of safe and capable LLMs.

2603.13384.tldr: Treating vulnerability detection as calibrated evidence accumulation improves detection, localization, auditability, and cost control under the evaluated protocol, while remaining a prioritization aid rather than a replacement for manual review.

2605.27488.tldr: Grimlock is presented, an Agent Guard that restores separation of concerns by moving trust enforcement into the sandbox substrate while leaving agent code unchanged, and offers a path toward transparent, auditable, and scope-bound agent-to-agent communication across heterogeneous multi-cloud environments, using commodity Linux primitives and without requiring changes to user-layer orchestration code.

2605.19294.tldr: DIY DEFLECT improves delay robustness over strong asynchronous VLA baselines, raising high-latency success by up to 6.4 percentage points and achieving a 4.6 percentage-point gain at the longest delay on a real-scale VLA.

2605.18879.tldr: This work reformulates machine unlearning as a precise knowledge re-mapping problem via model editing, and proposes ZeroUnlearn, a few-shot unlearning framework that enforces representational orthogonality through a multiplicative parameter update with a closed-form solution, enabling efficient and targeted unlearning.

2605.13672.tldr: SpurAudio is introduced, a benchmark that leverages the natural separability of foreground events and background environments in audio to enable controlled, multi-level evaluation of contextual shifts across support and query sets and shows that many state-of-the-art few-shot methods suffer severe performance degradation when background correlations are disrupted.

2605.28210.tldr: This work proposes three normative imperatives for AI-mediated consequential decisions: existential honesty, which acknowledges the limits of prediction; ecological rationality, which situates guidance within heterogeneous lived ecologies; and counterfactual reparation, which acknowledges and repairs foreclosed alternatives when AI-mediated decision-making pathways fail.

2605.25402.tldr: An anatomy-anchored ultrasound self-supervision framework ANAUS is proposed that shifts representation learning from generic visual regions to clinically meaningful anatomical structures, and a dual-policy self-supervised learning paradigm consisting of inter-view semantics-aware anatomy-separating alignment and contextual core-region prediction to enhance representation learning.

2605.19398.tldr: DyMoS (Dynamic Motion Slider), a training-free and model-agnostic method that rebalances the attention pathway from generated frames to the reference frame during initial denoising steps, is proposed and demonstrated to improve motion dynamics while maintaining visual quality and fidelity to the reference image.

2605.09081.tldr: A novel schema: Setpoint, Effort, Feedback, Feedback, Context (S-E-F-C) underlying the whole pipeline that maps any actuated system into a common representational frame is introduced that enables robust zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer and highly parameter-efficient anomaly detection.

2605.07724.tldr: It is proved that, under certain conditions, the model converges to a stable distribution that allocates probability mass across competing high-reward regions and provably satisfies a weighted Nash bargaining solution, offering a formal interpretation of value aggregation in synthetic retraining loops.

2604.04944.tldr: Inclusion-of-Thoughts (IoT), a progressive self-filtering strategy that is designed to mitigate this cognitive load and enable the model to focus more effectively on plausible answers, is proposed.

2605.18931.tldr: It is demonstrated that integrating Markov chain-based distributions into the decoder of a generative model institutes a principled and practically effective solution to the heavy-tail generation problem.

2604.09686.tldr: This work proposes a belief-aware VLM framework that integrates retrieval-based memory and reinforcement learning and approximate belief using a vector-based memory that retrieves relevant multimodal context, which is incorporated into the VLM for reasoning.

2606.03810.tldr: It is established that consistency training is not alignment-neutral, and that its use in critical systems should be carefully audited.

2606.03307.tldr: A Hyperbolic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (HyRAG) framework designed to enhance the generalization capabilities of GFMs and retains the tree-like hierarchies of the external knowledge base by modeling them within hyperbolic space.

2606.03303.tldr: LEAP is presented, an agentic framework that enables general-purpose foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance on automated formal theorem proving, and its research-level utility is demonstrated by autonomously formalizing complex proofs for open combinatorial challenges.

2606.01961.tldr: AutoMedBench is presented, a workflow-aware benchmark for autonomous medical-AI research across diverse medical imaging and multimodal inference tasks, organizing agent execution into a unified five-stage workflow (S1-S5): Plan, Setup, Validate, Inference, and Submit.

2605.31483.tldr: BenHalluEval is introduced, a fine-grained hallucination evaluation framework for Bengali covering four tasks: Generative Question Answering, Bangla-English Code-Mixed QA, Summarization, and Reasoning, and the inadequacy of single-track and prompting-only evaluation approaches for low-resource language settings is highlighted.

2606.02670.tldr: Current MTSAD benchmarks are unsuitable for validating cross-channel modeling capabilities, and it is called for the development of more structurally diverse evaluation sets.

2605.29928.tldr: The findings indicate that source-label bias in reasoning evaluation is primarily a human vulnerability and highlight the potential of human-LLM collaboration in increasingly AI-mediated environments.

2606.04029.tldr: This position paper argues that deploying an agent that is incapable of optimality, but receives an evaluative reward signal, is inherently a continual RL problem, and identifies four sources of non-stationarity after deployment that necessitate never-ending learning.

2606.04027.tldr: This work proposes MaskForge, a fully black-box adaptive attack that casts dLLM red-teaming as optimized search over a growing library of structural patterns and abstracts successful attempts into reusable schemas, selects goal-compatible patterns with a UCB bandit, and invokes a scorer-guided fallback when the current library fails.

2606.04010.tldr: To recover what BFMs lose, this work designs a linear pipeline that projects the fMRI signal into the subspace that best preserves its co-skewness and computes FC there, and recovers the raw-FC ceiling on BrainLM's forward pass by finetuning with a loss targeted at this same subspace.

2606.03995.tldr: An explainable machine learning model trained on routine clinical assessments achieves near-perfect three-class Alzheimer's detection, and SHAP analysis reveals clinically plausible, class-specific feature importance patterns supporting clinical validity.

2606.02403.tldr: This work introduces AutoForest, the first end-to-end system that generates publication-ready forest plots directly from biomedical papers, and describes the system architecture, user interface and demonstrates its effectiveness on real-world examples through a user study involving clinicians.

2606.03564.tldr: Attention-Guided and CoT-Enhanced Coarse-to-Refined Reasoning Segmentation is proposed, a two-stage framework for coarse-to-refined reasoning segmentation that guides the model to reason progressively from global scene context to local target details.

2606.03554.tldr: This work proposes a principle of constraint-enhanced physical search in which temporal correlations in exploration are matched to constraint-induced spatial correlations in the update dynamics, and suggests a general organizing principle for physical search.

2606.03376.tldr: Perceptual Processing Direct Preference Optimization (P$^2$-DPO), a novel training paradigm in which the model generates and learns from its own preference pairs, thereby directly addressing the identified visual bottlenecks while inherently avoiding the issues of vision-agnostic and off-policy data is proposed.

2606.03163.tldr: The design is intended to support heterogeneous Agent frameworks and interaction protocols, including MCP, A2A, ANP-like systems, domain-specific Agent protocols, Skills, MCP Servers, and Tool/API resources.

2606.04023.tldr: The extensive evaluation reveals that while state-of-the-art LLMs can generate optimized code for ubiquitous architectures like x86_64, they exhibit significant performance degradation on domain-specific architectures with limited public documentation and training data, highlighting critical limitations in cross-platform generalization.

2606.03937.tldr: This work introduces VEPO (Vision-Entropy token-selection for Policy Optimization), an effective RL framework explicitly integrating visual sensitivity with token entropy via a principled multiplicative coupling, where VEPO redirects gradient credit toward tokens which are simultaneously visually grounded and highly informative.

2606.03201.tldr: This work introduces XIPER (Cross-domain Video Prediction Reward), a reward model for learning from expert videos collected in a visually different domain, where the agent's appearance differs due to factors such as color, morphology, or the sim-to-real gap.

2606.02886.tldr: This paper proposes Neural Tangent Kernel-based uncertainty quantification (NTK-UQ) using last-layer empirical features, which achieves 31--37% sharper prediction intervals at 90% coverage, and uniquely produces intervals that scale with extreme event severity, which conformal prediction cannot achieve by construction.

2606.04032.tldr: It is shown that Q-K=V preserves quality because keys and values can occupy similar representational spaces and attention operates in a low-rank regime, whereas Q=K-V breaks attention directionality.

2606.04009.tldr: This work proposes a counterfactual explanation framework for deep two-sample testing that generates sample-level edits moving observations from a source group toward a target group while explicitly reducing the discrepancy measured by the test.

2606.03988.tldr: Imaginative Perception Tokens (IPT) is introduced, intermediate perceptual representations that externalize what a VLM would perceive under alternative spatial configurations while remaining consistent with the observed input, suggesting a modality mismatch when spatial computation is forced through language.

2606.03938.tldr: This work introduces hyper-epoch pretraining (q0), which turns a multi-epoch budget into a population of diverse models whose combined predictions reach a lower validation loss than a single refined model.

2606.03660.tldr: ChemCoTBench-V2 is introduced, a rule-verifiable diagnostic benchmark for low-cost, auditable evaluation of structured, verifier-addressable chemical reasoning traces and reports three separate signals: final-answer correctness, template adherence, and step-wise verifier correctness over expert-refined intermediate commitments.

2606.03606.tldr: This work introduces an automatic algorithm for generating numeric-remapping attacks on arithmetic word problems and demonstrates that numeric-remapping robustness depends strongly on dataset structure: GSM8K remains sensitive even when reasoning programs are preserved and answers are recomputed, while shorter, more regular datasets are more robust.

2606.03161.tldr: This white paper explains the motivation, architecture, roles, governance model, relationship with MCP, A2A, and ANP, deployment patterns, cooperation model, on-chain governance layer, prototype status, performance profile, and roadmap of OAN.

2606.01023.tldr: A design proposal for an in-line machine-vision system whose primary purpose is to inspect the carpet web in real time and to systematically collect and label images of defect patterns so that increasingly capable quality-control models can be trained over the life of the installation.

2605.29861.tldr: Experiments on deep research benchmarks show that Ptah produces more reliable, visually informative, and usable human-facing multimodal reports than strong baselines.

2606.03892.tldr: PROVE (Programmatic Rewards On Verified Environments), a framework with a library of 20 stateful MCP servers exposing 343 tools, enabling live-execution RL training with session-scoped state isolation, is presented, demonstrating that this framework yields consistent gains on multi-step tool orchestration across two model families.

2606.04019.tldr: A gravity-aware hierarchical routing head is proposed as a lightweight post-alignment adaptation built on top of an already aligned model, rather than a new large-scale pretraining framework, which significantly improves macro-F1 with minimal parameter overhead and preserves strong performance on dynamic activities.

2606.03746.tldr: This work revisits few-step distillation from a complementary perspective, focusing on the training recipe that critically shapes student performance, and suggests that effective few-step distillation requires not only carefully designed objectives, but also principled organization of the broader training pipeline.

2606.03631.tldr: This paper proposes AnchorMoE, an interpretable-by-construction classification framework built upon a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which achieves highly competitive classification performance while faithfully grounding its decisions in the raw time series.

2606.03598.tldr: PHASER, an architecture-agnostic continual learning framework that employs a phase-centric capacity allocation to guarantee equal memory support for all sub-skills, coupled with a multi-modal interference routing strategy that dynamically prioritizes historical phases at high risk of forgetting, is introduced.

2606.03323.tldr: dstack-capsule is presented, a Kubernetes platform that enables Pod-level remote attestation on Intel TDX by allowing multiple Pods to share a single Confidential VM while each retains independent, hardware-backed proof of identity.

2606.04025.tldr: This paper introduces Software 4.0 -- an autopoietic heterarchy of human intelligence, neural AI, and natively reflective symbolic substrate that unlocks a superior inference-time scaling regime where connectionist compute translates entirely into deep semantic exploration and hypothesis traversal rather than the ruinous computational and financial cost of simulating structural constraints probabilistically.

2606.02914.tldr: A two-dimensional classification framework organizing models by architectural paradigm and dental specialization degree is proposed, finding that general-purpose and dental-specific models play complementary roles; the most effective systems combine both within structured pipelines.

2606.01770.tldr: Adaptive Auto-Harness is introduced, a framework and system for auto-harness that decomposes the gap to an oracle harness into evolution loss and adaptation loss and addresses these losses with a stateful multi-agent evolver, a harness tree with solve-time routing, and human-steering hooks for cases where history lacks the needed signal.

2606.01212.tldr: This paper proposes DiscourseFlip, an agentic, graph-guided attack that dynamically allocates a limited poisoning budget to maximize discourse-level opinion deviation and demonstrates that DiscourseFlip consistently induces targeted opinion shifts across the contextualized query network and significantly outperforms existing baselines in terms of coverage and effectiveness.

2606.04171.tldr: This work introduces MimeLens, a family of small BERT-style encoders pretrained on binary content from windows sampled at a uniformly random offset within each file, with no privileged head-of-file position, in standard- and short-context variants.

2606.04040.tldr: This article proposes a channel-oriented design with three key components that preserve weak yet informative signals across channels and enable stable alignment to a semantic music representation space and integrates this channel-oriented design within an encoding-alignment-decoding pipeline for EEG-to-music reconstruction.

2606.04167.tldr: Reforming the MNEP as a Non-Markovian Rewards Decision Process (NMRDP), tabular RL is used to achieve similar performance with significantly fewer training episodes, additionally offering greater interpretability and incorporating social equity criteria into the reward functions.

2606.04126.tldr: HighTide is introduced, an evolving AI-assisted benchmark suite spanning multiple design languages and technology nodes and designed to grow with the open-source hardware ecosystem.

2606.04123.tldr: This paper presents a framework that leverages large language models to translate natural language descriptions of mission requirements and constraints into executable trajectory optimization code and corresponding mathematical formulations, enabling more flexible and efficient trajectory design of spacecraft.

2606.04103.tldr: The Differentiable Auditory Loop (DAL), a new open-source framework for personalized hearing aid design and fitting, provides a practical path toward model-based, machine-learning-driven personalization of hearing aid signal processing.

2606.04074.tldr: This paper asks under what conditions a content-adaptive patching operator should outperform a tuned uniform one, and derives an explicit threshold that a dynamic patching rule must satisfy to beat a well-tuned uniform baseline.

2606.04073.tldr: The results show that the proposed TPA-AD method yields relatively stable anomaly responses, is sensitive to degradation evolution, and demonstrates a certain degree of broader applicability on public TSAD benchmarks and real high-speed-train-related bearing data.

2606.04067.tldr: A CI-guided reinforcement learning framework that converts essential and non-essential sensitive spans into verifiable optimization signals, and train a query rewriter to preserve task critical information while suppressing unnecessary sensitive disclosure is proposed.

2606.04058.tldr: Tracking singular value quantiles of the momentum buffer across layers in models ranging from 77M to 2.8B parameters, a consistent picture is observed: after a short burn-in, the quantiles stabilize at a value determined by the layer type and model size.

2606.04053.tldr: A goal-set-based composition method that performs logical operations on goal sets and reconstructs composed value functions by selecting slices from the universal and empty value functions is introduced, which reduces learning costs for standard BTA and reduces composition time for both BTA and Skill Machines.

2606.04048.tldr: By rigorously propagating coordinate-size estimates through the forward pass, gating mechanisms, and recurrent state dynamics, the scaling rules for Gated Delta Network are derived and confirmed, validating the correctness and practical utility of the analysis.

2606.04046.tldr: SceneDiver is proposed, a coarse-to-fine focus plan generation method for VLMs leveraging their long-term planning abilities, that first constructs a holistic scene graph to establish initial comprehension, then progressively decomposes the task into simpler sub-problems through an iterative cycle of recognition, understanding, and analysis.

2606.04039.tldr: DyNACO is presented, a novel framework that achieves dynamic neural guidance by periodically observing the pheromone distribution and the incumbent solution and is extended to CVRP via a capacity-aware backend, consistently improving the unguided baseline with less than 1% neural overhead.

2606.04244.tldr: VAMPS (Visual-Assisted Mathematical Problem Solving), a benchmark for graph-assisted mathematics, is introduced and found that across a diverse set of models, direct analytical solving surprisingly outperforms tool-enabled visual solving, even on problems where plotting is a natural strategy.

2606.04205.tldr: DetectZoo lowers the barrier to entry for multi-modal AI forensics, enabling researchers to identify performance gaps across domains and accelerating the development of robust, generalizable detection techniques.

2606.04193.tldr: A class of protocols is proposed that resolves the trust boundary by inverting the trust boundary: the service that receives an agent's call signs a receipt of what it observed using its own key, encrypts the receipt to the agent's owner, and publishes it to a public transparency log.

2606.04177.tldr: It is shown that classifiers based solely on linguistic features can reliably distinguish AI-generated from human-written text and which linguistic signals generalize across contexts and provide a foundation for more reliable, interpretable analyses of AI-generated language.

2606.04152.tldr: This commentary introduces PEEL - Protocols for Epistemically Engaged Literacy in AI, a working scaffolding that combines deterministic distant reading via Voyant Tools with LLM interpretation via Claude, grounded in Peircean semiotics and abductive reasoning.

2606.04150.tldr: It is suggested that current policy, focused on companion apps and isolated interactions, cannot adequately protect human connection and effective regulations should extend to general-purpose AI systems and address cumulative, trajectory-level changes in how people seek support.

2606.04143.tldr: A Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) framework that incorporates hydrological knowledge directly into the loss function of an LSTM model improves model robustness without requiring complex hydrodynamic equations and reduces unphysical fluctuations common in purely data-driven models.

2606.04141.tldr: The results suggest that credential-exfiltration defenses should combine pre-output monitoring, calibrated canary detection, and temporal leakage accounting rather than relying only on text-level output filters.

2606.04104.tldr: Proof-Carrying Agent Actions (PCAA), a runtime-neutral governance model centered on an action certificate rather than on a vendor-native session record, and an implementation-grounded account of how that formulation can remain portable under runtime churn without collapsing into vendor-specific control surfaces.

2606.04095.tldr: The results suggest that length generalization is a meaningful stress test for creative-writing models and a useful lens for distinguishing otherwise close models.

2606.04057.tldr: Large language models (LLMs) now generate substantial production code, often for tasks with multiple valid algorithmic solutions, and accidental context creates an "invisible lottery" over performance, security, and maintainability.

2606.04051.tldr: RUBAS improves safety over standard alignment baselines, reduces tool-grounded hallucinations, and maintains competitive utility, and the results suggest that multi-dimensional rubric rewards provide an effective training signal for aligning LLM agents in safety-critical tool-use settings.

2606.04240.tldr: This report describes the challenge design, datasets, and evaluation protocol; reports the final standings; reports the three winning teams'systems; and analyses the three winning teams'systems.

2606.04106.tldr: This work proposes principle-driven foundation models that encode signal-theoretic principles (Fourier decomposition, energy conservation, symmetry) rather than learn untethered statistical correlations, and achieves cross-modal transfer to audio, images, text, and video using only frozen representations learned from RF data.

2606.04063.tldr: A differentiable NAS framework is introduced that explores the entire space and jointly optimizes architectural configurations alongside mixed-precision quantization for linear layers of LLMs and achieves superior accuracy-latency trade-offs.

2606.04050.tldr: LiftQuant is a novel framework that enables continuous bit-width control for true Pareto-optimal deployment of Large Language Models and generates a structured yet non-uniform codebook, capturing the expressive power of Vector Quantization (VQ).

2606.04045.tldr: This work asks what relevance means for a fixed supervised decision problem: a representation is defined to be Bayes-sufficient for a joint distribution and loss if some prediction head can use it to implement a Bayes-optimal action rule, which makes the target information loss-dependent.

2606.04231.tldr: MM-BizRAG proactively extracts and represents document structure via a document structure-aware split that dynamically routes documents through orientation-specific ingestion pipelines, applying explicit layout-aware parsing for vertically structured documents and holistic page-level representations for horizontally structured documents.

2606.04227.tldr: An amortized $O(|E|)$ streaming construction for the cellular decomposition is given and an adversarial algebraic-RAM barrier arguing that unpartitioned non-trivial sheaves do not admit the same locality is discussed.

2606.04226.tldr: PerceptTwin is introduced, a fully automatic pipeline that constructs interactive simulations directly from semantic scene representations produced by a robot's perception stack that combines open-vocabulary object maps with 3D asset generation, affordance prediction, and commonsense condition checking.

2606.04202.tldr: This work introduces SMAC-Talk, a natural language extension of the StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge for evaluating LLM-based agents in cooperative multi-agent environments that has several key features such as decentralized control, partial observability and long-horizon decision making.

2606.04188.tldr: This work proposes Dual Advantage Fields, a policy-extraction method that turns a bilinear dual value model into a local advantage signal that improves aggregate RLiable metrics and performs strongly in settings where locally correct actions differ from direct movement toward the final goal.

2606.04115.tldr: dMX, a differentiable mixed-precision quantization framework for learnable floating-point bit-width assignment, is introduced, and its application for the microscaling floating-point (MXFP) family of data types defined by the Open Compute Project (OCP) standard is studied.

2606.04238.tldr: This work proposes a selective mixed-precision strategy in which only gate and up projection layers of the MLP are quantized to 2-bit (W2), while all other linear layers remain at higher precision, yielding a mixed-precision GateUp configuration.

2606.04236.tldr: AXON is a training-free module that can be added on top of existing parallel decoding strategies for diffusion language models and improves the quality-latency trade-off of existing parallel decoders, often reducing the number of function evaluations while maintaining or improving accuracy.

2606.04223.tldr: This work instantiate the framework in content moderation and argues that disagreement-aware routing provides a bridge between sub-symbolic LLM deliberation and symbolic knowledge representation for multi-agent strategic reasoning.

2606.04191.tldr: This work built a metric-aware hybrid system that assigned a different predictor to each metric family: synthetic-pretrained denoisers for full-trajectory reconstruction, Lorenz ODE fitting and trajectory shooting for the first 20 forecast steps, and histogram-tail substitution using synthetic Lorenz libraries for long-time evaluation.

2606.04164.tldr: ADAPTOOD is proposed, a novel framework that leverages data uncertainty to quantify distribution shift severity and guide fine-tuning for time series, and achieves up to 7% higher accuracy and 12.9% higher precision than existing methods in OOD tasks, maintaining strong performance as distribution shift severity increases.

2606.04145.tldr: EvalStop is a composable scheduling primitive that terminates jobs on k consecutive eval-score declines, releases GPUs, preserves the best checkpoint, and delegates to any base scheduler, frame scheduler-level early stopping as a detection problem and evaluate it in a discrete-event simulator.

2606.04120.tldr: SALIMORY is introduced, a framework that trains a single language model to manage a cognitively-structured memory-spanning user facts, preferences, and working memory by introducing a hierarchical stage-wise process reward and reward-decomposed contrastive refinement.

2606.04111.tldr: AgenticDiffusion is proposed, a multi-view UAV navigation framework that coordinates language-guided reasoning, open-vocabulary target grounding, vision-based diffusion planning, and NMPC within a unified aerial navigation pipeline.

2606.04108.tldr: SymTRELLIS is a method that enforces arbitrary finite point group symmetries (rotational, reflectional, and polyhedral) during the flow-based 3D generation of TRELLIS.2, without retraining the underlying VAE or flow model.

2606.04037.tldr: An ontology-grounded verification framework offers a reproducible, regulation-grounded route to pre-deployment assurance for enterprise AI agents, complementing runtime governance with an auditable deployment gate.

2606.04460.tldr: CyberGym-E2E is a large-scale and realistic end-to-end cybersecurity benchmark that comprehensively evaluates AI agents'abilities across the full lifecycle of vulnerability discovery, PoC generation, and patch generation.

2606.04445.tldr: RowNet is presented, a retrieval-based neural architecture for real estate price-per-square-meter prediction that represents a query property through pairwise similarity features against a memory bank of labeled properties.

2606.04365.tldr: This work reformulates kidney CT characterization as a per-lesion set-prediction task: one model emits a variable number of lesions per kidney, each with four clinical attributes, and proposes a DETR-style architecture with size-distance Hungarian matching and a hierarchical loss that aggregates per-slot outputs to side-level objectives.

2606.04349.tldr: MorphoQuant is proposed, a modality-aware PTQ framework engineered to preserve cross-modal morphology and mitigate outlier loss, and introduces Distribution-Aware Bias Compensation (DABC), which selectively absorbs long-tailed outliers into channel-wise biases.

2606.04345.tldr: HYolo is an intelligent IoT-based object detection framework that integrates hypergraph learning into the YOLO architecture and indicates that integrating hypergraph learning into object detection pipelines offers a promising direction for intelligent and context-aware IoT vision systems.

2606.04298.tldr: The synthesis finds that root DNS anycast can exhibit substantial path inflation while still producing limited user-visible delay, whereas CDN anycast requires active engineering of peering, route policy, catchment scope, and measurement feedback to keep inflation small.

2606.04296.tldr: The joint mapping of this problem across human inter-rater reliability, four detector architectures, a cross-model LLM-judge sweep, and a reproduced saturation effect is contribution, rather than any single detector's accuracy.

2606.04271.tldr: StandardE2E standardizes per-dataset preprocessing under one shared data schema, combines multiple datasets in a single PyTorch DataLoader for cross-dataset pretraining, auxiliary-task supervision, and scenario-level filtering, and reduces adding a new dataset to a single per-dataset mapping from raw frames to the canonical schema, leaving the entire downstream pipeline unchanged.

2606.04262.tldr: DOSEBENCH, a focused benchmark of 81 curated OTC dosing scenarios focused on adult acetaminophen and ibuprofen use, is introduced and it is suggested that OTC dosing QA provides a narrow yet practical testbed for evaluating temporal reasoning, constraint following, and safety-relevant uncertainty handling in medical QA.

2606.04484.tldr: AgentJet is a distributed swarm training framework based on a decoupled multi-node architecture that supports heterogeneous multi-model RL, mixed-task training with isolated runtimes, fault-tolerant execution, and live code iteration through hot-swappable clients.

2606.04465.tldr: Self-Evolving Prompt Optimization (SePO), which treats the prompt agent's own system prompt as an optimization target alongside task agents'system prompts, outperforms Manual-CoT, TextGrad, and MetaSPO and adopts a self-referential design.

2606.04455.tldr: The Meta-Agent Challenge (MAC) is introduced, an evaluation framework designed to test the capacity of frontier models for autonomous agent development, offering an empirical proxy for evaluating recursive self-improvement.

2606.04438.tldr: This work presents LoopMoE, a looped MoE language model that integrates sparse routing with iterative weight-shared computation through two designs, and establishes a controlled synthesis of sparsity and recurrence, and suggests a promising direction for looped language models.

2606.04409.tldr: The experimental results show that increasing the training data scale consistently improves generalization performance, whereas changes in model complexity do not provide stable gains, and removing color information degrades model performance.

2606.04408.tldr: This study proposes an Ensembled Latent Factor Model via Differential Evolution and Gradient Descent Optimization (ELFM-DEGDO) with two-fold designed: 1) two diverse latent factor models are independently modeled via differential evolution and gradient descent optimization, respectively, and 2) the two diverse latent factor models are combined via a customized self-adaptive weighting mechanism to effectively fuse their strengths.

2606.04391.tldr: SGDR consists of three components: a sliding-window extraction process that turns completed trajectories into reusable sub-procedures invokable at intermediate execution states, a dual text-code representation that connects skill retrieval with executable action, and a state-grounded dynamic retrieval mechanism that matches skills to both the task goal and the current webpage state.

2606.04382.tldr: This work introduces LCSHBench, a low-rank fine-tune of a 300M on-device embedder that improves cross-lingual retrieval and beats a 3,072-dimensional hosted embedder on development exact recall@200 and beats a 3,072-dimensional hosted embedder on development exact recall@200.

2606.04321.tldr: The Digital Apprentice is a framework for scalable, safe AI agency in which autonomy is earned, not assumed, and three architectural components, stitched together as a system, form a safer and more viable path to agentic systems that can scale without sacrificing trust.

2606.04320.tldr: OpenRFM, a simple yet effective RFM that improves average task performance by approximately 30% over the RT backbone and surpasses the commercial model KumoRFMv1 on a large set of evaluation tasks, is defined.

2606.04287.tldr: A lightweight autoregressive framework that uses a structure-guided topological ordering to serialize graphs into regular edge sequences, enabling near log-linear generation, and a two-phase training strategy that combines exploration-oriented augmentation with iterative refinement to reduce overfitting and promote controlled novelty.

2606.04269.tldr: Instant-Fold is introduced, an in-context imitation learning framework for DOM that generalizes across diverse folding modes and transfers zero-shot to real-world settings without additional data collection or finetuning.

2606.04479.tldr: This work finds that current T2I models frequently produce semantic errors, logical inconsistencies, and incorrect intermediate steps, even when the rendered text appears visually clear, which reveals a substantial gap between visual text generation and procedural reasoning.

2606.04469.tldr: Adaptive Calibration is introduced, a novel calibration strategy for facial recognition that maps cosine similarity between normalized embeddings to well-calibrated probabilities that avoids "leveling down" where fairness comes at the cost of degraded performance for some groups.

2606.04468.tldr: ParetoPilot is proposed, a plug-and-play method that guides designs to Pareto front at inference time using a pre-trained conditional diffusion model without any surrogate.

2606.04459.tldr: This work investigates more restrictive APIs that expose token rankings and finds that rankings also constitute a signature, which is the first known (polynomially) unforgeable signature, since finding a model with the same set of feasible rankings is NP-hard.

2606.04442.tldr: MemoryDocDataSet, a synthetic benchmark of 50 micro-worlds and 1,000 QA pairs in which each instance comprises 3-5 personas, a temporal event graph spanning months of activity, 3-5 real long documents, multi-session conversations grounded on those documents, and 20 question-answer pairs across five reasoning categories is introduced.

2606.04425.tldr: This work formalizes stored prompt injection and develops a taxonomy of how adversarial content persists and affects agentic systems across sessions, and develops a benchmark and sandbox toolkit to evaluate the risks of stored prompt injection.

2606.04421.tldr: This work proposes long-horizon temporal regret as a first-class objective alongside outcome regret and epistemic regret over the working causal model, and proves three conditional results under explicit causal-probing, persistence, and detectability assumptions.
