2605.18562.tldr: This study evaluating three off-the-shelf LLMs as difficulty raters for newly created items without access to response data positions LLMs as a promising tool for initial item calibration and offers insights into effective workflow configuration.

2605.18570.tldr: Query-Conditioned Entity Alignment (QCEA) is proposed, which reformulates entity alignment as a query-conditioned correspondence problem and treats the textual description of a source entity as a query and ranks candidate entities in the target graph, enabling context-dependent alignment.

2605.18580.tldr: This work introduces discipline stability, a trace-based evaluation paradigm: define the benchmark behavior, restrict observations to the deployment regime, induce trace diagnostics from failure, separate mechanisms with ablations, and test transfer and deployment.

2605.18583.tldr: OverEager-Gen is presented, a benchmark dedicated to overeager behavior on benign tasks, and OverEager-Bench contains 500 validated scenarios and ~7,500 runs across four agent products and six base models, indicating that model-layer alignment does not fully propagate through permissive permission gating.

2605.18591.tldr: This work presents Randomized Advantage Transformation (RAT), a method for estimating Tikhonov-regularized natural policy gradients via direct backpropagation, and demonstrates empirically that it matches or exceeds established natural-gradient methods across continuous and visual control benchmarks, while remaining simple to implement and compatible with various architectures.

2605.18593.tldr: These results establish typographic misclassification as a real, measurable, and physically consequential threat to the safety of modular manipulation pipelines that prior typographic attack research has left unexamined.

2605.18610.tldr: This work makes the first attempt to study continual unlearning for VLMs and identifies three key challenges in this setting: effectiveness in removing target knowledge, fidelity in preserving retained model utility, and persistence in preventing knowledge re-emergence under sequential updates.

2605.18613.tldr: This work introduces SAME (Semantically-Aligned Music autoEncoder), an autoencoder for stereo music and general audio that reaches a 4096$\times- temporal compression ratio while maintaining reconstruction quality and downstream generative performance.

2605.18617.tldr: ManiSoft is introduced, a benchmark for vision-language manipulation with soft arms that features a tailored simulator that couples realistic soft-body dynamics with contact-rich interactions via an elastic force constraint, and is anticipated to serve as a valuable testbed, bridging the gap between rigid and soft arms in the context of vision-language manipulation.

2605.18621.tldr: CrossViewer is proposed, a progressive three-stage framework for cross-view spatial reasoning in MLLMs, following a Perception ->Alignment ->Reasoning paradigm that equips an adaptive spatial region tokenizer to capture fine-grained object representations, and then aligns the multi-view objects explicitly, and thus fuses aligned features for boosting the cross-view inference capacity for MLLMs.

2605.18627.tldr: This work considers the problem of learning STRIPS+ action domains from traces in a more general context where the traces carry partial information about both actions and states and formulates algorithms and completeness results for three general cases, all of which assume full observability of selected action arguments.

2605.18630.tldr: This work introduces SCICONVBENCH, a benchmark for multi- turn clarification in scientific task formulation across four computational science problem domains: fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, materials science, and par- tial differential equations (PDEs).

2605.18632.tldr: This position paper argues that model checkpoints should be treated as a first-class data modality, and that generative modeling in weight space should be standardized as a core machine learning primitive.

2605.18635.tldr: With a balanced context of 5K to 10K examples, the strongest TFMs reach the AUC of classical baselines trained on the full data, while also recovering meaningful default-class recall that default-threshold GBDTs do not.

2605.18643.tldr: ZEDA injects parameter-free zero-output experts into each MoE layer and adapts the augmented model through two-stage self-distillation, utilizing the original MoE as a frozen teacher and applying a group-level balancing loss.

2605.18648.tldr: A controlled audit of soft-label learning across MNIST and a synthetic variant is presented, re-annotating subsets to extract human uncertainty and reveals models trained on human soft-labels mirror human uncertainty, whereas those trained on synthetic labels fail to align with humans.

2605.18654.tldr: This work distills the TFM offline into an XGBoost or CatBoost student that runs natively on CPU, closing the gap between the best tabular foundation models (TFMs) and the best tabular foundation models (TFMs) on GPU.

2605.18656.tldr: This work proposes FedNewton, which averages local Newton iterations to reduce bias in FedAvg, achieving an estimation accuracy comparable to FedSGD with much fewer communication rounds when the number of clients grows sufficiently slowly.

2605.18661.tldr: It is shown that greater automation can obscure rather than eliminate failure modes, making human-governed collaboration the most credible deployment paradigm, and a structured taxonomy, benchmark suite, and tool inventory, cross-stage design principles, and a practitioner-oriented playbook are provided.

2605.18663.tldr: This work calibrates a continuous response 2-parameter logistic IRT model over>200k prompt-response pairs across 28 models, producing robust ability estimates that correctly order test-configurations even when raw accuracy is distorted by errors or missing data, addressing a common challenge in benchmark reporting.

2605.18672.tldr: This position paper argues that enforcing LLM agent safety within a single abstraction layer is not merely suboptimal but categorically insufficient for deployed LLM agents, and proposes a contract-based architecture in which each safety dimension is enforced by an independently certified layer whose probabilistic guarantee satisfies the next layer's assumption.

2605.18674.tldr: This work improves on the recently published idea of Iterated Width (IW) policies, introducing a vastly more efficient holistic encoding of the entire search tree and defining Abstracted IW(1) to improve scaling through relational abstraction during novelty checks.

2605.18675.tldr: This work introduces COOPO (Cyclic Offline-Online Policy Optimization), a generalized framework that repeatedly cycles between constrained offline training and online fine-tuning, and achieves better online sample efficiency, surpassing pure online RL, with guaranteed monotonic improvement under standard coverage assumptions.

2605.18681.tldr: A framework that serves as a quantifiable metric for the quality of XAI methods, based on continuous input perturbation is proposed, and an adapter module that can be trained on top of any black-box model to output causal explanations of the model's decision process, without degrading model performance is proposed.

2605.18684.tldr: Reversa, a reverse documentation engineering framework for converting legacy software into traceable operational specifications for AI agents, is presented and an evaluation protocol with metrics for coverage, traceability, confidence, utility, and cost is proposed.

2605.18693.tldr: SkillGenBench establishes a reproducible testbed for studying skill generation as an independent research problem in agent systems, and shows substantial performance variation, highlight the difficulty of reusable skill distillation, and reveal distinct failure modes in skill generation from software repositories versus long-form documents.

2605.18696.tldr: Six ensemble strategies over six tabular foundation models are benchmarked: competitive accuracy and ROC-AUC, the worst log-loss rank among the ensembles, and greedy selection as the practical default.

2605.18697.tldr: PopPy is a system that can uncover parallelization opportunities in Python applications that invoke these heavy external components, including those used in compound AI applications, by addressing three key challenges in extracting parallelism from Python applications: language complexity, dynamic dispatch, and variable mutation.

2605.18702.tldr: Leakage-aware distillation is a viable route for bringing TFM-quality predictions into inference-constrained health settings and is addressed with stratified out-of-fold teacher labeling.

2605.18727.tldr: DexHoldem, a real-world system-level benchmark built around Texas Hold'em dexterous manipulation with a ShadowHand, is introduced, which evaluates dexterous tabletop execution, agentic perception, and embodied decision routing in a shared physical setting.

2605.18732.tldr: This work evaluated 38 models on over 8,900 scholarly references evaluated by an automated reference verification system and found that recall quality follows a sigmoid in the log-linear combination of model parameter count and topic representation in training data.

2605.18738.tldr: A framework for auditing value pluralism in medical AI is presented, comprising a benchmark of clinician-verified dilemmas and an attribution method that recovers value priorities directly from decisions.

2605.18753.tldr: This work proposes DashAttention (Differentiable and Adaptive Sparse Hierarchical Attention), which leverages the adaptively sparse $\alpha$-entmax transformation to select a variable number of blocks according to the current query in the first stage, keeping the entire hierarchy fully differentiable.

2504.07756.tldr: This paper investigates the epistemic and practical success of the AI-framings, and argues that there is a possible semantic catch to the AI-framing, which is that the AI-framings point towards avenues for forms of conceptual engineering.

2505.23747.tldr: Spatial-MLLM is presented, a novel framework for visual-based spatial reasoning from purely 2D observations that achieves state-of-the-art performance in a wide range of visual-based spatial understanding and reasoning tasks.

2509.19182.tldr: In this prototype system, YAC, Yet Another Chatbot, YAC uses a tool-calling multi-agent system to generate declarative output, which is interpreted to render linked interactive visualizations and apply data filters, and includes adjustment widgets, which allow users to directly modify the structured output.

2602.11767.tldr: This work proposes TSR (Trajectory-Search Rollouts), a training-time approach that repurposes test-time scaling ideas for improved per-turn rollout generation and provides a modular and general mechanism for stronger multi-turn agent learning, complementary to existing frameworks and rejection-sampling-style selection methods.

2602.23622.tldr: This paper introduces DeepLookEditBench, the first benchmark dedicated to assessing the abilities of IIEMs in editing small-scale objects and proposes an evaluation protocol with refined score rubrics to minimize subjectivity and ambiguity in two criteria: Instruction Following and Visual Consistency.

2605.01733.tldr: GEASS (Gated Evidence-Adaptive Selective Caption Trust), a training-free, logit-level module that decides per query how much of the caption to trust, gating it by the clean path's confidence, weighting it by the entropy reduction it induces, and raising the evidence bar when the two pathways disagree.

2605.17480.tldr: The results show that upgrading components to stronger models can actively degrade system security, and that effective defenses require exploiting--rather than eliminating--capability asymmetries between agents.

2605.18920.tldr: A synergistic generative recommendation framework that explicitly encourages the exploitation of cross-modal dependencies during generation, SynGR enables the model to capture emergent item semantics beyond shared or modality-specific signals.

2605.19228.tldr: NIBS, a non-parametric IB approach measuring consistency without graph structures, and GIBS, a graph-based IB model that learns subgraphs through a differentiable mask to capture logical variability are proposed, a non-parametric IB approach measuring consistency without graph structures.

2605.19266.tldr: FormalASR requires no post-processing LLM at deployment time, providing a lightweight, on-device solution for spoken-to-formal transcription, while also improving ROUGE-L and BERTScore.

2605.19576.tldr: Eight ablations decompose which governance mechanisms are load-bearing and which are subsumed, providing a concrete playbook for diagnosing library drift in any self-evolving agent.

2605.20098.tldr: In inference-time argumentation (ITA), a trainable neurosymbolic framework for ternary claim verification, is introduced, which improves upon argumentative baselines and can perform competitively against non-argumentative direct-prediction baselines, while providing verdicts that are computed deterministically from explicit, inspectable argumentative structures.

2605.20167.tldr: The HaorFloodAlert system raised a high-risk alert about three days before the river neared its danger level in May-June 2026 and raised a high-risk alert about three days before the river neared its danger level in May-June 2026.

2605.20052.tldr: PromptRad reformulates multi-label classification as masked language modeling and incorporates synonyms from the UMLS Metathesaurus into a multi-word verbalizer to enrich category representations and requires substantially less labeled data than conventional fine-tuning.

2605.20256.tldr: FBOS-RL is proposed, which learns substantially faster than GRPO and feedback-based baselines and ultimately attains a higher performance ceiling, while exhibiting higher policy entropy and lower gradient norms throughout training.

2605.20308.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that compared with previous state-of-the-art methods, SDM not only achieves stronger attack performance but also exhibits superior cost-effectiveness.

2605.20382.tldr: It is suggested that instruction-following remains brittle under induction pressure even for otherwise capable models, and that output diversity, rather than semantic engagement with the input, is the primary factor predicting robustness.

2605.20689.tldr: Under query-disjoint evaluation with two LLM2Vec backbones, five BEIR benchmarks, 128d and 256d outputs, and six baselines, DIVE is the strongest adapter on all five primary benchmarks and outperforms PCA and an autoencoder in comparisons against unsupervised compressors.

2605.20708.tldr: A systematic empirical analysis of cross-layer information flow in DiTs is presented, jointly along depth and denoising timestep, and three concrete symptoms of traditional residual addition are identified, namely monotonic forward magnitude inflation, sharp backward gradient decay, and pronounced block-wise redundancy are identified.

2605.20712.tldr: This work introduces SCRIBE, a diagnostic framework offering categorical error decomposition into lexical, punctuation, numeral, and domain-entity rates via sandhi-tolerant alignment with domain vocabulary injection, and releases SCRIBE, an LLM curation pipeline, benchmarks, and open-weight rich transcription models for Hindi, Malayalam, and Kannada.

2605.20803.tldr: This paper proposes a model merging framework, termed Tunable MAGMAX, which enables preference-aware control of task-specific performance in CL and proposes a method for automatically constructing appropriate preference vectors by leveraging small amounts of target environment data and datasets from model training tasks, thereby eliminating the need for manual specification.

2605.20868.tldr: A tiered KV cache architecture that enables runtime-certified attention: INT8 keys and INT4 values are stored in GPU memory, while FP16 originals are retained in system RAM for deterministic fallback and adaptive precision selection and a multi-stage fallback ladder.

2605.20872.tldr: Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation (CAdam), a novel framework that reinterprets densification as a statistically grounded signal verification problem, is introduced, which reduces Gaussian count by 85%-97% relative to standard densification while preserving overall comparable perceptual quality.

2605.20874.tldr: This demo presents CUGA's policy system, a modular policy-as-code layer that composes with a generalist LLM agent to deliver predictable, auditable, and compliance-aware behavior in compound workflows without model fine-tuning.

2605.20876.tldr: Terminal-World is introduced, a fully automated pipeline that uses agent skills as the central synthesis primitive, which jointly encode what to accomplish, when to apply, when to apply, and how to execute, enabling task instructions, environments, and teacher trajectories to be co-derived.

2605.20901.tldr: VISTA, a V-JEPA Integrated StillFast Temporal Anticipator for the Ego4D Short-Term Object Interaction Anticipation (STA) Challenge at EgoVis 2026 achieves first place on the official challenge server.

2605.20911.tldr: An alternative decision-making framework in which the agent learns not only what action to take but also for how long to execute it is considered, which makes it easier to learn exploitative strategies where the same action is repeated over and over, which the scripted bots appear to be susceptible to.

2605.20915.tldr: It is demonstrated that good calibration can coexist with shortcut-based decision rules after unlearning, extending the reliability paradox to the machine unlearning setting.

2605.20922.tldr: WONN is, to the authors' knowledge, the first synchronization-based oscillatory architecture to scale competitively to ImageNet-1K, and the results suggest that structured oscillatory dynamics provide a scalable and parameter-efficient alternative to conventional neural architectures.

2605.20923.tldr: This work gives a vector-clock monitor with latest-value views and proves that the locally computed monitor value coincides with the denotational semantics of the guard at the current event, so runtime verification becomes part of the coordination language itself, rather than a post-hoc check over an execution log.

2605.20924.tldr: This work proposes Strategy-Induct, a framework that derives task-level instructions solely from a small set of example questions without requiring labeled answers, and observes that jointly utilizing LLMs and Large Reasoning Models across task instruction generation and inference may lead to further performance improvements.

2605.20936.tldr: DASH is introduced, a fast differentiable search framework for hybrid attention architecture design, which relaxes discrete layer-wise attention operator placement into continuous architecture logits, prepares reusable teacher-aligned linear candidates, and performs architecture-only search with model and operator weights frozen to significantly enhance search efficiency.

2605.20965.tldr: This work finds that LVLMs tend to hallucinate when they pay insufficient attention to the correct visual evidence and gradually forget it during the generation process, and proposes a novel hallucination mitigation method that enhances visual evidence based on Inter-Layer Visual Attention Discrepancy (ILVAD).

2605.20971.tldr: This study compares the performance of four pretrained CNN architectures including VGG16, ResNet50, EfficientNetB0, and XceptionNet for fake image detection using a unified preprocessing and training pipeline to provide a reproducible baseline.

2605.20982.tldr: This work instruments five open MoE checkpoints that span today's sequence-mixer designs, and introduces DODOCO to test two assumptions about the workload: that routing imbalance is correctable by the system layer, and that the mock-token benchmarks evaluating them faithfully represent production routing.

2605.20994.tldr: Anchor Invariance Regularization (AIR), which treats verifiable prompts as anchors and uses a stop-gradient target to regularize only the open-ended variants toward the anchor performance, improves context invariance and makes safety constraints robust to adversarial framings.

2605.20997.tldr: The extended model is applied and validated on several TanDEM-X acquisitions over the Gabonese Lopé national park site and assessed against airborne LiDAR measurements, showing a 13.5% reduction in root-mean-square error (RMSE) and a 16.6% reduction in mean absolute error (MAE) compared to the original hybrid model, confirming the added value of multispectral inputs.

2605.20998.tldr: It is argued that Transformer depth is a costly, queryable resource, and DABS, a single-pass inference framework that encodes each sentence once to construct a reusable, depth-ordered substrate, is proposed, which decouples shared sentence encoding from lightweight, aspect-conditioned readout.

2605.21006.tldr: It is suggested that sycophancy is better understood as a persona-level property rather than a single steerable direction, and off-the-shelf persona steering vectors, originally developed for general role-playing and not trained on sycophancy data, can serve as an alternative.

2605.21027.tldr: Analytic Agent is presented, an LLM-based agentic system that translates natural language intents into secure interactions with enterprise analytics APIs and reliably interprets user goals, validates permissions, executes governed queries, and generates compliant visualizations through multi-step reasoning and policy-aware orchestration.

2605.21028.tldr: DySink is proposed, a retrieval-based framework that maintains a compact memory bank and selects visually relevant historical frames as dynamic frame sinks and couples adaptive retrieval with a sink anomaly gate, which detects excessive inter-head consensus over retrieved context and suppresses collapse-prone context.

2502.17518.tldr: This paper evaluates the effectiveness of various ensemble methods, comparing them with individual RL models across key financial metrics, including Cumulative Returns, Sharpe Ratios (SR), Calmar Ratios, and Maximum Drawdown (MDD).

2509.09215.tldr: A blockchain-enabled layered architecture for regulatory agent collaboration, comprising an agent layer, a blockchain data layer, and a regulatory application layer is proposed, establishing a systematic foundation for trustworthy, resilient, and scalable regulatory mechanisms in large-scale agent ecosystems.

2603.26539.tldr: It is recommended that when models are used in research, potential threats to inference should be systematically identified along with the steps taken to mitigate them, and that specific justifications for model selection should be provided.

2603.26603.tldr: A replicable and reproducible experimental pipeline is constructed to profile the complex interplay between energy consumption, latency, and quality of LLMs on mobile devices, and identifies a pragmatic sweet spot of mid-sized models that effectively balance response quality with sustainable energy consumption.

2605.07926.tldr: It is suggested that current agents can often handle local tool use but still struggle with deep contextual dependencies, and AgentEscapeBench can serve as a diagnostic testbed for measuring current agent capabilities and informing future training efforts toward more robust general-purpose reasoning, action, and adaptation.

2605.09492.tldr: Adaptive Path-Contrastive Decoding (APCD) is proposed, a multi-path decoding framework that improves output reliability through adaptive exploration and controlled path interaction and dynamically attenuating inter-path influence as prediction distributions diverge.

2605.10574.tldr: This work introduces SciAidanBench, a benchmark of open-ended scientific questions designed to measure the scientific creativity of large language models (LLMs), and finds that jaggedness manifests both across models and within models, and shows that this jaggedness can be harnessed.

2605.12321.tldr: The proposed LIDSA (LLM-Based Intent-Driven Speed Advisory), a signal-free cognitive arbitration framework for autonomous intersection management, demonstrates that LLM-based reasoning can enable real-time, signal-free intersection management.

2605.12597.tldr: It is demonstrated that diffusion models can overcome the critical slowing down through appropriate architectural design, and establish a controlled framework for understanding and improving learned sampling methods in statistical physics and beyond.

2605.15156.tldr: MeMo (Memory as a Model), a modular framework that encodes new knowledge into a dedicated memory model while keeping the LLM parameters unchanged, is introduced, showing that MeMo achieves strong performance compared to existing methods across diverse settings.

2605.17618.tldr: This work fine-tuned state-of-the-art foundation models for multimodal wearable time-series analysis and shows that challenging behavior episodes can be predicted up to 10 minutes in advance with an AUC-ROC of 0.78, establishing a concrete foundation for developing proactive in-class intervention systems that enable teachers to minimize the safety risks of challenging behaviors in special education classrooms.

2605.18991.tldr: A set of core principles are articulated, grounded in decades of systems security research, that provide a foundation for designing agentic systems with predictable guarantees and identify the research challenges that stand in the way of implementing these principles.

2605.19362.tldr: It is argued that agent-skill evaluation should treat specifications as user-facing capability disclosures, not merely as containers for executable instructions.

2605.20706.tldr: The design significantly reduces memory overhead through static memory planning and efficient model loading, addresses cross-device variability through a tunable kernel library, and introduces templated GPU kernels that support performant implementations of numerous quantization formats, enabling broad model support and extensibility to new formats.

2605.21060.tldr: This work proposes a compositional approach to multiclass calibration, where region-specific calibration maps are constructed from shared codeword-dependent factors, and instantiates this idea via Vector Quantization (VQ), which induces a structured partition of the representation space.

2605.21061.tldr: A re-design of Driving VLA in the style of an inverse kinematics solver that recovers visual grounding and reaches trajectory planning performance comparable to 7B--8B VLAs more than an order of magnitude larger, on both the closed-loop NAVSIM-v2 and the nuScenes benchmarks.

2605.21082.tldr: Experiments across multiple GUI environments demonstrate that RPA functions generated by AutoRPA successfully solve similar tasks while reducing token usage by 82% to 96%, significantly improving runtime efficiency and reusability.

2605.21085.tldr: SLIM is provided, a minimal architecture that decouples the communication pathway from the policy's latent representation, allowing us to isolate the effect of bandwidth from the effect of policy capacity while benefiting from in-step communication.

2605.21102.tldr: The extractive question answering system VerbatimRAG is applied to research papers in the ACL Anthology, directly mapping user queries to verbatim text spans in retrieved documents, and a novel ground truth dataset is contributed.

2605.21146.tldr: MIST, a Trojan detection approach that analyzes how a model's internal representations change during fine-tuning indicates that spectral evolution provides a stable and assumption-light signal for detecting malicious model updates.

2605.21154.tldr: This research demonstrates that adapting LLMs to specific clinical nomenclature is essential for overcoming the challenges of ``long-tail''label distributions and the inherent ambiguity of psychiatric discourse.

2605.21157.tldr: This research boosts the performance and reliability of drone-based operations by contributing to the development of advanced detection systems in both defensive and offensive missions.

2605.21182.tldr: This work revisit the dialogue text annotations of Manga109 and identifies five categories of annotation issues, including inaccurate transcriptions, missing text regions, overlapping dialogue and onomatopoeia, and under-segmented speech balloons, to better align Manga109 with modern OCR and multimodal manga understanding systems.

2605.21186.tldr: A novel eXplainable AI (XAI) framework that innovatively transforms initial feature attribution maps into geometry-aware prompts and introduces a dual-constraint mechanism based on physical significance and geometric alignment to perform instance-level denoising, generating coherent explanations that better align with human expert intuition.

2605.21198.tldr: SURGE, a multi-event social media benchmark that pairs event-level time series with aligned text and interaction structure linking posts within an event, is presented and a lightweight structure-aware probe is included as a reference implementation, illustrating how SURGE can support interaction-aware forecasting research.

2605.21213.tldr: This work develops a generalized framework that formally poses process synthesis as a Markov decision process and introduces quantum-enhanced RL algorithms to solve it with improved scalability and establishes a controlled benchmark for comparing classical and quantum algorithms.

2605.21224.tldr: This Review Paper provides the first comprehensive overview of AI‐enabled MWP, systematically summarizing the state‐of‐the‐art advances and presenting insights for both the academic community and the broader public.

2605.21225.tldr: This work addresses the problem of making a pre-trained reinforcement learning (RL) policy safety-aware by incorporating cost constraints without retraining it from scratch by introducing PREFINE: Preference-based Implicit Reward and Cost Fine-Tuning for Safety Alignment, a preference-based fine-tuning method that adapts Direct Preference Optimization to the sequential decision making setting.

2605.21226.tldr: Across text, video, and audio, OCTOPUS matches or beats every prior rotation codec at every reported bit width and metric, with a lead that grows as bits drop for extreme compression.

2605.21237.tldr: This work focuses on leveraging the more accessible end-diastolic frame to infer a full-cycle sequence of Bi-ventricular mesh motion completion, and proposes Region-Aware and Phenotype-Adaptive Bi-Ventricular Cardiac Motion Synthesis (RePCM) for single frame Bi-ventricular mesh motion completion.

2605.21240.tldr: This work proposes Autonomous Policy EXploration (APEX), which builds and maintains an explicit strategy space through a strategy map-a directed acyclic graph of milestones with prerequisite dependency edges, demonstrating APEX's effectiveness for sustained exploration in self-evolving agents.

2605.21258.tldr: A novel pretraining framework that learns a hybrid representation-structural latent points, and develops a streamlined, efficient 3DGS-based rendering pipeline that is deliberately kept lightweight, improving efficiency while leaving greater representational capacity to the front-end latent module.

2605.21266.tldr: G2D (GRPO to DPO) is introduced, a three-stage pipeline that performs a short GRPO warm-up, constructs a static preference dataset, and fine-tunes a model offline with DPO, finding that offline DPO with moderate warm-up matches or outperforms GRPO at substantially lower compute cost in the authors' setting.

2605.21272.tldr: MONET, an open Apache 2.0 dataset of approx.

2605.21292.tldr: The results show that large constant learning rates can change the training attractor of the learned transformer rather than merely accelerating convergence: beyond sharp stability thresholds, finite-step training may settle into cycles, bounded chaos, or divergence instead of a single in-context linear-regression solution.

2605.21295.tldr: TimeSRL is introduced, a two-stage LLM framework that routes predictions through an explicit semantic bottleneck, demonstrating that semantic abstractions are reusable and point to a new direction for generalizable behavior modeling via RL-tuned LLMs.

2605.21299.tldr: Overall, LLMs are accurate semantic operators, but fail to capture the pragmatic enrichments characteristic of human reasoning, suggesting that pragmatic reasoning is still an emerging ability in the cognitive toolkit of artificial systems.

2605.21303.tldr: This work provides a formal infrastructure for cumulative mechanistic science by treating circuit interpretation as inductive theory construction, and reveals qualitatively distinct computational strategies across task types, including attention-mediated copying versus MLP-mediated binding.

2605.21308.tldr: Deformba is proposed, a context adaptive method that dynamically augments the spatial structural information while maintaining the linear complexity of SSMs, and allows multi-modal fusion like cross attention.

2605.21311.tldr: DeCoR is introduced, a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that leverages flow observations to co-optimize crosswalk layout and network-level signal control and is robust to layout changes without retraining.

2605.21312.tldr: Frontier, a discrete-event simulator for modern LLM inference serving, features a disaggregated abstraction that scales to over 1K GPUs on commodity CPUs and enables new use cases such as SLA-dependent Pareto frontier exploration, heterogeneous disaggregated allocation, agentic reasoning scheduling validation, and RL post-training reconfiguration.

2605.21318.tldr: TextReg is proposed, a regularization framework that realizes a soft-penalty objective through regularized textual gradients, combining Dual-Evidence Gradient Purification, Semantic Edit Regularization, and Regularization-Guided Prompt Update, which substantially improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization.

2605.21333.tldr: SymbolicLight V1 is presented, a spike-gated dual-path language model that combines binary Leaky Integrate-and-Fire spike dynamics with a continuous residual stream that trails GPT-2 201M by 7.7% in PPL while surpassing GPT-2 124M under the reported comparison.

2605.21372.tldr: This work conceptualizes the data mixture approximately as a dynamic optimization process that iteratively adjusts the training data mixture to maximize model performance, guided by closed-loop evaluation feedback, and proposes AutoScale, a fully automated closed-loop data engine unifying scene representation, data mixture optimization and retrieval, as well as model training and evaluation.

2605.21384.tldr: SpecBench is introduced, a benchmark comprising 30 systems-level programming tasks ranging from short horizon tasks like building a JSON parser to ultra long horizon tasks like building an entire OS kernel from scratch, which offers a principled testbed for measuring whether coding agents build genuine working systems or merely game the test suites developers hand them.

2605.21388.tldr: A theoretical framework for understanding the regularity of transport maps and the generalization properties of one-step Wasserstein-guided generative models for PDE-induced probability measures is developed and it is shown that the optimal transport map from a uniform source measure to the target measure is Holder continuous.

2605.21390.tldr: Factors such as tone, language, and conversational rhythm -- factors unique to the user's memory of the deceased -- shape interactions with generative ghosts, and it is argued that those interactions are always collaborative.

2605.21395.tldr: A BlueSky vision on how Artificial Intelligence will be natively integrated into 6G is presented, shifting the paradigm from Network for AI to AI for Network, framing network management as a unified, multi-modal, multi-task optimization problem.

2605.21401.tldr: A variation of Milgram's obedience experiment on 11 open-source LLMs was ran and it was found that most models reached or approached the final shock level before refusing, across 8 conditions with 30 trials per model per condition.

2605.21405.tldr: The stdlib capability boundary across complexity tiers and library categories is characterized, where LLM-assisted development succeeds and where it requires iterative human correction is discussed, and implications for dependency-free software engineering at scale are examined.

2605.21418.tldr: Simulations in an interference-rich reuse-1 setting show that FedCritic improves mean signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) and cell-edge rate, increases network-wide average sum-rate and fairness relative to non-coordinated and CTDE baselines, and achieves more stable training with lower coordination overhead.

2605.21420.tldr: Highland Reaction Representations is presented, a retrieval-augmented condition recommendation system whose learned reaction space serves as both a classifier feature and an inspectable precedent memory that supplies both competitive recommendations and the concrete chemical precedents necessary for practical synthesis planning.

2605.21427.tldr: A power-aware runtime for LLM serving, PALS, that treats GPU power caps as a first-class control knob and jointly optimizes them with software parameters such as batch size, highlighting the potential of integrating power control directly into LLM inference runtimes, enabling energy-proportional and grid-interactive AI systems.

2605.21443.tldr: This work introduces TempGlitch, a controlled gameplay video benchmark for temporal glitch detection, and evaluates 12 proprietary and open-weight VLMs across multiple frame-sampling settings, showing that current VLMs remain near chance on TempGlitch.

2605.21453.tldr: An empirical study of Python refactoring pull requests from the AIDev dataset highlights both the promise and current limitations of agentic refactoring, and motivates stronger tool-in-the-loop quality and security gating for AI-driven development workflows.

2605.21458.tldr: Fisher-SEP, a simulation-aided experimental policy (SEP) that minimizes the posterior predictive variance of a target policy's value, with reward-only and transition-only specializations, is proposed.

2605.21460.tldr: Human-In-The-Loop Diffusion (HITL-D), a shared control framework that enhances user performance in multi-step, insertion, and fine manipulation tasks, and effectively integrates human expertise with autonomous assistance, improving both objective and subjective aspects of teleoperation.

2605.21463.tldr: Across diverse agentic benchmarks spanning web navigation, terminal-based tool use, and text-based embodied interaction, Mem-$\pi$ consistently outperforms retrieval-based and prior RL-optimized memory baselines, achieving over 30% relative improvement on web navigation tasks.

2605.21481.tldr: This work proposes AiraXiv, an AI-driven open-access platform built on open preprints, AI-augmented analysis and review, and reader feedback, and validate AiraXiv through real-world deployments, demonstrating its potential as a fast, inclusive, and scalable research infrastructure for the AI era.

2605.21482.tldr: A deep research benchmark that is substantially harder than existing benchmarks for the current frontier, and every reference answer is accompanied by a source-provenance record with four disclosure levels and cross-source checks where available, making scores easier to audit against the underlying evidence.

2605.21486.tldr: It is found that the overwhelming benefit of $\mu$P relative to SP when training with AdamW arises simply from maximizing the learning rate of the embedding layer, while weight decay improves the scaling law fits, while, in the fixed token-per-parameter setting, it hurts the robustness of the extrapolation.

2306.01690.tldr: It is suggested that neuron selectivity and neuron-wide consolidation is a simple and viable meta-plasticity hypothesis to enable CL in the brain and this simple model balances forgetting and consolidation leading to better transfer learning than contemporary CL algorithms on image recognition and natural language processing CL benchmarks.

2508.15943.tldr: This work extends the Iterative Local Refinement (ILR) neurosymbolic algorithm, leveraging the recent introduction of fuzzy LTLf interpretations, and proposes a neurosymbolic framework designed to incorporate temporal logic specifications directly into deep learning architectures for sequence-based tasks.

2412.13841.tldr: This exploratory study investigates cultural differences in mental models of AI using 71 imaginaries of AI's potential futures to identify significant differences in expectations, evaluations, and risk-benefit tradeoffs from Germany and China.

2606.11092.tldr: RoboNaldo is introduced, a three-stage motion-guided curriculum RL framework for high-impulse humanoid interaction that first learns a stable whole-body kicking prior, then adapts the kick to free-kick settings where the ball is stationary at random positions, and finally extends it to moving-ball shooting through a locomotion-command and kick-trigger interface.

2606.09426.tldr: This work introduces WeaveBench, a long-horizon hybrid-interface benchmark with 114 tasks across 8 real-world work domains, grounded in real user requests and publicly verifiable artifacts, and proposes a companion trajectory-aware judge that reveals that outcome-only grading substantially overestimates agent performance.

2606.07591.tldr: ResearchClawBench is presented, a benchmark for evaluating autonomous scientific research across 40 tasks from 10 scientific domains and provides a reproducible evaluation frontier for measuring progress toward autonomous scientific research.

2606.09365.tldr: SkeMex is a post-deployment self-evolution framework that improves medical agents through a skill-based memory without updating model weights and consistently outperforms representative memory-based agents in both offline and online settings.

2606.11042.tldr: Workflow-GYM is introduced, a benchmark for long-horizon GUI tasks centered on professional domains and specialized software environments and provides important insights into the limitations of current agent systems and suggest key directions for the next generation of GUI-agent research.

2606.07537.tldr: This paper analyses hallucination as a structural consequence of three architectural decisions that together form a compound failure system, locating intrinsic hallucination in self-attention, extrinsic hallucination in MLE, and logical inconsistency in autoregressive decoding.

2606.10135.tldr: BiWM provides a compact, reproducible path from pretrained bidirectional video models to interactive, controllable, and efficient world models, and requires only two stages: camera/action-control fine-tuning and few-step Distribution Matching Distillation.

2605.28591.tldr: It is demonstrated that evaluation meta-knowledge may inflate safety benchmark performance, introducing a novel confounder that is independent of explicit memorization or verbalized evaluation awareness, thus, challenging to detect.

2605.26938.tldr: A reformulation of alignment-based conformance checking as a totally unimodular linear program (LP) defined on the reachability graph of the synchronous product, exploiting the underlying network-flow structure to guarantee the existence of an integral optimal extreme-point solution through LP relaxation.

2606.11270.tldr: This study quantifies subliminal behavioral transfer ratios by steering two teacher models (Llama-2-7B-Chat and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) at varying steering strengths and distilling student models using only benign data.

2606.11218.tldr: EeVA, an agentic-like LLM-based workflow designed to support comparative ethical reflection rather than deliver definitive ethical answers, is developed and offers a promising proof of concept for supporting ethical reflection where access to ethics expertise is limited.

2606.11198.tldr: A formal framework decomposing attention scores into semantic and structural components is developed, and two orthogonal axes for improving retrieval-augmented ICL are revealed: optimising retrieval quality and reducing format-driven attention capture.

2606.11214.tldr: The Fairness-to-Action framework is introduced, which integrates methodological, organizational, and systemic dimensions to identify where translation of algorithmic fairness knowledge stalls, and shows that fairness remains weakly institutionalized, translation mechanisms are externally driven, and system-level priorities continue to emphasize accuracy over fairness.

2606.11210.tldr: Text to Multimodal Model (T2MM), a robust, dynamic LLM supported architecture that assists in model construction within the open inquiry ecology-based modeling software Virtual Experimental Research Assistant (VERA), is introduced.

2606.11201.tldr: BlendIn is introduced, an inference-time alignment framework that shifts from binary decisions to creating hybrid distributions integrating both models'knowledge that stabilizes inference-time alignment by performing quality-aware alignment and proportionally weighting each model's contribution based on reliability.

2606.11197.tldr: A memory-based feature augmentation method that enhances the representational capacity of GRU-extracted features that is evaluated on the widely used DAIC-WOZ and E-DAIC datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

2606.11430.tldr: A paper-level formalization score that measures how much of a publication is covered in formal systems is introduced, a first step toward integrating bibliographic and formal mathematical ecosystems into scalable, machine-actionable knowledge graphs linking publications to formal proof objects.

2606.11349.tldr: This work proposes ACTION-RATING, a formulation that places it inside the agent's action space on a shared ordinal scale with navigation, so that asking competes directly with acting at every decision point and help-seeking becomes observable at intermediate states.

2606.11275.tldr: RoVE is proposed, a parameter-free modification that makes values position-sensitive by rotating them simultaneously with keys, and it is shown that it turns RoPE attention into attentive convolution.

2606.11219.tldr: This work evaluates audio language models across five semantic and paralinguistic reasoning tasks: entailment, consistency, plausibility, accent drift, and accent restraint, to highlight critical limitations in current audio reasoning evaluations.

2606.11217.tldr: This paper proposes a preregistration template tailored to experiments with AI agents and calls on conferences, journals, and funding agencies to make preregistration standard practice for this emerging research paradigm.

2606.11211.tldr: It is suggested that increasing reasoning depth does not always improve reliability and should be monitored carefully, and CABStop is introduced, a calibration-aware stopping rule that halts reasoning when confidence diverges from an auxiliary accuracy estimate.

2606.11199.tldr: NightFeats, a structured multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system submitted to the MMU-RAGent competition at NeurIPS 2025, is presented, confirming that architectural transparency and verifiable evidence grounding are better aligned with human preferences than systems optimizing narrowly for automatic similarity metrics.

2606.11357.tldr: Results show that XDNA2 is a practical target for AWQ-style edge LLM inference and that native NPU support for off-the-shelf quantization can make NPUs substantially more usable in real client deployments.

2606.11245.tldr: This position paper argues that integrating explicit memory is the cornerstone for advancing LLMs toward AGI and complement it with computational requirements for artificial explicit memory systems, hoping to foster further research and lay the groundwork for explicit memory integration.

2606.11244.tldr: SPEAR, a system for post-quantization error-adaptive recovery that improves low-bit LLM serving through adaptive kernel-fusion dispatch, combining an epilogue-integrated peer-reduction kernel with P2P dual-write to fuse the post-EC computation into low-bit GEMMs, and an SLO-constrained EC-aware scheduler for predictable serving performance.

2606.11238.tldr: It is argued that AI-assisted systems can support maritime finance professionals in managing increasingly complex information and reporting requirements.

2606.11209.tldr: This work proposes ProcessThinker, a practical post-training pipeline that provides step-level process rewards without training an explicit PRM, and gives dense credit assignment and encourages reasoning steps that more reliably support a correct conclusion, helping reduce inconsistent or self-contradictory progress across steps.

2606.11196.tldr: PoQ-Judge, a framework that trains dedicated judge models to score query-output pairs without ground-truth references, is presented, showing that online calibration identifies semantic quality as the dominant dimension and that cascade evaluation reduces cost by 72.7 percent with only modest quality loss.

2606.11215.tldr: This work proposes an open-source method for systematically measuring and reporting the computational expense of LLMs and environmental impact of running Machine Learning (ML) AIED systems and provides software solutions to measure the carbon footprint for both local and cloud based hardware.

2606.11208.tldr: BioDivergence offers a more faithful way to distinguish contextual divergence from direct contradiction and to separate article-level memorization from genuine task learning.

2606.11207.tldr: The LLM-Integrated Semantic Inference Engine is introduced, a fully implemented two-phase LLM-driven inference architecture that leverages complete element metadata at inference time that leverages complete element metadata at inference time.

2606.11195.tldr: Relational Reflective Intelligence (RRI), an inference-time governance layer that operationalizes reflection through auditable reasoning loops, reframes AI safety as a cognitive architecture problem, where reliable decisions depend on embedding reflection directly into the interaction process.

2606.11719.tldr: Ouroboros-Spatial is proposed, a self-evolving training framework in which the model plays dual roles as a proposer and a solver, and substantially improves Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B while using an order of magnitude fewer training examples than recent large-scale curated datasets.

2606.11637.tldr: This work proposes TouchThinker, a tactile-language framework that scales tactile commonsense reasoning to the open world from both data and representation perspectives, and proposes action-aware modeling mechanism to improve tactile representation efficiency and enable efficient reasoning.

2606.11520.tldr: Fine-tuning on ISETrace improves ClawEval pass@1 from 19.3 to 37.7 using Qwen3-8B on agent tool-use tasks with a standard protocol, which outperforms zero-shot GPT-4o and the larger Qwen3-32B base model which is four times bigger.

2606.11767.tldr: Results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands.

2606.12040.tldr: This study proposes a novel "generation-evaluation-optimization"closed-loop framework for automated concrete barrier design using the multi-agent orchestration capabilities of AutoGen, and reveals that design performance is not necessarily correlated with model scale, where an 8B-parameter lightweight model could outperform unconstrained 631B-parameter flagship models.

2606.11930.tldr: The findings suggest that AVI-based psychological assessment benefits from trait-specific multimodal modeling, but cognitive ability prediction requires careful control of dataset shortcuts.

2606.11990.tldr: A lightweight learning approach is introduced, in which a frozen pretrained time-series foundation model is used as a frozen backbone to extract context window features and train a lightweight regression neural network for RUL prediction from multivariate sensor streams.

2606.11766.tldr: This work explores training acceleration of SFM distillation to speed up model deployment and proposes interleaved stacking, a novel stacking method that consistently preserves layer position throughout the stacking process.

2606.12025.tldr: The Human-Enhanced Loop Modeling (HELM) framework is presented, a collaborative human-agent protocol that decomposes long-sequence finite element modeling into discrete, visually verifiable checkpoints across geometry generation, boundary condition definition, and material assignment.

2606.11836.tldr: A novel data-free and training-free compression approach for speech foundation models using channelwise clustering via k-means using channelwise clustering via k-means is presented and more fine-grained, mixed sparsity pruning by layer-level varying number of parameter clusters is explored.

2606.11792.tldr: MultiToP is proposed, a multimodal-context-aware visual token patching framework that mitigates hallucinations by refining unreliable visual tokens before language generation and enables localized visual evidence refinement without modifying the original model.

2606.11751.tldr: AnchorEdit is proposed, the first autoregressive (AR) diffusion-based framework designed specifically for high-resolution, long-term multi-turn editing, and achieves state-of-the-art results, maintaining exceptional subject fidelity and instruction following even over 10+ interaction rounds.

2606.11793.tldr: A data-driven framework AI4Land, for generating high-resolution historical reconstructions and future projections of key land surface variables, developed and trained on MareNostrum5, demonstrating how GPU-accelerated HPC infrastructure enables global-scale climate AI pipelines.

2310.04680.tldr: This work studies two natural scaling techniques -- weight pruning and simply training a smaller or larger model, which is referred to as dense scaling -- and their effects on two core capabilities of LLMs: recalling facts presented during pre-training and processing information presented in-context during inference.

2606.12346.tldr: An AI-based system built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models that predicts tissue quality, tissue region, and cell type labels across multiple cancer types, yielding over 4,500 quantitative readouts per slide at cell-level resolution, and proposes an IHC-informed multi-pathologist consensus protocol that substantially improves inter-rater agreement over conventional H&E-only annotation.

2606.12109.tldr: InDex is introduced, an intent-conditioned adaptation framework that preserves the VLA's reaching competence while markedly improving conversion from approach to stable grasp and task completion and identifies post-reach arm--hand coordination as the principal bottleneck in adapting parallel-gripper VLAs to dexterous manipulation.

2606.12384.tldr: This work proposes Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization (APPO), which shifts branching and credit assignment from coarse interaction units to fine-grained decision points in the sequence and introduces procedure-level advantage scaling to better distribute credit across branched rollouts.

2206.02178.tldr: Factored conditional filters, new filtering algorithms for simultaneously tracking states and estimating parameters in high-dimensional state spaces, and new filtering algorithms for simultaneously tracking states and estimating parameters in high-dimensional state spaces are introduced.

2410.15595.tldr: This work categorizes recent studies on DPO based on key research questions to provide a thorough understanding of DPO's current landscape, and proposes several future research directions to offer insights on model alignment for the research community.

2409.04519.tldr: This study explores the effects of three data embedding techniques, data re-uploading, parallel embedding, and alternate embedding, on the representability and effectiveness of QAEs in detecting anomalies, highlighting the significant impact of embedding methods on QAE performance.

2407.20242.tldr: The introduction of BadRobot, a novel attack paradigm aiming to make embodied LLMs violate safety and ethical constraints through typical voice-based user-system interactions, and a benchmark of various malicious physical action queries to evaluate BadRobot's attack performance.

2412.11449.tldr: This paper shows how the proposed WHISPER-GPT architecture improves the perplexity and negative log-likelihood scores for the next token prediction compared to a token-based LLM for speech and music.

2504.03118.tldr: NuWa performs self-knowledge purification to prune class-detrimental weights and efficiently derives compact ViTs through closed-form optimization and without post-pruning retraining, the derived edge ViTs surpass the base ViT in class-specific accuracy and accelerate inference.

2508.07048.tldr: Whisfusion is proposed, which trains a dedicated masked diffusion decoder from scratch on top of frozen Whisper-large-v3 audio embeddings, denoising masked transcripts in just a few steps, and establishes masked diffusion as a Pareto-competitive non-autoregressive paradigm for high-throughput multilingual transcription.

2508.00491.tldr: The HannesImitationPolicy is presented, an imitation learning-based method to control the Hannes prosthetic hand, enabling object grasping in unstructured environments and it is shown that the policy outperforms a segmentation-based visual servo controller in unstructured scenarios.

2505.11034.tldr: This work introduces CleanPatrick, the first large-scale benchmark for data cleaning in the image domain, built upon the publicly available Fitzpatrick17k dermatology dataset, and enables a systematic comparison of image-cleaning strategies.

2503.08460.tldr: The fundamental role and functionality of standardization is examined, with a particular focus on its importance in Europe's regulatory framework, and selected topics in context of standardization activities in context intelligent manufacturing and digital twins are highlighted.

2509.21925.tldr: The theoretical analysis reveals that, in the presence of estimation errors, the stochastic generation process effectively produces convex combinations of training samples corrupted by a mixture of uniform and Gaussian noise.

2508.17196.tldr: This paper introduces BudgetThinker, a novel framework designed to empower LLMs with budget-aware reasoning, enabling precise control over the length of their thought processes, and proposes a methodology that periodically inserts special control tokens during inference to continuously inform the model of its remaining token budget.

2507.17188.tldr: This paper investigates secure communications in rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) enabled heterogeneous UAV networks, where multiple UAVs collaboratively serve ground terminals in the presence of eavesdroppers by proposing a hierarchical optimization framework.

2505.14608.tldr: It is demonstrated that while current attacks can effectively degrade performance of standard detectors, they fail to erase the underlying stylistic"fingerprints" of machine text, and suggests that reliable machine-text detection requires moving beyond single-document analysis to multi-document analysis.

2501.11937.tldr: This paper introduces MeshONet, the first generalizable intelligent method for structured mesh generation, and proposes a dual-branch, shared-trunk architecture to approximate the mapping between function spaces based on input-output pairs.

2411.02817.tldr: Experiments show that the conditional scores recover ground-truth diversity orderings and can also guide diffusion models toward more diverse samples toward more diverse samples.

2404.11716.tldr: This survey examines semantic modelling for BEM during the building operational phase, reviews 60 semantic models and analyses more than 20 ontology-based BEM use cases, and quantifies Ontology Instantiation Rates (OIR) and missing concepts across those use cases.

2508.19273.tldr: This work proposes MixGAN, a hybrid detection method that integrates conditional generation, semi-supervised learning, and robust feature extraction that achieves up to 2.5% higher accuracy and 4% improvement in both TPR and TNR compared to state-of-the-art methods, confirming its robustness in large-scale IoT-cloud environments.

2508.02548.tldr: KG-ER is proposed, a conceptual schema language for knowledge graphs that describes the structure of knowledge graphs independently of their representation while helping to capture the semantics of the information stored in a knowledge graph.

2507.05019.tldr: This work empirically demonstrates that the increased quality and diversity of such data improve the generalization abilities of in-context learners beyond their training domain, while achieving comparable performance with models trained on a single large-scale dataset.

2606.13247.tldr: Empirical results show that EPIG reduces mean arousal error compared to strong baselines, including naive insertion and LLM-based prompt expansion, with reductions of 14% and 12%, respectively, which are statistically significant.

2507.10599.tldr: It is found that LLMs naturally form hierarchical emotion trees that align with human psychological models, and larger models develop more complex hierarchies, with systematic biases in emotion recognition across socioeconomic personas.

2508.04427.tldr: This systematic literature review analyzes research published between January 2020 and early 2024 that focuses on the explainability of multimodal XAI models and provides a comprehensive set of recommendations aimed at promoting rigorous, transparent, and standardized evaluation and reporting practices in multimodal XAI research.

2505.04021.tldr: Prism is developed, a memory-centric LLM co-serving framework that applies memory ballooning to reclaim memory across models and support both forms of sharing under a single scheme, observing that elastic memory allocation can unify spatial and temporal sharing.

2606.00807.tldr: Interaction-Centered Intelligence is introduced as a framework for understanding human-AI co-creation, collaborative emergence, adaptive participation, and interactional dynamics, and the framework emphasizes interaction trajectories, coordination patterns, participatory engagement, adaptive regulation, and interactional drift unfolding through time.

2603.06652.tldr: PaLMR offers a principled and practical route to process-aligned multimodal reasoning, advancing the reliability and interpretability of MLLMs and achieving state-of-the-art results on HallusionBench while maintaining strong performance on MMMU, MathVista, and MathVerse.

2606.02133.tldr: This work introduces a probabilistic framework for learning insertion order in variable-length insertion models and proposes the Insertion Process (IP), a stochastic generative model that jointly learns where to insert, what to insert, and when to terminate, trained via permutation-based variational inference.

2605.25225.tldr: This paper develops Transformer Field Theory: a response-theoretic framework in which the residual stream of a fixed forward pass is treated as a Transformer field over layer depth and token position, providing the forward mathematical basis for patch-site inference and cross-scale response transfer.

2602.18154.tldr: FENCE, a bilingual (Korean-English) multimodal dataset for training and evaluating jailbreak detectors in financial applications, provides a focused resource for advancing multimodal jailbreak detection in finance and for supporting safer, more reliable AI systems in sensitive domains.

2603.26705.tldr: Physic-Informed Mamba is presented, a generative model that enforces exact local covalent geometry by construction while enabling linear-time inference and introduces a spectral initialization derived from the Rouse polymer model and an auxiliary cis-proline awareness head.

2605.08116.tldr: Experimental results show that the Safety-Aware Denoiser substantially reduces unsafe generations while preserving generation quality, diversity, and fluency, outperforming existing methods.

2603.24603.tldr: This study introduces a multi-scale fusion learning framework, namely MSFL, which leverages two complementary dFC features derived from SWC and phase synchronization, and evaluates the efficacy of MSFL in classifying autism spectrum disorder and major depressive disorder.

2602.18072.tldr: An overview of the hard- and software stack is provided, the underlying design principles are explained, some of the system’s capabilities are demonstrated, and the system is made easily available over a web portal for use by the wider community.

2605.27628.tldr: It is concluded that formalizing failure management within the autonomy lifecycle is a crucial step toward realizing reliable and governed artificial intelligence.

2606.12425.tldr: Results indicate that the assistant can provide accurate, instructor-verified feedback to students while fostering a positive experience, and grounding reliability in instructor-defined pedagogical knowledge.

2606.12422.tldr: The results demonstrate that LLM graders, especially when based on foundational models with more parameters, achieve substantial agreement with human raters in mathematics and science assessments, while the performances vary in ELA, suggesting generic foundation models can be effective at scoring in given contexts.

2606.10716.tldr: Improvements extend to domain-specific, task-specialized, and native long-context models, showing that the proposed mechanism provides complementary information rather than merely compensating for limited input length.

2606.12451.tldr: This work introduces ToolSense, an open-source LLM-powered diagnostic framework that takes any tool catalog as input and automatically generates three benchmarks: a Realistic Retrieval Benchmark (RRB) with queries at three ambiguity tiers, an MCQ probing benchmark, and a QA probing benchmark.

2606.12429.tldr: This report presents evaluations for catastrophic risk domains under Meta's Advanced AI Scaling Framework, along with the evidence that informed the launch decision of Muse Spark, and releases Muse Spark as the underlying model of Meta AI.

2606.09500.tldr: Determinism-where-possible verification yields an auditable, re-executable trail that exposes the evidence a human needs to check an LLM-assisted manuscript: feasibility and reproducibility evidence, not a claim of human-competitive quality, which a separate blinded study addresses.

2606.10616.tldr: Experiments show OSL-MR outperforms recency-based, Generative Agents-style, and other heuristic baselines, especially under tight budgets, and the Mixed-Score prior improves precision and recall, and sensitivity analysis shows robustness across cost settings.

2606.12476.tldr: A first-order Markov model of the latent faithful/hallucinated state of the latent faithful/hallucinated state is placed inside classical change-point theory and Lorden's lower bound on detection delay is yielded.

2606.12441.tldr: Generativism is proposed as a learning theory for the generative AI age that posits that learning increasingly occurs through the iterative co-construction of knowledge between human learners and AI systems.

2606.12420.tldr: Eigenism is introduced, an ethical framework that treats identity not as an all-or-nothing property tied to specific hardware, but as a graded, distributed pattern of information, showing how deep, non-redundant shared histories can make human flourishing a genuine component of an AI's own rational self-interest.

2606.12419.tldr: GeoDial is introduced, a multimodal tutoring dataset of over 1.3K teacher-student dialogs in the domain of geometry collected from experienced math teachers, where instructional turns are explicitly grounded in diagram highlights, and a scalable annotation protocol is proposed that integrates dialog acts, visual highlighting, and feedback.

2606.12413.tldr: A pedagogical framework that leverages AI SciBrief, a platform powered by a Large Language Model designed to automatically generate digests of scientific trends that functions as a “gateway to research” effectively reducing students' cognitive load and empowering them to transition more rapidly from information searching to knowledge creation.

2606.09073.tldr: The pessimistic branch unifies the prior heuristics for RM ensemble aggregation: mean aggregation, worst-case optimization (WCO), and uncertainty-weighted optimization (UWO) all emerge as limits or truncations of this single expression.

2606.12442.tldr: A working definition of control is established by anchoring it to the"setting and getting of goals", and various aspects of control are discussed, built on foundational concepts from related fields like cybernetics, management control, and control theory.

2606.12428.tldr: This work offers a record of AI programs in the U.S. at a time of great upheaval, a tool to explore AI programs and their requirements, and an analysis of the courses required for 66 AI majors and 87 AI minors.

2606.12423.tldr: This paper presents a systematic literature review to examine the challenges of balancing AI compliance and technological innovation across critical infrastructure sectors, and highlights practical governance strategies to support scalable and trustworthy AI deployment in critical sectors.

2606.12418.tldr: It is argued that LLM divination preserves core functions of traditional practice while introducing scalability, repeatability, and prompt-driven co-production that reshape how divinatory authority is constructed and evaluated.

2606.12415.tldr: The paper provides a juridically grounded definition of the profile, argues for its autonomy from adjacent figures and international standards, proposes a reference competence architecture aligned with the European e-Competence Framework (e-CF, EN 16234-1) as a methodological choice, and articulates the conditions for its operational measurement through key performance indicators.

2606.10683.tldr: UniDexTok is introduced, a retargeting-free state tokenizer that learns embodiment-conditioned discrete tokens from standardized real joint states that provides a unified representation for heterogeneous dexterous hands without relying on retargeting or simulation data.

2606.12439.tldr: This position argues the need for answer-level governance and measurement: stronger contestability, high-precision disclosure, black-box auditing of material influence, and deployment-aligned metrics for exposure persistence.

2606.12437.tldr: It is argued that the idea of ethical engineering, which was developed in the literature as a solution to the challenge of governing AI, is inadequate for various reasons and developed a different approach to coping with the risks of AI governance, which is termed "algorithmic constitutionalism".

2606.12430.tldr: Tasks perceived as bullshit are natural candidates for AI delegation, aligning worker preferences with perceived feasibility, according to Graeber's theory of bullshit jobs.

2606.12424.tldr: The findings support the curricular adoption of AI automation tooling in undergraduate computing education and identify three theory-grounded instructional levers: instruction-sequencing scaffolds, self-efficacy supports, and trust-calibration interventions.

2606.10200.tldr: It is shown that the improved GAN-based imaging logging image restoration method can be used for the restoration of micro-resistivity imaging log images with good improvement in semantic structural coherence and texture details, thus providing a new deep learning method to ensure the smooth advancement of the subsequent interpretation of micro-resistivity imaging log images.

2606.08098.tldr: This work characterize exactly when delegation overturns majority: a two-option model gives a closed-form flip condition on each option's confidence and the weight it routes to the other, with a do-no-harm corollary for near-unanimous questions.

2606.12747.tldr: This work investigates whether frontier language models can distinguish between tampered and untampered assistant-side context, a capability the authors call prefill awareness, and constructs a binary preference benchmark across three prefill mechanisms, filtering for cases where models show consistent stances.

2606.12736.tldr: SciAgentArena is introduced, a systematic benchmark for evaluating AI agents in real-world scientific research scenarios drawn from emerging needs across multiple domains and provides a practical framework for measuring progress in AI agents for science and for guiding the design of future agents capable of addressing complex scientific challenges.

2606.12699.tldr: GlyLLM is proposed, an LLM-powered framework for modeling CGM-based glycemic dynamics through the integration of wearable sensor data and structured metadata that can leverage the extensive prior knowledge of pre-trained LLMs and achieve sensor-text semantic abstraction at decision time.

2606.12666.tldr: CAPED is designed as a phone-side protection layer that extracts task requirements, uses screen context as a privacy prior, parses visible UI elements, and selectively exposes only content needed for the current task while masking incidental private content.

2606.12662.tldr: BASENet is a frequency-adapted architecture that partitions the spectrum into Bark-scale bands and assigns each a scaled-capacity encoder derived from critical-band density, automatically granting deeper branches to perceptually dense low frequencies and lighter ones to high frequencies.

2606.12620.tldr: This paper introduces HybridCodeAuthorship, a novel benchmark of Python code files with interleaved human- and AI-authored lines of code to simulate authentic utilization of AI code assistants and benchmark the performance of two state-of-the-art AI-generated code detection algorithms at both the line- and chunk-level.

2606.12594.tldr: Pythagoras-Prover is introduced, a compute-efficient open-source family of Lean theorem provers built for practical compute budgets, and Augmented Lean Formalisation (ALF), which expands scarce verified corpora into variants of formal statements, populated via self-distillation for extra training signal without formally verifying every mutated instance.

2606.12754.tldr: It is found that LLMs'estimates of their own error are poorly calibrated, though they can predict human variability relatively well, and this suggests that asking better questions to LLMs can yield better answers.

2606.12683.tldr: How AI itself might continue to develop in a post-AGI world along the continuum of machine intelligence is investigated, which provides some formal grounding for the main focus of this report: the transition from human-level AGI to artificial general superintelligence.

2606.12691.tldr: It is demonstrated that when trained by empirical risk minimization on data from partially observed linear dynamical systems, two-layer linear auto-regressive models naturally learn to approximate Kalman filtering, and that the learned hidden representation coincides, up to a similarity transformation, with the state estimates produced by the optimal (Kalman) filter, even though the model has no explicit knowledge of the underlying dynamics or state.

2606.12737.tldr: PI-Hunter, an automated agentic auditing framework for proactive vulnerability exposure in LLM agents, is proposed and demonstrated that PI-Hunter substantially improves vulnerability exposure and attack-surface coverage over strong automated red-teaming baselines, while remaining effective under existing prompt injection defenses.

2606.12721.tldr: The architecture generates directional, falsifiable predictions about mentalizing failure that follow from structural properties of the model rather than auxiliary assumptions, and positions ToM-U as a domain-agnostic mechanism upstream of goal inference and other downstream social cognitive processes.

2606.12824.tldr: It is argued that a necessary, currently unmonitored layer sits beneath output metrics: whether incoming studies remain within the acquisition envelope a model was validated on, and whether acquisition state behaves as a structured, measurable variable.

2606.12821.tldr: The GeoNatureAgent Benchmark is introduced, the first benchmark for environmental analysis agents that operate via structured tool calls to a production-style geospatial API, and shows extensibility by integrating BigEarthNet V2 land cover for Portugal alongside Spanish CO2 and erosion indicators.

2606.12783.tldr: This tutorial presents a coherent framework in which diverse world modeling approaches are unified through shared predictive structure and differentiated by how such structure is represented and exploited.

2606.12774.tldr: This manuscript introduces an agentic MPC framework that enables context-aware, semantically adaptive control synthesis by integrating with large language model-based agents.

2606.12595.tldr: This work presents an apples-to-apples comparison of leading FM architectures designed for geospatial multimodal reasoning, with a particular focus on flexibility across varied spectral band configurations.

2606.12797.tldr: It is concluded that the current agentic framework ecosystem may not yet meet secure-by-default expectations for public-facing deployments and outline priority architectural interventions to enable trustworthy deployment in high-stakes, socially impactful applications.

2606.12708.tldr: The first large-scale collection of syntactically annotated treebanks for nine diverse African languages spanning major language families and regions across Sub-Saharan Africa is introduced by introducing AfriSUD, the first large-scale collection of syntactically annotated treebanks for nine diverse African languages spanning major language families and regions across Sub-Saharan Africa.

2606.12690.tldr: The Enhanced World Action Model (EWAM), a closed-loop online adaptation architecture built upon a pretrained and fully frozen Cosmos3 backbone network, is evaluated entirely under a zero-shot task protocol.

2606.12657.tldr: Experiments show that TrajGenAgent improves spatiotemporal fidelity, semantic coherence, and individual-specific behavioral realism over representative neural and LLM-based baselines, while avoiding parameter updates.

2606.12647.tldr: This work develops token complexity within the framework of AI-Oracle Turing machines, in which a probabilistic Turing machine interacts with a stochastic oracle via dedicated query and response tapes, and proves that the complexity frontier is non-empty, upward-closed, and convex.

2606.12603.tldr: FlowPilot is introduced, a mapless navigation policy that achieves robust and efficient long-horizon navigation performance using only a monocular RGB camera and a human-in-the-loop preference learning scheme to tune the policy on a small amount of human intervention data strengthens the model's counterfactual reasoning and social compliance on sidewalks.

2606.12616.tldr: This work introduces PersonaDrive, a pipeline that conditions a vision-language-action (VLA) driving agent on retrieved demonstrations from a style-instructed human driving dataset, in which participants drive CARLA leaderboard routes under aggressive, neutral, and conservative instructions on a driver-in-the-loop rig.
