2606.12826.tldr: A dual-disentangling feature extraction framework is proposed that separates and extracts appearance and motion information within both image and event modalities, thereby improving feature density and enabling more effective fusion with rich spatial and temporal details.

2606.12818.tldr: Using attribution-based circuit localization on 7B--8B Qwen and Llama base and instruction-tuned models, it is found that edge-level methods recover this anchor-sensitive signal more faithfully than node-level methods.

2606.12808.tldr: SymQNet is introduced, an amortized reinforcement-learning approach for low-latency adaptive Hamiltonian learning that substantially reduces acquisition latency relative to bounded Fisher-information search and bounded two-step Bayesian active learning by disagreement.

2606.12805.tldr: Understanding of how GenAI's sociolinguistic design features shape group dynamics in CSCL is advanced, with implications for designing culturally inclusive AI partners in group learning.

2606.12702.tldr: A deployment-centered evaluation of an LLM system embedded within electronic health records at an academic medical center is performed, demonstrating the feasibility of predicting user rejection using deployment-specific context, opening the door to targeted guardrails.

2606.12742.tldr: This paper investigates the feasibility of deploying state-of-the-art DNN models in resource-constrained wearable devices and explores the trade-off between accuracy and computational complexity of DNNs when parameter quantization and electrode reduction methods are used.

2606.12688.tldr: This work presents M*, a universal serving system for efficient serving of composite AI models, and calls this abstraction the Walk Graph, a modular abstraction that supports arbitrary composition of model components, flexible placement onto a physical cluster, and model-agnostic optimizations within a distributed runtime.

2606.12673.tldr: AlignGAD is proposed, a zero-shot generalized graph anomaly detection framework that aligns heterogeneous node features and normalizes graph signals in the spectral domain and demonstrates the effectiveness of AlignGAD under the zero-shot GAD setting.

2606.12634.tldr: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation is introduced, which uses distillation for bounded credit weighting rather than as a competing actor loss rather than as a competing actor loss, and support a narrow design rule for long-horizon tool-use agents.

2606.12569.tldr: eCREAM-MedCorpus is the largest freely available dataset of clinical notes existing for the Italian language and proposes CRF-filling as a novel structured information extraction benchmark, and provides zero-shot baseline resulting from Gemma-27B and MedGemma-27B.

2606.12713.tldr: DAF-AGI is developed, a second-order conceptual artifact with two coupled components: five ordinal criteria for assessing the adjudicative fitness of candidate definitions and a structured governance audit of authorship, interest, certification, external verification and revision authority.

2606.12703.tldr: It is proved that no provenance-free retrieval-time filter can certify against adaptive injection, and the Consistent Minority Effect is formalised, whereby a consistent adversarial answer wins string-based voting as a numerical minority while verdict-based voting removes it.

2606.12674.tldr: Evoflux is introduced, an inference-time evolutionary search method that treats compact tool use as the repair of executable tool workflows and shows that execution-grounded search is more reliable under scarce teacher-trace budgets.

2606.12817.tldr: This work introduces Teach VLM, a core model designed to translate mobile screen trajectories into step-wise operational knowledge by extracting and analyzing operation-related keyframes from demonstration videos, and proposes the Teach-and-Repeat paradigm, where the generated operational knowledge serves as an interpretable procedural reference to guide downstream screen-based execution agents.

2606.12814.tldr: Stubborn is a streamlined and unified reinforcement learning framework to achieve robust humanoid motion tracking and fall recovery that introduces a Bernoulli-based probabilistic termination mechanism and adaptive sampling strategy that dynamically reshapes the sampling distribution based on tracking performance.

2606.12809.tldr: This work introduces the MLUBench, a large-scale and comprehensive benchmark featuring 127 entities across 9 classes under lifelong unlearning requests and proposes LUMoE, an effective method that significantly mitigates the degradation problem faced by baselines.

2606.12767.tldr: Results show that procedural richness and natural phrasing do not guarantee representational grounding, motivating explicit representation-aware validation for evaluation datasets in AI-supported learning.

2606.13079.tldr: A new autonomous penetration evaluation framework consisting of two components: target servers and agent scaffolding is constructed, and it is observed that autonomous penetration capability continues to improve alongside advances in overall model capability.

2606.13054.tldr: A post-training quantization (PTQ) framework that achieves 1.58-bit weight compression and 4-bit activation quantization while maintaining high accuracy, and maintains high accuracy under W1.58A4 is proposed.

2606.13053.tldr: Across navigation, deformable-object, wall-constrained, and language-described manipulation studies, EV-WM shows that predicate-grounded verification can make feature-space world-model planning more interpretable and better aligned with task progress.

2606.13026.tldr: The Handbook on Democracy in the Era of Artificial Intelligence asks how to upgrade democracies and the principles they are built on, using AI and which new values and design principles are required to build democratic resilience.

2606.12983.tldr: STG, a Structured Testbench Generation framework that exploits the inherent structure of hardware designs to generate deterministic testbenches, and the resulting distilled models provide state-of-the-art performance in the multi-benchmark evaluation.

2606.12918.tldr: The first agent-level Shapley value analysis for MAS is proposed, quantifying each agent's marginal contribution to system robustness under task-specific distributions and revealing critical vulnerabilities and coordination patterns that are overlooked by prior single-agent or template-based methods.

2606.12883.tldr: It is revealed that the scaling factor $\alpha$ and the learning rate function differently, with $\alpha$ emerging as the dominant driver of effective optimization, delivering gains that cannot be replicated by learning rate scaling alone.

2606.12864.tldr: UOJ-Bench is introduced, a benchmark designed to evaluate not only the problem-solving ability of LLMs, but also their ability to identify errors in human-written code -- a crucial educational activity traditionally supported by running test cases over online judge systems.

2606.13039.tldr: It is argued that responsible public sector AI requires both national policy adjustments and structural reforms to institutional capacity, values, and governance mechanisms at the local level, as well as barriers and enabling conditions where national policy meets local practice.

2606.13038.tldr: Nous extracts a structured eight-dimension behavioral profile from real Polymarket trading activity and injects it into agents through prompts, position Nous as measuring the cognitive-monoculture problem and the limits of a prompt-level remedy, motivating deeper, below theprompt injection (fine-tuning, activation steering).

2606.13035.tldr: TetherCache is proposed, a training-free and plug-and-play cache management strategy for drift-resistant long video generation that consistently improves long-video generation quality on VBench-Long across 30s, 60s, and 240s settings.

2606.13020.tldr: SciR is the first multi-paradigm scientific-reasoning benchmark with parametric control on both extraction and inference difficulty, and is believed to be the first multi-paradigm scientific-reasoning benchmark with parametric control on both extraction and inference difficulty.

2606.12977.tldr: The proposed method encodes strings of bits into the coefficients of a personalized normalization module (PNM) incorporated into T2I models, so that fingerprints can be reliably recovered from any generated image.

2606.12896.tldr: PolicyGuard is proposed, a test-time step-level backdoor defense which leverages Gaussian Process (GP) posterior variance and adapts pseudo trajectories to enable uncertainty computation for individual time step and also provides theoretical foundations to explain the efficacy of GP posterior variance.

2606.12834.tldr: This work proposes treating agent construction as a workflow stage and introduces AgentBuild, which builds a scientific agent from a contract the scientist authors, which is a version-controlled rubric, a difficulty-graded curriculum, and a curated external knowledge base.

2606.12830.tldr: This work introduces PERception-Interaction-reason Agent (PERIA), a tool-augmented visual agent for spatial reasoning tasks across map reasoning, visual probing, and vision reconstruction, and demonstrates the effectiveness of PERIA in enhancing spatial reasoning capabilities.

2606.12828.tldr: This work defines an early-warning signature, four publication-dynamics criteria frozen on 2017-2021 data, and evaluates it out of sample on 2023-2025 transitions, obtaining a precision of 27% and recall of 63% against a 13.5% base rate.

2606.13003.tldr: It is shown that expert-architected MAS consistently outperforms automatically generated architectures in both raw performance and cost-efficiency on this dataset, demonstrating that existing evaluation frameworks mask critical architectural gaps and inefficiencies of complex MAS by failing to account for the marginal utility of increased computational cost.

2606.12988.tldr: A scalable and pragmatic approach for real-time ergonomic evaluation by combining state-of-the-art 3D data technologies and traditional 2D pose estimation algorithms is offered, addressing the increasing need for safety and health monitoring in workplace environments.

2606.12945.tldr: A multi-factor memory value function V(m) over seven interpretable factors drawn from cognitive psychology drawn from cognitive psychology is proposed, whose weights are learned from a downstream objective by a gradient-free optimiser and whose single scalar uniformly controls encoding depth, forget risk, and retrieval rank.

2606.12924.tldr: Systematic philosophical disagreement between frontier LLM judges: Gemini rewards process correctness while Claude demands concrete outcomes, despite using the same evaluation prompt is documented.

2606.12916.tldr: This work builds MDForge, an LLM agent whose in-context update rule densifies the sparse reward via a multi-agent debate among physics experts, and automatically designs MD pipelines competitive with human experts.

2606.12858.tldr: Extensive experiments on latent-space image transmission demonstrate that the JSCGC consistently improves feature-based, semantic-level, and distributional quality across diverse channel conditions, while exhibiting a distinct error behavior characterized by semantic inconsistency rather than distortion.

2606.12848.tldr: HLER is interpreted as a research harness rather than an autonomous AI scientist: it sharply reduces failures, makes residual weaknesses more visible, and prevents unreliable claims from being advanced as publication-ready outputs.

2606.12987.tldr: A compact latent world model that, given the present front-camera latent and a sequence of ego-actions, predicts future scene latents a frozen decoder renders to $256 \times 256$ frames up to 8 seconds ahead, evaluated on 150 held-out nuScenes scenes.

2606.13024.tldr: CausalMoE is the first to integrate LLMs and VLMs to align numerical signals with textual and visual priors, regularizing causal estimation in complex scenarios, while effectively generalizing to few-shot settings where traditional methods fail.

2606.12991.tldr: APCyc is introduced, a target-aware de novo cyclic peptide generation framework that explicitly models cyclization and jointly optimizes multiple essential physicochemical properties and leverages Bayesian posterior guidance to steer sampling toward cyclic peptides satisfying multiple property objectives.

2606.12976.tldr: It is argued that a deployed platform of this kind constitutes a continuously growing, community-validated dataset of mathematical problems and step-by-step solutions, a resource that can be used to train and benchmark AI systems for accurate mathematical reasoning.

2606.12969.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate the strengths and limitations of current foundation models in these three dimensions, providing empirical evidence for deploying autonomous agents in high-stakes industrial environments.

2606.12942.tldr: This work proposes PRISMR (Parameterized Representation Internalization for Semantic Multimodal Ranking), a framework that replaces transient in-context list processing with parametric structural conditioning, and introduces a large-scale multimodal review-ranking benchmark for evaluation.

2606.12910.tldr: This approach leverages a pretrained VLM to translate natural-language queries into neuro-symbolic goal states, grounded in the physical world via a bounding-box detection pipeline, and enables robots to interpret abstract spatial concepts such as top shelf and execute tasks without additional fine-tuning.

2606.12900.tldr: Extensive experiments show that HCPD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, offering an effective and explainable solution for zero-source hallucination detection.

2606.12882.tldr: This work introduces HarnessBridge, a lightweight learnable harness controller that parameterizes the agent--environment interface as a bidirectional projection and trains HarnessBridge on a harness supervision dataset via unified instruction tuning.

2606.12852.tldr: A long-horizon agent framework with an enhanced low-level controller equipped with a Causal Event Graph that augments episodic memory with explicit causal structure linking observations to task relevance and enables robust recall under viewpoint changes and supports opportunistic task reordering through causal reasoning.

2606.12923.tldr: The evidence supports local admitted control and measurable stochastic response operators, while leaving deployable pre-generation control, hidden/logit causal sufficiency, biological-to-LLM coordinate identity, and literal thermodynamic quantities outside scope.

2606.12936.tldr: Pipette is presented, an embodied simulation platform, benchmark, and data-efficient augmentation framework for wet-lab robot learning, which replays human demonstrations in simulation, applies lighting, camera, speed, and action perturbations, and filters generated episodes with automatic task success checks, rapidly expanding usable training data from limited manual demonstrations.

2606.12871.tldr: DailyReport is introduced, an open-ended benchmark to evaluate SA capabilities on daily search tasks, and shows that current systems still fall short of users' expectations.

2606.12841.tldr: TimeROME-DLM is introduced, the first training-free, gradient-free, inference-time knowledge-editing framework for MDLMs and closes the locate-then-edit gap between AR LLMs and MDLMs at a fraction of the computational cost.

2606.12838.tldr: OCOO-T 1, a minimalist flow-matching-based AIVC model for transcriptional perturbation response prediction, utilizes a vanilla Transformer stack that operates directly on continuous gene expression profiles and formulates perturbation response prediction as a continuous-time denoising process.

2606.12835.tldr: The vision of the Internet of Agentic AI is developed: an open ecosystem in which heterogeneous agents discover one another, negotiate responsibilities, exchange context, invoke tools, and execute workflows across cloud, edge, device, organizational, and cyber-physical environments.

2606.13081.tldr: The proposed approach overcomes the related work in image classification based on CIFAR, revealing Emotional Regulation as the new state-of-the-art in emotion-augmented deep learning for large-scale vision datasets.

2606.13051.tldr: The utility of AAbAAC for information extraction in the domain of autoimmunity, showing expected improvement in NER performance after finetuning is demonstrated, illustrating the value of small-scale annotation efforts for specialized domains and contributes to the computational study of autoimmunity.

2606.13016.tldr: This work uses the measured decay of a custom In$_2$O$_3$ optoelectronic synapse to directly realize the TTFS temporal term, removing the need for explicit digital decay computation, and shows that physically grounded TTFS computing can be efficient, trainable, and robust under realistic hardware effects.

2606.12953.tldr: OpenMedQ, a medical vision-language model pretrained on the broadest fully-open medical mix to date, reaches state-of-the-art BLEU-1 on PathVQA, beating Med-PaLM M variants up to 562B parameters (~80x larger), and matches the best reported VQA-MED BLEU-1.

2606.12921.tldr: This work derives LoRA-Muon by applying the Muon optimizer's spectral steepest-descent rule to the low-rank setting, and shows that the Spectron optimizer depends on arbitrary factor scaling, so it would likely be a poor fit when finetuning starts from badly imbalanced factors.

2606.12935.tldr: MARS, a margin-adversarial stopping rule that estimates which active traces are likely to change their answers and stops once the leader remains safe under a conservative bound on future vote movement is introduced, which closely matches oracle switching behavior.

2606.13249.tldr: A multi-field hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework for automated maritime RCA, utilizing a comprehensive dataset of 13,329 Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal reports, is proposed, suggesting that field-aware RAG can substantially streamline maritime safety investigation workflows.

2606.13233.tldr: It is shown that quantization increases incorrect sampling at low-entropy symbolic tokens, while causing over-concentration on a small set of tokens in high-uncertainty reasoning steps, and a reasoning-step entropy-based temperature-scaling method is proposed that estimates step-level uncertainty online and adapts the decoding temperature using both token-level and step-level entropy signals.

2606.13176.tldr: Cognitive Relative Policy Optimization (CRPO) is proposed, a reinforcement learning framework tailored for the mental health domain that introduces a stage-wise entropy regularization mechanism that encourages broad exploration in early reasoning phases and progressively enforces confident decision-making in later stages, mimicking the human cognitive shift from uncertainty to certainty.

2606.13156.tldr: A faithful instance of Iterative Visual Thinking with a two-phase recipe: a supervised warm-up in which the base model's own predictions serve as realistic errors that a teacher VLM turns into corrective reasoning traces (yielding training data without human annotation), followed by GRPO with a simple IoU reward.

2606.13135.tldr: A tunable triage threshold gives sensitivity control not attainable in standard single-stage (argmax) classification and better reproduces clinical differential-diagnosis logic.

2606.13121.tldr: A fluency-aware optimization framework designed to discover the sweet spot between the low-latency benefits of simultaneous translation and the natural flow of consecutive translation, which produces natural speech flow while maintaining competitive latency and translation quality.

2606.13316.tldr: ReSum is a novel RLVR framework that enables LLMs to compress and organize their reasoning trajectories through self-summarization, and adopts a summarization-aware adaptive rollout mechanism that contrastively evaluates whether self-summarization benefits the ongoing reasoning process.

2606.13115.tldr: G-Long is proposed, a graph-enhanced framework that utilizes a fine-tuned small Language Model for structured triplet extraction and associative retrieval, significantly reducing operational costs and introducing the novel attention-aware importance scoring mechanism that leverages the intrinsic cross-attention signals of a T5 summarizer to identify salient memories.

2606.13385.tldr: The results reveal substantial and heterogeneous vulnerabilities: not a single attack objective is reliably resisted by current agents, and failures distribute across qualitatively distinct modes ranging from stealthy parasitism tomisaligned disruption.

2606.13380.tldr: An autonomous agentic framework that employs large language models (LLMs) to conduct iterative quantum circuit designs under explicit design constraints is introduced and the generated ansatz attains competitive accuracy with widely used chemically inspired and hardware-efficient constructions while satisfying the imposed scaling constraints.

2606.13368.tldr: This paper presents IterCAD, a unified multimodal agent framework for closed-loop, interactive CAD generation and editing, and introduces the IterCAD-Bench evaluation suite, establishing a survivor-bias-free standard that unifies code validity and geometric precision.

2606.13348.tldr: Results seem to indicate that the neuro-symbolic approach successfully balances flexibility with narrative coherence: symbolic validation grounds LLM generation without eliminating generative freedom.

2606.13341.tldr: The results demonstrate that combining dual-domain learning with geometric equivariance substantially enhances multimodal image synthesis accuracy and robustness, enabling practical applications in PET completion and data augmentation.

2606.13288.tldr: This work proposes MACCO (MAsked Compositional Concept MOdeling), a framework that masks compositional concepts in one modality and reconstructs them conditioned on the full contextual information from the other, enabling the model to capture and align cross-modal compositional structures more effectively.

2606.13285.tldr: Equilibrium State Estimation (ESE), a novel paradigm for simultaneous prediction, where multiple interacting systems require separate yet coordinated forecasts, is introduced, establishing ESE as a fast, generalizable, robust, and scalable multi-prediction method.

2606.13282.tldr: The Ethical Robustness Testing System (ERTS) is introduced, a closed-pipeline framework that encodes ethical dilemmas into a 22-dimensional Ethical Consequence Space (ECS) grounded in established ethical theory and applies 17 semantic perturbation functions subject to 6 validity constraint classes including a novel semantic coherence constraint.

2606.13253.tldr: Two aggregation strategies to achieve personalization are explored, including the parameter-based averaging strategy and the embedding-based averaging strategy, including the parameter-based averaging strategy and the embedding-based averaging strategy.

2606.13222.tldr: It is shown that a humanoid robot can learn self-other distinction from proprioceptive-visual correspondence, without any identity labels or kinematic models, and this distinction bootstraps a predictive self-model that maps joint configurations to three-dimensional body occupancy, capturing how the robot's body changes with action.

2606.13211.tldr: This structured narrative synthesizes peer-reviewed studies, benchmark datasets, and FDA regulatory guidance across five imaging modalities to produce a cross-modality analysis of hallucination taxonomy, etiology, detection, and mitigation.

2606.13192.tldr: UI-UX is proposed, an MLLM based on Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking foundation model and enhanced via reinforcement learning with two key innovations: a reward routing mechanism that dynamically balances perceptual understanding and logical reasoning during inference, and an asymmetric transition reward that suppresses redundant or insufficient reasoning steps.

2606.13179.tldr: A unified perspective on analog computing is provided, highlighting its strengths, current developments, and challenges, and positioning it as a pivotal enabler of next-generation computational frontiers.

2606.13097.tldr: By eliminating redundant prefill computation, this approach reduces generation latency, while reusing validated control structures improves robustness over prompt-level caching methods RAGCache, achieving 18.31% higher task success rate and 2.3x faster policy synthesis.

2606.13240.tldr: Jeffrey guidance is proposed, a principled framework that extends diffusion-model control to applications beyond what standard guidance can express and leverages Jeffrey's rule of conditioning to update marginal distributions towards a prescribed target, preserving the conditional structure and minimally perturbing the joint distribution.

2606.13236.tldr: PULSE, a semi-supervised, multi-task framework for Orthoptera bioacoustics, combining weakly-supervised species classification, self-supervised learning on unlabelled field audio, and knowledge distillation from a general-purpose bioacoustic model is presented.

2606.13196.tldr: This paper asks under what conditions a machine can be called genuinely creative, and how human agency can be preserved within shared cognitive and creative environments, and develops a requirement framework derived from Designics, the science of meaning-bearing intentional change.

2606.13188.tldr: It is argued that for cardiac digital twin pipelines, geometric fidelity and topological correctness matter more than pixel-level Dice scores.

2606.13177.tldr: This work proposes MemRefine, an LLM-guided framework that, since surface similarity poorly reflects factual value, uses similarity only to propose candidate pairs and defers delete, merge, and preserve decisions to an LLM judge based on factual content, iterating until the budget is met.

2606.13171.tldr: NTS-CoT is proposed, a novel framework that leverages Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to mitigate hallucinations in TLS, and demonstrates that NTS-CoT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, effectively mitigating hallucinations and improving LLM-based TLS performance.

2606.13141.tldr: V-RAGBench is introduced, a benchmark of $\langle$ query, evidence chunk, answer$\rangle$ triplets that enables faithful, decoupled evaluation of retrieval and generation, and CARVE, a simple method that runs parallel retrievers across configurations and employs chunk-adaptive reranking to identify the winning configuration for each chunk.

2606.13125.tldr: This analysis, based on controlled math reasoning experiments with Qwen-2.5-1.5B, reveals two core mechanisms: strategy selection and strategy improvement, and highlights the role of SFT data and reinforcement learning data in activating these mechanisms.

2606.13119.tldr: A novel Multi- Period Pattern Pre-training (MP3) is developed, a plug-and-play pre-training plugin for distinguishing temporal mirages that can seamlessly integrate into existing STGNN backbones to strengthen their forecasting performance.

2606.13311.tldr: R Rarity-Gated Feature-wise Linear Modulation (RGFiLM), a rarity-aware conditioning module that combines feature-wise modulation with a gate controlled by a data-driven rarity score, is proposed, suggesting that explicitly accounting for context rarity is an effective approach for reducing false alarms in context-sensitive anomaly detection.

2606.13258.tldr: This work identifies the Toxic Teacher phenomenon and introduces Modality-Specific Warm-Up to stabilize newly learned modality representations before distillation and designs a statistics-decoupled MSBN architecture that isolates sensor statistics while maintaining a shared semantic backbone.

2606.13239.tldr: This work identifies the Component Object Model (COM) as a unified executable abstraction, proposing COM-as-Action: a new paradigm that reframes professional software interaction as deterministic program synthesis rather than sequential visual control, and introduces ComCADBench, the first benchmark for agents operating real industrial CAD software.

2606.13355.tldr: Across simulated and real-world environments, the autoregressive policy consistently outperforms its equivalent-level flow-matching policy counterpart while achieving significantly improved task completion speeds from synchronous inference, confirming that autoregressive policies can remain a competitive policy type supporting real-time execution.

2606.13276.tldr: Results suggest that symmetry-aware and geometry-aware optimization for transformers should be module-specific rather than uniform, and that symmetry-aware and geometry-aware optimization for transformers should be module-specific rather than uniform.

2606.13262.tldr: ProFact, an agentic reinforcement learning framework for end-to-end optimization of multi-stage fact verification trajectories, is proposed and empirical evaluation shows that ProFact consistently outperforms strong baselines in both verification performance and inference efficiency.

2606.13241.tldr: Brick is a multimodal router that scores each model on six capability dimensions, combines this with a per-query difficulty estimate, and dispatches via a cost-penalized geometric rule, and a continuous preference knob lets operators slide between max-quality and max-saving profiles at deploy time.

2606.13220.tldr: The results show that the proposed LLM-as-an-Investigator approach identifies the problem more accurately than direct prompting and reasoning-only baselines, while its evidence-first protocol helps reduce user-induced conversational bias.

2606.13197.tldr: ARMOR-MAD consistently improves over fixed-round heterogeneous debate with the same model pool, suggesting that genuine model heterogeneity and agreement-based control are both important for making MAD more accurate and efficient.

2606.13148.tldr: TerraBench is introduced, a benchmark for grounded Earth-science reasoning, built on TerraAgent, a ReAct-style executable framework that interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and observations to couple LLM planning with scientific tools for environmental retrieval, geospatial processing, simulation, and artifact-backed computation.

2606.13126.tldr: This work presents Minimalistic PIC (MiniPIC), a minimal, flexible and fast vLLM design built from two ingredients: positional-encoding-free KV cache and user-controlled cache-reuse primitives that realize multiple PIC methods within the same running vLLM instance, while natively integrating with KV cache CPU offload implementations.

2606.13382.tldr: This work proposes SmartFont, a diffusion-based few-shot font generation framework that combines global content-style generation with weakly supervised local corrective experts, and argues that it achieves better global-local balance, improves glyph quality and local detail fidelity.

2606.13370.tldr: It is suggested that compute-aware language model evaluation should examine training trajectories rather than endpoint metrics alone, because in constrained compute settings, additional token exposure may increase computational cost without producing proportional generalization gains, and interval-level telemetry can reveal instability, regression, and diminishing returns that final metrics may obscure.

2606.13361.tldr: This work makes a proposal that is almost offensively simple: let a publisher precompute a document's KV cache, and let every other agent buy the right to load it and skip prefill, and frames the resulting agent-native prefill CDN and leaves lossless KV compression and a cross-party payment layer as the open problems.

2606.13298.tldr: The causal effect of adoption on architectural smell density (ASD) is estimated with a staggered difference-in-differences design and the Borusyak imputation estimator, applying a causal design recently used for code-level metrics to the architecture level.

2606.13289.tldr: This paper presents HYDRA-X, the first UMM that unifies image and video tokenization within a single Vision Transformer (ViT), and proposes a principled improvement of the editing pipeline: source-target interaction should occur at the latent level inside the tokenizer rather than at the semantic level inside the LLM, substantially improving editing consistency and accelerating convergence.

2606.13256.tldr: Results show that humor type significantly influences funniness, with Aggressive and Affiliative humor rated higher, while joke content primarily affects appropriateness, with person-related jokes preferred over political ones.

2606.13629.tldr: This work proposes statistical principles for using synthetic data in scientific research with provable validity guarantees, and develops methods for valid inference under task exchangeability, together with extensions that provide guarantees even beyond exchangeability.

2606.13621.tldr: A what-if analysis shows that formal defensibility and operational effectiveness capture distinct aspects of security: small architectural changes can produce large shifts in operational outcomes while leaving formal safety margins nearly unchanged.

2606.13591.tldr: Three protocols are introduced that produce a final answer along with a single aggregated confidence that is substantially more discriminative than that of the best single agent or the standard debate baselines, while correctness stays stable and recovers the losses MAD incurs on more ambiguous tasks.

2606.13572.tldr: This work introduces ArogyaBodha, a large-scale multilingual multimodal medical question-answer dataset, and proposes ArogyaSutra, an actor-critic-based multi-agent framework that integrates tool grounding with dual-memory mechanisms for step-wise, reasoning-aware decision making, and uses stored actor-critic simulation trajectories for distillation.

2606.13535.tldr: An automated workflow based on Large Language Models, referred to as AgentRivet, extracts the physics analysis information from published papers and writes the missing Rivet routines, with intermediate code- and physics- reviews as part of an autonomous quality control.

2606.13513.tldr: This work proposes CloudCons, a comprehensive end-to-end benchmark designed to evaluate forecasting models within the specific context of cloud resource consolidation, and systematically analyzes how the selection of predictive quantiles acts as a critical lever to balance the trade-off between resource efficiency and service reliability.

2606.13464.tldr: This work proposes an ontology memory-augmented ASR correction framework for long text-speech interleaved conversations, which improves over direct correction in 9 out of 10 paired backbone-setting combinations and encourages more selective and evidence-grounded corrections for context-dependent ASR errors.

2606.13405.tldr: This work proposes compliance-by-construction as a complementary paradigm to guardrail-based monitoring: a structural foundation that prevents control-flow violations, while guardrails remain essential for catching semantic errors.

2606.13673.tldr: SpatialClaw is proposed, a training-free framework for spatial reasoning that adopts code as the action interface, enabling the agent to flexibly compose and manipulate perception results and adapt its analysis to both intermediate text and visual observations and the demands of each problem.

2606.13669.tldr: An end-to-end knowledge orchestration pipeline that converts raw documents into agent-native scientific knowledge graphs, and can be extended to general-domain corpora and to schema-conformant data synthesis.

2606.13662.tldr: EurekAgent is presented, an environment-engineered agent system for metric-driven autonomous scientific discovery, that sets new state-of-the-art results on multiple mathematics, kernel engineering, and machine learning tasks, and calls for environment engineering as a core research direction for developing reliable autonomous research agents.

2606.13658.tldr: The paper introduces the concept of cognitive colonization, according to which AI systems can embed external interests within the architecture of the self in ways that are difficult for users to perceive.

2606.13607.tldr: It is suggested that everyday causal reasoning in people and LLMs is more consistent with a form of pattern-matching than with abstract world models.

2606.13598.tldr: OrchRM is proposed, a self-supervised framework for evaluating orchestration quality without human annotations that operates directly at the orchestration level, enabling efficient and high-performing reward-guided orchestrator training and MAS test-time scaling.

2606.13580.tldr: This paper proposes EvTexture++, the first event-driven framework dedicated to texture enhancement in VSR, which leverages high-frequency spatiotemporal details from events to improve texture recovery and is designed as a plug-and-play tool to flexibly boost the performance of existing VSR models.

2606.13571.tldr: Timeflies is proposed, a unified framework that reformulates forecasting as a joint problem of future observability inference and value estimation, and demonstrates the importance of explicitly modeling future observability in time series forecasting with missing values.

2606.13562.tldr: Findings suggest that contrast-informed data augmentation combined with adversarial training may improve robustness to domain shift in undersampled neonatal MR reconstruction.

2606.13550.tldr: Uncertainty-aware Multi-Granularity RAG (UMG-RAG), a training-free hybrid retrieval framework that treats chunk granularity as query-specific reliability estimation, and a parent promotion variant that uses fine-grained hits to locate relevant evidence while returning broader non-redundant parent chunks for local coherence are introduced.

2606.13503.tldr: This paper proposes MinkUNeXt-VINE++, a novel approach that combines early fusion of heterogeneous LiDAR data from two sensors and a learned re-ranking strategy in inference time and achieves a 20% improvement in the Recall@1 metric compared to single-sensor approaches, and +30% including re-ranking.

2606.13486.tldr: CRAFTIIF (Cross-Resolution Analytic Four-Type Interpretable Isolation Forest), a fully unsupervised framework targeting all four types without dataset-specific tuning, is presented, ranking first among all 25 evaluated methods on VUS-PR.

2606.13449.tldr: It is found that specifying instructions for AI-agents does not necessarily lead to better results, and projects that managed to increase their merge rate have substantially longer instruction files, which are also well structured into a higher number of sections and sub-sections.

2606.13436.tldr: It is demonstrated that models exhibiting strong performance under operational ("silver") evaluation degrade substantially under independent ("gold") evaluation, particularly for fine-grained classification, suggesting that commonly reported performance metrics may reflect alignment with labeling processes rather than true predictive capability.

2606.13400.tldr: PolyFlow is a polytope-constrained flow matching framework that embeds constraints directly into the model and flow dynamics, without the need for expensive iterative solvers and demonstrates a favorable trade-off between safety, efficiency, and generative quality.

2606.13392.tldr: This work introduces MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), a blockwise sparse attention built upon Grouped Query Attention (GQA), and co-designs MSA with a GPU execution path that uses exp-free Top-k selection and KV-outer sparse attention to improve tensor-core utilization under block-granular access.

2606.13610.tldr: This work introduces FORGE (Fake Online Recommendations in Generative Environments), a benchmark for measuring fake-product promotion under controlled web-content pollution, and evaluates three defenses: skepticism prompting and consensus filtering (over model priors or cross-document evidence).

2606.13578.tldr: RoboGenesis is built, a simulation-based workflow and data engine that composes configured laboratory workflows from atomic skills, validates and filters rollouts, and exports structured demonstrations across supported robot profiles.

2606.13556.tldr: This work develops this architecture across six physiological domains, grading genomic priors by evidence strength, distinguishing robustly replicated anchors from contested candidate genes, and defining four constraints for deployment: evidence-graded priors, dynamic decay, ancestry-matched effect sizes, and attribution rather than deterministic output.

2606.13468.tldr: The goal in this paper is to understand the failure modes of AI-agents, an understanding that is crucial for better integrating AI-agents as efficient teammates and suggest the need for good prioritization of tasks so that generated fixes do not lead to wasted human review efforts or wasted agent resources.

2606.13680.tldr: RA-RFT uses gold-relevance distillation to train a retriever that ranks contexts by expected reasoning benefit rather than semantic overlap, and then fine-tunes the policy model via reinforcement fine-tuning methods with retrieved analogous demonstrations, so the model learns to leverage reasoning traces under verifiable outcome rewards.

2606.13473.tldr: MaxProof, a population-level test-time scaling framework for competition-level mathematical proof in the MiniMax-M3 series, reaches 35/42 on IMO 2025 and 36/42 on USAMO 2026, exceeding the human gold-medal threshold on both.

2606.13441.tldr: This paper addresses objections from the intentional stance, functionalism, compatibilism, and the presence of moral reasoning in model outputs, arguing that none suffice to establish genuine agency.

2606.13603.tldr: It is shown that answer-formation stages can be linearly decoded from intermediate reasoning steps with high accuracy and generalize robustly to unseen reasoning tasks, and exploit this signal to early-exit reasoning blocks at the commitment boundary.

2606.13544.tldr: Mod ModeratorLM is proposed, a role-playing voice agent that conditions turn-taking behavior on an explicitly assigned role in multi-party settings and is built on a speech large language model operating in chunk-wise streaming manner.

2606.13677.tldr: Mana (Manipulation Animator), a general sim-to-real framework that reinterprets dexterous manipulation as an animation problem, employs a coarse-to-fine pipeline that transforms procedurally-generated grasp keyframes into manipulation trajectories through motion planning and reinforcement learning.

2606.13647.tldr: SkMTEB is introduced, the first comprehensive MTEB-style text embedding benchmark for Slovak, a low-resource West Slavic language, comprising 31 datasets across 7 task types and open-source models that achieve competitive performance with proprietary APIs while remaining locally deployable for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

2606.13608.tldr: This work advocates Agentified Agent Assessment (AAA), where evaluation is performed by judge agents and all participants interact through standardized protocols: A2A for task management and MCP for tool access, and introduces AgentBeats as a concrete realization of AAA.

2606.13604.tldr: A deployed reinforcement learning system at DoorDash is presented that adapts dispatch objective weights in a large-scale food-delivery marketplace using delayed signals and illustrates how world feedback from a live economic and logistics system can be used to safely adapt decision policies online.

2606.13602.tldr: EpiBench evaluates whether agents can make well-defined analysis decisions from realistic workflow states and return deterministically gradable answers, and shows performance varies across assay types, and many failed runs still contain parts of the correct answer.

2606.13566.tldr: A three-layer view of AI in discovery is proposed: Layer 1 is search and retrieval by large language models, Layer 2 is model formation through qualitative reasoning, and Layer 3 is execution, optimization, and refinement.

2606.13509.tldr: Experimental results show that data fusion improves localization accuracy compared to single-camera baselines and measurement-calibrated fusion provides only limited improvement in absolute accuracy over standard fusion, but substantially reduces trajectory variance and improves motion smoothness, which are critical for applications requiring stable and continuous motion estimates.

2507.13263.tldr: This work introduces a novel framework for generating efficient permutation representations via kernel functions derived from sorting algorithms, and introduces the Merge Kernel, which leverages the divide-and-conquer structure of merge sort to achieve the lowest possible complexity with no information loss and effectively capture permutation structure.

2504.03686.tldr: A theoretical framework is proposed that introduces and mathematically characterizes the inference outage (InfOut) probability, which quantifies the likelihood that the E2E inference accuracy falls below a target threshold, and establishes a fundamental tradeoff between communication overhead and inference reliability as quantified by the InfOut probability.

2506.17255.tldr: UltraSketchLLM is introduced, compressing LLMs with data sketch with a high compression rate down to 0.5 bit per weight, which reduces peak GPU memory footprint with a high compression rate down to 0.5 bit per weight.

2504.16173.tldr: This work highlights the potential of FPGA-based NN accelerators to enhance onboard computing systems, and analyzes existing literature, identifying trends and gaps, and proposing future research directions.

2503.19947.tldr: A self-supervised training approach that extends pretrained RGB encoders with a depth adapter to incorporate and align metric depth into a combined latent space without interfering with the pretrained RGB feature extraction, enabling generalized and robust depth density and distribution invariant feature extraction.

2508.08935.tldr: LNN-PINN is proposed, a physics-informed neural network framework that incorporates a liquid residual gating architecture while preserving the original physics modeling and optimization pipeline to improve predictive accuracy of physics-informed neural networks in complex scientific and engineering problems.

2505.16988.tldr: This work introduces MASLab, a unified, comprehensive, and research-friendly codebase for LLM-based MAS, which integrates over 20 established methods across multiple domains and implements methods within a shared streamlined structure, lowering the barriers for understanding and extension.

2112.04573.tldr: A panoramic view of AI and ML in libraries for researchers, practitioners and educators for furthering the more technology-oriented approaches, and anticipating future innovation pathways is provided.

2303.09209.tldr: This paper addresses the problem of learning optimal behavioral policies by proposing an AI-based approach that learns an optimal policy directly from historical process executions using Reinforcement Learning (RL) to recommend the best actions for optimizing a KPI.

2505.12992.tldr: Fractured Sampling is introduced, a unified inference-time strategy that interpolates between full CoT and solution-only sampling along three orthogonal axes: the number of reasoning trajectories, the number of final solutions per trajectory, and the depth at which reasoning traces are truncated.

2606.10881.tldr: This work extracted 8,954 definitions and 2,700 scale items from over 14,000 publications to investigate how researchers actually used learner agency and autonomy with a semantic analysis pipeline, and carries direct implications for conceptualization, measurement, and practice towards supporting the multidimensional learner agency and autonomy.

2605.07984.tldr: Using rhyming-couplet completion as a clean test of forward-looking constraint, two lightweight methods are applied across Qwen3, Gemma-3, and Llama-3 at more than ten scales to show that future-rhyme information is linearly decodable at the line boundary.

2603.23530.tldr: A salience-enhanced format recovers much of the lost compliance, restoring performance to 90-100% in many settings, using a controlled paradigm that combines verifiable formatting constraints with benchmark tasks of increasing complexity.

2603.20821.tldr: Compound AI is a distributed intelligence approach that represents a unified system orchestrating specialized AI/ML models with engineered software components into AI workflows and Compass, a novel framework that enables dynamic configuration switching through offline optimization and online adaptation, is presented.

2606.03108.tldr: EvoTrainer is introduced, an autonomous training framework that co-evolves LLM policies and training-side harnesses through empirical feedback: it diagnoses rollout-level evidence, revises diagnostics, backtests interventions, and accumulates reusable skills.

2605.13217.tldr: Generalized Advantage Grouped Policy Optimization (GAGPO), a critic-free reinforcement learning method for precise, step-aligned temporal credit assignment, is proposed, suggesting that GAGPO offers a simple yet effective framework for multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning.

2606.01730.tldr: This work proposes an objective-wise reputation-market mechanism that treats each expert-objective pair as a falsifiable prior source and introduces a decoupled counterfactual gate that can use the LLM prior without confidence, use it with confidence, or abstain from the LLM prior entirely.

2605.18784.tldr: This paper maps that emerging boundary by coding 55 AI threat classes against 26 insurance products, endorsements, and exclusion regimes using public carrier materials and OWASP/MITRE threat catalogs and identifies a four-tier insurability frontier.

2603.02230.tldr: This work proposes a Self-Correcting Discrete Diffusion model to reformulate pretrained self-correction with explicit state transitions and learn directly in discrete time, which enables more efficient parallel decoding while preserving generation quality.

2606.02995.tldr: Patcher is presented, a post-hoc defense framework that repairs backdoored language models using only a single reported failure case and the model parameters, and represents a significant step toward practical defenses against training-time attacks in deployed language models.

2606.00947.tldr: This work introduces a taxonomy of six silent failure modes arising from the interaction of foundation model personalization, dataset shift, and core federated constraints and proposes that silent failures become a standard diagnostic category for trustworthy federated artificial intelligence.

2606.08881.tldr: Experimental results show that stronger pretrained VLA policies generally outperform the imitation learning baseline, although performance remains highly task-dependent under low-cost robotic deployment conditions, and establish SO-101 as a practical benchmark for evaluating embodied AI systems under realistic low-cost robotic deployment conditions.

2605.08270.tldr: Inspired by the brain's predictive coding mechanism, SAFformer actively suppresses predictable signals and focuses on salient visual features in a novel Spiking Transformer architecture based on an active predictive filtering paradigm.

2604.09737.tldr: A modular prompt-engineering architecture combining XML-style structure, expert disambiguation rules, chain-of-thought reasoning, metadata-aware decision logic, schema contracts, and a self-validation gate is introduced, which targets recurrent in-context failures, including format drift, label ambiguity, evidence hallucination, and metadata-conditioned confusion.

2606.13737.tldr: FreoStream is proposed, a novel streaming guardrail framework that fine-tunes a LoRA module to perform Future-Aware Reasoning when the base guardrail detects unsafe tokens and introduces the Safety-Aligned Optimization module that extracts the safety-aligned component from the reasoning gradients to update the base guardrail model, thereby enhancing streaming safety detection.

2606.13731.tldr: TwinBI is presented, an agentic digital-twin framework that couples an LLM-based agent system with an executable BI dashboard state and improves both agent-level analytical reliability and user-facing analytical support by turning visible dashboard state into richer actionable context.

2606.13710.tldr: The Hybrid Open-Ended Tri-Evolution (HOTE) framework is proposed, which leverages hybrid-mode reinforcement learning to facilitate the collaborative evolution of a proposer, solver and judge based on web-scale knowledge, moving toward autonomous evolving agents in open-ended tasks and environments.

2606.13767.tldr: This study suggests that restricting LoRA-based PEFT methods'adaptation to a sparse, structured column space remains competitive across tasks with their parameter-matched baselines while reducing up to 10% training time and peak GPU memory up to 15%, even with a na\"ive, non-optimized, sparse implementation.

2606.13757.tldr: Evaluating 8 review agents against this benchmark, it is revealed that review agents are susceptible to narrative manipulation, exposing a significant gap in security capabilities.

2606.13734.tldr: The evidence does not support a simple claim that lower AI literacy predicts greater receptivity to AI in general, and points instead to a narrower pattern of broader adoption across lower-penetration, non-text AI tools.

2606.13720.tldr: This work compares DiM-based interventions with two interventions derived from Iterative Nullspace Projection (INLP) -- nullspace projection and counterfactual flipping -- on five open-weight chat models, asking whether INLP can match DiM at steering refusal and whether its richer parameterisation yields more tweakable interventions.

2606.13698.tldr: An active inference controller for a four-arm signalized intersection that dynamically selects phases by minimizing expected free energy (EFE) over Gaussian beliefs about per-direction congestion levels, yielding a fully traceable decision pipeline is proposed.

2606.13692.tldr: A unified agentic-retrieval framework for autonomous context-aware data quality assessment that interprets natural-language descriptions of intended data usage, derives context-aware assessment strategies, and generates executable validation logic through a multi-agent workflow is proposed.

2606.13685.tldr: It is suggested that single-trial LLM judging is often too noisy for high-stakes evaluation, and that multi-trial aggregation, position randomization, and explicit uncertainty reporting should be standard practice.

2606.13589.tldr: Simplex-Constrained Sparse Bagging (SCSB), a mathematically rigorous framework for post-training compression and probability calibration of bootstrap-based bagging ensembles, is presented and the theoretical"L1-simplex paradox" is addressed by introducing a concave quadratic penalty.

2606.13802.tldr: This work introduces a benchmark for systems that observe a sequence of user actions in a spreadsheet and predict future actions, and proposes an online evaluation that expects a prediction after each user action, accepts or rejects that prediction, updates the future actions upon acceptance, and repeats this until the target spreadsheet is obtained.

2606.13782.tldr: MA-ProofBench is intended to serve as a reliable reference for tracking progress in formal mathematical reasoning in advanced domains, and identifies Mathlib hallucinations and incomplete proofs as the two dominant failure modes.

2606.13723.tldr: This work uncovers a non-sensitive region on the IoU response curve, within which samples yield nearly identical IoU scores despite distinct geometric overlaps, and introduces a set of morphological similarity metrics covering area, shape, and aspect ratio, to refine the positive sample assignment process, thereby ensuring more discriminative and reliable matching.

2606.13713.tldr: CisTransCell is proposed, a cell-conditioned multi-modal framework for single-cell perturbation prediction that augments each gene with two complementary priors: a regulatory-sequence prior that captures how the gene is controlled, and a coding-sequence prior that captures what the gene product does.

2606.13705.tldr: Evidence that a concrete generation pathology can be localized to a few parameters and edited out is evidence that a knowledge-precision problem rather than a removable circuit is fundamentally a knowledge-precision problem.

2606.13684.tldr: A lightweight UI that supports instructors in automatically classifying large question banks is presented that indicates low workload and high usability and the best prompting strategy combined in-context examples with course-specific action verbs is presented.

2606.13682.tldr: Results indicate that a Transformer policy trained on small OSSP instances can generalize to substantially larger problems and provide a feature-light, learning-based alternative to classical dispatching rules.

2606.13742.tldr: This work introduces a fully GPU based workflow that integrates accelerated data generation with the training of neural emulators augmented by uncertainty quantification and physics-aware refinement, and shows that residual-based refinement enables training on cases where only mesh and input parameters are available, substantially reducing residuals and improving physical consistency.

2606.13722.tldr: By integrating automated generation, user-created worlds, and spatial multi-agent collaboration, YeasierAgent formalizes the category of Symbiotic Agent-Native Applications, demonstrating a shift from isolated, tool-specific chatbots toward cohesive, socially embedded computational environments.

2606.13715.tldr: An updated version of the benchmark with data and code quality improvements, new model scores, and analysis of agent progress on WorkBench since 2024 is released.

2606.13707.tldr: This work proposes Orchestra-o1, an omnimodal agent orchestration framework designed to support efficient agent collaboration across multiple modalities, and introduces decision-aligned group relative policy optimization (DA-GRPO), an efficient agentic reinforcement learning approach for training Orchestra-o1-8B, which also achieves state-of-the-art performance against all existing open-source omnimodal agents.

2606.13695.tldr: Korzhinskii-Net is presented, a 2-D radial physics-informed neural network (PINN) that couples Darcy flow, advective-diffusive heat transport, and a softplus-saturated reaction rate into a single differentiable forward model, weakly supervised by surface and remote-sensing proxies.

2606.13683.tldr: In collaborative and non-collaborative dialogue benchmarks, UP-NRPA demonstrated considerable benefits, achieving an impressive 100% success rate in multiple dialogue tasks, and the sale-to-list ratio (SL) increased by 56.41%.

2606.13739.tldr: If the authors finetune an AI to adopt beliefs and dispositions that substantially reduce its existential risk -- by shaping the AI to be systematically subordinate to external human authorities -- the likelihood that a human user can deliberately induce the AI to engage in various kinds of generally unsafe behaviors is increased.

2606.13735.tldr: This work proposes a data pipeline that automatically converts Verilog designs and their accompanying testbenches into executable VHDL benchmark instances, followed by VUnit/GHDL-based validation to ensure each released task is compilable, runnable, and consistently checkable in the VHDL environment.

2606.13732.tldr: It is theoretically prove that siloed selection accelerates collapse and induces power-law diversity decay, and empirical results confirm that local-reference selection fails on skewed distributions, whereas collaborative proxy references mitigate diversity degradation, suggesting that recursive synthetic-data pipelines require particular caution when real-data coverage is fragmented or scarce.

2606.13706.tldr: HierSVA-SP pairs an RTL preprocessing toolchain with an LLM-in-the-loop formal verification flow to produce reference SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) on hierarchical RTL, an integrated suite that combines a pipeline, dataset, and benchmark for LLM-driven hierarchical hardware formal verification.

2606.13694.tldr: Random Attention is proposed, a lightweight temporal modeling module based on fixed random projections, which replaces learnable sequence modeling with similarity-based aggregation and demonstrates strong generalization across different backbone encoders and improved robustness over conventional temporal smoothing methods.

2606.13815.tldr: Poker Arena is introduced, a no-limit Texas Hold'em tournament platform that couples a three-layer memory architecture with a nine-axis cognitive profile decomposing strategic reasoning into interpretable dimensions such as bet-sizing calibration and positional awareness, and shows that multi-axis evaluation surfaces capability structure that scalar leaderboards systematically misrank.

2606.13811.tldr: This work introduces an approach that maps unitary operators into the latent space of an LLM, enabling unified modeling over quantum and linguistic inputs, and suggests a path toward quantum--aware foundation models that can natively interpret and reason about quantum operations.

2606.13753.tldr: A final LayerNorm removes the dependence by decoupling weight scale from the network function; without it the exponential law returns.

2606.14120.tldr: FAConformer is proposed, a frequency-aware CNN-Transformer framework for AAD that explicitly integrates band-specific encoding and adaptive cross-band interaction and performs frequency-aware modeling that more effectively exploits frequency domain information.

2606.14094.tldr: This work proposes FEMOT, a large-scale RGB-event multi-object tracking dataset that covers diverse real-world scenarios and 14 challenging attributes and proposes FEMOTR, a multimodal tracking framework that decouples RGB and event features and fuses them in the frequency domain, thereby effectively exploiting their complementary characteristics for robust object localization and identity association.

2606.13962.tldr: It is argued that human re-entry into the decision loop is not a passive option but an active cognitive event requiring intentional bandwidth restoration, and the design of AI systems must incorporate structured re-entry pathways that preserve human agency while appropriately distributing responsibility.

2606.13898.tldr: This work proposes HiLo-Token, an input-adaptive token compression framework that allocates more token budget to high-frequency, rich-context regions while assigning fewer tokens to low-frequency areas, and introduces a simple yet effective high-frequency token selection strategy based on spatial frequency.

2606.14218.tldr: This paper presents UME, an upper-limb exoskeleton that provides real-time haptic torque feedback while recording whole-arm configurations and joint torque signals for teleoperation and demonstrates that this combination of capabilities enables learning bimanual, whole-body, and active compliant policies that operate effectively in highly constrained spaces.

2606.14211.tldr: RefGRPO is proposed, a simple yet effective fix that augments standard RL algorithms with two key ingredients: a free calibration bonus computed by contrasting the agent's own reflection with the actual outcome (requiring no additional reward model, LLM judge, or external annotation), and a dynamic schedule on its coefficient.

2606.14210.tldr: This work unveils novel vulnerabilities of Split-LLM by presenting Patched Model Inversion with Dual-Sided Initialization (PIDI), a two-stage attack that simultaneously targets both private input prompts and output responses in Split-LLM settings.

2606.14199.tldr: It is shown that LLM-as-judge RL induces reward-hacking patterns, and that LLM-as-judge RL detectors can mitigate them during post-training, suggesting that behavioral foundation models require rethinking the LLM training paradigm.

2606.14188.tldr: This work presents CORD-SLS, a real-time control method for safe deformable object manipulation, with a focus on ropes and cloth, which is a GPU-parallel differentiable simulator with contact smoothing which enables efficient gradient-based planning through intermittent contact.

2606.14156.tldr: This paper introduces two algorithms rooted in submodular maximization, which not only provide provable guarantees on coverage but also yield rule sets that are both discriminative and parsimonious, and empirically demonstrates that rule sets learned through these approaches achieve higher accuracy and interpretability.

2606.14142.tldr: This work systematically decomposes explicit reasoning training pipelines for LLM-based GR, revealing three key limitations: weakened world-knowledge verbalization, misalignment between SID and natural-language token embedding spaces, and sensitivity to rationale quality, all of which hurt explicit reasoning performance.

2606.13858.tldr: A mood-conditioned ranking framework that integrates user affective signals into the recommendation process via softmax-based sampling in the energy-valence space is proposed, providing preliminary evidence for the effectiveness of incorporating mood-based inputs into music recommendations.

2606.14176.tldr: VeriGeo, a controllable geometry generation framework grounded in executable reasoning traces, achieves the best reported GeoQA performance among end-to-end multimodal LLM-based solvers, and obtains strong results on PGPS9K and MathVista-GPS, demonstrating the effectiveness of verified synthetic data for improving multimodal geometry reasoning.

2606.14078.tldr: This work proposes Blind Inversion-Backdoor Adversarial Unlearning (BI-BAU), which formulates the generation of adversarial examples satisfying the unlearning conditions as a blind inversion problem by integrating the bi-level optimization process of adversarial training into an Expectation-Maximization algorithm framework to optimize the maximum a posteriori (MAP) objective.

2606.14000.tldr: This work applies a coding agent to formalize Numerical Methods for Ordinary Differential Equations, a textbook in numerical analysis that is largely absent from mathlib, stressing the agent's capacity to develop new theory from scratch, and introduces a systematic, reproducible three-dimensional framework for evaluating the quality of agent-produced formalizations beyond compilation.

2606.13968.tldr: STREAM (Smart Tiered Routing Engine for AI Models) addresses the gap between local, HPC, and cloud inference with a three-tier routing architecture combining local, HPC, and cloud inference with a local LLM-based complexity judge.

2606.13904.tldr: SANA (Search Agent Navigation Ablation framework), a diagnostic ablation framework that transforms EQA tasks into runtime profiles containing gold source sequence, sanitized subquestions, and execution records, and allows for systematic comparisons of progress in search, planning, data analysis, and agent design.

2606.13892.tldr: It is concluded that AI and crypto are still in the very early stages of meaningful integration, and that AI and crypto are still in the very early stages of meaningful integration.

2606.14219.tldr: Persistent Mission Runtime (PMR), a UAV recovery framework that keeps the mission loop and safety-critical execution local while using an external agentic reasoner only as an on-demand recovery module, is presented.

2606.14238.tldr: This work evaluates Alpamayo R1, a 10B-parameter open-weight driving VLA, and finds a conservative-aggregate gap, and finds the scenarios with the loosest noise thresholds are not those with the lowest high-severity rate.

2606.13862.tldr: This work proposes SuperThoughts, which compresses pairs of consecutive CoT tokens into single latent representations and decodes two tokens per step via a lightweight Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) module, which preserves discrete token supervision at training time while doubling throughput at inference time.

2606.13839.tldr: These metrics move XAI for rPPG toward auditable numerical evidence about spatial alignment and perturbation faithfulness, i.e. trustworthy rPPG XAI.

2606.14119.tldr: FactoryLLM, a safe and open-source AI playground designed for evaluating different LLM-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models by analysing documents from multiple machines across the manufacturing process, is proposed.

2606.13934.tldr: This paper uses an LLM's representational geometry to predict which concept combinations it will fail on, and reliably anticipates failure modes across different compositional tasks, without evaluating specific inputs.

2606.13919.tldr: Graph Matching Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis (GMN4AD), designed to model interactions between heterogeneous brain graphs derived from neuroimaging data, is proposed, offering a robust and generalizable solution for AD diagnosis.

2606.13894.tldr: Gefen, a memory-efficient optimizer that automatically shares second-moment estimates across parameter blocks and quantizes the first moment using a learned codebook, thereby reducing AdamW's memory footprint by ~8x while maintaining the same performance, corresponding to a reduction of 6.5 GiB per billion parameters.

2606.14200.tldr: This work studies skill-conditional trust R(i | k)--the trust to place in agent i for a task requiring skill k, rather than one score per agent--and poses three falsifiable questions: when is conditioning worth it, how much cross-skill evidence should be borrowed, and whether that borrowing is safe.

2606.14141.tldr: ST-AudioQA, a spatio-temporal audio QA dataset and benchmark built from first-order ambisonic (FOA) renderings of static and moving sound sources, and ST-Audio Encoder, a time-resolved FOA audio encoder that learns event semantics together with source trajectories, and ST-AudioLM, which connects the audio tokens from the encoder to an LLM for spatio-temporal audio QA.

2606.14081.tldr: It is suggested that GFMs are most effective for landslide detection when they complement spatially detailed convolutional architectures rather than replace them.

2606.14047.tldr: The dynamic knowledge graph construction approach advances memory-augmented language modeling by enabling domain-specific knowledge representation that adapts to input contexts rather than relying on fixed knowledge bases.

2606.14027.tldr: This work proposes SOPGuard, an SOP enforcement mechanism tailored to agentic browsers, and implements SOPGuard in BrowserOS, an open-source agentic browser, demonstrating that SOPGuard effectively enforces SOP while preserving utility and incurring only a small runtime overhead.

2606.13884.tldr: RACG is introduced, a framework that decides whether to act on, defer, or abstain from a model's prediction by combining causal effect estimation with calibrated risk control, offering a principled mechanism for trustworthy automation in high-stakes settings.

2606.13871.tldr: This work investigates the use of HyperDimensional Computing (HDC), specifically the Holographic Reduced Representations (HRR) model, as a framework for tabular row embeddings when the retrieval task corresponds to answering structured select-project queries in vector space, and derives closed-form expected similarity values for both equality and non-equality retrieval predicates, and uses these to identify suitable retrieval thresholds.

2606.13870.tldr: This work shows that mirage behavior is linearly decodable from internal activations across residual stream, MLP, post-attention, and attention-head sites in two open-source VLMs, and demonstrates that a Naive Bayes text baseline cannot recover this signal, ruling out surface lexical confounds.

2606.13854.tldr: SpheriCity is presented, an expert-grounded conversational prototype designed to support trustworthy knowledge sensemaking from sustainability reports that foregrounds evidence traceability, structured synthesis, and interaction scaffolds to support exploratory querying and cross-document synthesis across sustainability reports.

2606.13835.tldr: A validation framework for evaluating the mobility of generative agents of LLM-based urban simulators against real-world mobility data is introduced, using mobility laws, temporal rhythms, network motifs, semantic activity transitions, and behavioral mobility profiles to highlight the need for rigorous empirical validation of LLM-based urban simulators.

2606.13832.tldr: A safety-contract graph MARL framework is presented and instantiate it as ACD$^3$-GAT (Adaptive Constrained Counterfactual Decisioning with a Graph Attention Network encoder), an architecture that separates simulator observations from reusable operational budgets, constrained optimization, graph state encoding, and counterfactual action screening.

2606.14125.tldr: SimEdit is proposed, a conditioning-aware framework with two complementary components: conditioning refinement, which constructs conditioning signals with improved semantic precision and structural alignment to facilitate stable inversion and consistent attention manipulation, and token-wise cross-branch attention control, which separates edit-relevant and structure-preserving components and modulates them asymmetrically during attention manipulation.

2606.14123.tldr: SLC (State-space Logit Correction), which converts binary observations to Gaussian pseudo-observations via Laplace/IRLS, applies empirical-Bayes shrinkage through a Kalman smoother, and fits an offset-Platt link, improves AUC on all four datasets and NLL on three, with the advantage concentrating on sparse items.

2606.14117.tldr: The Implicit Association Test is adapted to a controlled, forced-choice framework and a two-stage modeling approach is introduced that separates response compliance from task-consistent classification, providing a principled framework for evaluating structured response patterns in LLMs.

2606.14108.tldr: Adelic operation-preserved embeddings (AOE), a training-free representation that captures both a number's real value and its modular (p-adic) signatures, is introduced, suggesting a principled path forward for overcoming the long-standing"number problem" in AI.

2606.13989.tldr: Mask, Sample, Revise, an inference-time CTMC stack for alignment-free DFM-TTS improves intelligibility and robustness in the low-NFE prompted setting, outperforming unguided and guidance-only samplers with substantially more steps.

2606.13949.tldr: MINIM is proposed, a trusted local broker that performs privacy-aware minimization on the client side before any observation leaves the device, and optimize a CI-aware objective that penalizes necessity errors more strongly on high-risk content, enabling aggressive pruning while preserving task-critical information.

2606.13925.tldr: It is argued that autoformalization should be evaluated not only by closed sorries, but by whether the resulting formalization survives expert review, and shows a sharp split: agents adapted well to local, mechanically checkable feedback, but remained weak at choosing definitions and designing APIs.

2606.13916.tldr: This work demonstrates how multi-agent coordination can solve complex document processing challenges, offering institutions a scalable, collaborative AI solution that preserves accuracy while dramatically reducing processing time.

2605.25045.tldr: This work formalizes next-generation time series tasks as three-component tuples consisting of a task file, a workspace, and a validation interface, and presents AION, a time series harness built from six component groups: agents, skills, rules, memory, evaluation, and protocols.

2605.25058.tldr: Evidence from four companion studies spanning six LLMs, three languages and three task domains shows structural-fidelity splits, human-validated metric dissociation, and weight-tolerance plateaus consistent with IST's predictions.

2605.25061.tldr: GL-LFGNN, a Global-Local Dual-branch Causal Graph Neural Network grounded in Liang-Kleeman information flow theory, achieves 86.17% (Arousal) and 86.71% (Valence) accuracy with only 37K parameters, demonstrating that principled causal modeling can simultaneously enhance interpretability, generalization, and computational efficiency.

2605.25062.tldr: Recursive, Ecological, Cognitive, Lifelike, Adaptive, Intelligent Machine, a theoretical framework for cultivating intelligence through computational ecology rather than engineering it through strict optimization, suggests the spontaneous emergence of dual-process cognition, sensory specialization, analogical reasoning, and intrinsic motivation as natural consequences of evolution under resource constraints.

2605.25073.tldr: This paper presents a systematic survey of LLM fine-tuning security and establishes a lifecycle-based framework for comparing attacks and defenses, complemented by unified empirical evaluation.

2605.25091.tldr: This work proposes Adversarial Curriculum and Evolutionary-enhanced Multi-agent Proximal Policy Optimization (ACE-MAPPO), a hybrid learning framework that integrates evolutionary algorithms with MAPPO, and introduces a genetic soft update mechanism to enhance population diversity and mitigate convergence to local optima.

2605.25095.tldr: A post-generation reranking layer that scores candidates against a tiered rulebook via differentiable proxies and a scene-conditioned applicability mechanism, then selects with a deterministic $\varepsilon$-lexicographic rule that preserves cross-tier priority by construction -- without retraining the predictor.

2605.25101.tldr: An LLM-powered multi-agent workflow for specification-based metamorphic testing of FMU-based simulation models is proposed, which takes functional and interface specifications as input and orchestrates multiple agents to extract requirements and derive MRs.

2605.25107.tldr: This work proposes Non-Gradient Inference Flows (NGIF), an algorithm to infer non-gradient population dynamics using a weak formulation of the continuity equation that improves distributional accuracy over gradient-restricted baselines and better captures non-potential transport.

2605.25110.tldr: The results demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods and show that learned uncertainty correlates with semantic importance, establishing uncertainty-aware alignment as a general, robust, and interpretable framework for learning from structured data.

2605.25115.tldr: It is demonstrated that Courant's inductive biases yield latents that are interpretable by design: they develop multiscale geometric specialization in the simulation domain and track coherent structures in the time-dependent case, acting analogously to time-evolving spatial basis functions and allowing for decoding a compact, geometry-anchored, partition-of-unity-like decomposition of the simulated field.

2605.25119.tldr: This work addresses, for the first time, the importance of modeling trust in the interaction between features and predictions for domain adaptation by introducing trust-aware domain adaptation, a principled framework that models domain discrepancy through the reliability of feature and prediction signals.
