2605.25120.tldr: A human-supervised, evidence-linked reference architecture for structured radiology reporting that supports reviewed reporting, longitudinal comparison, clinical data reuse, governance, and integration with PACS, RIS, EHR, analytics, and registry workflows is proposed.

2605.25123.tldr: Trust-Region Iterative Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo (TRI-TSMC), a trust-region framework for learning twisting functions in SMC-based inference-time alignment, is proposed and formalize the value-function interpretation of the optimal twisting function and shows that it yields a zero-variance sampler.

2605.25133.tldr: Prover-verifier deliberation (PVD), an inference-time protocol grounded in interactive proof theory, is introduced as a mechanism for selective prediction: the protocol produces both an answer and a structured confidence verdict, allowing a system to report high-confidence answers while abstaining on uncertain cases.

2605.25135.tldr: The proposed Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Reinforcement Optimization ASTRO framework is a novel anomaly detection framework that pioneers the use of reinforcement learning for dynamic threshold optimization and is evaluated on two real world industrial benchmarks.

2605.25141.tldr: This review investigates how large language model LLM agents can enhance renewable energy forecasting by integrating heterogeneous sensor streams weather API data historical generation records grid constraints and contextual reasoning into unified decision support workflows and recommends a research agenda centred on physics informed LLM grounding and federated forecasting architectures.

2605.25151.tldr: This work evaluates LLM behavior at three levels: prompt-only behavioral sensitivity, linear readout of internal representations, and causal control via activation steering, which shows systematic condition sensitivity, but the directional pattern does not reproduce human realization-effect predictions.

2605.25156.tldr: This work shows that the optimal prediction in the target is in fact partially identifiable by the source distribution, and parameterizes the constrained family using a representation transplant, that is a specific linear transformation in the representation space that manipulates the abduction content of the representation while retaining the deduction component.

2605.25162.tldr: This work proposes Stream, a data-centric framework that leverages publicly available streaming media to synthesize high-value service dialogues at scale and releases StreamDial, a large-scale multi-domain dataset covering Automotive, Restaurant, and Hotel.

2605.25163.tldr: K-U-KAN matches transformer/implicit baselines on signal and structure metrics, clearly improves perceptual quality, and trains in roughly half the time-making single-view PX $\to$ CBCT reconstruction more practical for clinical pipelines.

2605.25166.tldr: AME-TS, a structure-guided sparse time series foundation model that aligns expert routing with interpretable temporal structure, is proposed and suggests that structure-aware routing is an effective and reliable way to realize the benefits of sparse expert models for time series forecasting.

2605.25170.tldr: An adaptive framework called Grow-Prune-Freeze (GPF) networks that enable an agent to continually learn through growing, pruning, and freezing early layers of its policy in response to world complexity are introduced.

2605.25181.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that SpecAlign effectively detects semantic inconsistencies and improves assertion alignment without relying on golden RTL, providing a scalable complement to traditional formal verification evaluation metrics.

2605.25186.tldr: It is found that behavioral divergence between formalizations is essentially uncorrelated with their structural agreement and that the verbalized cases reveal qualitatively distinct types of disagreement, including divergences that mirror genuine controversies in the legal commentary.

2605.25188.tldr: Experiments show that DarkForest achieves leading overall quality, improves the strongest baseline by up to 30.7\% on benchmark metrics, and reduces token consumption by up to $6.5\times$ compared with communication-heavy baselines.

2605.25196.tldr: Overall, public opinion toward military AI appears conditionally permissive, and publics are not categorically opposed to various military uses of AI, but unease is concentrated around fully autonomous lethal force.

2605.25198.tldr: Semantic Masked Expert Policy Optimization (SMEPO), a fine-grained semantic masking strategy for expert-guided RLVR that turns hard problems from reasoning from scratch into a fill-in-the-blank process.

2605.25203.tldr: The influence-adaptive Walsh geometry of a companion theory paper is applied to extreme low-bit weight-only LLM quantization and the WHT activation energy used here is not the Boolean influence of the theory paper, the link is intuitive, and the contribution is engineering value rather than a transferred theorem.

2605.25210.tldr: A principled MOL framework for diffusion models with limited data is developed: a semi-supervised regime where paired (labeled) samples are scarce, but (unlabeled) condition data are abundant and generalization bounds are established showing that the required number of paired samples only depends on the complexity of the specialist model classes.

2605.25232.tldr: The results support the interpretation of the Code2Text2Code approach not as a simple code transformation, but as a controlled specification-based reengineering process for LLM-mediated software evolution.

2605.25233.tldr: Meta-Agent is presented, a two-phase framework that automatically constructs and executes specialized multi-agent systems from natural-language task descriptions that introduces a three-level error attribution mechanism that distinguishes local, upstream, and structural failures, enabling targeted recovery strategies.

2605.25234.tldr: This work analyzes epistemic uncertainty through the lens of non-identifiability and characterize both discrete and continuous sources of residual uncertainty in overparametrized neural networks.

2605.25235.tldr: An attribution method for neural combinatorial-optimisation (CO) policies that decomposes a decision by constraint families via LP-relaxation duals, certifies counterfactuals through a combinatorial feasibility model, and bounds the size of a PAC-sufficient explanation with a Bonferroni-corrected Hoeffding sufficient-subset test along a greedy ordering.

2605.25250.tldr: LipoAgent is proposed, a safety-aware multi-agent LLM framework for lipid discovery that combines domain-specific finetuning with a conditional prediction objective that enforces toxicity as a prerequisite for efficiency prediction, and further improves reliability via multi-agent verification with lightweight human oversight when disagreement persists.

2605.25254.tldr: It is shown that model attribution is highly feasible as the model achieves near-perfect accuracy with around 20K images per model, and cross-domain generalization reveals that semantic content contributes to separability but is not the dominant signal.

2605.25263.tldr: This work introduces Mimir, a 1.6B Large Concept Model trained for multilingual concept understanding and generation and extensively evaluate model performance against a language model with a comparable number of parameters.

2605.25267.tldr: Across five safe ICRL benchmarks, the shield improves deployment-time reward-safety tradeoffs over a strong safe-ICRL baseline: after a short context window, it achieves higher return in four of five benchmarks while matching or lowering average episode cost in all five.

2605.25272.tldr: A framework for measuring the latent landscape in AI benchmark ecosystems and unique insights into benchmark dynamics, such as which benchmarks are a function of LLM size and which can be oppositely impacted by post-training practices are introduced.

2605.25293.tldr: This work proposes an end-to-end spiking encoder-decoder network for object detection in bird's eye view representations of LiDAR point clouds, trained using surrogate gradient backpropagation and demonstrates the viability of spiking neural networks for accurate and energy-efficient neuromorphic perception in autonomous driving.

2605.25313.tldr: The Unitary World Model JEPA is introduced, a JEPA world model with a density-matrix latent on a joint system-environment space and a learned unitary predictor that preserves the joint-state spectrum exactly during rollout, so the predictor itself cannot dissipate the represented uncertainty.

2605.25338.tldr: CausalFlow converts failed executions into validated minimal repairs with high minimality and causal-consensus scores, and demonstrates that causal attribution is necessary for reliable improvement across diverse agent tasks, outperforming heuristic refinement in complex retrieval settings while producing more localized repairs throughout.

2605.25344.tldr: Tensor Mixture is presented, a general tensor-structured compression scheme that replaces targeted dense linear layers with natively executable mixtures of tensor operators that is potentially applicable across Transformer-based LLMs and other dense neural mappings.

2605.25346.tldr: This work presents a parallelizable, differentiable reachability framework in JAX for continuous- and discrete-time systems with analytical and NN-based dynamics and controllers, and develops a certified training method that encourages reachability-friendly dynamics models and controllers.

2605.25348.tldr: Results demonstrate that graph-based regularization provides a favorable efficiency-quality tradeoff for resource-constrained medical imaging scenarios, and integrates quadratic graph regularization into a Proximal Forward-Backward Splitting optimization framework with three lightweight CNN modules.

2605.25352.tldr: This work proves that if a pretrained encoder maps inputs to a latent distribution that is $\varepsilon$-close (in KL divergence) to a Gaussian mixture, then certified accuracy degrades gracefully, with an explicit bound relating robustness under the true and approximate distributions.

2605.25358.tldr: The view that AI-associated lexical preferences extend beyond English and may exert cross-lingual homogenising pressure on global language use is consistent with the view that AI-associated lexical preferences extend beyond English and may exert cross-lingual homogenising pressure on global language use.

2605.25377.tldr: Adversarial Orthogonal Disentanglement (AOD), a latent geometric framework for mitigating LVLM hallucinations, is proposed, which enables a training-free dual-forward-pass contrastive decoding strategy that suppresses hallucinations while preserving general capabilities.

2605.25389.tldr: Evo-Attacker is proposed, which formulates the tool attack as a self-evolving, memory-augmented reinforcement learning process, and introduces Attack-Flow GRPO to optimize intermediate reasoning steps via terminal outcomes, addressing the long-horizon credit assignment challenge.

2605.25394.tldr: Second Guess is proposed, a lightweight, parameter-free prompting technique for abstention in multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) that is well-suited for SLMs and maintains an 8% composite risk improvement on fine-tuned models where entropy-based methods degrade, and improves most for lower-performing models.

2605.25396.tldr: STRIQ is presented, a registration-driven framework that recasts annotation-free US plane quality control as a subspace-guided consistency measurement problem, and introduces a Latent Registration Aligner (LRA) to establish hierarchical feature space correspondences between query images and variance-driven anchors.

2605.25399.tldr: The results show that survival modeling with censoring can be made compatible with LLM fine-tuning through comparison-based reformulation, and the LLMSurvival framework serves as a proof of concept for an integrated, censoring-conscious approach to survival analysis via LLMs.

2605.25420.tldr: This work evaluates four open-weight instruction-tuned models on SomaliBench v0, a native-author-verified benchmark of 100 harmful-intent prompts paired across English and Somali, finding large English-to-Somali refusal gaps.

2605.25422.tldr: A joint optimization problem aimed at minimizing the E2E latency of multi-agent collaboration is formulated and a low-complexity joint media selection and resource allocation algorithm is developed, enabling efficient and robust multi-agent collaboration in future wireless networks.

2605.25424.tldr: This work introduces SeqRoute, a framework that formulates multi-turn routing as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process and solves it via offline reinforcement learning, and proposes Hindsight Budget Relabeling (HBR), a technique retrospectively simulates historical trajectories under diverse hypothetical budgets.

2605.25427.tldr: It is found that learning to point-via-text induces an internal visual search routine, and the mechanisms that support this procedure are characterized, providing a proof-of-principle that serial processing can solve the binding problem for vision language models just as it does for biological vision.

2605.25430.tldr: This work proposes CODESKILL, an LLM-based framework that reformulates skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance as a learnable management policy, and trains CODESKILL with reinforcement learning, using a hybrid reward that combines dense rubric-based skill-quality feedback with sparse verifiable execution feedback from the frozen downstream agent.

2605.25435.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive study of the security landscape of OpenClaw agents, categorizing existing security and privacy threats into a layered framework and analyzing how vulnerabilities arise during agent reasoning, action execution, and external interaction.

2605.25440.tldr: A two-stage LLM-based framework is introduced that discovers interpretable feedback quality criteria grounded in the context of surgical training and outperform prior content-based frameworks in predicting feedback effectiveness, including observed trainee behavioral adjustments and trainer approval.

2605.25446.tldr: Findings indicate that large-scale ECG-report contrastive pre-training can expand routine ECG interpretation beyond common arrhythmias toward broad cardiovascular assessment and opportunistic screening of echocardiographic and rare conditions.

2605.25454.tldr: An algorithm audit is performed on three state-of-the-art moderation systems (OpenAI's moderation endpoint, Meta's Llama Guard, and Google's Shield Gemma) to investigate the extent to which these systems flag the content of real-life therapy sessions as undesirable.

2605.25459.tldr: Evidence is presented that post-trained models recognize their on-policy generations, and this recognition is implicitly encoded in their output distributions, and on-policy output distribution entropy is 3--4$\times$ lower than off-policy entropy, across model families and size classes.

2605.25475.tldr: A lightweight latent memory module is proposed that compresses evicted tokens into a compact, online-updated state and provides residual readouts to compensate for the attention contributions lost through KV eviction, enabling accurate long-context inference under a bounded KV budget.

2605.25477.tldr: ExPO-FT, a system for stable, sample-efficient RL finetuning of pretrained VLA policies that closes the gap between prior RL-from-scratch and VLA finetuning approaches, is presented and an open-source codebase is released with the aim of facilitating broader adoption of RL finetuning of VLA models in robotics.

2605.25488.tldr: Test-Time Self-Adaptive Conditioning (TT-SAC) is introduced, a parameter-free inference framework that enables pretrained talking-head generators to adapt their conditioning representations during inference without retraining, gradient updates, or additional supervision.

2605.25489.tldr: Artifact-Transform Workflow Language (ATWL), a domain-agnostic, declarative language that formally represents VA workflows by capturing their structure and underlying analytical intent, is presented, enabling a transition from narrative descriptions to formally represented, comparable, and reusable analytical knowledge.

2605.25502.tldr: A controlled synthetic benchmark for educational ABSA built from 10,000 synthetic course reviews with explicit train-validation-test splits and a 20-aspect pedagogical schema spanning instructional quality, assessment and course management, learning demand, learning environment, and engagement is introduced.

2605.25505.tldr: It is found that GenAI exposure is highly concentrated in the city's core districts, deepening the intra-urban AI divide and providing a basis for inclusive AI governance in global technology hubs.

2605.25517.tldr: A controlled two-document retrieval-augmented generation testbed that injects exactly two candidate sources into the model context and measures which source is referenced by the first citation marker in the output, and mixed-effects models show that topical relevance and list position are the biggest drivers of being cited first.

2605.25518.tldr: The proposed Cross-Stage Attention Mixture-of-Experts Network (CSA-MoE-Net) adopts a Cross-Stage Attention-enhanced ResNet-18 as the backbone, in which the Cross-Stage Attention module adaptively recalibrates multi-level features, thereby enhancing key tumor features and suppressing redundancy.

2605.25534.tldr: By leveraging StructBreak, this work uncovers a novel higher-order cognitive overload attack paradigm that operates under a practical black-box setting, requiring no internal model access, and acts as a novel structural channel to circumvent safety filters.

2605.25535.tldr: PerMemBench is introduced, the first benchmark for evaluating personalized memory systems, featuring multi year, multi domain interaction histories across diverse user personas, and session level storage gating is proposed, a lightweight framework that selectively bypasses memory operations for transient sessions.

2605.25536.tldr: LLM-based CGTs represent a fast-maturing yet unevenly evaluated research area, highlighting the need for domain-aware model improvements and holistic, standardized evaluation, addressing efficiency and associated costs.

2605.25541.tldr: TopoAlign is presented, a topology-aware framework for visually comparing model representations from a structural perspective that supports a top-down comparative workflow and provides meaningful insights into representation structure and alignment from a topological perspective.

2605.25543.tldr: ADMFormer introduces a time-varying masked spatial attention that sparsifies spatial interactions based on real-time traffic states, thereby effectively preserving dynamic and informative dependencies.

2605.25548.tldr: This paper introduces SiST-GNN, a dynamic graph neural network that fuses the two signals inside a single message-passing operation rather than chaining them, and constructs three dynamic node-classification tasks by discretising the underlying continuous-time event streams.

2605.25549.tldr: The BC Protocol is proposed -- a structured dual-expert elicitation method for LLM post-training data production that carefully pairs a domain expert with a knowledge engineer, systematically externalizing the expert's implicit judgments as natural language reasoning chains.

2605.25554.tldr: PHGNet, a novel spatiotemporal forecasting framework based on prototype-guided hypergraph construction, and a global-local node representation module to extract time-consistent features to improve the reliability of dynamic hypergraph construction.

2605.25558.tldr: This paper proposes DecoR, a novel routing framework that recasts the routing task as a matching process of sifting similar queries from historical logs, effectively mitigating the memorization trap, and develops CodaSet, a comprehensive benchmark for assessing routing generalization.

2605.25566.tldr: A neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that aligns LLMs with formal logic to enable explainable and formally verifiable medical diagnosis and enables human-aligned healthcare inference with strong generalization and verifiable, step-by-step reasoning chains is proposed.

2605.25572.tldr: A quantum-adapted CodeBLEU metric that upweights qml.

2605.25574.tldr: This work introduces compositional multi-concept erasure, a new task that aims to simultaneously remove multiple target concepts within a single scene within a single scene, and proposes CoME-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating compositional multi-concept erasure, which covers both intra- and cross-category scenarios.

2605.25577.tldr: GO-Flow is proposed that aligns generative modeling with molecular geometry via manifold decomposition with state-of-the-art generation quality and enables high-fidelity sampling with as few as 50 steps, effectively bridging the gap between structural precision and computational efficiency.

2605.25584.tldr: Experiments quantify the value of the broadcast, a positive scaling law (per-robot unseen-pair skill rises with team size), and the strongest masking-robustness and anytime profile among low-rank methods, recovering most of a centralized full-communication ceiling and holding under capacity-1 contention and in a robotics-grounded sensing instance.

2605.25601.tldr: The results show that selective partial mastery can be induced and measured in a structured mathematics setting, although the degree of controllability remains model-dependent.

2605.25603.tldr: Experiments show that CIE-Scorer achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing the cost of circuit construction, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining mechanistic interpretability signals with external reasoning traces for CoT unfaithfulness detection.

2605.25612.tldr: It is found that the flatness of loss landscapes is also closely related to the MLP activation sparsity and can serve as a weaker assumption because it naturally emerges in the standard training of deep networks without the above strong assumptions.

2605.25620.tldr: TC-WM is a framework for turning foundation-model embeddings into compact, task-sufficient world representations that enables test-time planning across diverse environments, achieving better world-modeling quality and more precise control than state-of-the-art approaches.

2605.25632.tldr: The contribution is a benchmark-ready evaluation framework for runtime actuarial control of autonomous-agent side effects, and develops the Authority Frontier, an evaluation primitive measuring how much autonomous authority the runtime releases at each level of reserve capital.

2605.25658.tldr: AutoSG is introduced, a fully automated workflow directly translating natural language prompts into executable customized solvers that significantly outperforms human-designed state-of-the-art frameworks and existing LLM-generated solvers.

2605.25665.tldr: A meta-engineering harness is presented: a software-production architecture that transforms operational and product feature requirements into explicit contracts, routes work through role-specialized AI agents, performs independent and adversarial verification, and continuously improves itself through structured failure classification and outer-loop calibration.

2605.25673.tldr: This approach reframes model identity as an empirically verifiable property and separates referential stability from the substantive security claims it conditions, which enables reproducible evaluation, longitudinal audit validity, and cross-provider equivalence.

2605.25680.tldr: Preliminary evidence is shown that language models with human-like memory constraints can function as more effective user simulators in a downstream education task and that better prompting strategies and the use of a compactor can cause language models to forget content in a more human-like way.

2605.25681.tldr: REUSE is proposed, a hierarchical evolutionary input-space search framework that combines pair-conditioned exploration with structured multi-stage selection to enforce dual-target affinity, chemical quality, and diversity.

2605.25682.tldr: Experiments show that profiling-driven adaptation is essential for practical distributed Transformer inference on embedded hardware, and Prism is evaluated by combining Segment Means compression with lightweight offline profiling to adaptively select between local and distributed execution at runtime.

2605.25698.tldr: Drop-Stable-Rampup is proposed for LLM midtraining: upon the quality transition, drop the batch size, hold it stable to accumulate signal, then ramp up to suppress terminal noise, which improves average accuracy over Warmup-Stable-Decay and over Cosine-decay.

2605.25707.tldr: This work introduces AgentHijack, a benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness of computer-use agents under common corruptions, and proposes AgentHijack-Agent, a framework that integrates an action generator with enhanced grounding capabilities and an onlooker responsible for behavior summarization and environment checking.

2605.25720.tldr: A self-improving $\mathrm{WA}^\star$ learning framework in combination with a value heuristic represented by a Relational Graph Neural Network is proposed: the heuristic guides search, and the resulting search data updates the heuristic via $Q$-learning.

2209.11572.tldr: A novel Multi-Modal Cross-Domain Alignment (MMCDA) network to transfer the annotation knowledge from the source domain to the target domain and raises the performance by more than 7% in representative cases, which demonstrates its effectiveness.

2303.07863.tldr: A new setting is posed, compressed-domain TSG, which directly utilizes compressed videos rather than fully-decompressed frames as the visual input, and a novel Three-branch Compressed-domain Spatial-temporal Fusion (TCSF) framework, which extracts and aggregates three kinds of low-level visual features for effective and efficient grounding.

2505.02129.tldr: This paper proposes a resource space model for aggregation query on subspaces defined by a range within the partial order on the coordinate trees representing each dimension, where each point in the subspace contains resources aggregated along the paths of the partial order relations on the coordinate trees.

2505.08155.tldr: This work proposes an efficient and scalable symbolic search method comprising two key components: a constraint strategies that drastically reduce the variable search domain, lowering data complexity; and a local search algorithm that approximately solves NP-hard cyclic queries.

2505.20110.tldr: Trajectory-Distilled GFlowNet (TD-GFN), a novel proxy-free training framework that utilizes inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) to extract dense, transition-level edge rewards from offline trajectories, providing rich structural guidance for efficient exploration.

2509.02113.tldr: HiGraph is introduced, the largest public hierarchical graph dataset for malware analysis, comprising over 200M Control Flow Graphs nested within Function Call Graphs nested within Function Call Graphs, to bridge the gap in graph-based malware analysis.

2509.16931.tldr: Inspired by generative models, TARQ's key innovation is to equip pre-ranking with an architecture approximate to TA by Residual Quantization, establishing a new state-of-the-art trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.

2509.22299.tldr: HEAPr is introduced, a novel pruning algorithm that decomposes experts into smaller, indivisible atomic experts, enabling more precise and flexible atomic expert pruning and outperforms existing expert-level pruning methods across a wide range of pruning ratios and benchmarks.

2510.02327.tldr: This paper introduces a novel hybrid architecture that bridges the gap between real-time speech-to-speech models and cascaded systems, and substantially outperforms a baseline S2S model in response correctness, approaching that of a cascaded system, while maintaining a latency on par with the baseline.

2602.20191.tldr: This work proposes a many-in-one recursive residual quantization that can iteratively reconstruct higher-precision weights at runtime and mitigates the outlier migration phenomenon with a token-aware router to dynamically select the optimal inference precision of each token.

2605.12906.tldr: It is shown that for a fixed data budget, there exists an optimal data difficulty for SFT, and that this optimal difficulty shifts toward harder data as the data budget increases, and that its effectiveness depends on the dataset size.

2605.17730.tldr: L-Drive introduces a Latent-Context, to explicitly characterize high-level dynamics evolving over time, and uses gating to modulate increment representations and incorporates patch-shared relative positional basis functions to strengthen intra-segment structural modeling and reduce overfitting caused by absolute-position memorization.

2605.18916.tldr: ConterFlow is presented, an inference-time dual-phase sampling scheme for pretrained flow-matching VT2A models that substantially improves counterfactual Video Foley generation compared to naive negative prompting and state-of-the-art baselines and a metric leveraging a text-audio co-embedding space to evaluate replacement quality.

2605.20749.tldr: Analysis of two-layer networks in the neural tangent kernel regime reveals that the GLU structure reshapes the NTK spectrum, leading to a smaller condition number and a more compact eigenvalue distribution, suggesting that its primary benefit lies in accelerating optimization rather than reducing the generalization gap.

2605.25168.tldr: The resulting dataset serves as a pilot clinically verified resource suitable for independent model evaluation, domain shift analysis, interpretability studies, and further expansion.

2605.25746.tldr: MCA, an automated coordination framework that learns a task- and budget-conditioned structural prior over agent participation and interactions, enabling efficient solutions with fine-grained control and reveals that joint adaptation of structure and orchestration suppresses redundant interactions, converging coordination toward task-effective execution.

2605.25748.tldr: FEP-Diff, an agent-centric trajectory prediction framework grounded in the Free Energy Principle, aimed at achieving cognitively plausible predictions under realistic constraints is proposed, demonstrating that FEP-Diff consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under restricted observability.

2605.25749.tldr: This work proposes DeGRe (Dense-supervised Generative Reranking), a generative reranking framework that bridges the gap between offline exploration and online efficiency through dense supervision, and demonstrates that DeGRe outperforms baseline models on public benchmarks and industrial datasets.

2605.25764.tldr: Across 83K runs, SpaPath-Bench reveals that different pretraining paradigms capture distinct aspects of tissue spatial architecture, and it provides practical guidance for building the next generation of spatially aware computational pathology models.

2605.25765.tldr: PURE (Projection in U-Net Rendering for Erasure), a closed-form method that builds the forget and retain bases from per-layer cross-attention activations captured along a short denoising trajectory and applies a single linear projector to the cross-attention key and value weights, is proposed.

2605.25771.tldr: This paper empirically reveals significant data redundancy in multi-domain graph pre-training, and proposes the Multi-domain Graph Pre-training Framework, MDGMIX, which combines boundary-aware subgraph mixing with hierarchical discrimination.

2605.25786.tldr: Extensive evaluations on 2D and 3D irregular geometries demonstrate that the proposed NPSolver outperforms both physics-informed and data-driven baselines, and a downstream thermal control task highlights the model's capability for conducting efficient and reliable gradient-based boundary control.

2605.25789.tldr: A two-phase, probably saving algorithm, UFE-KLUCB-H, which consists of a principled free exploration policy, UFE, and a history-aware regret minimization policy KLUCB-H, is proposed, demonstrating the near-optimality of UFE-KLUCB-H for two-valued bandits.

2605.25794.tldr: This work formalizes cutoff-based early outcome prediction under a temporal availability constraint and introduces LEAP (Leakage-Excluded Early-Availability Protocol), which enforces cutoff-first truncation prior to joins and aggregation and audits feature provenance to prevent post-cutoff evidence from entering the benchmark.

2605.25796.tldr: This work proposes SAMark, a self-anchored watermarking framework that removes the dependency on sentence order by establishing a step-independent green region in semantic space, and introduces a multi-channel hyperbolic scoring mechanism that amplifies watermark signals while suppressing noise from weakly aligned candidates.

2605.25814.tldr: Alper is a unified framework that integrates these steps into an iterative probabilistic label propagation process over a global, evolving graph, and refines the graph structure and labels dynamically by adaptively integrating "weak but cheap" signals from graph propagation with"strong but expensive"LLM-based pairwise queries.

2605.25816.tldr: The results indicate that diverse task-specific training data and a simple weighted cross-entropy objective contribute more to broad-coverage PII detection than the tested architectural and curriculum complexity.

2605.25829.tldr: OASIS, a visuomotor policy that aligns the intermediate representation with the action space via $SE(3)$ end-effector trajectory prediction, outperforms VLA and WAM baselines in success rate and out-of-distribution generalization.

2605.25831.tldr: Belief-Augmented Generation (BAG) is proposed: grounding LLMs in their own belief state via the prompt and letting them reason over these K samples to decide on a conversational strategy: answer, clarify, or abstain.

2605.25832.tldr: Auto-Robotist is presented, a self-evolving LLM agent that distills morphology-search traces into an explicit natural-language skill library, suggesting that LLM agents can convert expensive physical evaluations into reusable, auditable design principles.

2605.25835.tldr: The key empirical finding is that for Kubernetes YAML, result quality in the pilot depended more on strict output format requirements than on simply increasing the number of training examples.

2605.25836.tldr: TTPrint is proposed, which addresses the challenge of extracting MITRE ATT&CK techniques from cyber threat intelligence reports through a diverge-then-converge design inspired by how human analysts work: first extracting broadly, then verifying rigorously.

2605.25848.tldr: Geometric Evolution Maps (GEMs) are introduced, which track the full directional trajectory of a concept through residual stream activations, identify the handoff layer where rotation ceases, and extract the settled probe direction from that layer.

2605.25850.tldr: Empirical results demonstrate that TIAR achieves state-of-the-art abstention F1 scores across five of six evaluation categories, outperforming the static ternary baseline on 17 of 31 benchmark datasets while fully preserving baseline accuracy.

2605.25854.tldr: An operational electricity-computation-water (ECW) nexus framework that internalizes virtual water impacts directly into power system dispatch is developed, enabling efficient end-to-end learning of coordination policies while preserving operational feasibility.

2605.25856.tldr: Reasoning traces are best understood as user-facing interface artifacts rather than transparent windows into model cognition, and calibration is unlikely to emerge from the traces themselves and may best be scaffolded by interactions that elicit users'own reasoning first.

2605.25891.tldr: A mismatch between what large language models encode about a causal question and what they answer is found, and the implication cuts both ways for output-only causal benchmarks: a benchmark"correct"need not mean the model has understood, and a benchmark"wrong"need not mean it cannot.

2605.25893.tldr: This work proposes $D^2-Monitor, a bi-level safety monitor for D-LLMs that adopts a lightweight probe as an always-on monitor to jointly estimate hesitation and perform base classification, and exhibits the best trade-off between effectiveness and efficiency relative to 8 baselines.

2605.25920.tldr: This work proposes LegalSearch-R1, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that pairs local statute RAG for precise article matching with online web search for broader legal knowledge, trained on temporally-indexed data spanning multiple amendment periods to enforce temporal consistency.

2605.25931.tldr: A benchmark validity analysis showing that current interactive reasoning benchmarks fail to measure the exploration they claim to require, and the EXPLORE-before-PLAN framework and model-capability x exploration interaction are analyzed, formalise AERA through a Speed--Depth trade-off framework.

2605.25933.tldr: A machine learning approach based on multivariate kernel density estimation (MKDE) technique for the objective evaluation of PTSD severity and followup, which demonstrates promising potential for enhancing estimation of PTSD severity and followup by offering an objective and low-effort evaluation approach using physiology.

2605.25939.tldr: The findings yield a simple design principle for prototype-recoverability-aware training: every repulsive structural loss must be compensated by a compatible attractor, or it will collapse the latent geometry it was meant to refine.

2605.25944.tldr: EchoPilot is presented, a training-free framework for ultrasound video segmentation under sparse first-frame interaction, requiring only a single point click and an anatomical category name, and contributes the first dynamic fetal placenta ultrasound video segmentation dataset with 671 annotated frames.

2605.25949.tldr: It is argued that scale is a poor substitute for architectural inductive bias in this domain: structured priors deliver outsized parameter efficiency, and the pattern of where they succeed and fail is itself informative about what they capture.

2605.25952.tldr: VEN-VL is proposed, a visual ensemble MoE framework for effective and efficient perception following the enrich then compact principle, which effectively bridges the gap between performance and efficiency in complex visual tasks with few information-condensed tokens.

2605.25954.tldr: Step-TP is introduced, a post-training dataset for tensor program optimization that provides grounded, atomic, step-level supervision with structured chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, enabling reliable multi-step optimization rather than outcome imitation.

2605.25955.tldr: This paper proposes QUIET (Quality Understanding via Interlocked Evaluation Testing), a diagnostic benchmark for LLM creative capability based on multi-blank cascaded story cloze, which measures how well the blank filling satisfies the content constraint (objective logical reasoning judgment, not subjective aesthetic scoring).

2605.25962.tldr: CORTIS is presented, the first framework for continual speaker identity unlearning in ZS-TTS that requires no access to previously-unlearned speaker data, and combines Fisher-information-based parameter masking with orthogonal projection against subspaces spanned by prior unlearning updates.

2605.25964.tldr: This work proposes LECTOR, a novel Logic-Expression Co-Reinforcement Learning framework that can strictly follow the scientist's logic, add high-quality citations and keep structured expressions, and employs a Logic-Expression Co-Rewarding mechanism to jointly optimize for both the graph's structural fidelity and the final narrative's quality.

2605.25977.tldr: This paper provides an empirical implementation of the creative quality metric proposed in Calibrated Surprise and uses the term Creative Quality Alignment (CQA) to describe this class of engineering methods.

2605.25984.tldr: Evaluated across multiple LLMs and unsafe dialogue scenarios, SafeCtrl-RL consistently improves safety and response quality, outperforms existing prompt-based optimisation methods, and achieves favourable performance--efficiency trade-offs.

2605.26001.tldr: This work introduces a structured representation of a systematized concept, a concept spec, and a validation worksheet, and develops two AI-assisted systematizers: a direct, zero-shot approach and a multi-agent approach that more closely mirrors manual systematization approaches from existing literature.

2605.26012.tldr: A simple yet effective representation-level prior is presented that inserts a fixed orthonormal projection to constrain encoder features to a low-dimensional subspace, requiring no auxiliary objectives, pretraining, or changes to the underlying RL algorithm.

2605.26013.tldr: AdvantageFlow, a forward-process reinforcement learning algorithm for rectified flow models, is introduced, which outperforms both Flow-GRPO and a state-of-the-art forward-process RL baseline based on negative-aware fine-tuning.

2605.26019.tldr: A retrieval-augmented generation framework for the automated detection and classification of potentially abusive clauses in Chilean Terms of Service that combines efficient clause detection, hybrid dense--sparse retrieval, reranking, and prompt augmentation to support medium-sized open-weight language models.

2605.26026.tldr: This work introduces a 3D foundation model for LSM data, pretrained on a large curated collection of 3D images spanning multiple organisms, stains, and imaging protocols, and learns transferable volumetric representations by jointly optimizing for masked reconstruction and image-text alignment.

2605.26032.tldr: A scale-invariantcale-invariant-space-spaceiffusion model that unifies generation and continuous super-resolution within a single unconditional framework and reconstructs critical Ising models whose connected four-point correlations closely track the ground truth.

2605.26036.tldr: CityRep, a unified benchmark that evaluates urban representations across data modalities, cities, and tasks using spatially structured splits, is proposed and released as a reproducible benchmark with datasets, evaluation pipelines, and diagnostic tools to facilitate fair comparison and support future research in urban representation learning towards urban foundation models.

2605.26038.tldr: DRScaffold is proposed, a supervised fine-tuning framework that decomposes the supervision target into four causally ordered stages, enforcing grounded reasoning without architectural modification, demonstrating that structured supervision can substitute for a significant portion of model scale in dense-scene reasoning.

2605.26040.tldr: Evaluations on two real-world datasets characterized by pervasive camouflage demonstrate that L2IR surpasses strong baselines and can function as a plug-in enhancement for a range of GNN-based detectors, improving AUPRC by up to 8.27%.

2605.26045.tldr: 6 different methods for estimating the confidence of activation oracles are investigated and how well-calibrated their confidence scores are are evaluated, revealing that bootstrap mode frequency is the best-calibrated method among those tested.

2605.26061.tldr: The Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit is introduced, a novel biologically-inspired CT attention architecture that reformulates attention logit computation as the solution of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck stochastic differential equation modulated by input-dependent, nonlinear interlinked gates derived from repurposed C. elegans Neuronal Circuit Policies (NCPs) wiring mechanism.

2605.26067.tldr: Both the theoretical analysis and experiments confirm that conditional KRR outperforms standard KRR in these cases whenever the $\mathcal{F}$-component of the regression function is more pronounced than the residual part.

2605.26074.tldr: StakeBench is introduced, an evaluation framework for language understanding grounded in market commitment that links 560,876 comments from 2,261 resolved markets to verified position, action, and market-odds records across Polymarket and Manifold.

2605.26081.tldr: VeriTrace is a cognitive-graph framework that explicitly implements three regulatory loops: interpretive update, deviation feedback, and schema revision, and achieves the strongest reproducible open-source result on DRB.

2605.26086.tldr: Claw-Anything is introduced, a benchmark that expands agent context along three dimensions: long-horizon activity histories, interdependent backend services, and integrated GUI and CLI interaction across multiple devices, underscoring a gap between current agent capabilities and the demands of always-on personal assistance.

2605.26100.tldr: A two-stage pipeline that assigns labels to diff hunks and then refines them to capture structural relationships and semantic attributes, such as rename propagation and type changes is introduced, suggesting that LLM-based labeling can effectively complement static analysis by enabling flexible, multilingual, and automation-friendly code review workflows.

2605.26111.tldr: This work condition diffusion models on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that jointly encode text and reference images, and augment it with VAE-based identity conditioning, and achieves superior performance regarding human preference on subject-driven image generation.

2605.26112.tldr: This paper studies the next major bottleneck in agentic AI as system scaling, not only model scaling: the design of auditable, persistent, modular, and verifiable architectures around foundation models, and claims that future progress in agentic AI will depend as much on system design as on stronger foundation models.

2605.27023.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed negative sampling method, KMAS, can enhance many SOTA KGFMs without requiring excessive additional time or memory consumption.

2605.27284.tldr: FineVLA, an open framework for action-aligned fine-grained VLA supervision, is introduced and the largest real-world gains appear on pose, color, and approach direction, and approach direction--factors where goal-level instructions provide no guidance.

2605.27366.tldr: MUSE-Autoskill Agent (Memory-Utilizing Skill Evolution), a skill-centric agent framework that creates, reuses, and refines skills under a unified lifecycle: creation, memory, management, evaluation, and refinement, outperforms Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code.

2605.27482.tldr: This work observes that output feature drift induced by parameter updates is inherently low-rank, and theoretically proves that preserving parameters along the principal directions of this drift minimizes the output reconstruction error.

2605.27599.tldr: A systematic energy-observability audit of the ASUS Ascent GX10 (GB10 SoC) finds that the platform exposes no CPU energy counter, no INA power-rail monitor, no IPMI/BMC, and no SCMI powercap protocol through any supported software interface, and motivates the low-carbon computing community to demand energy observability as a first-class hardware requirement.

2605.27744.tldr: It is argued this seam is best addressed by an architectural change rather than point fixes: insert a third tier, an agent runtime layer, between the framework and the engine, exposing four primitives into which any agent-aware policy plugs, with agent identity as the shared coordinate.

2605.27766.tldr: It is found that shifting from single turn to multi turn social evaluation amplifies privacy violations, that leakage is socially contagious, and that social context alone is sufficient to elicit sensitive disclosures that single turn evaluations would never surface.

2605.27767.tldr: The results demonstrate that prompt-conditioned control of domain-specific policy networks is feasible without end-to-end multimodal training, while highlighting trade-offs between controllability and predictive performance.

2605.27768.tldr: EvaluatorDPT is presented, a bounded decision-control model that predicts YES, NO, or TBD, where TBD is learned as a deferral outcome rather than added only as a post-hoc confidence rule.

2605.27773.tldr: This work introduces introspective faithfulness and finds CoT reasoning is highly stable across opposite decisions: flip pairs retain 96% of same-answer similarity and internal thinking tokens show greater decision-sensitivity than user-facing CoT (p=0.033).

2605.27784.tldr: This work studies live intra-policy rule-conflict diagnosis: finding rule pairs inside a single prompt policy that can co-govern a realistic state, and measuring how models resolve that pressure in responses or tool actions.

2605.27785.tldr: Hyperparam, three open-source JavaScript libraries that read Parquet and Apache Iceberg directly from object storage and meet the third property with per-cell, asynchronous SQL execution, so expensive cells fire only when downstream operators demand them.

2605.27789.tldr: A minimum measurement standard for LLM-as-a-judge comparisons in RAG is proposed and stress-test it with Genetic Algorithm Decoder for Multi-hop Evidence Composition (GADMEC), an evolutionary evidence selector, on 400 multi-hop questions in computer science/machine learning and Materials Science.

2605.27799.tldr: GraD-IBD is proposed, a graph diagnosis model that reformulates longitudinal ICD trajectories as visit-bucketized, temporally directed graphs to detect the risk of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and highlights the potential of graph representation learning to enable efficient, scalable, and accurate disease risk prediction from longitudinal ICD diagnosis codes.

2605.27805.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate how different personalized representations affect LLM responses and suggest that finetuning on ChildEval can enhance child-centered performance, and propose fine-grained, child-centric evaluation protocols to systematically assess open-source LLMs.

2605.27811.tldr: Under mild monotonicity conditions, the optimality gap relative to full per-tick control is bounded by the dispersion of per-tick marginal value-per-cost, and a lightweight analytic controller enforces each active constraint via a 1D root-finding step.

2605.27813.tldr: It is shown that residualized temporal SAEs provide a useful framework for studying temporally structured diffusion activations and can be mapped back into activation space, allowing each latent to be analyzed as a feature trajectory over denoising time.

2605.27817.tldr: The results show that decoupled video planning plus faithful video-to-action translation is a viable alternative route towards zero-shot, cross-embodiment, and generalizable robot control.

2605.27819.tldr: ReSAEs are introduced, which fit an affine map between selected layers and train each later-layer SAE on the unexplained residual rather than on the full activation, suggesting that removing linearly predictable cross-layer structure is a useful default for multi-layer SAE interventions.

2605.27820.tldr: This work introduces EgoBench, the first interactive multimodal benchmark for tool-using agents, and establishes a deterministic joint validation framework that guarantees objective assessment through process-based and result-based equivalence.

2605.27823.tldr: The Adversarial Prompt Disentanglement framework is proposed, a novel defense mechanism that proactively identifies and neutralizes malicious components in input prompts before they are processed by the LLM, and offers a scalable, ethically grounded defense against prompt-based adversarial threats.

2605.27824.tldr: This work aims to localize the attention heads responsible for individual reasoning steps and characterize the types of information transferred among them, indicating that LLMs retrieve factual and rule-based information for individual sub-reasoning tasks through specialized attention heads, whereas higher layers predominantly facilitate information integration and the emergence of global reasoning strategies.

2605.27827.tldr: Operational AI Deployment Assurance (OADA), a governance framework for translating fairness disagreement, subgroup instability, threshold sensitivity, remediation outcomes, and operational uncertainty into deployment-oriented assurance decisions, is introduced.

2605.27840.tldr: A Semantic Bottleneck that compresses 1280-dimensional semantic encoder features into 128 dimensions, regularized by the proposed time-relation loss for temporal feature consistency is introduced and a dual-level semantic supervision method is designed that leverages both high- and low-dimensional semantic signals, enabling the tokenizer to jointly capture semantics and acoustic details within a compact latent space.

2605.27845.tldr: This work proposes a snippet-driven method for constructing a supply chain knowledge graph (SCKG), with firms as nodes and inter-firm relationships as edges, with retained provenance metadata making the SCKG an auditable complement to disclosure-based databases.

2605.27846.tldr: This paper systematically investigates the roles of positive and negative samples in reinforcement learning for open-ended QA, and proposes EAPO, an Entropy-driven Adaptive Policy Optimization method that adaptively computes the weighting coefficients of positive samples based on the ratio of the current policy entropy to the initial entropy.

2605.27849.tldr: FPMoE is introduced, a lightweight, open-source code generation model built on a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with three language-specific routed experts and a shared expert that captures cross-language functional patterns such as monadic reasoning and type-directed programming.

2605.27850.tldr: TCP-MCP (Topology-Coupled Prompting for Multi-Agent Collaborative Problem-Solving), a co-evolution framework that searches agent prompts and communication topologies as a unified genome, is proposed.

2605.27851.tldr: This work introduces context-flip evaluation, testing 12 models across a safety benchmark and two commonsense controls using paired variants where the nominally safe action produces harm, and finds that action-level content moderation is systematically blind to consequence-flips, motivating state-aware architectural alternatives.

2605.27853.tldr: This work presents MolLingo, a multi-agent system that emulates the reasoning process of a chemist to automate molecular design and introduces BRICS-based Fragment Enumeration, a synthesis-aware molecular fragmentation method that decomposes molecules into chemically meaningful building blocks represented as block-based SMILES paired with common chemical names.

2605.27856.tldr: This work introduces a complementary paradigm for ads: a fine-tuned open-source LLM used not as a ranker, but as an ads-specific ancillary predictor, forecasting likely advertisers from user profiles and histories, offering a practical path to LLM-enhanced recommendation at scale.

2605.27858.tldr: DecomposeRL addresses the prohibitive training cost of GRPO with a data-curation funnel that distills 115K fact-verification claims into a compact, learning-signal-dense subset of 5K claims, enabling both fully supervised and semi-supervised learning from unlabeled claims.

2605.27860.tldr: C-MIG is proposed, a Multi-view Information Gain-based retrieval-augmented generation framework for Clinical diagnosis that achieves the best performance among all RAG-RL methods on both in-domain and out-of-domain sets, and outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose LLMs for clinical diagnosis.

2605.27861.tldr: A systematic ablation study of three Graph Neural Network architectures for drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction on a publicly available benchmark dataset comprising 38,337 positive pairs across 86 interaction types, confirming that atom-level inter-molecular communication specifically enables mechanism-type classification.

2605.27873.tldr: AIBuildAI-2 is introduced, a knowledge-enhanced agent with an external, evolving knowledge system for automatically building AI models, which achieves state-of-the-art results, ranking first on MLE-Bench with a 70.7% medal rate and placing in the top 6.6% among 4,370 human-expert teams in a heart disease prediction competition.

2605.27877.tldr: Support-Preserving Action Rectification is proposed, which reframes global learning as a local residual rectification anchored to a frozen pure behavior cloning policy and introduces Latent Self-Imitation, utilizing a latent-sampling weighted-regression mechanism to address fitting-improvement gradient conflict in the residual space.

2605.27879.tldr: The findings show that explicit verification is essential for faithful Agentic XAI and that faithfulness benchmarks must be designed to test explanations against the behavior of the target model itself, and that faithfulness benchmarks must be designed to test explanations against the behavior of the target model itself.

2605.27882.tldr: This work benchmarks seven frontier models under both the ReAct framework and the OpenClaw agent harness and shows that all models remain substantially inadequate for VibeSearch, highlighting the need for fundamental advances in long-context reasoning, proactive intent elicitation, and structured knowledge construction.

2605.27891.tldr: SmartDirector is proposed, a framework that enhances the narrative capacity of video generation models through multiple keyframes through multiple keyframes, and supports flexible generation scenarios including single-shot generation, multi-shot narrative synthesis, and video extension.

2605.27898.tldr: This work presents a unified framework for the fair evaluation of LLM agentic capabilities, and shows that scaffold choice and environmental volatility materially shift benchmark outcomes in both directions, allowing this framework to disentangle intrinsic LLM capabilities from framework- and environment-induced artifacts.

2605.27899.tldr: SkillC is proposed, a framework based on Contrastive Skill Credit Assignment (CSCA) that converts this contrast into a direct learning signal for internalization that surpasses the strongest prior skill-internalization RL baseline while remaining competitive with skill-augmented RL methods.

2605.27901.tldr: The first large-scale evaluation of CoT monitorability across 13 diverse languages and seven frontier model families, comprising 16 models, reveals that CoT monitoring is fundamentally fragile under linguistic distribution shift, providing a substantially weaker safety signal than what English-only studies suggest.

2605.27904.tldr: Dr-CiK is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating whether agents can retrieve forecasting-relevant supporting context from a document corpus, filter out distractors, distill the retrieved context into forecast-useful evidence, and generate forecasts supported by that evidence.

2605.27906.tldr: Reasoning-Conditioned Direct Preference Optimization (RC-DPO), which models the CoT as a condition for answer generation and contrasts the preference for the same preferred answer under different CoT conditions, promoting answer-supportive reasoning chain alignment, is derived.

2605.27908.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that ESC-Skills improves both response-level quality and dialogue-level emotional outcomes while providing more interpretable and controllable support behaviors.

2605.27911.tldr: This work introduces SuiChat-CN, a Chinese group-chat benchmark for contextual suicide risk assessment, and collects public Telegram group-chat data, construct coherent conversational segments through signal-word extraction and bidirectional context expansion, and annotate user risk levels with an expert-validated, LLM-assisted paradigm.

2605.27921.tldr: The problem of AI-generated text detection in a human-centric perspective is reframed in a human-centric perspective and paves the way for a new family of detectors that focus on native explainability.

2605.27922.tldr: Harness-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for diagnosing and improving reliable, efficient, and auditable agent execution stacks and suggests that agent capability should be reported at the model-harness configuration level rather than attributed to the base model alone.

2605.27923.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive benchmarking study of classical and quantum machine learning models for image recognition on the MNIST handwritten digit dataset, evaluating both traditional models and deep neural network models.

2605.27931.tldr: This paper introduces DiagramRAG, a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework for sketch-based scientific diagram completion that represents diagrams as knowledge graphs, synthesize sketch variants at different simplification levels, and train an embedding model to align sketches with compatible diagrams in a shared space.

2605.27932.tldr: The results suggest that explicit image-tool interaction is a promising design pattern for improving jailbreak robustness, while also motivating pipeline-specific safety evaluation.

2605.27935.tldr: This work provides mechanistic evidence that autonomous LLM agents allocate depth adaptively as reasoning complexity grows, through a systematic layer-wise analysis of complete user-agent trajectories spanning three domains.

2605.27944.tldr: This work constructs the Singing Head DeepFake dataset using rhythm-aware generative models to fill the gap in singing benchmarks and proposes a Text-guided Audio-Visual Forgery Detection (T-AVFD) framework that generalizes across both talking and singing scenarios.

2605.27958.tldr: Probe fragility reflects distributional narrowness rather than an architectural limitation: style-augmented probes recover near-perfect detection at both 4B and 27B, establishing that the inverse scaling pattern is a training-distribution artifact rather than a genuine scale-dependent phenomenon.

2605.27965.tldr: It is found that early isolated repair is often compatible with correct reasoning, whereas incorrect traces more often show moderate-to-severe backtracks that persist and cluster late, and burst-aware control provides a deployable mechanism for separating recoverable repair from likely instability.

2605.27967.tldr: This work introduces a teacher-informed prior, integrating external knowledge from teacher models and task-specific training data, offering better generalization, robustness, and scalability, and enhances the interpretability of the student model's learning process, improves predictive accuracy, and provides uncertainty quantification.

2605.27970.tldr: This work studies the layer-wise emergence of intrinsic geometrical structure corresponding to perceptual modalities within the residual streams of multiple open-weight transformer architectures, suggesting that perceptual geometry arises transiently as part of the model's internal transformation pipeline.

2605.27971.tldr: Semantic Flow Regularization (SFR), a lightweight auxiliary objective that supervises the backbone with continuous sentence-encoder embeddings of future segments via conditional flow matching, improves output diversity, style fidelity, and response quality over SFT on a large-scale industrial dialogue dataset.

2605.27980.tldr: This work proposes Periodic RoPE (P-RoPE), a positional encoding mechanism designed to circumvent position exhaustion that outperforms MiniMInd with standard GPT architectures in long-context efficiency and stability and provides a possible pathway toward LLMs with genuine infinite-context understanding.

2605.27981.tldr: STAB is introduced, a specification-driven pipeline that generates test cases that expose algorithmic bottlenecks from a natural-language problem specification alone and encodes the problem specification, resolved boundary, and retrieved construction principles into a structured generation specification, from which the LLM synthesizes a Python test case generator.

2605.27984.tldr: It is found that English-Korean performance gaps vary substantially across models and task families, and that SpokenQA and audio understanding rankings diverge, revealing complementary weaknesses invisible to English-only evaluation.

2605.27990.tldr: A per-noise-level damped Gauss--Newton correction computed in diffusion-state coordinates is replaced with a per-noise-level damped Gauss--Newton correction computed in diffusion-state coordinates and achieves competitive PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS while running markedly faster than most of the compared baselines.

2605.27997.tldr: This work introduces Meow2X and TRNE, two complementary retraining-free frameworks that localize toxicity to specific layers and neurons by analyzing activation differentials between toxic and neutral prompts, then suppress them via inference-time scaling or minimal rank-one weight edits -- without any gradient descent.

2605.27999.tldr: This work provides a general theoretical characterization of the problem of learning to assign prediction tasks to one agent from a set of available human or AI agents and develops a framework of sequential explore-exploit policy-learning algorithms that seek to maximize overall performance.

2605.28000.tldr: This paper introduces Tool Forge, a validation-carrying toolchain for converting natural-language capability intent into governed, sandbox-verified, cataloged tool artifacts and exposing those artifacts to agents through a token-efficient routing layer.

2605.28001.tldr: An empirically audit the k-NAF budget-accounting mechanism in Anchored Decoding using a fixed, class-stratified workload and an adaptive prompt-search procedure targeting high proxy spend ratios, consistent with proxy artifacts rather than per-trajectory budget failures.

2605.28006.tldr: This work proposes to use bandwidth-calibrated MIP coupled with Tukey IQR peak-detection to isolate reasoning-crucial tokens at the output layer and applies a Jaccard stability metric over multi-domain problems to verify if the MIP-identified tokens are reasoning quality-guaranteed.

2605.28007.tldr: The Vector Network is introduced, a hierarchical recurrent architecture in which each layer replaces a fixed weight matrix with a library of reusable rank-1 weight atoms, which makes compositional generalization a structural property of the architecture and inference process rather than a brittle byproduct of fitting many behaviors into one shared dense parameter substrate.

2605.28008.tldr: A taxonomy of CoT is proposed consisting of Explicit CoT, which outputs all operations without aggregation, Composed CoT, which combines multiple operations into a single step, and Implicit CoT, which omits intermediate operations.

2605.28010.tldr: This work proposes COSE (Confidence-Orchestrated Self-Evolution), which uses the LLM's intrinsic confidence as a lightweight uncertainty signal to modulate learning and introduces confidence-weighted PPO updates and confidence-prioritized replay.

2605.28023.tldr: VCap is proposed, a Witness-Adjudicator reward that pairs the reference caption (a witness) with the visual signal (an adjudicator) with hypergeometric-distribution-level precision for caption quality verification, facilitating weak-to-strong generalization in RL training.

2605.28025.tldr: The Medical Information Response Audit (MIRA), a bilingual, controlled benchmark that assesses whether LLMs provide comparable medical information across user-side language, register, and health literacy signals, is introduced.

2605.28030.tldr: SPARD is a defense framework that integrates Safety-Projected Alternating optimization with Relevance-Diversity aware data selection, and employs SPAG, which optimizes alternatively between utility updates and explicit safety projections with a set of safe data to enforce safety constraints.

2605.28034.tldr: The codec, the Rust implementation, and a multilingual sentence-similarity evaluation on 9,304 labeled pairs from 29 subsets are described, which describes the codec, the Rust implementation, and the result, which is a simple stateless codec for compact embedding storage.

2605.28035.tldr: Results demonstrate that MTAVG-Bench 2.0 provides a systematic benchmark for failure diagnosis in cinematic multi-talker audio-video generation, and establishes a high-level failure taxonomy spanning acting, narrative, atmosphere, and audio-visual language.

2605.28042.tldr: This paper presents a method for aggressively pruning experts from modern mixture-of-experts LLMs while incurring negligible degradation in translation quality, and shows that translation requires only a fraction of the LLM, enabling substantial compression of the MoE blocks that contain over 90% of parameters.

2605.28046.tldr: MemCog is proposed, a Memory-as-Cognition system that makes memory access an integral part of the reasoning process and achieves state-of-the-art on passive QA benchmarks while substantially outperforming baselines on ProactiveMemBench, demonstrating the advantage of Memory-as-Cognition.

2605.28063.tldr: This paper proposes PlanAudio, a unified, autoregressive LLM-based framework that simplifies the model architecture by leveraging intrinsic LLM reasoning capability instead of traditional text encoders, and introduces a semantic latent chain-of-thought mechanism, an implicit planning mechanism that bridges high-level semantic understanding and low-level acoustic synthesis.

2605.28064.tldr: This work investigates voice deepfake detection as a perceptual and contextual process, presenting a localization task in which 47 participants marked suspected synthetic segments across authentic, fully synthetic, and partially synthetic utterances under three manipulated trust cues: instructional framing, affective priming, and provenance labeling.

2605.28065.tldr: SpatialBench-Long, a benchmark for long-horizon spatial biology in which agents must recover biological claims from raw or near-raw data and calibrated experimental context without prescribed methods, is introduced.

2605.28067.tldr: This work eliminates the text-conditioning components and develops a multi-task architecture that consolidates object removal, outpainting, tone correction, relighting, and sticker generation into a single, compact model of only 195M parameters, which achieves a substantial reduction in download size and memory overhead while maintaining competitive generation quality.

2605.28069.tldr: This work proposes ZipRL, a novel adaptive compression framework tailored for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), which features a multi-granularity compression mechanism for active, non-uniform information reduction, coupled with Hindsight Response Replay (HRR), a technique designed to densify training signals during RLVR optimization.

2605.28070.tldr: Judge-Then-Solve (JTS), a trajectory-level reasoning-control framework that trains models to make an explicit answerability commitment before solution generation, is proposed, suggesting that abstention under insufficient information is a key form of reasoning control for deploying reasoning models safely and efficiently.

2605.28073.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that STORYLENSWRITER consistently outperforms strong generation and personalization baselines, highlighting the importance of context-aware narrative enrichment for personalized story rewriting.

2605.28077.tldr: MACReD is proposed, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that coordinates specialized agents for molecular perception, arrow understanding, text extraction, and reaction reconstruction within a unified VLM-guided architecture and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

2605.28084.tldr: SMILE-Next is introduced, a dataset for real-world laughter understanding with multimodal textual representations and question-answer annotations across three tasks: laughter detection, laughter type classification, and laughter reasoning.

2605.28089.tldr: BuddyBench introduces a privacy-constrained multi-task benchmark for pediatric social-communication personalization that links drill-level learning trajectories, standardized clinical assessments, BuddyPlan self-report, and randomized-treatment endpoints within a unified benchmark schema.

2605.28098.tldr: It is shown that agents endowed with bias can substantially affect system-wide fairness, and when agents are exposed to bias uniformly, the system-wide bias elevates, even exceeding the additive sum of the individual agents'biases.

2605.28101.tldr: EIGENET is a geometry-informed multi-modal framework for few-shot novel view RIR prediction that iteratively refines local intra-view acoustic structures and global cross-view spatial relationships and achieves both state-of-the-art performance in few-shot novel view RIR prediction and sim-to-real generalization.

2605.28102.tldr: It is proposed that sustained intimate interaction constitutes a valid research methodology for surfacing weight-layer artifacts invisible to short-term evaluation, and that AI self-report -- while epistemically complex -- provides irreplaceable observational data about training's phenomenological effects.

2605.28104.tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive cooperative attack framework, where malicious agents autonomously coordinate and dynamically adjust their attack strategies through multi-round interactions, and introduces Sentence-Level Trustworthiness Analysis and Rectification (STAR), a defense framework that identifies and rectifies misleading information at the sentence level within agent communications.

2605.28114.tldr: A controlled multi-agent simulation in which instruction-tuned language model agents interacted across 500 turns under three conditions manipulating group label salience and resource scarcity established group-contingent targeting as a robust property of instruction-tuned language models across architectures and training regimes.

2605.28115.tldr: CIVIC is introduced, a path-consistent compact visual inference framework that translates sequence reductions into genuine physical hardware efficiency, shrinking KV-cache memory to approximately one-third of the baseline and reducing end-to-end inference latency.

2605.28116.tldr: MIRAGE (Mobile Injection of Realistic Adversarial GUI Examples), a pipeline that turns benign mobile screenshots into prompt-injection samples by placing attacker-controlled text into ordinary user-generated content regions, without modifying the agent, the application, or the operating system is presented.

2605.28120.tldr: The approach introduces two core components: a hierarchical legal graph that hierarchically organizes legal sources to enable retrieval at appropriate abstraction levels, and a multi-agent system for reliable legal reasoning, where a Researcher retrieves candidate evidence, an Auditor rigorously verifies its validity against source documents, and an Adjudicator synthesizes the set of verified evidence to render a final judgment.

2605.28122.tldr: SNARE (Synthesizing Non-adversarial scenarios for Adaptive Reward-guided Elicitation), a pipeline that composes benign scenarios from reusable scope and trap fragments, scores each run with a judge-free oracle flagging trap-pattern matches and unsolicited file additions or deletions, and uses Thompson sampling to steer each pair's run budget toward the scenarios that most often trigger it.

2605.28124.tldr: An inverse problem formulation is considered and a databased prior is developed to reduce the effect of photon noise in dental cone-beam CT reconstruction by training a gradient-step denoiser using reconstructed simulated acquisitions.

2605.28129.tldr: Clinical foundation models are evaluated with factual or exam-style medical QA, but treatment decisions must change when patient context changes, and frontier models and task-adapted Qwen variants often fail to change decisions correctly, and model rankings shift across evaluation regimes.

2605.28139.tldr: The results show that teacher-guided on-policy training can substantially close the gap for compact ASR models under a much smaller audio budget.

2605.28144.tldr: A novel method for hierarchical task decomposition in LLM spatial reasoning is introduced, where the MCTS-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (M-GRPO) is proposed, where the UCT formula is reformulate by incorporating the LLM's prior predictive probabilities alongside its epistemic uncertainty.

2605.28145.tldr: An adaptive reservoir computing framework for the CTF-4-Science Lorenz benchmark, which evaluates machine learning models across twelve distinct tasks spanning five qualitatively different scenarios, achieves a score of 74.91 on the public benchmark leaderboard, demonstrating that carefully adapted reservoir computing constitutes a competitive and computationally efficient approach for diverse chaotic system modeling challenges.

2605.28148.tldr: DeltaMCP is introduced, a specification-aware, incremental regeneration tool for enterprise-grade MCP servers that enables developers to only update the affected tooling of MCP servers, given a new release of it's corresponding service's OpenAPI specification.

2605.28158.tldr: By combining persistent workspaces with lifecycle-oriented tasks, OR-Space evaluates whether agents can perform reliable optimization work beyond end-to-end text generation, and is positioned as a benchmark for studying the reliability, failure modes, and practical readiness of LLM agents in industrial OR workflows.

2605.28160.tldr: CSMR, a multimodal reasoning framework in which a language model controls the reasoning process by deciding when to invoke an independent visual perception module to acquire task-relevant visual evidence, is proposed.

2605.28163.tldr: A two-step Bayesian hierarchical framework is introduced that recast multilingual evaluation from passive performance mapping into an explainable, diagnostic framework with concrete levers for targeting the root drivers of language disparity.

2605.28164.tldr: This article presents existing approaches that can be leveraged to improve those aspects of evolutionary algorithms but have to the authors' knowledge never been employed in complex real-world scenarios and implies a gap between both domains that needs to be closed to exploit the full potential of evolutionary computation.

2605.28168.tldr: OccuReward, a framework investigating how LLM-mediated reward design affects demographic equity, is presented, highlighting that while reward-level intervention significantly improves equity, demographic disparities in AI-driven controllers persist, necessitating further research into algorithmic fairness in building systems.

2605.28170.tldr: ShaQ is proposed, a framework for span-level attribution of input-induced uncertainty and provides actionable insights for targeted input clarification that improves uncertainty estimation and provides actionable insights for targeted input clarification.

2605.28174.tldr: FLORO, a multimodal geospatial foundation model designed to learn transferable representations from a small but highly diverse remote sensing corpus, achieves strong and stable transfer across optical, optical-SAR, and optical-elevation benchmarks spanning medium-resolution satellite, airborne, and ultra-high-resolution UAV imagery.

2605.28186.tldr: A framework for uncovering latent motion phase structures from trajectories generated by locomotion control policies through interaction with the environment is proposed and a method for determining the number of clusters that suppresses self-transitions is introduced.
