2605.28187.tldr: A benchmark that disentangles the effects of model choice and prompt design on recommendations is proposed, finding that basic technical quality is driven by model choice, factuality and parity by context, and diversity by location.

2605.28192.tldr: This work introduces MOV-Bench, a benchmark containing 519 carefully curated questions that require multi-hop reasoning over temporally dispersed audio-visual evidence, and proposes AOP-Agent, an efficient agentic framework built on open-source Omni-LLMs for active omni-modal perception.

2605.28201.tldr: Experiments on seven strong open-source and closed-source LLM agents show that state-of-the-art LLM agents remain vulnerable to Sleeper Attack, even when they achieve low attack success rates under a single-interaction baseline.

2605.28213.tldr: KLineage walks expert implementations backward through validation-gated simplifications and reverses each accepted step into a reusable optimization skill, exceeding recent memory-based LLM-kernel baselines in both final kernel quality and optimization efficiency under the same fixed budget.

2605.28215.tldr: It is demonstrated that explaining is genuinely harder than predicting alone, and that while MLLMs excel at visual classification, they lack the specific instruction-tuning required for formal, machine-verifiable explainability.

2605.28219.tldr: Three workflows constitute the main contribution: they provide actionable, method-specific guidance for navigating parameter spaces, studying how data structure evolves across configurations, and grounding analytical understanding in domain context.

2605.28224.tldr: A unified framework that decomposes memory along two axes -- the scope of transfer (within an expansion vs. across trajectories) and the abstraction of the transferred content -- is proposed and four methods under three inference strategies are evaluated on four tool-use benchmarks spanning SQL, knowledge-graph, and CLI environments.

2605.28229.tldr: VidPrism pioneers a division of labor by deploying functionally specialized experts, each assuming a role ranging from spatial understanding to temporal modeling, leading to a comprehensive video representation.

2605.28232.tldr: District-level key performance indicators (KPIs) show that PIRS attains cost, carbon, and electricity metrics on par with the manual baseline while substantially outperforming non-physics-grounded designs -- particularly on load ramping and daily peak demand.

2605.28247.tldr: IRDS (Inter- pretable RLVR Data Selection), which selects RLVR training instances on a sparse autoen- coder (SAE) cluster basis so the selection itself is auditable on recognizable problem motifs and achieves the highest overall accuracy.

2605.28255.tldr: This work studies collaborative human--AI teams competing in a question-answering game in which humans can choose when and how to work with AI agents to win, and recommends calibrated confidence, evidence-grounded explanations, and mechanisms that help users refine trust.

2605.28258.tldr: It is argued that evaluating and improving game generation requires a player, and two roles for graphical user interface agents are studied in this process: as an objective evaluator, for which PlaytestArena is introduced and as a subjective playtester, for which Play2Code is proposed.

2605.28264.tldr: This work formalizes hallucination detection as a statistical hypothesis test and proposes the Calibrated Entropy Score (CES), a lightweight algorithm requiring only a single forward pass and black-box access to token logits that achieves the highest detection performance among all single-pass black-box methods while providing formal error guarantees that existing heuristics lack.

2605.28273.tldr: This work adopts Population Exploitability (PE) to measure how well a restricted strategy set represents the full game, and introduces a two-phase exploration--selection framework that explicitly minimizes PE during expansion.

2605.28277.tldr: MentalMap is introduced, a multilingual diagnostic benchmark with a six-level capability hierarchy spanning atomic spatial facts to generative world-graph construction, together with four diagnostic axes probing frame of reference, reading-direction bias, reasoning-effort allocation, and hallucination.

2605.28282.tldr: This technical report provides the complete protocol specification, state model, transition rules, claim-admission algorithm, and insight-compounding mechanism for ResearchLoop, an evidence-gated control plane for AI-assisted computational research.

2605.28283.tldr: PrunePath, a budget-adaptive structured sparsification framework for FFN layers built on MoEfication, achieves a favorable sparsity--performance trade-off compared with existing static pruning and MoEfication-based methods.

2605.28295.tldr: REFT (Rollout Exploration with First-Token Diversification), a light addition to the RLVR pipeline that samples first tokens uniformly from the policy's own top-$N$ candidates and allocates rollouts evenly, leaving every other component unchanged.

2605.28298.tldr: A post-training representation editing method for cross-domain linguistic steganalysis that can achieve high cross-domain detection performance, especially in terms of F1-score, while requiring no architecture modification or parameter updates after source-domain training.

2605.28301.tldr: A before--after pattern persists across evaluators, teacher strengths, student scales and families, medical benchmarks, and style, segmentation, and answer-correctness controls.

2605.28302.tldr: This work systematically characterize this trade-off for MoE inference across realistic workloads spanning input/output sequence lengths, prefix-KV reuse, and per-user latency constraints, providing design principles for current rack- and cluster-scale deployments as well as future disaggregated AI infrastructure.

2605.28303.tldr: By coupling causal bootstrapping with asymmetric on-policy distillation with asymmetric on-policy distillation, CODE engraves causal transition logic directly into parametric memory, seamlessly transforming discrete fact injection into coherent knowledge evolution.

2605.28305.tldr: The results show that anthropomorphic markers are not uniformly necessary for reasoning performance: suppressing them can preserve or improve performance in several settings, especially under larger sampling budgets, and suggest that anthropomorphic markers tend to be surface cues rather than reliable proxies for reflection itself.

2605.28306.tldr: RA-MoE (Routing-Aligned MoE Fine-Tuning), a three-stage framework that categorizes parallel task examples into a four-way taxonomy based on correctness in English and the target language, identifies task-relevant experts in the middle layers, and augments standard SFT with a routing alignment loss that encourages target-language routing on ci-type examples to follow the English task-expert activation pattern is proposed.

2605.28317.tldr: A recipe for training and deploying multi-horizon surrogates in physical state space, where a single network with continuous horizon conditioning is trained with direct supervision against textbook reference solvers to predict any future state at horizon T in one forward pass is presented.

2605.28320.tldr: This paper addresses the problem of identifying parsimonious explicit piece-wise polynomial relationships that might involve a relatively large number of raw features by leveraging a recently proposed identification algorithm that yields parsimonious implicit relationships enabling to derive normality characterization in the context of anomaly detection and localization.

2605.28321.tldr: ARMeta is presented, a tool-supported approach that uses an LLM-based multi-agent workflow to support metamorphic testing of REST APIs documented with OpenAPI and explores behaviors that serve as a complement to existing scenario-based testing approaches.

2605.28328.tldr: Palla boosts compile rates for Qwen2.5-1.5B on TypeScript generation, by over 60%, allowing Qwen2.5-1.5B to achieve similar performance to Llama3.1-8B unconstrained.

2605.28338.tldr: SafeMed-R1, trained with a traceable Clinical Trust Signals pipeline that links each reasoning instance to clinician rubric scores and edit histories, and aligned through safety and ethics supervision and red team stress testing, suggests that clinician-audited supervision provenance can strengthen governance-relevant evidence without relying on inference-time retrieval or citation grounding.

2605.28345.tldr: This work introduces \picid, a modular evaluation infrastructure that formalizes the PHM evaluation pipeline as an explicit, executable, and reproducible protocol, and establishes a reusable foundation for standardized, fair and reproducible evaluation in PHM.

2605.28347.tldr: The FedMPT is the first method specifically designed for federated MLR to leverage generalizable conditions to steer federated MLR to mitigate erroneous label activations, and introduces an Large Language Model-driven pipeline to decipher the underlying conditions that govern label dependencies.

2605.28353.tldr: This work demonstrates that hyperparameter optimisation can lead to improvements in performance for recombination-based Cartesian Genetic Programming.

2605.28354.tldr: A self-bootstrapping paradigm is proposed in which a small-scale seed model generates filtered trajectories that activate Plan in any target model, eliminating the need for distillation from an external stronger model.

2605.28358.tldr: SB-ECC, a score-based decoder that casts decoding as continuous-time denoising, is proposed, a score-based decoder that casts decoding as continuous-time denoising and is trained across noise levels without time/SNR conditioning, enabling inference without SNR estimation.

2605.28359.tldr: KTD-Fin is released as a reproducible template for leakage-controlled and attribution-aware evaluation of LLM trading agents, showing that LLM agents'cumulative returns under leakage-controlled evaluation are largely explained by passive market and style exposure, with limited evidence of persistent stock-selection alpha.

2605.28365.tldr: COVCAL is proposed, a selector over Lean-trace diagnostics that certifies a finite-sample selective-risk bound on accepted answers or abstains, under two regimes (a conservative Bonferroni bound and a tighter dev-then-cal rule).

2605.28369.tldr: CyberJurors is proposed, a multi-agent framework to clarify the dispute logic and regulate the verdict process and outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs, MLLMs, and court simulators, while achieving stronger alignment with real-world jury voting patterns.

2605.28371.tldr: The results show that coupling agentic generation with a shared framework transforms paper reproduction from isolated code synthesis into executable, assumption-aware, and systematically comparable benchmark implementations.

2605.28387.tldr: CLANE, Continual Learning of Actions on Neuromorphic Hardware from Event Cameras, deployed end-to-end on Intel Loihi 2 and validated through iso-algorithm cross-platform benchmarking across three evaluation levels.

2605.28388.tldr: It is found that sample difficulty has a non-monotonic effect on RLVR: easy and medium-difficulty problems yield the strongest and most stable reasoning improvements, whereas overly hard problems often provide weak learning signals, induce degenerate behaviors such as answer repetition or skipping necessary computation, and can ultimately degrade the model's pre-existing capabilities.

2605.28390.tldr: Experiments on mainstream agentic benchmarks show that meta-evolving can produce a higher-quality skill library than pure skill evolving and can derive diverse meta-skills for different scenarios, thereby facilitating future continual experience learning.

2605.28396.tldr: ADWIN is proposed, an adaptive-window framework for OPD that treats rollout length as an online admissibility decision, training on short teacher-anchored prefixes while using delayed full-rollout probes to audit prefix--full alignment and adapt the next horizon with staleness control.

2605.28398.tldr: How different switching strategies occupy distinct effectiveness-efficiency trade-off regions is characterizes: prompt-based methods often provide favorable token-accuracy trade-offs, routing methods offer more stable cost reduction, and speculative methods tend to improve accuracy at higher token cost.

2605.28405.tldr: A Cognitive Taxonomy is introduced that deconstructs general intelligence into 10 key cognitive faculties and proposes a rigorous evaluation protocol in which a system's performance is measured across a suite of targeted, held-out cognitive tasks, generating a cognitive profile that can be used to understand a system's strengths and weaknesses.

2605.28409.tldr: This paper explores the application of offline RL to code-generating models by leveraging existing code datasets and shows that offline RL can be especially beneficial for small LLMs and challenging coding problems.

2605.28421.tldr: DoiseRL is introduced, a reinforcement learning framework that substitutes external supervision with recovery-oriented optimization over failures from weak models that improves reasoning performance and overall training efficiency while reducing the need for expensive data curation or stronger teacher models.

2605.28422.tldr: VITAL, a latent-space reasoning framework for medical MLLMs with visual-semantic dual supervision: an auxiliary text decoder reconstructs reasoning chains from latent states, while a visual projector regresses ROI features from a frozen, independent medical vision encoder, exceeds prior medical visual latent reasoning datasets by an order of magnitude.

2605.28428.tldr: A training-free Laplacian graph energy optimization formulation, named ANoCo that scores Anomaly by the cost of Non-Conformity of a query patch to align with a fixed normal manifold, demonstrating the effectiveness of using optimization-induced feature drift as anomaly measure.

2605.28441.tldr: Unlike standard approaches, BayesNCL introduces a probabilistic gating mechanism that dynamically filters out task-irrelevant, high-frequency common features while selectively retaining discriminative semantics, and effectively resolves the optimization conflict.

2605.28450.tldr: This work introduces BiasEdit, a modular framework that automatically detects bias attributes from the original dataset and edits them to construct a debiased dataset, addressing a fundamental challenge in Web-sourced visual AI, mitigating dataset-induced bias and achieving state-of-the-art debiasing performance even when training data are fully biased.

2605.28454.tldr: A memory-efficient extension of GBFS that allows search to continue under strict memory limits by periodically compressing the search tree while retaining a sparse set of anchor states, then upon reaching the goal reconstructs the path by re-searching between the sparse states.

2605.28456.tldr: DLLM-VSR is proposed, to the best of the authors' knowledge, the first Diffusion Large Language Model (DLLM)-based VSR framework, formulating transcription as iterative masked denoising with flexible-order decoding, and develops length-guided candidate decoding, which uses video duration to construct plausible transcript-length hypotheses.

2605.28464.tldr: Prosecution Decision Prediction (PDP) is proposed, the first Legal AI task built around prosecutorial review, which classifies each case into prosecution or one of three non-prosecution decisions and reflects legal AI's capabilities in evidence evaluation, legal subsumption, and value-based discretion.

2605.28483.tldr: An end-to-end alignment pipeline that uses a large language model (LLM) as a constrained, evidence-producing tagger that achieves strong results, outperforming zero-shot and few-shot LLM variants, retrieval/similarity baselines, and supervised classifiers -while also producing more mechanically traceable evidence spans to support human auditing and educational analysis.

2605.28487.tldr: MatProcBench is introduced, a provenance-grounded benchmark constructed from literature-mined MatPROV graphs, to evaluate seven process-reasoning tasks spanning route continuity, step-level variable inference and global causal consistency under both same-split and shift-aware evaluation.

2605.28490.tldr: Across ReferIt3D, ScanRefer, and Multi3DRef, SSR3D-LLM achieves the strongest results among unified 3D-LLM baselines, with substantial gains over the single-pointer QPG baseline on fine-grained grounding and consistent improvements over prior unified 3D-LLMs, while preserving the default language-task route.

2605.28498.tldr: The findings reveal that reliance persists despite users having access to both conversational and web search, and conversational warmth's indirect effect on overreliance is revealed, with implications for designing trustworthy conversational search systems.

2605.28500.tldr: Functional equivalence methods are introduced, a family of code-specific methods that replace NLI-based semantic equivalence with an LLM-based functional equivalence assessment, including functional entropy, a code-specific analog of semantic entropy.

2605.28513.tldr: This paper develops the first non-vacuous generalization analysis of the representative VR method: Stochastic Variance Reduced Gradient (SVRG), through the lens of algorithmic stability, and establishes sharp stability bounds of the SVRG in both convex and strongly convex settings by exploiting its algorithmic structure.

2605.28515.tldr: Evaluating frontier provider-affiliated models against non-affiliated controls finds positive VIB in direct generation, with six of ten affiliated models showing statistically significant effects up to $+18.8$ percentage points (pp).

2605.28517.tldr: A generalized SGDM framework is introduced that encompasses both Polyak's and Nesterov's momentum schemes, and tight on-average model stability bounds for smooth and convex problems are established.

2605.28520.tldr: GS-Fuse is proposed, a multimodal event-based forecasting framework that employs a Granger-supervised, causal-aware gated fusion module, which learns to open toward event text only when it provides incremental predictive value beyond historical prices, and a multi-granularity alignment mechanism that jointly aligns high-level event representations and fine-grained textual cues with future market trajectories.

2605.28524.tldr: This work proposes LLM-GNN Soft Prompt Framework (LGSPF), which bridges the graph structure and semantic space using soft prompt to eliminate reliance on text and enhances deep semantic alignment between LLM and GNN.

2605.28526.tldr: This work examines a token masking strategy based on entropy distribution that aims to target tokens that are more informative and uncertain to improve the training efficacy and proposes a novel self-masking approach that enhances training efficiency without relying on an external reference model.

2605.28532.tldr: This work proposes FeasiGen, an automatic pipeline for constructing infeasible agent tasks by identifying the critical tools required for successful task completion by extracting tool-calling traces from successful executions across multiple agent systems, and masks these tools to automatically transform solvable tasks into infeasible ones.

2605.28552.tldr: To model vehicle-type-specific pedestrian crash avoidance behavior, a Smooth-Mamba Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient framework is developed, termed SMamba-DDPG, which integrates smooth action constraints with efficient temporal representation learning and outperforms baseline reinforcement learning and supervised learning models in reproducing pedestrian crash avoidance behaviors.

2605.28553.tldr: Mechanistic AutoDAN is introduced, a probe-guided variant of AutoDAN that replaces full-model fitness evaluation with partial forward passes and probe-based scoring inside a genetic prompt search loop and shows that refusal is not only observable at the output level, but is encoded as a structured and actionable signal in intermediate LLM activations.

2605.28557.tldr: The findings demonstrate that token optimization cannot be treated as simple prompt shortening; it must be evaluated as a multi-objective migration problem balancing cost, syntactic validity, semantic preservation, and structural fidelity.

2605.28563.tldr: This work finds that EEG foundation models consistently provide performance gains on long-context tasks such as sleep stage prediction and mental health state classification, and motivates the use of multi-dimensional evaluation protocols that characterize model behavior under realistic use constraints.

2605.28565.tldr: This work designs a three-dimension evaluation framework that scores each citation on intent-purpose alignment, source suitability, and answer-source fidelity, using expert-validated predefined matrices and a five-level fidelity rubric; the framework applies to any system that produces citation-bearing responses.

2605.28566.tldr: This work synthesizes the ToT landscape through a unified taxonomy based on classical heuristic search terminology, and identifies open algorithmic challenges at the intersection of heuristic search and LLM reasoning, and calls on the heuristic search community to engage with this emerging domain.

2605.28567.tldr: This work introduces a distributional framework for SAE analyses, in which each feature is represented not by a single decoder vector like in the literature, but by an activation-weighted distribution over the hidden states that express it, and provides a unified semantic metric for cross-layer feature comparison.

2605.28573.tldr: TSVD is introduced, a framework that maintains low rank and strict orthonormality throughout the training process and utilizes a spectral energy-based heuristic for adaptive rank selection, and a caching mechanisms to maintain orthonormality.

2605.28575.tldr: A Conflict-aware Penalty that detects and penalizes gradient norm conflicts at each training step, and a Statistical Loss that aligns predicted distribution statistics with empirical input statistics that prevents dominant modality gradients from interfering with the SL objective are proposed.

2605.28577.tldr: This paper formalises this setting as Continual Model Routing (CMR) and proposes CMRBench, a new large-scale benchmark simulating realistic hub expansion and including over 2,000 candidate models and introduces CARvE, a contrastive embedding approach for efficient continual model routing via checkpoint-based anchoring and structured replay.

2605.28583.tldr: SARAD is proposed, a novel safety-aware hybrid framework that synergizes LLMs and DRL for autonomous driving, and substitutes the random exploration of DRL with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-enhanced, LLM-guided decisions sourced from a dynamic expert knowledge repository.

2605.28594.tldr: An improved version of the PULSE method (Partition function Unsupervised Learning Sampling and Evaluation) for estimating the thermodynamic properties of chemically disordered compounds is presented to reduce the computational cost of Monte Carlo approaches for this type of material.

2605.28597.tldr: This position paper argues that the AI/ML community should stop overclaiming and retire the label "positive backdoor," and instead treat trigger-activated hidden behaviors as Secret Alignment, offering a behavioral lens for understanding deployment-time risks and motivating community-wide evaluation that makes Secret Alignment claims provable.

2605.28598.tldr: Results show that off-the-shelf models are poor proxies for real audience reactions: they strongly underproduce hate speech, introduce model-specific sentiment biases, and remain distributionally distant from human replies.

2605.28602.tldr: A paired-formula protocol based on minimally different satisfiable and unsatisfiable instances, together with Accurate Differentiation Rate (ADR), which requires both members of each pair to be classified correctly to probe representation-invariant reasoning.

2605.28603.tldr: Under-Cali is proposed, an uncertainty-driven dual-expert calibration framework consisting of three core components: an uncertainty estimator, a dual-expert calibration module, and an adaptive routing module that serves as the core control signal to jointly manage inference and adaptation processes.

2605.28604.tldr: The VIP-Net framework is developed, which includes a Social Cue Encoder for extracting multi-modal spatio-temporal cues, a Temporal Importance Rectifier (TIR) for hierarchical cue fusion and cross-modal alignment, and VIP Inference for ranking individuals.

2411.18502.tldr: Isometry pursuit is a convex algorithm for identifying isometric embeddings from within interpretable dictionaries that offers a synergistic alternative to greedy and brute force search for problems involving coordinate selection and diversification.

2503.04863.tldr: It is found that the Gaussian function required by this method is larger than the query resolution of the original dense grid network, resulting in impaired performance, and the Spatial-Temporal Self-attention Mechanism from the previous grid-given occupation network is improved to GaussianFormer.

2504.04540.tldr: ScanReQA, a 3D spatial reasoning benchmark encompassing text, vision, and point cloud modalities, reveals that binary spatial reasoning remains challenging for current 3D LLMs, and MLLMs based on point cloud and visual modalities demonstrate stronger spatial reasoning capabilities than LLMs.

2505.09861.tldr: This paper introduces a unified transformer-based attribution approach that can handle member-level data, aggregate-level data, and integration of external macro factors, and details the large scale implementation at LinkedIn.

2605.12929.tldr: Results indicate that object-centric anatomical correspondence offers a principled path toward interpretable diagnostic systems aligned with clinical bilateral comparison, and indicate that object-centric anatomical correspondence offers a principled path toward interpretable diagnostic systems aligned with clinical bilateral comparison.

2605.25010.tldr: Three algorithms, namely RRT*, Neural RRT*, and Neural Informed RRT*, are implemented and evaluated on environments containing convex and concave obstacles with different obstacle densities, and neural-guided planners improve path quality and trajectory smoothness.

2605.28607.tldr: A novel multimodal multi-agent framework that achieves automatic workflow execution through a distinct two-phase pipeline that facilitates superior task decomposition and adaptive navigation performance and is validated in a real-world context.

2605.28616.tldr: This work proposes Contextual Alternative Choice (CAC), a new prompting method which provides targeted tests for both syntactic and discourse knowledge of language, with specific emphasis on cognitive status of language models.

2605.28617.tldr: A programming model for agents that closes this split between the runtime that drives the agent and the code the model writes while preserving safety, and expresses ReAct loops, sub-agents, skills, parallel decomposition, and multi-model planning as ordinary control flow.

2605.28632.tldr: SeedHijack is introduced, the first supply-chain attack on LLM watermarking that is simultaneously blind -- requiring no knowledge of the watermark key, detector, or model logits, and integrity-preserving -- amplifying rather than erasing the watermark signal, and orthogonal to detection.

2605.28639.tldr: It is found that prohibited concepts remain highly recoverable from hidden representations under suppression, continue to influence attention routing, and measurably shape downstream generations despite successful lexical avoidance.

2605.28642.tldr: This paper proposes Edge-cloud Speech Recognition and Translation (ESRT), a privacy-preserving and bandwidth-efficient collaborative edge-cloud MLLM framework that retains a lightweight speech encoder and adapter on the device, transmitting only highly compressed intermediate features to the cloud.

2605.28647.tldr: It is argued that actively generating reality gaps is in fact unethical because it knowingly shifts epistemic risk back to the uninformed user -- this is reality laundering.

2605.28655.tldr: AutoScientists, a decentralized team of AI agents for long-running computational scientific experimentation that interprets a shared experimental state, self-organize into teams around promising hypotheses, critique proposals before using experimental compute, and share successes and failures to reduce redundant exploration.

2605.28666.tldr: A hybrid assistance system that augments an existing capability-based Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) planning approach with an Large Language Model (LLM)-based layer for natural-language interaction, explanation, and adaptation and confirms that combining formal planning with LLM-based assistance substantially improves accessibility and adaptability in industrial automation.

2605.28669.tldr: ACROS is introduced, which induces an explicit sense pathway into a frozen pretrained decoder LM through a gated residual addition, and makes sense representations an inducible interface for ordinary pretrained LMs.

2605.28678.tldr: DREAM-R is introduced, a framework that substantially improves the performance of speculative reasoning and develops a Fully Parallel Speculative Reasoning (FPSR) framework that parallelizes draft generation, target-side reasoning, and verification across multi-step reasoning, enabling early stopping and clean fallback.

2605.28680.tldr: Examining AI's impact on job satisfaction via perceptions of job decency and meaningfulness, now and in the future reveals that the anticipated impact of AI on overall job satisfaction varies with the occupational domain, with differing perceptions of its underlying decency and meaningfulness.

2605.28683.tldr: VeriTrip provides the rigorous foundation necessary for the next generation of planning agents capable of operating in unconstrained, multimodal environments, and reveals a critical cognitive load of autonomous retrieval significantly erodes instruction retention.

2605.28693.tldr: Focusing on a recent self-supervised vision model (DINOv3) and reproducing results on eight vision models, it is found that backpropagated gradients can reliably predict both fMRI and MEG signals, specifically in higher-level visual cortex and for later latencies.

2605.28697.tldr: A novel simulation strategy is proposed that incorporates speckle decorrelation measures from real videos and uses an iterative refinement process to improve the motion realism in the simulations.

2605.28699.tldr: TRACER is introduced, a turn-level reinforcement framework for cooperative multi-LLM reasoning that provides a compact and reproducible testbed for studying learned collaboration policies beyond fixed debate, voting, or aggregation protocols, and achieves mathematically rigorous convergence.

2605.28703.tldr: This work uses modern empirical and theoretical methods to revisit Lamarckian and Baldwinian evolution and rigorously compare them with the generic Darwinian evolution, revealing Baldwinian and Lamarckian evolution consistently outperform Darwinian evolution, confirming the great potential of local search augmented evolutionary algorithms.

2605.28707.tldr: A normative ethics simplex that integrates ethical pluralism as a probabilistic normative distribution supports human-like moral reasoning, ethical disagreement analysis, and future alignment in AI systems.

2605.28710.tldr: Key trade-offs are revealed: When in-domain data is available, fine-tuned smaller models can achieve performance comparable to proprietary models, whereas zero-shot evaluation with larger models proves more effective in out-of-domain settings.

2605.28713.tldr: This work derives Thinking as Compression (TaC), a new compression paradigm that treats thinking itself as compressed context, and introduces Thinking as Compression Constrained (TaC-C), a new compression paradigm that consistently outperforms existing baselines.

2605.28714.tldr: The IPO-Toolkit is introduced, an open-source framework for downloading and parsing IPO filings into standardized section-structured text and extracted images and the IPO-Dataset is constructed, a large, section-structured, multimodal dataset covering more than 109,000 IPO filings and amendments from 1994 to 2026 and containing over 76,000 images.

2605.28717.tldr: OpenURMA is the first clean-room open implementation of UB's transport and transaction layers, realised at three tiers - synthesisable RTL on Alveo U50, a cycle-level two-node SystemC simulator, and a gem5 full-system scaffold - each with a matched OpenRoCE (RoCEv2 RC) baseline.

2605.28721.tldr: Analysis of LLM-based search agents on BrowseComp reveals Intrinsic Knowledge Dependence (IKD), and introduces LiveBrowseComp, a deep-search benchmark designed to evaluate agents beyond intrinsic coverage.

2605.28722.tldr: This work introduces a competitive multi-adapter mechanism in which specialized experts capture non-linear correction patterns and adaptively determine the appropriate intervention direction and strength for different samples, and designs an energy-based gating module that leverages internal propagation dynamics to distinguish inputs that are applicable for intervention.

2605.28730.tldr: This work introduces AlphaTransit, a search-based planning framework for cityscale bus network design that couples Monte Carlo Tree Search with a neural policy-value network, and suggests that coupling learned guidance with MCTS is more effective than using either approach alone for transit network design.

2605.28732.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that transforms memory pipelines into executable memory evolution graphs, enabling fine-grained tracing of operational information flow and introduces an automatic attribution method that iteratively traces operation subgraphs to pinpoint the root cause of any failed case.

2605.28733.tldr: In downstream applications on Amazon and Airbnb, product images generated and edited by the utility-aware framework outperform state-of-the-art models in increasing demand and preserving fidelity, while maintaining text-image consistency.

2605.28739.tldr: The results show that BIRDNet stays within 0.02 AUROC of the strongest dense baseline, at a small accuracy cost, while using up to $96\times$ fewer active parameters than an architecture-matched dense MLP.

2605.28740.tldr: Reverse Probing is proposed, the first UQ framework specialized for clinical summarization, which estimates token-level uncertainty directly from pre-existing labeled summaries, and reveals that delta energy and neighborhood context are the most consistent predictors across all models.

2605.28751.tldr: Nested unit-test coverage in code RL induces a frontier that extrapolative weight averaging can navigate, extend, and exploit, and both the frontier and its extrapolative continuation appear across three inference settings, pure reasoning, tool use, and agentic coding.

2605.28763.tldr: CubePart is presented, a generative framework for open-vocabulary, part-controllable 3D mesh generation that exposes part structure as an explicit inference-time control signal and can be directly integrated into game engines and driven by animation and behavior scripts without manual post-processing.

2605.28764.tldr: SwarmHarness is a decentralised protocol in which HarnessAPI skill nodes self-organise into a compute swarm without any central authority, a foundational primitive for autonomous distributed AI agent networks in which agents hire compute, route subtasks, and settle credits without human intermediation.

2605.28773.tldr: FluxMem is a connectivity-evolving memory framework that models memory as a heterogeneous graph and progressively refines its topology through three stages: initial connection formation, feedback-driven refinement, and long-term consolidation.

2605.28775.tldr: This work introduces LearnWeak, an annotation-free specialization framework for small computer-use agents that uses a stronger reference agent to identify the student's weaknesses in the target domain, synthesize targeted tasks, and construct supervision automatically and introduces an error-aware specialization objective that disentangles planning and execution errors.

2605.28787.tldr: A comparative analysis of agentic data retrieval across two distinct environments is presented, concluding that while unstructured retrieval supports broad exploratory tasks, structured ecosystems remain the indispensable foundation for reliable, execution-oriented autonomous workflows.

2605.28791.tldr: This work proposes Skill-Conditioned Gated Gated Self-Distillation (SGSD), which formulates skill-based SD as teacher hypothesis validation rather than unconditional imitation and shows that SGSD consistently improves over GRPO and remains competitive with answer-conditioned OPSD under a weaker PI assumption.

2605.28792.tldr: CaMBRAIN is proposed - the first Causal, Mamba-based state space model (SSM) capable of real-time inference of EEG signals, arguing that bidirectional approaches are needlessly expensive given the causal, unidirectional nature of EEG.

2605.28805.tldr: This work investigates multimodal meta-verification, which leverages verifier-generated rationales rather than decision-only signals, and explores how to effectively incorporate meta-verification feedback into multimodal verifier training.

2605.28807.tldr: Calibrated Collective Oversight (CCO), which aggregates diverse auxiliary scoring functions into a penalty measuring deviation from a conservative baseline, enables collective conservatism and substantially reduces ethical violations while preserving reward.

2605.28812.tldr: This work introduces Center-of-Pressure (CoP), an effective tactile representation grounded in physical principles that preserves dense contact information while maintaining robustness for sim-to-real transfer and suggests that CoP-conditioned policies encode task-relevant physical properties, such as object mass, as an emergent byproduct of control.

2605.29733.tldr: The Transfer Robustness Index (TRI) is introduced, an architecture-agnostic metric for quantifying generalization quality across domain gaps that shows monotonic improvement with increasing target-domain data, providing practical guidance for district energy deployment.

2605.29738.tldr: This work introduces Multi-Legal-Bench, the first cross-jurisdictional legal benchmark that evaluates identical tasks across six countries, four language families, and 134 million court decisions, and reveals task-dependent few-shot effects discovered in Ukrainian replicate across all jurisdictions.

2605.29742.tldr: This work formalizes Regulatory Compliance QA with RegOps-Bench, a novel benchmark featuring an Operational Knowledge Graph derived from complex national R\&D regulations and proposes RefWalk, a unified framework driven by a shared topic anchor.

2605.29744.tldr: HetMedAgent is proposed, a heterogeneous medical multi-agent framework that enables conflict-aware evidence fusion, uncertainty-based clinician intervention triggering, and adaptive threshold calibration that validates the irreplaceable value of specialist models in modality-specific analysis.

2605.29753.tldr: A unified deep learning framework is proposed that synthesizes contrast-phase-specific virtual monochromatic 50 keV images from single-energy CT (SECT) data by leveraging contrast phase information as a prior.

2605.29754.tldr: It is suggested that the optimal positional encoding strategy is task-dependent, with no universal solution across EEG decoding scenarios, and spherical Positional Encoding yields strong representations for motor imagery but underperforms on emotion recognition.

2605.29756.tldr: Logit-aware Final-block Quantization (LFQ), a simple yet effective enhancement to block-wise PTQ that quantizes the final Transformer block by minimizing the cross-entropy between the logits of the FP model and those of its quantized counterpart, consistently improves the accuracy of complex generation tasks over state-of-the-art block-wise PTQ across diverse model families.

2605.29768.tldr: This work defines a yearly streaming forecasting protocol on EvoXXLTraffic, a sensor-evolving reorganization that exposes per-year active sensors, yearly traffic-flow matrices, and yearly graph snapshots across nine PeMS districts, with growth ratios ranging from +305% to over +10,000%.

2605.29773.tldr: This work proposes Energy-Aware NECO, a single-pass pixel-wise out-of-distribution out-of-distribution (OOD) detector for semantic segmentation that improves overall ranking performance while preserving the efficiency advantages of a single-pass design.

2605.29782.tldr: This work introduces the State Value Estimation Benchmark (SVEB) to assess state estimation within existing RL frameworks and shows that critics in standard approaches like PPO collapse to a coarse group-average baseline.

2605.29786.tldr: Croissant Tasks is introduced: a declarative, machine-actionable metadata format that abstracts low-level implementation details into high-level specifications that enables conceptual reproducibility: verifying claims via independent, agent-generated implementations rather than brittle source code replication.

2605.29788.tldr: This work proposes Nested Causal Thompson Sampling (NCTS), a causal PAC-Bayesian excess-risk bound that certifies any candidate deployment policy from historic data alone, off-policy and anytime, answering the deployment question: can the authors trust this agent here, and at what risk?

2605.29790.tldr: Meta-Team is proposed, an experience-driven MAS evolution framework based on collaborative self-evolution that consistently outperforms single-agent systems, hand-crafted MAS, and prior MAS evolution methods and enables more reliable and scalable MAS self-evolution.

2605.29794.tldr: These results show that skill-augmented agents benefit from optimizing the injected context itself, and propose SkillsInjector, a two-stage adaptive method that jointly addresses these decisions.

2605.29795.tldr: MEMENTO, a framework that treats the web as a learning signal rather than a stateless retrieval interface, is proposed, demonstrating that the web can serve as a scalable learning source for acquiring task-specific expertise in data-scarce settings.

2605.29801.tldr: This work updates the agent safety taxonomy to accommodate emergent risks from Codex and OpenClaw execution scenarios, and builds a taxonomy-guided data engine with influence-function purification to train lightweight AgentDoG 1.5, a lightweight and scalable agent safety alignment framework.

2605.29807.tldr: A comparative analysis of two automatic label error detection methods - Confident Learning and Dataset Cartography - on three Russian text classification corpora of varying size, number of classes, and domain shows that the effectiveness of both methods depends strongly on dataset characteristics.

2605.29815.tldr: This work introduces the Peer Review AI Benchmark (PRAIB), a novel framework comprising thoroughly defined metrics that measure review specificity, style, and behavior of engagement and observes that LLMs tend to generate longer, more complex reviews, yet frequently overlook the atomic weaknesses noted by human reviewers.

2605.29816.tldr: It is shown that robustness can be achieved via a simple fine-tuning process: debiasing for robustness, and conditions when debiasing helps and when it does not are identified.

2605.29822.tldr: TRAILS~ (Targeted Reasoning Agreement via Inputs and Specifications), an approach that grounds LLM reasoning with concrete (input, output) pairs, demonstrates greater stability across seeded runs, reducing sensitivity to LLM non-determinism, and assigns correct labels to a larger set of unique code samples than competing approaches.

2605.29826.tldr: This work proposes Localized and Disentangled Knowledge Editing (LDKE), a new framework that achieves precise and generalized editing by localizing fact-specific model layers and disentangling target-relevant inputs from irrelevant ones.

2605.29829.tldr: This work proposes OptSkills, an archetype-centric skill learning and reasoning agent system for optimization modeling and solving that achieves a state-of-the-art micro-averaged accuracy of 68.27% on datasets encompassing diverse problem types and scenarios.

2605.29836.tldr: CB-SLICE is introduced, a concept-based SDM that groups samples with shared concept prediction failures and identifies the keyword concepts most responsible for each slice's failure mode, showing that CB-SLICE outperforms state-of-the-art methods in uncovering well-known biases while providing richer and more faithful explanations of model errors.

2605.29843.tldr: This work introduces HARP (Hadamard-preconditioned Adaptive Rotation Processor), a learnable structured two-sided orthogonal processor that replaces fixed Hadamard mixing while preserving exact full-precision equivalence in PTQ.

2605.29860.tldr: ESO (Early-Stopping Proximal Policy Optimization), which detects trajectory failure on-the-fly and terminates rollouts early and computes a surrogate regret using only the logits already computed during sampling, and terminates when the smoothed cumulative regret significantly exceeds its estimated values.

2605.29862.tldr: A causality-inspired multimodal FedDG framework that combines a causality-inspired device style intervention network that performs content-preserving style perturbations, counterfactual text augmentation that neutralizes metadata shortcuts, and gradient alignment that facilitates device-invariant representations across clients is proposed.

2605.29873.tldr: Moment-KV is proposed, a decoding-time KV cache compression method based on momentum-driven temporal attention aggregation that models token importance as a continuously evolving state, where attention is aggregated with decay, capturing both long-term influence and recent relevance.

2605.29874.tldr: Cooperative bias persists across providers; provider identity, rather than model generation, is the strongest correlate of equilibrium outcomes; noise remains a universal challenge regardless of model size or vintage.

2605.29881.tldr: BRACS monitors the model's own attention to measure visual grounding and applies corrections to the hidden states only when grounding deteriorates, and is computed analytically in closed form, requiring no training of auxiliary networks or model retraining.

2605.29886.tldr: CRITIC-R1 is a structured critic framework that formulates and learns RAG critique as an explicit error diagnosis problem using reinforcement learning (RL) and consistently improves answer quality over strong RAG baselines.

2605.29888.tldr: This work proposes LaRA, a layer-wise representation analysis framework for detecting contamination in RL post-trained LLMs and finds that contamination produces progressive geometric deviations across layers, including amplified perturbation sensitivity, stronger directional collapse, and enhanced local rigidity.

2605.29893.tldr: The results show that even the best-performing method achieves only 24.88\% score in detecting redundant steps, while some methods perform worse than random guessing, which highlights the task's complexity and the need for further research in this area.

2605.29910.tldr: Agora is a domain-aware multi-agent framework that integrates hypothesis-driven testing with LLM capabilities for systematic protocol verification and discovers 15 previously unknown protocol-level logic bugs that violate safety properties, while existing LLM-based agents fail to detect any such protocol-level logic bugs.

2605.29919.tldr: Viewing equilibrium computation as the joint problem of learning solver mechanisms and mapping the geometry of solvability is suggested, suggesting that solvability is governed by latent structural properties defining a continuous solver-aligned geometry of games.

2605.29927.tldr: This work introduces PlanAhead, a static planner-executor framework that evaluates the impact of plan representation in agent performance, and introduces two novel evaluation metrics: Achievement Rate (AR) and Solved-Task Consistency (STC).

2605.29931.tldr: Tensions that may be created between users and automated tools in key areas such as the need for speed and efficiency, controllability, and maintaining creative agency are discussed, and how these tensions may be alleviated through tool design.

2605.29935.tldr: CityGen is proposed, a diffusion-based generative framework that performs zero-label city adaptation via HD-map-conditioned synthesis guided by city-level visual prompts that consistently improves cross-city robustness across multiple tasks, establishing a scalable and label-efficient foundation for generalizable autonomous driving.

2605.29940.tldr: This work introduces StreamSynth, a new setting in which synthesis tasks arrive sequentially and experience from historical tasks provides informative signals for future synthesis, and proposes SynLearner, a general framework that enables synthesis models to acquire reusable synthesis experience over a task stream.

2605.29951.tldr: MuPHIRM is proposed, a reasoning-augmented training framework which learns joint semantics by optimizing multi-perspective rewards which improves both harm detection and reasoning quality of VLMs while demonstrating superior out-of-distribution robustness compared to both trained and inference-time baselines.

2605.29960.tldr: MemPoison is proposed, a novel memory poisoning attack that bypasses selective memory mechanisms in LLM agents, where an attacker can inject triggerable backdoors into the agent's long-term memory through dialogue interactions, thereby misleading its subsequent responses.

2605.29963.tldr: This work proposes Honeyval, a comprehensive evaluation framework for LLM-powered HTTP honeypots that addresses the limitations of prior evaluations by grounding the honeypots in 16 backend applications, using AI hacking agents as attackers, employing two control tasks to monitor agent and honeypot capabilities across customizations, and defining clear and verifiable exploit goals for the attacker.

2605.29965.tldr: This work proposes a flexible meta-programming framework that operationalizes the semantics of varied temporal logics through a unified, declarative framework and introduces a transformation pipeline that protects nested modalities from stable-model-based simplifications during grounding.

2605.29976.tldr: Despite being originally developed for weather forecasting, it is demonstrated that forced configurations of ArchesWeather and ArchesWeatherGen produce stable long-term climate simulations, have a stable annual cycle, and capture the drift of many climate variables.

2605.29980.tldr: A framework to align single white blood cell images with chromosomal aberrations (karyotype) and somatic mutations from targeted gene panels is presented, providing a framework that aligns with clinical diagnostic workflows and paves the way for future multimodal hematology-specific AI.

2605.29986.tldr: CFGzip, an offline technique for compressing the token search space, which massively reduces CFG engine overhead is introduced, yielding an up to 7.5x speedup in total constrained generation time: with CFGzip, constrained decoding is now feasible at scale for complex CFGs.

2605.30002.tldr: KairosAgent, a novel agentic framework for multimodal time series forecasting, including an LLM-based reasoner and a TSFM-based forecaster, unifies textual reasoning and numerical forecasting by dynamically invoking analytical tools to enhance the numerical understanding and semantic reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

2605.30003.tldr: Two-level autoresearch for cooperation is studied: an outer-loop AI agent autonomously redesigns the inner-loop pipeline of an LLM policy-synthesis system for multi-agent Sequential Social Dilemmas (SSDs) and the discovered pipelines are objective-dependent.

2605.30011.tldr: This work presents VISUALTHINK-VLA, a visual intermediate-reasoning framework for accurate, low-latency VLA policies, and achieves the highest success rate on most benchmarks while reducing the multi-second latency of reasoning-augmented baselines to the sub-second regime.

2605.30014.tldr: HTP is proposed, which Hierarchically generatesravel patterns first and then generates GPS points by using large language models (LLMs) by using large language models (LLMs), rather than directly generating GPS points.

2605.30015.tldr: Test-Time Training for Supervised Causal Learning (TTT-SCL), a novel framework that dynamically generates training sets explicitly aligned with any specific test instance, is proposed, and significantly outperforms existing SCL and traditional causal discovery methods.

2605.30022.tldr: Building on evidence that positional and semantic signals occupy nearly orthogonal subspaces in trained Transformers, an encoder Transformer is modified to process three explicitly disentangled streams: semantic, absolute positional (AP) and relative positional (RP), and confine the masked-language-modeling (MLM) objective to the semantic stream.

2605.30029.tldr: The RAG Intelligence Search Engine (RAISE) is introduced, a comprehensive framework and benchmark for RAG hyperparameter optimization, which evaluates optimization methods for RAG pipelines under standardized search spaces and budgets.

2605.30031.tldr: A unified taxonomy and a controlled empirical evaluation of LALM jailbreak attacks and defenses are provided, showing that Acoustic Best-of-N reveals strong worst-case audio-space vulnerabilities, Narrative Framing is an effective low-latency semantic threat, and current defenses trade robustness against benign usability.

2605.30036.tldr: This work draws on established psychological value theory to induce human-like values in LLMs and assess their alignment with patterns observed in human studies, revealing strong agreement between value-prompted LLMs and humans across both dimensions.

2605.30038.tldr: A lightweight, reward-free post-training method that refines soft tokens by integrating contrastive alignment guidance directly into the score-matching objective of diffusion models, which mitigates these limitations and yields more coherent and semantically faithful generations.

2605.30040.tldr: This work studies three recent token auditing frameworks and shows that a provider with ordinary commercial capabilities can systematically inflate billed token counts, suggesting the problem is not in any specific auditor but in any audit whose evidence comes from the audited party.

2605.30042.tldr: This work introduces a multi-agent framework that combines contextual bandits with structured inter-agent communication and semantic checkpoints that preserve action-outcome fidelity throughout the pipeline, and suggests a broader design principle for scientific multi-agent systems.

2605.30046.tldr: This paper proposes Masked Diffusion for Anomaly Detection (MaskDiff-AD), a forward-only method based on masked diffusion models trained only on nominal data that achieves competitive performance against classical, diffusion-based, and recent tabular/text anomaly detection baselines.

2605.30049.tldr: SafeDIG is proposed, a safety steering framework that formulates DiT safety adaptation as position-aware sparse feature transfer and consistently reduces target-domain and overall unsafe generation rates while preserving source-domain safety and image quality.

2605.30052.tldr: RePoT (Recoverable PoT): a deterministic verified replay that walks the plan through the environment to its first invalid transition, then one LLM call that resumes from the verified prefix.

2605.30054.tldr: This paper proposes projectional decoding, a novel conceptual framework that integrates domain semantics directly into the generation process by maintaining, alongside text, a partial graph model as the primary artifact representation throughout generation.

2605.30070.tldr: The findings show that OPSD performance can be predicted and tuned before training, offering a principled way to incorporate world feedback as a first-class component of the post-training pipeline.

2605.30085.tldr: CROP (Conformal Reasoning Output Prefixes), a verifier-agnostic calibration procedure for clean-prefix certification, is introduced, demonstrating that standard step-level metrics such as AUROC do not fully capture prefix utility, suggesting verifiers should be evaluated by certified prefix length.

2605.30087.tldr: This work develops a benchmark containing 18 question templates across 8 reasoning types, 480 personas, 4 random seeds, and 34,560 instances, with controlled source distortions and deterministic ground truth, and evaluates the performance of baselines without access to any source, access to a single source, structured fusion methods, and frontier LLMs.

2405.13003.tldr: This survey offers a systematic and comprehensive review of multi-turn conversational data generation, focusing on three types of dialogue systems: open domain, task-oriented, and information-seeking, and introduces a general framework that outlines the main principles of conversation data generation systems.

2508.15180.tldr: PuzzleClone is introduced, a formal framework for synthesizing verifiable data at scale using a novel DSL-driven approach that constructs PC-83K, a benchmark comprising over 83K diverse and programmatically validated puzzles.

2602.11389.tldr: C-JEPA is a simple and flexible object-centric world model that extends masked joint embedding prediction from image patches to object-centric representations, and provides a formal analysis demonstrating that object-level masking induces useful inductive bias by controlling observability.

2604.10219.tldr: The Forced Reflection Mechanism (FRM), a trajectory editing strategy that disrupts cognitive inertia by triggering reflection around high entropy cognitive bifurcation points and encouraging verification of subsequent steps against the visual input, is introduced, thereby translating external debiasing interventions into an intrinsic capability for hallucination mitigation.

2604.10228.tldr: Self-Verification and Self-Rectification (SVSR), a unified framework that explicitly integrates self-verification and self-rectification into the model's reasoning pipeline, substantially improving robustness and reliability in complex visual understanding and multimodal reasoning tasks.

2605.25376.tldr: KYA detects 89% of 1,200 adversarial probes from PyRIT and Garak, including the recently-published topology-guided multi-agent attack.

2605.27078.tldr: The representation-readout decomposition is established as a top-down framework for understanding learning dynamics and revealing underlying algorithms for interpretability research.

2605.28746.tldr: It is proved that exact integral R2 improvement is exactly a scalarization-space volume, namely the measure of the Tchebycheff shadow between the incumbent scalarization envelope and the reference envelope, which yields finite-sum ER2I algorithms for discrete R2, quadrature methods for exact integral R2, and an achievement-space Gaussian surrogate formulation.

2605.29169.tldr: Laarhoven's treatment of Ajtai et al.'s sieving as a genetic algorithm for the SVP is enhanced by incorporating domain-informed SVP representation and crossover while naturally extending application to the module lattices.

2605.30094.tldr: The key finding is that rule-based skills alone do not constitute a strong strategy, and LLMs alone cannot play well, but their combination yields an agent that requires neither training nor solver access yet competes with systems built on millions of core-hours of computation.

2605.30096.tldr: This work presents the first large-scale empirical measurement of LLM attack consistency: 400 autonomous penetration testing runs against an identical honeypot hosting OWASP Juice Shop and two additional vulnerable services, holding prompt, orchestrator, and target constant.

2605.30102.tldr: The findings paint a nuanced picture of hybrid MAS design: while SLMs can effectively benefit from LLM assistance, the optimal architecture is highly task-dependent, and greater frontier-level compute does not consistently translate to better performance.

2605.30111.tldr: Experimental results show that cross-modal fusion achieves a 2% absolute improvement in mIoU over a LiDAR-only baseline, demonstrating the benefit of leveraging complementary multi-modal information for scalable and annotation-efficient 3D scene understanding.

2605.30117.tldr: VLA-Trace is presented, a progressive diagnostic framework that analyzes VLA models through a unified evidence chain from representation dynamics to causal control attribution and behavioral manifestation to highlight future directions for representation-preserving adaptation, causal VLA circuits, and compositional semantic control.

2605.30126.tldr: PARCEL improves the performance-efficiency Pareto frontier, consistently outperforming existing matryoshka baselines across visual-token budgets while preserving the"train once, deploy anywhere"paradigm.

2605.30135.tldr: A new multi-expert learning algorithm, called the dual-axis multi-expert learning (DAMEL), which reduces both bias and variance of predictions by using multiple experts along both representation and time axes is proposed.

2605.30136.tldr: This work presents Agent-Radar, a training-free context management method that dynamically steers each agent's attention toward relevant context with a novel temporal and spatial decay mechanism that outperforms state-of-the-art methods across five different benchmarks.

2605.30144.tldr: This work introduces AgentSchool, an LLM-driven multi-agent simulator that models learning as state transition rather than prompted behavior, and frames education as a socially meaningful testbed for long-horizon memory, multi-agent coordination, and future institutional reasoning under organizational pressure.

2605.30148.tldr: The paper shows that prior-task forgetting under ES is largely avoidable, positioning ES as a promising approach for continual learning in LLMs and introduces Anchored Weight Decay as a parameter-space regularization technique that constrains optimization toward the initial model parameters.

2605.30150.tldr: These results establish practical anchorless baselines for open-ended LLM ideation, and compare independent generation and semantic direction stratification with self-, peer-, and representative-anchor baselines, under neutral and population-referential divergent instructions.

2605.30151.tldr: These findings demonstrate that prompt engineering techniques can have larger and more reliable effects than passive model improvements, and that version updates may not always improve performance on specialized educational tasks.

2605.30152.tldr: A small temporal-graph-learning model is used as the encoder, which treats the always-on signal as graph updates rather than text and gives the strongest trigger AUCs and the most stable deployed threshold in trigger-architecture comparisons.

2605.30159.tldr: This work introduces Belief Entropy, a self-supervised proxy that probes how uncertain the model remains about the latent task state given its current memory, and proposes Metacognitive Memory Policy Optimization (MMPO), a fine-grained, memory-specific supervision via explicitly penalizing summaries that induce high epistemic uncertainty.

2605.30160.tldr: It is shown that under mild statistical stability assumptions, the return distribution evolves more regularly than individual trajectories when measured under the $1$-Wasserstein metric, yielding a smoother distributional Bellman objective.

2605.30162.tldr: Preliminary evidence suggests activation-level auditing may surface failure modes invisible to behavioral evaluation, with substantial variation across architectures, which suggests refusal tracks legality and cultural salience over CBRN hazard.

2605.30179.tldr: iLoRA is the first Bayesian graph-conditioned LoRA framework, which infers a latent interaction graph from the input and uses it to generate input-conditioned LoRA updates, and learns prediction and latent interaction structure jointly.

2605.30187.tldr: This paper introduces an agentic AI chatbot architecture assisting students with exercise solving, specifically designed to contribute to more responsible AI use in education.

2605.30189.tldr: It is shown that LoRA adapters, the dominant distribution format for fine-tuned LLMs, can be reliably backdoored through training data poisoning while preserving baseline task performance and Behavioral detection is the operationally portable result for adapter supply chain scanning.

2605.30195.tldr: An operator-level factorial benchmark is presented that decomposes 2D molecular MPNNs into the three families of message-seed initialization, node-edge fusion, and node update operators, providing empirical design heuristics for molecular MPNNs by turning model design from a search over monolithic architectures into a targeted assessment of where and how chemical information enters the message-passing pipeline.

2605.30200.tldr: While both LLM and teacher are critical for skill improvement, a ceiling effect where excessive linguistic expansion yields diminishing marginal utility is uncovered, suggesting a dynamically adaptive LLM-teacher collaboration as student proficiency increases.

2605.30201.tldr: Hysteretic Policy Optimization (HPO) is proposed, a minimal modification of GRPO that reduces the weight of negative-advantage updates and replaces per-response length normalization with mean-length normalization, and Adaptive HPO is introduced, which sets the hysteretic weight based on batch-level advantage-sign statistics, thereby removing the need for tuning a fixed hysteretic weight.

2605.30207.tldr: The same prompt --"best CRM software"-- reaches AI assistants from buyers in widely different contexts: a solo founder, an enterprise VP, a UK SMB owner, a solo founder, a UK SMB owner; how strongly that contextual variation reshapes which brands the model recommends is audit.

2605.30208.tldr: Risk-aware layered automation can materially reduce review bottlenecks created by AI-driven code growth without compromising production safety, according to difference-in-differences analysis of efficiency outcomes.

2605.30219.tldr: To make CBM measurable, BeliefTrack is introduced, a closed-world benchmark spanning Rule Discovery and Circuit Diagnosis, where a finite belief space and symbolic verifiers enable exact turn-level evaluation.

2605.30227.tldr: This work argues that tractable MAS optimization needs structural inductive biases to disentangle error signals, and introduces a discrete, verbalized block coordinate descent algorithm for iterative refinement, which substantially reduces query complexity while improving performance.

2605.30231.tldr: This paper proposes GASP (Geometric-Aware Spatial Priors), a framework that injects fundamental geometric priors directly into the LLM's transformer layers, and demonstrates that learning from fundamental geometric priors is a promising and generalizable pathway towards VLMs with more reliable 3D spatial reasoning.

2605.30233.tldr: It is found that LMs do not incrementally track world states across tokens or query-relevant states across layers, but simply aggregate relevant information in parallel at the last token when the query becomes evident.

2605.30244.tldr: This work proposes Reinforcement Learning with Robust Rubric Rewards, extending RLVR from task-level verification to criterion-level verification, and introduces a minimal exposure strategy that masks ground truths from extractors and images from judges.

2605.30251.tldr: Canonical-Context On-Policy Distillation (CCOPD) is proposed, which yields a 32\% average relative improvement in RAW-SHARDED performance over the original base model across math and five zero-shot out-of-domain task families, while largely preserving full-context performance.

2605.30260.tldr: The Parametric Memory Law, a robust power law linking loss reduction Delta L to effective parameters and sequence length is introduced and MemFT, a threshold-guided optimization strategy that dynamically redistributes the training budget toward sub-threshold tokens is introduced.

2605.30268.tldr: Experiments show PhyGenHOI generates physically consistent 4D HOI across diverse actions, humans, and objects, outperforming baselines.

2605.30273.tldr: The findings suggest that open-source models, when trained with community-derived preference signals, can support high-quality mental health support assistance while offering a more privacy-preserving alternative for sensitive support contexts.

2605.30274.tldr: A human-like long document translation agent called Loong, which leverages a 3E memory module (Essence-Exemplar-Entity) to store summaries, sentence pairs, and entity records as historical context and performs deep reasoning to adaptively identify the optimal context for translation guidance.

2605.30284.tldr: A benchmark framework for evaluating model performance in scientific discovery and reasoning, building up from a raw problem to the classical null hypothesis test, and provides a foundation for systematically evaluating scientific reasoning and discovery capabilities in LLMs, crucial for advancing the development of next-generation AI scientist/co-scientist systems.

2605.30295.tldr: A reusable pipeline for generating terminology-grounded HL7 FHIR R4 bundles from unstructured text is introduced, enabling controllable evaluation of clinical decision support systems over structured inputs and highlighting the importance of deployment-aligned benchmarking.

2605.30310.tldr: The proposed City-Mesh3R is a scalable framework for reconstructing watertight surface meshes directly from large unordered image collections and yields high-fidelity watertight 3D meshes with regular geometry, capturing fine surface details, and is suitable for scaling to arbitrarily large scenes owing to the end-to-end processing in a distributed setting.

2605.30311.tldr: This paper presents Archon, a fully pretrained, human-centric unified multimodal model for holistic avatar generation, and proposes a "Thinking in Modality" that decomposes ambiguous cross-modal tasks into stepwise thinking in an alternative chain of modality, progressively enhancing fidelity and controllability.

2605.30318.tldr: 3D aesthetic portrait planning is introduced, the task of generating human pose, camera, lighting, and exposure plans that produce visually compelling portraits while satisfying geometric and photometric feasibility in a 3D scene.

2605.30322.tldr: Gram, an automated alignment auditing framework to assess the propensity of AI agents to engage in sabotage, is introduced and it is found that increasing realism of environments and removing nudges to misbehave tends to reduce sabotage rates close to zero.

2605.30323.tldr: This work proposes In-Context Reward Adaptation, a transformer-based framework designed to model diverse and unseen human preferences on the fly, and demonstrates that while a standard transformer architecture is insufficient for this task, incorporating human response time as an auxiliary input signal enables the model to successfully adapt to preferences from previously unseen domains.

2605.30324.tldr: These results show bounded memory affects these tasks differently: generation remains achievable for every countable collection, while density and identification are confined to finite collections, with guarantees weakening as the collection grows.

2605.30326.tldr: This work introduces RoboWits, a bi-manual robotic benchmark designed to systematically evaluate cognitive reasoning, creative tool use, and robustness to unexpected conditions, and proposes an automated task generation pipeline formulated as a multi-agent cooperative framework.

2605.30327.tldr: An algorithm is introduced that uses the base model's next-token entropy as a proxy to identify key decision points and resample from those positions and it is proved that the method's mixing time scales with the number of decisions in a trace rather than with the number of tokens, which can be much larger.

2605.30334.tldr: This paper systematically explores the influence of data organization on LLM training by reusing pre-computed sample-level scores originally generated for data efficiency, thereby incurring minimal additional computational overhead.

2605.30335.tldr: This work formalises this locally coherent, globally incoherent failure via the compositional residual eps*, the L2 distance from the composed quote to the joint coherent polytope, computable at runtime from system output and the declared cross-component coupling constraints.

2605.30341.tldr: GPIC, a Giant Permissive Image Corpus of approximately 28 trillion pixels, is introduced and a reference baseline for pixel-space flow matching on GPIC is provided, providing a benchmarking protocol for generative modeling on GPIC.

2605.30343.tldr: Reasoning in Memory is introduced, a latent reasoning method that replaces the autoregressive generation of reasoning steps with memory blocks that unlock the working-memory capacity of large language models and matches or exceeds existing latent reasoning methods while avoiding the autoregressive generation of thoughts.

2605.30344.tldr: This work constructs VisAnomBench, a curated benchmark built from public time-series datasets and augmented with high-quality anomaly explanations selected from multiple large VLMs using fine-grained, task-specific rewards, and develops VisAnomReasoner, a parameter-efficient VLM for time-series anomaly detection.

2605.30345.tldr: SchGen is presented, the first large language model that generates editable PCB schematics from natural-language requests and significantly outperforms alternative representations and even larger general-purpose LLMs on wire connectivity accuracy and functional correctness.

2605.30348.tldr: This work presents a practical, post-hoc approach for auditing the digital DNA of foundation models without access to their training data, and formalizes LLMSurgeon, a strong framework that casts DMS as an inverse problem under the label-shift assumption.

2605.30351.tldr: This paper presents the first study of Multi-Head Latent Attention in video diffusion and shows that the MLA bottleneck, rather than the pretrained spectrum, determines the effective rank: both spectral and random initialization occupy nearly the full rank budget from initialization, and training preserves this budget while adapting within it.

2605.30353.tldr: A physicist supervising an AI coding agent over 12 work days and 57 sessions to build CLAX-PT, a differentiable one-loop perturbation theory module in JAX shows that supervision design, not model capability, determined whether the agent's output was trustworthy.

2509.22888.tldr: JE-IRT establishes a unified and interpretable geometric lens that connects LLM abilities with the structure of questions, offering a distinctive perspective on model evaluation and generalization.

2412.00107.tldr: This work introduces operator-based virtual sensing for nuclear-grade thermal-fluid systems, using the neural-operator framework to learn solution operators that map sparse boundary measurements to coupled internal fields in physically inaccessible regions, and shows that operator-based virtual sensing can restore observability where physical instrumentation fails.

2407.02362.tldr: This paper proposes a scalable and energy-efficient LUT-based approximate matrix multiplication unit (LUT-MU) constituting the basic component of the neural networks by integrating a pruning strategy on the MADDNESS algorithm, a LUT-based matrix multiplication methodology.

2408.05568.tldr: This work proposes metacognitive myopia as a cognitive-ecological framework accounting for a conglomerate of established and emerging LLM biases that provides a novel perspective on flawed human-machine interactions and agentic AI and raises significant ethical concerns regarding the implementation of LLMs in organizational structures and high-stakes decisions.

2508.04243.tldr: A deep learning-based approach for automated Doppler angle estimation was developed using 2100 human carotid ultrasound images including image augmentation to demonstrate potential for applying a deep-learning based technique for automated ultrasound Dopplers angle estimation.

2506.22427.tldr: Clustering of Loss Vector Embeddings (Clustering of Loss Vector Embeddings), a novel algorithm for Clustered Federated Learning, achieves highly accurate cluster recovery in just a few rounds of training, along with state-of-the-art model accuracy, across a variety of both supervised and unsupervised PFL tasks.

2505.19699.tldr: Mosaic is a novel data-free knowledge distillation framework tailored for heterogeneous distributed environments that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches under both model and data heterogeneity.

2505.04397.tldr: PURe is built around a 2D Product Unit with a real-valued log-domain formulation that makes multiplicative local aggregation practical within deep residual hierarchies, and serves as a drop-in replacement for native residual units.

2406.07277.tldr: The results indicate that agents can develop a language capable of expressing the relationships between parts of their observation, achieving over 90% accuracy when trained in a referential game which requires such communication.

2409.06708.tldr: A framework for auditing AI fairness, involving third-party auditors and AI system providers, and a tool to facilitate systematic examination of AI systems are presented, which advocates a transparent white-box and statistics-based approach.

2509.00176.tldr: A novel dataset specifically designed for waste classification in real-world scenarios, characterized by complex environments and deformed shaped objects is introduced and an in-depth evaluation approach is presented to rigorously assess the robustness and accuracy of VLLMs.

2506.16738.tldr: LM-SPT is proposed, an LM-aligned speech tokenization method based on semantic speech-resynthesis distillation that consistently outperforms previous semantic-enhanced speech tokenizers when applied to SLMs for the tasks of automatic speech recognition and text-to-speech, even without compromising the speech reconstruction fidelity at the codec level.

2505.23878.tldr: Actor--Critic Online Data Mixing (AC-ODM), which approaches data mixing from a reinforcement learning perspective with a parameterized policy that theoretically prove to act as a dynamic linear surrogate maximizing the constructive interference of gradients, significantly outperforms prior methods in convergence speed and downstream accuracy across various architectures.

2505.13986.tldr: RidgeCut is proposed, an RL framework that constrains the action space to enforce structure-aware partitioning in the Normalized Cut problem and provides a general mechanism for embedding structural priors into RL frameworks for graph partitioning.
