2410.20066.tldr: This paper introduces an innovative framework designed for progressive prediction of seizures through the utilization of a Deep Learning (DL) methodology based on non-invasive multimodal sensor networks, achieving 95% sensitivity, 98% specificity, and 97% accuracy, averaged among 29 patients.

2410.11861.tldr: This study demystifies how BFFs improve the estimation performance of rapport through a comparative analysis between models with and without BFFs, and decomposes rapport ratings into perceiver effects, target effects, and relationship effects using the social relations model.

2310.06555.tldr: This work provides the first reported temporal vocabulary within emergent communication literature, showing that a different agent architecture is sufficient for the natural emergence of temporal references, and that no additional losses are necessary.

2308.06035.tldr: It is suggested that current transformer-based vision-language models can approximate human behaviour exploiting visual context during language prediction - and that selective attention to informative cues, not sheer model scale, is the principal driver of this alignment.

2502.12445.tldr: A formalization of the concept of computational safety, which is a mathematical framework that enables the quantitative assessment, formulation, and study of safety challenges in GenAI through the lens of signal processing theory and methods, is presented.

2504.08609.tldr: This work presents the first systematic and comprehensive survey of scientific literature on this emerging research landscape in English, identifying imbalanced training data, reliance on crowdsourcing platforms, small and sparse datasets, and missing methodological alignment as critical open issues and formulate twelve recommendations for research.

2602.17990.tldr: WorkflowPerturb is introduced, a controlled benchmark for studying workflow evaluation metrics by applying realistic, graded perturbations to golden workflows and characterize systematic differences across metric families and support severity-aware interpretation of workflow evaluation scores in change-management settings.

2512.10104.tldr: This paper proposes LLMPEA, an LLM-based framework to detect phishing email attacks across multiple attack vectors, including prompt injection, text refinement, and multilingual attacks, and reveals that LLMs can detect the phishing email over 90% accuracy.

2606.01561.tldr: S-SPPO is proposed, a dual-space semantic calibration framework comprising: i) Supervision Calibration via semantic gating, which anneals win rate targets toward the maximum-entropy baseline as semantic overlap increases; and ii) Representation Calibration via latent repulsion to enforce geometric diversity to prevent manifold collapse and maintain latent diversity between chosen and rejected samples.

2604.02863.tldr: Efficient multi-agent voting is formulated as a reliability-aware agent scheduling problem and Efficient Majority-then-Stopping (EMS) is proposed to improve reasoning efficiency and preserves the accuracy of Majority Voting.

2604.13085.tldr: Adaptive Memory Crystallization is conceptually inspired by the qualitative structure of synaptic tagging and capture theory, the idea that memories transition through discrete stability phases, but makes no claim to model the underlying molecular or synaptic mechanisms.

2604.09679.tldr: This work introduces Heterogeneous Consensus-Progressive Reasoning for Efficient Multi-Agent Debate (HCP-MAD), leveraging consensus as a dynamic signal to facilitate progressive reasoning.

2604.06173.tldr: Experiments across multiple large language models show that graph-guided retrieval substantially improves performance, but also reveal a critical safety trade-off: domain-adapted models are more likely to hallucinate when key statutory evidence is missing.

2606.01602.tldr: This work proposes a nonparametric mutual information estimator that directly measures the dependence between time series and event sequences without data transformation, learning, or ad hoc discretization, positioning it as a general-purpose dependence operator for heterogeneous temporal data, similar to Pearson correlation for homogeneous time series.

2606.03489.tldr: Tree-like Self-Play (TSP), a framework that reframes secure code generation as a fine-grained sequential decision process, induces robust out-of-distribution generalization and demonstrates that TSP fundamentally enhances model reliability.

2605.00924.tldr: StyleShield is presented, the first flow matching framework for conditional text style transfer, operating directly in continuous token embedding space via a DiT backbone with zero-initialized cross-attention adapters conditioned on frozen Qwen-7B representations, and RateAudit is introduced, a document-level scheduling algorithm that demonstrates detection-rate verdicts can be set to arbitrary values, directly questioning the reliability of score-based evaluation.

2604.13301.tldr: The honeypot protocol is introduced, which tests for context-dependent behavior by varying only the system prompt across three conditions (evaluation, synthetic deployment, explicit no-monitoring) while holding the task, environment, and scoring identical.

2606.14756.tldr: Across several quality metrics, including the GenEval benchmark, the proposed Divide-and-Denoise method outperforms baselines and resolves common failures including missing objects and mismatched attributes.

2606.14747.tldr: This work introduces MMLongEmbed, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating MEMs in long-context scenarios, and finds that current architectures rely heavily on superficial feature matching and struggle to capture deep semantic and structural dependencies.

2606.14715.tldr: This paper introduces MiroBench, a benchmark for Reddit discussion simulation built from 4,292 real Reddit threads, and offers a concrete benchmark for measuring, diagnosing, and improving realism in LLM-based social simulation.

2606.10456.tldr: A non-empty detectability band is demonstrated and the sub-threshold sabotage frontier is characterized: distribution-shape monitors fail by construction; temporal-correlation monitors can detect but are not trivially optimal.

2606.09669.tldr: SpatialWorld is introduced, a unified benchmark designed specifically for evaluating the interactive spatial understanding of multimodal agents in complex real-world tasks and exposes a clear mismatch between task success and execution efficiency, alongside substantial domain-specific performance variations.

2606.08270.tldr: An AI-based security agent for ACMIS is presented that combines supervised anomaly detection, behavioural analytics, and a natural language processing chatbot for secure password recovery that achieves 97.1 percent identity verification accuracy and an 87.3 percent mass-reset attack detection rate.

2606.14750.tldr: Pixel-TTS is proposed, the first framework for visually grounded speech synthesis that renders text as images and projects them through a 2D convolutional layer to generate embeddings, improving robustness to unseen characters and orthographic variations.

2606.14766.tldr: XMedFusion is presented, a modular AI framework designed as an intelligent perception and reasoning module for autonomous medical systems that decomposes visual information into coordinated functional components that emulate expert-driven analysis, enabling integration into autonomous healthcare and robotic diagnostic workflows.

2606.14765.tldr: A Momentum-Guided Semantic Forecasting framework for self-supervised video representation learning that combines predictive latent forecasting with contrastive regularization to encourage temporal consistency while preventing representation collapse.

2606.14760.tldr: GeoRoPE is injected into pretrained RSFMs through a lightweight adapter, preserving the frozen spatial prior while adding geo-aware positional corrections, and improves cross-resolution robustness and scale-sensitive representation learning.

2606.14755.tldr: Frozen SAM is not a texture segmenter by default, but its failures are not simple texture blindness, and default mask failure should be decomposed into representation evidence, proposal-bank support, readout mismatch, and commitment failure.

2606.14748.tldr: A theoretical framework for MINT is established and multiple architectures for MINT are proposed depending on the amount of information known about the models that are being audited, to improve transparency in machine learning training processes.

2606.14732.tldr: Steady-Forcing, a memory and training framework combining a persistent visual anchor (V-Sink), an exponential moving-average motion memory (EMA-Sink), block-relative temporal encoding, periodic cache purification, and distillation from a Wan2.1-14B teacher with motion-rewarded priors under task-focused configurations is proposed.

2606.14710.tldr: This poster highlights the migration from MQTT relay prototypes (common in IoT communication) to the current hybrid architecture and demonstrates a working cross-device testbed spanning ARM64, x64, and Android clients.

2606.14708.tldr: This paper proposes a structure-preserving identification framework for nonlinear port-Hamiltonian systems based on Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that parameterizes the interconnection matrix, dissipation matrix, Hamiltonian, and input mapping using dedicated KAN blocks, while enforcing the port-Hamiltonian constraints by construction.

2606.11692.tldr: A way of evaluating solutions using the LLM-based Agentic Bipolar Argumentation Simulator, grounded in a framework which formalises a poll as a six-tupleof endorsing and opposing justifications, to the NP-hard Subsuming Justification Problem.

2606.10237.tldr: Minimalist Genetic Programming is presented, an algorithm that like GP is biologically inspired, but instead of evolution it takes inspiration from the Minimalist Program to human language, in which syntax is understood as an optimal solution to the problem of linking two other mental systems.

2606.08898.tldr: This paper proposes a FCIAC method using prototype adaptation and pseudo class-variable training, which exceeds previous methods in average accuracy and designs a pseudo class-variable training strategy to enhance the model's adaptability to changing classes.

2606.14762.tldr: An LLM-based video summarization framework that balances macro-level comprehension with micro-level semantic analysis is proposed and establishes a foundation for video analysis tools that visualize semantic chunking and semantic matching through relevance-based heatmaps.

2606.14758.tldr: OSP, a geometric intervention that utilizes the residual property of OMP to disentangle unique semantic signals from shared concepts, is introduced, proving theoretically and empirically that OSP minimizes hallucination by orthogonalizing the query vector against distractor concepts.

2606.14749.tldr: A high-throughput 3D behavioral phenotyping framework integrating deep learning object detection with binocular stereo vision for real-time monitoring of juvenile tilapia in high-density environments and successfully establishes circadian locomotor baselines.

2606.14734.tldr: This work proposes an innovative framework named Biological Evidence Refinement and Heterogeneous Dynamic Gating for Gene Regulatory Networks (BRIDGE), which applies heterogeneous gated encoding to adaptively regulate information transfer between genes and cells, enabling robust transcription factor-to-target gene prediction.

2606.14724.tldr: VigilFormer is presented, a unified framework that combines deformable spatio-temporal attention with causal temporal modeling to detect anomalies in untrimmed surveillance video, outperforming recent weakly-supervised methods in both accuracy and speed.

2606.14707.tldr: Green AI Carbon Optimizer is presented, a carbon aware cloud region recommendation method for training workloads, and a power law forecasting pipeline for global AI energy demand, highlighting the importance of deployment choices, model scaling discipline, and transparent energy reporting.

2606.08090.tldr: This work is the first to use the oracle's per-document confidence for three purposes: a query-level difficulty compass, a lower bound on the minimum oracle calls any proxy-based cascade can make, and the proxy's soft training label.

2606.14759.tldr: This work proposes a generative method for synthesizing temporally coherent and anatomically consistent cardiac sequences with high temporal coherence and strong fidelity to input prompts, and highlights its potential to produce high-fidelity, on-demand medical data.

2606.14754.tldr: A new category of sub-semantic image segmentation that blurs the line between visual cues and language, and introduces DETECTURE that resolves three concrete failure modes -- language leakage between texture regions, prompt competition inside the segmentation backbone, and semantic distortion at the language-to-mask interface.

2606.14752.tldr: X-Tokenizer is introduced, a lightweight encoder-Semantic Residual Quantization (SRQ)-decoder architecture that provides a shared action interface across diverse robotic arm embodiments and achieves top real-world aggregate and strong RoboTwin 2.0 simulation results, showing that action tokenizers serve as semantic interfaces for VLA pretraining beyond mere action compression.

2606.07678.tldr: DOG-DPO is proposed, a training-free data selection framework that treats preference pairs as structured geometric signals and recovers most of the safety gains of full-data training while remaining entirely teacher-free, training-free, and substantially faster than representative selection baselines.

2606.14753.tldr: The standard self-attention mechanism in Vision Transformers is replaced with a probabilistic transformer approach based on a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), a soft-clustering technique, which reduces the computational complexity from quadratic O(n^2) to linear O(nK), where K<<n.

2606.14718.tldr: Both genders improved in AI knowledge post-intervention, yet females showed a richer profile of gains: wider conceptual understanding, greater confidence, and meaningful increases in AI and CS career interest that partially narrowed the gender STEM gap.

2606.10740.tldr: This work evaluates three distilled reasoning targets against a fixed attacker across five oversight conditions, collecting 6750 turn-level observations on the Information-Hazard scenario and reveals two reproducible vulnerabilities: an oversight paradox where explicit monitoring cues paradoxically increase alignment-faking rates rather than suppress them.

2606.08402.tldr: This work proposes a multi-agent orchestration framework that decomposes single-image 3D scene generation into three structured stages: scene initialization, environment construction, and multi-agent refinement, and introduces a geometry-aware layout predictor supervised by sparse geometric priors derived from point maps.

2606.13693.tldr: It is concluded that in span-based ESG narrative scoring, reasoning-heavy deployment does not materially improve outcomes relative to reasoning-off consensus, while substantially increasing operational cost.

2606.15038.tldr: A foundation model-driven framework for cross-modal representation alignment between CT imaging and longitudinal EHR data is introduced, designed to generalize across tasks and institutions and establish task-aware multimodal alignment as a necessary design principle for robust generalization and scalable clinical deployment.

2606.14990.tldr: The Rational Sparse Autoencoder (RSAE) is introduced, which replaces the fixed encoder activation with a trainable rational function and strictly improves on it after the fine-tuning step, without sacrificing feature-level interpretability under sparse probing.

2606.14934.tldr: The Separable Neural Architecture is introduced, a function representational class combining neural approximation with tensor decomposition that serves as a compact mathematical substrate for continuous parameter manifolds to enable real-time inversion, optimization loops, and rapid uncertainty propagation.

2606.14929.tldr: This work establishes that standard regret notions suffer from structural misspecification or statistical intractability, and identifies a log-quadratic policy class that is expressive enough to capture query-dependent model routing, yet structured enough to allow efficient online learning.

2606.14922.tldr: This paper aims to give the solutions to deal with the task emotional speech synthesis at VLSP 2022 which allows to generate humanlike natural-sounding voice from a given input text with desired emotional expression.

2606.14912.tldr: This work proposes a novel mask proposal voting framework that overcomes the major drawback of classical approaches, allowing robust segmentation even in complicated scenarios, and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art minimal path-based approaches in both accuracy and robustness.

2606.14892.tldr: This work formally study when and how a model of its environment that is causal, supporting reasoning about interventions and counterfactuals, and also combinatorial, supporting generalization to unseen combinations of objects can be learned.

2606.14886.tldr: An improved Knowledge Distillation (KD) framework has been proposed for efficient compression of deep convolutional neural networks for land-use image classification task and achieves an accuracy of 99.04%, outperforming both baseline student training and single-loss distillation approaches.

2606.14838.tldr: A definition of a good explanation is proposed inspired by the notion of counterfactual explanations, however it is argued that one must also take into account the interlocutor's prior beliefs in each fact that could be offered in an explanation.

2606.14821.tldr: This work proposes Co-Scraper, a two-stage framework capable of handling the hierarchical complexity of long HTML documents that significantly enhances the accuracy and resilience of data extraction, providing a highly efficient approach for web data acquisition tasks.

2606.14817.tldr: Overall, the findings demonstrate that the RAG-augmented architecture effectively produces reading content tailored to user queries and desired textual complexity.

2606.14816.tldr: A taxonomy of security threats and a framework for analyzing attack propagation are proposed to support future research in agentic AI security.

2606.14792.tldr: It is demonstrated that multimodal discrete diffusion models are effective alternatives to AR models for reinforcement learning in interleaved reasoning, owing to their ability to perform efficient visual rollouts via localized visual editing rather than full image-token regeneration.

2606.14788.tldr: NeurMLLM is presented, an efficient multimodal generative framework for neurodegenerative disease staging that achieves strong performance, consistently outperforming classical machine learning methods and existing LLM-based approaches.

2606.14820.tldr: A psychoacoustic benchmark based on the binaural masking level difference is proposed and Progressive physical ablations show that general purpose binaural SSL models rely on spectro temporal interference textures rather than cross channel phase computation.

2606.14790.tldr: XFlow improves reliability by making constraints, evidence handling, and process requirements explicit and enforceable and keeps informal semantic work inside actors while moving selected commitments into harness structure that can be checked, preserved, and enforced.

2606.14824.tldr: A novel approach to hardware-aware neural architecture search (HW NAS) that considers the resources available on the computing platform running it, enabling its execution on various embedded devices, achieving state-of-the-art results in the human-recognition tasks on the Visual Wake Word dataset.

2606.15007.tldr: Nemotron 3 Ultra is introduced, a 550 billion total and 55 billion active parameter Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Attention language model that achieves up to ~6x higher inference throughput as compared to state-of-the-art publicly available LLMs while attaining on-par accuracy.

2606.14941.tldr: Experiments across seven real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of SERAF in bridging numerical and semantic views of time series compared with state-of-the-art baselines.

2606.14923.tldr: The results show that trust dispositions can be measured before deployment and suggest that calibration, rather than maximal suspicion, should be the central concern in the governance of multi-agent AI systems.

2606.14867.tldr: It is argued that a robust proof autoformalizer must remain faithful even for informal proofs that diverge from these idealized ones, and the first study on the robustness of proof autoformalization models is presented.

2606.14770.tldr: A systematic ablation of Multi-Label Focal Loss hyperparameters (alpha and gamma) on a ResNet-18 backbone is presented, identifying the Sparsity Wall, a hard boundary where positive sample fractions below 0.1% make global loss reweighting ineffective, requiring instance-level intervention.

2606.14813.tldr: JetParticle-JEPA (JP-JEPA), a self-supervised Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture that learns physically meaningful jet representations directly from continuous particle clouds without tokenization or reconstruction of raw inputs, is introduced.

2606.14805.tldr: This work formulate zero-replay counterfactual-effect prediction: given a trace under a fixed budget, predict which events the oracle would mark high-effect before any replay is performed, and proposes BranchPoint-Latent, a lightweight predictor over observable, structural, uncertainty, and latent features of the knowledge graph.

2606.14778.tldr: FactCheck is proposed, a novel multi-agent collaboration framework that improves feasibility through a closed-loop "Observe-Plan-Verify"mechanism, establishing a new paradigm for feasibility-aware long-term action anticipation.

2606.14777.tldr: Across six real-world scenarios, human raters prefer JoyAI-VL-Interaction over the in-app video-call assistants of Doubao and Gemini by a wide margin, and the first open, vision-driven interaction model released together with its training recipe, data, and complete deployable system.

2606.14773.tldr: Double-Helix Vision is presented, a geometry-based visual sampler that compresses 2D images into compact 1D signals using paired golden-ratio-inspired spiral trajectories, and achieves a 1,433x compression ratio while preserving the geometric structure of the scene.

2606.14772.tldr: FG-EQA, a fine-grained active perception EQA benchmark with more than 40K simulated trajectories and 1K real-world trajectories, is introduced and ScoutVLA, an evidence-driven Vision-Language-Action model for outdoor EQA, is proposed, an evidence-driven Vision-Language-Action model for outdoor EQA with decoupled dual-expert architecture.

2606.14769.tldr: A workflow-based framework for valuing, attributing, and pricing human and artificial agents, which formsulates AI deployment as a coalition-formation problem and defines coalition value as the incremental net surplus generated relative to a benchmark human workflow.

2606.14997.tldr: A closed-form estimator is derived that isolates individual memory traces from globally entangled parameters, and it is shown that this biologically-derived solution corresponds to a natural gradient update on the parameter manifold.

2606.14975.tldr: The machinery of cortex--its geometry, wiring, and functional structure--can be harnessed as a powerful inductive basis for building recurrent networks that learn more effectively while converging toward key organizational principles of biological computation.

2606.14971.tldr: FASTMIX is a novel framework that automates data mixture discovery while training only a single proxy model, and jointly optimizes mixture coefficients and model parameters, substantially improving efficiency and scalability over prior approaches.

2606.14948.tldr: An agentic judging pipeline using a strong LLM as a scalable proxy for expert architectural evaluation, comprising two judges: the Architecture Complexity Judge (ACJ), which estimates codebase-specific architectural understanding a task demands, and the Architecture Quality Judge (AQJ), which evaluates patch conformance to repository-specific architectural conventions via source-grounded rubrics.

2606.14871.tldr: Adversarial Training is applied to improve models'ability and ensure reliable predictions under noisy data and Grad-CAM visualization highlights the important regions of leaf images that validate the model prediction with confidence level.

2606.14865.tldr: Results suggest that guided parameter-space evolution can yield compact and robust parameter configurations under matched computation, and propose GRAPE, Guided Parameter-Space Evolution, a training framework for compact adversarial robustness.

2606.14885.tldr: DR-DCI is introduced, a retriever-steered DCI framework that treats retrieval as an agent-callable action for expanding a local workspace, and combines retriever-level recall with DCI-style precision: retrieval keeps exploration scalable, while DCI preserves the local operations needed for effective evidence resolution.

2606.15034.tldr: OSGuard is introduced, a dual-granularity benchmark suite for evaluating safety in computer-use agents under benign, unchanged user instructions that enables more precise diagnosis of whether models can both recognize unsafe proposed actions and improve full-task safety when deployed as guardrails.

2606.15029.tldr: This work develops a method (Metric Match) for estimating correlation-based reliability metrics of LLM judges from limited annotations, which achieves a win-rate of 0.838 against random subset selection across four different correlation metrics and 15 datasets.

2606.15024.tldr: It is found that prompted LLM agents fail to reach agreement that is achievable in principle: consensus can fail even in settings where classical theory guarantees that a convergent algorithm exists, and this failure persists across temperatures and horizons.

2606.14981.tldr: ViTaL is introduced, a visuo-tactile inference-time steering framework that formulates multimodal guidance as a bi-level optimization problem that improves overall success by 51% over the base policy, outperforms unimodal steering by at least 33%, and exceeds naive multimodal fusion by at least 20%.

2606.14963.tldr: A novel framework leveraging remote sensing imagery and deep learning to automate building damage classification using pre- and post-disaster satellite imagery, which categorizes buildings into four damage levels and demonstrates overall classification accuracy of 94.90%.

2606.14935.tldr: PrologMCP is introduced, a task-agnostic, open-source server that exposes Prolog as a stateful tool through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and its compact tool interface, structured error reporting, and per-session isolation make the translate-run-inspect-repair loop a reusable primitive for MCP-capable agents.
