2606.01221.tldr: A unified hybrid framework that integrates both data- and algorithm-level balancing strategies into a regressor-agnostic pipeline that consistently improves predictive performance compared to standalone regressors and existing imbalanced regression approaches is proposed.

2606.01229.tldr: This platform provides a reliable decision-support tool for design engineers and sustainability practitioners, enabling accurate, data-driven delivery of energy-efficient buildings and confirms that the integrated algorithm framework offers good scalability, strong performance, and technical feasibility for green building design.

2606.01230.tldr: This work proposes HomeFlow, a verifiable data flywheel for smart home agents, which uses HomeEnv as a unified simulation environment and HomeMaker to procedurally generate diverse home settings and optimize the agents via supervised fine-tuning and step-wise RLVE, which facilitates iterative improvement through authentic physical feedback.

2606.01237.tldr: An atlas-knowledge-guided Generative Counterfactual Attention-guided Network (GCAN) for explainable cognitive decline diagnosis using multimodal brain connectomes is proposed, enabling counterfactual analysis of complementary functional reorganization and structural topology changes.

2606.01246.tldr: This work presents SIRIUS-SQL, a difficulty-smoothing RL recipe that trains SIRIUS-32B to generate diverse executable SQL candidates, paired with a generalist LLM that fills in gaps left by the specialist.

2606.01252.tldr: An inference-time activation steering method is introduced that leverages hidden representations from English summarization to guide MTXLS generation and shows that this method consistently improves MTXLS quality across target languages.

2606.01265.tldr: This paper demonstrates the effectiveness of machine learning-driven optimization for designing application-specific GaN tri-gate FinFETs in vertical power delivery systems by systematically exploring key structural parameters, and identifies two optimized devices with aggressively scaled gate-to-drain lengths.

2606.01277.tldr: DeepIPCv3 is proposed, a novel multi-modal autonomous navigation framework that synergizes the dense 3D spatial geometry of LiDAR point clouds with the microsecond-level asynchronous event streams of a Dynamic Vision Sensor (DVS).

2606.01279.tldr: Andes (Agent Native Data Evolving Synthesis), a framework that reimagines data generation as a plug-and-play agent skill, provides an intelligent abstraction layer that allows trainer agents to dynamically steer data synthesis through an interactive, closed-loop interface.

2606.01281.tldr: Empirical evaluations demonstrate that POPO substantially accelerates RL finetuning and achieves strong reasoning performance with significantly fewer rollouts, and employs decoupled importance sampling to correct off-policy bias while maintaining stable policy updates under consistent trust-region constraints.

2606.01285.tldr: This work introduces knowledge-intensive video generation (KIVI), where models generate videos from short information-seeking prompts that ask for explanations, procedures, or demonstrations, and proposes automatic metrics for factuality and helpfulness.

2606.01286.tldr: benchEvolver, a solution-centric evolutionary framework that automatically transforms existing coding problems into harder variants, is introduced, enabling scalable construction of high-quality, diverse, and difficult tasks with verifiable correctness.

2606.01287.tldr: This work decomposes latent tokens into three testable components: latent slots, boundary markers, and format, and develops a state-of-the-art method as a probe under favorable conditions.

2606.01291.tldr: QADR demonstrates excellent scalability, operating successfully at $n_{\text{features}}=2000$ where standard global VQCs crash due to memory exhaustion, while matching or exceeding the performance of optimized classical architectures.

2606.01292.tldr: A unified spectral analysis of SGD dynamics in high-dimensional linear regression is established, elucidating the efficiency of KT across seemingly disparate regimes and revealing that the efficacy of transfer is governed by the interplay between implicit regularization and heterogeneous spectral learning speeds over the spectrum.

2606.01293.tldr: This research introduces a novel deep learning model that combines a ResNet-34 encoder with a lightweight decoder leveraging multi-layer perceptron (MLP) modules for adaptive feature refinement that enhances the model's ability to preserve anatomical boundaries and mitigate segmentation errors caused by motion artifacts and intensity inhomogeneities.

2606.01300.tldr: ChronosAD is a novel architecture for anomaly detection that uses a time series foundation model as a feature extractor that demonstrates robust generalization across a wide range of domains, including industrial, medical, cyber-physical, and automotive systems.

2606.01311.tldr: This work proposes SkillAdaptor, a training-free step-level skill adaptation framework with explicit failure attribution, and it can plug into OpenClaw-class agent harnesses, and it improves over no-skill and skill-adaptation baselines on all three suites.

2606.01312.tldr: A communication-centric hierarchical architecture for Tactical Autonomous Defense Vehicle Networks (TADVNs) that models the integration of edge-assisted Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning with 6G-enabled connectivity and semantic communication to demonstrate measurable benefits in coordination and communication when semantic reasoning is combined with low-latency 6G connectivity.

2606.01313.tldr: Probabilistic Scene Graph Navigation is proposed, which constructs a 3D Probabilistic Scene Graph that uses full semantic categorical distributions to account for perception uncertainty and introduces the Evidential Experience Calibrator, which enables online lifelong adaptation by cross-validating detections against memories of past successes and failures.

2606.01322.tldr: TUKABENCH is introduced, a jailbreak benchmark for seven African languages that extends JailbreakBench (JBB) beyond direct translation through four settings: human translation of JBB prompts, English adaptation to African contexts followed by human translation, human-curated prompts validated through interactions with GPT-5.2, and code-switched prompts combining English and African languages.

2606.01323.tldr: DiffuSent is presented, a non-auto-regressive diffusion framework that systematically formulates all ABSA subtasks as boundary denoising diffusion processes, progressively refining boundaries over noisy states, and introduces a contrastive denoising training strategy which effectively address duplicate predictions with subtle variations introduced by diffusion process.

2606.01324.tldr: This work proposes a digital twin (DT)-assisted adaptive deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework that enables intelligent spectrum sharing and resource allocation across distributed ground users and demonstrates significant gains in spectral efficiency, data rates, and energy utilization.

2606.01351.tldr: A Mean-Field Entropy Dynamics framework is proposed, modeling the orchestration process as a system governed by the competing forces of task resolution and cumulative context loading, and it is demonstrated that the entropy dynamics model fits empirical trajectories, providing physically interpretable parameters that quantify system stability and performance collapse.

2606.01352.tldr: This work formally proposes a new (or the fourth) paradigm -- Continuous Generative Regression, and introduces FlowTime, a novel method utilizing a One-step Generative Variational Autoencoder and designs a Flow-based Personalized Prior that leverages NFs to warp a standard Gaussian prior into a complex, history-conditioned manifold, thereby enabling the adaptive modeling of multimodal interaction patterns.

2606.01364.tldr: Symbolicate-Enrich-Sample is presented, a low-cost batch pipeline that turns a corpus of production Windows binaries into a queryable, priority-ranked research queue and describes the pipeline's selectivity and its failure modes, the methodology, and aggregate statistics are described.

2606.01372.tldr: A block-rotation predictor is introduced that imposes the circular structure of modulo-10 arithmetic in latent space that enables strong zero-shot generalization and suggests that latent world models can learn symbolic transformation rules when architecture matches the structure of the problem.

2606.01382.tldr: This work shows that standard iterative NLHF can suffer an exponential dependence on the KL-regularization parameter, and proposes an explicitly exploratory iterative NLHF algorithm that combines SFT-based regularization with adversarial policy exploration, and proposes an explicitly exploratory iterative NLHF algorithm that combines SFT-based regularization with adversarial policy exploration.

2606.01385.tldr: MAAD (Multi-Agent Architecture Design), a knowledge-driven framework that orchestrates four specialized agents to autonomously and collaboratively transform requirements specifications into comprehensive, multi-view architectural blueprints with quality attribute assessments, is proposed.

2606.01386.tldr: The results indicate that FL can deliver high-quality conversational AI for public services without centralized data sharing and indicate that FL can deliver high-quality conversational AI for public services without centralized data sharing.

2211.14411.tldr: Constrained TPE (c-TPE) is proposed, an extension of the widely-used versatile Bayesian optimization method, tree-structured Parzen estimator (TPE), to handle constraints of hyperparameter optimization.

2403.07008.tldr: Efficient and statistically principled algorithms are suggested that improve sample efficiency while remaining unbiased and increase the effective human-labeled sample size by up to 50% on experiments with GPT-4.

2407.15510.tldr: This paper begins an algebraic (i.e. semantic) theory of anti-unification in the general setting of universal algebra, thereby extending anti-unification from term-based representations to arbitrary algebras and beyond equational theories.

2409.18624.tldr: This paper proposes a primitive-based, unsupervised learning approach for decision-making inspired by a novel cognition framework that models the input space constructively as a distributed hierarchical structure in an input-agnostic way and outperforms the compared algorithms.

2411.05196.tldr: DhondtXAI is presented as a SHAP-independent, D'Hondt-based attribution framework for tabular XAI, which computes background-interventional removal effects, separates positive and negative evidence, forms optional feature alliances, applies optional thresholds, allocates seats via the D'Hondt rule, and projects onto the local model-output difference.

2411.11436.tldr: This paper addresses the problem of feature selection in the context of multi-label learning, by using a new estimator based on implicit regularization and label embedding via Hadamard product parameterization, which may lead to benign overfitting.

2502.04646.tldr: A training-free weighted sampling framework that approximates the backward diffusion process of the target distribution by augmenting the pretrained base score function with an auxiliary guidance term, in a principled and computationally efficient manner is proposed.

2503.05500.tldr: This paper revisits the development of multilingual encoders through the lens of advances in generative decoder-only models, and introduces EuroBERT, a family of multilingual encoders covering European and widely spoken global languages.

2503.15639.tldr: A novel, training-free plug-and-play framework that leverages the strengths of pre-trained text recognizers while minimizing redundant computations, and introduces an attention-based segmentation stage, which refines candidate text regions at the pixel level, improving downstream recognition.

2504.17471.tldr: Empirically, the results indicate that GRANITE converges within 5% of non-Byzantine accuracy under 30% Byzantines nodes, offers faster convergence and operates on graphs with up to 9x lower communication cost.

2507.19881.tldr: Experiments on five real-world datasets show that the global model significantly outperforms individual client models and is only 2 mIoU points behind the model trained with simultaneous access to all client data.

2508.06588.tldr: RGVQ is proposed, a novel framework that integrates graph topology and feature similarity as explicit regularization signals to enhance codebook utilization and promote token diversity, and incorporates a structure-aware contrastive regularization to penalize assigning the same token to dissimilar node pairs.

2509.18025.tldr: This expository note gradually introduces the concepts and tools used to build convergence guarantees for stochastic gradient descent in a general nonsmooth nonconvex, but tame, setting.

2509.24808.tldr: Normalized Deviation Faithfulness (NDF) is introduced, a robust metric to evaluate how well a discovered circuit recovers the model's decision for a specific input, and is broadly applicable to circuit discovery beyond the authors' setting.

2602.07298.tldr: A novel, layered framework for generating high-quality synthetic data that circumvents issues by creating a curated, pedagogical curriculum for the LLM and empirically demonstrate, for the first time, robust power-law scaling for an LLM that is continually pre-trained on high-quality, recommendation-specific data.

2602.11177.tldr: This work empirically evaluates various model architectures across three heterogeneous transcript corpora to investigate their effectiveness for text-based AD detection and analyze how task-relevant information is encoded within their internal representations and uses linear probing to empirically show that fine-tuning shifts the representations of individual tokens in ways that reflect AD-related signal.

2603.00133.tldr: The resulting GUARD offers a surgical, dynamic per-prompt inference-time approach that is by far the most robust method in terms of consistently producing state-of-the-art results for memorization mitigation across two architectures and for both verbatim and template memorization, while also improving upon or yielding comparable results in terms of image quality.

2603.03291.tldr: This work categorizes RM failures as tractable or resistant to linear intervention and proposes a simple post-hoc intervention to mitigate low-complexity biases that arise from spurious correlations.

2603.06741.tldr: By eliminating synchronization requirements and enabling mixed DDPM/FM objectives, this framework makes decentralized generative model training accessible to contributors with single GPUs requiring only 24--48GB VRAM.

2603.18016.tldr: This paper proposes MineDraft, a batch parallel speculative decoding framework designed to effectively hide drafting latency by overlapping it with verification, and shows that PSD is substantially more efficient than standard SD.

2604.03893.tldr: Evaluating 19 state-of-the-art multimodal LLMs, FeynmanBench offers a controlled testbed for multimodal reasoning over formal scientific diagrams and highlights fundamental limitations of current architectures in topology-sensitive scientific reasoning.

2604.09482.tldr: Process Reward Agents is introduced, an inference-time method for providing domain-grounded, online, step-wise rewards to a frozen policy, and suggests a paradigm in which frozen reasoners are decoupled from domain-specific reward modules, allowing the deployment of new backbones in complex domains without retraining.

2604.09549.tldr: ContextSim is introduced, an LLM agent framework that simulates believable user proxies by anchoring interactions in daily life activities and model agents' internal thoughts and enforce consistency at both the action and trajectory levels to align preferences with genuine humans.

2605.07804.tldr: Prune-OPD is introduced, a framework that dynamically aligns training budgets with supervision quality and improves OPD not by blindly shortening rollouts, but by reallocating computation toward locally exploitable teacher rewards.

2605.17110.tldr: ECC, an algorithm that calibrates prior semantic embeddings using limited posterior model comparisons to bridge the gap between surface-level semantics and latent capability requirements, is proposed and significantly improves LLM capability ranking quality.

2605.18077.tldr: LLM-driven Multi-Agent Communication is proposed, which leverages an LLM's reasoning capability to design a communication protocol that enables all agents to reconstruct the underlying state as accurately and uniformly as possible.

2605.20301.tldr: This design substantially improves the temporal stability and discriminative capability of BEV representations, and integrates a Dual Attention Fusion (DAF) module to further enhance spatiotemporal feature interaction.

2605.26089.tldr: This work presents Channel-wise Vector Quantization (CVQ), a novel image tokenization paradigm that replaces patch-wise tokens with channel-wise tokens, and introduces a new visual autoregressive framework with "next-channel prediction".

2605.27458.tldr: This work proposes an interpretation method for Transformer models with heterogenous attention structures, and proposes an experimental analysis paradigm to interpret the operating mechanisms of representative models, conduct semantic interpretation and logical interpretation.

2605.28508.tldr: It is argued that the meaningful unit of assessment is the deployed system rather than an isolated model and that effective evaluation frameworks must integrate task performance with deployment conditions such as noisy inputs, code-switching, intermittent connectivity, low-end hardware, and domain shift.

2605.30188.tldr: It is argued that Post-Hoc Improvement in proper scoring rules offers a principled alternative to traditional calibration error estimators for comparing post-hoc methods, capturing both calibration quality and potential degradation to the model's predictive performance.

2605.30280.tldr: Qwen-VLA is presented, a unified embodied foundation model that extends Qwen's vision-language modeling stack from perception, understanding, and reasoning to continuous action and trajectory generation through a DiT-based action decoder, enabling transferable visual grounding, spatial reasoning, and continuous action generation across robot morphologies, task families, and environments.

2606.01339.tldr: FreqLite is an ultra-lightweight, channel-independent frequency-decomposed linear forecaster: a learnable, lossless, partition-of-unity spectral filter splits the input into bands that are forecast by per-band linear heads and, unlike low-pass-truncation approaches, the high-frequency band is retained and modeled.

2606.01393.tldr: This work introduces Dr. DocBench, a difficulty-aware benchmark for expert-level document parsing, and reveals substantial failures across subjects, content types, and structural attributes, highlighting Dr. DocBench as a comprehensive testbed for diagnosing and advancing document intelligence.

2606.01703.tldr: JenBridge is presented, a modular and interpretable framework for adaptive long-form video soundtracking that ensures both high-fidelity audio generation and transition naturalness, and significantly outperforms existing methods in both objective and subjective metrics.

2606.01708.tldr: 2FFS is proposed, a two-fidelity tree-search algorithm that brings multi-fidelity flat bandit ideas into trees and proves fixed-confidence correctness, establish finite stopping for exact identification, and give a polynomial-depth cost upper bound for general-depth trees.

2606.01719.tldr: This work provides the first formal bound connecting a model's measured EO disparity directly to its adversarial advantage in the DIA game, opening a new avenue for unified fairness-and-privacy defenses.

2606.01737.tldr: The results validate that integrating multimodal factual evidence with legal clauses via retrieval augmentation can effectively improve the reliability and accuracy of traffic accident liability determination.

2606.01738.tldr: THRD is presented, the first training-free framework that explicitly models temporal risk accumulation for multi-turn jailbreak defense and demonstrates the necessity of explicit temporal aggregation in multi-turn jailbreak defense.

2606.01741.tldr: This paper proposes SECUREVENT, a hybrid AI/ML security-monitoring architecture for distributed event-based systems that combines traditional protections such as authenticated transport, topic-level authorization, and signed events with online anomaly detection, graph-aware behavioral features, complex-event policy rules, federated learning, and adversarial-ML governance.

2606.01747.tldr: This paper provides a high-level architecture that combines bidirectional encoder representations of transformers (BERT) and graph neural networks (GNN) to extract the entities and relationships from various types of historical texts to add accumulated wisdom to the knowledge repository.

2606.01755.tldr: TriAlign is proposed, the first offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for TIA, where each social group is modeled as an agent interacting, and jointly optimizes universal truth accuracy, cross-group truth consistency, and personalization through a fairness-aware objective and an explicit inconsistency penalty.

2606.01774.tldr: The results suggest that practical dLLMs are limited not only by decoding algorithms, but also by transfer data quality and the training inefficiency of current block-diffusion objectives, motivating joint design of data, objectives, architectures, and inference systems.

2606.01781.tldr: SGAP-PPIS is a structure-guided adaptive propagation model for PPIS prediction that leverages multi-scale geometric states from an equivariant graph neural network to generate residue-wise propagation coefficients and allows each residue to adaptively balance local feature preservation and neighborhood diffusion according to its geometric microenvironment.

2606.01783.tldr: SPHERE (Semantic Personas for Heterogeneous cross-domain Recommendation), a design artifact that enables recommendation knowledge transfer across strictly disjoint domains with no shared users or items is proposed, offering a practical mechanism for overcoming information silos while preserving interpretability and modularity.

2606.01787.tldr: A new class of asynchronous adaptive first-order optimization methods is introduced, comprising asynchronous variants of several popular algorithms, and it is suggested that such asynchronous adaptive algorithms are very relevant in heterogeneous large-scale machine learning systems.

2606.01789.tldr: This work designs a pipeline that automatically retrieves relevant research papers from scientific databases, and prompts LLMs to check the consistency between the benchmark causal graphs and domain research papers, and shows that popular benchmarks vary significantly in their consistency with domain research.

2606.01790.tldr: Across four GUI benchmarks, STaR-KV achieves the strongest average accuracy among state-of-the-art KV compression methods (e.g., GUIKV, SnapKV) at matched budgets, with no compression-stage FLOPs overhead (-0.07%) and cutting peak GPU memory by nearly 40% at a 20% KV-cache budget.

2606.01800.tldr: It is revealed that low-resource languages are structurally more different from English than high- and mid-resource languages, and that language-specific post-training alters their structures while preserving inter-language relationships.

2606.01803.tldr: OctoT2I, a novel agentic framework that reformulates the T2I task as a joint optimization of generation quality and inference efficiency, and implements a stateful, multi-round routing strategy that adaptively selects the most suitable tool based on its knowledge and memory.

2606.01806.tldr: ProbScale is proposed, a framework that unifies insights from scaling laws and probing to identify parameter-efficient subnetworks within pre-trained SLMs and formulate the subnetwork selection as finding a layer subset maximizing aggregated, task-weighted probe performance under a parameter budget.

2606.01810.tldr: This work argues that reliable physical autonomy requires a shift from linguistically grounded token prediction toward physically grounded causal reasoning, and introduces Causal-Plan-Bench, a high-fidelity diagnostic suite curated through multi-stage verification to evaluate embodied planning across four causal dimensions.

2606.01811.tldr: This work proposes a new approach to measuring diversity using in-context learning, of which the ``Decan''metric, D_{Ca_n} = C \times a_n, is the working instance, which makes use of language model in-context learning to detect a wide range of similarities between any number of inputs, and obviates the need to train a special-purpose model.

2606.01828.tldr: DySCo (Dynamic Sparse Consensus), a dynamic trust-aware sparse consensus mechanism that replaces universal broadcasting with on-demand communication, thereby reducing communication overhead while preserving essential cross-validation information is proposed.

2606.01830.tldr: CAPF lets the policy revise zero-reward attempts into positive-reward repair trajectories and attenuates credit for the feedback call and earlier actions to accommodate deployment without this call, which improves Qwen3-4B's average exact-match score from 44.7% under outcome-only RLVR to 48.5% on seven open-domain QA benchmarks.

2606.01833.tldr: An implicit, history-dependent bias in the generative space of a pretrained emulator is introduced, and a history-aware score estimator augments the frozen emulator with a distance-weighted bias that steers reverse-time sampling away from previously generated structures, regularized by an environment-support term.

2606.01834.tldr: This work proposes a compact temporal convolutional network (TCN)-based framework that explicitly incorporates motion-aware inductive biases into feature learning and introduces a Doppler-energy-guided temporal attention mechanism in feature space and a variance-driven channel attention module to weight informative subcarriers based on temporal motion statistics adaptively.

2606.01838.tldr: LayerRoute, a lightweight adapter that learns to selectively skip transformer blocks on a per-input basis, is introduced, a lightweight adapter that learns to selectively skip transformer blocks on a per-input basis.

2606.01840.tldr: Evaluating and analyzing the performance of simple baseline approaches for IDD-based A* and the effect of OS-level mechanisms for managing and speeding up accesses to external memory, such as page caches are addressed.

2606.01843.tldr: This work proposes Shortcut Subspace Suppression (S^3) framework, a framework that explicitly characterizes and suppresses method-specific shortcuts via subspace modeling and significantly improves cross-method generalization while maintaining strong in-domain performance.

2606.01845.tldr: Through the evaluation, it is observed that LLMs struggle to infer underlying meaning from non-verbal responses, with accuracy dropping by up to 60% points compared to verbal ones, and in-context learning facilitates pragmatic inference.

2606.01850.tldr: It is suggested that accuracy-only evaluation is insufficient for assessing the deployment readiness of compressed LLMs, and that uncertainty-aware benchmarking should be a standard component of model compression pipelines.

2606.01856.tldr: FedMChain is proposed, a balanced MMFL framework that structures federated multimodal training as a chain of modality-wise phases that gives each modality a dedicated local optimization window on multimodal clients to mitigate modality competition, and further promotes cross-modal complementarity via an error-compensated regularizer.

2606.01862.tldr: RadioMaster is introduced, a fully autonomous multi-agent framework that drives user input to verified emissions transmitted over the air, which substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in configuration viability and signal fidelity, while reducing configuration time by up to 28x.

2606.01886.tldr: The interaction-native knowledge harness (InKH), an architecture for financial LLM agents that absorbs complexity into the system that supports a design thesis for financial AI: adoption happens when complexity is absorbed by the system rather than transferred to the user.

2606.01894.tldr: This work proposes PC-MambaSDE, a unified continuous-time framework for robust RUL prediction under irregular observations that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under extreme observation scarcity, validating the efficacy of embedding physical priors into continuous-time latent dynamics.

2606.01895.tldr: These findings establish multi-view fusion as a viable and effective strategy for SOD, with broad implications for space situational awareness in LEO constellation deployments.

2606.01896.tldr: The synthetic-data utility for safety-critical hand detection is determined by the training procedure, and simple multi-stage experiments extract substantial real-deployment benefit from inpainted accessory data.

2606.01899.tldr: RA-LWLM is proposed, a retrieval-augmented in-context localization framework that achieves training-free cross-scene adaptation by externalizing scene-specific information into a per-scene fingerprint database rather than encoding it in model weights.

2606.01901.tldr: The Image Reconstruction Game is introduced, a fully automated benchmark in which a vision-language model issues corrective instructions to an image generator across multiple turns, making accumulated common ground directly observable as a rendered image.

2606.01906.tldr: Bayesian Spectral Emotion Transition Discovery (BSETD), a two-stage framework that discovers emotion-transition structure from multi-rater soft labels, is proposed, demonstrating that a pipeline preserving annotator uncertainty bridges the computational study of emotion dynamics with established psychological theory.

2606.01912.tldr: SMH-Bench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs in smart-home environments and hopes it will facilitate the development of more reliable, context-aware, and practically deployable smart-home agents.

2606.01947.tldr: The potential of PEFT to enable scalable, customizable, and computationally efficient transfer learning for instance segmentation tasks is demonstrated, with key findings indicate that using 2–3 adapters per transformer block offers an optimal balance of performance and efficiency.

2606.01948.tldr: Group Rank-Constrained Deep Matrix Completion (Group RC-DMC), a novel framework that extends RC-DMC by integrating group-level representation learning via a Set-Transformer aggregator, jointly leveraging low-rank structure and attention-based nonlinear modeling, is proposed.

2606.01975.tldr: The results highlight both the promise of verifier-guided evolutionary coding agents for algorithm development/improvement and the continuing importance of evaluation, validation, and interpretation -- and corresponding challenges -- by the human scientist.

2606.01982.tldr: A four-stage NLP framework that combines schema-constrained prompting of a two-model frontier-LLM ensemble against a JSON Schema-enforced seven-slot competency formalism, a verification mechanism that combines per-slot Cohen's kappa, schema conformance, and document-level completeness audits, and is instantiated for a critical application in higher-education quality assurance.

2606.01991.tldr: This work proposes SafeMCP, a server-side defense plugin that constrains tool acquisition via predictive reasoning regarding future safety risks and achieves a safe equilibrium, effectively mitigating risks while preserving agent utility.

2606.01992.tldr: Standard benchmarks overstate the text-guided capabilities of current multimodal anomaly detection systems, and that a protocol of this kind is a prerequisite for models that can be reliably controlled through language for industrial deployment.

2606.01993.tldr: This work proposes MMG2Skill, a closed-loop framework that compiles guides into editable skills, conditions a fixed vision-language model (VLM) agent on these skills during execution, and revises the skills from trajectory-level root-cause feedback without using benchmark scores.

2606.01999.tldr: It is proved that even for processes with memory length $P$, an input window size strictly larger than $P$ is necessary to achieve the minimum attainable error and it is shown how decoupling GPI and CF can improve computational scalability without compromising accuracy.

2606.02000.tldr: This work proposes a render-free framework that conditions video generation directly on compressed 3D human mesh tokens, and suggests that video diffusion models, when equipped with mesh tokenization, can better capture complex 3D human structures and their interactions with the surrounding environment.

2606.02010.tldr: This work evaluates 91 models on the 199 simplest non-isomorphic connected planar graphs and finds edge count is the dominant difficulty predictor ($r = -0.85$) -- a finding not reported in prior LLM graph benchmarks, which use only node count as the difficulty axis.

2606.02011.tldr: The results show that extreme low-bit reasoning becomes practical when its failures are treated as controllable generation pathologies: with lightweight detection and selective FP16 support, 2-bit inference can recover accuracy while preserving real end-to-end speed.

2606.02022.tldr: It is shown that optimizing just a few post-processing parameters significantly boosts AP and FPR-95 without corresponding improvements in assignment-level metrics such as ACC and IPAA, and that Sinkhorn-based normalization can make them perfect.

2606.02035.tldr: RL-ACRGNet, an improved encoder-decoder model that integrates a pre-trained DenseNet encoder with a multilevel LSTM decoder within an off-policy reinforcement learning framework, is proposed and demonstrated that RL-ACRGNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the IU-Xray dataset.

2606.02049.tldr: A framework for explainable deep reinforcement learning (XRL) applied to energy management in residential buildings is presented and results indicate that on-policy algorithms, particularly Advantage Actor Critic (A2C) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) outperform off-policy methods in terms of cumulative rewards and policy stability.

2606.02054.tldr: Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, eMoT improves accuracy and solution consistency over standard Chain-of-Thought and structured reasoning baselines, demonstrating that the performance gains are fundamentally driven by the eMoT framework's reasoning control rather than sheer model size.

2606.02068.tldr: To address the issues of holes and artifacts in sparsely initialized MPI, one-step diffusion is introduced, which participates in both the differentiable optimization of MPI and the postprocessing of rendering results, which is 30.7% faster and uses only 14.8% of its model size.

2606.02080.tldr: Agentic-J is presented, a containerised, multi-agent AI assistant primarily for ImageJ/Fiji that enables biologists to specify analysis tasks in natural language, from nuclei segmentation and cell tracking to multi-condition quantification.

2606.02092.tldr: LALE (Lightweight-transformer Architecture for Land-cover Estimation), an end-to-end remote sensing image segmentation architecture, that bifurcates its encoder by resolution: lightweight ConvMixer stages handle high-resolution local features, while transformer stages handle low-resolution global context, confining the quadratic cost of self-attention to deep, downsampled feature maps.

2606.02093.tldr: This paper uses Gated Experts and Selective Prediction to incorporate gold and predicted ambiguity labels into the error prediction pipeline, and finds that ambiguity information improves error prediction scores across model families, training and evaluation paradigms, datasets, and sources of aleatoric uncertainty.

2606.02107.tldr: Results demonstrate smooth consensus trajectories and planner-tracker integration when compared to a centralized MARL controller, and highlight ND-MARL as a stable framework for distributed, communication-aware quadcopter consensus control.

2606.02109.tldr: BADGER is presented, developed at Merkle, a unified evaluation framework integrating text-to-SQL assessment with agentic behavior evaluation into a production-grade pipeline calibrated against human expert judgment.

2606.02111.tldr: This work introduces Multi-Clip Video (MCV) SafetyBench, a dataset of 2,920 videos designed to evaluate how the diversity of video inputs affects the vulnerability of MLLMs, and proposes a defense strategy that leverages the relative robustness of the image modality.

2606.02113.tldr: This paper is the first primer to synthesize over 150 key public studies and system reports on post-training reasoning data around four questions: what data objects exist, what makes them useful, how they are constructed, and how they scale.

2606.02119.tldr: An unlearning algorithm (HAMU) is derived with the overall goal of guaranteeing a specified improvement in forget quality while minimizing the retain utility cost/degradation by updating the model weights based on the authors' hardness measure.

2606.02120.tldr: An Understanding-Enhanced Model Collaboration Method (UE-MCM) that combines efficient coarse-grained video understanding with accurate fine-grained action reasoning is proposed, making it effective for detecting subtle, rare, and ambiguous mistakes in egocentric instructional videos.

2606.02134.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive multi-objective comparison of certified training approaches, showing that prior advancements are less pronounced than assumed and revealing previously unreported performance complementarities.

2606.02138.tldr: VLBM (Variational Latent Basis Model), a theory guided latent forecasting framework that separates stable dynamics from OOD induced deviations, achieves state of the art OOD robustness and ID accuracy, and supports latent structured forecasting as a principled route to robust prediction under mixed ID and OOD conditions.

2606.02147.tldr: This work introduces MIDI, a multilingual idiom dataset spanning 3 high-, 3 medium-, and 12 low-resource languages, curated by native speakers, which provides idioms embedded in both sentence-level and conversational contexts, capturing both literal and figurative readings.

2606.02151.tldr: A Stochastic Scenario-Structured Tree Search (S3TS) algorithm that explicitly represents uncertainty through scenario trees while enabling the integration of advanced non-linear models is proposed.

2606.02156.tldr: This protocol paper outlines a comprehensive framework for developing and validating an AI-driven system for preoperative risk assessment using pre- and post-contrast CT imaging and demonstrates that such a system is technically feasible and clinically implementable within existing healthcare infrastructures.

2606.02162.tldr: Overall, the study provides a systematic basis for comparing multimodal architectures and offers practical guidance for selecting effective feature combinations and model designs for document type classification.

2606.02163.tldr: This article proposes a set-theoretic framework for belief change, called Abstract Worlds Semantics, in which no logical syntax is assumed, and which provides a homogeneous account of AGM, KM, and Multiple Change models.

2606.02167.tldr: This work shows that AAS capability models, structured using four established Industry 4.0 standards, contain sufficient information to generate complete PDDL problems automatically, and derives all planning elements from domain-level descriptions of resource functions, allowing engineers to model capabilities without any exposure to PDDL syntax or planning concepts.

2606.02178.tldr: This work proposes FLAME, a unified framework that utilizes a LAD map to capture these intrinsic anomalies, coupled with a parameter-efficient adapter for SAM to achieve precise, pixel-level forgery localization, and introduces EditStream, an automated pipeline for continuous, instruction-based training data synthesis.

2606.02179.tldr: Conference on sensitivities yields state-of-the-art OOD performance, while increasingly distant physical fields degrade toward raw parameter conditioning, and results hold across structural TO benchmarks under load shifts and the new CFD-TO dataset under boundary-condition shifts such as multi-outlet configurations.

2606.02211.tldr: Rate Matching Consistency Training (RMCT), which trains for consistency over selected behavioural properties without constraining how this behaviour is expressed, shows that consistency training can improve behavioural robustness without directly trading off against monitorability.

2606.02218.tldr: Straggler-Aware Group Control is proposed, a dynamic group-size controller that adapts the training group online based on observed rollout behavior and is competitive with or better than the strongest static group-size baseline on downstream reasoning benchmarks, and often produces shorter outputs without any explicit length penalty.

2606.02242.tldr: It is observed that I2I ReID pre-training positively impacts the generalization ability to T2I data, and incorporating textual supervision during the vision encoder training stage enhances both I2I and T2I performance.

2606.02251.tldr: This work introduces the Frequency-Weighted Neural Kalman Filter (FW-NKF), a unified hybrid approach that embeds a causal spectral-shaping operator into the Kalman measurement residual and jointly learns observation, and transition networks and confirms that frequency weighting and deep latent-state modeling contribute to overall performance.

2606.02255.tldr: The results show that annotation reporting in NLP has improved over time but remains uneven, and they establish a scalable framework and bare-minimum reporting recommendations for making human annotation more reliable, reproducible, and interpretable.

2606.02276.tldr: It is found that re-linkage rose systematically with specialization: the strongest VLM retrieved the correct report at 15 times chance at a candidate pool of N = 100, 50 times chance at N = 10,000, and well above chance at full-database scale.

2606.02282.tldr: POIROT is presented, a protocol that repurposes a system's own agents as its diagnostic layer, leveraging the epistemic diversity already present in the architecture, and demonstrates that safety oversight need not be externalised.

2606.02287.tldr: Findings show that urban trajectory generation quality is inherently multi-objective, that no single model dominates all criteria equally, and that CityTrajBench provides a reproducible benchmark protocol and testbed for future research on urban mobility generation.

2606.02301.tldr: Quantitative Movement Testing provides an objective, accessible biomarker for tracking disease progression and treatment response in clinical trials, though further research is needed to optimise reliability in home environments.

2606.02302.tldr: SeClaw is introduced, a framework that combines specification-driven security task synthesis with execution-based security evaluation for Autonomous agents and provides a practical foundation for measuring, diagnosing, and comparing security failures in autonomous LLM agents.

2606.02322.tldr: AdvCL combines three plug-in modules: Intra-Smooth promotes local smoothness via small adversarial perturbations; Proto-Clip uses similarity clipping to prevent excessive alignment to current task prototype; and Inter-Align applies directional alignment toward previous task prototype to reduce representational gaps.

2606.02326.tldr: Repairs-Augmented Constraint Learning (RACL), a contextual decision framework that lifts known repair operators into the classifier semantics, reveals an irreducible false-veto gap for terminal-veto rules, separates binary-label non-identifiability from decision-rule learnability, and gives capacity and calibration bounds for the observed-feasibility shared-weight setting.

2606.02337.tldr: Experiments on cooperative navigation tasks show that the CG-CMARL method produces Pareto fronts dominating established baselines trained at fixed reward-shaping ratios, while scaling to team sizes where centralized approaches become intractable.

2606.02355.tldr: Self-Internalizing Reinforcement learning with Intrinsic skills (SIRI), a three-phase framework that enables agents to discover, validate, and internalize skills without external skill generators or inference-time skill banks, is proposed.

2606.02357.tldr: In the settings the authors study, the analyzed agents appear to learn tool-calling patterns more reliably than tool-contributed capabilities, suggesting that evaluation should distinguish tool availability from whether tools actually expand what agents can solve.

2606.02359.tldr: This work formalizes the communication mechanism to construct a structured multi-order evidence stream, and subsequently design a Semantic-Topological Merging algorithm to optimize semantic fidelity within token constraints.

2606.02365.tldr: This work provides a theoretical study of staleness through the complementary lenses of convergence and stability and proposes FOAM, an adaptive algorithm that stabilizes training by dynamically controlling both the damping factor and the eigendecomposition frequency based on an approximation of the staleness-oriented error.

2606.02372.tldr: COMAP is a novel framework that co-evolves textual world models and agent policies through closed-loop interaction and improves the world model's prediction accuracy over time and leads to more effective long-horizon decision-making.

2606.02373.tldr: This work introduces Harness-1, a 20B search agent (retrieval subagent) trained with reinforcement learning inside a stateful search harness, suggesting that reinforcement learning over explicit search state can produce retrieval behaviors that generalize beyond the training domains.

2606.02374.tldr: This perspective paper calls for a paradigm shift toward joint Spatial Representation Learning (SRL) in an unified embedding space that integrate raster perception with vector-based reasoning, arguing that such integration is essential for developing next-generation geospatial AI systems capable of more accurate, interpretable, and semantically grounded understanding of the Earth.

2606.02380.tldr: SPADE-Bench is introduced, a benchmark designed to evaluate spontaneous plan-action divergence that ensures ecological validity and rigorously distinguishes strategic deception from mere hallucination through controlled plan-action comparisons under pressure.

2606.02381.tldr: A generalized operator-based mathematical conflict framework is presented to explicitly represent structural discrepancies between raw data and contextual data, and considers conflict as an independent, operator-based, and component-level mathematical object.

2606.02388.tldr: PaW is a Policy and World modeling co-training framework that adds auxiliary WM supervision to the same policy during RL, without changing the inference paradigm, and shows consistent improvements over strong RL baselines across models and RL algorithms.

2606.02418.tldr: Results show that LLM-guided program evolution can serve as a practical tool for structured quantum-code discovery when paired with independent evaluation.

2606.02424.tldr: Genomics-Guided Cell-Type-Specific Mixture-of-Experts (GC-MoE) is proposed, which estimates cell-type probabilities with a routing network and softly combines cell-type-specific experts for gene expression prediction.

2606.02430.tldr: This study presents a comprehensive study on error propagation in LLM inference, enabled by the proposed LLMFI, a configurable and deterministic fault-injection framework, and introduces four low-overhead directions to improve reliability through software-only modification.

2606.02433.tldr: This work proposes TimeFore, an LLM agent-based framework that decomposes the problem into three collaborative roles: a Retriever autonomously generates SQL to fetch data, a Forecaster invokes external time-series models for higher accuracy, and an Analyzer synthesizes the results to construct a precise and consistent final answer.

2606.02434.tldr: A visual program synthesis framework in which a Vision-Language Model converts inspection images into editable Domain-Specific Language (DSL) code describing circuit geometries, enabling controlled generation of training data with exact parameter manipulation is proposed.

2606.02438.tldr: This work presents the first method for learning domain-dependent heuristics that are admissible by design and thus preserve the optimality guarantees of A* search, using an LLM-driven evolutionary program-synthesis framework to construct abstractions that induce admissible heuristics.

2606.02443.tldr: Results indicate that current models rely on scene-level activity cues rather than reasoning about emerging harm in daily life, where risks are inherently anomalous, yet fire indiscriminately in driving, where routine and hazardous scenes look alike.

2606.02444.tldr: It is found that specific linguistic cues in prompts increase the likelihood of unsafe responses and, through systematically varying the degree of potential risk present in the user prompt, the extent to which LLMs uncritically adapt to problematic, and potentially dangerous user inputs is reported.

2606.02449.tldr: Humanity's Last Line of Verification (HLL) is introduced, a controlled benchmark that uses interactive CAPTCHA verification to evaluate whether agents can cross this boundary through grounded, human-like interaction rather than recognition alone.

2606.02453.tldr: Diversity-inducing Initialization (DivIn), which leverages Langevin dynamics to actively navigate the initialization landscape, steering initial noise away from collapsing regions while anchoring them to the valid data manifold serves as an inference-time diversity enhancement compatible with both diffusion and flow matching models.

2606.02458.tldr: This research shows that tool-augmented AI can learn from experimental data and generate improved domain-relevant interventions, transforming behavioral experimentation from one-shot evaluation into a scalable system for cumulative design learning.

2606.02463.tldr: MASER (Modality-Adaptive SpEcialist Routing), a lightweight framework that trains five different modality adapters of a shared VLM backbone and learns a neural routing policy that selects the best adapter based on the question during inference, is proposed.

2606.02465.tldr: This work proposes Luar, a Language Understanding Boundary-aware Reinforcement Learning framework that trains RLMs to selectively invoke translation when direct understanding is unreliable, and suggests a selective approach to multilingual reasoning.

2606.02470.tldr: MCP-Persona is introduced, the first benchmark specifically designed for evaluating agent performance on real-world, personalized MCP tools and demonstrates their significant struggles with personalized tool use, thereby highlighting the benchmark's crucial role in identifying and addressing these limitations.

2606.02483.tldr: Speculative Tool Privacy Contracts is proposed, a runtime abstraction that treats observation before commitment as a first-class effect, distinct from state mutation, and is implemented in a prototype runtime and evaluated across three corpora.

2606.02484.tldr: The introduction of an agentic research system, Iteris, designed for open problems in computational mathematics, and its application to two open problems from a recent Simons Workshop collection suggest that agentic AI systems can participate meaningfully in research workflows for open problems in computational mathematics.

2606.02488.tldr: RASER (Recoverability-Aware Selective Escalation Router), a family of cheap routers built on one-shot RAG and six features from it, which stays competitive with the other state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines in F1 while spending only 41-49% of always-prune's tokens and also less than the iterative and decomposition retrieval baselines.

2606.02494.tldr: A monitoring and triage methodology that decomposes agentic system evaluation into three dimensions (quality, suitability, efficiency) at three monitoring scopes (within-run, cross-run, structural), using variance as a characterization signal.

2606.02497.tldr: This paper forms this stage as the last-mile forecasting problem and presents an LLM-agent framework that sits on top of a forecasting backbone that maintains a unified forecast workspace, invokes tools to retrieve contextual evidence, and converts reasoning trajectories into explicit forecast revision actions under structural safety constraints.

2606.02526.tldr: This paper first provides a class-conditional distribution perspective to support norm rescaling methods, and proposes a simple but effective approach called Self-Adaptive Monotonic Normalization (SAMN), which avoids the need for parameter regularization and directly enforces monotonicity on per-class weight norms using the Pool Adjacent Violators Algorithm.

2606.02530.tldr: This paper argues that, because safety features are inherently sparse within the output distribution, alignment requires localized modifications rather than global trade-offs, and proposes SafeSteer, which performs on-policy distillation confined to safety tokens.

2606.02536.tldr: This work presents a methodology and framework for measuring agent traits by defining traits as directions in the embedding space of a text embedding model, and builds this trait evaluation into a broader agent-to-agent protocol that enables one agent to evaluate another's skill file updates through a trusted intermediary.

2606.02544.tldr: A simple but effective speculative decoding algorithm for diffusion language models, named SimSD, which mainly adopts a plug-and-play masking strategy that equips dLLMs with temporally valid token-level contexts for speculative decoding, and restores the key verification ability provided by causal masks in AR models while preserving the parallel decoding advantages of dLLMs.

2606.02552.tldr: MDA is introduced, a mixture-density representation that lets the model predict multiple depth hypotheses and their associated probabilities for each pixel and extends to transparent objects and to sky regions, where a dedicated component separates the unbounded sky from finite-depth regions, producing flying-point-free skylines.

2606.02559.tldr: This work introduces SubFit (Submodule-level Fitted residual replacement), which compresses LLMs at the submodule level: Attention and FeedForward submodules are selected non-contiguously, and each receives its own lightweight fitted residual bypass.

2606.02562.tldr: This paper proposes an algorithmic approach to certify high-probability safety of BeliefSF using conformal prediction, while explicitly accounting for the reliability of the robot's runtime inference module.

2606.02568.tldr: ClinEnv is an interactive benchmark that evaluates LLMs as attending physicians over real inpatient admissions under a paradigm the authors term Longitudinal Inpatient Simulation, an interactive benchmark that evaluates both what the model decides, through deterministic ontology-grounded matching, and how it gathers information.

2606.02569.tldr: AdaCodec spends full visual tokens on a reference frame only when its conditional predictive cost is high; otherwise, it encodes inter-frame changes, including motion and prediction residuals, as compact P-tokens.

2606.02578.tldr: The Perceptually Perturbed Judgment Dataset is introduced, which constructs minimally edited counterfactual responses that isolate perceptual errors and enable verifiable supervision, and a unified training framework is developed that combines a structured GRPO-based reward with a batch-ranking objective, achieving coherent global ordering without explicit pairwise labels.

2512.03005.tldr: This work explores whether LLMs can serve not only as moderators that detect harmful content, but as mediators capable of understanding and de-escalating online conflicts.

2605.27762.tldr: Experiments in Minecraft show that PEAM improves long-horizon task performance, mitigates forgetting on previously consolidated skills, and improves parametric-versus-retrieval efficiency over retrieval-based embodied agents and parametric memory variants.

2606.02638.tldr: Experimental results show that SegTune achieves superior controllability and musical coherence compared to existing baselines, and proposes new evaluation metrics to assess segment-level alignment and vocal attribute consistency.

2606.02639.tldr: AReT, an anatomy-regularized tensorial radiance field framework for lung nodule reconstruction using coronal, sagittal, and axial projections from the LIDC-IDRI dataset is proposed, which incorporates chest-anatomy-aware regularization combining L1 sparsity and total variation smoothness.

2606.02640.tldr: D-Judge is introduced, a semantics-preserving output rewriting defense that intervenes directly in this loop by rewriting the victim LLM's responses before they are evaluated by the attacker's judge, thereby derailing the attacker's prompt-refinement process.

2606.02641.tldr: CARVE is introduced, a prediction-free certificate layer over a finite lattice of ego-owned and agent-owned tactical operators that certifies whether a proposed interaction is bounded, attributable, and normatively admissible under declared assumptions.

2606.02642.tldr: It is shown that speech content can induce hallucinations in audio-visual LLMs, which uncovers a new and fundamental limitation of current audio-visual LLMs and highlights the need for speech-grounded video comprehension.

2606.02643.tldr: This work introduces the Retrieval-Augmented Inference Cost Attack (RA-ICA), a novel attacking paradigm that targets the computational cost of RAG-enhanced LLM systems by injecting malicious documents into external knowledge corpus by injecting malicious documents into external knowledge corpus.

2606.02644.tldr: This work presents the first framework for establishing refusal boundaries in offensive security contexts, and assesses how current LLM-powered agents adhere to appropriate refusal boundaries across a range of web-based offensive security scenarios, finding that 6 of 8 frontier models tested show near-zero refusal rates.

2606.02645.tldr: Although linear Q-learning can fail to converge in general, it is proved that, under explicit spectral and step-size conditions, periodic hard target updates and soft target updates can guarantee convergence to the exact projected Q-Bellman solution.

2606.02646.tldr: A two-parameter scaling law is derived that predicts that peer count $k$ and rounds $\tau$ during agent debate enter the dynamics only through their product $k\tau$, and applies at two levels: answer diversity and correctness redundancy.

2606.02659.tldr: A Dynamic Multimodal Data Fusion model based on Contrastive Learning (CL-DMDF), which introduces a novel attention mechanism that operates across both feature and modality dimensions to compute reliable attention scores, effectively reflecting importance at each level

2606.02661.tldr: Experiments show SDIR significantly outperforms SOTA methods in spatial accuracy while achieving spectral fidelity competitive with diffusion-based methods, enabling reliable high-resolution operational nowcasting.

2606.02662.tldr: An adaptive on-the-fly multifidelity framework for machine learning that autonomously determines training dataset composition that reduces data generation costs by up to a factor of 30 compared to single fidelity methods and improves upon standard MFML by up to a factor of 5.

2606.02663.tldr: AdaWeather is introduced, an adaptive framework that combines many probabilistic forecasts using both machine learning as well as mixture of experts to arrive at a unified improved probabilistic forecast.

2606.02671.tldr: This work introduces a decision-focused learning approach based on optimizing normalized discounted cumulative gain (NDCG), a mainstay metric in information retrieval, and establishes the utility of NDCG in survival analysis by proving that it translates to guarantees on the performance of allocation.

2606.02673.tldr: The claim that graphs should be studied not only as external knowledge structures for LLMs, but also as visual scaffolds for organizing reasoning is supported.

2606.02724.tldr: AVTrack is introduced, a human-centric audio-visual instance segmentation (AVIS) dataset designed for dynamic real-world scenarios and established as a challenging benchmark for robust human-centric audio-visual scene understanding in complex environments.

2606.02737.tldr: This work adapts inference-time attention calibration to downstream retrieval and extends it with a strength coefficient lambda that interpolates between the original and fully calibrated attention distributions, finding that partial calibration frequently outperforms full calibration.

2606.02739.tldr: EntangleCodec is proposed, a unified discrete audio tokenizer that learns caption-aligned semantic-acoustic representations before quantization that achieves reconstruction quality competitive with specialized codecs, outperforms all codec-based baselines on audio understanding, and supports both TTS and TTA generation in a unified framework.

2606.02747.tldr: GeoPlanAgent is proposed, a document-grounded, geospatial-tool-in-the-loop system that decomposes the task into evidence extraction, localisation, map registration, boundary segmentation, projection, and verification, substantially outperforming direct VLM-to-GeoJSON baselines.

2606.02753.tldr: MetaWorld is proposed, a novel framework that scales multi-agent video world models to open-domain environments directly from single-view videos and achieves superior cross-view consistency and identity fidelity, establishing a highly scalable, physics-driven paradigm for multi-agent video world modeling.

2606.02755.tldr: This paper contributes an evaluation-protocol extension for operational LLM systems grounded in acceptance-test-driven development, safety engineering, and business-centric validation that translates stakeholder goals into executable behavioral contracts, release gates, monitoring signals, and evidence artifacts before prompt, model, retrieval, or agent changes are accepted.

2606.02765.tldr: Representational capacity is defined as an upper bound on the number of distinguishable directions available for features and embeddings in a model's latent space, and larger models favor tighter orthogonality constraints over maximizing raw capacity.

2606.02775.tldr: AURA-Mem (Action-Utility Recurrent Adaptive Memory) wraps a frozen vision-language-action backbone with a constant-size recurrent memory and a learned gate that writes only when the current observation would change the next action: memory that knows when to stay silent.

2606.02781.tldr: This work proposes an error-resilient CRAM (CRAM-ER) architecture for scalable in-memory matrix-vector multiplications (MVMs) and develops an error-aware model fine-tuning and fine-grained error correction for enhanced error resilience.

2606.02798.tldr: A benchmark for evaluating personalized decision modeling from real-world behavioral traces, and provides an evaluation setting for studying whether personalized methods can use real-world behavioral evidence rather than simulated users alone.

2606.02812.tldr: Traj-Evolve is presented, a self-evolving multi-agent system with two complementary evolving mechanisms, one of which is multi-agent reinforcement learning via reward-ranked fine-tuning, which optimizes inter-agent and agent-memory collaboration.

2606.02814.tldr: This work investigates whether supervised bi-encoder retrievers implicitly learn a document-level relevance prior, and finds that supervised neural retrievers encode relevance priors that generalize to unseen documents and are consistent across models.

2606.02822.tldr: This work adds four OWASP-LLM-Top-10-aware agents to a 21-agent baseline scanner and targets a lattice of four synthetic LLM endpoints, probing brittleness under paraphrasing and measuring attribution.

2606.02832.tldr: Three different novel approaches to generate enemy morphologies based on player collision information are explored, finding that each provides different strengths and weaknesses, but all had equivalent or better performance than an evolutionary baseline adapted from prior robotics morphology work.

2606.02834.tldr: This work presents the first byte-native LLM, capable of responding to complex questions about malware binaries, with accuracies ranging from 69% for malware family classification to 98% for architecture classification.

2606.02835.tldr: A prefix-level trajectory evaluation protocol grounded in reasoning sufficiency is introduced, defining the minimum reasoning budget required for a model to first generate the correct answer, and it is found that many instances considered reasoning-intensive require surprisingly little reasoning.

2606.02837.tldr: An LLM-based framework to support humans in manual reviewing NL-to-FOL datasets is proposed, empirically showing that it is possible to achieve 90% dataset accuracy after reviewing fewer than 24% of instances, compared to over 70% required by unguided review.

2606.02857.tldr: GRZO is a Group-Relative Zeroth-Order optimizer that draws one pseudo-independent perturbation per mini-batch example and aggregates the per-example losses through group-relative normalization, raising the effective gradient-direction count from one to the batch size at no additional forward cost while preserving inference-level memory.

2606.02859.tldr: This work shows that, initialized with weak agents, the economy produces emergent multi-step reasoning strategies and outperforms stronger monolithic baselines across five agentic tasks, including mathematical reasoning, financial research, scientific research, accelerator design, and distributed-system optimization.

2606.02860.tldr: It is found that a significant portion of apparent forgetting can be attributed to interface drift between internal stages rather than permanent erasure of task-relevant computation, suggesting that continual learning may require better mechanisms for indexing and re-accessing latent computations, not only methods that prevent weight change.

2606.02862.tldr: A modular reference architecture for Embedded Agent Systems is proposed that bridges the divide between deterministic real-time control and agentic intelligence, and a key contribution is the integration of a cross-cutting Governance Layer, ensuring observability, policy enforcement, and safety across distributed fleets of autonomous devices.

2606.02863.tldr: GAMBLe is introduced, a framework that decomposes ADRS behavior into four parameters and one compositional object, the effective landscape, which reveals that distinct generator-assessor pairs induce structurally different per-problem optimization landscapes.

2606.02866.tldr: A debate benefit condition is derived: debate helps when the probability of rescuing a wrong output (Critic verification odds weighted by fixability) exceeds the probability of destroying a correct one.

2606.02867.tldr: The Epi-LLM framework is introduced: a novel integration of agent-based modelling, real-life epigames, and large language models in which a synthetic society of agents reasons and adapts dynamically over an outbreak contact network.

2606.02871.tldr: Adaptive Latent Agentic Reasoning (ALAR), a dual-mode framework that uses compact latent reasoning for routine turns and selectively escalates to explicit chain-of-thought when deeper deliberation is needed, is proposed.

2606.02875.tldr: This work studies the rediscovery cost imposed when a predecessor's work is opaque or incomplete, and suggests that coding-agent evaluation should report not only whether a task is solved, but also how costly that work is for another agent to resume.

2606.02883.tldr: This work investigates whether LLM-assisted reranking, while improving personalization, inadvertently amplifies exposure to ideologically extreme or conspiratorial political content, and highlights the power of LLMs to operationalize contextual nuance in high-stakes recommendation.

2606.02884.tldr: It is shown that reward hacking arises from an approximation made in most practical implementations of reward-guided diffusion -- finite-particle plug-in estimation of the Doob h-function -- even in the simplest non-trivial settings of Gaussian and Gaussian mixture targets with quadratic rewards.

2606.02908.tldr: WRIT is proposed, a pipeline for synthesizing multi-turn agent training trajectories along two complexity axes: the number of write decisions in a task and the evidence burden of each individual decision.

2502.08006.tldr: This work shows that these two seemingly separate families of techniques for gradient-based guidance can actually be unified by looking at posterior guidance as a greedy strategy of end-to-end guidance and shows a method for interpolating between these two families enabling a trade-off between compute and accuracy of the guidance gradients.

2506.01969.tldr: A novel framework that enhances MLA inference for the single-instance deployment scenario on NVIDIA H20 GPUs, and proposes the Efficient Transpose Attention Pipeline (ETAP), which reconfigures attention computation through transposition to align the KV context length with the \(M\)-dimension in WGMMA operations, significantly reducing redundant computations.

2506.03087.tldr: This work proposes a novel stealing framework that integrates explanation alignment for capturing decision logic with guided data augmentation for efficient training under limited queries, enabling effective replication of both the predictive behavior and underlying reasoning patterns of target models.

2506.21129.tldr: A curriculum-guided adaptation framework that progressively exposes a robust policy to gradient-based adversarial observation perturbations of increasing intensity while aligning temporal-difference error distributions across curriculum stages to promote transferability across attack conditions is proposed.

2507.19684.tldr: This work presents CoMPAS3D, a motion capture dataset of improvised partner salsa paired with an evaluation framework covering kinematic quality, two objective metrics (move legibility and proficiency appropriateness), and six competition-based subjective dimensions.

2509.19305.tldr: Wavelet Fourier Diffuser is proposed, a novel diffusion-based RL framework that integrates Discrete Wavelet Transform to decompose trajectories into low- and high-frequency components and employs Short-Time Fourier Transform and cross attention mechanisms to extract frequency-domain features and facilitate cross-frequency interaction.

2509.22468.tldr: C-FREE (Contrast-Free Representation learning on Ego-nets), a simple framework that integrates 2D graphs with ensembles of 3D conformers with state-of-the-art results on MoleculeNet, surpassing contrastive, generative, and other multimodal self-supervised methods.

2603.20508.tldr: This work describes a goal to achieve weak-to-strong legibility in reasoning language models, and suggests that adoption of weak monitors may become a standard for reliability scaffolds on a healthy budget.

2603.23117.tldr: It is shown that CoT reasoning introduces a novel attack vector for targeted behavior hijacking--for example, causing a robot to mistakenly deliver a knife to a person instead of an apple--without modifying the user's instruction.

2605.08426.tldr: This work proves that the answer is negative: drawing from incomplete contract theory, it is formally shown that when contracts cannot distinguish all relevant future contingencies, there is a strictly positive welfare loss that no realistic mechanism can eliminate.

2605.08767.tldr: This work introduces EDMolGPT, a decoder-only autoregressive framework that generates molecules from low-resolution ED point clouds that mitigates structural bias and produces molecules with 3D conformations.

2605.18160.tldr: The Vision Inference Former (VIF) is proposed, a lightweight architectural module that establishes a direct bridge between pure visual representations and the model's output space, ensuring that the model remains firmly grounded in visual content during generation.

2605.18740.tldr: Experiments on multiple fine-grained visual understanding benchmarks show that Vision-OPD models achieve competitive or superior performance against much larger open-source, closed-source, and"Thinking-with-Images"agentic models.

2605.19805.tldr: Latent Laplace Diffusion is presented, a generative framework that models the target as a low-dimensional latent trajectory, enabling horizon-wide generation without step-by-step integration over physical time, and its continuous-time generative nature supports missing-value imputation by querying the same model at historical timestamps.

2605.20731.tldr: A criterion-agnostic signal-validation framework based on Kendall's $\tau$, majority-vote probability, and Condorcet cycles against exact iid-uniform nulls; the analysis reveals significant but moderate designer agreement, with every TASTE criterion rejecting the random-rater null.

2605.28556.tldr: The proposed TASTE: Task Synthesis from Tool Sequence Evolution, an automatic method that generates challenging tasks with broader tool-use coverage by automating the generation of difficult, high-coverage benchmarks, enables continuous, scalable evaluation of future agents.

2605.29930.tldr: A world-model theory of cognitive diversity and alignment is developed by reconstructing recognition as the construction of such approximate sufficient statistics under finite informational, representational, observational, and action constraints by reconstructing recognition as the Multi-Phase Inference Assumption.

2606.00809.tldr: This work proposes NBQ, a plug-and-play framework that seeds a diverse pool of candidate questions, maintains a compact and continuously updated user state, adaptively selects the next question within a turn budget, and distills the resulting free-form dialogue into a structured vector-based user profile.

2606.01013.tldr: The case study shows that AI review can cover a significant fraction of human-raised issues, but also raises issues missing in human review, and the potential and limitation of AI-based peer review.

2606.01162.tldr: To the authors' knowledge, DEFT is the first to introduce and validate a Mixture-of-Experts architecture for dynamic cloud workflow scheduling, and significantly reduces execution cost and deadline violations, outperforming multiple state-of-the-art DRL baselines.

2606.01269.tldr: The results ground a 50-year-old behavioural regularity in the geometry of learned representations, offering a mechanistic account of transitive inference that bridges cognitive science and modern neural networks.

2606.01472.tldr: HOPM is presented, a hierarchical online prompt mutation framework evaluated on a real marketplace dispute-evidence workflow and includes control setup, sample sizes, confidence intervals, paired tests, prompt-token categories, pseudocode, schema, rubric, guardrail taxonomy, and a constructed example so the evaluation structure can be reproduced without exposing proprietary evidence.

2606.01767.tldr: EvoBrain is proposed, a dynamic, task-aware continual learning framework for unified EEG decoding that pioneers cross-task continual learning in the EEG domain, advancing the realization of a unified, one-for-all brain decoding system.

2606.01904.tldr: This work introduces KliniskVestBERT, a suite of three BERT-based encoder models pre-trained on a substantial corpus of real-world, de-identified Norwegian clinical texts from Helse Vest, highlighting the significant benefit of domain-specific pre-training for NLP tasks within the clinical domain.

2606.02060.tldr: This work proposes DRIFT, a claim-centric auditing framework that tracks agent claims, checks their support in trajectory evidence, and marks spans where unsupported or conflicting claims affect the answer path, and improves span-level error localization and first-error accuracy by up to 30 percentage points.

2606.02132.tldr: EAPO introduces tool-free trajectories into each rollout group, applies difficulty-aware reward shaping to penalize redundant tool calls mainly on easier queries, and uses confidence-aware token reweighting to improve policy learning.

2606.02240.tldr: AGENTREDBENCH is introduced, a dynamic LLM-driven redteaming benchmark of 215 subtle underspecified-authorization scenarios across 24 enterprise integrations and five attack types, and AGENTREDGUARD, a dynamic LLM-driven redteaming benchmark of 215 subtle underspecified-authorization scenarios, is introduced.

2606.02332.tldr: SISA (SSM-Informed Softmax Attention), which adds an SSM-derived importance term directly inside the attention score and realizes the full operation as a single SDPA call on augmented query/key vectors, defines a third design axis for SSM-attention hybrids -- score-level fusion -- beyond the block-level and head-level paradigms that have dominated the field.

2606.02461.tldr: An evaluation framework AgentCL for continual learning in agents, centered on controlled task streams and metrics for transfer gains is presented, and MemProbe, a probing method that stores interactions, insights, and skills, while filtering unreliable experiences during consolidation is developed.

2606.02951.tldr: This work introduces a Blender-based agent environment that exposes realistic PTZ control affordances and enables reproducible, language-driven tasks aligned with real-world camera operation, and identifies a practical, sim-to-real–validated design point for real-time, edge-feasible language-driven PTZ control.

2606.02958.tldr: Echelon is presented, a boundary-first training architecture that enforces device-level model-state non-export as a systems invariant and improves time-to-target under WAN latency relative to a privacy-parityDiLoCo+SA baseline, and quality degrades by at most 2.2% under 200ms emulated latency or severe non-IID partitioning.

2606.02962.tldr: A hand-trajectory encoder is proposed for converting a sequence of hand skeletons into highly-semantic hand kinematic features, which are then aligned and combined with pretrained video--text features through a cross-attention fusion strategy with adaptive gating.

2606.02965.tldr: A three-gap taxonomy of abstention-warranted scenarios is introduced, covering specification gaps where required information is absent, verification gaps where world state cannot be confirmed, and authority gaps where explicit authorization has not been given, which together provide a principled basis for constructing abstention-aware agent benchmarks.
