2606.02967.tldr: This work introduces Glass Box: a runtime constitutional AI verification layer that intercepts every candidate action from an onboard AI policy and evaluates it against six physics-grounded constitutional constraints and seven Linear Temporal Logic safety invariants before a single command reaches any spacecraft subsystem.

2606.02974.tldr: The results indicate that the proposed approach to recognize three distinct human activities using the Wallhack1.8k WiFi spectrogram dataset is robust, reliable, and suitable for real-world deployment in diverse environments with different hardware configurations.

2606.02979.tldr: This work presents a novel compact deep multi-task learning model to handle various autonomous driving perception tasks in one forward pass and provides an adaptive loss weighting algorithm to tackle the imbalanced learning issue.

2606.02991.tldr: This work introduces TypewriterLM, a 7.24B History language model trained exclusively on English text predating 1913, and introduces lexically grounded instructing tuning, a post-training framework that constraints responses to remain directly grounded in historical source documents.

2606.02994.tldr: Across five comparable subtasks spanning narrative deduction, rule application, and constraint-satisfaction planning, a single fixed configuration improves over zero-shot Chain-of-Thought on every subtask, matches or surpasses expert-authored decompositions, and outperforms AWM at lower average inference cost.

2606.03005.tldr: MUSE is introduced, a multimodal unified structured execution harness that wraps any off-the-shelf MLLM with composable modules for task representation, visual processing, perception tool use, structured parsing, deterministic verification, and verifier-guided repair, without any model retraining.

2606.03017.tldr: Factorized Contrastive Abstractions for Transferable IRL (ConTraIRL), a framework that enables compositional reward transfer by learning decoupled latent representations of these two factors, is proposed.

2606.03019.tldr: It is argued that a functional analogue of copyleft for AGI must be grounded not in share-alike clauses over code, but in reproducible builds: a practice guaranteeing bit-exact reconstructability from declared inputs.

2606.03022.tldr: This work proposes that hallucinations manifest as orthogonal noise relative to the semantic manifold of the residual stream, and introduces Dynamic Contextual Orthogonalization (DCO), an inference-time intervention method that achieves superior contextual faithfulness compared to state-of-the-art intervention baselines.

2606.03026.tldr: A C++ CPU inference runtime that treats sparse binary spike states as an execution primitive rather than only applying post-hoc weight compression, which can improve CPU throughput and memory behavior for sparse spiking language models.

2606.03029.tldr: This work proposes two econometrics-inspired methods: one introduces feature--covariate interactions to detect sign reversals, and the other applies within-stratum demeaning and inverse-frequency reweighting to equalize underrepresented strata.

2606.03031.tldr: This work proposes AuditFlow, a graph-grounded multi-agent framework that separates adaptive search from deterministic verification, and builds a symbolic environment from a static US-GAAP taxonomy graph and a dynamic XBRL filing graph and exposes it through typed tools for fact retrieval, taxonomy traversal, numerical checking, and rule evaluation.

2606.03034.tldr: A failure taxonomy that names confident-wrong as a non-adversarial, correlated subclass of Byzantine faults that classical fault-tolerance mismodels is named, a market-for-lemons model showing that faith-based protocols admit only a low-trust equilibrium, and a market-for-lemons model showing that faith-based protocols admit only a low-trust equilibrium.

2606.03036.tldr: TriEval is being released as open source to enable broader access for researchers with limited computational resources and show clear differences between open-source and closed-source models, especially in terms of toxicity and truthfulness.

2606.03040.tldr: This work proposes RelGT-AC (Relational Graph Transformer for Autocomplete), extending the RelGT architecture with three targeted contributions: a column masking strategy that prevents trivial solutions by masking the target column during subgraph encoding, a unified task head supporting binary classification, multiclass classification, and regression autocomplete tasks within a single model.

2606.03054.tldr: ToolGate is introduced, a lightweight external controller that predicts execute/skip decisions from trajectory text and simple structural features that reduces token cost to 64-69% of the unrestricted ReAct baseline while preserving average accuracy in cross-domain settings.

2606.03056.tldr: SkillDAG is presented, which models inter-skill relationships as a typed directed graph and exposes it to an LLM agent as an inference-time, agent-callable structural retrieval interface, queried and evolved during execution rather than baked into a fixed retrieval pipeline.

2606.03057.tldr: A systematic benchmark evaluating LLM molecular competence across nine representations and eight chemical tasks argues against representation-invariant evaluation and motivate task-aware representation routing for LLM-based chemistry.

2606.03066.tldr: By performing conflict-oriented representation enhancement and reasoning based on CAC, CORE achieves robust and generalizable conflict detection, effectively and rapidly adapting to unseen manipulation types with a few samples or in even zero-shot settings.

2606.03068.tldr: MAVN is proposed, an end-to-end differentiable MPNN framework that allows non-constrained connections between nodes and VNs and dynamically introduces VNs on demand in response to evolving node representations across layers and theoretically proves that for any node-VN connectivity pattern, there exists a set of MAVN's parameters that can simulate the pattern.

2606.03069.tldr: Improvements to the WT-PSE learning framework are examined to indicate that training-level improvements can provide consistent performance gains without modifying the underlying WT-PSE architecture.

2606.03073.tldr: JF-HPO is empowered by a small proxy model of the target LLM for efficient training and evaluation in each HPO trial, and it integrates carefully designed early-stopping strategies based on training dynamics to eliminate redundant computations.

2606.03080.tldr: Regret Pre-training, a self-supervised framework grounded in the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm, employs a dual-view architecture in which a single model generates both a causal Student distribution and a future-conditioned Teacher distribution that minimizes the KL divergence from teacher to student.

2606.03083.tldr: DeltaMem is proposed, a framework that organizes experience memory into two independent residual trees, one storing goal-conditioned task experience as reusable skills and another for scene-level environment knowledge, allowing related experiences to share a common foundation without duplication.

2606.03093.tldr: A nested geometric decomposition framework that treats prompting as a transformation of the representational geometry of the content following the prompt and reveals how models route task-relevant structure to produce prompt-driven behavior is introduced.

2606.03097.tldr: A novel framework that combines importance-aware news compression and process-level retrieval supervision, and introduces a process reward model that ranks multiple supplementary-news candidates conditioned on the current error profile and the history of previously selected articles, replacing one-shot blind retrieval with quality-controlled selection.

2606.03099.tldr: PhotoCraft is proposed, a training-free, hierarchical memory system for photo-search agents that equips MLLMs with working, episodic, and semantic memory, which are dynamically invoked during reasoning to preserve logical consistency and knowledge transferability throughout multi-step reasoning and answer generation.

2606.03103.tldr: DeskCraft is introduced, a desktop GUI benchmark targeting long horizon creative and engineering workflows and proactive human-agent collaboration and will open-source all evaluation codes, tasks, and data at https://github.com/mrwwk/DeskCraft.

2606.03116.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate that AnyAudio-Judge not only significantly enhances zero-shot alignment detection compared to state-of-the-art baselines, but also provides precise and interpretable reward signals that substantially improve instruction alignment in downstream reinforcement learning for audio generation.

2606.03119.tldr: This work introduces a weak prior, which is unseen during bridge pre-training, hindering prior exploitation and thereby degrading denoising result, and develops a cascaded framework, CFG-FMPG, which first generates a noisy hidden representation via CFG and then exploits it as a generative prior with FMPG, fulfilling their complementary strengths without compromising inference efficiency.

2606.03128.tldr: This study introduces an efficient end-to-end smart contract security audit framework utilizing lightweight, highly optimized open-source LLMs (0.6B-4B parameters), and empirically validate the superiority of the decoupled audit processes over unified prompting and uncover a novel severity centrality bias.

2606.03135.tldr: This work proposes a goal-oriented clarification framework that aligns clarification behavior with ambiguity resolution, and trains the clarifier using this reward to optimize for high information gain, ensuring that clarifications effectively reduce uncertainty and improve task completion within the agent-tool-user environment.

2606.03137.tldr: TBS (Think-Before-Speak), an interval-based multi-agent simulation framework that separates agents' private reasoning from public utterance generation, is introduced and it is suggested that TBS supports mechanism-sensitive social simulation by making the pathway from internal evaluation to public expression observable and analyzable.

2606.03144.tldr: GTBench is introduced, a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLMs as mathematical research assistants in graph theory, comprising 63 problems organized into three groups of increasing difficulty: undergraduate definitions and basic properties (Group 1), algorithm tracing and structural reasoning (Group 2), and graduate-level proof construction (Group 3).

2606.03157.tldr: ClinicalMC, a benchmark for multi-course clinical decision-making and a multi-agent evaluation framework that includes patient, examiner, and doctor agents, is proposed to better understand LLM performance in the medical domain and support its effective deployment in healthcare.

2606.03159.tldr: Preliminary results indicate that a world-action model (WAM) post-trained from OmniDreams achieves strong performance on the Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec dataset, surpassing the VLA-based Alpamayo 1.5 research policy model while using only 1/5 the total parameters.

2606.03165.tldr: Two curation-free, assumption-light evaluation metrics are introduced: the Lexical Alignment Score, which identifies lexical overuse, and the Triangulated Preference Shift, which quantifies how much of such shifts can be attributed to human preference learning.

2606.03198.tldr: Findings support rubric anchoring as the scoring protocol that preserves discriminative power in clinical AI evaluation; rubric-free scoring cannot substitute when questions require patient-specific or jurisdiction-specific criteria that rater models cannot infer from parametric knowledge alone.

2606.03203.tldr: This work introduces MedCUA-Bench, an interactive benchmark for clinical computer-use agents, reconstructed from real product manuals and open-source medical systems to capture authentic clinical interfaces while avoiding licensing and privacy constraints.

2606.03214.tldr: This study evaluates the performance of skin lesion classification using ResNet-based convolutional models, focusing on the impact of demographic bias in training data, particularly variations in patient sex and age, to advance equitable AI in medical imaging.

2606.03220.tldr: This work introduces WebRISE, which compiles task requirements into Interaction Contract Graphs of observable states, user-intent transitions, and DOM/visual assertions for implementation-agnostic browser execution.

2606.03223.tldr: This system enhances robot storytelling with flexible scenarios, enabling young children to create robot dramas with everyday objects, enabling young children to create robot dramas with everyday objects.

2606.03232.tldr: Through the first systematic benchmarking of model merging for GNNs, it is shown that existing methods designed for vision and language catastrophically fail on force field regression, while GFFMERGE recovers performance approaching gold standard joint training.

2606.03236.tldr: The Pre-Reasoning Perception Framework is proposed, a two-stage framework built on perceiving before reasoning that substantially reduces false trigger rates (FTR) while improving success rates (SR) and inference efficiency over the ProactiveMobile baseline.

2606.03237.tldr: This work contends that superintelligence, an extremely capable task solver, born out of a solipsistic approach to AI design, is unlikely to be cooperative, and calls for a non-solipsistic research paradigm that treats interdependence as a core design principle rather than approaching cooperation as a task to solve.

2606.03251.tldr: The results indicate that real-world datasets do contain natural experiments and they can take advantage of those natural experiments to improve model performance using causal inference.

2606.03252.tldr: This work designs a navigation framework that navigates with a reinforcement-learning-based policy on top of a world-model-based environment understanding to overcome environment-dependent and generalizing issues in navigating complex, unseen environments and escaping local optima where other methods fail.

2606.03257.tldr: Experimental results show that PSViT effectively obtains 22.4% memory saving through single-shot pruning, while maintaining high accuracy within 3% from the original non-pruned SViT model on the ImageNet-1K.

2606.03260.tldr: EqGINO is a geometrically robust framework that enforces isotropy in the spectral domain that robustly models coordinate-invariant physical laws on complex irregular 3D geometries and guarantees exact equivariance to the discrete symmetries inherent to the discretized computational domain.

2606.03269.tldr: The method prompts an LLM to extend an initial VQA reasoning theory, expressed as an answer-set program, to meet new requirements of the task, and suggests that rule distillation from LLMs is a promising alternative to traditional data-driven rule learning approaches.

2606.03273.tldr: Experiments show that even state-of-the-art MLRMs remain far from solving VistaHop, with the best-performing model, SenseNova-MARS-32B, achieving only 26.33% Pass@1.

2606.03288.tldr: Generated Animated Traces (GATs) are proposed, AI-generated, analogy-based, narrated animations that coordinate source code, execution state, and conceptual analogies that coordinate source code, execution state, and conceptual analogies.

2606.03290.tldr: Through the PS-Theory, it is proved that the adaptation capacity of MTG can exceed the theoretical upper bound of graph prompt tuning, and Message Tuning for GFMs (MTG), a lightweight approach that injects a small set of learnable message prototypes into each layer of the GNN backbone to adaptively guide message fusion without updating pre-trained weights.

2606.03310.tldr: An adaptive multi-scale hyperedge learning framework, i.e., MuHL, which constructs hierarchical node features and dynamically learns high-order interactions through continuous hyperedge construction over multi-resolution graph signals is introduced.

2606.03312.tldr: Using RobotValues, a benchmark to evaluate household robot planners in 10K value-conflict scenarios, it is suggested that household robot evaluation should measure not only task completion or safety compliance, but also whether robots can choose among plausible actions when human values conflict.

2606.03322.tldr: This work proposes an integrated framework guiding diffusion process at each node by a downstream transformer where both short- and long-range properties of graphs are aggregated via diffusion-kernel and multi-head attention respectively and demonstrates the superiority of this model by improving performance of pre-clinical Alzheimer's disease classification with various modalities.

2606.03326.tldr: The Violation Situation Pattern (VSP) reifies each detected violation as a graph node with a rule identifier, a temporal validity interval, a lifecycle state, and evidence links to the entities involved, which separates a pattern contribution from a detector contribution.

2606.03330.tldr: This paper introduces instance-level fingerprinting, a regulator-oriented paradigm that distinguishes configurations of the same LLM, and exploits biases in generated binary random sequences to reach 96% and 90% identification accuracy across 237 model instances, showing that instance-level fingerprinting is both necessary for regulation and practically feasible.

2606.03331.tldr: This work evaluates six state-of-the-art LLMs in English and Bangla using four repair-specific criteria: correctness, completeness, practicality, and safety, and shows that while LLMs can provide useful repair assistance, they remain unreliable for high-risk real-world repair tasks without rigorous evaluation and explicit safety safeguards.

2606.03347.tldr: This work proposes AugMask, a plug-and-play training framework that adapts missing-unaware backbones to incomplete data by separating conditioning from supervision, and shows that marginalizing missing entries yields a variance-weighted sensitivity penalty, discouraging over-reliance on uncertain completions.

2606.03348.tldr: SYNCRED-Bench is introduced, a benchmark of 600 AI-generated misinformation images balanced across six credible-form categories and seven fine-grained circulation styles to establish synthetic credibility as a severe and underexplored visual misinformation challenge, and provide a benchmark for developing detectors that reason beyond superficial credibility cues.

2606.03381.tldr: This work systematically demonstrates that the SCA is fundamentally invalid in the presence of coordinated threat actors, such as Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs), and introduces a modular, open-source framework called CerberusAI for reproducible model-stealing research, and uses it to simulate distributed attack scenarios.

2606.03385.tldr: GTP-FA (Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution), a task-oriented two-stage grasp-then-plan framework that generates grasp candidates and performs downstream motion planning conditioned on the selected grasp, is proposed.

2606.03391.tldr: HARC is proposed, a training-free framework that leverages second-order curvature information to realign the merged router and effectively mitigates routing breakdown across diverse MoE merging baselines and leads to substantial performance improvements.

2606.03398.tldr: This paper investigates the causal role of representational analysis in transformers trained on next token prediction over counter languages, and finds strong empirical evidence that the stack representation is not just learned, but is causally necessary for model performance.

2606.03428.tldr: The proposed PrimeSVT framework performs automated memory-aware structured pruning on pre-trained SViT models, thereby maximizing their efficiency gains during inference amenable to widely-used computing architectures and enables design automation for SViTs and their embedded implementation.

2606.03430.tldr: FlowGuard is proposed, an identity-independent defence based on flow matching that classifies incoming queries as out-of-distribution (OOD) prior to IDS processing that results in measurably lower log-likelihoods when using a Continuous Normalizing Flow that has been trained on legitimate data.

2606.03432.tldr: The proposed method uses feature fusion after extracting relevant malware features such as API calls and fixed and variable length n-grams with a customized feature selection method and indicates the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed approach.

2606.03435.tldr: CP-Agent is introduced, an agentic multimodal large language model capable of generating mechanism-relevant, human-interpretable rationales for cell morphological changes under drug perturbations that highlights CP-Agent's potential to accelerate drug discovery by enabling more interpretable, scalable, and context-aware phenotypic screening.

2606.03444.tldr: A novel dual-stream Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that synergizes VFMs via modular specialization, validating that sparse, emergent specialization is a scalable approach for integrating diverse visual knowledge.

2606.03453.tldr: This paper presents FORGE, a multi-agent system that bridges these three silos through graduated exploitation depth, and demonstrates how a tiered knowledge architecture accumulates intelligence across assessments, transferring build and exploitation experience to subsequent CVEs.

2606.03459.tldr: Tonal parsimony preserves the transition optimum while reducing tonal vocabulary in 55.8% of cases, supporting tractable professional-scale harmonic analysis and minimizes lexicographically the number of modulations and then the number of distinct tonalities.

2606.03461.tldr: The results suggest that the frontier of agent post-training lies beyond mere outcome-matching, shifting the focus toward "Harness Engineering", where the systematic design of environment-grounded interaction structures serves as the primary catalyst for reproducible and generalizable agentic intelligence.

2606.03463.tldr: The results show that it is possible to eliminate LLM calls from the memory-management loop, reducing token costs to nearly zero and enabling deterministic memory systems for conversational AI agents.

2606.03465.tldr: A fundamental mismatch is identified between the shared subspaces assumed by tensor decompositions and the heterogeneous representations learned by modern LLMs, thereby delineating their practical limits and clarifying their viable role in large-scale deployment.

2606.03467.tldr: Experimental results on the Who&When benchmark demonstrate that StepFinder outperforms LLM-based methods in step-level failure attribution while achieving substantially higher inference efficiency, reducing inference time by 79% compared with the fastest LLM-based method, with no text generation overhead.

2606.03483.tldr: It is shown that breaking symmetry at stream initialization reduces dominant behavior and improves performance acrossHyper-Connections variants, and it is shown that breaking symmetry at stream initialization reduces dominant behavior and improves performance across \textit{m}HC variants.

2606.03486.tldr: NeuroArmor is proposed, a white-box runtime defense that uses prompt-specific safe variants as a local safety reference for deciding when intervention is needed and, once triggered, as safe targets for intervention.

2606.03503.tldr: This work proposes ThoughtFold, a framework that leverages fine-grained preference learning to mitigate redundant explorations for efficient reasoning and reduces the token usage of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B by approximately 56% while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy.

2606.03512.tldr: An overhauled annotation tool built on ROS 2, and a novel training strategy that integrates diffusion-based augmentation into baseline behavioral cloning models are introduced that attains diffusion-level generalization while preserving the real-time, on-edge properties of state-of-the-art models.

2606.03517.tldr: A training framework that reduces this cost to logarithmic in the number of qubits, making gradient-based QNN optimisation feasible on near-term hardware at increasing scales and validated on clinical data imputation using MIMIC-III electronic health record dataset.

2606.03518.tldr: This paper proposes a compositional governance framework that introduces primitives indispensable for agentic AI, and defines a compositional operator that overlays new agentic semantics, such as recursive delegation chains, onto existing relational policies without rewriting them.

2606.03521.tldr: This work introduces post-hoc robustification of deep RL agents at inference time by using the learned model in combination with a trained nominal policy, and utilizes model-predictive control under adversarial rollouts, which are approximated via projected gradient descent within a bounded uncertainty set.

2606.03523.tldr: This work presents a high-precision APT malware attribution method based on ranked binary classifiers with explicit abstention, which achieves higher precision than previously published results on the same dataset.

2606.03532.tldr: Consolidation-Gated Teacher Refresh (CGTR), which preserves isolation periods while gating each refresh on joint evidence of reward improvement and length-tail safety, ensuring every teacher movement responds to genuine student consolidation rather than a clock signal.

2606.03544.tldr: This work introduces SAGE (Social Agent Group Evolution), an evaluation framework that compares two compute-matched conditions: SocialEvo, where agents from five distinct model families co-evolve with access to all peers' histories; and SelfEvo, where each agent receives the same number of task attempts but sees only its own past.

2606.03557.tldr: An SLM-based Agent Orchestration Gateway is presented, a lightweight runtime coordination mechanism that decouples a virtual world client from heterogeneous AI backends through intent-driven service routing, and the findings show that SLMs can support practical AI service orchestration in virtual worlds.

2606.03566.tldr: A SwinUNETR-driven pipeline that leverages targeted intra- and peri-ventricular small patch sampling to automatically segment the LVCP in MS from both standalone and multi-modal MRI inputs is developed, offering an accurate, robust, and statistically superior alternative to current leading models for LVCP segmentation.

2606.03568.tldr: Two learned filtering modules that replace heuristic non-maximum suppression (NMS) by leveraging relations among detections are introduced, offering a principled alternative to heuristic suppression.

2606.03569.tldr: Structure-to-Semantics (STS) is introduced, a novel two-stage visual token pruning framework that explicitly decouples the pruning process and mitigates the redundancy caused by attention-based selection, improving both structural diversity and fine-grained task alignment of the preserved visual tokens.

2606.03601.tldr: DDOR (Delta Debugging for OverRefusal), a fully automated and explainable framework for overrefusal testing and repair in a black-box setting, where only model inputs and outputs are accessible and internal safety mechanisms remain opaque, is presented.

2606.03602.tldr: CauTion is a framework that reliably integrates LLM domain knowledge into an ensemble of statistical causal discovery algorithms through consensus filtering and LLM reliability estimation, and consistently outperforms both data-centric and LLM-augmented baselines.

2606.03608.tldr: TTRL-CoCoV (Test-Time Reinforcement Learning with Confidence-Conditioned Verification with Confidence-Conditioned Verification), a novel confidence-adaptive framework that expands Pass@k coverage and improves Pass@1 performance, is proposed.

2606.03618.tldr: A pre-flight, edge-side prompt-rewriting middleware that operates between the developer and the cloud agent is introduced that demonstrates that proactive prompt optimization can substantially reduce inference costs without sacrificing coding quality.

2606.03620.tldr: This work proposes Physics-Guided Policy Optimization (PGPO), which introduces an information-modulated step-size multiplier derived from a mutual-information estimate between the student's predictions and the feedback-conditioned teacher, which preserves the order-1 weak-approximation guarantees of vanilla SGD, and incurs negligible overhead per iteration.

2606.03624.tldr: A novel framework that addresses CAP by representing instructions as a structured knowledge graph of constraints, explicitly models relationships between constraints, identifies adherence challenges, and discovers ``bridge constraints'' that help the model better focus on and reconcile requirements.

2606.03626.tldr: TurtleAI, a benchmark containing 823 tasks curated based on real-world visual programming tasks in the Turtle Graphics domain, is introduced, revealing that GPT-4o struggles with spatial reasoning and precise visual replication, whereas fine-tuning primarily improves the alignment between visual reasoning and code implementation.

2606.03628.tldr: A novel inference-time hallucination mitigation framework, named Segment-wise HAllucination Rejection Sampling (SHARS), which uses an arbitrary hallucination detector to identify and reject hallucinated segments during generation and resample until faithful content is produced.

2606.03629.tldr: This work proposes TSQAgent, a novel agentic reasoning framework for TS quality rating that introduces an agentic reasoning strategy that instills the ability to identify and prioritize the most relevant quality dimensions, and proposes an agent workflow equipped with external analytical tools to enable precise quantitative comparisons over selected dimensions.

2606.03635.tldr: This work introduces VidMsg, a benchmark for evaluating implicit message understanding in short, internet-native video clips, and introduces VidVec-Msg, a baseline method that improves message-oriented retrieval while leaving substantial headroom for future work.

2606.03641.tldr: It is demonstrated that clinical LLMs replicate documented human clinical biases by using epidemiological priors to suppress triage urgency, suggesting that AI triage engines must decouple urgency assessment from probabilistic diagnostic priors.

2606.03647.tldr: Indirect Harm Optimization is introduced, a masked diffusion language model attacker trained via iterative preference optimization against a harmfulness judge, requiring only black-box access to the target, requiring only black-box access to the target.

2606.03648.tldr: It is argued that anchoring fine-tuning to a specific capability goal is essential for avoiding arbitrary empirical choices, allowing us to draw meaningful conclusions about safety impacts, and to compare mitigation methods on a consistent basis.

2606.03655.tldr: This paper proposes a means of lifting the class of (non-monotonic) rational entailment relations from traditional KLM-style reasoning to a fragment of PDSL, and characterising non-monotonic entailment in this fragment.

2606.03657.tldr: NovelAPIBench is introduced, a fully automated dynamic benchmark that discovers novel APIs, extracts decomposed knowledge bundles, generates executable coding tasks, and assigns failed samples to six diagnostic categories, suggesting that retrieval and tuning play complementary roles: retrieval supplies volatile API content, while tuning improves procedural integration.

2606.03664.tldr: AUGUSTE (Anticipatory Uplink Grants for URLLC via Self-Adapting Temporal Estimation), a learning-based Medium Access Control (MAC) scheduling framework that embeds online Machine Learning models in the UL scheduler to predict packet arrivals and proactively allocate resources before an SR is issued, is proposed.

2606.03678.tldr: EvoDrive is presented, the first automated, LLM-based agentic evolution framework for multi-objective scenario generation and maintains a Pareto archive of evaluated candidates to preserve diverse attack-realism trade-offs and guide future evolution via simulation feedback.

2606.03685.tldr: This work devise and perform a series of interpretability experiments that holistically interrogate world model recovery by examining both internal representations and generative capabilities of fine-tuned LLMs and generates insights that shed light on open questions about how knowledge is represented in LLMs.

2606.03686.tldr: This work presents DeepSpeak-Agentic, a dataset of videos comprising over 37 hours of semi-structured conversations between a human and an embodied AI agent that is a benchmark for future advances in the large-language models and AI-generated voices and faces that power embodied AI agents.

2606.03689.tldr: This work presents a training-free method to survival regression by leveraging TFMs to both predict the time of the event and iteratively impute right-censored data and introduces a non-parametric in-context estimator for right-censored data.

2606.03692.tldr: SkillPyramid is proposed, a skill consolidation framework that reuses existing skill experience for broader task generalization and introduces a self-evolution mechanism that enables agents to compose, validate, and incorporate new skills during task execution.

2606.03704.tldr: This paper proposes DOSS (Dynamic Objective Selection with Safeguards), a learning-based selector that directly chooses the decision-relevant objective function at each time point from interpretable statistical summaries of recent returns, selecting among a small set of candidates without introducing intermediate regime variables.

2606.03705.tldr: Code-on-Graph (CoG), a programmatic reasoning framework for LLM-KG integration that enables flexible code-based reasoning while avoiding the direct injection of large-scale factual knowledge into prompts is proposed.

2606.03719.tldr: This work introduces derivation graphs, which represent how do-calculus rules are applied and combined, and characterize the full space of observational and interventional probabilities which are equivalent under the do-calculus.

2606.03741.tldr: It is found that subgoal persistence -- not subgoal injection alone -- is the central knob: moderate periods P in [3, 6] consistently outperform both very frequent (P=1) and very long horizons, with a clear minimum LM loss at P=3.

2606.03743.tldr: On generated Lean proofs from PutnamBench and Putnam2025, Proof-Refactor improves rubric-based refactoring scores over a strong Claude Code refactoring baseline, with the largest gains in signature quality and human readability.

2606.03748.tldr: Ultralytics YOLO26 is a unified real-time vision model family that addresses limitations through coordinated architecture and training advances, and introduces task-specific head and loss designs for instance segmentation, pose estimation, and oriented detection, producing consistent gains across tasks and scales.

2606.03755.tldr: The Lab Agent Protocol is presented, a protocol design that fills the gap between A2A's peer-to-peer, discovery-first, task-lifecycle structure and encapsulates rather than replaces existing device standards such as SiLA 2 and OPC-UA.

2606.03762.tldr: A unified framework TAO-RL that couples tool-aware trajectory filtering with entropy-guided exploration for efficient policy optimization and introduces a tool-aware entropy-guided bonus that reshapes the advantage function at post-tool-call tokens, encouraging the policy to explore more diverse reasoning paths at critical decision points.

2606.03770.tldr: E2LLM replicates the full model across multiple groups of devices (replicas) and applies model parallelism within each replica, which leverages the inherent differences between these two phases of LLM inference.

2606.03777.tldr: This paper addresses losses in which the insured's AI system is in the causal chain, including externally triggered failures such as prompt injection, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), malicious tool output, credential misuse, and data poisoning, and introduces CER, a use-case-level diagnostic for AI residual risk transfer.

2606.03808.tldr: Purse leverages gradient projection from A-GEM by adapting gradient projection from A-GEM so that every unlearning step is constrained to not increase the retain-set loss, outperforming gradient ascent, KL-uniform, and several published baselines on the privacy-utility frontier.

2606.03811.tldr: The results demonstrate that self-sustaining AI-driven cyber-threats are no longer theoretical and must be prepared for autonomous generative adversaries: malware systems that propagate without human operators and are defined not by fixed exploit code, but by the capacity to reason about targets, adapt to observations, and synthesize attack logic in real time.

2606.03812.tldr: HAZDIAL is introduced, a framework that investigates whether structured agentic dialogue-multi-agent, multi-turn interactions improves the quality of NLP- based hazard identification over single-pass baselines and proposes an algorithm-based agentic interaction optimization.

2606.03814.tldr: Rubric-aware, multitask fine-tuning of transformer models for automated grading of introductory C++ programming assignments is investigated, suggesting that calibration-aware, rubric-guided training produces more instructor-like grading behavior than accuracy-optimized alternatives.

2606.03823.tldr: This work demonstrates that realistic urban traffic simulation can be achieved from minimal real-world observations, offering a scalable and data-light approach to simulation calibration that reduces the barrier to deploying traffic models across diverse cities.

2606.03829.tldr: BigFinanceBench is introduced, a 928-item expert-authored benchmark of open-ended financial-research tasks in which each item pairs a ground-truth reference answer with a point-weighted rubric that decomposes the derivation into independently checkable steps.

2606.03841.tldr: EvoDS is introduced, a self-evolving autonomous data science agent that learns to expand its skills and adaptively managing long-term context through agentic reinforcement learning, and outperforms state-of-the-art open-source data science agents by an average of 28.9% across four diverse benchmarks.

2606.03843.tldr: Through few-shot evaluation with a novel metric -- per-shot plasticity -- it is shown that adding `foresight'to continual learning methods via the meta-learning of a short sequence of future tasks induces learning-to-learn behavior over the task sequence.

2606.03846.tldr: This work proposes a simple yet effective self-assessment method for uncertainty quantification in LLMs that groups sampled generations into semantically distinct clusters, converts them into answer options in a structured multiple-choice question, and uses the probability assigned by the LLM to each option as a confidence estimate.

2606.03852.tldr: Flare, an iterative framework with a lightweight diagnostic model that predicts line-level suspiciousness signals for bug localization and code refinement, achieves the best performance compared with recent fault localization methods, demonstrating that it can provide reliable fine-grained guidance for code refinement.

2606.03858.tldr: The Smart Optimization&Learning-based VErsatile module (SOLVE) and Interactive Relative Policy Optimization (IRPO) are proposed, which enhance LLMs'numerical-mathematical synergy via efficient tool calls (fuzzy matching and low-quality call rejection).

2606.03866.tldr: Taiji, a novel LLM-as-Enhancer framework designed for industrial recommender systems, is presented and Pareto Optimal Policy Optimization (POPO), which adaptively adjusts cross-domain reward weights is proposed, achieves an optimal trade-off between the semantic world knowledge of LLMs and the collaborative ID features representing online user preferences.

2606.03867.tldr: This work presents a training-free mixture-of-agents framework for MDS that leverages the complementary strengths of large language models (LLMs) and knowledge graphs and unifies their outputs using a multi-perspective consistency mechanism guided by LLMs.

2606.03876.tldr: This work redesigned an existing system to generate retrospective summaries from multi-modal tracking data for RFMs of older adults into a multi-layer, multi-agent, insight-driven summary approach that builds from objective statistics and descriptions to enriched, context-aware narratives.

2606.03879.tldr: The Capacity-Necessity decomposition and the pre-projector rank analysis, along with comprehensive evaluation through retraining, expose a methodological gap in multi-encoder LVLM design, and offer concrete primitives for closing it.

2606.03883.tldr: This work introduces a scalable LRM benchmark of logic puzzles and a pipeline that converts unstructured traces into verifiable reasoning graphs of claims and dependencies, and defines a reasoning efficiency metric that quantifies how concentrated the model's logical flow is.

2606.03895.tldr: The prototype implements process-local namespaces, persistent runtime state, LLM-call observability, human approval queues, budgets, syscall-mediated JIT tools, trusted Runtime Modules, Object-bound PTY sessions, checkpoint restore/fork/commit, JSON-RPC and MCP providers, and a deterministic runtime-safety benchmark.

2606.03906.tldr: This work presents scTranslation, a comprehensive benchmark for single-cell multi-omics modality translation tasks, which includes diverse translation datasets, integrates state-of-the-art models, and provides a comprehensive evaluation metrics.

2606.03907.tldr: A pre-registered protocol is presented to study how configuration mechanisms alter build-versus-buy behavior in two popular agentic AI coding tools: Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.

2606.03910.tldr: NetKV, the O(|D|) per-request greedy that consumes this oracle, has tier rankings that are provably robust to stale telemetry, and it is proved that ignoring the network term renders cache-aware-only scheduling arbitrarily suboptimal as context length grows.

2606.03918.tldr: Hedge-Bench 1.0 is presented: a benchmark of 102 actual, on-the-job tasks grounded in the explicit reasoning traces of professional hedge fund analysts working with relevant information sources that enables deterministic grading against verified expert steps.

2606.03927.tldr: This work proposes FFR (Forward-Forward for Regression), to their knowledge, the first framework to extend FF to real-world regression and demonstrate competitive performance across diverse real-world datasets.

2606.03939.tldr: This work formalises temporal forgetting in FL with a per-phase metric isolated from protocol-level fluctuations and proposes Flashback Continual Learning (FlashbackCL), a drop-in extension of Flashback with temporally-decayed label counts and a device-aware replay buffer with Class-Balanced Reservoir Sampling.

2606.03957.tldr: An augmentation pipeline that generates scenario-level dialogues with participant metadata, maps speaker attributes to TTS voice profiles, and assembles synthesized utterances into speaker-aware simulated conversations is proposed that indicates that LLM-generated conversational data synthesized with TTS is a practical complement to real conversational corpora for speech model training.

2606.03962.tldr: A fundamental reformulation of the RL objective is proposed by replacing the scalar reward with a distribution over reward functions, and applying a non-linear objective over sets of actions, which results in a framework in which calibrated behavioural diversity emerges naturally, remains controllable through the reward function distribution, and is obtained without sacrificing expected reward.

2606.03965.tldr: Agentic Chain-of-Thought Steering (ACTS), which formulates reasoning steering as a Markov decision process where a controller agent adaptively steers a frozen reasoner during inference, and enables controllable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different reasoners and tasks.

2606.03967.tldr: To the authors' knowledge, this is the first application of AlignAtt to a decoder-only LLM, where the encoder-decoder cross-attention used by earlier AlignAtt systems is absent.

2606.03968.tldr: QUBRIC, a framework that co-designs queries and rubrics can make rubric-based RL a practical complement to RLVR beyond strictly verifiable tasks, provides evidence that co-designing queries and rubrics can make rubrics a practical complement to RLVR beyond strictly verifiable tasks.

2606.03969.tldr: A novel framework is introduced to systematically quantify FC of large reasoning models (LRMs) and establishes FC as a distinct reliability and alignment target for LRMs, particularly as such systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes contexts.

2606.03976.tldr: The binding problem is formalized with an information-theoretic approach, and a probing method to measure binding information in model representations is introduced, demonstrating binding as a key ingredient to strong visual recognition and reasoning.

2606.03979.tldr: Inspired by human learning process, a ''Sleep'' paradigm is introduced that allows the models to continually learn, distill their short-term fragile memories into stable long-term knowledge with replay, and recursively improve themselves with''Dreaming''process.

2606.03985.tldr: Humanoid-GPT is introduced, a GPT-style Transformer with causal attention trained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control that demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks while simultaneously tracking highly dynamic and complex motions.

2606.06311.tldr: An empirical investigation of memory-based trajectory prediction using Automatic Identification System (AIS) data shows consistent and substantial performance gains over a range of deep learning baselines that do not incorporate an external memory.

2606.06315.tldr: This work creates a detectable fingerprint that enables attribution of a given text to a specific LLM by steering the internal residual stream during generation with a random sparse vector, and demonstrates that activation spaces contain exploitable structure for encoding signals without semantic interference.

2606.06316.tldr: A quantum algorithm is introduced for rare-event discovery and sampling without first learning which events are rare, which achieves the optimal quantum scaling with the rarity threshold and can achieve a quadratic speedup for heavy-tailed systems whose tail has nonvanishing total mass.

2606.06320.tldr: The results suggest that retain conflict provides an effective criterion for identifying what language models should forget, enabling unsupervised learning of token level forget-specificity directly from model representations with minimal computational overhead.

2606.06322.tldr: DragOn is introduced, a drag grounding benchmark and training dataset covering four domains: text highlighting, cell selection, element resizing and slider manipulation, and results suggest that the dataset could improve performance of state-of-the-art models on downstream computer-use tasks.

2606.06328.tldr: PAMF is presented, a multimodal time-series framework that explicitly handles different missingness patterns while coupling imputation with downstream prediction through prior-aware flow matching and weight sharing and connects imputation and classification through architecturally matched encoders with weight sharing.

2606.06333.tldr: Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders (SASA), which replace single-vector decoders with learned decoder subspaces, enforce block sparsity via Top-$s$ group gating, and adapt each group's effective rank with a nuclear-norm regularizer are introduced.

2606.06335.tldr: Fused Reference Alignment Prediction (FRAP), which leverages the complementary strengths of an external foundation model and the base model to construct a more reliable surrogate of the ground-truth labels, provides consistent and substantial improvements over representative performance-estimation methods under distribution shift.

2606.06337.tldr: This work presents TokenMizer, an open-source transparent proxy that maintains session history as a typed knowledge graph and, at context boundaries, replaces the raw transcript with a token-budgeted serialization of session state.

2606.06345.tldr: Surprisingly, image decoders trained exclusively on synthetic fMRI can perform above chance in some settings, suggesting that TRIBE v2 can support zero-shot brain-to-image decoding.

2606.06356.tldr: This work instantiate the framework in diffusion models, map representative methods to all four layers, and derive design principles for multi-layer composition, showing empirically that each additional layer addresses failure classes that prior layers cannot reach and empirically confirming the framework's complementarity prediction.

2606.06357.tldr: A single audio tokenizer that provides high-dimensional representations for understanding while preserving normalized continuous latents as generation targets is adapted.

2606.06373.tldr: LatentWave is proposed, a wireless foundation model pretrained using a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) on diverse wireless spectrograms and channel state information (CSI) and shows that the masking geometry introduces a task-dependent inductive bias.

2606.06375.tldr: Results indicate that the instruction-based classifier outperforms encoder-based ones and gains from comparison with reference images shows that IDC can be an effective task modeling for tackling data constraints in infrastructure inspection and DT asset condition updating.

2606.06380.tldr: A generative methodology: emergent language (EL) in multi-agent reinforcement learning, where agents start from minimal and develop communication under task pressure alone, ensuring causal attributability to task demands rather than inherited human language priors is proposed.

2606.06390.tldr: A unified hierarchical framework that decomposes indoor scene synthesis into controllable stages is proposed that produces indoor spaces with greater layout diversity and stronger 3D design appeal, outperforming prior methods on both quantitative and qualitative metrics.

2606.06416.tldr: This work proposes DataCOPE, an unsupervised verifier-guided skill discovery framework for data-analytic agents and evaluates it on report-style analysis from Deep Data Research and reasoning-style analysis from DABStep.

2606.06418.tldr: This paper introduces a new optimization paradigm called double-preconditioning (DoPr) uniquely tailored to the challenges of TTF, which combines gradient-wise preconditioning with activation-wise preconditioning and yields a drop-in intervention for increasing downstream model performance across a range of TTF settings.

2606.06423.tldr: RiskFlow is proposed, a closed-loop safety-critical multi-agent traffic generation framework that formulates future trajectory generation as transport in the action space and achieves a strong adversariality-realism trade-off across multi-agent and long-horizon settings.

2606.06448.tldr: This work presents the first systems characterization of agent memory, introducing a system-oriented taxonomy classifying agent memory systems along four axes, and derives 10 system recommendations covering construction scheduling, capability floors, amortization via query volume, freshness-latency tradeoffs, and fleet-scale management.

2606.06453.tldr: Vortex is a system that combines a Python-embedded frontend language atop a page-centric tensor abstraction for expressing a broad range of sparse attention algorithms, with an efficient backend tightly integrated into modern LLM serving stacks.

2606.06458.tldr: It is shown that pretraining an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synthetic data yields a model that can solve new tasks from a handful of labeled bags, outperforming supervised baselines that require task-specific training.

2606.06460.tldr: The Recuse Signal is proposed, a lightweight in-band governance signal a server emits over a protocol's existing channels asking an automated agent to voluntarily withdraw asking an automated agent to voluntarily withdraw.

2606.06462.tldr: This work introduces Benchmark Agent, a fully autonomous agentic system designed for benchmark building, which orchestrates the complete benchmark construction pipeline, from user query analysis and subtask design to data annotation and quality control.

2606.06467.tldr: This work proposes cross-layer sparse attention (CLSA), which is built on top of KV-sharing architectures such as YOCO, which improves all major inference bottlenecks jointly, including pre-filling, KV-cache storage, and long-context decoding.

2606.06468.tldr: Goedel-Architect, an agentic framework for formal theorem proving in Lean 4 centered on blueprint generation and refinement, represents state-of-the-art performance for an open-source pipeline at a price point up to 500x less than comparable open-source pipelines.

2606.06470.tldr: A preconditioning (PC) layer is proposed, a weight parameterization via polynomial preconditioner that ensures stable weight conditioning throughout LLM training, and it is proved that uniformly bounding each layer's singular values ensures geometric convergence of gradient descent to global minima, for certain deep linear networks.

2606.06473.tldr: MLEvolve is presented, an LLM-based self-evolving multi-agent framework for end-to-end machine learning algorithm discovery that outperforms specialized algorithm discovery methods including AlphaEvolve on mathematical algorithm optimization tasks, demonstrating strong cross-domain generalization.

2606.06474.tldr: Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models (SARDI) is a dynamic RAG framework that uses lookahead tokens to guide retrieval during denoising, and outperforms current training-free diffusion and autoregressive retrieval baselines at up to $8\times$ higher throughput.

2606.06475.tldr: This work introduces RREDCoT (Reward REDistribution for Chain of Thoughts), which utilizes the model itself to approximate the optimal reward redistribution without additional generation, and investigates the advantages of the method compared to MC sampling and several attribution methods.

2606.06479.tldr: Supervised Memory Training is proposed, a method for training nonlinear RNNs that sidesteps recurrent credit propagation entirely by reducing RNN training to supervised learning on one-step memory transition labels and enables nonlinear RNNs to better capture long-range dependencies and train in parallel.

2606.06481.tldr: OpAI-Bench provides a controlled testbed for analyzing whether, when, and how AI-assisted writing becomes detectable under realistic progressive editing scenarios, and reveals that mixed-authorship intermediate versions are often harder to detect than both fully human and heavily AI-edited endpoints, exposing non-monotonic detection patterns missed by existing benchmarks.

2606.06486.tldr: This paper introduces {\tt Repeated Policy Regret (RP-Regret)}, a game-theoretic metric that measures the difference between the difference between the best-in-hindsight utility and the accumulated utility when all players can respond to the history of play, and proposes three algorithms to minimize it.

2606.06491.tldr: TempoVLA is a single VLA whose execution speed is controlled by an explicit condition, and by cooperating with a large multimodal model, TempoVLA realizes dynamic speed control, accelerating through low-risk phases and decelerating for high-risk ones.

2606.06492.tldr: This work introduces Code2LoRA, a hypernetwork framework that generates repository-specific LoRA adapters, effectively injecting repository knowledge with zero inference-time token overhead, and evaluates Code2LoRA against parameter-efficient fine-tuning baselines.

2410.05985.tldr: By injecting delays into the communication between workers, LayUp remains robust to stragglers while DDP and other methods degrade in performance, and provides a novel practical, straggler-robust alternative for distributed training without sacrificing accuracy.

2408.14792.tldr: This study raises the research question of measuring human contribution in AI-assisted content generation and introduces a framework to address this question that is grounded in information theory and demonstrates that the proposed measure effectively discriminates between varying degrees of human contribution across multiple creative domains.

2403.11420.tldr: A novel map with which a wide class of quantum mechanical systems can be cast into the form of a neural network with a statistical summation over network parameters, which can be applied to interacting quantum systems / field theories, even away from the Gaussian limit.

2401.08461.tldr: This paper introduces a general methodology through which a population of autonomous agents can converge on a linguistic convention that enables them to refer to arbitrary entities in their environment, and demonstrates the robustness of the method against perceptual variation, as well as the ability of the emergent conventions to self-adapt to changes in the environment.

1702.07976.tldr: A compressive-privacy based method, namely RUCA (Ratio Utility and Cost Analysis), is proposed, which can not only maximize performance for a privacy-insensitive classification task but also minimize the ability of any classifier to infer private information from the data.

2503.01290.tldr: This work introduces ACTIVA, a transformer-based conditional variational autoencoder for amortized estimation of full interventional distributions from observational data and intervention queries and shows that it substantially outperforms a correlational baseline, reduces spurious non-descendant effects, and achieves competitive performance relative to strong amortized baselines.

2505.04999.tldr: Continuous latent action models (CLAM) are designed which incorporate two key ingredients necessary for learning to solve complex continuous control tasks from unlabeled observation data: using continuous latent action labels instead of discrete representations, and jointly training an action decoder to ensure that the latent action space can be easily grounded to real actions with relatively few labeled examples.

2408.07822.tldr: The results show that LLMs can estimate sleep quality based on human textual behavioral features and provide personalized sleep improvement suggestions and guided imagery scripts; however, detecting attention, sleep stages, and sleep quality based on EEG and activity data requires further training data and domain-specific knowledge.

2403.06828.tldr: NeuPAN is a real-time, highly accurate, map-free, easy-to-deploy, and environment-invariant robot motion planner that outperforms existing baselines in terms of accuracy, efficiency, robustness, and generalization capabilities across various environments.

2506.08026.tldr: TIP-Search studies time-predictable inference scheduling over fixed market predictors under uncertain load, which filters conformal latency-quantile feasible models, dispatches over finite workers, and uses shielded constrained online experts to trade accuracy, queue pressure, and deadline risk.

2505.11129.tldr: This work introduces PhiNet v2, a novel architecture that processes temporal visual input without relying on strong data augmentation, enabling it to learn robust visual representations in a manner similar to human visual processing.

2505.10885.tldr: BangalFake, a Bengali Deepfake Audio Dataset with 12,260 real and 13,260 deepfake utterances, serves as a crucial resource for advancing deepfake detection in Bengali, addressing the limitations of low-resource language research.

2504.03615.tldr: This paper introduces the concept of an autonomous self-adaptive synthetic media identification system -- one that not only detects synthetic images and attributes them to known sources but also autonomously identifies and incorporates novel generators without human intervention.

2402.02362.tldr: This study mathematically formulate the parametric redundancies in neural ODEs, and finds that their gauge symmetries are given by spacetime diffeomorphisms, which play a fundamental role in Einstein’s theory of gravity.

2302.14062.tldr: Quality assessment for neural network based ASR is addressed by providing explanations that help increase the understanding of the system and ultimately help build trust in the system by adapting existing explainable AI techniques from image classification.

2502.17843.tldr: This work significantly advances autonomous navigation technology and opens new research avenues in object detection for autonomous vehicles by integrating the strengths of CNNs and Transformers, and highlights the potential of DETR for robust and efficient vehicle detection in challenging driving environments.

2509.20679.tldr: QAMO extends conventional one-class learning by introducing multiple quality-aware centroids, enabling better modeling of intra-class variability in bona fide speech and supports a multi-centroid ensemble scoring strategy, which improves decision thresholding and reduces the need for quality labels during inference.

2410.12261.tldr: To perceive appropriate channel correlations, a Channel Fusion Module (CFM) is proposed, which features a patch-wise mask generator and a masked-attention mechanism, driven by a bi-level multi-objective optimization algorithm.

2508.13744.tldr: It is demonstrated that FOCUS offers a general solution for enhancing multi-image reasoning without additional training or architectural modifications, and that FOCUS generalizes to video understanding, extending its applicability beyond static multi-image inputs.

2507.08262.tldr: This work proposes CLAR, a novel 3D pre-training framework that synergizes global understanding with fine-grained local alignment and introduces an adaptive alignment mechanism that leverages deformable attention to force precise correspondences between local 3D geometry and 2D visual features, thereby overcoming the limitations of conventional global alignment in manipulation tasks.

2503.00366.tldr: Investigating the impact of three data augmentation strategies including Stable Diffusion (SD), Flow Matching (FM), and Conventional Augmentation (CA), on enhancing DL-based classification of disease finds that high-fidelity generative augmentation can supersede conventional heuristics.

2411.18276.tldr: This work introduced a largescale part-centric dataset for articulated object manipulation that features both photo-realistic material randomizations and detailed annotations of part-oriented, scene-level actionable interaction poses and proposed a novel modular framework that delivers superior and robust performance for generalizable articulated object manipulation.

2408.02153.tldr: This work proposes a method to produce a new security dataset which ensures reproducibility for diverse vulnerabilities at scale by identifying the key obstacles to large-scale bug reproduction and addressing them with general solutions and constructs the ARVO dataset (an Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities in Open-source software).

2403.17407.tldr: The key idea is to provide the model with explicit information about the regional dialect or"district" of the input text before generating the IPA transcription by prepending a district token to the input sequence, effectively guiding the model to understand the unique phonetic patterns associated with each district.

2103.00180.tldr: A survey of ways in which existing scientific knowledge is included when constructing models with neural networks by means of changes to: the input, the loss-function, and the architecture of deep networks.

2603.13293.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive architectural case study validating the engineering robustness of FedCVR, a privacy-preserving Federated Learning framework applied to heterogeneous clinical networks, providing a validated engineering blueprint for secure multi-institutional collaboration.

2604.03070.tldr: The first large-scale empirical study on credential leakage in agent skills is presented, identifying 520 affected skills containing 1,708 security issues, and yields a taxonomy of 10 leakage patterns.

2604.01989.tldr: Inertia-aware Visual Excitation is proposed that breaks this inertial pattern by modeling cognitive inference as the dynamic responsiveness of visual attention and introduces an inertia-aware penalty that discourages over-concentration and limits the persistence of attention within localized regions.

2604.06191.tldr: Harf-Speech is presented, a modular system scoring Arabic pronunciation at the phoneme level on a clinical scale that combines an MSA phonetizer, a fine-tuned speech-to-phoneme model, Levenshtein alignment, and a blended scorer using longest common subsequence and edit-distance metrics.

2605.14240.tldr: This paper investigates the paraphrasing attack resilience of various machine-generated text detection methods, evaluating three approaches: fine-tuned RoBERTa, Binoculars, and text feature analysis, along with their ensembles using Random Forest classifiers.

2602.24060.tldr: Qualitative error analysis reveals that reasoning degrades simpler tasks through systematic over-deliberation, offering mechanistic insight beyond the high-level overthinking hypothesis.

2602.16653.tldr: It is found that very small models struggle with reliable skill selection, while models around 30B-80B benefit substantially, while models around 30B-80B benefit substantially in the trade-off between GPU cost and agent performance.

2602.12373.tldr: Policy4OOD jointly encodes policy knowledge graphs, state-level spatial dependencies, and socioeconomic time series into a policy-conditioned Transformer that forecasts future opioid outcomes, and demonstrates that spatial dependencies and structured policy knowledge significantly improve forecasting accuracy.

2606.20564.tldr: This paper presents a reproducible DSM-to-CLI semantic benchmark covering five cloud LLMs, three vendors, five representative use cases, and ten repeated runs per experimental cell under fixed judges and an explicit failure taxonomy, demonstrating that semantic quality and operational reliability are orthogonal.

2606.16118.tldr: This work compares three paradigms of LLM classification, LLM-based Formal Reasoning, and solver-based Formal Reasoning using the Z3 SMT solver on a re-annotated subset of ContractNLI to reveal a systematic and measurable gap between pragmatic legal interpretation and strict formal entailment.

2606.09751.tldr: This paper presents CHAP, the Collaborative Human-Agent Protocol, which achieves this through a small Core (workspaces, participants, tasks, artefacts, and an append-only evidence log) together with composable profiles that add review, modes, routing, deliberation, handoff, identity, signatures, and transparency-backed audit as deployments require them.

2606.16246.tldr: This work investigates training-time data augmentation as a regularizer to mitigate AR pretraining's data inefficiency and offer a promising solution to the data-constrained regime.

2606.08327.tldr: The MetaRouter stabilises at g ~ 0.22, indicating that at scale the model reaches a robust compute-quality equilibrium: attention layers absorb representational complexity while spectral preprocessing efficiently anchors low-frequency structure.

2606.18497.tldr: This work introduces Epoch Key Rotation, which encrypts vectors and discards the key upon deletion, and generates an ECDSA-signed cryptographic proof as an auditable record of the deletion event.

2606.20565.tldr: This paper presents the AI-Native Network Controller (AI-NNC), an open-source and modular framework that enables agentic AI control across diverse network domains and enables a safer paradigm for autonomous network management.

2606.10787.tldr: This paper addresses the current limitations of NeurASP by improving its computational performance through vectorization, batch processing and caching of intermediate computations during training, and proposes a new dataset of difficult tasks involving playing cards to test the capabilities of NeurASP's enhanced learning function.

2606.09316.tldr: Anything2Skill is proposed, a taxonomy-guided framework that compiles heterogeneous external knowledge into reusable, retrievable, and executable skills for agents and suggests that compiling latent procedural knowledge into explicit skills is an effective way to extend retrieval-augmented agents from knowledge access toward capability reuse.

2606.09052.tldr: INFUSER is introduced, an iterative co-training framework with two co-evolving roles: a Generator that drafts questions and reference golden answers from a pool of unstructured, automatically collected documents, and a Solver that improves by training on them, and DuGRPO, a dual-normalized variant of GRPO, for generator training.

2606.15980.tldr: It is suggested that fine-tuning should trigger activation-monitor revalidation by default, with prediction triaging which monitors to check first and label-free realignment as the default repair.

2606.09520.tldr: This work shows that replacing a single number with the full physicochemical rationale from first-principles calculations transforms the LLM from a stochastic sampler into a causal reasoner, and establishes a new paradigm: when the model understands not only that a molecule fails, but why, iterative molecular design becomes genuinely mechanistic.

2606.20644.tldr: The first theoretical frameworks for safely integrating MVHs with DR are developed, including a theoretical baseline that restores search correctness by enforcing heuristic consistency and a "lazy,"optimistic approach to DR.

2606.20634.tldr: DEMM-Bench is a cross-regime benchmark for agent-runtime governance-evidence sufficiency, grounded in the Decision Evidence Maturity Model, supporting reproducible evaluation of decision-evidence maturity across heterogeneous agent-runtime evidence substrates.

2606.20625.tldr: Experiments on CSI 500 and S\&P 500 show improved out-of-sample performance and fixed-budget discovery efficiency, with ablations validating the roles of residual learning, confidence gating, AST-diff motifs, and veto memory.

2606.20601.tldr: A structured research framework for transforming an AI agricultural prototype into an empirically testable, accountable and localized decision-support infrastructure for smallholder production is presented.

2606.20637.tldr: This work presents the first computational framework for Irish electoral redistricting that systematically optimises across multiple constitutional requirements while making trade-offs explicit and quantifiable.

2606.20577.tldr: This work term the unconstrained optimum human-less serving and provides a prototype demonstrating that it is practical on real workloads, and argues that serving systems should expose workload-class-aware SLA configurations rather than silently applying the human tax uniformly to all traffic.

2606.20569.tldr: It is shown that closed-loop encoder estimates do not uniquely identify user adaptation, but instead reflect properties of the joint system.

2606.20640.tldr: Results show that this framework, serving as a proof of concept for integrating RL decision-making and LLMs, balances safety, adaptability, and explainability, and is most effective when requests are delayed or overridden due to safety constraints.

2606.20638.tldr: This work introduces RIZZ (Routing Interactions to Near Zero-interference Zones), a continual adaptation framework for compound language-model systems that learns entirely through verifier-gated memory, routing, and prompt compilation, and yields a black-box agent that improves through persistent natural-language feedback while explicitly controlling interference.

2606.20623.tldr: A hierarchical Adaptor Grammar with distinct local and global libraries, governed jointly by constraints on memory and computation, which achieves better rate-distortion trade-offs and stronger generalization than fixed grammars or shallow chunking methods.

2606.20621.tldr: Comprehensive empirical evaluations demonstrate PEAR significantly improves average accuracy over the strongest debate baselines, and theoretically characterize PEAR as an equivariant sparse router: it preserves accuracy under agent relabeling while reducing routing complexity and improving generalization.

2606.20606.tldr: A new DQL study conducting a holistic convergence analysis for DQL under practical settings and developing a novel multi-layered post-quantum cryptographic architecture with a quantum neural network-powered adaptive mechanism that monitors conditions, evaluates threats, and adjusts parameters across three National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)-compliant levels is presented.

2606.20590.tldr: This work proposes treating the physical resource block (PRB) allocation problem as an Optimization-as-a-Service (OaaS) provided by a large language model multi-agent (LLM-MA) system, and introduces a one-shot reflection distillation mechanism to eliminate the computational latency of iterative reflection.

2606.20588.tldr: The AInterviewer platform is an opensource solution based on a multi-agent pipeline that combines controlled question administration of survey software with the flexibility of LLMs, and it can run with locally hosted models to ensure security, transparency, and reproducibility.

2606.20648.tldr: A hybrid platooning control strategy based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is developed, which effectively suppresses velocity disturbance propagation by dynamically optimizing platoon structures, thereby significantly enhancing the stability and safety of mixed traffic while reducing fuel consumption and emissions.

2606.20643.tldr: SPARC, a multi-agent system that answers questions over circuit diagrams by grounding reasoning in executable physics-based simulations, achieves 83% accuracy, with up to a 58% absolute improvement over baselines, while enabling systematic error diagnosis.

2606.20631.tldr: The architectural responsibilities that govern the transition from skill artefacts to skill-in-use, bound the executable consequences associated with skill-in-use, and capture evidence for attribution, verification, repair, and evolution are studied.

2606.20628.tldr: It is proved that computing the optimal policy is NP-hard and derive a dynamic programming-based algorithm that finds the optimal policy for finite horizons and develops an approximation that plans for shorter horizons and appends a stationary suffix, achieving near-optimal performance.

2606.20627.tldr: Latent Goal Prediction from Language (LAGO) is introduced, a framework that predicts both sequences of intermediate goal states from language instructions and action-conditioned rollouts, all within the same latent space.

2606.20624.tldr: It is argued that, even when an LLM has been well aligned in (post-)training, it may still fail to maximise the aligned value in reasoning, and the utility discrepancy between a model's deployed reasoning strategy and its rational counterpart is formalised as rational value risk.

2606.20622.tldr: This work establishes the practical and theoretical foundation necessary to move toward truly autonomous, self-evolving GUI agents and introduces Darwin Mobile Agent, an open-source infrastructure designed as a foundation for autonomous reinforcement learning in this domain.

2606.20610.tldr: The paper argues for a dedicated, federated international monitoring capability anchored in OSINT methods and independent of frontier AI developers, and identifies sustained non-industry funding as the highest-leverage structural intervention available.

2606.20598.tldr: It is suggested that AI-assisted programming is not a faster version of solo coding but a cognitively distinct activity, with implications for the design of AI assistants and for biometric monitoring in AI-augmented development.

2606.20596.tldr: HAAS Studio turns the HAAS framework into an interactive environment for asking a practical deployment question: before introducing AI into a workflow, how can a team compare allocation strategies, inspect governance tradeoffs, and derive a defensible task-level operating model?

2606.20591.tldr: The analysis identifies a critical delay below which single-token speculation is optimal and shows that the optimal length grows only logarithmically with communication delay, and proposes UCB-SpecStop, an online control algorithm with gap-free and gap-dependent expected regret bounds.

2606.20589.tldr: This work argues that people's interactions with AI companions-conversational systems built for ongoing, emotionally meaningful relationships should be understood as attachment relationships, and identifies caregiving-system capture as a distinct mechanism by which apps inhibit user disengagement.

2606.20651.tldr: Simulations confirm that the adaptive framework remains feasible where fixed-radius methods fail: it roughly doubles the admissible drone count, reduces traversal time through constrained passages by about 25 percent, and enables passage through openings impassable to static safety zones.

2606.20650.tldr: This work proposes EmoInstruct-TTS, a dual-path instruction-guided framework for emotional speech synthesis and introduces Emotion2embed, a supervised semantic-acoustic emotion embedding covering 48 emotional states, including fine-grained categories and intensity levels.

2606.20642.tldr: This work proposes a hypothesis-disciplined Lean 4 formalization pipeline built from multiple agents: a manager that coordinates seven specialist roles for proof planning, skeleton scaffolding, Mathlib reconnaissance, proof construction, integration, independent review, and audit of asymptotic statistical theory.

2606.20636.tldr: SkillHarness moves beyond static skill abstractions by modeling skill learning and utilization as a safety-constrained interaction process, and introduces the skill boundary that leverages multi-source supervision signals to identify safe skills from interaction trajectories, and construct self-improving safety constraints throughout the skill lifecycle.

2606.20605.tldr: Text highlighting alone is insufficient to reduce overreliance, highlighting the need for more effective interface designs that encourage critical evaluation of GenAI outputs.

2606.20600.tldr: This paper argues that taking AI seriously as a model of human learning supports a modest but genuine associationism, and finds that supervised learning -- learning driven by evaluative feedback -- underlies a surprisingly wide range of contemporary AI systems.

2606.20587.tldr: This work scales model depth and transfers the same tokenizer to a fundamentally different architecture family, finding that Protocol-aware tokenization is the primary performance lever, and the backbone becomes a deployment knob trading accuracy for speed.

2606.20583.tldr: Simulation results show that the proposed predictive framework reduces outage probability and blockage-response latency, particularly under increasing beam-switching delays, and establishes Physical-AI as a promising architecture for intelligent 6G systems.

2606.20580.tldr: A role-based multi-agent architecture (MAS) for end-to-end intent orchestration that mirrors Communication Service Provider (CSP) organisational structures is presented, illustrating how agentic MAS can support accountable and scalable intent-driven service orchestration.
