2606.20572.tldr: This work introduces a rigorous framework using Shapley values to quantify the steering effect of individual adjectives on model performance, moving beyond anecdotal heuristics to principled attribution and suggesting that as models scale, their interpretation of prompts becomes more sophisticated but also less predictable, posing a significant challenge for robustly steering model behavior.

2606.20570.tldr: A systematic analysis of Agentverse, the agent cloud platform developed by Fetch.ai, provides a diagnostic of current agent infrastructure and a technically grounded vision for what the agent cloud must become to support the agentic web -- Web4 -- by 2030.

2606.20599.tldr: It is argued that effective search for scientific reasoning agents requires strategies that can adapt their behavior based on search progress and available resources.

2606.20574.tldr: The proposed large language model (LLM)-assisted framework for automatic gNB parameter configuration may enable automated recovery from misconfigurations without manual intervention and supports scalable and autonomous RAN operation.

2606.20635.tldr: Findings establish that both technological platform enhancements and structured enterprise AI eduction programs independently and substantially expand the reach of AI across the AbbVie workforce.

2606.20630.tldr: This position paper argues that AI agents should not be solely evaluated or deployed based on autonomous task capability alone; because agents interact with, adapt to, influence, and sometimes fail humans, human-agent interaction must be treated as a core design and evaluation target for agentic AI.

2606.20629.tldr: AgentCARD is introduced, a role-aware benchmark suite for evaluating LLM agent teams across role assignment and deployment mode that extends beyond planner--executor teams to workflows with additional roles such as verification, and supports continual evaluation as new domains and team structures emerge.

2606.20609.tldr: This paper uses a multi-modal logic to provide an initial formalization of different theories, basic principles and their implications investigating the right to privacy as an epistemic right within the theory of normative positions.

2606.20608.tldr: The results show that pedagogical video quality depends less on surface fluency than on explicit, typed instructional contracts that make scaffolding, adaptation, engagement, and grounding auditable.

2606.20626.tldr: The results establish that psychometric methods enable benchmark-aware reductions in evaluation costs across the safety evaluation pipeline.

2606.20641.tldr: A reinforcement learning fine-tuning approach that aligns the MLLM-based driving agent with planning objectives by learning from token-level rewards, MAGNIFIED optimizes for the true planning objectives rather than focusing solely on token prediction accuracy, enabling the model to refine its understanding of the planning task beyond simple imitation.

2606.20764.tldr: WMGen-v1, an agentic text-based world model framework for long-tail spatial data generation, is introduced, an agentic text-based world model framework for long-tail spatial data generation that outperforms baseline approaches in both spatial and physical consistency.

2606.20718.tldr: This work proposes a rigorous and systematic mathematical framework for tracking the cognitive trajectories of a user, in the context of algorithmic sycophancy and AI-driven delusional spiraling, and demonstrates that genuine external information can successfully challenge these rigid states.

2606.20717.tldr: This paper proposes MIRAGE, a novel visual indirect prompt injection framework for targeted next-action hijacking that leverages diffusion models to generate perceptually benign adversarial images strictly confined to the attacker-controlled boundaries permitted by the trusted service provider.

2606.20713.tldr: FairTutor is proposed, an equity-aware model-routing framework that achieves cost-effective AI tutoring via pedagogically motivated multi-agent orchestration and reveals a tunable cost--quality Pareto frontier, enabling FairTutor to be tailored to the needs of diverse student populations.

2606.20704.tldr: Artificial Intelligence should be understood as a form of monism: a unified substance that cannot be decomposed into separate elements such as data, algorithms, or technical architectures, suggesting that only by embracing AI as monism can organisations achieve genuine agility and avoid the structural inefficiencies inherent to reductionist approaches.

2606.20696.tldr: MindAlign, a decoupled two-stage brain-to-language framework that enables open-ended text generation from fMRI signals without modifying the underlying language model, indicates that neural signals modulate semantic content beyond image-driven priors, supporting a scalable and modular direction for brain-to-text decoding.

2606.20677.tldr: This work presents PathLab, an autonomous agentic framework that translates natural-language research objectives into executable and validated computational pathology workflows through the structured composition of domain-specific skills and tools, and establishes PathLab as a reliable interface between biomedical intent and computational execution.

2606.20658.tldr: This paper demonstrates that EFE-based planning can be formulated as Variational Free Energy minimization on a generative model augmented with epistemic priors, and reinforces theoretical consistency with the Free Energy Principle by casting planning as the same inferential process that governs perception and learning.

2606.20762.tldr: It is argued that these constructs describe a structural inevitability, not an anomaly, using the public case of Richard Dawkins's interaction with Claude as a paradigmatic instance, and called for shared terminology as a precondition for appropriate governance and design response.

2606.20761.tldr: This dissertation proposes a three-layer framework that integrates large language models, digital twins, and automation systems into an autonomous system and enables the integration of LLM-based reasoning into industrial automation systems and improves adaptability and usability.

2606.20758.tldr: It is argued that the missing ingredient in autonomous operations is not a better anomaly detector or a larger language model, but operational memory: a persistent, structured representation of how a system normally behaves, how its parts depend on one another, and how it has failed before.

2606.20707.tldr: It is argued that indicators of physical plausibility are implicitly captured by five geometric properties of the per-frame embeddings produced by frozen image encoders, and shown that these signals correlate with human EEG responses to two forms of object-permanence violations.

2606.20686.tldr: A joint prediction-planning diffusion framework that treats participant prediction and robot planning as a single conditional trajectory generation problem, where the model samples the future robot trajectory and all participant trajectories from one coupled distribution using a causal Transformer with cross-trajectory attention is presented.

2606.20683.tldr: This survey argues that agent quality -- including success, efficiency, safety, and generalization -- emerges from the interaction between model capability, runtime infrastructure, task structure, and evaluation design.

2606.20679.tldr: MemoryVAM, an episodic memory mechanism for video-world-model policies, employs a Recap-Cue module, in which a Perceiver-based Recap Compressor maps per-frame CLIP embeddings into compact memory tokens, and a lightweight Cue Gate estimates task completion from memory and language.

2606.20676.tldr: VOIR DIRE is introduced, a multimodal benchmark of 626 culturally paired image--prompt artifacts spanning U.S. and mainland Chinese contexts across food, fashion, and architecture, with annotator pools that are within-pool reliable but cross-pool divergent on evaluation.

2606.20674.tldr: A weight-discretized quotient model abstraction that maps continuous synaptic weights to a compact integer range while preserving the relative contribution of each synapse is introduced, and CogSpike is presented, a unified workbench that integrates SNN design, simulation, and PRISM-based formal verification within a single isomorphic tool chain.

2606.20672.tldr: Under conditions with a large supply of renewable energy and installed energy storage systems, simulation results for the IEEE-69 power system indicate that the fuzzy genetic algorithm strategy effectively reduces technical constraints compared to deterministic optimization schemes.

2606.20670.tldr: A channel-adaptive roadmap toward CSI-native foundation models is presented, proposing a unified framework that aligns pretraining, positional modeling, and attention control with three channel requirements: scale-aware heterogeneous exposure, physical time-frequency-antenna coordinates, and correlation-bounded token interaction.

2606.20675.tldr: The proposed VQ4SNN is a hardware-aware architecture that reduces memory requirements through Vector Quantization (VQ)-based weight sharing, and is the first application of VQ to pipelined spatial-dataflow SNN accelerators on FPGAs.

2606.20753.tldr: It is argued that polymer science is entering an era of autonomous discovery, in which data, simulation, reasoning and experimentation operate within self-improving feedback loops that continuously generate hypotheses, design materials, execute experiments and refine predictive models.

2606.20742.tldr: Results demonstrate that digital twins can support the development and evaluation of traffic-aware UAV inspection strategies before real-world deployment and show that flight altitude has a strong influence on inspection coverage and that adaptive recovery improves performance under occlusion.

2606.20724.tldr: Results show that synthetic-data GRPO reduces abstention and improves partial correctness, but leaves a completion-correctness gap that requires evidence-grounded coverage and synthesis diagnostics.

2606.20708.tldr: Decision fidelity is introduced -- whether a simulated population reproduces the decision-state dynamics of real users facing real, consequential choices -- and measured on a unique testbed: 2,790 production conversations between an LLM sales agent and real customers, including 793 with verified payment outcomes.

2606.20669.tldr: The results indicate that practitioners view behavioral transparency as a prerequisite for trust and consider the ability to examine agent reasoning as an important governance requirement for the next generation of AI-driven business processes.

2606.20667.tldr: A quantum-assisted agentic distributed artificial intelligence (DAI) framework is proposed in which the dispatch problem of each control slot is formulated as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem by Belief-Desire-Intention extended (BDIx) agents and is solved by a portfolio of quantum, quantum-inspired and classical solvers.

2606.20666.tldr: A Convolutional Restricted Hopfield Networks (CRHNs) is proposed, which integrates convolutional feature extraction with attractor-based memory retrieval in a structured latent space and maintains stable retrieval performance under increasing perturbation strength.

2606.20662.tldr: This work proposes latent uncertainty as an uncertainty-bearing carrier attached to decision handoffs that aims to preserve pre-commitment fragility in a form that downstream components can use and shifts agent uncertainty propagation from step-wise uncertainty estimation toward uncertainty-preserving interface design for more recoverable agent systems.

2606.20756.tldr: It is demonstrated that adapting UltraNMR to a range of molecular structure analysis tasks on experimental NMR spectra consistently yields state-of-the-art performance and clearly outperforms UltraNMR variants trained directly on downstream data without simulation pre-training, suggesting that large-scale simulation pre-training can effectively bridge the simulation-to-real gap.

2606.20738.tldr: Findings indicate that Mamba-based models constitute a suitable alternative for multimodal classification in medical data, especially in scenarios in which sensitivity is a relevant requirement.

2606.20737.tldr: These results dissociate learning competence from editing affordance -- repeated shared access suffices to grok, but edit propagation depends on whether the substrate exposes an addressable memory that the forward computation can write to and later reread, an affordance that loop recurrence provides only partially.

2606.20734.tldr: This work proposes an alternative paradigm that bypasses target-domain training and recombines knowledge from existing datasets and models and shows that, in out-of-distribution settings, the resulting merged model achieves superior zero-shot generalization to the pre-trained base model.

2606.20731.tldr: A scalable pipeline for constructing in-the-wild human motion datasets and demonstrates quality by training motion reconstruction and motion generation models, showing performance comparable to models trained on traditional motion capture datasets and strong cross-dataset generalization.

2606.20729.tldr: LADeQ is introduced, an LLM-guided workflow that discovers, implements, and benchmarks candidate approximation algorithms at test-time within existing quantum chemistry codes, demonstrating autonomous, objective-driven discovery of approximation algorithms inside existing electronic-structure solvers.

2606.20711.tldr: Video2Code is introduced, an action-aware video-to-code approach for recovering executable UI state transitions and substantially strengthens the underlying open-source model for UI video-to-code generation, improving functional correctness over direct video observation, especially on dense multi-step interactions.

2606.20705.tldr: MotionPyramid shows that motion, like perception, can be organized into a reusable multi level representation, providing structured abstraction without sacrificing controllability.

2606.20702.tldr: The results provide practical insight into the trade-off between semantic richness and robustness, and identify embedding calibration as a simple and effective tool for improving zero-shot remote sensing performance.

2606.20700.tldr: It is argued that machine coaching is best understood as a controller-level extension of explainable adaptive ABM, complementary to causal, information-theoretic, and trajectory-based diagnostics.

2606.20671.tldr: This paper shows that this surrogate gradient can be interpreted as a first-order local approximation of the video codec, providing insight into its effectiveness, and demonstrates that it is effective not only for learning downscaling operations, but also for the more challenging task of full neural wrapping with pre-and post-processing networks.

2606.20668.tldr: BELLS-O (Benchmark for the Evaluation of LLM Supervision Systems, Operational), the first independent operational benchmark of LLM supervision systems, is presented as the first vendor-neutral basis for selecting safeguards under real deployment constraints.

2606.20768.tldr: This work proposes a unified framework, termed UniSLAD, which jointly addresses logical and structural anomalies without additional training, enabling a practical solution for dynamic industrial environments and achieves competitive performance in comprehensive anomaly detection.

2606.20743.tldr: It is found that massive activations exist only because one stream is forced to be both scratchpad and answer, then a dedicated answer channel should remove the need for them, and it is found that it does not.

2606.20695.tldr: This work defines coordination-active pass^k, pass^k restricted to trials where the coordination mechanism is logically active, as the minimum reporting protocol, with sample-size targets and runtime hooks in the body, as the minimum reporting protocol.

2606.20663.tldr: This work introduces DrugBench, an AI control evaluation benchmark which combines 3,671 multi-turn medical conversations from HealthBench with drug information from official FDA labels, covering four categories of medication-related harm: drug interactions, contraindications, dosing constraints, and patient action restrictions.

2606.20661.tldr: KAPRO (Knowing-Acting Quadrant PRObe), a framework that evaluates cognitive-behavioral alignment by decoupling an agent's metacognitive judgment from its spontaneous execution (Acting), is introduced and KAware is constructed, a dataset rigorously partitioning tasks into external, internal, and hybrid subspaces to systematically probe these epistemic boundaries.

2606.20659.tldr: Skill coverage, a test adequacy metric that treats the skill artifact as the object under test, is introduced, highlighting skill coverage as a measure of how thoroughly agent skills are tested.

2606.20656.tldr: This paper introduces a data-driven approach to automatically generating splitting heuristics, and implements this approach in two popular string solvers, Z3seq and Z3str4, demonstrating that the learned heuristics outperform manually designed ones in the number of solved formulas and the average solving time.

2606.20961.tldr: It is shown that the benchmark primarily rewards learning in isolation rather than genuine continual transfer, and motivates a new design for future benchmarks of continual MLLM learning, with overlapping task manifolds, multiple task orders, fine-grained domain shifts, and evaluation protocols that reward forward transfer as well as retention.

2606.20912.tldr: This framework models system failures as parametric interventions over Partial Ancestral Graphs (PAGs) to perform RCA in the presence of latent variables and integrates partial identification to evaluate and score candidates using analytical causal bounds.

2606.20906.tldr: The Multi-level, Multi-color Graph Neural Network (MMGNN), a hierarchical framework that decomposes a molecular graph into overlapping atom-type-pair-specific subgraphs while preserving atom-level resolution, is introduced.

2606.20905.tldr: Vesta is presented, a unified embodied generalist that consolidates localization, spatial reasoning, navigation, navigation, and long-horizon planning capabilities into a single foundation model and demonstrates that a generalist model can match or exceed specialists.

2606.20897.tldr: The PeerCheck framework is proposed, which investigates LLM-human review differences (RQ1) and explores methods to improve LLM-generated review quality (RQ2), and CoT significantly improves the quality of LLM reviews, while an unexpected "RAG paradox" is discovered.

2606.21015.tldr: It is argued that evidence sufficiency is a missing layer of AI governance and that closing the AI Evaluability Gap is a prerequisite for both managing risk and sustaining value in AI-enabled organizations.

2606.21010.tldr: It is proposed that system boundaries can be defined as closures of loops formed by these relations, referred to as causal-constitutive loops, which implies a dual-process organization.

2606.21005.tldr: Beaver is introduced, an agent harness that extracts structured information from scientific papers while preserving provenance to the supporting evidence, and harness design is a central determinant of agent performance.

2606.20837.tldr: It is concluded that the functions presented in (van Ditmarsch, 2005) are not good formalizations of the philosophical intuition behind AGM, which is captured by the function $*^0$ originally defined in this paper (but highly inspired by (van Benthem, 2007)).

2606.20814.tldr: The evaluation prompt-only activations from both the pre-trained and the original instruct models (prior to narrow fine-tuning) could predict fine-grained alignment scores after narrow fine-tuning, and although the mean and standard deviations of the misaligned model scores are usually statistically different from those of the pre-trained model, there are some potential signals on overall positive correlation.

2606.21018.tldr: Preliminary observations and architectural analysis demonstrate that while ensuring musical coherence and interactive role-play, the proposed system successfully challenges extreme real-time engineering constraints, offering a highly robust and deployable technical paradigm for next-generation AI co-performers in live music.

2606.21008.tldr: This work introduces the first spectral solution, to the authors' knowledge, to the wicked problem of benchmarking LLMs' factual accuracy without golden keys or oracle models: one singular value decomposition of the evaluators'ratings matrix yields their competence as both generators and judges of true statements at once.

2606.20980.tldr: It is found that Humans and VLMs diverge in their responses -- though this is modulated by the type of questions asked, and that Humans answer similarly independent of where they are from (Lima/NYC), and that Humans answer similarly independent of where they are from (Lima/NYC).

2606.20913.tldr: PROTON (PROtotype-based Test-time ONline OOD detection), a lightweight post-hoc module that maintains an online prototype bank from high-confidence test predictions and adaptively fuses prototype distance with MCM scoring via stream-level variance statistics, requiring no model modification, training data, or prompt engineering.

2606.20911.tldr: Latent Personal Memory (LPM), a scalable framework that represents user-specific history as a compact, persistent matrix of N latent slots, that are interpretable, is presented.

2606.20881.tldr: This study conducts extensive experiments on LiveCodeBench, systematically evaluating representative certainty-based Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback approaches under different training scenarios and hyperparameter settings, showing both the promise and limitations of intrinsic reward methods for code.

2606.21013.tldr: This work introduces Agentic Time Machine, an infrastructure that approximately reconstructs the web state at any chosen past time by filtering post-cutoff content and proposes a planner-solver-aggregator multi-agent framework that breaks each question into diverse analytical angles, gathers evidence in parallel, and combines the results into a single forecast.

2606.20785.tldr: This work introduces FaraGen1.5, a scalable data pipeline for computer use agents composed of three modular components: environments, solvers, and verifiers, and trains Fara1.5, a family of native computer use agents at three scales built on Qwen3.5.

2606.20776.tldr: This work presents a LLM powered, evolutionary code synthesis system for structured data translation in a Medical Internet of Things settings and provides a set of experimental results which demonstrate that the system is able to consistently generate correct translation at low cost.

2606.20769.tldr: Deployed in the pre-submission loop as an anticipatory scientific co-author, FirstPass simulates expert critique and predicts revision cycle outcomes before submission, giving authors the judgment a trusted colleague would provide, with consistent cross-domain performance across five disciplines.

2606.21020.tldr: CheXpercept is a sequential, multi-level perception benchmark that mirrors a radiologist's cognitive workflow across coarse-level detection, fine-level contour evaluation and revision, and semantic-level attribute extraction, and highlights a systemic flaw in current domain adaptation.

2606.20950.tldr: The Power Systems Agent Benchmark is introduced, an executable benchmark for power-engineering agents that contains 41 task families across eight areas of power engineering, from power flow and protection to stability, microgrids, reliability, power quality, and forecasting.

2606.20857.tldr: SignVLA is presented, a real-time sign-language-guided VLA framework for accessible human-robot interaction that converts visual sign gestures into semantic instructions compatible with downstream VLA policies and suggests that lightweight temporal sign recognition can serve as an effective and practical accessibility layer for multimodal embodied intelligence.

2606.20852.tldr: meaningful performance gains were observed in one of three evaluated VLMs, suggesting that activation steering may serve as a lightweight approach for adapting medical VLM behavior.

2606.20839.tldr: The paper evaluates whether process-supervised tactic accumulation improves long-horizon bioinformatics workflow completion, biological correctness, and execution efficiency over no-memory and reflection-style baselines over no-memory and reflection-style baselines.

2606.20936.tldr: Comparisons of loss of a matched transformer and hybrid at the same target tokens under the same prefixes are compared, showing how token-level decompositions can sharpen pretraining diagnostics for hybrid architectures.

2606.20812.tldr: SplitUNet, a velocity network that factorizes each block into separate 1D temporal and 1D electrode convolutions and downsamples only along time, preserving electrode topology throughout the hierarchy, is introduced to address time-electrode asymmetry.

2606.20774.tldr: TriMotion is presented, a modality-agnostic framework for camera-controlled video generation that maps video, pose, and text inputs, describing the same camera trajectory into a shared motion embedding space, and introduces a latent motion consistency objective to encourage the generated video to follow the target camera trajectory directly in latent space, avoiding the cost of pixel-space decoding.

2606.20976.tldr: This paper presents a semi-supervised RF detection and classification workflow for satellite monitoring that combines Non-negative Matrix Factorization with automatic model determination (NMFk), expert-guided cluster interpretation, and classifier-based prediction.

2606.20969.tldr: AutoACSL is introduced, a novel framework that integrates LLM prompting with semantic features extracted from Code Property Graphs (CPGs) that substantially enhances both generation robustness and verification effectiveness for automated ACSL specification synthesis.

2606.20963.tldr: The Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) is introduced as a lightweight open-source data model for centralising AI observability across popular vendors and provides a practical pathway toward more consistent and reproducible benchmarking, tuning and assurance activities for generative AI systems.

2606.20929.tldr: This work explores the potential of leveraging internal artifacts of LLM to detect the correctness of their predictions in legal-domain classification tasks and develops approaches that utilize features derived from these internal artifacts to build downstream classifiers capable of identifying incorrect LLM outputs.

2606.20898.tldr: A comparison of two grounding architectures for document-grounded assistants finds that broader access (via long context) can increase it, but with a token tax of broader evidentiary access, which is interpreted as the token tax of broader evidentiary access.

2606.20895.tldr: The impact of neurosymbolic methods for automating CTM is demonstrated, providing a path toward the next generation of auditable, LLM-driven clinical applications.

2606.20893.tldr: This work proposes a generative attack framework operating in the continuous latent space of a neural audio codec that achieves targeted attack success rates up to 99% with sub-7 ms inference, outperforming generative baselines while reducing latency by 24x.

2606.20877.tldr: It is suggested that multi-agent design could benefit from matching interpretive networks to both task demands and agents'computational limits, with implications for the efficiency and energy costs of multi-agent systems.

2606.20868.tldr: This work presents the first systematic empirical evaluation of LLM brand intelligence across three tasks: domain enumeration (Q1), open ended brand attribution (Q2), and binary ownership classification (Q3), and reveals a stark dichotomy.

2606.20991.tldr: This tutorial introduces text-to-image generation to the M&S community and details how it can support several M&S tasks, including communicating conceptual models, visualizing simulation outcomes, generating educational materials, and interfacing heterogeneous models in multi-scale simulations.

2606.20978.tldr: These results offer a concrete design recommendation for PbD pipelines and, more broadly, for any system that feeds procedural context to an LLM agent: segment action sequences into named subgoal groups rather than presenting flat step lists.

2606.20954.tldr: It is argued that, because memory eviction in LLM agents is a fidelity problem, it requires a deployable proactive policy where the future query is unavailable and exact state is decisive, and that cheap learned relevance can be sufficient.

2606.20918.tldr: This paper benchmarks ten machine learning models for daily electricity demand forecasting across the New England ISO (February 2020 - March 2023), indicating the model over-applies stale pandemic patterns after behavioral adaptation was complete by August 2022.

2606.20910.tldr: This work demonstrates that AI web agents can be effectively distinguished from humans and traditional crawlers using a multi-layer fingerprint based on both network layer characteristics and browser interaction behavior, and demonstrates that cross-layer agent tracking provides a robust, evasion-resistant strategy for content protection and web security policy enforcement.

2606.20882.tldr: This paper argues that AI code generation severs that inference at its root, and that the consequence is not the degradation of the authorship-based metrics but their invalidation as a class.

2606.20874.tldr: Machine learning approaches for automated classification of cryopathy syndromes from laboratory data were developed and compared and the most informative predictors were derived cryoglobulin-based interaction features.

2606.20867.tldr: FOCA, a future-oriented conditioning framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation that combines explicit prediction of task-grounded future interaction embeddings with implicit alignment to future goal observations, enables long-horizon reasoning in latent space without pixel-level prediction.

2606.20799.tldr: GroundShot is presented, a training-free, model-agnostic agentic framework for entity-grounded multi-shot generation that improves multi-shot consistency over existing methods while requiring no additional training or model modification.

2606.20770.tldr: Punjabi Multimodal Visual Reasoning is introduced, the first benchmark designed to quantify script-dependent bias through 375 culturally grounded image-reasoning tasks across Punjabi's three active scripts, and SCR is proposed as a core metric for script-agnostic evaluation.

2606.20997.tldr: Results show that BioInsight achieves best, and suggest that biomedical AI systems should move beyond text-only and static reports toward provenance-preserving, interactive evidence artifacts.

2606.21053.tldr: This paper improves Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with two-stage on-policy reward learning (OPRL) to mitigate reward hacking under limited supervision from expert demonstration and proposes a novel imitation learning (IL) framework to learn TTS models from expert demonstrations.

2606.21297.tldr: This paper proposes a novel normalization method tailored to online RL, which normalizes low-dimensional observations and balances the resulting losses and gradients, and introduces Normalized Observation Space Dynamics-Augmented Q-learning (NASDAQ), a framework for observation-predictive RL applicable across diverse domains.

2606.21202.tldr: It is found that linguistic distance slows consensus, that it produces mild divergence between groups rather than full fragmentation, and that a collective whose shared rule was trained under diverse protocols is robust to mismatch; a homogeneously trained one is not.

2606.21201.tldr: It is argued that machine whistleblowing must be normative and principled and routed in the existing understanding of whistleblowing as an important rule-breaking mechanism in society.

2606.21194.tldr: This work introduces MedLayXPlain, the first large-scale multimodal benchmark and evaluation framework for Medical Lay Language Generation (MLLG), and introduces MedLayEval, a lightweight 3B evaluator distilled from a 27B verifier that scores expert-lay alignment across five clinically grounded attributes, addressing the poor correlation between standard NLG metrics and clinical judgment.

2606.21140.tldr: This work introduces AGENTMETER, a benchmark for evaluating model-CLI matching in CLI-mediated local task-solving agents, together with AgentMeter Score (AMS), a success-anchored, cost-aware metric over calibrated task-effort tiers.

2606.21119.tldr: Mammography dataset MammoExpert is presented, the first mammography dataset with Chain-of-Thought reasoning annotations across three diagnostic phases: primal observation, factual assessment, and diagnostic synthesis, and can serve as a benchmark for interpretable breast lesion diagnosis through explicit CoT reasoning.

2606.21115.tldr: This study introduces MS-rPPG, a multi-spectral framework that combines RGB with near-infrared (NIR) face video to alleviate rPPG estimation under challenging driving conditions and introduces MS-Mamba, a novel state space model designed to effectively model long-range temporal dependencies while jointly capturing cross-channel interactions between multi-spectral features.

2606.21098.tldr: LLM-based Multi-Reference Evaluation (LMRE) is proposed for phrase break annotations that models the one-to-many nature of prosodic phrasing and generates multiple valid phrasings from minimal demonstrations and shows stronger alignment with human judgment than single-reference evaluation in both acceptance behavior and score correlation.

2606.21083.tldr: It is argued that evaluation must report both coherence and non-vacuous commitment and release a toolkit for standardized assessment, a dual-query evaluation paradigm that jointly measures consistency and decisiveness.

2606.21082.tldr: This work addresses multi-turn jailbreak detection as a conversation-level classification problem and introduces an efficient hierarchical detector that avoids expensive long-context concatenation while retaining cross-turn reasoning.

2606.21071.tldr: CLAWAUDIT derives a five-category vulnerability taxonomy from STRIDE and develops custom static-analysis rules that target agent-specific patterns absent from established rule sets for vulnerability analysis, and evaluates on OPENCLAWBENCH, a benchmark of source-code-level advisories from the OpenClaw repository.

2606.21215.tldr: This work presents the first systematic study across 10 NVV types and proposes a framework combining frozen Data2Vec self-supervised features with ECAPA-TDNN, enhanced by a Mixture of Experts (MoE) module with learned domain-aware routing.

2606.21173.tldr: Surprisingly, it is found that policies trained exclusively on a Reacher agent's implicit world model are quasi-optimal on out-of-distribution, velocity-based goals despite position-only training -- suggesting that agents contain hidden generalisation capabilities and providing a new lens into the connection between model-based, model-free, and goal-conditioned RL.

2606.21130.tldr: A deployment-oriented, burst-aware early warning framework for proactive capacity stress prediction under AI workload surges, and shows how the proposed framework can be integrated into operational control loops to support proactive actions such as workload throttling and resource scaling.

2606.21121.tldr: Answer Engineering is presented, a deterministic runtime and authoring layer that applies localized rule-guided interventions to the visible reasoning trajectory during standard autoregressive generation, without retraining, modifying model weights, or performing global search, to support a systems-level view in which protocol adherence can be improved through auditable runtime control of reasoning trajectories.

2606.21109.tldr: Chem2Gen-Bench is introduced, a benchmark comprising 260,084 chemical and 1,099,045 genetic perturbation profiles organized into cell-target contexts, and evaluated pairwise alignment, retrieval, protocol covariate associations, feature spaces, and foundation-model embeddings.

2606.21075.tldr: This work proposes a FiLM-coordinated dual-branch Transformer for language modeling, where each layer explicitly contains a global branch and a local branch, and feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) is used for dynamic cross-branch coordination instead of simple concatenation or static addition.

2606.21022.tldr: SAGMTL decomposes OD prediction into structural state modeling and flow intensity estimation, jointly learning regional activity states, OD connection activity, and edge-level flow intensity within a unified framework and achieves superior overall performance compared with state-of-the-art baselines.

2606.21295.tldr: Topological Neural Dynamics (TND) is introduced, a sequence modeling framework that shifts computation from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics and suggests that shifting from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics provides an effective inductive bias for sequence modeling.

2606.21177.tldr: This work proposes TISC, a TMJ disc segmentation framework that integrates semantic anchoring with clinical metadata-guided boundary refinement, and achieves up to a 4.96 Dice improvement over strong baselines across diverse architectures, delivering more anatomically coherent and clinically reliable TMJ disc segmentation.

2606.21147.tldr: Evaluating 12 representative LALMs from six major model families, it is found that over-refusal is widespread and several important patterns in their safety judgments are uncovered, and two lightweight strategies are explored to reduce over-refusal.

2606.21144.tldr: It is argued that what is worth remembering is role-dependent, and AdaMem (Adaptive Memory) is proposed, a method that learns what to remember for each user from feedback.

2606.21124.tldr: PulseCX, a framework that decouples knowledge acquisition from consumption, removes synchronous search bottlenecks and drives significant gains in Intent Resolution and Customer Satisfaction in dynamic environments.

2606.21116.tldr: This work releases ConnectomeBench2, a unified multi-species dataset of over 716,485 expert-labeled proofreading decisions with>4,500,000 associated images spanning four major open connectomes, spanning both split and merge error correction.

2606.21096.tldr: SLeDGe is proposed, an SSL method for data streams that jointly learns a predictive model and an adaptive graph structure under strict memory and label constraints that outperforms state-of-the-art competitors.

2606.21213.tldr: QBioFusion-QSAR is supported as an auditable QMKL framework for identifying localized residual quantum-kernel contributions in small-data, activity-cliff-aware ligand classification and which molecules account for the change.

2606.21072.tldr: This paper designs Square Partition, a geometry-adaptive algorithm that partitions massive traffic sensors into balanced, non-overlapping, and near-square spatial regions and proposes a Hierarchical Linear Interaction (HLI) module that abandons the costly attention mechanisms commonly used in Transformer-based spatio-temporal models.

2606.21033.tldr: To make MoE effective in compression model, a stable routing strategy is introduced that combines expert-choice routing with spatial total variation regularization to encourage spatially coherent assignments, and a lightweight expert architecture is proposed, Group Shuffle MLP (GShMLP), to control parameter growth.

2606.21024.tldr: The results suggest that structured negative knowledge is a knowledge asset that should be explicitly maintained in broader AI-engaged scientific research beyond a memory-compression or debugging aid, alongside positive findings, as a collective infrastructure for scientific memory.

2606.21262.tldr: This work proposes ARCO (Adaptive Rubric CO-evolution), which generates a per-step rubric and predicts a rubric-conditioned step-level reward for each action, and continually updates this rubric model on on-policy rollouts so that its criteria and scores co-evolve with the agent's improving behavior.

2606.21244.tldr: A momentum consistency-guided densification strategy, strictly constraining primitive growth onto authentic geometric manifolds to avoid computational waste while significantly accelerating convergence, and a statistical sensitivity-driven sparsification mechanism to precisely prune redundant primitives, yielding a further compressed footprint.

2606.21171.tldr: An exploratory empirical case study of GPT-4o in a custom Python/Pygame endless runner suggests that, in this setting, GPT-4o handled localized transformations more reliably than tasks requiring new gameplay interactions across multiple existing systems.

2606.21169.tldr: Trip+ is introduced to measure the ability of agents to plan travel holistically, given traveler profiles and dynamic interactions, and finds a consistent gap in experiential quality.

2606.21165.tldr: OmniV2X, a generative foundation model for vehicle-to-everything (V2X) cooperative driving, is presented, which directly interprets independent context sequences comprising multi-modal and multi-agent observations and demonstrates its computational efficiency and robustness under real-world constraints.

2606.21156.tldr: This work proposes a bio-saliency score and a learning-to-rank strategy to adaptively identify the most informative spots within the tissue, and designs a cross-modal joint encoder that integrates visual and genetic modalities.

2606.21151.tldr: This paper presents a context-aware generative AI framework for automated telecom test script generation that treats testing as a continuously adapting process driven by the current state of the system rather than a static artifact and demonstrates applicability across software-system and telecom-network use cases.

2606.21139.tldr: Polar Latent Actions with Radial structure (PoLAR), which imposes a radial-direction structure on latent actions, encouraging radius to encode transition extent and direction to retain transition mode, improves downstream policy performance in simulation and real-world robot experiments.

2606.21085.tldr: Sim2O is introduced, an elegant and minimalist framework for offline-to-online MARL that significantly outperforms existing baselines, underscoring that a minimalist design is not only viable but highly effective for multi-agent offline-to-online adaptation.

2606.21052.tldr: The first systematic study of poisoning-based backdoor attacks on Speech Emotion Recognition systems with a focus on threats enabled by text-to-speech (TTS) generated audio is presented, revealing that TTS technology dramatically lowers the barrier to effective backdoor attacks.

2606.21267.tldr: It is demonstrated that FastGAN-based augmentation effectively enhances hyperspectral plant disease classification and that transformer-based models provide the most reliable discrimination between healthy and infested leaves.

2606.21257.tldr: A controlled empirical study of OpenPangu 1B and 7B models on Huawei Ascend 910B1 NPUs provides an NPU-oriented accuracy map for selecting OpenPangu quantization settings and highlights the persistent difficulty of extreme low-bit compression.

2606.21222.tldr: FleetAgent is introduced, a cloud-hosted multimodal large language model (MLLM) assistant that consumes compact vectorized vehicle-to-network (V2N) messages, such as map elements, detected objects, and the ego planned path, to enable efficient, explainable teleoperation monitoring for autonomous fleets.

2606.21197.tldr: This work proposes a framework based on SAEs to extract and analyze visual, textual, and multimodal concepts from VLMs, providing a structured approach to distinguish between visual, textual, and multimodal concepts.

2606.21189.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that TF-SNO significantly reduces prediction errors and improves robustness compared to strong baselines, with particularly clear gains in long rollout, suggesting the effectiveness of state-dependent spectral adaptation in modeling non-stationary physical systems.

2606.21525.tldr: A segmented backpropagation scheme with MC and critic-based bootstrap modes that mitigates gradient degradation on long-horizon tasks, and present ablations over segment length and bootstrap strategy.

2606.21401.tldr: SwarmX is presented, a system that implements agentic scheduling for low-latency agentic applications that reduces tail latency by up to 61.5% compared to state-of-the-art schedulers and sustains up to 2x the throughput of production schedulers under the same SLO.

2606.21384.tldr: Across four benchmarks spanning brain, cardiac, lesion, and oncology domains, EnTrust achieves state-of-the-art segmentation accuracy while reducing calibration error by 40% compared to the strongest baseline, and outperforms 5x deep ensembles using a single model at roughly half the memory footprint.

2606.21315.tldr: This work decomposes social interaction into five dimensions (scene setting, observation, mental state, action, and dialogue) to build a closed-loop learning framework, and provides a reusable data synthesis mechanism and a lifelong learning benchmark, transforming social capabilities from an"object of evaluation" into an"object of sustainable training".

2606.21689.tldr: These findings support targeted hybrid extraction workflows rather than replacement of existing rule-based methods for ALSFRS-R subscore detection.

2606.21307.tldr: A CL framework that jointly determines how many new atomic skills to introduce for each task and which skills to activate, and applies orthogonality-enhanced skill detection to ensure these skills remain semantically distinct and independently reusable.

2606.21579.tldr: A unified Zero-shot Procedural Mistake detection (ZeProM) framework that jointly solves procedural mistake detection and temporal action segmentation with a single pre-trained VLM is proposed.

2606.21498.tldr: This systematic theoretical analysis reveals that different divergences reshape token-level updates in distinct ways and achieves a favorable trade-off by mitigating uniform bias relative to the reference policy while still discouraging large deviations under the sampled-token shaping form used.

2606.21385.tldr: These findings challenge the prevailing impossibility claims for unsupervised disentanglement and provide a principled alternative foundation for unsupervised disentangled representation learning.
