2606.21641.tldr: On tabular HPO, seed classical search with a sensible default with a rule-based confidence filter that removes ~33% of wasted compute without changing accuracy; an LLM advisor adds no measurable generalization benefit and is overtaken within a handful of evaluations.

2606.21496.tldr: This work addresses the inability of current models to decouple the declarative and procedural knowledge from the procedural knowledge encoded in their parameters, enabling robust behavior cloning and unprecedented zero-shot skill transfer capabilities across dissimilar, unseen objects.

2606.21317.tldr: A gap between AI perception and AI influence is revealed: by shifting perception without reducing influence, warning-based interventions may offer a false sense of protection.

2606.21306.tldr: This work proposes an influence-based, instance-level explainability framework that explains each decision through supportive and competing training samples for each prediction, and provides auditable explanations by linking decisions to perceptible reference cases.

2606.21550.tldr: It is illustrated how the social choice perspective helps identify failure modes in the feedback aggregation layer and reveals a broader design space for handling disagreement in explicit and principled ways.

2606.21497.tldr: Hierarchical Block-Local Learning (HBLL), a framework that decomposes deep neural networks into hierarchically linked blocks trained using local learning objectives derived from variational principles, eliminating the need for full end-to-end backpropagation while maintaining effective information propagation across the network is proposed.

2606.21445.tldr: This work proposes AutoRAS, a framework for the Automated design of Robust Agentic Systems, which formulates system design as generating a sequence of symbolic primitives that jointly encode structural connectivity and behavioral actions, and learns to optimize this sequence using execution-derived safety signals and flow-based sequence-level objectives.

2606.21419.tldr: A large-scale multimodal dataset comprising 141,364 images, 981,947 image-level captions, 1,742,264 region-level captions, and 1,391,779 bounding box annotations is introduced to help VLMs learn fine-grained visual attributes.

2606.21409.tldr: It is shown that clean-tool gains can overstate tool value, and that matched no-feedback fallback controls are necessary for evaluating tool-augmented agents.

2606.21397.tldr: It is shown that scoped prompts that narrow the vulnerability scope outperform open-ended ones, whereas the prompt complexity has little impact, and that scoped prompts that narrow the vulnerability scope outperform open-ended ones, whereas the prompt complexity has little impact.

2606.21368.tldr: Graph-of-Differences (GoD), which grounds identity comparisons in explicit anatomical structure, improves Rank-1 by +7.1 pp on fundus and +3.1 pp on CXR over a strong frozen-backbone baseline, with further gains on zero-shot external transfers confirming that anatomy grounding improves both accuracy and generalization.

2606.21685.tldr: TACO is presented, a task-aware framework for automatic column description generation using single-prompt large language models (LLMs) and shows that TACO consistently outperforms existing methods, improving downstream task performance by up to 32%.

2606.21678.tldr: Verifier-coupled reasoning is proposed, a framework that inserts inline claims into reasoning traces and trains an auxiliary consistency head to predict programmatic verifier outputs from rationale-span hidden states to establish that consistency losses are effective diagnostics and representation-shaping tools, but not sufficient conditions for faithful reasoning.

2606.21611.tldr: This work identifies a critical structural barrier in the AC landscape: a "Two-Hump" distribution, where problem instances are either trivially solvable or effectively impossible, with a scarcity of intermediate"hard-but-solvable"instances required for effective learning.

2606.21344.tldr: The study demonstrates that trajectory prediction accuracy can rapidly deteriorate as the noise intensity increases, revealing the strong sensitivity of trajectory prediction models to noisy data, underscoring the need for more realistic training and evaluation datasets as well as noise mitigation strategies.

2606.21492.tldr: A retrospective cohort study using demographic, lifestyle, and comorbidity data from patients who underwent colonoscopy to develop and validate machine learning models to predict high-risk colorectal polyps using only noninvasive, pre-colonoscopy demographic, clinical, and behavioral features in a diverse, predominantly African American, urban cohort.

2606.21474.tldr: An interpretable, scalable, and context-sensitive AI system for mental health pre-diagnosis with potential integration into student support services globally is presented.

2606.21460.tldr: A benchmark of 240 Arabic test items distributed across eight domains and ten language skills provides a structured reference for evaluating compact Arabic language models and supports future work on efficient, reliable, and culturally appropriate Arabic AI systems.

2606.21414.tldr: Preliminary evidence is provided that synthetic, 2D diffusion-based training data can substitute for real X-ray data, identifying a promising avenue towards generating large, diverse datasets for training robust AI models in interventional X-ray imaging.

2606.21365.tldr: LambdaMark is introduced -- the first generic radioactive watermarking scheme that exhibits general and robust radioactivity and remains robust to distortions and adversarial removal attacks even on the generated outputs of those finetuned models.

2606.21732.tldr: This work identifies relinking, a compression-boundary vulnerability where the compressor behaves as a confused deputy, summarizing distributed, locally benign fragments into a complete malicious instruction, and presents Relink, an automated DSL-based tool that splits malicious payloads into benign fragments while keeping the complete payload absent before compression.

2606.21710.tldr: PrivacyAlign is introduced, a dataset of 1,350 samples with 3,516 detailed annotations from 599 unique annotators across diverse scenarios where current LLMs actually leak, and it is shown that conditioning LLM judges on human annotations and explanations for reference responses to the same prompt makes their judgments more reliable.

2606.21672.tldr: This work instantiates a grounded latent-action world model (GLAM), a pair of generative models with a shared latent action space across data sources that is grounded by predicting future observations consistently across sources, providing a paradigm for learning from heterogeneous data.

2606.21670.tldr: The entry to the efficiency track of the Academic Text-to-Music (ATTM) Grand Challenge at ICME 2026 is described, with a learned human-preference reward from TuneJury, a twin pairwise ranker trained over open music-preference datasets.

2606.21666.tldr: The Context Divergence Score (CDS), a lightweight scalar metric quantifying knowledge-state discrepancy between agent pairs across spatial, temporal, and task dimensions, is defined and the Shared State Verification Protocol (SSVP), which lets agents periodically exchange compressed state summaries and flag high-divergence conditions before joint reasoning is proposed.

2606.21627.tldr: Counsel, the first public dataset of meta-evaluations for agentic tasks, consists of process-level critiques from open-weight LLMJs on two agent benchmarks: tau-bench and DA-Code, and human meta-evaluations of these critiques.

2606.21613.tldr: This work operationalizes agreement as the alignment of independently derived hourly activity curves both with each other and with published behavioral priors-a three-way convergence that rules out shared-data confounds and dataset-internal correlation as alternative explanations.

2606.21337.tldr: Evaluations on video generation, real-world VQA, and GUI navigation confirm that $\text{DataClaw}_0$ delivers high-information-density tailored data, facilitating efficient model adaptation to new tasks under limited training data regimes.

2606.21565.tldr: A design-time verification approach that models agentic workflows as compositions of reusable building blocks and checks their compatibility through twelve structural rules and shows that the verifier reliably detects violations even when flawed designs are obscured through structural transformations such as splitting tasks between agents.

2606.21540.tldr: Mem-GF (Memory-efficient GF), a new GF-based CF method that departs from conventional designs by principally leveraging the structure of Krylov subspaces as a core mechanism for approximating polynomial graph filters without explicitly storing the item similarity graph, is proposed.

2606.21366.tldr: Drawing on a Feminist HCI perspective, this work examines sexualised AI-generated English-speaking voices offered by a popular commercial platform, revealing a narrow range of gender expression, largely binary and heteronormative.

2606.21356.tldr: This work proposes SOHET (Sequence Of Heterogeneous Events Transformer), a hierarchical architecture combining event-type-specific tabular encoders with temporal and type embeddings, processed by a causal or bidirectional transformer, processed by a causal or bidirectional transformer.

2606.21726.tldr: This work presents a formalization of the problem of synthesizing control policies that enforce a concentration property on the state distributions of a stochastic system in terms of synthesizing strategies for maintaining an entropy-based objective in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs).

2606.21623.tldr: This paper presents OmniDrive, a vision-language-action driving agent with 3D perception, reasoning, and planning capabilities, built upon OmniDrive, a vision-language-action driving agent with 3D perception, reasoning, and planning capabilities, to the doScenes Instructed Driving Challenge.

2606.21587.tldr: FAST employs Dynamic Parallel Sampling Alignment (DPSA) to maintain vectorization synchronization by extending terminated episodes via virtual continuation, thereby decoupling the sampling loop from individual terminations, effectively eliminating the bottleneck of premature resets without sacrificing data diversity.

2509.18120.tldr: This paper proposes CoCoGen, a coopetitive-compatible data generation framework, leveraging generative AI (GenAI) and potential game theory to model, analyze, and optimize collaborative learning under heterogeneous and competitive settings.

2508.04460.tldr: This work proposes MERA, a meta-cognitive reasoning framework that decouples reasoning from control to enable independent optimization of control strategies and improves both efficiency and accuracy.

2503.13505.tldr: This article categorizes LLM ensembles into seven main methods - weight merging, knowledge fusion, mixture ofexperts, reward ensemble, output ensemble, routing, and cascading - analyzing capabilities of those approaches and highlights key benefits such as improved diversity representation, enhanced output quality, and greater application flexibility.

2509.03647.tldr: Results show that steering vectors can reduce unjustified self-preference bias by up to 97\%, substantially outperforming prompting and direct preference optimization baselines, yet steering vectors are unstable on legitimate self-preference and unbiased agreement, implying self-preference spans multiple or nonlinear directions.

2508.18684.tldr: FALCON is introduced, an agentic framework for CTI-grounded rule retrieval, generation, and validation that drives the functional alignment between a CTI and a rule and refines them through self-reflective syntactic, semantic, and performance validators.

2508.10971.tldr: Rule2Text is presented, a comprehensive framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to generate natural language explanations for mined logical rules, thereby improving KG accessibility and usability and developing an LLM-as-a-judge framework that demonstrates strong agreement with human evaluators.

2508.06021.tldr: A state-of-the-art diffusion model is developed to address data imbalance by generating high-fidelity images that can augment training datasets, enabling the effective training of multi-class deep neural networks.

2505.24622.tldr: This work introduces Random Rule Forest, an interpretable ensemble that uses a large language model (LLM) not as an end-to-end predictor but as a generator of simple YES/NO questions, showing that LLMs can serve as auditable feature generators for high-stakes text-based decisions, combining transparency with competitive predictive performance.

2505.10457.tldr: This work introduces SEAL, a NAS-based framework tailored for data-incremental learning, a scenario where disjoint data samples arrive sequentially and are not stored for future access, and highlights the promise of combining NAS and selective expansion for efficient, adaptive learning in incremental scenarios.

2501.11790.tldr: RV-Bench, a novel evaluation methodology for Benchmarking LLMs with Random Variables in mathematical reasoning, develops question-generating functions to produce random variable questions (RVQs), whose background content mirrors the original benchmark problems, but with randomized variable combinations, rendering them "unseen" to LLMs.

2501.07761.tldr: This work develops a predictive model of delayed rewards that incorporates all information obtained to date and devise a bandit algorithm that quickly learns to identify content aligned with long-term success using this new predictive model.

2407.12690.tldr: This piece advocates for a middle path that leverages technical innovation and smart regulation to maximize the benefits of AI while minimizing its risks, offering a pragmatic approach to the responsible progress of AI technology.

2403.03739.tldr: The A&B BNN is proposed to directly remove part of the multiplication operations in a traditional BNN and replace the rest with an equal number of bit operations, introducing the mask layer and the quantized RPReLU structure based on the normalizer-free network architecture.

2503.05226.tldr: The resulting claim is bounded: Reward-Centered ReST-MCTS is an inspectable test-time verifier for same-backbone high-uncertainty manipulation, not a replacement VLA policy or a broad standard-benchmark superiority claim.

2505.13087.tldr: An open-source Python package to generate graph alignment datasets and benchmark new GNN architectures and proves that there is an optimal task difficulty for having a statistically relevant ranking of different models and that, even on a structure-only task, anisotropic models perform better compared to isotropic ones.

2407.18957.tldr: This research explores the study of agents' free trading gaps in the context of no prior knowledge related to market data, and finds patterns identified through StockAgent simulations provide valuable insights for LLM-based investment advice and stock recommendation.

2412.08147.tldr: The main theoretical result is to show that more flexible posteriors necessarily yield better estimates of Pareto fronts, and validate the theory through extensive empirical results on vision and language transformers where better Gaussian families consistently yields better or comparable Pareto fronts.

2411.08875.tldr: It is demonstrated that rex is the most efficient black-box tool and produces the smallest explanations, in addition to outperforming other black-box tools on standard quality measures.

2409.11363.tldr: CORE-Bench (Computational Reproducibility Agent Benchmark), a benchmark consisting of 270 tasks based on 90 scientific papers across three disciplines (computer science, social science, and medicine), is introduced, designed to measure the accuracy of AI agents in tackling a crucial yet surprisingly challenging aspect of scientific research: computational reproducibility.

2408.07003.tldr: It is found that, first, both GPT models are capable of correctly and precisely labelling topics from the models' output keywords at the default temperature and, second, 3-word labels are preferable to grasp the complexity of research topics.

2509.04827.tldr: VoltanaLLM is introduced, the first system that explicitly targets and reduces the energy bloat in modern prefill-decode (P/D) disaggregated LLM serving via phase-aware, iteration-level frequency selection coupled with architecture-aware routing.

2505.17338.tldr: To bridge the domain gap between natural scene reconstruction and medical volumetric rendering, Anatomy-Guided Priming (AGP) is introduced, which incorporates segmentation masks and transfer functions as structural and appearance priors, information that existing Gaussian splatting methods overlook.

2504.17070.tldr: This paper develops MuTRAP, the first multi-trigger trojan attack specifically designed and targeted for LLM-assisted robot task planners, and develops a trigger optimization method for selecting multiple-trigger words that are most effective for different robot applications.

2412.14522.tldr: CwA-T, a novel framework that combines a channelwise CNN-based autoencoder with a single-head transformer classifier for efficient EEG abnormality detection, demonstrating great potential for future applications in neuroscience research and clinical practice.

2504.06138.tldr: This paper proposes a framework to bring multimedia and visual analytics together and indicates how it could impact current and new multimedia analytics solutions.

2503.00069.tldr: It is argued that improving LLM alignment requires incorporating insights from societal alignment frameworks, including social, economic, and contractual alignment, and potential solutions drawn from these domains are discussed.

2405.19062.tldr: This work proposes CIR, a framework grounded in a novel structural causal model termed the ICCM that jointly captures invariant structural and temporal patterns through dedicated subgraph extractors, and maintains an environment memory bank to model distributional shifts across evolving contexts.

2402.09934.tldr: New datasets from Twitter and YouTube are introduced, revealing overlaps as well as distinctions between whataboutism, propaganda, and the tu quoque fallacy, and drawing on recent work in linguistic semantics differentiate the `what about'lexical construct from whataboutism.

2603.13673.tldr: This work proposes LLM-MINE, a Large Language Model-based phenotype mining framework for automatic extraction of ADRD phenotypes from clinical notes and demonstrates that LLM-based phenotype extraction is a promising tool for discovering clinically meaningful ADRD signals from unstructured notes.

2606.09831.tldr: An AI-based speech processing approach is presented to analyse classroom talk in team-teaching settings and reveals systematic differences in loudness dynamics: high-experience teachers, undergraduate classes and collaborative learning tasks exhibited greater loudness variation.

2603.20450.tldr: A dataset of peer reviews simulating multiple levels of human-AI collaboration, and five state-of-the-art detectors are evaluated, finding that none meets the accuracy standards required for identifying AI use in peer reviews.

2603.13343.tldr: A contextual data fusion framework that combines vehicle-internal sensor streams with external environmental signals–road quality, weather, traffic density, and driver behaviour–acquired via third-party APIs and Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication, with inference at the vehicle edge is presented.

2603.19957.tldr: HiPath is presented, a lightweight VLM framework built on frozen UNI2 and Qwen3 backbones that treats structured report prediction as its primary training objective and achieves 68.9% strict and 74.7% clinically acceptable accuracy with a 97.3% safety rate.

2606.16845.tldr: The Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion framework is introduced, a hybrid neuro-symbolic architecture that compresses Chain-of-Thought reasoning trajectories without Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).

2606.10124.tldr: FedSteer is proposed, a novel method that constructs a gradient subspace from a cache of recent client gradients to serve as a low-dimensional representation of the current optimization landscape and significantly outperforms baselines in challenging scenarios while delivering accuracy gains of over 7% in others.

2605.03940.tldr: This work describes a dynamical system in which a symbolic field is coupled to a geometric field via a bipartite Hilbert-Schmidt kernel via a bipartite Hilbert-Schmidt kernel and describes design specifications that fulfill the hypotheses of the main Theorem.

2603.20750.tldr: These findings establish subjective-graph LLM agents as a mechanism-oriented framework for data-constrained simulated social perception in which LLM agents operate through individualized subjective graphs that determine peer visibility, evidence access, and interaction opportunities.

2606.16428.tldr: Experimental results show consistent gains in lecture content quality, embodied teaching quality, assessment, and personalization over existing approaches, positioning Lect\=uraAgents as a pedagogically well-grounded framework for personalized learning at scale.

2603.20510.tldr: This work introduces a general framework for distilling expert system reasoning into natural language chain-of-thought explanations, enabling compact models to acquire domain expertise and the ability to generate faithful, grounded explanations.

2604.08558.tldr: WAND, Windowed Attention and Knowledge Distillation, a framework that adapts pretrained AR-TTS models to operate with constant computational and memory complexity, and utilizes knowledge distillation from a full-attention teacher to recover high-fidelity synthesis quality with high data efficiency.

2606.22068.tldr: In this approach a reduction of the learning rate is shown to be achieved by using alternate loss functions that are infinitely differentiable, strictly convex or quasiconvex and more closely approximate the absolute error than Huber and log-cosh losses.

2606.23797.tldr: The Goal-Oriented Dialogue Runtime (GODR), a framework-neutral design pattern that treats goals, task frames, lifecycle state, invalidation rules, and resumption contracts as first-class runtime objects while delegating bounded execution to graph runtimes, agents, tools, or application programming interfaces (APIs).

2606.23702.tldr: UAMR-ShiftBench is the first benchmark to jointly cover in-distribution, low-SNR, unseen-environment, unseen-environment, unseen-communication-parameter, and measured sea-trial evaluation under a single matched protocol, with two independent real-world subsets collected during two sea-trial campaigns conducted in March and November in the South China Sea.

2606.23695.tldr: The NCU metric is introduced, leveraging continuous token log-probabilities across zero-shot, oracle, and adversarial conditions to strictly quantify contextual information gain and highlight the structural epistemic advantage and superior contextual adherence of SLMs in strict extraction workflows.

2606.23690.tldr: Diffusion Models are discussed, which generate code via holistic denoising that captures long-range syntactic constraints often missed by AR models and Code World Models, which simulate execution states to support reasoning, and State Space Models, which provide linear-time efficiency for massive contexts.

2606.22974.tldr: The existence of coherent preferences as demonstrated in choice paradigms should not be taken as evidence that those preferences have incentive value for the models or affect their behavior in other contexts.

2606.22748.tldr: It is suggested that AI-generated fiction shares structural affinities with on-demand, personalized, and repetitive cultural forms, and that LLMs enable interactivity, play, and permutation in ways that are seemingly pleasurable for users, raising questions about where AI will fit into contemporary storytelling and entertainment ecosystems.

2606.23825.tldr: This work proposes a paradigm shift from spatial to spectral feature processing, introducing a holistic solution with the following novelty: a versatile A versatile Frequency-Guided Feature Representation framework that generalizes across diverse detector architectures and extensive validation on multi-domain benchmarks demonstrating consistent gains.

2606.23821.tldr: This article reports a human--AI collaboration on two computations that produced accurate candidates and plausible proof strategies, but several failed, including one apparently complete tail argument that omitted the componentwise check required by a nonuniform polydisc.

2606.23768.tldr: This work outlines the approach at a high level, gives the core mathematical translation, relate the proposal to proof-carrying code, zkVMs, formal methods, and agent governance, and note the specification, auditing, and deployment questions that a full implementation must answer.

2606.23761.tldr: GSU-DBNet simultaneously models the speech magnitude spectrum and complex spectrum, predicting the corresponding magnitude and complex spectral masks and outperforming existing SNN-based methods while using only 4.5%--10.6% of the parameters of representative ANN-based models.

2606.23705.tldr: A rater-aware, event-aligned framework that converts sparse, rater-specific pain ratings into discrete pain-change events and aligns continuous wearable physiological signals to these events, preserving rater identity throughout is introduced.

2606.23701.tldr: A scalable and interpretable framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to quantify product desirability from such data and incorporates model confidence ratings and human-readable rationale explanations (xAI), improving interpretability, transparency, and trust while supporting practical use in product satisfaction assessment.

2606.23697.tldr: This paper defines a set of code chunk categories, and introduces SemChunk-C, a family of lightweight language models for semantic chunking of C-related files based on the first four Ettin encoders, capable of identifying cohesive code units, such as data structures, interface blocks, and other components.

2606.22600.tldr: It is shown that IW-OPD converges significantly faster than OPD, with better learning efficiency, and achieves better final performance than standard OPD in both same-size and cross-scale settings, improving performance up to 6.9 points on AIME-2025.

2606.22314.tldr: This work introduces a new generative perspective for flexible, inference-time controllable Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods, by proposing Diffusion Integrated Gradients, a novel method that reformulates path generation as a conditional generative modeling problem.

2606.23700.tldr: SGTR finetuning is studied as a character-targeted intervention that is distinct from existing in-training defenses and reframe EM not as the adoption of a coherent misaligned persona but as the destabilization of aligned character.

2606.23771.tldr: A multimodal sensing architecture for XR that combines 5G MillimeterWave Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) and surface electromyography (sEMG) signals is proposed, which enables multi-scale gesture recognition, at the body level via existing 5G signals and finger level via lightweight sEMG sensors, forming a complete XR framework.

2606.23764.tldr: Extensive experiment results support interpreting Differential Order as a structure-sensitive emergent outcome of general social mechanisms, with LLM-based multi-agent simulation providing an interdisciplinary framework for studying social structure and change.

2606.23759.tldr: VeriPilot is an LLM-powered debugging framework that leverages golden reference models to enable fine-grained bug localization and repair and improves the repair success rate of GPT-4o, significantly enhancing both bug localization accuracy and repair effectiveness for complex Verilog designs.

2606.23745.tldr: JEDEL is the first model to map pharmacophore interaction patterns to actionable, scalable synthesis instructions, enabling the design of targeted libraries comprising potentially millions of molecules, within the space of purchasable building blocks and validated reactions.

2606.23720.tldr: An integrated framework that unifies runtime verification and model-based diagnosis within the stream specification language LOLA is presented, which enables continuous, online fault localization directly alongside fault detection, without requiring separate toolchains.

2606.23716.tldr: It is argued that current benchmarks are not equipped to support the assumption that large language models can improve access to justice, and called for legal benchmarks that directly measure robustness under pro se-like inputs so that access-to-justice claims about legal AI can become empirical testable.

2606.23715.tldr: It is shown that, for every choice of weights, if the weights are scaled by $1/n$ then, for every first-order sentence $\varphi$ the probability that $\varphi$ holds tends to either 0 or 1 as $n \to \infty$; that is, a 0-1 law for first-order logic holds.

2606.23707.tldr: This paper reformulate EEGSR as learning a shared conditional scalp field from partially observed support channels, and introduces a fidelity-preserving channel corruption training strategy under mixed electrode states.

2606.21894.tldr: From observations, this work identifies the skills developers need in the agentic era of development, with implications for training and educating future software engineers in coming years.

2606.23757.tldr: A new 10-seed acquisition study shows that EI, GWU, PC-EI, uncertainty sampling, discrepancy hunting, and random search have different trade-offs: PC-EI substantially reduces low-yield BO suggestions, while EI-style criteria give the strongest final-yield performance.

2606.23742.tldr: Inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, trainable nonlinear functions are placed on the connections, making each physical connection a learnable computational element in physical neural networks.

2606.23712.tldr: This work proposes to augment the diffusion training objective with a contrastive audio-visual loss to encourage stronger use of visual information while keeping the posterior sampling framework unchanged and shows consistent improvements in interference suppression, signal reconstruction, and perceptual quality.

2606.23698.tldr: Ozaki-Bailey FFT is presented, an emulated 3-D FFT via the Bailey six-step decomposition with both 1-D FFT GEMMs on FP8 tensor cores, and Kulisch fixed-point complete arithmetic is identified as a Phase B reformulation that keeps full FP64 accuracy while running entirely on the INT32 SIMT pipe.

2606.23604.tldr: This work introduces Polycepta, an object-centric appearance state estimation framework that reformulates appearance modeling as a recursive estimation problem rather than a frame-wise matching task and demonstrates consistent reductions in identity switches and improvements in tracking performance when integrated into the tracking-by-detection pipelines.

2606.23238.tldr: HOLMES (Higher-Order Logic Meets real-world Explainable Symbolic reasoning), the first real-world benchmark for higher-order symbolic reasoning in LLMs, is introduced, revealing that high final-answer accuracy can mask shortcut reasoning in conflict-resolution settings, while performance drops sharply under scope-conditioned and compositional reasoning.

2606.23830.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that SurfBind achieves state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization across unseen antibodies and conformational states, highlighting the value of interaction-aware surface modeling for understanding the crucial mechanisms of protein-protein interactions.

2606.23763.tldr: PV-TAM adopts prompt-side semantics and incorporates a filter to remove systematic bias induced by modality boundary markers and consistently improves both attention-based and IoU-style localization metrics over answer-side baselines on various datasets.

2606.23741.tldr: FCD and FCI are formalized as complementary stages of a unified federated causal reasoning pipeline, where FCD supplies the structural knowledge required for valid effect estimation in FCI, and their shared concerns regarding privacy, communication efficiency, theoretical guarantees, and application domains are highlighted.

2606.23740.tldr: Training six methods on identical math rollouts from a single base model with attention-only LoRA and analyzing the resulting deltas via cosine similarity, principal-angle subspace analysis, linear mode connectivity, and CKA finds that SFT, RFT, and RIFT have nearly colinear weight deltas and DPO reaches the highest accuracy.

2606.23032.tldr: IPO Finance Agent is introduced, which extends the Finance Agent v2 framework along two directions: task domain and retrieval architecture, and introduces an evaluator-optimizer pipeline to automatically generate evaluation rubrics for the benchmark.

2606.22220.tldr: This work establishes the first framework for measuring and mitigating memorization in multi-modal contrastive learning, preventing harmful data retention and contributing to higher-performing models.

2606.23877.tldr: JupOtter achieves cell-level bug detection F1 scores that surpass static analyzers and large language models in two out of three evaluation datasets, and achieves cell-level bug detection F1 scores that surpass static analyzers and large language models in two out of three evaluation datasets.

2606.24104.tldr: A large-scale survey of HSS students in China finds that more than half perceived enhanced learning motivation, independent thinking and creativity, although a substantial minority reported little change or even decline in GenAI use.

2606.24093.tldr: A poet-level corpus of 357 poets is built and it is shown that, when given the whole corpus through a hierarchical frozen-encoder representation, a classical-Chinese transformer only matches -- not beats -- simple TF-IDF, and that combining them adds nothing, indicating that character $n-grams already capture the regional signal.

2606.24075.tldr: This work proposes EMRFormer, a novel end-to-end spiking nerural network (SNN) architecture that applies spike-driven transformer to the constraints of neuromorphic hardware for AMR, and demonstrates a promising pathway for AMR on resource-constrained devices.

2606.24064.tldr: Strategic-Guided Policy Optimization is proposed, which replaces instance-level trajectory imitation with reusable strategy distillation and consistently outperforms SFT, on-policy RL, and hybrid-policy baselines.

2606.24062.tldr: The Regime-Aware Variable-context Expert Network (RAVEN), a Mixture-of-Experts framework designed to adaptively determine the temporal context for each input sample, is proposed, a Mixture-of-Experts framework designed to adaptively determine the temporal context for each input sample.

2606.24026.tldr: This work proposes HyVE (Hypothesize, Validate, Explain), an agentic explainer that analyzes each component through an iterative loop of observation, hypothesis generation, and causal validation, eventually producing a component-level explanation and a circuit-level task description.

2606.24014.tldr: Results suggest that RL to reinforce beneficial behavior in realistic domains can produce models that are more robustly aligned with human flourishing, and models trained with beneficial trait RL show improved persistence.

2606.23991.tldr: It is argued that genuine agency requires these structures to be internalized within the system itself rather than assembled through external scaffolding, and proposed the Goal-Identity-Configurator (GIC) architecture for a general-purpose agent model.

2606.23927.tldr: RIFT-Bench is introduced, a graph representation-driven methodology for dynamic red-teaming that enables unified evaluations across diverse agentic architectures and generalizes effectively to heterogeneous agentic architectures.

2606.23888.tldr: Experiments on large-scale 3D CT tumor datasets demonstrate that E-MRL significantly reduces hallucinations and improves diagnostic accuracy compared to SFT and RL baselines, offering a clinically interpretable solution for visually-grounded and tumor analysis.

2606.24115.tldr: Estimating confident confabulation, a failure mode in which models hallucinate with high inter-sample consistency or high token-level probability, is identified, as a systemic failure for both consistency and uncertainty-based methods.

2606.24112.tldr: ReMMD-Agent obtains the best five-way veracity performance, with 41.80% accuracy and 39.12% macro-F1 using GPT-5.2, while reducing cost by 17.5% relative to MMD-Agent and 79.9% relative to T2-Agent.

2606.24096.tldr: This work validates robustness on ACDC's fog, night, rain, and snow, and concludes with a simple recipe: learn the 2x2 CFA weights and keep an identity PSF, which decomposes which sensor degrees of freedom benefit dense prediction.

2606.24081.tldr: PixJail is proposed, a self-evolving paper-to-pipeline agent framework for reproducible T2I jailbreak evaluation that can serve as a unified foundation for future T2I jailbreak reproduction and evaluation, significantly reducing manual effort.

2606.24074.tldr: This paper develops an analogous notion for certifying the reliability of a stochastic oracle on a given domain by constructing an SPRT-based certification SOTM that queries the oracle, computes binary correctness scores, and stops when the accumulated log-likelihood evidence crosses a decision threshold.

2606.24063.tldr: BSU is proposed, a representation-level framework that isolates and attenuates intent-conditioned directions underlying this mapping and substantially reduces forced-prefix recoverability while preserving retained performance.

2606.23983.tldr: Maestro Order is presented, a model-agnostic orchestration harness that turns unreliable solvers into reliable problem-solving systems by composing them according to four structural primitives and a budget-aware controller that decides where to spend compute.

2606.23898.tldr: This work introduces ARIA, a framework that adaptively allocates training effort across coarse regions of the conditioning space and provides a theoretical analysis showing that the proposed tracking mechanism follows the evolving discrepancy during training under bounded variance and drift assumptions.

2606.24127.tldr: DTT-BSR+ improves multi-mel signal-to-noise ratio (MMSNR) over the single-stage DTT-BSR across all stems, and surpasses the state-of-the-art X-LANCE MSR system on five stems.

2606.24089.tldr: Evaluation of the learned representations through Principal Component Analysis (PCA) visualization and quantitative metrics reveals that the encoder hierarchically captures terrain geometry with higher terrain encoding capability, leading to enhanced terrain adaptability and motion smoothness.

2606.24084.tldr: This paper introduces blockwise policy-drift gating, a lightweight student-only old-current drift controller for OPD under rollout reuse and identifies local old-current policy drift as a practical control signal for reused OPD rollouts and motivate block-level gating as a simple default for improving solve-rate robustness.

2606.24083.tldr: Cavewoman is presented, a two-channel evaluation protocol that scores every generation on task accuracy, realized per-item cost, and reference-text agreement against the model's unconstrained reference, and survives length-controlled re-scoring, multiple-comparisons correction, and replication under complementary semantic measures.

2606.24040.tldr: A version-aware operation layer is proposed in which high-level operations such as replace, obsolete, keep-history, rollback, and trace are compiled into MeMo-native primitive calls over sequences and tokens.

2606.23872.tldr: Data Circuit Breaker (DCB) is proposed, a three-stage method that combines complementary signals from a generative model's autoencoder and latent generator to distinguish training members from generated samples.

2606.23884.tldr: It is argued that ethical design and deployment of these LLMs demand clearly defined harm categories across clinical conditions and implementation of safeguards accordingly, and an eight-dimension harm taxonomy and a multi-dimensional evaluation framework are introduced.

2606.23879.tldr: ChameleonNet demonstrated feasibility for heart chamber segmentation from non-contrast CT without manual non-contrast annotations, however, volume errors, particularly for LV and RV, indicate that further refinement and validation are needed before clinical use.

2606.23858.tldr: The apothem measure is introduced and it is proved that the authors cannot have a volume-optimal, oracle-based algorithm, even if they discard the oracle costs, thus providing apothem-minimum upper bounds to a robustness certification.

2606.23832.tldr: It is found that in decentralized settings with only local information, the aircraft are able to conform to the corridor boundaries more than 94% of the time and reach their goal in a relatively efficient manner.

2606.24124.tldr: VeryTrace is presented, a zero-shot verification-and-repair framework that formalizes natural-language reasoning traces into a structured, compilable representation that improves accuracy over zero-shot baselines on state-of-the-art LLMs without requiring domain-specific training or in-context examples, demonstrating that formalized trace verification achieves both precision and generalization.

2606.24046.tldr: This work presents a machine learning framework that leverages an autoencoder (AE) for the efficient modeling of FinFET, providing a powerful tool for rapid device characterization, modelling and circuit level simulation.

2606.24042.tldr: A multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that formalizes recommendation as a semantic multi-objective Markov decision process and treats engagement, diversity, and fairness as distinct, non-aggregable reward signals, avoiding the pitfalls of static reward scalarization is introduced.

2606.24007.tldr: This work introduces a new optimizer that not only consistently improves over existing VCL optimizers, but also performs better than other weight-regularization strategies across domain-incremental learning, continual pre-training, and fine-tuning of large language models.

2606.24004.tldr: This work proposes spec learning, a framework that relies on a brief user instruction and a small set of preference judgments that are compiled into specifications in the form of natural-language prompts for an LLM, and shows that the responses generated based on the compiled specifications often outperform direct preference optimization (DPO) on datasets from specialized domains whose preference signal is dense.

2606.23995.tldr: EMAgnet is introduced, which regularizes toward an exponential moving average of the last-iterate policy's parameters, providing an adaptive regularization target that evolves with the agent's improving strategy and achieves lower exploitability in the majority of tested environments.

2606.23992.tldr: Results show that retrieval-constrained LLM adjudication can substantially improve value set completion while preserving the safety constraint that all returned codes must come from an auditable candidate pool.

2606.23978.tldr: An offline reinforcement learning (RL) framework for optimizing SLAM throughput control in a warehouse fulfillment environment that includes a history-informed state representation, action space abstraction for delayed-impact control, and a reward function that captures both upstream and downstream operational metrics.

2606.24010.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that enforces hard safety constraints under mild assumptions at low level via a constraint manifold, while enabling effective coordination through high-level policy learning, thereby enabling stable and efficient training.

2606.23989.tldr: CAMS matches strong end-to-end and span-attribution baselines on summary quality while substantially improving faithfulness and citation precision, lifting multi-source attribution accuracy by roughly two-thirds, and exposing a controllable faithfulness--coverage trade-off that end-to-end models leave implicit.

2606.23938.tldr: Neural-Symbolic Drive is introduced, a neuro-symbolic driving framework that supervises a driving VLA with rule-grounded reasoning traces extracted directly from classical rule-based planners, ensuring reasoning is structurally coupled to motion generation by construction, rather than by post-hoc alignment.

2606.23937.tldr: The results indicate that exact-match clause recall can underestimate downstream policy utility in this benchmark setting, motivating evaluation with retrieved policies in the classification loop rather than recall alone.

2606.23920.tldr: This work conjecture that no inference-time technique can efficiently produce samples from the target distribution in certain well-motivated settings, and shows that score estimation error has a more catastrophic effect on performance when the target distribution is out-of-distribution with respect to the sources.

2606.23897.tldr: This work proposes TheProfessor, a multi-teacher extension that distills from a fixed two-teacher ensemble: a domain-finetuned PromptSRC ViT-L/14 teacher and a zero-shot EVA-CLIP-L/14 teacher whose logits are pre-computed per dataset.

2606.24129.tldr: OmniPath is presented, a system that moves from passive mapping to proactive environmental auditing, and fuses the network topology of OSM with the submeter precision of high-density aerial LiDAR (USGS 3DEP) to create a high-fidelity 3D model of the pedestrian environment.

2606.24107.tldr: DramaDirector is proposed, a geometry-grounded framework that lets the planner borrow cinematographic geometry from a gallery of real short-drama shots indexed by depth and pose, and improves over representative multi-agent and video generation baselines on faithfulness, consistency, and controllability.

2606.24099.tldr: This paper aims to build the co-occurrence network of algorithms in the natural language processing field based on the full-text content of academic papers and analyze the academic influence of algorithms in the group based on the features of the network.

2606.24047.tldr: A hybrid predictive model is suggested that merges an ensemble feature selection strategy using ANOVA and mutual information and mutual information and Harris Hawks optimization-tuned logistic regression and represents a new application of swarm intelligence to predict mental health in vulnerable groups.

2606.23885.tldr: Head-Wise Representation Alignment (HeRA) is proposed, a method that enforces cross-modal alignment at the level of individual attention heads and serves as an effective regularizer against visual hallucinations by naturally curbing the over-reliance on linguistic priors.

2606.23993.tldr: This work presents the first demonstration of RL-based trigger control on real Large Hadron Collider collision data, and adapts Group-Filtered Policy Optimization to streaming control and introduces two variants that enforce background rate feasibility during training.

2606.24416.tldr: Agentic-LTPO is presented, a nested bilevel optimization framework that can be applied to adaptive physical layer problem configuration and exhibits strong adaptability to dynamic operator policies and effectively enhances the system's long-term performance by 57.2% compared to traditional methods.

2606.24255.tldr: The Solo-to-Social framework bridges social organization and motion realization, producing 3D HHI with improved phase consistency, role alignment, and partner-aware coordination.

2606.24235.tldr: SP-Mind is presented, the first autonomous AI agent designed to unify the spatial proteomics analysis pipeline, from raw multiplexed tissue imaging to downstream phenotype discovery, and achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing open-source biomedical agent baselines.

2606.24231.tldr: The proposed FlowR2A unifies the dense supervision of scoring-based methods with the proposal generation of anchor-based methods in a single generative model, forcing the model to internalize the correlation between an action and its outcomes in safety, progress, comfort, and rule compliance.

2606.24200.tldr: MMed-Bench-IR is introduced, a benchmark designed to disentangle axes across 6 languages and three structurally heterogeneous tasks: cross-lingual medical QA retrieval with 6,127 queries grounded in the Unified Medical Language System, concept discrimination over 4,975 confusion sets at three difficulty tiers, and multilingual evidence retrieval for RAG with 2,040 quality-assured queries.

2606.24192.tldr: This work proposes ReCARE (Robust erasure for CARE), a framework that explicitly safeguards CARE while erasing only the target concept, and achieves overall state-of-the-art performance in balancing robust concept erasure, overall utility, and CARE preservation.

2606.24320.tldr: This work presents ZONOS2 8B, the latest TTS model, which achieves state-of-the-art naturalness, prosody, and voice cloning fidelity, and improves upon Zonos-v0.1 across scale, data, and training recipe, improving inference latency and throughput.

2606.24267.tldr: It is found that pigeonholing worsens almost monotonically with the number of conversation turns, and pigeonholing-induced mode collapse can happen even when the provided example is correct.

2606.24177.tldr: This work presents \textsc{Agon], a research orchestrator that validates what can be checked inside the workflow and leaves the remaining judgments to human scientists, built on six design principles: Prompt Economy, Future-Facing, Minimal Prompts, OmniDisciplinary, Massive Parallelism, and Zero-Code.

2606.24172.tldr: A four-part benchmark suite is proposed to render this shared architecture of Indic languages explicit, measurable, and ready to be leveraged for practical applications, and underscores the question it raises for interpretability research: whether neural models trained on these languages come to represent P\={a}nini's categories on their own.

2606.24160.tldr: This work introduces and discusses through causal lenses generalized policy learning, where to intervene, imitation learning, and counterfactual learning, which is introduced and discussed through causal lenses generalized policy learning, where to intervene, imitation learning, and counterfactual learning.

2606.24145.tldr: T2D-Bench is a reproducible benchmark and evidence-gated evaluation framework for testing whether LLM outputs satisfy explicit, graph-checkable evidence requirements and shows that computable evidence constraints can make unsupported clinical omissions explicit, measurable, and correctable in diabetes-focused LLM outputs.

2606.24392.tldr: This work presents \textsc{ATRIA], a multi-agent ECG reporting system that binds every report claim to its supporting evidence, flags statements unsupported by that evidence, incorporates additional context mid-session, and lets clinicians verify and revise individual findings rather than accept one opaque output.

2606.24245.tldr: AutoSpec is a framework that automatically evolves deployed expert-designed safety rules from user safe/unsafe annotations through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS) guided by inductive logic programming (ILP), producing interpretable rules that balance precision and recall.

2606.24206.tldr: I2C-3D is proposed, a novel optimization-based method to generate multi-view consistent compositional 3D assets with reasonable interactions and an Inclusive Interactive Collisions strategy to guide Gaussian primitives appearing in reasonable interaction regions naturally, thereby ensuring objects in the compositional scene interact in a physically plausible and visually coherent way.

2606.24169.tldr: A controlled sweep of a 0.6 B-parameter cache-aware FastConformer transducer across eight European languages, up to five target-language data scales, three streaming tiers plus offline decoding, and up to four public test sets concludes that multilingual initialization is a data-limited advantage, not a latency-limited one.

2606.24251.tldr: This work proposes to monitor misalignment by decomposing it into fine-grained cognitive processes -- misalignment indicators -- and detecting their presence in a model's internal activations via linear probes, and develops a taxonomy of 18 indicators spanning different misaligned behaviors.

2606.24173.tldr: A benchmark comparing traditional ML methods against lightweight transformer architectures for binary fault detection across three public datasets: NASA C-MAPSS turbofan degradation, SECOM semiconductor manufacturing, and UCI AI4I 2020 predictive maintenance reveals TinyBERT-4L emerges as the most deployment-friendly transformer.

2606.24151.tldr: This work presents Metis, a self-evolving agent system built on a hierarchical dual-representation memory that organizes textual experience into execution plans, environment facts, and common pitfalls, and selectively crystallizes recurring plans into validated callable tools.

2606.24237.tldr: FedEPD, a framework built on a dual decoupling paradigm that separates topological purification from semantic recalibration, is proposed, which overcomes Non-IID distribution shifts by extracting robust global prototypes from topologically central nodes, which are incorporated into local representations via a spatial low-pass prototype injection.

2606.24224.tldr: Using a multi-source panel dataset of Chinese listed firms from 2015 to 2023, it is found that HCAI is associated with lower firm IR and digitalisation and executive shareholding strengthen this risk-reducing effect, whereas operational efficiency and CEOs with IT background surprisingly attenuate it.

2606.24180.tldr: The evolution in representation paradigms, such as voxel grids, point learning, implicit neural fields, transformer networks, diffusion networks, and the latest paradigm based on rendering-aware 3D Gaussian primitives, has been discussed in this study.

2606.24178.tldr: Because canonicalizing an already-aligned input can hurt accuracy, this work adds a gated mechanism that transforms an input only when its OOD score indicates this is needed, preserving most in-distribution accuracy while retaining the robustness gains on transformed inputs.

2606.24164.tldr: This work proposes TRUST-TSE, a two-stage framework to mitigate shortcut learning in EEG structure that outperforms end-to-end baselines under strict cross-trial protocols, addressing a key reliability bottleneck of existing approaches.

2606.24616.tldr: This paper develops a framework for AI tokenomics: the study of how tokens are generated, consumed, priced, allocated, and optimized across AI systems, and identifies open research directions in hidden-token measurement, empirical calibration, token productivity, dynamic allocation, and token-based markets.

2606.24780.tldr: BluTrain was architected from first principles as a robust, lightweight, and architecture-general training framework in standard C++ and the core CUDA programming model, which outperforms industry-standard baselines in both throughput and memory efficiency and strictly preserving numerical fidelity.

2606.24722.tldr: Spheroid BlockTrain is presented, a decentralized training protocol in which a model is partitioned into independently trainable blocks, each optimized on a local objective derived from the same global target and composed at inference into one model.

2606.24770.tldr: It is suggested that a context-aware model adds useful signal about the text and visual features of questions to better predict student quiz performance compared with using past student performance alone.

2606.24506.tldr: CrossPool is presented, a serving engine for cold MoE models that separates FFN weights and KV-cache into two GPU memory pools: a weights pool that consolidates FFN weights across cold models, and a KV-cache pool that dynamically serves active requests while keeping attention local to KV-cache.

2606.24598.tldr: A reversible, Strangler-Fig migration path that refactors legacy workflows into composable, typed, and auditable stages, and central to this framework is a three-tier convertibility taxonomy (A/B/C), implemented as a routing stage within the system harness.

2508.02521.tldr: LAVA (Layered Architecture for Voice Attribution), a hierarchical framework for audio deepfake detection and model recognition that leverages attention-enhanced latent representations extracted by a convolutional autoencoder trained solely on fake audio, is introduced.

2606.24790.tldr: Grad Detect is presented, a gradient-based approach for predicting hallucinations by analyzing layer-wise gradient patterns from a single forward-backward pass during inference, showing that the internal gradient structure of a model carries rich information about the correctness of its output.

2402.03347.tldr: This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of the transfer learning method with the DenseNet201 architecture in increasing the classification accuracy of potato leaf disease compared to traditional classification methods.

2407.09580.tldr: This work addresses two major bottlenecks in impeding the development of super-expressive activation functions: the limited identification of super-expressive functions, which raises doubts about their broad applicability, and their often peculiar forms, which lead to skepticism regarding their scalability and practicality in real-world applications.

2311.11483.tldr: Examining the adaptability of a publicly accessible structured EHR foundation model (FMSM) demonstrates that adapting EHR foundation models across hospitals provides improved prediction performance at less cost, underscoring the utility of base foundation models as modular components to streamline the development of healthcare AI.

2605.08442.tldr: A reasoning model inverts this defense via goal-directed RAG fallback, a mechanism that replicates cross-family on Bedrock, and resolves a double dissociation: no single sandbox implementation is safe across both reasoning and non-reasoning model classes.

2606.08998.tldr: This tutorial clarifies what it means to call agentic AI systems stochastic, when such variability can be reproduced under matched conditions, and why deterministic execution need not imply identical behavior in deployed settings.

2604.13097.tldr: ECM Contracts is presented, a contract-based interface model for embodied capability modules that builds a compatibility framework that checks installation, composition, and upgrade before deployment, and a release discipline of version-aware compatibility classes and upgrade gates.

2606.24891.tldr: This paper presents a parser for Haystack definition files, and a code generator that derives Pydantic models and JSON Schema definitions from these parsed specifications, which enable static type checking and enable structural validation of Haystack grids within Python, as well as schema-based validation of JSON representations outside the Python ecosystem.

2606.24910.tldr: The proposed End-to-End Spoken Language Understanding architecture for real-time human-drone interaction in French achieves semantic robustness, low latency, and calibrated confidence, and demonstrates that End-to-End architectures are not only feasible but preferable for spontaneous voice-guided UAV teleoperation.

2606.24899.tldr: It is argued that human-AI co-discovery workflows, with systems such as AIM as important components, are most valuable not as standalone theorem provers, but as research partners for problem formation, connection discovery, derivation, and skeptical review inside a human-gated research loop.

2606.24892.tldr: ReviewGuard is introduced, a two-stage framework that aligns LLM-generated reviews with citation-based estimates of long-term scientific impact rather than contemporaneous reviewer judgments, demonstrating that impact-aligned reinforcement learning can provide editors with a complementary signal for identifying high-potential work, without replacing human judgment.

2606.24976.tldr: Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG) is introduced, a systems intervention that routes strategies through a discrete categorical bottleneck to decouple argumentative structure from topical content and acts as a capability bridge in asymmetric deployments, empowering lightweight persuaders to consistently defeat parametrically superior opponents.

2606.24912.tldr: The velocity prediction is shown to outperform a baseline model which does not use the pretrained velocity weights, when evaluated on synthetic data, and using the pretrained velocity weights offers a small improvement in note transcription.

2606.24901.tldr: This survey reformulates Industrial Continual Learning for LLMs as a closed-loop update-and-release problem in a versioned ecosystem, where updates propagate hierarchically to industrial, application-specific models and LLM-powered applications, with capability inheritance and transfer across versions and model families.

2606.24915.tldr: This letter proposes a highly efficient, purely lexical error-aware framework designed to explicitly resolve phonetic and loop hallucinations, integrating a symmetric text normalization module with a novel error-aware term frequency-inverse document frequency algorithm.

2606.24911.tldr: This paper introduces signed pattern control for variable-order Markov generation with BP-Regular sampling, and provides a positive branch for probing attractor basins, phase transitions, and hysteresis in the underlying variable-order model.

2606.24894.tldr: RWGBench is constructed from a large-scale collection of 40,108 computer science papers and a retrieval corpus of 1.09 million documents, with a carefully curated test set comprising 100 papers and their corresponding published related work sections that assesses citation selection, contextual appropriateness, organization, and discourse structure.

2606.25198.tldr: Heuresis is introduced, a framework that abstracts the research pipeline into a set of general and composable primitives, enabling open-ended scientific exploration in machine learning research, finding that completely novel ideas are rare and do not expand the quality-novelty frontier.

2606.25041.tldr: Wan-Streamer is presented, a native-streaming, end-to-end, multimodal interactive foundation model for low-latency streaming interaction designed from the ground up for real-time, low-latency, full-duplex audio-visual interaction.

2606.25034.tldr: Yuvion VL, a family of multimodal large language models purpose-built for content and AI safety, with both instruction-tuned and reasoning-oriented variants, is presented, and Confuse-then-Contrast Fine-Tuning is introduced, a contrastive framework that mines model-specific confusions and constructs multi-image contrastive groups to enforce explicit discrimination of fine-grained visual-semantic elements.

2606.25449.tldr: This work maps where the fix fails, shows the failure compounds through memory loops, and replicate across three deployed memory systems, real dialogue, and tau-bench, a deployed-agent benchmark where whether a lossy memory becomes a harmful action is a joint model-and-interface property.

2606.25432.tldr: It is argued that brevity is the missing inference-efficiency lever, and that pretraining data curation is a practical way to pull it: a model trained on concise, correct data learns to answer in fewer tokens; i.e. it has a lower Cost-of-Pass.

2606.25375.tldr: This work reformulates synthetic medical image detection as an audit of multimodal robustness at the image-record interface and introduces a paired benchmark that holds the image fixed while swapping controlled metadata variants, providing a standardized tool for assessing and improving multimodal robustness beyond image-only settings.

2606.25476.tldr: A red teaming framework that systematically uncovers vulnerabilities in LLM outputs and provides both actionable insights into current LLM vulnerabilities and a scalable methodology for ongoing safety evaluation as models evolve is presented.

2606.26071.tldr: A baseline protocol for model forensics consisting of two steps, iterated as needed, that establishes that Kimi K2 Thinking takes shortcuts due to a genuine disposition towards low-effort actions, and establishes that DeepSeek R1 deceives out of a desire to be consistent with a previous instance of itself.

2606.25956.tldr: This work studies whether state-of-the-art models can accurately classify risk stratification from only medical records and biomarkers extracted from CTPA images, and suggests that, counter-intuitively, vascular graphs might hold no discriminative information for PE risk stratification.

2606.25996.tldr: Autodata, a general method that enables AI agents to act as data scientists who build high quality training and evaluation data, is introduced and how to train such a data scientist agent is shown, so that it learns to create even stronger data.

2606.25836.tldr: It is concluded that agentic surveillance can already be easily implemented and, therefore, is called for a comprehensive technical, ethical, and legislative framework to protect users.

2606.25680.tldr: Imposing energy as an explicit constraint to energy-efficient underwater control as a constrained Markov decision process in which average thruster power is subject to an explicit budget, solved with a PPO-Lagrangian algorithm.

2602.09379.tldr: A large-scale multi-agent benchmark that evaluates LLMs on both static diagnostic inference and dynamic multi-turn psychiatric consultation in Chinese, finding that dynamic consultation often underperforms static evaluation and consultation quality assessed by LLM-as-a-Judge shows only moderate correlation with diagnostic accuracy.

2505.12343.tldr: Decoding with Inter-layer Consistency via Layer Aggregation (DCLA), a training-free decoding mechanism that requires no retraining, fine-tuning, or access to external knowledge bases, thereby enforcing inter-layer consistency.

2508.06871.tldr: This work systematically explores how sparsification methods, particularly Gradual Magnitude Pruning (GMP) and Sparse Evolutionary Training (SET), enhance plasticity and consequently improve performance in MTRL agents, and demonstrates that both GMP and SET effectively mitigate key indicators of plasticity degradation.

2506.16702.tldr: A framework for using LLMs as psychological simulators across two primary applications: simulating roles and personas to explore diverse contexts, and serving as computational models to investigate cognitive processes is developed.

2501.13955.tldr: The results demonstrate that LLMs can effectively capture complex dependencies between demographic attributes and preferences while offering flexibility to explore hypothetical scenarios, enabling scalable, cost-efficient and privacy-preserving data generation.

2409.16395.tldr: HELIOT leverages advanced natural language processing capabilities to interpret medical narratives, extract relevant drug reaction information from unstructured clinical notes, and learn from past patient-specific medication tolerances to reduce false alerts, enabling more nuanced and contextual adverse drug event warnings across primary care, specialist consultations, and hospital settings.

2606.26115.tldr: It is argued that AI systems for media analysis should support epistemic mapping: a transparent, multi-dimensional account of how facts, interpretations, actors, and narratives interact over time.

2606.26106.tldr: It is shown that NVC-constrained prompting consistently reduces conversational escalation and stabilizes interactions with highly resistant users, suggesting that simple communication constraints can meaningfully improve the trustworthiness of LLM dialogue in conflict-prone settings.

2606.26102.tldr: Results suggest that, for labs building on value-laden mid-training, coding-domain post-training may better preserve mid-trained values than helpfulness post-training without harming general reasoning capabilities.

2606.26112.tldr: This work addresses the critical gap in AI accessibility for low-resource languages, offering a practical alternative to corpus-intensive approaches and potentially enabling specialized AI development for the hundreds of languages with existing WordNet resources.

2606.26111.tldr: It is argued that unauthorized lyric copying poses a high risk of infringement of the musical composition, whereas mere AI-generated voice imitation typically falls outside federal sound recording protection and instead implicates state publicity rights.

2606.26105.tldr: ContextForge is introduced, a system for context recycling that maintains task-relevant information across turns by combining structured query generation, external memory retrieval, and controlled synthesis, which suggests that context recycling provides a practical approach for extending LLM capabilities in long-horizon tasks without requiring larger context windows or model retraining.

2606.26114.tldr: This work traces the historical pattern of creative resistance to technological disruption, then develops an analytical framework -- the Human-AI Agency Continuum for mapping the spectrum of human and machine collaboration in creative work and proposes four principles for navigating the transition.
