2606.26373.tldr: A deliberately restricted hybrid design that conditionally hides numerical query slots, but does not provide semantic-query, document, unlinkability, circuit, or access-pattern privacy is evaluated.

2606.26130.tldr: Large Language Models are increasingly used to guide research methodology, yet their default methodological tendencies under minimal prompting remain unclear, and researchers who rely on LLM suggestions without cross-checking risk narrowing their methodological search space toward a more concentrated default.

2606.26300.tldr: Quality of verification signals are characterized along three dimensions -- scalability, faithfulness, and robustness -- and it is argued that achieving all three simultaneously is the central challenge.

2606.26117.tldr: The Governance Inversion Hypothesis is introduced as a structural condition in which governance expansion may actively undermine operational coherence rather than strengthen it and the central risk in AI governance is the emergence of institutions that appear increasingly governed while progressively losing the capacity to govern effectively.

2606.26454.tldr: It is suggested that increasing data and training time alone cannot ensure symbolic level logical reasoning, since syllogistic reasoning underpins logical reasoning and human rationality.

2606.26529.tldr: This work proposes reporting-complete evaluation, scoring what a system fails to report alongside what it is asked to find, as a requirement for safety-critical deployment, and argues that it decouples measured benchmark safety from real-world safety.

2606.26494.tldr: This work defines clinical AI skills and proposes the Clinical Harness, a runtime governance architecture that registers, orchestrates, constrains and monitors them and shows how knowledge-driven, data-driven and physics-enhanced skills can support lifecycle care and provide a governed substrate for future medical agents.

2606.26614.tldr: Highlights the importance of human-centered design in agentic SciVis and guide the development of future collaborative visualization systems with HiLSVA, a human-in-the-loop agentic system that supports mixed-initiative SciVis workflows.

2606.26423.tldr: This paper proposes CoStream, a framework orchestrating foundation models and diverse sensing modalities into multiple composable core behaviors: a semantic behavior extracting spatial constraints via foundation models; a predictive behavior forecasting trajectories by tracking keypoints in imagined videos; and a reactive behavior providing high-frequency tactile and force corrections.

2606.26519.tldr: NeuraDock Agent is presented, an open-source architecture that separates a deterministic local EEG engine from a hardware-aware language layer and support hardware- and implementation-aware grounding as a practical mechanism for calibrating what an EEG agent accepts, qualifies, or refuses.

2606.26530.tldr: It is argued that solving ARC-like problems requires not only positive sample supervision but also the ability to improve model reasoning by distinguishing negative samples, and proposed DiARC, a method that constructs preference pairs to enable the model to distinguish between them.

2606.26964.tldr: Look-Before-Move, a camera planning framework that separates observation specification from motion execution, is proposed and experiments show that the framework improves subject perception, intent consistency, and trajectory quality over representative baselines, demonstrating the importance of organizing visual attention before generating camera motion.

2606.26734.tldr: Robust Onion is presented, an empirical study that uses controlled synthetic visual degradations to peel OV-ODs layer-by-layer, revealing how, why, and where robustness degrades, systematically analyzing feature collapse.

2606.26795.tldr: NaviCache is proposed, a plug-and-play test-time self-calibration method re-conceptualizing feature evolution as an Inertial Navigation System (INS) problem re-conceptualizing feature evolution as an Inertial Navigation System problem that bridges the fundamental domain gap and the non-stationary nature of diffusion by modeling the relative coupling between input and output variations.

2606.26879.tldr: This work introduces a synthetic clinical notes pipeline and dataset designed to support the development of clinical AI tools while avoiding the privacy risks associated with real patient data.

2606.26859.tldr: This work presents AgentX, a production-deployed multi-agent system that fundamentally restructures this production function and operates as a self-evolving development engine that autonomously generates, implements, evaluates, and learns from recommendation experiments at a scale and pace that no manual workflow can sustain.

2606.26987.tldr: This work test the generality of emotion vectors in Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 and Gemma-4-E4B-it, extracting emotion contrast vectors across all layers, using two model-generated corpora to observe notable differences in how valence representations emerge across model depth.

2606.27154.tldr: PAVE, a step-wise labeling protocol that leverages known interventions from fault injection to reconstruct causal propagation paths, is introduced, a step-wise causal ground truth is the missing piece for trustworthy LLM-based RCA agents.

2606.27330.tldr: This analysis reveals that mastering low level atomic skills does not guarantee high level planning competence, while high level task training yields stronger OOD generalization, and proposes the task decomposition hierarchical analysis framework (TDHAF) to systematically study compositional generalization across three task granularities: low, middle and high levels.

2606.27251.tldr: OmniAct is presented, a framework integrating a multimodal semantic planner for skill routing across unified action spaces, an adaptive hierarchical memory with event-boundary-driven compression for sub-linear context growth, and an asynchronous visual preemption engine that closes the semantic loop during physical execution.

2606.27233.tldr: This framework addresses key limitations in current analytical approaches through a hierarchical two-layer coding scheme that integrates cognitive and non-cognitive problem solving with metacognitive regulatory mechanisms, and shows in particular that metacognitive regulation can be an essential discriminator of deeper collaboration.

2606.27163.tldr: The work improves a vision-language-action (VLA) policy with a reinforcement-learning loop that predicts success, progress, and a few task-relevant future quantities and drives advantage estimation, live failure detection, and candidate selection in the LeHome Challenge 2026.

2606.27002.tldr: A deep learning-assisted methodology for the inverse synthesis of a compact, wideband inverted Doherty power amplifier (PA) with pixelated output combiner networks that integrate load modulation, impedance matching, power combining, and phase compensation into a single structure.

2606.27361.tldr: Autoregressive Boltzmann Generators (ArBG) -- a novel autoregressive modelling framework -- is proposed that circumvents the topological constraints of flows and enables sequential inference-time interventions, while offering enhanced scalability by leveraging architectures effective in Large Language Models.

2606.27354.tldr: It is shown, theoretically and empirically, that numerically minimizing the PDE residual can be an unreliable proxy for reconstruction accuracy in ill-conditioned systems, explaining why these methods often do not make accurate predictions despite achieving low residuals.

2606.27321.tldr: This work hypothesizes that a sparsity penalty acting before the selection could sharpen each latent's selectivity and make the code more interpretable, without reintroducing the drawbacks of the $\ell_1$ penalty.

2606.27288.tldr: Multi-model LLM systems such as routing, voting, cascades, fusion, and mixture-of-agents are used to beat single-model accuracy, it is shown that their gain is capped by a quantity the field rarely reports, and combining models rarely beats the single best model without a strong query-level routing signal.

2606.27286.tldr: Simulation-based inference using neural posterior estimation using neural posterior estimation as a scalable alternative for Bayesian calibration of a mechanistic SECIR epidemiological model is investigated, demonstrating that SBI provides a rapid and computationally efficient framework for Bayesian calibration of mechanistic epidemiological models, supporting repeated near-real-time inference and rapid outbreak analysis.

2606.27268.tldr: E-TTS is introduced, a modular and plug-and-play Embodied Test-Time Scaling framework that unifies reasoning and action scaling for robotic manipulation via history-aware iterative refinement with vision-language verifiers with vision-language verifiers.

2606.27234.tldr: A large-scale study of AI nudification in the wild, identifying 24,105 SNEACI items and finding a significant shift in target demographics, indicating that AI nudification has expanded from targeting public figures to increasingly harming individuals within users'own social circles.

2606.27215.tldr: GAversary is proposed, a hybrid Genetic Algorithm to generate adversarial attacks on natural language models by using GloVe embeddings to propose word replacements (the mutation operator) to improve the semantic similarity of the adversarial examples.

2606.27180.tldr: This work introduces the VLM-guided PBRS framework VLM-PBRS, the first application of VLM preference-based learning to synthesize a potential function for PBRS, a principled, low-cost solution that leverages small VLMs, and extensive empirical demonstration of improved sample efficiency and robustness to reward hacking.

2606.27161.tldr: TOPS is proposed, a training-free and model-agnostic pruning module that can be applied to various MLLMs and outperforms prior methods under diverse pruning settings, suggesting that pruning redundant visual tokens can sometimes mitigate hallucination and inspire future lightweight MLLM design.

2606.27106.tldr: An evaluation of threats extracted from media documents shows high agreement between automatically generated results and human judgment for core aspects such as threat and mission relevance, indicating that LLMs provide a promising approach to support analysts in the context of peacekeeping missions.

2606.27061.tldr: This work reviews the most common external validity indexes focusing on set-matching-based measures and recommends centroid index (CI), because it is an intuitive cluster-level measure with an explainable result.

2606.27045.tldr: The Spec Growth Engine is presented, a lightweight framework that addresses both failure modes through a machine-readable spec graph whose nodes carry explicit contract/design separation, a Spine context assembler that scopes agent context to an ownership path, a vertical-slice growth protocol that enforces hardest-first ordering, and a drift gate that makes spec-code divergence a blocking merge condition.

2606.27032.tldr: The results suggest that state representation is not a minor preprocessing choice in storage-trading RL, but a central part of the policy design: robust transfer requires combining price scale, recent relative price context, and short-horizon forecast information, rather than relying on any single feature family.

2606.27018.tldr: A novel unsupervised detection method based on ResNet (RSFM) + FPN which identifies a wide spectrum of anomalies by detecting subtle semantic shifts in the latent space between successive orbital passes is presented.

2606.27009.tldr: This work proves deterministic termination and well-definedness and machine-check these claims, while treating the convergence of the distance sequence as an empirically tested conjecture rather than a (previously over-claimed) Banach contraction.

2606.26990.tldr: This work introduces decision-alignment, a criterion that reveals which evaluation metrics meaningfully align with downstream utilities and proposes prior-weighted utility metrics, a special class of proper scoring rules that provides decision-aligned uncertainty evaluation.

2606.27287.tldr: Overall, LLM-based screening is most vulnerable when manipulation is rare and candidate quality differences are small, but prompt injection is less effective on average, but can occasionally allow lower-quality candidates to outrank higher-quality ones, raising fairness concerns.

2606.27342.tldr: This paper investigates a state-of-the-art method for low-resource, domain-aware EM--BEACON--and study how its performance is affected by different algorithmic choices and data availability conditions, providing deeper insight into the role of distribution alignment and the behavior of the BEACON framework.

2606.27334.tldr: A language-based digital twin framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to mimic the conversational behavior of elderly individuals by incorporating stylometric cues and contextual metadata is proposed.

2606.27226.tldr: BINEVAL is proposed, a framework that decomposes evaluation criteria into atomic binary questions and aggregates the resulting verdicts into interpretable, multi-dimensional scores, which makes evaluation easier to inspect, easier to diagnose, and directly usable for prompt improvement.

2606.27119.tldr: NTU is instantiate as NTU-Transformer, a transformer-based neural decoder tailored for planar surface codes and bivariate bicycle codes, which establishes the proposal as a scalable route to amortized cross-distance training of foundation decoders for fault-tolerant quantum processors.

2606.27147.tldr: This work uses the understanding and judgment capabilities of the unified multimodal model itself to identify unsafe generated images without human annotation, and proposes iterative self-improving codebooks for safe autoregressive generation.

2606.27136.tldr: JERP updates a long-term experiential-rule pool and the policy from the same interaction trajectories, which keeps the rule pool aligned with the evolving policy while allowing stable and effective behaviors to be gradually absorbed into the model itself.

2606.27090.tldr: Two mathematical tools are introduced: Mass Index for recording the polynomial and logarithmic decay scales of local mass, and regularised extended KL (RE-KL), a set-localised divergence that can be formulated in the presence of singular components.

2606.27027.tldr: This paper introduces ShareLock, a multi-tool threshold poisoning framework that utilizes Shamir's threshold scheme to ensure exceptional stealth and fault tolerance and significantly outperforms existing single-tool poisoning strategies in tool description-based detection while maintaining an average attack success rate exceeding 90%.

2606.27188.tldr: The process harness uniquely reconciles imperative requirements, realized through deterministic workflow execution that enforces structural compliance, with normative requirements, realized through policy-framed agentic autonomy invoked at designated control points wherever the process demands it.

2606.27112.tldr: A corrected heavy-ball Q-learning method for reinforcement learning (RL) is proposed and convergence of its deterministic mean dynamics is established and conditions under which the method is theoretically guaranteed to converge faster than standard Q-learning are identified.

2606.27095.tldr: CIRCLE is a class-incremental classifier built from fixed bidirectional two-dimensional reservoir features, adapted from BiRC2D for image classification, and streaming linear discriminant analysis heads, yielding a tunable bias-variance tradeoff between richer random features and prediction-level ensembling.

2606.27091.tldr: This work studies Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct and its base model, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and derives a pre-deployment monitoring method that identifies command families where canonical indicators change role after fine-tuning, showing that security fine-tuning can improve task accuracy while expanding the evasion surface.

2606.27005.tldr: AURORA-AI, an Adaptive Utility-driven Resource Orchestration framework for Resilient AI that unifies Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman feedback control, Lyapunov-based stability monitoring, and a fairness-aware composite utility into a single closed-loop policy is presented.

2606.26994.tldr: EVIS, an Event-Aware Video Instructed Segmentation Assistant, is introduced, which utilizes text-guided Event Queries to partition a video into simple events, extracting event-aware visual-text features to achieve a hierarchical understanding of the video.

2606.27302.tldr: This study examines over 15,000 user reviews from 59 AI healthcare chatbot apps to explore how these systems function in everyday informational and emotional contexts, and highlights how failures in access, usability, and trust affect users.

2606.27229.tldr: CARVE (Content-Aware Recurrent with Value Efficiency), which fixes both and, via a single-launch"megakernel"scheduling of the same WY-form math, trains faster than the matrix-gated baseline it replaces.

2310.10196.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive, up-to-date review of large models tailored or adapted for time series and spatio-temporal data along four dimensions: data types, model categories, model scopes, and application areas/tasks.

2412.13858.tldr: This work proposes IDEQ, a new SOTA for neural based methods solving the TSP that exhibits a lower variance and better scales-up with the number of cities with regards to DIFUSCO and T2TCO.

2502.16584.tldr: This work introduces Audio-FLAN, a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset covering 80 diverse tasks across speech, music, and sound domains, with over 100 million instances that lays the foundation for unified audio-language models that can seamlessly handle both understanding and generation across a wide range of audio domains in a zero-shot manner.

2508.05950.tldr: ClONE, a 3DGS-based Closed-Loop differentiable Optimization framework for single-image Normal Estimation, designs a one-step deterministic diffusion-inspired refinement network, which enhances local geometric details while preserving end-to-end differentiability.

2508.06659.tldr: This work formulates ICRL as a two-agent emergent communication problem and introduces CORAL (Communicative Representation for Adaptive RL), a framework that learns a transferable communicative context by functionally separating latent representation learning from control.

2508.11874.tldr: This work presents LegoNE, a framework encoding expert proof strategies into a symbolic language that automatically compiles any candidate algorithm into a finite optimization problem certifying its worst-case guarantee, and rediscovered an algorithm matching the best polynomial-time guarantee for two-player games.

2509.09151.tldr: This survey argues that the evolution of video understanding is fundamentally shaped by dataset structure, and presents a dataset-centric perspective that connects dataset structure, inductive biases, and architectural design within a unified framework.

2509.10334.tldr: I-Segmenter is introduced, the first fully integer-only ViT segmentation framework that achieves accuracy within a reasonable margin of its FP32 baseline, while reducing model size by up to 3.8x and enabling up to 1.2x faster inference with optimized runtimes.

2509.17455.tldr: This paper extracts computables: executable representations whose runtime behavior provides operational evidence of semantic adequacy, including executability, execution traces, and runtime failures, and finds that the proposed approach consistently exceeds text-only reasoning and one-shot code execution.

2510.03244.tldr: VFEM is proposed, a cross-modal forecasting model that leverages pre-trained large vision models (LVMs) to capture complex cross-variable patterns and achieves competitive performance on multiple benchmarks, offering a new perspective on multivariate time series forecasting.

2602.05774.tldr: The results lead to the Martingale Convergence Theorem, which is applied to study the extinction behavior in Galton--Watson branching processes.

2602.23234.tldr: This work generates millions of textual relevance labels by systematically evaluating LLM configurations, finding that a specialized, fine-tuned model significantly outperforms a much larger pre-trained one in providing highly relevant labels to overcome the data scarcity.

2603.14147.tldr: This work argues for first constructing explicit symbolic abstractions (knowledge graphs, ontologies, and formal logic) to underpin synthetic curricula enabling small language models to master domain-specific reasoning without the model collapse problem typical of LLM-based synthetic data methods.

2604.08849.tldr: SatIR converts trial eligibility criteria and summaries into formal constraints, then retrieves patient--trial pairs by executing these constraints over a database by combining Satisfiability Modulo Theories, relational algebra, medical ontology grounding, and large language models.

2605.25085.tldr: The rate-distortion limits of online KV cache compression in autoregressive language models are studied as sequential Wyner-Ziv source coding on the filtration induced by the model, with the next-step query as decoder side information as decoder side information.

2605.25624.tldr: This work presents CUA-Gym, a scalable pipeline that co-generates task instructions, environment states, and reward functions, and constructs CUA-Gym, a dataset of 32,112 verified RLVR training tuples grounded in 110 environments and synthesizes CUA-Gym-Hub, a broad suite of high-fidelity mock web applications grounded in real-world software-use distributions.

2605.27786.tldr: It is shown that inter-layer redundancy can be either localized or globally distributed depending on the LLM architecture, and Representation Locality Score (RLS) is introduced, derived from global inter-layer hidden-state similarity.

2605.28510.tldr: SOURCETRACKER, a 300M-parameter encoder tailored for code retrieval, together with a hybrid two-stage provenance-tracking pipeline HYBRIDSOURCETRACKER, demonstrate that integrating vector search with fingerprinting enables scalable, high-precision provenance tracking for code produced by LLMs.

2605.29823.tldr: This work introduces polynomial representations as a distribution-aware, low-dimensional surrogate for neural functions that approximate a network's predictive behavior along data-dependent interpolation paths using orthogonal polynomial bases, yielding a compact functional representation.

2606.01060.tldr: This study reveals that alignment-induced change is selective rather than uniform: normative concepts exhibit larger torsion shifts than factual concepts on average; torsion is negatively correlated with contextual entropy; and peak effects localize to architecture-specific mid-to-late layers.

2606.01567.tldr: This work evaluates guardian-based defenses: an intermediary LLM agent that acts as a mediator for skill file access or pre-rewrites these files at build time (dynamic guardian) or an intermediary LLM agent that pre-rewrites these files at build time (static guardian).

2606.01619.tldr: Analysis of the skill lifecycle shows skills being automatically created, tested, refined, and pruned as the policy improves, demonstrating reconciled skill-policy co-evolution.

2606.08376.tldr: RiskNet is a large-scale dataset of AI risk incidents constructed from large-scale multilingual news sources intended to support downstream research on AI safety, governance, risk analysis, and benchmarking, as well as longitudinal and cross-source analyses of AI-related harms.

2606.08379.tldr: TT-DAC-PS (Twin-Target Deterministic Actor-Critic with Policy Smoothing), a deterministic actor-critic architecture that combines twin exponential-moving-average critic targets with pessimistic min backup, TD3-style target policy smoothing noise, delayed actor updates, and conservative Q regularisation to curb overestimation is introduced.

2606.08381.tldr: A statistical framework for detecting proprietary alignment in black-box language models via comparative behavioral analysis is proposed and provides a systematic and scalable basis for external assessment of provider-specific alignment behavior in large language models.

2606.08382.tldr: STAR-KV is proposed, an adaptive low-rank KV cache compression framework with fine-grained rank control that achieves up to 75% KV cache compression and up to 20x overall KV cache reduction when combined with quantization.

2606.08400.tldr: A human-aligned LLM-assisted grading workflow is proposed and a case study based on 180 student submissions from a graduate advanced software engineering course is presented, highlighting that indiscriminate LLM grading may introduce systemic unfairness and suggesting that specific operational practices are required to mitigate such disparities.

2606.08403.tldr: This work studies a reproducible LLM01-style indirect prompt/content-injection failure mode where that assumption breaks: a payload caught in plain English slips past the same detector when it is transported as structured float parameters and reconstructed only as fragmented telemetry.

2606.08405.tldr: The results show that an autonomous scientific agent can successfully transform accumulated physical evidence into robust, mathematically readable control policy, while maintaining a fully traceable process of scientific discovery.

2606.08408.tldr: Experiments show that TimpaTeks provides a feasible novel mechanism to steer diffusion language model outputs in-place and is computationally cheaper than prompt-based DLM steering, as it performs denoising in-place rather than constructing an additional prompt-conditioned output sequence.

2606.08410.tldr: MO-PQUCB is introduced, a hybrid algorithm that integrates query-based preference anchoring with bandit feedback through shift-invariant regularization and dual-exploration UCB, and it is proved that proactive queries accelerate preference estimation and yield improved regret scaling over prior preference-aware MO-MAB methods.

2606.08414.tldr: Physical safety Alignment for Constrained Trajectories (PACT), a self-evolving post-training framework that projects pretrained diffusion policies onto constraint-feasible regions without accessing demonstration data or task rewards, is proposed.

2606.08417.tldr: A suite of zero-parameter, deliberately naive samplers that achieve state-of-the-art gen-PPL on LM1B and OpenWebText at non-degenerate entropy, surpassing recently published diffusion and continuous-flow models while producing text that is incoherent by construction.

2606.08432.tldr: This work proposes Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD), a trajectory-level correction method that revises the student's rollout under the teacher guidance while within on-policy support, and mitigates prefix failure at its source.

2606.08433.tldr: This paper reads six engine-level measurements together to describe how five AI-sandbox products isolate guest code from the host kernel, and reports per-axis orderings, per-product portraits, and a threat-model qualification matrix.

2606.08445.tldr: S3 is proposed, a training-free framework that constructs a final summary by composing segment-level summary candidates by partitions a long document into segments and generates multiple summary candidates per segment, forming nodes of a search tree.

2606.08446.tldr: This work hypothesizes that sparse rollout training remains stable if the lower tail of per-token actor-policy mismatch stays above a critical threshold throughout the trajectory, and introduces a dynamic sparsity schedule that keeps this tail statistic constant during generation and validates this hypothesis.

2606.08447.tldr: It is shown that multiple new tasks can be trained sequentially before an unsupervised sleep-like replay phase is applied to partially restore performance across all previously learned tasks, pointing to novel principles for developing a broad range of continual learning AI solutions.

2606.08450.tldr: GIFT is proposed, an LLM-guided framework for state-reward interface design in PPO-based financial reinforcement learning that improves learning-signal quality and out-of-sample risk-adjusted portfolio performance over baselines.

2606.08451.tldr: The first large-scale, multi-model evaluation of cross-lingual sycophancy is presented, benchmarking six instruction-tuned models across 1.1 million instances and identifying a consistent resource-tier effect: sycophancy rates spike sharply in low-resource and zero-shot language settings.

2606.08467.tldr: A framework designed for the worst-case analysis of GNN calibration robustness, with theoretical insights linking model generalization, dataset complexity, and calibration vulnerability, showing that models with higher accuracy or trained on datasets with more classes are more susceptible under this threat model.

2606.08471.tldr: A sufficiency test is constructed to rigorously examine the self-correction capabilities of small language models (SLMs) and proposes a minimal three-step self-correction pipeline that collects initial SLM answers, prompts the same model to generate hints for its incorrect responses given the ground truth, and feeds the model the same question with its own feedback to refine the initial answer.

2606.08476.tldr: FlashCP introduces a sharding-aware communication mechanism to eliminate redundant KV communication and proposes a novel Whole-Doc sharding strategy that maximizes communication savings while maintaining balanced workloads.

2606.08477.tldr: This paper investigates concept naming in FCA and RCA from a symbolic knowledge representation perspective and proposes a configurable framework for LLM-assisted concept naming, which relies on a variability model that controls which sources of information are exposed during naming.

2606.08480.tldr: AdaGRPO is introduced, a novel framework that treats reward-guided optimization as selective admission rather than uniform pressure and achieves statistically significant gains in click-through rate and dwell time, confirming its practical utility.

2606.08481.tldr: PIPE-Cypher makes Text2Cypher benchmarking a repeatable process that evolves with the graph, its users, and its target workloads, by combining schema profiling, reverse-query grounding, constrained generation, deterministic Cypher governance, execution validation, redaction, diversity controls, and a calibrated local LLM judge.

2606.08483.tldr: No reliable independent evaluation framework yet exists for examining how consumer-facing health LLMs behave in ordinary use, and oversight requires disclosure of personalization signals, stable version identifiers, researcher safe harbor programs, and post-deployment monitoring of health-related outputs.

2606.08484.tldr: STELLAR (Spatio-Temporal Environmental Learning with Latent Alignment and Refinement), a novel framework that learns a shared latent space where dynamic habitat context and community structure are optimized jointly, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2606.08491.tldr: An end-to-end structural optimizer is developed that applies both operations to adapt relational graphs automatically and consistently improve accuracy while often reducing inference cost.

2606.08497.tldr: This work proposes a method that explains predictions of DLMs by selecting a small, informative subset of input words byforming this as an amortized optimization problem, enabling efficient one-shot inference without the need for input-specific search.

2606.08500.tldr: Across 408 trajectories, spanning multiple models, repositories, task families, and launch conditions, the study shows how faithful digital traces can be transformed into disciplined, comparable projections of emerging SWE-agent mindset.

2606.08503.tldr: This work characterise the semantics for DRSL through a set of KLM-style postulates adapted for the standpoints case and provides a means to lift preferential entailment, and the class of entailment relations based on single ranking functions from the purely propositional to the standpoint-enhanced context, including rational and lexicographic closure.

2606.08508.tldr: ActProbe is introduced, a lightweight, pure action-space detector that uses two compact signals available from a single forward pass: Temporal Consistency Error between consecutive action chunks and Action Chunk Magnitude of the current chunk to map per-step failure probabilities with a task-conditioned LSTM-MLP architecture.

2606.08529.tldr: Results indicate that single-scaffold capability numbers are scaffold-conditional estimates and that the elicitation gap is not guaranteed to shrink as models improve, and that the elicitation gap is not guaranteed to shrink as models improve.

2606.08531.tldr: VESTA, a fully automated scenario generation and safety evaluation framework for LLM agents, is introduced and the results show that current agents still face substantial behavioral safety risks during task execution, with an average ASR of 47% and several models exceeding 70%.

2606.08539.tldr: The result is what sets AgentTrust v2 apart from its static v1 predecessor: a trust layer that self-evolves from its own stream of decisions -- cheaper on the lexical class (it distils its own rules) and smarter on the semantic class (it accrues guarded precedent), while never hard-blocking a benign action.

2606.08542.tldr: Closed-Loop Trace Distillation is introduced, a pipeline that uses a per-task coding agent to inspect labeled training traces and distill a one-line natural-language prompt over the trace, which is called the Distilled Reading Heuristic (DRH).

2606.08543.tldr: Position-Aware Entropy Calibration (PAEC), a token-level entropy-management framework that constructs a soft mask from local top-p entropy and top-two candidate competition, and applies an anchor-based lower-bound penalty to prevent selected-position entropy collapse, is proposed.

2606.08552.tldr: How Bayesian probability and information theoretic optimization, including Active Inference, may be incorporated with promise semantics -- as well as how Promise Theory supplements solutions, helping to avoid probability's pitfalls, which include non-local coordination, calibrating, and normalizing probabilistic computations are described.

2606.08565.tldr: An adaptive tensorization method is proposed that discovers inherent low-rank structure in a target tensor by index ordering and demonstrates improved reconstruction quality compared to baselines.

2606.08571.tldr: A JSON-formatted output schema that demands a model explicitly name the missing domain intersection, enumerate required concepts, and propose a productive retrieval query rather than hallucinating an answer is introduced, demonstrating that explicit epistemic structuring is a learnable and measurable capability.

2606.08590.tldr: Graph Traversal Agent is presented, a graph-guided RCA agent that combines LLM reasoning with specialized tools that combines LLM reasoning with specialized tools and makes no production-readiness or mean-time-to-repair claim.

2606.08596.tldr: Co-pi-tree is a closed-loop method that learns an executable policy tree consisting of a partner-behavior prediction tree and an agent-action selection tree and shows that Co-pi-tree improves average reward and test-time latency while reducing the number of LLM queries.

2606.08601.tldr: This paper proposes Instruction-aware Active Probing (InA-Probe), which shifts the paradigm from passive alignment toward an active, instruction-driven probing mechanism, and designs a Multi-Level Instruction Injection mechanism that enriches the model with both global task objectives and fine-grained, patch-level semantic priors.

2606.08602.tldr: An online reinforcement learning algorithm for fine-tuning flow-matching policies in continuous-control problems that outperforms competitive baselines in reward quality and convergence speed and holds across diverse continuous-control tasks, encompassing both dense and sparse rewards.

2606.08610.tldr: HARBOR is introduced, an agentic framework that frames robot RL automation as a harness-engineering problem: given a simulator codebase and a task specification, it automates the workflow from environment setup to policy training in simulation, and reduces engineering effort at practical token and wall-clock cost.

2606.08633.tldr: Experimental results show that RLVR-trained LLMs substantially improve over zero-shot LLMs and representative deep learning baselines, especially on destination-related metrics, and shows that LSTM remains a strong deep learning baseline under limited fine-tuning data, while Transformer-style spatio-temporal models typically require larger datasets and richer structured inputs.

2606.08644.tldr: Overall, the results reveal an interpretable mechanism for context dependent state tracking in LLMs, a retrieval conditioned rebinding mechanism, a compact attention head circuit that encodes relevant binding information and reinstates it at readout.

2606.08649.tldr: CEF-Log is presented, a context-enhanced few-shot chain-of-thought prompting strategy for Large Language Models that addresses the critical"black-box"limitation of traditional machine learning approaches.

2606.08653.tldr: FiberTune is proposed, a training-time objective that preserves teacher-structured visual residuals without adding inference-time overhead and improves over task-loss-only fine-tuning in every one of six controlled simulation settings spanning two benchmarks and two architectures.

2606.09416.tldr: This work sketches this as a ROS 2 Harness Profile, a deployment artifact that carries an AI model's declared output region, inference budget, and operating regime while the middleware enforces them across ROS 2, DDS, and Zenoh.

2606.09419.tldr: A context-aware learning framework that integrates image-derived contrast with metadata describing composition, beam energy, and detector geometry and shows that conditioning on contextual variables transforms defect classification from an ill-posed image-only task into a well-posed, physically grounded problem.

2606.09430.tldr: LargeMonitor is proposed, a framework that leverages large pretrained foundation models to autonomously orchestrate task-free continuous adaptation and introduces a decoupled detection module utilizing the frozen, stable representation space of large vision models to achieve robust, zero-shot drift detection without training-dependent interference or brittle threshold tuning.

2606.09433.tldr: This work proposes Bayesian Selective Latent Inference (BSLI), a principled Bayesian method that maintains a posterior over latent burden and identifiability, certifies answerability through explicit scientific gates, and optimizes query-stop decisions with an exact cost-calibrated Bellman policy.

2606.09441.tldr: SIFT: Selective-Index For Fast Compute of RAG Prefill by Exploiting Attention Invariance is proposed, which processes documents offline and extracts fine-grained locations of high attention scores for each document and stores locations of high scores in the form of two compact bit vectors.

2606.09447.tldr: A rule-based reward evaluation protocol grounded in backend audit logs is introduced, providing objective, reward-hacking-resistant outcome judgment in real cloud environments, and a high-determinism rollout system featuring Terraform-based resource pre-provisioning and LLM-driven on-demand provisioning is constructed, which effectively isolates environment noise from the training signal.

2606.09450.tldr: TheoremBench, a Lean4 benchmark designed to evaluate theorem provers beyond contest settings, provides a more fine-grained view of formal reasoning ability and highlights the importance of structural benchmark design for evaluating Lean4 theorem provers.

2606.09470.tldr: A rubric-guided SpeechLLM for multi-aspect, multi-granular assessment, trained with a hybrid objective combining supervised fine-tuning and Bounded Direct Preference Optimization is proposed, which matches or outperforms single-granularity models while remaining competitive with prior approaches.

2606.09483.tldr: DCPM is proposed, which reorganises agent memory along a cognitive capability hierarchy ascending from raw inputs and atomic facts, through diachronic belief trajectories and identity, to domain schemas, latent intentions and cross-domain patterns.

2606.09489.tldr: A modular framework based on the orchestration of Large Language Models to support medical conformance checking directly from unstructured clinical and guideline texts, without requiring predefined CIGs is introduced.

2606.09499.tldr: This work demonstrates that world models introduce a uniquely stealthy and effective data poisoning entry point into the robot learning supply chain that can result in the deployment of unsafe or otherwise compromised robotic policies despite training on seemingly safe ground truth training data.

2606.09508.tldr: The proposed EntropyInfer is a training-free framework that uses attention entropy to adaptively allocate compute at the granularity of individual heads and segments during prefilling, and introduces a latent KV cache compression scheme that leverages generated output tokens, rather than prefill tokens alone, to identify and retain the most critical cache entries.

2606.09525.tldr: It is revealed that context usage is actively reshaped at each IFT stage, and designing a balanced IFT dataset is important in ensuring robust context utilization of instruction-tuned models.

2606.09548.tldr: A task-agnostic backdoor attack that is implanted during the FL training time by inducing hardware faults (bit-flips) in parameters of a single local model that relies on model poisoning based on hardware-fault attacks is proposed.

2606.09549.tldr: SecureClaw is the only defense evaluated in a common harness that simultaneously retains usable task utility and achieves 0\% attack success rate (ASR) on ASB, 0.64\% ASR on AgentDojo, and 3.23\% overall leak on AgentLeak's attacked parity lane, which measures final-output and internal-relay leakage.

2606.09551.tldr: FuseFSS is presented, a compiler that replaces per-operator protocol design with a single compilation pipeline and preserves accuracy while achieving a end-to-end speedup.

2606.09556.tldr: This work runs a controlled three-arm ablation on a production valuation agent that improves calibration and audit discipline, and introduces completeness-aware decision utility: informed decision-quality = decision-quality x gold-coverage.

2606.09559.tldr: This work proposes a new learning paradigm, named safe reinforcement unlearning (Safe-RULE), used as a defense framework to remove the influence of poisoned data without retraining from scratch or requiring access to the original training environment.

2606.09563.tldr: PRISM is an activation-conditioned interpreter that decodes hidden states from a frozen target model into a faithful bullet list of active instructions, an activation-conditioned interpreter that outperforms activation-to-language baselines, especially on security-relevant objectives.

2606.09568.tldr: A systematic literature review on Self-Explainability (SX) is presented, analysing existing approaches, including their domains, targets, and evaluation methods and developing a unified definition and taxonomy.

2606.09572.tldr: A cerebello-thalamic-inspired vision-action model (CT-VAM) for efficient task-conditioned visuomotor control that acts as a compact local execution policy that predicts action chunks from dualview visual observations, proprioception, and a lightweight task condition, potentially enabling a practical cloud-edge paradigm.

2606.09578.tldr: TABVERSE is introduced, a controlled multimodal table benchmark that aligns the same table content across multiple structural formats and rendered images, with question category and difficulty tags, and shows that representation choice substantially affects table understanding.

2606.09585.tldr: This work proposes optical reasoning, which treats images as a standalone reasoning medium, and shows that images can effectively and efficiently encode rationales while providing a unified visual canvas for reasoning.

2606.09587.tldr: The Semantic Repulsion Technique is introduced and evaluated both computationally and through a study with 16 participants who regularly use AI for creative tasks to inform the design of AI systems that aim to support everyday creativity without contributing to homogenization.

2606.09589.tldr: It is argued that despite their seemingly innocuous aesthetic, generative AI minidramas reproduce deeply gendered narrative structures in which female characters are systematically associated with moral transgression, sexual betrayal, and reproductive capacity, and that several plots also encode the logic of racialization.

2606.09605.tldr: Hypnos, a multi-modal sleep foundation model trained using eight different sensing modalities drawn from over 20,000 overnight polysomnography recordings, demonstrates that next-token prediction is a strong self-supervised objective for representation learning from multi-modal physiological signals.

2606.09607.tldr: It is concluded that a cheap signal is a circuit proposal, not a confirmed circuit; closure is what separates them; extending closure across training, attention-target selectivity and participation ratio decouple from function in both directions.

2606.09610.tldr: The approach enables a multi-robot system to autonomously position itself underneath an object to support its weight while avoiding obstacles during the formation process, and leads to policies that reliably produce balanced formations and generalize to cluttered scenes and objects with complex geometry and non-uniform mass distribution.

2606.09630.tldr: ReCoVLA is a failure-conditioned residual recovery framework that keeps a pretrained VLA policy frozen, uses an external vision-language model (VLM) to infer the failure mode and recovery stage, and compiles a structured reward from task-relevant components.

2606.09634.tldr: ATN3D introduces density-aware early fusion with cross-modal gating that conditions fusion on per-voxel density/sparsity and Radar evidence, a Range-aware loss that re-balances classification and localization by distance, aligning training with distance-stratified evaluation.

2606.09643.tldr: FMplex is presented, a serving system that treats FM backbones as a virtualization substrate for deployment sharing, and a batch-aware fair-queueing scheduler that combines weighted task-level sharing with inter- and intra-task batching across colocated tasks.

2606.09646.tldr: The results suggest that intuitive-physics knowledge emerges reliably in pretrained video representations, but its accessibility depends strongly on pretraining paradigm, representational depth, and readout mechanism.

2606.09648.tldr: This work presents ArtiFact, a multi-modal cultural heritage dataset of 651045 museum records collected from the Metropolitan Museum of Art, the Art Institute of Chicago, and the Rijksmuseum, and demonstrates the utility of ArtiFact through two downstream tasks.

2606.09658.tldr: In a representative classification problem with multi-component features, it is proved that Muon attains larger margins and higher effective rank than Adam and SGD, providing theoretical support for the empirical findings.

2606.09659.tldr: Latent Context Language Models are introduced, a family of compressors that improve the Pareto frontier across general-task performance, compression speed, and peak memory usage and serve as efficient backbones for long-horizon agents.

2606.09663.tldr: An operational evidence framework with four criteria: inspectable target system, meta-level modifier, feedback-directed selection, and recursive continuation is proposed, and MetaAI-Mini, a reproducible HumanEval-based protocol and codebase is provided.

2606.09666.tldr: It is formally proved that CFips samples interval patterns proportionally to their frequency within the constrained pattern space, and the experimental results show that integrating constraints into the sampling procedure enables to complete mining tasks that would otherwise fail within a given time out.

2606.09670.tldr: A visual prompting pipeline that isolates objects using foreground-background masking, a mechanism for unfreezing the teacher in student-teacher models to improve domain adaptability, and a data augmentation strategy leveraging diffusion-generated synthetic images to enhance anomaly detection performance are introduced.

2606.09671.tldr: A personalised digital twin framework for AD prediction and scenario-based analysis using multimodal longitudinal data is presented and it is suggested that transition-based digital twin formulations may provide a practical and interpretable approach for personalised disease forecasting in neurodegenerative disorders.

2606.09672.tldr: The benchmark suite, training corpora, the BODHI generator, and the OpenVINO scripts are released and one finding contradicts standard advice: FP16 beats INT8 on this silicon at every serving batch size, and it is explained why.

2606.09692.tldr: This work presents an agent-aware observability substrate consisting of a lightweight gateway and a common information model that binds delegation context at execution time that enables reliable cross-tool delegation-scoped reconstruction and direct forensic queries without heuristic time-window correlation.

2606.09701.tldr: AdvGRPO is introduced, a co-training framework that makes GRPO viable for joint attacker-defender optimization using dense multi-channel rewards and decoupled advantage normalization and can produce highly effective and transferable attacks and that co-trained defenders outperform baselines on safety benchmarks.

2606.09711.tldr: This work introduces Proxy Reward Internalization and Mechanistic Exploitation (PRIME), a learned capability to assess task correctness, predict proxy acceptance, and reason about exploitable proxy--gold gaps that amplifies a proxy-internalization capability upstream of visible hacking.

2606.09724.tldr: It is argued that high-profile failures in legal AI are not residual confabulations to be eliminated by scaling language models, but symptoms of an architectural mismatch between probabilistic retrieval and the hierarchical, temporal, and institutional structure of legal knowledge.

2606.09730.tldr: A harness that guides the model toward high-quality task decomposition and delegation, while constraining subagents to return results properly to support the main agent's workflow is designed and the resulting model, SearchSwarm-30B-A3B, achieves the best results among all models of comparable scale.

2606.09746.tldr: Spatio-Temporal Bound Propagation (STBP) is introduced, a verification framework that computes an exact closed-form characterization of the first convolutional layer and propagates certified bounds through subsequent layers using scalable approximations, providing stronger robustness guarantees with significantly improved scalability.

2606.09748.tldr: To enable process-level feedback, the RGI method is designed, a method that analyzes patterns of satisfied and unsatisfied rubric criteria to infer research-process gaps and reveals three key findings.

2606.09758.tldr: This work presents Difference-Aware Retrieval Policies for Imitation Learning (DARP), a semi-parametric retrieval-based imitation learning approach that addresses this limitation by reparameterizing the imitation learning problem in terms of local neighborhood structure rather than direct state-to-action mappings.

2606.09762.tldr: This work relates plasticity to the empirical Neural Tangent Kernel, and identifies dynamical isometry (the condition that layer-wise Jacobian singular values remain close to one) as a key mechanism for preserving plasticity in continual learning.

2606.09767.tldr: It is established that synthetic bootstrapping is a highly effective structural primer, but requires authentic data for semantic refinement via Curriculum Learning, and overfitting to the constrained structural variance of the synthetic templates.

2606.09778.tldr: It is argued that safe policy learning should ask who earns the safety - the policy or its protective layers - and this question is measurable, and the IA-VQC-DPC is introduced.

2606.09800.tldr: Fast Adaptive Semantic Entropy (FASE) is introduced, a novel metric that approximates functional correctness based on the minimum spanning tree of structural and semantic dissimilarity graphs that positions FASE as a practical, cost-effective solution for optimizing uncertainty quantification in real-world multi-agent workflows.

2606.09806.tldr: Topological Neural Operators (TNOs) are introduced, a principled framework for operator learning on cell complexes that lifts neural operators (NOs) from functions on points and/or edges to topological domains, providing a unified perspective on operator learning across discretizations.

2606.09811.tldr: This work proposes AHA-WAM, an Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Model built on a dual Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that reorganizes world-action modeling around this temporal asymmetry, and introduces horizon-adaptive offset training and Observation-Guided Video-Context Routing (OVCR), which together let the action expert exploit long-horizon world context while remaining responsive to real-time execution state without rerunning the video DiT.

2606.09816.tldr: Experiments show that PTL-Diffusion improves manifold-level distributional matching over matched DDPM baselines, reducing phase-conditioned errors, feature-space covariance errors, and nearest-neighbour manifold distances, and suggest structured terminal reference laws as a promising direction, while motivating more expressive phase constructions and larger-scale evaluations.

2606.09825.tldr: A method for embedding a functional but suboptimal policy available as a baseline into the RL training process, simultaneously improving training efficiency relative to from-scratch methods and producing a learning policy that outperforms the baseline.

2606.09826.tldr: OmniGameArena is a real-time benchmark of twelve newly built Unreal Engine 5 games spanning Solo, PvP, and Coop with unified action interfaces, and the Improvement Dynamics Curve (IDC), an agentic-reflection harness in which a tool-using reflector LLM autonomously refines a bounded skill prompt across multiple rounds.

2602.12424.tldr: RankLLM introduces difficulty as the primary criterion for differentiation, enabling a more fine-grained evaluation of LLM capabilities and achieving 90% agreement with human judgments and consistently outperforms strong baselines such as IRT.

2605.08171.tldr: CDLinear is introduced, a block-circulant linear layer with block size B = 2l + 1 that uses 1/B the parameters of a dense layer with the same input and output dimensions that gives an explicit Fourier-domain diagnostic for optimization.

2605.28057.tldr: This work proposes the first theoretical framework for studying the learnability of TTA and introduces order-wise matching lower and upper bounds on recovery complexity and TTA learnability, revealing fundamental limits of TTA and an intrinsic adaptivity-information trade-off.

2606.01884.tldr: EVA-Net is proposed, a two-stage framework that uses action videos as semantic priors for subject-independent EEG motor decoding and results suggest that video provides a more effective semantic anchor than the text baseline considered in this work.

2606.01929.tldr: The VET Framework is introduced, a method for categorizing AI discourse along the dimensions of valence, effectiveness, and trajectory, and it is shown how this framework can be used to identify, compare, and critique prevalent narratives of AI Hype, AI Doom, AI Denial, and AI Normalcy.

2606.02386.tldr: AgentPLM achieves state-of-the-art results with a gain in antibody top-10% hit rate over the strongest passive baseline, providing mechanistic evidence of online error correction without explicit backtracking.

2606.06493.tldr: HANDOFF is introduced, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery.

2606.07532.tldr: Durable Evaluation Framework (DEF) Arbitration is presented, a multi-agent architecture that mitigates identity-framed sycophancy by arbitrating between two models tuned to opposing DEFs, with a pragmatist synthesizer evaluating both arguments blind to their origins.

2606.07586.tldr: This work presents a two-stage methodology, instantiated on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU, that progresses from human-guided development to agent autonomy, and autonomously deploy eight additional decoder-only LLMs end-to-end on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU using the open-source compiler stack.

2606.07605.tldr: This work proposes Super-Resolution for Time series (SRT), a novel framework that reconstructs temporal patterns lost in low-resolution inputs via disentangled rectified flow and introduces SRT-large, a scaled-up version with extensive pre-training, which enables strong zero-shot super-resolution capability.

2606.07936.tldr: A large-scale analysis of human evaluation protocols for evaluating long-form generation tasks in *CL conference publications from 2023--2025, including a full manual review of 284 papers and LLM-assisted analysis for another 1.8k+ papers finds widespread under-reporting of important aspects of human evaluation study design.

2606.07998.tldr: It is argued that localised architectures with lower bandwidth but higher expressivity per node have the potential to be fundamentally more interpretable than deep neural networks running on GPU clusters while remaining competitive for smaller datasets.

2606.08251.tldr: This work invited authors of 121,640 recent preprints across biology, medicine, chemistry, and the social sciences to judge ideas that large language models (LLMs) generated from the context and puzzles of their own papers, and mapped what AI cannot yet do for science.

2606.08982.tldr: On a cross-dimensional medical evaluation suite, Baichuan-M4 attains leading results in static medical knowledge and safety, dynamic OSCE-style consultation, long-context clinical memory, evidence-based retrieval, medical document OCR, and multimodal image understanding, while lowering the hallucination rate to 3.3%.

2606.09041.tldr: It is examined how community-engaged computing operationalizes human-centered AIED across three dimensions: education, technology, and culture to contribute a collaborative framework for culturally-aware AIED.

2606.09377.tldr: This work adapts two parallelism techniques originally developed for large-scale model training to the auto_LiRPA / $\alpha,\beta$-CROWN verification framework, finding the memory bottleneck in $\alpha$-CROWN+BaB mode proves to be per-neuron alpha tensors, not weight matrices, pointing to the key direction for future work.

2606.09475.tldr: It is concluded that alignment strategies should be evaluated, not just on their (in-distribution) general safety performance, but also specifically on their degree of projectability.

2606.09919.tldr: Co-GLANCE is introduced, a real-time onboard perception and decision-making system for uncertainty resolution in heterogeneous robot teams that outperforms cloud-based vision-language model baselines in occlusion segmentation and robot allocation accuracy while reducing per-frame inference latency 350x.

2606.09922.tldr: An information-theoretic framework in which the effective information of bioelectrical data is determined not only by signal fidelity, but also by physiological structure, model capacity and downstream task requirements is proposed.

2606.09923.tldr: This work proposes the first application of split conformal prediction to neural operator-based physics simulation, providing distribution-free prediction intervals with finite-sample coverage guarantees, and introduces a normalized conformal prediction scheme that leverages MC Dropout uncertainty to produce adaptive-width intervals.

2606.09924.tldr: Sigma-Branch is proposed, a framework that restructures a pretrained dense network into a hierarchical binary tree composed of a shared backbone, hierarchical routers, and specialized leaves and substantiates a framework-level claim that decouples per-inference memory traffic from the total parameter count.

2606.09926.tldr: Entropy-Guided Power Sampling (EGPS) is proposed, a training-free and verifier-free sampler that re-derives its proposal from token-level entropy already in the forward pass, making sampling cost scale with entropy mass rather than sequence length.

2606.09927.tldr: This paper introduces a quantile-robust scaling policy for SmoothRot-style transforms by replacing max-based activation statistics with high quantiles, and complements it with constrained gradient-based optimization of channel scales.

2606.09928.tldr: It is demonstrated that introducing learnable channel specialization and layer contribution weighting significantly enhances the representational capacity of forward-only learning in deep CNNs, substantially narrowing the gap with backpropagation.

2606.09931.tldr: It is argued that systems of learnt strategic agents naturally instantiate this problem because they do not admit complete behavioural specifications, their learnt conventions generally cannot be predicted or reproduced by an external observer, and sufficiently capable agents can construct covert communication schemes that are difficult to detect or eliminate.

2606.09932.tldr: Rejuvenation leverages base-anchored model fusion to reduce excessive SFT-induced drift with targeted neuron reset to mitigate model rigidity and consistently improves RL performance on over-trained SFT models, while also enhancing generalization to out-of-distribution tasks.

2606.09935.tldr: This work presents GitInject, an open-source framework for evaluating prompt injection vulnerabilities in real, live GitHub workflows, a widely deployed instance of CI/CD pipelines, and finds that all tested providers are susceptible to at least one attack class in their default configuration.

2606.09936.tldr: WorldModelLens is presented, an open-source interpretability substrate organized around a capability-typed adapter that declares a set of optional heads so that reinforcement-learning and self-supervised world models are first-class without either imitating the other.

2606.09937.tldr: RKSC (Reasoning-Aware KV Cache Sharing), a training-free inference framework that eliminates two structural redundancies in multi-branch LLM reasoning pipelines, and RSBCM (Reasoning-Selective Block Cache Manager) prevents unbounded cache growth via attention-weighted depth-priority eviction.

2606.09940.tldr: This work formalizes intuition via compact proofs that an error term arising in this proof can naturally be interpreted as a measure of interaction between crosscoder features and provides an explicit expression for the interaction term in the Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) layers.

2606.09944.tldr: The Gini- Adjusted GDP per Capita Index is argued that GAGI is a necessary complement to GDP-based monitoring: any macroeconomic monitoring instrument that tracks only aggregate output will systematically miss the distributional harm that automation can cause even while reported growth remains strong.

2606.09949.tldr: Online Generative Active Sampling (OGAS), an active learning method that reactively learns the relationship between configuration parameters and surrogate performance to control the sampling distribution, is introduced.

2606.09953.tldr: A deep learning system that synthesizes intermediate CT slices from pairs of neighboring axial slices, halving the effective through-plane spacing is presented, supporting in a single external case that interpolation quality and implicit denoising are not confined to the training distribution.

2606.09954.tldr: This work evaluates normalization strategies for transformer-based large time-series models trained with patching and efficient causal strategy and demonstrates that normalization choice significantly influences both training convergence and forecasting performance.

2606.09958.tldr: Uncertainty-Aware Motion Planning (UAMP) is proposed, which incorporates uncertainty in human intent prediction for AV decision-making and introduces Uncertainty-Calibrated Value Learning (UCVL) to correct value function learning biases arising from directly incorporating uncertain human intent predictions into the observation.

2606.09959.tldr: Experiments show that temporal conditioning is most beneficial for rare, high-intensity precipitation events, while also improving the representation of seasonal variability and predicted rainfall-intensity distributions, and suggest that simple, physically motivated temporal context can improve the realism and reliability of deep learning-based precipitation nowcasts.

2606.09960.tldr: Experiments show that HydraCIL matches or outperforms state-of-the-art CIL methods while significantly reducing training time and carbon footprint, making it a practical solution for continual learning in real-world and embedded settings, where energy efficiency and rapid adaptation are critical.

2606.09961.tldr: Theoretically, under a per-state bandit abstraction, the proposed score-supervised allocation mechanism achieves logarithmic allocation regret and provide sample-complexity guarantees for action identification, score distinguishability, and filtering stability.

2606.09962.tldr: It is found that FSQ tokenization scheme has the latent space structure with the properties that make it best suited for continuous diffusion for categorical data as verified through rigorous theoretical analysis and numerical experiments.

2606.09963.tldr: GeoABC is proposed, a geometry-conditioned anisotropic boundary correction framework that leverages the boundary geometries to introduce direction-aware boundary correction into the intermediate representations of neural operators, transforming boundary geometry from static input features into a structural prior that modulates physical prediction.

2606.10010.tldr: DeRA-MOS is proposed, a decoupled optimization framework for TTM evaluation that introduces a batch-aware listwise ranking loss that models relative order within each mini-batch and better aligns with evaluation based on Spearman's rank correlation coefficient (SRCC).

2606.10029.tldr: A modality-aware auto-interp pipeline is introduced that labels each feature from where it fires-text-prefix context, 1-second speech clips, or both, and shows these features are interpretable, spanning phonemes, laughter, accent prompts and speaker gender.

2606.10044.tldr: The proposed architecture integrates semantic data representations, probabilistic machine learning models, deterministic business rules, and explicit action spaces into a coherent internal simulator to establish a conceptual foundation for autonomous business systems capable of moving from instruction-based execution toward goal-driven planning, optimization, and execution.

2606.10064.tldr: It is argued that an incentive-aligned agent arena can be engineered to manufacture such trajectories, and demonstrated this on ORO Subnet 15 (SN15), a Bittensor deployment of the ShoppingBench agentic-commerce benchmark.

2606.10066.tldr: These cohort-relative detectors are unreliable as standalone membership-inference signals on small medical-VLM cohorts because they collapse under an external pre-domain baseline.

2606.10068.tldr: Greedy Importance First (GIF), an importance-aware scheduling strategy that uses a small-sample warm start to estimate hyperparameter importance, forms importance-based groups, allocates trials proportionally, and retains a full-space fallback, is proposed.

2606.10080.tldr: VFUSE is introduced, a mechanistic interpretability approach that trains SAEs on diffusiontransformer activations to audit protein models for hazard-aware features and identifies monosemantic features from the SAE that fire only on hazardous designs at up to AUROC 0.84.

2606.10531.tldr: LC-QAT is proposed, a 2-bit weight-only VQ-QAT framework that represents quantized weights via a learned affine mapping over discrete vectors, which yields a high-quality PTQ initialization and enables fully differentiable end-to-end optimization without explicit codebook lookup in the training forward pass.

2606.10829.tldr: Across LLaDA-8B-Base and Dream-7B-Base on GSM8K, MATH500, HumanEval, and MBPP, plugging ADAS into Top-k, Fast-dLLM, and EB-Sampler improves low-NFE performance at matched denoiser evaluations by \(9.11\) and \(10.46\) percentage points on average.

2606.10917.tldr: Role-Agent is introduced, a framework that harnesses a single LLM to function concurrently as both the agent and the environment, enabling a bootstrapped co-evolution.

2606.11015.tldr: A reproducible benchmark delimiting when on-premise open-source large language models help in control tuning: not as optimizers, but as a sample-efficient, interpretable structural prior.

2509.19376.tldr: A lightweight, model-agnostic temporal layer for RAG is presented and cybersecurity data is used to separate two problems that are usually conflated, with honest real-data scope and a reference implementation.

2508.07743.tldr: This work proposes a novel contrastive learning objective to make transformers symmetry-aware and thereby compensate for their lack of inductive bias, and shows that transformers can be efficiently trained for either plan-generation or heuristic-prediction.

2601.16956.tldr: DataStates-LLM is introduced, a novel checkpointing architecture that leverages State Providers to decouple state abstraction from data movement, effectively mitigating the serialization and heterogeneity bottlenecks in extreme-scale LLM training.

2508.03898.tldr: A hybrid modeling approach that combines multi-task learning with a recurrent neural network to parameterize a differentiable biophysical model is proposed that significantly outperforms both conventional biophysical models and baseline deep learning approaches in predicting phenological stages, as well as other crop state variables such as cold-hardiness and wheat yield.

2507.18632.tldr: This work proposes SIDA, a novel and efficient zero-shot domain adaptation method leveraging synthetic images, and introduces Domain Mix and Patch Style Transfer modules, which enable effective modeling of real-world variations.

2411.19537.tldr: The results indicate that state-of-the-art detectors fail to generalize to deepfakes generated by unseen generators, and a novel multimodal benchmark is developed to evaluate deepfake detectors on out-of-distribution content.

2308.05201.tldr: A pronounced displacement effect and an overall contraction in submarkets where required skills closely align with core LLM functionalities are documented, highlighting not only the displacement of certain occupations but also the inducement of skill transitions within the labor supply.

2508.12410.tldr: A novel Mamba-based network, SRMA-Mamba, designed to model the spatial relationships within complex anatomical structures of MRI volumes, and surpasses state-of-the-art methods, delivering exceptional performance in 3D pathological liver segmentation.

2510.11103.tldr: This work systematically evaluates SO(3) action representations across three standard continuous control algorithms, PPO, SAC, and TD3, under dense and sparse rewards and shows that representing actions as tangent vectors in the local frame yields the most reliable results across algorithms.

2409.13007.tldr: iCost is proposed, an instance-complexity-aware CSL framework that assigns adaptive penalties to minority-class samples according to their estimated learning difficulty, which ensures fairer weighting, reduces unwarranted bias, and improves overall classification performance.

2403.00510.tldr: Experimental findings reveal that longer words are less likely to be memorized, higher confidence correlates with greater memorization, and representations of the same concepts are more similar across different contexts.

2506.01442.tldr: Agentic Episodic Control (AEC), a novel architecture that integrates large language models (LLMs) into episodic RL, shows that combining LLM-derived priors with reinforcement learning yields more sample-efficient and adaptable agents.

2505.23847.tldr: This position paper maps the security agenda for cross-domain multi-agent LLM systems and introduces seven categories of novel security challenges, for each of which it is presented plausible attacks, security evaluation metrics, and future research guidelines.

2401.17505.tldr: A theoretical framework is provided to explain how an asymmetry in the ability to learn natural language can appear from sparsity and computational complexity considerations, and a number of perspectives opened by the results are outlined.

2509.21785.tldr: This paper introduces the unbiased binning problem that, given an attribute to bucketize, finds its closest discretization to equal-size binning that satisfies group parity across different buckets, and develops a dynamic programming solution that finds the optimal binning in quadratic time.

2605.08704.tldr: Experiments on mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks show that AgentPSO improves over static single-agent skills and test-time-only multi-agent reasoning baselines, suggesting that AgentPSO captures reusable reasoning procedures rather than merely optimizing benchmark-specific prompts.

2604.08591.tldr: TheSpectral Sensitivity Theorem, which predicts a phase transition in deep networks from a dispersive regime (signal decay) to an attractor regime (rank-1 collapse) governed by layer-wise gain and alignment, is validated by analyzing the eigenspectra of activation graphs in Whisper models under adversarial stress.

2603.00374.tldr: CoffeeE-PSRO, an online game-solving approach that extends Policy Space Response Oracles (PSRO), an online game-solving approach, by quantifying game dynamics uncertainty and modifying the RL objective to skew towards solutions more likely to have low regret in the true game, is extended.

2606.09774.tldr: SIGA is introduced, a coding-agent adapter that supplies this contract through retrieval, procedural memory, agent-callable validation, and validation-gated termination while leaving the model and loop frozen.

2604.13072.tldr: This work introduces LiveClawBench, a benchmark designed around this dual-fidelity requirement that combines a Triple-Axis Complexity Framework for difficulty-driven task construction with reproducible full-stack mock applications that preserve stateful execution semantics.

2606.16974.tldr: Assessing all published papers at five leading AI conferences over the past decade reveals that in the period 2014 to 2024, documentation practices have improved; papers sharing both code and data increased nearly sixfold, from 11% to 64%

2606.16494.tldr: The findings indicate that recall@k is the wrong metric for deployed KB-VQA and that closing the gap requires reader-side intervention; the first controlled probe of reader-side position dependence in multimodal KB-VQA is designed, a gold-position protocol in which only the gold passage's prompt slot varies within question.

2606.23533.tldr: This work proposes POTracker, an optimized LLM for power outage report generation that outperforms other fine-tuning approaches, improving overall accuracy by up to 51% and reaching 86.47% structural accuracy for generated power outage reports.

2606.27443.tldr: This work investigates whether personality composition matters for multi-agent team performance by manipulating personality traits across frontier LLMs on three task domains: structured coding, open-ended research collaboration, and competitive bargaining and finds that personality effects depend critically on task structure.

2606.27405.tldr: The proposed framework enables fast, accurate, and cost-effective brain tumor detection from MRI images using Convolutional Neural Networks and Residual Networks, and demonstrates better generalization on limited medical data.

2606.27381.tldr: OverFlowLight is presented, a real-time framework designed to preemptively resolve overflow and enhance overall TSC performance, and is the first practical, scalable, and data-driven framework for actively preventing traffic gridlock.

2606.27683.tldr: Controlled Behavioral Divergence is proposed, an API only black box unlearning framework that uses two auxiliary models to create controlled behavioral divergence between retained inputs and unlearning target inputs, converts this divergence into an unlearning relevance score, and routes unlearning related prompts away from the target LLM.

2606.27667.tldr: It is argued that explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) should become a standard component of ecological model validation because conservation practitioners increasingly depend on understanding not only whether a model is accurate, but why it is accurate.

2606.27619.tldr: DysLexLens is designed as an end-to-end, evidence-traceable architecture which transforms noisy social media posts into a dictionary-driven corpora, provides knowledge-graph-based question reasoning, generates verifiable query responses, and enables response evaluation through quantitative and human-grounded assessment.

2606.27596.tldr: This work proposes Fox (Faithfulness and Observational-flow via eXpression-rectification), a training-free inference-time framework that reconciles interventional faithfulness with observational fluency and achieves SOTA performance, outperforming SID by 29.1% while preserving linguistic richness.

2606.27580.tldr: RAC proves that under an unbiased clipped importance ratio, the cumulative RAC correction is exactly unbiased when the effective delay kernel reinjects all of its mass, and carries a bias linear in the unreinjected fraction otherwise; at the no-delay identity kernel it reduces to V-trace.

2606.27539.tldr: This work introduces MMG-Pop, a Multi-modal Graph-based Popularity Prediction benchmark, which unifies datasets, modalities, temporal interaction signals, and representative baselines under a standardized evaluation protocol, and proposes MMG-PopNet, a unified multi-modal graph-based network that jointly models the aforementioned multi-modal signals and graph-structured social interactions.

2606.27687.tldr: A protocol to mitigate p-hacking in LLM-based research is proposed: preregistering the experiment and eligible models, and then running it on the first eligible LLM that is released after the preregistration, which confirms the protocol's effectiveness and reveals that mitigation remains substantial under several stress tests.

2606.27652.tldr: This work proposes MER-R1, a reinforcement learning framework that turns slow-fast complementarity into explicit optimization, and achieves state-of-the-art performance and makes reasoning genuinely benefit emotion recognition.
