2606.27629.tldr: A dual threshold hard example mining strategy for cross-platform deployment of offensive comment detection for Chinese social media suffers performance degradation, and a dual-threshold hard mining method is proposed to address this.

2606.27599.tldr: KARMA is introduced, a method for explaining time-series predictors by constructing a Markov surrogate model that captures the temporal dependencies learned by the predictor and identifies temporal dependencies better than established attribution methods such as TimeSHAP.

2606.27593.tldr: ODYSSEY is fully implemented and tested across a wide spectrum of concrete foundries, showing that the same categorical machinery supports domain construction, artifact replay, sheaf diagnostics, grounded Toulmin/local-LLM scrutiny, residual-obstruction ledgers, and optimized TICKET-compatible causal-claim extraction across heterogeneous sources.

2606.27538.tldr: The context-ready transformer is introduced, a new recurrent neural network architecture built from a D-layer transformer block that pre-contextualizes each token before it enters the block, benefiting most from wide representations and long contexts.

2606.27567.tldr: This work formalizes prompted systems as Prompted Action Models whose outputs include control-authoritative actions: refusal decisions, tool authorization, policy routing, and memory writes, and defines Semantic-Faithful Control (SFC), the property that such behavior depends only on the meaning of untrusted input, not on how it is encoded.

2606.27474.tldr: Speculative Refinement (SpecRef), a training-free hybrid method that warm-starts a masked diffusion language model from an AR draft using entropy-guided selective masking, surface several findings relevant beyond the specific system.

2606.27472.tldr: To the knowledge of this work, this is the first trainable environment whose reward targets temporal fact-currency, and the first evidence the supersession gap can be trained down, not only measured.

2606.27412.tldr: Experiments show that OAR consistently outperforms baselines across controlled observer-frame reorientations without training-time frame-reorientation augmentation, while remaining competitive on the standard benchmark.

2606.27411.tldr: The results demonstrate that quantum autoencoders provide an interpretable and controllable mechanism for anomaly detection based on incompressibility with respect to a learned latent representation, and highlights the potential of quantum autoencoders as a principled tool for studying compression dynamics in quantum machine learning.

2606.27413.tldr: The novel Gene-Graph Regression for Arabidopsis Functional Traits (GRAFT) dataset is presented, a curated multi-modal dataset linking gene expression profiles with phenotypic trait measurements in Arabidopsis thaliana, a model organism in plant biology.

2606.27382.tldr: This paper proposes the concept, vision, and system architecture of world wide AI-model network (AI-ModelNet), a novel paradigm that achieves interconnection, capability sharing, and collaborative reasoning by establishing pathways between models.

2606.27657.tldr: The study revealed depot-specific differences, with visceral adipocytes undergoing additional extracellular matrix remodeling absent in subcutaneous differentiation, and provided the first comprehensive map of human adipocyte development, highlighting IGF and FGF pathways as potential therapeutic targets.

2606.27579.tldr: Using only slide-level TPS scores as labels, this end-to-end framework can leverage a novel distribution-based architecture to improve prediction accuracy and explainability and significantly outperforms baseline linear and ridge regression while capturing expected accuracy through distribution concentration.

2606.27578.tldr: PEBS is a closed-form post-hoc estimator for annotator-specific affine calibration in RLHF reward modeling; it leaves the reward base model unchanged and estimates only the rater-level map used at inference time for new ratings.

2606.27577.tldr: HIA-GAT is proposed, a dual-stream heterogeneous graph attention network that processes longitudinal and lateral interactions through dedicated attention pathways and fuses them via a conflict-type-aware gating mechanism with event-level gate supervision derived from SSM conflict attribution, supporting actionable, real-time freeway safety monitoring.

2606.27627.tldr: Experimental results show that the proposed novel approach significantly improves the retention of speaker characteristics compared to discrete-only methods, while simultaneously reducing the number of required autoregressive steps.

2606.27527.tldr: LaViD--Language-to-Visual Knowledge Distillation--a simple and effective framework for transferring high-level semantic knowledge from a language-only teacher to a vision-only student model, which consistently outperforms recent methods like MaKD that distill from vision-language models across multiple fine-grained benchmarks.

2606.27483.tldr: The results demonstrate that effective internal world modeling in LLM agents requires a capability-first training pipeline to achieve grounded and calibrated foresight, and this approach consistently outperforms other training baselines.

2606.27386.tldr: The Agentic Publication Protocol is outlined, a lightweight repository format for packaging a paper together with code, data, environment information, reproducibility instructions, and an agent-facing instruction file and a broader discussion of the future of scientific research in the agent era.

2606.27499.tldr: Inspired by dual-coding theory, DualMem is proposed, a memory architecture that maintains a visual and a verbal code in parallel that outperforms a caption baseline and three recent multimodal agent-memory systems at every chain length J.

2606.27406.tldr: This paper takes a step toward a broader evaluation by shifting the observable axis to execution resources: alongside test outcome and exception class, it predicts peak memory, wall-clock time, and ranked profiler outputs at method and line granularity.

2606.27383.tldr: label-level strength judgment and auditable evidence organization are distinct abilities currently in tension, and should be evaluated separately for LLM research assistants, and should be evaluated separately for research assistants.

2606.27379.tldr: This position paper argues that machine unlearning is overused as a term in LLM research and should be reserved for dataset-defined deletion: removing the training influence of a precisely specified forget set such that the resulting model is approximately indistinguishable from retraining without that data.

2606.27679.tldr: The results show that raw hidden states and attention features are difficult to outperform in-domain, however, under distribution shift, structured and compressed features are more robust, suggesting that in-domain performance alone is insufficient to measure progress.

2606.27584.tldr: This work proposes CoIn, a novel framework that bridges 2D inpainting models and 3DGS through a multi-stage consistency pipeline, and introduces Reference Adaptive GS with Feature Attention to reconstruct a coarse 3D scene by adaptively weighing towards a reference view.

2606.27581.tldr: The results demonstrate that SceneBot is the first general framework to seamlessly unify free-space and contact-rich behaviors executing complex, long-horizon tasks like carrying a box upstairs and establishing contact conditioning as a powerful interface for humanoid control.

2606.27786.tldr: SHIFT is introduced, a novel framework that reformulates neuron-level modification as learnable gate modulation, allowing LLMs to adaptively regulate internal activations for knowledge conflict resolution, allowing LLMs to adaptively regulate internal activations for knowledge conflict resolution.

2606.27766.tldr: RS-Diffuser is proposed, a risk-sensitive offline diffusion planning framework that combines diffusion-based trajectory generation with distributional value critics, and achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving both overall return and worst-case robustness while reducing safety violations.

2606.27732.tldr: Bifocal dLLMs are introduced, a new paradigm that resolves this dilemma throughasymmetric bidirectional context and combines two complementary mechanisms: standard causal attention providing precise left-context with full KV cache compatibility, while a lightweight reverse Mamba SSM sidecar supplying compressed right-side context without breaking cacheability.

2606.27711.tldr: A neural network-based framework for learning time series estimators that can outperform traditional baselines such as maximum likelihood estimation and model selection via AICc, and achieve competitive or state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy on major real-world benchmarks, compared with statistical, neural or large pre-trained models.

2606.27688.tldr: The results show that inference-time deployment is a meaningful source of adaptiveness in financial forecasting, and that trained volatility forecasters should be evaluated not only by their architecture, but also by their deployment policy.

2606.27922.tldr: This work proposes Reflect-R1, the first Evidence-Driven self-correction framework for long video understanding, which significantly improves the genuine rectification rate and enables authentic self-correction strictly grounded in objective evidence.

2606.27876.tldr: Evaluating representative vision-language models across three categories, it is shown that current models remain far from human-level performance, with pronounced bottlenecks in cross-view association, structured grounding, geometric reasoning, and temporal viewpoint understanding.

2606.27824.tldr: Pepti-drift, a toxicity-aware latent refinement framework that generates peptide candidates through a single antigen-conditioned drift step, provides a fast, scalable, and controllable framework for antigen-specific peptide design that directly encodes safe-and-active properties.

2606.27821.tldr: This paper adapts gated quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold network fast-weight programmers to direct multi-step Abilene TM forecasting and identifies a classical slow programmer with a quantum-inspired fast programmer as a promising accuracy-efficiency design for resource-conscious network traffic-matrix forecasting.

2606.27967.tldr: RelBall is proposed, which extends Rotate3D with two innovations, and introduces a tail-centric relation ball to model one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many relations.

2606.27974.tldr: ProMSA, a progressive multimodal search agent for KB-VQA, is proposed, a progressive multimodal search agent for KB-VQA that shows consistent gains over strong RAG and agent baselines, and improved retrieval and end-to-end accuracy.

2606.27960.tldr: This work calls for a new paradigm of human-machine cooperation: one where machines don't just automate routine tasks or predict from learned patterns, but actively amplify engineers'reasoning through the lens of causation.

2606.27909.tldr: This work extends the Werewolf game with a Jester, a third faction whose utility on peer suspicion is inverted because it wins by being voted out, so optimal play requires reasoning across three opposing utility functions.

2606.27863.tldr: GNBAN (Graph Neural Basis Attention Network), an end-to-end architecture combining heterogeneous graph representation learning with an interpretable basis-decomposition head, is proposed, demonstrating that scalable relational forecasting and interpretable forecast decomposition can be achieved together in a unified graph-based framework.

2606.27841.tldr: A task independent, layer-wise energy estimation model for AI architectures that achieves a median error of 19.6%, outperforming state-of-the-art methods and shows that layer-wise decomposition generalize to new tasks without complete retraining, by leveraging shared layers across architectures.

2606.27806.tldr: This work proposes Hybrid World-Model Planning (Hybrid-WM), which keeps the language model as the planner while using a small parametric transition model to predict action validity, state deltas, risk, and value, and suggests that lightweight parametric transition models can serve as effective grounding mechanisms for language-agent planning without replacing semantic reasoning.

2606.27757.tldr: A natural language prompting mechanism is introduced to map logical symbols into natural language descriptions, enabling LLMs to better capture task constraints and semantics, and leverage a plan recognizer to infer goal reachability, facilitating more effective guidance toward desired goals.

2606.27751.tldr: GP-AT priors appear promising for SELD design when embedded in spatial-aware architectures and optimized through integrated calibration and deployment oriented strategies.

2606.27743.tldr: This work proposes Learning to Allocate (L2A), an end-to-end framework for resource-adaptive inference that introduces lightweight, budget-conditioned and input-aware gating networks integrated into the LLM.

2606.27696.tldr: The CFRG noise schedule is proposed, leveraging the insight that low-frequency classes should be endowed with larger-scale noises, and achieves substantial improvements over baselines, manifesting the crucial role of frequency statistics in noise schedule design.

2606.27755.tldr: The results suggest that current VLA benchmarks may exert limited pressure on deep language grounding and compositional instruction understanding, and that future VLA architectures should allocate capacity more deliberately across language, vision, and action components.

2606.27748.tldr: Flexformer is proposed, a flexible linear Transformer that learns attention kernels in a fully data-driven manner and exhibits strong kernel transferability across domains, achieving both high efficiency and competitive performance on long-sequence tasks.

2606.27709.tldr: This work introduces a persona-driven rewriting pipeline that conditions user turns on low agreeableness and pairs this with warm, de-escalating assistant responses, and shows that safer empathetic fine-tuning is achievable through data design alone, without safety labels, harm detectors, or changes to the training objective.

2606.27701.tldr: By testing over 8 million adversarial evaluations, it is demonstrated that acoustic awareness yields relative Word Error Rate increases of up to 94.5\% under Whisper and wav2vec, and lays the groundwork for repeatable, verifiable research that embraces, rather than abstracts, the acoustic environment.

2606.27698.tldr: These evaluations across four diverse architectures demonstrate up to a 55% relative reduction in Word Error Rate, while also providing granular word- and sentence-level certifications to enhance acoustic security.

2606.27694.tldr: This work presents a novel meta-learning framework for anytime-valid certified robustness that adaptively deploys computational resources and demonstrates how anytime-validity enables adaptively allocating compute based upon application-specific risk thresholds, a form of resource triage impossible under classic certification frameworks.

2606.27918.tldr: This work proposes a passive, video-based framework that estimates step count in a coarse-to-fine manner using diverse motion representations and consistently outperforms existing step counting methods on real-world PD turning datasets.

2606.27793.tldr: Debiased One-Pass Attention Sorting is proposed, which estimates a per-prompt position-bias curve from the low-attention majority of documents and uses it to correct raw attention scores (via subtraction or division) to enable single-pass sorting.

2606.27941.tldr: VASAE is introduced, a method that trains SAE features under vocabulary-aligned anchoring and assigns each feature an intrinsic token name: the token string whose embedding is nearest to that feature: the token string whose embedding is nearest to that feature.

2606.27936.tldr: An end-to-end pipeline in which large language model agents autonomously search the open web, cross-reference public records and social media, and resolve raw coordinate sequences to candidate identities - without human intervention is presented.

2606.27939.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage pipeline in which domain-adaptive fine-tuning on an in-domain protein dataset is followed by iterative reward-weighted FT via reinforcement learning anchored against the FT model as a frozen reference, and finds that FT brings the average composition close to the target, while the subsequent RL enforces specific sequence constraints that FT alone cannot satisfy.

2606.27973.tldr: A multi-stage explainability framework that translates black-box transformer predictions into clinically grounded narratives by integrating SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based token attribution, theory-informed linguistic features, and a four-stage LLM reasoning pipeline using LLaMA-3.1-70B-Instruct is proposed.

2606.27926.tldr: SD-GPS is proposed, a solver-driven framework that treats the symbolic solver as an execution oracle throughout both formalization and deduction, offering profound insights into how neural agents can be grounded by formal systems to achieve verifiable problem-solving capabilities.

2606.27872.tldr: Despite its compact 2B parameter size, S$^2$-VLA consistently outperforms larger 7B-scale models and achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon manipulation benchmarks, including LIBERO and SimplerEnv, highlighting the importance of adaptive feature fusion for long-horizon robotic manipulation.

2606.27855.tldr: Results provide first evidence that decreases in test accuracy during fine-tuning are ac companied by characteristic changes in activation rates, indicating that activation-based memorization indicators are a promising tool for early spotting of unsuccessful learning in low-sample sEMG calibration settings.

2606.27814.tldr: This paper proposes ATOD (Annealed Turn-aware On-policy Distillation), a hybrid online distillation algorithm that explicitly exploits this complementarity between OPD and RL to improve small language-model agents for long-horizon interactive tasks.

2606.27791.tldr: NLL-guided layer selection is proposed, a training-free method that directly measures each layer's importance by computing the negative log-likelihood degradation on answer tokens when that layer uses sliding-window instead of full attention, advancing the efficiency-accuracy Pareto frontier for long-context LLM deployment.

2606.27785.tldr: This work investigates whether aligning the allocation cost with the output-space objective improves compressed model fidelity and results suggest that the effect of the cost function is minor at lower compression ratios.

2606.27780.tldr: This work formulate fixed-edge and dynamic-edge GWM rollouts under a unified state-action transition framework and derive topology-aware error bounds, and proposes Error-Aware GWM, a training objective that combines spectral regularization, rollout consistency, and critical-node weighting.

2606.27742.tldr: This work presents KG2Cypher, a data-centric pipeline for building enterprise text-to-Cypher systems from existing KGs, and evaluates KG2Cypher in Korean enterprise settings, where short search-style queries and schema paraphrases make language grounding difficult.

2606.27736.tldr: Tree of Evidence is proposed, a hierarchical evidence reasoning framework for automated fact-checking that models each claim as a dynamically expanding argument tree that achieves improvements ranging from 4 to 24 percentage points over competitive baselines.

2606.27731.tldr: Smooth Maximum Mean Discrepancy (SMMD), which builds on the classic MMD by incorporating value-distance kernels over numeric tokens and graph-based smoothness, and consistently improves accuracy over both cross-entropy and recent numeric-target losses.

2606.27717.tldr: MMEE (Multilingual Multi-Emotion Emphasis), a corpus of 10,000 professionally recorded expressive utterances, is introduced and two state-of-the-art architectures are benchmarked under monolingual, cross-lingual, multilingual, cross-emotion, cross-dataset, and data-scale settings.

2606.27884.tldr: SEADA is presented, an efficient methodology designed to address challenges of efficiently mapping mixed-precision networks onto multi-precision spatial architectures and provides designers with a robust framework for the design-space exploration of multi-precision architectures.

2606.27881.tldr: This paper systematically study how temporal metadata can be structurally embedded into NER models using a range of lightweight fusion strategies, injected into Transformer-based architectures via early or late fusion mechanisms such as cross-attention, adapters, and concatenation.

2606.27831.tldr: This study not only provides a novel object detection framework, but also offers a feasible technical pathway for integrating neurocognitive mechanisms with deep learning models, highlighting its significant value in improving model learning efficiency and task robustness.

2606.27826.tldr: NormAct is introduced, a benchmark for embodied social-norm interactions that evaluates plans on Goal Achievement, Norm Compliance, and overall Task Success, and a context-conditioned cue generator that infers scene-relevant norms prior to planning, increasing Task Success from 24.2\% to 46.7\%.

2606.27797.tldr: An HPC-aware methodology for KD that decouples teacher and student partitioning efficiently and achieves up to 67% higher samples-per-second than TRL by avoiding unnecessary teacher-model data structures and selecting the best split strategy.

2606.27784.tldr: Activation Amplification and Attenuation (A3), a lightweight plug-in module that enhances adversarial robustness with minimal modifications of the activations with minimal modifications of the activations.

2606.28270.tldr: The Agent-Native Immune System (ANIS) is introduced, the first biologically inspired, endogenous defense architecture embedded directly within the agent's cognitive loop, and a rigorous theoretical demarcation between model alignment and agent immunity is established.

2606.28268.tldr: TopoTTA (Topological Test-Time Adaptation) is introduced, a novel framework that integrates persistent homology, a tool from topological data analysis, into the TTA pipeline to enforce geometric and structural coherence during adaptation, bridging the gap between geometric learning and robust adaptation.

2606.28235.tldr: This work studies integration friction, the cost of integrating a contribution into a codebase that other contributors are concurrently changing, and finds that AI-native software is better measured and governed at the ecosystem level than one agent at a time.

2606.28153.tldr: Token-level attribution further shows that ACH suppression is driven specifically by attack-template tokens, providing a mechanistic account of why attacks can bypass refusal decisions through ACH suppression while leaving internal safety signals sustained by SAHs -- a phenomenon the authors term Robust Harmful Features.

2606.28128.tldr: PhysisForcing is a scalable training framework that strengthens physical consistency by focusing supervision on physics-informative regions through joint optimization of pixel-level and semantic-level features, indicating that physically aligned video models yield stronger representations for robotic manipulation.

2606.28127.tldr: Yann LeCun argues in 2022 that reaching general intelligence requires abandoning autoregressive token prediction in favour of latent-space architectures, and investigates whether the transformer generalises to continuous-state prediction, or whether a new primitive is needed.

2606.28094.tldr: OSOR introduces an occupancy-guided discriminator for precise boundary supervision, enabling stable single-step diffusion training; an alpha head that leverages knowledge from pretrained diffusion models to predict appropriate removal regions with minimal overhead; and a semantic-anchored verification pipeline (SAVP) that filters noisy instruction-based triplets to produce effect-aware supervision at scale.

2606.28062.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that LLM-based approaches outperform traditional unsupervised truth discovery methods, such as DART and LTM, across all datasets.

2606.28308.tldr: It is found that selection is determined by the algorithm, not the seed, but families differ only on asymmetric Nash sets, and the maximum-entropy / I-projection characterization is checked throughout against analytic ground truth.

2606.28024.tldr: This article introduces parametric causal factor graphs (PCFGs) to incorporate causal knowledge in lifted models and gives a formal semantics of interventions therein and presents the Lifted Causal Inference algorithm to compute causal effects on a lifted level, thereby drastically speeding up causal inference compared to propositional inference.

2606.28065.tldr: OperatorSHAP is introduced, a grid-agnostic attribution method and training procedure that allows us to train FastSHAP-like explainers for neural operators and establishes a theoretical framework for attributions in function space, connecting to Aumann-Shapley values.

2606.28279.tldr: HORIZON is a self-evolving agent framework that treats hardware design as repository-level code evolution, and extends prior works of repository-scale self-evolution from EDA software systems, to hardware-design artifacts themselves.

2606.28274.tldr: The Parameter-Efficient Hybrid Transformer (PEHT), a network traffic prediction framework that integrates urban mobility and congestion information into a Transformer-based architecture and incorporates Low-Rank Adaptation into the Transformer encoder to reduce the number of trainable parameters while maintaining high predictive accuracy.

2606.28217.tldr: This work formulate value-conditioned gradient filtering, online marginal contribution signals, and cumulative revenue settlement within a traversal learning (TL) substrate that offers a finer attribution substrate than FedAvg-style federated learning by preserving explicit traversal and gradient paths.

2606.28166.tldr: Tandem Reinforcement Learning (TRL) is proposed, which carries the tandem training paradigm into RLVR and demonstrates a promising route for RLVR with practical payoffs in multi-model communication and human compatibility.

2606.28076.tldr: PI introduces a relation-centric ontology graph to capture the head-tail type constraints of relations, providing a compact interface for answer-side constraints, and introduces a bidirectional retrieval mechanism by mapping the predicted answer type to compatible final-hop relations and combining topic-side prefix expansion with answer-side final-hop matching, thereby suppressing noisy mixed-type expansion.

2606.28061.tldr: The ToolPrivacyBench benchmark formalizes a need-to-know disclosure boundary, under which each tool should receive only the information necessary for its stated purpose, and uses trajectory-level auditing to identify privacy over-disclosure in multi-tool workflows.

2606.28226.tldr: This work proposes that exposure bias itself inherently contains dynamic signals that can guide its own rectification, and introduces DEFAR (DirEctional-Frequency Adaptive Rectification), which simulates the single-step inference process during training to identify exposure bias.

2606.28149.tldr: This work revisits ICS from the robustness perspective and introduces a novel paradigm, Concept-Guided In-Context Segmentation (CG-ICS), which performs segmentation by extracting high-level semantic concepts from references rather than relying solely on low-level visual matching.

2606.28122.tldr: The Higher-Order Spectral Convolution is introduced, a spectral mixer that extends FNO from diagonal modulation to explicit n-linear mode mixing, aligned with the dynamics of nonlinear PDEs.

2606.28070.tldr: The JD Oxygen AI Item Center (Oxygen AIIC), an industrial-scale platform built on LLMs/VLMs for item-knowledge production and service, has delivered measurable gains at scale.

2606.28027.tldr: MLVC is the first neural video codec to combine competitive compression performance, real-time speed, and cross-platform robustness across diverse consumer devices, making it suitable for widespread deployment.

2606.28242.tldr: This work analyzes $\ell_2$-regularized empirical test error minimization in a quadratic two-layer network in a finite-sample setting with structured data and reveals a phase diagram with distinct scaling regimes as the number of parameters varies.

2606.28182.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework, Learning Laws of Cooperation (LLawCo), that enables embodied agents to autonomously align with both their partners and task objectives, and allows agents to reflect on past failures to extract misaligned behavioral patterns.

2606.28179.tldr: This work proposes CPAgents, an iterative phenotype-Composition framework for cardiovascular Phenome-wide association study (PheWAS) that automatically constructs and validates interpretable composite phenotypes from base imaging features, enabling scalable discovery of stronger phenotype-disease associations beyond expert-driven feature selection.

2606.28112.tldr: Intervention probes show that BiRank preserves restoration quality while increasing wrong-prior and native-prior sensitivity, framing degradation memory as both a restoration module and a falsifiable explanation mechanism.

2606.28057.tldr: This paper proposes MultiHashFormer, a new framework that allows hash-based autoregression that consistently outperforms standard Transformer LMs across multiple benchmarks and shows that the model handles multilingual vocabulary expansion with a constant parameter footprint without any modifications.

2606.28050.tldr: LoRA fine-tuning confirms the asymmetry is not a training artifact: generation fine-tuning induces over-acceptance and evaluation fine-tuning degrades generation, and challenge core assumptions in self-evaluation pipelines.

2606.28048.tldr: DG^VoiC, a voice clustering framework for customer verification and cross-profile speaker linking on anonymised real call-centre audio, shows that speaker clustering can provide a strong additional signal for fraud investigation by helping analysts verify speaker consistency and surface repeated voices across customers.

2606.28134.tldr: This work proposes ADC-GNN, short for Attention-guided Diffusion-Contrastive Graph Neural Network, a unified framework that combines diffusion-guided feature augmentation, contrastive representation learning, and multi-hop spectral attention for few-shot graph fraud detection.

2606.28277.tldr: The Paper Assistant Tool is introduced, an agentic AI framework built for deep scientific review and verification and able to identify deeper issues than a single model call alone, achieving a 34% improvement over zero-shot recall on mathematical errors in the SPOT benchmark.

2606.28215.tldr: HAT-4D is proposed, the first agentic framework designed to reconstruct the 3D geometry, temporal dynamics, and physical interactions of multiple objects from a single video, accompanied by a novel multi-dimensional evaluation protocol focused on physical plausibility and temporal consistency.

2606.28083.tldr: STAG, a dynamic ROI-AU-coupled spatial-temporal network that jointly models motion flow and adaptive facial connectivity, is proposed, confirming the effectiveness of adaptive relational reasoning, AU-guided dynamic connectivity, and deep spatial-temporal feature fusion for accurate cross-dataset micro-expression recognition.

2606.28002.tldr: A synthetic multimodal framework that replicates FNOL conditions and generates agent-customer dialogue transcripts and two-speaker audios, performs ASR and diarisation, and offers a reproducible baseline beyond text-only fraud detection.

2606.27978.tldr: Parallel Rollout Approximation (PRA) is proposed, a scalable framework that addresses both challenges jointly in pixel-space continuous-token autoregressive generation and achieves higher ImageNet classification probing accuracy than other AR and diffusion baselines, suggesting its potential for unified pixel-space image generation and understanding.

2606.27976.tldr: SHARD preserves retrieval and compartmentalizes alignment evidence, but does not provide DP, unlinkability, or cancellable templates, but is evaluated as a leakage trade-off, not a cryptographic document-privacy guarantee.

2606.28186.tldr: Epi2Diff (Episode to Difficulty), a framework that maps LRM reasoning traces into cognitively grounded episode sequences, demonstrating that cognitive episodes in LRM reasoning traces provide a predictive and interpretable process representation for human item difficulty, is introduced.

2504.02871.tldr: A zero-shot hierarchical prompt engineering method that requires minimal knowledge transfer from a human expert and is applicable to multiple biomedical domains is proposed.

2502.06631.tldr: This work investigates how Conformal Prediction techniques, which provide rigorous coverage guarantees, can enhance the reliability of state-of-the-art human action recognition (HAR) systems built upon Vision-Language Models (VLMs).

2501.14940.tldr: CASE-Bench is introduced, a Context-Aware SafEty Benchmark that integrates context into safety assessments of LLMs and identifies notable mismatches between human judgments and LLM responses, particularly in commercial models within safe contexts.

2406.03367.tldr: This paper introduces CLMASP, an approach that couples LLMs with ASP for robotic task planning and demonstrates a significant improvement in the executable rate from under 10% to nearly 90% and reducing average ASP planning time from over 2 hours to under 5 seconds.

2508.17117.tldr: It is found that current frontier vision-language models, including recent open-source instruction-tuned multimodal LLMs, perform poorly on PlantExpertVQA, but parameter-efficient fine-tuning of a compact 2B-parameter model on a small fraction of the dataset yields substantial improvements across all question categories, demonstrating its effectiveness for domain adaptation.

2504.07971.tldr: An evaluation card SPHERE is presented, which encompasses five key dimensions: what is being evaluated, how is the evaluation conducted, who is participating in the evaluation, when is evaluation conducted, and how is evaluation validated.

2403.07711.tldr: The ablation study shows that when using SSMs for temporal modeling, incorporating bidirectionality and selective scans enhances video generation performance, and SSM-based models incur lower computational cost to achieve the same Fréchet Video Distance as attention-based models.

2402.06359.tldr: This work proposes a formal computational framework for representing human values that provides the foundational structures required for value-aware reasoning in multi-agent systems and demonstrates how the model supports the evaluation of behaviour in terms of value alignment across a real-world scenario.

2002.11508.tldr: This work defines a notion of arc-consistency for TCSPs, which the authors will refer to as binarized-domains Arc-Consistency, or bdArc-Consistency for short, and provides an algorithm achieving bdArc-Consistency for a TCSP, which they will refer to as bdAC-3.

2410.06355.tldr: UNCOM, a novel hybrid framework for interpreting natural human commands in tabletop scenarios, is presented, designed for zero-shot operation, without reliance on predefined object models or training data specific to a given task.

2409.08775.tldr: This work introduces Requirement-Oriented Prompt Engineering (ROPE), a paradigm that focuses human attention on generating clear, complete requirements during prompting, and demonstrates a direct correlation between the quality of input requirements and LLM outputs.

2407.21740.tldr: This paper introduces a novel Contrastive Factor Analysis framework, aiming to leverage factor analysis's advantageous properties within the realm of contrastive learning, and extensive experimental validation showcases the efficacy of the proposed contrastive (non-negative) factor analysis methodology across multiple key properties.

2407.19633.tldr: This work introduces a Large Language Model (LLM)-based system designed to formulate and solve (mixed integer) linear programming problems from their natural language descriptions and finds that system architecture is a stronger driver of performance than model capability.

2509.10858.tldr: This survey provides the first comprehensive and structured analysis of LLM integration into SOC operations and systematically map LLM applications to the functions of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) and the MITRE ATT&CK framework as an analytical lens to evaluate their granular threat detection capabilities.

2507.07445.tldr: StarDojo, a novel benchmark based on Stardew Valley, designed to assess AI agents in open-ended production-living simulations, offers a unified, user-friendly interface that eliminates the need for keyboard and mouse control, supports all major operating systems, and enables the parallel execution of multiple environment instances.

2509.20218.tldr: This study explores cooperative lane-change prediction through a real hardware deployment in mixed traffic and shares the insights that emerged during implementation and testing, including bottlenecks, reliability issues, and operational constraints that shaped the behavior of the system.

2501.17559.tldr: GraphChase is introduced, an open-source platform designed to support the development and evaluation of algorithms for UNSGs, and offers a unified environment for modeling diverse UNSG variants on unweighted and weighted road networks across urban topologies.

2410.06347.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the Goal-Conditioned Decision Transformer adapted for offline multi-goal robotics outperforms state-of-the-art online baselines in complex tasks and maintains robustness in sparse-reward settings, even with limited expert demonstrations.

2101.05993.tldr: A multi-view ensemble meta-learning framework for classification algorithm recommendation that constructs base recommendation models from different combinations of heterogeneous meta-feature groups and combines them through an accuracy- and diversity-aware ensemble strategy is proposed.

2506.12078.tldr: Light Society formalizes social processes as structured transitions of agent and environment states, governed by a set of LLM-powered simulation operations, providing researchers with a practical foundation for hypothesis testing and the study of emergent collective behaviors at planetary scale.

2506.08774.tldr: This work empirically investigates the geometric relationships between visual and textual embeddings derived from both vision-language models and combined unimodal models, and proposes a proposed custom contrastive loss that is advantageous over the MSE loss for aligning image and text representations.

2503.00539.tldr: The experimental results show that the robust training of RLHF methods improves the accuracy of the learned reward models on average, and markedly on some tasks, such as reasoning, and that the robust versions of policy optimization methods, similarly improve performance on OOD tasks.

2410.05289.tldr: The results emphasize the importance of using interpretable models, like NeSy ones, for applications in drug discovery, by identifying and mitigating reasoning shortcuts, MARS MoA predictions which are biologically meaningful and, therefore, more reliable for downstream drug discovery research.

2406.08311.tldr: This paper presents high-order structural causal information as a natural form of prior knowledge and introduces a benchmark framework to evaluate tabular synthesis models, positioning the framework as a controlled diagnostic benchmark for causal fidelity, complementing existing low-order and downstream evaluations.

2405.01906.tldr: This work designs a simple yet efficient instance-conditioned adaptation function that adjusts the policy based on the specific geometry and density of the current traffic scenario to improve model adaptability with minimal computational overhead, and proposes a powerful yet low-complexity instance-conditioned adaptation module to generate better solutions for instances across various scales.

2508.06482.tldr: This work designs a focused, cognitively-motivated interaction benchmark that consistently elicits strong convention formation trends in humans and creates a new document-grounded reference completion task that reflects in-the-wild convention formation behavior.

2503.19501.tldr: A robust fall detection system that does not require any additional sensors or high-powered hardware, and uses pose estimation techniques, combined with threshold-based analysis and a voting mechanism to effectively distinguish between fall and non-fall activities.

2506.08795.tldr: A teleoperation system to collect human demonstration data for training the prosthetic hand control model using imitation learning, which mimics the prosthetic hand actions from human, and showed that the imitation learning algorithm can achieve high success rates and generalize effectively to new users and previously unseen objects with varying weights.

2412.04924.tldr: The AISE index is introduced, a novel metric based on O*NET occupational descriptions and AI applications developed by venture backed startups worldwide that suggests that even though white-collar high-skilled occupations are theoretically highly exposed, they are heterogeneously targeted by AI startups.

2407.21359.tldr: The Prospective (ProSpec) RL method is proposed, which makes higher-value, lower-risk optimal decisions by imagining future n-stream trajectories by employing a dynamic model to predict future states based on the current state and a series of sampled actions.

2509.12159.tldr: A bidirectional compression framework designed for efficient UI code generation and an Adaptive Duplicate Token Suppression mechanism, which dynamically modulates token probabilities during decoding by tracking HTML/CSS code structure frequencies and applying exponential penalty strategies to minimize repetitive generation.

2504.17421.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive overview of recent advances and challenges in harnessing the collaborative power of large and small models for private-domain adaptation, and proposes a unified taxonomy that classifies research into three primary directions: downward knowledge transfer, upward knowledge transfer, and inference-time collaboration across parties.

2507.21136.tldr: This work proposes three new independence criteria for designing supervised and unsupervised dimensionality reduction methods, aiming to improve feature extraction and representation quality and suggests a promising direction for interpretable representation learning based on statistical dependence and independence criteria.

2506.18295.tldr: GeNeRT is a generalizable neural RT framework that improves generalization and accuracy through relative geometric features, scatterer semantics, and a Fresnel-inspired polarization-driven architecture that proves robust intra-scenario transferability and inter-scenario zero-shot generalization.

2602.11351.tldr: Behavior Agentic Optimization (BAO) is proposed, an agentic RL framework that enhances and regularizes inter-turn behaviors to improve information-gathering capabilities and suppress inefficient or redundant interactions with users.

2603.03305.tldr: Draft-Conditioned Constrained Decoding is proposed, a simple two-step, training-free inference procedure that decouples semantic planning from structural enforcement and enables smaller model pairs to match or exceed much larger constrained baselines, yielding substantial gains in parameter efficiency.

2602.11395.tldr: Noise-Aligned RFM Steering (NA-RFM) is presented, a general recipe for efficiently steering diffusion models without gradient guidance during inference, enabling fast controllable generation.

2512.10359.tldr: This work equipped MLLM with a comprehensive and extensible Video Toolkit to enhance MLLM's spatiotemporal reasoning capabilities and ensure the harmony between the quantity and diversity of tools, and proposes a Spatiotemporal Reasoning Framework (STAR) that strategically schedules temporal and spatial tools, thereby progressively localizing the key area in the video.

2603.13326.tldr: Feature-level I2MoE (FL-I2MoE), a structured Mixture-of-Experts layer that operates directly on token/patch sequences from frozen pretrained encoders and explicitly separates unique, synergistic, and redundant evidence at the feature level is presented.

2606.16620.tldr: The expanded rollout pool provides richer per-prompt candidates for any downstream procedure that consumes rollouts, including self-consistency, best-of-N with verifiers, and group-relative RL training (GRPO), opening a new direction for inference-time scaling that does not rely on stochastic noise.

2605.08022.tldr: This work extends the work on convexification of parallel feedforward threshold networks to parallel recurrent threshold networks, which subsume parallel SNNs as a structured special case, and proposes a parameter reconstruction algorithm for SNN training that demonstrates consistent and significant advantages across various tasks.

2603.06638.tldr: HEARTS (Health Reasoning over Time Series), a unified benchmark for evaluating hierarchical reasoning capabilities of LLMs over general health time series, provides a standardized testbed and living benchmark for developing next-generation LLM agents capable of reasoning over diverse health signals.

2605.17064.tldr: This work presents a dataset construction and training framework for book-scale creative writing that reframes supervised fine-tuning as a prompt-to-book generation task grounded in human-authored fiction and trains a long-context language model on these prompt-to-book trajectories, which shifts generation away from assistant-style prose and toward human literary writing.

2606.28345.tldr: A gradient-based audit framework for multilingual evaluation of LLM moral trade-off behavior against cultural preference gradients is introduced, and model factors are suggested to be a more robust lever than prompting alone.

2606.28331.tldr: This work performs a critical analysis of the policy discourse surrounding generative AI content transparency in the US and EU through a broad document selection methodology, and identifies critical points of disconnect between policy and technological capabilities and practice.

2606.28329.tldr: This work proposes M^3QAFrame, a multi-modal, multi-span medical question-answering framework that leverages visual cues to enhance the generation of comprehensive answers drawn from diverse textual and visual spans and consistently outperforms existing methods across various evaluation metrics.

2606.28342.tldr: A fully decentralized protocol is implemented that overlaps synchronization with local training and supports partial tensor-level transfers when contacts end early, and three operating regimes are identified: inter-contact time largely dictates convergence via mixing, partial updates are often well tolerated when contacts are frequent, and very dense contact patterns can trigger contention, reducing effective throughput.

2606.28337.tldr: A controlled empirical study of RAG sensitivity, robustness, and stability across 56 experimental runs suggests that RAG evaluation should include sensitivity, robustness, stability, and multi-stage failure analysis rather than relying only on final answer accuracy.

2606.28334.tldr: A synthesis of current research on AI-based suicide detection in social media drawing on a recent umbrella review of 22 systematic reviews covering studies up to 2022, alongside an ongoing literature review extending the analysis to more recent work suggests that current advances in model performance should be interpreted with caution.

2606.28332.tldr: It is shown that medical safety cannot be inferred from general alignment or medical capability alone, highlighting the need for domain-specific stress testing before deploying LLMs in safety-critical medical applications.

2606.28330.tldr: The results show that similarity signals progressively lose contrast as dimension increases, leading to unstable retrieval behavior and structural bias in nearest-neighbor selection, and motivate geometry-aware diagnostics and robustness-oriented retrieval strategies for embedding-based AI systems.

2606.28327.tldr: A unified signal detection theory (SDT) framework that applies to both human episodic memory and Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems under semantic interference is presented, and behavioral and computational data are fit to fit behavioral and computational data in matched paradigms.

2606.28326.tldr: The ADEPT framework is proposed: a training-free agent that pioneers an entropy-driven decision engine to efficiently guide dialogue by dynamically selecting between ASK and REFINE strategies that sets a new performance benchmark for the field of interactive video retrieval.

2606.28365.tldr: CAMI (Cost-Aware Multi-Indexing) is introduced, a framework that formalizes multi-index construction as a budgeted, multi-objective portfolio selection problem and systematically isolates high-recall portfolios under strict budget constraints.

2606.28363.tldr: Meta-pipe, an open-source large language model-agent pipeline that integrates the complete systematic review and meta-analysis workflow with mandatory human oversight at critical decision points, offers four capabilities not available in any single existing tool.

2606.28361.tldr: ConCise is proposed, a training-free state-layer protocol that restructures cross-round context transmission for multi-step RAG services and achieves 64.63\% average token savings while maintaining acceptable accuracy, providing a plug-and-play, deployment-friendly solution for cost-efficient multi-step RAG service optimization.

2606.28360.tldr: The results show that production-ready LLM systems for institutional policy guidance require rethinking standard RAG patterns to prioritize safety, transparency, and departmental autonomy over conversational sophistication.

2606.28353.tldr: This work formalizes medical device-patent linking as a challenging cross-domain entity linking problem characterized by label scarcity and domain shifts and proposes Bridge-MedDevKG, a coarse-to-fine framework that provides 6.8M high-confidence links, laying a scalable foundation for regulatory-IP integration across medical specialties.

2606.28339.tldr: Simulation results show improvements of up to 75% in data rate, 25-latency reduction, and 16-% energy savings compared with state-of-the-art learning-based and non-RIS baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of RIS-assisted Open-RAN intelligence for industrial 6G networks.

2606.28356.tldr: SafeGEO, an evaluation suite with 22 GEO attack variants across 600 recommendation cases, empirically shows that GEO attacks can promote flawed target products and that simple defenses, including defensive prompting and structured evidence checks, reduce harmful target promotion.

2606.28347.tldr: This paper argues that safety should be treated as an epistemic property of the evolving learner, not merely a behavioral property of the current policy, and introduces teachability as the capacity to preserve future corrective leverage under bounded human, institutional, or environmental intervention.

2606.28343.tldr: This work demonstrates that for a fixed embedding space, a phase transition occurs where minority user goals suffer a catastrophic collapse in performance as the density of majority goals increases, and derives a non-linear Fokker-Planck equation that governs the evolution of document embeddings as the agent updates them to maximize retrieval accuracy.

2606.28336.tldr: HyBIRD is proposed, a frozen-anchor framework that treats MIR as hyperbolic bridge retrieval and post-hoc method diagnosis, and suggests that hyperbolic geometry is most useful as calibrated structure over a dense anchor, rather than as a standalone replacement for dense retrieval.

2606.22528.tldr: Constraint Pinning is proposed, a simple training-free mitigation that quarantines governance constraints from lossy compaction and restores violation to 0% in a benchmark of long-horizon agent scenarios with deterministic tool-call grading.

2606.28362.tldr: LUMEN is the first empirical cost and operational characterization of such a pipeline: a complete review costs 19 to 29 USD (median 22.65 USD), with title-abstract screening and data extraction together dominating expenditure.

2606.28358.tldr: This paper offers the first mechanistic account of how a large language model decides whether to attach an inline citation while answering a factoid question, using the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model in a controlled experimental environment based on the PopQA dataset.

2606.28357.tldr: This work introduces ReasonRec, a reasoning-augmented multimodal agent structured around a three-stage explicit reasoning pipeline that systematically transforms diverse recommendation tasks into unified CoT prompts, enabling the VLM to explicitly articulate intermediate decision steps.

2606.28349.tldr: HMARS is proposed, a hierarchical multi-agent memory system that treats long contexts as managed memory rather than a flat retrieval corpus and achieves the best overall performance against retrieval, reranking, full-context, graph-based, and agentic long-context baselines.

2606.28333.tldr: It is argued that LLM outputs are patterned in ways that reproduce racial hierarchies, gender asymmetries, and Western-centric epistemic frameworks, and that critical AI literacy must engage seriously with questions of whose knowledge systems are reproduced and legitimated, or marginalised and undermined.

2606.28513.tldr: Results support that heteroscedastic noising with the pro-posed HDDPM is feasible, and it provides a physically motivated inductive bias for quantitative low-count PET recovery by reflecting the activity-dependent noise structure of PET.

2606.28419.tldr: The proposed MedDiffuseMix framework uses classifier-derived saliency maps to separate high-saliency diagnostic regions from low-saliency background areas and applies diffusion-guided mixing mainly to regions with lower diagnostic importance, suggesting that saliency-guided diffusion mixing is an effective augmentation strategy for limited-data medical image classification.

2606.28409.tldr: This work forms C-to-HLS-C conversion as a closed-loop generation-verification-diagnosis-repair problem on an HLS tool, contributing three components: an end-to-end workflow of cooperating agents closed by the four-stage verifier under strict evidence isolation; a Progressive Mismatch Localization Chain that localizes CSim/CoSim mismatches through log normalization, AST backward slicing, and dual-trace instrumentation.

2606.28404.tldr: Examining AI infrastructure investment flows across Africa through a systematic analysis of 46 publicly announced projects reveals a highly concentrated landscape dominated by global data center operators, hyperscale technology firms, and development finance institutions, clustering in South Africa, Kenya, Nigeria, and Egypt.

2606.28391.tldr: This paper proposes a variation of Fidelity-based XAI metrics, with a focus on real-conditions applications, where the number of classes is often low, and generates in-distribution, uncertainty-provoking perturbations to ensure proper measurement of the XAI methods faithfulness.

2606.28376.tldr: This work instantiates OSU-Mem, which retrieves from an overlapping OSU pool via budgeted coarse-to-fine expansion, and shows its benefit is conditional: overlapping memory helps when the evidence steps a query needs share tool calls or entities, but hurts when those steps are fully heterogeneous and share neither.

2606.28479.tldr: This first empirical study of how DP SGD and HMAC pseudonymization interact when fine tuning small language models with 1B to 3B parameters on structured CSIRT data shows that 1B to 3B SLMs do not achieve operationally useful performance.

2606.28467.tldr: An end-to-end agentic pipeline that combines deep time-series forecasting, variational anomaly detection, and LLM-based reasoning to generate prioritized, actionable maintenance recommendations is proposed.

2606.28456.tldr: This work investigates whether lying can emerge among LLM agents in a competitive sustainability game in which agents are informed that common resources can regenerate, although regeneration does not actually occur and develops an agent-based model of a sustainability game.

2606.28450.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive overview of the opportunities and challenges of LLM agents in security, focusing on two core areas: threats to LLM agents themselves and corresponding mitigation strategies and the role of LLM agents in empowering the cybersecurity lifecycle across offense and defense (LLM agents empowered cybersecurity).

2606.28447.tldr: This work proposes SemFlowRAG, a framework that reconstructs the flat retrieval space into a corpus-adaptive semantic gradient graph, and designs an abstractness-guided directed PageRank algorithm that forces the retrieval trajectory to follow a ``high-to-low semantic abstractness''gradient.

2606.28439.tldr: This paper proposes an adversarial attack specifically designed for NIDS that incrementally generates packet-level features to construct adversarial traffic and achieves an average evasion success rate of 92.78%, while ensuring that the generated adversarial traffic remains semantically consistent with the original malicious traffic.

2606.28438.tldr: Stable recursive code LLM training requires exogenous verification rather than model-coupled self-review, and the results suggest that stable recursive code LLM training requires exogenous verification rather than model-coupled self-review.

2606.28436.tldr: Dockerless is proposed, an environment-free agentic patch verifier that evaluates generated code patches without executing them, rather than simply matching candidate patches to references, which judges patch correctness using evidence gathered through agentic repository exploration.

2606.28413.tldr: Proved per agent, the necessity binds every agent of a mesh, a structural condition on mesh intelligence, and two necessary conditions from one model of a self-evolving latent observed at irregular, exogenous times are proved.

2606.28403.tldr: A task- and formulation-oriented taxonomy is proposed and the absence of RL agents that use source-code CFGs as states to detect and localize vulnerable nodes is identified: the absence of RL agents that use source-code CFGs as states to detect and localize vulnerable nodes.

2606.28387.tldr: Results show that catalog selection is a first-class retrieval problem for natural language analytics, not a prompt formatting detail, and introduces Schema-First Retrieval, a retrieval layer that embeds catalog metadata rather than warehouse rows.

2606.28386.tldr: Although IAR-generated images often appear visually identical to real images, their generation process introduces characteristic patterns in their outputs, which serves as a reliable provenance signal for the generated images, and a post-hoc framework is presented that enables the robust detection of such patterns for provenance tracing.

2606.28384.tldr: This work proposes a query-driven DT architecture to enable the DT to actively request the desired environment data from vehicles based on its simulation result, and designs a cross-time-step progressive query mechanism to further improve communication efficiency.

2606.28374.tldr: This work introduces RSEA, a Recursive Self-Evolving Agent that carries a compact three-layer natural-language state: an imperative strategy, reusable skills, and a procedural playbook that never significantly underperforms the base agent on any benchmark and falls back to vanilla ReAct when evolved context would hurt.

2606.28475.tldr: It is shown that the LMKF SLAM is significantly superior to the state-of-the-art methods, especially EKF-based SLAMs, both in accuracy, convergence, and computational complexity.

2606.28471.tldr: An evaluation taxonomy, a non-instruction data taxonomy, and mapping rules form a closed loop turning a benchmark-level failure into a targeted, testable data intervention, showing the evaluation-to-data inference can be routine, auditable, and experimentally validated rather than intuitive.

2606.28460.tldr: A novel Counterfactual Residual Data Augmentation technique for tabular regression that combines principled counterfactual variations to the training data, offering a simple and efficient remedy for noise-prone, small-sample regression settings.

2606.28444.tldr: This work proposes S-GAI, a spectral geometry-aware initialization framework for one-hidden-layer sigmoidal MLPs, and formulate a SVD-based subspace classifier as a non-neural geometric reference, which tests whether the estimated spectral class geometry is already discriminative before being embedded into the MLP.

2606.28430.tldr: This work re-implements a React Fluent-UI data table in Angular as a reusable library under a hidden 222-test Playwright oracle across 18 runs and three oracle-availability conditions and calls it validation self-awareness.

2606.28416.tldr: This paper presents AEGIS, a semantic aware and uncertainty guided adversarial detection framework designed for robust image classification in vision sensors pipelines, outperforming conventional softmax-based detectors in terms of detection performance, robustness, interpretability, and uncertainty calibration.

2606.28380.tldr: This work uses hypernetworks to learn a compressed generative process that generates the connectivity of a modular reservoir and shows that this marriage between curriculum-based meta-learning and modular reservoir computing can generate sparse recurrent networks that solve difficult temporal tasks with minimal training and without concessions to robustness.

2606.28369.tldr: This work presents a novel framework that leverages AI foundation models, including Large Language Models and Vision-Language Models, to enable effective similarity search and ranking for such event documents, and demonstrates that VLM-enhanced methods outperform unimodal, LLM-based approaches in similarity ranking effectiveness.

2606.28514.tldr: GPTNT, a benchmark built on the cooperative video game Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes, in which two agents must coordinate to defuse procedurally generated bomb puzzles against a live countdown, is introduced, designed to separate collaboration from reliance on memorized solutions.

2606.28425.tldr: The results suggest a shift in the threat model for covert communication between AI agents, where the main barrier is no longer whether frontier agents can understand and implement sophisticated stegosystems, but coordination: whether independently acting agents can converge on compatible schemes, keys, and parameters.

2606.28397.tldr: Closed-loop Self-verified Retrieval-augmented Reasoning (CLOSER), a training-policy-free method that sequentially performs action reasoning, reliability verification, targeted retrieval, and action correction in a closed-loop manner before executing concrete actions is proposed.

2606.28392.tldr: RADIANT-PET is presented, a reasoning-augmented framework that couples a high-sensitivity voxel-level segmentation model with lesion-level large language model (LLM) adjudication that consistently outperforms strong image-only baselines and suppressing physiologic false positives and aligning voxel-level predictions with clinical interpretation.

2606.28381.tldr: Evolutional Math, an open-source genetic programming system that combines four design choices to yield compact, interpretable formulas in this regime, consistently recovers compact ground-truth structures with R-squared at or above 0.99 within tens of thousands of unique formula evaluations.

2606.28377.tldr: This work proposes a fully unsupervised spatiotemporal feature fusion framework using a memory-augmented autoencoder that enhances activity representations via short temporal windows of multi-sensor IMU data, enabling real-time applications.

2606.28373.tldr: The MERGEvolve framework is proposed, which unifies model merging and evolution within an evolution strategy by treating the merged model as the initialization for evolutionary exploration of the parameter space.

2606.28370.tldr: COGNI is presented, a production conversational BI system that treats natural-language analytics as a heterogeneous query processing problem, organized as four architectural layers.

2606.28390.tldr: Topo4Vec, an automated GeoAI framework, designed for scalable vector data quality assessment via advanced Spatial Representation Learning (SRL), and lessons learned shed a promising light into a scalable and autonomous GeoAI approach for large-scale vector data consistency and quality monitoring within the fast-growing geospatial data ecosystems.

2606.28480.tldr: TUA-Bench aims to accelerate the transition from narrow, task-specific assistants to general-purpose agents capable of operating reliably across diverse digital environments by providing a broad and realistic evaluation of terminal-use capabilities.

2606.28465.tldr: SVC-Probe is introduced, a perturbation-aware framework that combines Subcellular Embedding Atlas Stability, Mondrian Neighborhood Graphs, and a Foundation Model Perturbation Probe to assess embedding stability, neighborhood rewiring, and centroid prediction under drug treatment and indicates that perturbation generalization may serve as a stricter and more informative benchmark than baseline condition discrimination.

2606.28455.tldr: Fixed-horizon projection causal field effect (CFE) shows that suppressing field-aligned directions can degrade event-relevant prediction, with strongest evidence for contact-aligned structure in collision-contact windows and more qualified evidence for object-permanence-aligned structure in hard-occlusion hidden windows.

2606.28446.tldr: A domain-informed representation learning framework for irregular astronomical time series with Joint-Embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), combining semantics-preserving views, uncertainty-aware tokenization, and multi-view self-distillation, demonstrating that domain-informed multi-view self-distillation is an effective strategy for learning representations of irregular time series.

2606.28445.tldr: A low-rank adaptation (LoRA)-tuned large language model (LLM) that performs structured multi-view reasoning over four complementary speech-derived signals, enabling a single LLM to learn a coherent decision function without modality-specific encoders or late-stage fusion.

2606.28434.tldr: SWE-MeM is presented, a training framework for proactive and on-demand memory management in software engineering agents that provides a flexible memory tool that lets agents decide when, what, and how to compress based on trajectory state, task progress, and remaining context budget.

2606.28410.tldr: RSGPNet is proposed, a training-free geometric prompting framework for RS OVSS that refines segmentation by leveraging object geometric areas and consistency constraints and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods across both quantitative and qualitative metrics while exhibiting excellent interpretability.

2606.28385.tldr: RoboGaze is presented, a training-free, multi-agent VLM framework that provides structured, interpretable evaluation for generated robot-manipulation videos, and dramatically outperforms zero-shot baselines, improving description-F1 by up to +43 points and temporal alignment by up to +37 points, closing approximately 85% of the gap to the human ceiling.

2606.28441.tldr: The proposed Covariance-Agnostic Neural Kalman Consensus Filter (CA-NKCF) outperforms traditional distributed Kalman and particle filters as well as purely model-free deep neural networks, exhibiting robustness even when the underlying motion and observation models are misspecified.

2606.28770.tldr: This work proposes a mechanistic interpretability approach that directly intervenes on the model's latent features and identifies latent directions in the residual stream corresponding to a target OCEAN trait using sparse autoencoders and contrastive activation analysis.

2606.28724.tldr: This work introduces Image Change Captioning and Segmentation (ICCS), a new multimodal task that jointly requires structured change description and pixel-level localization and proposes the Change-aware Captioning and Reasoning Chain (CCRC), a dual-chain framework that decouples semantic reasoning from spatial segmentation.

2606.28719.tldr: ComMem is proposed, an innovative approach that mimics the distinct but cooperative roles of the hippocampus and neocortex to enable effective TTA for VLMs, offering a promising direction for enhancing VLMs'practical adaptability.

2606.28715.tldr: SEATauBench is introduced, the first agent-focused evaluation framework for SEA sovereign AI, which adapts TauBench to five languages and provides a diagnostic benchmark and reusable adaptation pipeline for building reliable multilingual agents for linguistically diverse regions.

2606.28710.tldr: It is shown that a self-audited agent with a community ledger is not, in general, sufficient to prevent community harm, and the algebraic and finite-grid backbone is machine-checked in Lean 4, with the barrier-crossing asymptotics retained as explicit hypotheses.

2606.28670.tldr: MACROCAST is, to the authors' knowledge, the first TSFM that rules out both forms of leakage entirely: at no stage of training is the model exposed to information that would not have been available to a forecaster in real time.

2606.28565.tldr: KernelSight-LM is a fine-grained inference simulator that models token-level execution and produces kernel-level latency breakdowns, and its kernel-level bottleneck breakdowns support hardware/software co-design and capacity planning.

2606.28789.tldr: It is argued that the decisive legal move is to place validity, a functional, second-order concept, at the centre of that chain that turns data into intelligence and intelligence into economic value, making validity an asset for the UNO Sustainable Development Goals.

2606.28739.tldr: It is concluded that action safety cannot be installed in weights and must be expressed as the least privilege, enforced outside the model at the action boundary, and evaluated as action alignment (a relational, deployment-conditioned property) rather than a refusal score.

2606.28737.tldr: 5ting, the authors' system for the SemEval2026 Task 8 (MTRAGEval), which evaluates multi-turn Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, combines BGE-M3 dense retrieval with FAISS indexing, dual-query merged retrieval, and LLM based reranking, followed by role separated generation constrained to retrieved evidence.

2606.28692.tldr: THENA-R1 is introduced, an AI agent for treatment reasoning across all FDA approved drugs since 1939, trained by reinforcement learning over a universe of 212 biomedical tools, and outperforms language models and tool-use systems on five benchmarks.

2606.28662.tldr: This is the first study to report a closed-form gradient that promotes convergence to flat minima without numerical approximations, and the theoretical analysis of this gradient is expected to contribute to the further development of NNs.
