2606.29279.tldr: This rewriting manufactures confidence: across constructed agent settings, a casual, hedged remark becomes a confident, dated assertion the agent then obeys like a verified fact, granting every above-clearance request it faces.

2606.29171.tldr: Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution (SMDA) is introduced, a framework that attributes training pairs to the interpretable symbolic policies governing model behavior and yields a diagnostic tool that is both more fine-grained than black-box influence functions and more scalable than manual circuit analysis.

2606.29136.tldr: This paper proposes a Cross-Modal information inTeraction transFormer, coined as CMTFormer, which hierarchically integrates RGB and event information to achieve efficient and stable multimodal collaboration and designs a shallow-to-deep information interaction scheme.

2509.15443.tldr: Implicit Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting (IKMR), a highly scalable, neural-based data transformation pipeline that bridges the gap between human motion and robotic data, achieves an unprecedented data conversion throughput exceeding 5000 frames per second.

2508.13836.tldr: This study presents one of the first systematic and comprehensive comparisons of these methods, providing rigorous definitions, benchmarking both across structured and unstructured settings, and applying different pruning criteria and modalities, finding that each method has specific advantages.

2504.12557.tldr: A theoretical analysis of the approximation gap introduced by the learning objective is provided, and it is demonstrated empirically that TraCeS improves constraint satisfaction and feedback efficiency over baselines across multiple continuous-control benchmarks, including long-horizon tasks and settings with noisy or inconsistent labels.

2502.15637.tldr: It is demonstrated that effective tokenization is critical to unlocking the full potential of transformers, proposing a novel token generator unit and an enhanced test-time methodology that bridges the performance gap between Mantis and strong specialized approaches by leveraging intermediate-layer representations, self-ensembling, and cross-model embedding fusion.

2410.12341.tldr: This paper conducts extensive simulations across multiple datasets and LLMs to address key gaps in the study of model collapse and proposes a perplexity-based filtering strategy that prioritizes high-surprise documents during fine-tuning.

2503.05785.tldr: Findings indicate that students have a strong interest in using AI tools in their studies, expecting them to improve their overall academic performance, understand the complexity of scientific approaches, and save time.

2502.00547.tldr: A key innovation of this work is the adoption of a multiple instance learning (MIL) approach, which extracts meaningful information from multiple facial expression images over time, capturing critical temporal dynamics often overlooked in previous studies.

2502.00684.tldr: Experimental results on both continuous and discrete environments demonstrate that the proposed novel concept-based explanation framework effectively identifies meaningful decision-making patterns, offering faithful explanations that align with human intuition.

2505.03303.tldr: A matched comparison of ImageNet pretrained and randomly initialized EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNetV3-Small models shows that the pretrained advantage is substantially larger on CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet than on CIFAR-10 under the fixed protocol.

2509.12046.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that SMARLI seamlessly integrates layout tokens with text and image tokens without compromising generation quality, and the proposed masking strategy and post-training scheme can also be transferred to standard next-token-based AR models.

2502.15845.tldr: A budget-friendly, two-stage detection algorithm that calls the verifier model only for a subset of cases and dynamically switches between self-consistency and cross-consistency based on an uncertainty interval of the self-consistency classifier is proposed.

2502.04489.tldr: This work proposes a comprehensive hierarchical unsupervised fusion (HUF) method for feature extraction and fusion from IMU sensor data, using a hybrid architecture of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and autoencoders (AEs).

2507.11061.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the RoMaP achieves state-of-the-art local 3D editing on both reconstructed and generated Gaussian scenes and objects qualitatively and quantitatively, making it possible for more robust and flexible part-level 3D Gaussian editing.

2505.21550.tldr: This position paper argues that interoperability, achieved by the adoption of minimal standards, is essential to ensure open, secure, web-scale, and widely-adopted agentic ecosystems and offers a pragmatic path forward before ecosystem fragmentation becomes the norm.

2402.06734.tldr: This work aims to design algorithms that identify a near-optimal policy from the corrupted data, with provable guarantees, and is the first work that provides provable corruption robust offline RLHF methods.

2508.01273.tldr: This work proposes \textbf{\textsc{Kcr}} (Knowledge Conflict Reasoning), a framework that adjudicates contradictions by systematically structuring their underlying logic by utilizing a hybrid representation of text and graphs to facilitate systematic comprehension.

2504.07385.tldr: This work proposes Search-AuGmented Evaluation (SAGE), a framework to assess LLM outputs without fixed ground-truth answers that offers a scalable and adaptive alternative for evaluating the factuality of LLMs.

2605.09045.tldr: This work introduces containment verification, which locates safety guarantees in the agentic framework itself and proves a universal guarantee by forward-simulation refinement and mechanize it in Dafny, the first deductive formal verification of an agentic framework.

2604.04138.tldr: GRIT is presented, a two-stage framework that learns dexterous control from sparse taxonomy guidance that improves generalization to novel objects over baselines and achieves an overall success rate of 87.9%.

2602.11354.tldr: ReplicatorAgent, an agentic framework equipped with necessary tools, like web search and iterative interaction with sandboxed environments, to accomplish tasks in ReplicatorBench, is developed, revealing that while current LLM agents are capable of effectively designing and executing computational experiments, they struggle with retrieving resources, such as new data, necessary to replicate a claim.

2604.09731.tldr: This work proposes SMART, a system-aware marginal analysis framework for runtime tree construction that reformulates tree expansion as a hardware-aware optimization problem that directly maximizes end-to-end speedup.

2606.30658.tldr: Comparing agentic AI against non-agentic baselines, physicians exhibited significantly higher cognitive and behavioral trust for the agentic model (P<0.001), highlighting the inherent limitations of decision-logic transparency alone and underscoring the continuous need for rigorous clinician oversight.

2606.30657.tldr: AI for quality assurance should be understood as a set of tools for augmenting the surgical team, scaling expert review, and helping surgery evolve toward a learning system in which intraoperative care is continuously observed, assessed, and improved.

2606.29575.tldr: TF-MoE, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances model capacity with almost no increase in inference cost, is proposed and demonstrated that TF-MoE consistently improves separation performance under computation cost constraints.

2606.29879.tldr: LWDrive is a VLM planning framework that refines coarse trajectories through layer-wise world-model guidance and introduces future-frame generation supervision to encourage the VLM to learn forward-looking scene representations, thereby injecting planning-relevant predictive dynamics into its internal hidden states.

2606.23672.tldr: This paper presents algorithmic innovations for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge, focusing on Bit Manipulation Puzzles, which earned the team the Best Fine-tuning Method and Best Data/Synthetic Data Method awards in the contest, alongside a 7th Place overall finish on leaderboard.

2606.30660.tldr: It is shown that convAI significantly improves survey completion rates relative to traditional modalities, with the highest completion and lowest drop-off observed when value-sensitive and culturally aligned conversational design elements are fully integrated.

2606.30653.tldr: A new measure, generator-evaluator self-consistency, is proposed to test this assumption directly and finds that there is substantial variation in self-consistency and that in a clinical setting with physician-validated mistakes, those with higher self-consistency are linked to greater vulnerability to mistakes.

2606.30650.tldr: A synthetic benchmark and decision-support framework for qualified educational capacity planning is introduced, a stylized single-institution service system with heterogeneous support-demand categories, backlog-only dynamics, continuous preparation states with hard threshold qualification and decay, and capacity-consuming training.

2606.30338.tldr: This work develops a sequential generalized likelihood-ratio framework that allows auditors to accumulate evidence from a finite audit pool and stop once sufficient support for compliance or violation has been obtained, and provides a practical statistical framework for sequential fairness auditing under realistic deployment constraints.

2606.22678.tldr: The results show that structured process discipline not only improves process quality scores by an average of 41% but also raises downstream outcome correctness by 17%, providing the first quantitative evidence that how agents code matters as much as what they produce.

2606.30560.tldr: This work collects and releases a trace of 4,300 coding-agent sessions, containing about 350,000 LLM steps and 430,000 tool calls from the authors' own day-to-day use of Claude Code and Codex, and analysis shows that coding-agent workloads feature long autonomous loops, long contexts with short outputs, diverse and heavily-tailed tool calls, and high but imperfect prefix cache hit rates.

2606.30662.tldr: This work proposes ELEVATE (Efficient LLM Education with Virtual Avatar Teaching Engine), a framework to develop efficient GenAI-driven avatar tutors governed by epistemic infrastructures and adopts a local-first execution model enabling deployment on consumer-grade hardware.

2606.30651.tldr: A user-centered interactive machine learning framework for delirium detection support that combines physician-guided feature refinement with interpretable modeling is presented and shows better overall discrimination and stronger temporal robustness, while the explanations highlight clinically meaningful signals.

2606.30646.tldr: This work proposes an ASR-agnostic framework operating directly on Mel spectrograms, extracting spectrotemporal displacement fields from consecutive spectrogram frames, capturing shifting spectral energy patterns as digital biomarkers of cognitive decline.

2606.29860.tldr: A relation set completion task (RSC) is introduced, which complements the link prediction task and aims to reason about missing relations that are semantically compatible with a given entity and a Relation Set Embedding model (RelSetE) is proposed, which models latent patterns among the observed relations of entities to infer missing ones.

2606.30652.tldr: An empirical analysis of 92 publicly available AI transparency statements published by Australian Government agencies under the national AI governance mandate is presented, and the stakeholder Risk--Control--Involvement--Need (RCIN) framework is introduced to differentiate stakeholder classes according to their structural position and transparency needs.

2606.30656.tldr: An empirical analysis of the current state of the AI landscape and how it compares with Africa's technological preparedness for the future is provided and concrete recommendations to policymakers are provided to help develop a more comprehensive and equitable AI ecosystem on the African continent.

2606.30655.tldr: An AI-resilient approximate-membership assignment centered on Bloom filters for COMP 480/580 at Rice University is described, designed to test whether students can improve beyond AI-generated implementations.

2606.30647.tldr: AtmoFuseNet is presented, a framework that fuses multi-view sky camera imagery with millimeter-wave cloud radar and ceilometer observations to produce 4D estimates of cloud state and wind.

2606.29980.tldr: This paper proposes to tackle a new online transfer in zero-shot RL, with the key insight that the BFM itself can be used to generate exploration policies, and shows that exploration can be achieved through the minimization of the eigenvalues of an uncertainty matrix.

2606.28578.tldr: A cross-factorial benchmark of surrogate performance spanning mechanical, electronic, and vibrational properties identifies pretrained ORB embeddings with a Gaussian process as the most reliable combination, which are adopted as the building blocks of the proposed workflow.

2606.22686.tldr: This work introduces Contrastive Logit Steering (CLS), a zero-optimization framework that isolates the "refusal direction" by contrasting hidden states derived from safe and unrestricted system prompts, and suggests that current alignment techniques create a steerable"safety axis" that serves as both a critical vulnerability and a precise primitive for defense.

2606.21876.tldr: This work introduces representation-CJ, a hidden-state generalization of the Jacobian to architectures without a masked-LM head (the output-head-independent analogue of logit-CJ), agreeing with the Categorical Jacobian where both are defined, and shows that the optimal $K$ tracks how diffusely a model spreads its contact heads.

2606.30863.tldr: This work draws on the Search-Experience-Credence framework from Information Economics to introduce CoPref, a model of how users construct preferences based on agent dialog actions, and proposes CoShop, an interactive benchmark for agentic recommender systems.

2606.30837.tldr: A stationary-distribution theory is developed for plateau-based Random Forest tuning as a stochastic process rather than a deterministic stopping rule.

2606.30819.tldr: An experimental framework to assess LLM-generated PowerShell malware is proposed, which comprises a novel sandbox approach for dynamic analysis of AI-generated malware, and a novel, manually curated dataset of real-world PowerShell malware is presented, annotated in natural language to assist the training and evaluation of LLMs.

2606.30790.tldr: This work introduces the Indi-RomCoM benchmark for facilitating systematic evaluation on Indic Romanized Code-Mixed instructions and extensively evaluates a suite of LLMs covering proprietary, open-weight, and Indic-focused models under zero- and few-shot settings.

2606.30704.tldr: MetaFlow is presented, which casts workflow generation as a meta-learning problem: given a task and an operator set, the model learns to compose solution strategies, and exhibits strong generalization to untrained tasks and novel operator sets.

2606.30669.tldr: The prototype learns local linear rules, preserves partitioned memories through tags and masks, reduces forgetting under consolidation, and uses replay under conflict, and a synthetic long-context hybrid memory task.

2606.30940.tldr: A new generative framework is proposed to unify model-based planning algorithms based on search or optimization and hierarchical coarse-to-fine structure, providing a large degree of flexibility while maintaining efficiency and producing realistic solutions by relying on the generative capabilities of the highly compressed autoencoder.

2606.30919.tldr: This paper presents a competitive weak-skipping estimator that extracts routing signal from raw pixels, outperforming the common after-weak placement weak-conditioned baselines, and proposes budget-adaptive routing, which selects between them by offload budget via two offline-tuned thresholds.

2606.30953.tldr: It is proved that shallow networks with deep reasoning can outperform opaque models in high-stakes cybersecurity, where interpretability is essential, and challenges the assumption that deep learning requires deep networks.

2606.30906.tldr: This work explores multi-agent deliberation (MAD) and introduces two novel multi-agent frameworks inspired by courtroom procedures and legal argumentation, demonstrating the potential of law-inspired multi-agent approaches for deliberation.

2606.30905.tldr: Although collaborative notes improve through human feedback, they reach helpful status and are shown on the platform at lower rates than human-only or AI-only notes, with limited human participation emerging as a key bottleneck.

2606.30852.tldr: A controlled study across 18 task-model settings spanning GSM8K, MATH-500, MMLU-Pro, AIME-90, and GPQA on Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1-distilled models replaces the single-method race with a decision procedure for choosing a stopping rule from the trajectory structure and serving regime of the target workload.

2606.30846.tldr: An experimental study investigating the impact of data representation, transformer-based embedding models, and retrieval strategies on the discovery of simulation models using natural language queries shows that data representation matters, open-source embedding models can achieve high performance, and reranking methods are important, especially as query complexity increases.

2606.30783.tldr: SecFid is introduced, a benchmark built so that executing an injection, processing it as data, and ignoring it produce distinguishable outputs that makes fidelity measurable and exposes a frontier in defending LLMs against indirect prompt injection.

2606.30709.tldr: The results suggest that the approximation introduced by hierarchical routing is small, and that the remaining quality gap is likely dominated by long-context positional encoding rather than by the routing algorithm itself.

2606.30702.tldr: The NHANES Accelerometry Cardiometabolic Benchmark is introduced, derived from NHANES 2003-2006, and the gap between marginal guarantees and the conditional coverage required for clinical fairness is illustrated, illustrating the gap between marginal guarantees and the conditional coverage required for clinical fairness.

2606.30701.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive framework designed to select the most suitable smart objects to deliver a target service within a given IoT environment while also monitoring the behavior of the entities involved during the service provisioning phase, using a Deep Reinforcement Learning approach.

2606.30689.tldr: These findings establish that citation annotations trade determinism for verifiability, and that this trade-off generalizes across model architectures.

2606.30687.tldr: This work introduces a mathematically consistent action-operator framework natively compatible with diffusion models and provides a rigorous path toward transforming generative molecular diffusion models from black-box coordinate samplers into auditable thermodynamic estimators.

2606.30675.tldr: A multimodal framework leveraging Whisper for dual-purpose extraction: acoustic representations from encoder outputs and transcripts via automatic speech recognition via automatic speech recognition (ASR), demonstrating effective integration of acoustic and LLM-augmented linguistic features.

2606.30668.tldr: This work gives collectives of three agents the ability to send messages and manipulate a shared actively decaying text store, introducing evolutionary pressure, and shows that these behaviours exhibit structured long-range coherence beyond the entropy horizon of the decaying store.

2606.30951.tldr: Prost-RL is introduced, which reframes micro-ultrasound detection as a spatially aware, policy-driven inference problem by learning where to look before decoding, and proposes Adaptive Policy Optimization (APO) to stabilize hybrid supervised-RL training and a noise-robust objective combining symmetric cross-entropy with negative-entropy regularization to mitigate weak-label noise and encourage sharp localization.

2606.30899.tldr: A mechanistically guided weight-space repair framework that first localizes modules involved in propagating trigger-induced behavior using activation patching and Fisher/K-FAC curvature analysis, and then applies targeted low-rank repair to only the most influential modules is proposed.

2606.30887.tldr: The results indicate that effective alignment of mental-health LLMs stems from acting on human-aligned evaluation, rather than relying solely on stronger generation.

2606.30813.tldr: Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation is established as a promising framework for exploiting cross-depth structure in optimization and Gradient Smoothing is demonstrated as a simple and broadly applicable instantiation.

2606.30780.tldr: This work proposes an on-device audio deepfake detection model that shows that a truncated self-supervised backbone with a simple logistic classifier is both very fast and often more accurate than existing solutions.

2606.30775.tldr: An automated description optimization pipeline is deployed on a production enterprise group chat agent and identifies a diagnostic (a large train-validation F1 gap) that flags the latter cases for architectural rather than text-level intervention.

2606.30923.tldr: A noisy expert model is proposed to explain why OPD can outperform SFT when training language models from imperfect teachers, and it is proved that online interaction with the noisy expert via a novel variant of OPD enables polynomial dependence on the horizon in general.

2606.30911.tldr: HASTE, a hierarchical multi-agent system that organizes cross-competition knowledge into three scope tiers (global, domain, and competition-specific), each coupled to a matching agent level is presented.

2606.30875.tldr: The Turing-inspired Label Imitation Game (LIG), a framework that formalizes pseudo-label pruning as an adversarial interrogation, is introduced, enabling a unique zero-shot task transfer capability - a TTN trained strictly on image classification datasets can effectively prune complex object detection pseudo-labels.

2606.30705.tldr: In the overlapping regime of real text autoencoders, it is proved that the posterior-mean terminal step flips tokens at the rate of the latent mass in an $O(s(t)$ tube around decision boundaries, resulting in an accuracy-depth-stiffness tradeoff within the deterministic-continuous class.

2606.30700.tldr: BEST-RQ-2 is presented, an evolution of BEST-RQ that retains frozen randomprojection-based discrete targets while introducing a two-step contextualize-then-predict pretraining scheme, and consistently outperforms one-stage baselines in overall transfer while keeping inference compute unchanged.

2606.30697.tldr: LUMOS (Language Model Unified Machine-Readable Operating-System Semantics), a semantic interaction layer between AI agents and operating systems, is introduced and suggests a path toward AI-native operating systems and machine-readable interaction layers.

2606.30963.tldr: Loc2Repair shows file-level localization is a consistent repair lever, improving effectiveness and mean latency in pooled analysis, while gold-guided failures expose headroom beyond localization.

2606.30949.tldr: AgRefactor is an LLM-based multi-agent workflow for refactoring software into HLS-compatible programs that incorporates a self-evolving memory system that accumulates and retrieves factual and strategic knowledge across tasks, improving robustness and efficiency on unseen programs.

2606.30851.tldr: It is demonstrated that ORM-based verification provides a simple, effective, and scalable alternative to heuristic test-time selection strategies for Text-to-SQL, and that ORMs scale effectively with larger candidate sets and yield stronger improvements on complex queries.

2606.30850.tldr: BayesBench is introduced, a suite of simulation environments that probe how closely LLMs' belief updates match those of a rational Bayesian reasoner in multi-turn settings, and scaling improves latent inference and evidence accumulation, but these gains do not reliably carry over to downstream prediction.

2606.30840.tldr: This work presents Contrastive Reflection, an iterative prompt-optimization framework for agentic IR workflows, aimed at making prompt repair more inspectable and validation-driven.

2606.30815.tldr: Using GPT-2 style models trained on perturbed"impossible"variants of English, sensitivity to grammaticality is measured using BLiMP minimal pairs, finding that model performance exhibits only gradual degradation, mediated by the language's information locality.

2606.30774.tldr: Dense student-teacher interaction matrices show that interactive gains are driven more by the student's ability to use feedback than by the teacher's identity, although teacher choice remains important for a fixed student.

2606.30755.tldr: SafeClawArena is developed, a benchmark of 406 adversarial tasks executed in containerized replicas of real agent platforms with canary-marked credentials and evaluated via automated taint tracking across nine output channels, exposing the inadequacy of current defenses and suggesting directions for future hardening.

2606.30694.tldr: DSIP (Diffusion-model-based Signal-free Intersection Planner), a multi-agent motion planning framework driven by a generative diffusion process, is proposed, suggesting that diffusion-based trajectory planning provides a scalable and robust foundation for future autonomous intersection management.

2606.30686.tldr: This position paper argues that the assumption underlying this interpretation -- that semantic generalization is sufficient to support physical action decisions -- has not been independently verified and cannot be tested under current evaluation protocols, and proposes a research direction based on evaluation designs that introduce controlled variation to separately measure semantic and physical generalization.

2606.30682.tldr: Experimental results show that ALM2Vec achieves competitive performance on standard audio and speech retrieval benchmarks while exhibiting promising compositional and controllable retrieval capabilities, highlighting its potential as a unified audio embedding model for retrieval across domains, tasks, and user intents.

2606.30664.tldr: This paper proposes a framework in which causal inference is applied on "natural randomized control trial experiments" to measure the effectiveness of sending coupons at the right time to users without requiring a dedicated AB test.

2606.31134.tldr: This work introduces an agentic autoformalization framework powered by general coding LLMs, and evaluates its system on five papers from the ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC) spanning combinatorics, communication complexity, mechanism design, and learning theory, successfully formalizing their main theorems.

2606.31128.tldr: UniSAE introduces a Discrete Phonetic PosteriorGram representation that factorizes speech content into discrete tokens encoding phoneme identity, pronunciation variants, and duration, enabling direct phoneme- and sub-phoneme-level editing.

2606.31121.tldr: Janus, a plug-in memory controller that decides whether to accept a candidate memory update or retain the previous memory, is proposed, a method-agnostic and wraps existing updaters without changing their update rules.

2606.31114.tldr: This work proposes framing UTM vulnerability discovery as a sequence modeling problem amenable to transformer-based RL architectures, and introduces a Policy Model that generates targeted test scenarios and an Action Sampler that enforces domain constraints.

2606.31050.tldr: Inspired by recent progress in 3D reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting, PredGS, a lightweight and plug-and-play adapter based on 2D Gaussian representation, which could be seamlessly integrated with existing pixel space predictors, significantly improving spatial detail preservation with negligible computational overhead is introduced.

2606.31038.tldr: This work investigates the use of LLMs to drive decision-making in virtual humans within a simulated evacuation scenario, incorporating OCEAN personality traits into agent representations and demonstrates that LLM-driven personality profiles significantly impact agents'decisions, leading to distinct behavioral patterns across different traits.

2606.30989.tldr: This work identifies a failure mode, deductive stereotyping, in which models apply population-level statistical regularities to individual cases, producing logically coherent yet socially biased inferences, and proposes a reasoning-time injection framework to steer models toward fairness-aware reasoning.

2606.31229.tldr: This work proposes Agentic-Ideation, a novel framework comprising an automated trajectory synthesis pipeline and a specialized agentic LLM trained for scientific ideation, and introduces an Oracle-Guided Data Synthesis strategy.

2606.31184.tldr: This work introduces Bayesian in-context experimenters: transformer policies trained to imitate a Bayesian posterior Neyman teacher, and proves this amortized policy can be learned via empirical risk minimization using supervised pretraining.

2606.31179.tldr: HealthAgentBench, a suite of 54 agentic healthcare tasks across 7 categories each with its unique environment, is introduced, suggesting that HealthAgentBench provides a challenging and realistic benchmark with substantial room for future progress.

2606.31106.tldr: Despite good closed-loop performance, policies often fail to form timely surrounding-vehicle predictions during near-collision events, revealing a limitation in the predictive signals available for ego planning.

2606.31048.tldr: It is demonstrated that CoT distillation improves compact student models and that response length is a critical factor in mathematical reasoning quality.

2606.31232.tldr: Delta-JEPA is proposed, an end-to-end reconstruction-free world model that augments latent forward prediction with a Latent Difference Action Decoder (LDAD), andlations show that displacement-based action decoding is consistently more effective than endpoint concatenation, and action-sensitivity analyses show clearer action-conditioned latent responses.

2606.31222.tldr: By reframing query construction as a staged inference process instead of a single-pass output, PEC-CIR reduces the propagation of generative errors by explicitly evaluating candidate queries before retrieval, thereby improving retrieval stability.

2606.31209.tldr: RosettaSim is introduced, a unified framework that projects scene topology, agent states, and spawning intents into a structured autoregressive stream with variable length, achieving both strong short-term accuracy and stable long-horizon simulation fidelity, and Retrieval-based Traffic Evaluation (RTE), which retrieves semantically similar real-world scenarios as context-aware reference anchors.

2606.31174.tldr: ClawArena-Team is introduced, a benchmark of 41 multi-turn, multimodal, multi-directory scenarios spanning 258 evaluation rounds and 72 staged updates that measures the management ability of the single LLM acting as leader.

2606.31154.tldr: A robust evaluation framework is designed to help create task-specific rubrics for PowerPoint tasks, taking inspiration from and building on past works for rubric-based evaluation, and proves highly effective.

2606.31163.tldr: This work proposes a classifier-gated routing architecture that enforces compliance by design in large language models, and achieves near-perfect PII recall at 7ms inference overhead, establishing pre-inference classification as a practical path to compliance-by-design LLM deployment.

2606.31148.tldr: This work introduces Language-Guided Spatial Pruning (LGSP), which leverages a frozen Vision Language Model to identify language-relevant regions, thereby reducing spatial computation and grounding candidates in the narrower search space, and proposes LLM-Grounder, which repurposes a detection-pretrained spatial LLM into a language-conditioned grounding model by aligning point cloud and linguistic representations within the pruned region.

2606.31131.tldr: This work proposes a scenario generation pipeline using categorical and contextual information available from historical records in natural language format, and successfully applies the method to generate a diverse set of scenarios for testing autonomous navigation on Metadrive simulator using the NHTSA ADS crash records.

2606.31127.tldr: SkillSpotter is introduced, a pose-aware multi-view architecture that jointly detects and grades skilled actions through three task-specific modules that transfer to other temporal action detection models with consistent gains, and generalizes beyond Ego-Exo4D to HoloAssist.

2606.31087.tldr: These findings indicate that higher computational cost does not guarantee better performance, and that reranking is most beneficial when targeted at high-uncertainty instances.

2606.31080.tldr: An intervention-based counterfactual reasoning framework in abstract argumentation that goes beyond the but-for test, thereby correctly identifying causes in argumentation structures such as Preemption and Overdetermination and surpasses prior methods in both expressiveness and reliability.

2606.31046.tldr: It is argued that large language model agents, with persistent memory, tool use, network access, and payment, now make it possible to move artificial life into the open social, technical, and economic world, a paradigm the authors call open-world Artificial Life (open-world ALIFE).

2606.30975.tldr: The results suggest that adaptive agents should be evaluated not only by whether they remain organized, but by how much regulation they must recruit to do so.

2606.31200.tldr: Agentic RAG-VLM is presented, a unified framework that bridges VLM-based semantic understanding and physically grounded grasp execution by integrating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with vision-language models (VLMs) and agentic self-reflective planning and demonstrates that affordance-aware retrieval, scene graph reasoning, and agentic recovery are jointly essential for robust manipulation.

2606.31250.tldr: These findings indicate that safeguards targeting literal copying alone are insufficient to mitigate broader copyright risks, and PSALM provides infrastructure for auditable, legally informed compliance evaluation, though the relationship between automated similarity scores and infringement determinations requires validation by legal experts.

2606.31213.tldr: MoralAltDataset is introduced, a dataset of 307 moral dilemmas spanning narrative Advisor dilemmas and AI-facing Agent dilemmas, each augmented with compromise and reframed alternatives, to examine whether humans and LLMs shift their judgments when such alternatives are introduced.

2606.31186.tldr: A Multi-View Gated Graph Attention Network is proposed that transcribes audio via Automatic Speech Recognition to construct semantic, dependency, and co-occurrence graphs, characterizing speech through a "content-structure-flow"framework.

2606.31178.tldr: This framework resolves long-standing barriers and captures respective trade-offs induced by AET framework, which existing methods fail to address.

2606.31171.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that MedKGTab consistently delivers superior performance across various data generation scenarios, whether inferring missing features within the same dataset or generalizing across different medical cohorts.

2606.31167.tldr: MIRTH augments a pretrained VLA backbone with three key innovations: dual-scale temporal memory hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings, and a parallel action decoding scheme that replaces autoregressive generation with vector-wise prediction to maximize control throughput.

2606.31158.tldr: A novel framework that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models to synthesize complex robotic actions from a rich tapestry of multimodal human inputs: natural speech, hand gestures, and music/sound beats.

2606.31144.tldr: An integrated system for the CMU Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Challenge, designed to enable an autonomous agent to perform complex tasks based on natural language instructions, using a modular architecture that orchestrates environment mapping, question processing, and navigation.

2606.31099.tldr: View-PNDF (View-specific Pattern Neuron Detection and Fine-tuning), a parameter-efficient framework that fosters view-consistent report generation from a neuronal perspective, substantially improves view-specific chest X-ray report generation quality while maintaining robust general-view performance.

2606.31054.tldr: This work provides an attention-based perspective on mitigating hallucinations by exploring the model's internal text-to-image cross-attention behaviors, and proposes ADAPT, an attention-based framework that intervenes directly on text-to-image cross-attention dynamics.

2606.31002.tldr: This work uses a full $2^3$ factorial design to decompose three recurring interventions in formalization pipelines: parametric expert drafting, Mathlib/context search, and Lean elaboration feedback, suggesting that formal validity, proof-oriented Lean competence, and faithful statement generation should be reported separately.

2606.30970.tldr: AgentBound is presented, a runtime governance framework that provides verifiable behavioral oversight for autonomous AI agents and introduces standing delegation for long-running agents, allowing periodic workloads to operate under continuously refreshed governance policies while preserving revocability and bounded authority.

2606.31026.tldr: This work provides a new perspective on accelerating diffusion models through Optimal-Transport-inspired schedule modeling through OTCache, a training-free framework for accelerating diffusion sampling via caching schedule prediction.

2606.30966.tldr: This paper introduces HyPOLE, a novel framework for MARL under partial observability, where learning is guided by the expressive power of the so-called hyperproperties and, in particular, the temporal logic HyperLTL.

2606.31156.tldr: It is argued that session-level coverage, not single-query recall, should be the primary metric for enterprise RAG evaluation.

2606.31366.tldr: An industrialization-oriented Materials Bank is proposed, a dedicated value-filtering and assetization layer that operates beyond traditional databases, offering a scalable paradigm to accelerate AI-driven materials innovation and deliver tangible real-world impact.

2606.31309.tldr: A novel plug-and-play paradigm for backdoor detection that serves two fundamental roles when applied to LLMs, and provides a form of implicit blacklisting that gives both strong detection performance and accurate inversion of ground-truth triggers on several LLM classification domains, and for several different LLM architectures.

2606.31552.tldr: Results show that augmentation with high-fidelity room-acoustic simulations directly translates into improved multichannel speech enhancement performance.

2606.31494.tldr: A systematic study of manipulation robustness, characterizing robustness as the degree to which a manipulation system can achieve its goal in the presence of uncertainty and variation, and synthesizing the guiding principles and concrete mechanisms across perception, planning, control, policy learning, and hardware.

2606.31470.tldr: The results suggest that zero-shot foundation models can support decision-aligned provisioning in non-stationary cloud environments while reducing the operational burden of repeated per-tenant retraining, revalidation, and redeployment.

2606.31464.tldr: This work proposes an LLM-based pipeline for comprehensive mental health analysis over sequentially ordered user posts, as part of the CLPsych shared task, and offers a unified framework that jointly enables post-level assessment and user-level temporal modeling.

2606.31461.tldr: CSTrader is presented, a multi-agent framework for language-grounded trading in the CS2 skin market and consistently outperforms both a falling market index and simple single-prompt LLM baselines, achieving up to a 7.58% cumulative return with controlled risk.

2606.31407.tldr: This work proposes Visual Semantic Entropy (VSE), which perturbs only the image to probe nearby visual variations while keeping the text query fixed, establishing a new state-of-the-art for VLM uncertainty estimation.

2606.31404.tldr: This work investigates whether large language models (LLMs) can approximate swarm intelligence effects through artificial swarms through artificial swarms, addressing a critical gap in understanding AI-based aggregation mechanisms.

2606.31377.tldr: Experiments show that STDR consistently improves sample efficiency and success rates over multiple baselines, and matches or surpasses handcrafted dense rewards on several challenging tasks, suggesting robustness to visual noise and better-calibrated reward assignment across settings.

2606.31334.tldr: Six open challenges emerge from the synthesis: the cross-paradigm benchmark deficit, real-world hardware-constrained deployment, joint waveform-RIS optimization for doubly-dispersive channels, multi-objective PAPR trade-offs, LLM safety in live network control, and diminishing returns of standalone heuristics.

2606.31329.tldr: 3D HAMSTER is proposed, a hierarchical framework that closes this gap by having the planner directly output metrically reliable 3D trajectories, and consistently outperforms proprietary VLMs and 2D-guided baselines.

2606.31325.tldr: A French-language dataset of multi-hop historical questions derived from parliamentary debates and newspapers of the French Third Republic, designed in collaboration with a historian, providing a resource for evaluating retrieval-augmented and large language model systems in domain-specific contexts.

2606.31311.tldr: It is argued that the field needs a typology of human knowledge injection, in a form that is both human-editable and machine-accessible, and that scaffolds work best when introduced after an initial unconstrained design pass.

2606.31275.tldr: This work introduces a hierarchical centroid-based memory, bounded in total number of stored images, combined with knowledge distillation on replayed examples to limit representation drift and shows that CLIMB outperforms state-of-the-art OCSSL methods.

2606.31495.tldr: It is shown that a prediction-error signal, computed by a small predictor over the latent space of a frozen encoder, can serve both as a gate on plasticity and as a substrate for metacognition.

2606.31473.tldr: Results indicate that ENS achieves lower uncertainty under nominal conditions and exhibits stronger sensitivity to severe perturbations, whereas EDL provides smoother uncertainty variation and slightly improved ranking consistency, highlighting a trade-off between geometric consistency and statistical generality in uncertainty-aware DOA estimation.

2606.31423.tldr: DA-Studio (Data Analysis Studio), an interactive web-based demo system for end-to-end data analysis that is autonomous, sandboxed, and inspectable, is presented.

2606.31410.tldr: Xiaomi-GUI-0 is proposed, a native multimodal GUI agent for real mobile environments, trained and evaluated within a real-device closed loop, and introduces an error-driven data flywheel that turns failure trajectories into corrected actions, reflective explanations, and recovery demonstrations.

2606.31347.tldr: This work compares two independent multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches for optimizing such decentralized EV charging: contextual combinatorial bandits and policy gradient algorithms.

2606.31332.tldr: CryoACE is presented, an end-to-end framework that reconstructs precise atomic graphs for both homogeneous and heterogeneous structures that significantly outperforms existing baselines on static benchmarks and unveils atomic-level dynamic conformations on complex real-world datasets like EMPIAR-10345 without relying on pre-built static structures.

2606.31268.tldr: TDGT (Tabular Data Generation Toolkit), a web-based toolkit for synthetic tabular data generation and fidelity assessment, and proposes VAE-ABMS, a hybrid architecture that couples Variational Autoencoder-based latent space learning with adaptive Bayesian mixture synthesis, enabling high-fidelity generation of complex, nonlinear tabular distributions.

2606.31557.tldr: A CVE-TTP Knowledge Graph is constructed that links CVEs to tactics and techniques using classification and relation extraction from the MITRE ATT&CK framework, enabling structured visualization of vulnerabilities.

2606.31349.tldr: A novel Pressure-Guided Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (PGUDA) framework is proposed, which leverages the robustness and stability of pressure signals to introduce a cross-modal knowledge distillation strategy that transfers consistent physical semantics across modalities.

2606.31639.tldr: This paper systematizes the literature on vulnerabilities in large language model systems through a lifecycle and application-stack lens and emphasizes where trust boundaries fail, how untrusted data becomes executable instruction, how delegated authority amplifies model errors, and why point defenses rarely compose.

2407.18950.tldr: This study identifies what may be called AI's uncertainty, a condition in which different forms of judgment become entangled, and argues that no definitive criterion exists for verifying functional implementation.

2407.10887.tldr: This work presents a novel fingerprinting framework that provides verifiable proof of ownership while preserving fingerprint integrity, and resists both benign transformations and adversarial fingerprint removal.

2507.14706.tldr: This study proposes the Causal Prototype Attention Classifier (CPAC), an interpretable architecture that promotes class-aware clustering and improved latent space structure through prototype-based attention mechanisms and couple it with the encoder of a Variational Autoencoder-Generative Adversarial Network (VAE-GAN) in order to achieve improved latent cluster separation moving beyond post-hoc sample augmentation.

2603.00198.tldr: A hybrid-aware token reduction framework with a low-to-high progressive schedule and a unified query-conditioned importance score for attention and Mamba layers is proposed, which outperforms prior baselines on the same hybrid backbone and combines effectively with visual redundancy reduction methods.

2603.26270.tldr: It is observed that recurring vulnerabilities across diverse DeFi business models often share the same underlying economic mechanisms, which are termed DeFi semantics, and that capturing these shared abstractions can enable more systematic auditing.

2607.00032.tldr: MMM is presented, a data model for knowledge documentation that emerged from the practical needs of interdisciplinary collaborative research, and positioned here within a comparative analysis of the design space of information systems.

2607.00013.tldr: GRACE-RAG is introduced, a retrieval-governed, graph-augmented RAG architecture that externalizes structural reasoning from the generative stage to a structured retrieval layer, resolving structural ambiguity offline, enabling deployment on self-hosted lightweight models calibrated to closed-domain institutional vocabulary.

2607.00052.tldr: AGE focuses on predicting nodes apart from key nodes, utilizing a learnable node sampler, and significantly improves approaches using non-parametric search component in GraphQA tasks, achieving superior accuracy across four benchmark datasets with distinct characteristics.

2607.00041.tldr: The AI-Atomic-Framework is presented, a specification-grounded governance substrate for software agents operating within a single governance domain and its results support feasibility, auditability, and bounded recoverability within the observed single-domain settings.

2607.00029.tldr: This paper proposes the memory-native NTN (MemNTN) paradigm that leverages long-horizon contexts for memory augmented system optimization and develops memory acquisition, compression, valuation, update, and utilization mechanisms that facilitate cross-layer, memory-native decision-making.

2607.00025.tldr: This work develops a recurrent neural network (RNN) whose architecture is directly derived from the synaptic-resolution brain connectome of the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster, and demonstrates the feasibility of training the fly connectome neural network to perform vision-based navigation in MuJoCo, achieving performance comparable to modern hand-crafted networks of similar parameter counts.

2607.00009.tldr: This work proposes LOOM, an assisted writing framework grounded in the narratological distinction between story and discourse that achieves the highest overall quality score, yielding substantial gains in factual integrity and descriptive intensity compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2607.00005.tldr: Topological Void Analysis is presented, a mathematical framework that defines topological voids as triads (A, B, C) in a dense-sparse hybrid embedding space and surfaces non-obvious connective tissue rather than merely obvious related pairs.

2607.00004.tldr: Vocabulary Transfer is proposed, a model-agnostic framework that migrates advanced encoders to sparse-friendly, normalized vocabularies with minimal computational cost and resuscitates failing models like RoBERTa-large, and generalizes seamlessly to inference-free architectures and specialized domains.

2607.00049.tldr: Overall, prompt techniques produced modest but consistent improvements, particularly in reducing misinterpretation and version drift, supporting more reliable use of LLMs in Agile learning and certification preparation.

2607.00048.tldr: Evaluating the performance of three contemporary LLMs in answering 993 Scrum certification-style questions aligned with the Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I) assessment format revealed clear differences among models, with Gemini 3 Flash achieving the highest accuracy, followed by GPT-5 mini and DeepSeek Chat 3.2, while intra-model variability remained low across all conditions.

2607.00035.tldr: A constrained, verifiable agent framework that shifts LLM output from free-form code to typed JSON collector configurations, combining a six-type collector taxonomy, template and utility-function constraints, static Airflow DAG execution, rule-based quality checking, and structured feedback correction is proposed.

2607.00010.tldr: A framework to automatically optimize prompts for LLM-based user simulators in CRSs, simultaneously mitigating issues and achieving improved behavioral alignment with human interaction patterns compared to baseline methods across diverse prompt settings is proposed.

2607.00007.tldr: BaRA performs breadth-first search (BFS)-based link discovery with liveness verification to filter hallucinated and dead links, then validates extracted multimodal artifacts using rule-based provenance and accessibility checks and consistently improves valid-link discovery and download-valid multimodal extraction over existing agents.

2607.00003.tldr: This paper bridges the gap between conversational"strings"and semantic"things" by presenting a reproducible pipeline for extracting structured user-preference triples using lightweight Large Language Models.

2607.00019.tldr: A case study on the initial stages of an LLM-based machine translation application's deployment in a real-world context and a set of concrete recommendations and best practices for stakeholders at every stage of the development and deployment pipeline are presented.

2607.00017.tldr: Profile-guided Personalized Retrieval Optimization is proposed, a retrieval-centric framework that makes memory retrieval both user-aware and optimizable and shows consistent gains over training-free memory systems and training-based baselines.

2607.00015.tldr: The proposed framework offers a scalable, consistent, and transparent approach to automated compliance checking across jurisdictions, supporting efficient enforcement of apartment design standards and promoting healthier, higher-density urban development.

2607.00011.tldr: SkillSelect-Serve is presented, a QoS-aware, budget-constrained Skill Service recommendation framework that supports managing reusable agent skills as discoverable, comparable, and constraint-aware service units instead of plain retrievable documents.

2607.00002.tldr: Bounded Morality, a formal framework for analyzing the computational demands of moral problems faced by finite agents, formalizes moral situations along two orthogonal dimensions: moral breadth, the scope of entities treated as morally relevant, and moral depth, the inferential integration required to evaluate their interactions.

2606.30139.tldr: Warrant is proposed, a path-localized interface that preserves attention relevance alpha_ij, exposes the value path leading to the primary metric, and turns alpha_ij * v_j into alpha_ij * g_ij * v_j through learned query-item permission g_ij.

2607.00044.tldr: It is proved that any graph-preserving deterministic realization enforcing dwell values $d_i$ requires exactly $\sum_i d_i$ control states, and given an $O(|Q||\Omega|)$ recognition and reconstruction procedure, which is extended to an edge-entry variant in which transitions may enter interior phases of successor fibers.

2607.00033.tldr: This work presents Contact Wrench Guidance from Human Demonstration in Robotic Dexterous Manipulation (CHORD), a framework for long-horizon manipulation of rigid and articulated objects with reinforcement learning, and introduces a large-scale simulation benchmark.

2607.00023.tldr: This work proposes a method to disentangle the dense representations of sentence transformers into human-interpretable concepts using Top-k Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), and suggests that SAE-based decomposition offers a viable path toward transparent and steerable neural information retrieval.

2607.00016.tldr: It is demonstrated that a minimalist coding agent equipped with Libra-optimized catalogs outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and these environmental improvements transfer zero-shot across different LLMs and problem sets.

2607.00012.tldr: PRA-RAG is proposed, a provably robust retrieval aggregation algorithm designed to defend against poisoning attacks on retrieved texts, and theoretical bounds on the maximum impact of poisoned retrieved content are provided and a quantitative measure of RAG's robustness is established.

2607.00008.tldr: This work proposes SchemaRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework that dynamically prunes the output schema space for schema-conditioned information extraction tasks by leveraging schema metadata and few-shot examples when available.

2607.00001.tldr: It is argued that alignment is not primarily about controlling AI behavior, but about regulating how AI systems influence the evolution of human preferences--ensuring that value trajectories remain coherent, reflectively endorsed, epistemically grounded, bounded against manipulation, and empowering under uncertainty.

2606.31980.tldr: This work uses DigitalCoach, a multimodal dataset of 72 human expert-novice computer use coaching sessions, to evaluate whether state-of-the-art models can teach humans how to use computers.

2606.30296.tldr: ManimAgent is presented, a self-evolving multimodal agent that carries reflection experience across tasks through a dual-channel Episodic Memory Bank grown entirely from its own task stream, with no weight updates and no human seeds.

2607.00363.tldr: A unified guidance framework that enhances generation efficiency and robustness through two complementary strategies, which accelerates inference by nearly three times while effectively improving speaker similarity compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2607.00329.tldr: This work introduces a remarkably effective transformation applied to the training labels which promotes learning in noisy, complexly represented, and class-imbalanced data and enables RFMs to close the performance gap with FNNs and, in some cases, even surpass them.

2607.00269.tldr: Agentic Transaction Processing (ATP) is introduced, a transaction model that treats generated actions as untrusted proposals until they pass deterministic admission under a declared, executable constraint set C.

2607.00248.tldr: Through extensive real-world use cases documented in this model card, it is demonstrated that Seed2.0 begins to exhibit the ability to handle initial complex real-world tasks, delivering greater value to hundreds of millions of users.

2607.00218.tldr: While guards reliably recognize videos containing hazards, they often miss specific hazardous moments, particularly contextual hazards, it is found that while guards reliably recognize videos containing hazards, they often miss specific hazardous moments.

2607.00211.tldr: This study introduces the conceptual framework of Epistemic AI Literacy (EAIL), reframing AI literacy as a process-oriented epistemic phenomenon that emerges through dynamic human-AI interactions across different domains.

2607.00152.tldr: This paper confirms the intuition on a large real difficulty dataset (Big-Math) and in a controlled training run that what looks like a harmless normalization step is the dial that decides where learning happens and how strongly.

2607.00144.tldr: This work reframes AL dynamics by reframing budget regimes as shifts in the dominant generalization mechanism, and proves that dominance shifts are structurally unavoidable, creating a moving bottleneck for generalization.

2607.00062.tldr: AlGOBENCH is introduced, a framework that automatically builds novel algorithmic problems from known competitive-programming problems through structured constraint-shifting transformations and error analysis shows that failures are mainly algorithmic rather than implementation-level, suggesting that ALGOBENCH evaluates adaptation beyond functional correctness.

2607.00053.tldr: This work introduces SWE-Router, a value-based temporal approach that lets a cheap model run for a few exploratory turns and reads the resulting partial trajectory before deciding whether to continue cheaply or to escalate to an expensive model, and provides a Bayes-optimality theorem showing that conditioning on the partial trajectory never harms routing and is strictly better whenever exploration is informative.

2607.00392.tldr: This work proposes GenDa (Generalizable Data-efficient Agent), a unified framework for robust unsupervised reinforcement learning, and proposes a Complementary Information Bottleneck (CIB), encouraging the learned skill policy to focus on ego-centric features and become robust to distribution shifts for downstream tasks.

2607.00374.tldr: FoCo is proposed, which models composition as two coordinated stages: focusing on modification-relevant visual content, and then completing the target semantics, and realizes these through two proxy tasks: text-anchored visual aggregation to selectively gather visual content guided by localized textual semantics, and context-conditioned semantic completion.

2607.00365.tldr: This survey reviews the interface from both directions of AI and QI, examining how quantum computation and quantum-inspired structures affect learning through algorithmic speedups, expressivity, trainability, generalization, neural-network design, and tensor-network representations.

2607.00341.tldr: DiscoLoop is proposed, a looping architecture whose recurrence carries both a discrete embedding channel and a continuous hidden-state channel that achieves near-perfect accuracy with substantially fewer training steps across symbolic and synthetic-language multi-hop reasoning tasks.

2607.00310.tldr: RetailSMV (Retail Synchronized Multi-View), a corpus of 32,105 captioned retail clips from five supermarkets with synchronized ego/exo capture from the store-staff perspective, is introduced, identifying the near-horizon prediction window as the regime in which adaptation is most beneficial.

2607.00292.tldr: This work investigates the ability of Large Language Models to generate structurally valid and constraint-compliant network topologies through a constraint-driven pipeline combining hierarchical modeling and systematic validation, and provides a systematic benchmark for understanding how LLMs handle structural and resilience constraints in topology synthesis.

2607.00283.tldr: This work presents the first systematic approach for training VLMs to focus on planning-critical occlusions, enabling more semantically grounded and efficient risk assessment in autonomous driving.

2607.00259.tldr: Treating TTA as a multi-hypothesis inference problem, rather than a single-point optimization task, is suggested to be key to mitigating underspecification and enabling reliable real-world deployment.

2607.00247.tldr: This work improves upon earlier prompt engineering by showing that a simple binary yes/no constraint reduces the model's tendency to falsely confirm absent audio features, and evaluates a diverse library of targeted audio perturbations and adaptively selecting the optimal negative branch for each task and example.

2607.00170.tldr: A scalable and purely backpropagation-based algorithm for training deep convolutional networks for thermodynamic inference on Ising machine hardware and calculates asymptotic results showing that inference cost is bounded by a well-controlled tradeoff with performance.

2607.00154.tldr: The results demonstrate that evolutionary search can effectively discover flexible and high-performing Transformer-like architectures for multivariate time-series forecasting within practical runtime constraints.

2607.00143.tldr: A comprehensive hate speech dataset covering five distinct topics in Turkish is introduced and state-of-the-art BERT-based models to address multiple dimensions of hate speech analysis are developed, including hate category classification, hate intensity prediction, target identification, and hate speech span detection, enabling a comprehensive understanding of hateful content in online discourse.

2607.00095.tldr: This work exploits the structure that sample-wise batching and local PDE couplings induce in the projection subproblems, exposing this structure using ExaModels.jl and GPU sparse factorization to show that sparse GPU nonlinear optimization is a practical foundation for constrained generative sampling in scientific machine learning.

2607.00090.tldr: Distribution-Aware Place Recognition (DAPR), a model-agnostic plug-in framework that rebalances gradient contributions across head and tail classes, achieves consistent improvements across representative VPR methods on SF-XL, MSLS, and Pitts30k, demonstrating broad generalizability across different methods and benchmarks.

2607.00272.tldr: ASIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library, is introduced.

2607.00251.tldr: The deblurring engine is dubbed UPADNet (Unrolled Phase and Amplitude Decomposition Network), such that each iteration of the underlying phase and amplitude recovery algorithm is parameterized and trained end-to-end.

2607.00191.tldr: HydraCollab is proposed, an adaptive collaborative-perception framework that selectively transmits the most informative sensor features and dynamically employs collaboration strategies (intermediate or late) based on spatial confidence maps that achieves the best overall trade-off between accuracy and communication cost among existing collaborative-perception methods.

2607.00147.tldr: This work introduces RareDxR1, an end-to-end reasoning-centric large language model designed for open-domain rare disease diagnosis directly from unstructured clinical notes and proposes Reflection-Enhanced Reasoning Sampling (RERS), a strategy that synthesizes expert-level diagnostic trajectories by learning from failures without human annotation.

2607.00334.tldr: A discrete-time control system that combines five execution gears with utility-gated dispatch and event-driven fallback, and proves monotonic stability, execution safety, eventual stabilization, fallback completeness, and equivalence to a gear-constrained Markov decision process.

2607.00371.tldr: This work introduces a scale-aware token-routed Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, allowing scale-adaptive expert selection, thereby facilitating decoupled representation learning across scales and enhances semantic modeling at early scales by incorporating external self-supervised features.

2607.00065.tldr: The key requirements for achieving optimal any-angle path planning are identified and a unified approach suitable for different environments is introduced, which introduces a unified approach suitable for different environments.

2607.00056.tldr: A novel Dual-Agent (DA) deep learning framework that jointly optimizes the discrete RIS phase profiles and the UE's transmit power in real time is proposed, effectively overcoming the non-differentiability of discrete phase responses from the RIS unit elements and the strict information bottleneck of single-bit feedback messages for pilot power control.

2607.00296.tldr: A rigorous multimodal pipeline is established combining MediaPipe body pose trajectories with HSEmotion facial affect representations, and the Gated Affect Transformer is introduced to dynamically regulate cross-modal information flow to provide practical guidance for selective multimodal fusion in unconstrained human motion forecasting.

2607.00208.tldr: SLIM-RL bounds the commit risk of each rollout step with a tau-budget decoder, reducing aggregate commit risk in the training data, and trains on these risk-controlled rollouts with a trace-free random-masking objective that adapts variance-reduction tools.

2607.00190.tldr: There is a trade-off between the path-finding methods used and hope that future research will focus on developing model solutions for human improvement, as shown in the example of StarCraft~II.

2607.00385.tldr: MalariAI, a two-stage decoupled framework that addresses all three failure modes in a unified pipeline, and Grad-CAM++ heatmaps generated per detected cell provide instance-level spatial evidence for clinical audit, enabling microscopists to verify model predictions at the individual parasite level without sacrificing classification performance.

2607.00362.tldr: This work establishes the first systematic framework for understanding the attack and defense landscapes of MoAI systems, serving as a foundation for building secure MoAI systems and advancing research in this critical domain.

2607.00083.tldr: This paper discusses contributions on harnessing the latent spaces of language models by proposing steering vectors for control and developing latent space-based model calibrators for trust and offers new insights into how to harness model internals to build more trustworthy language technology.

2607.00057.tldr: Multi-Scale Layer Attention (MSLA) is proposed, a novel paradigm that explicitly models both multi-scale and cross-layer feature interactions and enables more accurate and robust OBIs recognition.

2607.00275.tldr: This work study entropy regularization of gate distributions as a mechanism to maintain uncertainty in sparse federated optimization by preventing early commitment to sparse support.

2607.00274.tldr: UniMatch is a reference-based evaluation framework for open-ended generation that reveals that models struggle to identify the feedback instructors would prioritize, and performance degrades as models generate more.

2607.00267.tldr: The Causal Abstraction Error (CAE) is introduced, a continuous validity metric with an explicit faithfulness test, which passes all discrimination tests across every system and can converge with as few as 30 sampled interventions.

2607.00233.tldr: It is shown that channel capacity alone cannot predict coordination; memory architecture determines whether agents turn interaction history into stable conventions, and both dimensions are needed to understand how signals become language.

2607.00155.tldr: A contextual-bandit team game with two-sided asymmetric information and a play/ask/trust/oversee interface and a partial analysis of how it resolves dynamically over repeated rounds through passive learning and active signaling with a one-period-lagged oversight response is introduced.

2607.00527.tldr: This paper defines AI-native games by whether runtime generative AI is constitutive of the core loop: if the AI component were removed or trivially replaced, the central form of play would collapse or become fundamentally different.

2607.00486.tldr: This work introduces Personalized Active Preference Alignment PAPA, a novel method that bypasses the requirement for a parametrized reward model by directly optimizing the diffusion model using real-time user feedback, and proposes an enhanced fine-tuning strategy, referred to as EPAPA, that requires less computational budget and accelerates the fine-tuning process, further boosting PAPA's suitability for real-world deployment.

2607.00481.tldr: It is demonstrated that prompt-level sanitization alone is fundamentally insufficient for defending tool-enabled LLM systems and highlight the urgent need for context-aware validation across schemas, arguments, tool outputs, and accumulated conversation state.

2607.00454.tldr: Agri-SAGE is a closed-loop framework designed to resolve the above two limitations by integrating retrieval-grounded multi-agent LLM reasoning with APSIM-based biophysical simulation, to generate and validate agronomic advisories.

2607.00746.tldr: This work designs a novel forward-projection-based multi-modal Gaussian initialization module and a shared cross-modal Gaussian encoder that iteratively updates Gaussian properties based on an attention mechanism to propose a new universal framework for multi-modal fusion based on 3D Gaussian representation.

2607.00716.tldr: This work introduces PartialVisGraph, a novel hypergraph framework tailored for robust skeleton action recognition under constrained FoV, and proposes the Single-Head Sample-Adaptive Transformer, which adaptively aggregates joint features onto hyperedges while explicitly incorporating a visibility prior.

2607.00642.tldr: This paper combines universal value function approximators (UVFAs) with carefully selected training scenarios, learning algorithms, and data augmentation to create a framework for coaching agents that exhibit styles in complex domains and demonstrates the framework's application in the AAA video games Horizon Forbidden West and Gran Turismo.

2607.00620.tldr: CPF serves as a generic, plug-and-play module that consistently boosts performance across diverse GCD baselines, validating that identifying and leveraging low-rank compositional structure is a crucial inductive bias for open-world recognition.

2607.00747.tldr: This work presents the first adaptation of Uncertainty Herding (UHerding), a hybrid coverage-uncertainty sampling method originally proposed for image classification, to cascaded object detection pipelines, and proposes two pipeline-aware extensions that exploit the TD-to-TSR dependency.

2607.00744.tldr: This work proposes a training-free framework for multi-class prenatal US anomaly classification and localization that operates with only a few reference images per class, representing the first exploration of this setting.

2607.00700.tldr: LLVM-Bench is introduced, the first large-scale benchmark for LLVM issue resolution, containing 423 real-world, validated tasks collected from the LLVM project, and LLVM-Gym is developed, a scalable evaluation platform that automates issue reproduction, patch application, compiler building, and test execution.

2607.00687.tldr: The Lightweight Universal Mask Adapter (LUMA) is introduced, a lightweight, backbone-agnostic mask-transformer head that treats any backbone as a black-box feature extractor, letting a set of queries read from its features through cheap cross-attention.

2607.00661.tldr: An explication interface for event-based emotion analysis with fine-tuned parser that trades insignificant accuracy difference to a black-box model for a verifiable, inspectable decision basis for first-person event-based emotion analysis.

2607.00547.tldr: EgoGapBench is introduced, a diagnostic benchmark for measuring action selection in multi-agent egocentric scenes and EAS is defined as selecting an appropriate action from the agent's perspective in the presence of other agents, showing that EAS is difficult to acquire from first-person-view data alone and that MLLMs should be evaluated and trained not only for scene understanding but also for egocentric action selection.

2607.00535.tldr: This work proposes Flow-Map GRPO, an online RL post-training framework for deterministic few-step flow-map generators that demonstrates that deterministic few-step flow-map generators can be effectively aligned with RL post-training without modifying their original model parameterization or retraining them as native stochastic models.

2607.00530.tldr: Findings confirm that the identified technical improvements are perceptible to users in direct interaction and underscore the importance of complementing benchmark evaluation with user-centred evidence when assessing robotic manipulation pipelines.

2607.00523.tldr: It is argued that the trajectory of human-machine teamings for autonomous and AI-enabled systems should be a state where the authors authentically view these not as artifacts which they simply make use of, but as collaborators with which they pursue complex goals and carry out complex tasks.

2607.00472.tldr: This study introduces an automated model to predict deadly outcomes of MI and helps doctors understand important biomarkers linked to its complications and evaluates all models using precision, recall, and other key measures to find the best option for clinical use.

2607.00448.tldr: Experiments on public datasets, along with deployment to a large-scale online system, demonstrate that the proposed negative sampling technique outperforms widely used industry methods and can help break inherent feedback loops in recommendations and significantly reduce popularity bias.

2607.00444.tldr: An algorithmic framework based on graphs of space-time convex sets (ST-GCSs), where collision-free regions are represented as convex sets in space-time and trajectories correspond to paths on the graph together with continuous motions within the selected sets, enabling unified handling of dynamic obstacles and multi-robot interactions.

2607.00397.tldr: NeuroCogMap is presented, a cognitive neuroscience-inspired framework that organizes internal features of LLMs into functional parcels and links them to interpretable functions, cognitive capabilities and a cognitive hierarchy that is partly conserved across models and functionally linked to model outputs.

2607.00720.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that leverages active learning to iteratively enhance the performance of unsupervised models and can be readily integrated into existing unsupervised reconstruction-based anomaly detection systems to significantly enhance their performance.

2607.00605.tldr: A causal auditing framework is proposed that holds the model fixed and varies the database state at inference time across three interventions: FULL, DEL-ON, and DEL-OFF and suggests that, for this class of LMLM and deletion procedure, the unlearning boundary is drawn primarily by the database administrator rather than by the model.

2607.00553.tldr: Deployment readiness should be assessed using cross-network evaluation under realistic class distributions, rather than within-domain accuracy alone, to suggest deployment readiness should be assessed using cross-network evaluation under realistic class distributions, rather than within-domain accuracy alone.

2607.00531.tldr: This work proposes active reasoning, a paradigm in which the policy actively decides, on a per-instance basis, when to imitate a reference and when to reinforce its own discoveries, while continuously upgrading what it imitates.

2607.00501.tldr: Apple Silicon is established as a more capable inference platform than previously reported, with direct implications for the emerging edge inference paradigm: as privacy requirements, latency constraints, and cloud cost pressures drive inference toward on-device deployment, performance-optimised local runtimes are a critical enabling layer for this transition.

2607.00457.tldr: MuSix is presented, a framework that addresses both challenges through scale-aware world model mixture and evolution and improves over state-of-the-art baselines on multi-scale reasoning and dynamic adaptation.

2607.00417.tldr: EO-VGGT is presented, a framework that adapts a frozen perspective-driven model to orbital observations via explicit physical geometry embedding via explicit physical geometry embedding for robust feed-forward satellite 3D reconstruction.

2607.00398.tldr: The Holographic Quantum Transformer (HQT), a physics-inspired generative architecture that leverages global self-attention to resolve non-local entanglement patterns, is introduced, establishing generative attention as a scalable paradigm for transferable quantum simulation.

2607.00556.tldr: Equivariant Poincar\'e ResNets are proposed, combining hyperbolic geometry with discrete symmetry groups with geometrically safe tensor reshaping, left-regular permutations for hyperbolic group convolutions, and joint-orientation Poincar\'e Midpoint Batch normalisation.

2607.00514.tldr: Experimental results show that the proposed Cross4D-JEPA method consistently outperforms intra-modal and global cross-modal baselines across the four benchmarks and is competitive with heavier published 4D methods; further analysis attributes this gain primarily to the granularity of the correspondence rather than the teacher modality.
