2607.02119.tldr: A vLLM-based inference pipeline for unified speech understanding and generation is presented, extending autoregressive decoding to natively execute delay-pattern de-interleaving and coordinated multi-stream sampling, integrating an on-GPU acoustic decoder for end-to-end waveform synthesis.

2607.02403.tldr: ACID is proposed, a decision-time planning framework that introduces cycle action consistency: the action inferred backward from a predicted transition by an inverse dynamics model should recover the one that was conditioned on.

2607.02396.tldr: While RFM allows for faster subspace identification, it also showed better performances on the ablation task than its alternatives, and could be a cheap and scalable complement to existing subspace-extraction methods in LLMs.

2607.02374.tldr: Memory-induced reasoning drift is a measurable and only partly mitigated failure mode of personalized language models and a ground-truth-free framework is introduced that maps each expressed reasoning step to a value category and measures divergence between a question's no-memory trajectory and its trajectory under injected user-attribute memory.

2607.02371.tldr: VisionAId is presented, an Android application that turns a commodity smartphone into a real-time visual assistant that integrates six on-device deep learning models running entirely through ONNX Runtime and makes a distinctive contribution to the few-shot pipeline for personal objects.

2607.02255.tldr: An agent design and a validated, reusable methodology for studying how explicit memory layers shape long-horizon LLM-agent decisions, as well as an alternative bounded contract, are introduced.

2607.02230.tldr: This evaluation aims to balance the number of misclassifications against the human effort required for data annotation, and examines the behavior of OvA and OvR classification strategies in identifying samples likely to be misclassified.

2607.02201.tldr: This paper presents the operationalization layer Eticas has built and run, shown end to end on a single risk (PII leakage) against a public benchmark, and then the open taxonomy that makes the method scale, and then the open taxonomy that makes the method scale.

2607.02121.tldr: This work proposes the first black-box guardrail reconnaissance methodology, which detects the presence of a guardrail within a target AI system through behavioral monitoring of HTTP, lexical, and timing signals, assuming only black-box access and zero prior knowledge of the guardrail or AI system.

2607.02423.tldr: A Neuron-Aware Active Few-Shot Learning framework that shifts the selection paradigm from output-level proxies to models'internal dynamics, and includes a dual-criteria selection strategy that ensures few-shot sample diversity with neuron patterns for broader example coverage, validating the superiority of the proposed NeuFS.

2607.02343.tldr: This work designs a target-aware selective localization strategy that employs a Prompt-Guided Selective Attention Module (PGSA) to generate prompt-informed embeddings and proposes SelectTSL, an end-to-end architecture that localizes only the user-specified target in multi-source acoustic scenes.

2607.02329.tldr: A pipeline that runs end-to-end from a corpus of 11,083 recent condensed-matter physics arXiv papers to a publication-grade manuscript with three substantive physics findings is presented, laying a foundation for autonomous research in high-stakes scientific domains beyond computational physics.

2607.02175.tldr: A small, deliberately difficult evaluation dataset of five clinician-authored clinical scenarios spanning four specialties, each accompanied by an atomic, weighted, MECE rubric, demonstrates a scalable, defensible pipeline ready to develop into a large-scale benchmark.

2607.02166.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach using dynamic graphs to represent neural network parameters, capturing the temporal dynamics of inference, and demonstrates significant improvements across multiple tasks, surpassing the state-of-the-art INR classification accuracy by approximately 10% on the CIFAR-100-INR.

2607.02134.tldr: This work introduces Paper-replication, a workflow that makes each selected paper claim a target with recorded evidence, and implements it as a coding-agent skill that makes completion depend on workspace evidence and validation checks rather than on the agent's final message.

2607.02118.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations of FitOne are conducted on professional fitness certification exams, including ACSM-EP and NSCA-CSCS, as well as general capabilities such as knowledge reasoning and instruction following, to believe this research advances LLM systems toward more reliable fitness intelligence and will inspire future research on developing domain-specific LLMs.

2607.02466.tldr: TAP is proposed, a two-stage framework that first learns transferable motor priors from cheap, unlabeled interaction data -- including discarded off-task trajectories and autonomous robot play -- via a self-supervised Inverse Dynamics objective and grounds these priors in language using minimal expert data.

2607.02436.tldr: The practical lesson is to match the fix to the failure: most first run failures came from weak reasoning, which a stronger model or more effort prevents, not from visible flaws a checking tool would catch.

2607.02426.tldr: This paper proposes QFedAgent, a hybrid quantum-classical personalized FL framework for multi-agent activity recognition that integrates a variational quantum circuit fusion module that models accelerometer--gyroscope interactions through quantum state encoding and entanglement, achieving approximately 10x total parameter reduction.

2607.02407.tldr: SPG-Layout, a novel text-driven framework designed to generate physically plausible indoor scenes within complex non-Manhattan environments, first utilizes statistical priors of object distributions to guide the training process, enhancing environmental understanding and fidelity.

2607.02363.tldr: Accumulated-memory modulation is identified as the key mechanism of Self-Modulating QFWP and bounded old-state gating as a targeted stabilization strategy and bounded old-state gating as a targeted stabilization strategy.

2607.02360.tldr: GAP-GDRNet is presented, a geometry-aware RGB framework built on GDR-Net for a single-target synthetic spacecraft benchmark and shows consistent gains over the reproduced baseline on textureless and occluded non-spacecraft objects.

2607.02509.tldr: Recursive Evidence Replay as LLM Harness for Long-Context Reasoning (RECONTEXT), a training-free inference method for improving long-context reasoning that uses model-internal relevance signals to construct a query-conditioned evidence pool and replays it before final generation while preserving the full original context.

2607.02469.tldr: TestEvo-Bench is a benchmark of test and code co-evolution tasks mined from software repositories, with two tracks: in test generation, the agent shall write new tests to capture the new software behavior; in test update, the agent shall adapt failing existing tests to the changed software behavior.

2607.02507.tldr: A dual-channel debate framework in which agents produce public utterances that enter the shared history alongside OTR responses that are recorded but never shown to the other participant is introduced, suggesting that agent evaluation should extend beyond explicit goals and detect emergent objectives.

2607.02491.tldr: A neuro-symbolic approach, ``Guiding with Recurrent Reasoning Models''(G-RRM), which integrates SE-RRMs with symbolic solvers for constraint satisfaction problems and delineate the regimes in which neural guidance translates into practical speedups.

2607.02510.tldr: A simple real-time monitor that turns a verifier signal from an external model into an alarm decision by thresholding, with the threshold calibrated via risk control is studied.

2607.02484.tldr: Entropy-Aware Dense Pruning (EADP) is proposed, a framework that reformulates pruning as a structured compression problem that improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off of VLMs, robustly preserving fine-grained visual cues under strict token budgets while achieving SoTA performance on challenging multimodal benchmarks.

2607.02467.tldr: Using a real-money prediction market (Polymarket) as an objective, externally resolved benchmark, this pilot shows that the value of human-AI collaboration depends on a specific, measurable form of human capital.

2607.02513.tldr: LACUNA is introduced: the first unlearning testbed with ground-truth parameter-level localization and shows that when localization is successful, even a simple gradient-based unlearning method achieves strong erasure and robustness to resurfacing attacks, highlighting the importance of precise unlearning.

2607.02504.tldr: DramaSR-LRM is designed to autonomously aggregate contextual evidence via multimodal tool-use, synthesizing diverse inputs to achieve high-fidelity attribution and significantly outperforms existing baselines, particularly on short utterances where acoustic biometrics are inherently unreliable.

2607.02512.tldr: Program-as-Weights (PAW) reframes the foundation model from a per-input problem solver into a tool builder: invoked once per function definition, it produces a small reusable artifact whose subsequent calls per function application are cheap and offline.

2607.02502.tldr: DemoPSD is introduced, a novel framework that resolves problems through the idea of *selective adoption of teacher guidance*.

2607.02499.tldr: This work implements and systematically compares a class of recently proposed matrix-structured optimizers, including Muon, SOAP, and the hybrid SOAP-Muon, for training NequIP and Allegro MLIP models and finds that these optimizers can substantially outperform Adam in both convergence speed and final accuracy.

2405.02369.tldr: A two-step framework for prototyping task-based neurons, which introduces VSR that stacks all variables in a vector and regularizes each input variable to perform the same computation, which can increase the regression speed, facilitate efficacy in high dimensions, and enable parallel computation.

2410.16089.tldr: This work proposes a methodology for developing a system that fuses already processed multi-sensor data into a new Deep Neural Network to increase its classification accuracy towards UAV detection.

2502.10389.tldr: This work introduces RAS, a novel, training-free sampling strategy that dynamically assigns different sampling ratios to regions within an image based on the focus of the DiT model, making a significant step towards more efficient diffusion transformers, enhancing their potential for real-time applications.

2505.20030.tldr: It is found that the cycles in performance -- indicated by loss function in test data -- are closely associated with the phase transition process between order and chaos of the model, and the local optimal training step are consistently at the critical transition point between the two phases.

2507.22951.tldr: This work proposes a characterization of post-hoc explanations via multi-objective optimization that unifies existing post-hoc explainability algorithms in KGC and the explanations they produce, balancing explanation effectiveness and conciseness.

2508.01401.tldr: This work introduces MedSynth -- a novel dataset of synthetic medical dialogues and notes designed to advance the Dialogue-to-Note (Dial-2-Note) and Note-to-Dialogue (Note-2-Dial) tasks.

2508.05287.tldr: FlowState is introduced, a novel TSFM architecture that achieves sampling-rate-equivariant forecasting through a unified design that pairs a state space model (SSM) encoder with a functional basis decoder (FBD) and enables continuous-time modeling and dynamic time-scale adjustment.

2509.00135.tldr: A tool based on a principled decision-support optimization framework for sequential facility planning that aims to maximize population coverage under budget uncertainty while satisfying region-specific proportionality targets at every time step is developed.

2509.07605.tldr: This work systematically evaluates the robustness of a diverse set of binary classifiers across both real-world and synthetic datasets, under progressively reduced minority class sizes, using one-shot and few-shot scenarios as baselines to assess the performance of binary classifiers"as-is", without performing any explicit rebalancing.

2509.25594.tldr: K-Prism is presented, a unified segmentation framework that mirrors this clinical flexibility by systematically integrating three knowledge paradigms: semantic priors learned from annotated datasets, in-context knowledge from few-shot reference examples, and interactive feedback from user inputs like clicks or scribbles.

2603.13584.tldr: Biochemistry, Genetics and Molecular Biology has outpaced other natural scientific fields in PTM reuse, adaptation is the most prevalent PTM reuse pattern identified across all natural science fields, and the testing stage of the scientific process has been most impacted by PTM integration.

2604.02343.tldr: Question-Asking compression (QA), an interactive lossy protocol inspired by the game'Twenty Questions', is introduced, suggesting that interactive protocols can transfer knowledge far more efficiently than transmitting full responses.

2604.03496.tldr: Experiments show that TRACE-KG produces structurally coherent, traceable knowledge graphs and offers a practical alternative to both ontology-driven and schema-free construction pipelines.

2604.09673.tldr: A computational model in which the self-prior emerges spontaneously through a single mechanism, the self-prior, without any external reward is presented, suggesting that the free energy principle can serve as a unifying hypothesis for investigating the developmental origins of self-awareness.

2605.01101.tldr: The VST system's potential to augment clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve therapeutic outcomes for individuals with speech impairments is demonstrated, as well as the system's potential to augment clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve therapeutic outcomes for individuals with speech impairments.

2606.01365.tldr: A trace-based framework for a three-agent architecture -- orchestrator, search agent, and execution agent -- that converts structured events into online signals for loops, budget pressure, low information gain, and tool instability, then adds offline semantic grounding metrics and selective LLM-as-judge evaluation is proposed.

2606.08151.tldr: The Counterfactual-Inspired Context Layer (CICL) is presented, which builds an instance context graph, estimates decision-oriented utility for candidate units, and compresses selected evidence into typed memory cards and provides a practical layer for measuring, ranking, and compressing decision-critical context for tool-using agents.

2606.10862.tldr: Viewpoint Imagination (VIM) is proposed, which generates a complementary view from an occluded primary observation and conditions action prediction on both observed and imagined evidence, suggesting that viewpoint imagination is an promising mechanism for perception completion in partially observable manipulation.

2606.15841.tldr: Large language model systems increasingly use uncertainty signals to allocate limited computation across verification, test-time scaling, tool execution, and other selective-compute decisions, but a failure mode of this assumption is identified: uncertainty quality is heteroskedastic across cost strata.

2606.15866.tldr: STRIDE (Strategic Trajectory Reasoning with Discriminative Estimation), a fine-grained RLVR framework that derives strategic reasoning supervision from verifiable outcomes, consistently improves reasoning performance across diverse models, tasks, and extended settings, including VLMs and agent-based systems.

2606.15877.tldr: It is proved that the policy minimizing expected free energy under uncertain precision stops integrating cues after a finite number of high-validity ones when the precision prior is heavy-tailed, and fast-and-frugal heuristics and active inference are two descriptions of the same computation.

2606.15880.tldr: Deep Visual Residual MLLM (Deep-VRM) is proposed to preserve early semantic processing while injecting artifact-specific visual signals as a residual path into an intermediate layer, where they are fused with semantic token representations and propagated through subsequent trainable layers.

2606.15887.tldr: This work validates AIPR, which reads a submitted manuscript and emits five 0-100 quality dimensions and a weighted overall score, against the public decision outcomes of a major machine learning venue.

2606.15888.tldr: This work proposes NVMOS, to its knowledge the first model that can reliably predict the perceptual quality of NV events in speech and shows that, with a local NV-event focusing module, NVMOS reaches expert-level or stronger agreement with human MOS.

2606.15890.tldr: UrbanWell, a large-scale benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs for urban wellbeing analytics through joint modeling of satellite and street view imagery, is introduced.

2606.15897.tldr: Topological flow matching is introduced, a topology-aware generalization of flow matching that serves as a drop-in replacement for standard flow matching and demonstrates its effectiveness on diverse structured datasets, including brain fMRIs, ocean currents, seismic events, and traffic flows.

2606.15899.tldr: This work presents SKILLVETBENCH, a live public leaderboard on Hugging Face that uses an LLM-as-Judge to vet agent skills and introduces SARS (Skill Agentic Risk Score), a five-dimensional agentic-risk metric with a principled weighted formula for instruction-following systems.

2606.15906.tldr: This paper proposes MAGE-RAG, a multigranular adaptive graph evidence framework for long-document multimodal QA, and establishes a unified comparison and analysis protocol covering Direct MLLM, Text RAG, Page-level Visual RAG, and Graph/Agentic RAG.

2606.15912.tldr: This work proposes Guided On-Policy Distillation (Guided-OPD), a simple yet effective algorithm that mixes teacher- and student-generated turns within each rollout and schedules the teacher's intervention probability along a curriculum that decays to zero.

2606.15923.tldr: An asymptotic bound is proved for the expected number of fitness evaluations of CGP to construct a conjunction of inputs using at most $D \geq n-1$ binary gates, a minimal function set, and even with a strict survival selection.

2606.15930.tldr: This paper is the first to inject spatial guidance signals into a diffusion model for HD map synthesis, using latent diffusion and ControlNet for spatial conditioning, and generates realistic HD maps that faithfully follow input road topologies while accurately preserving city-specific details.

2606.15931.tldr: DeepRoot is a multi-agent LLM system that jointly builds and utilizes a verified knowledge graph, showing that grounding and reasoning -- often conflated -- are separable axes the system can compose for therapeutic reasoning.

2606.15943.tldr: This work proposes methods for documenting generative flows and for stating properties of LLM-based software designs that provide a foundation for principled reasoning about generative interactions and system-level properties in LLM-centric software architectures.

2606.15954.tldr: Green SARC applies the SARC governance-by-architecture framework -- four enforcement sites in the agent loop -- to FinOps and GreenOps, contributing the theory of what to enforce and how to predict it.

2606.15956.tldr: Temporal Difference in Vision (TDV) is introduced, a new paradigm for self-supervised learning from video that avoids existing inductive biases, relying instead on a causal assumption that the past causes the future.

2606.15959.tldr: This work characterizes the uncertainty inherent in training neural networks and proposes a method to estimate how much compression-induced error a surrogate model can tolerate without affecting its accuracy, which significantly reduces memory/storage requirements and speeds up training while producing high-quality surrogate models.

2606.15963.tldr: This work proposes PreLort: a nested low-rank formulation for federated LoRA that organizes adapter dimensions into a prefix hierarchy that consistently outperforms prior heterogeneous federated LoRA methods in accuracy and ROUGE-L, while achieving lower or comparable perplexity across multiple base models.

2606.15972.tldr: BASE is proposed, a base-and-edit pipeline that formalizes a single base candidate per problem and derives the remaining K-1 statements by editing the answer expression in place and simultaneously improves selection accuracy and reduces formalization cost.

2606.15989.tldr: A framework to identify generalisable common subspaces for cross-subject predictions and downstream tasks, demonstrated here for visual cortex responses to static images.

2606.15994.tldr: A fully autonomous system that combines In-Context Learning (ICL) with oracle-driven self-debugging with high numerical equivalency, providing a highly reliable, scalable blueprint for cross-framework migration.

2606.15998.tldr: This work formalizes a distinction between Conceptual Entity Relevance (CER) and Observable Entity Relevance (OER) - whether an entity is topically related to a query- and Observable Entity Relevance (OER)- whether its observed presence in a collection discriminates relevant from non-relevant documents.

2606.16003.tldr: This work develops an explainable equation generation workflow and evaluates it across diverse open- and closed-source LLM backbones, introducing an evaluation protocol combining automatic metrics, LLM-based rubrics, and human judgments to assess accuracy, explainability, and human-LLM alignment.

2606.16010.tldr: Theorem-Grounded Execution Ontologies (TGEO) is introduced, a framework that models reasoning as an executable state-transition process rather than a sequence of generated tokens and demonstrates the value of executable reasoning representations for interpretable, verifiable, and reproducible AI reasoning systems.

2606.16014.tldr: This work formalises an LLM-driven game world for a human player as a Parameterized-Action POMDP, and reports work in progress on a framework that makes the world a canonical object owned by a singleton orchestration agent analogous to the tabletop-RPG Game Master (GM).

2606.16038.tldr: Open-SWE-Traces is established as a premier resource for distilling human-level software engineering capabilities into efficient, open-source agentic LLMs.

2606.16042.tldr: A deep learning-based framework is presented to detect load carriers and estimate their pose for use with autonomous logistics vehicles using a convolutional neural network to identify characteristic reference points on the carrier from RGBD input and computes its pose.

2606.16050.tldr: Results demonstrate that adaptive robustness through joint learning of loss parameters provides a computationally efficient alternative to static correntropy-based losses for deep learning in non-Gaussian environments.

2606.16054.tldr: This paper proposes an analytical framework that centers on institutional assessability as the central condition for democratic control over AI, and stresses that how severe a harm is, and how much risk is acceptable, are evaluative judgments that current methodologies neither acknowledge nor operationalize.

2606.16059.tldr: Mojo, Modular's 2026 Python-like systems language, is surveyed as a structural response for capital markets engineering, and mojo-deterministic, an open-source library of reproducible reduction kernels is introduced, to provide a candid assessment of the problems Mojo does and does not yet solve.

2606.16062.tldr: The rate at which code RL environments accept incorrect solutions as correct in SWE-bench Verified and a procedure for hardening the broken tasks is described.

2606.16074.tldr: PVminerLLM2 is presented, an improved set of LLMs for structured patient voice extraction that applies preference optimization to address token-critical errors beyond the reach of supervised fine-tuning.

2606.16076.tldr: Phys-JEPA is introduced, a physics-informed joint-embedding predictive architecture for multivariate time-series forecasting that learns a latent world model in which predictive states are decomposed into physical and residual components, and physical consistency is imposed directly on latent states and latent transitions.

2606.16082.tldr: The proposed Tool-IQA equip VLMs with simple yet effective view tools: a Magnifier to inspect local details, and a Gamma Corrector to uncover visibility and hidden artifacts, and introduces a batch-aware training strategy to reward tool interactions that can yield positive contributions rather than simply encouraging usage.

2606.16084.tldr: Representation-level evidence is reported for a duality-of-patterning-like architecture whose lower tier is rhythmic rather than segmental, and a portable null-controlled framework for testing combinatorial structure in induced acoustic token systems is provided.

2606.16092.tldr: This work introduces VinQA, a dataset for long-form answer generation where cited visual elements are explicitly interleaved with their supporting text and grounded in relevant document pages, and proposes M-GroSE, a multimodal evaluation framework extending GroUSE to assess answers along four dimensions: completeness, answer relevancy, faithfulness, and unanswerability.

2606.16093.tldr: Results demonstrate that separating sequence modeling paradigms into parallel specialists enables Transformer-level perplexity with substantially improved efficiency for long-context language modeling.

2606.16112.tldr: NAG is introduced, a norm-agnostic residual architecture that separates magnitude from directional information in the residual stream, preserving meaningful layer contributions throughout depth and preventing later updates from being systematically suppressed by residual-norm growth.

2606.16113.tldr: This work introduces \emph{RecourseBench}, a unified evaluation framework built around three commitments namely, modularity, reproducibility, and interactivity, which constitutes the first recourse benchmark to explicitly enforce method-level reproducibility through automated, quantitative testing.

2606.16122.tldr: This work introduces visually grounded thinking, a reasoning process in which models interleave natural-language thoughts with explicit point or box groundings of the visual evidence used at each step, and proposes grounding-aware reinforcement learning, which combines answer correctness rewards with dense grounding rewards that score whether generated object references match the correct image evidence.

2606.16127.tldr: The introduction of AuAu, a comprehensive benchmark for assessing the risk of authoritarian tendencies in LLM responses, underscores the need for continued, systematic auditing of LLM-based AI systems to detect and mitigate authoritarian tendencies in their outputs.

2606.16137.tldr: This work proposes a training-free explanation framework that integrates XAI evidence with multimodal LLMs to generate grounded and specific explanations and shows that methods with XAI increase inside accuracy by over 45\%, verified through human evaluation and faithfulness checks.

2606.16140.tldr: This technical report introduces VibeThinker-3B, a compact dense model with 3B parameters developed to investigate how far verifiable reasoning can be pushed within a strictly small-model regime, and systematically enhances the model through an optimized pipeline that includes curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning, and offline self-distillation.

2606.16152.tldr: Style-Aligned Refinement is introduced, which preserves the native trajectory of the SLM while retaining logical repair from the Oracle, and suggests that effective mathematical reasoning distillation should jointly optimize perceived solution quality and learner-data compatibility, rather than relying solely on reward-model scores.

2606.16153.tldr: A comprehensive review of its systematic development is presented, covering widely used public datasets, representative methods built on the U-Net, Transformer, and SAM architectures, and key evaluation metrics with their differences, followed by an analysis of major challenges from multiple perspectives.

2606.16167.tldr: This paper develops a bounded conceptual and qualitative synthesis across value pluralism, pluralistic alignment, participatory and democratic AI, procedural justice, science and technology studies, accountability research, aggregate themes from 11 expert interviews, and three urban AI companion cases.

2606.16173.tldr: This paper introduces TimeVista, a comprehensive VLM-as-a-Judge benchmark comprising 5563 time series samples paired with detailed evaluation rubrics, and comprehensively assess recent Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) under the VLM-as-a-Judge paradigm.

2606.16175.tldr: PAL-Bench provides a testbed for perceptual entity resolution, multimodal data integration, temporal evidence aggregation, and provenance-aware structured prediction, and PAL-TRACE, a reference framework that freezes identity bindings before owner-fact mining, performs best but leaves hard identity resolution far from solved.

2606.16183.tldr: An LLM-powered virtual population model that simulates demand for pricing decisions, in settings where products are described by rich unstructured information, and where decision makers need not only mean-demand predictions but also uncertainty estimates for counterfactual prices.

2606.16190.tldr: This work introduces a hardware-in-the-loop agent arena in which the agent iteratively refines both model and firmware -- compiling, flashing, and measuring on real hardware -- to enable closed-loop optimization, and achieves 250x compression for vision models with<3.3% accuracy loss and 400x for audio with<6% Feature Error Rate loss.

2606.16193.tldr: Experiments show that CSAEs improve interpretability in terms of hierarchical concept coherence over state-of-the-art SAE baselines, and results on concept steering further demonstrate that the learned concept groups support effective group-level interventions in MLLM outputs.

2606.16202.tldr: EgoPhys overcomes the limitations of existing methods to enable controllable deformable digital twin generation from egocentric videos by distilling per-object inverse-physics solutions into a compact codebook, enabling prediction of dense spring stiffness fields for unseen objects without per-spring test-time optimization.

2606.16206.tldr: It is argued that public tutoring benchmarks can better support positive-impact evaluation by reporting solving-oriented and pedagogy-oriented scores separately and by making disclosure-sensitive, student-agency-preserving criteria more explicit.

2606.16210.tldr: The results suggest that sensor-conditioned representations should be evaluated not only by predictive utility, but also by whether their latent geometry preserves sensing-justified scene distinctions.

2606.16212.tldr: Experiments under multiple sparse-view settings show that Lucid achieves stable reconstruction performance across different sampling densities, improves image quality and structural fidelity, and reduces the risk of hallucination-like structures in generative sparse-view CT reconstruction.

2606.16215.tldr: PACT keeps rollout generation prompt-only, then uses expert traces to guide optimization through two complementary signals: a trace-conditioned RL surrogate that evaluates prompt-only rollouts under expert-trace context, and a component-aware SFT loss that supervises reasoning prefixes and tool-calls with annealed strength.

2606.16222.tldr: Experiments under finetuning and transfer learning settings show that LTF outperforms explicit CoT and latent reasoning baselines, improving accuracy by 9.5% while reducing reasoning length by 27.2% on average compared with strong latent reasoning baselines.

2606.16231.tldr: This work investigates CUDA sensitivity from the perspective of token confidence patterns, showing that CUDA sensitivity appears at both token and region levels, where most CUDA-sensitive tokens are predicted with high confidence, while a smaller low-confidence subset forms regions corresponding to execution-critical structures.

2606.16234.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that synthesizes FFA from CFP with structural guidance provided by optical coherence tomography (OCT), and introduces Token-wise Cross-Modality Alignment (TCMA), a token-level contrastive learning strategy that explicitly aligns CFP and FFA representations at corresponding spatial positions.

2606.16244.tldr: This work presents SPARK, an inference-time security harness that activates this latent knowledge without any retraining, and evaluates SPARK on 9 open-source models across C++, Java, and Python, and compares with 7 baselines spanning fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented methods.

2606.16253.tldr: This work introduces SPARC (SPatially Adaptive Rate Control), a learned image compression framework tailored for VLA-driven robots that consistently achieves stronger control performance than conventional image/video codecs and recent learned compression methods under the same bitrate budget.

2606.16257.tldr: This work develops the first unified analysis of these estimators for sampling from non-log-concave distributions and establishes improved non-asymptotic convergence rates in $\varepsilon$-relative Fisher information and, under a Poincar\'e inequality assumption, in squared total variation distance, and proves weak convergence to the target distribution.

2606.16262.tldr: UXBench is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs as interaction-grounded UX judges and shows that UX judging is neither saturated nor one dimensional: models differ meaningfully in report actionability.

2606.16278.tldr: RealityBridge is proposed, a structure-preserving and asset-aware Sim-to-Real framework for edited 3DGS driving videos that outperforms existing methods in artifact removal, illumination harmonization, and long-sequence temporal consistency.

2606.16281.tldr: Strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, along with analyses, suggests that TIE offers a practical approach to the underexplored problem of MDLM ensembling.

2606.16286.tldr: Across PickCube and PickSingleYCB, adding the world model improved performance over the FM policy alone, with especially clear gains in end-of-episode success, suggesting that world-model-based planning can effectively complement flow-based imitation policies without modifying the FM training objective.

2606.16292.tldr: This work presents AI Supply Chain Galaxy, an interactive 3D visual analytics system for model provenance and compliance auditing, and shows how AISCG empowers analysts to intuitively trace inherited restrictive terms and identify root causes across deep topological networks, significantly reducing the cognitive load of compliance auditing.

2606.16307.tldr: StateGen is presented, a synthetic data generation platform that produces scored, reasoning-trace-rich training conversations by orchestrating a four-role LLM loop: a persona-conditioned user simulator, an agent under test, a state-grounded tool simulator, and a multi-axis LLM judge.

2606.16313.tldr: FluidTest is proposed, an evaluation pipeline with three components: a pairwise WebUI protocol for reliable human annotation; a taxonomy of 32 semantic threats with evidence-grounded decision graphs; and a three-agent verification system with reflection for precision and auditability.

2606.16316.tldr: This paper proposes RL-Index, an agentic indexing framework that formulates retrieval index reasoning as a reinforcement learning problem, and shifts reasoning to the indexing stage by augmenting documents with LLM-generated rationales that explicitly encode the latent query-knowledge relationship.

2606.16319.tldr: This work proposes architectural wisdom as a corrigible objective-governance layer above the optimization substrate, and defends the distinction against the intelligence-completeness thesis using goal-questioning over goal-taking, Bostrom's orthogonality, structural separation in the authors' exemplar cases, and persistent failure modes despite capability scaling.

2606.16327.tldr: The results suggest that speech--mesh data provide an effective and scalable source of articulatory supervision for AAI, and evaluations across different AAI architectures demonstrate stable performance gains, indicating that \textit{ArtBoost} can be integrated into diverse AAI models.

2606.16328.tldr: AdaSTORM is the first multi-agent framework tailored for dynamic graph reasoning, scaling reasoning to thousand-node graphs with over 90% accuracy across several large-scale dynamic graph settings without external tools, and significantly outperforms seven competitive baselines.

2606.16329.tldr: This paper presents a procedure for numeric planning based on Symbolic Pattern Planning (SPP), and defines a formula encoding the existence of a state closer than $P$ to a goal state, with $P' reachable from the starting state $S$ when using the pattern $\prec$.

2606.16330.tldr: A phase-aware guidance injection framework that augments a trained recurrent MAPPO (RMAPPO) scheduling policy through logit-level action bias during evaluation and shows that decision-time guidance injection can exploit heterogeneous recovery hints without redesigning the actor.

2606.16332.tldr: This paper presents SMEPilot, an LLM inference engine that selects CPU-only, SME-only, or cooperative SME+CPU execution for each operator shape, and presents SMEPilot, an LLM inference engine that selects CPU-only, SME-only, or cooperative SME+CPU execution for each operator shape.

2606.16344.tldr: A pre-specified algorithm audit using a randomized choice-based conjoint finds that list position -- a content-free artifact -- shifts recommendations causally, worth about \$12 per night.

2606.16352.tldr: Communication-efficient TEE-GPU Attention (VeriAttn) for accelerating verifiable LLM inference and offloads both linear and non-linear computations of attention to the GPU, while TEE performs verification.

2606.16353.tldr: This work proposes SelectStream, a selective latent-memory framework that keeps the current observation directly visible to a frozen VLM while exposing historical information only through a compact, query-conditioned evidence budget.

2606.16358.tldr: AEGIS is proposed, a provider-transparent attested API router whose data path is a client-verified faithful passthrough whose data path is a client-verified faithful passthrough that shows that all four malicious-router attack classes succeed against a plaintext-access baseline and are blocked by AEGIS.

2606.16360.tldr: Tyler is proposed, a typed and budget-aware framework for latent reasoning during autoregressive decoding that generalizes across diverse reasoning domains and achieves the best final-stage performance with the lowest forgetting.

2606.16362.tldr: The results support the iFIM framework as a principled tool for analyzing local decision sensitivity and for complementing existing attribution-based interpretability methods in medical imaging.

2606.16415.tldr: Posterior Twins is introduced, a memory-grounded digital-twin approach that represents likely behavior as an updated distribution under a specific decision context that represents likely behavior as an updated distribution under a specific decision context.

2606.16432.tldr: ACCORD (Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding), a simple and effective agent framework for adaptive grounding that actively probes the environment for missing information and integrates relevant context from the agent's trajectory that would otherwise be overlooked.

2606.16434.tldr: TC-SOH is introduced: a modular, plug-and-play service architecture for autonomous, end-to-end SOH prediction that outperforms the considered physics-informed and data-driven baselines, reducing MAPE by 1.91 times and RMSE by 2.13 times.

2606.16440.tldr: The paper introduces BF16W, which stores weights in BF16 while retaining Adam optimizer moments in FP32, and reduces memory requirements for on-chip training, and describes the vocabulary-budget constraint observed during earlier experiments, quantify BF16W memory savings, and outline FPGA training as the next stage of development.

2606.16454.tldr: A new low-rank parameterization is proposed, SDS-LoRA, which structurally decouples singular values from the backward pass and improves loss convergence and reduces the gap to full fine-tuning, significantly enhancing adaptation performance.

2606.16456.tldr: This work proposes SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization (SPRI), which distributes SVD-partitioned residuals derived from pretrained feed-forward network (FFN) weights across routed experts, introducing controlled expert diversity grounded in pretrained spectral structure and introduces a two-stage training strategy to improve adaptation stability.

2606.16462.tldr: These results support subject-specific encoders as a learned alignment mechanism for EEG decoding and identify head selection for unseenSubject-specific heads increase class distinctiveness and place each subject close to its own latent manifold, improving most subjects while leaving a method-sensitive subset.

2606.16465.tldr: T trace-economic underwriting is introduced, which maps tool-use traces to customer exposure and claimable loss, then uses this representation for pricing, control, and risk transfer, and uses deterministic economic labels rather than an LLM judge.

2606.16475.tldr: AI systems were reliably more persuasive than expert humans, even when expert humans chose their issues, researched in advance, underwent hours of live, structured practice, and were incentivized with 1,000 cash bonuses.

2606.16478.tldr: Tensor-Coord is introduced, a multilinear algebra framework that represents the joint plan of N agents as a third-order tensor over agents, timesteps, and actions, and it is proved that R*=N is necessary and sufficient for plan independence.

2606.16479.tldr: The analysis identifies an effective confidence threshold for filtering VGGT's raw output and demonstrates that enhancing uncertainty quality holds strong potential for improving the accuracy of its 3D reconstructions.

2606.16480.tldr: HOLO-MPPI is presented, a multi-scenario motion planning framework that combines high-level policy learning with low-level stochastic optimal control that improves upon MPPI and end-to-end RL baselines while maintaining real-time control.

2606.16481.tldr: EC-Script is proposed, an LLM agent-based framework that enables hierarchical control of the affective trajectory in narrative generation for emotional healing, and significantly outperforms baseline methods in affective trajectory adherence, thereby providing effective technical support for AI-assisted emotional healing scenarios.

2606.16484.tldr: A novel unified multimodal model, UniBrain, for brain magnetic resonance image (MRI) analysis that achieves high performance for brain image imputation, understanding, and disease diagnosis under various extents of modality incompleteness.

2606.16501.tldr: This work shows that replacing post-hoc merging with an iterative many-shot merging protocol is effective in improving multi-task performance, and proposes METIS, Mitigating Erasure from Task Interference for Stable many-shot merging, a loss-aware many-shot merging method that addresses information erasure in post-hoc merging through task-wise loss-gap weighting and consensus-based masking.

2606.16509.tldr: Model Graph Inductive Learning is introduced, a framework that constructs a model graph by clustering entities based on the similarity of their incoming and outgoing relational structures or their entity types, and serves as high-quality initial features %embeddings for the original knowledge graph, replacing random initialization and leading to more stable and expressive representations.

2606.16515.tldr: DCP is proposed, a fully online method that decomposes goal-reaching into two components sharing one InfoNCE representation $\psi$: a subgoal-scoring step that selects a visited state aligned with the final goal in $\psi_g$, and a direction-conditioned actor that consumes the unit direction and magnitude of the goal-reaching distance.

2606.16541.tldr: A \emph{drift detection theorem} and a \emph{PAC-faithfulness} result establishing that the equivalence class of a natural language statement is learnable from $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/\delta)/\varepsilon)$ probes under mild assumptions are proved.

2606.16558.tldr: ROSA-RL -- uncertainty-aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning enables safe and efficient roundabout entry for automated and human-driven vehicles in mixed traffic through probabilistic conflict forecasting.

2606.16568.tldr: An audio-only two-stage pipeline that separates when to trigger a turn boundary from whether the floor is actually transferring is proposed, and diffusion-based, label-preserving background-audio mixing as a data augmentation strategy is investigated.

2606.16595.tldr: ArtNet is a framework that explores a structured feature prediction task based on articulatory features to enhance acoustic robustness and integrates an articulatory predictor, designed to extract universal articulatory representations from self-supervised learning features, with a variational information bottleneck (VIB) to suppress language-specific variations.

2606.16603.tldr: VeriGraph is proposed, a traceable neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that enables agents to construct an explicit heterogeneous evidence directed acyclic graph (DAG) during execution and designs a graph-based policy optimization strategy with a composite reward that jointly supervises answer correctness, computational integrity, and derivational coherence.

2606.16605.tldr: Results show that attacks targeting value estimation, latent representations, and RSSM dynamics can be as damaging as direct policy disruption, and that early or frequent perturbations are especially harmful, while input-level defenses provide limited recovery under adaptive attacks.

2606.16613.tldr: Analysis of agent behavior reveals substantial differences in long-horizon economic interaction: higher-performing models communicate more actively with other firms, whereas Claude~Haiku~4.5 exhibits an idle-drift failure mode, repeatedly choosing inaction despite producing coherent assessments and plans.

2606.16624.tldr: This study proposes a geometry-aware variational neural operator for Mindlin-Reissner plate problems, termed MR-GVNO, which achieves millisecond-level full-field inference and favorable cross-geometry generalization.

2606.16633.tldr: A two-stage pruning framework consisting of Anchor-Context Graph Recovery (ACGR) and Text-Aware Token Cluster Selection (TATCS) is proposed that achieves superior and more stable performance under ultra-low token budget.

2606.16649.tldr: It is argued that the near term value of Agentic AI does not lie in full autonomy or workforce reduction, but in controlled partial autonomy for simple and medium complexity business processes.

2606.16652.tldr: The creation and use of DOMUS, a cloud-based, AI-enabled decision-support system built from scratch and customised for the needs of London Borough of Newham to support statutory Temporary accommodation placement, demonstrate the feasibility of scalable, ethically governed AI deployment in local government and contribute to debates on AI-enabled public value creation in e-governance.

2606.16687.tldr: Results show that textual semantics support current affect prediction, whereas future affective change is better captured through prior numeric trajectory dynamics.

2606.16690.tldr: PATCH, an action-chunk-conditioned latent patch innovation monitor for deployment-time intervention that accumulates persistent residuals unexplained by the robot's own motion that allows PATCH-Router to pause execution, select an available recovery source, and resume the original policy once localized innovation subsides.

2606.16694.tldr: This work introduces a theory of a deep transformer as a mean-field interacting system that implements distributed inference, subject to constraints on communication, locality and depth, and shows that such a system can exploit internal state representations to infer a latent context variable at increasingly finer scales over its layers.

2606.16707.tldr: This work introduces User as Code (UaC), a paradigm in which an agent's model of a user is a living software project: typed Python objects hold the user's state and ordinary Python functions encode the rules that govern it, so representing and reasoning about the user happen in one medium an interpreter can run.

2606.16721.tldr: This review outlines a roadmap for advancing medical AI from isolated diagnosis and prediction toward medical world models that simulate disease evolution and support intervention decisions, and identifies the challenges involved in turning plausible rollouts into clinically useful simulators.

2606.16730.tldr: This work re-interpret Transformer pretraining as a fast-slow, singularly perturbed flow along depth, with untied weights as its non-autonomous feature, and partitions parameter space into visible and invisible directions.

2606.16733.tldr: This survey revisits the landscape of LLM policy optimization from J(\theta) on first principles and uses the trajectory side, induced by $p_\theta(\tau)$, and the reward side, induced by $R(\tau)$, as the two axes along which methods are located.

2606.16742.tldr: Noise amplification is comprehensively constructed by incorporating three aspects: pixel-level intensity enhancement, region-level spatial amplification, and frame-level temporal aggregation and shows that this simple approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

2606.16751.tldr: This paper presents UNIATTACK, an adversarial testing framework designed from a defense-oriented perspective to systematically construct effective black-box attack prompts, providing a practical tool for assessing LLM robustness.

2606.16769.tldr: The proposed Skill-to-LoRA(S2L), a behavior-centric skill representation that replaces runtime skill text with skill-specific LoRA adapters, suggests that many procedural agent skills can be converted from runtime instructions into trainable, dynamically loadable behavioral modules.

2606.16774.tldr: This work proposes Collective Skill Tree Search (CSTS), a novel tree-search-based skill construction framework that constructs structured, diverse and generalizable tree of skills, and introduces Collective Skill Reinforcement Learning, which actively selects multiple relevant skills from the tree to broaden solution-space exploration.

2606.16783.tldr: Gen-VCoT, a framework using expert vision models to generate RGB images as reasoning intermediates, establishes a new paradigm for interpretable multimodal reasoning.

2606.16790.tldr: Decision-Weighted Flow Matching (DW-FM), a regret-aligned training framework that preserves the simplicity of standard flow matching while reweighting its velocity-regression objective using decision-sensitive endpoint information, is proposed.

2606.16799.tldr: MST-CLIPIQA, a multi-scale two-stream framework that achieves hierarchical vision-language alignment through explicit representational decoupling, is introduced, a multi-scale two-stream framework that achieves hierarchical vision-language alignment through explicit representational decoupling.

2606.16802.tldr: This work introduces LabOSBench, a challenging benchmark for multimodal GUI agents built on a suite of web-based scientific-instrument simulators that provides a reproducible, low-cost testbed for advancing computer-using agents toward scientific-instrument control.

2405.15768.tldr: A novel approach grounded in the principle of maximizing Fisher's ratio, defined as the quotient of between-class variation to within-class variation, is introduced, which outperforms well-established algorithms that operate on vector representations derived from distributional data.

2410.11687.tldr: This work proposes a sufficient constructive inductive bias for LRNNs: equip a diagonal recurrent state with multiplicative readout and a short sliding-window cross-product self-attention update, presenting windowed cross-product self-attention as a practical, testable inductive bias for LRNNs that learn in context through gradient-descent-like updates.

2605.00873.tldr: BRITE is introduced, the first framework that unifies (1) implausible prompting, (2) fine-grained assessment of audio-visual consistency, and (3) QA-based interpretable evaluation into a comprehensive T2V benchmark.

2606.02955.tldr: Experiments show that the theoretical improvement translates directly into empirical gains: profile-aware selection improves the accuracy--throughput frontier by exploiting safe parallelism that weakest-token rules miss, achieving up to 37% higher throughput at comparable accuracy.

2606.16808.tldr: This work first employs Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to explicitly induce safe tags to trigger safety analysis and guidance following the initial reasoning content for unsafe queries, while preserving standard responses for general queries to ensure adaptive triggering.

2606.16811.tldr: A semi-supervised framework that scales reasoning learning from minimal supervision, turning reasoning verification itself into a data creation mechanism and paves the way for future autonomous reasoning systems that learn from minimal human input.

2606.16813.tldr: GIST-CMTF is introduced, a goal-state inference layer that predicts candidate symbolic goals over the same state-transition vocabulary used by CMTF, estimates ambiguity, and either applies CMTF or exposes clarification as a causal action that produces missing goal or state variables.

2606.16815.tldr: This paper presents a theoretically grounded interpretation of score-based channel estimation through the lens of the perception-distortion tradeoff, identifying the conditions where score matching excels as well as its key limitations and quantify the excess risk incurred by standard distortion-minimization approaches.

2606.16825.tldr: This work introduces Expert Tying, an architectural modification that shares expert parameters across consecutive transformer layers while preserving independent, layer-wise routing and attention, and evaluates this approach across common, state-of-the-art architectures, including OLMoE, Qwen3, and DeepSeek-style MoEs.

2606.16826.tldr: Through 2,700 physical rollouts on five representative manipulation policies, it is found that current policies can acquire simple instruction-grounding skills, but still struggle with fine-grained motor atoms, counting, and logical filtering, and strong atomic performance does not reliably transfer to held-out compositional tasks.

2606.16837.tldr: A Temporal Pyramid Adapter that utilize parallel temporal convolutions with varying receptive fields to capture multi-scale spoofing cues, ranging from local artifacts to global prosodic irregularities, is proposed.

2606.16842.tldr: The design and implementation of a project-based master's-level course titled AI Algorithms: Theory and Engineering, at the University of Bremen, in which students developed a movie recommendation system while making architectural design decisions to address challenges related to scalability, deployment, and evolving requirements are reflected.

2606.16846.tldr: The operator-theoretic core of Q-learning in continuous-time stochastic control with continuous states and actions is studied, showing that a Bellman update maps bounded inputs into an anisotropic regularity class, smoothing the state variable while leaving only Lipschitz dependence on the action variable.

2606.16868.tldr: The presented suite provides a realistic and discriminative basis for FNLL evaluation in medical image segmentation and establishes a reusable foundation for fair benchmarking, dataset-specific label-noise characterization, and future method development under realistic federated settings.

2606.16883.tldr: Experiments on models trained on the ImageNet dataset show that the bounds remain consistently non-vacuous and achieve the tightest estimates among existing methods, closely aligning with empirical performance across a range of robust deep neural networks.

2606.16890.tldr: Hop count is a theory-motivated, cross-architecture predictor of large-language-model error on EHR question answering, with direct implications for deployment risk stratification of clinical AI.

2606.16891.tldr: A formal mathematical definition of a federated message that accounts for both utility and privacy is proposed and a taxonomy that organizes these exchanges into three categories is introduced: model structures, statistical summaries, and data-conditioned representations is introduced.

2606.16893.tldr: The project Informath is outlined, which aims to show how symbolic informalization can produce fluent text with a reasonable development effort and address multiple formal and natural languages.

2606.16898.tldr: This work proposes Semantic Flip, a simple yet effective framework that synthesizes auxiliary out-of-distribution samples for embodied refusal without requiring external OOD annotations, to independently transform the query and video memory to construct auxiliary OOD pairs that lack sufficient visual grounding.

2606.16902.tldr: BinaryTracking is proposed, a simple yet effective, fully open-source spatial-localization agent that leverages the temporal ordering of a robot's trajectory that improves overall accuracy and optimized inference strategy consistently yields more than a 1.5x inference speedup over previous approaches.

2606.16920.tldr: It is demonstrated that CEAP, the new circuit discovery method that improves upon EAP-IG with a theoretical guarantee, can substantially lessen resampling variance and rephrasing variance, and shows that the magnitude of unfaithfulness is affected by selective contribution scaling, a neural mechanism that accounts for the extremely poor scores sometimes observed.

2606.16923.tldr: Misspecification-Aware Simulation-Based Inference (MA-SBI), a calibration-free framework that turns this side-channel into a posterior correction, and bounds achievable bias reduction by the mutual information between misspecification and side-channel.

2606.16925.tldr: Under a strict true cold-start protocol, RAID outperforms strong foundation models and competitive baselines on both forecasting accuracy and prediction interval coverage, while reducing inference latency by an order of magnitude through non-autoregressive decoding.

2606.16933.tldr: This work develops a unified causal-origin taxonomy that characterizes sources of distributional shift in RL and relates ID/OOD generalization to non-stationary settings and introduces an evaluation framework for measuring shift impact and adaptation through performance degradation and recovery metrics.

2606.16935.tldr: CrossMaps is a real-time confidence-aware open-vocabulary semantic mapping pipeline that constructs language-queryable maps from RGB-D data and produces semantic heatmaps that can be queried with natural language to guide rover navigation.

2606.16939.tldr: This work proposes CircuitLasso, a scalable circuit-learning approach based on sparse linear regression that efficiently uncovers relationships among SAE features, showing how human-interpretable semantic features propagate through the model and influence its predictions.

2606.16944.tldr: A structural causal model formalized as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), treating ToM as a mechanism activated by situational and agent-level conditions rather than as an always-on capacity is presented, giving AI systems a principled, resource-rational decision procedure for mentalizing.

2606.16952.tldr: This work presents a customizable empirical auditing framework that effectively functions as a membership inference attack on privacy leakage, providing empirical lower bounds on privacy leakage that are tighter than prior data-based auditing methods.

2606.16969.tldr: This work reproduces a quality cliff at 6.25 Hz reported in previous works and evaluates candidate explanations: phonemic collisions and codebook saturation, neither of which shows evidence of a fundamental barrier.

2606.16973.tldr: These findings suggest that, under typical rating-prediction settings, collaborative information continues to dominate performance, raising important considerations for the effective integration of semantic review signals into recommendation models.

2606.16987.tldr: Experimental results show that exact 10-digit classification remains difficult even for advanced LLMs, with performance decreasing from coarse chapter-level prediction to fine-grained tariff and statistical suffix assignment, demonstrating the need for evidence-grounded, uncertainty-aware, and human-centered classification workflows rather than fully autonomous single-step prediction.

2606.16989.tldr: Evidence is provided for the following workflow suggestions: prompting with human intuition can encourage the LLM to have better"taste", and multi-turn workflows help when the pipeline encourages"ambitious"steps.

2606.16995.tldr: Evaluated on three FrozenLake configurations of increasing difficulty, PACT outperforms all baselines while relying on a 2B-parameter SLM backbone, suggesting that deliberative planning and reactive execution are more powerful in concert than either is alone in these settings.

2606.16996.tldr: Across eight OVSS benchmarks, ActiveSAM improves the speed-accuracy tradeoff of training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, outperforming the current state-of-the-art SegEarth-OV3 by approximately +1.4 mIoU on average while running up to 5.5x faster on large-vocabulary datasets.

2606.17005.tldr: An archive-and-adjudication protocol reconstructs public evaluation histories, isolates a verified timing boundary, and falsifies unsupported frontier claims.

2606.17006.tldr: TuneJury is introduced, an open, instance-level pairwise reward model for text-to-music that predicts a music preference score from a text prompt and an audio clip that generalizes to both held-out test pairs and out-of-distribution benchmarks, remaining competitive with prior baselines on the latter.

2606.17016.tldr: TokenPilot, a dual-granularity context management framework that reduces costs by 61% and 56% in isolated mode, and 61% and 87% in continuous mode, while maintaining competitive performance compared to prior systems.

2606.17020.tldr: FusionRS is the first large-scale RGB-infrared-text dataset designed for dual-modal vision-language learning in remote sensing, and improves RGB-IR alignment, infrared-to-text retrieval, and dual-modal captioning over RGB-only and non-IR-aware training settings.

2606.17028.tldr: HAMON is introduced, a passive diffractive optical forecasting core in which historical values are encoded onto an optical aperture, future positions are left dark, and cascaded trainable phase masks with free-space diffraction shape the forecast directly in the output field, indicating that the forecasts arise from the data-bearing optical field rather than from a digital forecasting head.

2606.17037.tldr: The architectures share a phase/sign identity code but expose it in different bases, set by rectification and readout geometry, which gives a mechanistic account of the texture--shape gap between CNNs and attention models.

2509.23722.tldr: OctoPipe is proposed, a pipeline parallelism system to jointly optimize partitioning, placement, and scheduling and implement a unified pipeline executor that dynamically orchestrates computation and communication to support irregular execution orders without deadlocks while maximizing communication-computation overlap.

2508.08983.tldr: Rational Inverse Reasoning is presented, which casts few-shot imitation as inference over latent explanation programs: compact, executable descriptions of intent that map an object-centric scene to a structured task-and-motion-planning specification of goals, subgoals and constraints.

2507.03670.tldr: Two interaction techniques that modify the prompt entry interface of chat-based generative AI assistants are evaluated: pressing and holding the prompt submission button, and continuously moving a slider up and down when submitting a short prompt, showing that these techniques increased prompt length and led to higher psychological ownership than baseline techniques.

2502.10706.tldr: This work proposes a novel method, termed Multi-Prototype Hyperspherical Invariant Learning (MPHIL), which introduces two key innovations: hyperspherical in variant representation extraction, enabling robust and highly discriminative hyperspherical invariant feature extraction, and multi-prototype hyperspherical classification, which employs class prototypes as intermediate variables to eliminate the need for explicit environment modeling in GIL and mitigate the semantic cliff issue.

2401.11512.tldr: This paper introduces the Transfer Entropy Redundancy Criterion (TERC), an information-theoretic criterion, which determines if there is entropy transferred from observable state variables to actions during training, and defines an algorithm that provably excludes variables from the observable state that do not affect the agent's policy during learning.

2506.05716.tldr: Ensemble Elastic DQN is introduced, a value-based reinforcement learning algorithm that combines adaptive elastic multi-step returns with ensemble-based target aggregation and achieves the highest final return in four of the five environments and remains competitive with conservative ensemble baselines.

2311.10090.tldr: JaxMARL is presented, the first open-source code base that combines ease-of-use with GPU enabled efficiency, and supports a large number of commonly used MARL environments as well as popular baseline algorithms, and SMAX, a vectorised, simplified version of the popular StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge, which removes the need to run the StarCraft II game engine.

2210.10619.tldr: This paper proposes Restricted Bernoulli Matrix Factorization (ResBeMF), a new algorithm aimed at enhancing the performance of classification-based collaborative filtering based on a collection of restricted matrix factorizations that jointly generate, for each user-item pair, a full probability distribution over the possible rating scores.

2505.13406.tldr: This paper proposes AutoMathKG, a high‐quality, wide‐coverage, and multi‐dimensional math KG capable of automatic updates, and develops Math LLM, a large language model developed to interact with AutoMathKG, providing missing proofs or solutions.

2508.04796.tldr: Pity-aware BPE reduces tokenization inequality -- operationalized by the Gini coefficient of per-language token costs -- by up to 89% relative to Classical BPE, with negligible impact on global compression rate and no evidence of systematic degradation in downstream LM performance.

2507.18206.tldr: MoRPI-PINN, a physics-informed neural network framework, has been proposed for inertial-based mobile robot navigation and shows accuracy improvements of over 80% compared to other baseline approaches for unseen trajectories.

2507.02950.tldr: These findings provide an expert-referenced benchmark for Japanese-language AI counseling simulations and show that reproducible LLM ratings should not be treated as calibrated counseling-quality evidence without expert validation.

2506.09740.tldr: This paper proposes ELBO-T2IAlign—a simple yet effective method to calibrate pixel-text alignment in diffusion models based on the evidence lower bound (ELBO) of likelihood, which requires no additional annotations, model retraining, or architectural modifications.

2506.03162.tldr: FuseMamba-VD: Dual Branch VideoMamba with Gated Class Token Fusion (GCTF), an efficient architecture combining a dual-branch design and a state-space model (SSM) backbone where one branch captures spatial features, while the other focuses on temporal dynamics.

2505.16388.tldr: EGT may provide a suitable framework to understand and predict human-AI interaction, evolution, and co-evolution, however, future research should extend beyond EGT and explore additional frameworks, empirical validation methods, and interdisciplinary perspectives.

2503.18509.tldr: A semantics for a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates inductive logic programming (ILP) to structure MI-PLL through relational constraints and formalizes the semantics of per-instance classifiers and provides a relational scaffold for reasoning about weak supervision is proposed.

2503.06269.tldr: This work identifies acceptance subspaces, then uses gradient-based optimization to reroute embeddings from refusal subspaces to acceptance subspaces, effectively achieving jailbreaks and showcases a practical application of mechanistic interpretability where other methods are less efficient, which highlights its utility.

2501.11086.tldr: This paper investigates LLM-based regression test generation as a machine translation task that takes the developer-provided commit message, the code change, and the name of the input format and produces regression test cases for the described change in the given input format.

2408.13378.tldr: DrugAgent provides heterogeneous evidence-grounded DTI assessment, complementing standalone DTI prediction, and provides strategies to model agreement, conflict, and uncertainty in biomedical evidence integration.

2409.17340.tldr: This study focuses on accurately predicting grip force during medium wrap grasps using a single sEMG sensor pair, addressing the challenge of escalating sensor requirements.

2501.05795.tldr: This study highlights the potential of ensuring robustness in decision-making by applying the concept of social welfare by proposing robust CEs that introduce a new viewpoint -- Pareto improvement -- and a method that uses multi-objective optimization to generate it.

2111.15255.tldr: The concept of double fuzzy probability interval linguistic term set (DFPILTS) is proposed, fuzzy semantic integration, DFPILTS definition, its preference relationship, some basic algorithms and aggregation operators are defined, and an aggregation-based approach is developed.

2403.11199.tldr: Graph Unitary Message Passing (GUMP), a message-passing framework that uses a unitary propagation operator on a transformed graph to avoid graph-induced exponential decay under repeated propagation, is proposed.

2508.12116.tldr: DynamixSFT is proposed, a dynamic and automated method for instruction-tuning dataset mixture optimization that effectively optimizes the Tulu-2-mixture and Tulu-3-mixture collections across 10 benchmarks, while introducing minimal computational overhead over naive sampling.

2507.15903.tldr: HalMit is presented, a novel black-box watchdog framework that models the generalization bound of LLM-empowered agents and thus detect hallucinations without requiring internal knowledge of the LLM's architecture, and significantly outperforms existing approaches in hallucination monitoring.

2506.21887.tldr: Active-MoSH is presented, an interactive local-global framework designed for high-stakes decision-making that integrates probabilistic preference learning with an active sampling strategy to adaptively refine Pareto subsets while minimizing cognitive burden.

2505.24415.tldr: Across four datasets of varying complexity, augmented variants closely resemble real-world data and contribute to gains in classification accuracy, generalization to unseen subjects, and patient-specific fine-tuning from few examples, the magnitude of these gains varies with dataset properties.

2504.08791.tldr: This work presents prima.cpp, a distributed on-device inference system that runs 30-70B LLMs on consumer home clusters with mixed CPUs/GPUs, insufficient RAM/VRAM, slow disks, slow disks, Wi-Fi links, and heterogeneous OSs, and proposes Halda, a heterogeneity-aware scheduler that co-optimizes per-device CPU/GPU workloads and device selection under RAM/VRAM constraints.

2503.10496.tldr: LBBNNs are advanced by enabling covariates to skip to any succeeding layer or be excluded, simplifying networks and clarifying input impacts on predictions, reaching state-of-the-art for compression of neural networks.

2603.13259.tldr: Under this scoped null the late-layer asymmetry is not localized to a single component, fitting a distributed-by-trajectory account rather than single-layer localized recall.

2603.19954.tldr: This work analyzes the ability of decoder-only models to verify whether a given plan correctly solves a given planning instance, and introduces C*-RASP, an extension of C-RASP designed to establish length generalization guarantees for transformers under the simultaneous growth in sequence length and vocabulary size.

2604.03553.tldr: Chronos, an AI Co-Historian designed to support historians, is introduced, which allows researchers to create and customize research workflows through natural-language interaction and share these as Chronos-Extensions with others.

2602.18037.tldr: GR achieves a higher GPT-judged win-rate in RLHF, avoids overly focusing on the format in rule-based math rewards, and prevents hacking the judge in LLM-as-a-Judge math tasks.

2606.07722.tldr: It is concluded that a basic chatbot cannot be a thinking partner capable of matching the cognitive flexibility of humans, and that further development of the Large Language Model will not lead to this either.

2606.23327.tldr: This work develops automated video shot creation with shot planning agents for coherent narratives and cross-modal retrieval for aligned visual content and designs a multi-agent orchestration framework integrating over thirty specialized editing agents.

2606.22726.tldr: STREAM achieves state-of-the-art alignment between motion and music while perfectly preserving choreographic semantics, positioning AI not merely as a reactive synthesizer, but as a controllable, collaborative partner for artistic direction.

2606.09118.tldr: These results show that expert-authored rubrics provide effective evaluation targets and scalable reward signals for improving LLM instruction following and agentic behavior, and empirical, rubric rewards improve training in both fixed task datasets, such as ComplexConstraints, and stateful RL environments, such as CoreCraft.

2604.09544.tldr: Targeted weight pruning is used as a causal intervention to probe the internal organization of harmfulness in LLMs and reveals a coherent internal structure for harmfulness in LLMs that may serve as a foundation for more principled approaches to safety.

2606.30111.tldr: This work evaluates three AAS variants across four embodied executors spanning vision-language navigation, embodied question answering, and language-conditioned manipulation, and shows that architecture-level search can produce deployable and directional success-rate gains on embodied tasks, while one apparent high-scoring candidate is rejected as leak-bearing.

2606.22574.tldr: SmartSDG, an automated, reproducible pipeline built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim using Physically-Based Shading (PBS), is introduced alongside ILLUM\_INTRUCK, a new multi-object industrial benchmark dataset, to provide actionable virtual scene design guidelines to maximize object detection robustness in industrial automation.

2606.30543.tldr: DyadEE, a dataset for emotional entrainment detection in dyadic speech interactions, and TRACE, a window-level framework that models dyadic interaction as ordered sequences of acoustic embeddings derived from emotion fine-tuned Whisper representations, treating each sample as an interaction trace rather than pooled utterances are introduced.

2607.02575.tldr: This work introduces a new setting, denoted as Criterion-Conditional In-Context Learning (CC-ICL), where models must infer the latent criterion from context and adjust predictions accordingly under fixed task semantics, and proposes two complementary metrics, Criterion Invariance and Criterion Sensitivity, to evaluate this capability.

2607.02574.tldr: This survey classifies more than thirty KV-management systems and frameworks using four axes: locality, lifetime, ownership, and substrate, and reveals five architectural archetypes -- local-paged, disaggregated-pipeline, shared-store, memory-pool, and hybrid-tier.

2607.02572.tldr: The results demonstrate that the proposed ACC-CRL framework significantly improves OOD generalization while maintaining in-distribution (ID) performance, validating the effectiveness and robustness of the ACC-CRL strategy based on mechanism alignment and uncertainty modeling in open environments.

2607.02520.tldr: In controlled evaluations on HumanEval, MBPP, a SciCode subset, citation-validation tasks, claim-support auditing, and small end-to-end workflow stress tests, AutoResearch improves execution success, citation validity, local claim support, and workflow completion relative to directly comparable baselines.

2607.02689.tldr: This work introduces S-EMBER (Streaming Egocentric Memory Benchmark for Episodic Retrieval), a large-scale benchmark comprising 3,141 videos totaling 388 hours of organic activity captured via Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses that establishes a hardware-authentic foundation for developing grounded, reliable episodic memory in the next generation of wearable AI agents.

2607.02630.tldr: This work observes that the concurrency already exists: serving concurrent requests is suspending and resuming them, so every server ships the machinery overlap needs, and proposes a recipe for overlapping the offload with other requests, which is bounded by device throughput and the server's own overlap capacity.

2607.02612.tldr: Fusion is introduced, a unified adaptive inference framework that coordinates token merging, early exiting, and token pruning through a simple staged design: tokens are merged first, confidence is evaluated next, and pruning is applied only to samples that continue inference.

2607.02594.tldr: An automated method to identify incorrectly labelled medical images by analyzing sequences of loss functions from deep learning classification networks over multiple training epochs is proposed and demonstrated's effectiveness in improving model performance through automated label quality control.

2607.02588.tldr: A Hierarchical Online Memory Exploration and Reasoning framework that mirrors the multi-scale structure of long videos, and consistently lifts three various LLM backbones, indicating a model-agnostic structural capability for grounded retrieval over long videos.

2607.02686.tldr: ASK+, is proposed, which supplies the SLM with trajectory-aware context and structured chain-of-thought reasoning, converting it from a passive redundancy check into a more informative consultant that occasionally corrects the policy.

2607.02636.tldr: Federated Learning enables scalable, high-performing, and privacy-preserving object detection across distributed drone fleets without data centralization, and shows that FL enables scalable, high-performing, and privacy-preserving object detection across distributed drone fleets without data centralization.
