2607.15755.tldr: This work develops AuEmoCodec, which learns a discrete authentic emotion token space from large-scale emotional speech via finite scalar quantization, enabling a more authentic emotion representation than limited basic emotion categories and proposes AuEmoToMe, an authentic-emotion-guided token merging algorithm that merges redundant tokens in multimodal dialogue history while preserving emotion-relevant context.

2607.15711.tldr: A Difficulty-aware Dynamic Routing (DDR) strategy that overcomes the rigid, one-size-fits-all processing paradigm for Real-ISR approaches, and builds a set of Real-ISR networks with varying model capacities by modulating the spatial downsampling ratio of the VAE in the SD backbone.

2607.15686.tldr: S1-Omni is trained on S1-Omni-Corpus, which covers 200 scientific tasks and contains millions of reasoning samples, and is evaluated on over 60 scientific benchmarks, providing a practical path toward unified scientific modeling.

2607.15647.tldr: This paper investigates whether small, locally deployed language models can perform meaningful screening of LEED documentation and how deterministic symbolic components should share that work.

2607.15776.tldr: This work proposes NeurOWL, an end-to-end neuro-symbolic framework that jointly performs verification and abduction, leveraging both formally defined semantics and textual semantics through Large Language Models and ontology embeddings.

2607.15715.tldr: The paper characterizes when agentic mechanisms change system behavior, whether these changes improve task completion, and how the observed failure modes motivate an optimized agent design under the same evaluation harness.

2607.15987.tldr: This work formalises the problems of ODRL evaluation for the access control and monitoring scenarios, in both static and streaming settings, and provides a novel, efficient algorithm and implementation of the first ODRL Evaluator with transparent formal semantics and supporting all rule types.

2607.15854.tldr: Results provide inspectable evidence that the evolved sketch carried reviewed policy and that retaining code reduced rework in this run; with one model and one reveal order, they do not establish general superiority or correctness beyond the encoded checks.

2607.16021.tldr: This paper presents a novel scalable framework for multi-domain dialogue state tracking that leverages the pretrained BERT model to achieve zero-shot generalization, making it easy to quickly adapt to new domains without additional training.

2607.15919.tldr: This work reformulates continuous reconstruction as a dense, per-feature classification task, allowing the decoder to output categorical logits and shows that boundary-seeking objectives are fundamentally ill-posed in bottlenecked generative architectures.

2607.15861.tldr: ToxGate, a trust-fusion head that conditions each auxiliary signal on the encoder representation before adding it to the prediction state, is proposed, and source-specific gating gives the strongest results in transfer, severe-abuse slices, and high-risk triage.

2607.15830.tldr: RTL-Sequencer is presented, a novel sequence-based paradigm that enables scalable RTL timing prediction via linearizing logic cones by breadth-first traversal and applying modern linear sequence models.

2607.15794.tldr: This work investigates the geometric structure that emerges inside a multi-modal network for egomotion estimation and shows that embeddings lie on low-dimensional manifolds aligned with motion variables, attention weights adapt with angular excitation and visual reliability, and the fused representation recovers classical observability cues.

2607.15740.tldr: An Implicit Cultural Alignment Reward Model built upon a lightweight 4.2-billion-parameter Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) is introduced, enabling late-stage semantic features to directly attend to early-stage visual representations and better preserve culturally salient details.

2607.15713.tldr: SigMap is a multimodal foundation model that introduces two key innovations: a cycle-adaptive masking strategy that dynamically adjusts masking patterns based on channel periodicity characteristics to learn robust wireless representations and a novel"map-as-prompt"framework that integrates 3D geographic information through lightweight soft prompts for effective cross-scenario adaptation.

2607.15660.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the ToolVerse framework significantly strengthens LLMs'capabilities in long-horizon tool use, achieving a marked performance boost and showcasing robust reasoning within dynamic environments.

2607.16051.tldr: The Loopie series, consisting of two Mixture-of-Experts models: a 20B-parameter model with 2B active parameters and a 6B-parameter model with 0.6B active parameters, develops strong reasoning abilities and achieves frontier-level reasoning performance.

2607.16004.tldr: This work decouples congestion detection and control by combining a random-forest violation pre-classifier with an actor-critic controller, and evaluates its robustness to measurement noise and grid-parameter mismatch.

2607.15898.tldr: A generic two-stage training paradigm that pretrains the model with diffusion forcing and fine-tunes with teacher forcing, combining the representational benefits of the former with the rollout stability of the latter, achieves state-of-the-art results across the standard suite of driving world model evaluations on established benchmarks.

2607.15883.tldr: It is proposed that the believability of an artificial interlocutor -- the degree to which a user attributes an inner life to it, which the authors call perceived mind -- is governed by whether the agent expresses a small set of first-person stances that humans use as evidence of mind, and that this is separable from task intelligence.

2607.15847.tldr: CAMMAR (Culture-Aware Matryoshka for Metaphorical Arabic Representations), a representation learning framework that organizes meaning into nested lexical, cultural, and metaphorical embedding subspaces through a staged semantic curriculum, is introduced.

2607.15799.tldr: A knowledge-assisted multi-graph framework for modeling sensor dependencies in multi-stage industrial processes for MTAD, which explicitly incorporates process knowledge into graph learning to enhance dependency modeling and improve anomaly detection performance.

2607.15648.tldr: The results show that, in addition to turn-taking, both gaze and backchannels are associated with address, and models using continuous address levels achieve better predictive fit than those using discrete labels, suggesting that address may exhibit graded structure.

2607.15879.tldr: DECODEM is introduced, a set of benchmark datasets for evaluating the automated extraction of corporate governance variables from organizational documents and demonstrates that current frontier models can extract legally meaningful information from complex corporate documents with high accuracy and suggests an important future role for automated feature extraction in constructing corporate governance datasets.

2607.15868.tldr: This paper proposes a novel distributed framework that jointly leverages ego- and exocentric multi-modal signals for human motion estimation from HMDs and shows that the approach can robustly reconstruct motion even in challenging scenarios.

2607.15781.tldr: AgentFAIR, a multi-agent framework combining structured metadata extraction with 13 sub-principle-specific LLM evaluators, is presented, supporting auditability and feasibility, while the limited benchmark, incomplete ablations, and single-model-family validation constrain claims about accuracy and generalization.

2607.15778.tldr: This work proposes MoD-VLLM, a novel Modularized Dynamic-Granularity Video LLM framework for multi-event long video understanding, which unifies temporal grounding and semantic understanding iteratively and self-reflectively and proposes a dynamic-granularity reinforcement learning strategy, allowing MoD-VLLM to learn optimal grounding policies and dynamic granularity visual representation jointly.

2607.15775.tldr: A novel feature augmentation algorithm is introduced, AquaAugmentor, to enhance the predictive performance of these models for low-dimensional datasets, using a dataset that includes chemical attributes of water, such as pH, hardness, solids, chloramines, sulfate, and others.

2607.15768.tldr: GeoChrono is proposed, an MLLM with enhanced capabilities for tracing, memorizing, and reasoning about long-term geographic evolution, surpassing the leading commercial MLLMs by over 20%, while C2FComp reduces visual tokens by over 56% while retaining GeoChrono's 94.6% performance on ChronoBench.

2607.15944.tldr: PHP-AIO is a five-gate sequential decision protocol with a final composite check that quantifies unpriced systemic risks at the role level and produces auditable automation decisions for candidates that standard cost-benefit analysis would uniformly automate.

2607.15641.tldr: IMBENCH is introduced, a benchmark designed to evaluate intuitive manipulation as an integrated capability spanning perception, physical reasoning, action generation, and iterative execution, and position IMBENCH as a step toward evaluating and enabling more integrated, adaptive physical intelligence.

2607.15629.tldr: The first machine-checked account of this 1-topos core is given, in Cubical Agda, over a previously verified probability monad and do-calculus, and it is shown that interventions and Pearl's rules are stable under every topology.

2607.15593.tldr: A cloud-scale gateway system for MCP service is presented, which breaks the direct-connect model on the data plane and offloads legacy service integration, consolidating incompatible MCP variants, access control, tool recommendation, and session-aware routing to the gateway.

2607.16169.tldr: These exploratory results show that Muon can benefit agentic RL and motivate studying the policy optimizer, advantage estimator, and learning rate jointly, jointly.

2607.16122.tldr: CRAFT is introduced, a method that converts any rubric based evaluation dataset into a model specific diagnosis of weak capabilities, and yields both a sharper picture of what a model cannot do and measurably better models after finetuning on that diagnosis.

2607.16090.tldr: DADiff is introduced, a diffusion-based framework that leverages the discrepancy between source and target domain generative trajectories in the generation process of the next state to estimate the dynamics mismatch and provides superior performance compared to existing approaches.

2607.16074.tldr: JoyNexus is presented, a unified service for multi-tenant VLA supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation and introduces group batching for heterogeneous VLA data schemas that share a compatible model-facing prefix.

2607.16131.tldr: This work introduces ToolSciVer, the first tool-augmented framework for MSCV, which equips a VLM with three type-aware visual tools, table row/column focus, chart-to-structure parsing, and high-resolution region zoom, which convert dense scientific visuals into explicit, claim-facing evidence.

2607.16065.tldr: This work investigates the role of spatial normalization as a preprocessing strategy to mitigate geometric domain shifts and improve the consistency of retinal layer segmentation in Optical Coherence Tomography and introduces a fovea-centered normalization framework that aligns OCT volumes into a common anatomical reference.

2607.16175.tldr: This work constructs a dataset called CAV-STIXGen that maps CAV vulnerability descriptions to STIX domain objects, and analyzes CWE and MITRE ATT&CK co-occurrences to identify recurring threat patterns in the CAV domain, demonstrating how AI-assisted vulnerability-to-STIX translation can automate threat intelligence and prioritize defense in transportation security.

2607.16133.tldr: This study shows that multi-agent design is fundamentally an information-bottleneck optimization problem, and explains when bounded inter-agent communication helps or hurts, and observes that MAS consistently helps when relays are near-sufficient, especially for weaker models.

2607.16066.tldr: A two-part tutorial-and-survey is presented that formalises the control, management, and AI-native planes of 5G and 6G, and maps agentic capabilities onto 5G/6G control surfaces, standardization, and major 6G initiatives.

2607.16130.tldr: This work proposes a lightweight methodology for auditable trustworthiness levels in AI governance and illustrates the methodology on synthetic AI lifecycle traces involving degradation, shocks, updates, heterogeneous monitoring cadences, and system comparison.

2607.16097.tldr: A quantitative account of the pretraining-to-RL interface and a controlled testbed for studying the science of reasoning across the full pretraining-to-post-training pipeline is provided.

2607.16076.tldr: Hierarchical Cross-modal Incongruity Graph Network is proposed, a novel framework that models cross-modal incongruity at token, phrase, and global levels using graph attention networks and adaptively integrates these representations through a learned hierarchical attention mechanism.

2607.16062.tldr: This work merges Qwen3-8B specialists on the AppWorld agent benchmark with LOOP and pits the result against a jointly trained model on the same data, finding that on task-goal completion, merging matches joint RL -- and every merge variant is statistically indistinguishable.

2507.03223.tldr: SI-Agent, a novel agentic framework designed to automatically generate and iteratively refine human-readable SIs through a feedback-driven loop, is introduced, offering a favorable trade-off between performance and interpretability compared to baselines.

2607.16112.tldr: A methodology for deriving harmonized thresholds across three risk domains, which takes expected harm as the key primitive and uses an explicit risk-modeling approach that accounts for risk channels and model release conditions for automated AI R&D.

2304.11171.tldr: A general representation model of granular-ball computing is proposed within a unified descriptive framework and systematically reviews its fundamental ideas and advances in granular-ball computing across granular-ball supervised learning, granular-ball unsupervised learning, approximate granular-ball representation and computation, granular-ball deep learning based on latent-space granulation, granular-ball graph learning, and granular-ballinterdisciplinary research.

2412.15529.tldr: This work thoroughly evaluates the performance of advanced core components in RAG systems, providing insights into optimizations for prevalent failure points and formulate a suite of experimental methodologies and diagnostic testing protocols to dissect the failure points inherent in RAG engineering.

2502.11491.tldr: This work proposes Ontology-Guided Reverse Thinking (ORT), a novel framework that constructs reasoning paths from purposes back to conditions and achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly enhances the capability of LLMs for KGQA.

2502.18864.tldr: Co-Scientist, a multi-agent artificial intelligence system built on Gemini for structured scientific thinking and hypothesis generation, helped to identify new drug-repurposing candidates and synergistic combination therapies for acute myeloid leukaemia that were validated through in vitro experiments.

2505.19809.tldr: An equivariant representation learning framework that simultaneously addresses regression, conditional probability estimation, and uncertainty quantification while providing first-of-its-kind non-asymptotic statistical learning guarantees is introduced.

2506.12697.tldr: The Multi-scale Global-detail Feature Integration Strategy (MGDFIS) is a neck-level feature-fusion strategy that couples global context exchange, local-detail recovery, and pixel-level foreground-background recalibration to balance low-SNR target preservation, clutter suppression, and efficient cross-scale context exchange.

2508.02425.tldr: This study evaluates three-class human/object detection models, offering more detailed contact analysis and a comparison of preprocessing strategies suggests a sliding window approach is optimal for this task.

2508.07683.tldr: This work proposes TAR (Temporal Anchor-Constrained Reasoning), a framework that introduces the temporal anchor (T-anchor) as a transparent and auditable checkpoint mechanism and introduces a bootstrapping paradigm that automatically harvests high-quality CoT data using only a standard 7B model, eliminating the dependency on ultra-large models.

2508.09883.tldr: This work develops a method to select an optimal teacher model for large language models through comprehensive comparisons of leading reasoning LLMs, and demonstrates that DED outperforms existing methods by considering factors beyond superficial hardness, token length, or teacher model capability.

2508.12435.tldr: This paper explores deep learning methods relying solely on a robot’s built-in joint sensors, eliminating the need for external sensors, and shows that spectrogram-based representations significantly improve accuracy, while model architecture plays a smaller role.

2603.26005.tldr: An agentic large language model (LLM)-based orchestration framework for scientific simulation, AutoB2G, which organizes simulation components into a directed acyclic graph (DAG)-structured codebase and employs LLM agents to perform retrieval, composition, execution, verification, and iterative repair of simulation workflows.

2604.28123.tldr: This work introduces PRISM, a three-stage pipeline that mitigates this drift by inserting an explicit distribution-alignment stage between SFT and RLVR, and casts alignment as a black-box, response-level adversarial game between the policy and a Mixture-of-Experts discriminator with dedicated perception and reasoning experts.

2605.01189.tldr: NEURON is a neuro-symbolic system designed to enhance both predictive reliability and clinical interpretability and integrates SNOMED CT ontology-informed structural representations with machine learning models to bridge the gap between raw data and medical nomenclature.

2605.09076.tldr: This work studies decentralized LLM multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) and proposes Self-Anchored Consensus (SAC), a fully decentralized iterative filter-and-refine protocol in which agents iteratively exchange responses, locally evaluate and filter unreliable messages, and refine their own outputs.

2606.09832.tldr: The Agentic Social Affordance Framework is introduced, a theoretical framework extending Social Affordance theory to multi-agent AI systems and identifies a directional reversal: where classical MAS used roles, norms, and coordination to constrain autonomous agents, ASAF applies the same organizational vocabulary to structure the cognition and oversight of human operators who remain in the loop.

2606.29437.tldr: LLMography is introduced, a framework for transforming Human-AI conversations into measurable indicators of provenance, human contribution, AI dependency, reproducibility, and auditability, and the findings suggest that AI transparency should move beyond output detection toward documenting the history of interaction.

2606.29445.tldr: VG-GUIBench (Video-Guided GUI Benchmark), a new benchmark designed to evaluate whether MLLM-based GUI agents can follow video tutorials to complete corresponding GUI interactive tasks, and proposes TASKER (Task-driven And Scene-aware Keyframe searchER), a keyframe extraction algorithm that jointly considers task relevance and scene dynamics to identify informative frames.

2606.29457.tldr: A cheap, reproducible way to study deal-making under uncertainty; a concrete, model-based answer to how much due diligence is worth buying; and evidence about when lightweight, general-purpose AI is good enough to replace specialized methods are found.

2606.29459.tldr: LLM4MOF shows that language-model agents can run interpretable, simulation-grounded inverse design without training a model per objective.

2606.29464.tldr: A rank-aware hyperbolic alignment (RAHA) that combines hierarchical geometry with explicit alignment-capacity control, and demonstrates competitive cross-modal retrieval and improved transfer indicators under fixed budgets is proposed.

2606.29472.tldr: This work introduces the Agent-Computer Observation Interface (AOI), a model-agnostic perception layer that decouples continuous, adaptive observation from discrete actions through three gated components: inter-step keyframe capture, volume-gated audio transcription, and CU-model-generated visual narration that persists as text.

2606.29474.tldr: An a posteriori error analysis framework for decoupled neural approximations of fully coupled forward--backward stochastic differential equations (FBSDEs) and the diagnostic role of the proposed indicators and the contribution of the mismatch penalty to the consistency and reproducibility of the numerical approximations are developed.

2606.29476.tldr: CRAFT is introduced, a three-pillar credit-assignment scheme that addresses both limitations of the prevailing recipe and proves the estimator's consistency and a variance bound, gives structural and bit-exact reproducibility guarantees, and is evaluated across three agentic environments, four model scales, and five end-to-end methods.

2606.29481.tldr: HIPPO is introduced, a novel RL framework that integrates hint-injected aggregation with a tailored pairwise reward model that yields substantial improvements over standard baselines and generalizes effectively to out-of-distribution general tasks, showing it extracts authentic, transferable reasoning skills rather than superficial shortcut patterns.

2606.29490.tldr: Verbal and log-probability confidence are thus not interchangeable: log-probabilities track answer evidence and correctness, whereas verbal confidence is better understood as a behaviour-facing readout of an internal commit-readiness state, challenging the practice of treating verbal reports as proxies for reliability.

2606.29493.tldr: A fault taxonomy, a suite of automated checkers and recall-oriented semantic audit prompts, and release standards are proposed to guide the creation of formal math datasets and to make evaluation more reproducible and trustworthy.

2606.29495.tldr: The proposed CogWM is an LLM-based user model that reframes multi-turn dialogue evaluation from ``what did the user say'' to ``how did the user's internal cognitive state evolves'' and serves as both a user simulator and an evaluation platform.

2606.29503.tldr: PopMedQA is presented, a benchmark isolating the verbose context problem through computational tasks on groups of longitudinal patient records, and it is found that domain-independent methods fail to alleviate the verbose context problem.

2606.29520.tldr: SAKE (Software Architectural Knowledge Evaluation), a standardized and reproducible benchmark for assessing software architectural knowledge in LLMs, is introduced and results are released as open source to give the community a baseline for tracking architectural reasoning in LLMs.

2606.29531.tldr: This work proposes MotionAtlas, a system for detailed captioning of motion-centric videos, comprising a dedicated human-annotated benchmark, a scalable, high-quality pipeline to construct training samples, and a family of powerful Video-MLLMs, which achieves consistent and substantial performance gains across diverse baseline Video-MLLMs.

2606.29532.tldr: This work proposes an LLM-agent-based decision pipeline that optimizes semantic joins by matching the execution strategy to the characteristics of the underlying tables, and achieves higher F1 scores than featurized-decomposition join (FDJ) at one to two orders of magnitude lower token cost.

2606.29540.tldr: The em-dash shows that something in how scientific literature is written changed markedly in the early 2020s, and roughly when; it shows that something in how scientific literature is written changed markedly in the early 2020s, and roughly when.

2606.29541.tldr: A diagnostic combining a role-routing matrix, formation sensitivity, and gradient/occlusion attribution across three-role MiniGrid and SMACv2 (Terran) environments shows that label-conditioned attention produces substantially more concentrated and role-specific routing than flat MLP baselines.

2606.29544.tldr: It is shown that specific augmentation chains can reliably flip detection verdicts while preserving speech intelligibility and speaker identity, and how these findings are used to harden the detector through targeted retraining is discussed.

2606.29548.tldr: VISTA-DZ is proposed, a semantic-profile-conditioned framework for personalized stop-go and decision-time prediction that outperforms trajectory-only and handcrafted personalization baselines, and cross-domain results further show feasible zero-shot simulation-to-real transfer and better real-world generalization when simulation data are combined with limited field data.

2606.29563.tldr: K-VEC, a novel coverage-aware KV-cache eviction strategy that prioritizes token coverage while evicting tokens in the cache is introduced, demonstrating its potential for efficient LLM deployment in resource-constrained settings.

2606.29577.tldr: The results show that grounding PET encoders in regional metabolic semantics -- rather than treating PET as generic volumetric data -- yields representations that are structured, interpretable, and language-compatible, pointing to a new direction for metabolic-aware PET understanding.

2606.29579.tldr: The results demonstrate that bounded activation reweighting provides a simple, architecture-agnostic, and highly parameter-efficient alternative for adapting pretrained VLMs and recovers a substantial fraction of standard PEFT performance while preserving strong non-spatial VQA accuracy.

2606.29582.tldr: A structured overview of NAS is presented, wherein the bilevel NAS formulation is addressed through an auxiliary mathematical programming framework that enables the systematic integration of second-order information from the model's training loss function and ensures the optimality of the model parameters while modifying architecture parameters.

2606.29586.tldr: SonoCLIP is proposed, the first million-scale region-controllable fetal ultrasound vision-language foundation model that integrates segmentation masks as mask-channel visual prompts within the vision encoder, enabling joint global-local contrastive representation learning.

2606.29593.tldr: This paper tells the story of how Stefan Kaczmarz's algorithm turned out to be the earliest known example of stochastic gradient descent, a ubiquitous computing paradigm that drives the training of modern AI models such as ChatGPT and Gemini.

2606.29600.tldr: MultiDepth-3k (MD-3k), a sparse two-layer ordinal benchmark for measuring depth-layer preference and multi-layer spatial relationship accuracy (ML-SRA), is introduced and leading depth foundation models exhibit diverse layer preferences under standard RGB input, showing that the same layered geometry can be resolved differently across models.

2606.29601.tldr: Langshaw is proposed, a declarative protocol language based on sayso, a new construct that captures who has priority over setting each attribute, and nono and nogo, two constructs to capture conflicts between actions.

2606.29604.tldr: Causal Perturbative Elicitation (CPE) is introduced, an unsupervised method for discovering interpretable low-rank adapters (LoRAs) that can elicit latent behaviors in LLM internals, and yields a powerful tool for aligning AI systems and evaluating their safety.

2606.29613.tldr: The findings suggest that structural role decomposition alone may be insufficient to guarantee faithful explanations and that representation-level separation helps improve explanation faithfulness, and that representation-level separation may provide a more general mechanism for enhancing explanation faithfulness in MoE systems.

2606.29614.tldr: It is suggested that, in realistic Turkish sentiment classification, prompted large language models do not yet match supervised fine-tuning in the zero-shot setting, and that including the neutral class is crucial for robust evaluation.

2606.29623.tldr: SCARCE (Scalable Cascade Analysis for Rare-event Characterisation via Embeddings), which replaces the performance function with learned latent representations and geometric rulers that score proximity to failure regions that formalise through a non-negative supermartingale, yielding a high-probability upper envelope that remains valid under early stopping.

2606.29639.tldr: A two-stage framework that combines reasoning-based prompt optimization with gradient-based prompt optimization that achieves state-of-the-art performance on FS-TACRED with Qwen3-4B and remains competitive on FS-FewRel.

2606.29640.tldr: A novel early-exit FM framework is proposed that attaches lightweight, per-task heads, at the most appropriate exit-stage of a frozen wireless FM encoder, enabling variable-depth inference tailored to each task's preferred representation depth.

2606.29646.tldr: This is the first systematic study of fuzzing on sleeper-agent backdoors and the first to show proxy-task hyperparameter selection transferring to real-task elicitation, and proposes reporting such results as a (uniform-baseline, proxy-selected, oracle) triple.

2606.29648.tldr: This work introduces a failure-driven evolution framework in which a meta-agent autonomously discovers how a tool-using task agent should coordinate diverse retrievers during multi-step document question answering, establishing autonomous multi-agent coordination as a promising paradigm for multimodal document reasoning.

2606.29654.tldr: Rather than relying on per-task post-hoc threshold search, the method prospectively converts a user-declared wrong-action budget into an auditable act-or-defer operating point before deployment, under explicitly stated assumptions.

2606.29661.tldr: The results suggest that the strength of the AI crowd comes not from sampling more forecasts indiscriminately, but from combining forecasts across models with complementary errors, motivating forecasting systems that explicitly optimize for both model quality and diversity.

2606.29667.tldr: The materials science literature encodes decades of experimental knowledge in figures, yet this visual record remains locked away and inaccessible to AI at scale, so this pipeline that resolves this by decomposing compound figures into individual sub-panels and generating structured, grounded annotations using a large language model guided by a curated materials science taxonomy is presented.

2606.29681.tldr: This work proposes a restart-based MDP modification that reduces PR-cause checking to two conditional reachability queries without using reachability values of the original MDP, and develops an anytime learning-and-checking algorithm based on two-sided value iteration that progressively classifies states as causal, non-causal, or undecided.

2606.29699.tldr: The result is deliberately limited: OpenVLA internal states contain failure relevant structure under controlled perceptual shift, but these experiments do not establish a causal mechanism, task held out generalization, or a deployable recovery system.

2606.29700.tldr: A planner-grounded optimization recipe that combines parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation supervised fine-tuning, offline planner-derived preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization, and inference-time planner-in-the-loop repair, without requiring online planner calls during training is developed.

2606.29705.tldr: GUICrafter is proposed, a weakly-supervised GUI agent leveraging massive unannotated screenshots to substantially reduce the reliance on expensive human annotations, and achieves competitive, or even superior, performance to advanced systems like UI-TARS while using only 0.1% of its data.

2606.29706.tldr: ARMOR, Adaptive Regularized Mixture Optimization for Retrievers, which learns separate temperatures for the RAG retrieval distribution and InfoNCE softmax and regularizes the adapted query encoder toward the frozen base query encoder, shows that ARMOR improves evidence retrieval and answer generation in several in-domain settings.

2606.29713.tldr: SEVA is presented, a structured verification agent that emits evidence alignments, step-by-step reasoning chains, calibrated confidence, and a six-category error diagnosis with actionable fixes, confirming a principle that should generalize: for any RL task with multi-component generation, reward granularity must match output granularity.

2606.29717.tldr: The work not only demonstrates that LLM-agent autonomous research can optimize an expert-designed machine learning model for material property prediction, but also investigates the limitations of such autonomous research.

2606.29718.tldr: This paper evaluates four flagship open-source models across three benchmarks and reveals a prevalent but unnoticed rot phenomenon: extensive context causes models to directly give up or prematurely provide uncertain answers, and this issue is exacerbated as the context grows.

2606.29721.tldr: An equation-grounded anomaly taxonomy is proposed that is implementable under a limited AIS observation schema and extensible to other AIS datasets, and a unified score-synthesize-label pipeline that produces LLM-guided plausibility scores, uses them to synthesize anomalies, and assigns timestamp-level labels is introduced.

2606.29726.tldr: A three-stage multiple mediation model based on the personality trait-perception-behavioral response framework based on the optimum stimulation level (OSL) theory, complementarity theory, and perceived value theory is constructed and verifies.

2606.29727.tldr: DeepTrans Studio is presented, a collaborative translation workspace that lets professionals intercept selected nodes in an agentic translation workflow, review evidence, revise AI outputs, and save approved decisions to a shared team memory.

2606.29746.tldr: DDEEPMED Search is presented, a fully open-source, agentic platform designed for transparent medical deep research that integrates an introspective verification module, powered by a causal-consistent multi-agent debate framework, to validate retrieved evidence against diagnostic logic before synthesis.

2606.29748.tldr: This work demonstrates that an adversary can use the generator-discriminator technique to reconstruct high-quality graphs in real-world black-box attack scenarios against GNNs, and shows that GNNs are highly vulnerable to privacy attacks, varying Laplacian noise-scales.

2606.29758.tldr: Prefix-Sampling Proximal Policy Optimization (PS-PPO) is proposed, a compute-efficient critic-free method for RLHF that achieves large reductions in training compute and peak GPU memory, while maintaining accuracy comparable to strong critic-free baselines.

2606.29763.tldr: An LLM-based agentic framework that automates topology learning for medical image analysis, TopoAgent, which analyzes input images and their topological characteristics, reasons about which topological descriptors best suit the input, and determines the optimal descriptor and its configuration, all without task-specific training.

2606.29771.tldr: CLQT separates outcome from capability, yielding not a model ranking but a durable, extensible map of agent competencies and limitations, and is validated on a contamination-controlled multi-model backtest with an ablation grid and a live broker track.

2606.29776.tldr: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance spectroscopy is the gold standard for molecular structure elucidation, yet interpreting complex spectra for unknown molecules remains a bottleneck reliant on human expertise, so NMRAgent establishes a new paradigm for interpretable AI in analytical chemistry.

2606.29778.tldr: Mandol, an agglomerative memory system that consolidates fragmented memory representations and storage into a unified memory-native architecture, is proposed and Experiments on two widely used long-term conversation benchmarks show that Mandol achieves the best overall accuracy among representative agent memory systems.

2606.29783.tldr: FalconTrack is presented, a unified perception-and-tracking framework that (i) leverages a photorealistic editable simulator for automated label generation and (ii) combines multi-head perception with physics-aware tracking for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

2606.29784.tldr: Horse (History Enhanced RObust model evaluation), a novel framework that uses historical data to suppress bias (improve reliability) and reduce variance (improve sensitivity) in model performance evaluation, is introduced.

2606.29791.tldr: This work presents a theoretical study of the inlier-memorization effect, and describes not only the emergence of the IM effect, but also its strength and persistence, and analyze how these properties depend on the data distribution and parameter initialization.

2606.29797.tldr: Multi-Level Distributional Entropy (MDE) is proposed, an analytical framework that derives interpretable entropy features directly from flow-level summary statistics at three levels: within-flow Gaussian differential entropy, cross-directional Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), and Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) flag-pattern Shannon entropy, without raw packet access or training data.

2606.29799.tldr: The CRISTAL Method is introduced, a neurosymbolic framework for automating complex analysis workflows, with fundamental investment analysis as a primary use case, and achieves Bayes-optimal accuracy with just 5 examples and a 5-second budget.

2606.29806.tldr: This paper introduces the mean-expansion layer, which accelerates action-value learning by sharing values across actions within a state and by changing the problem from directly learning potentially large action-values to learning a lower-norm representation of them.

2606.29808.tldr: It is argued that chart data extraction should follow a progressive learning process similar to how people read charts, and the training framework substantially improves numerical accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art performance with a 7B-parameter model.

2606.29809.tldr: Five lightweight, CPU-feasible hallucination detection methods based on publicly available models are benchmarked and it is found that no single method dominates and performance is highly task-dependent.

2606.29820.tldr: This work proposes Dual-Flow RL, a unified actor-critic framework that jointly models a continuous return distribution and a multimodal policy distribution using conditional flow matching (CFM), and introduces an Entropy-Covariance Exploration Regulator (ECER) that enables state-aware exploration regulation leveraging policy entropy and action-uncertainty covariance.

2606.29823.tldr: Trellis turns inference-time search from disposable computation into a durable institutional asset: logs made databases reliable; experience graphs may make agents cumulative.

2606.29824.tldr: NPM is introduced, a training-free framework that represents agent memory through implicit activation steering rather than explicit instructions, and results show that combining implicit steering with explicit workflows provides complementary advantages, leading to more robust task execution.

2606.29844.tldr: Empirical results show that MATCH significantly improves the performance of sparse-attention models on both synthetic and real-world natural-language tasks, and highlight the versatility of MATCH as a general approach for enhancing in-context retrieval capabilities while maintaining the efficiency benefits of sparse attention architectures.

2606.29859.tldr: This study reveals how authors mention algorithm entities in academic writing and provides a basis for future research on algorithm relationship identification and algorithm impact evaluation.

2606.29861.tldr: This work develops a nonlinear State Space Model (SSM) inspired by robotics principles to capture the complex object dynamics and proposes a Selective Unscented Filter (SUF) for accurate state estimation, which features a joint scoring mechanism and dynamically fuses multi-source predictions to identify the most plausible object state over time.

2606.29867.tldr: Results reveal substantial variations in robustness across environments and show that some commonly used defenses can be more detrimental than the attacks they aim to mitigate, while temporal smoothing consistently achieves strong performance.

2606.29869.tldr: A reinforcement-learning-based adaptive KL-weighted distillation framework is proposed, in which a policy network dynamically assigns weights to FKL and RKL based on teacher-student distributional characteristics, guided by immediate reward signals to achieve dual alignment on principal and long-tail modes.

2606.29871.tldr: The results suggest that schema-conditioned LLMs can serve as bounded supervisory managers for live training runs, complementing conventional optimizers and schedulers with interpretable, multi-axis intervention capabilities.

2606.29876.tldr: Clinical reasoning graphs, structured graph representations extracted from free-text LLM diagnostic traces using a domain-grounded ontology with 5 node types and 7 edge types show diagnostic competence without schema-scale reasoning consistency, and indicate that final-answer accuracy should be complemented by process-level evaluation.

2606.29887.tldr: It is found that in-context policy guardrailing remains highly challenging: even the best-performing model, GPT-5.5, exactly identifies the full set of violated rules in only 54.0%, 35.3%, and 12.9% cases on L0, L1, and L2, respectively.

2606.29892.tldr: T^2VLA (Test-time VLA), an architecture-agnostic test-time RL framework that enables VLA models to achieve self-bootstrapping policy improvement, which leverages trajectory-level similarity to high-confidence expert demonstrations as an intrinsic reward signal.

2606.29894.tldr: SABER-Math is introduced, the first fully automated benchmark for evaluating mathematical IR without expert annotation, and it is shown that general-purpose IR benchmarks such as MTEB do not reliably predict mathematical performance, especially for recent embedding models, highlighting the need for math-specific retrieval benchmarks.

2606.29897.tldr: Experimental results show that child-domain adaptation improves intelligibility and perceptual quality while maintaining strong privacy protection, and highlight the importance of child-specific adaptation for practical speech anonymization systems.

2606.29898.tldr: This paper introduces Critical Interval MSE (CI-MSE), an intuitively simple yet effective offline validation metric that restricts error computation to task-critical segments and pairs it with simple action-alignment procedures that better match rollout-time behavior.

2606.29900.tldr: An LLM-based framework that semantically fuse facial action units (AUs) with textual responses of AVI is proposed that provides a psychologically grounded and computationally efficient framework for personality recognition in AVIs.

2606.29901.tldr: This work adopts an embedding-level self-supervised contrastive loss inspired by ATST-Frame pretraining, which combines composition mixup and perturbation mixup in one semi-supervised framework and defines the corresponding embedding-level contrastive losses.

2606.29907.tldr: CW-B combines fold-specific class-balanced instance weighting, missingness-indicator augmentation, and classwise error auditing to improve recognition of clinically prioritized phenotypes while preserving interpretable and auditable decision logic.

2606.29908.tldr: This work proposes SWAM (Spatial-perceiving World Action Model), a task-centric joint observation-action generation framework that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art two-stage planners in success rate, trajectory accuracy, and inference efficiency, while demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen environments.

2606.29911.tldr: A formal performance metric based on hypothetical interventions that enforce a given decision theory across a population - such as might be achieved through education or policy -- is introduced and it is shown that, under certain assumptions, personal decision theory is optimal with respect to this metric.

2606.29916.tldr: This work introduces EVAF, an Echo-Valence Attractor Field mechanism for gated LoRA consolidation, and a test-retest protocol for measuring selective parametric consolidation under controlled interference, which support a separation between memory access and memory depth.

2606.29928.tldr: Latent-CURE is proposed, a novel diagnostic framework driven by asymmetric weighted chain-of-thought methodology grounded in latent space reasoning grounded in latent space reasoning that provides transparent clinical evidence while achieving robust, accurate diagnostic performance in imbalanced medical cohorts.

2606.29929.tldr: HippoSpark is introduced, a state-level experience system that performs on-demand retrieval tailored to the immediate needs of the current reasoning state that outperforms both standard prompting and task-level experience baselines.

2606.29949.tldr: It is shown that training a lightweight alignment module atop frozen histopathology and RNA-Seq foundation models enables open-vocabulary molecular prompting -- querying H&E slides with gene-set signatures to predict pathway activity without sequencing or end-to-end retraining, achieving a 25-fold improvement in retrieval over baseline methods.

2606.29952.tldr: Fold is proposed, a lightweight flatness-modulated OOD detector that leverages the feature Hessian and partial feature normalization to improve ID-OOD separability while avoiding costly parameter-space curvature approximations.

2606.29955.tldr: A workflow-level benchmark for spreadsheet agents that covers three task categories: generation, debugging, and visualization, and indicates that insufficient spreadsheet inspection and incorrect target-cell selection are the dominant bottlenecks.

2606.29957.tldr: Experiments with frontier coding agents show that stronger agents generally achieve higher final success rates while requiring fewer interventions, suggesting an improved user experience.

2606.29961.tldr: DuoMem is introduced, a dual-space distillation framework that transfers procedural problem-solving ability from a large teacher model to compact student models and is viable for real-time edge deployment, which would be challenging for the teacher.

2606.29966.tldr: RiverONE, a lightweight vision-language model for quantum calibration plot understanding, is built using simulated quantum computation, which suggests that simulated quantum computation can serve as a practical construction-stage mechanism for building lightweight, knowledge-intensive scientific VLMs.

2606.29972.tldr: First-Order Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (FOT-LTN) is presented that is an extension of Logic Tensor Networks that fills this gap by considering a linear-temporal dimension and joins the syntax of First-Order Linear Temporal Logic with the fuzzy semantics of LTN obtaining a framework that supports both temporal operators and quantifiers.

2606.29983.tldr: This work suggests that "when to stop" should be treated as a training-time design choice, not merely an inference-time computation-allocation rule.

2606.29984.tldr: A Faithful Warm-Start (FWS) strategy is proposed that first curates samples with explicit vision-language causal relationships from six general VQA benchmarks to construct the FaithfulQA dataset, and a VLM-based judge is employed to further purify the dataset, ensuring strong causal consistency and visual faithfulness.

2606.29999.tldr: Experiments on competitive programming and combinatorial optimization benchmarks show that AlgoSkill improves over direct LLM generation, chain-of-thought prompting, self-refinement, and MCTS without typed skills, which support treating automatic algorithm design as verification-guided skill scheduling rather than one-shot code generation.

2606.30011.tldr: T3R is proposed, leveraging multiple Rotograd matrices to improve task affinity between the target and auxiliary tasks, essential for effective test-time training and introduces a rotation technique that reorients self-supervised signals using these matrices to create surrogate gradients for the target task, allowing deeper adaptation across nearly the entire architecture.

2606.30024.tldr: This paper proposes IBRSteG, a generalizable framework for 3DGS steganography that enables undetectable concealment of secret scenes within a steganographic scene and introduces GAS (Gaussian Attributes Steganographer), a network that learns a scene-independent embedding function by injecting the attributes of secret 3D Gaussian points into a cover scene.

2606.30026.tldr: Musebench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs on nuanced artistic understanding that reveals that even the best-performing model achieves only 48.29% accuracy, substantially below human expert performance, exposing a significant gap in current models' creative domain expertise.

2606.30062.tldr: This study investigates how smaller language models perform during the generation stage within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system and demonstrates that a RAG system with small language models can be executed directly on-device without requiring any GPU hardware within a reasonable time.

2606.30067.tldr: This work proves that in cyclic environments any memoryless allocation policy incurs cumulative regret Omega(T(M-1)Delta_switch) relative to a history-aware policy backed by the Bank, and finds that a simple similarity-based retrieval rule matches or beats a learned reinforcement-learning controller.

2606.30077.tldr: GAIA (Global Adaptive Instruction tuning via GAussian processes), a framework that formulates data valuation as a global estimation process that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines like \greats, establishing the method as a scalable and robust solution for efficient instruction tuning.

2606.30090.tldr: This work integrates interpretable visualization with the automated extraction of latent tactical patterns from high-dimensional sequence data and develops a rule-based multi-label extraction method to transform unstructured state-action sequences into discrete and interpretable tactical labels.

2606.30092.tldr: HRL-IM/CBS is proposed, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework with influence map hashing and cluster-based scripts for StarCraft micromanagement that decomposes decision-making into upper-level clustering strategy selection and lower-level tactical execution, with reward allocation providing dense learning signals.

2606.30104.tldr: Although not specifically adapted to EEG, the pretrained TSFM serves as an effective temporal feature extractor, suggesting that general-purpose time-series representations can be transferred as frozen temporal feature extractors within EEG foundation models.

2606.30105.tldr: A sound framework for quantitative verification under imprecise probabilistic information is proposed, combining interval belief structures to represent marginal uncertainty with imprecise copulas to model uncertain dependence and develops a propagation method for imprecisely coupled interval belief structures through feed-forward neural networks.

2606.30107.tldr: This work introduces Physics-Anchored Certification (PHACT), a propose-certify loop spanning five scientific domains, and identifies what makes such a certificate trustworthy.

2606.30113.tldr: SA-VLA is proposed, a state-aware action tokenizer that conditions action decoding on robot state and demonstrates that state-conditioned action decoding is a simple and effective mechanism for reducing the compression gap in discrete VLA policies.

2606.30116.tldr: It is highlighted that constitutions should be evaluated as constitution--executor systems, with implications for LLMs-as-a-judge broadly, and that principle refinement (ICAI+) may be a first step towards ameliorating these problems.

2606.30128.tldr: What matters is what the extra tokens do (the reasoning and validation content they carry), not how many there are, a picture neither a pure forward-pass-compute nor a pure semantic-content account fully explains.

2606.30131.tldr: A hyper-network is introduced that predicts non-linear neural functional maps (NFM) in an unsupervised manner, learned in an unsupervised manner, to better align spectral bases.

2606.30133.tldr: A spreading-activation method that achieves the same query-aware traversal with a single per-step semantic gate: the step weight is the cosine similarity between the candidate entity's description and the question, and the number of iterations is fixed.

2606.30145.tldr: Through extensive experiments, ablation studies, and a user study, it is shown that FacePlex enables full-duplex joint speech-facial motion generation under online streaming constraints, while achieving stronger lip-sync quality and motion fidelity than audio-driven facial motion baselines.

2606.30152.tldr: The first attempt to disentangle grammatical gender from semantic contamination for contextual embeddings is made, revealing that unweighted controlled contexts yield the purest grammatical gender direction, and the centroid estimator achieves better performance than discriminative baselines.

2606.30156.tldr: A Physically-Constrained Harmonic Separation (PCHS) framework is proposed that formulates HR and RR estimation from wrist PPG as an analysis-by-synthesis problem, where accelerometer measurements condition artifact separation rather than directly regressing vital signs are considered.

2606.30161.tldr: This work proposes a framework that refines client aggregation weights using Conditional Random Fields (CRFs), and defines unary potentials for individual clients and pairwise potentials for all client pairs, allowing the server to model both client-specific reliability and interactions between clients.

2606.30185.tldr: Dynamo, a training-free framework that adapts a frozen VLM without any weight updates, improves direct inference on all 20 model--benchmark settings and combines additively with RL when available.

2606.30190.tldr: A novel algorithm, namely Continual Vision-Language Consolidation (CVLC), is proposed to address the FSDIL problem, where the key idea lies in the concept of latent space reservation in the base domain coupled with dual coalescent projection (DCP) as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method.

2606.30191.tldr: The durable residue is formalized as an operational behavioral self and it is argued that self-caused credit doing slow work is a necessary building block for agents that develop a self.

2606.30192.tldr: AIDA (Adaptive Imagination for Domain Adaptation), a domain adaptation framework for visual reinforcement learning that addresses sim-to-real transfer under scarce target data without requiring additional interaction with the target environment, is proposed.

2606.30196.tldr: It is demonstrated that certain embedding dimensions are sensitive to perturbations and can serve as indicators of decoding anomalies, and an accurate detector is successfully built by leveraging the consistency between successive encoding and decoding.

2606.30206.tldr: It is argued that through the pricing of artificial intelligence Capital distils most clearly the value of intelligence and allows for its comparison across the organism - mechanism divide.

2606.30209.tldr: A multi center breast fine needle aspiration cytology (FNAC) dataset designed for patch wise classification using C1 to C5 reporting labels is presented, designed for patch wise classification using C1 to C5 reporting labels.

2606.30215.tldr: This work proposes a sparse fusion mechanism for efficient RGB-T detection: first rapidly scanning the image to identify the proposals and then carefully examining the remaining sparse proposals via feature fusion, which achieves competitive performance with substantially fewer parameters and lower cost, while maintaining strong scalability to high-resolution images.

2606.30246.tldr: Clarus reformulates research as an open, auditable, attributable, and resource-aware multi-phase collaboration process and provides an initial foundation for open research networks.

2606.30256.tldr: This work presents EMPATH, a benchmark for safety evaluation of emotional-support chatbots, and studies the measurement properties of the benchmark through judge calibration and cross-family inter-judge agreement.

2606.30258.tldr: It is shown that injecting domain-specific structural knowledge during fine-tuning yields meaningful gains over vanilla variants in specialist settings, whereas gains on general-domain tasks are marginal.

2606.30263.tldr: Dual-Reference SFT (DR-SFT), which adapts DPO-style contrastive objective design to SFT through token-level regularization, mitigating harmful fine-tuning beyond coarse data filtering.

2606.30266.tldr: This work introduces low-rank adaptation (LoRA) variants designed to mitigate inter-task interference and proposes mixture-of-experts architectures that utilize an autoencoder-based router to select task-specific experts at inference time, so that no task-label is needed.

2606.30291.tldr: Results show that PromptGNN-sim outperforms classical GNNs, LLMs, and recent GNN-LLM fusion methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of interactive structure-semantic collaboration for text-attributed graph learning.

2606.30294.tldr: Rhetor is proposed, a multi-agent system that takes a running web application and its source-code repository as input and produces a rehearsed live demonstration with segment-synchronized narration and real-time voice question answering.

2606.30304.tldr: Mistral offers a high-performance, operationally efficient, and secure solution for large-scale analysis of sensitive grant data, outperforming the fragmented DSIT-Taxonomies approach.

2606.30306.tldr: The Always-On Evaluation Protocol (AOEP-v0) is introduced, a pilot evaluation contract that makes these governance requirements concrete by scoring state mutation and recovery obligations rather than answer quality alone.

2606.30317.tldr: Five recurring MCP server architectural patterns observed across an enumerated corpus of fifteen independently developed servers are cataloged: Resource Gateway, Tool Orchestrator, Stateful Session Server, Proxy Aggregator, and Domain-Specific Adapter.

2606.30335.tldr: This work introduces BayesEvolve, a belief-guided discovery framework that converts experimental evidence into a predictive belief state and uses this belief to guide future experimentation and improves sample efficiency over memory- and archive-guided LLM baselines under a fixed evaluation budget.

2606.30344.tldr: End-to-end CIFAR-10 training shows that low early cue precision improves pre-target conflict behavior, but shortcut-rich fine-tuning can rapidly overwrite this benefit; Cue decorrelation must be maintained during downstream adaptation rather than treated as a one-time inoculation.

2606.30345.tldr: Evaluated across five benchmarks and three model scales, DRIFT surpasses the peak performance of both GRPO and SDPO across all evaluated metrics and sets a new state-of-the-art and substantially outperforming all concurrent methods.

2606.30355.tldr: A discrepancy-aware noise regularization that adaptively perturbs the residual router's decisions when the feature router deviates, enhancing expert robustness under imperfect imitation is developed.

2606.30362.tldr: This work proposes ReactiveBFM, a real-time closed-loop planning-control framework that effectively mitigate exposure bias via a scheduled prefix sampling curriculum, forcing the generative planner to actively learn error-recovery behaviors from imperfect physical states rather than ground-truth trajectories.

2606.30372.tldr: A well-calibrated LLM achieves the Bayes-optimal risk for conditional-mean-dependent inference, bounded by explicit scope conditions, which means that under satisfied conditions and well-calibrated models, large language models can be used in many prediction and decision-making tasks, approximating near-optimal statistical inference at lower cost.

2606.30374.tldr: A probabilistic representation framework that models representations as Gaussian distributions, where their mean captures task information and their variance measures uncertainty from missing evidence, and is introduced, which offers superior performance over baselines across diverse missing-modality scenarios.

2606.30383.tldr: A rapidly growing class of LLM agents is multi-party: the agent acts for a principal while also conversing in a separate channel with a counterparty whose interests may diverge, and the agent must stay loyal to the principal it represents without over-refusing the principal's own cooperative asks.

2606.30398.tldr: Extensive experiments on Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset demonstrate that ENC-ODE outperforms representative sequence models while offering a scalable and neuroscientifically grounded solution for clinical support.

2606.30410.tldr: BeyondArena is the first unified holistic benchmark for tabular data that supports diverse task types (IID, temporal, grouped), across sample size and feature dimensionality scales, with diverse feature types from a broad range of disciplines.

2606.30417.tldr: This work forms VF forecasting as a probabilistic prediction problem and uses conditioned denoising diffusion models to generate distributions of plausible future VFs from longitudinal observations with irregular follow-up intervals, highlighting the advantages of distributional modeling for VF forecasting.

2606.30442.tldr: This work observes a new and critical scaling dimension: the duration of the Feedback Information Loop, the time required for a system to receive a verification signal after generating a prediction, and proposes a method that is orthogonal to purely data-driven approaches, based on human-inspired expert knowledge.

2606.30454.tldr: Test LLM agents against a direct empirical benchmark: a large-scale networked Prisoner's Dilemma experiment with human participants reveals a macro--micro dissociation in LLM-based social agents: collective outcomes can appear human-like even when the underlying behavioral distributions and mechanisms are not.

2606.30473.tldr: Permutation-invariant fine-tuning is proposed, which serializes each record under a freshly sampled field order with random field dropout, so meaning binds to the labels rather than to position.

2606.30479.tldr: COHORT is the first end-to-end framework to automate this procedure for deployable mitigations, and across three topologies and four attack scenarios, 46.7% of generated mitigations both disrupt the attack and preserve connectivity under replay.

2606.30491.tldr: Downstream evaluation suggests that SIMAX can assess how a communication coding system responds to behavioral targets and reveal insufficient sensitivity in some dimensions, providing a data foundation for developing, validating, and refining communication coding systems.

2606.30498.tldr: This work analyzes the learned projections directly and identifies two failure cases: First, for concept projections learned from auxiliary data, covariate shifts can lead to unfaithful concept representations for the target task, and second, systematic label noise in surrogate concept labels generated by vision-language models leads to unfaithful projections.

2606.30512.tldr: This work establishes the Shannon-Topological Bottleneck Theorem, proving that when a target boundary's geometric complexity exceeds this informational horizon, the system undergoes a sudden entropic phase transition and falls into a state of Informational Frustration.

2604.02371.tldr: A synthetic data pipeline for reasoning in long-document understanding that generates thinking traces by scoring each page for question relevance, extracting textual evidence and ordering it from most to least relevant is introduced.

2605.00994.tldr: A simple perplexity-based method can reveal the finetuning objectives of model organisms by exploiting a widespread tendency to overgeneralize finetuned behaviors beyond intended contexts and achieves state-of-the-art success at detecting hidden behaviors on AuditBench.

2605.31603.tldr: The proposed Lumos-Nexus is a training-efficient unified video generation framework that facilitates the development of strong reasoning-driven generation capabilities while significantly enhancing visual fidelity, and introduces VR-Bench, which assesses a model's capability to translate inferred intent into coherent and semantically aligned video content.

2606.30531.tldr: These findings show that safe tool use requires not only selecting the correct tool, but also reliably binding natural-language references to the correct real-world entity before action, and that safe tool use requires not only selecting the correct tool, but also reliably binding natural-language references to the correct real-world entity before action.

2606.30537.tldr: Rollout-Retrieval Lifelong Policy Learning (R$^2$LPL), a policy learning framework that retrieves corrective targets from recoverable policy-induced mistakes and retains the resulting knowledge through lifelong policy learning, is proposed.

2606.30544.tldr: Observed Transition Factorization (OTF), which decomposes each transition into a sparse set of observed transition primitives and proposes OTF-LAM, which abstracts motion primitives into action-like latents within the standard inverse-forward dynamics framework, and OTF-LAM-Dino, a decoder-free variant that predicts future states in a frozen DINOv2 representation space.

2606.30549.tldr: Clover, a code completion tool that logs students' interactions with code suggestions and additionally offers attention checks to probe reflective engagement during programming tasks, is presented and a taxonomy of behavioral interaction metrics for AI-assisted programming is developed.

2606.30561.tldr: The Human Creativity Benchmark (HCB) is presented, a benchmark that operationalizes this separation between convergence and divergence in creative AI by collecting pairwise preferences, scalar ratings on prompt adherence, usability, and visual appeal, and qualitative rationale from domain professionals.

2606.30572.tldr: This work proposes a unified multi-task malware analysis framework based on Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures, and investigates multiple architectural variants, including Homogeneous MoE, Heterogeneous MoE, and Multi-Gate MoE (MMoE).

2606.30576.tldr: This work introduces \dataset, a large-scale, high-fidelity building dataset comprising over 220,000 ground-satellite and drone-satellite pairs, and proposes a novel single-stage Geometry-Aware Geo-localization framework (GAGeo), built upon the permutation-equivariant 3D foundation model $\pi^3$.

2606.30587.tldr: A proof-of-concept black-box cognitive attack that can suppress up to 97% of previously detected vulnerabilities is demonstrated and indicates that cognitive susceptibility is a consistent and exploitable property of LLM-based vulnerability detection.

2606.30602.tldr: Mesa is introduced, a label-free framework for proactively ranking which MAS edges are most security-critical -- that is, most likely to affect the system's decision if compromised, allowing proactive hardening of multi-agent infrastructures.

2606.30609.tldr: Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that C$^2$R effectively mitigates both splitting and absorption while, crucially, preserving reconstruction fidelity, providing a principled solution that enhances latent interpretability without degrading model performance.

2606.30625.tldr: By analyzing the optimization dynamics, this work derives an analytic formula demonstrating that embedding length naturally encodes this information as a byproduct of the training process, providing a grounded explanation for a previously heuristic observation.

2606.30626.tldr: DOPD is proposed, an advantage-aware dual distillation paradigm that dynamically routes token-level supervision between privileged teacher and privileged student policies based on their advantage gap and relative probabilities that consistently outperforms Vanilla OPD and other counterparts.

2606.30627.tldr: A power-law curve is fitted to the data and identified as a practical optimal conservatism level $\beta^{\star}$ that balances alignment fidelity against hacking vulnerability, suggesting that the field needscalibrated, notmaximal, conservatism.

2606.30632.tldr: This work introduces GROW$^2 (GROunding Which and Where), which leverages object parts as a natural abstraction to split the grounding process hierarchically into semantic and geometric levels, thus bypassing the need for data-heavy, end-to-end training.

2606.30639.tldr: Extensive experiments show that WorldEvolver achieves the highest prediction accuracy across three backbones and leads other world model baselines on downstream agent success rate, demonstrating that test-time memory revision enhances both predictive fidelity and planning performance.

2606.30642.tldr: LeVo 2 outperforms open-source baselines across six subjective dimensions, and approaches leading commercial systems on several listening metrics, as well as mitigating optimization conflict and the limitations of static offline preference pairs.

2606.30645.tldr: This work generates vision-language-kinematics (VLK) supervision synthetically in reconstructed scenes and evaluates on the physical Unitree G1 performing navigation and single-object transport, demonstrating that synthesized interactions in reconstructed scenes provide effective supervision for sim-to-real perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation.

2405.12775.tldr: A novel unsupervised multimodal clustering method (UMC), making a pioneering contribution to this field by introducing a unique approach to constructing augmentation views for multimodal data, which are then used to perform pre-training to establish well-initialized representations for subsequent clustering.

2509.00930.tldr: SATQuest is presented, a verifier that generates diverse SAT-based reasoning tasks directly from Conjunctive Normal Form instances and checks answers objectively with PySAT, enabling fine-grained, multi-dimensional analysis and reinforcement fine-tuning.

2504.17356.tldr: Compared to contemporary or the one-feature-one-agent RL-based approaches, HRLFS improves the downstream ML performance with iterative feature subspace exploration while accelerating total run time by reducing the number of agents involved.

2502.04411.tldr: This work observes that different layers exhibit varying levels of parameter conflicts, and uses a novel task-level expert routing for layers with significant conflicts to average layers with minimal parameter conflicts and use a novel task-level expert routing for layers with significant conflicts.

2505.20161.tldr: This work shows that data diversity can be a strong predictor of generalization in LLM reasoning -- as measured by average model performance on unseen out-of-distribution benchmarks, and introduces G-Vendi, a metric that quantifies diversity via the entropy of model-induced gradients.

2307.00493.tldr: The mathematical definition of FWin attention is given, and its equivalency to the canonical full attention under the block diagonal invertibility (BDI) condition of the attention matrix is verified to hold with high probability on benchmark datasets experimentally.

2505.02722.tldr: This work constructed reasoning-intensive questions from a nationwide sepsis registry and fine-tuned Phi-4 on these questions using reinforcement learning, resulting in C-Reason, which exhibited strong clinical reasoning capabilities on the in-domain test set, as evidenced by both quantitative metrics and expert evaluations.

2509.14335.tldr: MalEval, a diagnostic framework for measuring the capability boundaries of LLMs in malware auditing, is introduced and finds that they rely on surface cues rather than verifiable evidence, struggle to compose dispersed facts into coherent attack chains, and are highly sensitive to context formulation.

2509.00446.tldr: This work introduces NEWSAGENT, a benchmark for evaluating how agents search raw materials, select relevant information, and iteratively revise drafts through core journalistic functions, and believes that NEWSAGENT serves a realistic testbed for iterating and evaluating agent capabilities in terms of web data manipulation to real-world productivity.

2507.07247.tldr: This study benchmarking eight attention mechanisms in training GPT-2 architecture reveals that attention mechanisms with optimized kernel implementations, including Flash Attention, Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) Attention, and Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), achieve the best energy efficiency.

2403.06025.tldr: A new approach using computer vision to predict the land surface displacement from subsurface geometry images for Carbon Capture and Seques- tration (CCS) and shows ResNetUNet outperforms the others thanks to its architecture in static mechanics problem, and LSTM shows comparable performance to transformer in transient problem.

2507.08392.tldr: This study proposes a framework for generating ethics requirements drafts by introducing an ethics advocate agent in a multi-agent LLM setting and highlights reliability issues in generating ethics requirements, emphasizing the need for human feedback in this sensitive domain.

2507.06445.tldr: This work proposes and demonstrates an alternate objective for a new interpretability objective: understanding model internals to predict behavior and assess reliability under distribution shift, and successfully uses attention patterns to predict which rule each model follows on OOD data.

2507.05515.tldr: This work explores LEGO Co-builder, a hybrid benchmark combining real-world LEGO assembly logic with programmatically generated multimodal scenes, and introduces a unified framework and assess leading VLMs such as GPT-4o, Gemini, and Qwen-VL, under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings.

2506.12190.tldr: BreastDCEDL fills a critical gap in public imaging resources, supporting development of advanced models for pCR prediction and other breast cancer analyses, and is designed for broad reuse and is accompanied by processing tools to support community-driven AI research in oncology.

2412.04704.tldr: It is suggested that improving traceability in practice requires a shift to data-centric engineering, focusing on artifact quality, consistency, and information alignment; rather than solely advancing model sophistication (or complexity).

2503.23536.tldr: This survey offers a comprehensive review of ULD, examining unlearnable data generation methods, public benchmarks, evaluation metrics, theoretical foundations and practical applications, and discusses key challenges, such as balancing perturbation imperceptibility with model degradation and the computational complexity of ULD generation.

2606.07559.tldr: Five transformer architectures of two families of two families over a fivefold parameter range are studied, on ten contexts where the correct completion and nearest competitor overlap substantially and an order parameter is constructed combining the predicted distribution with the geometric overlap between token embeddings.

2604.09757.tldr: Results show that latent visual reasoning provides an effective mechanism for preserving diagnostically relevant visual evidence and improving the reliability of medical VQA.

2604.03614.tldr: This work presents a novel neural approach that learns to find global minima through iterative refinement of noisy function samples and their fitted spline representation as input, then iteratively refines an initial guess toward the true global minimum.

2607.16204.tldr: This work formalizes text-based world modeling as a steerable transition-dynamics problem decomposed into initial state, task context, tool schemas, domain rules, and steering directives, and curate 239,403 grounded state-action trajectories spanning nine open-source environments and twelve frontier model families.

2607.16196.tldr: The study demonstrates that emotionally meaningful, privacy-preserving touch interpretation is computationally feasible for direct embedding within soft therapeutic companions, with hardware integration addressed in a forthcoming study.

2607.16206.tldr: Empirical evaluations on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks demonstrate that PPO-HSC significantly enhances solution diversity and state-space coverage while maintaining or surpassing the accuracy and syntax integrity of state-of-the-art RL baselines.

2607.16201.tldr: The Node Coverage Score, a novel evaluation metric that measures the fraction of structural ontology nodes appearing in generated outputs, is introduced and shows that GOI-prompted generation covers 95-100% of the structural backbone in every case.

2607.16200.tldr: This work formalises the agent execution model, defines the request-key matching function K(s), and proves the determinism invariant, and introduces a noise-aware diff algorithm classifying HTTP header divergence into signal and noise tiers.

2607.16199.tldr: This work introduces PlanFlip, a framework comprising four planning-phase prompt injection attacks -- GoalSubstitution, PriorityInversion, PriorityInversion, ContextPollution, and RoleConfusion -- each disguised as plausible tool outputs to evade keyword filters.

2607.04071.tldr: MTEB-PT is presented, a Portuguese benchmark constructed from a subset of MMTEB, comprising 14 existing datasets across Semantic Textual Similarity (STS), classification, retrieval, and reranking, and shows that language-specific fine-tuning still improves model performance in Portuguese, especially on task types that match the adaptation data most closely.

2607.16203.tldr: This work proposes DocOCR-Eval, an annotation-free evaluation framework for automatic OCR assessment and selection that employs a three-staged correction and ranking strategy to approximate annotation-based tool ordering without ground-truth labels and shows that aggregating across multiple MLLMs progressively improves alignment with annotation-based rankings.

2607.04438.tldr: ResearchStudio-Reel is presented, a native-editable dissemination workspace that binds its three artifacts into one interactive deliverable at the experience level, implemented as five skills executable in Claude Code and Codex: one shared extractor, three editable artifact generators, and one interactive convergence layer.

2607.16208.tldr: This work evaluates replacing the visual candidate-ranking operator over graph-linked image nodes with late-interaction MaxSim-style multi-vector scoring in the ColBERT/ColPali lineage, while keeping offline graph construction, text- and table-side retrieval, structured extraction, and downstream reasoning unchanged.

2607.16205.tldr: W2SPO is introduced, an off policy RL method that injects short auxiliary segments often as brief as 8 tokens into intermediate target model trajectories and the target model then completes the reasoning path from these diverted states, suggesting that weak auxiliary branches can induce stronger target reasoning policies by expanding local exploration support.
