2607.04290.tldr: Agentic-V2X is introduced, an architecture where a small, locally deployed language model acts as a periodic non-real-time rApp-inspired policy creator, while a lightweight xApp-like controller executes validated policies at intervals suitable for scheduling.

2607.04292.tldr: Agentic SABRE (Semantic-Behavioural Arbitration for Ransomware Evaluation), an uncertainty-aware, neuro-symbolic, multi-agent framework for adaptive ransomware detection, fuses semantic, representation-based evidence with behavioural, time-window forensic telemetry and employs Monte Carlo Dropout inference to quantify epistemic uncertainty for each agent.

2607.04293.tldr: CausalGame provides a scalable and controlled testbed for evaluating the causal thinking of AI Scientist agents through interactive games, and designs 14 scenarios that incorporate selection bias, measurement error, and hidden confounders.

2607.04302.tldr: HiFA4 is a post-training operator-level design that executes both QK^T and PV in FlashAttention as 4-bit HIF4 Cube GEMMs for LLM inference on Ascend NPUs, while maintaining the online softmax state in FP16, the first Ascend-HIF4-targeted design of this kind evaluated on standard NLP benchmarks.

2607.04329.tldr: HAS-Framework is introduced, a graph-based framework that represents humans and LLM-powered agents as first-class participants with explicit roles, permissions, communication paths, and action authority, and HAS-Bench evaluates Human-Agent Systems under configurable human participation across agency levels, interaction channels, and persona policies.

2607.04336.tldr: The proposed YAACS system achieves a classification accuracy of 88.6% with a false positive rate of 0.6%, demonstrating that incorporating temporal context through sequence modelling is critical for minimising false accusations in FPS cheat detection.

2607.04339.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive study of a unified membership inference framework that applies across text-to-text, text-to-image, and image-to-text modalities, and demonstrates its superior performance in comparison to existing state-of-the-art methods, which are typically optimized for a single model class.

2607.04344.tldr: IRIS, an Intelligent Recognition and Interaction System tailored for fine-grained OSD understanding via external eye photography, and a synergistic data generation paradigm to explicitly inject clinical priors are proposed, underscore that structured knowledge injection profoundly prevails over sheer parameter scaling.

2607.04353.tldr: A hierarchy-aware self-supervised training framework that combines a distillation framework with a segmentation teacher to improve morphological awareness in the latent space and a hierarchy-aware contrastive loss based on HDBSCAN to improve decision boundaries between closely related subtypes at different hierarchical levels is proposed.

2607.04389.tldr: Experiments on question-answering and forecasting benchmarks across heterogeneous models and private-information settings show that WALLA matches centralized aggregation methods in predictive performance, while simultaneously achieving decentralized learning, advantage-aligned aggregation weights, uncertainty awareness, and incentive-compatible prediction.

2607.04394.tldr: The MechMath Agent Team (MMAT) is presented, which is a large language model driven agent designed to serve as a co-pilot throughout the full cycle of mathematical research, and a tripartite Harness Architecture that decouples system responsibilities into Control, Execution, and Augmentation planes, thereby reconciling rigorous logical control with the agility demanded by open-ended research.

2607.04412.tldr: LLM-as-a-Tutor is introduced, a framework that extends the LLM's role from judge to tutor: a single model serves as an examiner that pairwise-compares policy rollouts to detect non-challenging prompts, and as a generator that appends atomic constraints to them.

2607.04422.tldr: This work proposes Full-Stack FP4, the first complete NVFP4 pretraining framework resolving all three stability bottlenecks via module-wise precision strategies, and validates near-BF16 performance with merely 1.47% loss gap, verifying feasible stable end-to-end NVFP4 LLM pretraining.

2607.04428.tldr: dOPSD derives the teacher's privilege directly from the student's own denoising trajectory, evaluating masked positions using later, more-decoded steps of that same trajectory rather than an external label, so the teacher's advantage emerges from the model's own decoding process.

2607.04429.tldr: Evalci, a pure-Python library that turns a per-item results table into a publication-ready claim, and re-analyzes a public comparison of nine language models'MMLU accuracy to find that 3 of the 8 adjacent leaderboard-rank gaps are not statistically significant after correcting for the 36 pairwise comparisons the ranking implies.

2607.04432.tldr: Applying the same geometric lens to cross-token behavioral entanglement in instruction-tuned LLMs, the effect appears to be activated by alignment training, acting on an inherited substrate, and that the standard log-ratio metric produces an apparent frequency bias that is largely a circularity artifact.

2607.04436.tldr: Results show that the proposed approach can detect pragmatic ambiguities and produce candidate disambiguated requirements that are relevant, clear, and consistent with the intended system functionality.

2607.04439.tldr: Blind automated-judge evaluations show that IdeaSpark consistently produces stronger research proposals than no-skill and generic-skill baselines while maintaining competitive novelty.

2607.04440.tldr: A conditional diffusion-based wavefield propagator that advances seismic wavefields recursively from one time step to the next, conditioned by a short history of recent wavefield time steps, the velocity model, and the wavefield time step index is introduced.

2607.04448.tldr: An automated regulation-to-requirements pipeline that identifies requirement-bearing clauses in regulatory documents and derives system-agnostic software requirements, accompanied by plain-language explanations, traceable to their legal sources is presented.

2607.04450.tldr: This work is the first study of the capabilities and limits of DL based surrogate modeling in approximating the challenging, highly non-linear physics of ASTEC.

2607.04453.tldr: A novel robustness verification framework for in-situ plankton classifiers based on reachability analysis and a continuous-time neural ordinary differential equation (neural ODE) classification model leveraging the high-resolution imaging capabilities of the SilCam particle imager are proposed.

2607.04470.tldr: It is shown that dynamically updating LLM-generated reward weights during off-policy MARL violates the stationarity assumption of Potential-Based Reward Shaping and contaminates the experience replay buffer, indicating that regime placement is a practical predictor of whether dynamic LLM shaping helps or harms.

2607.04478.tldr: By integrating architectural diversity, multi-scale attention, hierarchical meta-learning, and rigorous explainability, the proposed framework provides a transparent, highly accurate, and clinically practical computer-aided diagnosis system for thoracic disease classification.

2607.04487.tldr: Across six variants combining three encoders with two decoders, it is found that graph inductive bias improves both representational predictability and decoder sanity, that the Mixture-of-Experts encoder represents constraints in a distributed rather than axis-aligned way, and that the Recourse training regime produces policies that represent infeasibility usefully.

2607.04508.tldr: Together, under a single agent, these components aim to accelerate the SDL loop by reducing both the number of loops and the cost per experiment.

2607.04517.tldr: Experiments on RL4VLA and VL-Think show that language-conditioning space optimization improves success on instruction-sensitive, symbolic, and multi-object manipulation tasks, demonstrating that language can serve as an optimizable variable for a robot foundation models.

2607.04525.tldr: Together, these findings show that models share a common geometry not only in how concepts are represented, but more importantly in how context transforms them, a structure with richer organization than prior work has recognized.

2607.04526.tldr: First-shot anomalous sound detection in DCASE Challenge Task 2 must flag anomalies of unseen machine types with a single threshold, without knowing whether a test clip comes from the data-rich source domain or the data-scarce target domain, with a training-free post-hoc layer over frozen audio embeddings.

2607.04528.tldr: A belief-rollout diagnostic is introduced that elicits structured K-step trajectories over progress, risk, recoverability, constraints, failure mode, uncertainty, future success, repair cost, and next action under alternative harnesses and suggests that harness design is an experimental variable in agent evaluation, not an implementation detail.

2607.04531.tldr: Results demonstrate that Lyapunov-based state control can act as a hardware-aware stabilisation mechanism for reliable fixed-point neural inference and training.

2607.04537.tldr: This work evaluates code language models across four experiments designed to assess whether models resist or obey incorrect instructions in single-pass and iterative repair settings, using the RunBugRun dataset of algorithmic Python problems with deterministic test cases to reveal a striking behavioral pattern.

2607.04541.tldr: Experiments on nuScenes show that CRISP improves long-horizon point cloud forecasting and transfers effectively to downstream tasks, suggesting that predictive CR pretraining is a promising path toward scalable driving representations under practical sensor configurations.

2607.04542.tldr: Auto is presented, a compiler that records live agent behavior, measures which parts are secretly deterministic, extracts them into verified programs or distilled specialists, and emits cognition binaries: WebAssembly artifacts whose manifests carry measured guarantees and whose declared capabilities are physically enforced by the sandbox.

2607.04546.tldr: Mask2Real-WM is presented, a two-stage action-conditioned world model for dexterous manipulation that decouples pixel prediction into a dynamics model and a rendering model that shows that mask conditioning and simulation pretraining are both required for per-DoF action controllability across all 23 degrees of freedom.

2607.04553.tldr: A bidirectional framework for estimating the energy consumption of text-to-video (T2V) and text-to-video-audio-audio models from architectural first principles and observable generation parameters, requiring no access to weights, model size, or implementation details.

2607.04557.tldr: PREDIKTOR is proposed, a patient-centered multi-view framework that aligns a personalized network view with a transferable transcriptomic perturbation view to predict clinical drug response and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under patient-, drug- and tissue-split evaluations, and transfers zero-shot to the I-SPY2 trial.

2607.04562.tldr: Heaviside Continuity of Rolling Coefficients (HCRC), a verification-first execution framework that reformulates inference as predicate-gated state transitions governed by a Heaviside Gate, is introduced, showing that reliable reasoning can be achieved through principled execution control rather than model scale alone.

2607.04574.tldr: Bounded unfiltered teacher continuations at learner-induced contexts improve over pure behavioral cloning at matched budgets and suggest that a few teacher steps, placed at learner-induced contexts, can be a more cost-efficient supervision allocation than longer or more heavily curated teacher completions.

2607.04579.tldr: An LLM-based CI/CD analysis pipeline that combines repository enrichment, anti-pattern detection, stage mining, and recommendation generation over a large GitHub corpus is presented, arguing for CI/CD observability that combines diagnosis, context, and human review.

2607.04590.tldr: It is shown that limited attention can fundamentally distort what pairwise comparisons reveal, and suggests that human feedback should be treated not as direct revealed preference, but as an attention-limited measurement process: a weak preference signal may reflect hidden evaluation difficulty rather than genuine indifference.

2607.04591.tldr: This work proposes a simple-to-complex structured demonstration collection strategy for VLA learning using a dual-arm robotic platform that enables VLA models to first acquire fundamental manipulation skills before learning increasingly complex task compositions, facilitating more effective learning of long-horizon manipulation tasks.

2607.04593.tldr: This work introduces TORINO (TOken Reduction via Interpretable coNcept Overlap), a plug-and-play framework for adaptive visual token reduction in VLMs that requires no fine-tuning of the underlying model.

2607.04603.tldr: This work derives a Latent Consistent Proximal (LCP) solver that evolves each latent variable from its previous state rather than reconstructing through an indirect residual, and stabilizes small target updates through task-adaptive normalization and gain control.

2607.04607.tldr: G2VD introduces a counterfactual intervention pipeline that generates controlled counterfactual samples via variational autoencoders (VAEs), followed by frequency-domain and pixel-domain alignment, thereby encouraging the detector to focus on generator-intrinsic cues and design a causal disentanglement classifier.

2607.04613.tldr: It is shown that confinement can be guaranteed as an invariant of the agent's execution architecture rather than a probabilistic outcome of its training, and no amount of learning, skill acquisition, or self-induced governance abstraction can widen the agent's permitted authority without an operator-signed change to its identity.

2607.04616.tldr: This work introduces a sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) framework for multi-stage cable routing that leverages GPU-parallelized simulation to approximate linear deformable behaviors and achieves higher success rates and 2x reduction in cycle times compared to prior state-of-the-art learning methods.

2607.04617.tldr: This work proposes an architectural memory substrate organized along two orthogonal axes: a representational axis spanning structured records, vector representations, and graph relations; and a temporal axis spanning short-term traces, medium-term abstractions, and long-term semantic commitments.

2607.04625.tldr: HIEVI-RAG is introduced, a hierarchical, evidence-driven multimodal RAG framework for closed-domain document understanding that significantly outperforms existing open-source baselines and exceeds the strongest reported baseline by an average of 8.05% in accuracy.

2607.04631.tldr: This work proposes Formal Disco: a distributed system for coordination of LLM-based workers that can be easily applied to open-ended synthetic data generation at scale and proposes a principle of maximum entropy for synthetic program generation.

2607.04645.tldr: This work introduces Retroactive Chain-of-Thought (RetroCoT), a single-turn attack that reframes harmful requests as forensic reconstruction tasks and identifies a pronounced generation gap: GPT-5-family models refuse RetroCoT entirely, consistent with explicit coverage of this reconstruction register.

2607.04648.tldr: The Circadian Rhythm Score is proposed, a composite index that compresses multi-domain daily behaviors into a unified representation of circadian rhythm and an interpretable depression screening framework based on gradient-boosted trees and SHAP analysis is developed, revealing nonlinear and saturation-like associations between circadian rhythm and depression risk.

2607.04661.tldr: This work proposes FocusGS, a simple yet effective framework that shifts the paradigm from global densification to targeted structural completion, and addresses the localization challenge by deriving a 3D Geometric Ambiguity Manifold to accurately isolate localized areas prone to occlusion and high geometric uncertainty.

2607.04668.tldr: The elastic gang of Anima OS is presented, a bare-metal x86-64 Rust kernel in which the inference gang is a first-class schedulable entity whose core membership may change between any two tokens, the property that makes elasticity safe in a kernel whose safety gate reads logits.

2607.04681.tldr: It is argued that SoTA alignment strategies offer a necessary but insufficient notion of faithfulness, and a behavioral surrogate for embodied faithfulness is operationalized through a learned critic, Pinocchio, and used as a dense reward signal in post-training an embodied policy with reinforcement learning, suggesting that faithful reasoning traces contribute to more robust, generalizable, and interpretable embodied intelligence.

2607.04686.tldr: ToolFailBench is introduced, a diagnostic benchmark for measuring tool-use failures across 1,000 tasks in finance, medicine, law, cybersecurity, and real estate, showing that faithful tool use is not saturated.

2607.04688.tldr: The URSA (Utilitarian RetroSynthesis Assessment) evaluation framework is introduced that provides the opportunity to benchmark the synthetic routes not only from a formal perspective, such as convergence to commercially available starting materials, but also from a chemical plausibility perspective, mimicking the way expert chemists evaluate the reactions and routes.

2607.04708.tldr: Results suggest language models are better suited to selecting among regimes and calibration samples than to making buy-or-wait decisions directly, according to making buy-or-wait decisions directly.

2607.04710.tldr: The results suggest that altruistic preferences encourage agents to contribute to the public goods, and fairness preferences induce mutual behavior between agents.

2607.04713.tldr: Reinforcement learning holds significant potential for training large language models to handle multi-turn interactive tasks, but directly training with outcome rewards often results in slow convergence due to the sparsity of signals and the lack of fine-grained feedback.

2607.04714.tldr: Geometry-Aware Motion Latents is introduced, which learns discrete motion latent codes by predicting how point clouds evolve during manipulation rather than reconstructing visual observations, demonstrating that effective motion latents for robot control can better emerge from understanding motion through its three-dimensional effects rather than pixel-level patterns.

2607.04718.tldr: This work presents FORGE (Fabricated Orchestrated Reasoning chain for aGent Exploitation), a two-level attack that combines intra-document reasoning fabrication with inter-document chain coordination to hijack subtask planning.

2607.04727.tldr: An automated evaluation framework tailored to dashboards is proposed that combines code semantic analysis with dynamic interaction-based testing to assess visual and interaction consistency, showing strong agreement with human judgments.

2607.04728.tldr: The proposed Selective Importance Sampling (SIS) acts as a plug-in that only modifies the importance ratio in the policy loss, adding negligible wall-clock overhead, and can be combine with a vast vary of RL post-training algorithms.

2607.04729.tldr: RustMizan is introduced, a benchmarking framework for Rust vulnerability analysis that addresses gaps in existing benchmarks and contains compilable code variants at the crate, file, and function levels, with annotations for binary vulnerability detection, CWE classification, and function- and line-level localization.

2607.04738.tldr: It is demonstrated that the stitching method achieves state-of-the-art performance across trajectory inference benchmarks, and unifies several existing methods and leads to a new particle-based method, stitching, that is simulation-free and robust to large gaps between observations.

2607.04750.tldr: FM-ChangeNet is presented, a pathwise-supervised framework for change detection that reformulates bi-temporal reasoning as continuous transport in feature space rather than static endpoint comparison and produces more structured and robust change representations while achieving state-of-the-art performance.

2607.04751.tldr: This work presents Trust Region Policy Distillation (TOP-D), which transforms the notoriously unstable, high-variance On-Policy Distillation (OPD) into a stable training paradigm by dynamically constructing a proximal teacher and establishes a rigorous framework demonstrating that TOP-D inherently controls gradient variance.

2607.04782.tldr: An encoder-based model is proposed that produces set-contextualized card embeddings to encode the draft decision sequence, with a consistent improvement over linear baselines on large-scale real-world data, establishing a first learned benchmark for outcome prediction in MTG Draft.

2607.04786.tldr: MAST is presented, a multi-agent framework that predicts which test cases require maintenance following changes to the production code, and illustrates the potential of multi-agent systems that can fuse multiple information sources when performing software testing tasks.

2607.04814.tldr: Pre-adaptation on related auxiliary languages yields no practically meaningful transfer improvements given minimal target-language data, suggesting that linguistic relatedness alone may not reliably predict cross-lingual transfer gains in large multilingual ASR, or constitute an effective strategy for extending such models to low-resource languages.

2607.04845.tldr: HamQASBench is introduced, a Hamiltonian-informed diagnostic benchmark organizing 11 molecules into five structural tiers via fingerprints derived from the Pauli operator basis, computational basis representation, and ground-state entanglement, complementing energy-based evaluation with per-qubit entanglement analysis and pairwise state fidelity.

2607.04846.tldr: It is shown that imbalanced learning of two conflicting copy tasks promotes in-context learning and improves the selectivity of refusal fine-tuning, suggesting that imbalanced pretraining curricula may be an important tool for promoting disentangled representations, with direct consequences for the precision and reliability of safety fine-tuning.

2607.04848.tldr: SynSFX, a large-scale corpus of 43374 clips spanning 7 popular text-to-audio models spanning 7 popular text-to-audio models, is presented, showing limited generalization to synthetic sound effects.

2607.04854.tldr: Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning (CARL), a novel RL framework designed to strengthen LLMs'intrinsic focus on constraints, is proposed, exhibiting a markedly increased focus on constraints.

2607.04872.tldr: The first event-centric video chain-of-thought framework, dubbed EventCoT, is proposed, which achieves state-of-the-art results on ActivityNet-RTL for reasoning temporal localization while using substantially fewer visual tokens than previous work.

2607.04907.tldr: The architecture and validation of Medi-Gemma, a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for wound pathology triage and workflow automation, are presented, which supports Medi-Gemma as a safer pattern for LLM-based clinical decision support where structured data fidelity, retrieval grounding, and deterministic safeguards are essential.

2607.04912.tldr: An imaging-based 3D spatio-temporal framework for treatment response prediction that integrates a state-of-the-art graph neural network with relational modeling of temporal interactions across timepoints alongside three novel complementary self-supervised treatment trajectory representation learning objectives is proposed.

2607.04921.tldr: This first comprehensive evaluation of SNNs for real-world automotive multi-object detection and tracking shows that SNNs can deliver high-performance object detection and tracking in an energy efficient manner, establishing their viability for perception in real-world autonomous systems.

2607.04926.tldr: The central claim is the two-factor account of few-shot binding, the endpoint and anatomy results are diagnostic constraints; the endpoint and anatomy results are diagnostic constraints.

2607.04927.tldr: DSWAM is introduced, a Dual-System World Action Foundation Model for fine-grained robot manipulation and built and evaluated under the DeMaVLA real-world deformable manipulation setting with matched robot platform, pretraining data, post-training data, and evaluation criteria.

2607.04930.tldr: This paper rethink category-level pose estimation from a memory-centric perspective and presents MemPose, a memory-augmented framework that explicitly incorporates category-level geometric memory into the pose estimation pipeline.

2607.04972.tldr: The Hypergraphic Open-ended Learning Algorithm (HOLA), which progressively expands partner and environment diversity during training rather than optimizing for fixed configurations, outperforms all baselines across all three adaptability dimensions.

2607.04993.tldr: This paper studies fixed-step gradient descent as a discrete dynamical system in a hierarchy of exactly solvable models retaining basic structures of deep learning: depth, factorization, width, data coupling, activation, and stochasticity.

2607.05007.tldr: This work indicates that quantum-inspired methods may offer a useful framework for modeling complex decision processes in creative domains such as music, and suggests that harmonic generation can be interpreted as a structured decision-making process in a constrained search space.

2607.05008.tldr: This study represents the first investigation of techniques for handling partially-labelled data from multiple different domains in echocardiography segmentation and provides a comprehensive comparison of loss-based solutions.

2607.05009.tldr: ImputeECG, a mask-conditioned one-dimensional Transformer autoencoder that completes 12-lead, 10-s ECGs while retaining all observed samples, supports ECG completion as a practical strategy for converting incomplete ECG records into AI-ready 12-lead, 10-s digital signals and extending the usable scope of ECG archives for digital cardiac assessment.

2607.05017.tldr: A transfer parameterization is developed and validated for GNNs trained with SGD, Adam, and AdamW that yields stable feature updates, learning rate transfer, and improved performance as width and depth increase, and provides a practical recipe for scaling GNNs across a variety of learning tasks and training scenarios.

2607.05029.tldr: This work demonstrates the need to protect not only an agent's retrieved content but also the integrity of its reasoning history, as the Forged Amplifying Rationale Memory Attack (FARMA) poisons an agent's remembered reasoning rather than its factual knowledge.

2607.05031.tldr: A systematic literature review of large language models used to produce test oracles, reporting how these oracles are evaluated and how they fail, and read the sparse and empty regions of the taxonomy as a research agenda.

2607.05035.tldr: RUFNet is proposed, a Hybrid Mamba-based few-shot framework that combines support mask refinement with uncertainty-aware posterior fusion and adaptively balances few-shot predictions with query-aligned priors to improve the robustness of few-shot medical image segmentation.

2607.05052.tldr: It is shown that supplying the continuum at inference shifts behavior but does not match supervised structured prediction, and theory-aware decoding thus offers a lightweight, controllable way to make value detection faithful to its label space.

2607.05055.tldr: Findings show that carefully scoped and rigorously safeguarded LLM-based agents can reliably automate complex healthcare operational workflows while maintaining safety guarantees and achieving substantial cost efficiency.

2607.05064.tldr: This paper theoretically proves the existence of the existence of a discrepancy between delayed state and true states induced by stochastic MDP, and proposes DUPO, which explicitly models the relationship between delayed state message and the current state using a diffusion model, and leverages the resulting discrepancy estimates to weight delayed policies.

2607.05100.tldr: AIFS-SUBS is ECMWF's first machine-learning model targeted at sub-seasonal time-scales, and uses about 200 times less energy than the IFS, opening the door to much larger real-time ensembles.

2607.05104.tldr: A publicly released ~11,856-parameter Llama-style Llama-style transformer on modular arithmetic is studied, small enough to enumerate its weights, attention, and full input-output map, and grokking is measured as a multi-seed rate rather than a single outcome.

2607.05114.tldr: Localized LoRA-MoE is introduced, a unified framework that fuses localized spatial blocking with dynamic, context-conditioned routing, and decentralized cell-level gating achieves complete statistical parity with an omniscient global coordinator, providing a robust"gradient firewall" that protects surviving pathways from fault-propagated corruption.

2607.05120.tldr: A new category of IPI, agent data injection attacks (ADI), which exposes a critical gap in agent security, signifying that current AI agents do not employ a fundamental security principle: current agents do not isolate trusted data from untrusted data.

2607.05123.tldr: AssemCAD is presented, an axiom-grounded framework for production-ready CAD assembly generation from natural language that extends Text-to-CAD from isolated part generation toward production-ready mechanical assembly design.

2607.05125.tldr: An exploratory evaluation of how increasing levels of AI autonomy affect software development productivity, requirement adherence, and developer cognitive workload suggests that tooling architecture may influence outcomes independently of AI autonomy level.

2607.05131.tldr: This paper proposes TacReasoner, a dynamic tactile-language framework for interactive reasoning in real-world scenarios that incorporates a Dynamic-aware Tactile Encoder and introduces TouchCoT-10k, the first tactile chain-of-thought dataset for structured reasoning over tactile inputs.

2607.05134.tldr: PDEFlow is an autonomous agentic framework that turns user-level ODE and PDE descriptions into solver-backed neural-operator pipelines, designed for repeatable scientific and engineering workflows where many related physics configurations must be specified, simulated, learned, and queried with minimal manual intervention.

2607.05147.tldr: DSpark is introduced, a speculative decoding framework that unifies high-throughput parallel generation with adaptive, load-aware verification, and enables performance tiers that were previously unattainable, shifting the Pareto frontier of the DeepSeek-V4 serving system.

2607.05163.tldr: Examination of existing frameworks related to AI incident governance by regulatory bodies and independent efforts finds that while there are frameworks that describe how individual functions can be performed, there is a lack of consistency within the aspects of definitions, classification, monitoring, and reporting.

2607.05168.tldr: It is argued that the future of symbolic methods lies not primarily as the computational engine of intelligent systems, but as the symbolic interface between increasingly capable AI systems and the humans who build, govern, and depend upon them.

2607.05174.tldr: AgentGym2 is presented, a new evaluation framework with task instances grounded in real-world end-to-end working demands that measures agents'ability to execute end-to-end procedures, discover tools via exploration, compose tools for unseen tasks, and remain robust to noisy and underspecified information.

2607.05177.tldr: CP-WSP is presented: a declarative CP-SAT framework enforcing 14 hard constraints as mathematically inviolable requirements (zero regulatory violations by construction) while optimizing 15 soft objectives through a unified weighted penalty function -- all configurable via a JSON specification with no code changes required.

2607.05179.tldr: Experimental results in a rail pricing reinforcement learning environment show that this novel framework achieves higher revenue and stability in two different settings of increasing market complexity compared to a representative selection of relational and non-relational baselines.

2607.05184.tldr: It is shown that privileged self-distillation degrades thinking models on long reasoning traces: across five Qwen3 and OLMo thinking models evaluated on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, privileged-context distillation causes a relative drop in accuracy, indicating that self-distillation for strong thinking models requires attention to token-level signal, especially around correction and reasoning steps.

2607.05185.tldr: ClassicLogic, a new benchmark suite designed to evaluate an agent's ability to learn and compose problem-solving strategies, is introduced, providing a challenging new testbed for advancing neuro-symbolic and other advanced AI reasoning systems.

2607.05189.tldr: Results suggest that persistent memory can turn ordinary external processing into a practical pathway for long-term agent compromise.

2607.05198.tldr: A noisy channel decomposition of MBR decoding that naturally incorporates bidirectional effects to account for asymmetries, which provides a unified interpretation of existing MBR variants and enables metric- and task-specific interpretability by isolating the contribution of each channel.

2607.05199.tldr: This work proposes a step-level reward framework that identifies the first reasoning error, generates targeted structured feedback, and trains the model to revise its solution via policy gradient with KL regularization, without exposing it to ground truth solutions as generation targets.

2607.05202.tldr: EvoAgentBench is introduced, a benchmark for agent self-evolution via Ability-guided transfer across four agentic domains: web research, algorithmic reasoning, software engineering, software engineering, and knowledge work, which shifts self-evolution evaluation from aggregate accuracy comparison to fine-grained diagnosis of experience encoding, routing, and uptake.

2607.05240.tldr: An Integer Linear Programming (ILP)-based workload partitioning framework for heterogeneous CPU-CIM systems that minimizes end-to-end inference latency under RRAM constraints, captures parallelism, and combines empirical profiling with analytical models is proposed.

2607.05242.tldr: This paper designs Platform-level Global Alignment (PGA) to capture cross-shop substitution through global GMV consistency constraints and introduces Redemption-based Decomposition Denoising (RDD), which uses redemption behavior to decompose treated outcomes and reduce attribution noise within an entire-space framework.

2607.05251.tldr: The SecureCROWN framework is built upon secure two-party computation (2PC), and enables a model owner and a data owner to jointly compute certified robustness bounds -- revealing only the final result while provably protecting both parties' private data under the semi-honest security model.

2607.05272.tldr: RL's advantage over engineered heuristics concentrates in combinatorial, multi-resource decisions rather than single-resource temporal scheduling, a practical distinction for deciding where learned policies justify their engineering cost in production inference infrastructure.

2607.05276.tldr: ProPS, Prompted Profile Synthesis, a framework for generating distributions of speaker embeddings conditioned on natural language prompts, enables controllable speaker-profile synthesis for speech generation systems like Text-To-Speech (TTS) or Voice Conversion (VC) while anchoring generated distributions in observed speaker-embedding structure.

2607.05282.tldr: The proposed WST framework establishes a rigorous, interpretable standard for EEG-driven psychiatric biomarker discovery that can also be applicable in the detection of schizophrenia subtypes in the future.

2607.05292.tldr: A station-guided framework for high-resolution PM downscaling over Europe that recovers fine-grained spatial structures and effectively mitigates localised CAMS biases and introduces a time-agnostic propagation strategy that utilises spatial Gaussian blending of interpolated OpenAQ observations.

2607.05297.tldr: MetaSkill-Evolve is introduced, a two-timescale framework that makes agentic skill improvement recursive and outperforms no-skill, static-skill, and single-level evolution baselines on three agentic benchmarks, improving held-out test accuracy over the raw backbone by +23.54, +16.09, and +1.92 points respectively.

2607.05310.tldr: A rigorous clinical stress test for multimodal model editing that evaluates whether an edit remains reliable, precise, and generalizable under the challenges of image and text variation, modality and protocol shifts, clinical knowledge composition, and temporal progression is introduced.

2607.05319.tldr: To steer optimisation toward stronger representations, SteeringDRL is introduced, combining gated residual U-Nets with a simple noise-level exposure curriculum for training, and across disentanglement benchmarks, SteeringDRL improves representation quality and reduces seed sensitivity.

2607.05339.tldr: TREK (Teacher-Routed Exploration via Forward KL), a simple staged procedure that uses distillation not for imitation but for exploration support expansion, achieves high success rates early in training while unaided GRPO requires substantially more optimization steps to reach comparable levels.

2607.05346.tldr: This work proposes OptiAgent, a multi-agent framework that, given a natural language description of an Operations Research problem, is able to output a solver-ready mathematical formulation as well as executable code, and introduces a novel multi-loop validation architecture with four specialized feedback mechanisms.

2607.05353.tldr: Hierarchical Vocabulary Routing (HeRo) is proposed, a watermarking framework that enables selective disclosure of embedded metadata and preserves the unbiasedness of the underlying sampling process and thus maintains text quality.

2607.05359.tldr: Graph Sparse Sampling (GSS), an online planning algorithm that shares sampled futures across many candidate decisions, rather than sampling separate successors for each candidate action, is proposed, supporting no-branching graph planning as a complementary design principle for online control.

2607.05363.tldr: SovereignPA-Bench is introduced, an executable benchmark for evaluating user-owned personal agents under evolving intent, platform mediation, privacy boundaries, consent constraints, evidence requirements, and burden tradeoffs, and results show that personal-agent evaluation must move beyond task completion toward representative, consent-aware, evidence-grounded action.

2607.05365.tldr: SPEARBench is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating naturalness in speech-to-speech language models from question-answer interactions that shows that current models can achieve high signal-level quality and low ASR error while still differing from human conversational behavior in latency, overlap, dialect preservation, emotional adaptation, and interpersonal stance dynamics.

2607.05369.tldr: Graph-as-Policy (GaP) is introduced, a multi-agent coding harness that generates directed computation graphs with perception, planning, and control nodes from a Modular Open Robot Skill Library (MORSL), and can achieve success rates that significantly outperform baselines.

2607.05377.tldr: Cortex is introduced, a bidirectionally aligned embodied agent framework with a customized planning interface that conveys executable and tractable subtask plans from high-level VLM to low-level VLA and enables zero-shot completion of unseen real-world long-horizon tasks.

2607.05381.tldr: This framework identifies which law each loss in the literature actually optimizes, recovering MDM, UDM, SEDD, and GIDD as special cases; explains why denoiser and cavity coincide for masked diffusion but not for uniform diffusion; proves that a denoiser parameterization makes the uniform ELBO diverge at initialization while the bridge plug-in stays finite; and calibrates ELBO implementations exactly at initialization.

2607.05393.tldr: The results show that injection-driven, weakly supervised training can enable scalable and consistent Real-Bogus classification without human-labeled training data while providing calibrated uncertainties, and achieves competitive calibration relative to more expensive ensemble baselines.

2607.05396.tldr: Camera-Centric VLA (CamVLA), a new VLA model that decouples manipulation controls from camera geometry by predicting a camera-centric end-effector action expressed in the local camera frame, and a 6-DoF hand-eye matrix relating cameras to the robot base.

2508.12393.tldr: MedKGent is introduced, a LLM agent framework for constructing temporally evolving medical KGs that demonstrates the KG's value in literature-based drug repurposing via confidence-aware causal inference and evaluates downstream utility.

2504.18471.tldr: This work introduces a generative framework leveraging flow matching for online robot dynamics model alignment and finds that by transforming the actions themselves rather than exploring with a misaligned model -- as is traditionally done -- the robot collects informative data more efficiently, thereby accelerating learning.

2502.07280.tldr: This study introduces a new framework utilizing the Memory Instance Gated Transformer (MIGT) for effective portfolio management that aims to maximize investment returns while ensuring the learning process's stability and reducing outlier impacts.

2501.08951.tldr: Examining the ethical reasoning of six prominent generative large language models reveals that LLMs exhibit largely convergent ethical logic, marked by a rationalist, consequentialist emphasis, with decisions often prioritizing harm minimization and fairness.

2012.05213.tldr: It is shown that the problem of identifying project bundles that maximize voter satisfaction while respecting all budget limits is generally intractable and efficient exact algorithms are described for several special cases, including instances with only few groups and instances where the group structure is close to being hierarchical.

2604.00024.tldr: The Women's Health Benchmark is presented, a targeted evaluation suite of 47 expert-crafted scenarios designed to expose clinically meaningful failure modes including outdated guidelines, unsafe omissions, dosing errors, and equity-related blind spots, to track safer and more equitable progress in womens health AI.

2509.09873.tldr: This study presents the first end-to-end audit of licenses for datasets and models on Hugging Face, as well as their downstream integration into open-source software applications, and prototype an extensible rule engine that encodes almost 200 SPDX and model-specific clauses for detecting license conflicts.

2507.01551.tldr: This work proposes SPRO, a novel framework that enables process-aware RL through two key innovations: it first theoretically demonstrate that process rewards can be derived intrinsically from the policy model itself, and it introduces well-defined cumulative process rewards and MSA, which facilitates rigorous step-wise action advantage estimation within shared-prompt sampling groups.

2410.19738.tldr: This proceedings contains abstracts and position papers for the work to be presented at the fourth Logic and Practice of Programming (LPOP) Workshop, which is integrating reasoning systems for trustworthy AI.

2408.02295.tldr: A novel framework for generalized Gaussian error modeling in deep reinforcement learning is introduced to enhance the flexibility of error distribution modeling by incorporating additional higher-order moment, particularly kurtosis, thereby improving the estimation and mitigation of data-dependent aleatoric uncertainty.

2508.10017.tldr: This study provides a practical methodological blueprint for creating effective, secure, and accurate diagnostic tools that can be applied to real-world, heterogeneous healthcare data.

2503.04143.tldr: This framework utilizes a novel encoder-attention mechanism to address the limitations by incorporating temporal market characteristics, a parallel strategy for automated short-selling based on market trends, and risk management through innovative Incremental Conditional Value at Risk, enhancing adaptability and performance.

2505.19212.tldr: Moral Behavior in Social Dilemma Simulation (MoralSim) is introduced and how LLMs behave in the prisoner's dilemma and public goods game with morally charged contexts is evaluated, showing substantial variation across models in both their general tendency to act morally and the consistency of their behavior across game types.

2605.08971.tldr: An end-to-end model is developed that reconstructs CAD models from point clouds and introduces a segmentation approach that decomposes them into individual extrusions, improving the generalization and robustness of deep learning models.

2607.21601.tldr: This paper analyzes 8 engineering repair records from a scenic-area interactive kiosk project, covering 4 gesture tasks: two-hand bowing, single-hand fist shaking, two-hand catching control, and knowledge-graph node hovering, and separates working failure classes into six non-exclusive working failure classes.

2607.21599.tldr: Decoupled Attention Fusion (DAF) is proposed, a framework that maintains high accuracy while significantly reducing recomputation overhead, and is natively compatible with Flash-Attention kernels, maximizing hardware utilization without requiring complex attention masks.

2607.21186.tldr: A systematic study of the effectiveness of a Hybrid Quantum-inspired Convolutional Neural Network (HQiCNN) compared with a parameter-matched classical Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that differs only in an intermediate dense neural layer is presented.

2607.20577.tldr: A novel deep learning surrogate pipeline based on the Swin3D Transformer is introduced to predict spatiotemporal discharge dynamics directly from volumetric data, providing a scalable and efficient framework for high-throughput battery design and optimization.

2607.21600.tldr: FlowGuard is a lightweight inference-time framework that detects harmful inputs by monitoring internal multimodal consistency and derives FlowVectors inspired by Partial Information Decomposition that quantify cross-modal redundancy, synergy, and modality-specific dominance, capturing whether fused multimodal predictions remain aligned with unimodal semantic evidence.

2607.21598.tldr: This paper proposes a visual control panel interface that would provide more cues to the semantics of prompt formation, enabling users to more easily express their intent.

2607.21596.tldr: Experiments on benchmarks spanning interactive environments (ALFWorld) and code/math generation (HumanEval, GSM8K) show that FlowEvo achieves the best accuracy-cost tradeoff among the evaluated baselines under the authors' implementation settings.

2607.21645.tldr: This work treats lambda, the weight on multi-step latent agreement, as a diagnostic control and measures an empirical expansion proxy L20,q95 together with horizon-20 prediction error E20 to support a narrow claim: soft consistency can push passive video toward a near-contractive band, and that band is domain-limited.

2607.21619.tldr: Adversarial Style Optimization (ASO) is proposed, a plug-and-play enhancement module to amplify existing visual jailbreaks and demonstrate that stylistic biases are a scalable vector for red-teaming MLLMs.

2607.21610.tldr: This work introduces SCOPE (Schema Construction and Ontology-induction Pipeline Evaluation), a train-text-only benchmark for corpus-to-schema induction and optional schema fusion from raw text, built from 24 public information extraction sources normalized into evaluation-only gold schema graphs.

2607.21757.tldr: It is argued that participation and process transparency can act as an"overtrust engine" that promotes trust while concealing systematic misalignment with potential structural consequences at scale.

2607.21716.tldr: This work stress test the simplest possible model of optimization -- the quadratic model -- and shows that it can be surprisingly predictive in an LLM setting with 150M parameters and 3B training tokens, and indicates the quadratic model may be a theoretically tractable proxy for pretraining optimization dynamics.

2607.21673.tldr: It is proved that a certified admission gate, reading only a frozen reserve, severs the feedback loop and removes the transition at every contamination rate, even adversarially, while controlling false positives label-free in test-time adaptive out-of-distribution OOD detectors.

2607.21660.tldr: A materials property hierarchy is introduced, from intrinsic, composition-determined properties to extrinsic, processing-dependent performance, to clarify deployment constraints and distinguish structural, physical and deployment novelty.

2607.21647.tldr: DUQFL-Prox is proposed, a drift-stable quantum federated learning framework based on deep-unfolded local optimization that improves stability, generalization, and client fairness compared with standard QFL baselines and is suggested to support more reliable and fair intelligent services in heterogeneous distributed environments.

2607.21628.tldr: Wavelet Phase Diffusion is introduced, which addresses wavelet phase injection in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain, whose localized wavelet packets enable spatially adaptive phase injection without global spectral interference.

2607.21615.tldr: This work proposes a novel probabilistic framework that operates entirely in a black-box setting, operating entirely without internal model access, and provides an efficient, interpretable mechanism for post-hoc influence analysis and domain-grounded retrieval.

2607.21614.tldr: An AI-enhanced framework for detecting indirect entity links associated with household movement in unstandardized name–address data is proposed, which integrates prompt-based large language model (LLM) named entity recognition for extracting personal names and addresses without extensive preprocessing, semantic text embeddings for robust similarity computation, and graph-based reasoning to infer group-level movement patterns.

2607.21612.tldr: It is established that for procedural tasks LoRA falls well short of full fine-tuning--a fundamental limitation for agentic applications.

2607.21780.tldr: Khondo establishes page-order reconstruction as a key open problem in vision-based, low-resource document understanding, and provides a controlled benchmark for measuring progress toward solving it.

2607.21604.tldr: Across four open-source LLMs spanning 3B to 32B parameters and two long-horizon agentic memory benchmarks, AgentKVShift achieves near full recompute performance while refreshing only 10-30% of the cache, outperforming baselines at the same recompute ratio.

2607.21774.tldr: This work connects activation-level interpretability with bias evaluation for underrepresented Spanish varieties and uses Natural Language Autoencoders to verbalize residual-stream activations from layer 20 across four positional quartiles per prompt.

2607.21735.tldr: This work defines the evidential ceiling of an evaluation as the largest factor by which one result can move belief under a fixed testing budget, derive it in closed form for the benchmark null result, and uses it to locate that boundary exactly.

2607.21686.tldr: Persistent Computational State (PCS), the minimal non-recomputable state that must survive across requests, is defined, show it can be discovered by measurement, and build a session-centric runtime over it.

2607.21641.tldr: The results show that integrating lightweight analysis tools can improve the safety of LLM-generated code for embedded development by integrating compilation diagnostics, CodeQL static analysis, and KLEE symbolic execution with retrieval of prior repair patterns for iterative refinement.

2607.21633.tldr: These results demonstrate that scalable depth in LGNs requires both stable optimization and an information-access pattern that supports input-conditioned refinement, and introduce Input-Anchored Logic Gate Networks (IALGNs), in which each gate combines an evolving hidden feature with a direct input anchor.

2607.21624.tldr: This work proposes FBLayout, a layout-aware framework that co-designs tensor organization with mobile GPU platforms and introduces a unified R-Tile layout for multidimensional reductions across forward/backward passes, enabling practical on-device large model fine-tuning.

2607.21618.tldr: LeafData is presented, an agentic system that converts user intent into validated and executable JSON configuration for data migration, enabling end-to-end pipeline generation and execution without manual coding.

2607.21617.tldr: It is shown VLMs do not always act as faithful transcribers: when text is imperfect, they often tend to rewrite it into a more plausible form - a behavior that clean-text OCR benchmarks cannot detect.

2607.21609.tldr: HierFlow is introduced, a training-free, test-time hierarchical search architecture that automates agentic workflow design by merging feedback-guided topology adjustments with a fast, MCTS-inspired tree search for sub-workflow optimization and maximizes efficiency through an intelligent gating module.

2607.21608.tldr: Assessment of organizational preparedness for EU AI Act-oriented RE and perceptions of LLM-based, agentic closed-loop validation tools suggest structured mechanisms to capture regulatory obligations, propagate updates into projects, and maintain lifecycle-wide traceability and evidence are often missing.

2607.21603.tldr: Examination of collaborative interaction among middle school students engaged in the design and development of an AI chatbot reveals that higher-quality chatbots are associated with more integrated sequences linking explanation, testing, and refinement.

2607.21793.tldr: Quadrant-weighted Sampling for Length-aware Policy Optimization (QLPO), a simple resampling-based variant of GRPO that introduces implicit length control without modifying the reward function, suggests that structured resampling provides an effective and robust approach to efficient reasoning.

2607.21785.tldr: This research validates that the integration of semantic news signals allows for the detection of social tension peaks not captured by historical inertia, providing a technical tool for risk management in critical transport corridors.

2607.21781.tldr: MosaicJoin achieves scalability through a novel sketching strategy that approximates the joinability of a column pair without having to compare all values, and scales robustly to query columns containing up to 57K values and data lake columns containing up to 1M values.

2607.21779.tldr: A robust, graph-theoretic molecular fragmentation framework integrated with machine learning to directly model post-Hartree-Fock nuclear forces at coupled cluster accuracy, laying the foundation for advanced, LLM-inspired transfer learning in modern chemical dynamics simulations.

2607.21777.tldr: It is argued that every AI instrument in science education should carry a distinct reflection point that prompts critical evaluation of the AI instrument itself, and how agentic AI, operating across the whole inquiry rather than a single practice, could be represented.

2607.21670.tldr: This work introduces Ordered Action Tokenization (OAT), a learned action tokenizer that satisfies three desiderata for action tokenization - high compression, total decodability, and an ordered token space - and introduces OAT, a learned action tokenizer that satisfies all three.

2607.21636.tldr: A dependency-aware fidelity diagnostic is introduced that decomposes a strong classifier two-sample test into marginal, dependency, and numerical-categorical cross components, anchored between a worst-case fully-factorized reference (all dependency destroyed) and a best-case real-data oracle.

2607.21627.tldr: Role Anchor is proposed, a regularizer that modulates how much each module deviates from its assigned role during end-to-end training to preserve how the role prompt shifts the module's next-token predictions relative to a neutral prompt, which serves as a proxy for the role's intended effect during training.

2607.21622.tldr: It is proved that two canonical local synaptic learning rules, the potentiation arm of spike-timing-dependent plasticity and homeostatic plasticity and homeostatic plasticity together can implement the exact gradient of a SIGReg-like self-supervised learning objective.

2607.21620.tldr: GLASS is a training-free framework for personalized generation via Global-Local Activation Steering with Sparse priors that outperforms retrieval, fine-tuning, and steering-based baselines across ROUGE metrics and LLM-as-judge evaluations.

2607.21613.tldr: This work identifies the _Hard Decision Layer_ (HDL), a natural architectural property where answer option rankings stabilize abruptly during inference, and shows that the HDL is invariant to fine-tuning.

2607.21611.tldr: This systematic survey examines 20 peer-reviewed studies on AI-based techniques for describing STEM visuals, with a specific focus on accessibility and human-computer interaction and reveals a shift from static, one-shot alt text toward interactive and multimodal systems that integrate conversational interfaces, keyboard navigation, and audio or haptic feedback.

2607.21602.tldr: It is shown that runtime-aware prediction with lightweight calibration can reduce profiling cost and support latency-aware LLM deployment across heterogeneous edge platforms and shows that latency is highly device- and runtime-dependent.

2607.21677.tldr: This paper shows how to enhance SLMs through the use of agentic AI, and extends the SLMs in two ways to improve code generation quality and performance: first with a multi-sampling generation strategy and second with incorporating compiler feedback.

2607.21672.tldr: This study measures black-box request accounting for one compact rendering pipeline, and does not measure semantic fidelity, task accuracy, latency, monetary cost, or coding-agent efficiency.

2607.21659.tldr: This paper defines AI-nativeness along a single axis---authority over the system's own decisions rather than by the capability of the underlying AI models to define a system as AI-native when an AI autonomously rewrites the system's own implementations.

2607.21656.tldr: Evaluation of the pairing of Claude and Codex indicates that the useful pairing is asymmetric: use Claude to review Codex, not the other way around.

2607.21634.tldr: MotifRole-Diff is introduced, a role-aware corruption process that allocates masking rates according to empirically measured denoising difficulty and graph-level perturbation impact while preserving the model architecture, clean sequence space, and lossless molecular-graph decoder.

2607.21626.tldr: It is found that when the action interface is replaced by a 5-way categorical choice over PID presets, training converges, and the resulting controller traces a smoothness-reliability Pareto frontier along training duration.

2607.21625.tldr: This work introduces TLM (Trajectory Language Model), a closed-loop agentic framework that iteratively refines the evidence set using SHAP-guided feedback and shows that, under a scorer-calibration assumption, the iterative refinement procedure is monotonically non-decreasing in the probability assigned to the correct label.

2607.21616.tldr: It is shown that models can learn alternative strategies for solving long-horizon problems without exhibiting context anxiety, suggesting that performance improvements may be achievable not through scaling model capabilities, but by improving models'ability to accurately assess and adapt to their own limitations.

2607.21607.tldr: Results show that a single eigenvalue computation is sufficient to flag topology-limited graphs before committing to expensive training pipelines, providing a principled first filter for GNN deployments.

2607.21606.tldr: TILT, a training-free framework for compositional text-to-image generation via test-time reward alignment, interprets compositional failures as overlap modes between joint and single-concept distributions, and defines a reward that favors samples where all concepts are jointly present.

2607.21763.tldr: The "solve rate"metric (clean passes only) is introduced to distinguish genuine capability from cheated outcomes, and it is argued it should be standard practice in any evaluation where cheating vectors are available.

2607.21971.tldr: MetaEvolve is presented, a framework designed to develop meta-skills that can transfer broadly to open-ended problems where such rich training signals are scarce, and aims to inspire generalizable domain-agnostic meta-skills that can transfer broadly to open-ended problems where such rich training signals are scarce.

2607.21897.tldr: The proposed ISPCloak is a novel optimization-free adversarial attack framework that explicitly weaponizes the ISP pipeline to mislead the judgment of deepfake detectors, yielding universally evasive adversarial examples with imperceptible visual alterations.

2607.21859.tldr: EviDAG reduces the burden of causal DAG curation while making the resulting assumptions auditable, supporting the design, analysis, and interpretation of biomedical studies.

2607.21850.tldr: This VLM provides rule-aware geometric guidance for local DRV repair, boosting state-of-the-art agents'solve rates by +12--25% on 100 real sub-2nm cases spanning enclosure, spacing, width, and color-spacing violations.

2607.22182.tldr: A multi-layer taxonomy of 14 capability domains and 91 subskills across Primitive, Constructed, and Integrative layers is introduced and supports research organization, coverage audits, evaluation interpretation, and testable hypotheses for diagnosis, training, and transfer.

2607.22165.tldr: DBA-Bench is presented, a benchmark addressing four gaps between evaluation and production operations: live-environment fidelity, outcome-first evaluation, and controlled scenario reproducibility, which uses instrumented PostgreSQL environments with active workloads, persistent state, and multi-source observations.

2607.22143.tldr: This work forms molecular glue design as a ternary complex generation problem and proposes a biology-inspired generative framework, TriGlue, which demonstrates that TriGlue generates chemically valid molecules and produces plausible ternary complexes.

2607.22081.tldr: LFS-FRAME is proposed, a Leakage-Free Stacked ensemble framework that integrates functional learning using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) and rule-based learning via XGBoost and rule-based learning via XGBoost for robust multiclass classification.

2607.22047.tldr: It turns out that for not-too-large coupling strengths there are no qualitative differences between the symmetric case, when the dynamics is a purely gradient evolution, and the asymmetric case, when limit cycles and chaos can, in principle, arise.

2607.22115.tldr: A comprehensive text-to-SQL benchmarking framework with realistic RBAC constraints is presented, which features an LLM-assisted workflow that augments existing text-to-SQL benchmarks with plausible user roles and access policies, and contains evaluation metrics that identify RBAC-specific failure modes, and disentangle SQL utility from access-control compliance.

2607.22014.tldr: This work introduces MissionBench, a benchmark for mission-level evaluation of MLLMs in aerial 3D environments, and shows that mission-level competence requires coordinating multiple capabilities beyond spatial perception, including multi-step planning and adaptive reasoning.

2607.22013.tldr: This study proposes Visual Saliency Steering Distillation, which leverages the attention maps of multimodal large language models to generate perturbed images that capture task-sensitive feature directions, and then applies singular value decomposition to extract dominant steering vectors to guide inter-layer distillation.

2607.22002.tldr: VarIance Guided Online Rollout allocation (VIGOR) is proposed which instead of allocating a fixed rollout budget per example, begins with a small number of rollouts for all examples in a batch and iteratively allocates additional rollouts to those with the highest group reward variance until a fixed total rollout budget is reached.

2607.21985.tldr: SPDP advances the inference efficiency-quality Pareto frontier, showing that unified static-dynamic pruning can deliver substantial throughput and performance-per-watt improvements in large-scale LLM serving.

2607.21970.tldr: TextSLIP is a general medical vision-language pretraining framework that augments CLIP with intra-modal text contrastive learning and indicates that text-level contrastive learning is a promising direction for improving medical visual-textual alignment.

2607.21933.tldr: HexLogicAgent is proposed, a framework that first organizes the meaning of natural-language statements and then guides logical reasoning through structured verification, supported by a logical hexagon theory, which explains why a complete structure of opposing meanings is necessary for reliable reasoning.

2607.21932.tldr: By formalizing the classical conditions for well-posedness within neural operators, this framework demonstrates the theoretical benefits of explicitly conditioning on PDE parameters and boundary conditions and achieves superior generalization across heterogeneous physical regimes while maintaining strict inference efficiency comparable to conventional numerical baselines.

2607.22238.tldr: This study developed PolyBO to improve optimization time by generating high-quality pseudo-experimental data even when the number of trials is limited, which achieves efficient optimization in settings where each experiment requires a long time.

2607.22231.tldr: TRaM-VSR, a Token Routing and Merging framework for adaptive token allocation, leveraging both context-aware video priors and network-level priors accelerates inference significantly while preserving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and robust temporal consistency is proposed.

2607.22205.tldr: This work instantiates FBA for coastal harbor understanding, a representative multi-source scenario, by constructing CPRS (Coastal-Port Remote Sensing), a three-layer supervision dataset coupled with three ordered stages: domain-bridge convergence for shared RS priors across target and bridging scenarios under different modalities, and evidence-grounded scenario tuning for downstream performance.

2607.22157.tldr: It is shown that feedback is a sufficient signal for continual learning when the frozen model is paired with an external memory that distils each episode into retrievable natural-language rules when the frozen model is paired with an external memory.

2607.22153.tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end DiagnosisToken pathway based on vibration-diagnostic outputs, rule-based event aggregation, structured textual token generation, and LLM-based interpretation, and positions Industrial Tokenization as a semantic interface between domain-specific industrial intelligence and LLM- or agent-based reasoning.

2607.22100.tldr: MEUSLI is introduced, the first open-science multilingual projector family that links a Whisper encoder with open-source multilingual LLMs, enabling fully open-source end-to-end ASR in 28 European languages.

2607.22098.tldr: RedE leverages final-answer attention as an automatic supervision signal to shape the step-level representation space, yielding refined embeddings in which noisy steps can be reliably identified and filtered and improves detection performance over competitive baselines.

2607.22075.tldr: FSE, a Fast-Slow Experts enhanced span-based NER model for CLNER that stabilizes learning by promoting knowledge sharing across tasks and maintains plasticity by reducing learning burden at each task is proposed.

2607.22038.tldr: A HW/SW co-designed approach in which a lightweight gating network, trained jointly with the backbone, predicts per-tile binary execution masks conditioned on the task input, resulting in a task-dependent reduction in compute.

2607.21964.tldr: ACME is a large and diverse multi-modal dataset aimed at advancing social navigation research, providing 29.35 hours of onboard robot data and 43.5 hours of overhead pedestrian tracking data that captures more challenging scenarios and a broader distribution of pedestrian behavior than previous datasets.

2607.22186.tldr: The Entropy-Scaled Trust Region (ESTR), which scales each token's off-policy deviation by its local entropy, requiring no auxiliary forward passes or explicit version-switch detection, consistently outperforms existing asynchronous methods and achieves the best train-inference consistency.

2607.22139.tldr: A new benchmark for the assessment of deep learning models which densely classify pixels of coronary angiograms to one of SYNTAX classes (or background), which covers 24 distinct architectures starting with classic convnets to recent state-space-based vision algorithms.

2607.22045.tldr: CEL (Counterfactual Explanations Library), a unified library and benchmark for counterfactual explanations designed to support consistent implementation and evaluation, is introduced, believed to be the first comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates recent counterfactual explanation methods within a unified and reproducible framework.

2607.22024.tldr: This work operationalizes contextual security through four properties that must hold jointly and be evaluated continuously across the agent's trajectory, which changes which defenses are coherent, which evaluations measure something useful, and which attack patterns evaluation can see at all.

2607.22016.tldr: An enhanced vision-language multi-CoT (EVL-MCoT) approach, which incorporates visual prototypes to guide the fusion process and enables the model to align textual and visual information more precisely, achieves promising results on the HatefulMemes and MultiOff datasets.

2607.22009.tldr: A honeypot/decoy placement model based on the principle of minimising the number of shortest paths and the number of Domain Admin-reachable nodes is proposed and an end-to-end adaptive prioritisation model that minimises the approval effort of the system admin is introduced.

2607.21999.tldr: Sharpness-Guided Equilibrium Sampling (SGS) is introduced, which treats the sampling distribution as an active control variable for optimization geometry and establishes a sampling-side route to loss-landscape control, suggesting that future long-tailed methods can jointly regulate data exposure and optimization geometry rather than treating either as fixed.

2607.21981.tldr: Under matched backbone and inference settings, J-CoT-Zero matches or exceeds the strongest evaluated latent-reasoning baseline on every benchmark, while J-CoT-Train obtains the highest score across the evaluated mathematical, scientific, coding, and structured path-reasoning tasks.

2607.21949.tldr: MA-DAR (Manifold-Aligned Dynamic Adaptive Routing), a lightweight plug-and-play framework for replay representation fusion, is proposed, demonstrating that MA-DAR consistently improves the performance of representative TKG encoders while remaining effective under different replay settings.

2607.21873.tldr: This systematic review explores the intersection between Multi-Agent Systems and Digital Twins, with a particular focus on predictive maintenance applications in resource-constrained contexts and reveals that, despite significant progress, no existing system offers an integrated embedded-distributed hierarchical solution that simultaneously meets the requirements of Industry 5.0.

2607.21867.tldr: An adapter necessity audit is introduced that separates global operating-point gain, same-state counterfactual headroom, deployment gain over a cross-fitted fixed action, and state-allocation gain over a frequency-matched randomized policy.

2607.21861.tldr: It is found that once adapter capacity is adequate, training-data quality is the dominant lever on closed-book accuracy, outweighing LoRA rank, learning rate, and two alternative architectures combined; capacity itself is a hard gate below which no data intervention helps.

2607.21820.tldr: The Identity Sensitivity Score (ISS), a per-utterance diagnostic that quantifies how much a detector's output changes across different speaker identity contexts, is proposed and positioned as a practical inference-time diagnostic for speaker-dependent failure analysis in audio deepfake detection.

2607.22166.tldr: ImiPath is a prior-guided learning framework that distills reusable spatiotemporal decision priors from demonstration trajectories and uses them as experience-informed directional guidance to bias planners toward reliable and promising search directions under partial observability.

2607.22148.tldr: This work proposes Hyper-Spherical Quantization (HSQ), which decouples semantic content from feature magnitude via angular routing, preventing code assignment from being dominated by scale rather than meaning.

2607.22119.tldr: DynaMAC treats the opposite arm as a dynamic task parameter, thereby providing a unified formulation for dynamic manipulation and bimanual coordination without requiring an explicit leader-follower relationship, and substantially simplifying data collection and establishing an elegant bridge toward human-robot collaboration.

2607.21914.tldr: An interventional response field supplied by structural information is introduced, defining causal influence $X_k\rightsquigarrow X_j$ as variation of the interventional marginal distribution of $X_j$ with $\xi$ and showing that the corresponding derivative of the marginal interventional score gives a local sufficient condition for influence.

2607.21910.tldr: TheTRACE-RealWorld is a commitment-level validity abstraction for materialized predictions; consequence-conditioned adaptive view maintenance; transaction-style, dependency-scoped compensation for commitments invalidated after authorization; and append-only provenance supporting exact replay.

2607.21856.tldr: The approach, LeAct (Learning to reason from Actions), optimizes this latent variable: the student samples candidate CoTs for each expert action, and the student retains those that measurably improve its own probability of recovering the action.

2607.21835.tldr: This paper presents ToolGuardian, a policy-driven framework for securing agent-tool interactions through pre-admission vetting and task-aware runtime authorization, and compares ASP against heuristic and LLM-based policy realizations using identical inputs and output contracts.

2607.22511.tldr: CausalForge is presented, a framework for automated theoretical research in causal inference grounded in the Lean proof assistant that combines Causalean, a foundational Lean library for causal inference containing 7,035 machine-checked declarations developed with language-model assistance under human design and review, with CausalSmith, a self-improving agentic pipeline.

2607.22471.tldr: MineValiCoder is proposed, a collaborative closed-loop TDD framework based on the mutual reinforcement of test-case quality and code quality that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in mitigating LLM stochasticity and improving the reliability of automated code generation.

2607.22367.tldr: Attention rollout is used here as a diagnostic of attention-mediated propagation, not as a causal explanation or faithful attribution of the complete Transformer, but as a structural interpretation to the corresponding rollout propagation profile.

2607.22260.tldr: A methodological framework is proposed to support the systematic integration of AI into PLE and evaluate its effectiveness through a multi-case study conducted in an industrial context.

2607.22516.tldr: New light is shed on quantum machine-learning model design by showing how input-conditioned spectral representations can provide an analysable inductive bias, while offering a broader perspective on structure-aware model design in machine learning and artificial intelligence.

2607.22489.tldr: It is shown for the first time that not all LoRA matrices are equally worth tuning: matrices with smaller condition numbers are already well-balanced across directions and contribute only marginally to adaptation, whereas matrices with larger condition numbers contain underdeveloped directions that span richer subspaces and drive most of the performance gains.

2607.22465.tldr: TRACE-Router is presented, a task-level routing framework that aligns routing with the unit of supervision, and learns routing policies that adapt to the workload while avoiding explicit task-complexity estimation.

2607.22463.tldr: It is argued that trio-ethnography offers a valuable reflective approach for helping computing educators move beyond observable student behaviors toward a richer understanding of AI-supported learning and for informing instructional adaptation in the era of generative AI.

2607.22444.tldr: An angular effective learning rate is derived that accounts for the parameter-update angle, parameter norm, and update norm, and shows that the conventional norm-based measure is a special case under parameter-update orthogonality.

2607.22428.tldr: It is shown how manipulating specific components of a diffusion pipeline produces relatively consistent families of visual effects allowing artists to build practical layerlevel intuition about how different parts of the model shape generated images.

2607.22393.tldr: This work presents SceneActBench, a benchmark for visually conditioned action across five 3D tasks under a unified agent-environment loop, and evaluates each final output against hidden ground truth with task-specific geometric metrics.

2607.22389.tldr: HiKV is a novel algorithm-hardware co-design that exploits KV cache redundancy through hierarchical importance awareness and outperforms state-of-the-art importance-based methods by achieving an additional 1.87x reduction in external memory accesses.

2607.22385.tldr: AgentRCA is introduced, a zero-shot agentic framework for evidence-grounded root cause analysis that produces transparent reasoning traces that explicitly link observed symptoms to their underlying physical causes and establishes autonomous hypothesis-driven reasoning as a practical foundation for scalable industrial root cause analysis.

2607.22355.tldr: SiPhy, a unified framework for single-image physical property reasoning that aligns 3D-aware visual cues, depth with language-based material knowledge, is introduced, demonstrating its potential as a data annotation engine for physical understanding from single-view imagery.

2607.22319.tldr: This paper envisions trustworthy, scalable, and cost-efficient integration through knowledge-grounded LLMs and agents operating within a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflow, and traces the evolution from classic RAG to GraphRAG and KG-RAG, highlighting how these paradigms bridge parametric and contextual knowledge.
